jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Career Conversion Programme (CCP) (Train-and-Place) for Advanced Biopharmaceuticals Manufacturing Executives/Professionals is a talent development programme aimed at building the next generation of skilled manpower for Singapore’s Biopharmaceuticals manufacturing industry in anticipation of hiring demand. This programme is jointly supported by the Workforce Singapore (WSG) and Workforce Advancement Federation (WAF).

The training programme consists of 15 months of local attachment with Roche.

The Opportunity

• Support the Biochemical Manufacturing Department by working effectively within the group to meet department goals and objectives.

• Responsible for completing assigned tasks which may include preparing small equipment, cleaning and sterilizing vessels, preparing solutions, monitoring and operation biochemical processing equipment, raw materials sampling, dispensing and environmental monitoring sampling and maintain housekeeping of the areas while adhering to Safety, cGMP and Biochemical Manufacturing guidelines.

• Assigned tasks must be prioritized and work must be documented per approved manufacturing formulae.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Operate computers for process control and data entry.

• Participate in staff and shift change meetings and work closely with other shift personnel and external support groups.

• Ensure all assigned tasks are performed as per safety requirement. Report safely incident and near misses on a timely basis and support SHE in incident investigation.

Safety, Health & Environment:

• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.

• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.

Lean Production System:

• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or Engineering, or equivalent qualifications such as a Diploma, NITEC, or similar.

• Experience in biologics is a plus.

• Must possess strong problem-solving abilities, interpersonal communication, and teamwork skills.

Who we are
At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Country Chief Accountant (Japanese/Korean Speaker)
jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be:

• Co-ordinate with SSC KL Finance teams (AP, GAMA, AR, TR, T&E, Compliance and Procurement) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with month-end close checklist.

• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, accountable for the financial accuracy of the affiliate’s Financials. Responsible of all Internal Controls of Financial Reporting (ICFR) documentation and internal controls matters, act as owner for the ICFR tools – INVOLVE and BWISE

• Review monthly balance sheet reconciliation – follow up on open items and rectify any anomalies encountered. Submission other reporting packages accurately and within specified timeline i.e. Sustainability, Insurance reporting. Responsible of IFRS 16 Leasing related matters i.e SimSol /Planon . Review and provide approval for all manual journal entries for posting by SSC KL team. Responsible for all management accounting aspects i.e. Period cost allocation, COPA allocation, SSC allocation, etc

• Accounts Receivables / Accounts Payables : Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Receivables – review and approve manual billings, review debtors ageing and determine follow up actions, ensure all sales related activities are reported timely and accurate. Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Payables – review and provide approval of AP related activities i.e. vendor invoices, payment, etc.

• Treasury : Cash flow management - forecast current and future cash flow requirement and arrangement for necessary fund transfers (if required). Responsible for all treasury matters i.e. FX deal, credit facilities, payment request, banking matters.

• Master Data : Managing of master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc. Others activities which include : Preparation of statutory taxes calculations and reconciliation, including tax reporting and liaising with Tax Consultant. Preparation of audit related schedules and documentation, including liaising with the Auditor. Participate in any compliance audits and responding to audit queries. Identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation. Being the main contact person for SSC KL Finance teams for issue resolution for all financial matters. Being the main contact person for FM in the affiliates for all financial matters, requests and advisory.

Who you are :

• A degree in Finance/ Accounting/ Commerce or equivalent. ACCA, CPA Australia or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage.

• Minimum 5 years of working experience in related field and minimum 3 years In accountant role / audit experience. Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit and taxation.

• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools. Meticulous, independent, proactive and ability to execute tasks within tight deadlines.

• Strong communication skills, expressing ideas and expectations in a clear and concise manner. Proven track record of effective relationship and stakeholder management with diverse populations (customers, colleagues and senior leaders). Proficiency in influencing skills. Comfortable working in a dynamic, changing and growing environment. The ability to operate effectively across diverse cultural and business environments.Able to commit for business travel when required.

• Proficient in English, Japa

jobs.title: Rechtsreferendar (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wer wir sind
Bei Roche leisten über 94.000 Menschen in mehr als 100 Ländern Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Gemeinsam haben wir uns zu einem weltweit führenden, forschungsorientierten Healthcare-Konzern entwickelt. Unser Erfolg baut auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt. Die Roche Pharma AG an ihrem Standort in Grenzach-Wyhlen steuert zentrale Elemente der technischen Qualitätssicherung für den gesamten europäischen Raum sowie die klinische Forschung, das Marketing und die Vertriebsaktivitäten für den deutschen Markt. Vom ersten Tag an werden Sie bei Roche von einem kollegialen Team aufgenommen und unterstützt. Neben zahlreichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen und einer attraktiven Vergütung erwarten Sie Angebote zum Thema Familie Beruf.

Was Sie erwartet
Ihr Referendariat im Bereich Rechtswissenschaften beinhaltet folgende Themen:

• Unterstützung der Anwälte der Rechtsabteilung bei der umfassenden rechtlichen Beratung der Fachabteilungen

• Bearbeitung verschiedener typischer wirtschafts- und pharmarechtlicher Fragestellungen aus dem Alltag eines Syndikusrechtsanwaltes

• Verhandlungen mit Vertragspartnern und Regelung außergerichtlicher Streitigkeiten

• Kostenlose Unterkunft im Roche Boardinghaus ab einer Entfernung zum Wohnort von mind. 100 km

• Die Möglichkeit aus dem Home Office heraus zu arbeiten

Wer Sie sind
Für Ihr Referendariat im Bereich Rechtswissenschaften bringen Sie folgende Voraussetzungen und Kenntnisse mit:

• Sie sind Referendar (m/w/d) der Rechtswissenschaft

• Die erste juristische Staatsprüfung mit kleinem Prädikat haben Sie bereits erfolgreich bestanden

• Ihre Persönlichkeit zeichnet sich durch Professionalität, Teamfähigkeit, Kreativität und Verhandlungsgeschick aus

• Sie handeln selbständig und eigenverantwortlich und sind aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen und Wege

Referendaren (m/w/d) wird die Absolvierung der Pflichtwahl oder Anwaltsstation (Teilableistung in Wirtschaftsunternehmen bis zu 4 Monaten) geboten.

Für weiterführende Informationen besuchen Sie bitte: https://www.roche.de/about/standorte/grenzach

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche Pharma AG at Grenzach-Wyhlen is steering central elements of the technical quality control for the whole European region. For the German market clinical research, marketing and all sales activities are located there. Grenzach-Wyhlen is the location of Roche Deutschland Holding GmbH. From here, the German Roche Group coordinates the financial activities of the national organization. From your beginning with Roche, our motivated team will welcome and support you. Numerous opportunities for personal development, flexible work hours, attractive compensation packages and special family assistance programs are available.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

In a global, cross-functional environment, the System Development (SD) department within R&D is responsible for workflow optimization and successfully integrating hardware, software, consumables, and reagents to perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments. As a Development Engineer, you will work as a cross-functional team on automating and tooling to maintain and further develop launched complex diagnostic systems.

In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• Elaborating on (Cobots-)Robotics concepts within a laboratory environment towards our vision of a dark lab by fully automating laboratory operations and workflows.

• Programming, testing, and maintaining of newly created and existing automated solutions within our laboratories.

• Supporting our Integration Teams in the installation and troubleshooting of Robotics Solutions within our laboratory environment

• Plan, coordinate, and execute work packages within your area of responsibility, including reporting and escalating topics or issues to the team and management.

• Be able to work as an individual and as part of a team.

Who you are:

• You are graduated with a bachelor's or master preferably in computer science, with specific knowledge in, e.g., robotics and/or vision, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or systems engineering or equivalent.

• Knowledge of professional Software development with one or more programming languages (e.g. UR-Polyscope, Python, C#/NET, LabView)

• You are excited to work as a professional in the medical diagnostics industry.

• Excellent spoken and written command of English (German is advantageous).

• You can communicate appropriately with different target groups.

• You are motivated to build, manage, and foster relationships and networks within the department and the related projects.

• Quick grasp and understanding of complex issues conceptual and creative thinking.

Please note that this vacancy is not currently linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today, and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In un ambiente globale e interfunzionale, il dipartimento System Development (SD) all'interno della R&D è responsabile dell'ottimizzazione del flusso di lavoro e dell'integrazione con successo hardware, software, materiali di consumo e reagenti per eseguire la verifica del sistema degli strumenti diagnostici. Come ingegnere di sviluppo, lavorerai come team interfunzionale per automatizzare e attrezzare per mantenere e sviluppare ulteriormente i sistemi diagnostici complessi. In questa posizione, sarete responsabili delle seguenti aree:
• Elaborazione di concetti (Cobots-)Robotics all'interno di un ambiente di laboratorio verso la nostra visione di un laboratorio oscuro automatizzando completamente le operazioni di laboratorio e i flussi di lavoro.
• Programmazione, collaudo e mantenimento di soluzioni automatizzate nuove e esistenti all'interno dei nostri laboratori.
• Supportare i nostri team di integrazione nell'installazione e nella risoluzione dei problemi di Robotics Solutions all'interno del nostro ambiente di laboratorio
• Pianificare, coordinare ed eseguire pacchetti di lavoro all'interno della vostra area di responsabilità, tra cui la segnalazione e l'escalation di argomenti o problemi al team e alla gestione.
• Essere in grado di lavorare come individuo e come parte di una squadra. Chi sei:
• Siete laureati con uno scapolo o master preferibilmente in informatica, con conoscenze specifiche in, ad esempio, robotica e/o visione, ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica o ingegneria dei sistemi o equivalente.
• Conoscenza dello sviluppo di software professionale con uno o più linguaggi di programmazione (ad esempio UR-Polyscope, Python, C#/NET, LabView)
• Sei entusiasta di lavorare come professionista nel settore della diagnostica medica.
• Ottimo comando parlato e scritto di inglese (il tedesco è vantaggioso).
• È possibile comunicare in modo appropriato con diversi gruppi target.
• Siete motivati a costruire, gestire e promuovere relazioni e reti all'interno del dipartimento e dei progetti correlati.
• Rapida comprensione e comprensione di questioni complesse pensiero concettuale e creativo. Si prega di notare che questo posto vacante non è attualmente collegato a una posizione aperta. Stiamo anticipando i bisogni futuri nella nostra organizzazione. Se siete interessati a questo tipo di ruolo, si prega di applicare oggi, e possiamo contattare si dovrebbe una posizione corrispondente al tuo profilo diventare disponibile. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position In einer globalen, funktionsübergreifenden Umgebung ist die Systementwicklungsabteilung (SD) innerhalb von R & D für die Workflow-Optimierung und die erfolgreiche Integration von Hardware, Software, Verbrauchsmaterialien und Reagenzien verantwortlich, um die Systemüberprüfung von Diagnoseinstrumenten durchzuführen. Als Entwicklungsingenieur arbeiten Sie als funktionsübergreifendes Team an der Automatisierung und dem Tooling, um eingeführte komplexe Diagnosesysteme zu warten und weiterzuentwickeln. In dieser Position sind Sie für folgende Bereiche verantwortlich:
• Ausarbeitung von (Cobots-)Robotik-Konzepten in einer Laborumgebung, um unsere Vision eines dunklen Labors durch die vollständige Automatisierung von Laborbetrieb und Workflows zu verwirklichen.
• Programmierung, Test und Wartung von neu erstellten und bestehenden automatisierten Lösungen in unseren Labors.
• Unterstützung unserer Integrationsteams bei der Installation und Fehlerbehebung von Robotiklösungen in unserer Laborumgebung
• Planen, koordinieren und führen Sie Arbeitspakete in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich aus, einschließlich der Berichterstattung und Eskalation von Themen oder Problemen an das Team und das Management.
• Sie können als Einzelperson und als Teil eines Teams arbeiten. Wer du bist:
• Sie haben einen Bachelor oder Master vorzugsweise in Informatik, mit spezifischen Kenntnissen in z.B. Robotik und / oder Vision, Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau oder Systemtechnik oder gleichwertig.
• Kenntnisse der professionellen Softwareentwicklung mit einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen (z.B. UR-Polyscope, Python, C#/NET, LabView)
• Sie freuen sich, als Profi in der medizinischen Diagnostikbranche zu arbeiten.
• Hervorragende gesprochene und schriftliche Englischkenntnisse (Deutsch ist vorteilhaft).
• Sie können mit verschiedenen Zielgruppen angemessen kommunizieren.
• Sie sind motiviert, Beziehungen und Netzwerke innerhalb der Abteilung und der damit verbundenen Projekte aufzubauen, zu verwalten und zu pflegen.
• Schnelles Erfassen und Verstehen komplexer Themen konzeptionelles und kreatives Denken. Bitte beachten Sie, dass diese Vakanz derzeit nicht mit einer offenen Position verknüpft ist. Wir antizipieren zukünftige Bedürfnisse in unserer Organisation. Wenn sie an dieser art von rolle interessiert sind, bewerben sie sich bitte noch heute, und wir können sie kontaktieren, wenn eine position, die ihrem profil entspricht, verfügbar wird. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

Who We Are
Roche Diagnostics International Ltd in Rotkreuz is one of the world’s leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for clinics, laboratories, and doctors’ offices. The company employs over 2200 people in Rotkreuz and is one of Roche Diagnostics main sites.

Please note that this vacancy is not currently linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.

The Position

In a global, cross-functional environment, the System Development (SD) department is responsible for workflow optimization and the successful integration of hardware, software, consumables, and reagents to finally perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments. As a Lab Technician, you will work as a cross-functional team to maintain and further develop launched complex diagnostic systems.
In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• Responsible for laboratories supervision and laboratory equipment

• Representing the working group in the quality team for laboratories

• Support of R&D and validation projects

• Carry out and analyze molecular biology experiments following established SOPs

• Ordering, tracking, and accepting test samples and consumables according to SOPs

• Independent communication with other departments

• Report experimental results to project managers in a timely manner

Who you are

You are someone who wants to influence your development. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

The ideal candidate for our dynamic, international team will have the following skills and experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in biology or related field preferred.

• Experience and willingness to work in a highly regulated industry and labs with biosafety levels 1 and 2.

• Enthusiastic team player with good communication and collaboration skills. Solution-oriented, autonomous, and proactive working style.

• Experience in statistical data analysis

• You write and speak English fluently; German is a plus.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position
The Position

( Please note that this vacancy is currently not linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.)
In a global and cross-functional environment, the System Development department is responsible for workflow optimization and the successful integration of hardware, software, consumables, and reagents to finally perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments.
As a System Development Software Tester, you will work as a part of a cross-functional team on the development of new complex diagnostics systems consisting of fluidics, robotics software, thermal, electrical, mechanical, and biochemistry elements.
As a Software Testergineer in the new Analyzer Project, your main responsibilities will consist of (but will not be limited to):

• Plan and execution of the work packages within the area of responsibility, including reporting and escalation of issues to the management.

• Experienced with Windows and Linux Operations System

• Know-how in setting up an automated testing environment and familiar in using data analysis tools to provide statistical data to the management

• Experienced in using Network Protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, and SSL)

• Familiar in using Gateways, Firewalls and using Remote Access

• Subject matter expert for Communications protocols between instruments and Laboratory informations systems(LIS). Provide guidance and support to others. Flexibility to transfer knowledge to different tasks/subprojects within SD.

• Experimental design and execution of the experiments in the lab. Creation of Test Cases based on Product Requirements. Execution of Test Cases, analysis of the results, and creation of the respective regulatory documents. Issue tracking and verification of bug fixes/Anomalies.

• Generate required documentation/procedures/technical reports in support of daily activities and be able to author official documents in English (e.g., Design history Files) for the preparation of milestones. Prepare and deliver presentations of project results to own or other groups.

• Coordinate efforts with other functional areas to accomplish tasks: Hardware-, Software-, Consumables-, Assay-and Algorithm-Development.

Who you are

You’re someone who wants to influence your development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

To be successful in this role (you provide):

• Degree in a technical or life sciences discipline (e.g., Software- or Electrical Engineering,

• Electronic/Automation, Bio- and Process-Engineering,) or related job experience.

• Minimum 1 years of work experience in the development of diagnostic systems in a System Development or related field

• Ability to work independently, handling cross-departmental development tasks

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English and German

• Strong analytical and interdisciplinary thinking

• Experience in statistical data analysis

• Experience in and willingness to work in a highly regulated industry and labs with biosafety levels S1and S2

You will perform hands-on experiments, Hardware (HW) and Software (SW) testing, including evaluation of system performance, error handling, and reliability improvements.

• Plan and execute the work packages within the area of responsibility, including reporting and escalating issues to management.

• Subject matter expert for an assigned area of responsibility. Provide guidance and support to team members.

• Prepare and deliver presentations of project results to team and management.

• Experimental design and execution of the experiments in the biosafety levels S1 and S2 laboratory.

• Creation of Test Cases based on Product Requirements. Execution of Test Cases, analysis of the results, and creation of the respective regulatory documents. Issue tracking and verification of bug fixes/Anomalies.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems. Document and maintain software functionality.

• Coordinate efforts with other functional areas to accomplish tasks: Hardware, Software-, Consumables-and Assay-Development.

You are someone who wants to influence your development. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. A job title is not considered the final definition of who you are but the starting point.

• Degree in a relevant life science discipline (e.g. (e.g. biology, biotechnology, biomedical informatics, engineering related to life sciences) or corresponding job experience

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Job Ad Text

Key Responsibilities:

• Data Excellence: Review and set up new suppliers, customers, or change existing vendor/customer details in SAP, adhering to our Vendor Master Data SOP.

• Accuracy in Action: Enter vendor data accurately in MDGS platform, including bank details and change requests, ensuring data integrity.

• Quality Assurance: Approve data and enhancements based on supporting, verifying bank details as per SOP and ICFR requirements.

• Collaborative Validation: Validate records sent by business for user requests, maintaining data accuracy.

• Continuous Improvement: Provide data and root cause analysis for process enhancements, supporting a culture of continuous improvement.

Key Accountabilities:

• Data Integrity Champion: Ensure accuracy and integrity of master data for vendors and customers, adhering to corporate policies and procedures.

• Compliance Steward: Monitor and resolve emails in the vendor master email box, ensuring adherence to Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR) and local statutory requirements.

• Efficiency Enabler: Timely creation, verification, and cleanup of vendor and customer master data, supporting business requirements seamlessly.

• Support Maestro: Provide timely helpdesk support, training, and collaboration with internal stakeholders for master data processes.

Qualifications & Experience:

• Degree or Diploma in Finance & Accounting/Commerce or equivalent.

• Excellent communication skills in English, fostering effective collaboration.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in transactional accounting or shared service environment, with exposure to master data management.

• Proficiency in SAP or other ERP accounting systems, as well as MS Office tools.

• Experience in shared services or business process outsourcing is a plus.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für Generationen.

Der Text zur Position der externen Stellenanzeige

Verantwortung - Data Excellence: Überprüfung und Einrichtung neuer Lieferanten, Kunden oder Änderung bestehender Lieferanten/Kundendaten in SAP, unter Einhaltung unserer Vendor Master Data SOP. - Genauigkeit in Aktion: Geben Sie die Lieferantendaten genau in MDGS-Plattform, einschließlich Bankdaten und Änderungswünsche, die Gewährleistung der Datenintegrität. - Qualitätssicherung: Genehmigen Sie Daten und Verbesserungen auf der Grundlage der Unterstützung, Überprüfung Bankdaten nach SOP und ICFR Anforderungen. - Kollaborative Validierung: Validierung von Aufzeichnungen von Unternehmen für Benutzeranfragen gesendet, Aufrechterhaltung der Datengenauigkeit.

- Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Bereitstellung von Daten und Grundursachen Analyse für Prozessverbesserungen, Unterstützung einer Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.

Wichtige Accountabilities - Data Integrity Champion: Sicherstellen Sie die Genauigkeit und Integrität der Stammdaten für Verkäufer und Kunden, unter Einhaltung der Unternehmenspolitik und -verfahren. - Compliance Steward: Überwachen und beheben Sie E-Mails in der Master-E-Mail-Box des Anbieters, um die Einhaltung der internen Finanzberichterstattung (ICFR) und der lokalen gesetzlichen Anforderungen zu gewährleisten. - Effizienz-Enabler: rechtzeitige Erstellung, Überprüfung und Aufräumung von Lieferanten- und Kundenstammdaten, die die Geschäftsanforderungen nahtlos unterstützen.

- Unterstützung Maestro: Bereitstellung von zeitnahen Helpdesk-Unterstützung, Schulungen und Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern für Stammdatenprozesse.

Voraussetzungen - Abschluss oder Diplom in Finance & Accounting/Commerce oder gleichwertig. - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch, Förderung einer effektiven Zusammenarbeit. - Mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung in der Transaktionsbuchhaltung oder geteilten Serviceumgebung, mit der Exposition gegenüber Master Data Management. - Kompetenz in SAP oder anderen ERP-Buchhaltungssysteme, sowie MS Office-Tools. - Erfahrung in gemeinsamen Dienstleistungen oder Geschäftsprozess Outsourcing ist ein Plus.

Was wir bieten - Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100 000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, damit jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für die kommenden Generationen. - Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Arzneimitteln behandelt werden, und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. - Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, so dass wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Kontakt Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Description Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassés pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à assurer que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir.

Le poste Emploi externe Texte de la publicité

Responsabilités - Excellence des données : Examiner et mettre en place de nouveaux fournisseurs, clients ou modifier les détails existants du fournisseur/client dans SAP, en respectant notre SOP de gestion des données du fournisseur. - Précision en action : Entrez les données du fournisseur avec précision dans la plateforme OMDS, y compris les détails bancaires et les demandes de changement, en assurant l'intégrité des données. - Assurance de la qualité : Approuver les données et les améliorations basées sur le soutien, la vérification des données bancaires conformément aux exigences SOP et ICFR. - Validation collaborative : Valider les dossiers envoyés par les entreprises pour les demandes des utilisateurs, en maintenant l'exactitude des données.

- Amélioration continue : Fournir des données et une analyse des causes profondes pour améliorer les processus, en appuyant une culture d'amélioration continue.

Responsabilités clés - Champion de l'intégrité des données : Assurer l'exactitude et l'intégrité des données principales pour les fournisseurs et les clients, en respectant les politiques et les procédures ministérielles. - Respect de la conformité Responsable : Surveiller et résoudre les courriels dans la boîte électronique principale des fournisseurs, en veillant au respect des exigences réglementaires locales et des exigences en matière de rapports financiers de contrôle interne (ICRF). - Efficiency Enable : Création, vérification et nettoyage en temps opportun des données principales des fournisseurs et des clients, en tenant compte des exigences opérationnelles de façon transparente.

- Soutien Maestro : Fournir en temps opportun un soutien, une formation et une collaboration avec les intervenants internes pour les processus de gestion des données.

Exigences - Diplôme ou diplôme en finance et comptabilité/1994 ou équivalent. - Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais, favorisant une collaboration efficace. - Minimum d'un an d'expérience en comptabilité transactionnelle ou en environnement de service partagé, avec une exposition à la gestion de données de base. - Compétence en SAP ou autres systèmes de comptabilité ERP, ainsi que des outils MS Office. - Expérience en services partagés ou en externalisation de processus opérationnels est un plus.

Ce que nous offrons - Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Mansion Als Account Manager bei Roche Sequencing Solutions stehen Sie an der Spitze der Revolution der Sequenzierungslandschaft. Nutzen Sie diese einzigartige Gelegenheit, mit einem dynamischen Team zusammenzuarbeiten und unsere innovativen Produkte zum Markterfolg zu treiben. In den Warenkorb - Identifizieren und kultivieren Leads: Entdecken Sie Verkaufsmöglichkeiten, pflegen neue Geschäftsbeziehungen und engagieren Sie wichtige Entscheidungsträger in der Sequenziergemeinschaft. - Execute Growth Plans: Entwicklung und Überwachung von regionalen kommerziellen Wachstumsplänen, die sich auf wichtige Erfolgsmetriken konzentrieren, um Umsatz und strategische Ziele zu erreichen. - Optimieren Sie Sales Opportunities: Verwalten Sie Verkaufsmöglichkeiten effektiv durch Salesforce/CRM. - Present and Consult: Führen Sie Produktpräsentationen und beratende Diskussionen, um den Wert unserer Sequenzierungslösungen zu präsentieren. - Fahren Sie den technischen Vertrieb: technisches Know-how im gesamten Vertriebsprozess, einschließlich Bewerbungsberatungen und Datenanalyseunterstützung. - Verbessern Sie die Markenvisibilität: Repräsentieren Sie Roche auf Konferenzen, Messen und Networking-Veranstaltungen, um Gedankenführung zu etablieren und potenzielle Kunden zu engagieren. - Verbundene Across-Teams: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Marketing-, Produktmanagement-, Service- und Support-Teams zusammen, um Vertriebsbemühungen mit Unternehmenszielen und Kundenbedürfnissen auszurichten. - Regionale Umsetzung: Partner mit subregionalen Teams in ganz Europa, um strategische Pläne für eine erfolgreiche Marktdurchdringung zu entwickeln und umzusetzen. Voraussetzungen - Bildungshintergrund: Bachelor-Abschluss in Life Science, Business oder einem verwandten Bereich. - Vertriebserfahrung: Bewiesene Erfahrung beim Verkauf von Kapitalanlagen in der Diagnostik/Lebenswissenschaften. - Technisches Wissen: Tiefes Verständnis der Next Generation Sequenzierung und verwandte genomische Techniken. - Strategische und Verhandlung Fähigkeiten: Demonstrierte Exzellenz in Verhandlungen, strategische Planung und organisatorische Fähigkeiten. - Consultative Selling: Fähigkeit, technische Bedürfnisse zu identifizieren und Geschäftslösungen bereitzustellen. - Entrepreneurial Spirit: Starkes Geschäft acumen und fahren, um komplexe Vertriebsprozesse zu navigieren. - Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, wirkungsstarke Gruppenpräsentationen zu liefern und effektiv mit verschiedenen Interessenvertretern zu kommunizieren. - Reisevoraussetzungen: Bereitschaft zur nationalen und internationalen Reise. - Bevorzugte Erfahrung: 5+ Jahre in einer klinischen Forschung oder akademischen Laborumgebung, Erfahrung Verkauf von Sequencern für NGS-Anwendungen und Kenntnisse in der NGS-Datenanalyse. - Sprachkenntnisse: fließend auf Englisch. Die Kenntnis deutscher und/oder anderer europäischer Sprachen ist ein Vorteil.
• Cosa offriamo Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Contattoo Bitte beachten Sie, dass dies eine Voraussetzung für das Talent Pool-Gebäude ist, was bedeutet, dass es nicht notwendigerweise eine aktuelle Eröffnung mit laufendem Rekrutierungs- oder Auswahlprozess widerspiegelt, sondern eine Position, für die wir häufig rekrutieren oder in naher Zukunft öffnen wollen. Chi Siamo Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns an
descriptionByLocale.fr:

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Mansioni En tant que responsable de compte chez Roche Sequencing Solutions, vous serez à l'avant-garde de la révolution du séquençage. Embrassez cette occasion unique de collaborer avec une équipe dynamique et de conduire nos produits innovants à la réussite du marché. Responsabilité - Identifier et cultiver des pistes : Découvrez les opportunités de vente, cultivez de nouvelles relations d'affaires et engagez les décideurs clés dans la communauté séquentielle. - Exécuter des plans de croissance : Élaborer et surveiller des plans régionaux de croissance commerciale, en mettant l'accent sur les indicateurs de succès clés pour atteindre les revenus et les objectifs stratégiques. - Optimiser les opportunités de vente : gérer efficacement les opportunités de vente grâce à Salesforce/CRM. - Présenter et consulter : Mener des présentations de produits et des discussions consultatives afin de mettre en évidence la valeur de nos solutions de séquençage. - Promotion des ventes techniques : fournir une expertise technique tout au long du processus de vente, y compris des consultations sur les demandes et un soutien à l'analyse des données. - Améliorer la visibilité de la marque : Représenter Roche lors de conférences, de salons professionnels et d'événements de réseautage afin d'établir un leadership de réflexion et d'engager des clients potentiels. - Collaborer entre les équipes : travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de marketing, de gestion des produits, de service et de soutien pour aligner les efforts de vente sur les objectifs de l'entreprise et les besoins des clients. - Exécution régionale: Partenaire avec des équipes sous-régionales à travers l'Europe pour élaborer et mettre en œuvre des plans stratégiques pour une pénétration réussie du marché.
• Requisiti - Études : Licence en sciences de la vie, en affaires ou dans un domaine connexe. - Expérience de vente: Expérience éprouvée dans la vente d'équipement au sein de l'industrie du diagnostic et des sciences de la vie. - Connaissances techniques : compréhension approfondie du séquençage de la prochaine génération et des techniques génomiques connexes. - Compétences stratégiques et de négociation : excellence démontrée dans la négociation, la planification stratégique et les capacités organisationnelles. - Vente consultative : Capacité à identifier les besoins techniques et à fournir des solutions d'affaires. - Esprit Entrepreneuriel: Forte entreprise et conduite pour naviguer dans les processus de vente complexes. - Compétences en communication : Capacité de présenter des exposés de groupe pertinents et de communiquer efficacement avec divers intervenants. - Conditions de voyage : Volonté d'entreprendre des voyages nationaux et internationaux. - Expérience préférée : 5 ans et plus dans un environnement de recherche clinique ou de laboratoire universitaire, expérience de vente de séquenceurs pour les applications de NGS et compétence en analyse des données de NGS. - Compétences linguistiques : maîtrise de l'anglais. La connaissance de l'allemand et/ou d'autres langues européennes est un avantage.
• Cosa offriamo Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Contatto Veuillez noter qu'il s'agit d'une demande de création d'un bassin de talents, ce qui signifie qu'elle ne reflète peut-être pas nécessairement une ouverture actuelle avec un processus de recrutement ou de sélection en cours, mais un poste auquel nous recrutons fréquemment ou que nous prévoyons ouvrir prochainement. Chi Siamo Un avenir plus sain nous pousse

jobs.title: Head of Molecular Lab
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Us
At Roche, we are committed to making a meaningful impact on society through innovative healthcare solutions. We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment where you can grow, learn, and contribute to cutting-edge advancements in diagnostics. Join us to be part of a purpose-driven company that values diversity, flexibility, and professional development.

The Opportunity
As the Head of Molecular Lab , you will report to the designated executive leader and be based in China. This pivotal role combines strategic vision with operational excellence, driving the growth and success of our Molecular Diagnostics division. You will collaborate with global teams, lead high-performing teams, and shape the future of diagnostics in China.

What You Will Be Working On

• Act as the key interface with Regional/Global Marketing Groups to secure resources and align strategies.

• Lead product launch processes, ensuring milestones are met and compliance standards are upheld.

• Represent Roche in business partnerships and key customer interactions to foster strong relationships.

• Oversee sales, marketing, and customer service operations to maximize effectiveness.

• Mentor and develop talent to build a high-performing team and ensure robust succession planning.

• Develop and implement strategies for distributor management, pricing, and regulatory compliance.

• Identify market opportunities, monitor industry trends, and drive innovative business initiatives.

Who You Are

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in a science/medical-related field; MBA or postgraduate qualifications are a plus.

• Experience: 15+ years in sales and marketing management within multinational pharmaceutical/medical device companies, preferably in In-Vitro Diagnostics (IVD).

• Skills: Proficiency in English (written and spoken), strong command of MS Office, and deep industry/market expertise.

• Values: Alignment with Roche’s core values of Integrity, Courage, and Passion.

• Leadership: Proven ability to drive operational excellence, manage P&L, and inspire teams.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Skills: Proficiency in English (written and spoken), strong command of MS Office, and deep industry/market expertise.
• Values: Alignment with Roche’s core values of Integrity, Courage, and Passion.
• Leadership: Proven ability to drive operational excellence, manage P&L, and inspire teams. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Medical Enabler
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose

• Medical Enabler in Roche is a group of people who are purpose-driven, experienced, and passionate with experience in medical affairs. We put patients and science at the center of all actions and we serve as the medical content expert in one or more therapeutic areas within the organization; build scientific partnership with external partners; ensure access to our products and clinical trials and attend diligently to patient safety and the needs of our healthcare professionals.

• We work hand in hand with our external partners and internal teams to discover the unmet medical needs along the patient journey, being obsessed with what they need to deliver exceptional patient care and acting boldly with them to transform science and ultimately patient lives by accelerating "better outcomes for more patients faster".

Role scope:
Functional expertise

• Developing and cultivating strategic relationships with therapeutic area experts and other healthcare influencers.

• Translating insights into strategic actionable recommendations for varied and broad stakeholder groups to impact the way we work and ensure we help deliver positive change in healthcare systems widely e.g nationally, beyond affiliates or globally especially through co-creation.

• Advising on, contributing to, or leading the strategic planning and driving the desired outcomes, taking into account patients’ needs, Taiwan uniqueness, business needs, resource requirements, regulatory and market access considerations. Can think from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, in order to bring best possible outcomes to both the local health environment, and more broadly, across Roche globally.

• Optimizing clinical development throughout the product lifecycle to bring better treatment to patients.

• Generating and communicating medical evidence that helps practitioners, patients and payers make good health care decisions.

• Initiating and implementing medical or innovative projects e.g. compassionate use program, local access mechanism to address access needs, or digital solutions.

• Internalizing the network way of working through transparent sharing of knowledge and resources to improve working effectiveness and create a bigger impact for the organizations.

• Working in a self-managed team of peers and acting as a coach or mentor with VACC mindst to make people hold each other accountable to deliver solutions for the healthcare systems effectively.

Mindset & behaviors

• Entreprise thinking, eager to learn, system thinker, self-managed & directed, bold, and being able to prioritize

• VACC mindset

• The ability to work with cross-functional teams is a must

• Ability to understand and leverage digital means and tools

• Embracing & implementing agile ways of working is a must

• Entrepreneurial mindset with good partnering capabilities (ability to deeply listen, question & understand, communicate smoothly)

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, takes risks and experiments, embrace challenges and failures, and contributes to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside Roche

Operating Principles

• Put Patients First: I always act as if patients I know are in the room and do what's best for them.

• Follow the science: I seek answers through experiments, data and debate, and act on facts.

• Act as one team: I care, collaborate and commit without boundaries, and trust others to do their part.

• Embrace differences: I seek diverse persp

titleByLocale.it: Praktikum in der analytischen Entwicklung e Qualitätskontrolle
titleByLocale.en: Internship in analytical development and quality control
titleByLocale.de: Praktikum in der analytischen Entwicklung und Qualitätskontrolle
titleByLocale.fr: Stage en développement analytique et contrôle de la qualité

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was Dich erwartet:
Die Funktion PTCG (Pharma Technical Operations Cell & Gene Therapy) der Roche Diagnostics GmbH, am Standort Penzberg, ist verantwortlich für die technische Entwicklung neuer in vivo gentherapeutischer Modalitäten während der präklinischen und klinischen Entwicklungsphasen. Unser Team “Analytical Development & Quality Control” befasst sich innerhalb PTCG mit der Entwicklung sowie der Implementierung neuer analytischer Methoden. Zudem sind wir verantwortlich für die Qualitätskontrolle der gentherapeutischen Wirkstoffe während der klinischen Phasen bis hin zur Marktzulassung.

• Zu Deinen Aufgabenbereichen gehört die Anwendung moderner und klassischer Methoden zur Analyse und Charakterisierung von Plasmiden, sowie viraler Partikel, insbesondere rekombinante Adeno-assoziierte virale Vektoren (rAAVv). Schwerpunkte hierbei sind die folgenden Techniken:

• Physikalische Methoden (u.a. Dynamische Lichtstreuung, HPLC)

• PCR (digitale PCR, Multiplexing, RT-PCR)

• Next-Generation Sequencing (u.a. Datenanalyse und PacBio Sequenzierungen)

• Zellkultur, Mikroskopie, FACS

• Elektrophoretische Methoden (Agarose Gelelektrophorese, SDS-PAGE, CE-SDS)

• Klonierungstechniken (u.a. Restriktion, Ligation, Aufreinigungsverfahren für Plasmid-DNA)

• Du unterstützt die Entwicklung, Implementierung und Validierung sowie die routinemäßige Durchführung dieser Methoden zur Charakterisierung von Plasmiden und viralen Vektoren.

• Ferner dokumentierst Du eigenständig Messergebnisse und erstellst unter Anleitung Analysenberichte in Übereinstimmung mit Regularien.

Wer Du bist:

• Du bist eingeschriebene/r Student/-in in einem der folgenden Fachbereiche: Chemie, Biochemie, Biologie, Virologie, Pharmazie oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.

• Kenntnisse in der biochemischen, molekular- oder zellbiologischen Analytik sind von Vorteil.

• Du bist sicher im Gebrauch der Standard-Office Anwendungen und erlernst den Umgang mit digitalen Systemen (Steuersoftware von Systemen sowie elektronisches Laborbuch) schnell.

• Die Fähigkeit zu selbstständigem und genauem Arbeiten sowie deren Dokumentation bringst Du mit.

• Du bist neugierig, hast zudem Freude an der Arbeit im Team und Eigeninitiative zählt ebenfalls zu Deinen Stärken.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung (37,5 Stundenwoche).

• Vergütung für das Vollzeitpraktikum.

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine.

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden.

• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit einem aussagekräftigen Lebenslauf.

Denke daran, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation richtet.

Die angebotene Stelle ist eine reine Praktikumsstelle, eine anschließende Bachelor-/Master-Thesis ist nicht vorgesehen.

Die Funktion PTCG (Pharma Technical Operations Cell & Gene Therapy) der Roche Diagnostics GmbH, am Standort Penzberg, ist verantwortlich für die technische Entwicklung neuer in vivo gentherapeutischer Modalitäten während der präklinischen und klinischen Entwicklungsphasen. Unser Team “Analytical Development & Quality Control” befasst sich innerhalb PTCG mit der Entwicklung sowie der Implementierung neuer analytischer Methoden. Zudem sind wir verantwortlich für die Qualitätskontrolle der gentherapeutischen Wirkstoffe während der klinischen Phasen bis hin zur Marktzulassung.

• Zu Deinen Aufgabenbereichen gehört die Anwendung moderner und klassischer Methoden zur Analyse und Charakterisierung von Plasmiden, sowie viraler Partikel, insbesondere rekombinante Adeno-assoziierte virale Vektoren (rAAVv). Schwerpunkte hierbei sind die folgenden Techniken:

• Physikalische Methoden (u.a. Dynamische Lichtstreuung, HPLC)

• PCR (digitale PCR, Multiplexing, RT-PCR)

• Next-Generation Sequencing (u.a. Datenanalyse und PacBio Sequenzierungen)

• Zellkultur, Mikroskopie, FACS

• Elektrophoretische Methoden (Agarose Gelelektrophorese, SDS-PAGE, CE-SDS)

• Klonierungstechniken (u.a. Restriktion, Ligation, Aufreinigungsverfahren für Plasmid-DNA)

• Du unterstützt die Entwicklung, Implementierung und Validierung sowie die routinemäßige Durchführung dieser Methoden zur Charakterisierung von Plasmiden und viralen Vektoren.

• Ferner dokumentierst Du eigenständig Messergebnisse und erstellst unter Anleitung Analysenberichte in Übereinstimmung mit Regularien.

Wer Du bist:

• Du bist eingeschriebene/r Student/-in in einem der folgenden Fachbereiche: Chemie, Biochemie, Biologie, Virologie, Pharmazie oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.

• Kenntnisse in der biochemischen, molekular- oder zellbiologischen Analytik sind von Vorteil.

• Du bist sicher im Gebrauch der Standard-Office Anwendungen und erlernst den Umgang mit digitalen Systemen (Steuersoftware von Systemen sowie elektronisches Laborbuch) schnell.

• Die Fähigkeit zu selbstständigem und genauem Arbeiten sowie deren Dokumentation bringst Du mit.

• Du bist neugierig, hast zudem Freude an der Arbeit im Team und Eigeninitiative zählt ebenfalls zu Deinen Stärken.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung (37,5 Stundenwoche).

• Vergütung für das Vollzeitpraktikum.

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine.

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden.

• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit einem aussagekräftigen Lebenslauf.

Denke daran, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation richtet.

Die angebotene Stelle ist eine reine Praktikumsstelle, eine anschließende Bachelor-/Master-Thesis ist nicht vorgesehen.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Typically studying in a field related to the assigned function. May be assigned a variety of tasks relevant to the assigned function and/or special projects for the assigned function. The objective of assignments is for the intern to practically apply academic or vocational studies/learning in a Roche setting, as well as learn more about the Roche organisation, as future employment with Roche may be a possibility subject to job availability, candidate qualification and past performance. Assignments vary but are typically to support the activities of regular employees, such as entry-level research and reporting, analyses and modelling, preparing materials for others, coordinating small events or meetings, improving basic departmental operations such as filing or archiving systems, departmental libraries, etc. Length of internship will vary according to business needs and legal requirements in the market where the internship is occurring.

Key Responsibilities

• Responsible for assessing compliance of employee reimbursement activities as well as associated healthcare compliance reviews in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Clearly documents all compliance assessment (i.e assessment results) activities in concur

• during claim processing

• Performs other relevant support activities as and when required (e.g. support in validating/ performing data analysis/testing which contributes to the reporting to affiliates/ Compliance Projects )

• Escalates issues to superior/RSS Line Manager (where required)

• Engages in networking with colleagues from other business functions when required to

• Supports the team in performing operational activities and involved in identifying/ implementing improvement opportunities within the current operational process

Academic requirement

• Undergraduate students from reputable universities in relevant fields of study (Prefer business, law or finance related major).

• Available for a minimum period of 6 months.

Key Competencies required

• Good command of spoken and written English and Mandarin

• Proactive at work and able to manage multiple tasks efficiently

• Strong analytical skills and great attention to details

• Able to challenge the status quo with skepticism and is passionate about process validation/ improvement

• Possess strong communication skills and a good record of extra-curricular activities.

• Good interpersonal skills, able to work in a team effectively, deliver on commitment.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Let’s build a healthier future, together.

The Position
1) Purpose

• Responsible for the maintenance and continuous improvement of the Change Control systems and processes.

• Ensure GMP compliance with the change control process.

2) Key Responsibilities

Technical and Functional:

• Ensure adherence to the Change Control management systems and processes

• Develop competency and proficiency in the QA Change Control process and the associated tools, supporting the delivery of training for change users as needed

• Evaluate Change Control requests for process, validation, regulatory and product impact.

• Coordinate the review and approval process of change requests to ensure timely execution of changes

• Ensure all site major changes are managed appropriately to meet the expectation of the global change control board and meets site project timelines.

• Participate in cross functional and cross site change management forums

• Collaborate with departments to ensure change control activities are executed efficiently and effectively, to provide supporting assistance to stakeholders in the process.

• Ensure completion of required change control actions prior to lifting lot disposition restrictions.

• Assist in the development and delivery of training materials and qualifications for Change Control processes and Change Management applications.

• Perform Change Records review in support of Annual Product Review activities.

• Ensure maintenance and continuous improvement of change control and processes

• Support regulatory inspections and provide audit support, which may include facility, utility, equipment documentation review

Safety, Health & Environment:

• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable

• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.

Lean Production System:

• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviours through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

3) Key Interfaces:

• Manufacturing, Local MSAT, Engineering

• Quality Functions (e.g. QA Ops, QC)

• Global Change Management BPOs and BPMs

• PT Regulatory

4) Qualifications

• Education:
• Diploma/Degree in Engineering or Science discipline is preferred

• Experience (may vary depending on site size/scope):
• Fresh graduates/mid-career professionals who are switching out of other industries

• Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
• Strong knowledge in of Change Control principles, practices and standards for the pharmaceutical industry

• Strong knowledge of cGMP regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry

• Systematic, meticulous and analytical approach to evaluation and execution of tasks.

• Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 1) Purpose
• Responsible for the maintenance and continuous improvement of the Change Control systems and processes.
• Ensure GMP compliance with the change control process. 2) Key Responsibilities Technical and Functional:
• Ensure adherence to the Change Control management systems and processes
• Develop competency and proficiency in the QA Change Control process and the associated tools, supporting the delivery of training for change users as needed
• Evaluate Change Control requests for process, validation, regulatory and product impact.
• Coordinate the review and approval process of change requests to ensure timely execution of changes
• Ensure all site major changes are managed appropriately to meet the expectation of the global change control board and meets site project timelines.
• Participate in cross functional and cross site change management forums
• Collaborate with departments to ensure change control activities are executed efficiently and effectively, to provide supporting assistance to stakeholders in the process.
• Ensure completion of required change control actions prior to lifting lot disposition restrictions.
• Assist in the development and delivery of training materials and qualifications for Change Control processes and Change Management applications.
• Perform Change Records review in support of Annual Product Review activities.
• Ensure maintenance and continuous improvement of change control and processes
• Support regulatory inspections and provide audit support, which may include facility, utility, equipment documentation review Safety, Health & Environment:
• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable
• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately. Lean Production System:
• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviours through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives. 3) Key Interfaces:
• Manufacturing, Local MSAT, Engineering
• Quality Functions (e.g. QA Ops, QC)
• Global Change Management BPOs and BPMs
• PT Regulatory 4) Qualifications
• Education:
• Diploma/Degree in Engineering or Science discipline is preferred
• Experience (may vary depending on site size/scope):
• Fresh graduates/mid-career professionals who are switching out of other industries
• Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
• Strong knowledge in of Change Control principles, practices and standards for the pharmaceutical industry
• Strong knowledge of cGMP regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry
• Systematic, meticulous and analytical approach to evaluation and execution of tasks.
• Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills in English Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcar

Lean Production System:

3) Key Interfaces:

• Manufacturing, Local MSAT, Engineering

• Quality Functions (e.g. QA Ops, QC)

• Global Change Management BPOs and BPMs

• PT Regulatory

4) Qualifications

• Education:
• Diploma/Degree in Engineering or Science discipline is preferred

• Experience (may vary depending on site size/scope):
• Fresh graduates/mid-career professionals who are switching out of other industries

• Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
• Strong knowledge in of Change Control principles, practices and standards for the pharmaceutical industry

• Strong knowledge of cGMP regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry

• Systematic, meticulous and analytical approach to evaluation and execution of tasks.

• Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Who we are

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcar

jobs.title: Masterarbeit Biosensorik (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wer wir sind

Sie absolvieren Ihr Praktikum / Ihre M.Sc. Arbeit im Chapter Near Patient Care Research & Early Development. Die Aufgabe des Chapters ist die Vorentwicklung von Near Patient Care Systemen für die nachfolgende Produktentwicklung.

Was Sie erwartet

Ihre Aufgabe besteht darin, neuartige Biosensoren zu entwickeln und bezüglich Ihres Aufbaus und Ihrer Funktion zu charakterisieren. Hierzu erarbeiten Sie neue Sensor-layouts unter Verwendung von state-of-the art Herstellungsmethoden und elektrochemischen Charakterisierungsmethoden.

Wer Sie sind

• Sie haben Ihr B.Sc. im Fachgebiet Bio(Chemie), Analytische Chemie, physikalische Chemie, Polymerchemie, Mikrosystemtechnik oder verwandter Studienfelder mit sehr gutem Erfolg abgeschlossen

• Sie bringen idealerweise Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in der Herstellung bzw. Charakterisierung von Biosensoren mit

• Sie kennen idealerweise die Grundlagen der Polymertechnik, Fertigungstechniken

• Sie verfügen idealerweise nicht nur über Grundkenntnisse der Statistik, sondern bringen auch Kenntnisse von Methoden zum Filtern und Fitten von Messdaten mit

• Kenntnisse im Bereich der Chemie und Elektrochemie sind vorteilhaft

• Hohes fachliches Interesse, insbesondere an interdisziplinärer Arbeit

• Begeisterungsfähigkeit

• Selbstständigkeit, hohe Einsatzbereitschaft, Zielorientierung

• Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit, Kontaktfreudigkeit

• Gute Englischkenntnisse

Ihre Vorteile

• 2.092,00 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/ offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Fitnessstudio auf dem Roche Campus

Ihre Bewerbung

Bitte bewerben Sie sich ausschließlich online und laden Sie Ihre Bewerbung inkl. aussagekräftiges Anschreiben, Zeugnisse sowie aktueller Immatrikulationsbescheinigung zusammen mit Ihrem Lebenslauf beim Schritt 'Lebenslauf' in einem Dokument hoch.

Denken Sie daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum ausschließlich an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden.

Zeitraum: ab dem 01. September oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von 6 Monaten.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
