jobs.title: Medical Director — Multiple Sclerosis
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED ) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
Neuroscience & Rare Diseases represent a major focus area where we are committed to realizing our long-term vision of changing lives of patients with severe brain disorders. Our preclinical research and early clinical development activities center around large and rare indications. With unparalleled strengths across diverse disciplines, Roche is uniquely positioned to lead in transforming science into medicines for patients with disorders of the nervous system.
To achieve our goals, we are seeking a Medical Director, focusing on multiple sclerosis.

The Opportunity
In this role, you will lead and/or support early-stage clinical projects from entry into a human through proof of mechanism and proof of concept, to transform molecules into new medicines in an area with huge unmet medical needs.
You will leverage your expertise to translate innovative molecules into potentially transformative therapies for patients with severe brain disorders. By marrying science and strategy, you will design rigorous and efficient clinical experiments that will support robust decision-making, to get promising therapies to patients as soon as possible.

Your main responsibilities are:

• Lead and/or support cross-functional teams to design and execute clinical development plans from Phase 1 through Phase 2 (proof-of-concept)

• Coach Clinical Scientists in a line- or functional-manager status

• Closely interface with project team leaders as well as safety, clinical pharmacology, clinical operations, biostatistics, regulatory, research and biomarker groups and other members of project teams

• Lead and/or support internal stakeholder management and governance interactions around project plans and therapeutic area strategy

• Lead and/or support external engagements with advisory boards, site investigators, health authorities, and other key stakeholders

• Provide clinical input to programs in discovery research

• Lead scientific communications and disseminate the results of clinical trials in the form of conference presentations and journal publications

Who you are

• You have an MD or MD/PhD with a speciality in neuroimmunology, multiple sclerosis, or a similar field. Board certification and fellowship training or research experience in relevant areas is preferred.

• You bring at least 5 years of experience in longitudinal clinical research, preferably in drug development or clinical trials.

• You hold a strong track record of scientific excellence in the field, evidenced by substantial achievement in designing and implementing clinical trials and/or a high level of scholarship in industry or academia.

• You have experience in clinical drug development within the industry, ideally in the early stages of clinical development.

• As a leader,

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. L'Azienda Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED ) , facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Neuroscienze & Malattie Rare rappresentano una importante area di attenzione in cui ci impegniamo a realizzare la nostra visione a lungo termine del cambiamento di vite di pazienti con gravi disturbi cerebrali. La nostra ricerca preclinica e le prime attività di sviluppo clinico si concentrano intorno a grandi e rare indicazioni. Con punti di forza senza pari in diverse discipline, Roche è posizionato in modo unico per condurre a trasformare la scienza in farmaci per i pazienti con disturbi del sistema nervoso. Per raggiungere i nostri obiettivi, stiamo cercando un direttore medico, concentrandosi sulla sclerosi multipla. L'Opportunità In questo ruolo, guiderai e/o supporterai i progetti clinici del primo stadio dall'ingresso in un umano attraverso la prova di meccanismo e la prova del concetto, per trasformare le molecole in nuovi farmaci in un'area con enormi esigenze mediche non metriche. Leverai la tua esperienza per tradurre molecole innovative in terapie potenzialmente trasformative per i pazienti con disturbi cerebrali gravi. Sposando scienza e strategia, si progettano rigorosi ed efficienti esperimenti clinici che supporteranno il processo decisionale robusto, per ottenere terapie promettenti ai pazienti il più presto possibile. Mansioni - Piombo e/o supporto di team interfunzionali per progettare ed eseguire piani di sviluppo clinici dalla Fase 1 alla Fase 2 (protezione del concetto) - Allenatore di scienziati clinici in uno stato linea- o funzionale-manager - Interfaccia ravvicinata con i leader del team di progetto e sicurezza, farmacologia clinica, operazioni cliniche, biostatistica, gruppi normativi, di ricerca e di biomarcatori e altri membri dei team di progetto - Guidare e/o sostenere la gestione interna degli stakeholder e le interazioni di governance intorno ai piani di progetto e alla strategia di area terapeutica - Guidare e/o sostenere gli impegni esterni con consiglieri, ricercatori del sito, autorità sanitarie e altri stakeholder chiave - Fornire input clinici ai programmi di ricerca alla scoperta - Guidare le comunicazioni scientifiche e diffondere i risultati delle sperimentazioni cliniche sotto forma di presentazioni di conferenze e pubblicazioni di riviste
• Requisiti - Hai un MD o MD/PhD con una specializzazione in neuroimmunologia, sclerosi multipla, o un campo simile. È preferibile la certificazione e la formazione di borsa di studio o l'esperienza di ricerca in settori rilevanti. - Porti almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella ricerca clinica longitudinale, preferibilmente nello sviluppo della droga o negli studi clinici. - Lei ha un forte record di eccellenza scientifica nel campo, evidenziato da un sostanziale successo nella progettazione e nell'attuazione di studi clinici e/o un alto livello di borsa di studio nell'industria o nell'accademia. - Hai esperienza nello sviluppo di farmaci clinici all'interno del settore, idealmente nelle prime fasi di sviluppo clinico. - Come leader, Cosa? Contatto

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. L'Azienda Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Neurowissenschaften & Seltene Krankheiten stellen einen Schwerpunktbereich dar, in dem wir uns verpflichten, unsere langfristige Vision des Wandels von Leben von Patienten mit schweren Hirnstörungen zu verwirklichen. Unsere präklinische Forschung und frühe klinische Entwicklungsaktivitäten rund um große und seltene Indikationen. Um unsere Ziele zu erreichen, suchen wir einen Medical Director, der sich auf Multiple Sklerose konzentriert. L'Opportunità In dieser Rolle führen und/oder unterstützen Sie die frühesten klinischen Projekte von der Einreise in einen Menschen durch den Nachweis von Mechanismus und Nachweis von Konzept, um Moleküle in neue Medikamente in einem Bereich mit riesigen unmet medizinische Bedürfnisse zu verwandeln. Sie nutzen Ihr Know-how, um innovative Moleküle in potenziell transformative Therapien für Patienten mit schweren Hirnstörungen zu übersetzen. Durch die Heirat von Wissenschaft und Strategie entwerfen Sie strenge und effiziente klinische Experimente, die eine robuste Entscheidungsfindung unterstützen, um so schnell wie möglich vielversprechende Therapien für Patienten zu erhalten. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED ) Roche, nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Neurosciences et maladies rares représentent un domaine d'intérêt majeur où nous nous engageons à réaliser notre vision à long terme de l'évolution de la vie des patients atteints de troubles cérébraux graves. Notre recherche préclinique et nos premières activités de développement clinique se concentrent autour de grandes et rares indications. Avec des forces inégalées dans diverses disciplines, Roche est particulièrement bien placée pour diriger la transformation de la science en médicaments pour les patients souffrant de troubles du système nerveux. Pour atteindre nos objectifs, nous cherchons un directeur médical, qui se concentre sur la sclérose en plaques. L'Opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez et/ou soutiendraz des projets cliniques en phase initiale, depuis l'entrée dans un humain jusqu'à la preuve de mécanisme et de concept, pour transformer des molécules en nouveaux médicaments dans une zone aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits. Vous tirerez parti de votre expertise pour traduire des molécules innovantes en thérapies potentiellement transformatrices pour les patients atteints de troubles cérébraux sévères. En mariant science et stratégie, vous concevrez des expériences cliniques rigoureuses et efficaces qui appuieront une prise de décision solide, pour obtenir des thérapies prometteuses pour les patients dès que possible. Mansioni - Chef et/ou soutien d'équipes interfonctionnelles pour concevoir et exécuter des plans de développement clinique de la phase 1 à la phase 2 (proof-of-concept) - Coach Clinical Scientists en ligne ou en gestion fonctionnelle - Interface étroite avec les chefs d'équipe de projet ainsi qu'avec les groupes de sécurité, de pharmacologie clinique, d'opérations cliniques, de biostatistique, de réglementation, de recherche et de biomarqueur et d'autres membres des équipes de projet - Diriger et/ou appuyer les interactions internes de gestion des intervenants et de gouvernance autour des plans de projet et de la stratégie du domaine thérapeutique - Diriger et/ou appuyer les relations externes avec les conseils consultatifs, les chercheurs sur place, les autorités sanitaires et d'autres intervenants clés - Apporter une contribution clinique aux programmes de recherche en découverte - Diriger les communications scientifiques et diffuser les résultats des essais cliniques sous forme de présentations de conférences et de publications de revues
• Requisiti - Vous avez un MD ou MD/PhD avec une spécialité en neuroimmunologie, sclérose en plaques, ou un domaine similaire. La certification du conseil d'administration et la formation ou l'expérience de recherche dans les domaines pertinents sont privilégiées. - Vous apportez au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la recherche clinique longitudinale, de préférence dans le développement de médicaments ou les essais cliniques. - Vous possédez une solide expérience en matière d'excellence scientifique dans le domaine, attestée par des réalisations importantes dans la conception et la mise en oeuvre d'essais cliniques et/ou un niveau élevé de bourses dans l'industrie ou le milieu universitaire. - Vous avez de l'expérience en développement de médicaments cliniques au sein de l'industrie, idéalement aux premiers stades du développement clinique. - En tant que leader,

As an Account Manager at Roche Sequencing Solutions, you will be at the forefront of revolutionizing the sequencing landscape. Embrace this outstanding opportunity to collaborate with a dynamic team and drive our innovative products to market success.

As an Account Manager, you will:

• Optimize Sales Opportunities : Manage sales opportunities effectively through Salesforce/CRM.

• Present and Consult : Conduct product presentations and consultative discussions to showcase the value of our sequencing solutions.

• Drive Technical Sales : Provide technical expertise throughout the sales process, including application consultations and data analysis support.

• Improve Brand Visibility : Represent Roche at conferences, trade shows, and networking events to establish thought leadership and engage potential customers.

• Collaborate Across Teams : Work closely with marketing, product management, service, and support teams to align sales efforts with company objectives and customer needs.

• Regional Execution : Partner with subregional teams across Europe to develop and implement strategic plans for successful market penetration.

Who You Are
You possess:

• Educational Background : Bachelor’s degree in Life Science, Business, or a related field.

• Sales Experience : Confirmed experience in selling capital equipment within the diagnostics/life sciences industry.

• Technical Knowledge : Deep understanding of Next Generation Sequencing and related genomic techniques.

• Strategic and Negotiation Skills : Demonstrated excellence in negotiation, strategic planning, and organizational abilities.

• Consultative Selling : Ability to identify technical needs and provide business solutions.

• Entrepreneurial Spirit: Strong eye for business and drive to navigate complex sales processes.

• Communication Skills : Ability to deliver impactful group presentations and communicate effectively with diverse collaborators.

• Travel Requirements : Willingness to undertake national and international travel.

• Preferred Experience : 5+ years in a clinical research or academic laboratory environment, experience selling Sequencers for NGS applications, and proficiency in NGS data analysis.

• Language Skills : Native Level of Japanese and Proficiency in English.

• Present and Consult : Conduct product presentations and consultative discussions to showcase the value of our sequencing solutions.

• Drive Technical Sales : Provide technical expertise throughout the sales process, including application consultations and data analysis support.

• Improve Brand Visibility : Represent Roche at conferences, trade shows, and networking events to establish thought leadership and engage potential customers.

• Collaborate Across Teams : Work closely with marketing, product management, service, and support teams to align sales efforts with company objectives and customer needs.

• Regional Execution : Partner with subregional teams across Europe to develop and implement strategic plans for successful market penetration.

Who You Are

• Educational Background : Bachelor’s degree in Life Science, Business, or a related field.

• Sales Experience : Confirmed experience in selling capital equipment within the diagnostics/life sciences industry.

• Technical Knowledge : Deep understanding of Next Generation Sequencing and related genomic techniques.

• Strategic and Negotiation Skills : Demonstrated excellence in negotiation, strategic planning, and organizational abilities.

• Consultative Selling : Ability to identify technical needs and provide business solutions.

• Communication Skills : Ability to deliver impactful group presentations and communicate effectively with diverse collaborators.

• Travel Requirements : Willingness to undertake national and international travel.

jobs.title: Environmental Intern 2026
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Job Ad Text

Objetivo del Puesto:

Apoyar el desarrollo de las actividades planeadas en pro de fortalecer el sistema integrado de gestión desde el ámbito ambiental por medio de la aplicación de la normativa vigente, así como el desarrollo de medidas acordes a las necesidades actuales y futuras de la organización, además del seguimiento de políticas y
disposiciones ya existentes.

Lo anterior, busca velar por generar el menor número de impactos ambientales posibles, asociados a la prestación de bienes y servicios contemplados en el enfoque empresarial y propiciando un ambiente laboral y natural saludable para todas y todos los colaboradores de la empresa.

Responsabilidades Principales:

• Adelantar iniciativas de gestión ambiental,

• Apoyar el plan de mitigación de huella de carbono y compensación de la misma.

• Apoyar la estimación de indicadores de gestión ambiental, resultados y planes de acción, así como la formulación de nuevos KPI acordes con la gestión.

• Realizar control de generación de residuos en todas las sedes.

• Apoyar las iniciativas de economía circular.

• Apoyar el plan de antifalsificación desde la gestión de residuos.

• Apoyo en el manejo de proveedores externos para la gestión de residuos.

• Apoyo en los reportes a las entidades ambientales competentes.

• Formular proyectos que aporten a la gestión ambiental de la organización.

Responsabilidades:

• Contribuir a la comunicación efectiva entre la organización y los colaboradores, facilitando la divulgación de información en temas relacionados con seguridad, salud en el trabajo, medio ambiente y bienestar.

• Gestionar las emisiones de la organización con el fin de conducirla a la carbono neutralidad acorde a los objetivos establecidos por el Sistema de Gestión.

• Evaluar los diferentes sitios de trabajo a nivel nacional para garantizar que equipos, materiales y procesos no presenten riesgos para los empleados y para el medio ambiente.

• Garantizar la necesidad de entrenamientos de los colaboradores y contratistas de acuerdo a las necesidades identificadas.

• Planificar y garantizar los entrenamientos para colaboradores, proveedores y contratistas en materia Safety, Health and environmental (SHE) que se requieran y que sean de su competencia.

• Trabajar con la ARL en el cumplimiento de los planes aprobados para el cumplimiento de los objetivos trazados.

• Suministrar información a empleados y público en general sobre aspectos de salud pública, higiene y seguridad en el trabajo, medio ambiente y salud mental.

• Participar en los comités que la organización determine o en los que a su juicio considere para aportar a la mejora de los procesos y para dar cumplimiento a los requisitos legales.

• Promover el uso correcto de los Elementos de Protección Personal (EPP) y de equipos de seguridad por parte del personal de la organización.

Formación:

• Estudiante de ingeniería ambiental .

• Estudiante de ingeniería sanitaria o afines.

• Inglés intermedio.

Habilidades, experiencia y competencias:

• Gestión ambiental

• Soluciones Ambientales en la industrial

• Desarrollo ambiental

• Control ambiental y de riesgos

• Economía circular

• Gestión de residuos

• Gestión de emisiones

• Huella de carbono

• Uso Eficiente de Agua y Energía

• Gestión documental

• Generación de informes

• Soluciones basadas en la naturaleza

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring ever

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As an Accounts Payable Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for Accounts Payable matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

The Opportunity

• Receive, sort, verify, handle exceptions, bar code, scan, and pre-archive Accounts Payable (AP) documents for further processing.

• Validate and process Purchase Order (PO) and contract-based invoices, non-PO invoices, prepayments, and down payments.

• Review supplier open items (due invoices, credit notes, debit balances, etc.) before executing payments.

• Handle internal and external queries and resolve them within the agreed timeline.

• Investigate and reverse non-successful payments.

• Perform supplier statement of account reconciliation and follow up on open items for closure.

• Perform month-end closing activities, including purchasing accrual according to the closing timetable/ schedule.

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, or yearly reporting, such as monthly KPI reports and other operational reports based on affiliate requirements.

• Reconcile AP balance sheet accounts and clear aged items (e.g., GR/IR, GIT, suspense account).

• Participate in compliance audits, prepare statutory audit reports & respond to audit queries as necessary.

• Troubleshoot AP issues (workflow, OCR, BOT, process) and work with respective teams (IT, Automation& GBPS) for resolution

• Participate & support implementation of projects/ initiatives from global, business partners & RSS.

• Engage in system integration and testing.

• Initiate and drive process improvement projects.

• Provide technical mentorship to team members and conduct internal process training for new joiners.

• Process suppliers and intercompany invoices accurately and within the predefined KPIs

• Ensure timely payment of suppliers and Intercompany invoices in accordance with agreed payment terms & Intercompany payment schedule

• Respond promptly to internal and external queries, adhering to predefined KPIs.

• Perform timely and accurate AP month-end closing activities, including purchasing accruals, and provide related reports.

• Create and maintain up-to-date work documentation and processes in compliance with ICFR, group policies, guidelines, and local statutory/legal requirements within agreed timelines

Who you are

• A degree in Finance & Accounting, Commerce, or equivalent. Professional qualifications (e.g., ACCA, CPA, MIA) are an advantage.

• Good communication skills and proficiency in English & Japanese Languages.

• Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking the specific country language for business communications.

• At least 2 years of experience in transactional accounting teams within a performance-driven environment.

• Knowledge and experience with SAP or other ERP/Accounting systems.

• Experience working in a shared service center across a global or large organization is advantageous.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Основні обов'язки:

• Інсталяція та валідація: Проведення монтажу, налаштування, валідації та введення в експлуатацію нових лабораторних систем Roche .

• Технічне обслуговування: Виконання планового та профілактичного обслуговування обладнання згідно з міжнародними стандартами та регламентами компанії.

• Діагностика та ремонт: Оперативна діагностика несправностей (як на місці у клієнта, так і за допомогою засобів віддаленої підтримки) та проведення ремонтних робіт будь-якої складності.

• Технічна підтримка: Надання професійних консультацій та навчання персоналу лабораторій (лікарів-лаборантів, біологів, інженерів клієнта) щодо правил експлуатації та догляду за обладнанням.

• Модернізація: Встановлення оновлень програмного забезпечення та апаратних модифікацій (апгрейдів) систем.

• Звітність та документація: Своєчасне та точне ведення всієї сервісної документації, заповнення актів виконаних робіт та звітів у корпоративній CRM-системі (відповідно до стандартів ISO та внутрішніх політик).

• Управління запчастинами: Ефективне управління власним складом запасних частин.

Вимоги до кандидата:

• Освіта: Вища технічна освіта (біомедична інженерія, електроніка, радіотехніка, метрологія, ІТ або суміжні спеціальності).

• Досвід роботи: Від 2-х років на посаді сервісного інженера з медичним або складним лабораторним обладнанням.

• Технічні знання: Глибоке розуміння принципів роботи електроніки, механіки, оптики та гідравліки.

• ІТ-навички: Впевнений користувач ПК. Розуміння принципів роботи комп'ютерних мереж (TCP/IP, LIS/HIS інтеграція) .

• Мови:
Українська – вільно.
Англійська – не нижче рівня Intermediate (B1). Обов'язкова вимога для читання технічної документації, проходження навчань у виробника та листування з глобальною підтримкою.

• Мобільність: Наявність водійського посвідчення категорії «В» та досвід водіння.

• Готовність до відряджень: Робота має роз'їзний характер, готовність до регулярних відряджень по Україні.

• Особисті якості: Висока клієнтоорієнтованість, відмінні комунікативні навички, відповідальність, аналітичний склад розуму, вміння працювати в режимі багатозадачності та самостійно приймати рішення.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Key activities & Deliverables

• Co-ordinate and execute month end, quarter end and year end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with work instructions and month end close checklist

• Perform and analyse booking accounting transactions, working and calculations are executed on timely and accurately

• Clearing of open items in accounts

• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, cost center checks and transaction posting checks

• Ensure accruals are properly justified and correctly posted

• To ensure all journals are performed accurately and timely

• Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliation, highlight and rectify any anomalies encountered

• Submission of monthly, quarterly and yearly reporting packages accurately and within specified timescale

Documentation & Controlling

• Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines

• Perform back up function and other duties, including job rotation to other functional teams as and when required

• Participate in any compliance audits and respond to audit queries

Transformation/ Continuous Improvement Implementations

• Initiate and execute the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Work collaboratively with customers and stakeholders

• Engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Proactively identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation

• Assist to ensure effective knowledge transfer as for sustainable development knowledge and sharing of best practices within the team

Coaching/Sharing

• Support the review entries posted by the team to ensure accuracy

• Extends coaching and guidance to juniors in daily operation

• Support the when there are any ad hoc activities or projects

• Contribute inputs/findings to establish a knowledge database of issue encountered, proposed resolution steps to facilitate continuous learning, development and cross sharing of knowledge and lesson learnt across the teams

Qualifications & Experience Required

• Degree or Diploma in Finance & Accounting/Commerce or equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English.

• Minimum 5 years working experiences in the related field, preferable in the area of General Accounting and Management Accounting

• SAP knowledge or other ERP accounting systems and MS Office tools

• Proficiency in English and Japanese language are mandatory with good communication skill (writing and speaking).

Desirable qualifications

• External experience in a shared service or business process outsourcing engagement will be preferable

• Clearly documents all compliance assessment (i.e assessment results) activities in concur

• during claim processing

jobs.title: 副总监 - 医院战略合作

titleByLocale.en: 副总监 - 医院战略合作
titleByLocale.de: 副总监 - 医院战略合作

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 您是谁：
• 作为医院战略合作部门区域负责人，您将带领团队 与负责区域的外部医疗机构建立长期、深度、多元的战略伙伴关系，从而全面助力医院实现高质量发展目标。

您的主要职责：
• 1、与负责区域的外部医疗机构建立长期、深度、多元的战略伙伴关系。作为医院非临床各职能科室的首要对接窗口，充分依托罗氏的创新资源禀赋，为医院提供一体化支持方案，从而全面助力医院实现高质量发展目标。
• 1.1 了解和挖掘所负责区域关键医院业务和学术发展需求，并提供相应的学术支持
• 1.2 设计和实施区域品牌项目，培养区域的讲者，打造公司在区域的影响力
• 1.3 部门合作推动所负责区域关键医院与公司的战略合作关系

2、负责所属区域关键医院的准入工作
• 2.1根据部门与业务共识的医院准入目标，确保在开发成功率和有效执行
• 2.2 推动需开发医院的药事会、临采流程，提供关键医院药学部解决方案
• 2.3 负责所属区域关键医院的已准入状态的维护；将医院总控影响降到最低；维护好与关键医院医保办合作

• 3、负责所属区域关键医院业务计划（Account planning）制定
• 3.1完成和完善区域关键医院的 项目及预算计划
• 3.2 监督SAM执行所负责关键医院的计划执行
• 3.3 协同业务和跨部门一起完善和落实相关项目的落地和高效执行

4、负责团队和人员管理
• 4.1按时准确完成日常工作和相关报告，严格遵守和执行公司的合规政策
• 4.2负责区域T&E费用预算审核及实际费用审核，对预算负责
• 4.3 根据团队业绩考核目标，定期辅导和跟进计划执行，以确保业务目标达成

5、 参与或带领部门或跨部门的相关项目

我们期待这样的你加入：
• 1，具备医院准入，市场准入或医药销售二线管理工作经验。
• 2， 具备项目管理能力，辅导及提升团队项目管理知识及流程；辅导团队设计项目；能对风险及突发事件处理及预防。
• 3， 具备团队合作能力，能建立跨部门沟通合作机制；具有全局观和全面思考能力，从公司策略角度引导开展区域及跨区域活动会议，促成跨区域内部合作，形成品牌项目。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Paid Media Specialist - TALENT POOL

titleByLocale.it: Media a pagamento Specialista - TALENT POOL

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

The Paid Media Specialist is responsible for supporting and partnering with our Business Partners in executing on the paid media strategy by delivering a full suite of objectives across the Roche online presence. The role is expert in all aspects of paid campaign management across different channels and platforms and is able to build out reporting metrics that supports the business in continuing their growth to meet KPIs and objectives.

The Opportunity:

• Planning, executing, and optimizing global digital marketing campaigns across key channels such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Display, in close collaboration with digital marketing managers and social media leads worldwide. This includes a focus on media buying, strategically purchasing ad space to reach our target audiences effectively and efficiently through our media agency.

• Monitoring, analyzing, and reporting on campaign performance, providing actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders, managing key KPIs and budgets, and continuously driving improvements

• Conducting A/B testing and audience optimization to refine targeting, ad copy, landing pages, and bidding strategies, ensuring data-driven enhancements and higher conversion rates

• Staying up to date with industry trends and best practices, leveraging research and insights to keep campaign strategies at the forefront, while discovering and learning the pharma advertising space

• Contributing to process optimization and knowledge sharing, establishing process governance, collaborating cross-functionally to align campaign goals, share learnings, and strengthen team capabilities

Who you are:

• You have a degree in Business or Marketing (BSc/MSc) and bring at least 3 years of hands-on experience in paid media campaign management, running campaigns across platforms focusing mainly on LinkedIn Ads, and have a good understanding of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and Display Advertising

• You are analytical and data-driven, with strong technical skills, and have experience using tools such as Google Analytics and Adobe Analytics. You know how to develop effective strategies, analyze performance, and continuously optimize campaigns for better results

• You are an excellent communicator with a C1-level English proficiency, confident in managing global stakeholders, collaborating with agencies and digital managers, and engaging with senior leaders to drive campaign success.

• You have a consultancy mindset, proactively providing insights and recommendations, developing actionable plans, and contributing to process improvements and best practices within the team

• You thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, are detail-oriented and well-organized, and bring a passion for digital technologies along with strong project management skills to keep initiatives on track

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be :

• Execute the day-to-day activities according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and best practice. Ensure quality and accurate delivery of services within agreed key performance indicators (KPIs) and as defined in the Service Level Agreement (SLA) and SOPs of the respective business sub-process.

• Follow the instructions of the Managers regarding the daily work coordination.

• Develop knowledge and capability to raise competence to expected levels to meet current and future business needs.

• Contribute process and technical expertise to process improvement initiatives. Support on assigned projects or programs.

• Key Accountabilities: Validate and process (fix & check) Purchase Requisitions to ensure completeness and in compliance with Procurement Policy. Convert Purchase Requisitions/Shopping Carts to Purchase Orders. Purchase Order amendment, close and cancellation.Manage and resolve internal and external queries. Participate in invoice reconciliation process. Work closely with Accounts Payable team to resolve any outstanding invoice reconciliation or mismatch.

• ​Execute and produce accurate and timely reports. Manage and execute the quote collections and multiple source biddings when applicable. Review and update SOP, DTP & LP timely.

• Ensure adherence to the Procurement Policy, Directive, Guidelines and Local Procurement SOPs.

• Actively participate in new project, such as ASPIRE/MyBuy and etc. Attend related meetings, trainings, knowledge transfer and etc.

Who you are :

• Degree or Diploma in Business Studies, Finance & Accounting/Commerce, Supply Chain or Procurement equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English and Japanese (N2 level)

• 3-years experience in a centralized purchasing environment and Supply Chain with production planning background.

• Experience of working in a shared service center across a global / large organization will be an added advantage.

• Good negotiation and analytical skills, resourceful in identifying new sources of items requested and results oriented.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

Role Purpose

• Build and enhance commercialization capabilities, ensuring alignment with Taiwan Pharma Ambition and boosting ecosystem mastery for customer-facing roles.

• Address skill gaps through coaching, insights, and learning programs, driving improved performance and patient value delivery.

• Support affiliate-wide excellence by connecting global best practices and fostering capability-driven strategies across all commercial functions.

Role scope:

• Lead commercialization capability learning programs, ensuring direct alignment with Pharma International’s overall business strategy and connecting with Taiwan Pharma Ambition.

• Translate global standards into local actionable roadmaps that ensure every PJP and partner has a clear path from foundational skills to advanced ecosystem mastery.

• Act as a strategic partner with PJS cluster leads and PJP team leads to identify key skill gaps and provide data-driven insights to improve individual and ecosystem-wide performance.

• Provide field coaching and timely feedback on customer engagement to remove roadblocks and unlock value for patients.

• Responsible for design and implement necessary trainings and connect internal / external resources

• Collaborate with Agile Coach to foster Working by Outcome realization at the affiliate level and facilitate key rituals like Impact Retrospectives to translate learnings and insights into business strategies.

• Partner with the Taiwan leadership team and chapter leaders to focus on capability building, ensuring end-to-end excellence across all commercialization functions.

• Serve as the Primary Subject Matter Expert and central point of contact for functional commercialization capability needs for Taiwan Pharma.

• Connect across APAC, Pharma International, and the extended global network to support ACE realization and share best practices across borders.

Requirements:
Qualifications:
Education:

• University degree (scientific, economic, or business degree). An advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus.

Working Experience:

• At least 8+ years work experience in commercial functions in the pharmaceutical industry.

• Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience excellence

• Solid experience in commercialization roles, such as Marketing, Sales, Medical, or Digital, with the ability to act as a credible coach for senior stakeholders

• Experienced in in-house training design, capability building, L&D, or Organizational Development within a complex, matrixed environment is a plus

Competencies:

• Strong strategic thinking and program/system design skills

• Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage, inspire and influence stakeholders at all levels.

• Innovative mindset with a continuous improvement approach to learning and development practices.

• Excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to influence and inspire teams without formal authority.

• Fast-learner, good digital fluency with the ability to leverage AI tools, data analytics, and modern learning platforms to enhance learning experience.

jobs.title: Expert Android Design System Engineer (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Expert en conception de système Android (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

Roche utilizes a unified Design System to streamline the user interfaces of its digital products and deliver a consistent, harmonized user experience for our customers. The One Design System encompasses all web and mobile applications developed at Roche Diagnostics.

Our Engineering Team is looking for an Android Expert able to lead the development of Android Mobile components ensuring the correct design and implementation of cutting-edge user interfaces for Android mobile applications. You are able to translate UX and clients requirements into technical solutions and vice versa, and you will lead the development of such components.

You will be located either in of Vienna, or in Sant Cugat (near Barcelona).

Your upcoming mission:

Hands-On Engineering & Tech Execution:

• Architect, develop, maintain the Design System components & interaction patterns for mobile, consistent with platform strategies, governance policy, and standards.

• Write and review clean, testable, scalable code aligned with best practices and design patterns.

• Architecte, développe, maintient les composants du système de conception et les modèles d'interaction pour mobile, en conformité avec les stratégies de plate-forme, la politique de gouvernance, et les normes.

• Maintenir la qualité du code au moyen d'essais automatisés, d'examens de code et de pipelines d'intégration continue.
• Fournir une évaluation technique du développement des composants de conception dans le mobile, en veillant à ce que l'approche soit de qualité, qu'elle soit centrée sur le client, la pensée future et facile à utiliser.
• Participer activement à la création de l'architecture pour les applications mobiles, conformément aux stratégies des plateformes, aux politiques de gouvernance et aux normes. Collaboration des intervenants et interfonctions :

• Assurer la documentation sur les composants mobiles et aider la communauté du développement mobile à adopter, mettre en œuvre, tester et entretenir.
• Travailler avec les clients Roche (chefs de projet, architectes, concepteurs, développeurs de front) pour établir la collaboration, comprendre leurs besoins et résoudre leurs doutes.
• Championne de l'adoption du système de conception avec le client et les ingénieurs d'utilisation de Roche. Activités créatives/stratégiques:
• Améliorations de brainstorm et propositions de solutions innovantes pour améliorer l'engagement communautaire.
• Évaluer les nouvelles technologies, modèles et cadres en vue de leur adoption éventuelle.
• Contribuer à l'examen de la conception, des prototypes et des normes d'expérience des utilisateurs mobiles. Système de conception alimenté par l'IA :
• Créer une documentation pour les agents de l'IA pour s'assurer que les utilisateurs du système de conception peuvent vibrer le code avec la bibliothèque
• Créer des applications de test en utilisant le codage par vibration pour assurer la compatibilité de la bibliothèque avec l'IA
• Documenter tous les composants du code Fiigma connecter Compétences essentielles pour votre mission :
• Développeur Android depuis au moins 5 ans
• Expert en Kotlin, Jetpack Compose et Git
• Expérience avec la conception de matériaux 3 pour Jetpack Compose et les systèmes de conception en général
• Forte expérience pour construire des composants d'interface réutilisables, testables et composables
• Compétence pour écrire des tests unitaires, des tests de capture d'écran, des tests d'interface Compose
• Connaissance approfondie de la mise en oeuvre des meilleures pratiques d'accessibilité (A11y) dans Jetpack Compose
• Compétences en bonus de connaissances RTL :
• Intérêt vif pour les tendances et les meilleures pratiques technologiques modernes

• L'engagement dans les communautés de développement, la gestion communautaire, la contribution active à l'ouverture

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责 / 责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）
1、 建立并维系 与区域政府决策部门及核心智囊机构的战略合作关系； 制定并落地 区域市场准入策略，推动产品 加速纳入 多层次医疗保障体系并实现报销覆盖最大化； 深度协同 区域业务团队，确保持续、顺畅的医保落地与报销执行。
Establish and cultivate strategic partnerships with regional government authorities and key think tanks. Formulate and execute regional market access strategies to accelerate product inclusion into multi-level reimbursement schemes and maximize coverage. Collaborate closely with the Regional Business Team to ensure seamless reimbursement implementation.
2、 确保区域准入策略与产品核心策略的深度协同 ；基于全生命周期管理要求及新政策环境，制定并落地区域市场准入计划。通过 优化医保报销政策 、 前瞻性化解准入风险与壁垒 ，持续最大化患者的用药可及性。
Ensure strategic alignment between regional market access initiatives and core product strategies. Formulate and execute regional access plans grounded in lifecycle management and the evolving policy landscape. Optimize reimbursement policies , proactively mitigate risks and barriers , and maximize patient accessibility.
3、 确保中央准入策略在团队内的协同与高效执行 ；建立并维护区域内医疗及卫生技术（HTA）领域的关键利益相关者关系； 全方位支持 从中央到省级及区域层面的市场准入工作。
Ensure alignment and execution of central market access strategies within the team. Manage key stakeholders in the medical and health technology (HTA) sectors. Provide comprehensive support for market access initiatives at national, provincial, and regional levels.
4、 构建并运营 区域市场准入平台，确立与政府部门的 长期战略合作 机制，统筹相关项目的落地实施。 深度研判 区域医药政策趋势，为业务决策提供智力支持，并 赋能 区域业务团队，确保政策信息的精准传达与应用。
Establish and operate regional market access platforms , ensuring the effective execution of collaborative projects. Cultivate long-term strategic partnerships with government authorities. Analyze and interpret key regional healthcare policies to support business decision-making, while empowering local commercial teams with actionable policy intelligence.
5、 构建区域跨职能协作与资源整合平台 ，统筹各部门资源以最大化利用效率； 强化 部门间协调机制，确保公司级项目中的深度协同，共同 驱动 区域业务目标的达成。
Establish a cross-functional collaboration and resource integration platform within the region. Orchestrate inter-departmental coordination to maximize resource efficiency, ensuring seamless synergy on corporate projects to drive the achievement of business objectives.

Q ualification and Experience 能力与经验

Education/Qualifications 教育程度 / 所获资格证书
本科及以上；医学、药学、药经或相关领域优先考虑

Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力

• Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry and policy affairs. 至少2年医药行业及政策事务相关工作经验。

• Specialization: Possess at least 2 years of experience in reimbursement account management. 具备至少2年政府客户管理经验。

• Project Management: Proven track record in project management and execution. 具备出色的项目管理与落地执行能力。

• Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication and networking skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and build strong professional relationships. 卓越的人际沟通与影响力，善于建立并维护稳固的业务关系网。

• Personal Attributes: Proactive, passionate, and highly self-motivated. 工作积极主动，富有激情，具备高度的自我驱动力。

• Teamwork: Strong sense of accountability, dedication, and a collaborative team spirit. 强烈的责任心与敬业精神，优秀的团队协作意识。

• Language: Proficiency in written and spoken English. 优秀的英语听说读写能力（可作为工作语言）

• Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in data analysis and presentation (PowerPoint/Excel). 精通PPT制作及数据分析技能。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the glob

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责 / 责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）

Establish and cultivate strategic partnerships with regional government authorities and key think tanks. Formulate and execute regional market access strategies to accelerate product inclusion into multi-level reimbursement schemes and maximize coverage. Collaborate closely with the Regional Business Team to ensure seamless reimbursement implementation.
2、 确保区域准入策略与产品核心策略的深度协同 ；基于全生命周期管理要求及新政策环境，制定并落地区域市场准入计划。通过 优化医保报销政策 、 前瞻性化解准入风险与壁垒 ，持续最大化患者的用药可及性。
Ensure strategic alignment between regional market access initiatives and core product strategies. Formulate and execute regional access plans grounded in lifecycle management and the evolving policy landscape. Optimize reimbursement policies , proactively mitigate risks and barriers , and maximize patient accessibility.
3、 确保中央准入策略在团队内的协同与高效执行 ；建立并维护区域内医疗及卫生技术（HTA）领域的关键利益相关者关系； 全方位支持 从中央到省级及区域层面的市场准入工作。
Ensure alignment and execution of central market access strategies within the team. Manage key stakeholders in the medical and health technology (HTA) sectors. Provide comprehensive support for market access initiatives at national, provincial, and regional levels.
4、 构建并运营 区域市场准入平台，确立与政府部门的 长期战略合作 机制，统筹相关项目的落地实施。 深度研判 区域医药政策趋势，为业务决策提供智力支持，并 赋能 区域业务团队，确保政策信息的精准传达与应用。
Establish and operate regional market access platforms , ensuring the effective execution of collaborative projects. Cultivate long-term strategic partnerships with government authorities. Analyze and interpret key regional healthcare policies to support business decision-making, while empowering local commercial teams with actionable policy intelligence.
5、 构建区域跨职能协作与资源整合平台 ，统筹各部门资源以最大化利用效率； 强化 部门间协调机制，确保公司级项目中的深度协同，共同 驱动 区域业务目标的达成。
Establish a cross-functional collaboration and resource integration platform within the region. Orchestrate inter-departmental coordination to maximize resource efficiency, ensuring seamless synergy on corporate projects to drive the achievement of business objectives.

Q ualification and Experience 能力与经验

Education/Qualifications 教育程度 / 所获资格证书
本科及以上；医学、药学、药经或相关领域优先考虑

Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力

• Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry and policy affairs. 至少2年医药行业及政策事务相关工作经验。

• Specialization: Possess at least 2 years of experience in reimbursement account management. 具备至少2年政府客户管理经验。

• Project Management: Proven track record in project management and execution. 具备出色的项目管理与落地执行能力。

• Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication and networking skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and build strong professional relationships. 卓越的人际沟通与影响力，善于建立并维护稳固的业务关系网。

• Personal Attributes: Proactive, passionate, and highly self-motivated. 工作积极主动，富有激情，具备高度的自我驱动力。

• Teamwork: Strong sense of accountability, dedication, and a collaborative team spirit. 强烈的责任心与敬业精神，优秀的团队协作意识。

• Language: Proficiency in written and spoken English. 优秀的英语听说读写能力（可作为工作语言）

• Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in data analysis and presentation (PowerPoint/Excel). 精通PPT制作及数据分析技能。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the glob

jobs.title: Technical Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Core Lab & POC
Location: Seoul, South Korea

Your Key Responsibilities
Sales and Market Strategy

• Responsible for planning and executing business plans to achieve sales targets for the Mass Spec product line.

• Formulate and execute customized sales strategies for key customers.

• Coordinate sales activities in conjunction with clinical chemistry/immunoassay equipment and pioneer new markets for TDM, Vitamin D, and High Medical Value Assays.

• Deliver differentiated value by achieving customer retention, expansion, and new acquisition through opportunity identification, solution proposal, and execution.

Customer Management

• Build relationships and establish long-term business connections with key decision-makers and KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders).

• Maximize the value of integrated solutions and customer satisfaction through KAM (Key Account Management).

• Utilize specialized knowledge to resolve technical inquiries and provide professional customer support.

• Provide necessary support and solutions to customers in a timely manner by collaborating with various organizations such as Marketing, Application Specialist, Service Engineer, and Medical Affairs.

Collaboration and Accountability

• Drive business success through close cooperation with relevant departments (Marketing, Finance, Service, etc.).

• Enhance overall diagnostic business performance through collaboration with other business units, including the Digital Business Unit, Molecular Diagnostics Business Unit, and Automation-related departments.

• Responsible for sales forecasting, contract management, and sales reporting.

Competency Development

• Practice continuous learning and internal sharing of Mass Spec technology, market trends, and competitor information.

• Strengthen expertise in automation systems, LC-MS/MS analysis principles, and Total laboratory automation integration technology.

• Continuously develop sales competencies (negotiation, strategic thinking, communication).

Who You Are

Education and Experience

• Major in a related field such as Life Science, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or Clinical Chemistry

• 5+ years of experience in the diagnostics, biotech, life science instruments, or analytical equipment sectors

Required and Preferred Experience

• Sales experience with LC-MS/MS or Mass Spec equipment portfolio

• Experience with LC-MS/MS reagent application (overall operation)

• Experience and understanding of clinical application of High Medical Value Assays, Vitamin D, Immunosuppressants, etc

• Understanding of the central laboratory operating environment, including Clinical Laboratory Automation Workflow, Laboratory Information System/Total laboratory automation, Clinical Chemistry/Immunoassay, or CBC

• Essential in English for technical communication and information sharing with Global/APAC teams

• Native-level proficiency in Korean is required

Submission

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Core Lab & POC
Location: Seoul, South Korea

Your Key Responsibilities
Sales and Market Strategy

• Responsible for planning and executing business plans to achieve sales targets for the Mass Spec product line.

• Formulate and execute customized sales strategies for key customers.

• Coordinate sales activities in conjunction with clinical chemistry/immunoassay equipment and pioneer new markets for TDM, Vitamin D, and High Medical Value Assays.

• Deliver differentiated value by achieving customer retention, expansion, and new acquisition through opportunity identification, solution proposal, and execution.

Customer Management

• Build relationships and establish long-term business connections with key decision-makers and KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders).

• Maximize the value of integrated solutions and customer satisfaction through KAM (Key Account Management).

• Utilize specialized knowledge to resolve technical inquiries and provide professional customer support.

• Provide necessary support and solutions to customers in a timely manner by collaborating with various organizations such as Marketing, Application Specialist, Service Engineer, and Medical Affairs.

Collaboration and Accountability

• Drive business success through close cooperation with relevant departments (Marketing, Finance, Service, etc.).

• Enhance overall diagnostic business performance through collaboration with other business units, including the Digital Business Unit, Molecular Diagnostics Business Unit, and Automation-related departments.

• Responsible for sales forecasting, contract management, and sales reporting.

Competency Development

• Practice continuous learning and internal sharing of Mass Spec technology, market trends, and competitor information.

• Strengthen expertise in automation systems, LC-MS/MS analysis principles, and Total laboratory automation integration technology.

• Continuously develop sales competencies (negotiation, strategic thinking, communication).

Who You Are

Education and Experience

• Major in a related field such as Life Science, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or Clinical Chemistry

• 5+ years of experience in the diagnostics, biotech, life science instruments, or analytical equipment sectors

Required and Preferred Experience

• Sales experience with LC-MS/MS or Mass Spec equipment portfolio

• Experience with LC-MS/MS reagent application (overall operation)

• Experience and understanding of clinical application of High Medical Value Assays, Vitamin D, Immunosuppressants, etc

• Understanding of the central laboratory operating environment, including Clinical Laboratory Automation Workflow, Laboratory Information System/Total laboratory automation, Clinical Chemistry/Immunoassay, or CBC

• Essential in English for technical communication and information sharing with Global/APAC teams

• Native-level proficiency in Korean is required

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities主要职责/责任
Product Release & Batch Documentation Management

• Batch Record Review: Lead the comprehensive review and approval of all Batch Production Records (BPR) and Batch Control Records (BCR) to ensure completeness, accuracy, and strict adherence to cGMP standards.

• Release Decision & Certification: Facilitate the efficient and timely release of products by verifying all testing results against specifications and issuing Certificates of Analysis (CoA) for final batch disposition.

• Aseptic Oversight: Oversee the local batch release process specifically for aseptic filling and packaging operations, ensuring that sterility assurance and environmental monitoring data support the release.

Materials Management & Supplier Quality

• Material Disposition: Manage the quality oversight of raw materials, consumables, and primary packaging materials, ensuring they are sampled, tested, and released on-time to support production schedules.

• Perform thorough risk assessments to identify potential quality risks, develop and implement risk mitigation strategies

• Supplier Lifecycle Management: Lead the quality evaluation and qualification of material suppliers based on risk-based quality criteria and international regulatory requirements.

Service Provider & Third-Party Oversight

• External Service Governance: Manage the quality oversight of third-party service providers and external laboratories, ensuring that outsourced testing and GMP-related services (e.g., calibration, validation) meet internal quality standards.

• Quality Agreements: Drive the establishment and maintenance of Quality Agreements with service providers and third-party labs to clearly define compliance responsibilities.

• Audit & Inspection Readiness: Collaborate and lead during internal/external audits and Health Authority (HA) inspections, representing the quality status of supplier and service provider management systems.
Annual Product Quality Review (APQR) & Quality Trend Analysis

• APQR Compilation & Coordination: Lead the end-to-end preparation, coordination, and compilation of the Annual Product Quality Review (APQR) to evaluate the consistency of existing manufacturing processes and the appropriateness of current specifications.

• Data Synthesis & Statistical Analysis: Systematically review and analyze critical data, including batch records, out-of-specification (OOS) results, deviations, changes, and stability data, utilizing statistical tools to identify any adverse trends.

• Compliance Assessment: Evaluate the effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) and previous year’s recommendations to ensure continuous improvement in product quality and process robustness.

• Regulatory Reporting: Ensure the timely completion and archival of APQR reports in compliance with global regulatory requirements (e.g., NMPA, FDA, EMA), and present key findings during Quality Management Reviews or health authority inspections.

• Responsible for ensuring that product quality issues are correctly investigated, and that appropriate corrective and preventative actions are implemented. Review deviation/exception/ investigation reports.

• Support and represent QA during audits and inspections; may directly interact with regulatory agencies during on-site inspections.

• Maintain project timelines associated with initiatives to support the evolving business.

jobs.title: (Sr.) Country Medical Manager (GI)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
The Country Medical Manager (CMM) is a trusted, externally focused, scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key top-tier customers over a meaningful period of time, the CMM will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, and ensure that Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas.
The Medical function serves as a critical engine of competitiveness to ensure our innovations reach their full potential for patients with an end to end perspective. The role of the CMM is designed to maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, community engagement, medical practice adoption, and access to our portfolio by proactively capitalizing on "Moments that Matter" across the asset lifecycle.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Contributing with Medical Expertise (core & common):

• Medical Expertise: responsible for proactively contributing strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise within the relevant diseases informing differentiation of our pipeline and portfolio. Acting as a medical expert for the pipeline and portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Shape Strategy: Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a forward-thinking, scientifically sound and differentiated value story locally and communicate Roche’s contributions across key disease areas, reflecting an end-to-end business perspective that pulls through the strategy with impact.

2. Proactive Customer Engagement & Insights (core & common):

• Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: As a medical function our ambition is to spend the majority of our time proactively engaging with external customers as partners in the integrated customer engagement strategy. The CMM serves as the scientific and medical expert, proactively engaging top-tier TAEs, and other key stakeholders in full strategic and operational alignment with other in-field roles. In the pre-launch phase it is the priority to drive proactive E2E strategies that deliver superior experience, anticipate the future and shape medical practice accordingly. In the post-launch phase the engagement continues to ensure that the right patients are treated at the right time and the engagement scope expands on unserved patient populations. In-field engagement serves as a critical component of this overarching strategy for targeted scientific engagement. It is understood that based on business needs the CMM can serve as the primary point of contact for certain customers with the ambition to drive required healthcare system changes and where feasible earlier and broader adoption of our transformative portfolio.

• Medical Partnership & Education: Establish and maintain effective peer-to-peer relationships with external stakeholders and identify/develop science-driven collaborations withTAEs. Provide current, high-quality, integrated Medical Education plan and differentiating scientific information to external customers, support the scientific training of internal teams and ensure continuous education on medical knowledge for PPoC roles. Conduct high-quality, non-promotional International/National Scientific Exchanges to disseminate relevant data, foster physician confidence and clinical endorsement base

jobs.title: Biomarker Group Leader (Principal Scientist)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we create transformative medicines to tackle some of the world's toughest unmet healthcare needs for patients. At CICoR, we aspire to serve patients by leveraging China's life science ecosystem to accelerate scientific innovation and develop breakthrough medicines. Together, we cultivate a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility—one where our talented people are empowered and inspired to deliver extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

The mission of our biomarker team is to accelerate early-phase clinical development, through effective patient selection and enrichment, and generation and analysis of clinical biomarker data. These efforts enable proof-of-mechanism (PoM) demonstration and deeper disease understanding, supporting faster and more confident decision-making. In addition, we provide biomarker expertise to discovery projects to elucidate the molecular pathways that drive disease.

We are seeking a highly motivated individual to lead the biomarker team. In this role, you will strategize and deliver rigorous biomarker support across multiple disease areas—including Oncology, Immunology, Neurology, Cardiovascular & Metabolism, and Ophthalmology, etc.—to advance translational science in China. You will ensure strong contributions to programs in both early- and late-stage clinical development by collaborating with cross-functional teams in China and globally, as well as with key TAEs and CROs in China.

Roles and Responsibilities

• Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team of biomarker experts while also serving as an hands-on individual contributor.

• Define and drive the China biomarker strategy for early and late-phase clinical development programs, including providing program-specific feasibility assessments and execution plans.

• Serve as the biomarker subject matter expert on clinical development project teams, advising on disease biology and biomarker science.

• Support the generation and review of critical clinical development documents (e.g., protocols, ICFs) to ensure alignment with biomarker strategies.

• Partner with global biomarker and project teams to lead the execution of biomarker studies, including data analysis, interpretation, and reporting.

• Integrate preclinical, clinical, and real-world data to guide indication selection and develop patient enrichment strategies to increase the probability of clinical success for CICoR programs.

• Design and lead forward and reverse translational research studies in collaboration with internal and external partners to support the preclinical and clinical portfolio.

• Stay abreast of novel biomarker modalities and technologies to drive the prioritization and harmonization of biomarker platforms across the portfolio.

• Lead biomarker assay outsourcing efforts, including overseeing assay development, transfer, validation, and execution at CROs for both non-clinical and clinical studies.

• Ensure data integrity through critical review and validation of CRO-generated results.

• Identify, select, and manage external vendors and institutional collaborators to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality data .

Qualification

• PhD or MD in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Oncology, Immunology, etc.).

• Minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience in Translational Medicine, Clinical Development, or Biology research, with a strong preference for candidates possessing a background in biomarker research or clinical

At CICoR, we aspire to serve patients by leveraging China's life science ecosystem to accelerate scientific innovation and develop breakthrough medicines. Together, we cultivate a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility—one where our talented people are empowered and inspired to deliver extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed. The mission of our biomarker team is to accelerate early-phase clinical development, through effective patient selection and enrichment, and generation and analysis of clinical biomarker data. These efforts enable proof-of-mechanism (PoM) demonstration and deeper disease understanding, supporting faster and more confident decision-making. In addition, we provide biomarker expertise to discovery projects to elucidate the molecular pathways that drive disease. We are seeking a highly motivated individual to lead the biomarker team. In this role, you will strategize and deliver rigorous biomarker support across multiple disease areas—including Oncology, Immunology, Neurology, Cardiovascular & Metabolism, and Ophthalmology, etc.—to advance translational science in China. You will ensure strong contributions to programs in both early- and late-stage clinical development by collaborating with cross-functional teams in China and globally, as well as with key TAEs and CROs in China. Roles and Responsibilities
• Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team of biomarker experts while also serving as an hands-on individual contributor.
• Define and drive the China biomarker strategy for early and late-phase clinical development programs, including providing program-specific feasibility assessments and execution plans.
• Serve as the biomarker subject matter expert on clinical development project teams, advising on disease biology and biomarker science.
• Support the generation and review of critical clinical development documents (e.g., protocols, ICFs) to ensure alignment with biomarker strategies.
• Partner with global biomarker and project teams to lead the execution of biomarker studies, including data analysis, interpretation, and reporting.
• Integrate preclinical, clinical, and real-world data to guide indication selection and develop patient enrichment strategies to increase the probability of clinical success for CICoR programs.
• Design and lead forward and reverse translational research studies in collaboration with internal and external partners to support the preclinical and clinical portfolio.
• Stay abreast of novel biomarker modalities and technologies to drive the prioritization and harmonization of biomarker platforms across the portfolio.
• Lead biomarker assay outsourcing efforts, including overseeing assay development, transfer, validation, and execution at CROs for both non-clinical and clinical studies.
• Ensure data integrity through critical review and validation of CRO-generated results.
• Identify, select, and manage external vendors and institutional collaborators to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality data . Qualification
• PhD or MD in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Oncology, Immunology, etc.).
• Minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience in Translational Medicine, Clinical Development, or Biology research, with a strong preference for candidates possessing a background in biomarker research or clinical
