The Position
Purpose
This position supports the life cycle management program for all site equipment, facilities and utility system.

Key Responsibilities
Safety, Health & Environment:

• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.

• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.

• Support a strong Engineering and Maintenance Safety Culture that encourages taking the right amount of time to perform each task safely.

Lean Production System:

• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

Reliability Engineering

• Support reliability improvement strategy.

• Proactively analyze plant reliability & downtime data to identify current & potential defects working in collaboration with Maintenance & Utilities Operations, Quality, Technology & Manufacturing.

• Support optimization of the application of preventive and predictive maintenance in order to achieve the right maintenance strategy & techniques for our manufacturing process equipment & site utility systems without compromising safety or compliance.

• Support data analysis for application of predictive Maintenance (PdM) methods such as oil analysis, thermography, vibration analysis, etc.

• Support analysis and compilation of reliability tools, equipment historical data, predictive technologies, and industry best practices to assist in determination and implementation of optimum equipment performance, maintenance strategies, and work processes. This includes supporting the development and analysis of criticality of equipment, maintenance strategy and spare parts.

• Assist in root cause analysis of reliability defects and verification of solution effectiveness

• Support Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) on process and utility equipment and systems.

• Identify trends and make recommendations based on data.

• Support optimization of performance (reliability, maintainability & availability) of our systems and cost effectiveness of reliability programs. This includes supporting the application of condition based preventive maintenance strategies.

• Analyze routine maintenance practices and assist in initiation and implementation of maintenance process changes that increase equipment and system uptime.

• Document system reliability issues and support equipment design change recommendations including supporting the evaluation of the cost benefit of changes to improve reliability.

• Assist in obsolescence tracking and management.

• Assist with new equipment purchase specifications, purchase decisions and installation qualification criteria.

• Provide support and input for the Asset Management Strategy.

• Interact with client groups, service providers, existing maintenance management, and Roche Network functions to leverage and support optimization of maintenance support resources, programs and practices.

• Assist MRO in the retention and archival of completed forms and documentation

• Complete all required in-house training in a timely manner

• All other duties and activities as directed by Supervisor

Qualifications

• Degree/Diploma in Engineering, preferably with knowledge of opera

jobs.title: Digital Campaign Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Campaign Specialist in the Digital Campaigns Chapter in the Global Digital Hub, you play a crucial role in driving the end-to-end orchestration of campaign content delivery across all channels and request types. You ensure seamless coordination between global and local teams, and achieve consistent messaging throughout the organization. You contribute to global and local content delivery, promote the adoption of global content and templatization.
In this role, you act as a content production coordinator, as well as an advisor to support affiliates in achieving their content goals while aligning with Roche’s digital vision. You build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders in the affiliate network, serving as the first point of contact for questions, ideas, and challenges.

Responsibilities

• Content production management: Drive the end-to-end orchestration of campaign and content delivery, across all channels and request types. Ensure delivery standards are met, and capture relevant feedback from stakeholders

• Content network facilitator: Initiate conversations between global and local teams to reflect needs, insights and learnings and achieve consistent messaging across the organization. Collaborate with the global brand engagement team on global/local content plans and reuse.

• Stakeholder Communication: Incorporate feedback from stakeholders, revise digital campaign content requests accordingly, and ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Build and maintain effective working relationships with the relevant stakeholders in the affiliate network by staying up-to-date with digital trends, industry innovations, and sharing best practices across affiliates.

• Empower affiliates to achieve their content goals while aligning with Roche’s digital vision.

• Support affiliates with content demand planning topics and integrate local demand forecast inputs into Roche's global demand planning methodology to ensure strategic alignment and readiness.

• Report and advise: Collect insights on localisation progress. Engage with the global brand team to communicate key insights and recommendations

Who you are

You are a proactive and skilled persona with a foundational background in coordinating content production and digital campaigns across various channels. You are adept at facilitating communication between global and local teams to ensure consistent messaging and effective content delivery. With a good understanding of the Life Science industry and its regulatory specific, your relationship-building skills enable you to effectively manage stakeholder expectations.

Further requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in content production, project management, or digital campaign management, with a focus on coordinating digital marketing initiatives across multiple channels.

• Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, content creation, and campaign management.

• Experience working with the Australian market.

• Familiarity with the Life Science industry, including key local compliance and regulatory concepts is an advantage.

• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with a proven track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with experience in facilitating collaboration between global and local teams.

• Proficiency in project management tools and software, with a readi

titleByLocale.de: Referendariat - Juristische Wahlstation am Standort Mannheim (m/w/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Referendariat - Juristische Wahlstation am Standort Mannheim (m/w/d)

Dein Team

Roche ist eines der weltweit führenden Biotechnologieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Medikamente, Diagnostika und digitale Lösungen, um die Gesundheitsversorgung nachhaltig zu verbessern. Gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft zu gestalten, heißt für uns, Stärken zu verbinden, Innovationen zu fördern und Verantwortung zu übernehmen - in einem Umfeld voller Vertrauen, Vielfalt und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Unser Team der Rechtsabteilung Deutschland berät die Geschäftsführungen der deutschen Landesgesellschaften sowie deren Geschäftsbereiche und Tochterunternehmen in allen Rechtsangelegenheiten. Zum umfassenden Aufgabengebiet, in das der Referendar (m/w/d) praxisnah und aktiv miteinbezogen wird, gehören die Prüfung von Rechtsfragen, die Erteilung von Rechtsrat sowie die Mitgestaltung von Vertragsverhältnissen mit Kunden und Kooperationspartnern. Wir bieten eigenständiges Arbeiten mit der Möglichkeit des direkten Mandantenkontaktes an.

Unser Team am Standort Mannheim besteht aus 6 Legal Counsel, 4 Paralegal sowie unserem Compliance Team. Wir arbeiten standortübergreifend Hand in Hand mit unseren Kollegen in Penzberg, Grenzach, der Schweiz und den Roche-Affiliates.

Unser Arbeitsstil ist von Wertschätzung, Technologie-Offenheit, guter Teamarbeit, Kreativität sowie nicht zuletzt Spaß an den Aufgaben geprägt. Auf diese Weise erreichen wir nicht nur passende, sondern innovative Lösungen für unsere Geschäftsbereiche.

Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Dein Referendariat

Im Rahmen deiner juristischen Wahlstation hast du bei uns als Referendar (m/w/d) die Möglichkeit, die Arbeitswelt eines Juristen in einem internationalen Großkonzern kennenzulernen.

Deine Aufgaben

• An der Seite unserer Legal Counsel bearbeitest du nationale und internationale Fragestellungen aus dem allgemeinen Wirtschaftsrecht und gewerblichen Rechtsschutz, Einblicke in weitere Rechtsgebiete möglich.

• Du wirkst bei Vertragsverhandlungen und der Vertragsgestaltung für den Abschluss künftiger Kooperationen – bspw. mit Universitäten oder Kliniken – mit.

• Das Erstellen von Gutachten unterschiedlichster Fragestellungen legen wir vertrauensvoll in deine Hände.

• Als Teil unseres kreativen Teams wirkst du zudem aktiv an nationalen und internationalen Projekten mit.

• Dein Examen hat Priorität, daher unterstützen wir deine ganzheitliche Ausbildung und stellen sicher, dass dir genügend Zeit für Arbeitsgemeinschaften und die Vorbereitung auf die mündliche Prüfung bleibt.

Deine Benefits

Unser Standort Mannheim liegt mit knapp 8.700 Mitarbeitenden im Herzen der Metropolregion Rhein-Neckar. Wir sind drittgrößter Standort von Roche weltweit. Damit du neben dem Lerneffekt auch die Vorteile unseres Standortes nutzen kannst, bieten wir unseren Referendaren u. a. folgende Benefits:

• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung (in Präsenz vor Ort/Home-Office)

• Attraktive monatliche Vergütung

• Vielfältige Unterstützung bei Fragen rund um dein

titleByLocale.en: Integrated Medical Engagement Change Management Lead
titleByLocale.de: Integriertes Medical Engagement Change Management Lead
titleByLocale.fr: Engagement médical intégré Responsable de la gestion du changement

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Integrated Medical Engagement Catalyst team is at the heart of designing and delivering modernised medical communication and engagement models. As part of the Global Integrated Medical Engagement chapter in PDMA, we focus on the evolution of medical engagement and the tools, processes, and mindsets required for the future. We bridge the gap between today’s standards and a future defined by personalised, scientific exchange.

As a Change Management Lead, you will be a "Catalyst" for organisational transformation. You will ensure that our medical network successfully navigates shifts in how we communicate and engage with customers by addressing both systemic requirements and day-to-day implications for individuals. This is a highly collaborative role, working across PDMA, GIME, and our global affiliate medical network to make our new engagement frameworks a sustainable reality.

• Architect the Change Journey: Design and implement end-to-end transformation strategies that bridge the gap between initial design and sustainable business-as-usual adoption.

• Lead Change Interventions: Serve as the primary change lead for major work packages, integrating human-centric plans into the technical delivery of new frameworks.

• Drive a Future-Ready Culture: Foster a growth and experimental mindset across the medical network, empowering teams to move toward proactive, value-based relationships.

• Ensure Sustainable Adoption: Establish and nurture a network of change agents and champions to drive adoption and ensure new frameworks are successfully scaled globally.

• Design Learning Strategies: Execute learning strategies that upskill the workforce in digital fluency and insight-driven engagement for the future operating model.

• Influence Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Commercial, Digital, and Technology partners to ensure a "One Roche" approach to the customer experience.

• Uphold Ethical Standards: Ensure all activities follow legal, regulatory, and company codes of practice, including HCP engagement policies and Roche directives.

Who You Are

You are a visionary leader who thrives in complex, fast-changing environments and has a passion for guiding people through transformational shifts. You look beyond current processes to solve customer pain points and are skilled at translating technical shifts into human-centric value propositions. You are a natural coach and facilitator, able to navigate ambiguity and build trust across a global matrix.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Expert Qualifications: An advanced life-science degree (PhD, PharmD, or MD) or equivalent experience in organisational development, alongside 5+ years of Medical Affairs knowledge.

• Change Mastery: Proven experience applying structured change management frameworks (e.g., Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter) to large-scale organisational shifts, preferably in an Agile environment.

• Strategic Storytelling: The ability to craft a compelling "Case for Change" that connects transformation to higher business impact and the "Triple Win."

• Matrix Fluency: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to speak the language of medical, digital, and commercial teams to drive a unified vision.

• Problem-Solving Agility: Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritise tasks, anticipate barriers, and focus on successful outcomes.

Relocation benefits are available for this position

Who we are
A healthier future drive

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità Il team di Engagement Medical Engagement Catalyst è al centro della progettazione e della fornitura di modelli di comunicazione medica e di fidanzamento modernizzati. Nell'ambito del capitolo Global Integrated Medical Engagement in PDMA, ci concentriamo sull'evoluzione dell'impegno medico e degli strumenti, processi e mentalità necessari per il futuro. Colpiamo il divario tra gli standard di oggi e un futuro definito da uno scambio scientifico personalizzato. Come Lead Change Management, sarai un "Catalyst" per la trasformazione organizzativa. Ti assicurerai che la nostra rete medica naviga con successo i cambiamenti nel modo in cui comunichiamo e ci impegniamo con i clienti affrontando sia i requisiti sistemici che le implicazioni quotidiane per gli individui. Questo è un ruolo altamente collaborativo, lavorando in PDMA, GIME, e la nostra rete medica di affiliazione globale per rendere i nostri nuovi framework di fidanzamento una realtà sostenibile.
• Architetto il Change Journey: Design e implementare strategie di trasformazione end-to-end che colmano il divario tra progettazione iniziale e adozione sostenibile business-as-ual.
• Interventi di cambiamento di piombo: Servire come il cambiamento primario piombo per i principali pacchetti di lavoro, integrando piani umani-centrici nella consegna tecnica di nuovi quadri.
• Guidare una cultura Future-Ready: promuovere una crescita e una mentalità sperimentale attraverso la rete medica, consentendo ai team di muoversi verso relazioni proattive e basate sul valore.
• Assicurare l'adozione sostenibile: istituire e nutrire una rete di agenti e campioni di cambiamento per guidare l'adozione e garantire che i nuovi quadri siano scalati con successo a livello globale.
• Strategie di apprendimento di progettazione: Eseguite strategie di apprendimento che migliorano la forza lavoro nella fluidità digitale e l'impegno orientato agli insight per il futuro modello operativo.
• Influenza Cross-Functional Alignment: Collabora con partner commerciali, digitali e tecnologici per garantire un approccio "One Roche" all'esperienza del cliente.
• Aggiornare gli standard etici: assicurarsi che tutte le attività seguano i codici legali, normativi e aziendali, comprese le politiche di impegno HCP e le direttive Roche. Chi sei Sei un leader visionario che prospera in ambienti complessi e in rapida evoluzione e ha una passione per guidare le persone attraverso cambiamenti trasformazionali. Si guarda oltre i processi attuali per risolvere i punti di dolore del cliente e sono abili a tradurre i cambiamenti tecnici nelle proposizioni di valore umano-centrico. Sei un allenatore naturale e facilitatore, in grado di navigare ambiguità e costruire la fiducia in una matrice globale. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Qualifiche di esperti: un grado avanzato di vita-scienza (PhD, PharmD, o MD) o un'esperienza equivalente nello sviluppo organizzativo, insieme a 5+ anni di conoscenza degli Affari medici.
• Cambia Mastery: Esperienza comprovata che applica quadri di gestione dei cambiamenti strutturati (ad esempio Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter) a turni organizzativi su larga scala, preferibilmente in un ambiente Agile.
• Storytelling Strategico: La capacità di creare una convincente "Case for Change" che collega la trasformazione ad un maggiore impatto commerciale e alla "Triple Win".
• Matrix Fluency: eccellenti competenze interpersonali con la capacità di parlare il linguaggio dei team medici, digitali e commerciali per guidare una visione unificata.
• Problem-Solving Agility: Forte capacità di gestione del progetto con la capacità di priorità compiti, anticipare le barriere e concentrarsi sui risultati di successo. Le prestazioni di trasferimento sono disponibili per questa posizione Chi siamo Un futuro più sano

Im Rahmen des Global Integrated Medical Engagement Kapitels in PDMA konzentrieren wir uns auf die Entwicklung des medizinischen Engagements und der für die Zukunft erforderlichen Werkzeuge, Prozesse und Denkweisen. Wir überbrücken die Lücke zwischen den heutigen Standards und einer Zukunft, die durch personalisierten, wissenschaftlichen Austausch definiert wird. Als Change Management Lead werden Sie ein "Katalyst" für die organisatorische Transformation sein. Sie werden sicherstellen, dass unser medizinisches Netzwerk erfolgreich die Verschiebungen in der Kommunikation und in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden anspricht, indem wir sowohl systemische Anforderungen als auch tägliche Implikationen für Einzelpersonen ansprechen. Dies ist eine hochkollaborative Rolle, die über PDMA, GIME und unser globales Affiliate medizinisches Netzwerk arbeitet, um unsere neuen Engagement-Frameworks zu einer nachhaltigen Realität zu machen.
• Architekt der Change Journey: Design und implementieren End-to-End-Transformationsstrategien, die die Lücke zwischen Erstgestaltung und nachhaltiger Unternehmensannahme überbrücken.
• Lead Change Interventions: Die primäre Änderung führt für große Arbeitspakete, die Integration human-zentrischer Pläne in die technische Lieferung neuer Rahmen.
• Führen Sie eine zukunftsfähige Kultur: Foster ein Wachstum und experimentelle Denkweise über das medizinische Netzwerk hinweg und befähigen Teams, sich auf proaktive, wertbasierte Beziehungen zu bewegen.
• Gewährleistung einer nachhaltigen Adoption: Aufbau und Pflege eines Netzwerks von Change Agenten und Champions, um die Adoption voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass neue Rahmenbedingungen weltweit erfolgreich skaliert werden.
• Design Learning Strategies: Lernstrategien ausarbeiten, die die Belegschaft in digitaler Grippe und insight-driven Engagement für das zukünftige Betriebssystem verbessern.
• Einfluss Cross-Functional Alignment: Zusammenarbeit mit Handels-, Digital- und Technologiepartnern, um einen "One Roche"-Ansatz zum Kundenerlebnis zu gewährleisten.
• Ethische Standards aufrecht erhalten: Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Aktivitäten den rechtlichen, regulatorischen und Unternehmenscodes der Praxis, einschließlich der HCP-Verlobungsrichtlinien und Roche-Richtlinien, folgen. Wer bist du? Sie sind ein visionärer Führer, der in komplexen, sich schnell verändernden Umgebungen lebt und die Leidenschaft hat, Menschen durch Transformationsverschiebungen zu leiten. Sie blicken über aktuelle Prozesse hinaus, um Kundenschmerzen zu lösen und sind fachkundig, technische Verschiebungen in human-zentrische Wertvorstellungen zu übersetzen. Sie sind ein natürlicher Trainer und Moderator, in der Lage, Mehrdeutigkeit zu navigieren und Vertrauen in eine globale Matrix zu schaffen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie:
• Expertenqualifikationen: Ein fortgeschrittener Life-Science-Abschluss (PhD, PharmD oder MD) oder gleichwertige Erfahrung in der Organisationsentwicklung, zusammen mit 5+ Jahren medizinischem Wissen.
• Change Mastery: Bewährte Erfahrungen bei der Anwendung strukturierter Change Management Frameworks (z.B. Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter) auf groß angelegte Organisationsverschiebungen, vorzugsweise in einer agilen Umgebung.
• Strategisches Storytelling: Die Fähigkeit, ein überzeugendes "Case for Change" zu schaffen, das die Transformation zu höheren Geschäftseinflüssen und dem "Triple Win" verbindet.
• Matrix Fluency: Ausgezeichnete zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, die Sprache der medizinischen, digitalen und kommerziellen Teams zu sprechen, um eine einheitliche Vision zu treiben.
• Problem-Solving Agility: Starke Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Aufgaben zu priorisieren, Barrieren zu antizipieren und sich auf erfolgreiche Ergebnisse zu konzentrieren. Verlagerungsleistungen für diese Position Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunftsfahrt

Dans le cadre du chapitre sur l'engagement médical global intégré de la PDMA, nous nous concentrons sur l'évolution de l'engagement médical et les outils, processus et mentalités nécessaires pour l'avenir. Nous comblons l'écart entre les normes actuelles et un avenir défini par des échanges scientifiques personnalisés. En tant que responsable de la gestion du changement, vous serez un "catalyseur" pour la transformation organisationnelle. Vous vous assurerez que notre réseau médical navigue avec succès dans la façon dont nous communiquons et intervenons avec les clients en répondant à la fois aux exigences systémiques et aux implications quotidiennes pour les individus. • Architect the Change Journey: Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de transformation de bout en bout qui comblent l'écart entre la conception initiale et l'adoption d'entreprises durables comme d'habitude.
• Mener des interventions de changement : servir de chef de file pour les grands ensembles de travaux, intégrer les plans axés sur l'homme dans la prestation technique de nouveaux cadres.
• Favoriser une culture axée sur l'avenir : favoriser une croissance et un état d'esprit expérimental dans l'ensemble du réseau médical, donner aux équipes les moyens de s'orienter vers des relations proactives fondées sur la valeur.
• Assurer l'adoption durable : établir et entretenir un réseau d'agents et de champions du changement pour favoriser l'adoption et veiller à ce que de nouveaux cadres soient appliqués avec succès à l'échelle mondiale.
• Concevoir des stratégies d'apprentissage : Exécuter des stratégies d'apprentissage qui améliorent la compétence de la main-d'œuvre en matière de fluidité numérique et d'engagement axé sur les connaissances pour le futur modèle opérationnel.
• Influence sur l'alignement interfonctionnel : Collaborer avec les partenaires commerciaux, numériques et technologiques pour assurer une approche « One Roche » de l'expérience client.
• Normes éthiques : veiller à ce que toutes les activités respectent les codes de pratique juridiques, réglementaires et d'entreprise, y compris les politiques d'engagement du HCP et les directives Roche. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader visionnaire qui prospère dans des environnements complexes et en évolution rapide et qui a une passion pour guider les gens à travers des changements transformationnels. Vous regardez au-delà des processus actuels pour résoudre les points de douleur du client et sont qualifiés pour traduire les changements techniques en propositions de valeur centrées sur l'homme. Vous êtes un entraîneur et un facilitateur naturel, capable de naviguer l'ambiguïté et de bâtir la confiance à travers une matrice globale. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Qualifications d'expert : Diplôme de sciences de la vie (PhD, PharmD ou MD) ou expérience équivalente en développement organisationnel, parallèlement à 5 ans de connaissances en affaires médicales.
• Maîtrise du changement : expérience éprouvée en appliquant des cadres structurés de gestion du changement (par exemple, Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter) à des changements organisationnels à grande échelle, de préférence dans un environnement agile.
• Histoire stratégique : la capacité d'élaborer un « cas pour le changement » convaincant qui relie la transformation à un impact commercial plus élevé et la « triple victoire ».
• Matrice Fluency: Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles avec la capacité de parler le langage des équipes médicales, numériques et commerciales pour conduire une vision unifiée.
• Agilité de résolution des problèmes : Des compétences solides en gestion de projet avec la capacité de prioriser les tâches, d'anticiper les obstacles et de se concentrer sur les résultats fructueux. Des prestations de réinstallation sont disponibles pour ce poste Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain

jobs.title: Pathology Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) is seeking a full-time Pathology Scientist (m/f/d) to join the Pathology team of the US-accredited Companion Diagnostics (CDx) laboratory located in Penzberg. If you have experience in Immunohistochemistry (IHC), in situ hybridization (ISH), or quantitative image analysis using artificial intelligence or machine learning, we want to hear from you!

At Roche PHCS, we value collaboration, innovation, and the drive to make significant contributions to healthcare. As part of our team, you'll work in a multidisciplinary environment, engaging with experts in bioinformatics, oncology, digital pathology, and biomarker development.

The Opportunity

Join a global team of over 20 pathologists located in both Germany and the United States who work together to drive innovation and bring new products to market. In this challenging role you will

• Provide medical oversight for pathology and slide reading for early phase clinical trials, assay development, CE-IVD and Pharma clients. Ensure quality and continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

• Support R&D activities for primary antibodies, detection systems, probes, special stains, and digital pathology, contributing to new product development and process improvements.

• Serve as the medical representative on project teams, addressing all pathology-related aspects and queries, and making strategic contributions through medical knowledge.

• Participate in Pharma client meetings to support biomarker hypothesis testing strategies, and drive activities for publication and/or patent potential.

• Coordinate the work of contracted pathologists, including training, assigning work and advising on day-to-day activities, as needed.

• Contribute to internal pathology education programs, perform training and scoring of slides, read clinical trial patient samples for the CDx laboratory (Penzberg), and stay up-to-date on pathology, oncology, and molecular biology literature.

• Serve as Principal Investigator with medical accountability across multiple European clinical trials within global CDx development programs, acting as the primary medical interface to Pharma partners.

• Provide medical oversight of laboratory processes, procedures, and quality management systems. Ensure compliance with local regulatory requirements as well as global Roche and international standards and supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

Who you are

• We seek a Pathologist (m/f/d) with German board certification, a valid German medical license and at least one year of clinical or industry experience

• The ideal candidates will have proven expertise in immunohistochemistry

• You are experienced in interpretation and assessment of primary antibodies, detection systems, probes, and molecular platforms

• You are proficient in providing pathology support to project teams and clinical trials

• Furthermore, you are skilled in leading people while communicating effectively, and working within multidisciplinary teams

Your Application
Please submit your updated CV. References and certificates are not required at this stage.
Please note that no additional documents can be submitted

jobs.title: （高级）渠道拓展策略经理

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable (senior) de la stratégie de développement des canaux

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
岗位名称：（高级）渠道拓展策略经理
工作地点：上海/北京

负责从战略规划到绩效达成的全流程管理。基于美多芭产品特性，构建医院广阔市场与院外零售市场双轨战略，与跨部门建立基于产品的高效合作机制，充分整合内外部资源、赋A能经销商，创新业务模式，最终实现业务的成功转型与稳健增长。

您将有机会：
负责核心战略规划与绩效管理：

• 分渠道策略制定： 深度洞察VBP政策、市场竞争及患者需求，分别制定美多芭在医院广阔市场与零售市场的精准业务策略、目标与实施路径。

• 整合策略设计： 主导制定医院与零售渠道的协同整合策略，确保患者在不同场景间的无缝流转。

• 策略迭代与优化： 建立策略追踪与评估体系，紧密监控落地过程，基于市场反馈与数据洞察，及时发起并领导策略的动态调整，确保战略敏捷性。

• 绩效目标设定： 主导设定两大渠道的年度/季度绩效目标，并确保目标清晰传达至所有相关执行团队及合作伙伴。

• 绩效监控与分析： 建立并主导定期的业务绩效复盘会议，深入分析绩效差距的根本原因，识别风险与机会。

负责跨部门领导与资源统筹：

• 横向协同枢纽：主动与销售市场部、销售部、医学部、财务及数字化团队进行无缝沟通与协调，确保各职能部门对整体战略的理解一致与行动同步。

• 资源整合与分配： 根据双轨策略的优先级，统筹并优化市场与渠道投入的预算与资源，向管理层提供基于投资回报分析的资金分配建议，确保资源投向最高价值领域。

负责生态构建与伙伴策略：

• 全域伙伴管理：主导构建基于产品特性的全域伙伴网络，从战略层面规划合作模式，赋能伙伴共同成长。

• 零售生态打造： 探索并推动与互联网医院、线上平台及患者社区等多元主体的深度合作，构建一个服务患者的创新零售生态体系。

创新模式探索与落地：

• 创新推广与患者管理： 探索并试点两个渠道的创新推广模式及患者管理模式。

• 创新支付与医疗生态： 牵头探索创新支付模式，并积极布局与各类医疗健康服务提供方的合作，共同构建服务于帕金森病患者的“诊-疗-付-管”一体化医疗新生态。

我们期待您：

• 本科及以上学历

• 8年以上药企经验，至少3年担任全国市场经理、高级产品经理或战略项目经理等职位，具有从策略制定到落地，并直接对业务指标达成负责的成功经验。

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As an Accounts Receivable & Treasury Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for AR & Treasury matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

You will be :

• You are responsible in processing Account receivable, treasury and inter-company task as per Service level Agreement.

• You process all cash application and remittance reconciliation for assigned countries accurately and within specific timescales. Then, you also prepare regularly the details of unallocated and unidentified receipts for key individuals further actions.

• You perform and responsible for credit analysis on customer according to company credit policy and procedures. Also, reviewing credit risk for new and existing customers by carry out credit assessment and make credit limit recommendation.

• You ensure customers pay within agreed payment terms, contacting sales team and customer on collection activities if vital as per company’s debt collection procedure.

• You ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines. You also engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project.

Who you are

• You possess Degree or Diploma in Finance & Accounting/Commerce or equivalent.

• You have minimum 3-5 years working experiences in Accounts Receivable and Treasury or other accounting functions

• Experience in using SAP or other ERP accounting systems will be added advantage.

• You possess good proficiency in English and Japanese language is required with good communication skill as the role will be supporting our counterpart in Japan.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Description of the area
The Network & Perimeter Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

Job description
As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Edge Defense), you will play a pivotal role in the end-to-end lifecycle of our perimeter and cloud security products. Your primary focus will be the global engineering, adoption, and optimization of our Edge security stack, including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), DDoS mitigation, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA). You are a technical "implementer" responsible for designing robust, high-availability architectures that protect our global network from external threats while enabling secure, seamless access to multi-cloud environments. By leveraging an "Automation-First" mindset, you will transform traditional perimeter controls into scalable, code-driven security services, ensuring Roche’s digital boundaries remain resilient in an evolving threat landscape.

Job responsibilities

1. Edge Architecture & Engineering

• Perimeter Defense Mastery: Lead the end-to-end deployment, configuration, and maintenance of Next-Generation Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet), ensuring high availability (Active/Active & Active/Passive) and optimal inspection performance across global entry points.

• Zero Trust Transition: Architect and implement ZTNA solutions to move beyond legacy VPNs, focusing on granular, application-level access and identity-aware security policies.

• Multi-Cloud Network Security: Engineer and manage cloud-native security controls within AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring consistent security posture across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

• DDoS & Threat Mitigation: Design and refine DDoS protection strategies and automated threat prevention policies (SSL decryption, IPS/IDS) to shield critical infrastructure from sophisticated external attacks.

​
2. Product Lifecycle & Evolution

• Lifecycle Governance: Oversee the delivery of Edge solutions from initial design through build, global rollout, and continuous optimization, ensuring that all security controls are reliable, scalable, and documented.

• Edge Innovation: Proactively identify emerging trends in Edge computing and SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) to inform the product roadmap and maintain a competitive advantage in network defense.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the lead engineer for complex network security escalations, performing deep-packet analysis and root-cause investigations to implement long-

This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

Job Description
As the Lead for Network Security Infrastructure Observability, you will be the primary architect and engineer responsible for the health, availability, and performance of our global security infrastructure. This is a hands-on technical leadership role that requires a solid foundation in Network Security engineering. You will architect, design, build, and operate the monitoring frameworks that ensure our security platforms (Firewalls, NAC, ZTNA) are running at peak operational efficiency. While your focus is on Infrastructure Reliability, success in this role depends on your deep technical understanding of how security controls—such as packet inspection, encryption, and access policies—impact system performance. By bridging the gap between security hardware/software (Palo Alto, Fortinet, ISE) and modern observability toolchains (LogicMonitor, Python, IaC), you will ensure that the organization’s security "engine" is always visible, resilient, and perfectly tuned.

Job Responsibilities

1. Infrastructure Architecture, Design & Build

• Security-Aware Monitoring Architecture: Architect and design a global visibility framework for understanding the key performance, health, and throughput indicators of core security appliances across services such as Edge Firewalls, Network Access Control (NAC), DDoS Mitigation, Network Authentication, Internal Network Segmentation, and VPNs.

• Observability Engineering: Build and deploy the observability toolchain specifically optimized to monitor the hardware and virtualized instances of Palo Alto, Fortinet, and Cisco ISE.

• LogicMonitor Development: Hands-on creation and tuning of DataSources and ConfigSources to capture hardware-level security telemetry (CPU/Data Plane utilization, Session counts, Tunnel health, and HA synchronization).

• Service Health Dashboarding: Design and build real-time operational dashboards that provide a clear view of the health, performance, and compliance status of the global security infrastructure.

​
2. Infrastructure Operations & Evolution

• Global Service Operations: Operate the global monitoring environment, ensuring the continuous health of the observability stack across diverse network segments and security zones.

• Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Leverage APIs and automation (Python/GitLab) to automate the provisioning of monitoring for new security devices, ensuring a "security-first" approach to visibility.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GPC Training and Service Quality Lead
Department: Global Patient Care (GPC)
Area: Global Customer Support (GCS)
Reports to: GPC Support Lead
Location: Sant Cugat, Spain

About the Role
The Training and Service Quality Lead for Global Patient Care (GPC) plays a pivotal role in shaping service excellence across Roche Diagnostics' customer support network. Leading a dedicated team of Training and Service Quality Specialists, this role ensures the development and implementation of robust training programs and quality assurance frameworks that enable consistent, high-quality, patient-centered care.

Collaborating closely with GPC leadership, you will drive strategies that enhance skill development, align with global service standards, and foster a culture of continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with regulatory and quality standards. Through effective leadership and data-driven insights, you will strengthen the quality and efficiency of interactions with patients and customers, advancing Roche's mission to deliver transformative healthcare solutions.

Your Responsibilities
Strategic Program Development:

• Identify training and service quality improvement opportunities by collaborating with regional Customer Support hubs, Business Implementation Specialists, and other GPC functions to ensure services evolve with business needs

• Design, enhance, or discontinue training and quality programs to uphold service excellence while ensuring compliance with auditable training standards

• Lead projects related to improvements and changes within Global Patient Care to meet evolving business needs

Customer Experience & Operational Excellence:

• Establish and continuously improve a global training and service quality framework to deliver consistent, high-standard customer and patient experiences

• Define and implement operational standards to ensure excellence in Training and Service Quality across all regions

• Implement a robust quality monitoring framework for external Customer Support operations

• Utilize customer satisfaction metrics, feedback, and operational data to identify trends and improvement areas

Training Program Design and Delivery:

• Lead the development and execution of training programs tailored to enhance competencies of frontline teams and specialists

• Ensure training initiatives align with global service delivery objectives and support achievement of organizational KPIs

• Work with external partners to define and implement global training standards

Quality Assurance & Compliance:

• Implement a robust quality assurance framework to monitor and improve interactions with patients and customers

• Ensure compliance with global standards for CRM systems, contact center operations, and regulatory requirements

• Report directly to GPC Leadership to guarantee consistent, high-standard experiences while supporting delivery of Roche's innovative products and digital solutions

KPI Management & Analysis:

• Track, analyze, and report key performance indicators related to training effectiveness and service quality

• Provide actionable insights to leadership teams and regional operations to drive continuous improvement

Team Leadership & Development:

• Foster a culture of excellence, inclusivity, and collaboration while driving team and individual performance

• Lead by example as a VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leader; set clear goals, provide continuous guidance, motivation, coaching, and feedback

• Cultivate an inspiring, in

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche is the world’s #1 provider of companion diagnostics and offers unrivaled experience in developing and commercializing predictive diagnostics that enable personalized treatment strategies for cancer patients. We offer unique opportunities for pathologists interested in playing a role in the development and implementation of new assays critical to our goal of providing more patient access to innovative new therapies. You have an opportunity to work with leading edge technologies, such as Immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, immunofluorescence, multiplex assays, digital pathology and more. This position is based onsite in Tucson, AZ

The Opportunity:

• You will provide crucial pathology and slide reading support for assay development, FDA submissions, clinical trials and collaborating with internal and external development teams.

• You will be at the forefront of research and development activities by supporting the development of primary antibodies, detection systems, probes and special stains.

• You will advise on future pathology and medical needs.

• You will be a medical representative on project core teams and contribute to pathology related aspects of specific development projects.

• You will drive continuous improvement in work processes, making a direct impact on the efficiency and effectiveness of our operations.

• You will utilize your expertise to advise on future pathology and medical needs, ensuring that we stay ahead of the curve in our industry

Who you are:

• You have an M.D. or D.O. with US Board Certification in Anatomic Pathology and an active state medical license.

• You are Residency-trained in anatomic pathology with expertise in surgical pathology and a proven ability to assess histopathology, IHC, ISH, and multiplex assays.

• You are experienced in evaluating complex immunohistochemistry assays such as PD-L1, HER2, and Ki-67.

• You are a precision medicine innovator and are Passionate about companion diagnostics (CDx) and the "right drug, right patient, right time" philosophy.

• You are a tech-Forward collaborator: Comfortable utilizing digital pathology scanners, automated algorithms, and advanced staining platforms (VENTANA Benchmark).

• You thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment, working seamlessly with scientists, engineers, and other experts to drive FDA submissions and clinical trial success.

​ Preferred Qualifications:

• Fellowship trained with 1 year of experience in clinical practice or industry.

• Prior experience in immunohistochemistry, cytology, molecular and/or genetics

​
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson, AZ is 174,000-323,100. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance.

This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable du produit HI Enterprise Cloud

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud (Senior Product Leader) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement of a complex product. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape.

Your primary objective is to define the direction for the engineering and service teams to build desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards.

Your main responsabilities:

• Drive the Product Vision: Define and execute the comprehensive strategy and roadmap for the Enterprise Cloud portfolio to accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics.

• Manage the Full Lifecycle: Take accountability for the entire product journey, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to scaling and retirement of complex cloud solutions.

• Lead Cloud Transformation: Orchestrate Roche’s "Cloud-First" strategy by optimizing for speed and release cadence to meet the evolving demands of Enterprise and R&D products.

• Foster Strategic Collaboration: Navigate a broad ecosystem of internal teams, external SaaS vendors, and academic partners to ensure seamless platform integration and API management.

• Ensure Compliance and Excellence: Balance innovation with strict adherence to industry standards, including GxP, while integrating AI capabilities to maintain a competitive advantage.

Who you are:

• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 10+ years in product management or business analysis with a proven history of launching and managing complex technology products.

• Industry Expert: You have 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology sector.

• Proven People Manager: You possess 2+ years of experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary technical teams.

• Technically Proficient: You hold a University Degree and have deep knowledge of modern software architecture, Cloud Hyperscalers, and Container as a Service (CaaS).

• Regulatory and Data Savvy: You are well-versed in GxP, FAIR data principles, and data privacy regulations such as GDPR to ensure secure and compliant foundations.

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

Questo ruolo è fondamentale per trasformare le esigenze scientifiche e aziendali in soluzioni tecnologiche tangibili e ad alto valore. Sarete responsabili di definire la visione del prodotto, la strategia e la roadmap, assicurando che si allinea con gli obiettivi di overarching della nostra organizzazione e, infine, accelera la consegna di diagnostica e medicine che cambiano la vita ai pazienti. Questo ruolo richiede una combinazione distintiva di inquisitività scientifica, competenza tecnica e business insight per navigare con successo nel paesaggio. Il vostro obiettivo primario è quello di definire la direzione per i team di ingegneria e di servizio per costruire prodotti desiderabili, fattibili, fattibili e sostenibili che soddisfino le esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri utenti interni, pur mantenendo una stretta conformità con i relativi standard del settore. Le sue principali responsabilità:

• Gestire il ciclo di vita completo: Prendere la responsabilità per l'intero viaggio del prodotto, dall'ideazione iniziale e dalla pianificazione strategica fino alla scalabilità e al pensionamento di soluzioni cloud complesse.
• Lead Cloud Transformation: la strategia "Cloud-First" di Orchestrate Roche ottimizza la velocità e la cadenza di rilascio per soddisfare le esigenze in evoluzione dei prodotti Enterprise e R&D.
• Foster Strategic Collaboration: Navigare un ampio ecosistema di team interni, fornitori esterni di SaaS e partner accademici per garantire l'integrazione della piattaforma senza soluzione di continuità e la gestione delle API.

• Esperto del settore: hai 2 anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o della tecnologia sanitaria regolamentata.
• Proven People Manager: Possiedi 2+ anni di esperienza leader, mentoring e sviluppo di team tecnici altamente performanti e multidisciplinari.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud (Senior Product Leader) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement of a complex product. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape.

Your primary objective is to define the direction for the engineering and service teams to build desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards.

Your main responsabilities:

• Drive the Product Vision: Define and execute the comprehensive strategy and roadmap for the Enterprise Cloud portfolio to accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics.

• Manage the Full Lifecycle: Take accountability for the entire product journey, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to scaling and retirement of complex cloud solutions.

• Lead Cloud Transformation: Orchestrate Roche’s "Cloud-First" strategy by optimizing for speed and release cadence to meet the evolving demands of Enterprise and R&D products.

• Foster Strategic Collaboration: Navigate a broad ecosystem of internal teams, external SaaS vendors, and academic partners to ensure seamless platform integration and API management.

• Ensure Compliance and Excellence: Balance innovation with strict adherence to industry standards, including GxP, while integrating AI capabilities to maintain a competitive advantage.

Who you are:

• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 10+ years in product management or business analysis with a proven history of launching and managing complex technology products.

• Industry Expert: You have 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology sector.

• Proven People Manager: You possess 2+ years of experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary technical teams.

• Technically Proficient: You hold a University Degree and have deep knowledge of modern software architecture, Cloud Hyperscalers, and Container as a Service (CaaS).

• Regulatory and Data Savvy: You are well-versed in GxP, FAIR data principles, and data privacy regulations such as GDPR to ensure secure and compliant foundations.

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicine

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
We are currently looking for two Process Technicians to join our Process Engineering team on a 12-month contract , with the possibility of extension. Both positions will involve the same day-to-day responsibilities outlined below; however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

As a Process Technician you will work closely with the sensor manufacture and packaging teams and will become highly skilled and competent in all aspects of manufacturing (e.g. line operation & packaging, processes and procedures). Be able to diagnose product and process issues quickly and effectively using a logical approach. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring the highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained. Analyse manufacturing data and conduct product / process testing to ensure CTQs are met. Update documentation such as standard operating procedures, work instructions and bills of material.

This is an on-site role based at our Athena Motherwell location. Please note that you will spend approximately 70% of your time working from our Bathgate site, however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

Responsibilities:
Technical:

• Work in close collaboration with manufacturing technicians and engineers to become highly competent in sensor manufacture line operation, processes and procedures

• Support monitoring of product and process data using statistical analysis techniques

• Quick and effective diagnosis and troubleshooting of problems using a methodical approach and report progress in a structured way

• Conduct CTQ testing and material / product analysis techniques

• Investigate and resolve non-conformances and help develop robust OCAP’s and preventative measures

• Support NPD projects through transfer of pilot work to high volume manufacture

• Support validation activities and completion of validation documentation in line with business needs

• Help drive continuous improvement initiatives through engagement of production team on shift

• Ensures highest levels of quality and compliance are maintained

• Lead/support change control updates to manufacturing documentation.

Who you are:

Essential Education/ Qualifications:

• Process Excellence Yellow or Green belt additional advantage.

• Preferably Degree qualified or relevant experience.

• Experience in rotary converting and / or reel to reel printing (rotary screen / flexographic etc.) additional advantage

• Knowledge of Statistical Analysis methods / techniques

Requirements (incl. Key Skills):

• GMP experience

• A hands-on Process Technician with a good level of relevant industry experience (preferably medical device related)

• Experience of optimising product and processes

• High level of computer literacy

• Team player and takes accountability for any manufacturing challenges

• Analyse production data and conduct process / product analysis to ensure CTQs are met

• Strong problem-solving skills and sense of urgency

• Detail orientated and ensures highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained on a daily basis

Recruitment process

Phase I:

• Submission of Cover Letter & CV: Evaluation of technical skills and motivation.

Phase II:

• In-person interview in Athena Motherwell (will be shared with the shortlisted candidates later)

• Monitoraggio del supporto dei dati dei prodotti e dei processi utilizzando tecniche di analisi statistica
• Diagnosi rapida ed efficace e risoluzione dei problemi utilizzando un approccio metodologico e riferire i progressi in modo strutturato
• Condurre test CTQ e tecniche di analisi dei materiali / prodotti
• Indagare e risolvere non conformità e contribuire a sviluppare misure di prevenzione e di OCAP robuste
• Sostenere i progetti NPD attraverso il trasferimento di lavori pilota alla fabbricazione di volumi elevati
• Supportare le attività di validazione e il completamento della documentazione di validazione in linea con le esigenze aziendali
• Guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso l'impegno del team di produzione a turni
• Garantisce elevati livelli di qualità e conformità sono mantenuti
• Aggiornamenti di controllo delle modifiche di piombo/supporto alla documentazione di produzione. Chi sei: Educazione Essenziale/ Qualifiche:
• Processo Eccellenza Giallo o Verde cintura ulteriore vantaggio.
• Preferibilmente Laurea esperienza qualificata o rilevante.
• Esperienza nella conversione rotante e/o bobina nella stampa a bobina (schermo rotatorio / flessografico ecc.) ulteriore vantaggio
• Conoscenza dei metodi / tecniche di analisi statistica Requisiti (incl. competenze chiave):
• Esperienza GMP
• Un tecnico di processo pratico con un buon livello di esperienza industriale rilevante (preferibilmente dispositivo medico correlato)
• Esperienza di ottimizzazione dei prodotti e dei processi
• Alti livelli di alfabetizzazione del computer
• Giocatore di squadra e tiene conto delle sfide di produzione
• Analizzare i dati di produzione e condurre l'analisi del processo / del prodotto per garantire il raggiungimento di CTQ
• Forte capacità di problem solving e senso di urgenza

• Intervista in persona a Athena Motherwell (sarà condivisa con i candidati più brevi in seguito) Scopo - la nostra attenzione

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED ) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence (CoE) is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units (pRED and gRED) to become more data-driven, more digitally adept, and better prepared for the challenges of the future. Within the CoE, Computational Medicine focuses on developing and applying innovative data analysis solutions to support clinical development — furthering our understanding of disease, disease progression, and individual patient response to treatment. In partnership with our scientists across pRED and gRED, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

As Digital Measures Lead , you will play a pivotal role in embedding sensor-based digital health technologies into the heart of our pRED and gRED drug development programs. In disease areas like Alzheimer’s disease and Multiple Sclerosis, you will be responsible for shaping and executing on strategies that allow us to increase R&D productivity using digital clinical outcome assessments, digital biomarkers and exploratory digital measures collected from wearables, smartphones and other sensor-based digital health technologies (DHTs). You will be part of a team of experts located in Basel and South San Francisco and report to the Sensor Data Insights group lead in the Computational Biology and Medicine department.

The Opportunity:

• Partner with drug development teams to shape high-impact opportunities that drive clinical trial productivity improvements with sensor-based DHTs; embed them into disease area, clinical development, and biomarker strategies.

• Develop comprehensive roadmaps to realize these opportunities, including assessing unmet measurement needs; evaluating, developing, validating sensor-based DHTs; driving towards community and regulatory acceptance

• Lead the delivery of these roadmaps. This includes securing governance endorsement and resourcing; leading CoE matrix team delivery; managing vendor/technology partnerships; ensuring seamless integration of sensor-based DHTs into clinical trials, including study designs, operations, data analyses; supporting results interpretation.

• Foster external partnerships with industry, technology providers, academic centers, regulators, and patients to strengthen and accelerate these efforts.

• Drive scientific communication and thought leadership both within and outside Roche through conferences and peer-reviewed publications, while upholding scientific rigor and patient-centricity in all activities.

• Collaborare con i team di sviluppo della droga per creare opportunità ad alto impatto che favoriscano i miglioramenti della produttività di trial clinici con DHT basati sui sensori; integrarli in aree di malattia, sviluppo clinico e strategie di biomarcatore.
• Sviluppare mappe stradali complete per realizzare queste opportunità, compresa la valutazione delle esigenze di misura non soddisfatte; valutare, sviluppare, convalidare i DHT basati sui sensori; guidare verso l'accettazione della comunità e della regolamentazione
• Guidare la consegna di queste roadmap. Ciò include la garanzia di approvazione e risourcing della governance; la consegna del team di matrice CoE leader; la gestione dei partenariati di fornitori/tecnologie; l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità dei DHT basati sui sensori in studi clinici, tra cui progetti di studio, operazioni, analisi dei dati; l'interpretazione dei risultati di supporto.
• Promuovere partnership esterne con industria, fornitori di tecnologia, centri accademici, regolatori e pazienti per rafforzare e accelerare questi sforzi.
• Guidare la comunicazione scientifica e la leadership di pensiero sia all'interno che all'esterno di Roche attraverso conferenze e pubblicazioni peer-reviewed, mentre sostenere il rigore scientifico e la concentrazione dei pazienti in tutte le attività. Chi sei?
• Ha un Ph.D. o un'esperienza equivalente in Digital Health, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Neuroscience o una disciplina correlata accoppiata con almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale sfruttando DHT basati sui sensori per migliorare la produttività R&D nelle prove di Fase I-IV
• Possiedi una profonda esperienza in neuroscienze, tra cui la malattia di Alzheimer e la sclerosi multipla, e capire come i DHT basati sui sensori possono essere applicati per i casi di uso di prova clinica in queste aree (ad esempio l'efficacia/sicurezza

La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED ) Roche, nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles (CdE) est une organisation mondiale qui permet aux unités de recherche et de développement précoce de Roches (PRED et GRED) de devenir plus axées sur les données, plus performantes sur le plan numérique et mieux préparées aux défis de l'avenir. Au sein du Conseil de l'Europe, la médecine computationnelle met l'accent sur l'élaboration et l'application de solutions innovantes d'analyse de données pour soutenir le développement clinique. Nous créons de meilleurs médicaments en partenariat avec nos scientifiques dans les domaines de la R-D et de la R-D, grâce à notre culture axée sur les données. En tant que chef de file en matière de mesures numériques, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'intégration des technologies de santé numériques basées sur des capteurs au cœur de nos programmes de développement de médicaments PRED et GRED. La possibilité :
• S'associer à des équipes de développement de médicaments pour créer des possibilités à fort impact qui favorisent l'amélioration de la productivité des essais cliniques avec des DHT à base de capteurs; les intégrer dans les stratégies de lutte contre la maladie, de développement clinique et de biomarqueur.

Hier werden Sie für die Person, die Sie sind, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert, sodass Sie sich persönlich und beruflich entfalten können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Mensch heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. • Expertise in der Praxis: Sie leiten die Ausarbeitung lokaler Standards und sind der primäre Vertreter von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply bei der Machbarkeitsbewertung und Entwicklung globaler Anforderungen. • Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in der chemischen Synthese, chemischen Prozesstechnologien und der Produktion in einer cGMP-Umgebung.

• Als technischer Experte verstehen Sie es, Teams in einer Matrixorganisation zu motivieren und einen starken Zusammenhalt zu schaffen, um gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein.

• Ihre Stärken liegen in der Zusammenarbeit: Sie pflegen ausgezeichnete Beziehungen zu Stakeholdern und navigieren geschickt durch Verhandlungen und funktionsübergreifende Projekte.

• Sie sind ein aktiver Impulsgeber für den Wandel, der eine flexible und offene Kultur für neue Möglichkeiten schafft.

• Sie sind eine treibende Kraft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung und packen neue Herausforderungen mit Leidenschaft an.

• Sie kommunizieren fliessend in Deutsch und Englisch und überzeugen durch Ihre exzellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools is the primary technical authority responsible for architecting the transition from legacy SAP Solution Manager to a modern, future-proof ALM ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the strategic design and operational excellence of the global "Requirements to Deploy" process, ensuring that our delivery pipeline remains robust during a period of significant technological shift.

Your core mission is to navigate the complexities of SAP’s Cloud ALM offering while maintaining the flexibility to custom-build proprietary solutions when standard tools lack the necessary influence on design or functional depth. As part of your daily remit, you will:

Architect the Pivot: Actively evaluate the functional gaps within SAP Cloud ALM and decide where the organization must "Build" rather than "Buy." You will be responsible for the high-level design of custom ALM modules (potentially on SAP BTP or other cloud-native platforms) to ensure our specific business requirements are met.

Design the "Requirements to Deploy" Lifecycle and Lead Technical Decisioning: You will orchestrate the end-to-end framework including Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management. You are not just a tool user; you are the designer of the framework that enables these processes.

Govern Hybrid Landscapes: You will define the integration patterns required to link SAP-specific ALM components with the broader enterprise DevOps toolchain, ensuring a "clean core" strategy while managing the decommissioning of legacy SolMan/ChaRM environments.

Qualifications

• Mastery of ALM Transition & Toolsets: Expert-level knowledge of legacy ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) paired with the ability to architect migrations to SAP Cloud ALM.

• 8+ years of Custom Build & Extensibility Expertise: Proven experience in designing custom-built enterprise software or side-by-side extensions. You must demonstrate an "architectural mindset" capable of building bespoke tools when SaaS products offer limited design influence.

• SDLC & DevOps Proficiency: Deep understanding of ERP change management and transport layers, with a modern approach to API-first design, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release orchestration.

• Advanced competency in using AI-augmented engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, or equivalent) to improve code quality, automate documentation, and design intelligent extensions that bridge functional gaps in standard SaaS offerings

• Lifecycle Management: Proven track record of managing at least 2–3 full-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles, specifically focusing on the architectural trade-offs between "Standard" and "Custom" solutions.

• Strategic Compliance: Solid background in IT Service Management / ITIL, alongside experience in Computerized System Validation (CSV) and ICFR, ensuring custom-built ALM tools meet global regulatory standards.

• Global Architectural Leadership: Experience working in a large global company, demonstrating the ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders

• English Communication: Superior command of the English language (both written and verbal) is essential for collaborating with global stakeholders and presenting complex ALM strategies to leadership.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equ
