jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

The Analytics and Workflows group within the Center of Excellence (CoE) is dedicated to turning complex data into actionable insights that advance drug discovery and development. We leverage cutting-edge high-throughput technologies and foundational multimodal machine learning models to analyze large-scale chemical and biological data, enabling deeper understanding of molecular behavior and the identification of novel therapeutic opportunities. Despite advances in these fields, however, transforming raw data and computational models into meaningful insights remains a key challenge. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of data science, medicinal chemistry, and engineering to build innovative analytical tools that bridge the gap between data generation and interpretation, helping unlock new avenues for scientific discovery and impact.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack) to design and build interactive tools for small-molecule drug discovery, with a particular focus on chemical data, molecular design workflows, and model interpretability. You will shape the technical and product direction of platforms that enable medicinal and computational chemists to explore data, test hypotheses, and design better drugs. This role is fullstack, with a strong emphasis on scientific data visualization, workflow design, and integration with computational pipelines. Success will be measured not only by technical delivery, but by the impact on how scientists design and evaluate small-molecule candidates. Your work will include:

• Partnering directly with medicinal chemists, cheminformaticians, and AI scientists to understand real-world molecular design and analysis workflows, including ambiguous or evolving needs.

• Designing and building end-to-end platforms—spanning front-end interfaces, backend services, and data integrations—that enable scientists to run analyses, explore data, and interpret model outputs.

• Leading the development of intuitive, extensible user experiences for complex scientific workflows, with a focus on interactive visualization, usability, and scientific fidelity.

• Architecting and implementing APIs, data models, and services that support scalable, data-intensive applications, including integration with computational pipelines and machine learning systems.

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies (including AI-assisted development tools) to accelerate iteration, while exploring new approaches to scient

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, dati e scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il nuovo Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare questo potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e trasformativi per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. Il gruppo di analisi e flussi di lavoro all'interno del Centro di eccellenza (CoE) è dedicato a trasformare i dati complessi in insight attuabili che anticipano la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Ci avvaliamo di tecnologie all'avanguardia ad alto rendimento e modelli di machine learning multimodali fondamentali per analizzare i dati chimici e biologici su larga scala, consentendo una comprensione più approfondita del comportamento molecolare e l'identificazione di nuove opportunità terapeutiche. Nonostante i progressi in questi campi, tuttavia, la trasformazione dei dati grezzi e dei modelli computazionali in insight significativi rimane una sfida chiave. In questo ruolo, lavorerai all'intersezione della scienza dei dati, della chimica medica e dell'ingegneria per costruire strumenti analitici innovativi che colmano il divario tra la generazione dei dati e l'interpretazione, aiutando a sbloccare nuovi viali per la scoperta scientifica e l'impatto. L'opportunità Stiamo cercando un Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack) per progettare e costruire strumenti interattivi per la scoperta della droga di piccole molecole, con una particolare attenzione ai dati chimici, ai flussi di lavoro di progettazione molecolare e all'interpretazione del modello. Potrai modellare la direzione tecnica e del prodotto di piattaforme che permettono ai chimici medicinali e computazionali di esplorare i dati, le ipotesi di test e progettare farmaci migliori. Questo ruolo è fullstack, con una forte enfasi sulla visualizzazione dei dati scientifici, la progettazione del flusso di lavoro e l'integrazione con pipeline computazionali. Il successo sarà misurato non solo dalla consegna tecnica, ma dall'impatto su come gli scienziati progettano e valutano i candidati alla piccola molecola. Il vostro lavoro comprenderà:
• Collaborare direttamente con chimici medicinali, cheminformatici e scienziati dell'IA per comprendere i flussi di lavoro di progettazione e analisi molecolari del mondo reale, comprese le esigenze ambigue o in evoluzione.
• Progettazione e costruzione di piattaforme end-to-end: interfaccia front-end, servizi backend e integrazioni dei dati, che permettono agli scienziati di eseguire analisi, esplorare i dati e interpretare le uscite dei modelli.
• Conducendo lo sviluppo di esperienze utente intuitive ed estensibili per complessi flussi di lavoro scientifici, con un focus sulla visualizzazione interattiva, l'usabilità e la fedeltà scientifica.
• Architettare e implementare API, modelli di dati e servizi che supportano applicazioni scalabili, ad alta intensità di dati, tra cui l'integrazione con pipeline computazionali e sistemi di machine learning.
• Valutazione e applicazione delle tecnologie emergenti (inclusi gli strumenti di sviluppo assistiti dall'IA) per accelerare l'iterazione, esplorando nuovi approcci allo scient
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

The Analytics and Workflows group within the Center of Excellence (CoE) is dedicated to turning complex data into actionable insights that advance drug discovery and development. We leverage cutting-edge high-throughput technologies and foundational multimodal machine learning models to analyze large-scale chemical and biological data, enabling deeper understanding of molecular behavior and the identification of novel therapeutic opportunities. Despite advances in these fields, however, transforming raw data and computational models into meaningful insights remains a key challenge. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of data science, medicinal chemistry, and engineering to build innovative analytical tools that bridge the gap between data generation and interpretation, helping unlock new avenues for scientific discovery and impact.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack) to design and build interactive tools for small-molecule drug discovery, with a particular focus on chemical data, molecular design workflows, and model interpretability. You will shape the technical and product direction of platforms that enable medicinal and computational chemists to explore data, test hypotheses, and design better drugs. This role is fullstack, with a strong emphasis on scientific data visualization, workflow design, and integration with computational pipelines. Success will be measured not only by technical delivery, but by the impact on how scientists design and evaluate small-molecule candidates. Your work will include:

• Partnering directly with medicinal chemists, cheminformaticians, and AI scientists to understand real-world molecular design and analysis workflows, including ambiguous or evolving needs.

• Designing and building end-to-end platforms—spanning front-end interfaces, backend services, and data integrations—that enable scientists to run analyses, explore data, and interpret model outputs.

• Leading the development of intuitive, extensible user experiences for complex scientific workflows, with a focus on interactive visualization, usability, and scientific fidelity.

• Architecting and implementing APIs, data models, and services that support scalable, data-intensive applications, including integration with computational pipelines and machine learning systems.

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies (including AI-assisted development tools) to accelerate iteration, while exploring new approaches to scient

Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen von Genentech (gRED) und Pharma (pRED) haben gezeigt, wie diese Technologien die FuE beschleunigen, Daten nutzen und neue Rechenmodelle nutzen, um Auswirkungen zu erzielen. • Führen Sie die Entwicklung intuitiver, erweiterbarer Benutzererlebnisse für komplexe wissenschaftliche Workflows, mit Fokus auf interaktive Visualisierung, Usability und wissenschaftliche Treue.
• Erstellung und Implementierung von APIs, Datenmodellen und Dienstleistungen, die skalierbare, datenintensive Anwendungen unterstützen, einschließlich der Integration mit rechnerischen Pipelines und maschinellen Lernsystemen.
• Bewertung und Anwendung von aufstrebenden Technologien (einschließlich AI-gestützter Entwicklungstools) zur Beschleunigung der Iteration und Erkundung neuer Ansätze für Scient

Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les organisations de recherche et de développement précoce de Genentech (GRED) et de Pharma (PRED) ont démontré comment ces technologies accélèrent la R-D, en tirant parti des données et des nouveaux modèles de calcul pour stimuler l'impact. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez à l'intersection de la science des données, de la chimie médicinale et de l'ingénierie pour construire des outils analytiques novateurs qui comblent l'écart entre la production de données et l'interprétation, aidant à débloquer de nouvelles pistes de découverte scientifique et d'impact. L'opportunité Nous cherchons un ingénieur scientifique principal (Fullstack) pour concevoir et construire des outils interactifs pour la découverte de médicaments à petites molécules, en mettant l'accent sur les données chimiques, les workflows de conception moléculaire et l'interprétation des modèles. Vous façonnerez la direction technique et produit des plates-formes qui permettent aux chimistes médicaux et calculateurs d'explorer les données, de tester les hypothèses et de concevoir de meilleurs médicaments. Ce rôle est complet, l'accent étant mis sur la visualisation des données scientifiques, la conception des flux de travail et l'intégration avec les pipelines informatiques. Le succès sera mesuré non seulement par l'exécution technique, mais aussi par l'impact sur la façon dont les scientifiques conçoivent et évaluent les candidats aux petites molécules. Votre travail comprendra :
• Établir des partenariats directs avec des chimistes, des chimistes et des scientifiques de l'IA pour comprendre les processus de conception moléculaire et d'analyse du monde réel, y compris les besoins ambigus ou en évolution.
• Concevoir et construire des plates-formes de bout en bout, des interfaces front-end, des services de backend et des intégrations de données, qui permettent aux scientifiques d'effectuer des analyses, d'explorer des données et d'interpréter les résultats des modèles.
• Diriger le développement d'expériences utilisateur intuitives et extensibles pour des workflows scientifiques complexes, en mettant l'accent sur la visualisation interactive, la convivialité et la fidélité scientifique.
• Architecte et mise en œuvre d'API, de modèles de données et de services qui prennent en charge des applications évolutives et à forte intensité de données, y compris l'intégration avec des pipelines de calcul et des systèmes d'apprentissage automatique.
• Évaluer et appliquer les nouvelles technologies (y compris les outils de développement assistés par l'IA) pour accélérer l'itération, tout en explorant de nouvelles approches de la science

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

•
• M.D. Required

• Therapeutic knowledge within metabolism, obesity, and diabetes with relevant clinical, scientific, and clinical trial/development experience required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Interpersonal skills : Good interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority

CDP Strategy and Planning

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

ESPERIENZA E QUALIFICHE

-Academico/Scientifico/Clinico:
- MD richiesto
- Sono richieste conoscenze terapeutiche nell'ambito del metabolismo, dell'obesità e del diabete con rilevante esperienza clinica, scientifica e di sperimentazione/sviluppo clinico
- Il background accademico/didattico costituisce un plus
- Esperienza di lavoro con i principi e le tecniche di analisi, interpretazione e rilevanza clinica dei dati
- È preferibile l'esperienza nella pubblicazione dei risultati di uno studio scientifico in una rivista peer-reviewed
- Normativa: è preferibile la conoscenza degli aspetti medici di GCP (buona pratica clinica), ICH (conferenza internazionale sull'armonizzazione dei requisiti tecnici per la registrazione di prodotti farmaceutici per uso umano), FDA, EMA e altre linee guida e regolamenti pertinenti
- Durata dell'esperienza: 2 o più anni di esperienza accademica o clinica post-laurea
- Fino al 30% di viaggi globali

Competenze e comportamenti chiave

- Etica: ha un'etica impeccabile. Dimostra, o comprovata capacità di dimostrare, i valori Roche
- Attenzione ai dettagli: eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli
- Senso degli affari: ha una conoscenza pratica del settore farmaceutico/biotecnologico, delle molteplici funzioni e ruoli coinvolti nel processo di sviluppo dei farmaci. Conduce regolarmente lo sviluppo di strategie e piani di malattia
- Organizzazione: può dare priorità a più attività e obiettivi nel rispetto dei tempi, degli obiettivi e del budget
- Abilità interpersonali: buone capacità interpersonali, di comunicazione verbale e di influenza: può influenzare senza autorità
- Scrittura: forti capacità di comunicazione scritta
- Capacità di presentazione: buone capacità di presentazione aziendale; è comodo ed efficace quando si presenta agli altri, internamente o esternamente. Fiducioso e competente quando interagisce con gli altri internamente ed esternamente: rimane concentrato e puntuale, è in grado di sollevare problemi o sfide in modo produttivo e maturo
- Abilità di negoziazione: buone capacità di negoziazione: sa come completare i risultati finali lavorando in modo efficace con gli altri internamente ed esternamente
- Processo decisionale: sa come prendere decisioni di compromesso bilanciando etica ed efficacia
- Lavoro di squadra: forte orientamento al lavoro di squadra

DOVERI E RESPONSABILITÀ SPECIFICHE

Strategia e pianificazione CDP

- Partecipa allo sviluppo del piano CD per le molecole/indicazioni assegnate
- Raccoglie e analizza i dati e le informazioni necessarie per creare il piano CD
- Collabora con altri membri CST e sottoteam pertinenti per sviluppare componenti del piano CD (ad esempio, strategia di analisi/dati, sviluppo KOL, strategia di pubblicazioni, ecc.)
- Collabora con CST e altri team pertinenti per sviluppare e fornire informazioni e input per i requisiti di budget/risorse necessari per implementare ed eseguire il piano CD
- Rimane al passo con gli sviluppi interni ed esterni, le tendenze e le altre dinamiche rilevanti per il lavoro del CD per mantenere, in ogni momento, una visione e una prospettiva completamente attuali delle influenze interne/esterne e/o implicazioni per le aree terapeutiche e patologiche assegnate
- Se appropriato, partecipa ad informazioni sulla concorrenza e/o ad altre attività e progetti di valutazione del mercato/settore
- Mantiene gli standard e i livelli più elevati di conoscenza scientifica e clinica nelle specifiche aree terapeutiche e patologiche di incarico
- Collabora con una varietà di partner e parti interessate interni ed esterni, come ricercatori clinici, medici, scienziati e opinion leader chiave (KOL), nonché gruppi interni multidisciplinari, inclusi altri gruppi nel campo della malattia di Parkinson, della ricerca, dello sviluppo aziendale, delle attività commerciali

Selbstbewusst und kompetent im internen und externen Umgang mit anderen: Bleibt konzentriert und sachlich, ist in der Lage, Probleme oder Herausforderungen auf produktive und reife Weise anzusprechen

- Teamarbeit: Starke Ausrichtung auf Teamarbeit

SPEZIFISCHE AUFGABEN UND VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

CDP-Strategie und -Planung

- Beteiligt sich an der Entwicklung des CD-Plans für zugewiesene Moleküle/Indikationen.
- Sammelt und analysiert Daten und Informationen, die zur Erstellung des CD-Plans erforderlich sind
- Arbeitet mit anderen CST-Mitgliedern und relevanten Unterteams zusammen, um CD-Plankomponenten zu entwickeln (z. B. Analyse-/Datenstrategie, KOL-Entwicklung, Publikationsstrategie usw.)
- Arbeitet mit CST und anderen relevanten Teams zusammen, um Informationen und Input für Budget-/Ressourcenanforderungen zu entwickeln und bereitzustellen, die für die Implementierung und Ausführung des CD-Plans erforderlich sind
- Bleiben Sie über interne und externe Entwicklungen, Trends und andere Dynamiken, die für die Arbeit von CD relevant sind, auf dem Laufenden, um jederzeit eine vollständig aktuelle Sicht und Perspektive interner/externer Einflüsse und/oder Implikationen für die zugewiesenen Therapie- und Krankheitsbereiche aufrechtzuerhalten.
- Nimmt gegebenenfalls an Wettbewerbsanalysen und/oder anderen Markt-/Branchenbewertungsaktivitäten und -projekten teil
- Hält die höchsten Standards und Niveaus an wissenschaftlichem und klinischem Wissen in den spezifischen Therapie- und Krankheitsgebieten des Auftrages aufrecht
- Arbeitet mit einer Vielzahl interner und externer Partner und Stakeholder zusammen, wie z. B. klinischen Forschern, Klinikern, Wissenschaftlern und wichtigen Meinungsführern (KOLs), sowie multidisziplinären internen Gruppen, einschließlich anderer Gruppen in den Bereichen PD, Forschung, Geschäftsentwicklung und Handel
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descriptif

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

Le poste

EXPÉRIENCE ET QUALIFICATIONS

- Académique/Scientifique/Clinique :
- MD requis
- Connaissances thérapeutiques dans le domaine du métabolisme, de l'obésité et du diabète, avec une expérience clinique, scientifique et en matière d'essais/développement cliniques pertinente.
- Une formation académique/enseignante est un plus
- Expérience de travail avec les principes et techniques d'analyse, d'interprétation et de pertinence clinique des données
- Une expérience dans la publication des résultats d'une étude scientifique dans une revue à comité de lecture est préférable
- Réglementaire : la connaissance des aspects médicaux des BPC (bonnes pratiques cliniques), de l'ICH (Conférence internationale sur l'harmonisation des exigences techniques pour l'enregistrement des produits pharmaceutiques à usage humain), de la FDA, de l'EMA et d'autres directives et réglementations pertinentes est préférable.
- Durée de l'expérience : 2 années ou plus d'expérience académique ou clinique postuniversitaire
- Jusqu'à 30% de voyages dans le monde

Compétences et comportements clés

- Éthique : A une éthique irréprochable. Démontre, ou capacité avérée à démontrer, les valeurs de Roche
- Souci du détail : Souci exceptionnel du détail
- Sens des affaires : possède une connaissance pratique de l'industrie pharmaceutique/biotechnologique, des multiples fonctions et rôles impliqués dans le processus de développement de médicaments. Dirige régulièrement l’élaboration de stratégies et de plans de lutte contre les maladies
- Organisation : peut prioriser plusieurs tâches et objectifs dans les délais, dans les délais et dans les limites du budget
- Compétences interpersonnelles : Bonnes capacités de communication interpersonnelle et verbale et d'influence : peut influencer sans autorité
- Rédaction : Solides compétences en communication écrite
- Compétences en présentation : Bonnes compétences en matière de présentation commerciale ; est confortable et efficace lorsqu’il se présente aux autres, en interne ou en externe. Confiant et compétent dans ses interactions avec les autres en interne et en externe : reste concentré et précis, est capable de soulever des problèmes ou des défis de manière productive et mature.
- Compétences en négociation : Bonnes compétences en négociation : sait comment réaliser les livrables en travaillant efficacement avec les autres en interne et en externe
- Prise de décision : sait comment prendre des décisions de compromis tout en équilibrant éthique et efficacité
- Travail d'équipe : Forte orientation vers le travail d'équipe

DEVOIRS ET RESPONSABILITÉS SPÉCIFIQUES

Stratégie et planification du CDP

- Participe à l'élaboration du plan CD pour la ou les molécules/indications assignées
- Rassemble et analyse les données et informations nécessaires à la création du plan CD
- Travailler avec d'autres membres du CST et les sous-équipes concernées pour développer les composants du plan CD (par exemple, stratégie d'analyse/données, développement de KOL, stratégie de publications, etc.)
- Travaille avec CST et d'autres équipes concernées pour développer et fournir des informations et des contributions aux exigences en matière de budget/ressources nécessaires à la mise en œuvre et à l'exécution du plan de CD.
- Se tenir au courant des développements internes et externes, des tendances et autres dynamiques pertinentes pour le travail du CD afin de maintenir, à tout moment, une vision et une perspective pleinement actuelles des influences internes/externes et/ou des implications pour le(s) domaine(s) thérapeutique(s) et pathologique(s) assigné(s)
- Le cas échéant, participe à la veille concurrentielle et/ou à d'autres activités et projets d'évaluation du marché/de l'industrie.
- Maintenir les normes et les niveaux les plus élevés de connaissances scientifiques et cliniques dans le(s) domaine(s) thérapeutique(s) et pathologique(s) spécifique(s) de mission
- Collabore avec une variété de partenaires et de parties prenantes internes et externes, tels que des enquêteurs cliniques, des cliniciens, des scientifiques et des leaders d'opinion clés (KOL), ainsi qu'avec des groupes internes multidisciplinaires, y compris d'autres groupes en PP, recherche, développement commercial, commercial.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GENERAL POSITION SUMMARY AND PURPOSE:
Roche’s Clinical Development organization is structured by therapeutic area and is responsible for developing and executing the late development (Phase II – III) clinical strategies and plans that deliver medically-differentiated therapies that provide meaningful improvement to patients.
The Lead Medical Director leads or makes major contributions to development of the Clinical Development (CD) strategy and plan and is responsible for effective and efficient execution for the assigned molecule(s)/indication(s).
Lead Medical Directors are expected to perform their responsibilities with more independence by comparison to Medical Directors.
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:

• M.D. Required

• Relevant clinical, scientific, or clinical trial/development experience in same/similar therapeutic area required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Significant experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Significant pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized expert in the field

• Significant experience designing and conducting clinical trials (i.e. one or more trials)

• Experience authoring a global development plan is preferred

• Understanding of Phase II – III drug development

• Knowledge and understanding of Phase I & IV drug development is a plus

• Understanding of product and safety profiles

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is required

• 4 or more years pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized local expert in the field (e.g Assistant Professor or equivalent)

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Is regarded as knowledgeable in his/her field, is respected by others, can effectively contribute to longer-range drug development, and can lead cross-functional teams to successful results

• Business Acumen: Has sound knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process.

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills: Strong interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority and has proven experience building and cultivating relationships with key partners and stakeholders, both internally and externally

• Writing: Outstanding written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Strong business presentation skills: effective at summarizing and presenting the key considerations and decision-points.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills: Strong negotiation skills: can effectively drive discussions and decisions toward desired end-results

• Decision Making: Makes good business decisions and exercises sound judgment. Balances decisions with imperatives for ethics and efficacy. Able to mak

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The people leader leads a team of China Technical Partners (CTPs) and CMC professionals that are accountable for China regulatory CMC submissions, through developing and implementing robust end-to-end China filing strategies based on close collaboration with global development teams, China business priorities, China regulatory requirements and landscape. The scope includes the complete Roche portfolio, the global products (small molecules, biologics, new modalities). The focus of this role is to lead and coach the team members in order to accelerate drug access and continuous supply to the patients by ensuring right first-time submissions to Chinese Health Authorities and effective interactions with the Health Authority. The incumbent of the role is responsible to shape the regulatory environment in China in close collaboration with PTR Policy and translate that into innovative regulatory strategies. In line with Roche’s China strategy and the China First initiative, this is a role with a high business impact.
In this position, the people leader is responsible for the management of China Technical Partners (CTPs) and CMC program managers, which includes setting performance objectives, providing timely feedback, and ensuring alignment of short-term development goals with longer-term career goals. Provides guidance and manages work activities of others for specific projects and/or objectives. Demonstrates the fundamentals of effective coaching skills and mentoring. Adapts coaching style to meet the needs of the individual.
The people leader leads cross-functional regulatory initiatives and strategies, defines associated critical steps and resources needed and takes responsibility for implementation of these initiatives and strategies. Proactively communicates with regulatory and cross-functional personnel in support of internal and partner-associated project goals. Collaborates with management in leading communications with HA on projects and initiatives of major complexity. Makes decisions based on cross-functional priorities rather than functional area priorities.

Project People Leader

• Provide leadership to a team of regulatory professionals.

• Responsible for performance management of employees.

• Work with direct reports and ensure that objective and timely feedback is provided to employees, focus on the development of the employee by facilitating regular development discussions and check-ins.

• Provide coaching and mentoring to colleagues for an assigned area of technical regulatory responsibility.

• Work closely with the Portfolio Leader to coordinate resources and priorities at a Portfolio level.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il leader della gente guida un team di Cina partner tecnici (CTPs) e professionisti CMC che sono responsabili per le presentazioni CMC di regolamentazione della Cina, attraverso lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di robuste strategie di archiviazione end-to-end Cina basate sulla stretta collaborazione con i team di sviluppo globale, le priorità aziendali della Cina, i requisiti normativi della Cina e il paesaggio. La portata include il portafoglio completo di Roche, i prodotti globali (piccole molecole, biologiche, nuove modalità). L'obiettivo di questo ruolo è quello di guidare e allenare i membri del team al fine di accelerare l'accesso alla droga e la fornitura continua ai pazienti assicurando le giuste presentazioni di prima volta alle autorità sanitarie cinesi e le interazioni efficaci con l'Autorità sanitaria. L'incombente del ruolo è responsabile di modellare l'ambiente normativo in Cina in stretta collaborazione con PTR Policy e tradurlo in strategie normative innovative. In linea con la strategia cinese di Roche e la prima iniziativa della Cina, questo è un ruolo con un alto impatto commerciale. In questa posizione, il leader delle persone è responsabile per la gestione dei partner tecnici cinesi (CTPs) e dei gestori dei programmi CMC, che include l'impostazione degli obiettivi di performance, il feedback tempestivo e l'allineamento degli obiettivi di sviluppo a breve termine con obiettivi di carriera a lungo termine. Fornisce indicazioni e gestisce attività di lavoro di altri per progetti e/o obiettivi specifici. Dimostra i fondamenti delle competenze di coaching efficaci e di mentoring. Adapts stile di coaching per soddisfare le esigenze dell'individuo. Il leader delle persone guida iniziative e strategie di regolamentazione interfunzionali, definisce i passi critici associati e le risorse necessarie e si assume la responsabilità per l'attuazione di queste iniziative e strategie. Proattivamente comunica con personale normativo e interfunzionale a supporto degli obiettivi di progetto interni e associati ai partner. Collabora con la gestione nelle principali comunicazioni con HA su progetti e iniziative di grande complessità. Prende decisioni basate su priorità interfunzionali piuttosto che su priorità di area funzionale. Leader del progetto
• Fornire leadership a un team di professionisti di regolamentazione.
• Responsabile per la gestione delle prestazioni dei dipendenti.
• Lavorare con rapporti diretti e garantire che il feedback oggettivo e tempestivo sia fornito ai dipendenti, concentrarsi sullo sviluppo del dipendente facilitando le discussioni e i check-in di sviluppo regolari.
• Fornire coaching e mentoring ai colleghi per un'area assegnata di responsabilità tecnica di regolamentazione.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il Leader Portfolio per coordinare risorse e priorità a livello Portfolio.
• Seguire regolarmente e controllare i progressi di ogni progetto specifico nel team, illuminare il team per elaborare strategie di presentazione per diverse applicazioni e identificare i rischi normativi e sviluppare piani di migrazione.
• Costruire e mantenere un rapporto sano con gli stakeholder chiave interni ed esterni, come NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, Supply Chain, Qualità e conformità, PDR Cina e PTR globale,
• Collaborare con le parti interessate chiave interne per lo sviluppo e l'allineamento della strategia tecnica, massimizzare e bilanciare le esigenze normative e di fornitura in Cina. QUALIFICA Istruzione Laurea magistrale in scienze della vita è preferito; Laurea post è un plus. Esperienza

• Gestione delle persone precedenti

The Position
The people leader leads a team of China Technical Partners (CTPs) and CMC professionals that are accountable for China regulatory CMC submissions, through developing and implementing robust end-to-end China filing strategies based on close collaboration with global development teams, China business priorities, China regulatory requirements and landscape. The focus of this role is to lead and coach the team members in order to accelerate drug access and continuous supply to the patients by ensuring right first-time submissions to Chinese Health Authorities and effective interactions with the Health Authority. The incumbent of the role is responsible to shape the regulatory environment in China in close collaboration with PTR Policy and translate that into innovative regulatory strategies. In line with Roche’s China strategy and the China First initiative, this is a role with a high business impact.

Provides guidance and manages work activities of others for specific projects and/or objectives. Demonstrates the fundamentals of effective coaching skills and mentoring. Adapts coaching style to meet the needs of the individual.
The people leader leads cross-functional regulatory initiatives and strategies, defines associated critical steps and resources needed and takes responsibility for implementation of these initiatives and strategies. Proactively communicates with regulatory and cross-functional personnel in support of internal and partner-associated project goals. Collaborates with management in leading communications with HA on projects and initiatives of major complexity. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Der Umfang umfasst das komplette Roche-Portfolio, die globalen Produkte (kleine Moleküle, Biologik, neue Modalitäten). In dieser Position ist der Personenführer für das Management von China Technical Partners (CTPs) und CMC-Programmmanagern verantwortlich, die Leistungsziele festlegen, zeitnah Feedback liefern und eine Ausrichtung von kurzfristigen Entwicklungszielen mit langfristigen Karrierezielen gewährleisten. Bietet Beratung und verwaltet Arbeitsaktivitäten von anderen für spezifische Projekte und/oder Ziele. Demonstriert die Grundlagen der effektiven Coaching Fähigkeiten und Mentoring. Proaktiv kommuniziert mit regulatorischen und funktionsübergreifenden Mitarbeitern zur Unterstützung interner und partnerschaftlicher Projektziele. Zusammenarbeit mit Management in führenden Kommunikationen mit HA über Projekte und Initiativen großer Komplexität. Entscheidungen auf der Grundlage von funktionsübergreifenden Prioritäten statt funktioneller Schwerpunkte. Projekt People Leader

• 8 oder mehr Jahre Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen, biotechnologischen oder verwandten Industrie und CMC, Qualität, regulatorische oder verwandte Erfahrung.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le chef du personnel dirige une équipe de partenaires techniques chinois (PTC) et de professionnels du CMC qui sont responsables des présentations de CMC réglementaires en Chine, en élaborant et en mettant en oeuvre des stratégies de classement de bout en bout de la Chine fondées sur une collaboration étroite avec les équipes de développement mondial, les priorités commerciales de la Chine, les exigences réglementaires de la Chine et le paysage. La portée comprend le portefeuille complet de Roche, les produits mondiaux (petites molécules, produits biologiques, nouvelles modalités). Ce rôle a pour but de diriger et d'entraîner les membres de l'équipe afin d'accélérer l'accès aux médicaments et l'approvisionnement continu des patients en veillant à ce que les premières présentations appropriées aux autorités sanitaires chinoises et les interactions efficaces avec l'autorité sanitaire. Le titulaire du rôle est responsable de façonner l'environnement réglementaire en Chine en étroite collaboration avec la Politique sur les PTR et de la traduire en stratégies réglementaires novatrices. Conformément à la stratégie de la Chine et à l'initiative China First, il s'agit d'un rôle qui a un impact commercial élevé. Dans ce poste, le chef de file est responsable de la gestion des partenaires techniques de la Chine (PTC) et des gestionnaires de programme du MCC, ce qui comprend l'établissement d'objectifs de rendement, la fourniture de rétroaction en temps opportun et l'harmonisation des objectifs de perfectionnement à court terme avec les objectifs de carrière à plus long terme. Fournit des conseils et gère les activités de travail d'autres personnes pour des projets ou des objectifs précis. Démontre les principes fondamentaux de l'efficacité de l'encadrement et du mentorat. Adapte le style de coaching pour répondre aux besoins de l'individu. Le chef des personnes dirige des initiatives et des stratégies de réglementation interfonctionnelles, définit les étapes et les ressources essentielles qui s'y rattachent et assume la responsabilité de la mise en oeuvre de ces initiatives et stratégies. Communiquer de façon proactive avec le personnel de réglementation et le personnel interfonctionnel à l'appui des objectifs des projets internes et associés aux partenaires. Collabore avec la direction pour diriger les communications avec l'AP sur les projets et les initiatives de grande complexité. Prendre des décisions fondées sur des priorités interfonctionnelles plutôt que sur des priorités fonctionnelles. Chef de projet Personnes
• Diriger une équipe de professionnels de la réglementation.
• Responsable de la gestion de la performance des salariés.
• Collaborer avec des rapports directs et veiller à ce que des commentaires objectifs et opportuns soient fournis aux employés, en mettant l'accent sur le perfectionnement de l'employé en facilitant des discussions régulières sur le perfectionnement et des vérifications.
• Fournir un encadrement et un encadrement aux collègues dans un domaine de responsabilité réglementaire technique assigné.
• Collaborer étroitement avec le chef de portefeuille pour coordonner les ressources et les priorités au niveau du portefeuille.
• Suivre et vérifier régulièrement l'avancement de chaque projet spécifique de l'équipe, éclairer l'équipe pour élaborer des stratégies de soumission pour différentes applications, identifier les risques réglementaires et élaborer des plans de migration.
• Établir et maintenir des relations saines avec les principaux acteurs internes et externes, tels que NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, chaîne d'approvisionnement, qualité et conformité, PDR Chine et PTR mondial,
• Collaborer avec les principales parties prenantes internes à l'élaboration et à l'alignement de la stratégie technique, en maximisant et en équilibrage des besoins en matière de réglementation et d'approvisionnement en Chine. QUALIFICATIONS Éducation Masters Le diplôme en sciences de la vie est préféré; le diplôme d'études supérieures est un plus. Expérience
• 8 ans ou plus d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, la biotechnologie ou l'industrie connexe et le CMC, la qualité, la réglementation ou l'expérience connexe.
• Gestion des personnes précédente

The Position
The Senior Solution Architect will design business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions to enable Roche’s omnichannel orchestration capabilities. This role focuses on building and scaling an integrated ecosystem leveraging Adobe Experience Platform (RT-CDP, AJO, CJA), ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, data strategy, and governance standards.
You will operate within a complex, multi-solution environment, driving the architecture vision across data, platforms, and activation use cases. The role requires balancing current delivery needs with long-term scalability, while ensuring robust handling of non-functional requirements (NFRs), data privacy, and system performance.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

• Define end-to-end omnichannel architecture aligned with business and enterprise standards

• Establish data models, identity frameworks, and integration patterns

• Manage NFRs (performance, scalability, security, compliance)

Data & Integration

• Integrate CRM, MDM, consent, and web/app event data
Enable unified customer profiles and audience segmentation

• Ensure data quality, governance, and privacy compliance

Platform (Adobe Stack)

• Architect and guide implementation of RT-CDP, AJO, and CJA

• Enable real-time segmentation, journey orchestration, and activation

• Ensure seamless integration with enterprise systems

Real-time & Orchestration

• Design event-driven and streaming architectures

• Enable multi-channel activation (email, paid media, others)

• Establish reusable audience and journey frameworks

Strategy & Delivery

• Define architecture roadmap and support delivery across use cases

• Identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities

• Drive adoption of best practices, patterns, and new technologies

Stakeholder Management

• Collaborate across business, product, and tech teams

• Communicate complex concepts clearly and drive alignment

Qualifications

Experience

• Proven experience in solution architecture within data and martech ecosystems

• Experience with CDPs and omnichannel platforms (Adobe preferred)

• Experience working in global, cross-functional teams

• Certifications on Adobe stack - (AJO, CJA and RT-CDP)

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of:

• Customer data platforms, identity resolution, segmentation

• Event-driven / streaming architectures

• Integration with CRM, MDM, consent systems

• Experience with APIs, cloud data platforms, and data governance concepts (GDPR)

What Success Looks Like

• Scalable omnichannel architecture aligned with enterprise standards

• Reliable data foundation enabling unified profiles and segmentation

• Real-time orchestration and activation across channels

• Measurable business impact through improved customer engagement

• Strong stakeholder alignment through clear communication and effective translation of complex concepts into business value

• Ability to influence and drive adoption of architectural decisions across cross-functional teams

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Local customer facing role unlocking value along patient journeys
Roche is a company with a 125 year history and our ongoing success is based on our strong focus on delivering meaningful value for our customers and society, and we will need to evolve our offering and approach in order to do so.
In response to the increasingly volatile world we live in, Roche Pharma International began a wide scale transformation process - changing our ways of working to be more agile, less hierarchical, highly collaborative. Now we take the next STEP in our journey focusing on how we can deliver the greatest value and make a meaningful difference to our customers, patients and society.

Mission and responsibilities:
As the Patient Journey Partner (PJP), you will be at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering extraordinary medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption.
You will be locally embedded and integrated in the healthcare ecosystem in a functionally agnostic way (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs).
As an empowered leader and the face of Roche, you will collaborate closely with all partners directly touching the patient journey, gaining a deep understanding of their needs, in service of connecting Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions. In addition, you will be responsible for:

• Acting as a trusted partner and the primary point of contact between stakeholders and Roche, prioritising and securing resources, and driving solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• Collaborating with patient journey partners to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• Guiding Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supporting their appropriate use, sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.

• Ensuring great experiences whenever partners in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services.

Who are you:
You demonstrate personal purpose in improving the patient journey, as well as a strong passion to bring value and impact to the healthcare ecosystem.
You are a true visionary, defining and embedding the strategy around creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand).

In addition, you bring the following skills & experience:

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche

• Self managed and self directed - altruistic in supporting the global network

• Display of integrity in everything as a leader who senses, reflects and responds

• Boldly acts on key decisions and opportunities and boldly stops any activity that is not adding value. Ability to say “No” to partners when the value is not predictable/foreseen.

• Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and organizations is required. Experience partnering with Patient Advocacy Groups (PGAs) is highly desired.

• Experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams

• Strong eye for business with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience excell

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapte r is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.

The Role

We are seeking an R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist I to join our global service and support team. You are well organized and detail-oriented. You will be the reliable service provider handling critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.

This role requires building organizational know-how—understanding who our internal customers are, how they work, and solving problems in a way that anticipates their support needs. You are quick in learning new software systems and tools, enjoy helping your coworkers every day, and are motivated to innovate internal processes to automate tasks, you will fit right into our team!

Your key Responsibilities

As a part of a global centralized expert support team, execute enterprise tool system tasks based on R&D customer requests, leveraging expert knowledge of business tools, compliance requirements, and R&D teams and processes.

• Execute R&D System Requests: Fulfill customer tool requests using expertise in business systems and compliance standards.

• Provide Timely Expert Support: Offer professional, empathetic, and quick solutions to R&D operational issues and system problems. You may be the primary contact for R&D scientists and engineers in the use of our internal enterprise systems.

• Expert in our Global Business Applications: Act as the subject matter expert for one or more complex R&D business applications.

• Specialize in R&D Business Processes: Develop deep expertise in key processes (e.g., records management, lab data, training system data, change requests) for timely and accurate execution.

• Maximize Scientist Productivity: Use your expertise across business data and organizational structure to streamline operations and save significant time for R&D scientists.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Build organizational know-how of R&D roles and priorities to deliver proactive system support.

• Maintain Global Service Excellence: Demonstrate a strong, collaborative customer service mindset within a diverse, global team.

• Drive Process Improvement: Identify manual steps and actively suggest opportunities for digitization and improvement.

• Automate Administrative Tasks: Apply or develop automation and AI tools to reduce administrative load on R&D staff.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes, supporting audits and data retrieval.

Who you are:

Education : Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical, scientific, or business discipline.

Experience : 2+ years of professional experience in an operations, technical support, or system administration role, or equivalent academic projects / internships

Language Skills: Excellent written and verbal English Language skills are required to support our global organization. German language skills are a plus.

System Proficiency:

• Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new software, systems, and processes is essential.

• P

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapter is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing the complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.

The Role

We are seeking an R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist II to join our global internal service and support team. In this mid-level role, you will apply your conceptual knowledge and significant working experience to perform a range of assignments with limited guidance. You will act as a reliable service provider with a customer-oriented mindset to handle critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.
Rather than just managing system change requests, you will manage the integrity of the business process within our internal tools. By developing a deep understanding of the R&D organization and unique team needs, you will translate diverse business needs into effective system and data configurations. You will handle complex requests, ensuring that as our internal digital infrastructure evolves, our global R&D teams remain compliant, organized, and productive.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute System Requests with Limited Guidance: Fulfill customer requests and generate business metrics by performing a range of assignments related to your discipline, ensuring that enterprise system tool configurations / data updates align with actual R&D workflows / needs.

• Anticipate and Solve Complex Problems: Understand the impact of system changes on the broader level to anticipate issues. Analyze possible solutions to operational issues and system problems by relying on your experience, judgment, and established precedents.

• Functional Decision-Making: Use your knowledge of your internal customers (the R&D teams) and their diverse needs to make informed decisions on system logic, such as grouping training curricula based on learner job functions, or making logical document hierarchies based on your learned organisational knowledge.

• Organizational Transition Management: Execute structural data migrations and updates within system tools driven by acquisitions, reorganizations, and digitalization projects to ensure user permissions, configurations, access, and data reflect the current state of the company.

• Mentorship and Guidance: Provide guidance to new team members and R&D internal customers. Based on your expertise navigating our enterprise tool workflows, configurations, and data - you provide guidance and oversight of system usage. You routinely will need to explain information to others in a straightforward manner, and deliver presentations when needed to support training, onboarding, and engaging stakeholders participation in our projects.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Understand key organizational drivers and areas of expertise to proactively anticipate needs, accomplish your work, and represent internal customers' needs to global project teams.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes

• Provide data monitoring and statistics You may be asked to support audits by showing adherence to our quality management systems and pr

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose

• The Head of Healthcare Transformation serves as a cornerstone in advancing Roche Diagnostics' commitment to enhancing patient care. By synthesizing clinical evidence, access frameworks, and governmental advocacy with business development, this leader ensures that breakthrough diagnostics gain market entry, clinical recognition, and financial sustainability within Taiwan. This executive role fundamentally evolves the local medical landscape while establishing Roche as a premier partner in the health ecosystem.

• A primary focus involves the evaluation and refinement of healthcare pathways and public policy to foster robust internal and external partnerships, thereby modernizing the local environment to drive substantive commercial growth. Achieving systemic change necessitates the seamless integration of policy shaping, medical insights and reimbursement expertise. Furthermore, you will identify and cultivate emerging business opportunities that respond to shifting clinical trends, overseeing the launch of programs that improve healthcare delivery and ensure the enduring availability of innovative diagnostic tools.

• Possessing a profound sense of purpose, the incumbent will mobilize teams to achieve superior outcomes under the "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan" vision, directly contributing to the execution of the RDTW 1000 days strategic roadmap.

• In this capacity, you will demonstrate an entrepreneurial spirit and system-wide perspective, converting visionary concepts into disciplined, high-impact strategies that secure organizational success across both immediate and future horizons.

• As a member of the RD Taiwan Leadership Team, you will role model VACC behaviors and uphold the LT Purpose Statement. Close collaboration with peers across the Leadership Team is essential to realize the company's broader objectives. This leadership approach centers on cultivating high-performing, customer-centric teams within an agile and continuously evolving organizational culture.

• Ultimately, you must exhibit the determination and resilience required to transform Taiwan's healthcare landscape, embodying the core Roche mission: "Doing what patients need next."

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute an integrated medical, market access & policy strategy aligned with global/regional guidelines and local business objectives.

• Medical Affairs Strategy: Lead the generation and dissemination of scientific evidence, foster strategic relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and medical societies, and ensure scientific accuracy in all activities.

• Market Access & Reimbursement: Drive successful NHI (National Health Insurance) listing and optimal pricing strategies for key diagnostic products, utilizing health economics and outcomes research (HEOR).

• Public Policy & Government Affairs: Proactively monitor the healthcare policy landscape. Engage collaboratively with government authorities (e.g., MOHW, NHIA), industry associations, and patient advocacy groups to shape favorable policies for diagnostic innovations.

• Business Development: Identify, develop, and manage strategic emerging business opportunities and partnerships that promote growth and innovation and ensure the delivery of scalable and impactful healthcare solutions.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

A Roche, potete presentarsi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove siete apprezzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Scopo del ruolo

- Il responsabile della trasformazione sanitaria serve da pietra angolare per far progredire l'impegno di Roche Diagnostics per migliorare l'assistenza ai pazienti. Sintassi delle prove cliniche, quadri di accesso e difesa governativa con lo sviluppo delle imprese, questo leader assicura che la diagnostica di innovazione ottenere l'ingresso sul mercato, riconoscimento clinico e sostenibilità finanziaria all'interno di Taiwan. Questo ruolo esecutivo evolve fondamentalmente il paesaggio medico locale, mentre la creazione di Roche come partner kicker nell'ecosistema sanitario.

- Un obiettivo primario consiste nella valutazione e nel perfezionamento dei percorsi sanitari e della politica pubblica per promuovere solidi partenariati interni ed esterni, modernizzando così l'ambiente locale per stimolare una crescita commerciale sostanziale. Il raggiungimento di un cambiamento sistemico richiede l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità tra definizione delle politiche, approfondimenti medici e competenze in materia di rimborso.

Inoltre, potrete individuare e coltivare opportunità di business emergenti che rispondono alle mutevoli tendenze cliniche, supervisionando il lancio di programmi che migliorano la fornitura di assistenza sanitaria e garantire la disponibilità duratura di strumenti diagnostici innovativi.

- Possesso un profondo senso dello scopo, l'operatore storico mobiliterà i team per ottenere risultati superiori sotto la visione "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan," contribuendo direttamente all'esecuzione della roadmap strategica RDTW 1000 giorni.

- In questa veste, si dimostrerà uno spirito imprenditoriale e una prospettiva di sistema, convertendo concetti visionari in strategie disciplinari e ad alto impatto che garantiscono il successo organizzativo in orizzonti sia immediati che futuri.

- Come membro del team di leadership di RD Taiwan, potrai svolgere un ruolo modello di comportamento VACC e sostenere la dichiarazione di intenti LT. Una stretta collaborazione con i pari in tutto il team di leadership è essenziale per realizzare gli obiettivi più ampi dell'azienda. Questo approccio di leadership si concentra sulla coltivazione di team ad alte prestazioni, customer-centric all'interno di una cultura organizzativa able e in continua evoluzione.

- In definitiva, è necessario mostrare la determinazione e la resilienza necessaria per trasformare il paesaggio sanitario di Taiwan, incarnando la missione principale Roche: "Fare ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno di prossimo."

Responsabilità chiave

- Leadership strategica: sviluppare ed attuare una strategia integrata in materia di salute, accesso al mercato e politica, in linea con gli orientamenti globali/regionali e gli obiettivi aziendali locali.

- Strategia per gli affari medici: guidare la generazione e la diffusione di prove scientifiche, promuovere relazioni strategiche con i leader chiave dell'opinione (KOL) e le società mediche, e garantire l'accuratezza scientifica in tutte le attività.

- Accesso al mercato e rimborso: Guidare successo NHI (National Health Insurance) elenco e strategie di prezzi ottimali per i principali prodotti diagnostici, utilizzando l'economia sanitaria e la ricerca sui risultati (HEOR).

- Politica pubblica e affari governativi: monitorare proattivamente il panorama della politica sanitaria. Coinvolgere in collaborazione con le autorità governative (ad esempio, MOHW, NHIA), associazioni di settore e gruppi di sostegno dei pazienti per definire politiche favorevoli per le innovazioni diagnostiche.

- Sviluppo di imprese: individuare, sviluppare e gestire opportunità commerciali e partnership strategiche emergenti che promuovano la crescita e l'innovazione e garantiscano l'erogazione di soluzioni sanitarie di tipo "bassa" e "impatto."

- Team Leadership & Cultura VACC: guida, allenatore e ispirare un team di assistenza medica, accesso al mercato, politica e sviluppo aziendale per liberare il loro pieno potenziale e sostenere la cultura VACC.
