Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Die Position Im China Early Development (ED) Centre of Excellence (CoE) von Roche spielen wir eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Beschleunigung der globalen Frühentwicklung transformativer Medikamente für Patienten, um einige der dringendsten ungedeckten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse der Welt zu bewältigen. Wir sind strategischer Partner der globalen Frühentwicklungsteams von Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) und Pharma Product Development (PD), um China in die globalen Frühentwicklungsprogramme zu integrieren. Gemeinsam bringen wir außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen schnell voran. Diese Position ist in der klinischen Wissenschaftsfunktion von Roche Product Development China angesiedelt, der Heimat des China ED CoE. Diese Position ist der Leitung und Förderung früher Entwicklungsprogramme in den Therapiebereichen Onkologie und Hämatologie als klinischer Leiter gewidmet. Die Chance Diese Rolle wird die Möglichkeit haben, die globale Frühentwicklungsstrategie und das CDP zu gestalten, innovative Studiendesigns für die Frühentwicklung voranzutreiben, erhebliche Auswirkungen auf die Effizienz und den Erfolg unserer Frühentwicklungsprogramme in der Onkologie/Hämatologie zu haben und zum Innovationsökosystem der Arzneimittelentwicklung in China beizutragen. • Als Mitglied der globalen Asset-Teams zur globalen Asset-Strategie und zum CDP für die frühe Entwicklung beitragen und diese beeinflussen.
• Proaktiv Möglichkeiten zur Beschleunigung und Optimierung des globalen ED-CDP unter Nutzung von Fachwissen, Erfahrung, Geschwindigkeit und Umfang in China identifizieren.
• Das funktionsübergreifende Team in China leiten, um die Möglichkeiten einer Teilnahme Chinas an globalen ED-Programmen oder China-First-Studien aus strategischer, wissenschaftlicher, behördlicher und betrieblicher Sicht zu bewerten Studien
• Als medizinischer Beobachter für klinische ED-Studien in China fungieren
• Wissenschaftliche Einbeziehung chinesischer TAEs sowie interner und externer Roche-Stakeholder
• Als wissenschaftlicher Ansprechpartner für globale Frühentwicklungs-Asset-Teams für Onkologie/Hämatologie fungieren
• Nachwuchsmedizinische Direktoren betreuen, um Fähigkeiten und Kapazitäten von ED CoE weiter auszubauen Wer Sie sind
• Sie haben einen MD in Onkologie/Hämatologie oder einen Bachelor/Master in klinischer Medizin mit mindestens 3 Jahren klinischer Praxis nach dem Abschluss in Onkologie/Hämatologie
• Sie haben Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der biopharmazeutischen Industrie und umfassende Erfahrung in der frühen Entwicklung in der Onkologie/Hämatologie.
• Sie verfügen über praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von CDP für die frühe Entwicklung, der Konzeption und Durchführung klinischer Studien in der frühen Entwicklung, der Interaktion mit Gesundheitsbehörden, der Zusammenarbeit mit Prüfärzten und der klinischen Forschung. Sie verfügen über ein sehr gutes Verständnis der globalen Entwicklungsrichtlinien und -vorschriften für Onkologie/Hämatologie, einschließlich CDE, FDA und EMEA.
• Sie sind ein effektiver Kommunikator: Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch mit dem Fähigkeit, komplexe Konzepte globalen funktionsübergreifenden Teams, Governance-Ausschüssen und wichtigen Stakeholdern auf logische und prägnante Weise zu präsentieren
• Sie sind ein großartiger Teamplayer; Sehr kollaborativ, gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und Einflussnahme, können ohne Autorität Einfluss nehmen. Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Le poste Au sein du Centre d'excellence (CoE) de développement précoce (ED) de Roche en Chine, nous jouons un rôle essentiel dans l'accélération du développement précoce mondial de médicaments transformateurs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé non satisfaits les plus difficiles au monde. Nous sommes un partenaire stratégique des équipes mondiales de développement précoce de Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) et de pharma Product Development (PD) pour intégrer la Chine dans les programmes mondiaux de développement précoce. Ensemble, nous mettons rapidement en avant des innovations extraordinaires qui changent la vie. Ce poste est situé au sein de la fonction science clinique de Roche Product Development China, siège du China ED CoE. Ce poste est dédié à la direction et à la conduite de programmes de développement précoce dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'oncologie et de l'hématologie en tant que responsable clinique. L'opportunité Ce rôle aura l'opportunité de façonner la stratégie mondiale de développement précoce et le CDP, de piloter la conception innovante d'essais de développement précoce, d'avoir un impact significatif sur l'efficacité et le succès de nos programmes de développement précoce en oncologie/hématologie, et de contribuer à l'écosystème d'innovation de développement de médicaments en Chine. Dans votre rôle, vous devrez :
• Contribuer et influencer la stratégie mondiale des actifs et le développement précoce du CDP en tant que membre des équipes mondiales des actifs.
• Identifier de manière proactive les opportunités d'accélération et d'optimisation du CDP ED mondial en tirant parti de l'expertise, de l'expérience, de la rapidité et de l'échelle en Chine.
• Être le moniteur médical des essais cliniques sur l'ED en Chine
• Engager scientifiquement les TAE chinois, les parties prenantes internes et externes de Roche
• Servir de point de contact scientifique pour les équipes mondiales de développement précoce en oncologie/hématologie
• Encadrer les directeurs médicaux juniors pour renforcer davantage les capacités et les capacités du CoE ED Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en oncologie/hématologie ou d'un baccalauréat/maîtrise en médecine clinique avec au moins 3 ans de pratique clinique post-diplôme en oncologie/hématologie
• Vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience d'expérience dans l'industrie biopharmaceutique et une vaste expérience de développement précoce en oncologie/hématologie
• Vous avez une expérience pratique dans le développement de CDP de développement précoce, la conception et la conduite d'essais cliniques de développement précoce, l'interaction avec les autorités sanitaires, la collaboration avec les enquêteurs et la recherche clinique. Vous avez une très bonne compréhension des directives et réglementations mondiales de développement en oncologie/hématologie, notamment CDE, FDA et EMEA. comités et intervenants clés de manière logique et succincte.
• Vous êtes un excellent joueur d'équipe; hautement collaboratif, bonnes compétences interpersonnelles et d'influence, peut influencer sans autorité Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, garantissant à chacun l’accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts permettent de traiter plus de 26 millions de personnes avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 millions de personnes

• Contribute to and influence global asset strategy and early development CDP as a member of the global asset teams

• Proactively identify opportunities of accelerating and optimizing global ED CDP leveraging expertise, experience, speed, and scale in China

• Lead the China cross-functional team to evaluate opportunities of China joining global ED programs or China-first trials from strategic, scientific, regulatory, and operational perspectives

• Drive innovative trial design and trial conduct in close partnership with global early development functional experts on China-first clinical trials

• Being the Medical Monitor for China ED clinical trials

• Scientifically engage China TAEs, Roche internal and external stakeholders

• Serve as a scientific point of contact to global early development asset teams of non-oncology therapeutic areas (immunology, neurology, CVRM, ophthalmology)

• Mentor junior medical directors to further build capability and capacity of ED CoE

Who you are

• You hold a MD, or a Bachelor/Master of Clinical Medicine with at least 3 years of post-graduation clinical practice; clinical expertise in immunology preferred

• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry and extensive early development experience, early development experience in immunology preferred

• You have hands-on experience in developing early development CDP, designing and running early development clinical trials, interacting with Health Authorities, collaborating with investigators and clinical research sites, and interpreting early development clinical trial data

• You have a very good understanding of global development guidelines and regulations, including CDE, FDA and EMEA

• You are an effective communicator: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts to global cross functional teams, governance committees and key stakeholders in a logical and succinct manner

• You are a great team player; highly collaborative, good interpersonal and influencing skills, can influence without authority

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the glob

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position La position Dans le Centre d'excellence pour le développement précoce de la Chine (CED) de Roches, nous jouons un rôle crucial dans l'accélération du développement précoce mondial des médicaments transformateurs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Nous sommes un partenaire stratégique des équipes mondiales de développement précoce de Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (PRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (GRED) et Pharmaceutical Product Development (PD) pour intégrer la Chine dans les programmes mondiaux de développement précoce. Ensemble, nous apportons rapidement des innovations extraordinaires qui changent la vie. Cette position est située dans la fonction de science clinique de Roche Product Development China, la maison de la Chine ED CoE. Ce poste est dédié à diriger et à diriger des programmes de développement précoce dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'immunologie, de la neurologie, du CVRM et de l'ophtalmologie en tant que chef de file clinique. L'opportunité Ce rôle aura l'occasion de façonner la stratégie mondiale de développement précoce et le PDC, de stimuler la conception novatrice d'essais de développement précoce, d'avoir des répercussions importantes sur l'efficacité et le succès de nos programmes de développement précoce dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'immunologie, de la neurologie, du CVRM et de l'ophtalmologie, et de contribuer à l'écosystème d'innovation pour le développement de médicaments en Chine. Dans votre rôle, vous :
• Contribuer et influencer la stratégie mondiale en matière d'actifs et le développement rapide en tant que membre des équipes mondiales d'actifs
• Identifier de manière proactive les possibilités d'accélérer et d'optimiser le CDP mondial ED en tirant parti de l'expertise, de l'expérience, de la vitesse et de l'échelle en Chine
• Diriger l'équipe interfonctionnelle de la Chine pour évaluer les possibilités de la Chine de rejoindre les programmes mondiaux de DE ou les premiers essais de la Chine sur le plan stratégique, scientifique, réglementaire et opérationnel
• Favoriser la conception et la conduite d'essais innovants en partenariat étroit avec des experts fonctionnels mondiaux en développement précoce sur les premiers essais cliniques en Chine
• Être le moniteur médical pour les essais cliniques de DE en Chine
• Mobiliser scientifiquement les TAE chinois, les acteurs internes et externes de Roche
• Servir de point de contact scientifique avec les équipes mondiales de développement précoce des domaines thérapeutiques non oncologiques (immunologie, neurologie, CVRM, ophtalmologie)
• Mentor des directeurs médicaux juniors pour renforcer les capacités et les capacités du Conseil de l'Europe Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un MD ou d'un baccalauréat/maîtrise en médecine clinique avec au moins 3 ans de pratique clinique après l'obtention du diplôme; expertise clinique en immunologie préférée
• Vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie biopharmaceutique et une expérience de développement précoce étendue, expérience de développement précoce en immunologie préférée
• Vous avez une expérience pratique du développement précoce du PDC, de la conception et du déroulement des essais cliniques de développement précoce, de l'interaction avec les autorités sanitaires, de la collaboration avec les chercheurs et les sites de recherche clinique, et de l'interprétation des données des essais cliniques de développement précoce
• Vous avez une très bonne compréhension des lignes directrices et des règlements mondiaux en matière de développement, y compris le CDE, la FDA et l'EMEA
• Vous êtes un communicateur efficace : Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais, avec la capacité de présenter des concepts complexes aux équipes interfonctionnelles mondiales, aux comités de gouvernance et aux principales parties prenantes de manière logique et succincte
• Vous êtes un grand joueur d'équipe; hautement collaborative, de bonnes aptitudes interpersonnelles et influentes, peut influencer sans autorité Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le glob

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Security and Cybersecurity Analyst serves as a trusted advisor and independent leader who drives the analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents and technical problems
By bridging deep business and technical understanding, you will manage end-to-end security analysis tasks across multiple products within a domain
You will shape stakeholder perspectives, champion accountability by taking on security incident lead or project owner roles, and foster continuous improvement in security operations and best practices

Description of the area
The Identity Management Support Team manages and operates the solutions and components used to provide customers with Directory and Identity Management Services using SailPoint. We are part of a global Roche Digital Technology group (RDT).

Job Responsibilities
In this role, you are mainly responsible for the multi-cloud Identity Management environment, focusing specifically on Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), while maintaining consistency with AWS. This includes the design of new solutions, consultancy, maintenance, performance, tactical lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies.

Scope

• Strong background in IAM concepts at design level and evolution in Cloud environments, Azure and/or GCP.

• Contributes to the design of new solutions based on SailPoint and PingFederate, AD, Privilege Access Management.

• Design and implement Centralized Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) based on Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) principles.

• Access Governance and Controls: Enforce strong security controls across cloud environments, including Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and Identity Protection. Implement Least Privilege policies, often involving custom roles and organizational-level controls. Implement IAM Deny Policies to strictly block high-risk actions, ensuring separation of duties

• Automation and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Drive the core value of "Automate as much as possible". Design and implement IAM infrastructure using IaC, leveraging Terraform. For Azure, this mandates IaC using Terraform and Azure Verified Modules (AVM) with CI/CD pipelines in GitLab

• Privileged Access Management (PAM): Design and support Just-in-Time (JIT) Access mechanisms, ensuring no standing privileges for administrators, using tools like Cyberark for Just-in-Time access

• Operational Excellence: Act as an expert in the release management activities, providing 2nd and 3rd level support for the Identity Management Infrastructure. Proactively monitor systems for performance, availability, and capacity management

• Actively focus on self-development in creating actionable plans to improve.

Stakeholder Management

• Consultancy and Collaboration: Act as a mentor and reference, working closely with stakeholders to provide the right level of consultancy. Ensure regular interactions with the Managed Service Provider

• Acts as a strategic influencer, defining and driving stakeholder engagement strategies for complex initiatives, facilitating workshops, resolving conflicts, and proactively shaping stakeholder perspectives to align with project goals

Impact/Strategy

• Demonstrates strong and consistent performance across diverse products, with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster

• Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overall business objectives, and takes a proactive role in shaping team pro

The Position
生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。

A. 目标与计划管理

• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性

• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划

B. 客户管理与区域合作

• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
¿Te apasiona impulsar el futuro del diagnóstico sanitario? Buscamos un/a Sales Specialist dinámico/a para unirse a nuestro equipo. En este rol, serás la cara estratégica de Roche Diagnostics dentro del ecosistema del laboratorio hospitalario, estableciendo relaciones sólidas y comprendiendo las necesidades técnicas y emocionales más profundas de nuestros clientes.
Tu misión irá más allá de la venta tradicional: realizarás análisis de situación exhaustivos para posicionar estratégicamente nuestro Portfolio de Near Patient Care y Diabetes. Promoviendo la eficiencia de los procesos, la innovación en los flujos de trabajo y la diferenciación de nuestros productos, ayudarás a los laboratorios a superar sus desafíos actuales, acelerando y mejorando el impacto en el paciente.

Your Main Responsibilities

• Ejecución Estratégica y Crecimiento: Implementar las actividades comerciales definidas para alcanzar y superar los objetivos anuales, ganar participación de mercado y cumplir con los KPI estratégicos en cuentas actuales y potenciales.

• Co-creación de Valor: Identificar las necesidades y retos en los laboratorios, así como en las áreas de compras, finanzas y gerencia hospitalaria. Propondrás soluciones diferenciadoras que ilusionen y enganchen al cliente.

• Gestión del Ciclo de Vida del Cliente (360°): Liderar todo el ciclo de vida del cliente, asegurando los máximos niveles de satisfacción y construyendo relaciones de confianza a largo plazo.

• Experto/a en el Portfolio: Desarrollar un profundo conocimiento de nuestras soluciones diagnósticas, realizando presentaciones y demostraciones de producto efectivas que comuniquen con claridad nuestras ventajas competitivas.

Who You Are (The skills you need)
Buscamos un/a profesional estructurado/a, metódico/a, con un fuerte empuje comercial y una gran pasión por el sector salud.

• Formación y Trasfondo: Licenciatura o Grado en Ciencias de la Salud y/o experiencia demostrada en el sector sanitario. Se valorará muy positivamente la experiencia previa como técnico/a de laboratorio o en tareas docentes/formativas.

• Experiencia: Mínimo de 3 a 4 años de experiencia contrastada en venta consultiva dentro del ámbito comercial del Sector Salud.

• "Hunter Mindset": Ambición, compromiso y un hambre clara por ganar nuevas cuentas, respaldado por un track record tangible de éxito comercial.

• Inteligencia de Mercado: Conocimiento profundo de la industria del diagnóstico, competidores, regulaciones y el funcionamiento de la Administración Sanitaria (licitaciones y concursos públicos).

• Enfoque Analítico: Capacidad para tomar decisiones basadas en datos y utilizar herramientas comerciales metodológicas para identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio en el territorio asignado.

• Orientación al Cliente: Alta capacidad de escucha activa para entender las necesidades técnicas y emocionales, asegurando que el valor diferencial de Roche sea evidente en cada interacción.

• Idiomas: Dominio del español; se valorarán positivamente los conocimientos de inglés para interactuar con redes globales y formaciones.

• Residencia en Castilla y León. Disponibilidad para viajar más de un 50% del tiempo.

What is here for You?

• Un Propósito Real: Conectar tu día a día con una misión global: transformar la medicina personalizada y mejorar los resultados de salud desde el corazón del laboratorio hospitalario.

• Innovación a Gran Escala: Trabajar con el portafolio líder del mercado, introduciendo la automatización y la eficiencia en lo

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【募集職種】 Clinician Engagement Sales_九州エリア担当
　　　　　　（小・中型医療機器のソリューション営業・保守サポート）

【職務内容】
担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、および開業医・クリニックに対し、中型医療機器（e411）および小型検査機器（Near Patient Care / POCT）の提案から導入後の保守点検まで、一貫した価値提供を担っていただきます。顧客の潜在的な課題を抽出し、現場に最適なオーダーメイド製品の提案を行い、導入から稼働後のアフターフォローまで伴走します。単なる機器の販売にとどまらず、検査の迅速化による院内ワークフローの改善や、救急・急性期医療における診療の質向上など、医療従事者との強固な信頼関係を構築しながら、患者ケアの質を高めるトータルソリューションを提供していただきます。また、定期的な保守点検やトラブルシューティングを通じて、機器が常に最適なパフォーマンスを発揮できるよう現場を支える重要な役割です。

＜具体的な業務内容＞
1. 提案・営業活動（Clinician Engagement）

• 担当エリア（大学病院、総合病院、クリニック、開業医）の医師、看護師、臨床検査技師などへのアプローチ

• 医療現場の課題のヒアリングと課題抽出

• ニーズに合わせた機器（cobas e 411、cobas pulse、cobas liatなど）や試薬のプレゼンテーション、デモンストレーションの実施

• 導入に伴う費用対効果（ROI）のシミュレーション、見積書作成、契約交渉

2. 導入・立ち上げサポート

• 機器納入時のセットアップおよび動作確認

• 医療従事者向けの操作説明会（アプリケーション・トレーニング）の実施

3. 保守点検・アフターフォロー（Technical Support）

• 契定期的な保守点検（メンテナンス）の実施

• 機器の不具合やエラー発生時の一次対応（電話によるリモートサポート、または現場への訪問・修理対応）

• 新しい試薬（検査項目）の追加提案や、最新の学術情報の提供

【応募資格（必須要件）】
医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験
（対象顧客：大学病院、総合病院、または開業医・クリニック等）
具体的には、以下のいずれかの経験において高い成果を上げている方：

• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験

• 院長・事務長などの経営層や、医師・臨床検査技師などの現場担当者などのキーマンに対するアプローチおよび強固な関係構築経験

普通自動車第一種運転免許（AT限定可）

【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】
・医療業界において、営業活動と保守サービス両方の業務を一貫して担ったご経験（ハイブリッド型のご経験）をお持ちの方
・エンジニアで、保守サービスなどのプロモーションや提案活動のご経験をお持ちの方
・臨床検査領域における専門知識、または同関連製品の営業経験

【求める人物像】
Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方

Achieving Results（結果志向）: 「顧客の課題解決」と「機器の安定稼働」という高い目標の達成に向け、新規提案からアフターフォローまで、当事者意識を持ち根気強く行動し続けられる方

Teamwork & Collaborations（協働と連携）: お客様に最適なトータルソリューションを届けるため、自身の役割や枠組みにとらわれず、社内のさまざまなステークホルダーを巻き込み、チームワークとコラボレーションを促進できる方

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　Clinician Engagement Sales
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
就業場所
　　　　　（雇い入れ直後）: 福岡オフィス　〒812-0011　福岡県福岡市博多区博多駅前1-4-4東京建物博多ビル 12F
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜
　　※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～
※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。

＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）

諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
（※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生・社会保険 ：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙
募集者名 　ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社　(Roche Diagnostics K.K.)

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【募集職種】 Clinician Engagement Sales_九州エリア担当
（小・中型医療機器のソリューション営業・保守サポート）

【職務内容】
担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、および開業医・クリニックに対し、中型医療機器（e411）および小型検査機器（Near Patient Care / POCT）の提案から導入後の保守点検まで、一貫した価値提供を担っていただきます。顧客の潜在的な課題を抽出し、現場に最適なオーダーメイド製品の提案を行い、導入から稼働後のアフターフォローまで伴走します。単なる機器の販売にとどまらず、検査の迅速化による院内ワークフローの改善や、救急・急性期医療における診療の質向上など、医療従事者との強固な信頼関係を構築しながら、患者ケアの質を高めるトータルソリューションを提供していただきます。また、定期的な保守点検やトラブルシューティングを通じて、機器が常に最適なパフォーマンスを発揮できるよう現場を支える重要な役割です。

＜具体的な業務内容＞
1. 提案・営業活動（Clinician Engagement）

• 担当エリア（大学病院、総合病院、クリニック、開業医）の医師、看護師、臨床検査技師などへのアプローチ

• 医療現場の課題のヒアリングと課題抽出

• ニーズに合わせた機器（cobas e 411、cobas pulse、cobas liatなど）や試薬のプレゼンテーション、デモンストレーションの実施

• 導入に伴う費用対効果（ROI）のシミュレーション、見積書作成、契約交渉

2. 導入・立ち上げサポート

• 機器納入時のセットアップおよび動作確認

• 医療従事者向けの操作説明会（アプリケーション・トレーニング）の実施

3. 保守点検・アフターフォロー（Technical Support）

• 契定期的な保守点検（メンテナンス）の実施

• 機器の不具合やエラー発生時の一次対応（電話によるリモートサポート、または現場への訪問・修理対応）

• 新しい試薬（検査項目）の追加提案や、最新の学術情報の提供

【応募資格（必須要件）】
医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験
（対象顧客：大学病院、総合病院、または開業医・クリニック等）
具体的には、以下のいずれかの経験において高い成果を上げている方：

• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験

• 院長・事務長などの経営層や、医師・臨床検査技師などの現場担当者などのキーマンに対するアプローチおよび強固な関係構築経験

普通自動車第一種運転免許（AT限定可）

【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】
・医療業界において、営業活動と保守サービス両方の業務を一貫して担ったご経験（ハイブリッド型のご経験）をお持ちの方
・エンジニアで、保守サービスなどのプロモーションや提案活動のご経験をお持ちの方
・臨床検査領域における専門知識、または同関連製品の営業経験

【求める人物像】
Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方

Achieving Results（結果志向）: 「顧客の課題解決」と「機器の安定稼働」という高い目標の達成に向け、新規提案からアフターフォローまで、当事者意識を持ち根気強く行動し続けられる方

Teamwork & Collaborations（協働と連携）: お客様に最適なトータルソリューションを届けるため、自身の役割や枠組みにとらわれず、社内のさまざまなステークホルダーを巻き込み、チームワークとコラボレーションを促進できる方

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 （雇い入れ直後）：募集職種 Clinician Engagement Sales
（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
就業場所
（雇い入れ直後）: 福岡オフィス 〒812-0011 福岡県福岡市博多区博多駅前1-4-4東京建物博多ビル 12F
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜
※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～
※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。

＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）

諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など ※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
（※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休 暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生・社会保険 ：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
受動喫煙防止措置 屋内全面禁煙

jobs.title: Government & External Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position: Government & External Affairs Lead
Team: Health System Shaping Lab
Reports to: General Manager

Roche Slovensko is seeking a Government & External Affairs Lead to join the Local Leadership Team (Purpose Enabling Board - PEB). This senior role is responsible for shaping national policy and creating patient access strategies.

The successful candidate will proactively drive changes in the national policy and legislative environment. You will lead strategies to influence key stakeholders, ensuring patient access to our innovations. This position requires strategic thinking, political knowledge, and an entrepreneurial approach to impact the Slovak healthcare system.

Key Responsibilities:

• Policy Advocacy: Lead targeted efforts to influence public health and pricing legislation to drive systemic improvements for patient access and innovation.

• Stakeholder Management: Develop and maintain strong, strategic relationships with political stakeholders, decision-makers, and payers at the national level.

• External Representation: Serve as the primary representative for OneRoche, building alliances with external organizations to enhance reputation and create value.

• Strategic Alignment: Manage the External Engagement Strategy, ensuring it supports Patient Access goals and integrates across Pharma, Diagnostics, and the wider Roche enterprise.

• Leadership: Participate in the Purpose Enabling Board (Affiliate Leadership Team), connecting the Health System Shaping group's goals to the affiliate strategy, and guiding the team.

Required Qualifications:

• Experience: Minimum 5 years in Government & External Affairs (policy/network development). Minimum 7 years of experience in the Slovak Health Care. Minimum 6 months in leadership roles.

• Expertise:
Deep understanding of healthcare funding and external conditions impacting the system. Proven ability in strategy development, execution, and navigating complex or uncertain situations (Triple Win concept).

• Mindset:

• Systemic & Enabling: Focus on leveraging networks for value creation and scaling.

• Entrepreneurial: Self-managed, comfortable with risk, committed to continuous learning.

• Ethical: High integrity and strong alignment with affiliate values.

• Skills:
Strategic Thinking (Enterprise Mindset), VACC Leadership, Influencing, Effective Decision Making (in ambiguity), Strategic Agility (managing long-term goals amid change).

• Education & Language:
Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Medicine, Law, Health Economics). Fluent in Slovak and proficient in English.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is 64,900.00 EUR - 120,540.00 EUR. Roche Slovakia provides 13th month Salary. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 25% subject to both individual and company performance.

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conduct

The Position Position: Government & External Affairs Lead Team: Health System Shaping Lab Reports to: General Manager Roche Slovensko is seeking a Government & External Affairs Lead to join the Local Leadership Team (Purpose Enabling Board - PEB). This senior role is responsible for shaping national policy and creating patient access strategies. The successful candidate will proactively drive changes in the national policy and legislative environment. You will lead strategies to influence key stakeholders, ensuring patient access to our innovations. This position requires strategic thinking, political knowledge, and an entrepreneurial approach to impact the Slovak healthcare system. Key Responsibilities:
• Policy Advocacy: Lead targeted efforts to influence public health and pricing legislation to drive systemic improvements for patient access and innovation.
• Stakeholder Management: Develop and maintain strong, strategic relationships with political stakeholders, decision-makers, and payers at the national level.
• External Representation: Serve as the primary representative for OneRoche, building alliances with external organizations to enhance reputation and create value.
• Strategic Alignment: Manage the External Engagement Strategy, ensuring it supports Patient Access goals and integrates across Pharma, Diagnostics, and the wider Roche enterprise.
• Leadership: Participate in the Purpose Enabling Board (Affiliate Leadership Team), connecting the Health System Shaping group's goals to the affiliate strategy, and guiding the team. Required Qualifications:
• Experience: Minimum 5 years in Government & External Affairs (policy/network development). Minimum 7 years of experience in the Slovak Health Care. Minimum 6 months in leadership roles.
• Expertise: Deep understanding of healthcare funding and external conditions impacting the system. Proven ability in strategy development, execution, and navigating complex or uncertain situations (Triple Win concept).
• Mindset:
• Systemic & Enabling: Focus on leveraging networks for value creation and scaling.
• Entrepreneurial: Self-managed, comfortable with risk, committed to continuous learning.
• Ethical: High integrity and strong alignment with affiliate values.
• Skills: Strategic Thinking (Enterprise Mindset), VACC Leadership, Influencing, Effective Decision Making (in ambiguity), Strategic Agility (managing long-term goals amid change).
• Education & Language: Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Medicine, Law, Health Economics). Fluent in Slovak and proficient in English. Salary starts from 5410 EUR gross/month. jobs.title: Commercial Excellence Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities
I. Sales Target Setting and Management
• Support the preparation of annual and quarterly sales target-setting by providing historical data, market trends, and performance insights.

• Maintain and update sales performance against targets daily/weekly/monthly, identifying variances and provide data summaries to Sales Leadership for follow-up actions.

• Ensure targets are equitably distributed and clearly communicated across the sales force.

• Manage the sales performance relevant process(contract fillment, sales rebate, allowance)
II. Territory Design and Management
• Partner with sales leaders to develop and optimize sales territory structures to ensure fair opportunity distribution, minimize channel conflict, and maximize market coverage and penetration.

• Develop and maintain territory assignment rules and policies, performing regular audits and re-alignments based on business changes, market potential, and sales force size.

• Provide analysis and recommendations on optimal sales resource deployment and headcount planning.
III. Sales Performance Management and Market intelligence Analytics
• Develop, maintain, and disseminate key performance indicators (KPIs) and dashboards that provide clear, actionable insights into the health of the sales pipeline and overall performance.

• Conduct deep-dive analysis on sales trends, productivity metrics, and funnel conversion rates to identify bottlenecks and areas for process improvement.

• Support regular business review preparation and follow-up, including identifying performance gaps and tracking improvement actions.
IV. Tender coordination
• Partner with sales leaders to build the systematic approach to monitor and capture tender opportunities and follow up with the sales team.

• Filter the tender by portfolio and dispatch to the respective territory sales team

• Support sales team to prepare tender documentation and compilation .

V. Process Improvement and Enablement
• Identify opportunities to streamline and standardize core sales processes (e.g., forecasting, pipeline management, account planning).

• Partner with Sales Enablement to translate best practices and process improvements into effective training content and tools.
Compliance & Additional Tasks

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

• Perform other tasks as assigned by the line manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Analytics & Intelligence - Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Analyst
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Chennai or Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

As an Senior Analyst, you will collaborate closely with the Strategic Analytics & Insights team based in the US, Therapy Areas Insights Directors, Ecosystem Insights Leads, and the broader GATE team. Your primary responsibility will be to deliver advanced analytics and actionable insights that support strategic priorities, ultimately aiming for the greatest impact with customers and patients.

Your Opportunity

• Lead complex projects and initiatives in pharma commercial operations, focusing on Brand Performance tracking, Disease Market Overview, Patient Journeys (Treatment and Drug Fulfilment), Forecasting, Product launch support and assessment, Patient adherence, Physician / Account Targeting, Payer Mix, Marketing Impact and ROIs

• Collaborate with Therapy area managers, Ecosystem insights leads and other business stakeholders to understand market dynamics and customer behaviors, leveraging this knowledge to support data-driven strategies

• Comprehend stakeholder requirements, prioritize tasks, and effectively manage day-to-day responsibilities, including liaising and coordinating with the GATE internal team for delivery

• Lead the team and stakeholder discussions, act as thought partner and provide them with high quality analytics solutions and recommendations

• Create impactful presentations to convey crucial insights and recommendations to stakeholders effectively

• Attend meetings with teams across different time zones to ensure smooth delivery of analytical & operations related requests for the business partners

• Take an enterprise mindset, linking individual responsibilities with broader organization, focus on outcomes that provide most business and patient value

• Be flexible to attend meeting during IST/PST overlapping working hours

• Provide mentorship and training to junior team members and interns on analytics principles and the Pharma domain, fostering the development of skill sets and capabilities

Who you are

• You hold a bachelor degree in Technology or a relevant discipline, with a preference for Computer Science, Software, Statistics, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering and related fields and 4-8 years of analytics / consulting experience, with 2-5 years specifically in Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare analytics projects. Preferably, Master’s Degree or any certifications on analytics or data science would be an added advantage.

• Must demonstrate expertise in US Pharma Commercial Operations and possess a strong background in Sales analytics, Claims analytics, Product analysis, Patients analytics, forecasting and ROI analysis

• Experience with a range of secondary data sets, including IQVIA Sales data, 867 data, LAAD Claims, affiliations, field interactions, Veeva, medical data, and more, is a significant advantage

• Exposure to therapeutic areas like oncology, neurology, immunology, etc., along with a working knowledge of Salesforce or Veeva, is a valuable additional qualification

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Analizzatore senior Roche India – Servizi e Soluzioni Roche Chennai o Hyderabad Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Roche ha stabilito Global Analytics e Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) per guidare le soluzioni analitiche e tecnologiche, collaborando con gli affiliati Roche in tutto il mondo. In qualità di Senior Analyst, collaborerai a stretto contatto con il team Strategic Analytics & Insights con sede negli Stati Uniti, Therapy Areas Insights Directors, Ecosystem Insights Leads e il team GATE più ampio. La vostra responsabilità primaria sarà quella di fornire analisi avanzate e approfondimenti attuabili che supportano le priorità strategiche, in ultima analisi, mirando al massimo impatto con clienti e pazienti. La tua opportunità
• Progetti complessi di piombo e iniziative nelle operazioni commerciali di farmaci, concentrandosi sul monitoraggio delle prestazioni di marca, Panoramica del mercato delle malattie, Viaggi dei pazienti (Treatment and Drug Fulfilment), Previsione, Supporto e valutazione del lancio del prodotto, Aderenza paziente, Targeting del medico / Account, Payer Mix, Impatto di marketing e ROIs
• Collaborare con Therapy area manager, Ecosystem insights conduce e altri stakeholder aziendali per comprendere dinamiche di mercato e comportamenti dei clienti, sfruttando questa conoscenza per supportare le strategie basate sui dati
• Comprehend requisiti delle parti interessate, priorità dei compiti e gestire efficacemente le responsabilità quotidiane, tra cui liaising e il coordinamento con il team interno GATE per la consegna
• Guidare le discussioni di team e stakeholder, agire come partner di pensiero e fornire loro soluzioni e raccomandazioni di analisi di alta qualità
• Creare presentazioni efficaci per trasmettere informazioni e raccomandazioni cruciali agli stakeholder in modo efficace
• Partecipare alle riunioni con i team in diversi fusi orari per garantire una consegna regolare delle richieste analitiche e operative relative ai partner commerciali
• Prendere una mentalità aziendale, collegare le responsabilità individuali con un'organizzazione più ampia, concentrarsi sui risultati che forniscono la maggior parte del valore aziendale e paziente
• Sii flessibile per partecipare all'incontro durante le ore di lavoro sovrapposte IST/PST
• Fornire mentorship e formazione ai membri del team junior e agli stagisti sui principi di analisi e sul dominio Pharma, promuovendo lo sviluppo di set di competenze e capacità Chi sei
• Hai una laurea in Tecnologia o una disciplina rilevante, con una preferenza per Computer Science, Software, Statistica, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering e campi correlati e 4-8 anni di analisi / consulenza esperienza, con 2-5 anni specificamente nei progetti di analisi Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare. Preferibilmente, Master’s Degree o qualsiasi certificazione su analytics o data science sarebbe un vantaggio aggiuntivo.
• Deve dimostrare esperienza nelle operazioni commerciali di farmacia degli Stati Uniti e possedere un forte background in analisi delle vendite, analisi dei reclami, analisi dei prodotti, analisi dei pazienti, previsione e analisi ROI
• Esperienza con una serie di set di dati secondari, compresi i dati di vendita IQVIA, 867 dati, reclami LAAD, affiliazioni, interazioni sul campo, Veeva, dati medici, e altro ancora, è un vantaggio significativo
• L'esposizione a aree terapeutiche come oncologia, neurologia, immunologia, ecc., insieme a una conoscenza di lavoro di Salesforce o Veeva, è una valida qualifica aggiuntiva

• Führen Sie die Team- und Stakeholder-Diskussionen, fungieren als Gedankenpartner und bieten ihnen qualitativ hochwertige Analyselösungen und Empfehlungen
• Erstellen Sie effektvolle Präsentationen, um entscheidende Einblicke und Empfehlungen für Stakeholder effektiv zu vermitteln
• Besuchen Sie Treffen mit Teams in verschiedenen Zeitzonen, um eine reibungslose Lieferung von analytischen und operativen Anfragen an die Geschäftspartner zu gewährleisten
• Nehmen Sie einen Unternehmensvorteil, die Verbindung einzelner Verantwortlichkeiten mit breiterer Organisation, konzentrieren Sie sich auf Ergebnisse, die die meisten Geschäfts- und Patientenwert bieten
• Seien Sie flexibel, um während der IST/PST überlappenden Arbeitszeit zu treffen
• Vermittlung von Mentorschaft und Ausbildung an Junior-Team-Mitglieder und Praktikanten zu analytischen Prinzipien und der Pharma-Domain, Förderung der Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeiten Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Technologie oder eine relevante Disziplin, mit einer Vorliebe für Informatik, Software, Statistik, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering und verwandten Bereichen und 4-8 Jahre Analytik / Beratungserfahrung, mit 2-5 Jahren speziell in Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare Analytics Projekten. Vorzugsweise wäre der Master-Abschluss oder jede Zertifizierung auf Analytik oder Datenwissenschaft ein weiterer Vorteil.
• Muss Know-how in US Pharma Commercial Operations demonstrieren und einen starken Hintergrund in der Vertriebsanalytik, Claim-Analyse, Produktanalyse, Patientenanalyse, Prognose und ROI-Analyse besitzen
• Erfahrung mit einer Reihe von sekundären Datensätzen, einschließlich IQVIA-Vertriebsdaten, 867 Daten, LAAD-Anforderungen, Zugehörigkeiten, Feldinteraktionen, Veeva, medizinische Daten und mehr, ist ein wesentlicher Vorteil
• Exposition gegenüber therapeutischen Bereichen wie Onkologie, Neurologie, Immunologie usw., zusammen mit einem Arbeitswissen von Salesforce oder Veeva, ist eine wertvolle zusätzliche Qualifikation

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste d'analyste principal Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions Chennai ou Hyderabad Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Roche a créé le Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) pour piloter des solutions d'analyse et de technologie en partenariat avec ses filiales dans le monde entier. En tant qu'analyste principal, vous collaborerez étroitement avec l'équipe de Strategic Analytics & Insights basée aux États-Unis, les directeurs de Therapy Areas Insights, Ecosystem Insights Leads et l'équipe plus large de GATE. Votre responsabilité principale sera de fournir des analyses avancées et des informations pratiques qui soutiennent les priorités stratégiques, en fin de compte en vue d'obtenir le plus grand impact auprès des clients et des patients. Votre opportunité
• Diriger des projets et des initiatives complexes dans le domaine des opérations commerciales pharmaceutiques, en mettant l'accent sur le suivi de la performance de la marque, l'aperçu du marché des maladies, les voyages des patients (traitement et traitement des médicaments), la prévision, le soutien et l'évaluation du lancement des produits, l'adhésion des patients, le ciblage des médecins et des comptes, le mélange des payeurs, l'impact sur le marché et les RI
• Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de secteur de la thérapie, les chefs de file en matière d'écosystème et d'autres intervenants commerciaux pour comprendre la dynamique du marché et le comportement des clients, exploiter ces connaissances pour appuyer les stratégies axées sur les données
• Compréhension des besoins des intervenants, hiérarchiser les tâches et gérer efficacement les responsabilités quotidiennes, y compris la liaison et la coordination avec l'équipe interne du GATE pour la prestation des services
• Diriger les discussions entre l'équipe et les intervenants, agir en tant que partenaire de réflexion et leur fournir des solutions et des recommandations d'analyse de haute qualité
• Créer des présentations efficaces pour transmettre aux intervenants des idées et des recommandations cruciales
• Assister à des réunions d'équipes dans différents fuseaux Prendre une attitude d'entreprise, relier les responsabilités individuelles à une organisation plus large, se concentrer sur les résultats qui fournissent la plus grande valeur aux entreprises et aux patients
• Être flexible pour assister à des réunions pendant les heures de travail recoupant IST/PST
• Offrir un mentorat et une formation aux membres de l'équipe junior et aux stagiaires sur les principes d'analyse et le domaine Pharma, favorisant le développement des compétences et des capacités Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en technologie ou d'une discipline pertinente, avec une préférence pour l'informatique, les logiciels, les statistiques, la science des données, l'IA, l'apprentissage automatique, le génie des données et les domaines connexes et 4-8 ans d'expérience en analyse / conseil, avec 2-5 ans spécifiquement dans les projets d'analyse Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare. De préférence, le diplôme de maîtrise ou toute certification en analyse ou en science des données serait un avantage supplémentaire.
• Doit faire preuve d'expertise dans les opérations commerciales de Pharma US et posséder une solide expérience dans l'analyse des ventes, l'analyse des revendications, l'analyse des produits, l'analyse des patients, la prévision et l'analyse du ROI
• Expérience avec une gamme de données secondaires, y compris les données de vente IQVIA, 867 données, les revendications LAAD, les affiliations, les interactions sur le terrain, Veeva, les données médicales, et plus encore, est un avantage significatif
• L'exposition à des domaines thérapeutiques comme l'oncologie, la neurologie, l'immunologie, etc., ainsi qu'une connaissance pratique de Salesforce ou Veeva, est une qualification supplémentaire précieuse

jobs.title: 治疗领域专员_ BC
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。
A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:

• Products for the respective area of responsibility shall obtain Regulatory approvals in defined markets in close cooperation with other functions.

• The documents/deliverables for submissions are coordinated and compiled in a timely manner to support planned product registration timelines.

• The obtained Regulatory approvals/licenses products are maintained throughout the life cycle of the product by applying successful Regulatory change controls.

• The efficiency and the success of the Regulatory activities and strategies are maintained by clear agreements with other functions, stakeholders and external partners (authorities, companies, NBs etc).

• The regulatory requirements and strategic aspects are understood, communicated and implemented, kept up to date and are transparent within the organization.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities:
1. Regulatory document and submission compilation:

• Oversees the development of submission/product registration dossiers of more complex products/programs. Develops and manages at least parts of comprehensive global regulatory submissions and registration plans. May act as mentor for more junior team members in this area.

2. External interface management:

• Understands the structure, key roles and responsibilities of external customers/stakeholders. Understands and communicates timely and effectively the needs of external customers/stakeholders. Builds effective and enduring external relationships and applies effective stakeholder management practices. Actively contributes to audits by supporting preparation, execution and follow up.

3. Regulatory knowledge and strategy:

• Leads the organization to adapt to evolving regulatory environment and requirements.

• Experience in solving complex, critical health authority issues or equivalent.

• Understanding of external environmental changes, precedents, to navigate complex situations and influence strategies and decision making.

• Ability to interpret and apply understanding of the regulators' thinking to projects and apply strategies to the different needs of different regions without significant guidance.

• Proactively creates unique/innovative regulatory strategies and influencing approaches to avoid regulatory obstacles and accelerate worldwide approvals.

4. Stakeholder management and influencing:

• Effectively partners with stakeholders to understand and provide best solutions. Takes initiative to address problems or opportunities and involves stakeholders for best solutions. Develops relationships that significantly influence the current and future direction for Roche and our products. Understands what motivates other people to perform at their best. Is skilled at managing and influencing peers. Fosters an exchange of ideas amongst key stakeholders to be able to shift perspectives to reach a common agreeable outcome. Negotiates with stakeholders and creates win-win compromises.

5. Decision making: :

• Has courage to make decisions even outside of scope/comfort zone.

• Proactively Initiates activities independently and initiates interactions across departments as applicable. Embrace the good decision making principles. Pushes decision making to the lowest appropriate level. Commits to decisions that have been made. Shows good judgment in decision making. Makes good decisions without necessarily having all the information in a timely manner.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer for Network Security
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.

You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Network Security, you will lead the Design, Build, and Improvement of critical security infrastructures, specifically focusing on Cisco ISE, Wired Access Control (WAC), and Palo Alto Networks. This is a dual-impact role: you are the technical authority for the secure access layer, while simultaneously leading the engineering of a custom observability framework. You will develop the front-end, back-end, and integration logic required to provide deep visibility into the security product health and asset inventory.

Job Responsibilities

1. SME:
Secure Access (ISE, WAC, Palo Alto)

• Design & Architecture: Lead the high-level and low-level design (HLD/LLD) for global Cisco ISE deployments and Wired Access Control (WAC) strategies to ensure seamless, identity-based security.

• Palo Alto SME: Serve as the primary engineer for Palo Alto NGFW architectures, including advanced threat prevention, decryption, and secure egress/ingress traffic management.

• Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify gaps in the current security posture and implement technical enhancements to NAC policies, SGT (TrustSec) propagation, and firewall rule-sets.

• Build & Implementation: Act as the lead "implementer" for complex global migrations and new feature rollouts across the network security stack.

​
2. Observability Framework Engineering

• Full-Stack Development: Architect and develop a custom framework (front-end and back-end) to provide a "single pane of glass" for infrastructure health.

• Inventory & Integration: Build automated integrations with external data sources (CMDB, IPAM, etc.) to maintain a real-time, dynamic inventory of all network assets and security nodes.

• Telemetry Logic: Design custom logic to ingest and visualize telemetry from ISE, WAC, and Palo Alto using APIs, SNMP, and Syslog.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the lead engineer for complex network security escalations, providing root-cause analysis and implementing long-term, automated architectural fixes.

• Security Observability: Develop dashboards and reporting to provide real-time visibility into the "connected landscape," identifying insecure nodes or unauthorized devices before they can affect the network.

• Automation & Orchestration: Manage security policies as code while continuously improving automation workflows and cross-platform orchest

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A Field Services Engineer is responsible for performing the field service activities for Professional Diagnostics by provision and co-ordination of all activities relating to instrument troubleshooting, instrument installation, instrument preventative maintenance, software and hardware modification’s, relating to both pre and post sales requirements.
This is a field-based role.

Key Responsibilities
Technical Support

• Take accountability for cases being resolved by receiving cases, contacting clients, providing telephonic support

• Coordinate the resolution of escalated technical cases by identifying issues that require escalation, referring to appropriate escalation processes, providing feedback to customers, internal sales and line manager, following up until resolved and closing cases within customer expectations.

• Proactively provide technical support to customers by receiving ad-hoc customer support requests while on site, after hours etc., by receiving request for support from customers, logging case on system, providing technical support and closing case or distributing case correctly immediately.

• Provide expert technical support by receiving escalated cases, evaluating and resolving or escalating according to escalation policy and providing feedback to customers until resolved.
Modifications

• Conduct modifications by receiving notification of modification/enhancements, upskilling on technical requirements, contacting customers to schedule modifications and conducting as per specifications and standards and within deadlines. Manage the modification projects by engaging with internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance.
Installations & De-Installations

• Initiate project installations / de-installations by being appointed as project installation lead, engaging with Project Manager, agreeing installation requirements and specifications, conducting site inspection, understanding customer expectations and Customer Service and Support

• Maintain a customer centric approach with all customer engagements by aligning with the Roche values, maintaining professionalism, providing quality technical support and advice and delivering according to their expectations and SLA at all times.

• Proactively resolve customer issues by conducting courtesy visits, identifying potential issues and resolving and taking preventative action at all times.

You, as an ideal candidate, will have the following skills, experience and education:

• Qualifications: Diploma in Electrical Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering/ Biomedical Technology or equivalent.

• Experience working with chemistry / core lab instruments.

• Willingness to be on-call during evenings, weekends, and holidays (team rotation basis).

• Experience in technical support services– advantage

• Experience in the medical diagnostic industry-advantage

• High-level fluency in Hebrew and English.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, Ability to work independently.

• The successful candidate needs to be in possession of a valid driver's license

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, smoke study, VHP, Isolator EMPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Support the initial development and optimization of aseptic filling processes.
● Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified on equipment operation and aseptic techniques.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:
● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.
● Performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, filling and stoppering, capping.
● Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.
● Support environmental monitoring activities to ensure that the Isolatore environment meets aseptic standards.
● Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.
● Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.
● Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.
● Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area.
● Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
● College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies
● 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.
● Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification，Isolator filling line is preferred.
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.
● Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Technical Product Owner

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity

As a Technical Product Owner for our Source-to-Procure (S2P) ecosystem, you bridge the gap between technical execution and business objectives. Working at an advanced professional level alongside Senior Product Managers, you own the product backlog and drive the execution of our digital procurement roadmap. You join a collaborative, forward-thinking Informatics team focused on delivering enterprise-scale value.
In this role, you will:

• Own and prioritize the S2P product backlog, translating strategic business goals into actionable technical user stories.

• Lead the end-to-end scope and execution of large-scale S2P initiatives, managing dependencies across cross-functional teams.

• Optimize delivery methodologies by tailoring frameworks like Scrum, SAFe, Kanban, or ITSM to maximize efficiency and maintain high quality.

• Act as a trusted advisor to a diverse group of stakeholders, navigating complex matrix environments to align expectations and build consensus.

• Diagnose system bottlenecks and lead root-cause analysis to design and validate technical or workflow enhancement plans.

• Mentor team members , fostering a collaborative spirit, driving mutual accountability, and guiding the team through ambiguity.

Who You Are

You are a versatile, analytical professional who thrives at the intersection of agile delivery and procurement technology. You are a natural facilitator who handles uncertainty with a pragmatic mindset and communicates effortlessly with both technical and business partners.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• 6-8 years of experience working with procurement platforms (Source-to-Pay, Sourcing, Contracting, or Requisition-to-Pay), including at least 2 years supporting the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.

• A proven track record of leading the delivery of complex features, major product releases, or service transitions within a product ownership or delivery management capacity.

• Versatile framework expertise with hands-on experience navigating environments as a Product Owner, Project Manager, Service Delivery Manager, or Agile Coach.

• Strong strategic acumen with a demonstrated ability to translate high-level business goals into structured implementation roadmaps and technical delivery strategies.

• Advanced problem-solving skills and proficiency with modern delivery tools to analyze dependencies, run root-cause analysis, and optimize workflows.

• Exceptional relationship-building skills , with a coaching mindset

Un livello professionale avanzato insieme ai Senior Product Manager, possiedi il product backlog e guidi l'esecuzione della nostra roadmap digitale di appalti. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, porti: - 6-8 anni di esperienza nel lavoro con piattaforme di approvvigionamento (Source-to-Pay, Sourcing, Contracting o Requisition-to-Pay), inclusi almeno 2 anni di supporto al settore delle scienze della vita o dell'industria farmaceutica. - No. Un track record comprovato nella guida della consegna di funzionalità complesse, di importanti rilasci di prodotti o di transizioni di servizi all'interno di una capacità di proprietà del prodotto o di gestione della consegna. - Esperienza versatile con i framework con esperienza pratica nella navigazione di ambienti come Product Owner, Project Manager, Service Delivery Manager o Agile Coach. - Forte acume strategica con capacità dimostrata di tradurre obiettivi aziendali di alto livello in road map di implementazione strutturate e strategie di consegna tecnica. - Abilità avanzata di problem solving e competenza con strumenti di consegna moderni per analisi le dipendenze, eseguire l'analisi delle cause eredita e ottimizza i flussi di lavoro. - Eccellenti capacità di costruzione di relazioni, con un mindset di coaching.

• Optimize delivery methodologies by tailoring frameworks like Scrum, SAFe, Kanban, or ITSM to maximize efficiency and maintain high quality.

• Act as a trusted advisor to a diverse group of stakeholders, navigating complex matrix environments to align expectations and build consensus.

• Diagnose system bottlenecks and lead root-cause analysis to design and validate technical or workflow enhancement plans.

• Mentor team members , fostering a collaborative spirit, driving mutual accountability, and guiding the team through ambiguity.

Who You Are

You are a versatile, analytical professional who thrives at the intersection of agile delivery and procurement technology. You are a natural facilitator who handles uncertainty with a pragmatic mindset and communicates effortlessly with both technical and business partners.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• 6-8 years of experience working with procurement platforms (Source-to-Pay, Sourcing, Contracting, or Requisition-to-Pay), including at least 2 years supporting the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.

• A proven track record of leading the delivery of complex features, major product releases, or service transitions within a product ownership or delivery management capacity.

• Versatile framework expertise with hands-on experience navigating environments as a Product Owner, Project Manager, Service Delivery Manager, or Agile Coach.

• Strong strategic acumen with a demonstrated ability to translate high-level business goals into structured implementation roadmaps and technical delivery strategies.

• Advanced problem-solving skills and proficiency with modern delivery tools to analyze dependencies, run root-cause analysis, and optimize workflows.

• Exceptional relationship-building skills , with a coaching mindset
