jobs.title: (Sr) AI Engineering Consultant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:
Serving as the Lead Architect of AI Transformation, this role is the visionary and technical engine behind redefining how the organization builds software. Much like a technical evangelist and researcher, you will bridge the gap between "Research AI" and "Applied AI Engineering." Your mission is to revolutionize the engineering lifecycle through AI, establish world-class methodologies for AI-native product development, and act as a high-impact coach to transition the entire engineering team into an AI-augmented powerhouse. You will ensure we don't just "use AI," but fundamentally change how we engineer for the future.

The Opportunity:

AI-Driven Engineering Transformation

• Methodology Research: Deeply research and define the next generation of software engineering workflows (e.g., Software 2.0, Agentic Workflows, AI-assisted coding architectures).

• Process Redesign: Diagnose existing engineering bottlenecks and deploy AI tools/frameworks to automate and optimize the SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle), achieving radical efficiency gains.

• Evolutionary Catalyst: Serve as a "Strategic Catalyst" to steer the engineering culture toward an AI-Native mindset.

Product Engineering & AI Integration

• AI Engineering Excellence: Design and oversee the implementation of robust, scalable AI engineering patterns (LLMOps, RAG architectures, and fine-tuning pipelines) to bring AI capabilities into the core product portfolio.

• Agile Prototyping: Rapidly translate the latest breakthroughs in AI research (from multi-modal models to reasoning-step optimizations) into production-ready features with an agile, hands-on approach.

• Technical Interpretation: Translate complex algorithmic logic and technical constraints into actionable business roadmaps and product strategies.

Capability Building & Knowledge Hub

• Master Educator: Design and lead high-level AI training programs for senior engineers and architects, focusing on Prompt Engineering, model evaluation, and AI-native architecture.

• AI Knowledge Hub: Build and iterate an enterprise-level repository of AI best practices, reusable code patterns, and internal benchmarks to ensure consistent technical excellence.

• Talent Coaching: Mentor engineering leads on how to leverage AI to scale their own teams’ output and creative capacity.

Who you are:

Education & Qualifications

• Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

• A proven track record of open-source contributions or technical thought leadership in the AI space.

Experience

• 5+ years of senior engineering experience, with at least 3+ years specifically focused on deploying AI/ML systems at scale.

• Experience in Digital Transformation or leading large-scale engineering team transitions is highly preferred.

Professional Capabilities/Skills

• AI Technical Mastery: Deep expertise in LLMs, Generative AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and modern AI infrastructure (GPU orchestration, vector databases).

• Engineering Methodology: Strong opinions, weakly held, on software architecture, clean code in the age of AI, and "Human-in-the-loop" engineering systems.

• Business Acumen: The ability to match bleeding-edge AI capabilities with specific market pain points and IVD/Tech business scenarios.

• Soft Skills: Exceptional cross-functional communication and "Change Management" capabilities—the ability to inspire a team to unlearn old habits an

titleByLocale.fr: フィールドサイエンティスト（東京）

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】 本ポジションは、検査に関して高度な専門性、学術知識を持つスペシャリストとして、臨床検査技師や医師、コメディカルに対して最前線で向き合い、検査機器の設置時の最適なアプリケーションセットアップや、検査試薬を用いた正確なデータ取得に向けた技術的アプローチを主導します。日進月歩で進化する医療技術や個別化医療のトレンドを捉えながら、医療現場や検査室が抱える潜在的な課題を専門的見地から抽出し、解決へと導くことが求められます。
高い責任感を持って検査室の検査の質や生産性向上にダイレクトに貢献し、ひいては患者様への最適な医療提供や「臨床検査の価値向上」に繋げていただく、非常にやりがいがあるポジションです。

【業務内容】 ご自身の専門領域および担当エリアにおいて、施設担当の営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職からの依頼、および電話一次対応のカスタマーサポートからの依頼に基づき、病院や検査センターに訪問して以下の業務を担っていただきます。

1. 医療従事者との関係構築・学術活動（拡販活動）

• 臨床検査技師、医師、コメディカルとのコミュニケーションを通じた強固な関係構築

• 当社製品の情報提供及び拡販活動（病院内、検査センター内向けの勉強会の企画・実施等を含む）

2.アプリケーション・セットアップおよび高度なデータサポート

• 検査機器の設置時における、専門的なアプリケーションセットアップ業務

• 検査試薬を用いた、正確なデータ取得のための技術的なサポート業務

• Digital Productを用いた検査業務の運用最適化の推進業務

• 機器試薬に関する問い合わせ、苦情対応業務

3. セールス・サポートおよび将来のプロモーション活動

• 専門的知見を用いた、機器・DigitalProduct・試薬販売における営業へのサポート業務および検査室への学術情報の提供

• 将来的にはセールスサイエンティストとして、顧客の課題抽出やソリューション提案、プロモーション活動など、ビジネスを牽引する役割も期待されます

【応募条件（必須要件）】

• 普通自動車運転免許および運転経験を有すること。

• 全国転勤可であること。

titleByLocale.it: Senior Cybersecurity Ingegnere for Secure Access Network
titleByLocale.en: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer for Secure Access Network
titleByLocale.de: Senior Cybersecurity Ingenieur for Secure Access Network
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Cybersecurity Ingénieur for Secure Access Network

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee ingress and egress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are delivered through leading-edge security platforms, automation, and orchestration .
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection, Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN), Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Network Security), you will act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Secure Access Network Services, leading the evolution of Network Access Control, identity-driven security, segmentation and authentication services across Roche's global enterprise.
Your mission is to ensure that Roche’s network remains resilient and compliant through the continuous evolution of our "Defense in Depth" strategy.

Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Technical Leadership

• Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Secure Access technologies, providing deep technical expertise in the evaluation and selection of emerging security tools.

• Drive the long-term technical roadmap for network access, ensuring all initiatives are strictly aligned with Roche's Zero Trust security architecture and strategy.

• Partner with business units to translate high-level security requirements into actionable, scalable technical initiatives and functional policies.

• Provide mentorship and technical leadership to junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence within the team.

Identity-Based Access and Authentication

• Design, deploy, and maintain robust authentication solutions utilizing protocols such as 802.1X, EAP-TLS, EAP-TEAP, RADIUS, TACACS+, SAML, and MFA.

• Integrate disparate security platforms with enterprise Identity Providers (IdPs) to ensure a seamless and secure authentication flow across the environment.

• Architect and manage highly available authentication services to support Roche's global workforce and critical business operations.

Network Access Control (NAC) and Segmentation

• Lead the end-to-end lifecycle management of Cisco ISE deployments, including software upgrades, capacity planning, and platform optimization.

• Develop and refine endpoint profiling techniques to accurately identify and secure corporate, medical, and IoT devices.

• Implement advanced access control mechanisms , including Dot1x, MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB), Guest Access, and posture-based authorization.

• Design and oversee the implementation of Cisco TrustSec and Scalable Group Tag (SGT)-based micro-segmentation to reduce the network attack surface.

Operational Excellence and Automation

• Serve as a senior point of escalation for complex technical incidents, performing deep root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive observability, monitoring, and reporting dashboards to track platform health and security compliance.

• Advocate for and implement Infrastruct

The Position
Job description

As a Cloud DevOps Infrastructure Engineer at the SE7 level, you will be responsible for solving unusually complex business problems with innovative DevOps solutions across the entire infrastructure landscape. Possessing deep knowledge of the impact of DevOps practices on business infrastructure, you will make critical technical decisions across multiple product lines with considerable independence. In this role, you will proactively influence technology strategy, mentor teams, and ensure alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory standards.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Establishes technical direction to the whole lifecycle of platforms and services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and retirement. Applies software engineering principles to build and manage large-scale IT infrastructure products and services, abstracting away the complexity of infrastructure to provide self-service tools and APIs for developers. Designs complex CI/CD pipelines, designs and develops self-healing features, and leads Disaster Recovery design and execution plans.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Strategically applies advanced problem-solving and decision-making skills to address highly complex issues spanning multiple product lines within a domain. Leads the maintenance of live services by designing metrics to measure availability, latency, and system health, and is responsible for identifying critical metrics used to establish SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs. Proactively plans for IT Infrastructure capacity, performance, and scalability, and leads large initiatives aimed at optimizing inter-related platforms. Accountable for availability, tuning, efficiency, change and configuration management, and emergency response.

• Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates exceptional customer and delivery focus by proactively leading partnership and collaboration with developers, Managed Services suppliers, and vendors to continuously improve application development velocity and optimize services reliability. Works closely with development teams to ensure new features are rolled out with a strategic understanding of reliability. Provides direction, guidance, and priority setting, acting as a senior analyst to transform customer and developer needs into specific requirements.

• Impact/Strategy: Ensures implemented solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and is responsible for implementing and updating cost, compliance, and security best practices. Leads complex audit exercises, providing required evidence to audit teams, and leads audit remediation plans. Manages ITSM processes, challenges requirements to scale systems sustainably, and applies innovation to foster business strategy.

• Complexity/ (Product Size): Demonstrates proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse virtual teams globally, driving success across multiple product lines within a domain. Leads geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing specialized guidance to optimize performance and innovation.

• Business/Technical ability: Utilizes wide experience applying Software Engineering principles, automated testing, and CI/CD tools to define technical computing infrastructure entirely under the control of software with no human intervention. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Solution Lead at this level, you lead the strategy, operating model, and delivery governance for Clinical Data Standards, Master Data, and the supporting technology ecosystem, including Roche's in-house standards and reference data platforms (Global Clinical Data Standards Repository (GDSR) and Lynx). You partner with PD Data Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Study Teams, Roche Data Technologies, and Enterprise Informatics to ensure clinical data is defined once, governed consistently, delivered reliably, and reused at scale. This role requires deep expertise in CDISC and semantic modelling, combined with strong delivery leadership, to shape interoperable, metadata-driven foundations and ensure the associated platforms are run with the right quality, compliance, and service levels.

Description of the area

Within PD Data Sciences, this area is responsible for defining, governing, and operationalizing the standards and master data that underpin Roche's clinical data landscape. The team ensures consistent use of clinical data standards, controlled terminology, metadata, and master/reference data across protocol design, data collection, transformation, analysis, submission, and downstream reuse. It also drives the roadmap and business-facing direction for the in-house technologies that manage these assets (GDSR and Lynx), enabling study teams and downstream analytical environments to consume trusted standards and master data through governed, reusable services.
A key focus of the area is advancing semantic interoperability across the clinical ecosystem. This includes developing semantically rich information models, metadata structures, and linked data concepts that improve traceability, reuse, and machine readability across clinical workflows. By combining strong governance with fit-for-purpose technology and disciplined delivery management, the team creates AI-ready foundations that allow analytics and agentic solutions to reason over high-quality, well-defined clinical data assets safely and consistently, while sustaining operational reliability, release quality, and business continuity for downstream consumers.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Leads the domain vision for Clinical Data Standards, Master Data, and supporting technologies, shaping cross-functional strategy, governance, priorities, and delivery models. Acts as a subject matter expert in CDISC, master/reference data management, and semantic modelling, while setting clear expectations for platform health, release quality, and vendor or partner accountability.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads resolution of complex issues spanning data standards adoption, metadata definition, master data stewardship, technology integration, and downstream consumption. Establishes transparent tracking for roadmap delivery, defects, incidents, and service health; anticipates gaps in process, governance, and architecture; conducts root cause analysis across organizational boundaries; and drives sustainable solutions that improve data quality, lineage, platform reliability, and operational efficiency.

• Stakeholder Management: Builds trusted partnerships across PD Data Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Study Teams, Regulatory, Roche Data Technologies, Enterprise Data, Architecture, Informatics, and external delivery partners. Translates between scientific, operational, and technical stakeholders, acts as a trusted liaison between business owners

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, w e offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The role of an Information Architect is to understand business processes and information objects and to work with members of the informatics and business team to identify and design information flows and information standards that meet the business needs . The Information Architect works toward consistency within and across groups and drives for reuse and simplicity of information objects . The Information Architect will do this by identifying, classifying, standardizing information objects and creating information flows, working closely with Business Stakeholders, Solution Architects, Software Architects, IT Business Partners, and Business Analysts .

The Opportunity:

• Design and maintain the comprehensive information landscape and streamline both incoming and outgoing information flows for MRHub .

• Establish and enforce critical standards and governance for information objects in close partnership with the Data Engineering Lead .

• Drive quality assurance by performing periodic reviews on the compliance and integrity of all information objects and architectural flows .

• Provide strategic leadership on information modeling to project and operational teams, ensuring alignment with global informatics goals .

• Identify and organize complex information requirements and objects for MRHub to ensure seamless traceability and easy access .

• Support remediation of sub-optimal data flows within business processes to enhance overall system efficiency and performance .

• Ensure architectural accuracy by maintaining up-to-date automated flows in Archimedes and creating conceptual designs that fit IT/Business strategies .

• Collaborate with Agile teams and Solution Architects to document governance, compliance, and master data standards within solution architecture .

Who you are:

• Extensive experience leading complex data science and information architecture projects from end-to-end with a drive for significant business impact .
Proven track record of working closely with senior leadership to inform and influence high-level strategic business decisions and data frameworks .

• Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing enterprise-wide data science frameworks, information lifecycles, and governance best practices .

• Deep technical proficiency in programming languages such as Python and R, coupled with the ability to architect and maintain complex version control workflows using Git.

• Comprehensive expertise in cloud-native database manageme

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data/Information Architect - Piattaforme dati Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è il luogo in cui l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. In qualità di team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnici orientati al business impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale dell’assistenza sanitaria di domani. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all’avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell’intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Spinti dallo scopo e dalla passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale sarà un punto di forza fondamentale per tutta Roche, consentendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, liberando il potenziale umano e promuovendo scoperte che contano davvero per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. In Roche offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità e collaborazione di persona. Per ora, richiediamo che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni di ufficio specifici possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi di collaborazione. Il ruolo di un architetto dell'informazione è comprendere i processi aziendali e gli oggetti informativi e lavorare con i membri del team informatico e aziendale per identificare e progettare flussi di informazioni e standard informativi che soddisfino le esigenze aziendali. L'Architetto dell'Informazione lavora per garantire la coerenza all'interno e tra i gruppi e promuove il riutilizzo e la semplicità degli oggetti informativi. L'architetto dell'informazione lo farà identificando, classificando, standardizzando gli oggetti informativi e creando flussi di informazioni, lavorando a stretto contatto con le parti interessate aziendali, gli architetti di soluzioni, gli architetti di software, i partner commerciali IT e gli analisti aziendali. L'opportunità:
• Progettare e mantenere il panorama informativo completo e semplificare i flussi di informazioni in entrata e in uscita per MRHub.
• Stabilire e applicare standard critici e governance per gli oggetti informativi in ​​stretta collaborazione con il responsabile dell'ingegneria dei dati.
• Promuovere la garanzia della qualità eseguendo revisioni periodiche sulla conformità e l'integrità di tutti gli oggetti informativi e dei flussi architettonici.
• Fornire leadership strategica sulla modellazione delle informazioni ai team operativi e di progetto, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi informatici globali.
• Identificare e organizzare requisiti di informazioni e oggetti complessi per MRHub per garantire tracciabilità senza soluzione di continuità e facile accesso.
• Supportare la correzione dei flussi di dati non ottimali all'interno dei processi aziendali per migliorare l'efficienza e le prestazioni complessive del sistema.
• Garantire l'accuratezza dell'architettura mantenendo flussi automatizzati aggiornati in Archimedes e creando progetti concettuali che si adattino alle strategie IT/aziendali.
• Collaborare con team Agile e Solution Architect per documentare gli standard di governance, conformità e dati master all'interno dell'architettura della soluzione. Chi sei:
• Vasta esperienza nella guida di progetti complessi di data science e architettura dell'informazione dall'inizio alla fine con una spinta verso un impatto aziendale significativo. Comprovata esperienza di lavoro a stretto contatto con la leadership senior per informare e influenzare decisioni aziendali strategiche di alto livello e strutture di dati.
• Competenza dimostrata nella progettazione e implementazione di strutture di data science, cicli di vita delle informazioni e best practice di governance a livello aziendale.
• Profonda competenza tecnica nei linguaggi di programmazione come Python e R, unita alla capacità di progettare e mantenere flussi di lavoro complessi di controllo delle versioni utilizzando Git.
• Competenza completa nella gestione di database nativi del cloud

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und in den kommenden Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Daten-/Informationsarchitekt – Datenplattformen Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation auf Zweck trifft. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft geschäftsorientierter Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien voranzutreiben und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der die Digitalisierung eine zentrale Stärke von Roche darstellt. Wir ermöglichen intelligentere Arbeitsweisen, setzen menschliches Potenzial frei und treiben Durchbrüche voran, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wirklich von Bedeutung sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Derzeit verlangen wir von unseren Mitarbeitern, dass sie durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Townhalls, Teambesprechungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Die Rolle eines Informationsarchitekten besteht darin, Geschäftsprozesse und Informationsobjekte zu verstehen und mit Mitgliedern des Informatik- und Geschäftsteams zusammenzuarbeiten, um Informationsflüsse und Informationsstandards zu identifizieren und zu entwerfen, die den Geschäftsanforderungen entsprechen. Der Informationsarchitekt strebt die Konsistenz innerhalb und zwischen Gruppen an und fördert die Wiederverwendung und Einfachheit von Informationsobjekten. Der Informationsarchitekt wird dies tun, indem er Informationsobjekte identifiziert, klassifiziert, standardisiert und Informationsflüsse erstellt und dabei eng mit Geschäftsinteressenten, Lösungsarchitekten, Softwarearchitekten, IT-Geschäftspartnern und Geschäftsanalysten zusammenarbeitet. Die Chance:
• Entwerfen und pflegen Sie die umfassende Informationslandschaft und optimieren Sie sowohl den eingehenden als auch den ausgehenden Informationsfluss für MRHub.
• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Data Engineering Lead kritische Standards und Governance für Informationsobjekte etablieren und durchsetzen.
• Fördern Sie die Qualitätssicherung durch regelmäßige Überprüfungen der Konformität und Integrität aller Informationsobjekte und Architekturabläufe.
• Bereitstellung strategischer Führung bei der Informationsmodellierung für Projekt- und Betriebsteams und Sicherstellung der Ausrichtung auf globale Informatikziele.
• Identifizieren und organisieren Sie komplexe Informationsanforderungen und -objekte für MRHub, um eine nahtlose Rückverfolgbarkeit und einen einfachen Zugriff sicherzustellen.
• Unterstützen Sie die Behebung suboptimaler Datenflüsse innerhalb von Geschäftsprozessen, um die Effizienz und Leistung des Gesamtsystems zu verbessern.
• Stellen Sie architektonische Genauigkeit sicher, indem Sie aktuelle automatisierte Abläufe in Archimedes beibehalten und konzeptionelle Designs erstellen, die zu IT-/Geschäftsstrategien passen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit agilen Teams und Lösungsarchitekten zusammen, um Governance, Compliance und Stammdatenstandards innerhalb der Lösungsarchitektur zu dokumentieren. Wer Sie sind:
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Datenwissenschafts- und Informationsarchitekturprojekte von Anfang bis Ende mit dem Streben nach erheblichen geschäftlichen Auswirkungen. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Architecte de données/informations - Plateformes de données Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation rencontre l'objectif. En tant qu’équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues à l’esprit commercial engagés à contribuer à façonner l’avenir numérique des soins de santé de demain. Notre mission est de propulser Roche grâce à des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Animés par un objectif et une passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique constitue une force essentielle dans l’ensemble de Roche, permettant des méthodes de travail plus intelligentes, libérant le potentiel humain et conduisant à des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous proposons un modèle de travail hybride qui allie flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l’instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient présents dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, tels que des ateliers, des conférences, des assemblées publiques, des réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements collaboratifs. Le rôle d'un architecte de l'information est de comprendre les processus métier et les objets d'information et de travailler avec les membres de l'équipe informatique et commerciale pour identifier et concevoir des flux d'informations et des normes d'information qui répondent aux besoins de l'entreprise. L'architecte de l'information travaille à la cohérence au sein et entre les groupes et favorise la réutilisation et la simplicité des objets d'information. Pour ce faire, l'architecte de l'information identifiera, classifiera, standardisera les objets d'information et créera des flux d'informations, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes de l'entreprise, les architectes de solutions, les architectes logiciels, les partenaires commerciaux informatiques et les analystes commerciaux. L'opportunité :
• Concevoir et maintenir un paysage d'informations complet et rationaliser les flux d'informations entrants et sortants pour MRHub.
• Établir et appliquer des normes et une gouvernance critiques pour les objets d'information en étroite collaboration avec le responsable de l'ingénierie des données.
• Piloter l'assurance qualité en effectuant des examens périodiques sur la conformité et l'intégrité de tous les objets d'information et flux architecturaux.
• Fournir un leadership stratégique sur la modélisation de l'information aux équipes de projet et opérationnelles, en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs informatiques mondiaux.
• Identifiez et organisez les exigences et les objets d'informations complexes pour MRHub afin de garantir une traçabilité transparente et un accès facile.
• Prise en charge de la correction des flux de données sous-optimaux au sein des processus métier afin d'améliorer l'efficacité et les performances globales du système.
• Assurer l'exactitude architecturale en maintenant les flux automatisés à jour dans Archimède et en créant des conceptions conceptuelles adaptées aux stratégies informatiques/commerciales.
• Collaborer avec les équipes Agile et les architectes de solutions pour documenter la gouvernance, la conformité et les normes de données de base au sein de l'architecture de la solution. Qui vous êtes :
• Vaste expérience dans la direction de projets complexes de science des données et d'architecture de l'information de bout en bout avec une volonté d'avoir un impact commercial significatif. Expérience avérée de travail en étroite collaboration avec la haute direction pour éclairer et influencer les décisions commerciales stratégiques de haut niveau et les cadres de données.
• Expertise démontrée dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de cadres de science des données à l'échelle de l'entreprise, de cycles de vie de l'information et de meilleures pratiques de gouvernance.
• Maîtrise technique approfondie des langages de programmation tels que Python et R, associée à la capacité d'architecturer et de maintenir des flux de travail de contrôle de version complexes à l'aide de Git.
• Expertise complète dans la gestion de bases de données cloud natives

titleByLocale.it: Pasante de Affari Aziendali e Comunicazione

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Como Pasante de Corporate Affairs & Communications en Roche Chile, tienes la oportunidad única de adquirir experiencia real dentro de una industria altamente regulada. Al integrarte a nuestra área, serás un actor clave para dar vida a nuestra cultura, conectando nuestro propósito y valores institucionales con los medios de comunicación, líderes de la salud y nuestra propia comunidad interna.

La Oportunidad:

• Apoyas en tácticas de relaciones públicas mediante el monitoreo diario de prensa, la actualización de bases de datos de periodistas y la redacción de comunicados para hitos corporativos.

• Colaboras en planes de posicionamiento para promover a líderes internos de Roche como referentes técnicos del debate de salud pública.

• Ejecutas estrategias de comunicación interna usando narrativas transmedia para traducir información en mensajes movilizadores que fortalezcan nuestra cultura corporativa.

• Planificas y redactas contenido para los canales digitales de Roche Chile, adaptando mensajes complejos a formatos multiplataforma para interactuar de forma fluida con la comunidad digital.

• Asistes en el análisis de entorno y en la preparación de documentos de posición dirigidos a autoridades ministeriales y legislativas, apoyando nuestro rol en la modernización del sistema de salud chileno.

• Aseguras el soporte operativo controlando los flujos de trabajo de comunicación y garantizando el cumplimiento riguroso de los estándares normativos de la industria farmacéutica.

Quién eres:

• Eres estudiante activo de 3ero o 4to año de la carrera de Periodismo .

• Cuentas con alta capacidad de autogestión para dedicar al menos 4 horas diarias, las cuales puedes coordinar de manera flexible según tus compromisos universitarios.

• Posees sólidas habilidades de redacción periodística, ortografía, capacidad de entrevista y un excelente criterio editorial.

• Manejas a nivel intermedio herramientas de edición digital, multimedia y creación de imágenes.

• Tienes un nivel de inglés intermedio.

*Los beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta vacante.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care

titleByLocale.it: Cardiologia e cura critica del partner del valore medico
titleByLocale.en: Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care
titleByLocale.de: Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care
titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire de valeur médicale Cardiologie et soins essentiels

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care
Roche Diagnostics Nederland

We zijn op zoek naar een ervaren Medical Affairs professional om ons team te versterken in de functie van Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care. In deze functie maak je deel uit van het Medical & Access Chapter en werk je samen met collega's aan de uitdagingen en ontwikkelingen in de gezondheidszorg. In een multidisciplinair team en op een agile werkwijze, draag je bij aan de toegankelijkheid van de diagnostische en digitale innovaties voor de patiënt om het zorgpad en daarmee de patiëntuitkomsten te verbeteren.

Als Medical Value Partner ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de medische strategie van Cardiologie en Critical Care. Hiervoor werk je samen met diverse stakeholders, waaronder Key Opinion Leaders binnen cardiologie, interne geneeskunde en anesthesiologie, patiëntenverenigingen, beroepsverenigingen en zorgverzekeraars.
We zoeken iemand met een sterk strategisch en analytisch denkvermogen, creativiteit en een proactieve houding. Je hebt ervaring met evidence generation, het vertalen van bewijslast naar de dagelijkse praktijk, de toepassing van waardegedreven zorg, medische of waardegedreven projecten en het ontwikkelen van gerichte medische educatie. Daarnaast is ervaring met werken in multidisciplinaire teams, stakeholder engagement en kennis van de farmaceutische industrie en/of gezondheidszorg gewenst.

Als persoon ben je een teamspeler, flexibel, resultaatgericht en in staat om prioriteiten te stellen. Je hebt een open mindset en kunt in een dynamische en agile omgeving werken. Daarnaast ben je communicatief sterk en kun je helder en effectief communiceren in zowel Nederlands als Engels.

Je verantwoordelijkheden:

• Het identificeren en creëren van kansen om de patiëntenzorg te verbeteren

• Het bouwen en onderhouden van relevante stakeholder netwerken

• Het genereren van klinische bewijslast in samenwerking met artsen en onderzoekers

• Het organiseren van medische educatie

• Als subject matter expert ben je een (sparring) partner voor interne en externe stakeholders

Je vaardigheden:

• Kennis op het gebied van cardiologie en/of critical care

• Uitstekende communicatie vaardigheden en in staat mensen te verbinden en mobiliseren

• Ervaring met klinische studies, medische educatie en stakeholder engagement

• Relevante medisch wetenschappelijke opleiding (Msc, MD, PharmD, PhD)

• Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in de farmaceutische en/of medical device industrie

Waarom Roche?
Al meer dan 125 jaar werkt Roche aan een gezondere toekomst met één duidelijk doel: “Doing now what patients need next”. Wij geloven dat we de grootste medische uitdagingen alleen kunnen oplossen door intensieve samenwerking met zorgprofessionals en patiënten.
Onze impact gaat echter verder dan de zorg; we nemen ook de volle verantwoordelijkheid voor onze planeet. Zo draaien al onze locaties sinds 2025 op 100% duurzame elektriciteit, een belangrijke mijlpaal in onze ambitie om in 2045 volledig klimaatneutraal (net zero) te zijn. Bij Roche werk je dus niet alleen aan de zorg van morgen, maar ook aan een gezonde, duurzame wereld.

Dit krijg je bij ons:

• Een inspirerende werkomgeving waar plezier en maatschappelijke impact samenkomen.

• Een organisatie waar jouw expertise wordt gewaardeerd en waar je autonoom beslissingen kan nemen binnen je team.

• Werken met een portfolio van innovatieve producten die de cardiologische zorg fundamenteel transformeren.

• Volop ka

• Het bouwen en onderhouden van relevante stakeholder netwerken
• Het genereren van klinische bewijslast in samenwerking met artsen en onderzoekers
• Het organiseren van medische educatie
• Als subject matter expert ben je een (sparring) partner voor interne en externe stakeholders Je vaardigheden:
• Kennis op het gebied van cardiologie en/of critical care
• Uitstekende communicatie vaardigheden en in staat mensen te verbinden en mobiliseren
• Ervaring met klinische studies, medische educatie en stakeholder engagement
• Relevante medisch wetenschappelijke opleiding (Msc, MD, PharmD, PhD)

Onze impact gaat echter verder dan de zorg; we nemen ook de volle verantwoordelijkheid voor onze planeet. Zo draaien al onze locaties sinds 2025 op 100% duurzame elektriciteit, een belangrijke mijlpaal in onze ambitie om in 2045 volledig klimaatneutraal (net zero) te zijn. Bij Roche werk je dus niet alleen aan de zorg van morgen, maar ook aan een gezonde, duurzame wereld. Dit krijg je bij ons:
• Een inspirerende werkomgeving waar plezier en maatschappelijke impact samenkomen.
• Een organisatie waar jouw expertise wordt gewaardeerd en waar je autonoom beslissingen kan nemen binnen je team.
• Werken met een portfolio van innovatieve producten die de cardiologische zorg fundamenteel transformeren.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
ERP Solution Consultant - SAP Intercompany

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The ERP Solution Consultant leads independently complex ERP solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to architecture. In this role, you will guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product or product line level. By bringing advanced ERP knowledge, in-depth expertise in key areas, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and team development.

Job Responsibilities

• Backlog Management: Defining, ordering, and refining Product Backlog items to align with business goals.

• Product Strategy: Evaluate existing SD processes to identify optimization opportunities, particularly in the areas of automated order processing and real-time analytics.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborating with Supply Chain stakeholders to gather feedback, manage expectations, and communicate product updates.

• Development Collaboration: Working with Scrum teams to define, build, and validate product features during sprints.

• Solution Design & Configuration: Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of new features within S/4HANA .

• Hands-on Core Customizing : Perform independent, hands-on SAP standard configuration and customization within the S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) and Material management (MM) module.

• WRICEF Specification & Design : Translate complex business requirements into detailed functional specifications for custom developments, actively designing and delivering WRICEF items (Workflow, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms) from ideation to hypercare.

• Logistics Integration: Act as the functional lead for SD integration touchpoints with Decentralized EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) and Embedded TM (Transportation Management) to ensure seamless flow from Sales Order to TM Integration

Technical & Professional Qualifications

• S/4HANA SD: Minimum of 3 of experience in SAP SD, ideally with full-cycle S/4HANA implementations.

• Familiarity with Solution Manager (SolMan) or SAP Cloud ALM for documentation and transport management.

• Technical Literacy: Proficiency in monitoring and troubleshooting IDocs/ALE.

Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

• Life Sciences / Pharma Experience: Familiarity with pharmaceutical business models

• Analytical Mindset: Ability to translate comp

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per chi sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. È così che ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Entra a far parte di Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ERP Solution Consultant - SAP Intercompany Roche Digital Technology (STD) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a modellare domani.s futuro digitale della sanità. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale di intelligenza artificiale, dati, e innovazioni tecnologiche di scalable.Svolto da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutta Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano e guidare scoperte che veramente contano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità e collaborazione personale. Per ora, chiediamo ai nostri dipendenti di essere nei nostri uffici in media due giorni a settimana. I giorni di ufficio specifici possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, municipi, riunioni di gruppo, e altri eventi collaborativi. L'ERP Solution Consultant conduce in modo indipendente la fornitura di soluzioni ERP, risolve proattivamente i problemi dei prodotti e contribuisce all'architettura. In questo ruolo, guiderai i team di prodotti, la responsabilità dei campioni e comunicherai efficacemente con le parti interessate. Risolverai problemi complessi, prenderai decisioni indipendenti a livello di prodotto, fornirai una supervisione tecnica e riferirai a livello di prodotto o linea di prodotto. Portando a conoscenza ERP avanzate, competenze approfondite in settori chiave e forti competenze analitiche, contribuirai attivamente al miglioramento continuo e allo sviluppo di team. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Gestione Backlog: Definizione, ordinazione e raffinazione di articoli Backlog prodotto per allinearsi agli obiettivi aziendali.
• Strategia del prodotto: Evaluare i processi SD esistenti per individuare opportunità di ottimizzazione, in particolare nei settori dell'elaborazione automatizzata degli ordini e dell'analisi in tempo reale.
• Gestione delle parti interessate: il trattamento con gli stakeholder di Supply Chain per raccogliere feedback, gestire le aspettative e comunicare gli aggiornamenti dei prodotti.
• Sviluppo: il lavoro con i team Scrum per definire, costruire e convalidare le funzionalità del prodotto durante gli sprint.
• Solution Design & Con 209tion: Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of new features in S/4HANA.
• Personalizzazione manuale del nucleo: eseguire una configurazione e personalizzazione standard SAP, pratiche e indipendenti all'interno del modulo S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) e Material Management (MM).
• Specificazione e progettazione WRICEF: Tradurre requisiti aziendali complessi in specifiche funzionali dettagliate per sviluppi personalizzati, progettare e fornire attivamente articoli WRICEF (Workflow, Reports, Interfaces, Conversioni, Miglioramenti e Forme) dall'ideazione all'iper cura.
• Integrazione logistica: agire come il lead funzionale per i touchpoint di integrazione SD con EWM decentralizzato (Extended Warehouse Management) e Embedded TM (Transportation Management) per garantire il flusso senza soluzione di continuità dall'ordine di vendita all'integrazione TM Qualificazioni tecniche e professionali
• S/4HANA SD: minimo 3 esperienze in SAP SD, idealmente con implementazioni S/4HANA a ciclo pieno.
• Fa.
• Scienze della vita / Esperienza Farmaceutica: Fa 1 91% con modelli di business farmaceutico
• Mente analitica: Capacità di tradurre comp

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Roche’s sequencing and pathology product portfolios.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a highly autonomous, deep-dive technical investigator. You masterfully dissect complex, edge-case software failures, bridging the gap between field trouble-shooting and core R&D development teams. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity

• You are accountable for handling complex software complaints for our sequencing and pathology products, like safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as a senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause/causal factor of software malfunctions. You master the Roche internal quality processes and understand their regulatory background to justify decisions.

• You are an interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

• You serve as a trusted technical proxy for the Principal Engineer when required.

Who You Are

• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an IT related field (preferred) with knowledge of bioinformatics or genomics. Advanced degrees (Master’s or Ph.D.) are a plus but not required.

• 5+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Bioinformatics or IT support related functions

• Strong IT skills, especially the ability to read and debug complex source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues

• Good ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty.

• Good ability to present technical work to stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

Locations
This is a primarily onsite position in Tucson, Arizona.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson Arizona is $77,280 and $143,520. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifi

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), sarai in prima linea nel garantire la qualità e le prestazioni delle soluzioni digitali di Roche, trattando reclami relativi ai portafogli dei prodotti di sequenziamento e patologia di Roche. Unire il Capitolo Soluzioni Digitali significa lavorare in un ambiente software altamente trasversale, dandovi l'opportunità di impegnarsi con tecnologie all'avanguardia e linguaggi di programmazione diversi per il software on-premise e cloud-based. La vostra missione principale sarà di agire come un investigatore tecnico altamente autonomo e profondo. Si distinguono i guasti complessi, bordure i guasti del software, colmare il divario tra i team di sviluppo R&D di campo e risoluzione dei problemi di campo. Mentre la vostra attenzione è sull'analisi della causa principale, non sarete responsabili per le correzioni di bug finali. Questo ruolo è ambientato in un ambiente Agile dove le tue idee e le tue proposte innovative sono altamente apprezzate, contribuendo direttamente a un team focalizzato sul miglioramento continuo. L'opportunità
• Sei responsabile per la gestione di reclami software complessi per i nostri prodotti di sequenziamento e patologia, come problemi di sicurezza e richieste di prodotti software (su premessa, cloud, mobile, applicazioni,...).
• Potrai gestire in modo indipendente l'intero ciclo di vita dei casi, dalla creazione iniziale e classificazione alle indagini approfondite, collaborazione con il team di risoluzione dei problemi in loco, documentazione e risoluzione finale. Per i casi che non possono essere risolti direttamente, si prende la proprietà di aumentare al reparto sviluppo.
• Si agisce come esperto tecnico senior per la risoluzione dei casi, utilizzando la capacità di leggere e comprendere il codice sorgente complesso per identificare la causa principale / fattore causale di malfunzionamenti software. Si padroneggia i processi di qualità interna Roche e capire il loro background normativo per giustificare le decisioni.
• Sei un'interfaccia con affiliati e organizzazioni di paese. Sarete responsabili della comunicazione tempestiva delle informazioni essenziali e delle iniziative di supporto alla qualità che migliorano i nostri partenariati regionali.
• Utilizzi le tue capacità di automazione e analisi dei dati per migliorare il processo di gestione dei casi e monitorare proattivamente i dati sulle prestazioni dei prodotti
• Serve come un proxy tecnico affidabile per l'Ingegnere Principale quando necessario. Chi sei
• Una laurea in Informatica o un campo relativo IT (preferito) con conoscenza di bioinformatica o genomica. I gradi avanzati (Master o Ph.D.) sono un plus ma non richiesto.
• 5+ anni di comprovata traccia di lavoro nell'area della Bioinformatica o funzioni correlate supporto IT
• Forti competenze IT, in particolare la capacità di leggere e debug codice sorgente complesso di diversi linguaggi di programmazione per comprendere la causa principale dei problemi segnalati
• Buona capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente anche di fronte all'incertezza.
• Buona capacità di presentare il lavoro tecnico alle parti interessate, influenzare e negoziare per spingere avanti iniziative
• Forte capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato) Località Questa posizione è principalmente in loco a Tucson, Arizona. Le prestazioni di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa posizione. L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla posizione principale di Tucson Arizona è $77,280 e $143,520. La retribuzione effettiva sarà determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche, alla posizione geografica e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro consentiti dalla legge. Un bonus annuale discrezionale può essere disponibile in base alle prestazioni individuali e aziendali. Questa posizione anche qualifi

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the small-molecule team within AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), formerly Prescient Design, at Roche and Genentech’s Computational Sciences Center of Excellence as a Machine Learning Scientist / Senior Machine Learning Scientist in Quantum Chemistry. You will combine machine learning methods and quantum chemistry to build fast, accurate models that power small-molecule drug discovery. You will work with world-class computational and experimental scientists and leverage proprietary datasets and state-of-the-art compute.

The Opportunity

• Create cutting-edge solutions that combine quantum chemistry and machine learning algorithm development to model small-molecule energetics and protein–ligand interactions, from conformation and reactivity to binding affinity and free energy.

• Build synthetic datasets using quantum mechanics and related methods to shape novel research directions in ML.

• Develop deployable pipelines that are robust, scalable and reproducible, and feed directly into molecular-design tools used across Roche.

• Drive scientific impact through publications, open-source releases, and talks at internal and external conferences.

• Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for optimization and standardization.

• Contribute to documentation, governance practices, templates, and best practices.

• Support reporting, insights, and measurement activities to evaluate business outcomes and adoption.

Who You Are
You are a delivery-oriented and collaborative leader who is comfortable operating across business and technology domains within large-scale enterprise transformation programs.

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Consulting, Product Delivery, CRM, Marketing Technology, Omnichannel Engagement, or Digital Transformation domains.

• Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements and translating them into scalable technology solutions.

• Strong stakeholder management skills with experience working in large-scale enterprise transformation or digital engagement programs.

• Experience operating within Agile delivery environments and collaborating across product, engineering, and business teams.

• Strong understanding of omnichannel engagement, campaign execution, customer journeys, audience segmentation, and activation workflows.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Service Delivery Manager, RDT Onsite Europe West (Engineering Manager) you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area

Workforce Enablement (WE) is the home for employee facing products, services, and experiences within RDT. We deliver digital tools, drive adoption, and provide the support necessary to enable the entire workforce, wherever they are, every single day.
The Onsite Enablement organization is the heartbeat of our physical presence. We are the bridge between digital strategy and local execution, ensuring that every site—from R&D labs to corporate hubs—operates with seamless, cutting-edge technology services. As part of this team, you will oversee a team of individual contributors who are the primary points of accountability for onsite service excellence, infrastructure stability, and user experience within their respective sites. Our mission is to provide a "frictionless" workplace where technology empowers our people to focus on what matters most: improving patient lives.
This RDT leader is accountable for the people, budget, and services required to deliver a high quality offering for employees.

Job responsibilities

• Team Member Capability and Career Development 

• Focuses on developing engineering team capabilities that align with the immediate project needs and goals and function's overall vision.

• Encourages team members to self-define their career journey and actively enables development opportunities that align with it.

• Removes roadblocks and sets clear, achievable performance goals.

• Ensures the team develops the right skills and healthy internal dynamics to meet current and future challenges.

• Team Health and Sustainability 

• Maintains a sustainable pace of work for the team, balancing delivery goals with team well-being.

• Cultivates healthy team dynamics and collaboration, ensuring psychological safety and open communication.

• Removes impediments that hinder flow or morale, acting as an escalation point for the team.

• Ensures team members are equipped with the necessary, relevant skills and that roles are clearly defined.

• Product and Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️

• Responsible for co-creating the Product / Service Roadmap from a technical perspective, partnering with the Product Manager who is overall responsible.

• Accountable for the team's end-to-end delivery of features as part of the product development, ensuring alignment with the product roadmap and quality standards.

• Sets clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work, ensuring alignment with product roadmaps.

• Actively removes impediments and roadblocks to progress, escalating when necessary to protect the team's focus.

• Manages and aligns stakeholders' expectations and needs, providing regular updates on progress and risks.

• Creates efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible across teams and functions.

•

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Service Delivery Manager, RDT Onsite Europe West (Engineering Manager) ti concentrerai sullo sviluppo delle funzionalità dei membri del tuo team che si allineano alla visione della funzione. Incoraggiate il vostro team a autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e cercare modi per consentire opportunità di sviluppo nella direzione del viaggio. Li supporterete nella rimozione dei blocchi stradali e impostando l'attenzione nella loro gestione delle prestazioni. Assicurati di sviluppare il tuo team con le giuste competenze, dinamiche sane e un ritmo sostenibile. Supporti il software e/o la fornitura di servizi come un focus di impostazione leader, la rimozione di impedimenti, la gestione delle parti interessate e la creazione di efficienze in collaborazione dove possibile. Descrizione della zona Workforce Enablement (WE) è la casa per i dipendenti che affrontano prodotti, servizi e esperienze all'interno di RDT. Forniamo strumenti digitali, adottiamo e forniamo il supporto necessario per consentire l'intera forza lavoro, ovunque si trovino, ogni singolo giorno. L'organizzazione Insite Enablement è il battito cardiaco della nostra presenza fisica. Siamo il ponte tra la strategia digitale e l'esecuzione locale, assicurando che ogni sito, dai laboratori R&D ai hub aziendali, funzioni con servizi tecnologici all'avanguardia. Nell'ambito di questo team, supervisionerai un team di singoli collaboratori che sono i principali punti di responsabilità per l'eccellenza dei servizi in loco, la stabilità delle infrastrutture e l'esperienza degli utenti all'interno dei rispettivi siti. La nostra missione è quella di fornire un luogo di lavoro "a frizione" in cui la tecnologia consente al nostro popolo di concentrarsi su ciò che conta di più: migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Questo leader RDT è responsabile per le persone, budget e servizi necessari per fornire un'offerta di alta qualità per i dipendenti. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Team Member Capability and Career Development 
• Si concentra sullo sviluppo di capacità di team ingegneristici che si allineano alle esigenze e agli obiettivi e alla visione generale della funzione.
• Incoraggia i membri del team a autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e consente attivamente opportunità di sviluppo che si allineano con esso.
• Rimuove i blocchi stradali e imposta obiettivi di performance chiari e realizzabili.
• Assicura che il team sviluppi le giuste competenze e dinamiche interne sane per soddisfare le sfide attuali e future.
• Salute e sostenibilità del team
• Mantiene un ritmo di lavoro sostenibile per il team, bilanciando gli obiettivi di consegna con il benessere del team.
• Coltiva dinamiche e collaborazione di team sane, garantendo sicurezza psicologica e comunicazione aperta.
• Rimuove gli impedimenti che ostacolano il flusso o il morale, agendo come punto di escalation per la squadra.
• Assicura che i membri del team siano dotati delle competenze necessarie, pertinenti e che i ruoli siano chiaramente definiti.
• Leadership del prodotto e del servizio ⚙️
• Responsabile per la co-creazione di Product / Service Roadmap da un punto di vista tecnico, collaborando con il Product Manager che è responsabile generale.
• Affidabile per la consegna end-to-end del team di funzionalità come parte dello sviluppo del prodotto, garantendo l'allineamento con la roadmap del prodotto e gli standard di qualità.
• Imposta la messa a fuoco chiara e le priorità per il lavoro di consegna del team, garantendo l'allineamento con le roadmap del prodotto.
• Rimuove attivamente gli impedimenti e i blocchi stradali per progredire, aumentando quando necessario per proteggere l'attenzione del team.
• Gestisce e allinea le aspettative e le esigenze degli stakeholder, fornendo aggiornamenti regolari sui progressi e sui rischi.
• Crea efficienze in collaborazione ovunque possibile tra team e funzioni. •

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Technology Accounts and Software Asset Management

The Head of Technology Vendor Management & Software Asset Management will lead RDT’s strategic technology vendor governance and Software Asset Management practice across a complex global technology landscape.

The role covers vendors across software, SaaS, cloud, platforms, on-premise infrastructure, infrastructure services and managed services. It is accountable for creating a transparent, stable, commercially disciplined and risk-managed vendor ecosystem.
This is a senior leadership role with responsibility for a large-scale technology vendor portfolio representing several hundred million CHF in spend and a team of around a dozen professionals.
The role combines vendor governance, SAM, licensing compliance, vendor risk management, service performance, operational stability, commercial oversight and senior stakeholder engagement.

Description of the area

Technology Vendor Management & Software Asset Management ensures that RDT’s critical technology vendors operate within clear standards, controls and performance expectations.
The function owns vendor governance frameworks and the SAM operating model, covering vendor lifecycle management, service performance, risk monitoring, license compliance, spend transparency and value realization.
It partners with RDT functions, IT, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Security, Architecture and Operations to ensure technology vendor relationships are compliant, stable, cost-effective and aligned with enterprise priorities.

Job responsibilities:

• Lead the Technology Vendor Management and Software Asset Management function, including strategy, operating model, standards, governance forums and team development.

• Govern a high-value technology vendor ecosystem across software, SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, platform and managed service providers.

• Define and implement baseline standards for technology vendor management, including SLAs, governance blueprint, escalation model, performance expectations and minimum control requirements.

• Own the SAM roadmap and lifecycle governance across entitlement, deployment, usage, compliance, optimization and remediation.

• Define and implement the technology vendor lifecycle model, from onboarding and classification through performance management, risk monitoring, renewal governance and exit planning.

• Establish dashboards and reporting for RDT leadership covering vendor performance, SAM status, license compliance, risk exposure, operational stability and key actions.

• Lead or coordinate vendor audit defense and remediation of licensing, contractual or compliance deviations.

• Drive software and technology spend optimization through usage analysis, renewal governance, license harvesting, reclaim, rightsizing, contract review and demand alignment.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on vendor risk, software compliance, licensing exposure, operational stability and technology vendor value.

Qualifications:

• 10+ years of experience in Technology Vendor Management, Software Asset Management, IT Asset Management, supplier governance, software licensing, IT sourcing, technology procurement, service provider management or enterprise IT governance.

• Proven experience governing large-scale technology vendor portfolios involving complex contracts, critical vendors, material spend and senior stakeholder accountability.

• Strong understanding of vendor governance models, vendor lifecycle management, SLAs, perfor

La posizione Capo dei conti tecnologici e della gestione dei beni software Responsabile dei conti tecnologici e della gestione patrimoniale software (Practice Leader) è responsabile per la gestione integrata dei principali account tecnologici (Platform, Cloud e fornitori di software) e della pratica Software Asset Management (SAM). Potrai guidare un team responsabile per ottimizzare la spesa tecnologica, massimizzare il ROI e garantire una rigorosa conformità della licenza attraverso il paesaggio RDT. Questo ruolo richiede un mix distintivo di competenza tecnica negli stack tecnologici moderni e una profonda esperienza nel software di licensing e asset governance. Descrizione dell'Area Asset Management & Technology Accounts gestisce il ciclo di vita dei beni tecnologici di RDT. Questo include la governance dei principali partner tecnologici (ad esempio SAP, AWS, Microsoft) e l'esecuzione dei processi SAM per garantire la conformità e l'ottimizzazione finanziaria. Questa sotto-funzione garantisce che queste partnership di alto livello forniscono il massimo valore attraverso la governance strutturata, la gestione dei rischi e i quadri di miglioramento continuo. Mansioni - SAM Governance: proprio la roadmap funzionale per la gestione del patrimonio software. Assicurare l'intero ciclo di vita dei beni software è gestito per mantenere la conformità e minimizzare il rischio. - Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve come il principale contatto per i partner interni, gestendo attivamente le relazioni e le aspettative circa le prestazioni e i consegnabili della (sub-)funzione. Funziona a stretto contatto con le parti interessate IT e gli utenti interni per identificare, prioritizzare e affrontare le esigenze delle politiche, la loro operativizzazione e controlli associati. - Strategia dell'account tecnologico: Allineare le roadmap della tecnologia con l'architettura moderna (Cloud, AI/ML, SaaS) in ambienti regolamentati. - Asset Compliance: Guidare le valutazioni di rischio di tecnologia a livello aziendale e garantire una tempestiva bonifica dei risultati o delle deviazioni di licenze. - Esecuzione Operativa: implementare e supervisionare strumenti e processi per il monitoraggio dell'utilizzo e del diritto di licenza. - Eccellenza Operativa: Definire e monitorare i KPI/OKR per analizzare le prestazioni del fornitore. Utilizzare i dati per migliorare continuamente e ottimizzare il modello di consegna del servizio. - Team Leadership: Guidare e sviluppare un team di manager di account fornitori altamente performanti. Personale di mentore e garantire l'allineamento delle risorse con i requisiti di progetto RDT. - Influenza e collaborazione: collaborare a stretto contatto con Architettura, Sicurezza e Finanza per garantire che le piattaforme tecnologiche supportino in modo efficiente i processi aziendali critici.
• Requisiti - Istruzione/Esperienza: 10+ anni in IT Asset Management, Technology Sourcing o IT Operations. È richiesta un'esperienza di leadership in team multidisciplinari globali. - Competenze Funzionali: Forte comprensione dei paesaggi tecnologici moderni (Cloud, DevOps, Piattaforme digitali). Conoscenza esperta delle strutture SAM e dei principali modelli di licenza del fornitore. - Leadership: Capacità di condurre attraverso l'influenza e la partnership. Forte capacità di mentore un team tecnico in un ecosistema di stakeholder complesso e globale. Cosa? - Gamma di insalata 23.300 - 43.300 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro. - Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 20%). - Indennità di automobile o di automobile. - Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.). - Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile). - Prenda tempo Programma (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile. - Posizione Flex (possibilità) Contatto *(Nessun recapito fornito nel testo originale)*
