The Position
¿Te apasiona conectar la innovación científica con la eficiencia hospitalaria? Buscamos un/a Sales Specialist Core para liderar y expandir nuestra presencia en el territorio de Cataluña. En este rol, serás el socio estratégico de los laboratorios y centros sanitarios de la región, estableciendo relaciones de confianza profunda y comprendiendo los retos del ecosistema de salud local.
Tu misión será impulsar el éxito del negocio basándote en la innovación de nuestro porfolio de especialidades diagnósticas y en la optimización de los flujos de trabajo de nuestros clientes. Si tienes una mentalidad estratégica, te apasiona el desarrollo de negocio y quieres transformar la atención al paciente a través de diagnósticos de vanguardia, ¡este es tu lugar!

Your Main Responsibilities

• Ejecución y Estrategia Comercial: Implementar los planes de acción y estrategias definidas en tu zona para alcanzar y superar los objetivos anuales, ganando cuota de mercado y cumpliendo con los KPI del negocio.

• Identificación de Retos y Co-creación: Detectar las necesidades tanto de los profesionales del laboratorio como de las direcciones económicas y gerenciales de los centros, proponiendo soluciones diferenciadoras que aporten un valor real.

• Gestión de Stakeholders (360°): Construir y mantener relaciones estrechas con el personal técnico del laboratorio y con áreas clave del hospital (adquisiciones, finanzas y gestión hospitalaria), garantizando la satisfacción del cliente en todo su ciclo de vida.

• Enlace y Colaboración Interna: Tras la firma de los acuerdos, asegurarás que los equipos y reactivos se implementen a la perfección en los laboratorios, colaborando estrechamente con nuestros equipos de soporte técnico y aplicaciones.

• Expertise y Demostraciones Técnicas: Desarrollar un conocimiento profundo del porfolio de Core Lab , realizando presentaciones y demostraciones de producto de alto impacto que resuelvan las dudas de los clientes y destaquen nuestro valor diferencial.

Who You Are (The skills you need)

Buscamos un perfil dinámico, con un fuerte background técnico o comercial en el sector salud y una alta capacidad de influencia.

• Formación: Licenciatura o Grado en Ciencias de la Salud y/o experiencia demostrada en el sector sanitario. Se valorará positivamente la experiencia previa como técnico/a de laboratorio o en el ámbito de la docencia/formación técnica.

• Apertura al Talento Diverso: En Roche creemos en el valor de las perspectivas únicas; por ello, también valoraremos aquellos perfiles que, aun no cumpliendo estrictamente con la formación o experiencia técnica tradicional, aporten un trasfondo comercial relevante y diferencial para la organización.

• Competencias Clave:

• Alta capacidad estratégica y habilidad técnica y de negocio para navegar en entornos hospitalarios complejos.

• Orientación a la consecución de resultados , con autonomía y toma de decisiones ágiles.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación , con capacidad de inspiración e influencia .

• Mentalidad colaborativa, fuerte orientación al trabajo en equipo y apertura para dar y recibir feedback y coaching .

• Un perfil promotor de la innovación y con competencias sólidas en gestión del cambio para acompañar al cliente en su transformación digital y organizativa.

• Idiomas: Dominio del español y catalán; se valorarán conocimientos de inglés .

• Ubicación : Barcelona y alrededores.

What is here for You?

• Propósito Elevado: Trabajar en una compañía líder donde tu actividad diaria impa

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Scientist, Clinical Pharmacology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Clinical Pharmacology (CP) Scientist is responsible for developing and implementing quantitative Clinical Pharmacology strategies across early to late phases of clinical drug development to ensure that the right drug is administered to the right patient at the right dosing regimen and to deliver an optimal therapeutic benefit/risk profile for the patients. The CP Scientist uses state of the art modeling and simulation tools and is able to implement model-informed drug development strategies to address critical questions that are aligned with project needs. The CP Scientist is an active member of cross-functional drug development teams, and works in close partnership with Pharmacometricians, Biostatisticians, Clinicians, Biomarker Scientists, Toxicologists, Preclinical Pharmacologists, and other function) to support drug development decisions through registration and post-marketing commitments. The Senior/Principal CP Scientist represents CP function on filing teams and fosters effective collaboration and communications with regulatory agencies to support efficient drug development of drug candidates.

Key responsibilities include:

• Leading the design and review of clinical study protocols for the development of novel therapeutic agents with particular focus on China development (all drug and delivery modalities);

• Leading the planning and conduct of PK/PD data analyses and setting strategy to foster the appropriate use of modeling and simulations to inform clinical drug development decisions;

• CP functional representation and leadership at functional and cross-functional China development focused meetings internally and externally (eg. cross-functional teams, department meetings, governance review meetings, scientific conferences, etc.);

• Implementing strategic agility and effective project management to align critical CP deliverables according to the rapidly evolving regulatory and project needs in China;

• Authorship of regulatory documents and meeting background packages to support key clinical development milestones in China;

• Lead CP representation at health-authority meetings in China, and contribute to the planning, implementation and organization of regulatory filings (e.g. IND, BLA, NDA, sNDA);

• Support the global development strategies for clinical pharmacology and M&S as needed.

Technical Skills:
Required:

• The ability to plan, organize, interpret, and/or perform PK/PD data analyses.

• Familiarity with clinical drug development and clinical study design options for development of different drug and delivery modalities.

• Familiarity with quantitative modeling approaches in drug development and working knowledge of relevant modeling software (e.g. NONMEM, WinNonlin, R, SimCYP, GastroPlus, PKSim, Matlab, etc).

• Familiarity with agentic approaches for work streamlining and integrating agent-based workflows to improve efficiency throughout the drug development lifecycle.

• Working knowledge of statistical approaches as they apply to clinical study design and analysis.

Desired:

• Experience in leading regulatory filing strategy as a CP lead to support the totality of CP filing package, dose/regimen justification, and drug labeling is highly desired.

Communication Skills:

• Excellent written communication skills, in order to deliver high quality protocols, publications, and regulatory documents for team and management review.

• Excellent oral communications to make clear presentations and foster effective stakeholder engagemen

The Position
Job description
The Cybersecurity Analyst investigates security incidents, performs vulnerability assessments, and contributes to improving security operations
You will be capable of independent work on defined tasks, independently handling less complex tasks and contributing to various stages of the analysis lifecycle
By taking ownership of delivering well-defined requirements and supporting the design of feasible security solutions, you will proactively identify solution-level issues and maintain a mindset of continuous improvement within the security domain

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities / Scope

• Independently handles less complex tasks and provides input to solution design by defining and managing requirements for small-scale problem areas

• Focuses on understanding the problem domain, recommending solution options, and proactively identifying solution-level issues, gaps, or inefficiencies to improve products or processes

Accountability/Problem Solving

• Takes ownership of delivering well-defined requirements and supporting the design of feasible solutions for specific features or components

• Independently analyzes less complex security technical problems, defines problem scope, contributes to identifying root causes, and provides solutions to a broad range of difficult problems

• Evaluates change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, diagnoses gaps, and applies analytical and logical reasoning independently to identify discrepancies and challenge assumptions

Stakeholder Management

• Identifies key business, technical, and security stakeholders for assigned tasks, analyzing their needs and interests regarding security posture and risk

• Primarily interacts within security product teams/squads and across Security Operations functions, while establishing rapport and managing realistic security expectations

• Develops and delivers tailored communication for security tasks and incident updates, facilitates meetings, and proactively engages with stakeholders to elicit, clarify, and validate security requirements

Impact/Strategy

• Contributes to projects or workgroups by providing well-analyzed requirements and supporting the design of solutions that align with business objectives within their specified area

• Demonstrates growing autonomy and expertise within their specific domain by translating requirements into a strategic plan with supervision, and may identify opportunities for minor process improvements within their immediate scope

Complexity

• Works on a product or larger contexts, handling requirements and analysis for specific features or components

• Can navigate moderate levels of complexity in requirements and stakeholder landscapes

• Begins to understand sources of influence and analyze business problems/opportunities within this product context, starting to map basic interconnections

Business/Technical ability

• Possesses a working knowledge of the relevant business domain and supporting technologies

• Understands sources of influence, comprehending internal and external factors affecting the problem space, and is capable of identifying and analyzing basic business problems or opportunities holistically

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Working knowledge of relevant business domains and supporting cybersecurity technologies

• Experience in conducting stakeholder interviews, synthesizing requirements, and mapping/analyzing current processes

• Demonstrated ability to independently handle less c

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose

• As the chapter lead for the Marketing Chapter, you will be responsible for leading, monitoring and developing in-depth marketing strategies to add continuous improvement and value to patients, establish commercial partnership with the external stakeholders and accelerate broader patient access as a result.

• As a chapter lead, you will act as an agile leader ( Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst ) and ensure all chapter members live Roche Taiwan’s desired state culture. You are passionate about our focus on people & culture, our external customers, patient access and long-term healthcare sustainability in Taiwan.

• You will be the catalyst and role model to lead the team, raise the standard of marketing capability in the era of AI to foster commercialization excellence.

• You will be the catalyst to contribute to the network within and beyond Taiwan. You always put patients at the center of our operations and ensure everything we do will sustainably benefit patients and bring value to our society and the company.

Role Scope

• Act as a VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leader who enable individuals and teams are developing and growing in line with their passion and the needs of the organization

• Develop framework to ensure chapter members are marketing experts and are competent to :

• Creates and fosters a strong team spirit and takes on the role of ‘strategic product champion’.

• Leads the development of the local (or above affiliate) marketing strategy.

• Drives and coordinates branding development/evolution process.

• Maintains up to date knowledge of the global market for the therapy area.

• Monitors competitor activity and recommends action.

• Cultivates and develops Key Opinion Leaders, product advocates and speakers.

• Reviews, approves and monitors budget.

• Provides input into public relations and access strategy.

• Assures forecast submission, inventory level and cost seasonality

• Ensure t he development of the marketing strategies and their execution with a strong focus of patient value and connected with all the strategies and solutions generated by different functions and teams

• Lead the t eam t o support commercial ac ti vities for dedicat e d disease areas

• Catalyze the network way of working: l eads the t eam to w ork as partners wi th other chapters/ clusters w ithi n and beyond the a ffi liate

• Ensure resource and talent fluidity to achieve affiliate outcomes

• Support APAC team for the people development of APAC marketers in Taiwan

Requirements

Qualifications: Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

Education:Minimum: A bachelor degree in scientific, economic, or business related fields. An advanced degree in Life Science and/or MBA is a plus.

Working Experience:

• More than 5 years’ experience of pharmaceutical product management or equivalent experience, and more than 8 years’ experience in commercial related function

• Demonstrate the capability achieving or exceeding sales and marketing goals

• Excellent proficiency in planning and managing resources deployment

• Experience in leading cross-functional teams or marketing teams achieving ambitious goals

• Experience in working in an organization that has adopted agile methodologies and ways of working would be a significant advantage

Skills & Knowledge:

• Good knowledge of Compliance requirements and clear understanding of high standards of Integrity

• Ability to lead tea

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Emploi
• En tant que chef de file du chapitre sur la commercialisation, vous serez chargé de diriger, de surveiller et d'élaborer des stratégies de commercialisation approfondies afin d'ajouter une amélioration et une valeur continues aux patients, d'établir un partenariat commercial avec les intervenants externes et d'accélérer l'accès des patients.
• En tant que chef de chapitre, vous agirez comme un leader agile (Visionnaire, Architecte, Coach, Catalyst) et vous assurerez que tous les membres du chapitre vivent Roche Taiwan. • Vous serez le catalyseur et le modèle pour diriger l'équipe, élever le niveau de la capacité de marketing à l'ère de l'IA pour favoriser l'excellence de la commercialisation.
• Vous serez le catalyseur pour contribuer au réseau à l'intérieur et au-delà de Taiwan. Vous mettez toujours les patients au centre de nos opérations et vous assurez que tout ce que nous faisons bénéficiera durablement aux patients et apportera de la valeur à notre société et à l'entreprise. Portée du rôle
• Agir en tant que chef de file VACC (Visionnaire, Architecte, Catalyste, Coach) qui permet aux individus et aux équipes de se développer et de croître en fonction de leur passion et des besoins de l'organisation
• Élaborer un cadre pour s'assurer que les membres du chapitre sont des experts en marketing et sont compétents pour :

• Dirige l'élaboration de la stratégie de commercialisation locale (ou au-dessus de l'affiliation).
• Démarre et coordonne le processus de développement et d'évolution de l'image de marque.
• Maintenir une connaissance à jour du marché mondial de la zone thérapeutique.
• Surveille l'activité des concurrents et recommande des mesures.
• Cultiver et développer des leaders d'opinion clés, des défenseurs de produits et des intervenants.
• Examiner, approuver et surveiller le budget.
• Apporte sa contribution à la stratégie de relations publiques et d'accès.
• Assure la présentation des prévisions, le niveau des stocks et la saisonnalité des coûts
• Assurer le développement des stratégies de marketing et leur exécution avec une forte concentration de la valeur du patient et lié à toutes les stratégies et solutions générées par différentes fonctions et équipes
• Diriger les activités commerciales de soutien des zones de dédicat et de maladie
• Catalysez la manière de travailler en réseau: le t eam à w ork en tant que partenaires avec d'autres chapitres/ clusters w ithi n et au-delà de la relation
• Assurer la fluidité des ressources et des talents pour atteindre les résultats des filiales
• Soutenir l'équipe d'APAC pour le développement des gens des marketeurs APAC à Taiwan Exigences Qualifications : Bon bilan de conformité. Aucune violation de la conformité n'a été décelée au cours des cinq dernières années. Éducation: Minimum: Baccalauréat en sciences, en économie ou en affaires. Un diplôme avancé en sciences de la vie et/ou MBA est un plus. Expérience professionnelle :
• Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de produits pharmaceutiques ou d'expérience équivalente, et plus de 8 ans d'expérience en fonction commerciale
• Démontrer la capacité à atteindre ou dépasser les objectifs de vente et de commercialisation
• Excellente maîtrise de la planification et de la gestion du déploiement des ressources
• Expérience dans la conduite d'équipes interfonctionnelles ou de marketing réalisant des objectifs ambitieux
• L'expérience de travail dans une organisation qui a adopté des méthodes et des méthodes de travail agiles serait un avantage important Compétences et connaissances :
• Bonne connaissance des exigences de conformité et compréhension claire des normes élevées d'intégrité
• Capacité à diriger le thé

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is based in the Regional Customer Support Center which is dedicated to providing excellence while helping laboratory personnel using our products. We operate with a holistic approach, which means that we take care of our product portfolio from the idea through development and market launch to phase-out. The outstanding variety of technologies applied in this area offers you great learning opportunities.

Technical Support Specialist ( Slovak & Czech language)

Locations: Warsaw, Prague or Bratislava (Your choice!)

Are you ready to transition from technical expertise to life-changing impact? Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is the intellectual engine behind laboratory excellence in Central Europe. We are looking for a Czech and/or Slovak-speaking talent who is hungry for knowledge, enjoys problem-solving, and is ready to master the world’s most advanced diagnostic technologies.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

More Than Just Support This isn't a typical helpdesk role. This is an engineering and application consultancy position where you become the "guardian" of diagnostic accuracy.

• Master the Complexity: You will work with high-end IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) systems that combine robotics, complex biochemistry, and advanced IT.

• Continuous Growth: We provide an intensive, world-class training program. We don’t expect you to know everything on day one, but we expect you to be the one who never stops asking "why?".

• Agile Impact: Join a team where your proactivity isn't just welcomed – it's required. You will prevent issues before they happen, using digital twins and remote diagnostic tools.

Who You Are:

• Education: You have a degree in Engineering, IT, Biochemistry, Lab Diagnostics or equivalent. More importantly, you have a "detective’s mind" for troubleshooting.

• Language Power: You are a native or C1/C2 speaker of Czech and/or Slovak . Your English is strong enough to lead you through international trainings and global technical forums.

• The "Lab-to-Office" Bridge: If you’ve worked in a clinical lab and feel you’ve outgrown your current walls, we want your diagnostic logic. We will teach you the engineering; you bring the passion for science.

• Resilience & Ambition: You are someone who sees a complex technical error not as a problem, but as a challenge to be conquered.

What Roche Offers You:

• Autonomy: A hybrid work model in Warsaw, Prague, or Bratislava.

• Unmatched Portfolio: Access to technologies that are setting the standard for the next decade of healthcare.

The role is an 18 - month contract via an external agency.

F or the secondary locations the compensation data will be provided during the first interview.

INTERESED? APPLY!

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche? Check out our blog!
https://diagnostics.roc

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Questo ruolo si basa nel Centro Assistenza Clienti Regionale che si dedica a fornire eccellenza aiutando il personale di laboratorio a utilizzare i nostri prodotti. Operiamo con un approccio olistico, il che significa che ci occupiamo del nostro portafoglio prodotti dall'idea attraverso lo sviluppo e il lancio di mercato a phase-out. L'eccezionale varietà di tecnologie applicate in questo settore offre grandi opportunità di apprendimento. Il nostro Centro Assistenza Clienti Regionale (RCSC) è il motore intellettuale dietro l'eccellenza di laboratorio in Europa Centrale. Stiamo cercando un talento ceco e/o slovacco che ha fame di conoscenza, gode di problem solving, ed è pronto a padroneggiare le tecnologie diagnostiche più avanzate del mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici dell'ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Si tratta di una posizione di consulenza ingegneristica e applicativa in cui si diventa il "guardiano" dell'accuratezza diagnostica.
• Master the Complexity: lavorerai con sistemi IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) di fascia alta che combinano robotica, biochimica complessa e IT avanzato.
• Crescita continua: forniamo un programma intensivo di formazione di livello mondiale. Non ci aspettiamo che tu sappia tutto il primo giorno, ma ci aspettiamo che tu sia quello che non smette mai di chiedere "perché?".
• Agile Impact: Unisciti a un team in cui la tua proattività non è solo accolta – è necessario. Impedirai i problemi prima che accadano, utilizzando gemelli digitali e strumenti di diagnostica a distanza. Chi sei?
• Istruzione: Hai una laurea in Ingegneria, IT, Biochimica, Diagnostica di laboratorio o equivalente. Più importante, si dispone di una "tendenza" per la risoluzione dei problemi.
• Language Power: Sei un madrelingua o C1/C2 di ceco e/o slovacco . Il vostro inglese è abbastanza forte da condurvi attraverso allenamenti internazionali e forum tecnici globali.
• Il Ponte "Lab-to-Office": Se hai lavorato in un laboratorio clinico e senti di aver superato le pareti attuali, vogliamo la tua logica diagnostica. Vi insegneremo l'ingegneria; portate la passione per la scienza.
• Resilience & Ambition: Tu sei qualcuno che vede un complesso errore tecnico non come un problema, ma come una sfida da conquistare. Cosa Roche ti offre:
• Autonomia: Un modello di lavoro ibrido a Varsavia, Praga, o Bratislava.
• Portfolio senza precedenti: Accesso alle tecnologie che fissano lo standard per il prossimo decennio di assistenza sanitaria. Il ruolo è un contratto di 18 - mese tramite un'agenzia esterna. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a Product Manager at Roche Diagnostics Central Asia and Caucasian countries.

Location: Kazakhstan, Almaty

• What will you do?
• · You will join the healthcare innovation team.
• · You will be responsible for growing the portfolio; delivering on the marketing plan and working cross functionally with related colleagues.
• · You will prepare short term (annual) and medium term business/marketing plans for the products.
• · You will be expected to maintain and communicate a high level of market and product knowledge.
• · You will organize training programs for commercial team about products, product marketing strategies and competition.
• · You will organize product related marketing events (congresses, conferences, etc) in cooperation with related parties

• Who are you?
• · Bachelor's Degree in medicine, biology, chemistry
• · Preferably 1-2 years’ experience of product management in the diagnostic, pharmaceutical, or related industry
• · Budget management and product launch experience preferred
• · Strong communication, analytical and presentation skills
• · At least upper-intermediate level of English and fluent Russian
• · Having driving license and willing to travel

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche .

As a Territory Manager - Jabalpur , you are responsible for managing the sale of the organization’s products through distribution and retail channels across the Mahakoushal Area. You serve as a strategic partner to the Area Sales Manager (ASM), providing critical market insights to estimate product demand and drive the organization’s growth. You apply new approaches to merchandising and field activation to increase brand visibility and ensure that our life-changing products reach the customers and patients who need them. You work collaboratively with distributors and dealers to break down barriers to access, ensuring that our sales plans are executed with precision and operational excellence.

Your Opportunity

• Territory Planning & Execution: You drive business results by providing information on the market environment to help estimate yearly product demand. You ensure the monthly achievement of SKU-wise sales plans and targets by generating secondary sales in the market.

• Distribution Management: You monitor distributor performance, reviewing the existing network to propose the appointment of new partners or the termination of non-performing ones. You motivate distributors and dealers through regular communication, sorting out issues regarding accounts, pricing, and schemes.

• Sales Promotion & Merchandising: You prepare and execute sales promotion plans through field activation and merchandising activities designed by the Marketing Team. You maintain rigorous records of these activities, tracking expenses and sales generated to provide feedback on program efficacy.

• Market Intelligence: You monitor competitor information and feedback within your category. You provide regular reports to the ASM on competitor activities and stock availability of promotional materials to ensure Roche remains competitive in the landscape.

• Customer Excellence: You address all complaints and suggestions from distributors and customers by coordinating with customer care. You organize dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies to ensure brand consistency and strong partnerships.

• Financial Oversight: You ensure timely monthly collections through continuous follow-ups and submit inventory requirements at the distributor level as per the sales plan. You maintain disciplined daily reporting of customer visits as per established work norms.

• Abwechselnder Arbeitseinsatz auf allen Posten in den Betrieben Gäste- und Direktionsrestaurant Panorama, Lounge 47, Pebbels Lounge, Schöpfli und Science Club

• Termingerechte Bereitstellung und Produktion aller Angebotskomponenten

• Zubereitung nach Rezeptur, inkl. Degustation und kontinuierlichem Verbesserungsprozess

• Ideenreichtum und Kreativität sind deine Antreiber

• Du bringst die Liebe zum Beruf auf den Teller

• Selbstständiges Führen eines Postens

• Erstellen der benötigten Mise en Place und verantwortlich für den reibungslosen Ablauf auf deinem Posten

• Einhalten von Hygienebestimmungen (TQM / HACCP)

• Wirtschaftlicher und korrekter Umgang mit Lebensmittel bei der Lagerung und/sowie bei deren Verarbeitung

• Sichere Warenbewirtschaftung sowie interne und externe Bestellungen tätigen

• Arbeitszeiten in der Regel zwischen 6.00 und 22.00 Uhr, mit Ausnahmen auch Abendeinsätze möglich

Dein Profil

• Du besitzt ein Durchsetzungsvermögen

• Du hast eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise und übernimmst Verantwortung

• Teamfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich

• Du hast Kenntnisse der Schweizer Lebensmittelgesetzgebung

• Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um deine Kunden kompetent beraten zu können

• In einer digitalen Welt wünschen wir uns zudem, einen sicheren Umgang mit Computerprogrammen (MS Office)

• Ideenreichtum und Kreativität sind deine Antreiber

• Sichere Warenbewirtschaftung sowie interne und externe Bestellungen tätigen

• Arbeitszeiten in der Regel zwischen 6.00 und 22.00 Uhr, mit Ausnahmen auch Abendeinsätze möglich

Dein Profil

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene Kochausbildung (EFZ) und verfügst über mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung (exkl. Ausbildungsjahre) in der gehobenen Gastronomie

• Du hast einschlägige Erfahrungen in allen Küchenbereichen

• Du hast eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise und übernimmst Verantwortung

• Teamfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich

• Du hast Kenntnisse der Schweizer Lebensmittelgesetzgebung

• Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um deine Kunden kompetent beraten zu können

• In einer digitalen Welt wünschen wir uns zudem, einen sicheren Umgang mit Computerprogrammen (MS Office)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

jobs.title: Investor Relations Officer (Finance)

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste des relations avec les investisseurs (Finances)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Welcome to a highly dedicated team where you will have the unique opportunity to gain deep insight into all aspects of investor relations at a world-leading, science-driven pharmaceutical company. Our team focuses on maintaining strong relations with the capital market while offering a dynamic and fast-paced environment with ample opportunities for professional development.

As an Investor Relations Officer, your core responsibilities will be to analyze financial community expectations and market sentiment, provide vital internal performance updates, and ensure a continuous information flow to shareholders and bondholders. By doing so, you will strengthen their understanding and appreciation of Roche’s business while gaining extensive experience in internal and external communications directed at senior management and the financial community.

The Opportunity

• Financial Reporting & Presentations: Manage the preparation of quarterly results presentations for the management team with a strong focus on finance, specifically supporting the CFO, and actively participate in the preparation of the Finance Report.

• Investor & Analyst Relations: Act as a key point of contact for analysts and investors to process all finance and sustainability (ESG: Environmental, Social, Governance) related requests, while building and maintaining an internal network of subject matter experts.

• Fixed-Income Management: Lead all fixed-income related activities, which includes handling requests from bondholders, supporting the issuance of new debt, and supporting annual reviews with rating agencies in close collaboration with Group Treasury.

• Market Intelligence & Valuation: Monitor sell-side reports, contextualize consensus estimates, and maintain an internal company valuation model in close collaboration with Group Planning.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise closely with Group Finance, Legal, BD, and Communications on a variety of strategic topics, such as business development, the implementation of regulatory changes, and the ad-hoc release process.

• Capital Market Events: Participate in the preparation of capital market days (e.g., Digitalization Day, Pharma Day, Diagnostics Day) by developing compelling storylines and building slide decks for individual speakers.

• IR Infrastructure: Oversee and run the day-to-day operations of the Investor Relations (IR) website and its associated digital tools.

Who You Are

• Experience & Industry Background: You bring a strong finance, accounting, or business background with at least five years of working experience at the group level of a global Pharma/Biotech company, including hands-on involvement in the quarterly and annual results review process.

• Capital Markets Expertise: You possess a deep interest in capital markets, a validated understanding of company valuations (especially within the healthcare sector), and a solid foundational understanding of accounting policies.

• Technical Skillset: You have strong proficiency in standard business tools such as Excel and PowerPoint; proficiency in specialized analytical tools like Bloomberg is considered a distinct asset.

• Communication & Articulation: You are fluent in English (both written and spoken), with German language skills being a clear advantage. You back this up with excellent interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills, enabling you to clearly explain financial value drivers and complex business concepts.

• Networking & Collaborative Spirit: You have

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Benvenuti in un team altamente dedicato dove avrete l'opportunità unica di acquisire una profonda conoscenza di tutti gli aspetti delle relazioni con gli investitori in una società farmaceutica leader mondiale. Il nostro team si concentra sul mantenimento di forti relazioni con il mercato del capitale, offrendo un ambiente dinamico e veloce con ampie opportunità di sviluppo professionale. In qualità di Investor Relations Officer, le vostre responsabilità principali saranno di analizzare le aspettative della comunità finanziaria e il sentimento di mercato, fornire aggiornamenti vitali delle prestazioni interne e garantire un flusso continuo di informazioni agli azionisti e agli obbligazionisti. Così facendo, rafforzerete la loro comprensione e apprezzamento del business di Roche, acquisendo una vasta esperienza nelle comunicazioni interne ed esterne dirette alla gestione senior e alla comunità finanziaria. L'opportunità
• Financial Reporting & Presentations: Gestire la preparazione di presentazioni trimestrali di risultati per il team di gestione con un forte focus sulla finanza, specificamente sostenere il CFO, e partecipare attivamente alla preparazione del Finance Report.
• Investor & Analyst Relations: Agire come punto chiave di contatto per analisti e investitori per elaborare tutte le richieste relative alla finanza e alla sostenibilità (ESG: Ambientale, Sociale, Governance), costruendo e mantenendo una rete interna di esperti in materia.
• Gestione dei proventi fissi: portare tutte le attività connesse a reddito fisso, che include la gestione delle richieste da parte degli obbligazionisti, sostenere l'emissione di nuovi debiti, e sostenere le recensioni annuali con agenzie di rating in stretta collaborazione con il Tesoro del Gruppo.
• Market Intelligence & Valuation: Monitorare i rapporti sul mercato, contestualizzare le stime del consenso e mantenere un modello di valutazione aziendale interno in stretta collaborazione con la Pianificazione del Gruppo.
• Collaborazione trasversale: Liaise a stretto contatto con le Finanze del Gruppo, Legale, BD e Comunicazioni su una varietà di argomenti strategici, come lo sviluppo aziendale, l'attuazione dei cambiamenti normativi e il processo di rilascio ad-hoc.
• Capital Market Events: Partecipa alla preparazione dei giorni del mercato dei capitali (ad esempio, Digitalization Day, Pharma Day, Diagnostics Day) sviluppando storie convincenti e ponti di scorrimento per i singoli diffusori.
• IR Infrastructure: supervisionare ed eseguire le operazioni quotidiane del sito Investor Relations (IR) e dei relativi strumenti digitali associati. Chi sei
• Experience & Industry Background: Lei porta una forte finanza, contabilità o background aziendale con almeno cinque anni di esperienza lavorativa a livello di gruppo di una società globale Pharma/Biotech, compreso il coinvolgimento pratico nel processo di revisione trimestrale e annuale dei risultati.
• Competenza sui mercati dei capitali: Lei possiede un profondo interesse nei mercati dei capitali, una valida comprensione delle valutazioni aziendali (soprattutto nel settore sanitario) e una solida comprensione fondamentale delle politiche contabili.
• Technical Skillset: Hai una forte competenza in strumenti di business standard come Excel e PowerPoint; la competenza in strumenti analitici specializzati come Bloomberg è considerato un bene distinto.
• Comunicazione & Articulation: Lei è fluente in inglese (sia scritto che parlato), con le competenze linguistiche tedesche è un chiaro vantaggio. Si sostiene questo con eccellenti capacità interpersonali, di presentazione e di comunicazione, consentendo di spiegare chiaramente i driver di valore finanziario e concetti aziendali complessi.
• Networking & Spirito collaborativo: Tu hai

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Willkommen in einem hoch engagierten Team, in dem Sie die einmalige Gelegenheit haben, einen tiefen Einblick in alle Aspekte der Investor Relations in einem weltweit führenden, wissenschaftsgetriebenen Pharmaunternehmen zu erhalten. Unser Team konzentriert sich auf die Aufrechterhaltung starker Beziehungen zum Kapitalmarkt und bietet ein dynamisches und schnelles Umfeld mit reichlich Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Entwicklung. Als Investor Relations Officer besteht Ihre Hauptaufgabe darin, die Erwartungen der Finanzgemeinde und die Marktstimmung zu analysieren, wichtige interne Performance-Updates bereitzustellen und einen kontinuierlichen Informationsfluss zu Aktionären und Anleihegläubigern sicherzustellen. Auf diese Weise stärken Sie ihr Verständnis und ihre Wertschätzung für das Geschäft von Roche und sammeln umfangreiche Erfahrungen in der internen und externen Kommunikation, die sich an die Geschäftsleitung und die Finanzwelt richten. Die Chance
• Finanzberichterstattung & Präsentationen: Verwalten Sie die Erstellung von vierteljährlichen Ergebnispräsentationen für das Managementteam mit einem starken Fokus auf Finanzen, insbesondere die Unterstützung des CFO, und beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an der Erstellung des Finanzberichts.
• Investor & Analyst Relations: Handeln Sie als wichtiger Ansprechpartner für Analysten und Investoren, um alle Anfragen im Zusammenhang mit Finanzen und Nachhaltigkeit (ESG: Environmental, Social, Governance) zu bearbeiten und gleichzeitig ein internes Netzwerk von Fachexperten aufzubauen und zu pflegen.
• Fixed-Income-Management: Führen Sie alle Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit Fixed-Income, einschließlich der Bearbeitung von Anfragen von Anleiheinhabern, der Unterstützung der Emission neuer Schulden und der Unterstützung jährlicher Überprüfungen mit Ratingagenturen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Group Treasury.
• Market Intelligence & Valuation: Überwachen Sie Sell-Side-Berichte, kontextualisieren Sie Konsensschätzungen und pflegen Sie ein internes Unternehmensbewertungsmodell in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Gruppenplanung.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Enge Verbindung mit Group Finance, Legal, BD und Communications zu einer Vielzahl strategischer Themen wie Geschäftsentwicklung, Umsetzung regulatorischer Änderungen und Ad-hoc-Release-Prozess.
• Capital Market Events: Beteiligen Sie sich an der Vorbereitung von Kapitalmarkttagen (z.B. Digitalization Day, Pharma Day, Diagnostics Day), indem Sie überzeugende Handlungsstränge entwickeln und Diadecks für einzelne Referenten erstellen.
• IR-Infrastruktur: Überwachen und betreiben Sie den täglichen Betrieb der Investor Relations (IR)-Website und der zugehörigen digitalen Tools. Wer du bist
• Erfahrung und Branchenhintergrund: Sie haben einen starken Finanz-, Buchhaltungs- oder Geschäftshintergrund mit mindestens fünfjähriger Berufserfahrung auf Gruppenebene eines globalen Pharma- / Biotech-Unternehmens, einschließlich einer praktischen Beteiligung am vierteljährlichen und jährlichen Ergebnisprüfungsprozess.
• Kapitalmarktexpertise: Sie haben ein großes Interesse an Kapitalmärkten, ein validiertes Verständnis der Unternehmensbewertungen (insbesondere im Gesundheitswesen) und ein solides grundlegendes Verständnis der Rechnungslegungspolitik.
• Technische Fähigkeiten: Sie verfügen über starke Kenntnisse in Standard-Business-Tools wie Excel und PowerPoint; Kenntnisse in spezialisierten Analyse-Tools wie Bloomberg gelten als eigenständiges Asset.
• Kommunikation & Artikulation: Sie sprechen fließend Englisch (sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen), wobei Deutschkenntnisse ein klarer Vorteil sind. Sie unterstützen dies mit hervorragenden zwischenmenschlichen, Präsentations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, finanzielle Werttreiber und komplexe Geschäftskonzepte klar zu erklären.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Bienvenue dans une équipe très dévouée où vous aurez l'occasion unique d'acquérir une connaissance approfondie de tous les aspects des relations avec les investisseurs dans une société pharmaceutique mondialement leader, axée sur la science. Notre équipe se concentre sur le maintien de relations solides avec le marché des capitaux tout en offrant un environnement dynamique et rapide avec de nombreuses possibilités de développement professionnel. En tant qu'agent des relations avec les investisseurs, vos principales responsabilités consisteront à analyser les attentes de la communauté financière et le sentiment du marché, à fournir des mises à jour essentielles du rendement interne et à assurer un flux continu d'information aux actionnaires et aux détenteurs d'obligations. Ce faisant, vous renforcerez leur compréhension et leur appréciation des activités de Roches tout en acquérant une vaste expérience dans les communications internes et externes destinées à la haute direction et à la communauté financière. L'opportunité
• Rapports financiers et présentations : Gérer la préparation de présentations trimestrielles des résultats à l'intention de l'équipe de gestion, en mettant l'accent sur les finances, en appuyant spécifiquement le DPF, et participer activement à la préparation du rapport financier.
• Relations avec les investisseurs et les analystes : agir en tant que point de contact clé pour les analystes et les investisseurs afin de traiter toutes les demandes liées au financement et à la durabilité (ESG : environnement, social, gouvernance), tout en créant et en maintenant un réseau interne d'experts en la matière.
• Gestion des revenus fixes : Diriger toutes les activités liées aux revenus fixes, notamment le traitement des demandes des détenteurs d'obligations, l'appui à l'émission de nouvelles créances et l'appui aux examens annuels avec les agences de notation en étroite collaboration avec le Trésor du Groupe.
• Intelligence et évaluation du marché : Surveiller les rapports côté vente, contextualiser les estimations consensuelles et maintenir un modèle d'évaluation interne de l'entreprise en étroite collaboration avec la planification de groupe.
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Assurer une liaison étroite avec le Groupe des finances, les services juridiques, le BD et les communications sur divers sujets stratégiques, comme le développement des entreprises, la mise en oeuvre de changements réglementaires et le processus de diffusion ad hoc.
• Événements sur le marché des capitaux : Participer à la préparation des journées sur le marché des capitaux (p. ex., Journée de la numérisation, Journée de la pharmacie, Journée du diagnostic) en élaborant des histoires convaincantes et en construisant des plates-formes pour les conférenciers individuels.
• Infrastructure IR : Surveiller et gérer les opérations quotidiennes du site Internet Relations Investisseurs (IR) et des outils numériques associés. Qui vous êtes
• Expérience et industrie Contexte : Vous apportez une solide expérience financière, comptable ou commerciale avec au moins cinq années d'expérience de travail au niveau du groupe d'une entreprise mondiale Pharma/Biotech, y compris la participation pratique au processus d'examen des résultats trimestriels et annuels.
• Expertise en marchés de capitaux: Vous avez un intérêt profond sur les marchés de capitaux, une compréhension validée des évaluations des entreprises (surtout dans le secteur de la santé), et une compréhension fondamentale solide des conventions comptables.
• Compétences techniques: Vous avez une solide compétence dans les outils d'affaires standard comme Excel et PowerPoint; la compétence dans les outils analytiques spécialisés comme Bloomberg est considérée comme un atout distinct.
• Communication & Articulation: Vous maîtrisez couramment l'anglais (écrit et parlé), les compétences linguistiques en allemand étant un avantage évident. Vous soutenez cela avec d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, de présentation et de communication, vous permettant d'expliquer clairement les facteurs de valeur financière et les concepts d'affaires complexes.

As an Intern in Roche Pharma Malaysia, you may be assigned to a variety of tasks and/or projects relevant for the assigned team/function.

The objective of assignments is for the intern to practically apply academic or vocational studies/learning in a Roche setting, as well as learn more about the Roche organization, as future employment with Roche may be a possibility subject to job availability, candidate qualification and past performance.

Assignments will vary but are typically to support the activities of regular employees, such as entry-level research and reporting, analyses and modeling, preparing materials for others, coordinating small events or meetings, improving basic departmental operations such as filing or archiving systems, departmental libraries, etc.

For assignments in Digital Marketing, key responsibilities of an intern may include but not limited to the following (with appropriate guidance from experienced colleagues):

• Collaborating closely with field-facing and office-based colleagues to understand customer/patient/healthcare ecosystem needs as well as Roche strategies and products in the assigned disease area

• Adapting materials/assets/content from global or other countries to local context and needs

• Creating new materials/assets/content

• Support planning, project management and implementation for (digital) marketing campaigns,

• Support development of content/channel strategies and tactics​

Education & Qualifications:

• Currently pursuing a degree in a Medical, Scientific, or Biotechnology-related field (e.g., Science, Medical, Biotechnology).

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This posting is for Talent Pool purposes and may not correspond to a current vacancy with an active recruitment process. However, it reflects a role for which we regularly recruit or anticipate having openings in the near future for permanent or fixed term opportunities.

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process. In this position in close collaboration with the Country Chief Accountant, you will focus on:

• Leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities

• Taxes, GL journals and accruals/ provisions, reconciling BS accounts

• Clearing customer accounts and bank suspense accounts, collecting direct debit, daily bank posting, posting and reconciling treasury transactions

• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices

• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling

• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP

• Performing Month-end Closing and Reporting for Consolidation and for Divisions

• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:
University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• 2-4 years of experience in a relevant position

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Outstanding customer orientation and service focus

• Strong interpersonal skills and team player attitude

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questa pubblicazione è per scopi Talent Pool e non può corrispondere a una vacanza corrente con un processo di reclutamento attivo. Tuttavia, riflette un ruolo per il quale regolarmente reclutare o anticipare di avere aperture nel prossimo futuro per opportunità a termine permanenti o fissi. Il Dipartimento Record to Report (R2R) è un'organizzazione globale di oltre 650 professionisti esperti di finanza che lavorano insieme per fornire servizi finanziari e soluzioni per Roche in tutta la regione EMEA. I nostri servizi riguardano la gestione finanziaria, la chiusura di fine periodo, la contabilità di capitale e di locazione, il credito e i crediti, la finanza di produzione e la rendicontazione divisionale, assicurando la conformità per 263 entità di reporting in 96 paesi con gli standard contabili (IFRS, GAAP) e fornendo garanzia di integrità finanziaria. L'opportunità In qualità di Senior Financial Accountant effettuerai attività quotidiane e di chiusura in collaborazione con dipartimenti interfunzionali, secondo scadenze predefinite con piena proprietà dei loro compiti e nel rispetto delle Documentazioni di Processo del rispettivo sottoprocesso aziendale. In questa posizione in stretta collaborazione con il Capo Contabile del Paese, ti concentrerai su:
• Attività bancarie, assetto fisso e CAPEX
• Tasse, riviste GL e accruals/ disposizioni, riconciliando conti BS
• Cancellazione account clienti e conti di suspense bancari, raccolta di addebito diretto, postazione giornaliera, postazione e riconciliazione transazioni tesoreria
• Calcolo e emissione di fatture manuali AR
• Definizione e calcolo dei costi e delle entrate nel controllo
• Condurre la chiusura del prodotto nel modulo Gestione dei Materiali di SAP
• Esecuzione di chiusura e reporting mensile per il consolidamento e per le divisioni
• Preparazione della documentazione di audit e partecipazione a audit interni ed esterni Chi sei Stiamo cercando qualcuno che è auto motivato, davvero appassionato del suo lavoro e capisce che fornire un servizio di alta qualità è fondamentale per l'organizzazione. Come membro del team ideale siete open-minded, dedicato a fare la differenza e aperto allo sviluppo costante. Inoltre, avete: Laurea universitaria, preferibilmente in Finanza / Contabilità disciplina relativa
• 2-4 anni di esperienza in una posizione rilevante
• Ottima comunicazione e capacità analitiche
• Ottimi orientamenti e messa a fuoco dei servizi
• Forte abilità interpersonali e atteggiamento del giocatore di squadra
• Proficienza in inglese In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto si può spostare Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.
• Una comunità globale inclusiva, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto concentrata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This posting is for Talent Pool purposes and may not correspond to a current vacancy with an active recruitment process. However, it reflects a role for which we regularly recruit or anticipate having openings in the near future for permanent or fixed term opportunities.

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process. In this position in close collaboration with the Country Chief Accountant, you will focus on:

• Leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities

• Taxes, GL journals and accruals/ provisions, reconciling BS accounts

• Clearing customer accounts and bank suspense accounts, collecting direct debit, daily bank posting, posting and reconciling treasury transactions

• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices

• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling

• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP

• Performing Month-end Closing and Reporting for Consolidation and for Divisions

• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:
University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• 2-4 years of experience in a relevant position

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Outstanding customer orientation and service focus

• Strong interpersonal skills and team player attitude

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Dieses Posting dient Talent Pool-Zwecken und entspricht möglicherweise nicht einer aktuellen Vakanz mit einem aktiven Rekrutierungsprozess. Es spiegelt jedoch eine Rolle wider, für die wir regelmäßig rekrutieren oder in naher Zukunft Öffnungen für dauerhafte oder befristete Möglichkeiten erwarten. Die Abteilung Record to Report (R2R) ist eine globale Organisation von über 650 erfahrenen Finanzexperten, die zusammenarbeiten, um Finanzdienstleistungen und -lösungen für Roche in der gesamten EMEA-Region bereitzustellen. Unsere Dienstleistungen umfassen Finanzmanagement, Periodenabschluss, Kapital- und Leasingbuchhaltung, Kredite und Forderungen, Fertigungsfinanzierung und Teilberichterstattung, um die Einhaltung der Rechnungslegungsstandards (IFRS, GAAP) für 263 berichtende Unternehmen in 96 Ländern sicherzustellen und die finanzielle Integrität zu gewährleisten. Die Chance Als Senior Financial Accountant führen Sie die täglichen und abschließenden Tätigkeiten in Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Abteilungen nach vordefinierten Fristen unter voller Verantwortung ihrer Aufgaben und unter Einhaltung der Prozessdokumentationen des jeweiligen Geschäftsteilprozesses durch. In dieser Position konzentrieren Sie sich in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Country Chief Accountant auf:
• Vermietung von Vermögenswerten, Sachanlagen und CAPEX-Buchführung
• Steuern, GL-Zeitschriften und Periodenabgrenzungen/Rückstellungen, Abgleich von BS-Konten
• Clearing von Kundenkonten und Bankkonten, Einziehung von Lastschriften, tägliche Bankbuchung, Buchung und Abgleich von Finanztransaktionen
• Berechnung und Ausstellung von AR-Handbuchrechnungen
• Festlegung und Berechnung der Kosten- und Einnahmenzuweisung im Controlling
• Durchführung des Produktabschlusses im Material Management Modul von SAP
• Durchführung des Monatsabschlusses und Berichtswesens für Konsolidierung und Divisionen
• Erstellung von Auditunterlagen und Teilnahme an internen und externen Audits Wer du bist Wir suchen jemanden, der selbst motiviert ist, wirklich leidenschaftlich über seinen Job und versteht, dass die Bereitstellung eines qualitativ hochwertigen Service ist entscheidend für die Organisation. Als ideales Teammitglied sind Sie aufgeschlossen, engagiert, um einen Unterschied zu machen und offen für ständige Entwicklung. Darüber hinaus haben Sie: Universitätsabschluss, vorzugsweise in der Finanz- / Rechnungswesen verwandten Disziplin
• 2-4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer relevanten Position
• Hervorragende Kommunikation und analytische Fähigkeiten
• Herausragende Kundenorientierung und Serviceorientierung
• Starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und Teamplayer Haltung
• Englischkenntnisse Im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen:
• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Roche ist reich an Lernressourcen. Wir bieten ständige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, kostenlose Sprachkurse & Schulungen, die Möglichkeit internationaler Einsätze, interne Positionsänderungen und die Möglichkeit, die eigene Karriere zu gestalten.
• Ausgezeichnete Vorteile: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Cafeteria-Paket, Jahresbonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, Coaching / Mentoring-Möglichkeit, Buddy-Programm, Teamgebäude, Feiertagsparty.
• Flexibilität: Wir unterstützen auch Flexibilität, um Ihnen zu helfen, Ihr Gleichgewicht zu finden. Home Office ist allgemein verfügbar (in der Regel 2 Bürotage / Woche im Durchschnitt). Wir schaffen die Möglichkeit zur Arbeitsfreiheit, in der Ihr Firmen- und Privatleben in Harmonie koexistieren.
• Eine globale inklusive Gemeinschaft, in der wir voneinander lernen. Bei Roche kooperieren, diskutieren, treffen Entscheidungen, feiern Erfolge und haben Spaß als Team. Unsere Führung ist sehr auf Menschen ausgerichtet und schafft eine starke, integrative Kultur, so dass Sie immer die Chance haben
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Cette affectation est aux fins de Talent Pool et peut ne pas correspondre à une vacance actuelle avec un processus de recrutement actif. Toutefois, il reflète un rôle pour lequel nous recrutons ou anticipons régulièrement avoir des ouvertures dans un avenir proche pour des possibilités permanentes ou à durée déterminée. Le département Record to Report (R2R) est une organisation mondiale de plus de 650 professionnels des finances expérimentés qui travaillent ensemble pour fournir des services et des solutions financiers à Roche dans toute la région de l'EMEA. Nos services couvrent la gestion financière, la clôture de l'exercice, la comptabilité des immobilisations et des contrats de location-acquisition, les crédits et créances, les finances manufacturières et les rapports divisionnaires, la conformité de 263 entités déclarantes dans 96 pays aux normes comptables (IFRS, GAAP) et l'assurance de l'intégrité financière. L'opportunité En tant que comptable financier principal, vous effectuerez des activités quotidiennes et de clôture en collaboration avec les départements interfonctionnels, selon des délais prédéfinis, avec la pleine propriété de leurs tâches et conformément aux documents de processus du sous-processus opérationnel respectif. Dans ce poste en étroite collaboration avec le comptable en chef de pays, vous vous concentrerez sur :
• Actifs loués, immobilisations et activités comptables CAPEX
• Impôts, journaux GL et provisions, rapprochement des comptes BS
• Effacement des comptes clients et des comptes d'attente bancaires, collecte des prélèvements, affichage bancaire quotidien, affichage et rapprochement des opérations de trésorerie
• Calcul et délivrance des factures manuelles d'EI
• Définition et calcul de la répartition des coûts et des recettes
• Réalisation de la fermeture des produits dans le module Gestion des matériaux de SAP
• Exécution de la clôture du mois et des rapports pour la consolidation et pour les divisions
• Préparation des documents d ' audit et participation aux audits internes et externes Qui vous êtes Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui est motivé par lui-même, qui est vraiment passionné par son travail et qui comprend que la prestation d'un service de haute qualité est cruciale pour l'organisation. En tant que membre idéal de l'équipe, vous êtes ouvert d'esprit, dévoué à faire la différence et ouvert à un développement constant. De plus, vous avez : Diplôme universitaire, de préférence dans la discipline liée aux finances et à la comptabilité
• 2-4 ans d'expérience dans un poste pertinent
• Excellente capacité de communication et d'analyse
• Orientation et service exceptionnels
• Fortes aptitudes interpersonnelles et attitude des joueurs d'équipe
• Compétence en anglais En échange, nous vous fournissons:
• Possibilités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage. Nous offrons des possibilités de développement constantes, des cours de langues et de formation gratuits, la possibilité d'affectations internationales, des changements de position interne et la possibilité de façonner votre propre carrière.
• Excellents avantages : Forfait salaire et cafétéria compétitif, bonus annuel, Services médicaux privés, Programme d'aide aux employés, All You Can Move Sportpass, occasion de coaching / mentorat, programme de copains, bâtiments d'équipe, fête de vacances.
• Flexibilité : Nous soutenons également la flexibilité pour vous aider à trouver votre équilibre. Le bureau à domicile est généralement disponible (habituellement 2 jours/semaine en moyenne). Nous créons l'occasion de la liberté dans le travail, où votre vie privée et d'entreprise coexistent en harmonie.
• Une communauté mondiale inclusive, où nous apprenons les uns des autres. Chez Roche, nous coopérons, débattons, prenons des décisions, célébrons les succès et nous amusons en équipe. Notre leadership est très concentré sur les gens, créant une culture forte et inclusive, donc vous avez toujours la chance

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Mission:
En tant que Key Account Manager Comptes Publics AP-HP et rattaché(e) au SubChapter Lead Key Account Manager, vous intégrez une équipe dynamique et êtes Expert(e) des comptes stratégiques.

Vous êtes la voix des clients et représentez Roche auprès de ces derniers. A ce titre, vous avez une compréhension parfaite de la cartographie des interlocuteurs et de la matrice décisionnelle des comptes, de l'environnement, des enjeux et visions stratégiques des clients. Vous avez également une vue précise du positionnement compétitif de Roche vis à vis de ces enjeux, ce qui vous permet de définir et porter la responsabilité de la stratégie commerciale et financière des comptes - existant(s) ou futur(s). Enfin, vous définissez la stratégie de négociation et la mettez en œuvre

Localisation idéale : région Parisienne

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous déterminez la stratégie Roche Diagnostics France à déployer pour les grands comptes publics sous votre responsabilité, en identifiant les leviers soutenant le développement d’un partenariat solide et capable de générer de la valeur pour toutes les parties.

• A toutes les étapes de la relation commerciale, vous identifiez et saisissez les différentes opportunités au sein des comptes pour contribuer à l’atteinte des objectifs stratégiques de Roche; en collaboration avec les experts internes, notamment les équipes commerciales, vous co-designez et proposez les solutions Roche adaptées aux besoins des clients et différenciantes. Vous êtes responsable de l'atteinte des objectifs business, de l'évolution du chiffre d'affaires et de la profitabilité des comptes.

• En étroite collaboration avec le chef de projet Appels d'Offres, vous coordonnez l’équipe projet engagée autour de la construction de la réponse et vous vous assurez que celle ci permettra l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux et financier attendus; Vous vous assurez également de la bonne contractualisation en adéquation avec les règles du groupe et de la filiale.

• Responsable de la bonne exécution des marchés notifiés et de la satisfaction du client, vous mettez en place et suivez les indicateurs de performance pertinents pour les comptes sous votre responsabilité et engagez les équipes sur l’amélioration continue des actions; Vous êtes garant(e) de la pertinence et de l'efficacité du schéma de communication au sein des comptes.

• Squad lead: en collaboration avec les chapter/subchapter leads, vous identifiez les compétences requises et constituez une équipe engagée autour des besoins du client, la stratégie commerciale, l'atteinte des objectifs et du plan d'actions.

• Vous vous assurez de la bonne compréhension, par les membres de la squad, de l’actualité du compte et de notre position compétitive, afin que l’équipe soit en mesure de prioriser ses actions. Vous tenez l’équipe informée des KPIs des comptes et engagez avec elle toutes les actions nécessaires à l’atteinte de nos objectifs et la satisfaction client.

• Ambassadeur Compliance : vous garantissez le respect de la compliance dans les relations avec le client

• Vous garantissez la justesse et l'exhaustivité des information relatives au client dont vous avez la charge dans le CRM

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous possédez une forte compréhension des enjeux stratégiques et business du secteur du Diagnostic In Vitro et, plus largement, de l’industrie de la Santé.

• Vous maîtrisez les techniques de négociation commerciale et de gestion de projet. Une culture scientifique constitue un réel atout.
