jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to steer the long-term category roadmap and command the high-value supplier ecosystems that drive our global Instrument development projects? As our Global Category Manager for Engineering Services based out of Sant Cugat, Spain, you will take ultimate accountability for developing strategies and leading strategic initiatives for this complex, high-value category. In this role, you will manage major engineering consultancies, technical suppliers, and service networks to ensure maximum value delivery across global business sites.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Engages directly with cross-functional teams composed of representatives from Category,, Procurement Center of Excellence, R&D and other global business partners. Serves as a key business partner contact point for senior functional and business stakeholders in R&D.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role with global category leadership position focused on strategic vision, category development, pipeline building, and relationship ecosystem management

• Impact: You deliver commercial impact by anchoring cost and developing a resilience pipeline of projects, in addition to securing our sustainability priorities. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, supplier data, and business requirements to formulate a formalized, global Category Strategy and initiative pipeline, to be aligned with leaders across the organization.

• Commercial Negotiations: Leading high-value commercial and contractual negotiations for strategic suppliers within the category.

• Supplier Ecosystems: Managing key global suppliers, establishing development and innovation programs, monitoring value targets, and managing supplier risks.

• Guidance & Content: Developing and maintaining category guidance documents to translate strategy into clear, executable content for procurement colleagues and business users.

• Business Partnering: Building deep relationships with senior stakeholders, particularly in R&D, challenging demand/specifications to maximize value, and managing risk/CSR reviews.

• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching procurement colleagues, providing professional development, managing a shared Associate Category Manager within the team, and tracking budget spend.

Who you are

We look for strategic procurement champions with extensive knowledge of the global instruments development (SW development and HW engineering) markets and the matrix leadership skills needed to drive complex organizational change.

• Education: University degree required (Business or Life Sciences focus preferred); a post-graduate business-related qualification is preferred.

• Experience: 5+ years of in-depth strategic and operat

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti a guidare la roadmap di categoria a lungo termine e a comandare gli ecosistemi fornitori ad alto valore che guidano i nostri progetti globali di sviluppo degli strumenti? Come nostro Global Categoria Manager per i Servizi di Ingegneria con sede a Sant Cugat, in Spagna, si terrà la massima responsabilità per lo sviluppo di strategie e principali iniziative strategiche per questa categoria complessa e di alto valore. In questo ruolo, gestirete importanti consulenze ingegneristiche, fornitori tecnici e reti di servizi per garantire il massimo valore di consegna nei siti aziendali globali.
• Reporting Line: Referisce direttamente al Global Categoria Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT all'interno dell'organizzazione Categoria.
• Wider Team e Stakeholders: Engages direttamente con team interfunzionali composti da rappresentanti di Categoria,, Centro di Eccellenza, R&D e altri partner commerciali globali. Serve come punto di contatto chiave del partner commerciale per gli stakeholder senior funzionali e aziendali in R&D.
• Tipo di ruolo: Un ruolo di Contributor individuale con la posizione di leadership di categoria globale focalizzata sulla visione strategica, lo sviluppo di categoria, la costruzione di pipeline e la gestione dell'ecosistema di relazione
• Impatto: si ottiene un impatto commerciale ancorando i costi e sviluppando una pipeline di resilienza di progetti, oltre a garantire le nostre priorità di sostenibilità. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Strategia & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, dati dei fornitori e requisiti aziendali per formulare un pipeline di strategia e iniziativa di categoria formalizzata e globale, da allineare con i leader di tutta l'organizzazione.
• Negoziati commerciali: negoziati commerciali e contrattuali di alto valore per i fornitori strategici all'interno della categoria.
• Ecosistemi del fornitore: Gestire fornitori globali chiave, stabilire programmi di sviluppo e innovazione, monitorare obiettivi di valore e gestire i rischi dei fornitori.
• Orientamento e contenuto: Sviluppare e mantenere i documenti di orientamento della categoria per tradurre la strategia in contenuti chiari ed eseguibili per l'approvvigionamento di colleghi e utenti aziendali.
• Business Partnering: Costruire relazioni profonde con gli stakeholder senior, in particolare in R&D, sfidando la domanda/specificazioni per massimizzare il valore e gestire le recensioni di rischio/CSR.
• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching colleghi di approvvigionamento, fornendo lo sviluppo professionale, la gestione di un Associate Categoria Manager condiviso all'interno del team, e il monitoraggio della spesa di bilancio. Chi sei Cerchiamo campioni strategici di approvvigionamento con una vasta conoscenza dei mercati globali di sviluppo degli strumenti (SW development and HW engineering) e delle competenze di leadership matrice necessarie per guidare il cambiamento organizzativo complesso.
• Istruzione: diploma universitario richiesto (Business o Scienze della vita si concentrano preferito); una qualifica post-laurea legata al business è preferito.
• Esperienza: 5+ anni di approfondimento strategico e operativo

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Über unser Team Wir bei Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) sind ein Team von rund 200 begeisterten Fachleuten, die sich dafür einsetzen, mit unseren Lieferanten weltweit Wert zu schaffen. Von Standorten auf der ganzen Welt und mit einem vielfältigen und multikulturellen Team beziehen, verwalten wir unsere Lieferantenbasis, entwickeln und führen Kategoriestrategien aus und entwickeln und digitalisieren ständig Prozesse, die es uns ermöglichen, unser Geschäft bestmöglich zu unterstützen, um nachhaltig zu wachsen. Wenn Sie etwas bewirken möchten und Teil eines leistungsstarken und erstklassigen Beschaffungsteams sein möchten, ist dies das Richtige für Sie. Wir sind DOP. Bei Roche tun wir jetzt, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, die langfristige Kategorie-Roadmap zu steuern und die hochwertigen Lieferanten-Ökosysteme zu beherrschen, die unsere globalen Instrument-Entwicklungsprojekte vorantreiben? Als Global Category Manager für Engineering Services mit Sitz in Sant Cugat, Spanien, übernehmen Sie die ultimative Verantwortung für die Entwicklung von Strategien und strategischen Initiativen für diese komplexe, hochwertige Kategorie. In dieser Funktion verwalten Sie wichtige Ingenieurberatungen, technische Lieferanten und Servicenetzwerke, um eine maximale Wertschöpfung an globalen Geschäftsstandorten zu gewährleisten.
• Reporting Line: Direkt an die Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT innerhalb der Kategorieorganisation berichtet.
• Breiteres Team und Stakeholder: Engagiert direkt mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, die sich aus Vertretern der Kategorie, des Procurement Center of Excellence, der F & E und anderer globaler Geschäftspartner zusammensetzen. Funktioniert als wichtiger Ansprechpartner für Geschäftspartner für leitende funktionale und geschäftliche Stakeholder in Forschung und Entwicklung.
• Rollentyp: Rolle eines einzelnen Mitwirkenden mit globaler Führungsposition in den Bereichen strategische Vision, Kategorieentwicklung, Pipelineaufbau und Beziehungs-Ökosystemmanagement
• Auswirkungen: Sie erzielen kommerzielle Auswirkungen, indem Sie Kosten verankern und eine Resilienz-Pipeline von Projekten entwickeln, zusätzlich zur Sicherung unserer Nachhaltigkeitsprioritäten. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Strategie & Jahrespipeline: Zusammenstellung von Marktinformationen, Lieferantendaten und Geschäftsanforderungen, um eine formalisierte, globale Kategoriestrategie und Initiativespipeline zu formulieren, die an Führungskräften im gesamten Unternehmen ausgerichtet ist.
• Kommerzielle Verhandlungen: Führen von hochwertigen kommerziellen und vertraglichen Verhandlungen für strategische Lieferanten innerhalb der Kategorie.
• Lieferanten-Ökosysteme: Management wichtiger globaler Lieferanten, Einrichtung von Entwicklungs- und Innovationsprogrammen, Überwachung von Wertzielen und Management von Lieferantenrisiken.

• Business Partnering: Aufbau enger Beziehungen zu hochrangigen Stakeholdern, insbesondere in der Forschung und Entwicklung, Herausforderung der Nachfrage/Spezifikationen zur Wertmaximierung und Verwaltung von Risiko-/CSR-Bewertungen.
• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching von Beschaffungskollegen, Bereitstellung professioneller Entwicklung, Verwaltung eines gemeinsamen Associate Category Managers innerhalb des Teams und Verfolgung von Budgetausgaben. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Nous, chez Diagnostics Direct Approvisionnement (DOP), sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à piloter la feuille de route de la catégorie à long terme et à commander les écosystèmes fournisseurs de haute valeur qui animent nos projets mondiaux de développement d'instruments? En tant que Global Category Manager pour les services d'ingénierie basés à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous aurez la responsabilité ultime de développer des stratégies et de diriger des initiatives stratégiques pour cette catégorie complexe et de grande valeur. Dans ce rôle, vous gérerez les principaux cabinets de conseil en ingénierie, fournisseurs techniques et réseaux de services afin d'assurer une prestation de valeur maximale sur les sites d'affaires mondiaux.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement de la catégorie mondiale Capex/Services d'ingénierie/TI au sein de l'organisation de la catégorie.
• Équipe élargie et parties prenantes : S'engage directement auprès d'équipes interfonctionnelles composées de représentants de la catégorie, du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement, de R-D et d'autres partenaires commerciaux mondiaux. Il sert de point de contact principal des partenaires commerciaux pour les principaux intervenants fonctionnels et commerciaux en R-D.
• Type de rôle : Un intervenant individuel avec un poste de leadership de catégorie mondiale axé sur la vision stratégique, le développement de catégories, la construction de pipelines et la gestion des rapports écosystémiques
• Impact: Vous produisez un impact commercial en ancrage des coûts et en développant un pipeline de résilience de projets, en plus de garantir nos priorités de durabilité. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Stratégie et pipeline annuel : Rassembler les renseignements sur les marchés, les données sur les fournisseurs et les exigences opérationnelles afin de formuler un pipeline officiel de la Stratégie et de l'initiative de catégorie mondiale, qui sera aligné sur les dirigeants de l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Négociations commerciales : Mener des négociations commerciales et contractuelles de grande valeur pour les fournisseurs stratégiques de la catégorie.
• Écosystèmes fournisseurs : gérer les principaux fournisseurs mondiaux, établir des programmes de développement et d'innovation, surveiller les cibles de valeur et gérer les risques pour les fournisseurs.
• Orientation et contenu : Élaborer et tenir à jour des documents d'orientation de catégorie afin de traduire la stratégie en contenu clair et exécutable pour les collègues et les utilisateurs commerciaux.

In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

Therapeutic Modalities (TMo) organization, accountable for translating disease biology into high-quality drug candidates across small molecules, large molecules, oligonucleotides, and genomic medicines. By integrating deep modality expertise with cross-disciplinary collaboration, TMo drives innovation within and across platforms to enable differentiated, sustainable therapeutic impact.

We are CMC experts and build our strength on a broad diversity of technical expertise in chemistry, formulation design, material science, and analytical chemistry, delivering and innovating in the space of small molecules, peptides, and nucleic acid based medicines.

As Subject Matter Expert (SME) you will lead the identification of the optimal solid-state form, ensuring that early-stage candidates possess the necessary solubility and stability to succeed in the clinic. • End-to-End Ownership: Assume full responsibility for the lifecycle management of materials, from the initial integration of biopharmaceutical assessments to the final definition of robust crystallization processes.

• Cross-Functional Integration: Orchestrate the interface between Chemistry, Analytics, and Formulation teams to harmonize the material science narrative throughout the drug development lifecycle.

• Deep understanding of solid-state analytical techniques (e.g., XRD, DSC, TGA, DVS, Microscopy) and their application in a pharmaceutical development context.

• Proven ability to lead complex projects in a matrix environment, with the communication skills necessary to translate technical data into strategic decisions for non-expert stakeholders.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

Therapeutic Modalities (TMo) organization, accountable for translating disease biology into high-quality drug candidates across small molecules, large molecules, oligonucleotides, and genomic medicines. By integrating deep modality expertise with cross-disciplinary collaboration, TMo drives innovation within and across platforms to enable differentiated, sustainable therapeutic impact.

We are CMC experts and build our strength on a broad diversity of technical expertise in chemistry, formulation design, material science, and analytical chemistry, delivering and innovating in the space of small molecules, peptides, and nucleic acid based medicines.

As Subject Matter Expert (SME) you will lead the identification of the optimal solid-state form, ensuring that early-stage candidates possess the necessary solubility and stability to succeed in the clinic. You will serve as the central hub, coordinating complex screening and characterization activities across internal labs and global external partners. You will lead cross-functional efforts to de-risk drug candidates and define the "Golden Form" that carries our therapies from the lab to the patient.

The opportunity

• Scientific Leadership: Act as the single point of accountability for the solid-state strategy of assigned projects, ensuring the selection of optimal salt, polymorph, and particle forms to support both stability and bioavailability.

• End-to-End Ownership: Assume full responsibility for the lifecycle management of materials, from the initial integration of biopharmaceutical assessments to the final definition of robust crystallization processes.

• Cross-Functional Integration: Orchestrate the interface between Chemistry, Analytics, and Formulation teams to harmonize the material science narrative throughout the drug development lifecycle.

• Strategic Oversight: Spearhead the evaluation, technical vetting, and selection of global external CRO/CMO partners. You will orchestrate these collaborations, governing the seamless exchange of scientific methodologies while ensuring data generation meets our rigorous standards for quality and project milestones. You will manage the balance between internal technical services and external outsourcing partners, ensuring high-quality data generation and proactive risk mitigation.

• Innovation Driver: Champion the adoption of digitalization and automated screening tools to enhance data analysis throughput and accelerate project cycle times.

Who you are

• Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Material Science, or a related field, with a strong focus on solid-state characterization and crystallization.

• Deep understanding of solid-state analytical techniques (e.g., XRD, DSC, TGA, DVS, Microscopy) and their application in a pharmaceutical development context.

• Proven ability to lead complex projects in a matrix environment, with the communication skills necessary to translate technical data into strategic decisions for non-expert stakeholders.

• Experience managing external CRO/

The Opportunity

Enabling Formulation Mastery:

• Establish a high-impact technical network to maintain state-of-the-art oral enabling formulation technologies for delivery of complex synthetic modalities.

• Lead the technical profiling of NCEs and conduct rigorous Developability Assessments to identify and mitigate risks in molecular properties early in the pipeline

Internal Advisory Collaboration:

• You act as subject matter expert (SME) for internal pRED scientists, advising on formulation strategies for complex synthetic molecules and foster collaborative innovation across the organization.

Portfolio Execution & Excellence:

• Act as pCMC Drug Product lead within research project teams, guiding the end to end CMC scientific strategy until transfer to the Technical Development Department.

• Plan, coordinate and effectively communicate with research teams, function, stakeholders and governance boards.

• Master Modeling & Simulation and AI/ML tools to predict drug performance, optimize formulation selection, and bridge in vitro data to in vivo outcomes.

• Ensure scientific excellence and operational efficiency while meeting dynamic portfolio needs through effective internal and external supply strategies.

Who You Are

You possess a very strong background in Pharmaceutical Research and Development, Chemistry or related field. Ideally you have obtained a PhD in Pharmaceutical Technology and got at least 8 years of industry experience in Drug Discovery/Development, with at least 3-5 years specifically focused on Enabling Formulation Technologies for Oral Drug Delivery.

• A strong knowledge and experience in Enabling Formul

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme, creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. L'organizzazione di Modalities terapeutici (TMo), responsabile per la traduzione della biologia delle malattie in candidati di droga di alta qualità attraverso piccole molecole, molecole di grandi dimensioni, oligonucleotidi e medicine genomiche. Integrando una profonda esperienza di modalità con la collaborazione interdisciplinare, TMo guida l'innovazione all'interno e attraverso piattaforme per consentire un impatto terapeutico differenziato e sostenibile. Siamo esperti CMC e costruiamo la nostra forza su una vasta gamma di competenze tecniche in chimica, progettazione della formulazione, scienza materiale e chimica analitica, fornendo e innovando nello spazio di piccole molecole, peptidi e farmaci a base di acido nucleico. Come Soggetto Matter Expert (SME) in Oral Eable Formulation Technologies . Si tratta di un ruolo di leadership tecnica ad alto impatto focalizzato sul superamento delle sfide dei candidati alla droga scarsamente solubili o scarsamente permeabili. Potrai condurre la strategia, la progettazione e l'esecuzione di piattaforme di formulazione avanzate per guidare la nostra pipeline dalla scoperta attraverso la prova clinica di-concep L'opportunità Abilitare la Mastery di Formulazione:
• Stabilire una rete tecnica ad alto impatto per mantenere all'avanguardia tecnologie di formulazione per la fornitura di complesse modalità sintetiche.
• Progettare ed eseguire formulazioni specializzate (ad es. sistemi a base di lipidi come SMEDDS/SNEDDS, estrusione a spruzzo a dispersione solida amorfa, a caldo) per massimizzare l'esposizione in PK, PD e studi di sicurezza.
• Guidare l'avanzamento delle strategie di formulazione globale integrando nuove tecnologie di consegna per migliorare l'assorbimento e l'efficacia terapeutica
• Guidare la profilazione tecnica delle NCE e condurre rigorose valutazioni di sviluppo per identificare e mitigare i rischi nelle proprietà molecolari all'inizio della pipeline Collaborazione consultiva interna:
• Agisci come esperto di materia soggettiva (SME) per gli scienziati pRED interni, consigliando strategie di formulazione per molecole sintetiche complesse e favorendo l'innovazione collaborativa in tutta l'organizzazione. Portfolio Execution & Excellence:
• Agire come pCMC Drug Product lead all'interno di team di progetto di ricerca, guidando la fine alla fine della strategia scientifica CMC fino al trasferimento al dipartimento di sviluppo tecnico.
• Pianificare, coordinare e comunicare efficacemente con i team di ricerca, la funzione, gli stakeholder e i consigli di governance.
• Gli strumenti Master Modeling & Simulation e AI/ML per prevedere le prestazioni della droga, ottimizzare la selezione della formulazione e collegare i dati in vitro ai risultati in vivo.
• Assicurare l'eccellenza scientifica e l'efficienza operativa, soddisfando le esigenze del portafoglio dinamico attraverso efficaci strategie interne ed esterne di fornitura. Chi sei Possiedi uno sfondo molto forte in Ricerca e Sviluppo Farmaceutico, Chimica o campo relativo. Idealmente hai ottenuto un dottorato in tecnologia farmaceutica e hai avuto almeno 8 anni di esperienza nel settore della ricerca/sviluppo della droga, con almeno 3-5 anni specificamente focalizzati su Eable Formulation Technologies for Oral Drug Delivery.
• Una forte conoscenza ed esperienza nell'abilitare Formul

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That's what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing, resulting in a sample in, result out workflow.

Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows. We are seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to contribute to the mechanical design, development, characterization, and integration of cutting-edge sequencing systems.

This is a hands-on role focused on solving the mechanical challenges at the heart of our next-generation platforms. You will be responsible for concepting, designing, building, and testing novel electro-mechanical, pneumatic, thermal, and fluidic solutions that ensure the ultimate performance, reliability, and longevity of our systems.

The Senior Mechanical Engineer will play a vital role in driving innovation for our next-generation instrumentation. We are looking for someone that exhibits a high degree of motivation, independence, and resourcefulness to help us develop solutions to novel DNA Sequencing and automation challenges in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

The Opportunity

• You will design and develop sub-systems, including electro-mechanical, pneumatic, fluidic, thermal, and consumable components.

• You will collaborate with cross-functional teams (including electrical, consumables, and materials engineers) to define and manage critical technical interfaces for your module.

• You will have ownership of your sub-systems during verification, integration, and troubleshooting, working closely with Systems Integration engineers.

• You will conduct cross-functional design reviews to drive alignment and resolve technical trade-offs between mechanical design, materials, and assay requirements.

• You will drive technical execution for sub-systems, manage design deliverable timelines, and contribute to the overall project plan.

• You will create and maintain comprehensive design documentation for your sub-systems, including detailed CAD models, drawings, and specifications.

• You will present technical progress, data, and design trade-offs to the project team and stakeholders, clearly articulating the impact of engineering decisions.

Who You Are:
(Required )

• You have a Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering (or a closely related discipline), with 4+ years of relevant industry experience; or a Master's in Mechanical Engineering (or a closely related discipline), with 2+ years of relevant industry experience; or a PhD in in Mechanical Engineering (or a closely related discipline), with 1+ years of relevant industry experience.

• You have demonstrated, hands-on experience designing, developing, and testing complex electro-mechanical, pneumatic, thermal, or fluidic assemblies, preferably for life science o

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. E' questo che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. E' questo che ci rende Roche. A Roche, stiamo lavorando per rendere il sequenziamento di prossima generazione abbastanza semplice e accessibile per uso di routine. Accelerando la ricerca clinica, razionalizzando i flussi di lavoro e espandendo i menu di analisi, stiamo ampliando l'accesso ai dati genomici e abbassando le barriere all'adozione. Dai robusti strumenti di isolamento e preparazione dei campioni alle nuove tecnologie di sequenziamento e alla bioinformatica avanzata, stiamo sviluppando soluzioni end-to-end differenziate e altamente integrate per la sequenziamento di nuova generazione, con un risultato di campionamento, risultato fuori flusso di lavoro. Il nostro System Technology Group, parte di Roche Sequencing Solutions, si concentra sulla creazione e l'avanzamento di tecnologie per migliorare in modo significativo i flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento del DNA. Stiamo cercando un ingegnere meccanico senior per contribuire alla progettazione meccanica, sviluppo, caratterizzazione e integrazione di sistemi di sequenziamento all'avanguardia. Questo è un ruolo pratico focalizzato sulla soluzione delle sfide meccaniche al centro delle nostre piattaforme di prossima generazione. Sarete responsabili di concettualizzare, progettare, costruire e testare nuove soluzioni elettromeccaniche, pneumatiche, termiche e fluidiche che garantiscono la massima performance, affidabilità e longevità dei nostri sistemi. L'Ingegnere Meccanico Senior svolgerà un ruolo vitale nella guida dell'innovazione per la nostra strumentazione di nuova generazione. Stiamo cercando qualcuno che esibisce un alto grado di motivazione, indipendenza e risorse per aiutarci a sviluppare soluzioni per nuove sfide di DNA Sequencing e automazione in un ambiente veloce e collaborativo. L'opportunità
• Progettare e sviluppare sottosistemi, inclusi componenti elettromeccanici, pneumatici, fluidici, termici e di consumo.
• Collaborerai con team interfunzionali (compresi ingegneri elettrici, materiali e materiali) per definire e gestire interfacce tecniche critiche per il tuo modulo.
• Avrete la proprietà dei vostri sottosistemi durante la verifica, l'integrazione e la risoluzione dei problemi, lavorando a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri di integrazione dei sistemi.
• Condurrai recensioni di progettazione interfunzionali per guidare l'allineamento e risolvere i trade-off tecnici tra progettazione meccanica, materiali e requisiti di analisi.
• Potrai guidare l'esecuzione tecnica per i sottosistemi, gestire le linee temporali consegnabili di progettazione e contribuire al piano di progetto complessivo.
• Potrai creare e mantenere una documentazione completa di progettazione per i tuoi sottosistemi, compresi modelli CAD dettagliati, disegni e specifiche.
• Verrà presentato il progresso tecnico, i dati e i trade-off di progettazione al team di progetto e agli stakeholder, chiaramente articolando l'impatto delle decisioni di ingegneria. Chi sei? (richiesto)
• Hai una laurea in ingegneria meccanica (o una disciplina strettamente correlata), con 4+ anni di esperienza industriale rilevante; o un Master in ingegneria meccanica (o una disciplina strettamente correlata), con 2+ anni di esperienza nel settore rilevante; o un dottorato in ingegneria meccanica (o una disciplina strettamente correlata), con 1+ anni di esperienza nel settore.
• Hai dimostrato, esperienza pratica progettare, sviluppare e testare complessi assemblaggi elettromeccanici, pneumatici, termici o fluidici, preferibilmente per la scienza della vita o

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns zu Innovationen antreibt. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Bei Roche arbeiten wir daran, die Sequenzierung der nächsten Generation einfach und für den routinemäßigen Einsatz zugänglich zu machen. Durch die Beschleunigung der klinischen Forschung, die Rationalisierung von Workflows und die Erweiterung der Assay-Menüs erweitern wir den Zugang zu genomischen Daten und senken die Akzeptanzbarrieren. Von robusten Werkzeugen für die Probenisolierung und -vorbereitung bis hin zu neuartigen Sequenzierungstechnologien und fortschrittlicher Bioinformatik entwickeln wir differenzierte, hochintegrierte End-to-End-Lösungen für die Sequenzierung der nächsten Generation, die zu einem Workflow für die Probeneingabe führen. Unsere Systems Technology Group, ein Teil von Roche Sequencing Solutions, konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Technologien, um DNA-Sequenzierungs-Workflows deutlich zu verbessern. Wir suchen einen Senior Mechanical Engineer, der zur mechanischen Konstruktion, Entwicklung, Charakterisierung und Integration von hochmodernen Sequenzierungssystemen beiträgt. Dies ist eine praktische Rolle, die sich auf die Lösung der mechanischen Herausforderungen im Herzen unserer Plattformen der nächsten Generation konzentriert. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, neuartige elektromechanische, pneumatische, thermische und fluidische Lösungen zu entwerfen, zu entwerfen, zu bauen und zu testen, die die ultimative Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Langlebigkeit unserer Systeme gewährleisten. Der Senior Mechanical Engineer wird eine wichtige Rolle dabei spielen, Innovationen für unsere Instrumente der nächsten Generation voranzutreiben. Wir suchen jemanden, der ein hohes Maß an Motivation, Unabhängigkeit und Einfallsreichtum zeigt, um Lösungen für neuartige DNA-Sequenzierungs- und Automatisierungsherausforderungen in einer schnelllebigen und kollaborativen Umgebung zu entwickeln. Die Chance
• Sie entwerfen und entwickeln Subsysteme, einschließlich elektromechanischer, pneumatischer, fluidischer, thermischer und Verbrauchskomponenten.
• Sie arbeiten mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams (einschließlich Elektro-, Verbrauchs- und Materialingenieuren) zusammen, um kritische technische Schnittstellen für Ihr Modul zu definieren und zu verwalten.
• Sie haben das Eigentum an Ihren Subsystemen während der Verifizierung, Integration und Fehlerbehebung und arbeiten eng mit Systemintegrationsingenieuren zusammen.
• Sie führen funktionsübergreifende Designüberprüfungen durch, um die Ausrichtung zu fördern und technische Kompromisse zwischen mechanischem Design, Materialien und Assayanforderungen zu lösen.
• Sie steuern die technische Ausführung für Subsysteme, verwalten die Lieferzeiten und tragen zum Gesamtprojektplan bei.
• Sie erstellen und pflegen eine umfassende Entwurfsdokumentation für Ihre Subsysteme, einschließlich detaillierter CAD-Modelle, Zeichnungen und Spezifikationen.
• Sie werden dem Projektteam und den Stakeholdern technischen Fortschritt, Daten und Design-Kompromisse präsentieren und die Auswirkungen von technischen Entscheidungen klar artikulieren. Wer Du bist: (erforderlich)
• Sie haben einen Bachelor in Maschinenbau (oder einer eng verwandten Disziplin), mit 4+ Jahren einschlägiger Branchenerfahrung; oder einen Master in Maschinenbau (oder einer eng verwandten Disziplin), mit 2+ Jahren einschlägiger Branchenerfahrung; oder einen PhD in Maschinenbau (oder einer eng verwandten Disziplin), mit 1+ Jahren einschlägiger Branchenerfahrung.
• Sie haben praktische Erfahrung beim Entwerfen, Entwickeln und Testen komplexer elektromechanischer, pneumatischer, thermischer oder fluidischer Baugruppen gezeigt, vorzugsweise für die Biowissenschaften.

The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of Roche organization, directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organization, faster. The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

Your Opportunity
The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) acts as a trusted partner and key point of contact for stakeholders involved in the Oncology patient journey across Sumatera. As the local face of Roche, the PJP works closely with healthcare professionals, healthcare institutions, and cross-functional Roche teams to better understand patient and healthcare system needs and improve patient outcomes.

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Patient Journey Partner (PJP) steht im Zentrum der Roche-Organisation und ist direkt dafür verantwortlich, Patienten, ihrer Gemeinschaft, dem Ökosystem und der Organisation schneller bessere Ergebnisse zu liefern. Die PJP ist eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit und das lokale Gesicht von Roche. Sie arbeitet eng mit allen Interessengruppen zusammen, die die Patientenreise (in einem bestimmten Therapie- oder Krankheitsbereich) direkt berühren, um ein tiefes Verständnis ihrer Bedürfnisse zu erlangen, um die Fähigkeiten von Roche zu verbinden und sinnvolle Lösungen zu entwickeln. Ihre Chance Der Patient Journey Partner (PJP) fungiert als vertrauenswürdiger Partner und wichtiger Ansprechpartner für Interessengruppen, die an der Oncology-Patientenreise in Sumatera beteiligt sind. Als lokales Gesicht von Roche arbeitet die PJP eng mit Gesundheitsexperten, Gesundheitseinrichtungen und funktionsübergreifenden Roche-Teams zusammen, um die Bedürfnisse von Patienten und Gesundheitssystemen besser zu verstehen und die Patientenergebnisse zu verbessern. • Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Roche-Teams zusammen, um Lösungen zu identifizieren, zu entwickeln und zu implementieren, die einen sinnvollen Mehrwert für Patienten, Interessengruppen und die breitere Gesundheitsgemeinschaft schaffen.
• Unterstützung der angemessenen und konformen Nutzung von Roche-Produkten durch den Austausch wissenschaftlicher und Produktinformationen in einer wahrheitsgetreuen, ausgewogenen und patientenorientierten Weise

Sie bringen eine kollaborative Denkweise, starke Stakeholder-Engagement-Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen und sich entwickelnden Gesundheitsumfeld zu navigieren. Sie bringen:

• Erfahrung im Stakeholder-Engagement in der Gesundheits-, Pharma- oder verwandten Industrie mit der Fähigkeit, vertrauenswürdige langfristige Partnerschaften aufzubauen
• Gutes Verständnis des indonesischen Gesundheitssystems und des breiteren Gesundheitsökosystems
• Kenntnisse der pharmazeutischen Industrie Vorschriften, ethischen Standards und Compliance-Anforderungen in Indonesien
• Verständnis von Patientenreisen, Behandlungswegen und Stakeholder-Dynamik im Onkologie-Bereich
• Starke Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv über mehrere Stakeholder und Funktionen zu arbeiten
• Strategisches Denken, Lernagilität und Interesse an Innovation und Gesundheitstransformation zur Verbesserung der Patientenergebnisse Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft und stellen sicher, dass heute jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat.

• Identifier les possibilités de collaboration qui aident à surmonter les obstacles au sein du système de santé et à améliorer les résultats et les expériences des patients
• Coordonner et mobiliser l'expertise, les ressources et le soutien internes appropriés pour répondre efficacement aux besoins des intervenants tout en assurant une expérience positive auprès des personnes, des produits et des services Roches Qui vous êtes Vous êtes passionné par l'amélioration des résultats des patients et l'établissement de partenariats significatifs dans l'ensemble de l'écosystème de santé. Vous apportez un état d'esprit collaboratif, de solides capacités d'engagement des intervenants et la capacité de naviguer dans un environnement de santé dynamique et en évolution. Vous apportez :
• Un diplôme universitaire en sciences de la vie, santé, affaires, économie, ou un domaine connexe; un diplôme avancé comme un MBA est un plus
• Expérience de l'engagement des intervenants au sein de l'industrie des soins de santé, des produits pharmaceutiques ou de l'industrie connexe, avec la capacité d'établir des partenariats de confiance à long terme
• Bonne compréhension du système de santé indonésien et de l'écosystème de soins de santé au sens large
• Connaissance des règlements de l'industrie pharmaceutique, des normes éthiques et des exigences de conformité en Indonésie
• Compréhension des parcours des patients, des voies de traitement et de la dynamique des intervenants dans la zone Oncologie
• Fortes compétences en communication et en collaboration, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement entre plusieurs intervenants et fonctions
• Pensée stratégique, agilité d'apprentissage et intérêt pour l'innovation et la transformation des soins de santé pour aider à améliorer les résultats des patients Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are
passionate about transforming patients’ lives and we are brave in both decision and action. And we believe that good business
means a better world.

Join Our Team: Make a Difference in International Regulatory Affairs!

Roche is seeking a dynamic and highly motivated individual to join our team as an International Regulatory Affairs
Professional. We are looking for candidates who bring an innovative and creative mindset to the table, along with a proven
track record in the Regulatory Affairs field. If you are passionate about making a positive impact on global healthcare through
regulatory excellence, we invite you to be part of our dedicated team.

Key Responsibilities

As an International Regulatory Affairs Professional at Roche, you will be responsible for:

• Leading and supporting regulatory strategies for global IVD/MD instruments and software submissions

• Ensuring compliance with international regulatory requirements and standards

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Quality, and Clinical, to drive regulatory initiatives

• Providing regulatory guidance to support product development and lifecycle management

• Staying abreast of evolving regulatory trends and up‐ dates, and implementing best practices

Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, or a related field

• 5 to 7 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs ( Regulatory, R&D, Quality and/or Clinical), with some experience in healthcare regulatory affairs

• In-depth knowledge of global regulatory requirements, guidelines, and procedures especially for IVD instruments & software

• Strong organizational and communication skills

• Ability to multitask and effectively manage multiple projects simultaneously

• Self-motivated and capable of working independently in a self-management environment

• Experience in IVD instrument and/or software development

Why Roche

• Collaborative and innovative work environment

• Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patients' lives globally

• Competitive compensation and benefits package

• Professional development and growth opportunities within a leading global healthcare organization

If you are a dedicated professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about contributing to the
International Regulatory Affairs landscape, we want to hear from you! Submit your resume and cover letter detailing your
relevant experience and qualifications.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.fr: Expert en biomarqueurs d'hématologie et de sécurité

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position is located in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, a department within the Pharmaceutical Sciences function. We drive the non-clinical safety assessment of drug candidates from small molecules to complex biological products during the discovery and development phases at Roche.

The Opportunity

As an engaged Pathology and Applied Safety Science Hematology & Safety Biomarker Expert, you will play a pivotal role in the development, validation, and implementation of assays for translational safety assessment. Your primary responsibility will be to propose, conduct and report relevant assays to understand mechanisms of toxicity, leveraging modern tools to maximise scientific insights, drive innovation, and advance our therapeutic pipeline in a highly collaborative environment.

• Strategic Biomarker Integration & Translational Safety: Collaborate with experts to develop and execute integrated in vitro and in vivo hematology and safety biomarker strategies, provide subject matter expertise for clinical candidate selection, and deliver comprehensive safety risk assessments for regulatory documentation (e.g., IND/CTA).

• Multi-Disciplinary Laboratory Expertise: Allocate approximately 50% of working time to wet-lab work, focusing on the development and implementation of tailored in vitro and ex vivo hematology and fluid-based safety biomarker assays, as well as generating and compiling clinical pathology data (hematology, coagulation, clinical chemistry, urinalysis) for the responsible pathologist.

• Digitisation, Image Analysis, and Automation: Partner with Digital Pathology and modelling experts to develop screening assays, utilise digital and data curation platforms (e.g., LIMS, SLIMS, Arvados) to ensure streamlined data transfer and harmonised datasets, and optimise workflow integration to maximise operational efficiency.

• Vendor Management, Quality, & Compliance Outsourcing & CRO Coordination: Manage external partnerships and drive the outsourcing of relevant assays to contract research laboratories (CROs), ensuring strict adherence to timelines and data quality standards.

• Safety Standards: Maintain strict compliance with Safety, Health, and Environmental (SHE) regulations, actively fostering a culture of safe and res

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti innovazione straordinaria e mutevole a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. Questa posizione si trova in Patologia e Scienze della Sicurezza Applicata, un dipartimento all'interno della funzione Scienze Farmaceutiche. Noi guidiamo la valutazione di sicurezza non ciclica dei candidati alla droga da piccole molecole a prodotti biologici complessi durante le fasi di scoperta e sviluppo a Roche. L'opportunità Come esperto di patologia e scienza della sicurezza applicata ematologia & sicurezza Biomarker, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nello sviluppo, nella convalida e nell'implementazione di saggi per la valutazione della sicurezza traduttiva. La vostra responsabilità primaria sarà quella di proporre, condurre e segnalare saggi rilevanti per comprendere meccanismi di tossicità, sfruttando strumenti moderni per massimizzare le intuizioni scientifiche, guidare l'innovazione, e avanzare il nostro pipeline terapeutico in un ambiente altamente collaborativo.
• Strategic Biomarker Integration & Translational Safety: Collabora con gli esperti per sviluppare ed eseguire strategie integrate in vitro e in vivo di ematologia e biomarcazione, fornire competenze in materia per la selezione dei candidati clinici, e fornire valutazioni complete di rischio di sicurezza per la documentazione normativa (ad esempio, IND/CTA).
• Multi-Disciplinary Laboratory Expertise: Legare circa il 50% del tempo di lavoro al lavoro a lastra bagnata, concentrandosi sullo sviluppo e l'implementazione di ematologia su misura in vitro ed ex vivo e saggi biomarcatori di sicurezza basati sui fluidi, oltre a generare e compilare dati di patologia clinica (ematologia, coagulazione, chimica clinica, analisi urinaria) per il patologo responsabile.
• Digitisation, Image Analysis, and Automation: Partner con la Patologia Digitale e gli esperti di modellazione per lo sviluppo di saggi di screening, l'utilizzo di piattaforme digitali e di cura dei dati (ad esempio, LIMS, SLIMS, Arvados) per garantire il trasferimento e l'armonizzazione dei dati, e ottimizzare l'integrazione del flusso di lavoro per massimizzare l'efficienza operativa.
• Gestione del Fornitore, Qualità, & Compliance Outsourcing & CRO Coordinamento: Gestire partnership esterne e guidare l'outsourcing di saggi rilevanti ai laboratori di ricerca di contratto (CRO), garantendo una rigorosa adesione alle linee temporali e agli standard di qualità dei dati.
• Norme di sicurezza: Mantenere il rigoroso rispetto delle normative sulla sicurezza, la salute e l'ambiente (SHE), promuovendo attivamente una cultura di sicurezza e res

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position is located in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, a department within the Pharmaceutical Sciences function. We drive the non-clinical safety assessment of drug candidates from small molecules to complex biological products during the discovery and development phases at Roche.

The Opportunity

As an engaged Digital Pathologist, you will play a pivotal role in the development, validation, and implementation of pathology investigations and the application of computational pathology approaches for translational safety assessment. Your primary responsibility will be to propose, conduct, and report computational toxicologic pathology approaches to understand mechanisms of toxicity, leveraging modern tools to maximise scientific insights, drive innovation, and advance our therapeutic pipeline. You will support the automation of pathology algorithms, workflows, and platforms, remaining accountable for the scientific delivery of pathology data to inform risk assessment across projects ranging from small molecules to complex biological products.

• Core Portfolio Toxicologic Pathology : Provide expert pathology support in preclinical development, aligning toxicity study designs with current science and regulatory guidelines. Conduct qualitative and quantitative (histo)pathologic evaluations for discovery and development toxicology studies, including GLP-compliant studies. Peer-review histopathologic data and interpretations from internal or CRO pathologists per established SOPs. Integrate clinical pathology data (haematology, clinical chemistry) with histopathology findings for a holistic, mechanistic interpretation of toxicity. Deliver clear, concise test result interpretations and author pathology sections for Research Reports, regulatory filings (e.g., IND/CTA), and governance presentations.

• Algorithm Architecture & Image Analysis Deployment : Propose, build, test, and implement custom image analysis solutions and algorithms to automate cell and biomarker quantification on scanned tissue. Oversee the integration of ML and non-ML software to detect, segment, and score complex tissue morphologies. Extract high-dimensional spatial features and quantitative metrics from multiplexed or standard IHC and ISH slides. Transform comp

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti innovazione straordinaria e mutevole a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. Questa posizione si trova in Patologia e Scienze della Sicurezza Applicata, un dipartimento all'interno della funzione Scienze Farmaceutiche. Noi guidiamo la valutazione di sicurezza non ciclica dei candidati alla droga da piccole molecole a prodotti biologici complessi durante le fasi di scoperta e sviluppo a Roche. L'opportunità Come un Patologo Digitale impegnato, si svolgerà un ruolo cardine nello sviluppo, nella convalida e nell'implementazione di indagini patologiche e nell'applicazione di approcci di patologia computazionale per la valutazione della sicurezza traduttiva. La vostra responsabilità primaria sarà quella di proporre, condurre e riferire approcci di patologia tossicologica computazionale per comprendere meccanismi di tossicità, sfruttando strumenti moderni per massimizzare le intuizioni scientifiche, guidare l'innovazione e avanzare la nostra pipeline terapeutica. Sosterrete l'automazione di algoritmi di patologia, flussi di lavoro e piattaforme, rimanendo responsabili per la consegna scientifica dei dati di patologia per informare la valutazione del rischio attraverso progetti che vanno da piccole molecole a prodotti biologici complessi.
• Patologia Tossicologica Core Portfolio: Fornire un supporto di patologia esperto nello sviluppo preclinico, allineare i progetti di studio tossicologico con le attuali linee guida scientifiche e regolamentari. Condurre valutazioni qualitative e quantitative (sito)patologiche per la scoperta e lo sviluppo di studi tossicologici, compresi gli studi conformi al GLP. Peer-review dati e interpretazioni istopatologiche dai patologi interni o CRO per i SOP consolidati. Integra i dati di patologia clinica (ematologia, chimica clinica) con i risultati di istopatologia per un'interpretazione olistica e meccanistica della tossicità. Fornire chiare e concise interpretazioni dei risultati dei test e sezioni di patologia dell'autore per i Rapporti di ricerca, i documenti normativi (ad esempio, IND/CTA) e le presentazioni di governance.
• Deployment: Proporre, costruire, testare e implementare soluzioni e algoritmi di analisi delle immagini personalizzate per automatizzare la quantificazione delle celle e dei biomarcatori sui tessuti scansionati. Controllare l'integrazione di software ML e non-ML per rilevare, segmentare e segnare morfologie di tessuto complesse. Estrarre caratteristiche spaziali altamente dimensionali e metriche quantitative da multisala o standard IHC e ISH diapositive. Trasformazione comp

Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen. Wir fördern die nichtklinische Sicherheitsbewertung von Wirkstoffkandidaten von kleinen Molekülen bis hin zu komplexen biologischen Produkten während der Entdeckungs- und Entwicklungsphase bei Roche. IND / CTA) und Governance-Präsentationen.

Beaufsichtigen Sie die Integration von ML- und Nicht-ML-Software, um komplexe Gewebemorphologien zu erkennen, zu segmentieren und zu bewerten. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. Ce poste est situé à Pathology and Applied Safety Science, un département de la fonction Sciences pharmaceutiques. Nous conduisons l'évaluation non clinique de l'innocuité des médicaments candidats à partir de petites molécules à des produits biologiques complexes pendant les phases de découverte et de développement à Roche. L'opportunité En tant que pathologiste numérique engagé, vous jouerez un rôle central dans le développement, la validation et la mise en oeuvre des enquêtes de pathologie et l'application des approches de pathologie computationnelle pour l'évaluation de la sécurité translationnelle. Votre responsabilité principale sera de proposer, de conduire et de rapporter des approches toxicologiques computationnelles pour comprendre les mécanismes de toxicité, en tirant parti des outils modernes pour maximiser les connaissances scientifiques, stimuler l'innovation et faire progresser notre pipeline thérapeutique. Vous soutiendrez l'automatisation des algorithmes de pathologie, des workflows et des plates-formes, en restant responsable de la livraison scientifique des données de pathologie pour éclairer l'évaluation des risques à travers des projets allant de petites molécules à des produits biologiques complexes.
• Portfolio de base Pathologie toxicologique : Fournir un soutien en pathologie experte dans le développement préclinique, en alignant les modèles d'études de toxicité avec les lignes directrices scientifiques et réglementaires actuelles. Effectuer des évaluations (histo)pathologiques qualitatives et quantitatives pour des études toxicologiques de découverte et de développement, y compris des études conformes aux BPL. Examen par les pairs des données histopathologiques et des interprétations des pathologistes internes ou du CRO selon les SOP établies. Intégrer les données de pathologie clinique (hématologie, chimie clinique) avec les résultats de l'histopathologie pour une interprétation globale et mécaniste de la toxicité. Fournir des interprétations des résultats d'essais claires et concises et des sections sur la pathologie des auteurs pour les rapports de recherche, les dépôts réglementaires (p. ex., l'IND/LTC) et les présentations sur la gouvernance.
• Algorithm Architecture & Image Analysis Déploiement : Proposez, construisez, testez et implémentez des solutions d'analyse d'images personnalisées et des algorithmes pour automatiser la quantification des cellules et des biomarqueurs sur les tissus numérisés. Superviser l'intégration des logiciels ML et non-ML pour détecter, segmenter et marquer des morphologies tissulaires complexes. Extraire des caractéristiques spatiales haute dimension et des mesures quantitatives des diapositives IHC et ISH standard ou multiplexées. Transformer comp
