jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position sits within the Clinical Pharmacology Section in the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology Department in pRED / Pharmaceutical Sciences, but maintains a company-wide footprint. The scope of influence transcends individual teams, regularly partnering across major organisational boundaries and cross-entities (e.g., pRED, gRED, PDR) to shape institutional knowledge.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will serve as a senior enterprise leader and expert in Clinical Pharmacology, including Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) and Quantitative Medicine, solving high-risk development challenges and embedding advanced computational capabilities to accelerate the R&D pipeline. Operating on a senior strategic and scientific track, you will hold high accountability for shaping long-term scientific and development strategies and capital allocation for entire disease areas or global functions. Additionally, you will drive high-stakes corporate due diligence for licensing opportunities, lead complex global health authority negotiations, and act as a strategic mentor across the wider organisation.

• High-Impact Strategic and Scientific Leadership : Formulate and evolve overarching Clinical Pharmacology and MIDD strategies for high-profile molecules or portfolio segments (e.g. Antibody-Drug-Conjugates) of Roche's focus disease areas (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology), ensuring alignment with end-to-end development goals.

• Pioneering Technical Innovation : Identify, develop, and integrate state-of-the-art computational methodologies into workflows, stimulating the broader scientific community to experiment and challenge development paradigms.

• Complex Submissions & Regulatory Defence : Provide authoritative guidance on highly complex or unprecedented submission strategies (e.g., pediatric extrapolations, novel modalities) and serve as a primary counter-partner to health authorities and KOLs.

• Strategic Business Development : Lead Clinical Pharmacology and modelling evaluations and actively contribute to the development of Clinical Development Plans for high-stakes due diligence, in-licensing, and out-licensing opportunities to assess the path to value as well as the technical viability and risks of external

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti innovazione straordinaria e mutevole a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. Questa posizione si trova all'interno della Sezione Farmacologia Clinica nel Dipartimento di Farmacologia Clinica Quantitativa in Scienze pRED / Farmaceutiche, ma mantiene un'impronta aziendale. La portata dell'influenza trascende i singoli team, collaborando regolarmente tra i principali confini organizzativi e le intersezioni (ad esempio, pRED, gRED, PDR) per plasmare le conoscenze istituzionali. L'opportunità In questo ruolo, si servirà come leader di impresa senior e esperto in Farmacologia Clinica, tra cui Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) e Quantitative Medicine, risolvendo sfide di sviluppo ad alto rischio e incorporando capacità computazionali avanzate per accelerare la pipeline R&D. Operando su una traccia strategica e scientifica senior, si terrà alta responsabilitÃ per la definizione di strategie scientifiche e di sviluppo a lungo termine e allocazione di capitale per intere aree di malattia o funzioni globali. Inoltre, guiderai le due diligence aziendali ad alto livello per le opportunità di licenza, guiderai negoziazioni di autorità sanitarie globali complesse e agirai come mentore strategico in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Leadership strategica e scientifica di alto impatto: formulare ed evolvere le strategie cliniche di farmacologia e MIDD per le molecole di alto profilo o segmenti di portafoglio (ad esempio Antibody-Drug-Conjugates) delle aree di malattia di punta di Roche (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology e Ophthalmology), garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi di sviluppo end-to-end.
• Identificare, sviluppare e integrare metodologie computazionali all'avanguardia nei flussi di lavoro, stimolando la più ampia comunità scientifica a sperimentare e sfidare i paradigmi dello sviluppo.
• Submissions & Regulatory Defence: Fornire una guida autorevole su strategie di presentazione altamente complesse o senza precedenti (ad esempio, estrapolazioni pediatriche, nuove modalità) e servire come contro-partner primario alle autorità sanitarie e KOL.
• Sviluppo Strategico delle Imprese: Lead Clinical Pharmacology and modelling assessments e contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo di Piani di Sviluppo Clinico per un elevato fabbisogno di diligenza, in-licenziamento e opportunità per la valutazione del percorso di valore, nonché la fattibilità tecnica e i rischi di esterna

Bei pRED verbindet uns unsere Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen. An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft und Innovation ermöglicht die pRED-Organisation Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Therapeutika in optimalen Dosen in relevanten Populationen mit einer Vision für die Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Beschleunigung der Entwicklung von Medikamenten von morgen. Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen. Diese Position liegt in der Sektion Klinische Pharmakologie in der Abteilung Quantitative Klinische Pharmakologie in pRED / Pharmazeutische Wissenschaften, unterhält aber einen unternehmensweiten Fußabdruck. Der Einflussbereich geht über einzelne Teams hinaus und arbeitet regelmäßig über große organisatorische Grenzen und übergreifende Einheiten (z. B. pRED, gRED, PDR) hinweg zusammen, um institutionelles Wissen zu gestalten. Die Chance In dieser Rolle werden Sie als leitender Unternehmensleiter und Experte für klinische Pharmakologie tätig sein, einschließlich Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) und Quantitative Medicine, um risikoreiche Entwicklungsherausforderungen zu lösen und fortschrittliche Rechenfunktionen einzubetten, um die F & E-Pipeline zu beschleunigen. Mit einem hochrangigen strategischen und wissenschaftlichen Kurs haben Sie eine hohe Verantwortung für die Gestaltung langfristiger wissenschaftlicher und Entwicklungsstrategien und die Kapitalzuweisung für ganze Krankheitsbereiche oder globale Funktionen. Darüber hinaus werden Sie die Corporate Due Diligence mit hohem Einsatz für Lizenzierungsmöglichkeiten vorantreiben, komplexe globale Verhandlungen der Gesundheitsbehörden leiten und als strategischer Mentor in der gesamten Organisation fungieren.
• Strategische und wissenschaftliche Führungsrolle mit hohem Einfluss: Formulierung und Entwicklung übergreifender klinischer Pharmakologie- und MIDD-Strategien für hochkarätige Moleküle oder Portfoliosegmente (z. B. Antikörper-Wirkstoff-Konjugate) der Roche-Fokus-Krankheitsbereiche (CVRM, Immunologie, Neurowissenschaften, Onkologie und Ophthalmologie), um die Ausrichtung auf die End-to-End-Entwicklungsziele sicherzustellen.
• Pionierhafte technische Innovation: Identifizieren, entwickeln und integrieren Sie modernste Computermethoden in Workflows, um die breitere wissenschaftliche Gemeinschaft zu ermutigen, Entwicklungsparadigmen zu experimentieren und herauszufordern.
• Komplexe Einreichungen und regulatorische Verteidigung: Geben Sie maßgebliche Leitlinien für hochkomplexe oder beispiellose Einreichungsstrategien (z. B. pädiatrische Extrapolationen, neuartige Modalitäten) und dienen Sie als primärer Gegenpartner für Gesundheitsbehörden und KOLs.
• Strategische Geschäftsentwicklung: Führen Sie klinische Pharmakologie- und Modellbewertungen und tragen Sie aktiv zur Entwicklung klinischer Entwicklungspläne für High-Stakes-Due-Diligence-, In-Licensing- und Out-Licensing-Möglichkeiten bei, um den Weg zum Wert sowie die technische Lebensfähigkeit und die Risiken externer Unternehmen zu bewerten

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. Ce poste fait partie de la Section de pharmacologie clinique du Département de pharmacologie clinique quantitative en sciences pRED / Pharmaceutiques, mais conserve une empreinte à l'échelle de l'entreprise. L'étendue de l'influence transcende les équipes individuelles, s'associant régulièrement entre les grandes frontières organisationnelles et les entités (p. ex., pRED, gRED, PDR) pour façonner les connaissances institutionnelles. L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez le rôle de chef d'entreprise principal et d'expert en pharmacologie clinique, y compris le développement de médicaments en connaissance de cause (PDIM) et la médecine quantitative, en résolvant les défis de développement à risque élevé et en intégrant des capacités informatiques avancées pour accélérer le pipeline de R-D. Dans le cadre d'une démarche stratégique et scientifique de haut niveau, vous serez fortement responsable de l'élaboration de stratégies scientifiques et de développement à long terme et de l'affectation des capitaux pour l'ensemble des domaines de maladie ou des fonctions mondiales. De plus, vous dirigerez une diligence raisonnable de l'entreprise pour les possibilités d'octroi de licences, dirigerez des négociations complexes sur les autorités sanitaires mondiales et agirez comme un mentor stratégique dans toute l'organisation.
• Leadership stratégique et scientifique à haut impact : Formuler et développer des stratégies globales de pharmacologie clinique et de MIDD pour les molécules ou les segments de portefeuille à haut rayonnement (p. ex. anticorps-drogue-conjugués) des domaines d'intervention de Roche (CVRM, immunologie, neuroscience, oncologie et ophtalmologie), en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs de développement de bout en bout.
• Innovation technique pionnière : Identifier, développer et intégrer des méthodologies informatiques de pointe dans les flux de travail, en stimulant la communauté scientifique à expérimenter et à défier les paradigmes de développement.
• Soumissions complexes et défense réglementaire : Fournir des lignes directrices faisant autorité sur les stratégies de présentation très complexes ou sans précédent (p. ex. extrapolations pédiatriques, nouvelles modalités) et servir de principal contre-partenaire aux autorités de la santé et aux KOL.
• Développement stratégique des affaires : Diriger les évaluations de la pharmacologie clinique et de la modélisation et contribuer activement à l'élaboration de plans de développement clinique pour la diligence raisonnable élevée, l'octroi de licences et les possibilités de sous-licence pour évaluer la voie de la valeur ainsi que la viabilité technique et les risques de l'extérieur

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Within Pharma Research & Early Development (pRED), our Ophthalmology teams are redefining how precision medicine can transform the detection and treatment of complex retinal diseases. This is a rare opportunity to build a new function from the ground up — establishing an Ophthalmology Precision Medicine group at our Welwyn site that brings together biomarker science, advanced imaging, clinical expertise, and artificial intelligence. You will have the platform, pipeline, and resources to shape something truly new in one of the most dynamic areas of ophthalmic research.
The Opportunity

• Build a new Ophthalmology Precision Medicine function from the ground up — defining the vision, structure, and scientific direction for a group that integrates biomarkers, advanced imaging, clinical science, and AI across the pRED Ophthalmology portfolio.

• Lead a cross-functional expert team spanning translational medicine, imaging, clinical development, data science, and biomarker disciplines — ensuring precision medicine is at the heart of our Ophthalmology strategy.

• Bridge laboratory science and clinical practice by steering the generation of robust fluid- and imaging biomarker strategies that enable project and disease area decisions.

• Advance innovation in imaging science by directing cutting-edge ophthalmic imaging approaches including OCT, OCT-A, and FA to inform future clinical practice and therapeutic development.

• Enable translational insights through AI and data by integrating preclinical and clinical datasets using classical and next-generation analytical approaches.

• Influence portfolio strategy across multiple retinal diseases including neovascular AMD, diabetic macular edema, geographic atrophy, and intermediate AMD — driving the direction and future of clinical development and research.

• Represent Roche externally through strong partnerships with scientific experts, investigators, and the broader ophthalmology community — remaining at the forefront of innovation.

Who you are

• You are a board-certified ophthalmologist (MD or MD/PhD) with deep expertise in ophthalmology, translational medicine, or biomedical sciences.

• You are a recognised expert in the retina space, with a strong scientific publication record and standing as a key opinion leader in your field.

• You have deep knowledge of ophthalmic imaging technologies (OCT, OCT-A, FA) and experience with imaging analysis or Reading Centre environments.

• You are experienced in integrating preclinical and clinical data to support proof of biology, efficacy, and safety strategies, with some exposure to clinical trials.

• You are a collaborative scientific leader who thrives in matrix environments, energised by innovation and the opportunity to build something new.

Preferred

• Experience applying AI or machine learning to ophthalmic imaging analysis or clinical data interpretation.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Within Pharma Research & Early Development (pRED), our Ophthalmology teams are redefining how precision medicine can transform the detection and treatment of complex retinal diseases. This is a rare opportunity to build a new function from the ground up — establishing an Ophthalmology Precision Medicine group at our Welwyn site that brings together biomarker science, advanced imaging, clinical expertise, and artificial intelligence. You will have the platform, pipeline, and resources to shape something truly new in one of the most dynamic areas of ophthalmic research.
The Opportunity

• Build a new Ophthalmology Precision Medicine function from the ground up — defining the vision, structure, and scientific direction for a group that integrates biomarkers, advanced imaging, clinical science, and AI across the pRED Ophthalmology portfolio.

• Lead a cross-functional expert team spanning translational medicine, imaging, clinical development, data science, and biomarker disciplines — ensuring precision medicine is at the heart of our Ophthalmology strategy.

• Bridge laboratory science and clinical practice by steering the generation of robust fluid- and imaging biomarker strategies that enable project and disease area decisions.

• Advance innovation in imaging science by directing cutting-edge ophthalmic imaging approaches including OCT, OCT-A, and FA to inform future clinical practice and therapeutic development.

• Enable translational insights through AI and data by integrating preclinical and clinical datasets using classical and next-generation analytical approaches.

• Influence portfolio strategy across multiple retinal diseases including neovascular AMD, diabetic macular edema, geographic atrophy, and intermediate AMD — driving the direction and future of clinical development and research.

• Represent Roche externally through strong partnerships with scientific experts, investigators, and the broader ophthalmology community — remaining at the forefront of innovation.

Who you are

• You are a board-certified ophthalmologist (MD or MD/PhD) with deep expertise in ophthalmology, translational medicine, or biomedical sciences.

• You are a recognised expert in the retina space, with a strong scientific publication record and standing as a key opinion leader in your field.

• You have deep knowledge of ophthalmic imaging technologies (OCT, OCT-A, FA) and experience with imaging analysis or Reading Centre environments.

• You are experienced in integrating preclinical and clinical data to support proof of biology, efficacy, and safety strategies, with some exposure to clinical trials.

• You are a collaborative scientific leader who thrives in matrix environments, energised by innovation and the opportunity to build something new.

Preferred

• Experience applying AI or machine learning to ophthalmic imaging analysis or clinical data interpretation.

• Prior experience in pharmaceutical drug development programmes for retinal diseases.

• Flexible working arrangements may be available for exceptional candidates who wish to maintain some clinical activity alongside this role.

jobs.title: IT Strategic Risk & Audit Manager

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire des risques stratégiques et de la vérification de la TI

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every patient deserves a personalized healthcare solution. As the IT Strategic Risk & Audit Manager , you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that our digital evolution—from AI-driven drug discovery to personalized healthcare apps—is built on a foundation of trust and resilience. You will act as a strategic partner to Digital Technology leaders, ensuring that risks are managed proactively rather than reactively.
This role moves beyond tactical "checkbox" auditing to focus on strategic foresight —anticipating shifts in the threat landscape, regulatory environment, and emerging technologies (like AI and Cloud architecture)

Job Responsibilities

Scope / (Content Leadership): Defines the strategic vision for IT risk, audit, and compliance, and drives strategic initiatives for long-term risk management success. Initiates and leads large, complex projects with a significant impact on the organization. Leads the development of enterprise-wide risk and compliance policies and advises on emerging trends and best practices.

• Strategic Risk Architecture & Vision: Define and architect the global IT Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), aligning long-term digital strategy with Roche’s risk appetite to ensure "Compliance by Design" across complex, interconnected global portfolios.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of highly complex business and risk challenges with significant organizational impact, proactively identifying potential strategic issues within your sphere of influence. Develops comprehensive risk management and compliance policies, implements proactive measures to avoid repeated issues, and leads initiatives to anticipate and mitigate future risks. Contributes to framing strategic questions and facilitates strategic decision-making at the executive level.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders at the executive level and external partners, analyzing enterprise-wide stakeholder landscapes. Leads enterprise-wide risk, audit, and compliance initiatives, presenting them to executive leadership to secure support and strategic alignment for risk-related investments. Navigates highly complex and politically sensitive landscapes, acting as an organizational trust builder and providing expert counsel on critical strategic decisions.

• E2E Audit & Compliance Leadership: Lead the full lifecycle of complex IT audits and continuous monitoring programs across infrastructure and applications, ensuring the organization meets global regulatory requirements while proactively identifying systemic issues to prevent recurrence.

• Inspection Command & Control: Serve as the primary IT liaison during complex Health Authority inspections (FDA, EMA, etc.), leading "Front-Room/Back-Room" operations, coaching SMEs in regulatory interview techniques, and ensuring the rapid delivery of high-quality, validated evidence.

• Data Integrity & ALCOA+ Systematically audit and enforce the "Digital Thread" to ensure all health-regulated data remains Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, and Accurate, maintaining the integrity of life-saving digital health solutions.

• Global Stakeholder & Transformation Management: Navigate sensitive landscapes to lead enterprise-wide risk initiatives, partnering with IT owners to develop robust remediation CAPAs and innovating risk management approaches to drive lasting, transformative impact across the global org

Conduce iniziative di rischio, audit e conformità a livello aziendale, presentandole alla leadership esecutiva per garantire il supporto e l'allineamento strategico per gli investimenti legati al rischio. Naviga paesaggi molto complessi e politicamente sensibili, agendo come costruttore di fiducia organizzativo e fornendo consulenza esperta sulle decisioni strategiche critiche.

• Comando di ispezione e controllo: Servire come collegamento IT primario durante le ispezioni complesse dell'Autorità sanitaria (FDA, EMA, ecc.), principali operazioni "Front-Room/Back-Room", coaching PMI nelle tecniche di intervista di regolamentazione, e garantire la consegna rapida di prove di alta qualità, convalidate.

• Global Stakeholder & Transformation Management: Navigare paesaggi sensibili per condurre iniziative di rischio a livello aziendale, collaborando con i proprietari IT per sviluppare una robusta bonifica CAPAs e innovare approcci di gestione del rischio per guidare un impatto duraturo e trasformativo attraverso l'org globale

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Bei Roche glauben wir, dass jeder Patient eine personalisierte Gesundheitslösung verdient. Als IT Strategic Risk & Audit Manager werden Sie eine entscheidende Rolle dabei spielen, sicherzustellen, dass unsere digitale Evolution – von der KI-gesteuerten Wirkstoffforschung bis hin zu personalisierten Gesundheits-Apps – auf einer Grundlage von Vertrauen und Widerstandsfähigkeit aufgebaut ist. Sie werden als strategischer Partner für Digital Technology-Führungskräfte fungieren und sicherstellen, dass Risiken proaktiv und nicht reaktiv gehandhabt werden. Diese Rolle geht über das taktische "Checkbox"-Auditing hinaus und konzentriert sich auf strategische Weitsicht - die Antizipation von Veränderungen in der Bedrohungslandschaft, dem regulatorischen Umfeld und neuen Technologien (wie KI und Cloud-Architektur). Aufgabenbereich Scope / (Content Leadership): Definiert die strategische Vision für IT-Risiko, Audit und Compliance und treibt strategische Initiativen für den langfristigen Erfolg des Risikomanagements voran. Initiiert und leitet große, komplexe Projekte mit erheblichen Auswirkungen auf die Organisation. Leitet die Entwicklung unternehmensweiter Risiko- und Compliance-Richtlinien und berät zu aufkommenden Trends und Best Practices.
• Strategische Risikoarchitektur und -vision: Definieren und gestalten Sie das globale IT Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT) und richten Sie die langfristige digitale Strategie an Roches Risikobereitschaft aus, um "Compliance by Design" in komplexen, miteinander verbundenen globalen Portfolios sicherzustellen.
• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Leitet die Analyse von hochkomplexen Geschäfts- und Risikoherausforderungen mit erheblichen organisatorischen Auswirkungen und identifiziert proaktiv potenzielle strategische Probleme in Ihrem Einflussbereich. Entwickelt umfassende Risikomanagement- und Compliance-Richtlinien, setzt proaktive Maßnahmen um, um wiederholte Probleme zu vermeiden, und leitet Initiativen, um zukünftige Risiken zu antizipieren und zu mindern. Trägt zur Gestaltung strategischer Fragen bei und erleichtert die strategische Entscheidungsfindung auf Führungsebene.
• Stakeholder Management: Identifiziert und bindet wichtige Stakeholder auf Führungsebene und externe Partner ein und analysiert unternehmensweite Stakeholderlandschaften. Leitet unternehmensweite Risiko-, Audit- und Compliance-Initiativen und präsentiert sie der Führungsspitze, um Unterstützung und strategische Ausrichtung für risikobezogene Investitionen zu sichern. Navigiert durch hochkomplexe und politisch sensible Landschaften, agiert als organisatorischer Trust Builder und bietet kompetente Beratung bei kritischen strategischen Entscheidungen.
• E2E Audit & Compliance Leadership: Führen Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus komplexer IT-Audits und kontinuierlicher Überwachungsprogramme in Infrastruktur und Anwendungen, um sicherzustellen, dass das Unternehmen die globalen regulatorischen Anforderungen erfüllt und proaktiv systemische Probleme identifiziert, um Wiederholungen zu verhindern.
• Inspection Command & Control: Dienen Sie als primäre IT-Verbindung bei komplexen Inspektionen der Gesundheitsbehörde (FDA, EMA usw.), leiten Sie "Front-Room / Back-Room" -Operationen, coachen Sie KMU in regulatorischen Interviewtechniken und stellen Sie die schnelle Bereitstellung hochwertiger, validierter Beweise sicher.
• Datenintegrität & ALCOA+ Systematisch überprüfen und erzwingen Sie den "Digital Thread", um sicherzustellen, dass alle gesundheitsregulierten Daten zuordenbar, lesbar, zeitgenössisch, originell und genau bleiben und die Integrität lebensrettender digitaler Gesundheitslösungen erhalten bleibt.
• Global Stakeholder & Transformation Management: Navigieren Sie durch sensible Landschaften, um unternehmensweite Risikoinitiativen zu leiten, arbeiten Sie mit IT-Besitzern zusammen, um robuste Sanierungs-CAPAs zu entwickeln und innovative Risikomanagementansätze zu entwickeln, um nachhaltige, transformative Auswirkungen auf die gesamte globale Organisation zu erzielen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous croyons que chaque patient mérite une solution de santé personnalisée. En tant que gestionnaire stratégique des risques et de la vérification de la TI, vous jouerez un rôle central pour faire en sorte que notre évolution numérique, de la découverte de médicaments à l'IA aux applications de soins de santé personnalisées, repose sur la confiance et la résilience. Vous agirez comme partenaire stratégique des leaders de la technologie numérique, en veillant à ce que les risques soient gérés de manière proactive plutôt que réactive. Ce rôle va au-delà de l'audit tactique de la « case à cocher » pour se concentrer sur la prospective stratégique – en anticipant les changements dans le paysage de menace, l'environnement réglementaire et les technologies émergentes (comme l'IA et l'architecture Cloud) Responsabilités professionnelles Portée / ( Leadership en matière de contenu) : définit la vision stratégique du risque, de la vérification et de la conformité en matière de TI, et dirige les initiatives stratégiques pour la réussite à long terme de la gestion des risques. Lance et dirige de grands projets complexes ayant un impact important sur l'organisation. Dirige l'élaboration de politiques de gestion des risques et de conformité à l'échelle de l'entreprise et donne des conseils sur les nouvelles tendances et les meilleures pratiques.
• Architecture et vision des risques stratégiques : Définir et concevoir le cadre mondial de gestion des risques de l'entreprise informatique (ERM) (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), aligner la stratégie numérique à long terme sur l'appétit pour les risques de Roches pour assurer la « conformité par la conception » dans des portefeuilles mondiaux complexes et interconnectés.
• Responsabilité/Résoudre les problèmes : Dirige l'analyse des défis opérationnels et des risques très complexes ayant un impact organisationnel important, en identifiant de façon proactive les problèmes stratégiques potentiels dans votre sphère d'influence. Élaborer des politiques globales de gestion des risques et de conformité, mettre en oeuvre des mesures proactives pour éviter les problèmes répétés et diriger des initiatives pour anticiper et atténuer les risques futurs. Contribue à la formulation de questions stratégiques et facilite la prise de décisions stratégiques au niveau des cadres.
• Gestion des intervenants : Identifier et mobiliser les intervenants clés au niveau de la direction et des partenaires externes, en analysant les paysages des intervenants à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Diriger les initiatives de gestion des risques, de vérification et de conformité à l'échelle de l'organisation, les présenter aux dirigeants pour obtenir un soutien et un alignement stratégique pour les investissements liés aux risques. Navigue dans des paysages très complexes et politiquement sensibles, agit comme un bâtisseur de confiance organisationnel et fournit des conseils spécialisés sur les décisions stratégiques critiques.
• Leadership de la vérification et de la conformité E2E : Diriger le cycle de vie complet des vérifications complexes de la TI et des programmes de surveillance continue dans l'ensemble de l'infrastructure et des applications, en veillant à ce que l'organisation respecte les exigences réglementaires mondiales tout en identifiant de façon proactive les problèmes systémiques afin d'éviter qu'ils ne se reproduisent.
• Commande et contrôle de l'inspection : servir de principale liaison informatique pendant les inspections complexes de l'Autorité de la santé (AFD, EMA, etc.), diriger les opérations « Salle avant/salle arrière », entraîner les PME dans les techniques d'entrevue réglementaires et assurer la livraison rapide de preuves validées de haute qualité.
• Intégrité des données & ALCOA+ Vérification systématique et application du « fil numérique » pour s'assurer que toutes les données réglementées en matière de santé demeurent Attribuables, lisibles, contemporaines, originales et exactes, en maintenant l'intégrité des solutions de santé numériques qui sauvent la vie.
• Gestion globale des intervenants et de la transformation : Naviguer dans des paysages sensibles pour diriger des initiatives de gestion des risques à l'échelle de l'entreprise, établir des partenariats avec les propriétaires de TI afin de mettre au point des APC robustes en matière d'assainissement et d'innover des approches de gestion des risques pour générer des impacts transformatifs durables à l'échelle mondiale

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist - French speaking in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a crucial role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion.

The Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist may collaborate closely with affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines.

The Opportunity:

• Manage the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.

• Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Instructs stakeholders on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area

• Supports Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators in client communications in the area of service offering, change management or communication

• Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility

Who you are :

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; you are highly creative, innovative, forward thinking marketer with the ability to demonstrate awareness of digital trends.

• You have a solid understanding of digital marketing principles, content creation, and campaign management and 3+ years of experience in content production, project management, or digital campaign management, with a focus on coordinating digital marketing initiatives across multiple channels.

• You own excellent communication skills in English and French , and you have experience in stakeholder management and incorporating feedback into content strategies.

• You have a customer-focused behavior in everything you do and ability to create and maintain well-functioning relationships with internal stakeholders and other 3rd party providers.

• You have proficiency in project management tools and software, with a readiness to learn new systems as needed.

• You possess strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with a proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibil

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Global Digital Hub è stato fondato all'interno del Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali di Roche a livello globale, supportando iniziative centrali con Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting e Creative Design. In qualità di Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist - Italiano che parla nel Global Digital Hub, garantisci la consegna di progetti di creazione di contenuti di campagne digitali all'interno del Digital Campaigns Chapter. Il ruolo riveste un ruolo cruciale nel garantire il coordinamento e il completamento della creazione di contenuti di campagne digitali tempestive e di alta qualità. Il Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist può collaborare a stretto contatto con i team aziendali affiliati o i team di marca, i vendori di terze parti, i coordinatori della campagna e della campagna globale nell'organizzazione, relativi ai requisiti di progetto, obiettivi e tempi. L'opportunità:
• Gestire la creazione e il processo di consegna dei contenuti delle campagne digitali affiliate o globali, assicurando il completamento tempestivo e di successo di tutti i progetti dall'iniziazione all'implementazione finale, garantendo al contempo gli standard di consegna.
• Incorporare feedback da parte degli stakeholder e rivedere le richieste di contenuti delle campagne digitali per garantire l'allineamento con le loro aspettative.
• Istruisce le parti interessate a nuovi processi o requisiti che aumenterebbero l'efficienza nei modi di lavorare nell'area tematica
• Supporta i Coordinatori della Campagna e i Coordinatori della Campagna Globale nelle comunicazioni dei clienti nell'ambito dell'offerta di servizi, della gestione dei cambiamenti o della comunicazione
• Adozione e Centro di Eccellenza: seguire i processi esistenti, stabilire i principi di governance dei processi e mantenere una corretta documentazione e attuazione nell'ambito della responsabilità Chi sei?
• Hai una laurea in Marketing, Comunicazione, Business o un campo correlato; sei altamente creativo, innovativo, avanzato marketing di pensiero con la capacità di dimostrare la consapevolezza delle tendenze digitali.
• Hai una solida comprensione dei principi di marketing digitale, la creazione di contenuti e la gestione delle campagne e 3+ anni di esperienza nella produzione dei contenuti, nella gestione dei progetti o nella gestione delle campagne digitali, con l'obiettivo di coordinare le iniziative di marketing digitale su più canali.
• Possiedi eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese e in italiano, e hai esperienza nella gestione degli stakeholder e incorporando feedback nelle strategie di contenuto.
• Hai un comportamento focalizzato sul cliente in tutto ciò che fai e la capacità di creare e mantenere relazioni ben funzionanti con gli stakeholder interni e altri fornitori di terze parti.
• Hai competenza negli strumenti di gestione del progetto e nel software, con una disponibilità ad imparare nuovi sistemi come necessario.
• Possiedi forti capacità organizzative e multitasking, con una comprovata esperienza di gestione simultanea di più progetti. In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche fle

Notre objectif principal est de renforcer les capacités numériques de Roche dans le monde entier en soutenant des initiatives centrales avec Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting et Creative Design. En tant que spécialiste de la livraison de campagnes numériques - Italien dans le Global Digital Hub, vous assurez la livraison réussie de campagnes numériques projets de création de contenu dans le chapitre des campagnes numériques. Le rôle joue un rôle crucial dans la coordination et l'achèvement des campagnes numériques en temps opportun et de haute qualité. Le spécialiste de l'exécution des campagnes numériques peut collaborer étroitement avec des équipes d'affaires affiliées ou des équipes de marque, des tiers vendors, des coordonnateurs de campagnes et des coordonnateurs de campagnes mondiales dans l'organisation, en ce qui concerne les exigences, les objectifs et les délais du projet. La possibilité :
• Gérer le processus de création et de livraison de contenu des campagnes numériques affiliées ou mondiales, en veillant à ce que tous les projets soient menés à bien en temps opportun, de leur lancement à leur mise en oeuvre finale, tout en respectant les normes de livraison.
• Intégrer les commentaires des parties prenantes et réviser les demandes de contenu des campagnes numériques en conséquence afin d'assurer l'alignement sur leurs attentes.
• Instruise les parties prenantes sur de nouveaux processus ou exigences qui amélioreraient l'efficacité des méthodes de travail dans le domaine traité
• Appui aux coordonnateurs de campagne et aux coordonnateurs de campagne mondiale dans les communications avec les clients dans le domaine de l'offre de services, de la gestion du changement ou de la communication
• Adoption et Centre d'excellence : suivre les processus existants, établir les principes de gouvernance des processus et maintenir la documentation et la mise en œuvre appropriées dans le cadre de la responsabilité Qui vous êtes :
• Vous avez un baccalauréat en marketing, communication, affaires, ou un domaine connexe; vous êtes très créatif, innovateur, de la pensée avant marché avec la capacité de démontrer la sensibilisation aux tendances numériques.
• Vous avez une solide compréhension des principes du marketing numérique, de la création de contenu et de la gestion de campagne et 3 ans d'expérience dans la production de contenu, la gestion de projet ou la gestion de campagne numérique, avec un accent sur la coordination des initiatives de marketing numérique sur plusieurs canaux.

In a dynamic environment, we promote seamless collaboration across business units and functions, offer innovative solutions and improve the working environment of employees at the Mannheim and Penzberg sites – where we actively shape the future. Responsibility | This is what awaits you In this role, you combine strategic vision with operational implementation. Design as an expert in cooperation with internal and external stakeholders You interact with different stakeholders and make IFM a value-driven management and service framework for our locations.

The Position

Solution Architect - DIA R&D

The Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions. You will develop and maintain the product's technology roadmap, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

The Opportunity:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within a defined Solution Context.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies general and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas. Contributes minimally but effectively to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Who you are:

Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a specific solution context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for technical solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on risk and application landscapes.

Technical Skills

• General and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas.

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for solutions and interfaces.

• Ability to define and drive reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions.

• Strong capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for the solution, including conducting vendor assessments.

Additional Qualifications

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain difficult or sensitive information and successfully build consensus.

• Proactive mindset to identify opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improve existing solutions, and manage technical deb

As a SW Technical Expert, you will define tasks for others, drive large-scale initiatives, and mentor colleagues to foster their growth. This role involves providing global-level support for technical initiatives, sharing knowledge internationally, and shaping the organization's technical direction. You will possess deep expertise across multiple technology areas, set high standards for code quality and security, and remove obstacles for teams, continuously improving developer productivity and the overall software development lifecycle.

The Opportunity:

• Architectural Evolution: Lead the strategic transition from a modular monolith to microservices, ensuring domain boundaries are respected and performance remains high. Take ownership of the development of new components and ideas as you cooperate with a multidisciplinary team to deliver end-to-end experiences to the End Users.

• Impact/Strategy: Provide global-level support for innovative and technological initiatives. Give speeches and share knowledge in local/international events and knowledge-sharing initiatives, and actively engage in RDT Data Domain/Site-related activities.

• Complexity/ (Product Size): Operate at the Product / Domain / Site level.

• Business/Technical ability: Actively contribute to the advancement of technical knowledge within the field through publications, presentations, and mentorship (for example, by serving as a capability owner). Inspire innovation, drive innovative solutions in line with technology trends, and focus on designing new approaches to existing problems.

Who you are:

• 10+ years proven experience driving cross-functional collaboration to solve organization-wide technical problems and aligning disparate engineering efforts toward common goals.

• Possess a deep understanding of data processing principles and AI-readiness data needs. Hold experience in building solutions for data experts (e.g., Data Owners, Data Consumers, Data Product Owners, and Digital Asset Management).

• Exhibit deep expertise in multiple technology areas and the ability to select and apply appropriate technologies to solve complex problems.

• Maintain proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Event-driven architecture, or similar technologies.

• Demonstrate a strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices, including performance tuning and scalability.

• Leverage excellent knowledge of market-available software development tooling to suggest adoption into the current Roche toolset, continuously improving developer productivity and experience Roche-wide.

• Gestione degli stakeholder: Possedere una forte comprensione degli ecosistemi delle parti interessate e delle loro esigenze, eccellendo nei negoziati e nelle partnership per i benefici reciproci. Fornire la direzione per obiettivi e obiettivi a medio-lungo termine.
• Impatto/Strategia: fornire supporto a livello globale per iniziative innovative e tecnologiche. Fai discorsi e condividi la conoscenza in eventi locali/internazionali e iniziative di condivisione delle conoscenze, e impegnarsi attivamente in attività correlate a RDT Data Domain/Site.
• Complessità/ (dimensione del prodotto): Operare a livello del prodotto / dominio / sito.
• Capacità aziendale/tecnica: contribuire attivamente all'avanzamento della conoscenza tecnica all'interno del campo attraverso pubblicazioni, presentazioni e mentorship (ad esempio, servendo come proprietario di capacità). Ispirare l'innovazione, guidare soluzioni innovative in linea con le tendenze tecnologiche, e concentrarsi sulla progettazione di nuovi approcci ai problemi esistenti. Chi sei:
• 10+ anni di esperienza collaudata che guida la collaborazione interfunzionale per risolvere i problemi tecnici a livello organizzativo e allineare gli sforzi di ingegneria disparati verso obiettivi comuni.
• Possiede una profonda comprensione dei principi del trattamento dei dati e delle esigenze di protezione dell'intelligenza artificiale. Tenere esperienza nella costruzione di soluzioni per gli esperti di dati (ad esempio, Data Owners, Data Consumers, Data Product Owners e Digital Asset Management).
• Esprimi una profonda esperienza in più aree tecnologiche e la capacità di selezionare e applicare tecnologie adeguate per risolvere problemi complessi.
• Mantenere la competenza in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Architettura basata su eventi o tecnologie simili.
• Dimostrare una forte comprensione delle pratiche del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del software, compresa la messa a punto delle prestazioni e la scalabilità.
• Levare la conoscenza eccellente dello sviluppo software disponibile sul mercato strumenti per suggerire l'adozione nell'attuale strumenti Roche, migliorando continuamente la produttività degli sviluppatori e l'esperienza Roche-wide.
• Applicare competenze nelle best practice di sicurezza informatica, assicurando che le soluzioni software conformi agli standard di sicurezza in coordinamento con l'esperto Roche appropriato

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about people, communication, and making a real difference in a global organization? If you excel at coaching, building relationships, and solving complex problems, we want you! Join our People Support Solutions team as a Talent Acquisition Partner and leverage your expertise in human interaction to launch a career in global talent acquisition.

The Opportunity:

• Launch your career in Talent Acquisition by learning to manage the full recruiting lifecycle within a supportive global team.

• Act as a key communication partner for hiring managers and senior leaders, applying your coaching and interpersonal skills to guide them through the hiring process.

• Learn to conduct in-depth candidate assessments , focusing on evaluating core competencies and fit.

• Manage and optimize the candidate experience , ensuring clear, consistent communication from application to offer.

• Utilize advanced HR technology (Workday) to streamline recruiting activities and support crucial data management.

• Collaborate closely on internal talent management efforts, including succession planning and internal mobility, applying a strategic lens to organizational needs.

• Contribute to process innovation , helping us challenge the status quo and continuously improve our talent search strategies.

Who You Are:

• Advanced language skills in German and English (both written and spoken) are mandatory.

• 2-3 years of experience in end-to-end recruitment

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Life Science or equivalent work experience is required

• You possess a strong customer-centric, growth, and agile mindset , thriving in ambiguous and multicultural environments.

• You demonstrate proven stakeholder management and influencing skills , with the ability to manage expectations and build trust with diverse partners.

• You are capable of working independently , effectively managing multiple, competing priorities, and driving toward results with a positive attitude.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/dpn4candidates

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 mil

The Position
As the Customer Partner, you will be responsible for growing the market share and achieving sales goals for the assigned territory. You will be responsible for executing the sales process, ensure operation effectiveness and efficiency, with proficient interpersonal and communication skills, and providing effective solutions to establish and maintain relationships that result in customer satisfaction, retention and acquisition.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

Territory coverage: Central + Negeri Sembilan
Primary work location: Central - based

In this role, you will

• Lead the complete sales process including prospecting, qualification, closing, contracting, implementation, and ensuring high-standard after-sales support through solution/consultative selling.

• Build long-term, value-based customer relationships by continuously uncovering changing needs, improving customer experience, and adding value through creative solutions.

• Establish credibility with stakeholders by demonstrating business acumen, professional expertise, and adapting one's communication style to align with customers' working styles.

• Drive business development by identifying, developing, retaining, extending, and acquiring accounts, and collaborating across teams to attain objectives.

• Strategize for growth by developing and implementing annual territorial plans to achieve sales goals and future growth, and profiling accounts to position RDMY strongly to win tenders.

• Maintain data integrity in REXIS Salesforce by regularly updating accounts/contacts, and ensuring weekly entry and monitoring of activities and business opportunities.

• Support sales execution with technical proficiency, including conducting basic troubleshooting and using the Global Deal Calculator (GDC) to prepare sales proposals, along with participation in relevant marketing events.

Any other tasks or projects as assigned from time to time.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Customer Partner, you will be responsible for growing the market share and achieving sales goals for the assigned territory. You will be responsible for executing the sales process, ensure operation effectiveness and efficiency, with proficient interpersonal and communication skills, and providing effective solutions to establish and maintain relationships that result in customer satisfaction, retention and acquisition.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

Territory coverage: Central + Negeri Sembilan
Primary work location: Central - based

In this role, you will

• Lead the complete sales process including prospecting, qualification, closing, contracting, implementation, and ensuring high-standard after-sales support through solution/consultative selling.

• Build long-term, value-based customer relationships by continuously uncovering changing needs, improving customer experience, and adding value through creative solutions.

• Establish credibility with stakeholders by demonstrating business acumen, professional expertise, and adapting one's communication style to align with customers' working styles.

• Drive business development by identifying, developing, retaining, extending, and acquiring accounts, and collaborating across teams to attain objectives.

• Strategize for growth by developing and implementing annual territorial plans to achieve sales goals and future growth, and profiling accounts to position RDMY strongly to win tenders.

• Maintain data integrity in REXIS Salesforce by regularly updating accounts/contacts, and ensuring weekly entry and monitoring of activities and business opportunities.

• Support sales execution with technical proficiency, including conducting basic troubleshooting and using the Global Deal Calculator (GDC) to prepare sales proposals, along with participation in relevant marketing events.

Any other tasks or projects as assigned from time to time.

Who you are

• Strong client-facing skills including communication, negotiation, and influencing.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
As the AI Product Manager, you will lead the strategic development and implementation guidance of AI & Digital empowered solutions, ensuring strict alignment with business objectives. You will drive the delivery of key initiatives including DPMM (Digital Patient Monitoring and Management), PLM (Patient-Like-Me), Content Generation, and Research Solutions. Success in this position requires partnering closely with Medical Affairs, Customer Engagement (CE), and Access teams to foster strategic synergy and ensure the seamless execution of these digital innovations.

Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Strategic Planning & Lifecycle Management Develop and execute a long-term strategic plan for the assigned AI & Digital empowered solutions (e.g., DPMM, PLM, Content Generation, or Research Solutions) that aligns with the organization’s overall business goals.
a) Market Intelligence: Conduct regular analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats within the data-driven product management and marketing landscape.
b) Roadmap & Implementation: Provide strategic guidance to cross-functional teams on the deployment of digital solutions; develop and maintain a phased roadmap to ensure structured execution and scalability.
c) Partnership Management: Establish and nurture relationships with external partners—including data providers, technology vendors, and industry experts—to leverage external capabilities and accelerate innovation.
d) Continuous Improvement: Create a systematic mechanism for the ongoing review and optimization of strategies, processes, and product performance across the solution lifecycle.

2. Scientific Leadership & Ecosystem Engagement Reinforce Roche’s position as a scientific leader in the increasingly competitive and evolving Innovative Healthcare Solution landscape.
a) Ecosystem Collaboration: Leverage internal expertise while fostering collaborations with key players in the external AI & Digital Innovation ecosystem to demonstrate scientific value and address stakeholder needs.
b) Value Communication: Ensure the medical and scientific value of the digital solutions is effectively communicated and recognized by the healthcare system, leveraging existing medical team expertise and stakeholder networks.

3. Governance, Compliance & Risk Management Ensure strict adherence to corporate policies, SOPs, and local regulations across all initiatives.
a) Medical Governance: Uphold high standards of scientific and medical compliance, ensuring a balanced framework for risk/benefit management specifically tailored to digital health innovations.
b) Regulatory Adherence: Guarantee that all initiatives strictly comply with Roche’s SOPs, codes of conduct, and local regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
1. Bachelor’s degree or above in life sciences, medicine, or data science, i.e. an MBA, or equivalent combination of scientific and business education/experience is helpful, such as strategy consulting experience
2. >2 years’ experience in medical affairs, marketing, business development, digital innovation in multinational company
Leadership Competencies
1. Strategic agility
2. Technical and business expertise
3. Inspiring and influencing
4. Teamwork and collaboration
5. Experienced strategic thinking and planning skills.
6. Demonstrated ability in cross-functional leadership, cross-industry and ecosystem leadership

Job Req

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position But principal de l'emploi (résumé de l'emploi) En tant que gestionnaire de produits d'IA, vous dirigerez le développement stratégique et l'orientation de la mise en œuvre des solutions d'IA & Digital, assurant un alignement strict avec les objectifs opérationnels. Vous dirigerez la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives clés telles que DPMM (Digital Patient Monitoring and Management), PLM (Patient-Like-Me), Content Generation et Research Solutions. Pour réussir, il faut s'associer étroitement aux équipes des Affaires médicales, de l'engagement client (EC) et de l'accès pour favoriser la synergie stratégique et assurer l'exécution transparente de ces innovations numériques. Rôles principaux &
• Responsabilités 1. Planification stratégique et gestion du cycle de vie Élaborer et exécuter un plan stratégique à long terme pour les solutions de l'IA et du numérique (p. ex. DPMM, PLM, Content Generation, ou Research Solutions) qui s'harmonise avec les objectifs généraux de l'organisation. a) Renseignements sur les marchés : Effectuer des analyses régulières pour déterminer les tendances, les possibilités et les menaces dans le contexte de la gestion et de la commercialisation des produits axée sur les données. b) Feuille de route et mise en oeuvre: Fournir des orientations stratégiques aux équipes interfonctionnelles sur le déploiement de solutions numériques; élaborer et maintenir une feuille de route échelonnée pour assurer une exécution structurée et une évolutivité. c) Gestion des partenariats : Établir et entretenir des relations avec des partenaires externes, y compris les fournisseurs de données, les fournisseurs de technologie et les experts de l'industrie, afin de tirer parti des capacités externes et d'accélérer l'innovation. d) Amélioration continue : Créer un mécanisme systématique pour l'examen et l'optimisation continus des stratégies, des processus et des performances du produit tout au long du cycle de vie de la solution. 2. Leadership scientifique et engagement écosystémique Renforcer Roches en tant que leader scientifique dans le paysage de plus en plus concurrentiel et en évolution des solutions de santé innovatrices. a) Collaboration entre les écosystèmes : Tirer parti de l'expertise interne tout en favorisant la collaboration avec les principaux intervenants de l'écosystème externe de l'IA et de l'innovation numérique pour démontrer la valeur scientifique et répondre aux besoins des intervenants. b) Communication de la valeur : S'assurer que la valeur médicale et scientifique des solutions numériques est efficacement communiquée et reconnue par le système de santé, en tirant parti de l'expertise de l'équipe médicale existante et des réseaux d'intervenants. 3. Gouvernance, conformité et gestion des risques Assurer le strict respect des politiques ministérielles, des PON et des règlements locaux dans toutes les initiatives. a) Gouvernance médicale: maintenir des normes élevées de conformité scientifique et médicale, en assurant un cadre équilibré de gestion des risques et des avantages spécialement adapté aux innovations en matière de santé numériques. b) Respect de la réglementation : Garantir que toutes les initiatives respectent strictement les SOP de Roche, les codes de conduite et les exigences réglementaires locales tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. Qualification et expérience Éducation/
• Compétences 1. Baccalauréat ou plus en sciences de la vie, médecine ou sciences des données, c'est-à-dire un MBA, ou une combinaison équivalente d'éducation et d'expérience en sciences et en affaires est utile, comme l'expérience de consultation stratégique 2. >2 ans d'expérience en affaires médicales, marketing, développement des entreprises, innovation numérique dans l'entreprise multinationale Compétences en leadership 1. Agilité stratégique 2. Expertise technique et commerciale 3. Inspiration et influence 4. Travail d'équipe et collaboration 5. Expérience de la pensée stratégique et des compétences de planification. 6. Capacité démontrée en leadership interfonctionnel, en leadership interindustriel et en leadership écosystémique Emploi requis

部门： 多渠道生态体系拓展部（ MCE ）

Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责 / 责任
1 、结合公司产品特点，制定区域市场策略与执行
深度解读国家及各省市政策动态、市场竞争格局，结合产品特性与医院终端需求，制定拓展目标医院业务整体策略，搭建医院端业务运作体系。
2 、项目管理与经销商协作
结合总部策略和区域实践提升产品医院覆盖广度与深度。
与区域合作伙伴构建良好的合作关系；整合经销商资源建立与合作伙伴的协同机制，确保产品在医院终端的供应保障以及业务目标达成。 联动市场部制定市场方案，赋能经销商聚焦产品临床价值传递。赋能合作伙伴的业务活动，定期向业务部门/职能部门负责人提供反馈
3 、目标达成与模式探索
向经销商商议制定负责区域内经销商年度/季度/月度商业目标，监督经销商建立关键绩效指标跟踪体系，监控业务数据，定期汇报目标达成情况、策略执行效果及市场动态。 针对目标达成偏差，敦促经销商快速制定优化策略与资源配置，确保产品医院端业务稳健发展。
制定区域市场策略和区域准入跟进机制，制定项目计划，建立区域项目管理回顾机制，确保区域项目合规落地及实现区域项目高效费用管理。积极探索创新模式并试点推广。
4 、跨部门协同与资源整合
积极协同公司内外部资源，联动公司各个跨部门团队，协调资源支持推动解决业务推进中的跨部门协作问题。推进渠道资源的整合，保障目标达成。
5 、其他
严格遵守中国法律法规及罗氏内部的合规政策，确保所有市场活动合法合规。监控业务流程中的潜在风险及时处理以保障业务健康运行。完成上级主管指派的其他临时性项目工作。

Education/
• Qualifications 教育程度/所获资格证书
医学/药学/本科及以上；
有销售、项目管理或市场营销经验；
5年及以上医药行业经验，其中至少3年销售管理或项目管理经验；
有医院/成熟产品渠道策略制定或运营经验者优先；
具备深度业务洞察能力，具有预见风险能力，并能提供长远发展建议和创新方案 ；
具备客户管理能力，能够分析区域信息，制定区域业务目标和工作计划能力，并能带领团队推动计划执行；
具备项目管理能力，具有多项目和复杂项目的管理知识，能够资源优化配置，有序推动项目计划 具备系统思考能力和区域管理能力；
能进行区域策略制定，流程优化和团队管理能力；
良好的跨部门合作、沟通能力 成长型思维

Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.
