jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As the Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader for the Master Data Data Product, you will be a vital member of the MRHub Team within the Data Management & Data Quality Platforms department. Your primary mission is to deliver high-quality IT operation services that empower our business partners to reliably provide life-saving products to patients.
In this role, you will lead the setup and lifecycle management of Master Data Data Products, ensuring they deliver consistent value regardless of the source system (MDMS, Aspire, MRHub).

Job Responsibilities

• Leads the Master Data Product setup and lifecycle, independent of specific source systems

• Manages and directs a small external team (4 people) delivering the Master Data Data Products and Snowflake capabilities.

• Manages the end‑to‑end request process for new/changed Master Data Data Products: intake, governance board engagement, approvals, coordinating with source system owners.

• Designs and implements the Data Product technically in Snowflake (pipelines, datasets, exposure for consumption).

• Coordinates closely with the Data Quality team and Ataccama so data quality rules run on Snowflake datasets from the Master Data Data Products.

• Serves as the main operational contact for ongoing demand, changes, and incident/support needs around the Master Data Data Products

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their data and analytics needs and develop a product roadmap that aligns with business goals.

• Define and prioritise product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for data and analytics products and ensure what was agreed gets delivered.

• Collaborate with Infrastructure Teams and software developers to ensure that data and analytics products are integrated into existing systems and platforms in a sustainable way that still meets the needs of business to generate the insights necessary to drive their decisions.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field.

• Extensive experience leading complex data science projects from end-to-end and driving significant business impact.

• Proven track record of working closely with senior leadership to inform and influence high-level strategic business decisions.

• Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing enterprise-wide data science frameworks and best practices.

Technical Skills

• Deep understanding of Master Data, Data Quality and

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale di intelligenza artificiale, dati e innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutto Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici dell'ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Come Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader per il Master Data Data Product, sarai un membro vitale del team MRHub all'interno del reparto Gestione dei dati e piattaforme di qualità dei dati. La vostra missione primaria è quella di fornire servizi operativi IT di alta qualità che consentono ai nostri partner commerciali di fornire in modo affidabile prodotti salvavita ai pazienti. In questo ruolo, si porterà la configurazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita dei prodotti Master Data, assicurando che essi forniscono un valore coerente indipendentemente dal sistema sorgente (MDMS, Aspire, MRHub). • Leads the Master Data Product setup and lifecycle, indipendente da specifici sistemi di sorgente
• Gestisce e dirige un piccolo team esterno (4 persone) che fornisce le funzionalità Master Data Products e Snowflake.
• Gestisce il processo di richiesta end-to-end per i nuovi/cambiati Master Data Data Products: assunzione, governance board engagement, approvazioni, coordinamento con i proprietari di sistemi sorgente.
• Progetta e implementa tecnicamente il Data Product in Snowflake (pipeline, dataset, esposizione al consumo).
• Coordina a stretto contatto con il team di Data Quality e Ataccama così le regole di qualità dei dati vengono eseguite sui dataset di Snowflake dai prodotti Master Data.
• Serve come principale contatto operativo per la domanda, le modifiche e le esigenze di incidente/supporto in tutto il Master Data Products
• Collabora con gli stakeholder aziendali per comprendere le loro esigenze di dati e analisi e sviluppare una roadmap del prodotto che si allinea agli obiettivi aziendali.
• Definire e dare priorità ai requisiti del prodotto, alle storie degli utenti e ai criteri di accettazione dei dati e dei prodotti di analisi e garantire che ciò che è stato concordato venga consegnato.
• Collaborare con i team di infrastruttura e gli sviluppatori di software per garantire che i prodotti di dati e analytics siano integrati in sistemi e piattaforme esistenti in modo sostenibile che soddisfi ancora le esigenze del business per generare le informazioni necessarie per guidare le loro decisioni. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Analyste principal principal des données / Chef Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force centrale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde entier. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau peuvent varier selon les besoins opérationnels, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements de collaboration. En tant qu'analyste principal des données / responsable du produit Master Data, vous serez un membre essentiel de l'équipe MRHub au sein du département Gestion des données et plateformes de qualité des données. Votre mission principale est de fournir des services d'exploitation informatique de haute qualité qui permettent à nos partenaires commerciaux de fournir de façon fiable des produits de sauvetage aux patients. • Gère le processus de demande de bout en bout pour les produits de données maîtresses nouveaux ou modifiés : entrée, engagement du conseil de gouvernance, approbations, coordination avec les propriétaires de systèmes sources.

jobs.title: Associate Manager- Filling
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities

Leadership & People Management

• ﻿﻿Build and retain an inclusive workforce and foster an environment where diversity of thought and perspective are valued.

• Maintain an inclusive team that values diversity of thought.

• Maintain strong partnerships with leaders to ensure alignment on strategic projects and daily operations.

• ﻿﻿Take the responsibility for department daily SHE management, implement site SHE procedure and program, and achieve site corporate /site SHE KPI. Promote SHE culture and improve employee safety behavior.

• ﻿﻿Manage performance and development team members to achieve organizational goals and employee personal and professional growth.

• Support manager to build a strong pipeline of talent and robust succession plans for key positions.

• ﻿﻿﻿﻿Maintain a culture of continuous improvement and model lean leadership principles.

• Maintain a culture of transparent, high performance, empowerment and innovation culture.

Technical

Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, equipment selection, URS review, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.

• As a key role, support to establish an effective operation system in alignment with the Roche’s standards, including manufacturing system, CCS strategy, people training and qualification system.

• Lead to establish the procedures related to aseptic techniques, good aseptic practices on the shop floor, and other relevant processes for aseptic production execution.

• Participate in CCS strategy implementation in operation to ensure a sustaining sterility assurance program setting up.

• Support the filling manager to establish the site aseptic training program and implement it, ensure only qualified people perform GMP lots’ manufacturing.

• Ensure team's competencies in performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, depyrogenating, filling and stoppering, crimping.

• Participate in tech transfer, collaboration with other functions to ensure the success of new product manufacturing.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:

• Ensure routine operation compliance with regulations, maintain sterile conditions, and achieve high-quality production standards .

• Ensure total readiness of manufacturing suites, including housekeeping, machine, materials, documents and other resources to ensure product delivery in time and within budget.

• Arrange the filling shifts in routine production, participate in operation as an aseptic SME and perform daily review of production batch record, deviation according to schedule.

• Lead annual aseptic operators’ qualification, provide on-the-job training to support formalized technical and GMP training.

• Oversee the daily operation, monitoring, and maintenance of filling equipment to ensure compliance with aseptic requirements .

• Supervise aseptic operations during production and intervene promptly in case of abnormalities .

• Participate in the response of regulator audit and global quality audit as SME during regulatory inspections and audits.

• Raise deviation and involve the root cause investigation, including appropriate escalation where needed to ensure closure of deviation within the set timeline.

• Raise change control and provide assessment.

• Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.

•

jobs.title: Medical Affairs Partner (Ophthalmology)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Medical Affairs Partner, you will act as a trusted, externally focused, and scientifically grounded collaborator within our customer engagement ecosystem. Based in the affiliate team, you will drive the local medical strategy, build deep peer-to-peer connections with scientific communities, and ensure our diagnostic and therapeutic innovations reach their full potential to transform patient lives.

In this role, you will:

• Drive Scientific & Medical Strategy: Lead the medical component of the integrated therapeutic strategy, translating complex clinical data into a clear, differentiated value story across key disease areas.

• Cultivate Trusted Partnerships: Proactively engage with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), external scientific experts, and healthcare stakeholders to foster meaningful, science-driven collaborations.

• Advance Evidence Generation: Develop and implement local integrated evidence plans, identifying data gaps and supporting Real-World Evidence (RWE) studies, non-interventional studies, and investigator-initiated research.

• Accelerate Patient Market Access: Contribute scientific expertise to local Health Technology Assessment (HTA) submissions, articulating the real-world value of our innovations to secure faster patient access.

• Lead Digital & Ecosystem Innovation: Systematically gather external clinical insights, utilizing emerging digital tools and AI insights responsibly to anticipate and optimize local medical practice adoption.

• Ensure Absolute Excellence & Compliance: Oversee medical information requests and collaborate with Regulatory and Clinical Operations teams, maintaining strict adherence to industry regulations, ethical standards, and Good Clinical Practice (GCP).

Who You Are
You are an entrepreneurial, solution-oriented professional who thrives in cross-functional team environments. You balance deep scientific expertise with the strategic acumen required to navigate ambiguity and communicate complex insights with clarity and impact.

Your Qualifications:

• Educational Excellence: You hold an advanced degree in Medical, Pharmaceutical, or Natural Sciences (e.g., MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent).

• Professional Experience: You bring proven experience in Medical Affairs or equivalent clinical/scientific expertise within relevant therapeutic areas preferably in Retinal Diseases & Ophthalmology

• Strategic Communication: You possess exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to confidently lead peer-to-peer scientific dialogue at an executive level in English.

• Digital Literacy: You maintain a growth mindset toward digital tools, demonstrating basic AI literacy and the ability to ensure robust human-in-the-loop oversight of digital content.

• Compliance & Collaborative Mindset: You demonstrate strong personal accountability, a collaborative approach to cross-functional "squad" environments, and an unwavering commitment to ethical compliance.

Together, we’ll advance along the whole patient journey with the aspiration to prevent, stop and cure diseases.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Roche Product Development Regulatory Affairs (PDR), a flexible, bold, and distinctive regulatory organization where we make strategic decisions quickly, innovate boldly, and deliver insights that shape our portfolio development. We are seeking a talented professional to help build, mature, and sustain our regulatory business capabilities while fostering a culture of continuous learning and meaningful impact for patients.

The Opportunity:

• Support complex and higher exposure quality and compliance activities , providing guidance and risk assessment to PDR staff on GCP, GVP, MDR, and IVDR compliance issues, and serving as advisor and subject matter expert for Quality and Compliance-related processes

• Lead deviation management and process management activities, updating and maintaining regulatory documents while sustaining Quality and Compliance operational activities required for maintaining Roche's license to operate and Quality Management System (QMS)

• Oversee training management , scheduling training sessions and ensuring completion across PDR to support our commitment to regulatory compliance and continuous learning

• Prepare and manage compliance reports , monitoring trends in the external compliance environment

• Partner across the enterprise with stakeholders within and beyond PDR (including affiliates, PD quality organizations, and the broader Roche group) to unlock company-wide benefits and ensure regulatory compliance

• Lead increasingly complex deliverables while collaborating cross-functionally with key stakeholders, generating insights, and mentoring peers to foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

• Monitor and respond to trends in innovation and the external compliance environment, anticipating changes in the regulatory landscape and assessing future business needs

• Contribute to initiatives that shape our technical, business, and healthcare environments , bringing new ideas into the business and leading them with entrepreneurial mindset

Who You Are:

• 5+ years of relevant regulatory affairs, quality, or compliance experience in the Pharma or Medical Device space, with a proven ability to independently deliver and lead increasingly complex projects and initiatives

• Experience working with health authorities , understanding the global regulatory environment

• Strategic and systems thinker with strong data management, content management, and knowledge management capabilities; experienced in change leadership and operating effectively in matrix environments

• Cross-functional collaboration expert with demonstrated experience in building trusted partnerships across internal and external stakeholders, including health authorities

• Compliance-focused professional with a deep understanding of the global regulatory environment, GCP, GVP, MDR, and IVDR requirements, and a commitment to maintaining license to operate and integrity

• Continuous learner with a growth mindset, strong communication skills, and ability to seek and act on feedback

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring

• Esperienza di lavoro con le autorità sanitarie, comprensione dell'ambiente normativo globale
• Pensatore strategico e sistemi con una forte gestione dei dati, la gestione dei contenuti e le capacità di gestione delle conoscenze; esperto nel cambiare la leadership e operare efficacemente in ambienti matrici
• Esperto di collaborazione interfunzionale con esperienza dimostrata nella costruzione di partenariati di fiducia tra gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, comprese le autorità sanitarie
• Professionista focalizzato sulla conformità con una profonda comprensione dell'ambiente normativo globale, dei requisiti GCP, GVP, MDR e IVDR, e l'impegno a mantenere la licenza per operare e l'integrità
• Imparente continuo con una mentalità di crescita, forti capacità di comunicazione, e la capacità di cercare e agire sul feedback In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto si può spostare Sportpass, coaching / mentoring

jobs.title: Clinical Selling Specialist - Toledo
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Clinician Selling Specialist , desempeñarás un papel fundamental en impulsar la adopción de nuestros biomarcadores y soluciones innovadoras dentro de las comunidades clínicas. Construirás relaciones sólidas con líderes de opinión clave (KOLs), investigadores y proveedores de atención médica para avanzar en nuestra misión de mejorar los resultados de los pacientes a través de la medicina personalizada y una mejor gestión de enfermedades crónicas.

En este rol, serás la persona de referencia para aspectos clínicos y técnicos en el área de Castilla-La Mancha . Serás responsable de promover nuestras soluciones con un enfoque técnico-científico, adaptando las estrategias globales a la realidad local de la Atención Primaria y los centros especializados, asegurando que nuestras innovaciones lleguen a los pacientes adecuados en el momento adecuado.

Tus Responsabilidades Clave

• Ventas Estratégicas y Promoción Técnica: Promover productos y servicios con mensajes científicos diferenciadores. Negociarás con centros de salud y hospitales, proporcionando explicaciones técnicas de alto nivel centradas en el tratamiento y la gestión del paciente.

• Enfoque en Atención Primaria y Diabetes: Serás un socio clave para los proveedores de Atención Primaria, especialmente en el contexto de la Diabetes , promoviendo las ventas con un enfoque orientado al tratamiento e identificando nuevas oportunidades de negocio dentro de las cuentas existentes.

• Participación de las Partes Interesadas: Identificar y cultivar una red de defensores (KOLs, Líderes Clínicos, Directores Médicos). Adaptarás los planes de ventas para satisfacer sus necesidades y comunicarás las implicaciones de las licitaciones públicas al Gerente de Zona.

• Formación Clínica: Educar al personal de enfermería y a los profesionales de la salud tanto en hospitales como en centros de Atención Primaria sobre el uso del producto, coordinando la participación de las enfermeras en los protocolos de atención al paciente.

• Experiencia Científica: Actuar como el experto local, presentando las soluciones de Roche en foros regionales y simposios. Te mantendrás actualizado sobre las regulaciones IVDR y los algoritmos de gestión de pacientes.

• Inteligencia de Mercado: Recopilar y compartir información sobre tendencias del mercado y competencia. Implementarás campañas de marketing y colaborarás con los Gerentes de Producto en actividades promocionales locales (congresos, talleres, etc.).

• Inversión y ROI: Proponer e implementar inversiones en tu territorio basadas en un retorno (ROI) definido y asegurar que se cumplan todos los compromisos con el cliente.

• Movilidad: Este puesto requiere una alta presencia en campo, con viajes esperados dentro del área designada (Castilla-La Mancha) 70+% del tiempo.

Quién Eres
Buscamos un perfil científico con una fuerte enfoque comercial y experiencia en el ecosistema sanitario local.

• Educación: Se necesita Licenciatura. Se valorará altamente la Licenciatura en Ciencias.

• Experiencia: 3 a 5 años de experiencia en la industria de ciencias de la vida. Es esencial una experiencia probada en Atención Primaria.

• Experiencia en la Materia: Se valora profundamente el conocimiento o la experiencia en Diabetes.

• Construcción de Relaciones: Gran capacidad para construir y mantener relaciones con profesionales de la salud a todos los niveles.

• Idiomas: Se valora mucho la fluidez en español ; un dominio sólido del inglés es obligatorio para la colaboración global.

• Ubicación: D

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. An integral part of achieving this vision is to deliver new and innovative data analytics solutions to our scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT). To do so, we have formed a new organization called PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) with the aspir ation to digitally transform and become a lean organization.

PTE catalyzes the global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy to enable PT to realize our performance promises. We build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, further de velop Lean and Digital skills across PT, and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients.

As we establish a PT-wide Data Governance framework to orchestrate sustainable solutions, we are looking for a Data Security & Privacy Lead . In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the security, privacy, and compliance of PT data. You will collaborate widely with PT regulatory functions, IT, and business stakeholders to define, implement, and monitor policies in line with industry standards. This role is critical in our ongoing dedication to ensuring patient safety and regulatory compliance, requiring a strong understanding of data privacy and security needs in a life sciences organization.

The Opportunity
As our Data Security & Privacy Lead, your main responsibilities will be divided into four core pillars:
1. Security & Privacy Policy Definition and Implementation

• Work closely with relevant Roche IT, legal, and regulatory functions to define policies for data acquisition, storage, usage, and deletion to ensure security and privacy across the data lifecycle.

• Partner with System Owners, Data Owners, and IT to ensure security and privacy policies are relevant and applied adequately to existing systems across PT.

• Conduct impact assessments and define implementation strategies for new and updated policies, working closely with business partners to effectively and consistently implement policy.

2. Security & Privacy Compliance

• Collaborate with business domains to effectively monitor privacy and security compliance across multiple systems and platforms.

• Support business domains to appropriately respond to data subject requests and regulatory requirements in a compliant and timely manner.

• Ensure PT data adheres to regulatory requirements and global data protection laws and regulations (e.g., GDPR, DPA).

• Coordinate architectural design decisions affecting security and privacy by design principles throughout the solution development lifecycle.

3. Advisory & Advocacy

• Act as the primary point of contact and provide expertise for staff regarding data privacy and protection obligations, including information governance activities and information security.

• Continuously train, upskill, and raise awareness for privacy and security maturity in PT. Lead policy-specific awareness activities, working with the Data Culture Lead where relevant to ensure PT-wide understanding and effective adoption.

4. Risk Monitoring & Escalation

• Conduct regular risk assessments and security audits, scoping and suggesting mitigations to ensure data security and privacy practices are adhered to, and the risk of future incidents is reduced.

• Leverage comprehensive knowledge of Roche escalation pathways and risk mit

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. A Roche, prosperiamo per fornire più benefici ai nostri pazienti come parte della nostra visione Pharma di 10 anni. Una parte fondamentale per raggiungere questa visione è fornire nuove e innovative soluzioni di analisi dei dati ai nostri scienziati attraverso Pharma Technical Operations (PT). Per farlo, abbiamo formato una nuova organizzazione chiamata PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) con l'aspirazione di costruire operazioni digitali e magre leader del settore attraverso funzioni e l'intera impronta produttiva. PTE è l'organizzazione che catalizza lo sviluppo globale e l'esecuzione della strategia di PT Digital and Operational Excellence per consentire a PT di realizzare le nostre promesse di performance. Costruiamo una forte comunità interfunzionale e inclusiva, mettiamo il potere dei dati nelle mani della nostra gente, sviluppiamo ulteriormente le competenze Lean e Digital in PT, e ridimensioniamo le nostre soluzioni Digital e Advanced Analytics, a beneficio dei nostri colleghi e pazienti. L'opportunità Stiamo cercando uno specialista di produzione – Cyber Security per aderire alla nostra organizzazione PTE. In questo ruolo, servirai come il collegamento chiave tra la funzione globale di sicurezza informatica TechOps e i nostri siti di produzione locale in tutto il mondo. La vostra missione sarà quella di garantire la conformità, garantire operazioni sicure, elevare la consapevolezza della sicurezza operativa (OT) e guidare l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità delle iniziative a livello aziendale con le esigenze specifiche del sito. Questa posizione richiede una forte e agile miscela di conoscenze di produzione, consapevolezza della sicurezza informatica e gestione eccezionale degli stakeholder a livello del sito. Principali responsabilità
• Rappresentanza PT sul sito: agire come il collegamento primario e partner affidabile tra le operazioni del sito di produzione e la sicurezza informatica PTE globale e le squadre digitali.
• Compliance & Governance del sito: garantire l'allineamento del livello del sito e la conformità con gli standard di sicurezza informatica aziendale, politiche e requisiti normativi.
• Consapevolezza di sicurezza OT: Promuovere una forte cultura della sicurezza in loco, elevando la consapevolezza intorno ai rischi e alle best practice di Operational Technology (OT).
• Integrazione strategica: colmare il divario tra le iniziative globali di sicurezza delle imprese e le realtà operative locali, garantendo un'implementazione regolare senza interrompere i flussi di produzione. Chi sei Sei un professionista dinamico che prospera in ambienti di cambiamento e di evoluzione digitale. Porti struttura, collaborazione interfunzionale e un approccio pragmatico alla risoluzione dei problemi.
• Esperienza comprovata che lavora all'interno di un ambiente di produzione (l'esperienza nel settore farmaceutico o regolamentato è un vantaggio).
• Solida comprensione o elevata consapevolezza dei principi di Cyber Security, particolarmente applicati ai sistemi operativi (OT) o di produzione.
• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di collegare strategie globali con le operazioni del sito locale.
• Fluency in inglese (come si interagirà con i team globali); lingue aggiuntive sono un bene.
• Una mentalità cambiante: appassionata di trasformazione digitale, operazioni magre e persone. Cosa offriamo (La nostra cultura) A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per la qualifica unica

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Technical Product Owner - Legal - RDT Group Functions

We are looking for an experienced Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner to partner with Business Product Owners and stakeholders in Legal to translate requirements into strategic digital solutions. You will work closely with the IT Product Manager to shape the strategic vision, roadmap, and delivery of Legal-related products within Roche. This includes supporting platforms that span global teams across both Pharma and Diagnostics.

The Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner will play a key role in analyzing complex business processes, identifying optimization opportunities, and enabling the automation and digitization of workflows - ranging from review and approval to oversight, monitoring, and governance frameworks - while ensuring alignment with the "One Roche" philosophy.

About Our Team: RDT Legal Product

Sitting within the broader Legal, Compliance & Group Communication division, our team partners with the Legal department to enable efficiency and effectiveness through legal-specific solutions. Working hand-in-hand, we blend IT expertise with business know-how to support Legal at every step of their digital journey.

The Legal Product portfolio covers solutions for legal spend and matter management, document management, and contract management, as well as workflows and reporting. We handle the entire lifecycle of these solutions - whether we build (make) or buy, manage, or operate them.

Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Process Analysis

• Conduct detailed discovery and analysis of processes across legal global teams to identify current pain points, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.

• Translate complex business requirements into clear functional specifications and technical requirements for development teams.

• Develop comprehensive business cases and impact assessments for legal products, quantifying benefits (cost reduction, time savings, risk mitigation) aligned to organizational goals.

• Create and maintain detailed process maps, workflow diagrams, and requirements documentation to ensure shared understanding across stakeholders.

Strategic Alignment & Partnership

• Collaborate with the Business Product Owner to define product strategies and outcomes that address organizational business objectives.

• Actively contribute to the global legal technology strategy through technical insights and feasibility analysis, including the development and alignment of long-term goals (e.g., Data Domain & AI-driven solutions).

• Partner with external vendors and internal teams across Roche to assess existing platforms, propose innovative approaches, and ensure optimal solutions for Legal Products.

• Conduct gap analysis between current state processes and target state solutions to inform product roadmap decisions.

Vendor Selection & Requirement Management

• Collaborate with the Product Manager and the Business Owner on vendor evaluations by defining functional and technical requirements, evaluating software capabilities, and contributing expert technical criteria to Request for Proposals (RFPs).

• Build trust and act as a key interface between Roche and external service providers to ensure value delivery, feasibility, and alignment with Roche standards.

• Engage closely with Procurement to adopt Roche good practice and ensure sufficient due diligence is applied, not only on functional and technically fit, but also fulfilling the security and privacy requi

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Titolare del prodotto tecnico - Legale - Funzioni del Gruppo RDT Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto Analista e Proprietario del Prodotto Tecnico per collaborare con i Proprietari del Prodotto Business e gli stakeholder in Legal per tradurre i requisiti in soluzioni digitali strategiche. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con l'IT Product Manager per modellare la visione strategica, roadmap e la consegna dei prodotti legali all'interno di Roche. Questo include piattaforme di supporto che abbracciano team globali sia in farmacia che in diagnostica. Il Technical Business Analyst e Product Owner svolgeranno un ruolo chiave nell'analisi di processi aziendali complessi, nell'individuazione delle opportunità di ottimizzazione, e nell'accertamento dell'automazione e della digitalizzazione dei flussi di lavoro - che vanno dalla revisione e dall'approvazione ai quadri di supervisione, monitoraggio e governance - garantendo al contempo l'allineamento con la filosofia "One Roche". Informazioni sul nostro team: RDT Legal Product Seduta all'interno della più ampia divisione Legal, Compliance & Group Communication, il nostro team collabora con il dipartimento legale per consentire efficienza ed efficacia attraverso soluzioni legali specifiche. Lavorando a mano, uniamo le competenze IT con il know-how aziendale per supportare Legal in ogni fase del loro viaggio digitale. Il portafoglio Legal Product copre soluzioni per la gestione legale della spesa e della materia, la gestione dei documenti e la gestione dei contratti, nonché flussi di lavoro e reporting. Noi gestiamo l'intero ciclo di vita di queste soluzioni - se costruiamo (fare) o compriamo, gestiamo, o li gestiamo. Principali responsabilità Requisiti aziendali e analisi dei processi
• Condurre la scoperta dettagliata e l'analisi dei processi in team legali globali per identificare i punti di dolore attuali, le inefficienze e le opportunità di miglioramento.
• Tradurre complessi requisiti aziendali in chiare specifiche funzionali e requisiti tecnici per i team di sviluppo.
• Sviluppare casi aziendali completi e valutazioni d'impatto per i prodotti legali, quantificando i benefici (riduzione dei costi, risparmio di tempo, mitigazione dei rischi) allineati agli obiettivi organizzativi.
• Creare e mantenere mappe di processo dettagliate, diagrammi di flusso di lavoro e documentazione dei requisiti per garantire la comprensione condivisa tra gli stakeholder. Allineamento strategico e partenariato
• Collaborare con il proprietario del prodotto per definire le strategie e i risultati del prodotto che affrontano gli obiettivi aziendali organizzativi.
• Contribuire attivamente alla strategia globale della tecnologia legale attraverso approfondimenti tecnici e analisi di fattibilità, tra cui lo sviluppo e l'allineamento di obiettivi a lungo termine (ad esempio, soluzioni basate su Data Domain & AI).
• Partner con fornitori esterni e team interni di Roche per valutare le piattaforme esistenti, proporre approcci innovativi e garantire soluzioni ottimali per i prodotti legali.
• Condurre l'analisi del gap tra i processi attuali dello stato e le soluzioni di stato di destinazione per informare le decisioni della roadmap del prodotto. Selezione e gestione dei requisiti
• Collaborare con il Product Manager e il Business Owner sulle valutazioni dei fornitori definendo requisiti funzionali e tecnici, valutando le funzionalità del software e contribuendo a criteri tecnici esperti alla richiesta di proposte (RFP).
• Costruire la fiducia e agire come un'interfaccia chiave tra Roche e fornitori di servizi esterni per garantire la consegna del valore, la fattibilità e l'allineamento con gli standard Roche.
• Impegnarsi a stretto contatto con Procurement per adottare Roche buona pratica e garantire sufficiente due diligence è applicato, non solo su funzionale e tecnicamente adatta, ma anche soddisfare la sicurezza e la privacy richiesta

Über unser Team: RDT Legal Product Mit Sitz in der breiteren Division Legal, Compliance & Group Communication arbeitet unser Team mit der Rechtsabteilung zusammen, um Effizienz und Effektivität durch rechtsspezifische Lösungen zu ermöglichen. Wir übernehmen den gesamten Lebenszyklus dieser Lösungen - ob wir sie bauen (machen) oder kaufen, verwalten oder betreiben. Hauptzuständigkeiten Geschäftsanforderungen & Prozessanalyse
• Führen Sie eine detaillierte Entdeckung und Analyse von Prozessen in rechtlichen globalen Teams durch, um aktuelle Schwachstellen, Ineffizienzen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren.
• Übersetzen Sie komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen in klare funktionale Spezifikationen und technische Anforderungen für Entwicklungsteams.

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Propriétaire de produit technique - Légal - RDT Group Fonctions Nous sommes à la recherche d'un analyste technique d'affaires et propriétaire de produit expérimenté pour nous associer avec les propriétaires de produits d'affaires et les intervenants en droit afin de traduire les exigences en solutions numériques stratégiques. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le gestionnaire de produits informatiques pour définir la vision stratégique, la feuille de route et la livraison des produits liés au droit au sein de Roche. Cela inclut les plateformes de soutien qui couvrent les équipes mondiales à la fois Pharma et Diagnostics. L'analyste technique des affaires et le propriétaire du produit joueront un rôle clé dans l'analyse des processus opérationnels complexes, dans l'identification des possibilités d'optimisation et dans l'automatisation et la numérisation des workflows - allant de l'examen et de l'approbation aux cadres de surveillance, de surveillance et de gouvernance - tout en assurant l'alignement avec la philosophie « One Roche ». À propos de notre équipe: RDT Legal Product Siégeant au sein de la division juridique, Compliance & Communication de groupe, notre équipe s'associe au département juridique pour permettre l'efficience et l'efficacité grâce à des solutions juridiques spécifiques. Travaillant main dans la main, nous mélangeons l'expertise informatique avec le savoir-faire d'affaires pour soutenir Legal à chaque étape de leur parcours numérique. Le portefeuille de produits juridiques couvre les solutions pour la gestion légale des dépenses et des matières, la gestion des documents et la gestion des contrats, ainsi que les flux de travail et les rapports. Nous gérons tout le cycle de vie de ces solutions - que nous construisions (make) ou les achetions, les gérons ou les exploitions. • Effectuer la découverte et l'analyse détaillées des processus entre les équipes juridiques mondiales pour identifier les points de douleur actuels, les inefficacités et les possibilités d'amélioration.
• Traduire les exigences opérationnelles complexes en spécifications fonctionnelles claires et exigences techniques pour les équipes de développement.
• Élaborer des analyses de rentabilisation et des analyses d'impact complètes pour les produits juridiques, quantifier les avantages (réduction des coûts, économies de temps, atténuation des risques) alignés sur les objectifs organisationnels.
• Créer et tenir à jour des cartes de processus détaillées, des diagrammes de flux de travail et de la documentation sur les exigences afin d'assurer une compréhension partagée entre les intervenants. Alignement stratégique et partenariat
• Collaborer avec le propriétaire du produit d'entreprise pour définir des stratégies et des résultats qui répondent aux objectifs opérationnels de l'organisation.
• Contribuer activement à la stratégie mondiale en matière de technologies juridiques au moyen d'études techniques et d'analyses de faisabilité, y compris l'élaboration et l'alignement d'objectifs à long terme (par exemple, les solutions axées sur le domaine des données et l'IA).
• Partenaire avec des fournisseurs externes et des équipes internes à Roche pour évaluer les plateformes existantes, proposer des approches innovantes et garantir des solutions optimales pour les produits juridiques.
• Effectuer une analyse des écarts entre les processus actuels de l'État et les solutions de l'État cible pour éclairer les décisions relatives à la feuille de route des produits. Gestion de la sélection des fournisseurs et des besoins
• Collaborer avec le gestionnaire de produit et le propriétaire d'entreprise à l'évaluation des fournisseurs en définissant les exigences fonctionnelles et techniques, en évaluant les capacités logicielles et en fournissant des critères techniques spécialisés à la demande de propositions.
• Renforcer la confiance et agir comme interface clé entre Roche et les fournisseurs de services externes pour assurer la prestation de valeur, la faisabilité et l'alignement sur les normes Roche.
• S'engager étroitement avec les Approvisionnements pour adopter les bonnes pratiques de Roche et veiller à ce qu'une diligence raisonnable suffisante soit appliquée, non seulement sur le plan fonctionnel et technique, mais aussi pour assurer la sécurité et la protection de la vie privée

Vous appliquerez des méthodes d'outils d'IA et de tests d'agents pour permettre une qualité durable à l'échelle, dans un environnement où la qualité des logiciels est une exigence de sécurité du patient. Key Account Management - Comptes Publics

Vous êtes responsable de l’atteinte des objectifs business, de l’évolution du chiffre d’affaires et de la profitabilité des comptes.

• En étroite collaboration avec le Chef de Projet Appels d’Offres, vous coordonnez l’équipe projet engagée autour de la construction de la réponse et vous vous assurez que celle-ci permettra l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux et financiers attendus. Vous vous assurez également de la bonne contractualisation en adéquation avec les règles du Groupe et de la filiale.

• Responsable de la bonne exécution du contrat-cadre et de la satisfaction du client, vous mettez en place et suivez les indicateurs de performance pertinents pour les comptes sous votre responsabilité et engagez les équipes sur l’amélioration continue des actions. Vous êtes garant(e) de la pertinence et de l’efficacité du schéma de communication au sein des comptes.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Excellence Chapter Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose

To lead end-to-end supply chain operations for the affiliate, ensuring patients and healthcare providers have timely access to Roche’s diagnostic solutions. Guided by Roche’s purpose of "doing now what patients need next," this role also needs to focus on managing 4PL partnerships, ensuring regulatory compliance, and driving operational excellence in alignment with global and regional strategies. Furthermore, this role dedicates 20% of its capacity to act as the "FSCP Business Partner," shifting from managing functional silos to orchestrating holistic value, aiming to empower the Commercial teams to achieve aggressive sales growth. Additionally, this position serves as the Transport Safety Advisor, coordinating compliance for dangerous goods, and the Export Control Officer, ensuring adherence to corporate export guidelines.
Job scope:
## Key Responsibilities – Supply Chain Excellence Chapter Lead
1. FSCP Business Partnering (20% Time Allocation) – Focused on Accelerating Sales Growth
• Act as the SPOC to Accelerate Deal Closures (擔任單一窗口，加速案件成交): Act as the dedicated Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Commercial teams. Proactively resolve cross-functional bottlenecks (e.g., integrating supply availability, logistics planning, and financial terms) to accelerate sales velocity and improve customer responsiveness.
• Internal Orchestration via T-shaped Skills (運用T型能力進行內部整合): Cultivate and utilize T-shaped interdisciplinary capabilities to independently coordinate within Finance, Supply Chain, and Procurement silos. Deliver holistic, "ready-to-execute" solutions to the Commercial team, minimizing their communication efforts.
2. Strategic Leadership & Operational Excellence
• Strategy Execution: Design and execute supply chain strategies that reflect Roche’s mission of improving lives through diagnostics.
• S&OP Ownership: Lead the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process to ensure high demand forecast accuracy and alignment with commercial objectives.
• End-to-End Oversight: Oversee all supply chain facets, including demand planning, inventory management, procurement, distribution, and customer order management.
• Continuous Improvement: Utilize data-driven insights and Lean principles to identify cost-saving opportunities and enhance speed to market.
• Process Standardization & SOP Management: Lead the creation, regular update, and effective implementation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to enhance or improve supply chain processes in accordance with Roche Supply Chain Standards.
3. 4PL & Logistics Provider Management
• Primary Interface: Act as the lead contact for the external 4PL partner and other logistics providers to coordinate transportation, distribution, and warehousing.
• Performance Monitoring: Evaluate 4PL performance against agreed SLAs and KPIs, including delivery accuracy, lead times, and cost efficiency.
• Optimization & Risk Mitigation: Partner with providers to optimize logistics models and resolve operational issues promptly to maintain business continuity.
4. Stakeholder Collaboration & Compliance
• Cross-functional Partnership: Collaborate with Marketing, Commercial, Finance, Regulatory, and Quality teams to create a cohesive supply chain aligned with business needs.
• Quality & Regulatory Standards: Ensure all warehouse and transportation practices conform to Roche’s Quality Standards, Good Distribution Practice (GDP), and local/international regulations.
• Risk Management: Proactively ide

• Strategy Execution: Progettare ed eseguire strategie di supply chain che riflettono la missione di Roche di migliorare le vite attraverso la diagnostica.
• S&OP ProprietÃ: Guidare il processo di pianificazione delle vendite e delle operazioni (S&OP) per garantire alta precisione e allineamento delle previsioni di domanda con obiettivi commerciali.
• Supervisione end-to-end: supervisionare tutte le sfaccettature della supply chain, compresa la pianificazione della domanda, la gestione dell'inventario, l'approvvigionamento, la distribuzione e la gestione dell'ordine del cliente.

• Monitoraggio delle prestazioni: Valutare le prestazioni 4PL contro SLA e KPI concordati, compresa la precisione di consegna, i tempi di consegna e l'efficienza dei costi.
• Ottimizzazione & Risk Mitigation: Partner con i fornitori per ottimizzare i modelli logistici e risolvere i problemi operativi prontamente per mantenere la continuità aziendale. 4. Collaborazione e conformità degli stakeholder
• Partenariato interfunzionale: collaborare con i team Marketing, Commerciale, Finanza, Regolazione e Qualità per creare una catena di fornitura coerente con le esigenze aziendali.
• Standard di qualità e regolamentazione: assicurarsi che tutte le pratiche di magazzino e di trasporto siano conformi agli standard di qualità di Roche, alla buona prassi di distribuzione (PIL) e alle normative locali/internazionali.

De plus, ce rôle consacre 20% de sa capacité à agir en tant que « partenaire d'affaires FSP », passant de la gestion de silos fonctionnels à l'orchestration de valeur holistique, visant à autonomiser les équipes commerciales pour atteindre une croissance agressive des ventes. De plus, ce poste sert de conseiller en sécurité des transports, coordonnant la conformité des marchandises dangereuses et d'agent de contrôle des exportations, assurant le respect des lignes directrices ministérielles sur les exportations. Portée de l'emploi: ## Principales responsabilités – Chapitre sur l'excellence de la chaîne d'approvisionnement Chef de file 1. Partenariat d'affaires du PCSF (20 %) – Accélérer la croissance des ventes
• Agissez en tant que SPOC pour accélérer la fermeture des marchés (SPOC) pour les équipes commerciales. Résoudre les goulets d'étranglement interfonctionnels (p. ex. intégration de la disponibilité de l'offre, planification logistique et conditions financières) afin d'accélérer la vitesse de vente et d'améliorer la réactivité de la clientèle.
• L'orchestration interne via des compétences en forme de T ( Fournir des solutions globales et « prêtes à exécuter » à l'équipe commerciale, en minimisant leurs efforts de communication. 2. Leadership stratégique et excellence opérationnelle
• Exécution de la stratégie : Concevoir et exécuter des stratégies de chaîne d'approvisionnement qui reflètent la mission de Roches d'améliorer les vies grâce au diagnostic.
• Propriété des S&OP : Diriger le processus de planification des ventes et des opérations (S&OP) afin d'assurer l'exactitude des prévisions de forte demande et l'alignement sur les objectifs commerciaux.
• Surveillance de bout en bout : Surveiller toutes les facettes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, y compris la planification de la demande, la gestion des stocks, les achats, la distribution et la gestion des commandes.
• Amélioration continue : Utiliser des idées fondées sur les données et des principes Lean pour identifier les possibilités d'économie et améliorer la rapidité du marché.
• Normalisation des processus et gestion des SOP : Diriger la création, la mise à jour régulière et la mise en oeuvre efficace des procédures opérationnelles normalisées (SOP) pour améliorer ou améliorer les processus de la chaîne d'approvisionnement conformément aux normes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement Roche. 3. 4PL & Gestion des fournisseurs de logistique
• Interface primaire : agir comme contact principal pour le partenaire externe 4PL et d'autres fournisseurs de logistique pour coordonner le transport, la distribution et l'entreposage.
• Surveillance du rendement : Évaluer le rendement de 4PL par rapport aux ALS et aux ICR convenus, y compris l'exactitude de la livraison, les délais d'exécution et le rapport coût-efficacité.
• Optimisation et atténuation des risques: partenariat avec les fournisseurs pour optimiser les modèles logistiques et résoudre rapidement les problèmes opérationnels afin de maintenir la continuité des activités. 4. Collaboration des intervenants et conformité
• Partenariat interfonctionnel : Collaborer avec des équipes de marketing, commercial, financier, réglementaire et de qualité pour créer une chaîne d'approvisionnement cohérente et adaptée aux besoins des entreprises.
• Normes de qualité et de réglementation : S'assurer que toutes les pratiques d'entreposage et de transport sont conformes aux normes de qualité de Roches, aux bonnes pratiques de distribution (PIB) et aux règlements locaux et internationaux.
• Gestion des risques : ide proactif

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, CHT, SHT etc. to contribute to project delivery.

• Support the initial development and optimization of logistic processes.

• Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, e.g. draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan.

• Trained and qualified on equipment operation and procedure.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:

• Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.

• Performing the following tasks: e.g. facility cleaning, cleanroom garments preparation, cleaning and sterilization of components.

• Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.

• Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.

• Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.

• Support regular validation activities, such as autoclave requalification.

• Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area.

• Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.

Qualification and Experience
Education/Qualifications

• College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies

• 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.

• Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification is preferred.

• Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.

• Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Forte conoscenza del cGMP e dei regolamenti relativi all'industria farmaceutica, soprattutto nell'industria biologica.
• Le competenze di comunicazione fluide in inglese è preferito e la capacità di comunicare, collaborare e promuovere interazioni positive con i membri del team e gli stakeholder. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

• Formé et qualifié sur le fonctionnement et la procédure de l'équipement.
• Exécuter d'autres fonctions selon l'affectation. Fonctionnement courant:
• Assurer un fonctionnement régulier conformément aux exigences des GMP/SHE de Roches et de la réglementation.
• Effectuer les tâches suivantes : nettoyage des installations, préparation des vêtements de chambre propre, nettoyage et stérilisation des composants.
• Former les nouveaux employés et améliorer les capacités professionnelles de l'équipe.
• Manipulation des déviations pendant la production et mise en oeuvre de l'ACP.
• Diagnostiquer et résoudre rapidement les dysfonctionnements de l'équipement avec le soutien des ingénieurs d'entretien afin de minimiser les temps d'arrêt.
• Soutenir des activités de validation régulières, comme la requalification des autoclaves.
• Assurer l'exactitude, l'intégrité et la traçabilité des données pour les activités dans le domaine des BPF.
• Opérations informatiques connexes, telles que SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone. Qualification et expérience Éducation/Qualifications
• Diplôme (Pharmaceutical / Biological est préféré) et supérieur. Compétences requises
• 5 ans ou plus d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique par injection, MNC Biopharma préféré.
• Expérience dans les projets stratégiques de l'installation de remplissage aseptique, y compris la conception, la mise en service et la qualification est préférable.
• Bonne connaissance des BPF et des règlements pertinents pour l'industrie pharmaceutique, en particulier dans l'industrie biologique.
• Il est préférable d'acquérir des compétences de communication en anglais et de communiquer efficacement, de collaborer et de favoriser des interactions positives avec les membres de l'équipe et les intervenants. Enterprise Architect - Data & AI (Cross Domain)
The Principal Enterprise Architect for Data & AI provides essential architectural oversight, visionary leadership, and strategic guidance across a Cross-Domain context. Reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Architecture, this highly impactful role is specifically designed to architect and oversee Roche’s largest, most promising AI and Data use cases that span across multiple functions (Pharma R&D, Pharma Medicines, Diagnostics, Group Functions, Data, AI, EPIE, Information Security).
In this role, you will act as a principal orchestrator across the broader global architecture community. Rather than focusing on a single sub-function, you will guide cross-domain alignment to balance enterprise coherence with functional autonomy. By architecting scalable Data & AI ecosystems and defining the "digital laws" that govern them, you will safely accelerate the adoption of high-value AI capabilities while actively preventing technological fragmentation and agentic chaos.

While you will support our vertical business facing functions to implement the most complex AI solutions you will ensure that foundational AI models, data products, and agentic workflows are built for enterprise-wide reuse, aligning closely with the ambitious RDT Excellence goals to simplify our landscape and drive value through digital synergy.

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Enterprise Architect

The Principal Enterprise Architect provides essential architectural oversight, visionary leadership, and strategic guidance across a broad Cross-Domain context. In this highly impactful role, you will take on the most complex, cross-functional topics that span multiple business and technology areas.
A significant focus of your mandate will be architecting "RDT as a Business" (Informatics Domain), treating our internal Roche Digital Technology organization as a critical business line. Your scope will also encompass other overarching enterprise initiatives across and beyond RDT. You will guide others in resolving highly complex issues and problems that have widespread implications on cross-functional organizational processes and outcomes.

Description of the area

The Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) Enterprise Architecture function shapes, aligns, and executes technology strategy by connecting business ambition to investment, architecture, and delivery. For this specific role, a primary domain is Informatics (RDT scope), alongside other complex cross-enterprise domains.
You will partner closely with operational leaders, the Transformation Office, RDT Excellence, and Portfolio Management to establish a modern, integrated operating model. This area ensures that operations are built on insight generation and adhere to industry standards (e.g., IT4IT, ITIL), establishing robust architecture support for strategic internal and cross-functional initiatives.

Job Responsibilities

• Architecting the North Star for "RDT as a Business": Define target-state architectures and capability models for RDT's internal operations. Take ownership of defining and evolving the RDT Application and Technology Landscape and Data Model, ensuring robust architecture support for strategic internal initiatives.

• Operating Model optimization: Actively support the evolution of the Operating Model and integrating its elements (eg. Strategy, Portfolio, Delivery, Operations). Shift the organization toward Data-Driven Portfolio Management and Agile, AI enabled Delivery and Operations, ensuring connection to our existing IT landscape assets and providing traceability.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Enterprise Architect Il Principal Enterprise Architect fornisce una supervisione architettonica essenziale, una leadership visionaria e una guida strategica in un ampio contesto Cross-Domain. In questo ruolo altamente impattante, si prenderanno i temi più complessi e interfunzionali che abbracciano più aree di business e tecnologia. Un focus significativo del vostro mandato sarà l'architettura "RDT as a Business" (Informatics Domain), il trattamento della nostra organizzazione interna Roche Digital Technology come linea di business critica. Il vostro scopo comprenderà anche altre iniziative di impresa che vanno oltre RDT. Potrai guidare gli altri nella risoluzione di problemi e problemi altamente complessi che hanno implicazioni diffuse sui processi e sui risultati organizzativi interfunzionali. Descrizione della zona La funzione Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) Enterprise Architecture forma, allinea ed esegue la strategia tecnologica collegando l'ambizione aziendale agli investimenti, all'architettura e alla consegna. Per questo ruolo specifico, un dominio primario è Informatics (soggetto RDT), insieme ad altri complessi domini cross-enterprise. Potrai collaborare strettamente con i leader operativi, l'Ufficio Trasformazione, l'Eccellenza RDT e la Gestione Portfolio per stabilire un modello operativo moderno e integrato. Questo settore assicura che le operazioni siano costruite sulla generazione delle informazioni e aderiscano agli standard del settore (ad esempio IT4IT, ITIL), stabilendo un robusto supporto architettonico per iniziative strategiche interne e interfunzionali. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Architettare la North Star per "RDT as a Business": Definire architetture e modelli di funzionalità target-state per le operazioni interne di RDT. Prendere la proprietà di definire ed evolvere l'applicazione RDT e il paesaggio tecnologico e il modello di dati, garantendo un solido supporto di architettura per iniziative interne strategiche.
• Ottimizzazione del Modello Operativo: supporta attivamente l'evoluzione del Modello Operativo e integra i suoi elementi (ad esempio Strategia, Portfolio, Consegna, Operazioni). Spostare l'organizzazione verso Data-Driven Portfolio Management e Agile, AI abilitato Consegna e Operazioni, garantendo il collegamento ai nostri asset di paesaggio IT esistenti e fornendo tracciabilità.
• Architettura Governance & Standards ("Enable & Govern"): Guidare la governance dell'architettura per il dominio Informatics e guidare l'allineamento cross-domain attraverso Information, Technology, Business e Application Architecture. Fornire chiarezza, "strada asfaltata", e guardrails che consentono velocità ed efficacia nella consegna piuttosto che creare attrito burocratico.
• Tackling Complex Cross-Functional Topics: Guide squadra a matrice nel risolvere i problemi interfunzionali più complessi con ampie implicazioni sui processi e sui risultati organizzativi. Agire come il piombo architettonico per le principali iniziative cross-domain che vanno oltre una singola funzione, garantendo architetture coessive target in tutta l'impresa.
• Cross-Domain Coherence & Technical Debt Management: condurre rigorose valutazioni di impatto architettonico per iniziative cross-domain. Gestione attiva del debito tecnico e supporto Future State Architecture semplificando sistematicamente il paesaggio delle applicazioni, disattivando i sistemi ridondanti e stabilendo la governance per prevenire la complessità futura.
• Trasparenza Data-Driven: Promuovere la filosofia che il valore dell'architettura è misurato da decisioni migliori e risultati di consegna. Sfrutta la nostra catena di strumenti di architettura integrata (ArchiMEDES) per fornire i critici architettonici

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are a high-performing cybersecurity team tasked with protecting the organization’s computing environments. While our historical stronghold has been managing enterprise Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Application Control, and Secure Data Erasure, we are now expanding our focus to secure our dynamic, cloud-native environments.
We are looking for a Cloud Security Engineer specializing in Cloud Workload Protection. You will be responsible for securing IaaS, PaaS, containers, and serverless architectures. Working alongside your senior endpoint security colleagues, you will bridge the gap between traditional endpoint defense and modern cloud infrastructure, ensuring our threat detection and application governance standards are seamlessly extended to the cloud.

Job Responsibilities

• Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP): Architect, deploy, and manage Cloud Workload Protection Platforms ( e.g., Prisma Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Wiz, or Aqua) across our multi-cloud environment ( AWS, Azure, and/or GCP).

• Container & Kubernetes Security: Implement runtime defense, vulnerability scanning, and configuration hardening for containerized applications and orchestration platforms (EKS, AKS, GKE).

• Extending Core Services to the Cloud: Adapt our existing strategies for EDR and Application Control to function effectively in ephemeral, cloud-native workloads without degrading performance.

• DevSecOps Integration: Embed security controls directly into CI/CD pipelines (Shift-Left), ensuring images, registries, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates are scanned and secured before deployment.

• Automated Remediation: Develop automated response playbooks for cloud misconfigurations and workload alerts using serverless functions and native cloud APIs.

Qualifications

We are looking for a Cloud Security Engineer specializing in Cloud Workload Protection. You will be responsible for securing IaaS, PaaS, containers, and serverless architectures. Working alongside your senior endpoint security colleagues, you will bridge the gap between traditional endpoint defense and modern cloud infrastructure, ensuring our threat detection and application governance standards are seamlessly extended to the cloud.

• DevSecOps Integration: Embed security controls directly into CI/CD pipelines (Shift-Left), ensuring images, registries, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates are scanned and secured before deployment.

• Automated Remediation: Develop automated response playbooks for cloud misconfigurations and workload alerts using serverless functions and native cloud APIs.

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. • Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP): Architektur, Bereitstellung und Verwaltung von Cloud Workload Protection-Plattformen (z. B. Prisma Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Wiz oder Aqua) in unserer Multi-Cloud-Umgebung (AWS, Azure und/oder GCP).

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.
• 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Sicherung von Public Cloud-Workloads mit einem starken Verständnis des Shared Responsibility-Modells.
• Tiefe technische Kenntnisse über Docker, Kubernetes und Container-Orchestrierung. Sie sollten wissen, wie Sie einen Pod sichern, Containerprivilegien einschränken und Netzwerkrichtlinien verwalten.
• Bewährte praktische Erfahrung bei der Bereitstellung und Abstimmung kommerzieller oder Open-Source-Cloud-Sicherheitsplattformen (CWPP / CNAPP).
• Starkes Verständnis von Cloud-nativen Netzwerken (VPCs, Sicherheitsgruppen) und Identitäts- und Zugriffsmanagement (Least-Privilege-Rollen, Service-Accounts).
• Kenntnisse in schriftlichem und gesprochenem Englisch (C1 oder höher). Zusätzliche Qualifikationen
• Bridge Builder: Die Fähigkeit, eng mit DevOps- und Cloud-Engineering-Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und nicht als Hindernis, sondern als Enabler zu fungieren.
• Strategischer Denker: Fähigkeit, unsere bestehenden On-Premise-Sicherheitsrichtlinien zu betrachten und sie intelligent an ephemere Cloud-Umgebungen anzupassen.
• Anpassbar: Komfortables Arbeiten in einer hochdynamischen Cybersicherheitsumgebung, in der sich die Prioritäten je nach Bedarf ändern können.
• Teamplayer: Fähigkeit, effektiv mit internen und externen Teamkollegen und Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten.
• Mentoring: Bereitschaft, unsere bestehenden Senior-Endpoint-Ingenieure zu Cloud-nativen Sicherheitskonzepten zu schulen und gleichzeitig von ihrer tiefen Endpoint-Telemetrie-Expertise zu lernen. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an.
