This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Functional expertise – Primary Responsibilities & Accountabilities

• Play the role of “strategic product champion” to lead the development of the local (or above affiliate) marketing strategy and drive/coordinate branding development or evolution process

• Ensure the development of the marketing strategies and their execution with a strong focus of patient value and connected with all the strategies and solutions generated by different functions and teams

• Design and deliver delightful end-to-end customer experiences through networked way of working

• Maintain up to date knowledge of the global market for the therapy area

• Use appropriate data analytics: analyze and assesses the data to extrapolate meaning and opportunities that drives the product’s overall market strength and positioning

• Enable a wide range of tactical activities to support a seamless, well integrated brand message and overall position across multiple marketing platforms. These activities may span several customer types (e.g. payers, HCPs) and will require working knowledge across different types of marketing

• Monitor competitor activity and recommend action

• Cultivate and develop Key Opinion Leaders, product advocates and speakers Ensure that all products are actively forecasted; manage the introduction/withdrawal of products; and that product changes/updates are communicated

• Provide input into public relations and access strategy Respect the compliance with all relevant Roche guidelines and policies

Mindset & Behaviors

• Enterprise thinking, eager to learn, system thinker, self-managed & directed, bold, and being able to prioritize

• VACC mindset

• The ability to work with cross-functional teams is a must

• Ability to understand and leverage digital means and tools

• Embracing & implementing agile ways of working is a must

• Entrepreneurial mindset with good partnering capabilities (ability to deeply listen, question & understand, communicate smoothly)

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, takes risks and experiments, embrace challenges and failures, and contributes to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside Roche

Operating Principles

• Put Patients First: I always act as if patients I know are in the room and do what's best for them

• Follow the science: I seek answers through experiments, data and debate, and act on facts

• Act as one team: I care, collaborate and commit without boundaries, and trust others to do their part

• Embrace differences: I seek diverse perspectives, invite opposing views, and challenge myself and others

• Accelerate learning: I push to learn new things even if difficult, and openly share my successes and failures

• Simplify radically: I eliminate complexity, reuse with pride, and accomplish more with less

• Make impact now: I take accountability to do what's right, deliver value fast, and don't wait for certainty

• Think long term: I choose actions today that benefit future generations

Skills and Experience :

• You have at least 8 years of experience in sales, marketing (at least 1 years of marketing relevant experience/projects including work packages and gigs), digital engagement and/or commercial operations (including leadership), with demonstrable evidence of successfully partnering with customers and achieving shared goals and outcomes.

• Pharmaceutical, Diagnostics, Health Sciences, Biotechnology , Business, Marketing or other related fields preferred

• You have a proven track record of

jobs.title: Tender Analyst (Technical bachground)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity
The Tender Analyst will analyze tender reporting requirements using data from internal and external sources to provide insights to decision-makers. He/she will demonstrate a high level of responsibility and collaboration with relevant stakeholders to understand the needs and deliver the requirement, timely and with high accuracy and reliability. He/she will identify data sources and interpret trends and patterns in datasets, will construct creative data / trends visualization based on business data and market knowledge. He/she will create specifications for reports and analysis based on data elements required or available. He/she could directly produce data sets and reports for analysis using system reporting tools as required.

• Dashboard Architecture & Data Modeling : Architect the underlying data models, schemas, and calculated fields required to power advanced Tableau and BI dashboards. Ensure that data structures are optimized for rapid query performance and scalable reporting.

• Database Structure & Pipeline Engineering : Build and maintain robust database structures (DB) and ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines. Integrate disparate data streams—including distributor spreadsheets, SimplyBid master data, and external bidding news—into a single source of truth.

• Technical Governance & Systems Integration: Establish data governance protocols to ensure data integrity, security, and compliance. Collaborate with regional IT teams, system administrators, and automation engineers (including IT Interns) to align database infrastructure with broader corporate IT frameworks.

• Build strong collaborative relationships with peers that includes timely feedback and communication to gain alignment

• Perform any other duties that may be assigned from time to time as required by the business.

Who you are

• Bachelor's degree in a business, scientific or related field such as finance, marketing, MIS, IT, engineering, etc. from a reputable university (local/overseas)

• Professional Experience, Core Competencies, Mindset, and Behavioral Traits

• Minimum 3 years of experience in analytics and consulting

• Experience working in cross-functional projects

• Experience in the Healthcare Industry and MNCs will be an added advantage ●

• SAP and BI reporting tools (ie. Tableau) experience is a Must

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. La tua opportunità L'Analista di Tender analizzerà i requisiti di reporting tenero utilizzando i dati provenienti da fonti interne ed esterne per fornire informazioni ai decisori. Egli dimostrerà un alto livello di responsabilità e collaborazione con le parti interessate rilevanti per comprendere le esigenze e fornire il requisito, tempestivo e con alta precisione e affidabilità. Identificherà fonti di dati e interpreterà tendenze e modelli in dataset, costruirà dati creativi / tendenze di visualizzazione basati su dati aziendali e conoscenze di mercato. Egli creerà specifiche per report e analisi basate su elementi di dati richiesti o disponibili. Potrebbe produrre direttamente set di dati e report per l'analisi utilizzando strumenti di reporting di sistema come richiesto.
• Dashboard Architecture & Data Modeling: Architetto i modelli di dati sottostanti, gli schemi e i campi calcolati necessari per alimentare le dashboard di Tableau e BI avanzate. Assicurarsi che le strutture dei dati siano ottimizzate per le prestazioni rapide di query e la reportistica scalabile.
• Database Structure & Pipeline Engineering: costruire e mantenere robuste strutture di database (DB) e ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipeline. Integrare flussi di dati disparati, inclusi fogli di calcolo del distributore, dati master di SimplyBid e notizie di offerte esterne, in un'unica fonte di verità.
• Technical Governance & Systems Integration: Stabilire protocolli di governance dei dati per garantire l'integrità dei dati, la sicurezza e la conformità. Collabora con team IT regionali, amministratori di sistema e ingegneri di automazione (compresi IT Interns) per allineare l'infrastruttura di database con più ampi framework IT aziendali.
• Costruire forti relazioni collaborative con i pari che includono feedback tempestivi e comunicazione per ottenere allineamento
• Eseguire qualsiasi altro dovere che può essere assegnato di volta in volta come richiesto dal business. Chi sei
• Corso di laurea in un campo commerciale, scientifico o relativo, come finanza, marketing, MIS, IT, ingegneria, ecc da un'università rispettabile (locale/oltremare)
• Esperienza professionale, competenze di base, Mindset e tratti comportamentali
• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza nell'analisi e nella consulenza
• Esperienza di lavoro in progetti interfunzionali
• L'esperienza nel settore sanitario e MNCs sarà un vantaggio aggiunto ●
• L'esperienza di SAP e BI (cioè Tableau) è un must Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

Il/elle fera preuve d'un haut niveau de responsabilité et de collaboration avec les intervenants concernés afin de comprendre les besoins et de répondre aux besoins, en temps opportun et avec une grande précision et fiabilité. Il/elle identifiera les sources de données et interprétera les tendances et les tendances dans les ensembles de données, élaborera une visualisation créative des données et des tendances basée sur les données commerciales et les connaissances du marché. Il créera des spécifications pour les rapports et les analyses en fonction des éléments de données requis ou disponibles. Il/elle pourrait produire directement des ensembles de données et des rapports à analyser en utilisant les outils de notification du système au besoin.
• Dashboard Architecture & Data Modeling : Architecte les modèles de données sous-jacents, les schémas et les champs calculés nécessaires pour alimenter les tableaux de bord avancés Tableau et BI. S'assurer que les structures de données sont optimisées pour des performances de requêtes rapides et des rapports évolutives.
• Structure de base de données et génie pipelinier : Construisez et maintenez des structures de base de données robustes (DB) et des pipelines ETL (Extract, Transformer, Charger). Intégrer les flux de données disparates – y compris les feuilles de calcul des distributeurs, les données de référence SimplyBid et les nouvelles de soumissions externes – à une seule source de vérité.

• Établir des relations de collaboration solides avec les pairs, y compris la rétroaction et la communication en temps opportun pour obtenir l'harmonisation
• Exécuter toute autre tâche qui peut être assignée de temps à autre comme l'exige l'entreprise. Qui vous êtes
• Baccalauréat dans un domaine commercial, scientifique ou connexe comme la finance, le marketing, le MIS, l'informatique, l'ingénierie, etc. d'une université réputée (locale/outre-mer)
• Expérience professionnelle, compétences de base, mentalité et comportements comportementaux
• Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en analyse et conseil
• Expérience de travail dans des projets interfonctionnels
• L'expérience de l'industrie de la santé et des MNC sera un avantage supplémentaire ●
• Les outils de rapport SAP et BI (p. ex. Tableau) sont une expérience Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Information Solutions (RIS) , we believe that every line of code can improve a patient’s life. Within our Patient Software Insights group, we build a diverse portfolio of digital solutions—from web apps to desktop tools—that help healthcare providers and patients stay one step ahead of disease.
We don't just "deploy"; we deliver trust.
As a Senior DevOps Automation Engineer , you will be the guardian of our delivery lifecycle, ensuring that our life-saving software reaches those who need it with the highest quality and security.

The Opportunity: Where Engineering meets Purpose
Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is life-changing. You will join a cross-functional squad of brilliant engineers, designers, and product owners to:

• Master the Pipeline: Architect and oversee complex CI/CD ecosystems for Backend, Web, API, and Desktop environments (Windows/MacOS).

• Define the Standard: Establish best-in-class code branching and review processes that empower our dev teams.

• Automation at Scale: Use your Python mastery to eliminate manual bottlenecks and create self-healing deployment flows.

• Security & Resilience: Integrate cutting-edge SAST/DAST tools (SonarQube, Mayhem) to ensure our medical software is impenetrable.

• Lead by Example: Mentor fellow engineers and act as a technical lighthouse within the organization.

Who You Are: The Architect of Flow
You are a seasoned engineer who sees the "big picture." You are passionate about clean code, robust infrastructure, and, above all, the people you work with.
Your technical footprint:

• Proven Track Record: 7+ years of hands-on experience in high-level CI/CD automation across diverse platforms (Web, API, Lambdas, Desktop).

• The CI/CD Trio: Deep expertise in GitHub Actions , Jenkins, or GitLab CI.

• Containerization & Repos: Master of Docker/Containerd and artifact management (Nexus/Artifactory).

• The Language of Automation: Proficiency in Python (or a similar high-level language).

• Security-Minded: Experience weaving security tools (Trivy, SonarQube) into the fabric of the development process.

• Soft Skills: A collaborative spirit, a desire to mentor, and excellent English communication skills.

You’ll stand out if you bring: Familiarity with AWS, experience with testing frameworks (Appium, Selenium, JUnit), or a background in SaaS/E-commerce.

What’s in it for you? (The Roche Experience)

• Work with Purpose: Direct contact with our users to understand how your work helps people living with diabetes and other conditions.

• Innovation Culture: We welcome "technical evangelists." If you want to speak at a conference or write a blog, we’ll support you 100%.

• State-of-the-Art Tech: From native development to Infrastructure-as-Code in the cloud.

• Premium Benefits: Brand new Apple hardware, professional training budget, fitness and lunch benefits, public transport support, and language classes.

• A Hub of Talent: Join a diverse, agile environment in Sant Cugat where knowledge sharing is part of our DNA.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity,

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior DevOps Automation Engineer The Patient Software Insights group within Roche Information Solutions (RIS) is responsible for a portfolio of software solutions that support healthcare providers and patients across various applications and disease areas. For a quick look at what we do, check out Roche tech4life . The Opportunity: Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is even better! As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and QA experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software development practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users' lives at risk! You will oversee application releases and manage the automation process to support building our applications. Tasks may include scripting, testing, troubleshooting problems, and communicating issues to software engineers. Who you are: We seek an experienced, motivated Senior DevOps Software Engineer who will work closely with engineers and our product teams. Required skills to accomplish your mission:
• At least 7 years of hands-on experience automating CI/CD pipelines (for example, Backend, Web, API, Lambdas, and Desktop (Windows, MacOS)).
• Proven ability to establish code branching and review processes.
• Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language.
• Deep experience in:
• Setting up and maintaining CI systems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
• Building containers (Containerd, Docker).
• Managing artifact repositories (Nexus, Artifactory).
• Integrating SAST and DAST security tools (SonarQube, Mayhem, Trivy).
• A real enthusiasm for teamwork and helping others across different teams.
• A desire to mentor colleagues and share your knowledge.
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. The following skills significantly strengthen your application:
• Familiarity with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other cloud platforms.
• Experience in building and testing applications (e.g., JMeter, Appium, xCUITest, JUnit, Selenium),
• Background in developing digital products such as SaaS, marketplaces, and e-commerce platforms.
• Knowledge of the diabetes or similar healthcare industries. Here's what you can expect from us:
• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products
• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams
• We welcome technical evangelists, so if you are interested in any thought leadership contributions (blogs, conferences) within the realm of the organization, we are happy to support you.
• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget,...) You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the specific requirements of medical software, be it security, medical risk management, safe and resilient programming, or certifications and audits. You will have direct contact with our users, learning about their daily struggles living with diabetes, as well as customers and partners, understanding the unique needs and mechanics of healthcare systems worldwide. Interested? Great. We’d like to hear from you!

jobs.title: Business Architect – Platform Strategy and Transformation

titleByLocale.it: Business Architetto – Platform Strategy and Transformation
titleByLocale.en: Business Architect – Platform Strategy and Transformation
titleByLocale.fr: Business Architecte – Platform Strategy and Transformation

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Business Architect, you will define and maintain the architectural vision and strategy for the Roche organization, ensuring alignment with business goals and supporting the adoption and implementation of Roche’s Reference Architecture. Acting as the authority and guardian of the Reference Architecture, you will create comprehensive solutions, promote best practices, and ensure architecture components and building blocks are reusable, scalable, and align with established standards. Through collaboration across the organization, you will lead efforts to integrate applications and systems effectively, drive innovation, and uphold the architectural integrity of Roche's customer-facing products. Furthermore, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s common platform strategy by contributing to its scalability, reliability, interoperability, and alignment with the needs of digital medical products and engineering teams.
Your tasks and Responsibilities

• Architectural Guardianship: Define and maintain the Architecture roadmap and Reference Architecture, ensuring all solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the Roche Ecosystem strategy.

• Strategy & Integration: Lead the delivery of actionable technology strategies and blueprints, guiding the integration of applications using standard building blocks and reusable components.

• Platform Leadership: Drive "platform-first" approaches, identifying technical gaps and developing innovative solutions for data interoperability and event-driven frameworks.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Engineers, Product Managers, and Sales/Medical teams to support strategic outcomes and ensure consistent technological implementation across customer-facing products.

• Quality & Risk Management: Analyze non-functional requirements (security, performance, scalability) and establish governance to reduce duplication and improve system robustness.

Who you are

• Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, with at least 10+ years of experience in business/reference architecture and shared platform strategies.

• Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of platform strategies, architectural governance, APIs, and shared services models. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and frameworks like TOGAF or SAFe is highly valued.

• Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare standards such as FHIR and HL7 , along with expertise in compliance-based design and industry regulations.

• Soft Skills: Advanced consulting and communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional, global environments and translate business goals into technical roadmaps.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Business Architect, definirete e manterrete la visione architettonica e la strategia per l’organizzazione Roche, garantendo l’allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali e sostenendo l’adozione e l’implementazione dell’Architettura di riferimento di Roche. Essendo l'autorità e il tutore dell'Architettura di riferimento, creerai soluzioni complete, promuovi le migliori pratiche, e garantirai che i componenti di architettura e i blocchi di costruzione siano riutilizzabili, scalabili e allineati a standard stabiliti. Attraverso la collaborazione in tutta l'organizzazione, si porterà gli sforzi per integrare applicazioni e sistemi in modo efficace, guidare l'innovazione e sostenere l'integrità architettonica dei prodotti di Roche. Inoltre, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel promuovere la strategia di piattaforma comune di Roche, contribuendo alla sua scalabilità, affidabilità, interoperabilità e allineamento con le esigenze di prodotti medici digitali e team di ingegneria. I vostri compiti e responsabilità
• Architectural Guardianship: Definire e mantenere la roadmap di Architettura e Architettura di riferimento, assicurando che tutte le soluzioni siano scalabili, affidabili e allineate alla strategia Roche Ecosystem.
• Strategia & Integrazione: Guidare la fornitura di strategie e progetti tecnologici attuabili, guidando l'integrazione delle applicazioni utilizzando blocchi di costruzione standard e componenti riutilizzabili.
• Leadership della piattaforma: Drive "platform-first" si avvicina, identificando le lacune tecniche e sviluppando soluzioni innovative per l'interoperabilità dei dati e le strutture basate sugli eventi.
• Collaborazione Stakeholder: Partner con ingegneri, Product Manager e team Sales/Medical per supportare i risultati strategici e garantire l'implementazione tecnologica coerente tra i prodotti di customer-facing.
• Quality & Risk Management: Analizzare i requisiti non funzionali (sicurezza, prestazioni, scalabilità) e stabilire la governance per ridurre la duplicazione e migliorare la robustezza del sistema. Chi sei
• Istruzione e esperienza: Laurea o Master in Informatica o Ingegneria, con almeno 10 anni di esperienza in business/reference architettura e strategie di piattaforma condivise.
• Esperienza tecnica: profonda conoscenza delle strategie di piattaforma, governance architettonica, API e modelli di servizi condivisi. Esperienza con piattaforme cloud (AWS, Azure, o GCP) e framework come TOGAF o SAFe è altamente apprezzata.
• Conoscenza del settore: familiarità con gli standard sanitari come FHIR e HL7 , insieme alle competenze nella progettazione e regolamentazioni del settore conformi.
• Soft Skills: competenze di consulenza e comunicazione avanzate, con una comprovata capacità di collaborare in ambienti interfunzionali e globali e tradurre obiettivi aziendali in roadmap tecniche. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

• Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, with at least 10+ years of experience in business/reference architecture and shared platform strategies.

• Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of platform strategies, architectural governance, APIs, and shared services models. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and frameworks like TOGAF or SAFe is highly valued.

• Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare standards such as FHIR and HL7 , along with expertise in compliance-based design and industry regulations.

• Soft Skills: Advanced consulting and communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional, global environments and translate business goals into technical roadmaps.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Collaboration avec les intervenants : Partenariat avec les ingénieurs, les gestionnaires de produits et les équipes des ventes et des services médicaux afin d'appuyer les résultats stratégiques et d'assurer une mise en oeuvre technologique uniforme des produits destinés aux clients.
• Qualité et gestion des risques : analyser les exigences non fonctionnelles (sécurité, performance, évolutivité) et établir une gouvernance pour réduire les doubles emplois et améliorer la robustesse du système. Qui vous êtes
• Éducation et expérience: Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique ou en génie, avec au moins 10 ans d'expérience en architecture d'affaires/de référence et stratégies de plateforme partagées.
• Expertise technique : Connaissance approfondie des stratégies des plateformes, de la gouvernance architecturale, des API et des modèles de services partagés. L'expérience avec les plateformes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et les frameworks comme TOGAF ou SAFe est très appréciée.
• Connaissance du secteur : Connaissance des normes de soins de santé telles que FHIR et HL7 , ainsi que de l'expertise dans la conception fondée sur la conformité et les règlements de l'industrie.
• Compétences souples : Compétences de conseil et de communication avancées, avec une capacité prouvée de collaborer dans des environnements interfonctionnels et mondiaux et de traduire les objectifs des entreprises en feuilles de route techniques. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission Statement
Finance Enterprise Partner is a critical role to maximize Revenue and Profitability by acting as a Co-driver and Guardian of the business.
The role's core mission is to provide a holistic, forward-looking financial view of the Japanese In-Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) market, enabling leaders to make faster, better strategic decisions.
Finance Enterprise Partner is not a support function but an active co-pilot of business performance, sitting at the intersection of finance, strategy, and commercial execution to establish a profit-driven company culture to achieve long-term company ambition.

Core Responsibilities
Finance Enterprise Partner will mainly focus on three core pillars:

1. Financial Planning & Analysis
[Planning & Forecasting]

• Lead & facilitate the rolling forecast events: drive annual budget, monthly forecast, and mid-term planning, ensuring strict alignment with commercial strategy.

• Design and maintain comprehensive financial models: incorporate volume, price, product mix and cost assumptions to ensure robust and agile financial planning.

[Performance Monitoring & Visualization]

• Drive performance reviews with clear and actionable visualization: produce executive-level dashboards and visualize performance by portfolio, product, and segment to foster shared understanding and clarify current financial positioning for next actions.

• Own the Gross Margin bridge analysis and prepare financial commentary, KPI scorecards, and forward-looking outlooks to clearly explain variances between actuals, budget, and prior periods with clear business narratives.

[Business Insights & Scenario Planning]

• Provide actionable business insights: proactively identify risks and opportunities in P&L and bring data-driven recommendations, focusing on actionable strategies beyond mere analysis. Translate macro market trends (pricing pressure, tender cycles, aging demographics) into quantified financial impact and scenario analysis.

2. Advanced management decision support
[Strategic Profitability Management]

• Evaluate and challenge current strategies for new and existing businesses. Conduct product-level and customer-level margin analysis to identify revenue growth opportunities, surface dilutive contracts, and prioritize high-value segments.

[Financial modeling for Complex Deals]

• Partner on strategic deals: build deal-level financial models, ROI analyses, pricing frameworks, and risk-adjusted projections. Participate in key customer strategic business reviews, providing top management with value-added financial insights and suggestions, bringing financial credibility to commercial discussions.

[Smart Risk Taking & Problem Solving]

• Enable "Smart Risks" for complex business cases: establish a collaborative system with business members to advance tough and highly complex business cases. Maximize value by providing expert quantitative analysis, consultation, and improvement proposals that drive strategic decisions.

3. Foster Profit-Driven Culture & Establish Organizational Governance
[Profit-Driven Culture]

• Foster financial acumen across the organization: contribute to profitability improvement and cultural change by embedding a mindset where all employees routinely engage in activities for profit improvement as their own responsibility.

[Cross-Functional Value Creation]

• Drive cross-functional financial initiatives: partner with Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, Finance Excellence and other groups to model the financial impa

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Scientist - NMR Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

NMR Expert in pRED-pCMC Analytical Chemistry

In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicine. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This role is situated within the preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (pCMC) department, part of the Small Molecule Research organization in pRED Therapeutic Modalities (TMo). We pave the path for drug candidates from early research to development in a diverse, ambitious, and innovative environment. Collaborating actively with our discovery and development partners, we leverage cutting-edge technologies and scientific excellence to transform molecules into future medicines. As CMC experts, we bring a rich diversity of technical expertise in chemistry, formulation design, material science, and analytical chemistry, pioneering advancements in small molecules, peptides, and nucleic acid-based medicines.

The Opportunity

We are offering a unique opportunity for a hands-on NMR Expert in our Analytical Molecular Characterization group. As a Centre of Excellence for Analytics, we provide state-of-the-art methods and services for determining chemical structures, purities, and impurities, supporting portfolio projects throughout the entire value chain. In this role you plan, run and report NMR experiments for structure elucidation and inter- and intra-molecular interaction studies.

• Innovative Analytics: By applying cutting-edge analytics you support synthesis and formulation development enabling fast progress for projects, and identification of possible challenges.

• Method Development: You develop and implement new NMR experiments and give input for future developments of our NMR group.

• Scientific Excellence: You enhance scientific excellence by identifying relevant industry trends, and building and maintaining academic partnerships.

• Strategic Vision: You contribute deep scientific insights to shape the mid- and long-term strategy for NMR within the Roche portfolio. Working alongside the NMR group and the Leadership Team, you guide the translation of your strategic input into actionable team strategies.

• Collaboration and Relationship Building: You foster trustful relationships and effective collaboration with internal discovery and technical development teams as well as with external partners.

Who You Are

• Educational Background: Masters with a minimum of 5 years or PhD in analytical chemistry or related fields with a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in the industry.

• Technical Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of NMR analytics and its applications paired with a deep understanding of the technical and theoretical basis beyond the standard experiments for liquid and solid state NMR. Experience with other methods for biophysical characterization is a plus.

• Proven Experience: Hands on expertise in structure elucidation and interaction studies by NMR for synthetic oligonucleotides and/or peptides. Demonstrated expertise on higher order structure studies and aggregation studies.

• Mindset: You possess an open-minded and highly proactive, "just-do-it" approach. You enjoy problem-solving and developing new ways

• Analisi innovativa: Applicando analisi all'avanguardia supporti lo sviluppo di sintesi e formulazione consentendo rapidi progressi per i progetti e l'identificazione di possibili sfide.

• Visione strategica: Contribuisci approfondimenti scientifici per modellare la strategia a medio e lungo termine per NMR all'interno del portafoglio Roche. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

NMR Expert in pRED-pCMC Analytical Chemistry

In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicine. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This role is situated within the preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (pCMC) department, part of the Small Molecule Research organization in pRED Therapeutic Modalities (TMo). We pave the path for drug candidates from early research to development in a diverse, ambitious, and innovative environment. Collaborating actively with our discovery and development partners, we leverage cutting-edge technologies and scientific excellence to transform molecules into future medicines. As CMC experts, we bring a rich diversity of technical expertise in chemistry, formulation design, material science, and analytical chemistry, pioneering advancements in small molecules, peptides, and nucleic acid-based medicines.

The Opportunity

We are offering a unique opportunity for a hands-on NMR Expert in our Analytical Molecular Characterization group. As a Centre of Excellence for Analytics, we provide state-of-the-art methods and services for determining chemical structures, purities, and impurities, supporting portfolio projects throughout the entire value chain. In this role you plan, run and report NMR experiments for structure elucidation and inter- and intra-molecular interaction studies.

• Innovative Analytics: By applying cutting-edge analytics you support synthesis and formulation development enabling fast progress for projects, and identification of possible challenges.

• Method Development: You develop and implement new NMR experiments and give input for future developments of our NMR group.

• Scientific Excellence: You enhance scientific excellence by identifying relevant industry trends, and building and maintaining academic partnerships.

• Strategic Vision: You contribute deep scientific insights to shape the mid- and long-term strategy for NMR within the Roche portfolio. Working alongside the NMR group and the Leadership Team, you guide the translation of your strategic input into actionable team strategies.

• Collaboration and Relationship Building: You foster trustful relationships and effective collaboration with internal discovery and technical development teams as well as with external partners.

Who You Are

• Educational Background: Masters with a minimum of 5 years or PhD in analytical chemistry or related fields with a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in the industry.

• Technical Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of NMR analytics and its applications paired with a deep understanding of the technical and theoretical basis beyond the standard experiments for liquid and solid state NMR. Experience with other methods for biophysical characterization is a plus.

• Proven Experience: Hands on expertise in structure elucidation and interaction studies by NMR for synthetic oligonucleotides and/or peptides. Demonstrated expertise on higher order structure studies and aggregation studies.

• Mindset: You possess an open-minded and highly proactive, "just-do-it" approach. You enjoy problem-solving and developing new ways

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Change Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization. Are you a project management and project change management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be working with the Marketing Technologies organization and its solution teams . You will be responsible for successful project change delivery and translating the technical vision into practical user adoption and rollout plans. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Change Management Strategy : Creating, owning and implementing a holistic change management strategy - including engagement, readiness and adoption - in close alignment with the respective solution owner. Drive behavioral change and technology adoption to ensure effective knowledge transfer, user readiness, and the seamless adoption of new functionalities.

• Change Monitoring : Actively monitor the adoption of technical functionalities across the ecosystem. Continuously identify opportunities to enhance product usability and platform capabilities by collaborating directly with Solution Owners, users and the wider ecosystem.

• Enablement and Readiness : Drive end-to-end user adoption by defining readiness frameworks, managing cross-solution engagement strategies, and delivering practical enablement materials that empower stakeholders to autonomously execute new business processes

• Adoption Support & Feedback Loop : Serve as the primary adoption contact for usability questions. Act as the ‘voice of the user’, understanding their business needs, guiding them on how the technology solves those needs, and translating affiliate pain points into actionable feedback for the Solution Owners.

• Content Consistency : Ensure the creation, accuracy, and consistency of learning content, aligning it closely with broader communication campaigns, and global engagement activities. Providing feedback and ensuring adoption of training material.

Capability Building
Be an active member of the RSS Project Management Organization by

• Continuously improving the project management and project change management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics

• Supporting the development of upskilling content and toolkits for our team

• Actively managing your own development

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your RSS colleagues

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

• University degree with 5+ years of experience in project management and project change management.

• Proven experience in change management principles , methodologies, and applying instructional design to adult learning portfolios.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Profile:
Role Summary:
The Finance & Operations Coordinator will play a central role in ensuring the financial and operational efficiency of Roche Kazakhstan. This role acts as a bridge between local operations and the Roche Shared Services Centre in Budapest, ensuring accurate financial posting, compliance with tax regulations, and procurement coordination. The position also supports local product teams by providing financial insights and modeling to drive data-based decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Financial Coordination with Shared Services Centre (SSC):

• Act as the primary liaison between Roche Kazakhstan and the SSC in Budapest for all accounting-related matters.

• Monitor the accuracy and timeliness of financial postings, including journal entries, accruals, and reclassifications.

• Review and validate financial reports and statements to ensure they align with local and corporate accounting standards.

• Coordinate with local agency and ensure compliance with Kazakhstan’s local tax regulations (VAT, CIT, WHT, etc.)

• Coordinate with SSC and external tax advisors for tax filings and audits.

• Support the month-end and year-end closing processes by providing local context, resolving discrepancies, and ensuring proper documentation.

• Collaborate with internal and external auditors by providing required financial data and explanations during audit cycles.
2. Business Partnering & Financial Insights:

• Work closely with product team - medical and commercial teams to provide financial support for key business initiatives and decision-making.

• Build and maintain financial models for product performance, pricing scenarios and new launch planning.

• Deliver timely, relevant, and actionable insights on revenue, cost structure, profitability, and financial risks/opportunities.

• Assist in the preparation of business cases, budget planning, and forecasting processes.

• Translate complex financial data into business language for non-finance stakeholders, helping them make informed strategic and operational decisions.
3. Procurement Coordination:

• Act as the point of contact for local procurement activities, ensuring alignment with global procurement policies and local regulations.

• Guide internal stakeholders on purchasing procedures, vendor onboarding, and contract compliance.

• Support tendering processes, vendor selection, negotiation input, and supplier performance monitoring.

• Collaborate with finance and legal teams to ensure contracts are financially and legally sound.

• Monitor procurement KPIs and help identify cost-saving opportunities and process improvements.
4. Cross-functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement:

• Serve as a cross-functional facilitator to improve coordination between finance, procurement, and commercial teams.

• Identify opportunities to streamline and automate finance and procurement processes at the local level.

• Promote compliance with internal controls, financial policies, and ethical procurement practices.

• Provide training or guidance to colleagues on basic finance and procurement principles as needed.

Qualifications:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

• Recognition and International Certificates (Chamber of Professional Accountants, ACCA , CIPA , CPA , DipIFR , or equivalent).

• Proven experience in finance operations, preferably in a multinational or shared services environment.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles and tax regulations.

•

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Profilo del lavoro: Riepilogo del ruolo: Il Coordinatore Finance & Operations svolgerà un ruolo centrale nel garantire l'efficienza finanziaria e operativa di Roche Kazakhstan. Questo ruolo funge da ponte tra le operazioni locali e il Roche Shared Services Centre di Budapest, assicurando un accurato distacco finanziario, il rispetto delle normative fiscali e il coordinamento degli appalti. La posizione supporta anche i team di prodotti locali fornendo informazioni finanziarie e modellazione per guidare il processo decisionale basato sui dati. Responsabilità chiave: 1. Coordinamento finanziario con Centro Servizi condivisi (SSC):
• Agire come collegamento primario tra Roche Kazakhstan e SSC a Budapest per tutte le questioni relative alla contabilità.
• Monitorare l'accuratezza e la tempestività delle postazioni finanziarie, comprese le voci di giornale, le accruals e le riclassificazioni.
• Verificare e convalidare le relazioni finanziarie e le dichiarazioni per garantire che si allineano con gli standard contabili locali e aziendali.
• Coordinare con l’agenzia locale e garantire il rispetto delle normative fiscali locali del Kazakistan (VAT, CIT, WHT, ecc.)
• Coordinate con SSC e consulenti fiscali esterni per i depositi fiscali e gli audit.
• Sostenere i processi di chiusura di fine mese e fine anno, fornendo contesto locale, risolvendo discrepanze e garantendo una corretta documentazione.
• Collabora con i revisori interni ed esterni fornendo i dati finanziari e le spiegazioni necessarie durante i cicli di audit. 2. Business Partnering & Financial Insights:
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il team di prodotti - team medici e commerciali per fornire supporto finanziario per le iniziative aziendali chiave e il processo decisionale.
• Costruire e mantenere modelli finanziari per le prestazioni del prodotto, scenari di prezzi e nuova pianificazione di lancio.
• Fornire informazioni tempestive, pertinenti e attuabili su ricavi, struttura dei costi, redditività e rischi finanziari/opportunità.
• Assistere nella preparazione di casi aziendali, pianificazione del bilancio e processi di previsione.
• Traduci dati finanziari complessi in linguaggio aziendale per gli stakeholder non finanziari, aiutandoli a prendere decisioni strategiche e operative informate. 3. Coordinamento degli appalti:
• Agire come punto di contatto per le attività di approvvigionamento locale, garantendo l'allineamento con le politiche di approvvigionamento globale e le normative locali.
• Guida le parti interessate interne alle procedure di acquisto, all'imbarco dei fornitori e alla conformità dei contratti.
• Supporta processi di appalto, selezione dei fornitori, input di negoziazione e monitoraggio delle prestazioni dei fornitori.
• Collaborare con team finanziari e legali per garantire che i contratti siano finanziariamente e legalmente validi.
• Monitorare i KPI di approvvigionamento e aiutare a identificare le opportunità di risparmio dei costi e i miglioramenti dei processi. 4. Collaborazione trasversale e miglioramento continuo:
• Servire come facilitatore interfunzionale per migliorare il coordinamento tra finanza, appalti e team commerciali.
• Identificare le opportunità di semplificare e automatizzare i processi di finanza e di approvvigionamento a livello locale.
• Promuovere il rispetto dei controlli interni, delle politiche finanziarie e delle pratiche di approvvigionamento etico.
• Fornire formazione o orientamento ai colleghi sui principi fondamentali della finanza e dell'approvvigionamento. Qualifiche:
• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, economia o un campo relativo.
• Riconoscimento e Certificati Internazionali (Camera dei Contabili Professionali, ACCA , CIPA , CPA , DipIFR , o equivalente).
• Esperienza comprovata nelle operazioni finanziarie, preferibilmente in un ambiente di servizi multinazionale o condiviso.
• Forte comprensione dei principi contabili e delle normative fiscali. •

Die Position unterstützt auch lokale Produktteams, indem sie finanzielle Einblicke und Modellierung bietet, um datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Wichtigste Aufgaben: 1. Finanzkoordinierung mit Shared Services Centre (SSC):

• Überwachen Sie die Genauigkeit und Aktualität von Finanzbeiträgen, einschließlich Zeitschrifteneinträgen, Rückstellungen und Neuklassifizierungen.
• Überprüfen und validieren Sie Finanzberichte und -erklärungen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie mit den lokalen und unternehmensweiten Rechnungslegungsstandards übereinstimmen.
• Koordination mit der lokalen Agentur und Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der lokalen Steuervorschriften Kasachstans (MwSt, CIT, WHT, etc.)
• Koordination mit SSC und externen Steuerberatern für Steuererklärungen und Audits.

• Arbeiten Sie mit internen und externen Auditoren zusammen, indem Sie die erforderlichen Finanzdaten und Erklärungen während der Auditzyklen bereitstellen. 2. Business Partnering & Financial Insights:

• Dienen Sie als funktionsübergreifender Vermittler, um die Koordination zwischen Finanz-, Beschaffungs- und Geschäftsteams zu verbessern.
• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, Finanzierungs- und Beschaffungsprozesse auf lokaler Ebene zu rationalisieren und zu automatisieren.
• Förderung der Einhaltung interner Kontrollen, Finanzpolitik und ethischer Beschaffungspraktiken.
• Bereitstellung von Schulungen oder Anleitungen für Kollegen zu grundlegenden Finanzierungs- und Beschaffungsgrundsätzen nach Bedarf. Qualifikationen:
• Abschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Wirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• Anerkennung und internationale Zertifikate (Chamber of Professional Accountants, ACCA, CIPA, CPA, DipIFR oder gleichwertig).
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Finanzgeschäft, vorzugsweise in einem multinationalen oder Shared Services Umfeld.
• Starkes Verständnis der Rechnungslegungsgrundsätze und Steuervorschriften. •

We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. The Opportunity
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Project Management. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) zielt darauf ab, "die Art und Weise, wie Roche arbeitet, zu verändern". jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer - Endpoint
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a highly skilled Cybersecurity Engineer responsible for protecting our digital footprint at the endpoint level. Our team manages critical security products across the enterprise, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Application Control, and Secure Data Erasure.
Our team consists of deep subject matter experts in cybersecurity and we are looking for a driven, technically rigorous Security Engineer to join us. Your primary mission will be to maintain and evolve our security tools, bringing a modern, automation-first development mindset to our operational security practices to ensure optimal performance.

Job Responsibilities

• Maintenance at scale: Configure, deploy, and maintain our global Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solution across thousands of endpoints (Windows, macOS, and Linux) to ensure peak performance.

• Application Control Governance: Design, implement, and fine-tune Application Control policies (e.g., AppLocker, WDAC, or third-party equivalents) to ensure only trusted executables, scripts, and libraries run within our environment, balancing security with user productivity.

• Optimization: Continuous evaluation to minimize false positives, optimize system performance, and improve the overall signal-to-noise ratio.

• Secure Data Erasure Lifecycle: Support the maintenance and auditing of our enterprise-grade secure data wiping services.

• Automation: Leverage a development mindset to build scripts, tools, and API integrations that automate repetitive engineering tasks and deployment processes.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other senior cybersecurity experts, translating their deep security requirements into scalable, automated technical solutions.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years of proven, hands-on experience managing EDR solutions (e.g., Cortex XDR, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint) in a large-scale enterprise environment.

• Proficiency in written and spoken English (C1 or above level).

Technical Skills

• Security Foundations: Good fundamental understanding of enterprise cybersecurity, specifically around endpoint security (EDR/XDR platforms like Cortex XDR), application whitelisting, and secure data handling.

• Application Control Expertise: Strong practical experience designing, rolling out, and maintaining Application Control/Whitelisting strategies across complex organizational structures.

• OS Internals: Strong understanding of operating system architectures, processes, memory management and filesystems (Windows, Linux, macOS).

• Analytical Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to dive into complex system logs to trace issues back to their root cause.

• Automation & Deployment: Hands-on experience with configuration management and deployment tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, SCCM, Microsoft Intune, Jamf).

• Development Best Practices: Solid understanding of software development lifecycles (SDLC), version control (Git), and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

Additional Qualifications

• The "Builder" Mentality: You look at a manual, repetitive IT task and immediately think about how to write a script to do it better and faster.

• Problem Solver: Capable of troubleshooting complex deployment failures across varied endpoint environments.

• Adaptable: Comfortable working in a high

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Shape the Future of Secure Engineering with Roche

Are you ready to tackle bold challenges and make a real impact? At Roche, we’re not just building IT infrastructure — we’re engineering secure, scalable, and highly innovative software solutions that protect and empower digital health systems globally. We're looking for passionate and driven individuals to join our Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) team as a Software Engineer and help us lead the way in cutting-edge, trust-based technology.

Who We Are: A Better Tomorrow Starts Today

At Roche, everything we do is powered by our passion to transform patients’ lives. We embrace science, ethics, and innovation. We're bold in our decisions and actions because we know a brighter future depends on it. Every day, we show up to build that future — for a better world, for humankind.

Diversity and inclusion aren’t just buzzwords here; they’re essential to who we are. We believe that unique perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we are committed to building teams that reflect the extraordinary range of human potential.

Your Role: Redefine Excellence in Secure Software Engineering

As a Software Engineer within Roche's Certman PKI team, you will become a driving force behind the design, development, and evolution of our mission-critical enterprise trust and identity software. Working closely with latest technology trends, you will build the software layer that manages digital certificate lifecycles, cryptographic keys, and secure authentication. Every feature you code, every system you architect, and every application you optimize will contribute directly to safeguarding the technology that enhances people’s lives worldwide.

A Key Element of Your Contribution: As an experience C# engineer, you will design and deliver high-performance, resilient software services that power Roche's global operations. This role demands deep expertise across the full .NET stack — from advanced memory management and asynchronous programming patterns to designing secure, scalable backend systems and orchestrating containerized microservices across AWS and Kubernetes at enterprise scale. You'll apply asynchronous programming practices and design excellence to build high-throughput, low-latency APIs that meet the reliability and compliance requirements of medical devices serving patients worldwide. Your commitment to software engineering excellence, clean code principles, and robust design patterns will be fundamental to delivering seamless and secure experiences that uphold Roche's standards of quality and trust.

What You’ll Do:

As a Software Engineer in the Certman PKI team, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and evolving our certificate issuance API using ASP.NET Core (C#). You will own the end-to-end quality of the service.

You will design and implement well-versioned REST APIs, automate cryptographic and certificate lifecycle workflows, and diagnose and resolve complex performance, concurrency, or architectural bottlenecks using profiling and observability tooling.

You will deploy and operate our services natively on AWS and AliCloud, working hands-on with EKS/Kubernetes, KMS for key operations, EC2, IAM, and other core AWS building blocks. You will own and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines on GitLab and GitHub Actions — building reproducible, secure, and fully automated build, test, scan, and deploy workflows for containerized .NET services.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Position
We are building a global Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team to support critical commercial and internal platforms and applications. As an SRE, you will help design, build, and scale reliable distributed systems that power healthcare innovation worldwide.
This role is focused on reliability, scalability, automation and operational excellence. You will influence system design, define reliability standards and reduce operational toil through engineering solutions.
This role includes participation in a structured on-call rotation.

Who We Are
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

Step into the Future of IT with Roche!
As a seasoned Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at Roche, you will leverage your deep software engineering expertise to propel our products to new heights of robustness, scalability and reliability. This isn't just a role—it's an invitation to shape the backbone of technological innovations forward.

Your Mission
Design and maintain cutting-edge tools, scripts and frameworks that automate repetitive tasks, streamline software deployment and manage expansive systems with unparalleled efficiency. Partner closely with forward-thinking development teams to architect and implement high-performance solutions that elevate system efficiency, optimize resource utilization and enhance deployment processes for superior uptime and user satisfaction.

Your Impact
Lead the charge in incident management and response. Detect system anomalies, troubleshoot swiftly and conduct thorough root cause analyses to prevent recurring issues.
Champion continuous improvement by refining monitoring and alerting mechanisms, conducting insightful post-incident reviews and embedding best practices in software lifecycle management. Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant.
By joining our elite team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering seamless experiences to our end-users, exceeding business and customer demands, and solidifying Roche's reputation as a leader in IT innovation.

Your Core Responsibilities
Reliability Engineering & Architecture

• Define and implement SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product and engineering teams

• Conduct reliability reviews for new and existing services

• Design scalable, fault-tolerant architectures in AWS and Azure environments

• Lead capacity planning, performance and cost optimization initiatives

• Improve system resilience through automation and self-healing patterns

• Drive organizational observability maturity (metrics, logs, traces, alert quality)

Incident Management & Continuous Improvement

• Perform complex root cause analysis and drive rapid mitigation

• Participate in blameless postmortems and follow-through

• Improve MTTR, reduce incident frequency, and elevate production standards

• Collaborate seamlessly with engineering teams to enable timely and effective

• Design architetture scalabili e tolleranti ai guasti in ambienti AWS e Azure

• Migliorare il MTTR, ridurre la frequenza degli incidenti e elevati standard di produzione

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Project Management. Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology. You will work with solutions teams for Marketing Technologies who are tasked to deliver strategic transformation while sustaining and evolving ongoing solution operations. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Project Management & Coordination : Coordinate daily project execution across the solution area by facilitating ceremonies (scrums, sprint planning), maintaining product backlogs, and actively managing action and decision logs.

• Inbound Funnel Control & Prioritization : Act as the primary project point of contact to capture, structure, and funnel heavy volumes of cross-program requests, ensuring the product teams maintain adequate focus on prioritized objectives.

• Cross-Program Coordination : Coordinate with other programs and incoming functional demands. Actively plan, track, and facilitate complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with overarching strategic timelines.

• Dependency & Interface Management : Actively manage and track end-to-end dependencies - both internal and external - while refining handover interfaces between product owners and other functions.

The Position

Engagement Delivery

• Dependency & Interface Management : Actively manage and track end-to-end dependencies - both internal and external - while refining handover interfaces between product owners and other functions.
