descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Seit über 60 Jahren wird Roche von einer tiefgreifenden Vision geleitet: die Gesundheitsversorgung zu verändern und lebensverändernde Behandlungen für Patienten anzubieten, die sie am dringendsten benötigen.

Als Teil unseres Engagements für die Bewältigung hoher unerfüllter medizinischer Bedürfnisse wird unser Fokus auf Immunologie in der Nephrologie weiter ausgebaut, mit einem Schwerpunkt auf komplexen, immunvermittelten Nierenerkrankungen, insbesondere bei Lupus-Nephritis.
Mit mutigen Schritten, die auf Wissenschaft und Erfahrung basieren, liegt unser Fokus darauf, wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche in bessere Ergebnisse für Patienten, Gesundheitssysteme und die Gesellschaft zu verwandeln.

Um diese Vision zu erreichen, suchen wir einen engagierten Pharmaspezialisten für Immunologie (Nephrologie), der sich unserem dynamischen Team als Patient Journey Partner (PJP) anschließt. Wenn Sie eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der Pharmaindustrie und eine Leidenschaft für Immunologie und Nierenpflege haben, dann möchten wir, dass Sie ein Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte sind.

Als Patient Journey Partner (PJP) für Immunologie (Nephrologie) spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Einführung neuer Produkte in unserem spannenden Portfolio an Nephrologie- und Immunologiebehandlungen für medizinische Fachkräfte. Sie sind verantwortlich für den Aufbau und die Aufrechterhaltung starker Beziehungen zu wichtigen Nephrologie-Stakeholdern, einschließlich Nephrologen, Rheumatologen und anderen jeweiligen Gesundheitsfachkräften, um sinnvolle Lösungen zu schaffen, die die Patientenergebnisse verbessern.

Woran Sie arbeiten werden:
Als PJP decken Sie das QLD-, NT- und WA-Gebiet ab und erfüllen unabhängig Gebietsmetriken und -ziele und zeigen Belastbarkeit und Vertrauen, wenn Sie sich an robusten, evidenzbasierten wissenschaftlichen Diskussionen mit Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) beteiligen. Sie werden mit Ihrem Team zusammenarbeiten, um Kunden durch die Adoptionsleiter zu bringen und das Marktwachstum voranzutreiben, um unsere patientenorientierten Ziele zu erreichen.

Zu den Zuständigkeiten gehören unter anderem:

• Die Einführung eines neuen Produkts in unser Immunologie-Portfolio (Nephrologie) mit Gesundheitsdienstleistern vorantreiben.

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Gebietsplänen zur Maximierung der Möglichkeiten zur Wertschöpfung für unsere Stakeholder und für Roche zur Erreichung unserer Ziele

• Aufbau starker, langfristiger Beziehungen zu Nephrologen, Rheumatologen und anderen medizinischen Fachkräften

• Treffen Sie Metriken zur Kundenbindung, um die Kommunikationskanäle zu optimieren und eine regelmäßige Interaktion mit Zielkunden durch persönliche Meetings, virtuelle Anrufe, Präsentationsgespräche, Mittagessen in der Klinik / Praxis und die Teilnahme an Branchenveranstaltungen zu gewährleisten

• Bereitstellung von Expertenwissen über die klinischen Daten und den Nutzen unserer Behandlung

• Interne Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams (Marketing, Medizin usw.), um das Geschäftswachstum und die großartige Kundenerfahrung zu fördern

• Überwachung und Analyse der Gebietsleistung, der Markttrends und der Wettbewerberaktivitäten zur Anpassung der Strategien/Taktiken zur Verbesserung der Ergebnisse

• Sammeln Sie wertvolle Erkenntnisse von Kunden und kommunizieren Sie diese effektiv an das interne Team, um unsere strategischen Initiativen zu validieren und zu definieren.

• Befolgen Sie die Unternehmensrichtlinien und Branchenvorschriften und halten Sie die höchsten Standards für Professionalität und Ethik ein.

Wer du bist:
Sie sind jemand, der eine Leidenschaft für Patientenergebnisse, Unternehmensdenken und eine unternehmerische Denkweise mit einem hervorragenden Verständnis der Pharmaindustrie zeigt. Sie haben:

• 5+ Jahre oder gleichwertige Erfahrung als pharmazeutischer Fachvertreter oder in ähnlicher Funktion

• Vertiefte Kenntnis des Gesundheitssystems und der Rolle mehrerer Interessengruppen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Depuis plus de 60 ans, Roche est guidée par une vision profonde : transformer les soins de santé et offrir des traitements qui changent la vie aux patients qui en ont le plus besoin.

Dans le cadre de notre engagement à répondre à des besoins médicaux élevés non satisfaits, notre attention en immunologie continue de s'étendre en néphrologie, avec un accent principal sur les maladies rénales complexes à médiation immunitaire, en particulier dans la néphrite de Lupus.
Diriger avec des gestes audacieux, tout en étant ancrés dans la science et l'expérience, nous nous concentrons sur la transformation des percées scientifiques en meilleurs résultats pour les patients, les systèmes de santé et la société.

Pour nous aider à réaliser cette vision, nous cherchons un représentant spécialisé en immunologie (Néphrologie) Pharma pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique en tant que partenaire de voyage patient (PJP). Si vous avez une expérience éprouvée dans l'industrie pharmaceutique et une passion pour l'immunologie et les soins rénaux, alors nous voulons que vous soyez une partie de notre réussite.

En tant que partenaire d'Immunology (Nephrology) Patient Journey (PJP), vous jouerez un rôle central dans la promotion d'un nouveau lancement de produit dans notre portefeuille passionnant de traitements de néphrologie et d'immunologie auprès des professionnels de la santé. Vous serez chargé d'établir et de maintenir des relations solides avec les principaux intervenants en néphrologie, y compris les néphrologues, les rhumatologues et d'autres professionnels de la santé/personnel de pratique, afin de créer des solutions significatives qui améliorent les résultats des patients.

Ce que vous allez travailler sur:
En tant que PJP, vous couvrirez le territoire QLD, NT et WA et rencontrerez indépendamment les paramètres et les cibles du territoire, montrant ainsi la résilience et la confiance lors de discussions scientifiques solides et fondées sur des données probantes avec les professionnels de la santé. Vous travaillerez avec votre équipe pour faire progresser les clients à travers l'échelle d'adoption et stimuler la croissance du marché pour atteindre nos objectifs axés sur le patient.

Les responsabilités comprennent notamment :

• Conduire l'adoption d'un nouveau lancement de produit dans notre portefeuille d'immunologie (néphrologie) avec les fournisseurs de soins de santé.

• Élaborer et exécuter des plans de territoire pour maximiser les possibilités de créer de la valeur pour nos intervenants et pour Roche pour atteindre nos objectifs

• Établir des relations solides et durables avec les néphrologues, les rhumatologues et les autres professionnels de la santé

• Rencontrer les indicateurs d'engagement des clients pour optimiser les canaux de communication assurant un engagement régulier auprès des clients cibles par des réunions en personne, des appels virtuels, des réunions de présentation de dîners, des déjeuners cliniques et pratiques et la participation à des événements industriels

• Fournir des connaissances spécialisées sur les données cliniques et les avantages de notre traitement

• Collaborer en interne avec des équipes interfonctionnelles (marketing, médecine, etc.) pour stimuler la croissance des entreprises et une grande expérience client

• Surveiller et analyser la performance du territoire, les tendances du marché et l'activité des concurrents afin d'adapter les stratégies et les tactiques pour améliorer les résultats

• Recueillir des informations précieuses auprès des clients et les communiquer efficacement à l'équipe interne pour les aider à valider et à définir nos initiatives stratégiques.

• Respecter les politiques de l'entreprise et les règlements de l'industrie, en maintenant les normes les plus élevées de professionnalisme et d'éthique.

Qui vous êtes :
Vous êtes quelqu'un qui démontre une passion pour les résultats patients, la pensée au niveau de l'entreprise, et un esprit d'entreprise avec une excellente compréhension de l'industrie pharmaceutique. Vous avez :

• 5 ans ou plus ou niveau équivalent d'expérience en tant que représentant pharmaceutique spécialisé ou à titre similaire

• Connaissance approfondie du système de santé et rôle de plusieurs parties prenantes w

The Development Services and Integration (DSI) organization has an opportunity for a Sub-Chapter Lead to join their Design Control Excellence team. The Chapter Design Control Excellence (DCE) is part of the global Diagnostics R&D organization and belongs to the Chapter Area Development Services & Integration. The Chapter is structured across various locations in the USA, Switzerland, and Germany, and one of its main responsibilities is to provide support in executing the one global product development process for Roche Diagnostics.
As the Sub-Chapter Lead DCE US, you will lead a team across different US sites as the key point of contact within Research and Development (R&D) for providing support to execute and implement the core development processes in development projects. Your team of process experts will support development activities (e.g., risk, requirements, configuration management, etc.) by providing excellent process expertise and their efficient application.

• Manage working relationships and project-related interactions with R&D Networks, and other global and local functions like Quality and Regulatory.

• Drive efforts to gain efficiency within development projects and identify, communicate, manage, and escalate project issues and risks in a timely manner.

• As a line manager you will design and optimize team members’ personal professional journeys, coach direct reports, and collaborate closely with your global peers. You will hire and train new staff and ensure state-of-the-art technical know-how.

• Lead process enhancement activities, including working on diagnostics-wide streamlining of processes and outputs.

• Lead and integrate organizational change management activities to ensure successful adaptation of new ways of working and application of processes.

• Play a key role in creating and implementing key aspects of DCE’s strategy and ultimately contribute to the overall success of Roche Diagnostics.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor's degree in natural or engineering sciences or a similar discipline with at least 8 years of industry experience. A Master's degree is preferred.

• You have 3–5 years of experience in a diagnostics development environment and a proven track record of successful line management experience.

• You possess deep experience in Diagnostics product development activities, a thorough understanding of Quality Management Systems, and broad knowledge of R&D and related processes.

• You have a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset with a good balance between compliance, efficiency, and risk-taking.

• You have the ability to strategically navigate a changing organization, maintain objectivity, and have respect for differences of opinion, fairness, open communication, and consensus-building skills.

An additional location of Pleasanton, California is also available.

Gewährleistet die strikte Einhaltung der Unternehmensrichtlinien, der SOP und der lokalen Vorschriften für alle medizinwissenschaftlichen Initiativen für den zugewiesenen Krankheitsbereich.

● Beitrag zur Ausführung von Beiräten.

3) Wissensaustausch

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
这是一个可以让你成长为更优秀的专业人才的大好机会，你未来可以通过以下工作职责获得多方面能力的提升：

• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
• 组织和支持区域专家会议
• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

你需要具备哪些条件才能加大申请这个岗位的竞争力呢？
岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限
• 3年以上医药行业工作经验
• 既往有学术推广/市场/医学经验
• 跨职能工作经验为佳

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Commercial Support Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Commercial Support Specialist

The Opportunity

As our Commercial Application Support Specialist, you will play an essential role in maintaining the integrity and seamless operation of Roche’s commercial contract management ecosystem. You will serve as a vital link between our business operations and IT systems, ensuring data accuracy and resolving critical inquiries that empower our teams to deliver excellence worldwide.

In this role, you will:

• Drive platform stability by operationally maintaining and supporting Contract Management Lifecycle Deal Solutions systems and their integrations.

• Empower global business users by diagnosing and resolving systems inquiries, tool-handling issues, and data consistency challenges with a strong customer-centric focus.

• Collaborate across ecosystems with diverse stakeholders from local, regional, and global Business and IT teams to implement system releases smoothly.

• Champion data excellence by proactively monitoring data quality, performing root-cause analysis, and leading data cleansing initiatives to support strategic business results.

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert in cross-functional stakeholder meetings, advising on technical limitations, platform logic, and process implications.

• Foster continuous improvement by translating complex technical data into concise, actionable solutions that streamline sales and pricing processes.

Who You Are

You are an upbeat, dynamic professional who is passionate about commercial technologies and digital ecosystems. A natural problem-solver, you look at the big picture to design sustainable, scalable solutions while keeping user experience at the center of everything you do.

To thrive in this role, you bring:

• An Academic Foundation: A BSc/MSc degree in Business Administration, Finance, IT, Economics, or a related field.

• Commercial Systems Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in contract management, commercial operations, or project coordination—ideally within a global or cross-functional environment.

• Technical Curiosity: Familiarity with sales, service, or ticketing ecosystems (such as Salesforce, SAP, or ServiceNow) and a passion for mastering new digital tools.

• Analytical Precision: An outstanding analytical mindset with intermediate to advanced Excel skills and the ability to synthesize data sets into straightforward formats.

• Exceptional Communication: Excellent oral and written communication skills in English, enabling you to manage stakeholders smoothly in a fast-paced environment.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. That’s what makes us Roche.

Pl

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Specialista di supporto commerciale

L'opportunità

Come nostro Commercial Application Support Specialist, si svolgerà un ruolo essenziale nel mantenere l'integrità e il funzionamento senza soluzione di continuità dell'ecosistema di gestione dei contratti commerciali di Roche. Potrai fungere da collegamento vitale tra le nostre operazioni di business e i sistemi IT, assicurando l'accuratezza dei dati e risolvendo le richieste critiche che consentono ai nostri team di fornire l'eccellenza in tutto il mondo.

In questo ruolo, voi:

• Promuovere la stabilità della piattaforma mantenendo e supportando i sistemi Contract Management Lifecycle Deal Solutions e le loro integrazioni.

• Offrire agli utenti di business globali la diagnosi e la risoluzione di richieste di sistemi, problemi di gestione degli strumenti e sfide di coerenza dei dati con un forte focus focalizzato sul cliente.

• Collaborare tra ecosistemi con diversi stakeholder di team locali, regionali e globali di Business e IT per implementare le release di sistema senza intoppi.

• Campione dell'eccellenza dei dati monitorando proattivamente la qualità dei dati, l'esecuzione di analisi root-cause e le principali iniziative di pulizia dei dati per supportare i risultati strategici aziendali.

• Agire come esperto di materia in riunioni di stakeholder interfunzionali, consigliando limitazioni tecniche, logica della piattaforma e implicazioni di processo.

• Promuovere il miglioramento continuo traducendo dati tecnici complessi in soluzioni concise e attuabili che razionalizzano i processi di vendita e prezzi.

Chi sei

Sei un professionista innovativo e dinamico che è appassionato di tecnologie commerciali e ecosistemi digitali. Un problem-solver naturale, si guarda al grande quadro per progettare soluzioni sostenibili e scalabili mantenendo l'esperienza dell'utente al centro di tutto ciò che si fa.

Per prosperare in questo ruolo, si porta:

• Fondazione Accademica: Laurea in Business Administration, Finanza, IT, Economia o un campo relativo.

• Commercial Systems Experience: 2+ anni di esperienza professionale nella gestione dei contratti, nelle operazioni commerciali o nel coordinamento dei progetti, in un ambiente globale o interfunzionale.

• Curiosità tecnica: Familiarità con gli ecosistemi di vendita, servizio o ticketing (come Salesforce, SAP o ServiceNow) e passione per la padronanza di nuovi strumenti digitali.

• Precisione analitica: Una mentalità analitica eccezionale con competenze intermedie e avanzate di Excel e la capacità di sintetizzare i dati in formati semplici.

• Comunicazione eccezionale: ottime capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta in inglese, che ti permettono di gestire le parti interessate senza problemi in un ambiente frenetico.

In cambio vi forniamo

• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.

• Vantaggi eccellenti e flessibilità: pacchetto stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto si può spostare Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa. Garantiamo anche la flessibilità, per aiutarvi a trovare il vostro equilibrio: l'ufficio di casa è una pratica comune (2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.

• Una comunità globale inclusiva, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche.

Sie sind eine wichtige Verbindung zwischen unserem Geschäftsbetrieb und unseren IT-Systemen, gewährleisten die Datengenauigkeit und lösen kritische Anfragen, die unsere Teams dazu befähigen, weltweit Exzellenz zu liefern.

In dieser Rolle werden Sie:

• Steigern Sie die Stabilität der Plattform durch die operative Wartung und Unterstützung von Contract Management Lifecycle Deal Solutions Systemen und deren Integrationen.

• Befähigen Sie globale Geschäftsanwender durch die Diagnose und Lösung von Systemanfragen, Problemstellungen bei der Werkzeugbearbeitung und Herausforderungen bei der Datenkonsistenz mit einem starken kundenorientierten Fokus.

• Arbeiten Sie ökosystemübergreifend mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern aus lokalen, regionalen und globalen Business- und IT-Teams zusammen, um Systemfreigaben reibungslos zu implementieren.

• Champion Data Excellence durch proaktive Überwachung der Datenqualität, Durchführung von Ursachenanalysen und Leitung von Datenbereinigungsinitiativen zur Unterstützung strategischer Geschäftsergebnisse.

• Handeln Sie als Subject Matter Expert in funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholder-Meetings und beraten Sie zu technischen Einschränkungen, Plattformlogik und Prozessimplikationen.

• Förderung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung durch die Übersetzung komplexer technischer Daten in prägnante, umsetzbare Lösungen, die Verkaufs- und Preisprozesse rationalisieren.

Sie sind ein optimistischer, dynamischer Profi, der sich für kommerzielle Technologien und digitale Ökosysteme begeistert. Als natürlicher Problemlöser betrachten Sie das Gesamtbild, um nachhaltige, skalierbare Lösungen zu entwerfen und gleichzeitig die Benutzererfahrung im Mittelpunkt Ihres Handelns zu halten.

• Analytische Präzision: Eine hervorragende analytische Denkweise mit mittleren bis fortgeschrittenen Excel-Fähigkeiten und der Fähigkeit, Datensätze in einfachen Formaten zu synthetisieren.

• Außergewöhnliche Kommunikation: Hervorragende mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in englischer Sprache, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, Stakeholder in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung reibungslos zu verwalten.

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Spécialiste du soutien commercial

L'opportunité

En tant que spécialiste du soutien aux applications commerciales, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le maintien de l'intégrité et de l'exploitation transparente de l'écosystème de gestion des contrats commerciaux de Roche. Vous servirez de lien vital entre nos activités et nos systèmes informatiques, assurant l'exactitude des données et résolvant les enquêtes critiques qui permettent à nos équipes d'offrir l'excellence dans le monde entier.

Dans ce rôle, vous :

• Conduisez la stabilité de la plate-forme en maintenant et en soutenant opérationnellement les systèmes de gestion de contrats Lifecycle Deal Solutions et leurs intégrations.

• Autonomiser les utilisateurs du monde des affaires en diagnosticant et en résolvant les demandes de renseignements sur les systèmes, les problèmes de traitement des outils et les défis liés à la cohérence des données avec une forte orientation axée sur le client.

• Collaborer à l'échelle des écosystèmes avec diverses parties prenantes des équipes commerciales et informatiques locales, régionales et mondiales afin de mettre en oeuvre les rejets de systèmes en douceur.

• Championne de l'excellence en matière de données en surveillant de façon proactive la qualité des données, en effectuant une analyse des causes profondes et en menant des initiatives de nettoyage des données pour appuyer les résultats stratégiques des entreprises.

• Agir à titre d'expert en matière de réunions interfonctionnelles des intervenants, donner des conseils sur les limitations techniques, la logique de la plate-forme et les répercussions sur les processus.

• Favoriser l'amélioration continue en traduisant des données techniques complexes en solutions concises et réalisables qui simplifient les processus de vente et de tarification.

Qui vous êtes

Vous êtes un professionnel dynamique et dynamique passionné par les technologies commerciales et les écosystèmes numériques. Un problème naturel-solveur, vous regardez le grand tableau pour concevoir des solutions durables, évolutives tout en gardant l'expérience utilisateur au centre de tout ce que vous faites.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :

• Une fondation académique : un baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finance, informatique, économie ou un domaine connexe.

• Expérience en systèmes commerciaux : 2+ ans d'expérience professionnelle en gestion de contrats, en opérations commerciales ou en coordination de projets – idéalement dans un environnement global ou interfonctionnel.

• Curiosité technique : Familiarité avec les écosystèmes de vente, de service ou de billetterie (comme Salesforce, SAP ou ServiceNow) et passion pour la maîtrise de nouveaux outils numériques.

• Précision analytique : Un état d'esprit analytique exceptionnel avec des compétences Excel intermédiaires à avancées et la capacité de synthétiser des ensembles de données en formats simples.

• Communication exceptionnelle: Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite en anglais, vous permettant de gérer les intervenants en douceur dans un environnement rapide.

En échange, nous vous fournissons

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
In qualità di Engineering Manager garantirai e supporterai l'hardware, il software e/o la fornitura di servizi come focus principale, rimuovendo impedimenti, gestendo le parti interessate e creando efficienze in collaborazione ovunque possibile. Ti concentrerai sullo sviluppo delle capacità dei membri del tuo team che si allineano alla visione della funzione e incoraggeranno il tuo team a autodefinire il loro percorso di carriera e cercare modi per consentire opportunità di sviluppo nella direzione del viaggio. Li supporterete nella rimozione dei blocchi stradali e mettendo a fuoco la loro gestione delle prestazioni e assicuratevi di sviluppare il vostro team con le giuste competenze, dinamiche sane e un ritmo sostenibile.

Descrizione della zona
La funzione Digital Operations and Reliability garantisce la gestione e la manutenzione proattiva delle prestazioni ottimali, dell'affidabilità e della disponibilità di tutte le piattaforme digitali e delle Infrastrutture aziendali RDT, riducendo al minimo le interruzioni dei processi aziendali critici nella catena del valore e garantendo la conformità.
Global Operations fornisce assistenza 24x7 al Change Advisory Board Team che gestisce i processi di change board e facilita / coordina i processi di rilascio per le implementazioni di produzione.
Questo team lavorerà in collaborazione con il Major Incident / Problem Management Team e si interfacciarà a stretto contatto con il L1 Support Team.

Lei sarà:

• Team Member Capability and Career Development 
Si concentra sullo sviluppo di capacità di team ingegneristici che si allineano alle esigenze e agli obiettivi e alla visione generale della funzione. Incoraggia i membri del team a autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e consente attivamente opportunità di sviluppo che si allineano con esso. Rimuove i blocchi stradali e imposta obiettivi di performance chiari e realizzabili. Assicura che il team sviluppi le giuste competenze e dinamiche interne sane per soddisfare le sfide attuali e future.

• Salute e sostenibilità del team
Mantiene un ritmo di lavoro sostenibile per il team, bilanciando gli obiettivi di consegna con il benessere del team. Coltiva dinamiche e collaborazione di team sane, garantendo sicurezza psicologica e comunicazione aperta. Rimuove gli impedimenti che ostacolano il flusso o il morale, agendo come punto di escalation per la squadra. Assicura che i membri del team siano dotati delle competenze necessarie, pertinenti e che i ruoli siano chiaramente definiti.

• Leadership del prodotto e del servizio ⚙️
- Responsabile per la co-creazione di Product / Service Roadmap da un punto di vista tecnico, collaborando con il Product Manager che è responsabile generale. Affidabile per la consegna end-to-end del team di funzionalità come parte dello sviluppo del prodotto, garantendo l'allineamento con la roadmap del prodotto e gli standard di qualità. Imposta la messa a fuoco chiara e le priorità per il lavoro di consegna del team, garantendo l'allineamento con le roadmap del prodotto. Rimuove attivamente gli impedimenti e i blocchi stradali per progredire, aumentando quando necessario per proteggere l'attenzione del team. Gestisce e allinea le aspettative e le esigenze degli stakeholder, fornendo aggiornamenti regolari sui progressi e sui rischi. Crea efficienze in collaborazione ovunque possibile tra team e funzioni.

• Prestazioni e ottimizzazione ⏫
Definisce le metriche di successo, analizza le tendenze della capacità della forza lavoro e identifica le opportunità di ottimizzazione per raggiungere gli obiettivi aziendali. Traduce i dati in insight attuabili e comunica regolarmente le prestazioni di consegna agli stakeholder e al team più ampio. Identificare e implementa i miglioramenti dei processi all'interno del team e nelle sue interazioni con altri team per aumentare l'efficienza e la qualità

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Als Engineering Manager stellen Sie sicher und unterstützen die Hardware, Software und / oder Servicebereitstellung als Führungskraft, indem Sie Hindernisse beseitigen, Stakeholder verwalten und Effizienz in der Zusammenarbeit schaffen, wo immer dies möglich ist. Sie konzentrieren sich auf die Entwicklung der Fähigkeiten Ihrer Teammitglieder, die sich an der Vision der Funktion orientieren, und ermutigen Ihr Team, seine Karrierereise selbst zu definieren und nach Möglichkeiten zu suchen, Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in Richtung der Reise zu ermöglichen. Sie unterstützen sie bei der Beseitigung von Hindernissen und konzentrieren sich auf ihr Leistungsmanagement und stellen sicher, dass Sie Ihr Team mit den richtigen Fähigkeiten, einer gesunden Dynamik und einem nachhaltigen Tempo entwickeln.

Beschreibung des Gebiets
Die Funktion Digital Operations and Reliability gewährleistet das proaktive Management und die Aufrechterhaltung der optimalen Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Verfügbarkeit aller unternehmensweiten digitalen RDT-Plattformen und Infrastrukturen, minimiert die Unterbrechung kritischer Geschäftsprozesse entlang der Wertschöpfungskette und garantiert die Compliance.
Global Operations bietet 24x7 Service-Support mit dem Change Advisory Board Team, das die Change Board-Prozesse besitzt und die Release-Prozesse für Produktionsbereitstellungen erleichtert / koordiniert.
Dieses Team wird mit dem Major Incident / Problem Management Team zusammenarbeiten und eng mit dem L1 Support Team zusammenarbeiten.

Sie werden sein:

• Team Member Capability und Karriereentwicklung
Konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten des Engineering-Teams, die mit den unmittelbaren Projektanforderungen und -zielen und der Gesamtvision der Funktion übereinstimmen. Ermutigt die Teammitglieder, ihre Karriere selbst zu definieren und ermöglicht aktiv Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, die mit ihr übereinstimmen. Behebt Hindernisse und setzt klare, erreichbare Leistungsziele. Stellt sicher, dass das Team die richtigen Fähigkeiten und eine gesunde interne Dynamik entwickelt, um aktuelle und zukünftige Herausforderungen zu meistern.

• Team Gesundheit und Nachhaltigkeit
Behält ein nachhaltiges Arbeitstempo für das Team bei und balanciert Lieferziele mit dem Wohlbefinden des Teams. Pfleget eine gesunde Teamdynamik und Zusammenarbeit, sorgt für psychologische Sicherheit und offene Kommunikation. Entfernt Hindernisse, die den Fluss oder die Moral behindern und als Eskalationspunkt für das Team fungieren. Stellt sicher, dass die Teammitglieder mit den notwendigen, relevanten Fähigkeiten ausgestattet sind und dass die Rollen klar definiert sind.

• Produkt- und Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️
- Verantwortlich für die gemeinsame Erstellung der Produkt- / Service-Roadmap aus technischer Sicht und die Zusammenarbeit mit dem insgesamt verantwortlichen Produktmanager. Verantwortlich für die End-to-End-Bereitstellung der Funktionen des Teams im Rahmen der Produktentwicklung, um die Übereinstimmung mit der Produkt-Roadmap und den Qualitätsstandards sicherzustellen. Legt klare Schwerpunkte und Prioritäten für die Lieferarbeit des Teams fest und stellt die Abstimmung mit Produkt-Roadmaps sicher. Entfernt aktiv Hindernisse und Hindernisse für den Fortschritt und eskaliert, wenn es notwendig ist, um den Fokus des Teams zu schützen. Verwaltet und richtet die Erwartungen und Bedürfnisse der Stakeholder aus und bietet regelmäßige Updates zu Fortschritt und Risiken. Schafft Effizienz in der Zusammenarbeit, wo immer möglich, über Teams und Funktionen hinweg.

• Performance & Optimierung ⏫
Definiert Erfolgskennzahlen, analysiert Trends der Mitarbeiterfähigkeit und identifiziert Optimierungsmöglichkeiten, um Geschäftsziele zu erreichen. Übersetzt Daten in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse und kommuniziert die Lieferleistung regelmäßig an Stakeholder und das breitere Team. Identifiziert und implementiert Prozessverbesserungen innerhalb des Teams und in seinen Interaktionen mit anderen Teams, um Effizienz und Qualit zu steigern
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
En tant que gestionnaire d'ingénierie, vous assurerez et supporterez le matériel, les logiciels ou la prestation de services en tant que point de mire, en éliminant les obstacles, en gérant les intervenants et en créant des gains d'efficacité en collaboration dans la mesure du possible. Vous vous concentrerez sur le développement des capacités des membres de votre équipe qui s'alignent sur la vision de la fonction et encouragerez votre équipe à se définir elle-même leur parcours de carrière et à chercher des moyens de permettre des opportunités de développement dans la direction du parcours. Vous les accompagnerez dans la suppression des barrages routiers et en mettant l'accent sur leur gestion des performances et assurez-vous de développer votre équipe avec les bonnes compétences, dynamique saine et un rythme durable.

Description de la zone
La fonction d'exploitation et de fiabilité numériques assure la gestion et la maintenance proactives de la performance, de la fiabilité et de la disponibilité optimales de toutes les plateformes et infrastructures numériques de RDT à l'échelle de l'entreprise, minimisant les perturbations des processus opérationnels critiques dans toute la chaîne de valeur et garantissant la conformité.
Global Operations fournit un soutien de service 24x7 avec l'équipe du Conseil consultatif du changement qui possède les processus du Conseil du changement et facilite / coordonne les processus de libération pour les déploiements de production.
Cette équipe travaillera en partenariat avec l'équipe de gestion des incidents majeurs et des problèmes et interagira étroitement avec l'équipe de soutien L1.

Vous serez :

• Capacité des membres de l'équipe et perfectionnement professionnel
Se concentre sur le développement des capacités de l'équipe d'ingénierie qui correspondent aux besoins et aux objectifs immédiats du projet et à la vision globale de la fonction. Encourage les membres de l'équipe à définir eux-mêmes leur parcours de carrière et permet activement des possibilités de développement qui s'harmonisent avec elle. Enlever les barrages routiers et fixer des objectifs de rendement clairs et réalisables. S'assure que l'équipe développe les bonnes compétences et une dynamique interne saine pour relever les défis actuels et futurs.

• Équipe Santé et durabilité
Maintenir un rythme de travail durable pour l'équipe, en conciliant les objectifs de prestation et le bien-être de l'équipe. Cultiver une saine dynamique d'équipe et la collaboration, en assurant la sécurité psychologique et la communication ouverte. Supprime les obstacles qui entravent l'écoulement ou le moral, agissant comme un point d'escalade pour l'équipe. S'assure que les membres de l'équipe sont dotés des compétences nécessaires et pertinentes et que les rôles sont clairement définis.

• Leadership de la prestation des produits et des services
- Responsable de la co-création de la feuille de route produit / service d'un point de vue technique, en partenariat avec le gestionnaire de produit qui est globalement responsable. Responsable de la livraison de bout en bout des caractéristiques de l'équipe dans le cadre du développement du produit, assurant l'alignement sur la feuille de route du produit et les normes de qualité. Établir des priorités et des priorités claires pour le travail d'exécution de l'équipe, en assurant l'alignement sur les feuilles de route des produits. Supprime activement les obstacles et les obstacles au progrès, et augmente au besoin pour protéger l'orientation de l'équipe. Gérer et harmoniser les attentes et les besoins des intervenants, en fournissant des mises à jour régulières sur les progrès et les risques. Créer des gains d'efficacité en collaboration lorsque cela est possible entre les équipes et les fonctions.

• Performance et optimisation
Définit les indicateurs de réussite, analyse les tendances en matière de capacité de main-d'oeuvre et identifie les possibilités d'optimisation pour atteindre les objectifs opérationnels. Traduit les données en informations pratiques et communique régulièrement les résultats de la prestation aux parties prenantes et à l'ensemble de l'équipe. Identifie et implémente les améliorations de processus au sein de l'équipe et dans ses interactions avec d'autres équipes pour augmenter l'efficacité et qualit

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche RDT Diagnostics, we believe every patient deserves the best possible treatment. To
achieve this, our RDT DIA R&D teams must operate with clinical precision and agile efficiency. We are seeking a Technical Lead to bridge the gap between complex DIA R&D business needs and cutting-edge technology. In this role, you will be the architectural and technical lead for our Portfolio and Project

Management (PPM) ecosystem. You won't just be "managing software", you will be designing the digital backbone that allows Roche to prioritize the right life-saving innovations and bring them to market faster.

The Opportunity

• Stakeholder Partnership - Act as the primary technical consultant for RDT DIA R&D PPM to optimize workflows through automation and data-driven insights

• PPM Solution Leadership - Lead Planisware configuration implementation, translating core business requirements into actionable configurations validated through strategic PoCs

• Solution Design - Translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and compliant cloud-based architectures (SaaS/PaaS)

• Custom Built Solution Leadership - Oversee design and implementation of custom solutions, i.e., RDT DIA PPM Portal, ROMA, DP360, etc.

• Lifecycle Management - Oversee the evolution of the PPM toolset (e.g., Planisware, Jira, or custom solutions) to ensure they remain "fit-for-purpose"

• Data Governance - Ensure the integrity and flow of R&D data across the ecosystem to provide a "single source of truth" for executive decision-making

• Solution Strategy - Define the end-to-end technical vision for the RDT DIA R&D PPM landscape, ensuring seamless integration between financial planning, resource management, and stage-gate execution

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker who thrives at the intersection of DIA PPM business processes, modern PPM software, and data engineering. You understand that in Diagnostics, "speed to market" is a healthcare imperative.

• Communication - Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical senior leadership

• Agile Mindset - Comfort working within SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) or similar agile methodologies

• Experience - 5+ years of experience configuring PPM solutions with a focus on Planisware

• Experience - 7+ years in Solution Design, with a specific focus on Portfolio and Project Management (PPM) or Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems

• Domain Knowledge - Previous experience in Life Sciences, Diagnostics, or Pharmaceuticals is highly preferred. Familiarity with GxP and CSV (Computer System Validation) is a major plus

• Technical Stack - Experience with enterprise PPM tools (e.g., Planisware, Planview, etc.)

• Strong understanding of integration patterns (APIs, Data Mesh/Products, and Middleware)

• Familiarity with Cloud platforms (AWS or Azure)

• Solid collaboration and influencing skills with a proven ability to lead and inspire

• Strong analytical, logical problem-resolution skills

Why Roche?

• Impact - Your work directly supports the development of diagnostic tests that affect millions of lives

• Innovation - You will have access to the latest technology and a culture that encourages experimentation

• Growth - A global environment with extensive opportunities for cross-functional career movement

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Compensation & Benefits

The Position
At Roche RDT Diagnostics, we believe every patient deserves the best possible treatment. To
achieve this, our RDT DIA R&D teams must operate with clinical precision and agile efficiency. We are seeking a Technical Lead to bridge the gap between complex DIA R&D business needs and cutting-edge technology. In this role, you will be the architectural and technical lead for our Portfolio and Project

Management (PPM) ecosystem. You won't just be "managing software", you will be designing the digital backbone that allows Roche to prioritize the right life-saving innovations and bring them to market faster.

The Opportunity

• Stakeholder Partnership - Act as the primary technical consultant for RDT DIA R&D PPM to optimize workflows through automation and data-driven insights

• PPM Solution Leadership - Lead Planisware configuration implementation, translating core business requirements into actionable configurations validated through strategic PoCs

• Solution Design - Translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and compliant cloud-based architectures (SaaS/PaaS)

• Custom Built Solution Leadership - Oversee design and implementation of custom solutions, i.e., RDT DIA PPM Portal, ROMA, DP360, etc.

• Lifecycle Management - Oversee the evolution of the PPM toolset (e.g., Planisware, Jira, or custom solutions) to ensure they remain "fit-for-purpose"

• Data Governance - Ensure the integrity and flow of R&D data across the ecosystem to provide a "single source of truth" for executive decision-making

• Solution Strategy - Define the end-to-end technical vision for the RDT DIA R&D PPM landscape, ensuring seamless integration between financial planning, resource management, and stage-gate execution

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker who thrives at the intersection of DIA PPM business processes, modern PPM software, and data engineering. You understand that in Diagnostics, "speed to market" is a healthcare imperative.

• Communication - Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical senior leadership

• Agile Mindset - Comfort working within SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) or similar agile methodologies

• Experience - 5+ years of experience configuring PPM solutions with a focus on Planisware

• Experience - 7+ years in Solution Design, with a specific focus on Portfolio and Project Management (PPM) or Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems

• Domain Knowledge - Previous experience in Life Sciences, Diagnostics, or Pharmaceuticals is highly preferred. Familiarity with GxP and CSV (Computer System Validation) is a major plus

• Technical Stack - Experience with enterprise PPM tools (e.g., Planisware, Planview, etc.)

• Strong understanding of integration patterns (APIs, Data Mesh/Products, and Middleware)

• Familiarity with Cloud platforms (AWS or Azure)

• Solid collaboration and influencing skills with a proven ability to lead and inspire

• Strong analytical, logical problem-resolution skills

Why Roche?

• Impact - Your work directly supports the development of diagnostic tests that affect millions of lives

• Innovation - You will have access to the latest technology and a culture that encourages experimentation

• Growth - A global environment with extensive opportunities for cross-functional career movement

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist (Pathology & Sequencing Labs)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Customer Success Specialist – Pathology Lab is a field-based position that is responsible for providing pre-sales support, installation services, technical expertise, and training/education to new and existing customers (Pathology Labs, Sequencing Labs, Commercial sequencing providers). The primary role of this position is to collaborate with sales, support teams, and serve as the scientific/technical expert to help drive sales and provide support for customers. While some work may be performed remotely, this position requires approximately 50-70% travel (including overnight travel) to customer sites across India.

Key Roles &
• Responsibilities:

· Provide expert knowledge of products/applications and consultative scientific support to sales, customers, support & applications teams, cross-functional resources, and other stakeholders

· Partner with sales in the field to provide customers with the scientific and product support necessary to accelerate the sales process

o Pre-sales customer presentations/seminars
o Experimental designs
o Product evaluation and selection
o Evaluation of IHC , ISH , IF ,DP , NGS methods and workflow optimization
o Training and post-sale technical support

· Participate in scientific seminars and trade shows by providing technical presentations

· Provide installation and training support for IHC , ISH ,DP , NGS library preparation and target enrichment workflow for our customers.

· Monitor technical trends and provide feedback on competitive landscape, conceptualization of product extensions, product positioning, and application development; share with Applications Manager and Product Managers

· Report on activities in the field on a regular basis to upper management

Who You Are

You are a mid-career IHC and NGS technical professional who is enthusiastic, customer-focused, and people-oriented. You look forward to traveling and serving in a customer-facing role. You are approachable, skilled in communicating with sales, influencing customers, and translating technical language. You seek and are comfortable with autonomy and have a continuous improvement mindset.

Minimum
• Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Bio-Technology, Chemistry, Biology or Clinical Laboratory or equivalent work experience
· 5 years of experience implementing, and evaluating complex laboratory, IT products, medical diagnostic equipment, reagents and/or systems
· Field implementation and training specialist experience or related experience
· Previous experience mentoring and/or training
Preferred
• Qualifications : Master or PhD degree in science

Knowledge & Experience
· 5+ years demonstrated experience applying IHC concepts / Molecular Biology/ Sequencing /, practices, and procedures.
· 3+ years’ experience in Sequencing and other genomics technologies
· IHC, ISH, NGS applications expertise, NGS data analysis/applications

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
L'opportunità

Il Customer Success Specialist – Pathology Lab è una posizione basata sul campo che è responsabile della fornitura di supporto pre-vendita, servizi di installazione, competenze tecniche e formazione/educazione ai nuovi e esistenti clienti (Pathology Labs, Sequencing Labs, Commercial Sequencing provider). Il ruolo principale di questa posizione è quello di collaborare con le vendite, i team di supporto, e servire come esperto scientifico / tecnico per aiutare a guidare le vendite e fornire supporto per i clienti. Mentre alcuni lavori possono essere eseguiti da remoto, questa posizione richiede circa 50-70% di viaggio (compreso il viaggio notturno) ai siti dei clienti in tutta l'India.

Ruoli chiave &
• Responsabilità:

· Fornire conoscenze esperte di prodotti/applicazioni e supporto scientifico consultivo per le vendite, i clienti, i team di supporto e applicazioni, le risorse interfunzionali e altri stakeholder

· Partner delle vendite nel settore per fornire ai clienti il supporto scientifico e di prodotto necessario per accelerare il processo di vendita

o Pre-vendita presentazioni/seminari del cliente
o Progetti sperimentali
o Valutazione e selezione dei prodotti
o Valutazione dei metodi IHC , ISH , IF ,DP , NGS e ottimizzazione del flusso di lavoro
o Formazione e supporto tecnico post-vendita

· Partecipare a seminari scientifici e fiere fornendo presentazioni tecniche

· Fornire supporto di installazione e formazione per IHC , ISH ,DP , NGS preparazione libreria e flusso di lavoro di arricchimento target per i nostri clienti.

· Monitorare le tendenze tecniche e fornire feedback su paesaggio competitivo, concettualizzazione delle estensioni di prodotto, posizionamento dei prodotti e sviluppo delle applicazioni; condividere con Applications Manager e Product Manager

· Relazione sulle attività in campo regolarmente alla gestione superiore

Chi sei

Sei un professionista tecnico di media cura IHC e NGS che è entusiasta, orientato al cliente e orientato alla gente. Non vedo l'ora di viaggiare e servire in un ruolo di cliente. Cercate e siete comodi con l'autonomia e avete una mentalità di miglioramento continuo.

Minimo
• Qualifiche

· Laurea in tecnologia medica, bio-tecnologia, chimica, biologia o laboratorio clinico o esperienza lavorativa equivalente
· 5 anni di esperienza di attuazione e valutazione di laboratorio complesso, prodotti IT, apparecchiature diagnostiche mediche, reagenti e/o sistemi
· implementazione del campo e esperienza specialistica di formazione o esperienza relativa
· Esperienza precedente mentoring e/o formazione
Preferito
• Qualifiche: master o dottorato in scienze

· 5+ anni hanno dimostrato esperienza nell'applicazione dei concetti IHC / Biologia Molecolare / Sequenziamento /, pratiche e procedure.
· 3+ anni di esperienza nel Sequenziamento e altre tecnologie genomiche
· IHC, ISH, competenze applicazioni NGS, analisi o applicazioni dati NGS

The Opportunity

The Customer Success Specialist – Pathology Lab is a field-based position that is responsible for providing pre-sales support, installation services, technical expertise, and training/education to new and existing customers (Pathology Labs, Sequencing Labs, Commercial sequencing providers). The primary role of this position is to collaborate with sales, support teams, and serve as the scientific/technical expert to help drive sales and provide support for customers. While some work may be performed remotely, this position requires approximately 50-70% travel (including overnight travel) to customer sites across India.

Key Roles &
• Responsibilities:

· Partner with sales in the field to provide customers with the scientific and product support necessary to accelerate the sales process

o Pre-sales customer presentations/seminars

· Monitor technical trends and provide feedback on competitive landscape, conceptualization of product extensions, product positioning, and application development; share with Applications Manager and Product Managers

· Report on activities in the field on a regular basis to upper management

You seek and are comfortable with autonomy and have a continuous improvement mindset.

Minimum

• Compétences

· 5 ans d'expérience dans la mise en oeuvre et l'évaluation de laboratoires complexes, de produits informatiques, d'équipements médicaux de diagnostic, de réactifs et/ou de systèmes
· Expérience de spécialistes de la mise en œuvre et de la formation sur le terrain ou expérience connexe

· Expertise en applications de l'ISC, de l'ISH, de la NGS, de l'analyse et des applications des données de l'ISS
· Bioinformatique, gestion automatique des liquides
· Capacité d'apprendre les solutions Roche (c.-à-d. moléculaires, sciences de la vie, pathologie numérique, solutions informatiques) et de rester au courant des tendances de l'industrie

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS) , medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a highly autonomous, deep-dive technical investigator . You masterfully dissect complex, edge-case software failures, bridging the gap between field trouble-shooting and core R&D development teams. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity:

• You are accountable for handling complex medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of transfering to the development department.

• You act as a senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause/causal factor of software malfunctions. You master the Roche internal quality processes and understand their regulatory background to justify decisions.

• You are an interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

• You serve as a trusted technical proxy for the Principal Engineer when required.

Who you are:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.

• 5+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions

• Strong IT skills, especially the ability to read and debug complex source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues

• Good ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty.

• Good ability to present technical work to stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);

• Training, language courses, and diversified career paths are available

• Recharge Days (2 days off per quarter)

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose)

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time)

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, focusing primarily on cloud-based medical software for patients , giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages.

Your core mission will be to act as the most experienced deep-dive investigator and internal-facing team organizer, as well as the main representative for the closer stakeholders (e.g., Local teams, Development…): You will analyze complex cases, system logs, coordinate investigations with internal partners, and source code to determine the root cause or causal factor of a software malfunction/issue, particularly those involving remote patient monitoring , patient-generated data (e.g., blood glucose levels) , and predictive insights . While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes.

The Opportunity:

• You are accountable for handling complex medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for patient-facing cloud and mobile applications within the Diabetes Care portfolio.

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle at global level, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as the most senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions.

• You will coach and support more junior team members in technical and process aspects.

• You are the main interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You orchestrate work distribution, manage internal alignments, and ensure the team consistently meets its performance and compliance KPIs. Furthermore you coach your team members to systematically elevate the debugging and automation skillsets of the entire team

Who you are:

• A degree in computer science or an IT -related field

• 7+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions, showcasing strong lateral leadership, a passion for coaching people and developing agile processes

• Excellent ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty, pressure and ambiguous information.

• Strong resilience and proven ability to steer a distributed team smoothly through high-pressure, uncertain, and highly visible product quality crises.

• Excellent ability to interact with stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forward

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UN

jobs.title: Intern Terminology and Language Solutions
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GCS Knowledge & Learning Excellence (KLE) is responsible for the creation of multilingual user and service documentation, user interface texts, digital learning material, internal knowledge management, and AI readiness of content. Within KLE, the Language Operations team takes care of all aspects related to terminology, translation, localization, language models, and source language governance. To do what really matters, we are in close contact with our stakeholders, both internally and externally. As a Terminology and Language Solutions Expert, you will work in an innovative and motivated team with a great team spirit constantly striving for the best.

As intern (m/f/d), you will have a mentor within the team. You will gain insights in an interesting field and a diversified position. You will work in a motivated team with a great team spirit constantly striving for the best. Collaboration and open communication are key.

As intern, your main responsibilities will be related to:

• Managing terminology in English and in the language(s) in charge

• Maintaining the terminology management system and continuously improving the representation of multilingual knowledge

• Ensuring that quality targets, timelines, and regulatory requirements are respected and contributing to improvements of content creation and quality assurance tools, processes, and standards, in alignment with other KLE subchapters and relevant stakeholders

• Creating English user interface texts, and reviewing them for translatability, terminological correctness, and adherence to style guidelines

• Managing user feedback on the content provided by GenAI applications

Who you are

You are open to new ideas and want to constantly learn. You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You like to work in an international, performance-oriented environment. Roche can be a great starting point for you.

• You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s/Master’s program or have completed your studies a maximum of 12 months ago in linguistics, translation studies, language technology, or computational linguistics

• You have good verbal and written communication skills in English

• You have one of the following as native language: Chinese, Japanese (preferred) or another language

• Good knowledge of terminology management

• Basic knowledge of language technology and artificial intelligence

• Good knowledge of terminology management systems, taxonomies, or controlled vocabularies is beneficial

• You are motivated, reliable and like to work independently

• Strong communication skills

Compensation & Benefits
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Warsaw. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Information about the compensation package for this position will be provided ahead of any interview

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing heal

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
GCS Knowledge & Learning Excellence (KLE) è responsabile per la creazione di documentazione multilingue dell'utente e del servizio, testi dell'interfaccia utente, materiale di apprendimento digitale, gestione della conoscenza interna e la disponibilità AI di contenuti. All'interno di KLE, il team Language Operations si occupa di tutti gli aspetti relativi alla terminologia, alla traduzione, alla localizzazione, ai modelli di lingua e alla governance della lingua di origine. Per fare ciò che realmente conta, siamo in stretto contatto con i nostri stakeholder, sia internamente che esternamente. Come esperto di Terminologia e Soluzioni linguistiche, lavorerai in un team innovativo e motivato con un grande spirito di squadra che si impegna costantemente per il meglio.

Come stagista (m/f/d), avrai un mentore all'interno della squadra. Si otterrà intuizioni in un campo interessante e una posizione diversificata. Si lavorerà in un team motivato con un grande spirito di squadra costantemente sforzandosi per il meglio. La collaborazione e la comunicazione aperta sono fondamentali.

Come stagista, le tue principali responsabilità saranno legate a:

• Gestire la terminologia in inglese e nelle lingue incaricate

• Mantenere il sistema di gestione della terminologia e migliorare continuamente la rappresentazione della conoscenza multilingue

• Garantire che obiettivi di qualità, tempi e requisiti normativi siano rispettati e contribuiscano a migliorare la creazione di contenuti e strumenti di garanzia della qualità, processi e standard, in linea con altri sottocategori KLE e stakeholder rilevanti

• Creazione di testi di interfaccia utente inglese, e rivederli per traducibilità, correttezza terminologica, e l'adesione a linee guida di stile

• Gestione dei feedback degli utenti sui contenuti forniti dalle applicazioni GenAI

Chi sei

Sei aperto a nuove idee e vuoi imparare costantemente. Sei qualcuno che vuole influenzare il tuo sviluppo. Ti piace lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e orientato alle prestazioni. Roche può essere un ottimo punto di partenza per voi.

• Sei attualmente iscritto a un programma di Bachelor/Master o hai completato i tuoi studi un massimo di 12 mesi fa in linguistica, studi di traduzione, tecnologia della lingua, o linguistica computazionale

• Hai buone capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta in inglese

• Hai una delle seguenti lingue: cinese, giapponese (preferito) o un'altra lingua

• Buona conoscenza della gestione della terminologia

• Conoscenza di base della tecnologia linguistica e dell'intelligenza artificiale

• Buona conoscenza dei sistemi di gestione della terminologia, tassonomie, o vocabulari controllati è benefico

• Siete motivati, affidabili e come lavorare in modo indipendente

• Forte capacità di comunicazione

Compensazioni e vantaggi
Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Varsavia. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione.
Le informazioni sul pacchetto di compensazione per questa posizione saranno fornite prima di qualsiasi intervista

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività, e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter offrire la vita che cambia la guarigione
