At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Local Quality Responsible (LQR) (temporary contract - replacement employee on maternity leave)

Countries of responsibility: Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Turkmenistan, Mongolia, Belarus.

Purpose of the role :
The LQR is a strategic partner of the Affiliate business and is considered an extended member of the global PD Quality (PDQ) Function. They are responsible for ensuring that the Affiliate Quality Management System (QMS) and local Medical Compliance related activities are delivered in accordance with the applicable Roche standards, global and local quality strategy, and regulatory requirements.
LQRs collaborate with Affiliate and Global colleagues to proactively enable Affiliate business while providing a quality framework for a healthy Affiliate QMS that protects patient safety, ensures reliability of Roche’s data and maintains the company’s license to operate while driving continuous improvement.

Roles and responsibilities :

• Shape and advocate the Quality vision, transparency and consistency, to promote an enterprise Quality Culture that ensures the highest standards of Quality and Medical Compliance.

• Design, evolve and integrate the Affiliate QMS to facilitate high performance and networking across organizational boundaries based on business needs and regulatory requirements. Enable the realization of business opportunities by embedding quality-by-design mindsets with key stakeholders.

• Helps the affiliate and the LQR network to build the skills and mindset they need to succeed and make informed decisions.

• Connect the QMS and business strategies to create synergies, clarity and focus to accelerate outcomes, remove obstacles, and maintain high quality standards.

• Act as a trusted Quality Partner for the local Enabling Team and the business by actively engaging on strategic decisions.

• Propose, lead, participate in and actively contribute to the Affiliate and Global Networks, by sharing knowledge, enhancing stakeholder collaboration, promoting quality mindset and co-creation of quality solutions.

• Build network with external parties/bodies (e.g. Quality Associations, Regulatory Authorities, Licensing Partners) to anticipate trends, address gaps, anticipate potential impacts to QMS, build trust, mitigate regulatory risks and enhance the Company's reputation.

• Clinical Operations & RWD in Kazakhstan: Hold oversight and responsibility for Clinical Operations in Kazakhstan, ensuring procedural execution for the completion/closeout of ongoing Clinical Trials, while providing operational support for planned and upcoming Real World Data (RWD) projects

• Strong business acumen with demonstrated expertise in QMS, Medical Compliance, Service Provider Oversight, CAPA and Risk Management, process simplification

• Demonstrated applied knowledge of ICH GCP, GVP and other relevant regulations and requirements, at a global and local level

• Understanding the Quality Principles of ISO standards (e.g ISO 9001 Quality

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Responsabile della Qualità Locale (LQR) (contratto temporaneo - dipendente sostitutivo del congedo di maternità)

Paesi di responsabilità: Kazakistan, Uzbekistan, Kirghizistan, Turkmenistan, Mongolia, Bielorussia.

Oggetto del ruolo :
Il LQR è un partner strategico del business Affiliato ed è considerato un membro esteso della funzione PD Quality (PDQ). Essi sono responsabili di garantire che il sistema di gestione della qualità dell'affiliato (QMS) e le attività correlate alla conformità medica locale vengono consegnati in conformità con gli standard Roche applicabili, la strategia di qualità globale e locale, e requisiti normativi.
I LQR collaborano con i colleghi Affiliati e Global per abilitare proattivamente il business Affiliato fornendo al contempo un quadro di qualità per un QMS affiliato sano che protegge la sicurezza dei pazienti, assicura l'affidabilità dei dati di Roche e mantiene la licenza dell'azienda per operare mentre guida il miglioramento continuo.

Ruoli e responsabilità:

• Formare e sostenere la visione di qualità, la trasparenza e la coerenza, per promuovere una cultura di qualità aziendale che garantisce i più elevati standard di qualità e conformità medica.

• Progettazione, evoluzione e integrazione del QMS Affiliato per facilitare alte prestazioni e networking attraverso confini organizzativi basati su esigenze aziendali e requisiti normativi. Abilitare la realizzazione di opportunità di business incorporando mentalità di qualità per design con i principali stakeholder.

• Aiuta la filiale e la rete LQR a costruire le competenze e la mentalità di cui hanno bisogno per avere successo e prendere decisioni informate.

• Collegare il QMS e le strategie aziendali per creare sinergie, chiarezza e attenzione per accelerare i risultati, rimuovere gli ostacoli e mantenere elevati standard di qualità.

• Agire come partner di qualità affidabile per il team locale di abilitazione e l'azienda impegnandosi attivamente su decisioni strategiche.

• Proporre, guidare, partecipare e contribuire attivamente alle reti affiliate e globali, condividendo le conoscenze, migliorando la collaborazione degli stakeholder, promuovendo la mentalità di qualità e la co-creazione di soluzioni di qualità.

• Costruisci la rete con soggetti esterni (ad esempio associazioni di qualità, autorità di regolamentazione, partner di licenza) per anticipare le tendenze, affrontare le lacune, anticipare gli impatti potenziali a QMS, costruire la fiducia, mitigare i rischi normativi e migliorare la reputazione della Società.

• Operazioni Cliniche & RWD in Kazakhstan: Tenere la supervisione e la responsabilità delle operazioni cliniche in Kazakhstan, assicurando l'esecuzione procedurale per il completamento/chiusura delle prove cliniche in corso, fornendo al contempo supporto operativo per progetti Real World Data (RWD) pianificati e prossimi

• In qualità di SHE Officer presso Roche Central Asia, vi garantirà la conformità ai requisiti del Gruppo Roche SHE e alle leggi locali. Potrai supervisionare la sicurezza e le questioni ambientali, mantenere il piano di continuità aziendale e coordinare i requisiti SHE in tutti i reparti. Collaborando con la gestione senior e i dipendenti, promuoverai un posto di lavoro sicuro e sicuro e supporterai iniziative strategiche di business.

Qualifica/Conoscenze ed Esperienze

• Laurea in Medicina, Biologia, Farmacia o Scienze della Vita correlate.

• Forte acume aziendale con esperienza dimostrata in QMS, Compliance Medica, Service Provider Oversight, CAPA e Risk Management, semplificazione del processo

• Conoscenza applicata dimostrata di ICH GCP, GVP e altre normative e requisiti pertinenti, a livello globale e locale

• Comprendere i principi di qualità delle norme ISO (ad es.

Lokaler Qualitätsverantwortlicher (LQR) (befristeter Vertrag - Ersatzmitarbeiter im Mutterschaftsurlaub)

Verantwortliche Länder: Kasachstan, Usbekistan, Kirgisistan, Turkmenistan, Mongolei, Belarus.

Zweck der Rolle:
Der LQR ist ein strategischer Partner des Affiliate-Geschäfts und gilt als erweitertes Mitglied der globalen PD Quality (PDQ)-Funktion. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, sicherzustellen, dass das Affiliate-Qualitätsmanagementsystem (QMS) und lokale Medical-Compliance-Aktivitäten in Übereinstimmung mit den geltenden Roche-Standards, der globalen und lokalen Qualitätsstrategie und den regulatorischen Anforderungen durchgeführt werden.
LQRs arbeiten mit Affiliate- und Global-Kollegen zusammen, um das Affiliate-Geschäft proaktiv zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig einen Qualitätsrahmen für ein gesundes Affiliate-QMS zu schaffen, der die Patientensicherheit schützt, die Zuverlässigkeit der Daten von Roche gewährleistet und die Betriebslizenz des Unternehmens beibehält und gleichzeitig die kontinuierliche Verbesserung vorantreibt.

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Gestalten und befürworten Sie die Qualitätsvision, Transparenz und Konsistenz, um eine Unternehmensqualitätskultur zu fördern, die die höchsten Standards für Qualität und medizinische Compliance gewährleistet.

• Entwerfen, entwickeln und integrieren Sie das Affiliate-QMS, um eine hohe Leistung und Vernetzung über organisatorische Grenzen hinweg zu ermöglichen, basierend auf Geschäftsanforderungen und regulatorischen Anforderungen. Ermöglichen Sie die Realisierung von Geschäftsmöglichkeiten durch die Einbettung von qualitätsorientierten Denkweisen in wichtige Stakeholder.

• Hilft dem Affiliate und dem LQR-Netzwerk, die Fähigkeiten und Denkweisen aufzubauen, die sie zum Erfolg und zur Entscheidungsfindung benötigen.

• Verbinden Sie das QMS und die Geschäftsstrategien, um Synergien, Klarheit und Konzentration zu schaffen, um die Ergebnisse zu beschleunigen, Hindernisse zu beseitigen und hohe Qualitätsstandards einzuhalten.

• Handeln Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Qualitätspartner für das lokale Enabling Team und das Unternehmen, indem Sie sich aktiv an strategischen Entscheidungen beteiligen.

• Schlagen Sie vor, führen Sie, beteiligen Sie sich an und tragen Sie aktiv zu den Affiliate- und globalen Netzwerken bei, indem Sie Wissen austauschen, die Zusammenarbeit der Stakeholder verbessern, Qualitätsdenken fördern und gemeinsam hochwertige Lösungen entwickeln.

• Aufbau eines Netzwerks mit externen Parteien/Gremien (z. B. Qualitätsverbänden, Regulierungsbehörden, Lizenzpartnern), um Trends zu antizipieren, Lücken zu schließen, mögliche Auswirkungen auf das QMS zu antizipieren, Vertrauen aufzubauen, regulatorische Risiken zu mindern und den Ruf des Unternehmens zu verbessern.

• Klinische Operationen und RWD in Kasachstan: Beaufsichtigen und verantworten Sie die klinischen Operationen in Kasachstan, stellen Sie die prozedurale Durchführung für den Abschluss / Abschluss laufender klinischer Studien sicher und bieten Sie operative Unterstützung für geplante und bevorstehende Real World Data (RWD) -Projekte

• Als SHE Officer bei Roche Central Asia stellen Sie sicher, dass die Anforderungen der Roche Group SHE und die lokalen Gesetze eingehalten werden. Sie beaufsichtigen Sicherheits- und Umweltfragen, pflegen den Business Continuity Plan und koordinieren die SHE-Anforderungen abteilungsübergreifend. In Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung und den Mitarbeitern fördern Sie einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und unterstützen strategische Geschäftsinitiativen.

Qualifikation/Wissen und Erfahrungen

jobs.title: "Principal Scientist siRNA Design
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

Therapeutic Modalities (TMo) organization, accountable for translating disease biology into high-quality drug candidates across small molecules, large molecules, oligonucleotides, and genomic medicines. By integrating deep modality expertise with cross-disciplinary collaboration, TMo drives innovation within and across platforms to enable differentiated, sustainable therapeutic impact.

As the siRNA Design Principal Scientist, you will play a key role in designing and optimizing therapeutic siRNA against various disease targets working from Target Assessment through Lead Optimization across different disease areas. You will integrate deep scientific expertise with high quality execution of discovery programs.

The Opportunity

• Therapeutic Design Strategy: Lead the drug design strategy of oligonucleotides with a strong focus on siRNAs, leveraging computational and empirical approaches, for both initial Proof of Concept on novel targets and full-scale lead optimization for clinical development.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:
This role sits within the Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX (MMC) Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The MMC Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Raw Materials, Logistics, External Manufacturing, and Engineering. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As a Procurement Specialist in External Manufacturing (CDMO Procurement), you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Applying both general procurement and specialized knowledge or expertise in a specific commodity or spend area, you will ensure effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability.

You will collaborate closely with internal procurement (i.e. Chapters and capability areas such as customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, analytics, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing and spend management activities and content enhancement.

You will work closely with other team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to deliver productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions.

As a Delivery Specialist, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter specialist in External Manufacturing of pharmaceutical products (Pharmaceutical Drug Product and Finished Goods), conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies and tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements (such as regulatory requirements, network strategy aspects, technical aspects, flow of goods and flow of funds, inventory and supply chain aspects).

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner, ideally with a solid background in CDMO management, delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and frameworks and project management skills.

Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

Global Procurement gestisce proattivamente l'intero ecosistema dei fornitori, fornendo un contributo vitale per migliorare i risultati della salute, riducendo i costi per i pazienti e i sistemi sanitari globali, e assicurando che Roche continui a fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo.

L'opportunità:
Questo ruolo si trova all'interno del gruppo Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX (MMC) Procurement Delivery, che copre le attività principali di approvvigionamento dalla gestione della categoria, dall'approvvigionamento strategico e operativo, dalla gestione dei fornitori, dalla contrazione, dalla definizione della strategia dei contenuti e dall'esecuzione. Il gruppo MMC Procurement Delivery comprende molte comunità che raggruppano le categorie della stessa catena del valore o che hanno una comunitÃ, tra cui materie prime, logistica, produzione esterna e ingegneria. Le comunità sono i principali abilitatori di una forte competenza di categoria, consentendo la flessibilità nella risposta di consegna degli appalti alle esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri clienti.

Come Specialista di approvvigionamento nella produzione esterna (CDMO Procurement), si porterà il pensiero analitico, la pianificazione, l'esecuzione e la messa a fuoco per l'approvvigionamento e la capacità di consegna. Applicando sia l'approvvigionamento generale che le conoscenze specialistiche o le competenze in una specifica area di merce o di spesa, garantirai una consegna efficace ed efficiente dei servizi di approvvigionamento di base e un miglioramento continuo dell'automazione e della disponibilità dei contenuti.

Collaborerai a stretto contatto con gli appalti interni (vale a dire i capitoli e le aree di capacità come la gestione delle relazioni con i clienti, la contrazione, le soluzioni, l'analisi, ecc.) e gli stakeholder aziendali per tradurre le esigenze aziendali in attività di sourcing e spendere attività di gestione e valorizzazione dei contenuti.

Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con altri membri del team per supportare la domanda del cliente, migliorare l'esperienza di acquisto del cliente, fornire attività operative quotidiane, e fornire capacità e competenze per fornire produttività e altri progetti / soluzioni orientate al cliente.

Come Specialista di Consegna, si giocherà una varietà di ruoli secondo la vostra esperienza, conoscenza e requisiti aziendali generali, tra cui ma non limitato a:

• Sei uno specialista di materia tematica di categoria e sourcing nella fabbricazione esterna dei prodotti farmaceutici (Prodotto farmaceutico e prodotti finiti), conducendo il mercato e l'analisi interna per sviluppare strategie e piani tattici per come Roche dovrebbe fonte e negoziare per beni e servizi di terze parti al fine di soddisfare i requisiti degli stakeholder (come requisiti normativi, aspetti di strategia di rete, aspetti tecnici, flusso di beni e flussi di fondi, inventario e aspetti della supply chain).

• Sei un professionista della consegna di appalti, idealmente con un solido background nella gestione di CDMO, fornendo e eseguendo strategie di approvvigionamento sfruttando spendere, know-how di categoria, sourcing robusto, negoziazione, contrazione, metodologie di gestione dei fornitori e quadri e competenze di gestione del progetto.

• Si sviluppano contenuti e automazione, traducendo i risultati e le opportunità di sourcing nel contenuto e

jobs.title: Digital Campaigns Subchapter Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Global Digital Hub has newly been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Digital Campaigns Subchapter Lead at Roche, you'll have the opportunity to develop groundbreaking digital skills while fostering the growth of colleagues across the organization. This role offers an unparalleled chance to advance your leadership and functional expertise.

The Opportunity:

• You will coordinate subchapter operations, onboard and mentor team members, and ensure the team's proficiency in executing high-impact digital campaigns.

• You'll provide strategic vision and direction, optimize processes, manage escalations, and ensure seamless coordination among teams to achieve organizational goals.

• Continuously monitoring and optimizing resource utilization, you will ensure customer satisfaction and the effective delivery of objectives.

• By fostering a culture of continuous improvement, you will encourage team members to grow and develop their digital capabilities.

• You will build strong relationships with other Subchapter Leads to align on strategic priorities, accelerate decision-making, and support each other.

• Additionally, you will gather and share best practices, creating a community of learning and synergy.

• Establishing and maintaining process governance principles, you will ensure proper documentation and adherence to best practices within the scope of responsibility.

Who you are:

• As an experienced professional, you have a minimum of 8 years in digital operations with a proven track record in omnichannel marketing and content delivery.

• You have at least 3 years in coaching, leadership, and people development.

• You are an excellent communicator in English (additional languages are a plus).

• You are skilled in navigating complex, multicultural environments with strong project and change management capabilities.

• As an innovative problem-solver, you are analytical, detail-oriented, and efficient in time management.

• You are able to work under pressure and manage complex issues independently.

• You are also a tech enthusiast, passionate about technology, a quick learner, and proficient with different tools.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

La posizione

Il Global Digital Hub è stato recentemente fondato all'interno del Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali di Roche a livello globale, supportando iniziative centrali con Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting e Creative Design.

Come un Digital Campaigns Subchapter Lead a Roche, avrete l'opportunità di sviluppare competenze digitali innovative, promuovendo la crescita di colleghi in tutta l'organizzazione. Questo ruolo offre una possibilità impareggiabile di avanzare la vostra leadership e competenze funzionali.

L'opportunità:

• Potrai coordinare le operazioni subchapter, i membri del team di bordo e mentore, e garantire la competenza del team nell'esecuzione di campagne digitali ad alto impatto.

• Potrai fornire visione strategica e direzione, ottimizzare i processi, gestire le escalation e garantire un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità tra i team per raggiungere obiettivi organizzativi.

• Monitoraggio continuo e ottimizzazione dell'utilizzo delle risorse, garantirai la soddisfazione del cliente e la consegna efficace degli obiettivi.

• Promuovere una cultura di miglioramento continuo, incoraggerete i membri del team a crescere e sviluppare le loro capacità digitali.

• Costruirete forti relazioni con altri Subchapter Conduce ad allinearsi alle priorità strategiche, accelerare il processo decisionale e supportarsi a vicenda.

• Inoltre, raccoglierai e condividere le migliori pratiche, creando una comunità di apprendimento e sinergia.

• Stabilire e mantenere i principi di governance dei processi, si assicurerà la corretta documentazione e l'adesione alle migliori pratiche nell'ambito della responsabilità.

Chi sei:

• Come professionista esperto, si dispone di un minimo di 8 anni in operazioni digitali con un record di traccia comprovato in marketing omnicanale e la consegna dei contenuti.

• Hai almeno 3 anni di coaching, leadership e sviluppo della gente.

• Sei un ottimo comunicatore in inglese (le lingue aggiuntive sono un plus).

• Siete abili nella navigazione di ambienti complessi e multiculturali con forti capacità di progettazione e gestione dei cambiamenti.

• Come un innovativo problem-solver, sei analitico, orientato ai dettagli ed efficiente nella gestione del tempo.

• Siete in grado di lavorare sotto pressione e gestire problemi complessi indipendentemente.

• Sei anche un appassionato di tecnologia, appassionato di tecnologia, un apprendimento rapido e competente con diversi strumenti.

In cambio vi forniamo:

• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.

• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.

• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.

• Una comunità globale inclusiva, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Der Global Digital Hub wurde im Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest neu gegründet. Unser Hauptzweck ist es, die digitalen Fähigkeiten von Roche weltweit zu stärken, indem wir zentrale Initiativen wie Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting und Creative Design unterstützen.

Als Teilkapitelleiter für digitale Kampagnen bei Roche haben Sie die Möglichkeit, bahnbrechende digitale Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln und gleichzeitig das Wachstum von Kollegen im gesamten Unternehmen zu fördern. Diese Rolle bietet eine beispiellose Chance, Ihre Führung und funktionale Expertise zu verbessern.

Die Gelegenheit:

• Sie koordinieren Unterkapiteloperationen, Onboard- und Mentor-Teammitglieder und stellen die Kompetenz des Teams bei der Durchführung von wirkungsvollen digitalen Kampagnen sicher.

• Sie bieten strategische Vision und Richtung, optimieren Prozesse, verwalten Eskalationen und sorgen für eine nahtlose Koordination zwischen den Teams, um organisatorische Ziele zu erreichen.

• Durch die kontinuierliche Überwachung und Optimierung der Ressourcenauslastung stellen Sie die Kundenzufriedenheit und die effektive Erfüllung der Ziele sicher.

• Indem Sie eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung fördern, ermutigen Sie die Teammitglieder, ihre digitalen Fähigkeiten zu erweitern und zu entwickeln.

• Sie werden starke Beziehungen zu anderen Unterkapitel-Leads aufbauen, um sich auf strategische Prioritäten auszurichten, die Entscheidungsfindung zu beschleunigen und sich gegenseitig zu unterstützen.

• Darüber hinaus werden Sie Best Practices sammeln und teilen, um eine Gemeinschaft von Lernen und Synergie zu schaffen.

• Durch die Festlegung und Aufrechterhaltung von Prozess-Governance-Prinzipien stellen Sie eine ordnungsgemäße Dokumentation und Einhaltung von Best Practices im Rahmen der Verantwortung sicher.

Wer du bist:

• Als erfahrener Fachmann haben Sie mindestens 8 Jahre im digitalen Betrieb mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz im Omnichannel-Marketing und der Bereitstellung von Inhalten.

• Sie haben mindestens 3 Jahre in Coaching, Führung und Entwicklung von Menschen.

• Sie sind ein ausgezeichneter Kommunikator in Englisch (zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein Plus).

• Sie sind in der Navigation durch komplexe, multikulturelle Umgebungen mit starken Projekt- und Change-Management-Fähigkeiten qualifiziert.

• Als innovativer Problemlöser sind Sie analytisch, detailorientiert und effizient im Zeitmanagement.

• Sie können unter Druck arbeiten und komplexe Themen selbstständig bewältigen.

• Sie sind auch ein Tech-Enthusiast, leidenschaftlich für Technologie, ein schneller Lerner und mit verschiedenen Tools vertraut.

Im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen:

• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Roche ist reich an Lernressourcen. Wir bieten ständige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, kostenlose Sprachkurse & Trainings, die Möglichkeit internationaler Einsätze, interne Positionswechsel und die Möglichkeit, die eigene Karriere zu gestalten.

• Ausgezeichnete Vorteile: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Cafeteria-Paket, Jahresbonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, Coaching / Mentoring-Möglichkeit, Buddy-Programm, Teamgebäude, Feiertagsparty.

• Flexibilität: Wir unterstützen auch Flexibilität, um Ihnen zu helfen, Ihr Gleichgewicht zu finden. Home Office ist allgemein verfügbar (in der Regel 2 Bürotage / Woche im Durchschnitt). Wir schaffen die Möglichkeit zur Arbeitsfreiheit, in der Ihr Firmen- und Privatleben in Harmonie koexistieren.

• Eine globale inklusive Gemeinschaft, in der wir voneinander lernen. Bei Roche kooperieren, diskutieren, treffen Entscheidungen, feiern Erfolge und haben Spaß als Team. Unsere Führung ist sehr auf Menschen ausgerichtet und schafft eine starke, integrative Kultur, so dass Sie immer die Möglichkeit haben, Ihre Meinung zu teilen.

• JOB DESCRIPTION
• GROUP LEADER OF ANTIBODY ENGINEERING at China Innovation Center of Roche (CICoR)

At Roche, over 100,000 colleagues worldwide are working together and doing what patients need next. Our ambition is to deliver novel therapeutics, diagnostic solutions and insights to patients with game changing clinical benefits. China Innovation Center of Roche (CICoR) is seeking a Group Leader and (Senior) Principal Scientist of Antibody Engineering in Biologics Discovery and Development Department with a keen interest and deep knowledge in drug discovery and development, who will lead the antibody generation, engineering and optimization efforts to deliver novel therapeutic antibody clinical candidates in Oncology, Immunology and CVRM. This leader will contribute to evolving the Antibody Discovery strategy. This leader will collaborate with colleagues in Biologics Discovery and Development, Lead Discovery, Pharmaceutical Sciences and disease areas to advance the biologics discovery programs into early development.
This is a high impact leadership position in a multi-national company R&D setting. We are looking for someone who welcomes and thrives in challenges, shapes strategy and vision with the team and continuously supports and develops every member of the team. The position calls for urgency to constantly innovate our technologies and translate relevant disease biology into impactful therapeutic candidates, and to seamlessly interface with other modalities, disease areas and global functions and to be a part of a strong global research network.

• ● Collaborate with Lead Discovery and Pharmaceutical Sciences to expand antibody discovery capabilities to drive in-house antibody discovery projects
• ● Evolve the antibody discovery strategy in the new AI era to meet the needs of CICoR discovery area strategies
• ● Lead your team to contribute to delivery of novel therapeutic antibody candidates
• ● Balance development of internal technologies/capabilities/capacities with external innovations/collaborations.
• ● Establish and maintain strong relationships with CROs and biotech companies in the Chinese ecosystem.
• ● Possess a strong ownership of LM discovery portfolio and contribute to project strategies in the context of the portfolio.
• ● Collaborate with all scientific functions and enable cross-functional project teams.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Within the Mechanical Engineering department at Roche R&D Near Patient Care, you will help develop blood glucose meters, continuous glucose monitoring systems, and related application systems (e.g., test stands) for series production—all in accordance with relevant standards and regulatory guidelines.

As a Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will be an integral member of an agile development team, directly contributing to the creation of high-quality, robust medical devices.

The Opportunity:

• You will actively contribute to taking innovative products from the initial idea to series production readiness and successfully launching them on the market. In the agile project team, you will work closely with the other colleagues and will commit to successfully complete the project together as a team.

• You are responsible for the development of the mechanical components. You enjoy getting involved in complex mechanical systems and understanding the interactions with other components. To this end, you will perform analyses on complex mechanical components and assemblies, create test plans with DoE, perform the tests, analyze and interpret the test results, and summarize all of this in technical documentation in accordance with regulatory requirements.

• You can provide demonstrated knowledge of parametric mechanical CAD design and FEM simulation independently across several projects; through this work, you can incorporate changes resulting from your investigations directly into the product design.

• You will work closely with other departments and project teams, including operations and manufacturing. You will build the interface between the development and production teams, which is responsible for the development, construction and implementation of the production line.

• You will collaborate with external partners such as injection molding suppliers is an additional aspect of your daily tasks.

Who you are:
(Required)

• You have a Bachelor's in mechanical engineering, mechatronics or medical technology (or relevant field of study) with 7+ years of experience; or a Master’s in mechanical engineering, mechatronics or medical technology (or relevant field of study) with 5+ years of experience.

• You have 5+ years of professional experience in the development of mechanical components and assemblies. In doing so, you have an affinity for practical activities and like to understand technical matters in detail by practically investigating and testing them.

• Ideally, you have a basic level of knowledge of parametric design (Creo Parametrics, Solid Works) and plastics engineering, and have acquired and applied both preferably in a regulated medical device environment.

• You are knowledgeable in at least two of the following topics: plastic technology, sterile component design, manufacturing and automated assembly of plastic parts

• You are characterized by the ability to work in a team, drive topics independently and self-motivated, have strong communication skills and search for solutions and not for problems. You want to make a difference, are flexible and always keep an open mind even in stressful situations.

Preferred:

• You have an advanced degree (e.g. PhD) in mechanical engineering, mechatronics or medical technology or a related field of study with 3+ years of experience.

• You have demonstrated experience in the area of agile methods and agile project management.

• You have strong interpersonal skills: Outstanding interpersonal, verbal,

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
All'interno del dipartimento di ingegneria meccanica di Roche R&D Near Patient Care, vi aiuterà a sviluppare contatori di glucosio nel sangue, sistemi di monitoraggio continuo del glucosio e relativi sistemi applicativi (ad esempio, stand di test) per la produzione di serie, il tutto in conformità con gli standard rilevanti e le linee guida regolamentari.

In qualità di Senior Mechanical Engineer, sarai parte integrante di un team di sviluppo agile, contribuendo direttamente alla creazione di dispositivi medici di alta qualità e robusti.

L'opportunità:

• Contribuirai attivamente a prendere prodotti innovativi dall'idea iniziale alla prontezza della produzione di serie e lanciarli con successo sul mercato. Nel team di progetto agile, lavorerai a stretto contatto con gli altri colleghi e si impegna a completare con successo il progetto insieme come team.

• Lei è responsabile per lo sviluppo dei componenti meccanici. Ti piace coinvolgere in complessi sistemi meccanici e comprendere le interazioni con altri componenti. A tal fine, eseguirai analisi su complessi componenti meccanici e assemblaggi, creerai piani di test con DoE, eseguirai i test, analizza e interpreta i risultati dei test, e riassumerai tutto ciò nella documentazione tecnica secondo i requisiti normativi.

• È possibile fornire una conoscenza dimostrata del design CAD meccanico parametrico e della simulazione FEM indipendentemente attraverso diversi progetti; attraverso questo lavoro, è possibile incorporare modifiche derivanti dalle indagini direttamente nella progettazione del prodotto.

• Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con altri dipartimenti e team di progetto, tra cui operazioni e produzione. Costruirete l'interfaccia tra i team di sviluppo e produzione, che è responsabile per lo sviluppo, la costruzione e l'implementazione della linea di produzione.

• Potrai collaborare con partner esterni come fornitori di stampaggio ad iniezione è un aspetto aggiuntivo delle tue attività quotidiane.

Chi sei:
(richiesto)

• Hai una laurea in ingegneria meccanica, meccatronica o tecnologia medica (o campo di studio rilevante) con 7+ anni di esperienza; o un Master in ingegneria meccanica, meccatronica o tecnologia medica (o campo di studio rilevante) con 5+ anni di esperienza.

• Hai 5+ anni di esperienza professionale nello sviluppo di componenti e assemblaggi meccanici. In questo modo, si ha un'affinità per le attività pratiche e come capire le questioni tecniche in dettaglio, praticamente indagando e testandole.

• Idealmente, si dispone di un livello di base di conoscenza del design parametrico (Creo Parametrics, Solid Works) e ingegneria della plastica, e hanno acquisito e applicato sia preferibilmente in un ambiente di dispositivo medico regolamentato.

• Sei esperto in almeno due dei seguenti argomenti: tecnologia plastica, progettazione di componenti sterili, produzione e assemblaggio automatizzato di parti in plastica

• Sei caratterizzato dalla capacità di lavorare in un team, guidare argomenti in modo indipendente e auto-motivato, avere forti capacità di comunicazione e ricerca di soluzioni e non per problemi. Si desidera fare la differenza, sono flessibili e mantenere sempre una mente aperta anche in situazioni stressanti.

Preferito:

• Hai una laurea avanzata (ad esempio PhD) in ingegneria meccanica, meccatronica o tecnologia medica o un campo di studio correlato con 3 anni di esperienza.

• Hai dimostrato esperienza nel campo dei metodi agili e della gestione agile del progetto.

• Hai forti capacità interpersonali: eccezionale interpersonale, verbale,

jobs.title: Marketing Automation Specialist (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

The Marketing Automation Specialist role is responsible for day-to-day production of digital marketing campaigns and programs in the Global Digital Hub for the Marketing Automation Chapter. The role acts as a subject matter expert role of OCE-D (OCE Digital) marketing automation tool, to reach Global Digital Hub’s key objectives and business goals by supporting business partners and stakeholders in owning and executing digital marketing programs and projects. The role is responsible for working with Pharma Division's affiliates and regional teams in executing on the digital strategy related to Roche events, products, services or any other marketing automation projects in OCE-D (A Salesforce Marketing Cloud based Marketing Automation Solution).

Please note that this is a maternity cover position.

The Opportunity:

• Develop, manage and support global/regional/affiliate E2E marketing campaigns (including asset creation, user journey/logic building, localization, segmentation, testing, analyzing).

• Work with key stakeholders to build contextual transactional and outbound marketing campaigns, and nurture campaigns leveraging valuable product data, to drive customer engagement and raise customer understanding of the product, service or order.

• Understand the business partners’ and stakeholders’ preferences and consulting, recommending, developing solutions and best practices to reach their own goals in marketing automation.

• Facilitate tracking and reporting on email campaigns in order to guide improvements and ensure current email best practices in the industry are being followed.

• Support global/regional projects /initiatives, as required.

• Operationalize marketing automation programs to support demand generation campaigns, nurture campaigns, retention, etc.

Who you are:

• You hold a University or College degree in a related field, such as Computing and IT, Communication, or Digital Marketing.

• You bring at least 2 years of professional email marketing experience, ideally within a global environment and supported by an established track record of developing automated campaigns.

• You master Marketing Automation Tools as a must—preferably Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, Eloqua, HubSpot, or Braze—while advanced knowledge of AMPscript and personalization techniques is a great extra.

• You possess a solid understanding of HTML and CSS within the context of email marketing, where basic skills are required and advanced knowledge is considered an extra bonus.

• You demonstrate an excellent understanding of user journeys and campaign logic while maintaining a customer-focused behavior in everything you do.

• You combine exceptional attention to detail and strong interpersonal skills with a quick-learning, technology-passionate mindset, a proactive work approach, and a positive attitude.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive sal

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il Global Digital Hub è stato fondato all'interno del Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali di Roche a livello globale, supportando iniziative centrali con Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting e Creative Design.

Il ruolo Marketing Automation Specialist è responsabile della produzione quotidiana di campagne e programmi di marketing digitale nel Global Digital Hub per il Marketing Automation Chapter. Il ruolo agisce come un ruolo esperto soggetto di OCE-D (OCE Digital) strumento di automazione di marketing, per raggiungere gli obiettivi chiave di Global Digital Hub e obiettivi aziendali, supportando partner commerciali e stakeholder nella gestione e nell'esecuzione di programmi e progetti di marketing digitale. Il ruolo è responsabile del lavoro con le affiliate e i team regionali della Pharma Division nell'esecuzione della strategia digitale relativa a eventi, prodotti, servizi o altri progetti di automazione di marketing in OCE-D (A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Based Marketing Automation Solution).

Si prega di notare che questa è una posizione di copertura di maternità.

L'opportunità:

• Sviluppare, gestire e sostenere campagne di marketing E2E globali/regionali/affiliate (compresa la creazione di attività, il viaggio utente/edilizia biologica, localizzazione, segmentazione, test, analisi).

• Lavorare con i principali stakeholder per costruire campagne di marketing transazionali e in uscita contestuali, e campagne nutrienti che sfruttano dati di prodotto preziosi, per guidare l'impegno del cliente e aumentare la comprensione del prodotto, del servizio o dell'ordine.

• Comprendere le preferenze e la consulenza dei partner commerciali e delle parti interessate, raccomandare, sviluppare soluzioni e best practice per raggiungere i propri obiettivi nell’automazione del marketing.

• Facilitare il monitoraggio e il reporting sulle campagne e-mail al fine di guidare i miglioramenti e garantire le migliori pratiche e-mail attuali nel settore sono in corso di approfondimento.

• Sostenere progetti globali/regionali/iniziativi, come richiesto.

• Operazionalizzare i programmi di automazione di marketing per supportare campagne di generazione della domanda, campagne di coltura, ritenzione, ecc.

Chi sei:

• Hai una laurea in università o college in un campo correlato, come Computing e IT, Comunicazione, o Digital Marketing.

• Porti almeno 2 anni di esperienza professionale di email marketing, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente globale e supportato da un record di traccia consolidato di sviluppo di campagne automatizzate.

• Lei padroneggia gli strumenti di automazione di marketing come un must — preferibilmente Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, Eloqua, HubSpot, o Braze — mentre la conoscenza avanzata di AMPscript e tecniche di personalizzazione è un grande extra.

• Possiedi una solida comprensione di HTML e CSS all'interno del contesto di email marketing, dove le competenze di base sono richieste e conoscenze avanzate è considerato un bonus extra.

• Si dimostra una eccellente comprensione dei viaggi degli utenti e della logica della campagna, mantenendo un comportamento focalizzato sul cliente in tutto ciò che si fa.

• Unisci un'attenzione eccezionale ai dettagli e a forti capacità interpersonali con una mentalità rapida, tecnologica-passionata, un approccio proattivo di lavoro e un atteggiamento positivo.

In cambio vi forniamo:

• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.

• Vantaggi eccellenti: Guarnizione competitiva

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Cybersecurity Engineer for Secure Access Network (Temporary, Fixed Term)

Description of the area

The Network Security team secures Roche’s global connectivity through policy-driven, automated infrastructure. We are seeking a Network Security Engineer to design, implement, and maintain secure network segmentation environments using Fortinet and Palo Alto firewalls. In this role, you will architect robust firewall solutions, build detailed implementation plans, and seamlessly integrate security controls into existing infrastructure. You will manage firewall deployments, handle complex policies, VPNs, and routing, while executing system migrations and platform upgrades. Additionally, you will troubleshoot advanced network issues, defend against emerging threats, and provide rotating on-call operational support.

This is a temporary, fixed-term position from 1 to 2 years

jobs.description:

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
​
IT Semantic Engineer - RDT Data Platforms

Description of the area

The IT Semantic Engineer is responsible for leading, designing, developing, and maintaining our enterprise-level semantic hub. This platform serves as the foundational data layer bridging the gap between vast enterprise knowledge and advanced AI systems.
In this role, you will integrate diverse data and metadata sources into a unified knowledge graph, design common ontologies to expose disparate datasets uniformly, build robust APIs and integration protocols for AI consumption. The ultimate goal is to provide high-precision enterprise context to AI assistants and intelligent agents—grounding their responses, enabling reliable workflow execution, and eliminating AI hallucinations.

The Opportunity:

• Scope / Content Leadership : Leads the design, build, and maintenance of scalable data pipelines and graph architectures. Independently drives data integration projects from ingestion to semantic transformation, establishing unified enterprise ontologies.

• Accountability / Problem Solving: Solves complex data modeling, ingestion, and querying challenges. Evaluates, benchmarks, and optimizes the performance of data access tools to ensure AI systems fetch enterprise context efficiently, accurately, and with minimal latency.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborates directly with data owners, domain experts, and AI application teams to thoroughly understand business requirements. Translates complex business use cases into robust schemas and standardized data endpoints.

• Impact / Strategy: Drives the technical evolution of the hub’s delivery architecture. Implements robust strategies for distributed data indexing, orchestration, and access, while embedding FAIR principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) across all workflows.

• Complexity / Product Size : Manages a highly interconnected, large-scale enterprise knowledge system. Integrates complex, multi-source metadata systems into a uniform layer, navigating advanced infrastructure and enterprise gateway patterns to maintain seamless, automated deployments.

Who you are:

Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience handling enterprise-scale data engineering projects and managing complex semantic web systems and knowledge graphs.

• Experience configuring, deploying, and maintaining infrastructure components in a Kubernetes environment using GitOps automation.

• Experience working with validated or qualified platforms (GxP) is a plus.

Technical Skills

• Experience: Senior-level experience in data engineering, software engineering, or semantic web engineering with strong Python coding skills, a proven track record of autonomous delivery, and a focus on knowledge graphs or AI system enablement.

• Semantic & Graph Technologies: Hands-on experience with Graph databases (Ontotext GraphDB preferred, Neo4j) and core semantic web standards (RDF, OWL, SPARQL and ontology design).

• APIs & AI Protocols: Deep understanding of GraphQL API design and hands-on experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to expose data tools to LLMs.

• DevOps & Infrastructure: Experience configuring, deploying, and managing containerized workloads within enterprise Kubernetes (Rancher/RKE2) environments.

• GitOps & CI/CD: Expert proficiency in Git-based workflows using trunk-based development, automated deployments via ArgoCD, and application packaging with Helm charts.

• Security & Networking: Solid practical understanding of secrets management

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
​
IT Semantic Engineer - RDT Data Platforms

Description of the area

The IT Semantic Engineer is responsible for leading, designing, developing, and maintaining our enterprise-level semantic hub. This platform serves as the foundational data layer bridging the gap between vast enterprise knowledge and advanced AI systems.
In this role, you will integrate diverse data and metadata sources into a unified knowledge graph, design common ontologies to expose disparate datasets uniformly, build robust APIs and integration protocols for AI consumption. The ultimate goal is to provide high-precision enterprise context to AI assistants and intelligent agents—grounding their responses, enabling reliable workflow execution, and eliminating AI hallucinations.

The Opportunity:

• Scope / Content Leadership : Leads the design, build, and maintenance of scalable data pipelines and graph architectures. Independently drives data integration projects from ingestion to semantic transformation, establishing unified enterprise ontologies.

• Accountability / Problem Solving: Solves complex data modeling, ingestion, and querying challenges. Evaluates, benchmarks, and optimizes the performance of data access tools to ensure AI systems fetch enterprise context efficiently, accurately, and with minimal latency.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborates directly with data owners, domain experts, and AI application teams to thoroughly understand business requirements. Translates complex business use cases into robust schemas and standardized data endpoints.

• Impact / Strategy: Drives the technical evolution of the hub’s delivery architecture. Implements robust strategies for distributed data indexing, orchestration, and access, while embedding FAIR principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) across all workflows.

• Complexity / Product Size : Manages a highly interconnected, large-scale enterprise knowledge system. Integrates complex, multi-source metadata systems into a uniform layer, navigating advanced infrastructure and enterprise gateway patterns to maintain seamless, automated deployments.

Who you are:

Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience handling enterprise-scale data engineering projects and managing complex semantic web systems and knowledge graphs.

• Experience configuring, deploying, and maintaining infrastructure components in a Kubernetes environment using GitOps automation.

• Experience working with validated or qualified platforms (GxP) is a plus.

Technical Skills

• Experience: Senior-level experience in data engineering, software engineering, or semantic web engineering with strong Python coding skills, a proven track record of autonomous delivery, and a focus on knowledge graphs or AI system enablement.

• Semantic & Graph Technologies: Hands-on experience with Graph databases (Ontotext GraphDB preferred, Neo4j) and core semantic web standards (RDF, OWL, SPARQL and ontology design).

• APIs & AI Protocols: Deep understanding of GraphQL API design and hands-on experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to expose data tools to LLMs.

• DevOps & Infrastructure: Experience configuring, deploying, and managing containerized workloads within enterprise Kubernetes (Rancher/RKE2) environments.

• GitOps & CI/CD: Expert proficiency in Git-based workflows using trunk-based development, automated deployments via ArgoCD, and application packaging with Helm charts.

• Security & Networking: Solid practical understanding of secrets management

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
​
IT Semantic Engineer - RDT Datenplattformen

Beschreibung des Gebiets

Der IT Semantic Engineer ist verantwortlich für die Leitung, das Design, die Entwicklung und die Wartung unseres semantischen Hubs auf Unternehmensebene. Diese Plattform dient als grundlegende Datenschicht, die die Lücke zwischen umfangreichem Unternehmenswissen und fortschrittlichen KI-Systemen schließt.
In dieser Rolle integrieren Sie verschiedene Daten- und Metadatenquellen in einen einheitlichen Wissensgraphen, entwerfen gemeinsame Ontologien, um unterschiedliche Datensätze einheitlich darzustellen, erstellen robuste APIs und Integrationsprotokolle für den KI-Verbrauch. Das ultimative Ziel ist es, KI-Assistenten und intelligenten Agenten einen hochpräzisen Unternehmenskontext zu bieten - die Erdung ihrer Antworten, die zuverlässige Ausführung von Workflows und die Beseitigung von KI-Halluzinationen.

Die Gelegenheit:

• Scope / Content Leadership: Leitet das Design, den Aufbau und die Wartung skalierbarer Datenpipelines und Graphenarchitekturen. Führt Datenintegrationsprojekte unabhängig von der Aufnahme bis zur semantischen Transformation und etabliert einheitliche Unternehmensontologien.

• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Löst komplexe Datenmodellierungs-, Aufnahme- und Abfrageherausforderungen. Bewertet, Benchmarks und optimiert die Leistung von Datenzugriffstools, um sicherzustellen, dass KI-Systeme den Unternehmenskontext effizient, genau und mit minimaler Latenz abrufen.

• Stakeholder Management: Arbeitet direkt mit Datenbesitzern, Domänenexperten und KI-Anwendungsteams zusammen, um die Geschäftsanforderungen gründlich zu verstehen. Übersetzt komplexe Business Use Cases in robuste Schemata und standardisierte Datenendpunkte.

• Impact / Strategie: Betreibt die technische Entwicklung der Auslieferungsarchitektur des Hubs. Implementiert robuste Strategien für die Indexierung, Orchestrierung und den Zugriff auf verteilte Daten, während FAIR-Prinzipien (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) in alle Workflows integriert werden.

• Komplexität / Produktgröße: Verwaltet ein hochgradig vernetztes, groß angelegtes Unternehmenswissenssystem. Integriert komplexe Multi-Source-Metadatensysteme in eine einheitliche Ebene und navigiert durch fortschrittliche Infrastruktur- und Enterprise-Gateway-Muster, um nahtlose, automatisierte Bereitstellungen zu gewährleisten.

Wer du bist:

Bildung / Erfahrung

• Demonstrierte Erfahrung im Umgang mit unternehmensweiten Data Engineering-Projekten und der Verwaltung komplexer semantischer Websysteme und Wissensgraphen.

• Erleben Sie die Konfiguration, Bereitstellung und Wartung von Infrastrukturkomponenten in einer Kubernetes-Umgebung mithilfe der GitOps-Automatisierung.

• Erfahrung mit validierten oder qualifizierten Plattformen (GxP) ist ein Plus.

Technische Fähigkeiten

• Erfahrung: Senior-Level-Erfahrung in Data Engineering, Software Engineering oder semantischem Web Engineering mit starken Python-Codierungskenntnissen, einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz bei der autonomen Bereitstellung und einem Fokus auf Wissensgraphen oder KI-System-Enablement.

• Semantic & Graph Technologies: Praktische Erfahrung mit Graph-Datenbanken (Ontotext GraphDB preferred, Neo4j) und zentralen semantischen Webstandards (RDF, OWL, SPARQL und Ontologiedesign).

• APIs & AI-Protokolle: Tiefes Verständnis des GraphQL-API-Designs und praktische Erfahrung mit dem Model Context Protocol (MCP), um Datentools LLMs auszusetzen.

• DevOps & Infrastruktur: Erfahrung beim Konfigurieren, Bereitstellen und Verwalten von containerisierten Workloads in Enterprise Kubernetes (Rancher/RKE2)-Umgebungen.

• GitOps & CI/CD: Expertenkenntnisse in Git-basierten Workflows mit trunk-basierter Entwicklung, automatisierten Bereitstellungen über ArgoCD und Anwendungsverpackung mit Helm-Diagrammen.

• Security & Networking: Solides praktisches Verständnis von Secrets Management
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
​
Ingénieur sémantique IT - Plateformes de données RDT

Description de la zone

L'ingénieur sémantique IT est chargé de diriger, de concevoir, de développer et de maintenir notre centre sémantique au niveau de l'entreprise. Cette plate-forme sert de couche de données fondamentale pour combler l'écart entre les vastes connaissances de l'entreprise et les systèmes d'IA avancés.
Dans ce rôle, vous intégrerez diverses sources de données et de métadonnées dans un graphe de connaissances unifié, concevoirez des ontologies communes pour exposer uniformément des ensembles de données disparates, construireez des API robustes et des protocoles d'intégration pour la consommation d'IA. L'objectif ultime est de fournir un contexte d'entreprise de haute précision aux assistants et aux agents intelligents de l'IA, en établissant leurs réponses, en permettant une exécution fiable des flux de travail et en éliminant les hallucinations de l'IA.

La possibilité :

• Portée / contenu Leadership : Dirige la conception, la construction et la maintenance de pipelines de données évolutives et d'architectures graphiques. Dirige indépendamment les projets d'intégration de données de l'ingestion à la transformation sémantique, établissant des ontologies d'entreprise unifiées.

• Responsabilisation / résolution de problèmes : se pose des problèmes complexes de modélisation des données, d'ingestion et de questionnement. Évaluer, évaluer et optimiser les performances des outils d'accès aux données pour s'assurer que les systèmes d'IA récupèrent le contexte de l'entreprise efficacement, avec précision et avec un latence minimale.

• Gestion des intervenants : Collabore directement avec les propriétaires de données, les experts de domaine et les équipes d'application d'IA pour bien comprendre les exigences opérationnelles. Traduit des cas d'utilisation commerciale complexes en schémas robustes et des paramètres de données normalisés.

• Impact / Stratégie: Dirige l'évolution technique de l'architecture de livraison du hub. Implémente des stratégies robustes pour l'indexation des données distribuées, l'orchestration et l'accès, tout en intégrant les principes FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) sur tous les workflows.

• Complexité / Taille du produit : Gère un système de connaissances très interconnecté et à grande échelle. Intégre des systèmes de métadonnées complexes et multisources dans une couche uniforme, en naviguant sur les modèles d'infrastructure avancée et de passerelle d'entreprise pour maintenir des déploiements automatisés et sans faille.

Qui vous êtes :

Éducation / Expérience

• Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de projets d'ingénierie des données à l'échelle de l'entreprise et la gestion de systèmes Web sémantiques complexes et de graphiques de connaissances.

• Découvrez la configuration, le déploiement et la maintenance des composants d'infrastructure dans un environnement Kubernetes grâce à l'automatisation GitOps.

• L'expérience de travail avec des plateformes validées ou qualifiées (GxP) est un plus.

Compétences techniques

• Expérience : Expérience de niveau supérieur en ingénierie de données, en génie logiciel ou en génie web sémantique avec de solides compétences de codage Python, une expérience éprouvée de la prestation autonome, et un accent sur les graphiques de connaissances ou l'activation du système d'IA.

• Technologies sémantiques et graphiques: Expérience pratique avec les bases de données graphiques (Ontotext GraphDB préféré, Neo4j) et les normes web sémantiques de base (RDF, OWL, SPARQL et conception d'ontologie).

• API et protocoles d'IA: Compréhension approfondie de la conception de l'API de GraphQL et expérience pratique avec le Model Context Protocol (MCP) pour exposer les outils de données aux LLM.

• DevOps & Infrastructure: Expérimentez la configuration, le déploiement et la gestion des charges de travail conteneurisées dans les environnements Kubernetes (Rancher/RKE2).

• GitOps & CI/CD: Compétence d'expert dans les flux de travail basés sur Git en utilisant le développement basé sur le tronc, déploiements automatisés via ArgoCD, et packaging d'applications avec des cartes Helm.

• Sécurité et réseautage: Une bonne compréhension pratique de la gestion des secrets

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing, resulting in a sample in, result out workflow.

This hands-on role focuses on solving mechanical challenges for our next-generation platforms. You will be responsible for conceptualizing, designing, building, and testing electro-mechanical, pneumatic, thermal, fluidic, and consumable solutions that ensure system performance, reliability, and longevity. As a technical authority, you will drive innovation and define solutions for novel DNA sequencing and automation challenges.

The Opportunity & Responsibilities:

• You will drive the research and development of various sub-systems, encompassing electro-mechanical, pneumatic, thermal, fluidic, and consumable technologies.

• You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and manage critical technical interfaces.

• You will own sub-systems through verification, integration, and troubleshooting, working closely with System Integration engineers.

• You will lead cross-functional design reviews to drive alignment and resolve technical trade-offs.

• You will manage design deliverable timelines and contribute to overall project planning.

• You will create and maintain comprehensive design documentation.

• You will contribute to technical strategy, providing data-driven recommendations on architecture and technology.

• You will present progress, data, and design trade-offs to stakeholders, clearly articulating the impact of engineering decisions.

This is an onsite position based in Santa Clara, CA.
Relocation benefits are not offered for this role.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline, with relevant industry experience (minimum 7+ years for a Bachelor's, 4+ years for a Master's, or 3+ years for a PhD).

• You have demonstrated hands-on experience designing, developing, and testing complex electro-mechanical, pneumatic, thermal, or fluidic assemblies, preferably for life science or diagnostic instrumentation.

• You are highly proficient in SolidWorks for detailed design and the creation of manufacturing drawings.

• You have demonstrated experience designing components for a variety of manufacturing processes (e.g., machining, sheet metal, injection molding, 3D printing).

• You have demonstrated problem-solving skills; ability to troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and chemistry interfaces.

• You are proficient with machine shop tools, measurement equipment, and rapid prototyping (e.g., CNC mills/lathes, laser cutters, 3D printers).

• You have experience solving unique or unpredictable problems that might have an impact on the goals and objectives as set by the organization

Preferred:

• You have an advanced degree in Mechanical Engineer, or a closely related discipline

• You have a high level of proficiency with Python for device control and data acquisition.

• You have experience with simulation tools (CFD, FEA) to guide design decisions.

• You have experience developing next-generation sequencing (NGS) or genomics instrumentation.

•

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
A Roche, stiamo lavorando per rendere il sequenziamento di prossima generazione abbastanza semplice e accessibile per uso di routine. Accelerando la ricerca clinica, razionalizzando i flussi di lavoro e espandendo i menu di analisi, stiamo ampliando l'accesso ai dati genomici e abbassando le barriere all'adozione. Dai robusti strumenti di isolamento e preparazione dei campioni alle nuove tecnologie di sequenziamento e alla bioinformatica avanzata, stiamo sviluppando soluzioni end-to-end differenziate e altamente integrate per la sequenziamento di nuova generazione, con un risultato di campionamento, risultato fuori flusso di lavoro.

Questo ruolo pratico si concentra sulla risoluzione di sfide meccaniche per le nostre piattaforme di nuova generazione. Sarete responsabili di concettualizzare, progettare, costruire e testare soluzioni elettromeccaniche, pneumatiche, termiche, fluidiche e di consumo che garantiscono prestazioni del sistema, affidabilità e longevità. Come autorità tecnica, guiderai l'innovazione e definirai soluzioni per nuove sfide di sequenziamento e automazione del DNA.

Le opportunità e le responsabilità:

• Aziona la ricerca e lo sviluppo di vari sottosistemi, che comprendono tecnologie elettromeccaniche, pneumatiche, termiche, fluidiche e di consumo.

• Collaborerai con team interfunzionali per definire e gestire interfacce tecniche critiche.

• Possiederai sottosistemi attraverso la verifica, l'integrazione e la risoluzione dei problemi, lavorando a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri di System Integration.

• Condurrai recensioni di progettazione interfunzionali per guidare l'allineamento e risolvere i trade-off tecnici.

• Potrai gestire le linee temporali di progettazione e contribuire alla pianificazione generale del progetto.

• Si creerà e manterrà la documentazione completa di progettazione.

• Contribuirai alla strategia tecnica, fornendo raccomandazioni basate sui dati sull'architettura e la tecnologia.

• Verrà presentato il progresso, i dati e i trade-off di progettazione agli stakeholder, articolando chiaramente l'impatto delle decisioni di ingegneria.

Questa è una posizione in loco con base a Santa Clara, CA.
I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono offerti per questo ruolo.

Chi sei?
(richiesto)

• Hai una laurea in ingegneria meccanica, o una disciplina strettamente correlata, con esperienza di settore rilevante (minimo 7+ anni per un Bachelor, 4+ anni per un Master, o 3+ anni per un dottorato).

• Hai dimostrato esperienza pratica progettando, sviluppando e testando complessi assemblaggi elettromeccanici, pneumatici, termici o fluidici, preferibilmente per la scienza della vita o la strumentazione diagnostica.

• Sei molto competente in SolidWorks per il design dettagliato e la creazione di disegni di produzione.

• Hai dimostrato esperienza nella progettazione di componenti per una varietà di processi produttivi (ad esempio, lavorazione, lamiera, stampaggio ad iniezione, stampa 3D).

• Hai dimostrato capacità di problem solving; capacità di risolvere problemi hardware complesso, software e interfacce di chimica.

• Siete abili con macchine utensili, apparecchiature di misura e prototipazione rapida (ad esempio, fresatori / torni CNC, frese laser, stampanti 3D).

• Hai esperienza di risolvere problemi unici o imprevedibili che potrebbero avere un impatto sugli obiettivi e gli obiettivi fissati dall'organizzazione

Preferito:

• Hai una laurea avanzata in Ingegnere meccanico, o una disciplina strettamente correlata

• Hai un alto livello di competenza con Python per il controllo dei dispositivi e l'acquisizione dei dati.

• Hai esperienza con strumenti di simulazione (CFD, FEA) per guidare le decisioni di progettazione.

• Avete esperienza nello sviluppo di sequenziamento di prossima generazione (NGS) o strumentazione genomica.

•
