Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Bei Roche arbeiten wir daran, die Sequenzierung der nächsten Generation einfach und für den routinemäßigen Einsatz zugänglich zu machen. Durch die Beschleunigung der klinischen Forschung, die Rationalisierung von Workflows und die Erweiterung der Assay-Menüs erweitern wir den Zugang zu genomischen Daten und senken die Akzeptanzbarrieren. Von robusten Werkzeugen für die Probenisolierung und -vorbereitung bis hin zu neuartigen Sequenzierungstechnologien und fortschrittlicher Bioinformatik entwickeln wir differenzierte, hochintegrierte End-to-End-Lösungen für die Sequenzierung der nächsten Generation, die zu einem Workflow für die Probeneingabe führen.

Diese praktische Rolle konzentriert sich auf die Lösung mechanischer Herausforderungen für unsere Plattformen der nächsten Generation. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, elektromechanische, pneumatische, thermische, fluidische und verbrauchbare Lösungen zu konzipieren, zu entwerfen, zu bauen und zu testen, die Systemleistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Langlebigkeit gewährleisten. Als technische Autorität werden Sie Innovationen vorantreiben und Lösungen für neuartige DNA-Sequenzierung und Automatisierungsherausforderungen definieren.

Die Chancen und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Sie werden die Forschung und Entwicklung verschiedener Subsysteme vorantreiben, darunter elektromechanische, pneumatische, thermische, fluidische und Verbrauchstechnologien.

• Sie arbeiten mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um kritische technische Schnittstellen zu definieren und zu verwalten.

• Sie besitzen Subsysteme durch Verifizierung, Integration und Fehlersuche und arbeiten eng mit Systemintegrationsingenieuren zusammen.

• Sie führen funktionsübergreifende Design-Reviews durch, um die Ausrichtung zu fördern und technische Kompromisse zu lösen.

• Sie verwalten die Lieferzeiten und tragen zur Gesamtprojektplanung bei.

• Sie erstellen und pflegen eine umfassende Designdokumentation.

• Sie werden zur technischen Strategie beitragen und datengesteuerte Empfehlungen zu Architektur und Technologie geben.

• Sie präsentieren den Stakeholdern Fortschritt, Daten und Design-Kompromisse und artikulieren die Auswirkungen von Engineering-Entscheidungen.

Dies ist eine Position vor Ort mit Sitz in Santa Clara, CA.
Umzugsvorteile werden für diese Rolle nicht angeboten.

Wer Du bist:
(erforderlich)

• Sie haben einen Abschluss in Maschinenbau oder eine eng verwandte Disziplin mit einschlägiger Branchenerfahrung (mindestens 7+ Jahre für einen Bachelor, 4+ Jahre für einen Master oder 3+ Jahre für einen PhD).

• Sie haben praktische Erfahrung beim Entwerfen, Entwickeln und Testen komplexer elektromechanischer, pneumatischer, thermischer oder fluidischer Baugruppen gezeigt, vorzugsweise für die Biowissenschaft oder diagnostische Instrumente.

jobs.title: Senior Bioinformatics Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Bioinformatics Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and implement features for the bioinformatics components and pipelines that are used in Roche Sequencing products. You will be part of a team working in a fast paced environment, developing cutting-edge, distributed, scale-out Next-Generation Sequencing data analysis software to ensure the highest possible software quality for gene sequencing research and disease diagnostics.

Work closely with experimental teams to understand their requirements and translate them into functional software, implementing those solutions directly within an existing research code repository. Collaborate with research and algorithm experts, accelerating bioinformatics techniques using GPU hardware. You will navigate and contribute to a large code base, applying your knowledge of advanced bioinformatics techniques (such as alignment methods and other sequence analysis algorithms) and neural nets to continuously improve the quality and feature sets of the software products.

Who You Are

• B.S. or M.S. or PhD in Computational Biology or Bioinformatics or Biomedical engineering or related field.

• 5+ years of experience in working with NGS data and data analysis pipelines.

• Strong expertise in Python, including numerical computing and data science libraries, alongside familiarity with C/C++.

• Demonstrated experience developing, maintaining, or refactoring within a large code base or existing research code repository.

• Understanding of core bioinformatics techniques, including alignment methods, as well as neural nets.

• Experience collaborating with experimental teams to gather requirements and implement technical solutions.

• Thrives in a fast paced environment, showing a self-driven, detail oriented, and analytical approach with a proven ability to learn quickly.

• Proficiency in GCP, AWS and Linux Shell environments.

• Be a team player, customer focused with excellent interdisciplinary collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Practical experience utilizing GPU-accelerated C/C++ libraries or knowledge of GPUs and CUDA.

• Experience with CI/CD tools and concepts.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $145,300-$269,800 . Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

L'opportunità

Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team sperimentali per comprendere i loro requisiti e tradurli in software funzionale, implementando tali soluzioni direttamente all'interno di un repository di codice di ricerca esistente. Potrai navigare e contribuire a una grande base di codice, applicando la tua conoscenza di tecniche di bioinformatica avanzate (come metodi di allineamento e altri algoritmi di analisi delle sequenze) e reti neurali per migliorare continuamente la qualità e le caratteristiche dei prodotti software.

Chi sei

• B.S. o M.S. o PhD in Biologia Computazionale o Bioinformatica o ingegneria biomedica o campo correlato.

• 5+ anni di esperienza nel lavoro con data e data analysis pipeline NGS.

• Forte competenza in Python, tra cui le librerie di calcolo numerico e di scienza dei dati, insieme alla familiarità con C/C++.

• Esperienza dimostrata nello sviluppo, nel mantenimento o nella ristrutturazione di una grande base di codice o di un repository di codice di ricerca esistente.

• Comprensione delle tecniche di bioinformatica di base, compresi i metodi di allineamento, così come le reti neurali.

• Esperienza di collaborazione con team sperimentali per raccogliere requisiti e implementare soluzioni tecniche.

• Thrives in un ambiente veloce, mostrando un approccio auto-driven, orientato ai dettagli e analitico con una comprovata capacità di imparare rapidamente.

• Proficienza negli ambienti GCP, AWS e Linux Shell.

• Sii un giocatore di squadra, il cliente si è concentrato con eccellenti capacità di collaborazione interdisciplinare.

Qualificazioni predestinate

• Esperienza pratica che utilizza librerie C/C++ accelerate dalla GPU e CUDA.

• Esperienza con strumenti e concetti CI/CD.

I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa pubblicazione.

L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla posizione primaria della California è di $145,300-$269,800 . La retribuzione effettiva sarà determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche, alla posizione geografica e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro consentiti dalla legge. Un bonus annuale discrezionale può essere disponibile in base alle prestazioni individuali e aziendali. Questa posizione si qualifica anche per i benefici dettagliati al link sottostante.
Vantaggi

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. È la nostra politica e la nostra pratica di impiegare, promuovere e trattare in altro modo tutti i dipendenti e i richiedenti sulla base del merito, delle qualifiche e delle competenze. La politica della società vieta la discriminazione illecita

jobs.title: Section Head, Medicinal Chemistry
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Section Head, Medicinal Chemistry
The Medicinal Chemistry Department at the China Innovation Center of Roche (CICoR) in Shanghai is a community of drug hunters specializing in synthetic chemistry, medicinal chemistry, and chemical biology. In partnership with our disease therapeutic areas and technology functions, our mission is to translate disease-relevant biological hypotheses into innovative small molecule therapeutics for indications with high unmet medical needs, including oncological, autoimmune, inflammatory, cardiovascular, and metabolic disorders.
• We offer a unique platform to impact small molecule drug discovery through your combined scientific acumen and leadership capabilities.

Key
• Responsibilities
In this role, you will:
● Lead internal and external chemistry teams (CRO) on small molecule drug discovery programs, leveraging advanced technologies to establish SAR and SPR profiles for potency, DMPK, and safety.
● Formulate comprehensive project strategies—including target compound profile, hit generation approaches, screening cascade, decision matrices, and patent strategies—collaborating within cross-functional teams and aligning with site-wide disease and technology strategies.
● Steer drug discovery campaigns and facilitate vital go/no-go decisions for project progression, prioritization, or termination from hit generation through to clinical candidate nomination.

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Sektionsleiter, Medizinische Chemie
Die Abteilung für Medizinische Chemie am China Innovation Center of Roche (CICoR) in Shanghai ist eine Gemeinschaft von Drogenjägern, die sich auf synthetische Chemie, medizinische Chemie und chemische Biologie spezialisiert haben. In Partnerschaft mit unseren krankheitstherapeutischen Bereichen und Technologiefunktionen ist es unsere Mission, krankheitsrelevante biologische Hypothesen in innovative niedermolekulare Therapeutika für Indikationen mit hohem ungedecktem medizinischen Bedarf zu übersetzen, einschließlich onkologischer, autoimmuner, entzündlicher, kardiovaskulärer und metabolischer Störungen.
• Wir bieten eine einzigartige Plattform, um die Entdeckung von niedermolekularen Medikamenten durch Ihren kombinierten wissenschaftlichen Scharfsinn und Ihre Führungsqualitäten zu beeinflussen.

Schlüssel
• Zuständigkeiten
In dieser Rolle werden Sie:
Führen Sie interne und externe Chemieteams (CRO) bei Programmen zur Wirkstoffforschung für kleine Moleküle und nutzen Sie fortschrittliche Technologien, um SAR- und SPR-Profile für Potenz, DMPK und Sicherheit zu erstellen.
● Formulieren Sie umfassende Projektstrategien - einschließlich Zielverbindungsprofil, Hit-Generierungsansätze, Screening-Kaskade, Entscheidungsmatrizen und Patentstrategien - und arbeiten Sie in funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen und richten Sie sich an standortweiten Krankheits- und Technologiestrategien aus.
● Steuerung von Wirkstoffforschungskampagnen und Erleichterung wichtiger Go / No-Go-Entscheidungen für Projektfortschritt, Priorisierung oder Beendigung von der Hit-Generation bis zur klinischen Kandidatennominierung.
● Förderung robuster Kooperationsnetzwerke mit Kollegen aus dem Projektteam, um Kandidatenmoleküle erfolgreich voranzubringen und in einem dynamischen Umfeld entscheidend und adaptiv zu handeln.
● Übernehmen Sie die Entwicklung und Ausführung neuer Krankheiten oder technologischer Bereiche wie zugewiesen.
● Bereitstellung von Fachkenntnissen zur Bewertung neuer Ziel- oder Technologiemöglichkeiten und Unterstützung von Due-Diligence-Initiativen auf Anfrage.

• Profil
Wir suchen einen erfahrenen medizinischen Chemiker mit einem Doktortitel in organischer Chemie, medizinischer Chemie oder chemischer Biologie mit über 8 Jahren Berufserfahrung in der Pharma- oder Biotech-Industrie oder einer gleichwertigen akademischen Amtszeit.
erforderlich

B. onkologische, Autoimmun-, Entzündungs-, Herz-Kreislauf- oder Stoffwechselerkrankungen) und Technologieplattformen (z. B. kovalente Medikamente, induzierte Nähe, ADCs).

● Ausgezeichnete Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, mit einer Leidenschaft für die Kultivierung kreativer, innovativer Lösungen, um die Projektziele zu erreichen und die Wirkung zu steigern.
Hohe Lernflexibilität und ein flexibler Betriebsstil, mit der Fähigkeit, voneinander abhängige, kollaborative Teamumgebungen aufzubauen, die Programme dringend voranbringen.
Herausragende Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, Stakeholder auf allen Ebenen zu beeinflussen, inklusive zu arbeiten und Programmstrategien, Risiken und Minderungsmaßnahmen für Führungs- und Führungsgremien effektiv zu präsentieren.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Chef de section, Chimie médicale
Le département de chimie médicinale du China Innovation Center de Roche (CICoR) de Shanghai est une communauté de chasseurs de drogues spécialisée dans la chimie synthétique, la chimie médicinale et la biologie chimique. En partenariat avec nos domaines thérapeutiques de la maladie et nos fonctions technologiques, notre mission est de traduire les hypothèses biologiques de la maladie en thérapies de petite molécule innovantes pour les indications avec des besoins médicaux élevés non satisfaits, y compris les troubles oncologiques, auto-immuns, inflammatoires, cardiovasculaires et métaboliques.
• Nous offrons une plate-forme unique pour impacter la découverte de médicaments à petites molécules grâce à votre acuité scientifique combinée et vos capacités de leadership.

Clé
• Responsabilités
Dans ce rôle, vous :
● Diriger les équipes de chimie interne et externe (ORC) sur les programmes de découverte de médicaments à petites molécules, en tirant parti des technologies de pointe pour établir des profils de R-S et de RPS pour l'activité, le DMPK et l'innocuité.
● Formuler des stratégies globales de projet, y compris le profil des composés cibles, les approches de génération de succès, la cascade de dépistage, les matrices de décision et les stratégies de brevets, en collaboration avec les équipes interfonctionnelles et en alignement avec les stratégies de lutte contre les maladies et la technologie à l'échelle du site.
● Mener des campagnes de découverte de médicaments et faciliter la prise de décisions vitales pour la progression du projet, l'établissement des priorités ou l'abandon du projet, de la génération à la nomination de candidats cliniques.
● Favoriser l'établissement de solides réseaux de collaboration avec les pairs de l'équipe de projet pour faire progresser les molécules candidates, en agissant de façon décisive et adaptative dans un contexte dynamique.
● S'occuper de la mise au point et de l'exécution de nouvelles maladies ou de nouveaux domaines technologiques.
● Fournir une expertise en la matière pour évaluer de nouvelles cibles ou possibilités technologiques et appuyer les initiatives de diligence raisonnable sur demande.
● Diriger un groupe de chimistes médicinaux hautement qualifiés (minimum de 8, principalement des doctorats) pour leur rendement et leur perfectionnement professionnel, relevant directement du chef de la chimie médicinale au CICoR.

Candidat
• Profil
Nous recherchons un chimiste médicinal expérimenté titulaire d'un doctorat en chimie organique, chimie médicinale ou biologie chimique avec plus de 8 ans d'expérience professionnelle au sein de l'industrie pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique, ou un mandat universitaire équivalent.
Requis
• Compétences
Vous possédez :
● Une compréhension globale des méthodes de découverte de médicaments à petites molécules et des disciplines scientifiques, complétée par des connaissances approfondies dans des domaines thérapeutiques spécifiques (p. ex. maladies oncologiques, auto-immunes, inflammatoires, cardiovasculaires ou métaboliques) et des plateformes technologiques (p. ex. médicaments covalents, proximité induite, CAD).
● Une expérience éprouvée de la réalisation d'étapes allant de la validation de la cible jusqu'à la sélection de candidats cliniques pour une cible de première classe, la gestion des décisions critiques de projet avec un équilibre de rigueur scientifique et l'exécution rapide.
● Excellentes capacités de résolution de problèmes, avec une passion pour cultiver des solutions créatives et innovantes pour atteindre les objectifs du projet et stimuler l'impact.
● Une grande agilité d'apprentissage et un style opérationnel souple, avec la capacité de créer des environnements d'équipe interdépendants et collaboratifs qui font progresser les programmes avec urgence.
● Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, vous permettant d'influencer les intervenants à tous les niveaux, de travailler de façon inclusive et de présenter efficacement des stratégies de programme, des risques et des mesures d'atténuation aux organismes de leadership et de gouvernance.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Workforce Enablement Professional

The Opportunity
Are you passionate about bridging the gap between cutting-edge technology and day-to-day business productivity?

As a Workforce Enablement Professional, you will contribute to the Digital Employee Experience. You won't just be fixing technical issues—you’ll act as a strategic digital consultant, partnering directly with business teams to automate processes, drive tool adoption, and ensure our workforce has the seamless IT experience they need to thrive.

If you love a mix of strategic IT consulting, hands-on technical problem-solving, and driving digital transformation from the ground up, this is the opportunity for you.

Key Responsibilities
Digital Workplace Ownership & Strategic Consulting

• You will act as a digital enabler for our business colleagues and functions and be the owner of the digital employee experience for the respective site.

• Present complex technical information to a non-technical audience in a clear and easy to understand manner. Take ownership of incidents and act decisively to ensure our customers maintain IT productivity.

• Provide technical consultancy for specific groups and work with them on how to leverage the existing tool for their benefit.

• Proactively approach business functions to understand their processes and suggest methods to increase productivity.

Hands-on Technical Support & Operations

• Day-to-Day Operations: Manage day-to-day IT activities at the site, working independently within company guidelines to maintain seamless operations.

• 2nd Level Support: Provide 2nd-level technical resolution (in-person or remote) for field-based and specialty spaces (GxP, Labs, R&D, etc.).

• Incident Ownership: Take ownership of incidents, act decisively to restore user productivity, and manage troubleshooting across network and system infrastructure.

• Vendor & Service Management: Work closely in conjunction with internal IT groups, Professional Services, and outsourcing partners to drive efficient solutions.

Mentorship, Training & Communication

• Translating Tech to Business: Present and communicate complex, highly technical information to non-technical stakeholders in a clear, accessible manner.

• Training & Onboarding: Design and conduct training programs to educate users on both basic and specialized applications of Digital Technology.

• Team Guidance: Act as a go-to resource and functional mentor for colleagues with less experience.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, Science or applicable discipline.

• A minimum of 5 years of direct experience with IT/desktop support.

• Excellent working knowledge of the ITIL v3 processes in IT service delivery.

• Strong consultative mindset, proactive communicator, self-starter capable of working under minimal guidance, and a passion for elevating the employee digital experience.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indianapolis, IN is between $65,500 - $121,700. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Expectation

• Able to handle & complete end to end AP daily operations & reporting activities timely & accurately adhering to the control process and meet the KPIs

• A team player with good soft skills, able to communicate well & work with the business partners & team members

• Contribute process and technical expertise to process improvement initiatives.

• Develop knowledge and capability to meet current and future business needs.

• Speak up to share challenges & best practices

• Agile in support projects & adhoc requests

Key Accountabilities:

• Process suppliers and intercompany invoices accurately and within the predefined KPIs

• Ensure timely payment of suppliers and Intercompany invoices in accordance with agreed payment terms & Intercompany payment schedule

• Respond promptly to internal and external queries, adhering to predefined KPIs.

• Perform timely and accurate AP month-end closing activities, including purchasing accruals, and provide related reports.

• Create and maintain up-to-date work documentation and processes in compliance with ICFR, group policies, guidelines, and local statutory/legal requirements within agreed timelines

Job Responsibilities:

(a) AP End to End Operations Activities

• Receive, sort, verify, handle exceptions, bar code, scan, and pre-archive Accounts Payable (AP) documents for further processing.

• Validate and process Purchase Order (PO) and contract-based invoices, non-PO invoices, prepayments, and down payments.

• Review supplier open items (due invoices, credit notes, debit balances, etc.) before executing payments.

• Perform duplicate checks & sanction screening, report exception to Sanction Screening Compliance Team

• Process payment and handle payment rejection, and reverse non-successful payments.

• Handle internal and external queries, response & resolve within the agreed timeline.

• Perform supplier statement of account reconciliation and follow up on open items for closure.

(b) Month End Closing and Reporting Activities

• Perform Purchasing Accrual analysis, propose accrual amount & commentary. Liaise with local Buyer, FM & CCA to validate the accrual amount for posting according to the process controls and timeline

• Perform month-end closing activities, adhere to the closing timetable

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, or yearly reports for Affiliates (tax reports, cash forecast report etc) and RSS monthly KPI reportsReconcile AP balance sheet accounts and clear aged items (e.g., GR/IR, GIT, suspense account).

• Participate in compliance audits, prepare statutory audit reports & respond to audit queries as necessary.Update process documentation to reflects the latest process & control requirement

(c) Operation Support

• Provide system & support guidance to team members and conduct internal process training for new joiners.

• Support business continuity by serving as a backup for peers or the seniors during their absence

• Troubleshoot AP issues (workflow, OCR, BOT, process) and work with respective teams (IT, Automation & GBPS) for resolutionParticipate & support implementation of projects/ initiatives from global, business partners & RSS.

• Engage in system integration and testing, user acceptance test (UAT) Initiate and support process improvement projects.

Qualifications & Experience Required:

• A degree in Finance & Accounting, Commerce, or equivalent.

• Professional qualification (e.g., ACCA, CPA, MIA) is an advantage.

• Good communication skills and proficiency in English

• Agile in progetti di supporto e richieste di adhoc

Capacità di contabilità chiave:

• Fornitori di processo e fatture intercompany con precisione e all'interno dei KPI predefiniti

• Assicurare il pagamento tempestivo dei fornitori e delle fatture Intercompany in conformità con i termini di pagamento concordati & Programma di pagamento Intercompany

• Rispondere tempestivamente a domande interne ed esterne, aderendo a KPI predefiniti.

• Eseguire le attività di chiusura puntuale e accurata AP fine mese, tra cui l'acquisto di accruals, e fornire rapporti correlati.

• Creare e mantenere la documentazione e i processi di lavoro aggiornati in conformità con ICFR, politiche di gruppo, linee guida e requisiti legali/legali locali entro termini concordati

Responsabilità del lavoro:

(a) AP End to End Operations Attività

• Ricevi, ordina, verifica, gestisci le eccezioni, il codice a barre, la scansione e i documenti pre-archivi dei conti pagabili (AP) per un'ulteriore elaborazione.

• Convalida e processo Ordine di acquisto (PO) e fatture basate sul contratto, fatture non-PO, pagamenti prepagati e pagamenti in calo.

• Fornitore di revisione articoli aperti (due fatture, note di credito, saldi di debito, ecc.) prima di eseguire pagamenti.

• Eseguire controlli duplicati e screening delle sanzioni, segnalare l'eccezione al Sanction Screening Compliance Team

• Elaborare il pagamento e gestire il rifiuto di pagamento e invertire i pagamenti non riusciti.

• Gestisci domande interne ed esterne, risposta & risoluzione all'interno della timeline concordata.

• Eseguire la dichiarazione del fornitore di riconciliazione del conto e seguire su elementi aperti per la chiusura.

b) Attività di chiusura e di segnalazione di fine mese

• Esegui l'analisi dell'accrostato di acquisto, proponga l'importo accrual & commento. Liaise with Local Buyer, FM & CCA per convalidare l'importo accrual per la pubblicazione secondo i controlli di processo e la timeline

• Eseguire attività di chiusura mese-fine, rispettare il calendario di chiusura

• Preparare relazioni mensili, trimestrali o annuali per gli affiliati (relazioni fiscali, rapporto di previsione in contanti ecc) e RSS relazioni mensili KPIReconcile conti di bilancio AP e elementi di età chiara (ad esempio, GR/IR, GIT, conto suspense).

• Partecipare ai controlli di conformità, preparare i rapporti di audit legali e rispondere alle domande di audit se necessario. Documentazione di processo di aggiornamento per riflettere il più recente processo & requisito di controllo

c) Supporto operativo

• Fornire assistenza e assistenza ai membri del team e condurre la formazione di processo interno per i nuovi iscritti.

• Supporta la continuità aziendale servendo come backup per i pari o gli anziani durante la loro assenza

• Risoluzione dei problemi AP (flusso di lavoro, OCR, BOT, processo) e lavorare con i rispettivi team (IT, Automation & GBPS) per la risoluzioneParticipate & supporto implementazione di progetti/ iniziative da parte di partner commerciali globali e RSS.

• Impegnarsi nell'integrazione e nella sperimentazione del sistema, test di accettazione dell'utente (UAT) Avviare e sostenere i progetti di miglioramento del processo.

Obbligatorio:

• Una laurea in Finanza e Contabilità, Commercio o equivalente.

• La qualificazione professionale (ad esempio, ACCA, CPA, MIA) è un vantaggio.

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e competenza in inglese

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This intermediate IT Infrastructure Engineer independently solves a range of technical business problems and contributes to challenging projects requiring deep knowledge in their area. You will design, build, test, and implement resilient solutions, evaluate new technologies, and contribute to technical documentation and standards for Linux technology.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and consulting internal or external stakeholders.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Skilled in solving a wide range of business problems with technology in creative and effective ways. Independently applies a complete understanding of theories and concepts from one’s technical discipline to address difficult problems. Contributes to delivery in challenging projects and designs, builds, tests, and implements (first-time deployments) integrated, resilient, and reliable solutions.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Exercises judgment in selecting methods and techniques to solve a variety of problems of larger scope and complexity. Evaluates promising technologies across two or more areas via proofs of concept (PoCs) to assess feasibility for business needs. Stays aware of operational challenges, works with product teams to provide internal escalation support for resolving incidents, and produces/maintains documentation for end-to-end designs and component standards. Responsible for the completion of milestones associated with specific projects.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates and presents complex information, issues, and potential solutions on assigned projects and to cross-functional teams. Networks with senior internal and external personnel within their area of expertise. Represents the organization on assigned projects and serves as a consultant to internal/external stakeholders on technical matters.

• Impact/Strategy: Plays a lead role responsible for key deliverables on projects and influences the decisions and direction of the project. May lead small project teams and mentor/lead individuals in the workgroup. Ensures that solutions and components comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and that technology designs adhere to the organization’s architectural strategy, policies, and direction.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Demonstrates proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse team members and virtual teams from various locations and cultural backgrounds to achieve project or product goals.

• Business / Technical ability: Demonstrates a wide application of technical principles, theories, and concepts in the technology area, with knowledge that is particularly deep in one area (e.g., network management, Platform Compute and Storage). Understands the business needs of assigned projects and maintains a general knowledge of other related disciplines.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience independently addressing a broad range of difficult technical problems and contributing to challenging projects.

• Experience in designing, building, testing, and implementing integrated, reliable IT infrastructure solutions.

• Experience representing workgroups on project teams, managing milestones, and potentially leading small project teams or mentoring individuals.

Technical / Business Skills

• Background in Linux/Unix Server technologies (RedHat, CentOS, Ubuntu, Satellite)

• In-depth knowledge in a specific I

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Questo intermedio IT Infrastructure Engineer risolve in modo indipendente una serie di problemi tecnici di business e contribuisce a sfidare i progetti che richiedono una profonda conoscenza nella loro area. Progettare, costruire, testare e implementare soluzioni resilienti, valutare nuove tecnologie e contribuire alla documentazione tecnica e agli standard per la tecnologia Linux.
Le forti capacità di problem solving e di comunicazione sono essenziali per collaborare efficacemente con i team interfunzionali e consultare gli stakeholder interni o esterni.

Descrizione della zona
Responsabilità del lavoro

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Abilitato nel risolvere una vasta gamma di problemi di business con la tecnologia in modi creativi ed efficaci. Indipendentemente applica una completa comprensione delle teorie e dei concetti della propria disciplina tecnica per affrontare problemi difficili. Contribuisce alla consegna in progetti e progetti impegnativi, costruisce, testa e implementa soluzioni integrate, resilienti e affidabili.

• Responsabilità/Problem Solving: Esercizi di giudizio nella selezione di metodi e tecniche per risolvere una varietà di problemi di portata e complessità più grandi. Valuta le tecnologie promettenti in due o più settori attraverso le prove del concetto (PoC) per valutare la fattibilità per le esigenze aziendali. Resta a conoscenza delle sfide operative, lavora con i team di prodotti per fornire il supporto all'escalation interna per risolvere gli incidenti, e produce / mantiene la documentazione per i progetti end-to-end e gli standard dei componenti. Responsabile del completamento delle pietre miliari associate a progetti specifici.

• Stakeholder Management: Comunica e presenta informazioni complesse, problemi e potenziali soluzioni su progetti assegnati e team interfunzionali. Reti con personale interno ed esterno senior all'interno della loro area di competenza. Rappresenta l'organizzazione su progetti assegnati e funge da consulente per gli stakeholder interni/esterni su questioni tecniche.

• Impact/Strategy: gioca un ruolo di primo piano responsabile dei principali responsabili dei progetti e influenza le decisioni e la direzione del progetto. Può condurre piccoli team di progetto e persone di mentore/ad nel gruppo di lavoro. Assicura che le soluzioni e i componenti siano conformi agli standard di qualità/regolazione e che i progetti tecnologici aderiscano alla strategia architettonica, alle politiche e alla direzione dell’organizzazione.

• Complessità / (Product Size): dimostra la comprovata capacità di collaborare efficacemente con diversi membri del team e team virtuali provenienti da varie sedi e background culturali per raggiungere obiettivi di progetto o di prodotto.

• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: dimostra un'ampia applicazione di principi tecnici, teorie e concetti nell'area della tecnologia, con conoscenze particolarmente profonde in un'area (ad esempio, gestione della rete, Compute della piattaforma e Storage). Comprende le esigenze aziendali di progetti assegnati e mantiene una conoscenza generale di altre discipline correlate.

Qualifiche
Istruzione / Esperienza

• Esperienza dimostrata indipendentemente affrontando una vasta gamma di problemi tecnici difficili e contribuendo a progetti impegnativi.

• Esperienza nella progettazione, costruzione, collaudo e realizzazione di soluzioni integrate e affidabili per l'infrastruttura IT.

• Esperienza che rappresenta gruppi di lavoro su team di progetto, gestione delle pietre miliari, e potenzialmente leader di piccoli team di progetto o persone di mentoring.

Competenze tecniche / aziendali

• Sfondo nelle tecnologie Linux/Unix Server (RedHat, CentOS, Ubuntu, Satellite)

• Conoscenza approfondita in una specifica I

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Dieser intermediäre IT-Infrastruktur-Ingenieur löst unabhängig eine Reihe von technischen Geschäftsproblemen und trägt zu anspruchsvollen Projekten bei, die fundierte Kenntnisse in ihrem Bereich erfordern. Sie entwerfen, bauen, testen und implementieren belastbare Lösungen, bewerten neue Technologien und tragen zur technischen Dokumentation und zu Standards für Linux-Technologie bei.
Starke Problemlösungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sind unerlässlich, um effektiv mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und interne oder externe Stakeholder zu konsultieren.

Beschreibung des Gebiets
Aufgabenbereich

• Umfang / (Content Leadership): Geschickt in der Lösung einer Vielzahl von Geschäftsproblemen mit Technologie auf kreative und effektive Weise. Wendet unabhängig ein vollständiges Verständnis von Theorien und Konzepten aus der eigenen technischen Disziplin an, um schwierige Probleme anzugehen. Trägt zur Lieferung in anspruchsvollen Projekten und Designs bei, baut, testet und implementiert (Ersteinsatz) integrierte, belastbare und zuverlässige Lösungen.

• Rechenschaftspflicht / Problemlösung: übt Urteilsvermögen bei der Auswahl von Methoden und Techniken aus, um eine Vielzahl von Problemen von größerem Umfang und Komplexität zu lösen. Bewertet vielversprechende Technologien in zwei oder mehr Bereichen über Proofs of Concept (PoCs), um die Machbarkeit für die Geschäftsanforderungen zu bewerten. Bleibt sich der operativen Herausforderungen bewusst, arbeitet mit Produktteams zusammen, um interne Eskalationsunterstützung bei der Behebung von Vorfällen zu bieten, und erstellt / pflegt Dokumentation für End-to-End-Designs und Komponentenstandards. Verantwortlich für den Abschluss von Meilensteinen, die mit bestimmten Projekten verbunden sind.

• Stakeholder Management: Kommuniziert und präsentiert komplexe Informationen, Probleme und mögliche Lösungen für zugewiesene Projekte und für funktionsübergreifende Teams. Netzwerke mit leitenden internen und externen Mitarbeitern in ihrem Fachgebiet. Repräsentiert die Organisation bei zugewiesenen Projekten und berät interne/externe Stakeholder in technischen Fragen.

• Impact/Strategie: Spielt eine führende Rolle für die wichtigsten Ergebnisse von Projekten und beeinflusst die Entscheidungen und die Ausrichtung des Projekts. Kann kleine Projektteams und Mentoren/Leiter in der Arbeitsgruppe leiten. Gewährleistet, dass Lösungen und Komponenten den Qualitäts- / Regulierungsstandards entsprechen und dass Technologiedesigns der architektonischen Strategie, den Richtlinien und der Ausrichtung des Unternehmens entsprechen.

• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Zeigt die nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, effektiv mit verschiedenen Teammitgliedern und virtuellen Teams von verschiedenen Standorten und kulturellen Hintergründen zusammenzuarbeiten, um Projekt- oder Produktziele zu erreichen.

• Business / Technische Fähigkeiten: Demonstriert eine breite Anwendung von technischen Prinzipien, Theorien und Konzepten im Technologiebereich, mit Wissen, das besonders tief in einem Bereich liegt (z. B. Netzwerkmanagement, Platform Compute und Storage). Versteht die Geschäftsanforderungen von zugewiesenen Projekten und pflegt ein allgemeines Wissen über andere verwandte Disziplinen.

Qualifikationen
Bildung / Erfahrung

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung, die unabhängig ein breites Spektrum schwieriger technischer Probleme anspricht und zu herausfordernden Projekten beiträgt.

• Erfahrung im Entwerfen, Bauen, Testen und Implementieren integrierter, zuverlässiger IT-Infrastrukturlösungen.

• Erfahrung in der Vertretung von Arbeitsgruppen in Projektteams, der Verwaltung von Meilensteinen und der potenziellen Leitung kleiner Projektteams oder der Betreuung von Einzelpersonen.

Technische / Business Skills

• Hintergrund in Linux/Unix Server Technologien (RedHat, CentOS, Ubuntu, Satellite)

• Tiefes Wissen in einem spezifischen I

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer for Edge Defense (Cloud)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate cloud-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.

As a Cloud Security Engineer, you will be part of the Information Systems Security team at Roche. You will join a global team of 40 engineers with expertise spanning Cloud Security, Endpoint Protection, Network Security, and Remote Access Management. This is an incredible opportunity to jumpstart your career, learn from senior experts, and grow your skills in a world-class enterprise security environment.
Job description

In the role of Cloud Security Engineer, you will integrate into the Information Systems Security division at Roche. You will be part of a global collective of 40 technical specialists whose proficiency encompasses Cloud Security, Endpoint Protection, Network Security, and Remote Access Management. This position offers a premier chance to launch your professional journey, gaining insights from seasoned experts and refining your capabilities within a sophisticated enterprise security framework

Responsibilities

1. Architecture & Design

• Collaboratively, develop and improve the security features and engineering capabilities for the Roche Cloud Platform (automatic deployment pipelines, secure controls and guardrails, abstraction layers to ease Cloud adoption, delegation capabilities to enable self-service functionality to end customers, etc.).

• Contribute, based on Security Epics, to the Cloud SecDevOps Engineering team on technical implementations and decisions and provide software security architecture and insight for propositions, product designs and service enhancements.

​
2. Product Lifecycle & Evolution

• Drive through all stages of the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and discussions with the Product Owner/Customer to the implementation and deployment of the security features, controls as code, and implement security policies and remediation processes using CI/CD.

• Focuses on priorities, milestones and deliverables as per direction of the product management team and Security Requirements.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Work with the Cloud SecDevops Engineering team to collaborate with stakeholders, customers, and external teams to improve Security posture of the Platform.

• Be part of the technical solution team focusing on maintaining service since they are live by measuring and monitoring availability and overall system health and improving the reliability of the IT Infrastructure

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Platform Engineer for Onsite Technologies, you will play a key role in the design, evolution, and continuous improvement of Roche’s workplace technology platforms. You will provide technical leadership across enterprise workplace services with a particular focus on Printing, Microsoft technologies, Automation, Platform Engineering, and service integrations. Working closely with architects, engineering teams, service delivery managers, and managed service providers, you will help ensure Roche’s workplace platforms remain scalable, reliable, secure, and operationally efficient.

You will contribute to the strategic evolution of workplace platforms while supporting global engineering initiatives and driving modernization efforts across the Onsite Technology Services portfolio. This role combines technical expertise, platform ownership, solution design, automation, and operational excellence within a global enterprise environment. The role is heavily focused on engineering, platform enablement, technical governance, and continuous improvement rather than people management responsibilities.

Your Responsibilities

• Design, maintain, and continuously improve workplace technology platforms.

• Drive technical roadmaps and platform modernization initiatives aligned with business and technology objectives.

• Ensure platforms are scalable, reliable, secure, and supportable.

• Contribute to technical standards, engineering practices, and operational governance frameworks.

• Support architecture reviews and technology evaluations.

• Act as a technical subject matter expert for enterprise printing solutions and related workplace technologies for creating great Office experiences.

• Drive continuous improvements across printing services, print management platforms, and associated integrations.

• Support implementation of new workplace technologies and service capabilities.

• Collaborate with vendors and service providers to improve platform performance and service quality.

• Identify opportunities for innovation and simplification across workplace services.

• Drive adoption of Microsoft technologies and automation capabilities across workplace services.

• Design and implement automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and service quality.

• Support integration of workplace services with Microsoft platforms and collaboration technologies.

• Contribute to Infrastructure as Code, workflow automation, and self-service initiatives.

• Promote automation-first engineering practices.

• Support operational engineering teams in improving platform reliability and service maturity.

• Analyze incidents, recurring issues, and operational trends to identify improvement opportunities.

• Drive root cause analysis and technical problem resolution activities.

• Contribute to observability, monitoring, telemetry, and operational health initiatives.

• Support service continuity and operational readiness activities.

• Work closely with Service Delivery Managers, Platform Engineering teams, Architects, and Managed Service Providers.

• Support global workplace technology initiatives and transformation programs.

• Provide technical guidance to operational teams and service stakeholders.

• Communicate technical risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities.

• Contribute to engineering roadmaps and strategic planning activities.

• Technical ownership of assigned workplace technology platforms.

• Subject matter expertise across printing, Microsoft

• Miglioramento continuo dei servizi di stampa, piattaforme di gestione della stampa e integrazioni associate.
• Sostenere l'implementazione di nuove tecnologie di lavoro e le capacità di servizio.
• Collabora con fornitori e fornitori di servizi per migliorare le prestazioni della piattaforma e la qualità dei servizi.
• Identificare opportunità di innovazione e semplificazione nei servizi di lavoro.
• Guidare l'adozione di tecnologie Microsoft e capacità di automazione attraverso i servizi di lavoro.
• Progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni di automazione che migliorano l'efficienza operativa e la qualità dei servizi.
• Supporto integrazione dei servizi di lavoro con piattaforme Microsoft e tecnologie di collaborazione.
• Contribuire alle Infrastrutture come Codice, automazione del flusso di lavoro e iniziative self-service.
• Promuovere le pratiche di automazione-prima ingegneria.
• Sostenere i team di ingegneria operativa per migliorare l'affidabilità della piattaforma e la maturità dei servizi.
• Analizzare gli incidenti, i problemi ricorrenti e le tendenze operative per identificare le opportunità di miglioramento.
• Guidare le attività di analisi delle cause root e risoluzione dei problemi tecnici.
• Contribuire alle iniziative di osservanza, monitoraggio, telemetria e salute operativa.
• Supporto della continuità del servizio e delle attività di prontezza operativa.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con Service Delivery Manager, team di Platform Engineering, architetti e fornitori di servizi gestiti.
• Sostenere le iniziative tecnologiche globali sul posto di lavoro e i programmi di trasformazione.
• Fornire assistenza tecnica ai team operativi e agli stakeholder dei servizi.
• Comunicare rischi tecnici, dipendenze e opportunità di miglioramento.
• Contribuire a roadmap di ingegneria e attività di pianificazione strategica.
• Proprietà tecnica delle piattaforme tecnologiche di lavoro assegnate.
• Competenze di materia per la stampa, Microsoft

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Rolle Spezifische Verantwortlichkeiten
Strategisches Design

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Strategie für verantwortungsvolle Produkte.

• Businessplan für verantwortungsvolles Produkt entwickeln; Launch-Price-Life-Cycle-Budgeting und Prognose.

• Thai Diagnostics Markt verstehen / analysieren; Aktualisieren Sie alle wichtigen Markttrends (Politik, Technologie, Kunden, Wettbewerber, Newcomer und Geschäftsallianzen).

Team Collaboration & Entwicklung

• Arbeiten Sie im Marketing Excellence Team und in funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um hohe Leistung und Geschäftswachstum zu gewährleisten.

Engagement der Interessenträger

• Etablieren Sie Beziehungen zu C-Suite und wichtigen Stakeholdern.

• Entwicklung von KOL, Business Networking, Referenzseiten zur Unterstützung von Roche Strategy.

Operative Exzellenz

• Verantwortlich für die Produktnachfrageplanung und die Gewährleistung der Zusammenarbeit mit dem Commercial Operation-Team, um effektiv zu sein und Abschreibungen und Produktknappheit zu minimieren.

• Überwachen und berichten Sie über die Leistung von Produktverkaufs- und Produktmanagementinitiativen und nehmen Sie bei Bedarf datengesteuerte Anpassungen vor.

• Entwerfen Sie Marketing-Tools, die zum thailändischen Markt passen.

Compliance und Qualität

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung lokaler Gesetze, bereichsspezifischer Richtlinien, Prinzipien und Qualitätsstandards im Krankheitsmanagement-Unterkapitel.

• Förderung einer Kultur der Compliance und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung aller Aktivitäten.

Qualifikation, Erfahrung und Kompetenzen

• Ausbildung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Medizintechnik oder MBA-Hintergrund ist vorzuziehen.

• Industry Support: Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Teams in der Gesundheits- oder Diagnostikbranche.

• Strategische Fähigkeit: Fähigkeit, strategische Pläne und Initiativen zu entwickeln und umzusetzen.

• Produktmanagement: Verständnis des Produktlebenszyklusmanagements, einschließlich Markttrends, Kundenbedürfnissen und Wettbewerbslandschaft.

• Kommunikation: Starke Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, um Beziehungen zu wichtigen Stakeholdern aufzubauen und aufrechtzuerhalten.

• Analytische Fähigkeiten: Analytische und Problemlösungskompetenzen mit Fokus auf datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung.

• Zusammenarbeit: Fähigkeit, in einer funktions- und matrixübergreifenden Umgebung zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Marketingstrategie: Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Durchführung von Marketingstrategien.

• Sprachkenntnisse: Gute Beherrschung von gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch (TOEIC > 700).

• Technische Fähigkeiten

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Please note that this role offers a fixed-term contract (up until Aug 31, 2027).

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

As a Finance and Accounting Team Lead you will coordinate complete, stringent and timely finance and accounting tasks the department's scope covers and proactively seek opportunities to allow more effective cooperation between teams / team members regardless of country / functional assignments.

In this role, you will focus on:

• Leading people management activities including goal setting, recruitment, and performance evaluation

• Ensuring the service quality in the responsible area

• Proactively and constructively managing change initiatives

• Fostering relationships with stakeholders in the respective business area

• Providing and organizing assistance to other teams or team members facing workload or expertise challenges

• Fostering a collaborative team environment where everyone thrives

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 5+ years of working experience in related field

• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools

• Strong communication skills, expressing ideas and expectations in a clear and concise manner

• Ability to work comfortably in a dynamic, changing and growing environment

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average. We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/dpn4candidates

Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

As a Finance and Accounting Team Lead you will coordinate complete, stringent and timely finance and accounting tasks the department's scope covers and proactively seek opportunities to allow more effective cooperation between teams / team members regardless of country / functional assignments.

• Ensuring the service quality in the responsible area

• Fostering relationships with stakeholders in the respective business area

• Providing and organizing assistance to other teams or team members facing workload or expertise challenges

• University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 5+ years of working experience in related field

• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools

• Strong communication skills, expressing ideas and expectations in a clear and concise manner

• Ability to work comfortably in a dynamic, changing and growing environment

• Proficiency in English

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Account Value Partner- Business Accelerator (New Account Acquisition)

Purpose of the Job
As a Business Accelerator, you are at the forefront of our mission to aggressively expand Roche's market presence in Thailand, specifically by targeting and converting new accounts currently served by competitors. This dynamic, field-based role demands a proactive hunter mentality to identify, engage, and secure high-value new partnerships with healthcare professionals and organizations, introducing them to Roche's innovative diagnostic solutions. You will be instrumental in displacing competitor solutions, building foundational new relationships, and significantly contributing to our market share growth and a healthier future.

Role-Specific Accountabilities

• Proactively identify, prospect, and convert new competitor accounts within the assigned territory, focusing on market share growth.

• Develop and execute aggressive strategies to displace competitor products and secure new business for Roche.

• Achieve ambitious new account acquisition and sales targets while managing costs efficiently.

• Conduct in-depth competitive analysis to develop compelling differentiation strategies and position Roche's solutions effectively.

• Initiate and nurture new high-level relationships with decision-makers in targeted competitor accounts.

• Lead tailored diagnostic solution presentations and value propositions to prospective new customers.

• Define and own medical education and KOL engagement strategies to attract and convert new accounts.

• Develop and implement strategic territory and new account acquisition plans focused on market penetration and competitor displacement.

• Demonstrate effective time management and prioritization in a competitive sales environment.

QUALIFICATIONS
Experience and Competencies:

• Proven success in new business development and competitive account conversion within the IVD or medical device industry.

• Exceptional prospecting and cold-calling skills with a relentless hunter mentality and drive to secure new logos.

• Adept at competitive selling, objection handling, and articulating differentiated value propositions.

• Strong negotiation skills to close complex deals with new clients.

• Deep understanding of business drivers, products, the local market, and competition.

• Ability to influence at all levels, position/sell ideas, and build trustful relationships.

• Capable of finding creative solutions to complex problems, driving results, and achieving outcomes.

Industry Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Medical Technology (required).

• 3+ years of work experience in a related sales or clinical field.

• Flexibility to be based in Northeastern Area or in a hybrid model, depending on the assigned territory.

• Proficient language skills in Thai and a good command of spoken and written English.

• A valid driver's license and willingness to travel frequently are required.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Conto Valore Partner- Acceleratore Business (Nuova Acquisizione Account)

Scopo del lavoro
In qualità di Business Accelerator, sei all'avanguardia della nostra missione per espandere aggressivamente la presenza di mercato di Roche in Thailandia, in particolare mirando e convertendo nuovi account attualmente serviti dai concorrenti. Questo ruolo dinamico e basato sul campo richiede una mentalità proattiva cacciatrice per identificare, coinvolgere e garantire nuove partnership di alto valore con professionisti e organizzazioni sanitarie, introducendole alle soluzioni diagnostiche innovative di Roche. Sarete strumentali nel displacing soluzioni concorrenti, la costruzione di nuove relazioni fondamentali, e contribuire significativamente alla nostra crescita di quote di mercato e un futuro più sano.

Responsabilità del ruolo

• Identificare, prospettare e convertire i nuovi conti concorrenti all'interno del territorio assegnato, concentrandosi sulla crescita delle quote di mercato.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie aggressive per spostare i prodotti concorrenti e garantire nuovi business per Roche.

• Ottieni obiettivi di acquisizione e vendita di nuovi account ambiziosi, mentre gestisci i costi in modo efficiente.

• Condurre un'analisi competitiva approfondita per sviluppare strategie di differenziazione e posizionare efficacemente le soluzioni di Roche.

• Avviare e nutrire nuovi rapporti di alto livello con i decisori in conti concorrenti mirati.

• Condurre presentazioni di soluzioni diagnostiche su misura e proposizioni di valore per i futuri nuovi clienti.

• Definire e propria formazione medica e strategie di impegno KOL per attirare e convertire nuovi conti.

• Sviluppare e implementare il territorio strategico e nuovi piani di acquisizione di account focalizzati sulla penetrazione del mercato e lo spostamento dei concorrenti.

• Dimostrare una gestione efficace del tempo e la priorità in un ambiente di vendita competitivo.

QUALIFICA
Esperienza e competenze:

• Risultato successo nel nuovo sviluppo aziendale e nella conversione competitiva del conto all'interno del settore IVD o dispositivi medici.

• Prospezione eccezionale e abilità di raffreddore con una mentalità di cacciatore implacabile e guidare per garantire nuovi loghi.

• Adept alla vendita competitiva, alla gestione delle obiezioni e all'articolazione di proposizioni differenziate di valore.

• Forte capacità di negoziazione per chiudere complesse offerte con nuovi clienti.

• Profonda comprensione di business driver, prodotti, il mercato locale e la concorrenza.

• Capacità di influenzare a tutti i livelli, posizione / idee di vendita, e costruire relazioni fiduciose.

• Capace di trovare soluzioni creative per problemi complessi, risultati di guida e risultati raggiunti.

Esperienza del settore:

• Laurea in tecnologia medica (richiesto).

• 3+ anni di esperienza lavorativa in un settore commerciale o clinico correlato.

• Flessibilità da basare in Northeastern Area o in un modello ibrido, a seconda del territorio assegnato.

• Competenti competenze linguistiche in Thai e un buon comando di inglese parlato e scritto.

• È richiesta una patente valida e la volontà di viaggiare frequentemente.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati all’avanzamento della scienza, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un più sano

Diese dynamische, feldbasierte Rolle erfordert eine proaktive Jägermentalität, um hochwertige neue Partnerschaften mit medizinischen Fachkräften und Organisationen zu identifizieren, zu engagieren und zu sichern und sie mit den innovativen Diagnoselösungen von Roche vertraut zu machen. Rollenspezifische Verantwortlichkeiten

• Proaktive Identifizierung, Prospektion und Konvertierung neuer Mitbewerberkonten innerhalb des zugewiesenen Gebiets, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf dem Wachstum des Marktanteils liegt.

• Erreichen Sie ehrgeizige neue Kontoakquisitions- und Verkaufsziele bei gleichzeitiger effizienter Verwaltung der Kosten.

• Führen Sie eine eingehende Wettbewerbsanalyse durch, um überzeugende Differenzierungsstrategien zu entwickeln und die Lösungen von Roche effektiv zu positionieren.

• Initiieren und pflegen Sie neue hochrangige Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern in gezielten Wettbewerbskonten.

• Definieren und eigene medizinische Ausbildung und KOL Engagement Strategien, um neue Konten zu gewinnen und zu konvertieren.

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung strategischer Gebiets- und Neukundenakquisitionspläne, die sich auf Marktdurchdringung und Verdrängung von Wettbewerbern konzentrieren.

• Demonstrieren Sie effektives Zeitmanagement und Priorisierung in einem wettbewerbsfähigen Verkaufsumfeld.

Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns eine gesündere
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Valeur du compte Partenaire - Accélérateur d'entreprise (nouvelle acquisition de compte)

Objet du travail
En tant qu'Accélérateur d'Affaires, vous êtes à l'avant-garde de notre mission d'étendre de manière agressive la présence de Roche sur le marché thaïlandais, notamment en ciblant et en convertissant de nouveaux comptes actuellement desservis par des concurrents. Ce rôle dynamique, basé sur le terrain, exige une mentalité de chasseur proactive pour identifier, engager et garantir de nouveaux partenariats de grande valeur avec les professionnels et les organisations de santé, en les présentant aux solutions diagnostiques innovantes de Roche. Vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans le déplacement de solutions concurrentes, l'établissement de nouvelles relations fondamentales et la contribution importante à la croissance de notre part de marché et à un avenir plus sain.

Responsabilités particulières

• Identifier, envisager et convertir de nouveaux comptes de concurrents sur le territoire assigné, en mettant l'accent sur la croissance des parts de marché.

• Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies agressives pour déplacer les produits concurrents et sécuriser de nouvelles affaires pour Roche.

• Atteindre de nouveaux objectifs ambitieux en matière d'acquisition de comptes et de vente tout en gérant efficacement les coûts.

• Effectuer une analyse concurrentielle approfondie pour élaborer des stratégies de différenciation convaincantes et positionner efficacement les solutions de Roche.

• Initier et entretenir de nouvelles relations de haut niveau avec les décideurs dans des comptes de concurrents ciblés.

• Présentez des solutions diagnostiques sur mesure et des propositions de valeur aux nouveaux clients potentiels.

• Définir et adopter des stratégies d'éducation médicale et d'engagement KOL pour attirer et convertir de nouveaux comptes.

• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des plans stratégiques de territoire et d'acquisition de nouveaux comptes axés sur la pénétration du marché et le déplacement des concurrents.

• Démontrer une gestion efficace du temps et des priorités dans un environnement de vente concurrentiel.

QUALIFICATIONS
Expérience et compétences :

• Succès prouvé dans le développement de nouvelles affaires et la conversion de comptes concurrentiels au sein de l'industrie de la DIV ou des instruments médicaux.

• Des compétences exceptionnelles de prospection et d'appel à froid avec une mentalité de chasseur implacable et un effort pour obtenir de nouveaux logos.

• Adepte de la vente concurrentielle, de la manipulation des objections et de la formulation de propositions de valeur différenciée.

• Fortes compétences en négociation pour conclure des ententes complexes avec de nouveaux clients.

• Connaissance approfondie des moteurs d'affaires, des produits, du marché local et de la concurrence.

• Capacité d'influencer à tous les niveaux, de positionner ou de vendre des idées et d'établir des relations de confiance.

• Capacité de trouver des solutions créatives à des problèmes complexes, de produire des résultats et d'obtenir des résultats.

Expérience de l'industrie :

• Licence en technologie médicale (obligatoire).

• 3+ ans d'expérience professionnelle dans un domaine commercial ou clinique connexe.

• La flexibilité doit être établie dans la région du Nord-Est ou dans un modèle hybride, selon le territoire assigné.

• Compétences linguistiques en thaï et bonne maîtrise de l'anglais parlé et écrit.

• Un permis de conduire valide et la volonté de voyager fréquemment sont nécessaires.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Laissez-les construire une santé

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The People Support Solutions (PSS) department brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions.

The opportunity:
As an Employee Lifecycle Management Specialist - German speaking you are part of a dynamic, vivid and spiritful Organizational Management and Compensation Team supporting our German affiliates. The Organizational Management and Compensation Team delivers customer service and advisory support to HR and business partners on global HR systems and processes, ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with our customer-focused principles.

Please note that this is a fixed-term opportunity, until December 31, 2028.

Your main responsibilities will be:

• Providing customer service on HR related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting in a proactive and customer focused way

• Supporting the embedding of the new ways of working, actively participating in the development and implementation of continuous improvement initiatives

• Behaving as role model to team members, showing positive and flexible attitude

• In close collaboration with our P&C Business Partners and the Works Council, you will manage promotion processes and compensation adjustments

• You will prepare seasonal pay offs for the whole german employee population such as vacation and christmas bonus or further ad hoc financial support

• You will strongly collaborate with the compensation and payroll teams on different topics

• You might prepare reports and analytics to support team dynamics and decision making as well as advice if needed
​
Who you are: ​
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• You have excellent communication skills; speaking English and German are routine for you

• Strong customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Strong stakeholder management and customer engagement skills

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Preferably you have some experience in employee lifecycle management or any related fields with focus on promotion, payment and compensation processes

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roch
