jobs.title: Communications Content and Channel Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
En Roche, nuestro equipo es fundamental para desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias de comunicación corporativa y de marca que refuercen la reputación, el posicionamiento y la credibilidad de la empresa en el sector salud. Trabajamos juntos para asegurar una comunicación clara, consistente y alineada con nuestra misión, valores y objetivos estratégicos, fortaleciendo la relación con stakeholders clave, incluyendo medios de comunicación, instituciones de salud, reguladores, pacientes y la comunidad médica. Nos enfocamos en liderar iniciativas de branding y storytelling que resalten el impacto de la innovación médico-científica y nuestro compromiso con la salud pública.

La Oportunidad
Estamos buscando un Especialista en Comunicación Externa y Digital para unirse a nuestro equipo. Esta posición será responsable de desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias de comunicación que refuercen nuestra reputación corporativa y el liderazgo de Roche en el ecosistema de salud.

Marca y storytelling

• Ejecutar y dar seguimiento a las estrategias de branding y posicionamiento que resalten la innovación de nuestras marcas estratégicas y el impacto en la salud.

• Crear y supervisar campañas de comunicación que refuercen la identidad y valores de Roche.

• Asegurar la alineación de la marca en todos los puntos de contacto, incluyendo comunicación digital y medios tradicionales.

Desarrollo y gestión de contenido y canales

• Redactar, editar y adaptar el contenido (copy, guiones, boletines, comunicados) para cada canal y formato, cuidando consistencia de mensaje, tono y voz de marca.

• Traducir los objetivos y la narrativa de comunicación en piezas de contenido concretas, ajustando lenguaje y estructura según el canal y la audiencia.

• Definir el canal más adecuado para cada contenido (digital, medios impresos, radio, podcast, eventos u otros) con base en la audiencia, el objetivo y el formato del mensaje.

• Desarrollar y mantener el calendario editorial de contenidos, coordinando tiempos de producción, revisión y publicación en los distintos canales.

• Elaborar y dar seguimiento a los briefs creativos para diseño, video y copy, asegurando alineación con la estrategia de marca, de canal y compliance.

Estrategia digital y gestión de plataformas online

• Colaborar en el diseño y ejecución de la estrategia de comunicación digital: creando y curando el contenido para sitio web, redes sociales, blogs, newsletters y otros canales digitales, asegurando mensajes alineados con los objetivos corporativos y de las marcas estratégicas.

• Monitorear, analizar y reportar métricas de desempeño digital para optimizar estrategias de comunicación y marketing online.

Relación con medios y stakeholders digitales

• Establecer y fortalecer relaciones con medios de comunicación, periodistas, influencers en salud y líderes de opinión en el entorno digital.

• Coordinar la difusión de comunicados de prensa, entrevistas y contenido relevante en medios tradicionales y digitales.

• Implementar estrategias de engagement con comunidades digitales, profesionales de la salud y organizaciones clave en el sector.

Comunicación corporativa y reputación

• Dar seguimiento a la participación de Roche en rankings y evaluaciones de reputación corporativa del sector salud, coordinando la recopilación y entrega de la información requerida.

• Monitorear los resultados de dichos rankings e identificar oportunidades de mejora para fortalecer el posicionamiento de la empresa.

Quién eres

• Escolaridad indispensable: Lice

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As an Accounts Payable Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for Accounts Payable matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

The Opportunity

• Invoice & Payment Processing – Handle receipt, verification, and processing of PO/non-PO invoices, prepayments, and intercompany transactions while ensuring timely and accurate payments.

• Reconciliation & Closing – Perform supplier and balance sheet reconciliations, clear aged items, and execute month-end closing activities including accruals and reporting.

• Query & Issue Resolution – Manage internal and external queries, investigate payment issues, and collaborate with relevant teams to resolve system or process-related problems.

• Compliance & Audit Support – Ensure adherence to company policies, ICFR, and statutory requirements; support internal and external audits as needed.

• Process Improvement & Knowledge Sharing – Drive process improvement initiatives, participate in system testing and integration, and provide training or mentorship to team members.

Who you are

• A degree in Finance & Accounting, Commerce, or equivalent. Professional qualifications (e.g., ACCA, CPA, MIA) are an advantage.

• Good communication skills and proficiency in English & Japanese Languages.

• Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking the specific country language for business communications.

• At least 2 years of experience in transactional accounting teams within a performance-driven environment.

• Knowledge and experience with SAP or other ERP/Accounting systems.

• Experience working in a shared service center across a global or large organization is advantageous.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

L'opportunité

• Traitement des factures et des paiements – Gérer la réception, la vérification et le traitement des factures, des paiements anticipés et des transactions interentreprises, tout en assurant des paiements exacts et en temps opportun.

• Rapprochement et clôture – Effectuer des rapprochements des fournisseurs et des bilans, effacer les éléments vieillis et exécuter les activités de clôture de fin de mois, y compris les charges à payer et les rapports.

• Résolution des questions et des problèmes – Gérer les questions internes et externes, enquêter sur les problèmes de paiement et collaborer avec les équipes compétentes pour résoudre les problèmes liés au système ou au processus.

• Soutien à la conformité et à la vérification – Veiller au respect des politiques de l'entreprise, du CIRF et des exigences législatives; appuyer les vérifications internes et externes au besoin.

• Amélioration des processus et partage des connaissances – Dirigez des initiatives d'amélioration des processus, participez aux essais et à l'intégration des systèmes et offrez une formation ou un mentorat aux membres de l'équipe.

Qui vous êtes

• Diplôme en finance et comptabilité, commerce ou équivalent. Les qualifications professionnelles (p. ex. ACCA, CPA, MIA) sont un avantage.

• Bonnes compétences en communication et maîtrise des langues anglaises et japonaises.

• Maîtrise de la lecture, de l'écriture et de la langue de pays spécifique pour les communications d'affaires.

• Au moins 2 ans d'expérience dans les équipes de comptabilité transactionnelle dans un environnement axé sur le rendement.

• Connaissances et expérience avec SAP ou d'autres systèmes ERP/Comptabilité.

• L'expérience de travail dans un centre de services partagés à travers une organisation globale ou grande est avantageuse.

Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Diagnostics Value Lead (DV Lead) for Clinical Diagnostics Solutions must have a strong purpose to enable and empower the team to deliver better outcomes under the motto: “To Improve lives by Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan.” As the Lead, you will think and act entrepreneurially, taking a whole-system perspective. You will translate strategic thinking into rigorous and thoroughly developed business and marketing strategies specific to the Clinical Diagnostics portfolio, ensuring that your team thrives in both the near and long term.

The Clinical Diagnostics Solutions portfolio includes Liver disease portfolio, navify AlgoSuite, Neurology & Infectious Diseases, Cardiac & Critical Care, Women’s Health & Health Check, Precision Oncology (Foundation Medicine, Avenio portfolio, navify Clinical Hub, Axelios1) and Clinical Research. These portfolios include instruments, assays and associated digital solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive, execute and monitor Marketing plans, strategies and tactics across the Clinical Diagnostics Solutions portfolio.

• Ensure strategies deliver medical value to healthcare systems, clinicians and patients, enabling optimal disease management to achieve better patient outcomes.

• Create synergy and collaborate closely with other commercial teams within RDTW, external partners, Roche Pharma Taiwan, APAC, and global teams.

• Role model VACC leadership (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) and work closely with relevant stakeholders both internally and externally.

• Manage and mentor your team members to build a high-performing, customer- and patient-focused team that exemplify an agile, creative, and learning organization.

• Lead and drive change and improvements in the Taiwan healthcare ecosystem, embodying the Roche motto: "Doing now what patients need next."

Role Scope:

• Actively lead and safeguard new ways of working and culture by being an ambassador and role model.

• Lead marketing and clinical engagement strategies to drive and expand the adoption of the Clinical Diagnostics Solutions portfolio. This includes maintaining a high level of market intelligence and maintaining a close liaison with key opinion leaders in the industry.

• Work closely with Customer Success Team (sales) to ensure sales and marketing alignment and successful execution of marketing plans.

• Enterprise thinking mindset, showing ability to integrate and draw connections across individual product portfolios e.g. systems and assays, functions and projects

• Ensure effective product lifecycle management through coordination of all commercial activities for existing and new solutions/products, management of customer and sales data, coordinate with Quality & Regulatory Affairs, manage stock allocation with Supply Chain and implementation of local and international marketing strategies.

• Contribute significantly to the achievement of financial targets (sales and adoption).

• Build strong internal and external relationships, developing partnerships and synergies to bring meaningful insights that catalyze strategy and product/service delivery.

• Take ownership of customer engagement by coordinating and planning appropriate resources to improve customer satisfaction. This includes creating and managing marketing budgets, to ensure efficient allocation of resources.

• Act as a visionary, connecting the Roche vision to functions, teams, squads, and individuals.

• Encourage smart-risk taking, prioritizati

jobs.title: Customer Support Partner (Application)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Customer Support Partner (Application) , you will be responsible to perform and install application setup, troubleshooting support and evaluation, conduct operator training for customer and internal team members aiming to ensure customer satisfaction and provide efficient customer support.
You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

In this role, you will

• Maintain and perform necessary support at customer site, such as troubleshooting, setup, install, and perform evaluation at customer's facility to ensure full functionality according to specification in a timely manner.

• Conducts operator / applications training and workshops for customers and peers.

• Develops, prepares and updates required training materials for training and demonstrations.

• Handles troubleshooting for customers and carries out root cause analysis, and liaises with GCS to manage technical issues when required.

• Responsible for ensuring (together with the Regulatory and Product team) that customer is informed of safety/ quality issues and technical updates via Customer Notification timely.

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of their needs and identifying shared purpose in order to create fruitful partnerships.

• Cooperate with the cross-functional support team to help customers solve the problem effectively.

Others:

• Represent Roche in engagement opportunities, collect and compile insights, positions and feedback to inform our access and policies strategies.

• Regularly check the intranet/emails and all available channels to keep up-to-date service information including instrument operation and application related information.

• Actively promote and provide digital service, proactive and remote support through Remote Care Giver.

• Well documented all customers’ touchpoints in the CRM system correctly in a timely manner.

• Meet customer service KPI and participate in continuous improvements.

• Take ownership of improving customer service experience, create engaged experience and facilitate organic growth.

• May act as a coach for colleagues with less experience and provide guidance. Proactively identify opportunities to improve and enhance the target audience experience. Work autonomously; complete work with minimal supervision or guidance but maintain communication with supervisor regarding progress.

• Any other tasks or projects as assigned from time to time

Who you are

You are someone who are/have:

• Strong troubleshooting and multi-tasking skills.

• Efficient, organized, details oriented and result driven.

• Customer-oriented individual and an outstanding problem-solver.

• Able to efficiently prioritize tasks in a fast-changing environment.

• Team players demonstrated by the ability to receive and provide feedback professionally thrive and collaborate in a cross-functional environment.

• Detail oriented, meticulous, responsive to deadlines.

• Ongoing interest in digital services, industry trends, best practices and emerging technologies.

Qualification and Experience

• Minimum Diploma in Health/Science/Medical disciplines or equivalent from a reputable University

• Preferably, at least 1-year experience/knowle

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
In qualità di Customer Support Partner (Application) , sarai responsabile dell'esecuzione e dell'installazione dell'applicazione, della risoluzione dei problemi e della valutazione, della formazione dell'operatore per i clienti e i membri del team interno al fine di garantire la soddisfazione del cliente e fornire un supporto clienti efficiente.
Lei dimostra lo scopo personale intorno a migliorare l'ecosistema sanitario pensando da un livello di impresa, oltre i confini e confini, per portare i migliori risultati possibili all'ambiente di salute; la creazione di migliori risultati di salute per più pazienti più veloce, e portando una forte mentalità imprenditoriale con capacità di partner eccezionali.

In questo ruolo, lo farai

• Mantenere ed eseguire il supporto necessario presso il sito del cliente, come la risoluzione dei problemi, l'installazione, l'installazione ed eseguire la valutazione presso la struttura del cliente per garantire la piena funzionalità secondo le specifiche in modo tempestivo.

• Conduce operatore / applicazioni formazione e workshop per clienti e colleghi.

• Sviluppa, prepara e aggiorna i materiali di formazione necessari per la formazione e le dimostrazioni.

• Gestisce la risoluzione dei problemi per i clienti e svolge l'analisi delle cause principali, e si lega con GCS per gestire problemi tecnici quando necessario.

• Responsabile per garantire (insieme al team Regolatore e Prodotto) che il cliente è informato di problemi di sicurezza/qualità e aggiornamenti tecnici tramite la Notifica del Cliente.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder, acquisendo una profonda comprensione dei loro bisogni e identificando lo scopo condiviso per creare partenariati fruttuosi.

• Collabora con il team di supporto interfunzionale per aiutare i clienti a risolvere il problema in modo efficace.

Altri:

• Rappresentare Roche nelle opportunità di coinvolgimento, raccogliere e compilare intuizioni, posizioni e feedback per informare le nostre strategie di accesso e politiche.

• Controlla regolarmente le e-mail intranet e tutti i canali disponibili per mantenere aggiornate le informazioni di servizio, comprese le operazioni degli strumenti e le informazioni relative alle applicazioni.

• Promuovere e fornire assistenza digitale, supporto proattivo e remoto tramite Remote Care Giver.

• Ben documentato tutti i touchpoint dei clienti nel sistema CRM correttamente in modo tempestivo.

• Incontra il servizio clienti KPI e partecipa a continui miglioramenti.

• Prendere la proprietà di migliorare l'esperienza del servizio clienti, creare esperienza impegnata e facilitare la crescita organica.

• Può agire come allenatore per i colleghi con meno esperienza e fornire guida. Identificare attivamente le opportunità per migliorare e migliorare l'esperienza del pubblico di destinazione. Lavoro autonomo; lavoro completo con minima supervisione o guida ma mantenere la comunicazione con il supervisore per quanto riguarda il progresso.

• Altri compiti o progetti assegnati di volta in volta

Chi sei

Sei qualcuno che è/ha:

• Forte risoluzione dei problemi e multi-tasking competenze.

• Efficiente, organizzato, i dettagli orientati e il risultato guidato.

• individuale orientato al cliente e un eccezionale problem-solver.

• In grado di priorizzare in modo efficiente le attività in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione.

• I giocatori di squadra hanno dimostrato la capacità di ricevere e fornire feedback professionalmente prosperare e collaborare in un ambiente interfunzionale.

• Dettaglio orientato, meticoloso, sensibile alle scadenze.

• Interessi in corso nei servizi digitali, tendenze del settore, best practice e tecnologie emergenti.

Qualificazione ed esperienza

• Diploma minimo in salute / scienza / discipline mediche o equivalente da un'università rispettabile

• Preferibilmente, almeno 1 anno di esperienza / conoscenza

jobs.title: ERP Business Analyst - Tax Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The ERP Tax Management team acts as a technical partner, managing digital solutions for indirect tax, direct tax, and transfer pricing. This multi-cultural, dynamic group leverages a mix of complementary skills to navigate and implement new tax mandates across the globe. Their primary mission is to design standardized global templates that provide a consistent digital framework for the entire organization. Simultaneously, they must remain agile enough to adapt these templates to meet unique local requirements for different affiliates. By bridging the gap between tax law and IT systems, they ensure seamless compliance across all international entities. They are responsible for the end-to-end delivery of technical mandates that protect the company's global financial position.

The Opportunity
In this role, you will be a key driver in our digital tax transformation, ensuring our global operations remain compliant and efficient. Your mission is to bridge the gap between complex tax laws and innovative IT systems within a dynamic team environment.

• Design Automated Logic : You will analyze intricate business requirements to design and deliver advanced automated tax determination logic within SAP S/4HANA using condition techniques.

• Drive Cross-Module Integration : You will ensure seamless integration of tax requirements across SD, MM, and FI modules to maintain consistent tax treatment throughout the entire supply chain.

• Lead Digital Reporting : You will support the technical setup for local statutory requirements, focusing on high-impact areas like real-time reporting and e-invoicing (e.g., SDI, CFDI).

• Manage Tax Engines : You will configure and maintain critical interfaces between SAP and external tax engines such as ONESOURCE or Sovos for real-time, accurate rate calculations.

• Bridge Business and IT : You will act as the primary liaison, translating complex global tax laws into clear, actionable functional specifications for technical teams.

• Ensure System Quality : You will lead comprehensive end-to-end testing cycles, including Unit Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

• Mitigate Global Risk : You will proactively resolve complex production issues where tax calculations or e-invoice submissions fail in high-volume transaction environments.

• Foster Innovation : You will contribute to the evolution of our global standardized templates, balancing consistency with the agility needed for local affiliate requirements.

Who you are
You are a proactive problem-solver who thrives on the intersection of technology and finance. You bring a meticulous approach to compliance and a passion for optimizing digital frameworks.

• Experienced Professional : You possess a minimum of 8+ years of hands-on implementation experience, including at least two full project lifecycles as an SAP SD/MM functional consultant.

• Academic Foundation : You hold a Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or an equivalent field of study.

• Tax Subject Matter Expert : You have expert knowledge of SAP Indirect Tax (VAT/GST) setup, with deep experience in complex EU tax rules within large MNC environments.

• Technical Troubleshooter : You possess strong ABAP debugging skills, allowing you to effectively troubleshoot complex tax calculation and interface issues.

• Regulatory Tech Specialist : You have experience implementing e-invoice submission frameworks; familiarity with SAP Document and Reporting Com

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il team di ERP Tax Management agisce come partner tecnico, gestendo le soluzioni digitali per le imposte indirette, le imposte dirette e i prezzi di trasferimento. Questo gruppo multi-culturale e dinamico sfrutta un mix di competenze complementari per navigare e implementare nuovi mandati fiscali in tutto il mondo. La loro missione primaria è quella di progettare modelli globali standardizzati che forniscono un quadro digitale coerente per l'intera organizzazione. Allo stesso tempo, devono rimanere agili abbastanza per adattare questi modelli per soddisfare i requisiti locali unici per le diverse affiliate. Separando il divario tra diritto fiscale e sistemi informatici, garantiscono una conformità senza soluzione di continuità tra tutte le entità internazionali. Sono responsabili della consegna end-to-end di mandati tecnici che proteggono la posizione finanziaria globale dell'azienda.

L'opportunità
In questo ruolo, sarai un driver chiave nella nostra trasformazione fiscale digitale, assicurando che le nostre operazioni globali rimangano conformi ed efficienti. La vostra missione è quella di colmare il divario tra leggi fiscali complesse e sistemi informatici innovativi all'interno di un ambiente di team dinamico.

• Design Logica automatizzata: Analizzerai i requisiti aziendali intricati per progettare e fornire una logica di determinazione fiscale automatizzata avanzata all'interno di SAP S/4HANA utilizzando tecniche di condizione.

• Integrazione tra i moduli SD, MM e FI garantisce un'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità dei requisiti fiscali per il mantenimento di un trattamento fiscale costante in tutta la catena di fornitura.

• Lead Digital Reporting: Sosterrai l'impostazione tecnica per i requisiti di legge locali, concentrandoti su aree ad alto impatto come la segnalazione in tempo reale e la fatturazione elettronica (ad esempio, SDI, CFDI).

• Gestisci i motori fiscali: Configura e manterrai interfacce critiche tra SAP e i motori fiscali esterni come ONESOURCE o Sovos per calcoli di tasso precisi in tempo reale.

• Bridge Business e IT: Si agirà come collegamento primario, traducendo complesse leggi fiscali globali in chiare e attuabili specifiche funzionali per le squadre tecniche.

• Garantisci la qualità del sistema: guiderai cicli di test end-to-end completi, tra cui test unità, test di integrazione di sistema (SIT), e test di accettazione utente (UAT).

• Rischio Globale Mitigate: Risolverai proattivamente problemi di produzione complessi in cui i calcoli fiscali o le richieste di fattura elettronica non riescono in ambienti di transazione ad alto volume.

• Foster Innovation: Contribuirai all'evoluzione dei nostri modelli standardizzati globali, bilanciando la coerenza con l'agilità necessaria per i requisiti di affiliazione locali.

Chi sei
Sei un problema-solver proattivo che prospera sull'intersezione di tecnologia e finanza. Porti un approccio meticoloso alla conformità e alla passione per l'ottimizzazione dei quadri digitali.

• Professionista esperto: Possiedi un minimo di 8+ anni di esperienza di implementazione pratica, tra cui almeno due cicli di vita di progetto completi come consulente funzionale SAP SD/MM.

• Fondazione accademica: si possiede una laurea o una laurea in Informatica, Business Administration, o un campo di studio equivalente.

• Esperto di materia fiscale: Hai una conoscenza esperta della configurazione di SAP Indirect Tax (VAT/GST), con una profonda esperienza nelle regole fiscali dell'UE complesse all'interno di grandi ambienti MNC.

• Troubleshooter tecnico: Possiedi forti capacità di debug ABAP, consentendo di risolvere efficacemente i problemi complessi di calcolo fiscale e di interfaccia.

• Specialista della tecnologia di regolamentazione: Hai esperienza nell'attuazione dei quadri di presentazione della fattura elettronica; familiarità con SAP Document e Reporting Com

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Das ERP Tax Management Team fungiert als technischer Partner und verwaltet digitale Lösungen für indirekte Steuern, direkte Steuern und Transferpreise. Diese multikulturelle, dynamische Gruppe nutzt eine Mischung aus komplementären Fähigkeiten, um neue Steuermandate auf der ganzen Welt zu navigieren und umzusetzen. Ihre Hauptaufgabe ist es, standardisierte globale Vorlagen zu entwerfen, die ein konsistentes digitales Framework für die gesamte Organisation bieten. Gleichzeitig müssen sie agil genug bleiben, um diese Vorlagen an die einzigartigen lokalen Anforderungen für verschiedene Affiliates anzupassen. Durch die Überbrückung der Lücke zwischen Steuerrecht und IT-Systemen gewährleisten sie eine nahtlose Compliance in allen internationalen Einheiten. Sie sind für die End-to-End-Lieferung technischer Mandate verantwortlich, die die globale Finanzlage des Unternehmens schützen.

Die Chance
In dieser Rolle werden Sie ein wichtiger Treiber in unserer digitalen Steuertransformation sein und sicherstellen, dass unsere globalen Aktivitäten konform und effizient bleiben. Ihre Mission ist es, die Lücke zwischen komplexen Steuergesetzen und innovativen IT-Systemen in einer dynamischen Teamumgebung zu schließen.

• Design Automated Logic: Sie analysieren komplizierte Geschäftsanforderungen, um mithilfe von Condition-Techniken eine fortschrittliche automatisierte Steuerermittlungslogik in SAP S/4HANA zu entwerfen und bereitzustellen.

• Drive Cross-Module Integration: Sie gewährleisten eine nahtlose Integration der Steueranforderungen in SD-, MM- und FI-Module, um eine einheitliche steuerliche Behandlung in der gesamten Lieferkette zu gewährleisten.

• Lead Digital Reporting: Sie unterstützen die technische Einrichtung für lokale gesetzliche Anforderungen, wobei Sie sich auf wichtige Bereiche wie Echtzeit-Reporting und E-Invoicing (z. B. SDI, CFDI) konzentrieren.

• Verwalten Sie Tax Engines: Sie konfigurieren und pflegen wichtige Schnittstellen zwischen SAP und externen Tax Engines wie ONESOURCE oder Sovos für genaue Ratenberechnungen in Echtzeit.

• Bridge Business und IT: Sie fungieren als primäre Verbindungsstelle und übersetzen komplexe globale Steuergesetze in klare, umsetzbare funktionale Spezifikationen für technische Teams.

• Systemqualität sicherstellen: Sie führen umfassende End-to-End-Testzyklen durch, einschließlich Unit Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT) und User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

• Mitigate Global Risk: Sie lösen proaktiv komplexe Produktionsprobleme, bei denen Steuerberechnungen oder E-Rechnungen in hochvolumigen Transaktionsumgebungen fehlschlagen.

• Foster Innovation: Sie werden zur Weiterentwicklung unserer globalen standardisierten Vorlagen beitragen und die Konsistenz mit der für lokale Affiliate-Anforderungen erforderlichen Agilität in Einklang bringen.

Wer du bist
Sie sind ein proaktiver Problemlöser, der an der Schnittstelle von Technologie und Finanzen lebt. Sie bringen einen sorgfältigen Compliance-Ansatz und eine Leidenschaft für die Optimierung digitaler Frameworks mit.

• Erfahrener Profi: Sie verfügen über mindestens 8 Jahre praktische Implementierungserfahrung, darunter mindestens zwei vollständige Projektlebenszyklen als SAP SD/MM Functional Consultant.

• Academic Foundation: Sie haben einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder ein gleichwertiges Studienfach.

• Tax Subject Matter Expert : Sie haben Fachwissen über die Einrichtung von SAP Indirect Tax (MwSt) und umfassende Erfahrung mit komplexen EU-Steuervorschriften in großen MNC-Umgebungen.

• Technische Fehlerbehebung: Sie verfügen über starke ABAP-Debugging-Fähigkeiten, mit denen Sie komplexe Steuerberechnungs- und Schnittstellenprobleme effektiv beheben können.

• Regulatory Tech Specialist: Sie haben Erfahrung mit der Implementierung von E-Invoice-Einreichungsframeworks; Vertrautheit mit SAP Document and Reporting Com
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
L'équipe de gestion fiscale ERP agit en tant que partenaire technique, gérant des solutions numériques pour la fiscalité indirecte, la fiscalité directe et les prix de transfert. Ce groupe multiculturel et dynamique met à profit un mélange de compétences complémentaires pour naviguer et mettre en oeuvre de nouveaux mandats fiscaux dans le monde entier. Leur mission principale est de concevoir des modèles mondiaux normalisés qui fournissent un cadre numérique cohérent à l'ensemble de l'organisation. Simultanément, ils doivent rester suffisamment agiles pour adapter ces modèles pour répondre à des exigences locales uniques pour différentes filiales. En comblant l'écart entre le droit fiscal et les systèmes informatiques, ils assurent une conformité transparente entre toutes les entités internationales. Ils sont responsables de l'exécution de bout en bout des mandats techniques qui protègent la situation financière mondiale de l'entreprise.

L'opportunité
Dans ce rôle, vous serez un moteur clé de notre transformation fiscale numérique, assurant que nos opérations mondiales restent conformes et efficaces. Votre mission est de combler le fossé entre des lois fiscales complexes et des systèmes informatiques innovants dans un environnement d'équipe dynamique.

• Conception Logique automatisée : Vous analyserez les exigences opérationnelles complexes pour concevoir et fournir une logique de détermination de la fiscalité automatisée avancée dans SAP S/4HANA en utilisant des techniques de condition.

• Intégration multimodules : Vous assurerez une intégration transparente des exigences fiscales dans tous les modules SD, MM et FI afin de maintenir un traitement fiscal uniforme tout au long de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.

• Rapport numérique principal : Vous soutiendrez la configuration technique pour les exigences réglementaires locales, en mettant l'accent sur des domaines à impact élevé tels que la déclaration en temps réel et la facturation électronique (p. ex., l'IDS, l'IDFC).

• Gérer les moteurs fiscaux : Vous configurez et maintenez des interfaces critiques entre SAP et les moteurs fiscaux externes comme ONESOURCE ou Sovos pour des calculs de taux précis en temps réel.

• Bridge Business et IT : Vous agirez comme la principale liaison, traduisant des lois fiscales mondiales complexes en spécifications fonctionnelles claires et réalisables pour les équipes techniques.

• Assurer la qualité du système : Vous dirigerez des cycles complets de tests de bout en bout, y compris des tests unitaires, des tests d'intégration du système (SIT) et des tests d'acceptation par l'utilisateur (UAT).

• Mitigate Global Risk : Vous résoudrez de façon proactive les problèmes de production complexes où les calculs fiscaux ou les soumissions de factures électroniques échouent dans des environnements de transactions à volume élevé.

• Favoriser l'innovation : Vous contribuerez à l'évolution de nos modèles standardisés mondiaux, en conciliant la cohérence avec l'agilité nécessaire aux exigences locales des filiales.

Qui vous êtes
Vous êtes un résolveur de problèmes proactif qui prospère à l'intersection de la technologie et de la finance. Vous apportez une approche méticuleuse de la conformité et une passion pour optimiser les cadres numériques.

• Expérience professionnelle : Vous disposez d'un minimum de 8 ans d'expérience pratique de mise en œuvre, y compris au moins deux cycles de vie complets du projet en tant que consultant fonctionnel SAP SD/MM.

• Fondation académique : Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en informatique, en administration des affaires ou d'un domaine d'études équivalent.

• Expert en matière de fiscalité : Vous avez une connaissance approfondie de la configuration de SAP Taxe indirecte (TVA/TPS), avec une expérience approfondie des règles fiscales complexes de l'UE dans de grands environnements MNC.

• Dépannage technique : Vous possédez de solides compétences de débogage ABAP, vous permettant de résoudre efficacement des problèmes complexes de calcul et d'interface fiscale.

• Spécialiste de la technologie de la réglementation : Vous avez de l'expérience dans la mise en oeuvre de cadres de soumission de factures électroniques; familiarisation avec SAP Document and Reporting Com

Join Roche as a Customer Service Digital Solutions Specialist where you will play a pivotal role in providing technical expertise and support for Roche IT solutions and Roche Instruments’ operating software at customer sites. This position focuses on ensuring smooth installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting while driving market strategies for Laboratory Business Improvement and Diagnostics IT solutions. Key Responsibilities:

• Install, maintain, and troubleshoot Roche IT solutions and software at customer sites, ensuring integration with Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS) via HL7 and ASTM standards.

• Collaborate with Sales, Service, and Marketing teams to promote Roche IT solutions, providing product positioning, customer value propositions, and consulting support on connectivity solutions, data security, and regulatory compliance.

• Offer workflow consulting services, including mapping and optimizing laboratory layouts and processes, leveraging tools such as turnaround time (TAT) simulations.

• Support sales efforts by delivering product presentations, demonstrations, and training to end-users, while ensuring staff are well-versed in IT product strategies.

• Drive the development of promotional concepts and marketing strategies in coordination with the Marketing Team to enhance the IT solutions portfolio.

• Proactively key in activities in the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system, escalating and resolving customer issues in a timely manner.

• Ensure compliance with Roche’s quality standards, regulatory requirements, and local SOPs. Maintain PPE usage and observe safety protocols during maintenance and service activities.

Who You Are

• Minimum of three (3) years’ experience in IVD IT Specialist role.

• Bachelor Degree in Information Technology

• Multinational company experience is preferred

• Proficient in both English and Filipino (written & spoken)

• Proficient in Personal Computer Skills, including Microsoft Office and Google Tools applications

• Creative Problem Solving and Time Management Skills and a bility to work independently and as a team player

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary) 主要工作目标（岗位简介）
As a core member of CPS&CSI, you will oversee the comprehensive management of the Roche China portfolio through prioritization, acceleration of Roche pipeline and bringing new pipeline, launch excellence, competitor intelligence, business development and late stage lifecycle management. The expected key outcomes are:

• Define China short/mid/long-term strategic goals and outcomes to deliver the overarching vision

• Develop the overall portfolio prioritization strategy for short, mid and long term

• Initiate and prioritize corporate level strategic engagements and follow through to track outcome

• Establish the framework and mechanism of an integrated pipeline planning process and launch roadmap

• Responsible for BD transactions for all commercial opportunities in China for China.

• Develop BD strategies to enhance our internal LifeCycle management activities, execute on business development needs for Roche including implementing new alternative commercial models

• Manage key strategic alliances with importance for China

• Provide the China perspective to Pharma Partnering for all deals

• Be the focal point for Established products lifecycle Team to align strategies and implement as relevant for China

• Strengthen the collaboration with the global relevant counterparts to ensure China's early and strong presence

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）

• Take a lead to support and integrate the inputs from various partners to define China short/mid/long-term strategic goals and outcomes to deliver the overarching vision with solid data and sound business rationale.

• Develop the overall portfolio prioritization strategy for short, mid and long term, playing a lead role in shaping the commercial development of Pharma China's future brands and significantly influencing management team and key stakeholders.

• Acts as a trusted advisor to the business's leadership and relevant stakeholders, initiates and prioritizes corporate level strategic engagements and follows through to track outcome.

• Establish the framework and mechanism of an integrated pipeline planning process and launch roadmap, and develop strategy, direction, and priorities to evolve the current Roche China portfolio, provide directions for internal as well as external assets sourcing focus.

• Identifying and implementing high-priority pre-launch and launch initiatives, meet or beat launch timelines, quality standards and other performance metrics

• Enable a high degree of cross-functional communication, inputs gathering and alignment, developing, sharing and driving best practices, scalable and sustainable processes, standards and tools to support excellence performing.

• Responsible for BD transactions for all late state commercial opportunities

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education & Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or above, MBA or an advanced degree in Business Administration, Strategy, or Finance is strongly preferred.

• More than 10 years of progressive experience within the pharmaceutical industry, specifically in portfolio strategy, corporate development, or pipeline management.

• Proven track record of evaluating and executing late-stage commercial BD transactions, asset sourcing, and alliance management within China.

• Proven capability to collaborate effectively with global counterparts, represent the China perspectiv

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Scopo primario di lavoro (Riassunto del lavoro)
Come membro centrale di CPS&CSI, supervisionerete la gestione completa del portafoglio Roche China attraverso la priorità, l'accelerazione della pipeline Roche e portando nuove pipeline, l'eccellenza di lancio, l'intelligenza concorrente, lo sviluppo aziendale e la gestione del ciclo di vita in fase avanzata. I risultati chiave attesi sono:

• Definire la Cina obiettivi strategici a breve/mezzo/lungo termine e risultati per fornire la visione overarching

• Sviluppare la strategia globale di priorità del portafoglio per breve, medio e lungo termine

• Iniziare e priorizzare gli impegni strategici a livello aziendale e seguire i risultati

• Stabilire il quadro e il meccanismo di un processo di pianificazione integrata delle tubazioni e lanciare roadmap

• Responsabile per le transazioni BD per tutte le opportunità commerciali in Cina per la Cina.

• Sviluppare strategie BD per migliorare le nostre attività di gestione interna di LifeCycle, eseguire le esigenze di sviluppo aziendale per Roche, compresa l'implementazione di nuovi modelli commerciali alternativi

• Gestire le principali alleanze strategiche con importanza per la Cina

• Fornire la prospettiva della Cina per Pharma Partnering per tutte le offerte

• Essere il punto focale per il team del ciclo di vita dei prodotti stabiliti per allineare le strategie e implementare come rilevanti per la Cina

• Rafforzare la collaborazione con le controparti rilevanti globali per garantire la presenza precoce e forte della Cina

Principio Roles & Responsabilità / Responsabilità dei conti
(Le principali funzioni della posizione) (职ی的)

• Prendere un vantaggio per supportare e integrare gli input da vari partner per definire la Cina obiettivi strategici a breve/mezzo/lungo termine e risultati per fornire la visione overarching con dati solidi e solida business razionale.

• Sviluppare la strategia globale di priorità del portafoglio per breve, medio e lungo termine, giocando un ruolo di primo piano nella modellazione dello sviluppo commerciale dei marchi futuri di Pharma China e influenzando significativamente il team di gestione e gli stakeholder chiave.

• Agisce come consulente di fiducia per la leadership del business e le parti interessate rilevanti, avvia e privilegia gli impegni strategici a livello aziendale e segue per monitorare i risultati.

• Stabilire il quadro e il meccanismo di un processo di pianificazione integrata delle tubazioni e lanciare roadmap, e sviluppare strategia, direzione e priorità per evolvere l'attuale portafoglio Roche China, fornire indicazioni per le attività interne e esterne che sourcing focus.

• Identificare e implementare iniziative di pre-lancio e lancio ad alta priorità, soddisfare o battere tempi di lancio, standard di qualità e altre metriche di performance

• Abilitare un alto grado di comunicazione interfunzionale, input di raccolta e allineamento, lo sviluppo, la condivisione e la guida delle migliori pratiche, processi scalabili e sostenibili, standard e strumenti per supportare l'eccellenza performante.

• Responsabile delle transazioni BD per tutte le opportunità commerciali in ritardo

Qualificazione e esperienza
Istruzione e qualifiche

• Laurea o superiore, MBA o un grado avanzato in Business Administration, strategia, o finanza è fortemente preferito.

• Più di 10 anni di esperienza progressiva nell'industria farmaceutica, in particolare nella strategia di portafoglio, nello sviluppo aziendale o nella gestione delle tubazioni.

• Provato il record di traccia di valutazione e l'esecuzione di transazioni commerciali BD di fine fase, asset sourcing e gestione delle alleanze all'interno della Cina.

• Prove capacità di collaborare efficacemente con le controparti globali, rappresentano il perspectiv cinese

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Background:
Local support at the CMO Gosun in Shenzhen for the upcoming technology transfer of Avastin drug product filling, visual inspection and secondary packaging to Gosun, subsequently followed by Herceptin SC and Phesgo.

Role Description:

• Work closely with and support the Technical Transfer team to manage and meet the deliverables and timelines for process and method transfers at Gosun and Shanghai.

• Act as liaison between the transfer team and Gosun.

• Manage and ensure Drug Substance (DS) import and shipment to Gosun in time for technical transfers.

• Manage and ensure sample shipment between Gosun and Shanghai per project plans.

• Support the Gosun team in writing and completing product specific validation and qualification plans and reviewing them locally with the respective QA person.

• Review and approve Chinese and English documentation.

• Observe operational activities like media fills, test runs, technical batches as a Person in Plant (PiP) and capture observation minutes, drive and coordinate technical mitigation activities and troubleshooting.

Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Hintergrund:
Lokale Unterstützung beim CMO Gosun in Shenzhen für den bevorstehenden Technologietransfer von Avastin-Arzneimittelabfüllung, Sichtprüfung und Sekundärverpackung nach Gosun, gefolgt von Herceptin SC und Phesgo.

• Verwalten und gewährleisten Sie den Mustertransport zwischen Gosun und Shanghai nach Projektplänen.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

La position
Rappel:
Soutien local à l'OCM Gosun à Shenzhen pour le transfert de technologie à Gosun du remplissage des produits pharmaceutiques Avastin, de l'inspection visuelle et de l'emballage secondaire, suivi par Herceptin SC et Phesgo.

Description du rôle :

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe du transfert technique et l'appuyer pour gérer et respecter les livrables et les échéanciers des transferts de processus et de méthodes à Gosun et Shanghai.

• Agir comme liaison entre l'équipe de transfert et Gosun.

• Gérer et assurer l'importation et l'expédition de substances médicamenteuses à Gosun à temps pour les transferts techniques.

• Gérer et assurer l'expédition d'échantillons entre Gosun et Shanghai par plan de projet.

• Aider l'équipe Gosun à rédiger et à compléter des plans de validation et de qualification spécifiques au produit et à les examiner localement avec la personne responsable de l'AQ.

• Examiner et approuver la documentation en chinois et en anglais.

• Observer les activités opérationnelles comme le remplissage des médias, les essais, les lots techniques en tant que personne en usine (PiP) et capturer les minutes d'observation, conduire et coordonner les activités techniques d'atténuation et le dépannage.

• Superviser la documentation conforme aux BPF des activités en collaboration avec l'AQ en usine

• Soutenir les analyses des lacunes techniques et les évaluations des risques dans le contexte des transferts techniques

• Aider l'équipe Gosun à définir, installer et qualifier les étapes/équipements opérationnels manquants, p. ex.:
• préparation et manipulation de l'API pour Herceptine SC et Phesgo

• processus d'emballage secondaire pour tous les produits

• Établir des processus d'expédition robustes pour les échantillons, les marchandises et les produits entre Gosun et Shanghai en collaboration avec l'équipe de Shanghai

• Coordonner l'examen de la documentation pertinente avec l'équipe de Shanghai (p. ex. la documentation par lots)

• Collaborer avec Roche pour coordonner les activités locales à Gosun avec les fonctions mondiales (p. ex. TTL, gestionnaire de site, poste QA). Participer aux réunions de l'OMC et du projet pour suivre les actions et les jalons

• Agir en tant que SPOC dans le pays aux équipes logistiques, réglementaires et de qualité respectives

Exigences en matière de capacités :

• Fond solide dans la fabrication stérile
• une bonne compréhension des exigences du processus de fabrication pour le remplissage aseptique, le composé, le gel/dégel DS, l'inspection visuelle et l'emballage

• expérience dans la fabrication stérile de produits biologiques

• bonne connaissance des exigences de qualité/réglementation respectives, y compris l'annexe 1 de l'UE

• L'expérience de la technologie à usage unique est un plus

• Fortes compétences en communication en anglais et en chinois

• Peut naviguer dans l'ambiguïté et l'incertitude

• Capacité de dépenser environ. 40% - 60 % du temps de travail à Shenzhen et la volonté de voyager entre Shanghai et Shenzhen.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

The Position
The Opportunity

As an Financial Compliance Authorization Analyst you will:

SAP access management support for missing or locked users. Access management support in case of missing role / job function assignment

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize, follow-through, and manage multiple tasks, responsibilities, and deadlines.

• Expertise is SAP security management, coordinating and implementing SAP authorization development in accordance with user roles and segregation of duties responsibilities.

Critical thinking and problem solving that result in process improvements

• First point of contact for key stakeholders, ensure collaborative relationship. Regular operational reviews with stakeholders for own area. Contribute to develop Customer Satisfaction on a cross-functional level

Who you are

• Bachelor's degree in a business or IT related field (e.g., Accounting, Finance, Economics, Information Science, etc.)

• 3-4 years of SAP experience (preferably in a consultant and/or helpdesk role)

• Strong knowledge in the area of (SAP) authorization and access management and GRC tools, based on business process management or IT experience and expertise

• Proven customer-centric mindset (internal and external). Exceptional problem solving and communication skills

• Very good skills in English and in international & intercultural collaboration. Ability to work independently and proactively

• Agile mindset (speed, stability, flexibility) - work according to and brings in agile mindset concept in daily operations. Good collaboration, teamwork and interpersonal skills. Good administrative skills. Interest to gain experiences in SAP Security and SoD compliance, and a good team player.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility : We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

jobs.title: Business Analytics Lead (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

As the Business Analytics Lead , you will be the strategic architect of the data roadmap shaping the Patient Insights portfolio and strategy at Roche Information Solutions (RIS). You will serve as the single source of truth for the RIS Patient Insights portfolio metrics and act as the orchestrator of Patient Insights-wide business analytics. You will create effective strategies to collect data, analyze information, conduct research and implement analytics. You will bring a keen strategic focus and ability to translate data into actionable insights, championing data-driven decision making and the journey at RIS Patient Insights to become the leading chronic disease management company.
We are looking for a proven business leader. You demonstrate energy, passion, courage, vision and the drive to be part of an organization at the forefront of the industry, delivering benefits for patients, our people, and our business.

The Business Analytics Lead will report to the Head of Digital Solutions Analytics. The Position is based in Vienna, Austria. This is a global role and up to 30% travel (largely international) is required.

Your upcoming mission:
Within this role, your responsibilities will fall into these main areas:
Business Analytics & KPI Strategy & Orchestration

• You explore, develop, implement and evaluation innovative business analytic solutions to meet customer needs (internal and external)

• You act as a bridge between traditionally siloed data sets (e.g. Finance, Portfolio, CX, Sales) in order to inform RIS Patient Insights business decisions and promote alignment with RIS Patient Insights Strategy

• You lead key strategic initiatives related to RIS Patient Insights-wide data analytics (e.g. executive dashboard creation; transversal governance data requirement / definition) – developing and coordinating project plans with stakeholders to deliver to expectations

• You collaborate with other business intelligence functions (incl. Finance, Commercial) to harmonize and simply the KPI identification, gathering, collection and visualization processes

• You work with technical colleagues in R&D and IT, identifying business requirements related to data analytics and supporting development of solutions that meet customer requirements (internal and external)

Customer Solution Business Analytics & KPIs:

• You serve as the single source of truth for RIS Patient Insights customer portfolio metrics

• You collaborate with product, service and solution development and pipeline key stakeholders to define key performance metrics for all RIS Patient Insights solutions – tracking product development, commercialization and use

• You serve as the accountable business owner of key reporting solutions (e.g. Tableau), serving as a ‘super user’ able to interrogate data and translate it into actionable insight

• You provide expertise with respect to portfolio analytics and key strategic recommendations that facilitate trade-off discussions

• You serve as an extended member of RIS Patient Insights’ solution development team at distinct points in product development – providing Business Analytic expertise

• As required, you act as a ‘visitor’ to RIS Patient Insights solution development Agile Release Trains (ARTs), participating in standard SAFe ceremonies and providing ‘hands on’ support

Leadership & Growth Mindset:

• You serve as a co

descriptionByLocale.it:
Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme! Combinando i nostri punti di forza unici, ridefiniamo la salute attraverso l'azione sostenibile e l'innovazione. Per uno sguardo dietro le quinte, controllare questo video per vedere come siamo a Roche stanno rendendo l'assistenza sanitaria personalizzata una realtà.

La mySugr GmbH è stata acquisita da Roche nel 2017 e il nostro ufficio di Vienna è uno dei siti globali di Roche. Ti troverai qui, nel cuore di Vienna, non importa se lavori su mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® o qualsiasi altro prodotto o soluzione Roche. Potete leggere di più sulla storia di mySugr & Roche qui .

Ecco cosa stiamo cercando:

Come Lead Business Analytics, sarai l'architetto strategico della roadmap dei dati che modella il portafoglio e la strategia di Insights del paziente a Roche Information Solutions (RIS). Potrai servire come unica fonte di verità per le metriche del portafoglio di informazioni paziente RIS e agire come orchestratore di analisi di business a livello di pazienti. Potrai creare strategie efficaci per raccogliere dati, analizzare informazioni, condurre la ricerca e implementare analisi. Si porterà un forte focus strategico e la capacità di tradurre i dati in insights attuabili, sostenendo il processo decisionale basato sui dati e il viaggio a RIS Pazienti Insights per diventare la principale società di gestione delle malattie croniche.
Stiamo cercando un leader di business collaudato. Dimostra energia, passione, coraggio, visione e la spinta a far parte di un'organizzazione all'avanguardia del settore, offrendo benefici per i pazienti, la nostra gente e la nostra attività.

Il Leader di Business Analytics riferirà al Responsabile di Digital Solutions Analytics. La posizione si trova a Vienna, in Austria. Questo è un ruolo globale e fino al 30% di viaggio (in gran parte internazionale) è richiesto.

La vostra prossima missione:
In questo ruolo, le vostre responsabilità cadranno in questi settori principali:
Business Analytics & KPI Strategy & Orchestration

• Esplora, sviluppa, implementa e valuta soluzioni analitiche aziendali innovative per soddisfare le esigenze dei clienti (interni ed esterni)

• L'utente agisce come un ponte tra i set di dati tradizionalmente siloed (ad esempio Finance, Portfolio, CX, Sales) al fine di informare le decisioni aziendali di RIS Paziente Insights e promuovere l'allineamento con la strategia di rischio paziente

• Conduci iniziative strategiche chiave legate alla analisi dei dati a livello dei pazienti RIS (ad esempio la creazione di dashboard executive; il requisito / la definizione dei dati di governance trasversale) – lo sviluppo e il coordinamento dei piani di progetto con gli stakeholder per fornire alle aspettative

• Collabora con altre funzioni di business intelligence (incluse Finanza, Commerciale) per armonizzare e semplicemente i processi di identificazione, raccolta, raccolta e visualizzazione KPI

• Lavora con colleghi tecnici in R&D e IT, identificando i requisiti aziendali relativi all'analisi dei dati e supportando lo sviluppo di soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti dei clienti (interni ed esterni)

Soluzione clienti Business Analytics & KPI:

• Lei funge da unica fonte di verità per le metriche del portafoglio clienti di RIS

• Collaborate con gli stakeholder chiave di prodotto, servizio e sviluppo di soluzioni e pipeline per definire le metriche di performance chiave per tutte le soluzioni di Insights paziente RIS – monitoraggio dello sviluppo dei prodotti, commercializzazione e utilizzo

• Lei è il proprietario responsabile di soluzioni di reporting chiave (ad esempio Tableau), servendo come un ‘utente superiore’ in grado di interrogare i dati e tradurlo in una visione attuabile

• L'utente fornisce competenze in materia di analisi del portafoglio e raccomandazioni strategiche chiave che facilitano le discussioni di trade-off

• Sei un membro esteso del team di sviluppo di soluzioni di RIS Paziente Insights in punti distinti nello sviluppo dei prodotti – fornendo competenze di Business Analytic

• Come richiesto, si agisce come ‘visitatore’ per lo sviluppo della soluzione RIS Paziente Insights Agile Release Trains (ART), partecipando alle cerimonie standard SAFe e fornendo ‘mani su’ supporto

Leadership & Growth Mindset:

• Tu servi come co

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

客户管理
• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道 , 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（ HCP ）观念、学术需求 传递专业化医学 / 疾病 / 产品信息
• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生 / 科室教育 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
• 组织和支持区域专家会议
• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

你需要具备哪些条件才能加大申请这个岗位的竞争力呢？
岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 ( 使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维 )

工作年限
• 3 年以上医药行业工作经验
• 既往有学术推广 / 市场 / 医学经验
• 跨职能工作经验为佳

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Partner/Partnerka ds. Rozwoju Biznesu
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Partner/Partnerka ds. Rozwoju Biznesu (Business Development Partner)

• Dział: Sprzedaż (Sales)

• System czasu pracy: Zadaniowy

• Raportowanie do: Business Development Chapter Lead

Czym będziesz się zajmować?

Jako Business Development Partner będziesz odpowiedzialny/a za aktywne pozyskiwanie nowych klientów oraz rozwój strategicznych obszarów biznesowych, które umocnią pozycję Roche jako lidera rynku Diagnostyki Laboratoryjnej . Rola ta wymaga proaktywnego i ambitnego podejścia do rynku. Twoim zadaniem będzie analiza otoczenia konkurencyjnego, tworzenie skutecznych strategii akwizycyjnych oraz ich skuteczna realizacja w celu przejmowania kluczowych, wysokowartościowych kontraktów.

Twoje główne zadania:

• Analiza rynku i selekcja potencjalnych klientów : Systematyczna ocena potencjału rynkowego oraz identyfikacja nowych szans biznesowych, ze szczególnym uwzględnieniem segmentów obsługiwanych obecnie przez konkurencję.

• Strategiczne planowanie i realizacja: Tworzenie spersonalizowanych planów biznesowych, nadzór nad procesem przygotowywania ofert oraz prowadzenie działań sprzedażowych aż do pomyślnego zamknięcia transakcji.

• Liderowanie współpracy międzyobszarowej (Cross-Functional Orchestration): Koordynowanie pracy wewnętrznych, multidyscyplinarnych zespołów projektowych oraz ścisła współpraca z działami: Medycznym, Marketingu, Konsultingu, Serwisu i Finansów w celu harmonizacji wspólnych inicjatyw.

• Zarządzanie projektami długoterminowymi: Kierowanie złożonymi, długofalowymi projektami strategicznymi, wspieranie zespołów klienta w osiąganiu wymiernych rezultatów oraz dbanie o płynne przekazanie klientów do działu obsługi klientów bezpośrednich (prywatnych i publicznych).

Kogo szukamy?

• Doświadczenie w obszarze Sprzedaży, Marketingu lub Konsultingu.

• Znajomość branży: Głębokie zrozumienie rynku ochrony zdrowia, kwestii finansowych, działań konkurencji oraz portfolio produktów Roche.

• Metodologie i narzędzia: Znajomość metodologii doskonałości sprzedażowej (np. Miller Heiman), systemu Salesforce/REXIS oraz nowoczesnych narzędzi zarządzania projektami.

• Języki i mobilność: Pełna biegłość w języku polskim i bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego oraz gotowość do podróży służbowych na terenie kraju (na co dzień może mieszkać i pracować zdalnie z dowolnego miejsca w Polsce).

Dodatkowe umiejętności:

• Determinacja i nastawienie na cel: Dyscyplina, silna orientacja na sukces, przedsiębiorcza mentalność oraz wysoka odporność na stres w warunkach długich i złożonych cykli sprzedażowych.

• Budowanie relacji i zaufania od zera: Ponadprzeciętne umiejętności komunikacyjne i negocjacyjne. Zdolność do występowania w roli zaufanego doradcy strategicznego oraz skutecznego wywierania wpływu na interesariuszy na wszystkich szczeblach – w tym na kadrę zarządzającą wyższego szczebla (C-suite).

• Przywództwo strategiczne: Umiejętność zarządzania złożonymi procesami, efektywne łączenie całościowej strategii firmy z realnymi potrzebami klientów oraz stosowanie zasad przywództwa VACC do angażowania zespołów międzyobszarowych.

Co oferujemy?

• Umowę o pracę,

• Roczną premię zależną od wyników,

• Samochód służbowy,

• Prywatną opiekę medyczną (LuxMed), ubezpieczenie na życie (UNUM),

• Lekcje językowe, szkolenia i możliwość rozwoju w międzynarodowej organizacji,

• 2 dodatkowe dni wolne w kwartale („Recharge Days”),

• Płatny urlop na działalność charytatywną (do 2 tygodni rocznie),

• Dostęp do programów zakupu sprzętu i aut pracowniczych i wiele więcej!

• Doświadczenie w obszarze Sprzedaży, Marketingu lub Konsultingu.

• Znajomość branży: Głębokie zrozumienie rynku ochrony zdrowia, kwestii finansowych, działań konkurencji oraz portfolio produktów Roche.

• Metodologie i narzędzia: Znajomość metodologii doskonałości sprzedażowej (np. Miller Heiman), systemu Salesforce/REXIS oraz nowoczesnych narzędzi zarządzania projektami.

• Języki i mobilność: Pełna biegłość w języku polskim i bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego oraz gotowość do podróży służbowych na terenie kraju (na co dzień może mieszkać i pracować zdalnie z dowolnego miejsca w Polsce).

Dodatkowe umiejętności:

• Determinacja i nastawienie na cel: Dyscyplina, silna orientacja na sukces, przedsiębiorcza mentalność oraz wysoka odporność na stres w warunkach długich i złożonych cykli sprzedażowych.

Zdolność do występowania w roli zaufanego doradcy strategicznego oraz skutecznego wywierania wpływu na interesariuszy na wszystkich szczeblach – w tym na kadrę zarządzającą wyższego szczebla (C-suite).

• Roczną premię zależną od wyników,

• Samochód służbowy,
