jobs.title: Sr. Manufacturing Engineer -Controls
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Doing now what patients need next. Near Patient Care is committed to helping people with diabetes everywhere in the world think less about their daily diabetes routine, so they can get true relief, day and night. We offer a broad portfolio of solutions for both people with diabetes and their professionals - from blood glucose monitoring to information management to continuous glucose monitoring. Our aim is to offer innovative products, services and comprehensive solutions for convenient, efficient and effective diabetes management.

Internal Manufacturing Indianapolis is a function within Roche Diagnostics - Near Patient Care Operations, responsible for the strip manufacturing of the majority of our blood glucose monitoring portfolio for the global demand of our patients. In the future, Internal Manufacturing Indianapolis will also be responsible for sensor manufacturing for our continuous glucose monitoring portfolio.

The Opportunity:

Join our Equipment Performance team at Roche Diagnostics, Indianapolis, as a Sr. Manufacturing Engineer -Controls . This role offers the opportunity to lead continuous improvement projects using a data-driven approach while providing technical support for our advanced automated manufacturing equipment.

You'll troubleshoot equipment and process challenges, optimize performance and reliability, and mentor engineering, maintenance, and production team members as they develop their skills. The position also includes testing and validation activities to ensure our production processes and equipment maintain validated compliance with Roche Diagnostics standards and regulatory requirements.

Your Responsibilities;

• Leads the development, implementation and maintenance of manufacturing methods, procedures and processes in the manufacture of products, components, subassemblies and final assemblies.

• Develops and improves automation and electromechanical processes by studying requirements; researching and testing manufacturing and assembly methods and materials; and soliciting observations from operators and maintenance technicians.

• Interfaces with design and process development engineering in coordinating the release of new products to the manufacturing process.

• Helps to estimate manufacturing cost and makes recommendations for tooling, controls system hardware and software, and process requirements of new or existing production lines.

• Manages multiple projects and time scopes for each project.

• Ensures process changes are characterized and implemented following validation policies and procedures.

• Assures system and product quality by designing testing methods; testing finished -product and system capabilities; and confirming fabrication, assembly, and installation processes.

• Assists department leadership in setting strategic direction.

• Possess and apply a broad knowledge of principles, practices, and procedures of the field.

• Maintains product and company reputation by complying with government regulations.

• Provide training, guidance, and advice to lower level staff.

• Support key initiatives such as information management, cyber security, and life cycle management.

• Participates in the on-call rotation to provide off shift / weekend support to production, as needed.

Knowledge/Skills/Attributes

• This Sr. level role requires extensive hands-on experience troubleshooting and optimizing manufacturing equipment controls systems. Candidates must demonstrate a proven track record of successfully diagnosing

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Fare quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. Nelle vicinanze della cura del paziente è impegnata ad aiutare le persone con diabete ovunque nel mondo pensare meno alla loro routine di diabete quotidiano, in modo da poter ottenere vero sollievo, giorno e notte. Offriamo un ampio portafoglio di soluzioni sia per le persone con diabete che per i loro professionisti - dal monitoraggio del glucosio nel sangue alla gestione delle informazioni al monitoraggio continuo del glucosio. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di offrire prodotti innovativi, servizi e soluzioni complete per una gestione del diabete conveniente, efficiente ed efficace.

Indianapolis è una funzione all'interno di Roche Diagnostics - Near Pazienti Care Operations, responsabile della produzione di strisce della maggior parte del nostro portafoglio di monitoraggio del glucosio nel sangue per la domanda globale dei nostri pazienti. In futuro, la produzione interna Indianapolis sarà anche responsabile della produzione di sensori per il nostro portafoglio di monitoraggio continuo del glucosio.

L'opportunità:

Unisciti al nostro team di prestazioni di attrezzature a Roche Diagnostics, Indianapolis, come ingegnere di fabbricazione di Sr. -Controls . Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di condurre progetti di miglioramento continuo utilizzando un approccio basato sui dati, fornendo supporto tecnico per le nostre attrezzature di produzione automatizzate avanzate.

Potrai risolvere i problemi di attrezzature e processi sfide, ottimizzare le prestazioni e l'affidabilità, e mentore ingegneria, manutenzione e membri del team di produzione, come si sviluppano le loro competenze. La posizione include anche attività di test e validazione per garantire che i nostri processi di produzione e le attrezzature mantengano validato il rispetto degli standard Roche Diagnostics e dei requisiti normativi.

Le vostre responsabilità;

• Conduce lo sviluppo, l'implementazione e la manutenzione di metodi di fabbricazione, procedure e processi nella fabbricazione di prodotti, componenti, sottoassemblaggio e assemblaggi finali.

• Sviluppa e migliora l'automazione e i processi elettromeccanici studiando i requisiti; la ricerca e la sperimentazione di metodi e materiali di produzione e assemblaggio; e sollecitando osservazioni da parte di operatori e tecnici di manutenzione.

• Interfacce con la progettazione e l'ingegneria di sviluppo del processo per coordinare il rilascio di nuovi prodotti al processo di produzione.

• Aiuta a stimare i costi di produzione e fa raccomandazioni per strumenti, controlli hardware e software di sistema, e requisiti di processo di nuove o linee di produzione esistenti.

• Gestisce più progetti e intervalli di tempo per ogni progetto.

• Assicura che i cambiamenti di processo siano caratterizzati e implementati seguendo politiche e procedure di validazione.

• Assicura il sistema e la qualità del prodotto progettando metodi di prova; testare le capacità di prodotto e di sistema finiti; e confermare i processi di fabbricazione, montaggio e installazione.

• Assiste la leadership del dipartimento nella regolazione della direzione strategica.

• Possedere e applicare una vasta conoscenza dei principi, delle pratiche e delle procedure del settore.

• Mantiene la reputazione del prodotto e della società rispettando le normative governative.

• Fornire formazione, guida e consulenza per il personale di livello inferiore.

• Supporto di iniziative chiave come la gestione delle informazioni, la sicurezza informatica e la gestione del ciclo di vita.

• Partecipa alla rotazione on-call per fornire supporto off shift / fine settimana alla produzione, come necessario.

Conoscenza/Skills/Attributi

• Questo ruolo di livello Sr. richiede una vasta esperienza nella risoluzione dei problemi e nell'ottimizzazione dei sistemi di controllo delle attrezzature di produzione. I candidati devono dimostrare un comprovato record di diagnostica con successo

• Verwaltet mehrere Projekte und Zeiträume für jedes Projekt.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Prozessänderungen nach Validierungsrichtlinien und -verfahren charakterisiert und implementiert werden.

• Sichert die System- und Produktqualität durch die Entwicklung von Testmethoden; Testen der fertigen Produkt- und Systemfähigkeiten; und Bestätigung von Herstellungs-, Montage- und Installationsprozessen.

• Unterstützt die Abteilungsleitung bei der Festlegung der strategischen Richtung.

• Besitzen und wenden Sie ein breites Wissen über Prinzipien, Praktiken und Verfahren des Feldes an.

• Bewahrt die Reputation von Produkten und Unternehmen durch Einhaltung der behördlichen Vorschriften.

• Bereitstellung von Schulungen, Beratung und Beratung für Mitarbeiter auf niedrigerer Ebene.

• Unterstützung wichtiger Initiativen wie Informationsmanagement, Cyber-Sicherheit und Life-Cycle-Management.

• Beteiligt sich an der On-Call-Rotation, um die Produktion bei Bedarf zu unterstützen.

Kenntnisse/Fähigkeiten/Attribute

• Diese Sr.-Level-Rolle erfordert umfangreiche praktische Erfahrung bei der Fehlersuche und Optimierung von Steuerungssystemen für Fertigungsanlagen. Die Kandidaten müssen eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz der erfolgreichen Diagnose nachweisen

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Senior Partner Systems Delivery Expert - EPIE

The Opportunity

As a Senior Partner Systems Delivery Expert , you'll lead the technical delivery of mission-critical enterprise integrations. You'll own complex system implementations end-to-end, manage technical dependencies across partners, and drive flawless execution at scale.
You'll define integration roadmaps, coordinate technical workstreams, and make critical decisions on system architecture and delivery approaches. This is hands-on technical leadership where execution excellence matters.

What You'll Do

• Technical Management: Own end-to-end delivery of complex system integrations

• Define technical roadmaps and coordinate dependencies across teams and vendors

• Manage timelines, milestones, and resource allocation

• Drive flawless execution of builds, data mappings, and transaction flows

Integration Architecture & Design

• Lead technical design of interface testing frameworks and data synchronization solutions

• Evaluate and select technical approaches (APIs, middleware, integration platforms)

• Manage technical scope aligned with immediate and long-term needs

• Ensure architectural decisions support system resilience

Dependency & Risk Management

• Orchestrate complex deliveries with multiple dependencies and data flows

• Identify technical risks early and surface mitigation strategies

• Manage integration points across disparate systems

• Resolve technical conflicts between platforms and partners

Technical Leadership

• Lead and coordinate technical workstreams across internal teams, vendors, and partners

• Mentor technical staff on complex integration challenges

• Ensure consistent execution of technical standards

• Guide teams through sophisticated problem-solving

System Readiness & Quality

• Establish rigorous interface testing and data validation frameworks

• Own system readiness activities and end-to-end validation

• Troubleshoot transaction synchronization issues

• Ensure production-ready integrations with strict data integrity

Technical Stakeholder Alignment

• Lead technical discussions with architects and system owners

• Translate requirements into clear delivery plans

• Communicate risks and mitigation strategies

• Maintain alignment across technical organizations

Who You Are

Essential Background

• Proven expertise leading the technical delivery of large-scale, complex system integrations and implementations

• Extensive hands-on experience managing integration technical workstreams, coordinating across multiple technical teams, and owning delivery outcomes

• Deep technical knowledge of enterprise system landscapes, data architectures, integration technologies, and implementation best practices

• Demonstrated success orchestrating end-to-end technical implementations with multiple dependencies and partners

SAP & ERP Experience Required

• Hands-on SAP and ERP platform experience is essential for this role. If you have a strong background as a Functional Business Analyst, SAP Developer, or Project Manager with proven success delivering enterprise system implementations and managing technical integration workstreams, this position could be an exceptional fit for you.

Core Competencies

• Advanced technical depth : In-depth understanding of enterprise architectures, data flows, integration platforms, API design, middleware solutions, and implementation methodologies

• Technical execution excellence : Lead the design, build, and testing of complex integrations;

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Esperto di fornitura di sistemi per partner senior - EPIE L'esperto di fornitura di sistemi per partner senior fornirà assistenza tecnica su integrazioni di sistemi complessi, guiderà l'efficienza dell'architettura, influenzerà le decisioni tecniche delle parti interessate e guiderà i team interfunzionali per raggiungere l'allineamento strategico dell'ecosistema. In questo ruolo, ti occuperai sia della complessità organizzativa che tecnica per guidare l'allineamento delle relative roadmap per iniziative su larga scala e strategicamente critiche. Avrai un ruolo fondamentale nella convalida dei test dell'interfaccia, garantendo una perfetta sincronizzazione dei dati e delle transazioni nel panorama più ampio dell'ecosistema. Approfondendo i dettagli tecnici con le parti interessate interne ed esterne, definirai e comunicherai visioni complete di soluzioni di integrazione. A seconda delle esigenze dell'organizzazione, puoi operare all'interno di archetipi di ruolo come Technical Program Manager, Integration Lead, Systems Readiness SME o Technical Delivery Manager. L'opportunità:
• Leadership nell'ambito/contenuto: fornisce una guida tecnica esperta e una direzione strategica sulla definizione e la gestione dell'ambito di integrazioni di sistemi complessi e iniziative di onboarding dei partner. Sviluppa, implementa e sostiene framework di test dell'interfaccia, criteri di preparazione e migliori pratiche di integrazione. Supervisiona la gestione delle modifiche all'ambito relative agli endpoint tecnici, garantendo l'allineamento strategico tra le relative roadmap e promuovendo in modo proattivo miglioramenti ai processi di integrazione.
• Responsabilità/Risoluzione dei problemi: guida l'analisi di complesse questioni di integrazione tecnica oltre i confini dell'ecosistema, individuando requisiti di sistema dettagliati e influenzando le decisioni sull'architettura. Responsabile della disponibilità complessiva del sistema su iniziative significative, della definizione di soluzioni di sincronizzazione di dati e transazioni e della promozione del consenso attraverso una comunicazione tecnica persuasiva. Identifica in modo proattivo i rischi di integrazione, come le discrepanze nella mappatura dei dati, e guida i colleghi nella risoluzione dei problemi tecnici.
• Gestione delle parti interessate: identifica le principali parti interessate interne ed esterne, inclusi responsabili tecnici, architetti aziendali e dirigenti senior delle organizzazioni partner. Sviluppa ed esegue piani di coinvolgimento completi che colmano il divario tra le esigenze aziendali e le realtà tecniche. Approfondisce i dettagli tecnici con le parti interessate, affronta i conflitti relativi alle specifiche dell'interfaccia e costruisce forti relazioni di collaborazione in tutto l'ecosistema.
• Impatto/Strategia: fornisce una leadership tecnica coerente e un impatto significativo sulle principali piattaforme dell'ecosistema. Promuove il successo dei programmi di integrazione allineando roadmap tecniche disparate, incorporando rigorosi standard di test dell'interfaccia e guidando iniziative di preparazione del sistema. Valuta le opzioni della soluzione tecnica (ad esempio, strutture API, middleware), promuove una cultura dell'innovazione tecnica e propone miglioramenti dell'architettura.
• Complessità/dimensioni del prodotto: gestisce integrazioni tecniche complesse tra diversi domini e partner, guidando attività di preparazione del sistema all'interno di grandi iniziative ecosistemiche. Orchestra consegne altamente complesse che coinvolgono molteplici dipendenze tecniche, flussi di dati continui e requisiti di sincronizzazione delle transazioni. Promuove la chiarezza sui requisiti tecnici ambigui e guida l'implementazione di framework di test mentre si esplorano scenari complessi e interorganizzativi delle parti interessate.
• Abilità commerciale/tecnica: possiede conoscenze tecniche approfondite

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Senior Partner Systems Delivery Expert – EPIE Der Senior Partner Systems Delivery Expert bietet technische Beratung bei komplexen Systemintegrationen, fördert die Architektureffizienz, beeinflusst technische Stakeholder-Entscheidungen und betreut funktionsübergreifende Teams, um eine strategische Ökosystemausrichtung zu erreichen. In dieser Rolle bewältigen Sie sowohl die organisatorische als auch die technische Komplexität, um die Ausrichtung entsprechender Roadmaps für groß angelegte, strategisch wichtige Initiativen voranzutreiben. Sie spielen eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Validierung von Schnittstellentests und sorgen für eine nahtlose Daten- und Transaktionssynchronisierung in der gesamten Ökosystemlandschaft. Indem Sie mit internen und externen Stakeholdern tief in die technischen Details eintauchen, definieren und kommunizieren Sie umfassende Visionen für Integrationslösungen. Abhängig von den Anforderungen der Organisation können Sie in Rollenarchetypen wie Technical Program Manager, Integration Lead, Systems Readiness SME oder Technical Delivery Manager tätig sein. Die Chance:
• Bereichs-/Inhaltsführung: Bietet fachkundige technische Beratung und strategische Ausrichtung bei der Definition und Verwaltung des Bereichs für komplexe Systemintegrationen und Partner-Onboarding-Initiativen. Entwickelt, implementiert und setzt sich für Schnittstellentest-Frameworks, Bereitschaftskriterien und Best Practices für die Integration ein. Überwacht die Verwaltung von Umfangsänderungen im Zusammenhang mit technischen Endpunkten, stellt die strategische Ausrichtung über die zugehörigen Roadmaps hinweg sicher und treibt proaktiv Verbesserungen der Integrationsprozesse voran.
• Verantwortlichkeit/Problemlösung: Leitet die Analyse komplexer technischer Integrationsprobleme über Ökosystemgrenzen hinweg, ermittelt detaillierte Systemanforderungen und beeinflusst Architekturentscheidungen. Verantwortlich für die allgemeine Systembereitschaft bei wichtigen Initiativen, die Definition von Daten- und Transaktionssynchronisierungslösungen und die Förderung des Konsenses durch überzeugende technische Kommunikation. Identifiziert proaktiv Integrationsrisiken, wie z. B. Diskrepanzen bei der Datenzuordnung, und unterstützt Kollegen bei der Lösung technischer Probleme.
• Stakeholder-Management: Identifiziert wichtige interne und externe Stakeholder, einschließlich technischer Leiter, Unternehmensarchitekten und der Geschäftsleitung aller Partnerorganisationen. Entwickelt und führt umfassende Engagementpläne aus, die die Lücke zwischen Geschäftsanforderungen und technischen Realitäten schließen. Erörtert technische Details mit Stakeholdern, löst Konflikte bezüglich Schnittstellenspezifikationen und baut starke Kooperationsbeziehungen im gesamten Ökosystem auf.
• Wirkung/Strategie: Bietet konsistente technische Führung und erhebliche Wirkung auf allen wichtigen Plattformen innerhalb des Ökosystems. Fördert den Erfolg von Integrationsprogrammen durch die Abstimmung unterschiedlicher technischer Roadmaps, die Einbettung strenger Schnittstellenteststandards und die Leitung von Initiativen zur Systembereitschaft. Bewertet technische Lösungsoptionen (z. B. API-Strukturen, Middleware), fördert eine Kultur technischer Innovation und schlägt architektonische Verbesserungen vor.
• Komplexität/Produktgröße: Verwaltet komplexe technische Integrationen über verschiedene Domänen und Partner hinweg und leitet Systembereitschaftsaktivitäten innerhalb großer Ökosysteminitiativen. Orchestriert hochkomplexe Lieferungen mit mehreren technischen Abhängigkeiten, kontinuierlichen Datenflüssen und Anforderungen an die Transaktionssynchronisierung. Schafft Klarheit bei mehrdeutigen technischen Anforderungen und leitet die Implementierung von Test-Frameworks, während er sich durch komplexe, organisationsübergreifende Stakeholder-Landschaften navigiert.
• Geschäftliche/technische Fähigkeiten: Verfügt über umfassende technische Kenntnisse

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Expert en livraison de systèmes de partenaire principal - EPIE L'expert en livraison de systèmes de partenaire principal fournira des conseils techniques sur les intégrations de systèmes complexes, stimulera l'efficacité de l'architecture, influencera les décisions des parties prenantes techniques et encadrera les équipes interfonctionnelles pour parvenir à l'alignement stratégique de l'écosystème. Dans ce rôle, vous naviguerez dans la complexité organisationnelle et technique pour piloter l'alignement des feuilles de route associées pour des initiatives à grande échelle et stratégiquement critiques. Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la validation des tests d’interface, garantissant une synchronisation transparente des données et des transactions dans l’ensemble de l’écosystème. En approfondissant les détails techniques avec les parties prenantes internes et externes, vous définirez et communiquerez des visions complètes de solutions d'intégration. En fonction des besoins de l'organisation, vous pouvez opérer au sein d'archétypes de rôles tels que responsable de programme technique, responsable de l'intégration, PME de préparation des systèmes ou responsable de la livraison technique. L'opportunité :
• Leadership en matière de portée et de contenu : fournit des conseils techniques d'experts et une orientation stratégique sur la définition et la gestion de la portée des intégrations de systèmes complexes et des initiatives d'intégration des partenaires. Développe, met en œuvre et défend les cadres de test d'interface, les critères de préparation et les meilleures pratiques d'intégration. Supervise la gestion des changements de portée liés aux points finaux techniques, assurant l'alignement stratégique sur les feuilles de route associées tout en conduisant de manière proactive des améliorations aux processus d'intégration.
• Responsabilité/Résolution de problèmes : dirige l'analyse de problèmes d'intégration technique complexes au-delà des frontières de l'écosystème, obtenant des exigences détaillées du système et influençant les décisions architecturales. Responsable de la préparation globale du système sur les initiatives importantes, de la définition de solutions de synchronisation des données et des transactions et de la recherche d'un consensus grâce à une communication technique convaincante. Identifie de manière proactive les risques d'intégration, tels que les écarts de mappage des données, et encadre ses collègues dans la résolution de problèmes techniques.
• Gestion des parties prenantes : identifie les principales parties prenantes internes et externes, notamment les responsables techniques, les architectes d'entreprise et la haute direction des organisations partenaires. Développe et exécute des plans d'engagement complets qui comblent le fossé entre les besoins commerciaux et les réalités techniques. Plonge dans les détails techniques avec les parties prenantes, gère les conflits concernant les spécifications d'interface et établit de solides relations de collaboration au sein de l'écosystème.
• Impact/Stratégie : Fournit un leadership technique cohérent et un impact significatif sur les principales plates-formes de l'écosystème. Favorise le succès des programmes d'intégration en alignant des feuilles de route techniques disparates, en intégrant des normes rigoureuses de test d'interface et en dirigeant des initiatives de préparation du système. Évalue les options de solutions techniques (par exemple, structures API, middleware), favorise une culture d'innovation technique et propose des améliorations architecturales.
• Complexité/taille du produit : gère les intégrations techniques complexes dans divers domaines et partenaires, dirigeant les activités de préparation du système au sein de vastes initiatives d'écosystème. Orchestre des livraisons très complexes impliquant de multiples dépendances techniques, des flux de données continus et des exigences de synchronisation des transactions. Favorise la clarté autour des exigences techniques ambiguës et dirige la mise en œuvre de cadres de test tout en naviguant dans des paysages complexes et interorganisationnels de parties prenantes.
• Capacité commerciale/technique : possède des connaissances techniques approfondies

The Opportunity

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Die Chance

Der Employee Experience Operations Travel & Expense Specialist als Teil der Demand-to-Pay-Abteilung unterhält und unterstützt die täglichen Aktivitäten der Reise-, Ausgaben- und Firmenkartenkosten im Zusammenhang mit den Roche Global Credit Card Programmen. Es wird erwartet, dass diese Rolle einen hohen Kundenservice bietet, da dies der erste Ansprechpartner für unsere internen Kunden ist.

• Kundensupport: Handeln Sie als primärer Ansprechpartner für interne Kunden und bieten Sie qualitativ hochwertige Unterstützung und Beratung für Unternehmenskreditkarten und das Kostenmanagement über Anrufe und Tickets.

• Ticket & Case Management: Help Desk-Tickets besitzen, verfolgen und lösen Sie effizient – mit dem Ziel einer Lösung am selben Tag –, während Sie Entscheidungen zu Problemen der ersten Ebene und weiteren Maßnahmen treffen.

• Systemadministration: Bewältigen Sie die täglichen Verwaltungsaufgaben innerhalb des Concur-Systems, damit die Plattform reibungslos läuft.

• SLA & KPI-Compliance: Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Dienstleistungen mit hoher Qualität und Genauigkeit geliefert werden und sich strikt an vereinbarte Service Level Agreements (SLAs), KPIs und Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) halten.

• Dokumentation & Training: Erstellen und pflegen Sie aktuelle Dokumentationen für Geschäftssysteme und -prozesse und bieten Sie den Endbenutzern nach Bedarf Prozessschulungen an.

• Reporting & Monitoring: Verwalten Sie geplante und Ad-hoc-Berichterstattungs- und Überwachungsaktivitäten, indem Sie Systemkorrekturen proaktiv anwenden und Auflösungen klar kommunizieren.

• Team Collaboration & Growth: Beteiligen Sie sich an der Planung der Teamverfügbarkeit (Ferien/Schulungen) und tragen Sie zum Onboarding und zur Umsetzung neuer Aufgaben bei, die am Standort Roche-Budapest ankommen.

Wer du bist

• Selbstmotiviert und leidenschaftlich über den Job, zu verstehen, wie wichtig es ist, qualitativ hochwertigen Service zu bieten.

• Aufgeschlossen, engagiert, um einen Unterschied zu machen, und offen für ständige Entwicklung.

• Erfahrung in einer Shared Service Umgebung, vorzugsweise im Customer Service Bereich.

• Erfahrung mit Firmenkreditkartenprogrammen ist ein Vorteil.

• Fließend in Englisch und Deutsch sprechen.

Im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen

• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Roche ist reich an Lernressourcen. Wir bieten ständige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, kostenlose Sprachkurse & Schulungen, die Möglichkeit internationaler Einsätze, interne Positionsänderungen und die Möglichkeit, die eigene Karriere zu gestalten.

• Ausgezeichnete Vorteile: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Cafeteria-Paket, Jahresbonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, Coaching / Mentoring-Möglichkeit, Buddy-Programm, Teamgebäude, Feiertagsparty.

• Flexibilität: Wir unterstützen auch Flexibilität, um Ihnen zu helfen, Ihr Gleichgewicht zu finden. Home Office ist allgemein verfügbar (in der Regel 2 Bürotage / Woche im Durchschnitt). Wir schaffen die Möglichkeit zur Arbeitsfreiheit, in der Ihr Firmen- und Privatleben in Harmonie koexistieren.

• Eine globale inklusive Gemeinschaft, in der wir voneinander lernen. Bei Roche kooperieren, diskutieren, treffen Entscheidungen, feiern Erfolge und haben Spaß als Team. Unsere Führung ist sehr auf Menschen ausgerichtet und schafft eine starke, integrative Kultur, so dass Sie immer die Chance haben, Ihre Meinung zu teilen.

Bitte lesen Sie die Datenschutzerklärung für weitere Informationen darüber, wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten im Zusammenhang mit dem Rekrutierungsprozess umgehen: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft und stellen sicher, dass heute jeder Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
L'opportunité

Le spécialiste des voyages et des dépenses de l'expérience de l'employé dans le cadre du service Demande de paiement maintient et appuie les activités quotidiennes des frais de voyage et de charge et des cartes d'entreprise associés aux programmes de cartes de crédit Roche Global. Ce rôle devrait offrir un haut niveau de service à la clientèle car c'est le premier point de contact pour nos clients internes.

• Soutien à la clientèle : agir en tant que principal point de contact pour les clients internes, fournir un soutien et des conseils de haute qualité pour les cartes de crédit d'entreprise et la gestion des dépenses de Concur via les appels et les billets.

• Gestion des tickets et des cas : Posséder, suivre et résoudre efficacement les tickets du Help Desk – en vue d'une résolution du même jour – tout en prenant des décisions sur des questions de premier niveau et d'autres mesures.

• Administration du système : Gérez les tâches administratives quotidiennes dans le système Concur pour assurer le bon fonctionnement de la plateforme.

• Conformité de l'ALS et de l'ICK : S'assurer que tous les services sont fournis avec une qualité et une précision élevées, en respectant strictement les ententes sur les niveaux de service (ALS), les ICR et les procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON).

• Documentation et formation : Construisez et maintenez à jour la documentation sur les systèmes et les processus opérationnels, et offrez une formation sur les processus aux utilisateurs finals sur demande.

• Rapports et surveillance : Gérer les activités de rapports et de surveillance planifiées et ponctuelles, appliquer de façon proactive les corrections du système et communiquer clairement les résolutions.

• Collaboration et croissance de l'équipe : Participer à la planification de la disponibilité de l'équipe (vacances/formation) et contribuer à l'embarquement et à la mise en oeuvre de nouvelles tâches arrivant sur le site de Roche-Budapest.

Qui vous êtes

• Automotivé et passionné par le travail, comprenant l'importance de fournir un service de haute qualité.

• Ouvert, dévoué à faire la différence et ouvert à un développement constant.

• Expérience dans un environnement de service partagé, de préférence dans la zone de service à la clientèle.

• L'expérience des programmes de cartes de crédit d'entreprise est un avantage.

• Connaissance de l'anglais et de l'allemand.

En échange, nous vous fournissons

• Possibilités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage. Nous offrons des possibilités de développement constant, des cours de langues gratuits et de formation, la possibilité d'affectations internationales, des changements de position internes et la possibilité de façonner votre propre carrière.

• Excellents avantages : Forfait salaire et cafétéria compétitif, bonus annuel, Services médicaux privés, Programme d'aide aux employés, All You Can Move Sportpass, occasion de coaching / mentorat, programme de copains, bâtiments d'équipe, fête de vacances.

• Flexibilité : Nous soutenons également la flexibilité pour vous aider à trouver votre équilibre. Le bureau à domicile est généralement disponible (habituellement 2 jours/semaine en moyenne). Nous créons l'occasion pour la liberté de travailler, où votre vie privée et professionnelle coexistent en harmonie.

• Une communauté mondiale inclusive, où nous apprenons les uns des autres. Chez Roche, nous coopérons, débattons, prenons des décisions, célébrons les succès et nous amusons en équipe. Notre leadership est très concentré sur les gens, créant une culture forte et inclusive, donc vous avez toujours la chance de partager votre opinion.

Veuillez lire l'Avis de confidentialité des données pour plus d'informations sur la façon dont nous traitons vos données personnelles liées au processus de recrutement: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde sont dédiés à faire progresser la science, garantissant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
岗位职责

• 会议支持与文书撰写：协助准备英文会议资料、简报及演讲 PPT。负责会议过程中的信息记录，并高效整理、撰写英文会议纪要。

• 中英双语翻译：协助完成部门内各类文档、报告及专业资料的中英文互译及校对工作。

• AI 与高效办公赋能：熟练运用生成式 AI 工具（如 ChatGPT、Claude、DeepL 等）辅助完成翻译初稿、文本润色、信息汇总及会议纪要整理，提升日常工作效率。协助管理团队日常文档、协同表格与共享云盘，确保信息传递高效准确。

• 团队综合事务支持：协助完成部门主管交办的其他日常行政与综合性工作。

学历与专业：

• 本科及以上在读学生，医药、生物等相关专业优先。

• 语言能力：大学英语六级（CET-6）及以上，或具备同等英语水平。

• 软件与工具应用：熟练掌握 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 等传统 MS Office 办公软件。

• 优先考虑：熟悉 Google 办公应用生态系统（Google Docs、Sheets、Slides、Drive 等云端协同工具）者，或具备 AI 工具使用经验，善于利用提示词（Prompts）借助 AI 工具辅助撰写文案、翻译或整理数据者优先。

• 综合素质：具备良好的沟通协调能力与团队合作精神；拥有强烈的求知欲与快速学习能力，执行力强；具备较好的抗压能力与细致认真的工作态度。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

● Migliora le relazioni con i portachiavi per identificare le possibilità di crescita per upsell e cross sell.
● Positivamente colpisce la conversione e la previsione di opportunità.

jobs.title: Learning Solutions Experience Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Learning Solutions Experience Specialist , you are responsible for executing Learning system data maintenance activities in a timely and accurate manner in support of Learning and more closely different event management business processes.

You are also contributing to the continuous improvement of the People Support Solutions delivery through analysis of the interactions and collaboration with other HR functions within and outside of People Support Solutions. You need a broad understanding of global Learning processes and tools, as well as local and global downstream impacts on compliance, audits, and right-to-operate, as well as finance, IT, etc. This is coupled with strong customer focus, communication skills, and solution orientation.

• Project Management Support: Deliver comprehensive support on project management tasks, covering planning, implementation, and execution phases.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Develop and manage critical stakeholder relationships and communications with a proactive and customer-outcomes-oriented approach.

• Collaboration and Coordination: Work effectively with team members, program owners, and vendors (both internal and external) to ensure seamless program execution.

• Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements in line with country-specific and customer-specific regulations.

• Financial Management: Manage purchase orders, review and authorize invoices, and track project expenses to ensure accurate and timely financial processes.

• Service Delivery: Align service delivery and quality with the overarching objectives of the global People Support Solutions (PSS) organization, striving for high customer satisfaction.

• Continuous Improvement: Consistently contribute to the enhancement of the Shared Service Center's performance and foster global consistency through collaborative efforts.

Who you are

• We are seeking an individual with 1-3 years in learning, team service delivery, or customer care environment, with a university degree.

• Skilled in Google Suite (Spreadsheets, Docs, Slides) and experienced with learning platforms or cloud-based learning management solutions.

• Fluent in English, with additional languages like German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Hungarian, or Chinese being a plus.

• Experienced in project management and event coordination, capable of engaging high-level stakeholders.

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, handling multiple priorities and finance-related tasks accurately.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility : We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
L'opportunità

In qualità di Learning Solutions Experience Specialist , sei responsabile per l'esecuzione delle attività di manutenzione dei dati del sistema di apprendimento in modo tempestivo e accurato a sostegno di Learning e processi aziendali di gestione degli eventi più strettamente diversi.

Contribuisci anche al miglioramento continuo della consegna di People Support Solutions attraverso l'analisi delle interazioni e la collaborazione con altre funzioni HR all'interno e all'esterno di People Support Solutions. Hai bisogno di una vasta comprensione dei processi e degli strumenti di apprendimento globali, così come gli impatti a valle locali e globali sulla conformità, audit e diritto-operare, così come la finanza, IT, ecc. Questo è accoppiato con forte focus del cliente, capacità di comunicazione e orientamento della soluzione.

• Supporto per la gestione del progetto: fornire un supporto completo sulle attività di gestione del progetto, coprendo fasi di pianificazione, implementazione e esecuzione.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Sviluppare e gestire le relazioni e le comunicazioni degli stakeholder critici con un approccio proattivo e orientato al cliente.

• Collaborazione e coordinamento: lavorare efficacemente con i membri del team, i proprietari di programmi e i fornitori (sia interni che esterni) per garantire l'esecuzione del programma senza soluzione di continuità.

• Compliance regolamentare: garantire il rispetto dei requisiti normativi in linea con le normative specifiche per il paese e specifiche per il cliente.

• Gestione finanziaria: Gestire gli ordini di acquisto, rivedere e autorizzare le fatture e monitorare le spese di progetto per garantire processi finanziari precisi e tempestivi.

• Consegna del servizio: Allineare la consegna del servizio e la qualità con gli obiettivi generali dell'organizzazione globale People Support Solutions (PSS), impegnandosi per un'elevata soddisfazione del cliente.

• Miglioramento continuo: contribuisce in modo coerente al miglioramento delle prestazioni del Shared Service Center e favoriscono la coerenza globale attraverso gli sforzi collaborativi.

Chi sei

• Stiamo cercando un individuo con 1-3 anni di apprendimento, servizio di squadra consegna, o ambiente di assistenza clienti, con una laurea.

• Abilitato in Google Suite (Spreadsheets, Docs, Slides) e sperimentato con piattaforme di apprendimento o soluzioni di gestione di apprendimento basate su cloud.

• Fluente in inglese, con lingue aggiuntive come tedesco, francese, italiano, spagnolo, portoghese, ungherese o cinese è un plus.

• Esperienza nella gestione dei progetti e nel coordinamento degli eventi, in grado di coinvolgere gli stakeholder di alto livello.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente in un ambiente multiculturale veloce, gestire più priorità e compiti legati alla finanza con precisione.

In Exchange ti forniamo:

• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.

• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto si può spostare Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma di amici, team building, festa.

• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.

• Una comunità inclusiva globale, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo

Die Chance

• Eine globale inklusive Gemeinschaft, in der wir voneinander lernen. Bei Roche kooperieren, diskutieren, treffen Entscheidungen, feiern Erfolge und haben Spaß

L'opportunité

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the Team
As part of the Category Management team within External Manufacturing Services, our global group works to proactively identify opportunities, engage with key business stakeholders, and collaborate with regional Procurement functions. We are dedicated to driving category performance, advancing innovation, and managing supplier networks effectively to deliver significant business value and high-value savings targets across the organization.

Role Introduction
The Procurement Manager in External Manufacturing Services is accountable for developing procurement strategies and leading initiatives for the assigned Category on a global basis. In this role, you will apply deep subject matter knowledge in Roche’s category and supplier relationship management (SRM) approaches, taking ownership of category strategies, high-value sourcing, demand management, and supplier performance while serving as a key point of contact for business stakeholders.

The Opportunity
In this role, you will have the opportunity to drive strategic impact and manage end-to-end category performance through the following key responsibilities:

• Define the DP & Finished Good Strategy and annual initiative pipeline by collating market, supplier, category, and internal data, while partnering with functions such as local and regional Procurement to gather input, endorsement, and validation.

• Identify, manage, and execute strategic category initiatives to achieve top-down targets, executing projects in compliance with policies, guidelines, operating procedures, and 3rd Party Spend Policy directives while escalating issues and utilizing continuous improvement approaches like LPS and DPP’s portfolio planning (Cost Optimization Initiative).

• Develop and maintain clear, executable category buying guides and content to translate category strategies and initiative outcomes into practical guidance for Procurement colleagues and business users.

• Deliver Procurement Balanced Scorecard (BSC) inputs, manage accurate reporting of measures, metrics, and savings targets (liaising with operational sourcing hubs, Shared Service Centers, and the Business), and ensure spend data accuracy through data validation and governance remediation.

• Lead supplier relationship management (SRM) and continuous improvement by identifying key suppliers, establishing and reporting value creation targets, mitigating risks, conducting regular business reviews, leading supplier innovation/development, and conducting thorough risk and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) reviews.

• Build and maintain strong business partner relationships across Procurement, Finance, external manufacturing operation and quality, demand planning, global supply chain owners, Technical Product Leaders, and Legal to challenge demand, ensure contract compliance, and offer Procurement solutions for business priorities.

• Support process and technology harmonization across global category teams, coach Procurement staff and project-related resources to foster professional development, and represent the Global Category Leader (GCL) in planning, stakeholder, people, and project management activities as needed.

Who You Are
To be successful in this position, you should bring the following qualifications, skills, and expertise:

• Deep category and sub-category subject matter knowledge with proven expertise in Pharmaceutical Industry Category and Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) approaches, sourcing, demand management, and process re-en

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Informazioni sulla squadra
Nell'ambito del team di gestione della categoria all'interno dei servizi di produzione esterna, il nostro gruppo globale lavora per identificare attivamente le opportunità, impegnarsi con i principali stakeholder aziendali e collaborare con le funzioni di approvvigionamento regionale. Siamo dedicati alla guida delle prestazioni di categoria, alla promozione dell'innovazione e alla gestione delle reti di fornitori in modo efficace per fornire valore commerciale significativo e obiettivi di risparmio ad alto valore in tutta l'organizzazione.

Introduzione al ruolo
Il Procurement Manager nei servizi di fabbricazione esterna è responsabile per lo sviluppo di strategie di approvvigionamento e le principali iniziative per la categoria assegnata su base globale. In questo ruolo, applicherete le conoscenze approfondite della materia nella categoria di Roche e nella gestione dei rapporti dei fornitori (SRM), assumendo la proprietà delle strategie di categoria, l'assistenza ad alto valore, la gestione della domanda e le prestazioni dei fornitori, mentre serve come punto chiave di contatto per gli stakeholder aziendali.

L'opportunità
In questo ruolo, avrete l'opportunità di guidare l'impatto strategico e gestire le prestazioni della categoria end-to-end attraverso le seguenti responsabilità chiave:

• Definire il DP & Finished Good Strategy e l'annuale pipeline di iniziativa raccogliendo mercato, fornitore, categoria e dati interni, mentre collaborando con funzioni come Procurement locale e regionale per raccogliere input, approvazione e validazione.

• Identificare, gestire ed eseguire iniziative strategiche di categoria per raggiungere obiettivi top-down, eseguendo progetti in conformità a politiche, linee guida, procedure operative e direttive di politica di spesa di terza parte, escalando i problemi e utilizzando approcci di miglioramento continuo come LPS e DPP pianificazione portafoglio (Cost Optimization Initiative).

• Sviluppare e mantenere le guide di acquisto di categoria chiare e eseguibili e contenuti per tradurre strategie di categoria e risultati di iniziativa in orientamento pratico per i colleghi di appalti e gli utenti di affari.

• Fornire ingressi Scorecard bilanciata (BSC), gestire la segnalazione accurata di misure, metriche e obiettivi di risparmio (tramite con hub di sourcing operativo, Centri di servizio condivisi e Business), e garantire la precisione di spesa dei dati attraverso la convalida dei dati e la bonifica della governance.

• Gestione delle relazioni dei fornitori di piombo (SRM) e miglioramento continuo identificando i fornitori chiave, stabilire e segnalare obiettivi di creazione di valore, mitigare i rischi, condurre regolari recensioni aziendali, leader innovazione/sviluppo dei fornitori, e condurre un rischio approfondito e Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) recensioni.

• Costruisci e mantieni forti relazioni commerciali tra Procurement, Finance, produzione esterna e qualità, pianificazione della domanda, proprietari della supply chain globale, Leader del prodotto tecnico e Legale per sfidare la domanda, garantire la conformità del contratto e offrire soluzioni di approvvigionamento per le priorità aziendali.

• L'armonizzazione del processo di supporto e della tecnologia in team di categoria globali, il personale di coach Procurement e le risorse relative al progetto per promuovere lo sviluppo professionale, e rappresentare il Leader della categoria globale (GCL) nella pianificazione, stakeholder, persone e attività di gestione del progetto secondo le necessità.

Chi sei
Per avere successo in questa posizione, dovresti portare le seguenti qualifiche, competenze e competenze:

• Conoscenze di materia di categoria profonda e sottocategoria con comprovata esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica Categoria e nei metodi di gestione delle relazioni dei fornitori (SRM) approcci, sourcing, gestione della domanda e ri-en di processo

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Über das Team
Als Teil des Category-Management-Teams bei External Manufacturing Services arbeitet unsere globale Gruppe daran, proaktiv Chancen zu identifizieren, sich mit wichtigen Geschäftsinteressenten zu beschäftigen und mit regionalen Beschaffungsfunktionen zusammenzuarbeiten. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, die Kategorieleistung zu steigern, Innovationen voranzutreiben und Lieferantennetzwerke effektiv zu verwalten, um einen erheblichen Geschäftswert und hochwertige Einsparungsziele im gesamten Unternehmen zu erreichen.

Rolleneinführung
Der Procurement Manager in External Manufacturing Services ist verantwortlich für die Entwicklung von Beschaffungsstrategien und Leitinitiativen für die zugewiesene Kategorie auf globaler Basis. In dieser Rolle werden Sie fundiertes Fachwissen in den Kategorien- und Lieferantenbeziehungsmanagement (SRM) -Ansätzen von Roche anwenden, indem Sie Kategoriestrategien, hochwertiges Sourcing, Demand Management und Lieferantenleistung übernehmen und gleichzeitig als wichtiger Ansprechpartner für Geschäftsbeteiligte dienen.

Die Chance
In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die strategische Wirkung zu steigern und die End-to-End-Kategorieleistung durch die folgenden Schlüsselaufgaben zu verwalten:

• Definieren Sie die DP & Finished Good Strategie und die jährliche Initiativpipeline, indem Sie Markt-, Lieferanten-, Kategorie- und interne Daten zusammentragen und gleichzeitig mit Funktionen wie lokaler und regionaler Beschaffung zusammenarbeiten, um Input, Bestätigung und Validierung zu sammeln.

• Identifizieren, verwalten und führen Sie strategische Kategorieninitiativen aus, um Top-Down-Ziele zu erreichen, indem Sie Projekte in Übereinstimmung mit Richtlinien, Richtlinien, Betriebsverfahren und Richtlinien für Ausgaben von Drittanbietern durchführen, während Sie Probleme eskalieren und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsansätze wie die Portfolioplanung von LPS und DPP nutzen (Cost Optimization Initiative).

• Entwickeln und pflegen Sie klare, ausführbare Anleitungen und Inhalte zum Kategorienkauf, um Kategorienstrategien und Initiativergebnisse in praktische Leitlinien für Einkaufskollegen und Geschäftsanwender zu übersetzen.

• Bereitstellung von Inputs für eine ausgewogene Einkaufs-Scorecard (BSC), Verwaltung der genauen Berichterstattung über Maßnahmen, Metriken und Einsparungsziele (Verbindung zu operativen Sourcing-Hubs, Shared Service Centern und dem Business) und Sicherstellung der Genauigkeit der Ausgabendaten durch Datenvalidierung und Governance-Beseitigung.

• Führen Sie das Lieferantenbeziehungsmanagement (SRM) und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung durch die Identifizierung wichtiger Lieferanten, die Festlegung und Berichterstattung über Wertschöpfungsziele, die Minderung von Risiken, die Durchführung regelmäßiger Geschäftsüberprüfungen, die Leitung der Lieferanteninnovation / -entwicklung und die Durchführung gründlicher Risiko- und Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) -Überprüfungen.

• Aufbau und Pflege starker Geschäftspartnerbeziehungen in den Bereichen Beschaffung, Finanzen, externer Fertigungsbetrieb und -qualität, Nachfrageplanung, globale Lieferketteneigentümer, technische Produktführer und Legal, um die Nachfrage zu bekämpfen, die Vertragskonformität zu gewährleisten und Beschaffungslösungen für Geschäftsprioritäten anzubieten.

• Unterstützung der Prozess- und Technologieharmonisierung in globalen Kategorieteams, Coaching von Beschaffungsmitarbeitern und projektbezogenen Ressourcen zur Förderung der beruflichen Entwicklung und Vertretung des Global Category Leader (GCL) bei der Planung, Stakeholder, Mitarbeiter und Projektmanagementaktivitäten nach Bedarf.

Wer du bist
Um in dieser Position erfolgreich zu sein, sollten Sie die folgenden Qualifikationen, Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse mitbringen:

• Tiefe Kategorie und Unterkategorie Fachkenntnisse mit nachgewiesener Expertise in Pharmazeutische Industrie Kategorie und Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) Ansätze, Sourcing, Demand Management und Prozess Re-en
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
À propos de l'équipe
Dans le cadre de l'équipe de gestion de la catégorie des Services externes de fabrication, notre groupe mondial s'emploie à cerner proactivement les possibilités, à collaborer avec les principaux intervenants commerciaux et à collaborer avec les fonctions d'approvisionnement régionales. Nous nous engageons à stimuler la performance de la catégorie, à faire progresser l'innovation et à gérer efficacement les réseaux de fournisseurs afin d'atteindre des objectifs importants en matière de valeur opérationnelle et d'économies de grande valeur dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Rôle Introduction
Le gestionnaire des achats des Services externes de fabrication est responsable de l'élaboration de stratégies d'approvisionnement et de la direction des initiatives pour la catégorie attribuée à l'échelle mondiale. Dans ce rôle, vous appliquerez des connaissances approfondies dans les approches de la catégorie Roches et de la gestion des relations avec les fournisseurs (GRS), en prenant en charge les stratégies de catégorie, l'approvisionnement à haute valeur ajoutée, la gestion de la demande et la performance des fournisseurs tout en servant de point de contact clé pour les intervenants commerciaux.

L'opportunité
Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion de stimuler l'impact stratégique et de gérer le rendement de bout en bout grâce aux responsabilités clés suivantes :

• Définir la bonne stratégie et le pipeline d'initiative annuel du PDD en regroupant les données internes, les données du marché, du fournisseur et de la catégorie, tout en s'associant à des fonctions telles que l'approvisionnement local et régional pour recueillir les commentaires, l'approbation et la validation.

• Identifier, gérer et exécuter des initiatives de catégorie stratégique pour atteindre des cibles descendantes, exécuter des projets conformément aux politiques, aux lignes directrices, aux procédures opérationnelles et aux directives de la troisième partie sur les politiques de dépenser, tout en élargissant les enjeux et en utilisant des approches d'amélioration continue comme la planification du portefeuille des SPL et des SPP (Initiative d'optimisation des coûts).

• Élaborer et tenir à jour des guides et du contenu clairs et exécutables pour l'achat de catégories afin de traduire les stratégies et les résultats de l'initiative en lignes directrices pratiques à l'intention des collègues de l'approvisionnement et des utilisateurs commerciaux.

• Fournir des données d'entrée sur la carte de pointage équilibrée des achats (BSC), gérer l'exactitude des rapports sur les mesures, les mesures et les objectifs d'économie (en liaison avec les centres d'approvisionnement opérationnels, les centres de services partagés et les entreprises) et assurer l'exactitude des données par la validation des données et l'assainissement de la gouvernance.

• Diriger la gestion des relations avec les fournisseurs (GRS) et l'amélioration continue en identifiant les fournisseurs clés, en établissant et en faisant rapport sur les objectifs de création de valeur, en atténuant les risques, en effectuant des examens commerciaux réguliers, en menant des innovations/développements des fournisseurs et en effectuant des examens approfondis des risques et de la responsabilité sociale des entreprises (RSE).

• Établir et maintenir de solides relations de partenaires commerciaux dans l'ensemble des secteurs de l'approvisionnement, des finances, de l'exploitation et de la qualité de la fabrication externe, de la planification de la demande, des propriétaires de chaînes d'approvisionnement mondiales, des chefs de produits techniques et des services juridiques pour contester la demande, assurer la conformité des contrats et offrir des solutions d'approvisionnement pour les priorités de l'entreprise.

• Appuyer les processus et l'harmonisation technologique entre les équipes de la catégorie mondiale, entraîner le personnel chargé des achats et les ressources liées aux projets pour favoriser le perfectionnement professionnel, et représenter le responsable de la catégorie mondiale dans les activités de planification, les parties prenantes, les personnes et la gestion des projets au besoin.

Qui vous êtes
Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous devez apporter les qualifications, les compétences et l'expertise suivantes :

• Connaissance approfondie de la catégorie et de la sous-catégorie des sujets ayant une expertise éprouvée dans les approches de la catégorie de l'industrie pharmaceutique et de la gestion des relations avec les fournisseurs (GRS), de l'approvisionnement, de la gestion de la demande et des processus

jobs.title: Hasta Destek Hemşiresi (Diyabet)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
İş Tanımı

Near Patient Care (NPC - Hasta Başı Çözümleri) departmanı bünyesinde görev yapacak Diyabet Hasta Destek Hemşiresi (Diabetes Patient Support Nurse) olarak, Roche Diagnostics'in yenilikçi hasta başı tanı çözümleri ile sağlık hizmeti sunumu arasında kritik bir bağ kuracaksınız. Diyabet Yönetimi portföyümüzde bulunan CGM (Sürekli Glukoz İzleme sistemleri) ve dijital çözümlerini kapsamlı bir şekilde destekleyecek ve yöneteceksiniz. Hasta sağlığı çıktılarını iyileştirmek amacıyla; ana odağınız hasta eğitimleri olmakla birlikte hasta destek programlarını yürütecek ve profesyonel klinik uygulamalar gerçekleştireceksiniz.

Temel Sorumluluklar

• CGM Eğitimi: Sağlık profesyonellerine (hekim, hemşire) ve hastalara online ya da fiziki uygulamalı ürün eğitimleri sağlamak.

• Hasta Destek ve Eğitimi: Hasta Destek Programlarını planlayarak ve yöneterek; hastaların evde kendi kendilerine test yapma teknikleri, cihaz kurulumları, veri takibi ve tedavi uyumu konularında klinik rehberlik sunmak.

• Yerinde Destek: Klinik alanları ve diyabet merkezlerini düzenli ziyaret ederek hasta başı çözümlerimizin operasyonel entegrasyonunu sağlamak; gelen teknik ve klinik soruları yanıtlamak.

• Veri Odaklı Bakım Entegrasyonu: Sağlık profesyonellerinin dijital sağlık raporlarını yorumlamalarına destek olarak zamanında tıbbi karar alınmasına katkıda bulunmak.

• Fonksiyonlar Arası İş Birliği: Satış, Pazarlama ve Medikal iş birimleri ile yakın çalışarak sahadan gelen içgörüleri paylaşmak, ürün lansman süreçlerini desteklemek.

Aranan Nitelikler

• Eğitim: Hemşirelik lisans mezuniyeti zorunludur. Diyabet Hemşireliği büyük bir avantajdır.

• Deneyim: Klinik hemşirelik alanında (tercihen Endokrinoloji, Dahiliye departmanlarında) en az 5 yıl deneyim. Tıbbi cihaz sektöründe ürün eğitim rollerinde kurumsal deneyim güçlü bir artıdır.

• Ürün Bilgisi: Hasta başı (POC) tanı cihazları hakkında güçlü bilgi; özellikle Sürekli Glukoz İzleme (CGM) teknolojilerine aşinalık tercih sebebidir.

• Dil Yetkinliği: Kurumsal küresel entegrasyon ve ürün kılavuzlarının takibi için iyi derecede İngilizce (hem yazılı hem sözlü) bilgisi.

• Sosyal Beceriler: Mükemmel iletişim, eğitmenlik ve sunum becerileri. Analitik problem çözme yeteneği ile birleşmiş empati düzeyi yüksek ve hasta odaklı yaklaşım.

• Mobilite: Aktif sürücü belgesine sahip olmak ve klinik/kurumsal ihtiyaçlar doğrultusunda bölgesel seyahat edebilmek.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As the Principal Enterprise Identity Engineer, you are the ultimate technical authority and visionary for our global Enterprise Identity Management (EIM) and Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) landscape. Moving beyond individual contribution, you will define the multi-year identity strategy, driving zero-trust initiatives across a highly complex, global ecosystem.

Operating at the highest levels of our technical ladder, you will bridge the gap between executive business strategy and deep technical execution. You will architect resilient, massively scalable identity frameworks, mentor senior engineering talent, and lead cross-functional transformations that protect our most critical global assets while enabling frictionless business operations.

Job Responsibilities

• Lead the multi-year roadmap and end-to-end technical strategy for enterprise identity, aligning IGA architectures with global security policies and zero-trust frameworks.

• Establish and enforce enterprise-wide architecture patterns, engineering standards, and reusable frameworks across identity, cloud, and infrastructure domains.

• Architect and oversee the deployment of next-generation, SailPoint-based EIM solutions that operate flawlessly at a massive, distributed scale.

• Translate complex security paradigms and regulatory requirements into actionable, board-level technical strategies.

• Pioneer the adoption of emerging identity technologies, including decentralized identity, advanced ML-driven access analytics, and complex microservice/API integrations.

• Act as the technical cornerstone for the identity organization, mentoring senior engineers and leading Tier 4 escalation and root-cause analysis for catastrophic or highly complex systemic issues.

Qualifications and Core Expertise

• Minimum of 12 years of hands-on engineering experience in Cybersecurity and Identity Management, with at least 5 years operating at an enterprise architecture or principal level.

• 5+ years of experience steering identity strategies in highly regulated, multinational enterprise environments (Healthcare, Finance, or similar industries highly preferred).

• Deep-tier technical expertise in SailPoint (IdentityNow/IdentityIQ), encompassing enterprise-scale design, custom development, performance tuning, and global deployment.

• Expert-level proficiency in Java and Python for developing highly complex connectors, custom rules, and automated workflows.

• Proven track record of architecting integration solutions across complex multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and profound familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps methodologies, and microservices.

• Deep, authoritative understanding of RBAC, PBAC, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and advanced access governance frameworks.

• Exceptional executive presence with the ability to communicate deeply technical concepts to non-technical C-suite stakeholders and lead distributed global engineering teams autonomously.

• Technical Certifications: Advanced certifications in AWS/Azure/GCP Architecture or SailPoint highly desirable.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As MarTech and Sales Business Process Owner you play an active part in the life cycle of digital solutions roadmap, which support the global/regional/affiliate marketing and/or sales management business processes by providing a seamless digital experience for our customers and affiliate partners.

The MarTech and Sales Business Process Owner is responsible and owner of the sales and marketing automation technology Solution in the Global Digital Hub. The role acts as a subject matter expert role to reach Global Digital Hub’s and its direct stakeholders’ key objectives and business goals by owning and executing digital marketing technology projects to make relevant (sales and marketing) stakeholders being accountable for their own business outcomes and partnering them to reach those.

The MarTech and Sales Business Process Owner is able to follow and use existing processes and procedures to work effectively but also continuously improves and revise those to reach the desired outcome, identifies opportunities and gaps on projects, and brings new approaches and tactics to tackle those gaps, owns, develops and communicates project goals and timelines for the stakeholders. The MarTech and Sales Business Process Owner is able to handle tasks with flexibility and agility to better address strategic needs and reach expected outcomes.

The main focus of the role is to define, co-create and drive the Marketing Automation and Sales Enablement vision and solution roadmap within the Roche Digital Marketing ecosystem. The MarTech and Sales Business Process Owner role is responsible for ensuring that the Roche Digital Marketing and Sales Management platforms, systems and processes are aligned with global best practices and are continuously enhanced and developed to support Roche digital maturity, as well as support affiliates with roll out planning and execution. The role scope includes identifying areas for improvements, process changes as well as best practices & training, coordinating and maintaining an international network of SMEs globally distributed, leading and/or supporting global projects/initiatives and steering the Change Management Team (CMT). The scope also includes contribution in consulting, identifying and prioritizing new business requirements to drive decision making for changes/amendments.

As a MarTech and Sales Business Process Owner, you are accountable for the Sales and Marketing Enablement value stream in the Roche SAFe framework, and define success metrics, business priorities and long-term business goals, co-create, coordinate and maintain a solution specific business support and training concept in the area of Marketing Automation and Sales Enablement. If applicable, the role is responsible for identifying and prioritizing operational changes (including business relevant system configurations) and fixes. The role is connected to respective product development, and covers many aspects such as prioritizing team backlog and/or contributing to the Product Vision, Roadmap, and/or content presentations, and/or preparing and running Program Increment (PI) planning to deliver the highest business impact.
