jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Basel Biotech Manufacturing produces biotech drugs such as monoclonal antibodies (mAb) and antibody-drug conjugates (ADC) for clinical use and commercial distribution. The MSAT department is a technology unit supporting production at Basel DS Manufacturing.

The Opportunity:

As a MSAT Process Performance Team Member with a focus on upstream processing, your main responsibilities will be in the area of:

• Building, sustaining and improving the technical capabilities in the group for the area of responsibilities of the Process Engineering chapters incl. coaching and mentoring of technical SMEs and provide recommendations for technical decisions

• Collaborating with technical experts across Roche to support strategic initiatives across the Roche manufacturing network and leading technology and innovation projects within the site and/or the network

• Embodying Lean Leadership principles and living a culture of continuous improvement to foster an environment of strong team spirit, timely and efficient communication, sense of urgency, high motivation and passion, in order to deliver mid/long term goals

• Supporting the analysis of end-to-end production processes and facility capabilities to identify opportunities for improvement regarding safety, quality, robustness of supply, reduce operational costs and lead times, and prevent problems

• Planning and coordination of troubleshooting activities in collaboration with the pilot laboratories, production, and the quality department

• Driving technical standardization and knowledge exchange in-between SUT and MAB stainless steel plant, serving as an SME in inspections and as a lead of root cause analysis teams for complex deviations

• Being a Site Representative in Network Teams i.e. UoTs, (Unit operation Teams), MPET (Manufacturing Process Evaluation Team) and becoming Site SME and decision maker in strategic technical changes

• Becoming the primary contact for partners in the Roche Biologics Drug Substance network (such as other manufacturing sites, PTI, PTD, DSTLs, other functions and external partners) for the exchange and collaboration in the area of MSAT

• Owner of the production processes (interface between Manufacturing and MSAT) as well as carrying out data analysis as part of process monitoring

Who You Are:

You have an academic degree in a scientific or technical area (Master or PhD), preferably in biotechnology, biochemistry or bio/chemical process engineering. Furthermore:

• 8+ years of relevant experience in industry (manufacturing), 6+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing with bioprocesses, and needs experience working in a cGMP environment

• Good knowledge of safety principles, quality systems, and cGMP and has done relevant work experience in a lab, pilot plant, manufacturing, or manufacturing support setting

• Extensive knowledge in the field of upstream processing of biotechnologically manufactured products with the ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment with changing priorities and to react flexibly to requests

• Very good (intercultural) communication skills with fluency in German and English

• Knowledge of process validation, process transfers, and single-use technologies would be an advantage

On-call Service occasionally possible.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Basel Biotech Manufacturing produce farmaci biotecnologici come anticorpi monoclonali (mAb) e congiunti anticorpo-droga (ADC) per uso clinico e distribuzione commerciale. Il reparto MSAT è un'unità tecnologica che supporta la produzione a Basel DS Manufacturing.

L'opportunità:

Come membro del team MSAT per le prestazioni di processo con un focus sull'elaborazione a monte, le vostre principali responsabilità saranno nel settore di:

• Costruire, sostenere e migliorare le capacità tecniche del gruppo per l'area delle responsabilità dei capitoli di Process Engineering incl. coaching e mentoring delle PMI tecniche e fornire raccomandazioni per le decisioni tecniche

• Collaborare con esperti tecnici in Roche per sostenere iniziative strategiche in tutta la rete manifatturiera Roche e progetti leader di tecnologia e innovazione all'interno del sito e/o della rete

• Integrare i principi di Leadership Lean e vivere una cultura di miglioramento continuo per promuovere un ambiente di forte spirito di squadra, comunicazione tempestiva ed efficiente, senso di urgenza, motivazione e passione, al fine di offrire obiettivi a medio/lungo termine

• Sostenere l'analisi dei processi di produzione end-to-end e delle capacità degli impianti per identificare le opportunità di miglioramento per quanto riguarda la sicurezza, la qualità, la robustezza dell'offerta, ridurre i costi operativi e i tempi di piombo, e prevenire i problemi

• Pianificazione e coordinamento delle attività di risoluzione dei problemi in collaborazione con i laboratori pilota, la produzione e il reparto qualità

• Guidare la standardizzazione tecnica e lo scambio di conoscenze tra lo stabilimento SUT e l'acciaio inossidabile MAB, servendo come PMI nelle ispezioni e come leader dei team di analisi delle cause radice per deviazioni complesse

• Essendo un rappresentante del sito in team di rete, cioè UoTs, (Unit Operation Teams), MPET (Manufacturing Process Evaluation Team) e diventare PMI del sito e decisore in cambiamenti tecnici strategici

• Diventare il contatto principale per i partner nella rete Roche Biologics Drug Substance (come altri siti di produzione, PTI, PTD, DSTLs, altre funzioni e partner esterni) per lo scambio e la collaborazione nell'area di MSAT

• Proprietario dei processi di produzione (interfaccia tra Manufacturing e MSAT) nonché dell'analisi dei dati nell'ambito del monitoraggio dei processi

Chi sei?

Hai una laurea accademica in uno spazio scientifico o tecnico (Master o PhD), preferibilmente in biotecnologia, biochimica o ingegneria del processo biochimico. Inoltre:

• 8+ anni di esperienza rilevante nell'industria (produttività), 6+ anni di esperienza rilevante nella produzione con bioprocessi, e ha bisogno di esperienza lavorativa in un ambiente cGMP

• Buona conoscenza dei principi di sicurezza, sistemi di qualità e cGMP e ha fatto esperienza di lavoro rilevante in un laboratorio, impianto pilota, produzione, o impostazione di supporto di produzione

• Ampia conoscenza nel settore della trasformazione a monte dei prodotti biotecnologici con la capacità di adattarsi ad un ambiente in rapida evoluzione con priorità in evoluzione e di reagire in modo flessibile alle richieste

• Molto buone (interculturali) capacità di comunicazione con fluenza in tedesco e inglese

• La conoscenza della validazione dei processi, dei trasferimenti di processo e delle tecnologie a singolo utilizzo sarebbe un vantaggio

Servizio di chiamata occasionalmente possibile.

Pronto a fare un impatto e contribuire al nostro emozionante viaggio? Applicare ora – non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi!

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Basel Biotech Manufacturing produziert Biotech-Medikamente wie monoklonale Antikörper (mAb) und Antikörper-Wirkstoff-Konjugate (ADC) für den klinischen Einsatz und den kommerziellen Vertrieb. Die MSAT-Abteilung ist eine Technologieeinheit, die die Produktion bei Basel DS Manufacturing unterstützt.

Die Gelegenheit:

Als MSAT Process Performance Team Member mit Fokus auf vorgelagerter Verarbeitung liegen Ihre Hauptaufgaben im Bereich:

• Aufbau, Erhaltung und Verbesserung der technischen Fähigkeiten in der Gruppe für den Aufgabenbereich der Kapitel Prozesstechnik inkl. Coaching und Mentoring von technischen KMU und Empfehlungen für technische Entscheidungen

• Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Experten von Roche zur Unterstützung strategischer Initiativen im gesamten Produktionsnetzwerk von Roche und zur Leitung von Technologie- und Innovationsprojekten am Standort und/oder im Netzwerk

• Lean Leadership-Prinzipien verkörpern und eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung leben, um ein Umfeld mit starkem Teamgeist, zeitnaher und effizienter Kommunikation, Dringlichkeit, hoher Motivation und Leidenschaft zu fördern, um mittel- und langfristige Ziele zu erreichen

• Unterstützung der Analyse von End-to-End-Produktionsprozessen und Anlagenkapazitäten, um Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten in Bezug auf Sicherheit, Qualität und Robustheit der Versorgung zu identifizieren, Betriebskosten und Durchlaufzeiten zu senken und Probleme zu vermeiden

• Planung und Koordination der Fehlersuche in Zusammenarbeit mit den Pilotlabors, der Produktion und der Qualitätsabteilung

• Förderung der technischen Standardisierung und des Wissensaustauschs zwischen dem Edelstahlwerk SUT und MAB, als KMU bei Inspektionen und als Leiter von Ursachenanalyseteams für komplexe Abweichungen

• Als Standortvertreter in Netzwerkteams, d.h. UoTs, (Unit Operation Teams), MPET (Manufacturing Process Evaluation Team) und als Standort-KMU und Entscheidungsträger bei strategischen technischen Veränderungen

• Primärer Ansprechpartner für Partner im Roche Biologics Drug Substance Netzwerk (wie andere Produktionsstätten, PTI, PTD, DSTLs, andere Funktionen und externe Partner) für den Austausch und die Zusammenarbeit im Bereich MSAT

• Eigentümer der Produktionsprozesse (Schnittstelle zwischen Fertigung und MSAT) sowie Durchführung von Datenanalysen im Rahmen der Prozessüberwachung

Wer Du bist:

Sie haben einen akademischen Abschluss in einem wissenschaftlichen oder technischen Bereich (Master oder PhD), vorzugsweise in Biotechnologie, Biochemie oder bio-chemischer Verfahrenstechnik. Außerdem:

• 8+ Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in der Industrie (Herstellung), 6+ Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in der Herstellung mit Bioprozessen und erfordert Erfahrung in einer cGMP-Umgebung

• Gute Kenntnisse von Sicherheitsprinzipien, Qualitätssystemen und cGMP und hat einschlägige Arbeitserfahrung in einem Labor, einer Pilotanlage, einer Fertigung oder einer Fertigungsunterstützung gemacht

• Umfangreiche Kenntnisse auf dem Gebiet der vorgelagerten Verarbeitung biotechnologisch hergestellter Produkte mit der Fähigkeit, sich an ein sich schnell veränderndes Umfeld mit sich ändernden Prioritäten anzupassen und flexibel auf Anfragen zu reagieren

• Sehr gute (interkulturelle) Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit fließendem Deutsch und Englisch

• Kenntnisse über Prozessvalidierung, Prozesstransfers und Single-Use-Technologien wären von Vorteil

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Basel Biotech Manufacturing produit des médicaments biotechnologiques comme les anticorps monoclonaux (mAb) et les conjugués anticorps-médicaments (ADC) à usage clinique et commercial. Le département MSAT est une unité technologique qui soutient la production à Bâle DS Manufacturing.

La possibilité :

En tant que membre de l'équipe de performance du processus MSAT, qui se concentre sur le traitement en amont, vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

• Renforcement, maintien et amélioration des capacités techniques du groupe dans le domaine des responsabilités des chapitres du génie des procédés, y compris : coaching et encadrement des PME techniques et formulation de recommandations pour les décisions techniques

• Collaborer avec des experts techniques de Roche pour soutenir des initiatives stratégiques à travers le réseau de fabrication de Roche et des projets technologiques et d'innovation de premier plan au sein du site et/ou du réseau

• Embodying Lean Principes de leadership et vivre une culture d'amélioration continue pour favoriser un environnement d'esprit d'équipe solide, de communication opportune et efficace, de sentiment d'urgence, de forte motivation et de passion, afin d'atteindre des objectifs à moyen et à long terme

• Appuyer l'analyse des processus de production de bout en bout et des capacités des installations afin de déterminer les possibilités d'amélioration de la sécurité, de la qualité, de la robustesse de l'approvisionnement, de réduire les coûts opérationnels et les délais d'exécution et de prévenir les problèmes

• Planification et coordination des activités de dépannage en collaboration avec les laboratoires pilotes, la production et le service qualité

• Conduire la normalisation technique et l'échange de connaissances entre les usines d'acier inoxydable SUT et MAB, servant de PME dans les inspections et de chef de file des équipes d'analyse des causes profondes pour les écarts complexes

• Être un représentant de site dans les équipes de réseau, c'est-à-dire les UoT, (équipes opérationnelles de l'unité), MPET (équipe d'évaluation des processus de fabrication) et devenir une PME de site et un décideur dans les changements techniques stratégiques

• Devenir le premier contact pour les partenaires du réseau des substances médicamenteuses biologiques de Roche (comme d'autres sites de fabrication, PTI, PTD, DSTL, autres fonctions et partenaires externes) pour l'échange et la collaboration dans le domaine du MSAT

• Propriétaire des processus de production (interface entre Manufacturing et MSAT) et réalisation d'analyses de données dans le cadre de la surveillance des processus

Qui vous êtes :

Vous avez un diplôme universitaire dans un domaine scientifique ou technique (maîtrise ou doctorat), de préférence en biotechnologie, en biochimie ou en génie des procédés biochimiques. En outre:

• 8+ années d'expérience pertinente dans l'industrie (fabrication), 6+ années d'expérience pertinente dans la fabrication avec des bioprocédés, et besoin d'expérience de travail dans un environnement cGMP

• Bonne connaissance des principes de sécurité, des systèmes de qualité et des BPFc et a fait une expérience de travail pertinente dans un laboratoire, une usine pilote, une fabrication ou un cadre de soutien à la fabrication

• Connaissance approfondie dans le domaine de la transformation en amont de produits fabriqués en biotechnologie, avec la capacité de s'adapter à un environnement en évolution rapide avec des priorités changeantes et de réagir avec souplesse aux demandes

• Très bonnes compétences en communication (interculturelle) avec maîtrise en allemand et en anglais

• La connaissance de la validation des processus, des transferts de processus et des technologies à usage unique serait un avantage

Service de garde parfois possible.

jobs.title: DMPK-PD Project Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

The Opportunity

As an experienced DMPK-PD Project Leader within the Translational DMPK-PD Group, you will be pivotal in ensuring the right drug is delivered at the right dose, safely and efficaciously, to patients. You will lead nonclinical and translational strategies, collaborating across therapeutic areas to transform scientific hypotheses into groundbreaking clinical candidates.

Your Impact & Responsibilities:

• Strategy & Design: Define and lead drug design and optimisation strategies and compound profiling integrating cutting-edge Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) principles, with a strong focus on target biology validation and translational PK/Pharmacodynamics (PD) concepts.

• Translational Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert, guiding early discovery teams in developing sophisticated translational strategies for clinical evaluation of target modulation, leveraging deep biochemical and pharmacological knowledge.

• Modelling & Simulation (M&S): Execute fundamental M&S activities, including PKPD, Physiologically-Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), and human dose/regimen prediction, to provide essential support for projects spanning from Lead Optimisation (LO) through early and late-stage clinical development (EIH, Ph 2/3).

• Regulatory Mastery: Author and present definitive, high-quality scientific assessments of non-clinical DMPK data for critical internal program reviews and all major external regulatory submissions (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), ensuring global compliance and accelerated timelines.

• Implementation: Implement biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close collaboration with key partners to ensure both patient safety and the achievement of meaningful therapeutic benefit.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparent, data-driven decision-making, acting as a trusted advisor and cultivating high-trust professional relationships across global project teams, governance bodies, and external partnerships.

Who You Are

• You hold a PharmD or PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, Bioengineering or similar, coupled with over 5-10 years of industry experience in a pharmacokinetic-related role

• You possess deep, comprehensive expertise across the entire discovery

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme, creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità.

All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani.

L'opportunità

Come leader di progetto DMPK-PD esperto all'interno del gruppo DMPK-PD Traduzionale, sarete fondamentali per garantire che il farmaco giusto sia consegnato alla dose giusta, in modo sicuro ed efficace, ai pazienti. Condurrai strategie non cliniche e traduttive, collaborando in aree terapeutiche per trasformare le ipotesi scientifiche in candidati clinici innovativi.

I vostri impatti e responsabilità:

• Strategia & Design: Definire e condurre strategie di progettazione e ottimizzazione della droga e profilazione dei composti che integrano i principi di Metabolismo e Farmacokinetics (DMPK) all'avanguardia, con un forte focus sui concetti di convalida della biologia e di traduzione PK/Pharmacodinamica (PD).

• Esperienza traduttiva: Servire come esperto di materia tematica, guidare i team di scoperta precoce nello sviluppo di sofisticate strategie di traduzione per la valutazione clinica della modulazione target, sfruttando la conoscenza biochimica e farmacologica profonda.

• Modelling & Simulation (M&S): Eseguire attività M&S fondamentali, tra cui PKPD, Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), e predizione dose/regimen umano, per fornire un supporto essenziale per i progetti che spaziano dall'Optimizzazione di piombo (LO) attraverso lo sviluppo clinico precoce e di fine stadio (EIH, Ph 2/3).

• Mastery di regolamentazione: Autore e presente valutazioni scientifiche definitive e di alta qualità dei dati DMPK non clinici per le recensioni critiche dei programmi interni e tutte le principali sottomissioni normative esterne (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), assicurando la conformità globale e tempi accelerati.

• Attuazione: Implement biomarker e strategie bioanalitiche in stretta collaborazione con partner chiave per garantire sia la sicurezza del paziente che il raggiungimento di un significativo beneficio terapeutico.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion trasparente, data-driven decision-making, agendo come consulente affidabile e coltivando relazioni professionali di alta fiducia in team di progetto globali, enti di governance e partnership esterne.

Chi sei

• Hai un PharmD o un PhD in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Farmacologia, Bioingegneria o simili, accoppiato con oltre 5-10 anni di esperienza nel settore in un ruolo legato alla farmacocinetica

• Possiedi competenze profonde e complete in tutta la scoperta

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

The Opportunity

As an experienced DMPK-PD Project Leader within the Translational DMPK-PD Group, you will be pivotal in ensuring the right drug is delivered at the right dose, safely and efficaciously, to patients. You will lead nonclinical and translational strategies, collaborating across therapeutic areas to transform scientific hypotheses into groundbreaking clinical candidates.

Your Impact & Responsibilities:

• Strategy & Design: Define and lead drug design and optimisation strategies and compound profiling integrating cutting-edge Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) principles, with a strong focus on target biology validation and translational PK/Pharmacodynamics (PD) concepts.

• Translational Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert, guiding early discovery teams in developing sophisticated translational strategies for clinical evaluation of target modulation, leveraging deep biochemical and pharmacological knowledge.

• Modelling & Simulation (M&S): Execute fundamental M&S activities, including PKPD, Physiologically-Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), and human dose/regimen prediction, to provide essential support for projects spanning from Lead Optimisation (LO) through early and late-stage clinical development (EIH, Ph 2/3).

• Regulatory Mastery: Author and present definitive, high-quality scientific assessments of non-clinical DMPK data for critical internal program reviews and all major external regulatory submissions (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), ensuring global compliance and accelerated timelines.

• Implementation: Implement biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close collaboration with key partners to ensure both patient safety and the achievement of meaningful therapeutic benefit.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparent, data-driven decision-making, acting as a trusted advisor and cultivating high-trust professional relationships across global project teams, governance bodies, and external partnerships.

Who You Are

• You hold a PharmD or PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, Bioengineering or similar, coupled with over 5-10 years of industry experience in a pharmacokinetic-related role

• You possess deep, comprehensive expertise across the entire discovery

Die Position
In Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organisation (pRED) stellen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten her, um einige der weltweit härtesten unerfüllten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED verbindet uns unsere Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires qui changent la vie.

A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain.

L'opportunité

En tant que chef de projet expérimenté de DMPK-PD au sein du Groupe DMPK-PD, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour vous assurer que le bon médicament est livré à la bonne dose, de façon sûre et efficace, aux patients. Vous dirigerez des stratégies non cliniques et translationnelles, en collaborant dans des domaines thérapeutiques pour transformer des hypothèses scientifiques en candidats cliniques révolutionnaires.

Votre impact et vos responsabilités :

• Stratégie et conception : Définir et diriger les stratégies de conception et d'optimisation des médicaments et établir le profil des composés en intégrant les principes de pointe du métabolisme et de la pharmacocinétique des médicaments, en mettant fortement l'accent sur la validation de la biologie cible et les concepts translationnels de PK/Pharmacodynamique (PD).

• Expertise translationnelle : servir d'expert en la matière, guider les équipes de découverte précoce dans l'élaboration de stratégies translationnelles sophistiquées pour l'évaluation clinique de la modulation cible, en tirant parti de connaissances biochimiques et pharmacologiques profondes.

• Modélisation et simulation (M&S) : Exécuter des activités fondamentales de M&S, y compris la PKPD, la Pharmacocinétique physiologique (PBPK), l'interaction médicament-drogue (DDI) et la prédiction de la dose humaine/régime, afin de fournir un soutien essentiel aux projets qui vont de l'optimisation du plomb (OL) jusqu'au développement clinique en début et en fin de développement (EIH, Ph 2/3).

• Maîtrise de la réglementation : Auteur et présentation d'évaluations scientifiques définitives et de haute qualité des données DMPK non cliniques pour les examens internes critiques des programmes et toutes les principales présentations de réglementation externe (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), assurant la conformité mondiale et des délais accélérés.

• Mise en oeuvre : Mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de biomarqueur et de bioanalyse en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires clés afin d'assurer la sécurité des patients et d'obtenir des avantages thérapeutiques significatifs.

• Influence interfonctionnelle : Championne, prise de décision transparente et axée sur les données, agissant comme conseiller de confiance et cultivant des relations professionnelles de haute confiance entre les équipes de projet mondiales, les organismes de gouvernance et les partenariats externes.

Qui vous êtes

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un PharmD ou d'un doctorat en sciences pharmaceutiques, pharmacologie, bioingénierie ou similaire, associé à plus de 5-10 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie dans un rôle lié à la pharmacocinétique

• Vous possédez une expertise approfondie et complète dans toute la découverte

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Business Analyst you will fill the gap between the Software Asset Management (SAM) team and the technology delivery. You will act as the vital link between SAM functional teams and software engineering. You will translate complex software licensing frameworks, entitlement logic, compliance needs, and asset lifecycle workflows into robust technical specifications, data models, and actionable user stories.
In this role, you will lead end-to-end technical business analysis workstreams, evaluating SAM tool capabilities, analyzing platform options, and driving the implementation, configuration, and integration of SAM platforms. You will ensure the technology solutions and SAM tools built or deployed directly automate SAM processes, reduce compliance risk, and optimize software spend, while serving as a trusted advisor to both functional leads and engineering teams.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / Content Leadership: Independently manages end-to-end technical BA workstreams, translating SAM operational needs into structured engineering backlogs, functional specifications, and solution workflows without requiring guidance. Proactively shapes agile team processes and technical BA standards.

• Accountability / Problem Solving: Leads technical root-cause analysis for SAM tooling and data pipelines. Evaluates gaps in discovery data, CMDB integrations, and license calculation logic, taking full accountability for delivering clear technical requirements and integration mappings that resolve business bottlenecks.

• SAM Tool Analysis & Implementation: Conducts in-depth tool capability assessments, fit-gap analyses, and platform evaluations. Defines functional requirements, configuration logic, and integration specs to drive the successful implementation and enterprise rollout of SAM tools.

• Stakeholder Management: Acts as the primary translator and liaison between functional SAM leads (business) and software engineers, data architects, and vendors (tech). Facilitates technical refinement sessions, resolves conflicting requirements between business desires and technical constraints, and aligns strategic priorities across both sides.

• Impact / Strategy: Ensures implemented SAM tools and custom technical solutions deliver tangible business outcomes—such as automated license reconciliation, audit readiness, and software cost reduction. Translates long-term SAM functional roadmaps into scalable, phased technical implementation plans.

• Complexity / Product Size: Operates across multi-product environments and complex technical ecosystems involving CMDBs, cloud management platforms, discovery tools, procurement engines, and enterprise SAM platforms. Navigates ambiguous requirements across intricate software licensing models (e.g., SaaS, core-based, concurrent user) and legacy tool migrations.

• Business / Technical Ability: Demonstrates deep domain expertise in Software Asset Management concepts (ISO 19770, license entitlement modeling, cloud cost management) coupled with hands-on technical proficiency in SAM tool architectures, API integrations, data flow mapping, and query logic (SQL) to guide platform development and system integration.

Qualifications

Education / Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems (MIS), Business Administration

• 5+ years of Business Analysis / Consultancy experience, with at least 3+ years in life sciences/pharma or the assigned busin

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Come Senior Business Analyst si riempirà il divario tra il team Software Asset Management (SAM) e la fornitura di tecnologia. Potrai agire come il collegamento vitale tra team funzionali SAM e ingegneria software. Tradurrete complessi framework software di licenza, logica di diritto, esigenze di conformità e flussi di lavoro del ciclo di vita di attività in solide specifiche tecniche, modelli di dati e storie utente utilizzabili.
In questo ruolo, guiderai flussi di lavoro di analisi di business tecnici end-to-end, valutando le capacità degli strumenti SAM, analizzando le opzioni della piattaforma e guidando l'implementazione, la configurazione e l'integrazione delle piattaforme SAM. Potrai garantire le soluzioni tecnologiche e gli strumenti SAM costruiti o implementati direttamente automatizzare i processi SAM, ridurre il rischio di conformità e ottimizzare la spesa software, mentre serve come consulente affidabile sia per i lead funzionali che per i team di ingegneria.

Descrizione della zona

Responsabilità del lavoro

• Scope / Content Leadership: gestisce in modo indipendente i flussi di lavoro BA tecnici end-to-end, traducendo le esigenze operative SAM in backlog ingegneristici strutturati, specifiche funzionali e flussi di lavoro di soluzione senza richiedere una guida. Proattivamente modella i processi di team agili e gli standard tecnici BA.

• Responsabilità / Problem Solving: conduce l'analisi tecnica di root-cause per la strumentazione SAM e le pipeline di dati. Valuta le lacune nei dati di scoperta, le integrazioni CMDB e la logica di calcolo della licenza, tenendo piena responsabilitÃ per fornire chiari requisiti tecnici e le mappe di integrazione che risolvono le strozzature aziendali.

• SAM Tool Analysis & Implementation: Conduce valutazioni approfondite delle capacità degli strumenti, analisi fit-gap e valutazioni della piattaforma. Definisce i requisiti funzionali, la logica di configurazione e le specifiche di integrazione per guidare l'implementazione e l'implementazione aziendale di strumenti SAM.

• Stakeholder Management: agisce come traduttore primario e collegamento tra porta SAM funzionali (business) e ingegneri software, architetti di dati e venditori (tech). Facilita le sessioni di perfezionamento tecnico, risolve i requisiti contrastanti tra desideri aziendali e vincoli tecnici, e allinea le priorità strategiche su entrambi i lati.

• Impatto / Strategia: Garantisce strumenti SAM implementati e soluzioni tecniche personalizzate forniscono risultati aziendali tangibili, come la riconciliazione automatica delle licenze, la disponibilità di audit e la riduzione dei costi del software. Traduce roadmap funzionali SAM a lungo termine in piani di implementazione tecnica scalabile e graduale.

• Complessità / dimensione del prodotto: Funziona in ambienti multi-prodotto e ecosistemi tecnici complessi che coinvolgono CMDB, piattaforme di cloud management, strumenti di scoperta, motori di approvvigionamento e piattaforme SAM aziendali. Naviga in condizioni ambigue attraverso intricati modelli di licenze software (ad esempio, SaaS, core-based, concurrent user) e migrazioni di strumenti legacy.

• Business / Technical Ability: Dimostra le competenze di dominio profondo nei concetti di Software Asset Management (ISO 19770, la modellazione del diritto di licenza, la gestione dei costi cloud) accoppiato con la competenza tecnica pratica nelle architetture degli strumenti SAM, integrazioni API, mappatura del flusso di dati e logica di query (SQL) per guidare lo sviluppo della piattaforma e l'integrazione del sistema.

Qualifiche

Istruzione / Esperienza

• Laurea in Informatica, Informatica, Management Information Systems (MIS), Business Administration

• 5+ anni di Business Analysis / Esperienza di consulenza, con almeno 3+ anni di scienze della vita/farmaco o il busin assegnato

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
En tant qu'analyste principal des affaires, vous comblerez l'écart entre l'équipe de gestion des biens logiciels (SAM) et la prestation de la technologie. Vous agirez comme le lien vital entre les équipes fonctionnelles SAM et l'ingénierie logicielle. Vous transformerez les cadres complexes de licence de logiciels, la logique des droits, les besoins de conformité et les flux de travail du cycle de vie des actifs en spécifications techniques robustes, modèles de données et histoires d'utilisateurs exploitables.
Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des flux de travail d'analyse technique d'affaires de bout en bout, évaluerez les capacités de l'outil SAM, analyserez les options de plate-forme et piloterez la mise en œuvre, la configuration et l'intégration des plates-formes SAM. Vous vous assurerez que les solutions technologiques et les outils SAM construits ou déployés automatisent directement les processus SAM, réduisent les risques de conformité et optimisent les dépenses logicielles, tout en servant de conseiller de confiance aux responsables fonctionnels et aux équipes d'ingénierie.

Description de la zone

Responsabilités professionnelles

• Portée / contenu Leadership : gère de façon indépendante les flux de travail techniques de bout en bout de BA, traduisant les besoins opérationnels de SAM en retards d'ingénierie structurés, spécifications fonctionnelles et workflows de solutions sans avoir besoin d'orientation. Forme proactivement les processus d'équipe agile et les normes techniques BA.

• Responsabilisation / résolution de problèmes : dirige l'analyse technique des causes profondes pour l'outillage SAM et les pipelines de données. Évaluer les lacunes dans les données de découverte, les intégrations du CMDB et la logique de calcul des licences, en prenant pleinement en compte les exigences techniques claires et les cartes d'intégration qui éliminent les goulets d'étranglement commerciaux.

• Analyse et mise en oeuvre de l'outil SAM : Effectue des évaluations approfondies de la capacité de l'outil, des analyses d'ajustement et des évaluations de plateforme. Définit les exigences fonctionnelles, la logique de configuration et les spécifications d'intégration pour conduire la mise en œuvre réussie et le déploiement d'entreprise des outils SAM.

• Gestion des parties prenantes : agit comme traducteur principal et assure la liaison entre les chefs de file (entreprises) et les ingénieurs logiciels, les architectes de données et les fournisseurs (technologie). Faciliter les séances de perfectionnement technique, résoudre les exigences contradictoires entre les désirs des entreprises et les contraintes techniques, et harmoniser les priorités stratégiques entre les deux parties.

• Impact / Stratégie : S'assure que les outils SAM mis en oeuvre et les solutions techniques personnalisées produisent des résultats opérationnels tangibles, comme le rapprochement automatisé des licences, la préparation à la vérification et la réduction des coûts des logiciels. Traduisez les feuilles de route fonctionnelles à long terme de la MAS en plans de mise en oeuvre technique évolutifs et échelonnés.

• Complexité / Taille du produit: Fonctionne à travers des environnements multi-produits et des écosystèmes techniques complexes impliquant des CMDB, des plateformes de gestion du cloud, des outils de découverte, des moteurs d'approvisionnement et des plateformes SAM d'entreprise. Navigue les exigences ambiguës dans les modèles complexes de licences de logiciels (p. ex. SaaS, utilisateur principal et concurrent) et les migrations d'outils hérités.

• Capacités d'affaires / techniques: Démontre une expertise de domaine profonde dans les concepts de gestion d'actifs logiciels (ISO 19770, modélisation des droits de licence, gestion des coûts du cloud) associée à une compétence technique pratique dans les architectures d'outils SAM, les intégrations d'API, la cartographie de flux de données et la logique de requête (SQL) pour guider le développement de plateforme et l'intégration de système.

Compétences

Éducation / Expérience

• Baccalauréat en informatique, technologie de l'information, systèmes d'information de gestion (MIS), administration des affaires

• 5+ ans d'expérience en analyse d'entreprise / conseil, avec au moins 3+ ans en sciences de la vie/pharmacie ou le busin assigné

jobs.title: Market Access Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Market Access Specialist

Location: New Delhi

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Market Access Specialist, as a part of the Access team, is central to our vision to transform healthcare for patients and their families in India. Reporting the Director, Access & Policy, the incumbent will be responsible for ensuring strategic development of high quality, evidence based, innovative programs that deliver transformational and lasting health impact for the underserved population segments in India across therapeutic areas. You will also provide
support to our State Access Partners as they build local strategies
and partnerships for health system and policy strengthening in key States.

A key aspect of the role is to ensure working in collaboration with other members of the team/affiliate and to support and promote progressive health system strategy and its implementation. The candidate will also lead the development of external relationships and contribute to the submission of high quality reports/proposals to various state governments and public health bodies for health system transformation through innovative, actionable and sustainable programs.

The Opportunity

• Coach and catalyst for State Access Partners, supporting ideation and implementation of strategies in line with business priorities

• Manages prioritized health systems engagement on prevention, early detection, screening, quality of life and access to care initiatives, and population health-related efforts to achieve cancer control priorities, ophthalmology, rare diseases and neurology.

• High-level representational role with the key external stakeholders including states governments and national/global public health organizations

• Lead innovative program design for health systems transformations and be responsible for implementation, follow-up, evaluation, quality strengthening and reporting of projects.

• Serve as a subject matter expert for both internal and external stakeholders on healthcare program monitoring and evaluation methods (qualitative and quantitative), including experience developing monitoring and evaluation plans, tools, training materials, reports and summary forms.

Who you are

• Deep understanding of Indian healthcare system. Demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities

• Understanding of health system concepts in general including health system capacity development, task shifting

• Demonstrated experience in co-creating and maintaining public-private partnerships

• Demonstrated experience working in low resource settings to implement public health programs

• Demonstrated success in program conceptualization and design, proposal development, fundraising, program delivery, and monitoring and evaluation

• Demonstrated understanding of global health trends and expertise in working with governments, non-profit organizations, and the private sector to achieve public health impact

• Ability to creatively solve challenging problems in the application of research and evaluation methods without extensive structural or operational support.

• Ability to adapt to fast-paced and changing environments, both internally and externally.

• Willingness to travel and spend significant time in the field.

• English language fluency, bot

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Specialista di accesso al mercato

Posizione: Nuova Delhi

La posizione
Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

Market Access Specialist, come parte del team Access, è centrale per la nostra visione di trasformare la salute per i pazienti e le loro famiglie in India. Segnalando il Direttore, Access & Policy, l'Incumbent sarà responsabile di garantire lo sviluppo strategico di alta qualità, basati su prove, programmi innovativi che forniscono un impatto sanitario trasformazionale e duraturo per i segmenti di popolazione sottoserviti in India attraverso le aree terapeutiche. Lei fornirà anche
supporto ai nostri partner di accesso allo Stato come costruiscono strategie locali
e partnership per il sistema sanitario e il rafforzamento della politica negli Stati chiave.

Un aspetto chiave del ruolo è quello di garantire il lavoro in collaborazione con altri membri del team/affiliato e di sostenere e promuovere la strategia del sistema sanitario progressivo e la sua attuazione. Il candidato porterà anche lo sviluppo di relazioni esterne e contribuirà alla presentazione di rapporti di alta qualità / proposte a vari governi statali e enti sanitari pubblici per la trasformazione del sistema sanitario attraverso programmi innovativi, attuabili e sostenibili.

L'opportunità

• Coach e catalizzatore per i partner di accesso di Stato, sostenendo l'ideazione e l'implementazione di strategie in linea con le priorità aziendali

• Gestisce l'impegno dei sistemi sanitari prioritari sulla prevenzione, il rilevamento precoce, lo screening, la qualità della vita e l'accesso alle iniziative di assistenza, e gli sforzi legati alla salute della popolazione per raggiungere le priorità di controllo del cancro, l'oftalmologia, le malattie rare e la neurologia.

• Il ruolo rappresentativo di alto livello con le principali parti interessate esterne, tra cui i governi degli Stati e le organizzazioni sanitarie pubbliche nazionali/globali

• Guidare la progettazione innovativa del programma per le trasformazioni dei sistemi sanitari e essere responsabile per l'implementazione, il follow-up, la valutazione, il rafforzamento della qualità e la segnalazione dei progetti.

• Servire come esperto di materia tematica sia per gli stakeholder interni che esterni sui metodi di monitoraggio e valutazione del programma sanitario (qualitativo e quantitativo), tra cui i piani di monitoraggio e valutazione dell'esperienza di sviluppo, gli strumenti, i materiali di formazione, i report e i moduli di sintesi.

Chi sei

• Profonda comprensione del sistema sanitario indiano. Capacità di pensiero strategiche dimostrate

• Comprensione dei concetti del sistema sanitario in generale, compreso lo sviluppo della capacità del sistema sanitario, il cambiamento delle mansioni

• Esperienza dimostrata nella co-creazione e nel mantenimento di partenariati pubblico-privati

• Esperienza dimostrata che lavora nelle impostazioni di bassa risorsa per implementare i programmi di salute pubblica

• Successo dimostrativo nella concettualizzazione e progettazione del programma, sviluppo della proposta, raccolta fondi, consegna del programma e monitoraggio e valutazione

• La comprensione dimostrata delle tendenze e delle competenze sanitarie globali nel lavorare con i governi, le organizzazioni senza scopo di lucro e il settore privato per raggiungere l'impatto sulla salute pubblica

• Capacità di risolvere in modo creativo problemi difficili nell'applicazione dei metodi di ricerca e valutazione senza un ampio supporto strutturale o operativo.

• Capacità di adattarsi a ambienti veloci e mutevoli, sia interni che esterni.

• Volontà di viaggiare e trascorrere un tempo significativo nel campo.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Marktzugangsspezialist

Standort: New Delhi

Die Position
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Market Access Specialist ist als Teil des Access-Teams von zentraler Bedeutung für unsere Vision, die Gesundheitsversorgung für Patienten und ihre Familien in Indien zu verändern. Der Direktor, Access & Policy, wird für die strategische Entwicklung hochwertiger, evidenzbasierter, innovativer Programme verantwortlich sein, die transformative und dauerhafte Auswirkungen auf die Gesundheit der unterversorgten Bevölkerungsgruppen in Indien in allen therapeutischen Bereichen haben. Sie bieten auch
Unterstützung unserer State Access Partner beim Aufbau lokaler Strategien
und Partnerschaften zur Stärkung des Gesundheitssystems und der Politik in Schlüsselstaaten.

Ein wichtiger Aspekt der Rolle ist es, die Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Mitgliedern des Teams / der Gruppe sicherzustellen und die fortschrittliche Strategie des Gesundheitssystems und seine Umsetzung zu unterstützen und zu fördern. Der Kandidat wird auch die Entwicklung externer Beziehungen leiten und zur Einreichung hochwertiger Berichte / Vorschläge an verschiedene Landesregierungen und öffentliche Gesundheitsbehörden für die Transformation des Gesundheitssystems durch innovative, umsetzbare und nachhaltige Programme beitragen.

Die Chance

• Coach und Katalysator für State Access Partners, Unterstützung der Ideenfindung und Umsetzung von Strategien im Einklang mit den Geschäftsprioritäten

• Verwaltet priorisierte Gesundheitssysteme Engagement auf Prävention, Früherkennung, Screening, Lebensqualität und Zugang zu Pflege-Initiativen, und Bevölkerung gesundheitsbezogenen Bemühungen, um Krebsbekämpfung Prioritäten, Augenheilkunde, seltene Krankheiten und Neurologie zu erreichen.

• Hohe repräsentative Rolle bei den wichtigsten externen Stakeholdern, einschließlich der Regierungen der Staaten und der nationalen / globalen Gesundheitsorganisationen

• Führen Sie innovatives Programmdesign für die Transformation von Gesundheitssystemen und sind Sie für die Umsetzung, Nachverfolgung, Bewertung, Qualitätsstärkung und Berichterstattung von Projekten verantwortlich.

• Dienen Sie als Fachexperte für interne und externe Stakeholder für Überwachung und Bewertung von Gesundheitsprogrammen (qualitativ und quantitativ), einschließlich Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Überwachungs- und Bewertungsplänen, Tools, Schulungsmaterialien, Berichten und Zusammenfassungsformularen.

Wer du bist

• Tiefes Verständnis des indischen Gesundheitssystems. Nachweis der strategischen Denkfähigkeiten

• Verständnis von Gesundheitssystemkonzepten im Allgemeinen einschließlich der Entwicklung von Gesundheitssystemkapazitäten, Aufgabenverschiebung

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Mitgestaltung und Pflege von öffentlich-privaten Partnerschaften

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung bei der Arbeit in ressourcenschwachen Umgebungen zur Umsetzung von Programmen der öffentlichen Gesundheit

• Nachgewiesener Erfolg in der Programmkonzeption und -gestaltung, Vorschlagsentwicklung, Fundraising, Programmbereitstellung sowie Überwachung und Bewertung

• Demonstriertes Verständnis globaler Gesundheitstrends und Expertise in der Zusammenarbeit mit Regierungen, gemeinnützigen Organisationen und dem privaten Sektor, um Auswirkungen auf die öffentliche Gesundheit zu erzielen

• Fähigkeit, anspruchsvolle Probleme bei der Anwendung von Forschungs- und Bewertungsmethoden ohne umfangreiche strukturelle oder operative Unterstützung kreativ zu lösen.

• Fähigkeit, sich an schnelllebige und sich verändernde Umgebungen anzupassen, sowohl intern als auch extern.

• Bereitschaft zu reisen und viel Zeit auf dem Feld zu verbringen.

• Englisch Sprachfluss, Bot

La position
Spécialiste de l ' accès aux marchés

Lieu: New Delhi

La position
Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Le spécialiste de l'accès au marché, dans le cadre de l'équipe Accès, est au cœur de notre vision de transformer les soins de santé pour les patients et leurs familles en Inde. Relevant du directeur, Accès et politique, le titulaire sera chargé d'assurer l'élaboration stratégique de programmes innovateurs, fondés sur des données probantes et de haute qualité qui produisent des effets de transformation et durables sur la santé des segments de population mal desservis de l'Inde dans toutes les régions thérapeutiques. Vous fournirez également
le soutien à nos partenaires d'accès de l'État dans l'élaboration de stratégies locales
et des partenariats pour le système de santé et le renforcement des politiques dans les États clefs.

Un aspect clé du rôle consiste à veiller à travailler en collaboration avec d'autres membres de l'équipe ou de l'affilié et à appuyer et promouvoir la stratégie progressive du système de santé et sa mise en oeuvre. Le candidat dirigera également le développement de relations externes et contribuera à la présentation de rapports/propositions de haute qualité à divers gouvernements des États et organismes de santé publique pour la transformation du système de santé au moyen de programmes innovateurs, concrets et durables.

L'opportunité

• Coach et catalyseur pour les partenaires d'accès de l'État, soutenant l'idée et la mise en œuvre de stratégies conformes aux priorités commerciales

• Gérer l'engagement prioritaire des systèmes de santé en matière de prévention, de dépistage précoce, de dépistage, de qualité de vie et d'accès aux initiatives de soins, et les efforts liés à la santé de la population pour atteindre les priorités en matière de lutte contre le cancer, d'ophtalmologie, de maladies rares et de neurologie.

• Rôle de représentation de haut niveau auprès des principales parties prenantes externes, y compris les gouvernements des États et les organisations nationales et mondiales de santé publique

• Diriger la conception de programmes innovateurs pour les transformations des systèmes de santé et être responsable de la mise en oeuvre, du suivi, de l'évaluation, du renforcement de la qualité et de l'établissement de rapports sur les projets.

• Servir d'expert en la matière pour les intervenants internes et externes sur les méthodes de suivi et d'évaluation des programmes de soins de santé (qualitatifs et quantitatifs), y compris l'expérience de l'élaboration de plans de suivi et d'évaluation, d'outils, de matériel de formation, de rapports et de formulaires sommaires.

Qui vous êtes

• Connaissance approfondie du système de santé indien. Capacités de réflexion stratégique démontrées

• Connaissance des concepts du système de santé en général, y compris le renforcement des capacités du système de santé, le transfert des tâches

• Expérience démontrée dans la création et le maintien de partenariats public-privé

• Expérience démontrée travaillant dans des milieux à faible ressource pour mettre en oeuvre des programmes de santé publique

• Réussite démontrée de la conceptualisation et de la conception du programme, de l'élaboration de propositions, de la collecte de fonds, de l'exécution du programme et du suivi et de l'évaluation

• Compréhension démontrée des tendances et de l'expertise en matière de santé mondiale dans la collaboration avec les gouvernements, les organismes à but non lucratif et le secteur privé en vue d'obtenir un impact sur la santé publique

• Capacité de résoudre de manière créative des problèmes difficiles dans l'application des méthodes de recherche et d'évaluation sans un soutien structurel ou opérationnel important.

• Capacité à s'adapter à des environnements rapides et changeants, tant à l'interne qu'à l'externe.

• Volonté de voyager et de passer beaucoup de temps sur le terrain.

• Connaissance de la langue anglaise, bot

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner - Oncology
Location: Mumbai

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche's capabilities and resources to co-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

Your Opportunity

• You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators

• You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public & private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations

• You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations

• You will be leading collaboration in field through co-creation of solutions for key accounts

Who you are ​

• Relevant graduate delivery required, post-graduation preferred

• More than 8 years’ experience with 4+ years in Oncology or similar preferred

• Strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management

• English language knowledge, written and verbal is preferred, knowledge of local language is an advantage

• Willingness to relocate

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner - Oncology
Location: Mumbai

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche's capabilities and resources to co-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

Your Opportunity

• You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators

• You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public & private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations

• You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations

• You will be leading collaboration in field through co-creation of solutions for key accounts

Who you are ​

• Relevant graduate delivery required, post-graduation preferred

• More than 8 years’ experience with 4+ years in Oncology or similar preferred

• Strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management

• English language knowledge, written and verbal is preferred, knowledge of local language is an advantage

• Willingness to relocate

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In this internship, you will play a critical part in maintaining our high standards by providing quality and compliance oversight for a diverse network of external GxP suppliers. You will ensure strict adherence to cGMP and Quality Agreement requirements across a broad portfolio of partners, including CMOs, CLOs, service providers, and suppliers of direct materials, critical process-contacting spare parts, analytical equipment, and manufacturing systems.
Serving as the primary Quality Point of Contact (PoC) for designated suppliers, you will act as an integral member of our GxP cross-functional management teams. In this collaborative capacity, you will support the end-to-end supplier lifecycle, helping to drive site selection, due diligence, and implementation, while ensuring the ongoing quality supply of commercial products, materials, and services right through to eventual decommissioning.

The Opportunity

• Oversee all required quality activities during the lifecycle of a GxP supplier (Source & Select, Implement, Manage, and Decommission) to support the Make, Assess, Release & Deliver (MARD) of commercial and IMP medicinal products.

• Develop, negotiate, and maintain Quality Contracts and Product-Specific Requirements (as appropriate) with GxP suppliers and ensure agreement compliance.

• Collaborate with GxP suppliers to address compliance gaps through Root Cause Analysis, CAPA implementation, deviation reporting and management, escalating as appropriate.

• Collaborate and manage relationships across End-to-End External Quality Operations and internal cross-functional teams to ensure quality expectations are aligned with Roche's objectives.

• Notify Senior Management of potential quality or regulatory issues impacting product quality or regulatory compliance.

• Timely complete all job-related training requirements before performing GMP-job functions and strive to continuously improve on knowledge and skills in quality, compliance and technology.

Who You Are

• You are a university student pursuing a Master's degree or have completed a Master's degree in Life Sciences or equivalent within the last 12 months of the start date.

• Ability to interpret data effectively and draw conclusions.

• Highly competent in MS Office or Google Suite applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, MS Project, etc.

• Ability to communicate clearly and professionally both in writing and verbally.

• Fluency in oral and written English is a must. German language skills are a plus.

Additional Information

• Please upload your CV and the certificate of your enrolment and/or your completed degree(s).

• Due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens have to provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory and the length of the mandatory internship as part of the application documents.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
In questo stage, si giocherà una parte critica nel mantenere i nostri elevati standard, fornendo qualità e controllo di conformità per una rete diversificata di fornitori GxP esterni. Garantirai una rigorosa adesione ai requisiti di cGMP e Quality Agreement in un ampio portafoglio di partner, tra cui CMO, CLO, fornitori di servizi e fornitori di materiali diretti, parti di ricambio di contatto di processo critiche, attrezzature analitiche e sistemi di produzione.
Servendo come Punto di Qualità primario di Contatto (PoC) per i fornitori designati, si agirà come membro integrante dei nostri team di gestione interfunzionale GxP. In questa capacità collaborativa, supporterai il ciclo di vita del fornitore end-to-end, aiutando a guidare la selezione del sito, la dovuta diligenza e l'implementazione, garantendo al contempo la fornitura di qualità continua di prodotti commerciali, materiali e servizi fino ad eventuali dismissioni.

L'opportunità

• Superare tutte le attività di qualità richieste durante il ciclo di vita di un fornitore di GxP (Fonte & Seleziona, Implementazione, Gestione e Decommissione) per supportare il Make, Assesss, Release & Delivery (MARD) di medicinali commerciali e IMP.

• Sviluppare, negoziare e mantenere i contratti di qualità e i requisiti specifici del prodotto (come appropriato) con i fornitori di GxP e garantire la conformità degli accordi.

• Collabora con i fornitori di GxP per affrontare le lacune di conformità attraverso l'analisi delle cause di radice, l'implementazione di CAPA, la segnalazione di deviazione e la gestione, aumentando come appropriato.

• Collaborare e gestire le relazioni tra le operazioni di qualità esterna end-to-End e i team interfunzionali interni per garantire che le aspettative di qualità siano allineate agli obiettivi di Roche.

• Informare la gestione senior di potenziali problemi di qualità o normative che influiscono sulla qualità del prodotto o sulla conformità normativa.

• Completano tempestivamente tutti i requisiti di formazione legati al lavoro prima di svolgere funzioni di GMP e si sforzano di migliorare continuamente le conoscenze e le competenze in qualità, conformità e tecnologia.

Chi sei

• Sei uno studente universitario che persegue una laurea o ha completato un Master in Scienze della Vita o equivalente negli ultimi 12 mesi della data di inizio.

• Capacità di interpretare efficacemente i dati e trarre conclusioni.

• Altamente competente nelle applicazioni MS Office o Google Suite, tra cui Excel, PowerPoint, Word, MS Project, ecc.

• Capacità di comunicare in modo chiaro e professionale sia per iscritto che verbale.

• La fluenza in inglese orale e scritto è un must. Le competenze linguistiche tedesche sono un vantaggio.

Informazioni aggiuntive

• Si prega di caricare il vostro CV e il certificato della vostra iscrizione e/o la vostra laurea completata(i).

• A causa di regolamenti, i cittadini non UE/EFTA devono fornire un certificato dall'università affermando che uno stage è obbligatorio e la durata dello stage obbligatorio come parte dei documenti di richiesta.

Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. • Entwickeln, verhandeln und pflegen Sie (gegebenenfalls) Qualitätsverträge und produktspezifische Anforderungen mit GxP-Lieferanten und gewährleisten Sie die Einhaltung der Vereinbarung.

• Arbeiten Sie mit GxP-Lieferanten zusammen, um Compliance-Lücken durch Root Cause Analysis, CAPA-Implementierung, Abweichungsberichterstattung und -management zu schließen und gegebenenfalls zu eskalieren.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir würden gerne von Ihnen hören. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt, um diese aufregende Gelegenheit zu erkunden!

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lass uns eine Heilung aufbauen
