titleByLocale.it: Principal II Automation Ricerca Ingegnere, Next Gen Sequencing Systems
titleByLocale.en: Principal II Automation Research Engineer, Next Gen Sequencing Systems
titleByLocale.de: Principal II Automation Forschung Ingenieur, Next Gen Sequencing Systems
titleByLocale.fr: Principal II Automation Recherche Ingénieur, Next Gen Sequencing Systems

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are developing the next-generation of sequencing systems. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are also broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing workflows.

Our Workflow Automation R&D Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on enhancing sequencing workflows. We are seeking a highly collaborative Principal II Automation Research Engineer to lead and contribute to the research and development of current and future automated platforms, while simultaneously building the tools to democratize key processes and eliminate bottlenecks. This is a hands-on, multidisciplinary role focused on solving automation challenges, integrating AI tools to streamline workflows, and tackling the fluidic, mechanical and consumables challenges at the heart of our next-generation platforms. We are looking for someone who exhibits a high degree of motivation, independence, and resourcefulness to help us develop solutions to our automation challenges in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Core Responsibilities

• You will utilize AI-assisted coding and modern software development tools to accelerate protocol generation, protocol simulation, debugging, test suite development, and automated error recovery.

• You will use the above tools to full automate and optimize complex workflows (i.e. sample prep, library prep, target enrichment, quantification, pooling, and sequencing)

• You will test scripts and validate system performance through various analytical equipment and data analysis pipelines

• You will contribute to architecture, design, research and development of next-generation automation platforms. Design, build, assemble and operate custom test fixtures to support testing of these platforms, modules and sub-systems.

• You will translate high-level system and assay requirements into fluidic schematics, system architectures and concepts to evaluate, compare, and downselect design paths.

• You will create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all work, from requirements, schematics, diagrams, CAD models, manufacturing drawings, and material specifications.

• You d emonstrate strong technical leadership skills and will mentor junior engineers and research staff, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning within the team.

• You will lead cross-functional strategy and influence product roadmaps by partnering directly with Assay Development Scientists, Hardware Engineers, Software Developers, and Product Managers. Conduct cross-functional concept, code/script and design reviews. Present progress, data, and engineering decisions clearly to stakeholders.

This is an on-site (5 days) position based in Santa Clara, CA. (A portion of the work will also take place in Pleasanton, CA. A connector shuttle is available.)
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Please include a cover letter with your application.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a degree in Bioengineering or Biomedical Engineering, or a closely related discipline, with relevant industry experience (12+ years for a Bachelor's, 10+ years for a Master's, or 7+ year for a PhD).

• You have deep, hands-on expertise characterizing and testing

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
A Roche, stiamo sviluppando la prossima generazione di sistemi di sequenziamento. Accelerando la ricerca clinica, razionalizzando i flussi di lavoro e ampliando i menu di analisi, stiamo anche ampliando l'accesso ai dati genomici e abbassando le barriere all'adozione. Dai robusti strumenti di isolamento e preparazione del campione alle nuove tecnologie di sequenziamento e alla bioinformatica avanzata, stiamo sviluppando soluzioni end-to-end differenziate e altamente integrate per flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento di nuova generazione.

Il nostro Workflow Automation R&D Group, parte di Roche Sequencing Solutions, si concentra sul miglioramento dei flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento. Stiamo cercando un Principal II Automation Research Engineer altamente collaborativo per guidare e contribuire alla ricerca e sviluppo di piattaforme automatizzate attuali e future, mentre costruiamo contemporaneamente gli strumenti per democratizzare i processi chiave ed eliminare i colli di bottiglia. Si tratta di un ruolo pratico e multidisciplinare focalizzato sulla soluzione delle sfide di automazione, integrando gli strumenti AI per semplificare i flussi di lavoro e affrontare le sfide fluidiche, meccaniche e di consumo al centro delle nostre piattaforme di nuova generazione. Stiamo cercando qualcuno che esibisce un alto grado di motivazione, indipendenza e risorse per aiutarci a sviluppare soluzioni alle nostre sfide di automazione in un ambiente veloce e collaborativo.

Responsabilità fondamentali

• Utilizzerai strumenti di codifica assistita dall'IA e di sviluppo software moderno per accelerare la generazione del protocollo, la simulazione del protocollo, il debugging, lo sviluppo della suite di prova e il recupero automatico degli errori.

• Userai gli strumenti di cui sopra per automatizzare e ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro complessi (cioè prep di esempio, prep di libreria, arricchimento di destinazione, quantificazione, pooling e sequenziamento)

• Testare gli script e convalidare le prestazioni del sistema attraverso varie apparecchiature analitiche e pipeline di analisi dei dati

• Contribuirai all'architettura, alla progettazione, alla ricerca e allo sviluppo di piattaforme di automazione di nuova generazione. Progettare, costruire, assemblare e utilizzare dispositivi di prova personalizzati per supportare i test di queste piattaforme, moduli e sottosistemi.

• Tradurrete requisiti di sistema e di analisi di alto livello in schemi fluidi, architetture di sistema e concetti per valutare, confrontare e downselect percorsi di progettazione.

• Si creerà e manterrà documentazione completa per tutti i lavori, dai requisiti, schemi, diagrammi, modelli CAD, disegni di produzione e specifiche dei materiali.

• Dimostrare forti capacità di leadership tecnica e tutorerà i giovani ingegneri e personale di ricerca, promuovendo una cultura di eccellenza tecnica e apprendimento continuo all'interno del team.

• Condurrai la strategia interfunzionale e influenzerai le roadmap dei prodotti collaborando direttamente con gli scienziati dello sviluppo del saggio, gli ingegneri hardware, gli sviluppatori di software e i manager dei prodotti. Condurre concezioni trasversali, code/script e recensioni di design. Presentare i progressi, i dati e le decisioni di ingegneria chiaramente agli stakeholder.

Si tratta di una posizione in loco (5 giorni) con sede a Santa Clara, CA. (Una parte del lavoro avrà luogo anche a Pleasanton, CA. È disponibile una navetta per il connettore.)
I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono offerti per questo ruolo.

Si prega di includere una lettera di copertura con la vostra domanda.

Chi sei?
(richiesto)

• Hai una laurea in Bioingegneria o Biomedical Engineering, o una disciplina strettamente correlata, con esperienza di settore rilevante (12+ anni per una laurea, 10+ anni per un Master, o 7+ anno per un dottorato).

• Hai un'esperienza profonda e pratica che caratterizza e prova

Die Position

Wenn Sie es schaffen, Compliance in ein automatisiertes, datengesteuertes Framework zu verwandeln, schließen Sie sich uns an!

Ihre Hauptverantwortung

• Agile IT-Compliance-Beratung: Bieten Sie fachkundige Beratung zu CSV, DSGVO, Datenintegrität und ICFR für dynamische Projekt- und Systembereitstellungsteams.

• Regulatory Expertise: Starkes Wissen über CSV, Datenintegrität, ICFR und DSGVO.

• Agile & Tech Savvy: Bewährte Erfahrung in SCRUM/SAFe und der Anpassung von Compliance an Cloud, RPA und Machine Learning.

• Mindset & Skills: Systematischer Denker, erfahren in datengesteuerter Automatisierung und fähig, verschiedene, globale virtuelle Teams zu beeinflussen.

• Sprachen: Ausgezeichnete englische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Bereitschaft für gelegentliche Reisen.

• Bonuspunkte: Erfahrung in SOC 1/2 Reporting, CISA oder Lean Six Sigma Zertifizierungen.

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Êtes-vous prêt à transformer la conformité informatique en un moteur d'affaires agile? En tant que spécialiste de l'assurance de la qualité et de la conformité en RDT, vous ne serez pas un gardien; vous serez un catalyseur au sein de Roche Digital Technologies.
Notre mission est de donner aux équipes informatiques les moyens d'offrir une qualité efficace, dès la première fois. Vous appliquerez des garde-corps réglementaires intelligents aux technologies de pointe, y compris le Cloud Computing, le Machine Learning, le RPA, DevOps et le SAFe.

Si vous réussissez à transformer la conformité en un cadre automatisé et axé sur les données, rejoignez-nous !

Vos principales responsabilités

• Conseil en conformité TI agile : Fournir des conseils d'experts sur le CSV, le RGPD, l'intégrité des données et le CIRF pour les équipes dynamiques de prestation de projets et de systèmes.

• Surveillance de la qualité et des risques : Superviser la validation, les qualifications et les évaluations des risques des systèmes dans les systèmes informatiques assignés.

• Future Quality Framework: Co-créez des SOP, des listes de contrôle et des garde-corps pour notre système de gestion de la qualité informatique, en harmonisant ce système avec les normes externes en évolution.

• Audits et contrôle : Covérifier les processus informatiques internes et externes, effectuer des examens périodiques du système et définir les spécifications de contrôle en fonction des politiques mondiales.

• Entraînement et amélioration continue : Former des équipes de prestation sur la conformité informatique intégrée et l'intégrité des données, favorisant une culture de propriété de qualité.

Qui vous êtes (Les compétences dont vous avez besoin)

• Expérience : 2 ans et plus dans l'assurance de la qualité des TI (lead de validation, gestion de la qualité, vérification), de préférence dans les produits pharmaceutiques et les soins de santé.

• Expertise en réglementation : Forte connaissance du CSV, de l'intégrité des données, du CIRF et du RGPD.

• Agile & Tech Savvy: Expérience éprouvée en SCRUM/SAFe et adaptation de la conformité au Cloud, RPA et Machine Learning.

• Mindset & Skills: penseur systématique, qualifié dans l'automatisation axée sur les données, et capable d'influencer diverses équipes virtuelles mondiales.

• Langues: Excellentes compétences en communication anglaise. Volonté pour un voyage occasionnel.

• Points Bonus : Expérience dans les certifications SOC 1/2, CISA ou Lean Six Sigma.

Qu'est-ce qui vous attend ?

• Impact & Innovation: Recadrer la conformité comme un moteur de transformation numérique aux côtés de la technologie de pointe.

• Exposition mondiale : Connectez-vous et développez-vous au sein d'un réseau mondial multiculturel.

• Une culture de l'appartenance : la diversité et l'inclusion sont essentielles à notre réussite. Nous encourageons chaleureusement les candidats handicapés à postuler, en offrant des avantages spéciaux, un soutien sur mesure et un milieu de travail inclusif où vous pouvez vraiment prospérer.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun un accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

We are looking for an IT senior engineer to join one of our teams in Roche Digital Technology.
In Roche Digital Technology we focus on delivering technology that evolves the practice of medicine and helps patients live longer, better lives.
You will be responsible for the Design and Implementation of Directory Services (mainly Microsoft Active Directory) solutions and tier 2-3 operational support, performance, lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies. You will be part of multiple initiatives or projects with multiple specialists across multiple time zones in order to achieve the organizational objectives.

As a Manufacturing Specialist Directory Services you would be part of a multicultural and global team protecting our information and assets from unauthorized access, security risks and cyber attacks.

Job Responsibilities

• Collaborate in small to medium sized technical teams and contribute to the end to end design of infrastructure solutions producing and maintaining sufficient documentation.

• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters and contribute to determining success criteria and evaluation of promising solutions/technologies via Proofs of Concepts (PoC’s) and feasibility studies.

• Providing 2nd and 3rd level support. Operationally manage and support and implement the Directory Services Infrastructure on premises for manufacturing environments and its associated compliments and applications.

• Proactively monitor systems and platforms for performance, availability and capacity management and ensure that the solution and component escalations are minimized.

• Promptly responding to customer requests, resolve incidents and implement changes, ensuring a high level of customer engagement and satisfaction

• Understanding, implementing and following relevant concepts of ITIL, GxP and Project Management. These include Request Management, Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Document Management, Qualification and Validation and Project Management

• Actively focusing on own self-development and creating actionable plans to improve

• Provide 24x7 on-call support. Flexibility regarding working hours

• Occasional international travel is required

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline; or recognition of prior working experience which is equivalent.

• 4+ years experience administering and advance troubleshooting in Active Directory

• Robust experience working in a major global organization, preferably in a regulated industry

Technical Skills

• Strong design and hands-on technical background. Solid experience on Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP) and desirable in Entra ID.

• Powershell Scripting skills will be required

• Ability to apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis in practical scenarios

• Skill in evaluating change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, and breaking down complex technical concepts with minimal guidance

Additional Qualifications

• Proven interpersonal skills to interact effectively with individuals in multiple countries and in varying cultures

• Willingness to continually evolve, acquire and maintain the technical and soft skills appropriate to the requirements of this position

• Committing to operational excellence, with a willin

Sarete responsabili per la progettazione e l'attuazione dei servizi di Directory (principalmente Microsoft Active Directory) e per il supporto operativo, le prestazioni, la gestione del ciclo di vita e il miglioramento continuo delle tecnologie sottostanti. Sarete parte di più iniziative o progetti con più specialisti in più fusi orari per raggiungere gli obiettivi organizzativi.

Come Manufacturing Specialist Directory Services faresti parte di un team multiculturale e globale che protegge le nostre informazioni e i nostri beni da accessi non autorizzati, rischi di sicurezza e attacchi informatici.

Responsabilità del lavoro

• Collaborare in team tecnici di piccole e medie dimensioni e contribuire alla progettazione finale di soluzioni infrastrutturali che producono e mantengono una documentazione sufficiente.

• Interagire con partner interni ed esterni senior su questioni tecniche significative e contribuire a determinare i criteri di successo e la valutazione di soluzioni/tecnologie promettenti tramite Proofs of Concepts (PoC) e studi di fattibilità.

• Fornire supporto di secondo e terzo livello. Gestire e supportare e implementare in modo operativo le Infrastrutture di Servizi Directory nei locali per ambienti produttivi e relativi complimenti e applicazioni associate.

• Monitorare attivamente sistemi e piattaforme per prestazioni, disponibilità e gestione delle capacità e garantire che le escalation della soluzione e dei componenti siano minimizzate.

• Rispondendo prontamente alle richieste dei clienti, risolve gli incidenti e implementa le modifiche, garantendo un elevato livello di impegno e soddisfazione del cliente

• Comprendere, implementare e seguire concetti rilevanti di ITIL, GxP e Project Management. Questi includono Gestione delle richieste, Gestione degli incidenti, Gestione dei cambiamenti, Gestione dei problemi, Gestione dei documenti, Qualificazione e Validazione e Gestione dei progetti

• Concentrandosi attivamente sul proprio autosviluppo e creando piani attuabili per migliorare

• Fornire supporto 24x7 on-call. Flessibilità rispetto alle ore di lavoro

• Occasionali viaggi internazionali è richiesto

Qualifiche
Istruzione / Esperienza

• Laurea in informatica, ingegneria o disciplina relativa; o il riconoscimento di esperienza lavorativa precedente che è equivalente.

• 4+ anni di esperienza nella gestione e nella risoluzione dei problemi in Active Directory

• Robusta esperienza di lavoro in una grande organizzazione globale, preferibilmente in un settore regolamentato

Competenze tecniche

• Design robusto e sfondo tecnico pratico. Esperienza solida su Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP) e desiderabile in Entra ID.

• Le competenze di scrittura Powershell saranno richieste

• Capacità di applicare strumenti, principi, concetti e tecniche relative a requisiti, dati, usabilità e analisi di processo in scenari pratici

• Capacità di valutare i cambiamenti e gli impatti tecnologici con una maggiore precisione e abbattere concetti tecnici complessi con una guida minima

Ulteriori qualifiche

• Prove capacità interpersonali per interagire efficacemente con gli individui in più paesi e in diverse culture

• La volontà di evolvere continuamente, acquisire e mantenere le competenze tecniche e morbide adeguate alle esigenze di questa posizione

• Commettendo l’eccellenza operativa, con una volontà

Bei Roche Digital Technology konzentrieren wir uns auf die Bereitstellung von Technologien, die die Praxis der Medizin weiterentwickeln und Patienten helfen, ein längeres, besseres Leben zu führen.
Sie sind verantwortlich für das Design und die Implementierung von Directory Services (hauptsächlich Microsoft Active Directory) Lösungen und Tier 2-3 Betriebsunterstützung, Performance, Lifecycle Management und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der zugrunde liegenden Technologien. Sie werden Teil mehrerer Initiativen oder Projekte mit mehreren Spezialisten in mehreren Zeitzonen sein, um die organisatorischen Ziele zu erreichen.

Als Directory Services für Fertigungsspezialisten sind Sie Teil eines multikulturellen und globalen Teams, das unsere Informationen und Vermögenswerte vor unbefugtem Zugriff, Sicherheitsrisiken und Cyberangriffen schützt.

• Aktive Fokussierung auf die eigene Selbstentwicklung und Erstellung umsetzbarer Pläne zur Verbesserung

• 24x7 On-Call-Unterstützung. Flexibilität bei der Arbeitszeit

• Gelegentliche internationale Reisen sind erforderlich

Bildung / Erfahrung

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder verwandten Disziplin; oder Anerkennung der vorherigen Arbeitserfahrung, die gleichwertig ist.

• 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Verwaltung und Verbesserung der Fehlersuche in Active Directory

• Robuste Erfahrung in einer großen globalen Organisation, vorzugsweise in einer regulierten Branche

Technische Fähigkeiten

• Starkes Design und praktischer technischer Hintergrund. Solide Erfahrung in Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP) und wünschenswert in Entra ID.

• Powershell Scripting Fähigkeiten werden benötigt

• Fähigkeit, Werkzeuge, Prinzipien, Konzepte und Techniken in Bezug auf Anforderungen, Daten, Usability und Prozessanalyse in praktischen Szenarien anzuwenden

• Geschick in der Bewertung von Veränderungen und technologischen Auswirkungen mit zunehmender Genauigkeit und der Aufschlüsselung komplexer technischer Konzepte mit minimaler Anleitung

Zusätzliche Qualifikationen

• Bewährte zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, um effektiv mit Individuen in mehreren Ländern und in unterschiedlichen Kulturen zu interagieren

• Bereitschaft, die technischen und Soft Skills, die den Anforderungen dieser Position entsprechen, ständig weiterzuentwickeln, zu erwerben und aufrechtzuerhalten

• Engagement für operative Exzellenz, mit einem willin

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Great medicine cannot change the world if it never leaves the lab. As Senior Legal Counsel – Global TechOps & Pharma Quality, you will step onto a highly collaborative, global team providing proactive legal support to our Pharma Technical Operations (PT) organization. In this high-impact role, you will advise on complex, high-stakes matters to ensure our medicines are manufactured and delivered safely to patients worldwide while supporting our mission to prevent, stop, and cure diseases.

The Opportunity
In this role, you will be at the forefront of global technical operations and quality compliance, driving legal excellence through key responsibilities:

• Lead Strategic Legal Counseling: Partner directly with the PT Global Head of Quality and PT Global Head of Regulatory to provide legal risk guidance on critical quality governance, change control, and cGMP compliance.

• Advise on Global Regulatory & Compliance Matters: Guide commercial operations and technical teams on EMA, FDA, Swissmedic, and other global health authority manufacturing compliance requirements.

• Support Inspections and Audits: Provide strategic legal direction during health authority facility inspections and internal GMP audits to protect product integrity and prevent enforcement actions worldwide.

• Manage Critical Quality Events: Collaborate closely with the Quality organization to resolve supply interruptions, manufacturing deviations, health authority notifications, and field actions.

• Drive External Quality Partnering: Structure novel quality agreements and align compliance standards with external CMO and CDMO networks to ensure seamless external manufacturing oversight.

• Direct Outside Counsel: Oversee and manage external legal counsel retained to support specialized technical operations and regulatory matters.

Who You Are
We are looking for a proactive, solutions-oriented legal expert who thrives in a fast-paced global environment and brings:

• Legal Qualifications: Qualified attorney-at-law (e.g., Rechtsanwalt, avocat, or equivalent) in at least one European jurisdiction.

• cGMP & Manufacturing Expertise: 7+ years of experience with cGMP and manufacturing support in a pharmaceutical/biotech corporate setting, top-tier law firm, or relevant regulatory agency.

• Cross-Cultural Leadership & Acumen: Strong business acumen, excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to influence and drive positive change across multinational teams.

• Technical Communication Skills: Proven capability to clearly translate complex, highly technical information into actionable legal advice in written and spoken English (proficiency in German, French, or Dutch is a plus).

• Agile & Collaborative Mindset: A results-oriented mindset, constructive approach to challenging the status quo, willingness to travel, and commitment to driving legal excellence.

We look forward to your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opp

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
La grande medicina non può cambiare il mondo se non lascia mai il laboratorio. In qualità di Senior Legal Counsel – Global TechOps & Pharma Quality, entrerete in un team altamente collaborativo e globale che fornisce un supporto legale proattivo alla nostra organizzazione Pharma Technical Operations (PT). In questo ruolo di alto impatto, si consiglia su questioni complesse e di alto livello per garantire che i nostri farmaci sono fabbricati e consegnati in modo sicuro ai pazienti in tutto il mondo, sostenendo la nostra missione per prevenire, arrestare e curare le malattie.

L'opportunità
In questo ruolo, sarete in prima linea nelle operazioni tecniche globali e nel rispetto della qualità, guidando l'eccellenza legale attraverso le responsabilità chiave:

• Consulenza Legale Strategica: Partner direttamente con il Responsabile Globale di Qualità e PT Global Head of Regulatory per fornire una guida al rischio legale sulla governance della qualità critica, il controllo dei cambiamenti e la conformità cGMP.

• Consigli su Global Regulatory & Compliance Matters: Guidare operazioni commerciali e team tecnici su EMA, FDA, Swissmedic e altri requisiti di conformità dell'autorità sanitaria globale.

• Ispezioni di supporto e audit: Fornire una direzione legale strategica durante le ispezioni di strutture sanitarie e controlli GMP interni per proteggere l'integrità del prodotto e prevenire le azioni di esecuzione in tutto il mondo.

• Gestisci eventi di qualità critica: Collabora con l'organizzazione di qualità per risolvere interruzioni di fornitura, deviazioni di produzione, notifiche di autorità sanitaria e azioni di campo.

• Partnering di qualità esterna: struttura nuovi accordi di qualità e allineare gli standard di conformità con le reti CMO e CDMO esterne per garantire una perfetta supervisione della produzione esterna.

• Consulente esterno diretto: supervisionare e gestire il consulente legale esterno mantenuto a supporto di operazioni tecniche specializzate e questioni regolamentari.

Chi sei
Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto legale proattivo e orientato alle soluzioni che prospera in un ambiente globale veloce e porta:

• Qualificazioni legali: Avvocato qualificato (ad esempio, Rechtsanwalt, avocat, o equivalente) in almeno una giurisdizione europea.

• cGMP & Manufacturing Expertise: 7+ anni di esperienza con cGMP e supporto manifatturiero in un ambiente aziendale farmaceutico/biotecnico, studio legale di alto livello o importante agenzia di regolamentazione.

• Leadership interculturale & Acumen: forte acume aziendale, eccellenti competenze interpersonali, e la capacità di influenzare e guidare il cambiamento positivo tra le squadre multinazionali.

• Abilità di comunicazione tecnica: comprovata capacità di tradurre chiaramente informazioni complesse, altamente tecniche in consulenza legale attuabile in inglese scritto e parlato (la competenza in tedesco, francese o olandese è un plus).

• Agile & Collaborative Mindset: Una mentalità orientata ai risultati, un approccio costruttivo per sfidare lo status quo, la volontà di viaggiare e l'impegno a guidare l'eccellenza legale.

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione!

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un'opzione uguale

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Große Medizin kann die Welt nicht verändern, wenn sie niemals das Labor verlässt. Als Senior Legal Counsel – Global TechOps & Pharma Quality treten Sie in ein hochgradig kooperatives, globales Team ein, das unsere Pharma Technical Operations (PT) Organisation proaktiv rechtlich unterstützt. In dieser einflussreichen Rolle beraten Sie in komplexen, anspruchsvollen Angelegenheiten, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Medikamente weltweit hergestellt und sicher an Patienten geliefert werden, und unterstützen gleichzeitig unsere Mission, Krankheiten zu verhindern, zu stoppen und zu heilen.

Die Chance
In dieser Rolle werden Sie an der Spitze der globalen technischen Operationen und der Einhaltung der Qualität stehen und die rechtliche Exzellenz durch wichtige Aufgaben vorantreiben:

• Führen Sie strategische Rechtsberatung: Partnerschaft direkt mit dem PT Global Head of Quality und dem PT Global Head of Regulatory, um rechtliche Risikoberatung zu kritischer Qualitäts-Governance, Änderungskontrolle und cGMP-Compliance bereitzustellen.

• Beratung zu globalen Regulierungs- und Compliance-Angelegenheiten: Leiten Sie kommerzielle Operationen und technische Teams zu EMA, FDA, Swissmedic und anderen globalen Gesundheitsbehörden, die Compliance-Anforderungen für die Herstellung erfüllen.

• Unterstützung von Inspektionen und Audits: Bieten Sie strategische rechtliche Anweisungen bei Inspektionen von Gesundheitseinrichtungen und internen GMP-Audits, um die Produktintegrität zu schützen und Durchsetzungsmaßnahmen weltweit zu verhindern.

• Verwalten Sie kritische Qualitätsereignisse: Arbeiten Sie eng mit der Qualitätsorganisation zusammen, um Versorgungsunterbrechungen, Fertigungsabweichungen, Benachrichtigungen der Gesundheitsbehörden und Feldaktionen zu beheben.

• Externe Qualitätspartnerschaften fördern: Strukturieren Sie neuartige Qualitätsvereinbarungen und stimmen Sie die Compliance-Standards mit externen CMO- und CDMO-Netzwerken ab, um eine nahtlose externe Fertigungsaufsicht zu gewährleisten.

• Direct Outside Counsel: Überwachen und verwalten Sie externe Rechtsberater, die zur Unterstützung von spezialisierten technischen Operationen und regulatorischen Angelegenheiten eingesetzt werden.

Wer du bist
Wir suchen einen proaktiven, lösungsorientierten Rechtsexperten, der in einem schnelllebigen globalen Umfeld lebt und Folgendes mitbringt:

• Rechtsqualifikationen: Qualifizierter Rechtsanwalt (z. B. Rechtsanwalt, avocat oder gleichwertig) in mindestens einer europäischen Gerichtsbarkeit.

• cGMP & Manufacturing Expertise: 7+ Jahre Erfahrung mit cGMP und Fertigungsunterstützung in einem Pharma- / Biotech-Unternehmen, einer erstklassigen Anwaltskanzlei oder einer zuständigen Regulierungsbehörde.

• Cross-Cultural Leadership & Acumen: Starker Geschäftssinn, ausgezeichnete zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, positive Veränderungen in multinationalen Teams zu beeinflussen und voranzutreiben.

• Technische Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, komplexe, hochtechnische Informationen in schriftlicher und gesprochener Sprache klar in umsetzbare Rechtsberatung zu übersetzen (Deutsch-, Französisch- oder Niederländischkenntnisse sind ein Plus).

• Agile & Collaborative Mindset: Eine ergebnisorientierte Denkweise, ein konstruktiver Ansatz, um den Status quo in Frage zu stellen, Reisebereitschaft und Engagement für die Förderung von juristischer Exzellenz.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
La grande médecine ne peut pas changer le monde si elle ne quitte jamais le labo. En tant que conseiller juridique principal – Global TechOps & Pharma Quality, vous vous lancerez dans une équipe mondiale hautement collaborative offrant un soutien juridique proactif à notre organisation d'opérations techniques Pharma (PT). Dans ce rôle à fort impact, vous conseillerez sur des questions complexes et à haut niveau pour s'assurer que nos médicaments sont fabriqués et livrés en toute sécurité aux patients du monde entier tout en soutenant notre mission de prévention, d'arrêt et de guérison des maladies.

L'opportunité
Dans ce rôle, vous serez à l'avant-garde des opérations techniques mondiales et de la conformité à la qualité, en stimulant l'excellence juridique grâce à des responsabilités clés :

• Conseillers juridiques stratégiques principaux : S'associer directement au responsable mondial de la qualité du PT et au responsable mondial de la réglementation du PT pour fournir des conseils sur les risques juridiques liés à la gouvernance de la qualité critique, au contrôle du changement et à la conformité aux BPFC.

• Conseils sur les questions de réglementation et de conformité mondiales : Guidez les opérations commerciales et les équipes techniques sur les exigences de conformité de l'EMA, de la FDA, de Swissmedic et d'autres autorités sanitaires mondiales.

• Appuyer les inspections et les vérifications : Fournir une orientation juridique stratégique lors des inspections des établissements des autorités sanitaires et des vérifications internes des BPF afin de protéger l'intégrité des produits et de prévenir les mesures d'application de la loi dans le monde entier.

• Gérer les événements critiques en matière de qualité : Collaborer étroitement avec l'organisation Qualité pour résoudre les interruptions d'approvisionnement, les écarts de fabrication, les notifications des autorités sanitaires et les actions sur le terrain.

• Encourager les partenariats externes en matière de qualité : Structurer de nouveaux accords de qualité et harmoniser les normes de conformité avec les réseaux externes d'OCM et d'OCM afin d'assurer une surveillance externe transparente de la fabrication.

• Conseillers externes directs : Surveiller et gérer les conseillers juridiques externes retenus pour appuyer les opérations techniques spécialisées et les questions réglementaires.

Qui vous êtes
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un expert juridique proactif et axé sur les solutions, qui prospère dans un environnement mondial rapide et apporte :

• Qualifications juridiques: Avocat qualifié dans au moins une juridiction européenne.

• cGMP & Manufacturing Expertise: 7+ ans d'expérience avec cGMP et soutien à la fabrication dans un cadre d'entreprise pharmaceutique/biotech, cabinet d'avocats de haut niveau, ou organisme de réglementation pertinent.

• Leadership transculturel & œcuménisme : Un œcuménisme d'affaires fort, d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et la capacité d'influencer et de stimuler des changements positifs au sein des équipes multinationales.

• Compétences techniques en communication : Capacité éprouvée de traduire clairement des informations complexes et hautement techniques en conseils juridiques pouvant être appliqués en anglais écrit et parlé (la compétence en allemand, en français ou en néerlandais est un plus).

• Agile & Collaborative Mindset: Un état d'esprit axé sur les résultats, une approche constructive pour contester le statu quo, la volonté de voyager et l'engagement à conduire l'excellence juridique.

Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun un accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Location: Astana

Local customer facing role unlocking value along patient journeys
Roche is a company with a 125 year history and our ongoing success is based on our strong focus on delivering meaningful value for our customers and society, and we will need to evolve our offering and approach in order to do so.
In response to the increasingly volatile world we live in, Roche Pharma International began a wide scale transformation process - changing our ways of working to be more agile, less hierarchical, highly collaborative. Now we take the next STEP in our journey focusing on how we can deliver the greatest value and make a meaningful difference to our customers, patients and society.

Mission and responsibilities:
As the Patient Journey Partner (PJP) in Ophthalmology, you will be at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering extraordinary medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption.
You will be locally embedded and integrated in the healthcare ecosystem in a functionally agnostic way (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives.
As an empowered leader and the face of Roche, you will collaborate closely with all partners directly touching the patient journey, gaining a deep understanding of their needs, in service of connecting Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions. In addition, you will be responsible for:

• Acting as a trusted partner and the primary point of contact between stakeholders and Roche, prioritising and securing resources, and driving solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• Collaborating with patient journey partners to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• Guiding Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supporting their appropriate use, sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.

• Ensuring great experiences whenever partners in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services.

Who are you:
You demonstrate personal purpose in improving the patient journey, as well as a strong passion to bring value and impact to the healthcare ecosystem.
You are a true visionary, defining and embedding the strategy around creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand).

In addition, you bring the following skills & experience:

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche

• Self managed and self directed - altruistic in supporting the global network

• Display of integrity in everything as a leader who senses, reflects and responds

• Boldly acts on key decisions and opportunities and boldly stops any activity that is not adding value. Ability to say “No” to partners when the value is not predictable/foreseen.

• Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and organizations is required. Experience partnering with Patient Advocacy Groups (PGAs) is highly desired.

• Experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams

• Strong eye for

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Sales Account Manager you will be responsible for achieving regional sales targets for our Near Patient Care (NPC) Roche Diagnostics portfolio. You will manage the full customer lifecycle, from prospecting new clients to maintaining relationships with existing ones through proactive communication.
Key responsibilities include providing demand-driven sales and after-sales support, conducting customer training, and installing NPC products, all while ensuring the highest level of customer satisfaction. You will also monitor market trends and competitor activity.
Our NPC covers healthcare customers such as physicians (General practitioners, ambulatory specialists - diabetologists, internal medicine doctors, cardiologists, pneumologists) and hospitals. The NPC portfolio consists of various POCT devices, professional/hospital and patient blood glucose meters and CGM.

Preferred location: Southern Moravia, e.g. Brno / Olomouc
Readiness to active business trips is required
Employment contract: initially fixed-term 2 years with a possibility to extend, contract with a vendor of service of Roche

The Opportunity

Customer Relationship & Sales Management:

• Proactively engage customers to identify needs, suggest solutions, and resolve issues, ensuring high satisfaction through exceptional after-sales support

• Drive sales growth by negotiating new business, promoting and installing products (instruments, reagents), and expanding the customer portfolio

• Manage the full sales process, including preparing, presenting, and negotiating quotations using designated tools and processes.

Portfolio Promotion & Training:

• Promote NPC portfolio by conducting customer training seminars and representing the company at key conferences

Market Intelligence & Personal Development:

• Monitor and report on regional competitor behavior and market trends

• Proactively engage in continuous self-learning to maintain expert knowledge of relevant publications and industry information

Compliance & Collaboration:

• Ensure strict compliance with all Complaint Management procedures, including accurate and timely reporting in our CRM and other global systems

• Collaborate effectively with colleagues within the NPC team and other departments to achieve shared goals

Who You Are

• Secondary education as a minimum, Natural or Health Sciences field preferred

• Proven customer-facing within commercial functional area experience (1+ years of experience as a minimum)

• Sales experience in the healthcare field of medical devices or In-vitro diagnostics is desired

• Czech language fluent and English at intermediate level

• Demonstrated communication skills to be able to present complex topics in concise and clear manner

• Negotiation and influencing skills with solution-orientated mindset

• Able to handle conflicting priorities with value-generating outlook

• PC Skills (experience working in Google Workplace, MS Office)

• Team player mindset to challenge colleagues but also support them grow in line with achieving common goals

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high

• Manutenzione dei record: Esegui rigorosi abbinamenti, fusione e manutenzione dei record Master (HCP, HCO e Affiliazioni) per garantire una "unica fonte di verità".

Gestione dei dati e garanzia della qualità

• Stewardship: Act as the Data Steward for HCP (Health Care Professional), HCO (Health Care Organization) dati del profilo, e Affiliations.

• Risoluzione della discrepanza: indagare attivamente le discrepanze dei dati da fonti interne ed esterne.

• Integrità dei dati: Assicurarsi che tutti i nuovi set di dati di bordo siano precisi, completi e rigorosamente conformi agli standard di dati definiti.

Ottimizzazione dei processi e governance

• Metodologie di governance: Sviluppare e documentare metodologie di governance adattabili per migliorare l'efficienza in MDM, integrazione dei dati, tassonomia e reporting.

• Automazione: Identificare le opportunità di automatizzare o migliorare i flussi di lavoro di gestione dei dati.

• Miglioramento del flusso di lavoro: costruire prodotti di dati per migliorare l'ottimizzazione del flusso di lavoro.

Analisi strategica

• Supporto analitico: fornire supporto analitico per sviluppare approfondimenti e strategie che ottimizzano i processi correlati ai dati.

• Collaborazione Stakeholder: Collabora con gli stakeholder attraverso le funzioni aziendali per tradurre i dati nel processo decisionale informato.

Chi sei?

Istruzione e esperienza

• Istruzione: laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Sistemi Informativi, o una disciplina tecnica correlata.

• Esperienza: esperienza pratica nelle operazioni di Data Stewardship o Data Analytics.

• Focus sul settore: L'esperienza prioritaria nel settore farmaceutico, delle scienze della vita o della biotecnologia è fortemente preferita.

Competenze tecniche

• Competenze Dati Core: È richiesta una competenza avanzata in Excel e SQL .

• Scrittura: Conoscenza pratica dei linguaggi di programmazione come Python o PySpark.

• Strumenti di dominio: esperienza con soluzioni MDM (ad esempio, Reltio, Informatica MDM) e soluzioni Pharma CRM (ad esempio, Salesforce, OCE, Veeva CRM).

• Piattaforme cloud: Esperienza di lavoro nei servizi AWS (S3, Athena, Glue, Sagemaker Studio, EC2, API Gateway, Bedrock) O altre piattaforme cloud come GCP, Azure è un vantaggio forte.

Competenze chiave

• Mindset analitico: eccellenti capacità di problem solving con un costante focus sulla qualità, precisione e dettaglio.

• Comunicazione: Eccezionale capacità comunicative verbali e scritte, con la capacità di gestire gli stakeholder e tradurre problemi di dati tecnici per il pubblico aziendale.

I benefici di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa pubblicazione di lavoro.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Das Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) wurde gegründet, um Analysen und technologieorientierte Lösungen durch Partnerschaften mit Roche-Tochtergesellschaften auf der ganzen Welt voranzutreiben.

Ihre Chance:
Als Analyst (MDM Data Steward) treten Sie der GATE-Organisation in einer zentralen Rolle als Partner des US-amerikanischen Master Data Management (MDM)-Teams bei.
Ihre Mission ist es, die Datenverwaltung voranzutreiben, die Datenqualität zu verbessern und kritische Geschäftsentscheidungen zu unterstützen. Sie fungieren als Brücke zwischen technischem Datenbetrieb und Geschäftsstrategie und stellen sicher, dass unsere Datenbestände korrekt, konform und umsetzbar sind.

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
Master Data Management (MDM) Operationen

• Data Change Requests: Führen Sie die laufende Verarbeitung von Data Change Requests (DCRs) im Zusammenhang mit Health Care Master Data.

• Record Maintenance: Führen Sie ein strenges Matching, Zusammenführen und Pflegen von Master-Records (HCPs, HCOs und Affiliations) durch, um eine "Single Source of Truth" zu gewährleisten.

Data Stewardship & Qualitätssicherung

• Stewardship: Aktieren Sie als Data Steward für HCP (Health Care Professional), HCO (Health Care Organization) Profildaten und Zugehörigkeiten.

• Diskrepanzlösung: Proaktive Untersuchung von Datendiskrepanzen aus internen und externen Quellen.

• Datenintegrität: Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle neu integrierten Datensätze korrekt und vollständig sind und sich strikt an definierte Datenstandards halten.

Prozessoptimierung & Governance

• Governance-Methoden: Entwicklung und Dokumentation anpassbarer Governance-Methoden zur Steigerung der Effizienz bei MDM, Datenintegration, Taxonomie und Reporting.

• Automatisierung: Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Automatisierung oder Verbesserung von Datenmanagement-Workflows.

• Workflow-Verbesserung: Erstellen Sie Datenprodukte zur Verbesserung der Workflow-Optimierung.

Strategische Analyse

• Analytische Unterstützung: Bieten Sie analytische Unterstützung, um Erkenntnisse und Strategien zu entwickeln, die datenbezogene Prozesse optimieren.

• Stakeholder-Zusammenarbeit: Arbeiten Sie mit Stakeholdern in allen Geschäftsfunktionen zusammen, um Daten in fundierte Entscheidungen zu übersetzen.

Wer Du bist:

Bildung & Erfahrung

• Ausbildung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Informationssystemen oder einer verwandten technischen Disziplin.

• Erfahrung: Praktische Erfahrung im Data Stewardship- oder Data Analytics-Betrieb.

• Branchenfokus: Vorkenntnisse in der Pharma-, Life Sciences- oder Biotech-Industrie werden stark bevorzugt.

Technische Fähigkeiten

• Core Data Skills: Erweiterte Kenntnisse in Excel und SQL sind erforderlich.

• Scripting: Praktische Kenntnisse von Programmiersprachen wie Python oder PySpark.

• Domain Tools: Erfahrung mit MDM-Lösungen (z.B. Reltio, Informatica MDM) und Pharma CRM-Lösungen (z.B. Salesforce, OCE, Veeva CRM).

• Cloud-Plattformen: Arbeitserfahrung in AWS-Diensten (S3, Athena, Glue, Sagemaker Studio, EC2, API Gateway, Bedrock) Oder andere Cloud-Plattformen wie GCP, Azure ist ein starkes Plus.

Schlüsselkompetenzen

• Analytisches Mindset: Ausgezeichnete Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit einem unerschütterlichen Fokus auf Qualität, Genauigkeit und Details.

• Kommunikation: Außergewöhnliche verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Stakeholder zu verwalten und technische Datenprobleme für das Geschäftspublikum zu übersetzen.

Umzugsleistungen sind für diese Stellenausschreibung nicht verfügbar.

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Le Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) a été créé pour piloter des solutions d'analyse et de technologie en partenariat avec des filiales Roche à travers le monde.

Votre opportunité :
En tant qu'analyste (MDM Data Steward), vous rejoindrez l'organisation GATE dans un rôle central en partenariat avec l'équipe américaine de Master Data Management (MDM).
Votre mission est de diriger l'intendance des données, d'améliorer la qualité des données et de soutenir les décisions opérationnelles critiques. Vous jouerez le rôle de pont entre les opérations de données techniques et la stratégie d'affaires, assurant que nos actifs de données sont précis, conformes et réalisables.

Principales responsabilités
Opérations de gestion des données (GDM)

• Demandes de changement de données : Diriger le traitement continu des demandes de changement de données (DCR) liées aux données maîtresses de soins de santé.

• Maintenance des dossiers : Effectuer un couplage rigoureux, la fusion et la tenue des dossiers principaux (HCP, HCO et Affiliations) pour assurer une « source unique de vérité ».

Gérance des données et assurance de la qualité

• Intendance : Agir en tant que délégué aux données pour le HCP (professionnel de la santé), les données du profil de l'HCO (organisation de soins de santé) et les affiliations.

• Résolution de discordance : Étudier de manière proactive les écarts de données provenant de sources internes et externes.

• Intégrité des données : S'assurer que tous les nouveaux ensembles de données embarqués sont exacts, complets et strictement conformes aux normes de données définies.

Optimisation et gouvernance des processus

• Méthodes de gouvernance : Élaborer et documenter des méthodes de gouvernance adaptables afin d'améliorer l'efficacité du MDM, l'intégration des données, la taxonomie et la déclaration.

• Automatisation: Identifier les possibilités d'automatiser ou d'améliorer les flux de travail de gestion des données.

• Amélioration du flux de travail: Construire des produits de données pour améliorer l'optimisation du flux de travail.

Analyse stratégique

• Soutien analytique : Fournir un soutien analytique pour élaborer des idées et des stratégies qui optimisent les processus liés aux données.

• Collaboration avec les intervenants : Collaborer avec les intervenants dans l'ensemble des fonctions opérationnelles pour traduire les données en décisions éclairées.

Qui vous êtes :

Éducation et expérience

• Études : Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie, en systèmes d'information ou dans une discipline technique connexe.

• Expérience : Expérience pratique des opérations de gérance des données ou d'analyse des données.

• Focus sur l'industrie : L'expérience antérieure dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, des sciences de la vie ou de la biotechnologie est fortement préférée.

Compétences techniques

• Compétences de base en données : Une compétence avancée en Excel et SQL est requise.

• Scripting: Connaissance pratique des langages de programmation tels que Python ou PySpark.

• Outils de domaine: Expérience des solutions MDM (par exemple, Reltio, Informatica MDM) et Pharma CRM (par exemple, Salesforce, OCE, Veeva CRM).

• Plateformes Cloud: Expérience de travail dans les services AWS (S3, Athena, Glue, Sagemaker Studio, EC2, API Gateway, Bedrock) Ou d'autres plateformes cloud comme GCP, Azure est un plus fort.

Compétences clés

• Analyst Mindset: Excellentes compétences de résolution de problèmes avec un accent indéfectible sur la qualité, la précision et le détail.

• Communication : Compétences exceptionnelles en communication verbale et écrite, avec la capacité de gérer les parties prenantes et de traduire les questions de données techniques pour le public d'affaires.

Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour cette affectation.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun un accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe our physical spaces shape the future of science. As our Workplace Strategy & Space Planning Lead , you will champion the design, master planning, and operational strategy for our campus, transforming office and high-complexity laboratory environments into inspiring, sustainable hubs of scientific excellence. In this role, you’ll bridge the gap between global architectural vision and day-to-day R&D needs—directing capital projects up to $5M, driving data-informed space allocation, and leading change management initiatives that keep our research teams performing at their best.

The Opportunity

• Direct all project delivery phases (budgets up to $5M, vendor coordination, timelines) for new construction and renovations across office and laboratory environments.

• Lead interior and exterior space optimization strategies, ensuring lab designs meet scientific requirements, biosafety/GLP/GMP standards, and operational workflows.

• Manage campus laboratory space assignments, tracking utilization metrics to make data-driven recommendations for capacity planning and reallocation.

• Maintain campus workplace policies, design guidelines, and safety/ergonomic standards in close partnership with R&D, SHE, and Quality teams.

• Develop and execute comprehensive change management and transition plans to maximize adoption of new workspace strategies with minimal business disruption.

• Collaborate with local and global partners to align capital projects with campus master planning and long-term strategic R&D objectives.

• Oversee sustainability, furniture reuse, and donation programs to ensure alignment with corporate environmental and safety goals.

Who You Are

• Education & Core Experience: Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Project Management, or related field with 5+ years in workplace design, space planning, or facilities management.

• Life Sciences & Lab Expertise: 3+ years managing laboratory space portfolios in a pharmaceutical/life sciences setting, with working knowledge of lab design standards, safety regulations (e.g., BSL, chemical fume hoods), and GMP/GLP compliance (preferred).

• Project & Financial Management: Proven track record leading cross-functional teams and managing end-to-end capital project deliverables with budgets up to $5M (PMP certification preferred).

• Technical & Analytics Systems: Proficiency with Integrated Workplace Management Systems (IWMS) or lab-specific tools (LIMS, equipment tracking) to analyze occupancy metrics and execute space allocation workflows.

• Strategic Stakeholder Engagement: Strong ability to collaborate directly with scientific leadership, R&D teams, and global facility partners to align workspace design with business objectives.

• Change Management Leadership: Demonstrated experience driving workplace experience initiatives, communication plans, and occupancy transitions to minimize operational disruption.

The Position
At Roche, we believe our physical spaces shape the future of science. As our Workplace Strategy & Space Planning Lead , you will champion the design, master planning, and operational strategy for our campus, transforming office and high-complexity laboratory environments into inspiring, sustainable hubs of scientific excellence. In this role, you’ll bridge the gap between global architectural vision and day-to-day R&D needs—directing capital projects up to $5M, driving data-informed space allocation, and leading change management initiatives that keep our research teams performing at their best.

The Opportunity

• Direct all project delivery phases (budgets up to $5M, vendor coordination, timelines) for new construction and renovations across office and laboratory environments.

• Lead interior and exterior space optimization strategies, ensuring lab designs meet scientific requirements, biosafety/GLP/GMP standards, and operational workflows.

• Manage campus laboratory space assignments, tracking utilization metrics to make data-driven recommendations for capacity planning and reallocation.

• Maintain campus workplace policies, design guidelines, and safety/ergonomic standards in close partnership with R&D, SHE, and Quality teams.

• Develop and execute comprehensive change management and transition plans to maximize adoption of new workspace strategies with minimal business disruption.

• Collaborate with local and global partners to align capital projects with campus master planning and long-term strategic R&D objectives.

• Oversee sustainability, furniture reuse, and donation programs to ensure alignment with corporate environmental and safety goals.

Who You Are

• Education & Core Experience: Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Project Management, or related field with 5+ years in workplace design, space planning, or facilities management.

• Life Sciences & Lab Expertise: 3+ years managing laboratory space portfolios in a pharmaceutical/life sciences setting, with working knowledge of lab design standards, safety regulations (e.g., BSL, chemical fume hoods), and GMP/GLP compliance (preferred).

• Project & Financial Management: Proven track record leading cross-functional teams and managing end-to-end capital project deliverables with budgets up to $5M (PMP certification preferred).

• Technical & Analytics Systems: Proficiency with Integrated Workplace Management Systems (IWMS) or lab-specific tools (LIMS, equipment tracking) to analyze occupancy metrics and execute space allocation workflows.

• Strategic Stakeholder Engagement: Strong ability to collaborate directly with scientific leadership, R&D teams, and global facility partners to align workspace design with business objectives.

• Change Management Leadership: Demonstrated experience driving workplace experience initiatives, communication plans, and occupancy transitions to minimize operational disruption.

About the Role
At Roche Diagnostics Turkey, the Logistics Operations Specialist plays a strategic role in the end-to-end management of logistics processes.
This position is responsible not only for executing daily operations but also for driving efficiency, system accuracy, digital transformation, and a culture of continuous improvement .
The role supports Roche’s operational excellence vision across 3PL management, SAP integration, inventory optimization, transportation non-conformance management, sustainability, and budget control .

Informazioni sul ruolo
A Roche Diagnostics Turkey, il Logistics Operations Specialist svolge un ruolo strategico nella gestione end-to-end dei processi logistici.
Questa posizione è responsabile non solo per l'esecuzione delle operazioni quotidiane, ma anche per l'efficienza di guida, l'accuratezza del sistema, la trasformazione digitale, e una cultura di miglioramento continuo.
Il ruolo supporta la visione di eccellenza operativa di Roche attraverso la gestione 3PL, l'integrazione di SAP, l'ottimizzazione dell'inventario, la gestione della non conformità dei trasporti, la sostenibilità e il controllo del budget .

Principali responsabilità
里 Eccellenza Operativa & Accuratezza del Sistema

• Identificare i problemi legati al trasporto o a SAP, creare biglietti per il team di supporto globale e gestire la risoluzione attraverso IT o altri stakeholder (ad esempio, partner di fattura elettronica)

• Analizzare le discrepanze dell'inventario e gestire i processi di ritorno o smaltimento come richiesto

• Condurre conteggi mensili delle scorte con 3PL, verificare l'accuratezza del sistema per le posizioni occupate e vuote e coordinare i preparativi annuali del conteggio

• Assicurare la piena conformità delle operazioni logistiche con gli standard di PIL, SHE, ambientale e qualità (Roche Global Standards & MQMS)

• Gestione dei processi di smaltimento e rifiuti in linea con i principi di sostenibilità ambientale di Roche
 Gestione dell'inventario e del magazzino

• Analizzare l'inventario a slow-moving per mantenere livelli ottimali di stock e gestire proattivamente il controllo della shelf-life e la pianificazione dello smaltimento

• Eseguire correzioni di stock e azioni di miglioramento, assicurando l'ottimizzazione basata sulla posizione in linea con i volumi di vendita fluttuanti

• Superare le attività di distruzione fisica e coordinare la preparazione dei materiali in quarantena per lo smaltimento

 Ottimizzazione dei trasporti e della rete

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i partner 3PL sulla capacità del veicolo e l'ottimizzazione della rete per migliorare l'efficienza

• Sostenere la preparazione di piani di distribuzione e programmi di consegna basati sulla città

• Migliorare l'efficienza operativa e l'efficienza dei costi nei flussi di trasporto

 Digitalizzazione e miglioramento dei processi

• Utilizzare strumenti digitali come SAP, Power BI e Tableau per misurare le prestazioni e identificare le opportunità di miglioramento

• Contribuire attivamente a progetti di automazione, integrità dei dati e integrazione del sistema

• Promuovere una mentalità di miglioramento continuo e sostenere l'attuazione delle metodologie Lean

欄 Collaborazione & Stakeholder Management

• Costruire una forte collaborazione interfunzionale con gli stakeholder globali, regionali e locali (Order Management, Finanza, Qualità, IT, 3PL, ecc.)

• Supporto del flusso di informazioni trasparente tra processi globali e locali per garantire visibilità operativa

• Partecipa attivamente a progetti logistici regionali e globali (ad esempio, armonizzazione dei processi, transizione 3PL, rollout SAP EWM)

 Reporting, analisi e gestione delle prestazioni

• Preparare rapporti operativi mensili del KPI e conciliare i risultati con i dati 3PL per identificare le lacune

• Tracciare indicatori di performance logistici (KPI), eseguire analisi causa radice, e sviluppare piani di miglioramento

• Generare informazioni attuabili dai dati operativi per supportare la pianificazione strategica

• Preparare il livello di stock, lo smaltimento e i rapporti di spedizione, fornendo supporto analitico, dove necessario

 Gestione finanziaria e finanziaria

As an Operations Associate Intern, you will join an environment dedicated to cross-functional collaboration and impactful delivery. This dynamic role connects you directly with diverse teams and functional areas, giving you hands-on exposure to core business operations and strategic initiatives. You will play a key part in supporting daily activities, drive project milestones, and gain broad insight into our operational ecosystem.

The Opportunity

• Manage, maintain, and optimize operational tools, shared platforms, and internal information systems.

• Liaise with internal legal and contracts departments to streamline documentation and operational processes.

• Assist with the creation and alignment of materials for key internal and external tactics.

• Support project execution within medical education programs and assist throughout the brand planning cycle.

• Apply flexible, Agile principles to daily workflows and cross-functional team collaborations.

• Ensure strict compliance with corporate document management guidelines while sharing best operational practices across teams.

Who You Are

• You are currently pursuing a Master's program in Biotechnology or Biomedical Discovery and Commercialization, or closely related fields.

• You possess strong analytical skills and demonstrate proficiency with productivity tools, including Google Workspace and Microsoft Office 365.

• You have clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate ideas effectively across diverse teams.

• You bring a continuous learner mindset, a positive attitude, and a strong work ethic.

• You thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments and demonstrate flexibility when navigating ambiguity.

Additional Information:

• Term & Location: 12-month full-time internship starting January 2027 in Mississauga, ON (Hybrid model: minimum 3 days in office)

• Application: Please submit applications directly via our Workday Portal .

#MBiotech&MBDC

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position
IT Infrastructure Lead, Mergers & Acquisitions

The Opportunity
The IT Infrastructure Lead will drive the physical and network IT integration of acquired companies into the Roche environment. This role demands strong technical leadership in integrating, consolidating, and optimizing infrastructure across diverse environments, ensuring seamless transitions and minimal business disruption.

Bridging technical expertise with tactical execution, you will lead site readiness, system migrations, structured cabling, and corporate network deployments. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on experience in enterprise networking, system architecture, physical layer installation, and IT security, alongside the ability to manage vendors, field technicians, and cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities

• M&A Strategy & Due Diligence: Lead infrastructure due diligence during M&A assessments to identify risks, gaps, and integration opportunities. Collaborate with business teams to align infrastructure strategy with M&A timelines and compliance requirements.

• Architecture & Systems Migration: Plan and execute system migrations, hardware relocations, consolidations, and upgrades with minimal downtime.

• Network Design & Physical Build-Outs: Design and implement network integration strategies with networking SMEs, including IP schema alignment, firewall rule harmonization, and secure interconnectivity. Oversee site surveys, scope MDF/IDF retrofits, and manage cabling installations while ensuring network performance, redundancy, and security during transitional phases.

• S ecurity & Compliance Alignment: Partner with Corporate Information Security to integrate security controls across merged infrastructures, enforcing network isolation during transitions, and ensuring unified policies and standard security postures

• Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Act as the primary technical liaison, providing strategic guidance and hands-on oversight to local teams at acquired sites. Lead infrastructure teams through integration projects, mentor junior engineers, and partner with cross-functional teams (IT, security, legal, business units). Communicate effectively with executive stakeholders, providing regular updates on progress and risks.

• Decommissioning & Documentation: Develop end-to-end decommissioning plans for closing sites, ensuring secure hardware wipes, compliant e-waste disposal, and strict chain-of-custody tracking. Maintain detailed documentation of architecture, integration plans, and operational procedures.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Informatics, or a related field; or equivalent work experience.

• Integration Expertise: Proven track record managing physical IT integrations, data center migrations, and office build-outs.
