jobs.title: ERP Data Migration
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior ERP Systems Engineer is a strategic technical leader for the ASPIRE program. The primary objective of this role is to execute the end-to-end data migration strategy for the ASPIRE program, ensuring a seamless and accurate transition from legacy systems to our new ERP environment. This position requires close collaboration with functional business owners, technical teams and vendors to resolve complex data discrepancies and ensure the migrated data fully supports the program's strategic business goals.

In this role, you will drive key initiatives, manage complex solutions throughout the application lifecycle, define tasks for others, and act as a coach and technical lead for your team to ensure optimal ERP performance and drive the organization's mid- to long-term business goals.

The Opportunity

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Leads the development of comprehensive data migration frameworks. Oversees and mentors junior specialists within the team.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Addresses highly complex data migration issues. Ensures robust and effective governance practices are implemented and maintained across the organization.

• Stakeholder Management: Liaises directly with senior leadership to align on data migration strategy. Guides and directs various teams on compliance and governance issues.

• Impact/Strategy: Provides global-level support for innovative and technological initiatives. Actively gives speeches and shares knowledge at global and international events, and drives tech universities, Centers of Excellence (CoEs), and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Highly engaged in Chapter/Site related activities.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Manages enterprise-level data governance systems. Designs and implements advanced governance frameworks that scale across the organization.

• Business / Technical ability: Acts as an expert in data migration tools.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience defining tasks, coaching engineers, and successfully driving medium to large-scale (M/L) initiatives across a product or product line.

• Proven track record of managing full-cycle data migration projects for major ERP platforms.

• Experience participating in global knowledge-sharing events, tech universities, or Centers of Excellence (CoEs).

Technical Skills

• Strong background in data profiling, cleansing, and validation, with the ability to establish data quality metrics and governance standards that ensure high-fidelity migration.

• Demonstrated ability to analyze complex legacy data structures, map them to target data models.

• Capability to drive innovative solutions aligned with the latest technology trends in ERP, system architecture, and lifecycle management.

Additional Qualifications

• Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentorship skills, specifically in leveraging team strengths and challenging others in a growth-enabling way.

• Strong communication and negotiation skills, capable of building mutually beneficial partnerships across stakeholder ecosystems and providing direction for mid-to long-term goals.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Warsaw Grafit is 228’900.00 PLN - 425’100.00 PLN. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location. jobs.description:

The Position
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Visionary Leader: Head of Service Excellence & Customer Support

Location: Zagreb (Croatia) or Ljubljana (Slovenia) | Office-based with expected travel across the affiliate 30%
Division: Roche Diagnostics Adriatic
Reports to: Country Manager, Diagnostics Adriatic

Successful candidate must be based in Croatia or Slovenia. We don't provide relocation support for this role.

About the Role

Are you a leader who loves helping people grow while ensuring customers get the best service support possible?
As the Head of Service & Customer Support Excellence, you are the chief architect of Roche Diagnostics Adriatic’s service ecosystem. This role goes far beyond oversight - it is about driving long-term customer impact and operational excellence across Slovenia, Croatia, and Bosnia and Herzegovina. Leading with a bold strategic vision, you will manage the department’s budget and efficiency, transforming technical support into a high-value growth driver for the Roche enterprise. At its core, this position is about people. You will cultivate a supportive, inclusive environment where every team member feels a genuine sense of belonging. Your mission is to champion continuous professional development and maintain deep team connectivity as we scale together across our affiliate.
As a senior leader in our Adriatic team, you will help shape our local business strategy. You will focus on making sure our service and customer support is top-notch, which ultimately helps our customers and patients get the results they need.

Key Responsibilities

Setting the Direction: You will define the future of our service department and advise the leadership team on how to achieve our goals. Further:

• Focusing on Customers: You will lead our service and customer support teams to make sure every customer has a great experience when they need help.

• Working Together: You will build strong relationships with other departments like Sales and Marketing, and connect our local team with our regional partners.

• Improving Operations: You will manage the department's budget and use data to make smart decisions about how we work and what we need to be successful.

• Coaching the Team: You will spend time coaching and mentoring your team. We want you to create a culture where people feel safe, supported, and encouraged to learn and grow every day.

What You Bring to the Team

We are looking for a visionary leader who is great at solving problems, stays calm under pressure, and naturally looks at the "big picture" while remaining ready to dive into the details to support a customer or team member.

• Education: A university degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• Experience: At least 3 years of experience managing teams in technical support, medical devices, or the pharmaceutical industry.

• Leadership: A proven track record of leading other managers, handling budgets, and collaborating effectively across diverse departments.

• Business Acumen: A strong understanding of how a business runs, with the ability to use data and metrics to improve team operations.

• Languages & Travel: Fluency in English and at least one local language of the region. A valid driving license and a willingness to travel across the affiliate are required.

• People Skills: A natural ability to build diverse teams and guide them through organizational change with kindness, empathy, and clear communication.

Candidate Selection Process:
We review CVs and contact the most suitable candidates only

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Business & Site Operations Partner

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche Polska, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Your Primary Mission

We're seeking a strategic operational partner who will transform administrative and procedural challenges into streamlined, value-driven solutions. In this role, you'll be the architect of operational excellence - bridging internal teams and external stakeholders to build scalable processes that empower our organization to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care and business impact.

The Opportunity:

• Identify and resolve administrative and procedural needs across Squads and Chapters, serving as a trusted partner in operational problem-solving.

• Centralize and optimize administrative processes, driving efficiency improvements and reducing operational friction across the organization.

• Partner with conference organizers, creative agencies, and publishing partners to develop impactful promotional and educational materials for both domestic and international initiatives.

• Manage purchase orders within our procurement systems, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

• Oversee supplier payment verification and financial reserves management.

• Collaborate with Chapters on HCP and HCO engagement processes using preferred tools and systems (SUZI/ROME), ensuring compliance and efficiency.

• Champion continuous team improvement by actively contributing to shared knowledge management, fostering experience-sharing, and documenting best practices across Squads and Chapters.

• Implement administrative and procedural solutions that align with and support our central strategy.

• Develop recommendations that strengthen external stakeholder engagement and partnership effectiveness.

jobs.title: AI Solution Catalyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
As the AI Solution Catalyst, you act as the vital bridge between the AI Innovation Teams (Product & BP) and the wider ecosystem. Your mission is to amplify the value of developed AI solutions by driving their adoption, commercialization, and integration across internal business units and external markets.
You will "catalyze" success by translating complex technical innovations into compelling value propositions, ensuring that the solutions built by the Innovation Leads (Science or Healthcare) achieve maximum impact and visibility.

Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Value Amplification & Adoption
a) Go-to-Market Strategy: Partner with AI Innovation Leads and Product Managers to design and execute deployment strategies, key objectives for key solutions (e.g., DPMM, PLM, or Research Tools).
b) Adoption Drive: Act as the primary champion for assigned digital solutions, overcoming barriers to entry and driving usage rates among internal users (e.g., Medical teams) or external customers (e.g., Patients, HCPs).
c) Success Storytelling: Identify and package "wins" and case studies. Transform data and usage metrics into compelling narratives that demonstrate ROI and scientific/business value to senior leadership and external stakeholders.
2. Stakeholder Connection & Synergy
a) Bridge Building: Serve as the connector between the AI Innovation Lab/Teams and the broader commercial/medical organization.
b) Feedback Loop: Gather real-world feedback from the field and market, channeling insights back to the Product Managers to inform future iterations and feature enhancements.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
1. Bachelor’s degree in Medical, Business, Administration, or related fields
2. 3-5 years of experience in project coordination, administrative support, or general marketing.
3. Experience working in a cross-functional environment, supporting technical or product teams.
Job Required Competencies
1. Exceptional ability to translate technical features (AI/Tech) into business benefits and human-centric value propositions. You are a "translator" between tech and business.
2. Strong interpersonal skills to build networks across a matrix organization. Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
3. Ability to pivot quickly between strategic planning (how to position a product) and tactical execution (organizing a launch event or creating sales aids).
4. Passionate about finding new ways to apply and scale existing innovations.
5. Focused on tangible outcomes (e.g., adoption rates, customer satisfaction, brand equity lift) rather than just process.
Travel Frequency
<25%

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Lead IT Expert - RDT ERP

titleByLocale.fr: Expert en TI principal - RDT ERP

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Lead IT Expert - RDT ERP

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Lead IT Expert merges high-level technical architecture with operational service management. In this dual-capacity role, you will design business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex multi-product environment while taking ownership of end-to-end service delivery performance, operational stability, vendor SLA compliance, and service lifecycle management.
You will bridge the gap between strategic technology roadmaps and day-to-day IT operational excellence, ensuring solutions are not only architecturally sound and scalable, but also reliably

The opportunity:

Architectural Scope & Technical Leadership

• Design scalable solutions meeting product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a complex, multi-solution RDT ERP landscape.

• Document and evolve architecture across the product lifecycle, managing Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs), fitness functions, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

• Define conceptual and logical data models, taxonomies, ontologies, and integration pathways.

• Develop, maintain, and drive the product technology roadmap while proactively managing technical debt, evaluating external technology trends, and conducting vendor technical assessments.

Delivery & Service Operations Management

• End-to-End Service Governance: Oversee the operational delivery life cycle for ERP solution platforms, ensuring service level agreements (SLAs), operational level agreements (OLAs), and key performance indicators (KPIs) are consistently met.

• Service Continuity & Incident Escalation: Act as the major incident escalation point for critical service disruptions; perform root cause analysis (RCA) and drive continuous service improvement (CSI) initiatives.

• Release & Operations Alignment: Align architectural change roadmaps with IT Service Management (ITSM) operational models, change management workflows, and zero-downtime deployment strategies.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Leader IT Expert - RDT ERP

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo.

A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi.

Il Lead IT Expert fonde l'architettura tecnica di alto livello con la gestione dei servizi operativi. In questo ruolo di dual-capacity, si progetta soluzioni business-driven, basate su standard e future-ready all'interno di un ambiente multi-prodotto complesso, mentre prendendo la proprietà delle prestazioni di servizio end-to-end, stabilità operativa, conformità SLA fornitore e gestione del ciclo di vita di servizio.
Potrai colmare il divario tra roadmap tecnologiche strategiche e eccellenza operativa IT quotidiana, assicurando che le soluzioni non siano solo architettonicamente solide e scalabili, ma anche in modo affidabile

L'opportunità:

Scopo architettonico e leadership tecnica

• Soluzioni scalabili di progettazione che soddisfano i requisiti dei prodotti, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali all'interno di un paesaggio RDT ERP complesso e multi-soluzione.

• Documento ed evoluzione dell'architettura in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, gestione dei Requisiti Non-Functional (NFR), funzioni di fitness e Architettura Decision Records (ADRs).

• Definire modelli di dati concettuali e logici, tassonomie, onlogie e percorsi di integrazione.

• Sviluppare, mantenere e guidare la roadmap della tecnologia del prodotto, gestendo in modo proattivo il debito tecnico, valutando le tendenze della tecnologia esterna e conducendo valutazioni tecniche dei fornitori.

Gestione delle operazioni di consegna e di servizio

• Gestione del servizio end-to-end: supervisionare il ciclo di consegna operativo per le piattaforme di soluzioni ERP, garantire accordi di livello di servizio (SLA), accordi di livello operativo (OLA), e indicatori chiave di performance (KPI) sono costantemente soddisfatti.

• Service Continuity & Incident Escalation: Agire come il principale punto di escalation incidente per interruzioni di servizio critiche; eseguire l'analisi delle cause root (RCA) e guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo dei servizi (CSI).

• Allineamento: allineamento delle roadmap di cambiamento architettonico con i modelli operativi IT Service Management (ITSM), i flussi di lavoro di gestione dei cambiamenti e le strategie di distribuzione zero-downtime.

• Gestione del Fornitore e del Fornitore di Servizi: Guidare la responsabilità operativa con fornitori di software di terze parti, integratori di sistema e fornitori di servizi gestiti per garantire la consegna della qualità, la conformità del contratto e la realizzazione del valore.

Gestione e strategia degli stakeholder

• Comunicare concetti architettonici e operativi complessi chiaramente a dirigenti, proprietari di processi aziendali e team di consegna interfunzionali.

• Negoziare i trade-off operativi strategici tra purezza architettonica, velocità di consegna del progetto, costo e stabilità di servizio a lungo termine.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Lead IT Expert - RDT ERP

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation ihren Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu unterstützen und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der Digital eine Kernstärke von Roche ist, intelligentere Arbeitsweisen ermöglicht, menschliches Potenzial erschließt und Durchbrüche ermöglicht, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt von Bedeutung sind.

Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Im Moment verlangen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen.

Der Lead IT Expert verbindet eine hochrangige technische Architektur mit operativem Service Management. In dieser Dual-Capacity-Rolle entwerfen Sie unternehmensorientierte, standardbasierte und zukunftsfähige Lösungen in einer komplexen Multi-Produkt-Umgebung und übernehmen gleichzeitig die Verantwortung für End-to-End-Servicebereitstellungsleistung, Betriebsstabilität, SLA-Compliance von Anbietern und Service-Lifecycle-Management.
Sie schließen die Lücke zwischen strategischen Technologie-Roadmaps und der täglichen operativen IT-Exzellenz und stellen sicher, dass die Lösungen nicht nur architektonisch solide und skalierbar, sondern auch zuverlässig sind.

Die Gelegenheit:

Architektur und technische Führung

• Entwerfen Sie skalierbare Lösungen, die Produktanforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards in einer komplexen RDT-ERP-Landschaft mit mehreren Lösungen erfüllen.

• Dokumentieren und entwickeln Sie Architektur über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg, indem Sie nichtfunktionale Anforderungen (NFRs), Fitnessfunktionen und Architekturentscheidungsaufzeichnungen (ADRs) verwalten.

• Definieren Sie konzeptionelle und logische Datenmodelle, Taxonomien, Ontologien und Integrationspfade.

• Entwickeln, pflegen und steuern Sie die Produkttechnologie-Roadmap, während Sie proaktiv technische Schulden verwalten, externe Technologietrends bewerten und technische Bewertungen von Anbietern durchführen.

Delivery & Service Operations Management

• End-to-End Service Governance: Überwachen Sie den operativen Lieferlebenszyklus für ERP-Lösungsplattformen und stellen Sie sicher, dass Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Operational Level Agreements (OLAs) und Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) konsequent eingehalten werden.

• Service Continuity & Incident Escalation: Handeln Sie als Hauptpunkt für die Eskalation von Vorfällen bei kritischen Serviceunterbrechungen; führen Sie eine Ursachenanalyse (Root Cause Analysis, RCA) durch und fördern Sie Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Serviceverbesserung (Continuous Service Improvement, CSI).

• Release & Operations Alignment: Align architektonische Change-Roadmaps mit IT Service Management (ITSM) Betriebsmodellen, Change Management-Workflows und Zero-Downtime-Bereitstellungsstrategien.

• Vendor & Service Provider Management: Führen Sie die operative Verantwortlichkeit mit Drittanbietern von Software, Systemintegratoren und Managed Service Providern, um die Qualität der Lieferung, die Vertragskonformität und die Wertrealisierung zu gewährleisten.

Stakeholder Management & Strategie

• Kommunizieren Sie komplexe architektonische und operative Konzepte klar an Führungskräfte, Geschäftsprozessbesitzer und funktionsübergreifende Lieferteams.

• Verhandeln Sie strategische operative Kompromisse zwischen architektonischer Reinheit, Projektliefergeschwindigkeit, Kosten und langfristiger Servicestabilität.

• Ensu
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Expert en TI principal - RDT ERP

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde.

Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration.

L'expert en TI principal fusionne l'architecture technique de haut niveau et la gestion des services opérationnels. Dans ce rôle à double capacité, vous concevrez des solutions axées sur l'entreprise, basées sur des normes et prêtes à l'avenir dans un environnement complexe à produits multiples, tout en prenant en charge la performance de la prestation de service de bout en bout, la stabilité opérationnelle, la conformité des fournisseurs SLA et la gestion du cycle de vie de service.
Vous comblerez l'écart entre les feuilles de route technologiques stratégiques et l'excellence opérationnelle des TI au quotidien, en veillant à ce que les solutions soient non seulement architecturalement saines et évolutives, mais également fiables.

L'occasion :

Portée architecturale et leadership technique

• Concevoir des solutions évolutives répondant aux besoins des produits, aux priorités opérationnelles et aux normes d'entreprise dans un environnement ERP complexe et multisolution.

• Documenter et faire évoluer l'architecture tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, gérer les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR), les fonctions de conditionnement physique et les dossiers décisionnels en architecture (ADR).

• Définir des modèles de données conceptuels et logiques, des taxonomies, des ontologies et des voies d'intégration.

• Élaborer, maintenir et piloter la feuille de route technologique des produits tout en gérant proactivement la dette technique, en évaluant les tendances technologiques externes et en effectuant des évaluations techniques des fournisseurs.

Gestion de la prestation et des opérations de services

• Gouvernance des services de bout en bout : Surveiller le cycle de vie opérationnel des plates-formes de solutions de PGI, en veillant à ce que les accords de niveau de service, les accords de niveau opérationnel et les indicateurs de rendement clés (ICP) soient constamment respectés.

• Continuité des services et augmentation des incidents : agir comme point d'escalade des incidents majeurs pour les perturbations critiques des services; effectuer une analyse des causes profondes (ARC) et diriger des initiatives d'amélioration continue des services (ICS).

• Alignement de la version et des opérations : Aligner les feuilles de route du changement architectural sur les modèles opérationnels de la gestion des services informatiques (GITI), les flux de travail de la gestion du changement et les stratégies de déploiement à temps zéro.

• Gestion des fournisseurs et des fournisseurs de services : Conduire la responsabilité opérationnelle avec les fournisseurs de logiciels tiers, les intégrateurs de systèmes et les fournisseurs de services gérés pour garantir la qualité de la livraison, la conformité des contrats et la réalisation de la valeur.

Gestion des intervenants et stratégie

• Communiquer clairement les concepts architecturaux et opérationnels complexes aux cadres supérieurs, aux propriétaires de processus opérationnels et aux équipes de prestation interfonctionnelles.

• Négocier des compromis opérationnels stratégiques entre la pureté architecturale, la rapidité de réalisation des projets, les coûts et la stabilité des services à long terme.

• Ensu

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a DevOps Infrastructure Engineer at the SE8 level, you will establish the technical direction for multiple platforms and oversee their entire lifecycle, ensuring seamless alignment with organizational goals. Applying exceptional problem-solving skills, you will resolve intricate challenges across multiple domains, lead cross-functional teams, and oversee critical system implementations. Exhibiting profound expertise and thought leadership, you will influence technology direction, shape the global DevOps culture, and engage in high-level strategic decision-making to drive enterprise-wide innovation.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Establishes the technical direction for the whole lifecycle of multiple heterogeneous and interrelated platforms and services—from inception through deployment, operation, and retirement. Applies software engineering principles to build large-scale IT infrastructure, abstracting away complexity to provide self-service tools for developers. Provides technical guidance for designing complex CI/CD pipelines, designs self-healing strategies, and leads Disaster Recovery design and execution plans.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leverages exceptional problem-solving skills to tackle intricate challenges across multiple domains, ensuring cohesive strategies that drive organization-wide performance. Leads the maintenance of live services by designing metrics and identifying critical metrics for SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs. Accountable for availability, capacity planning, tuning, and leading large initiatives aimed at optimizing interrelated platforms for scalability.

• Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates superior customer and delivery focus by proactively leading partnerships and influencing at senior levels with developers, managers, Managed Services suppliers, and vendors. Acts as a reference model analyst and integrates insights across customers and partners to inform customer-centric IT decisions.

• Impact/Strategy: Responsible for implementing and updating cost, compliance, and security best practices while ensuring solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards. Leads complex audit exercises and remediation plans, manages ITSM processes, and continuously scales systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation.

• Complexity/ (Product Size): Exhibits superior ability to collaborate globally with diverse, virtual teams, fostering success and alignment across multiple domains. Leads geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing visionary guidance and driving excellence.

• Business/Technical ability: Technically leads the definition of computing infrastructure entirely under software control. Designs and leads the implementation of Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and CI/CD pipelines. Flexes and thrives in am biguous environments undergoing transformational change and applies innovation to foster business strategy.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Proven experience leading geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing visionary guidance across multiple domains.

• Demonstrated experience applying design thinking, lean, prioritization, and agile methodologies to evolve services.

• Ability to flex and thrive in an ambiguous environment undergoing transformational change.

Technical Skills

• Proven hands-on technical skills in automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), logging, monitoring, observability, infrastructure configurati

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The ERP Solution Architect designs business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements and evolving the architecture throughout the product life cycle. By solving complex technical problems, defining reference architectures, and aligning with the broader architecture community for governance, you will ensure robust ERP implementations that deliver enhanced value to the organization.

The Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools is the primary technical authority responsible for architecting the transition from legacy SAP Solution Manager to a modern, future-proof ALM ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the strategic design and operational excellence of the global "Requirements to Deploy" process, ensuring that our delivery pipeline remains robust during a period of significant technological shift.

Your core mission is to navigate the complexities of SAP's Cloud ALM offering while maintaining the flexibility to custom-build proprietary solutions when standard tools lack the necessary influence on design or functional depth.

As part of your daily remit, you will:

• Architect the Pivot: Actively evaluate the functional gaps within SAP Cloud ALM and decide where the organization must "Build" rather than "Buy." You will be responsible for the high-level design of custom ALM modules (potentially on SAP BTP or other cloud-native platforms) to ensure our specific business requirements are met.

• Design the "Requirements to Deploy" Lifecycle and Lead Technical Decisioning: You will orchestrate the end-to-end framework including Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management. You are not just a tool user; you are the designer of the framework that enables these processes.

• Govern Hybrid Landscapes: You will define the integration patterns required to link SAP-specific ALM components with the broader enterprise DevOps toolchain, ensuring a "clean core" strategy while managing the decommissioning of legacy SolMan/ChaRM environments.

Qualifications

• Mastery of ALM Transition & Toolsets: 8+ years of total IT experience with Expert-level knowledge of legacy ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) paired with the ability to architect migrations to SAP Cloud ALM.

• Developer Foundation: Strong background as a Developer (e.g., ABAP, OO-ABAP, Web Dynpro, or general software engineering). You must understand code logic, transport logs, APIs, and database structures to design custom ALM workarounds.

• SDLC & DevOps Proficiency: Deep understanding of ERP change management and transport layers, with a modern approach to API-first design and automated release orchestration.

• AI-Augmented Engineering: Competency in using AI-augmented engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, or equivalent) to improve code quality, automate documentation, and design intelligent extensions that bridge functional gaps in standard SaaS offerings is good to have.

• Lifecycle Management: Proven track record of managing at least 2–3 full-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles, specifically focusing on the architectural trade-offs between "Standard"

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

L'ERP Solution Architect progetta soluzioni business-driven, basate su standard e future-ready enterprise pianificazione delle risorse (ERP) in un contesto specifico di soluzione. In questo ruolo, si progettano soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti di prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali, mentre gestiscono i requisiti non funzionali e l'evoluzione dell'architettura in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Risolvendo complessi problemi tecnici, definendo architetture di riferimento, e allineando con la più ampia comunità di architettura per la governance, ti garantirai robuste implementazioni ERP che offrono un valore aggiunto all'organizzazione.

L'Architetto Soluzione per ERP Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) Processi, Framework and Tools è l'autorità tecnica primaria responsabile dell'architettura del passaggio da SAP Solution Manager legacy a un ecosistema ALM moderno e futuro. In questo ruolo, guiderai il design strategico e l'eccellenza operativa del processo globale "Requirements to Deploy", garantendo che la nostra pipeline di consegna rimanga robusta durante un periodo di significativo cambiamento tecnologico.

La vostra missione principale è quella di navigare le complessità dell'offerta SAP Cloud ALM, mantenendo al contempo la flessibilità di realizzare soluzioni proprietarie personalizzate quando gli strumenti standard non hanno la necessaria influenza sul design o sulla profondità funzionale.

Come parte del vostro impegno quotidiano, voi:

• Architetto il Pivot: Valutare attivamente le lacune funzionali all'interno di SAP Cloud ALM e decidere dove l'organizzazione deve "Build" piuttosto che "Buy". Sarete responsabili del design di alto livello dei moduli ALM personalizzati (potenzialmente su SAP BTP o altre piattaforme cloud-native) per garantire che i nostri requisiti aziendali specifici siano soddisfatti.

• Progettare i "Requisiti per Diploy" Lifecycle e Lead Technical Decisioning: Organizzerai il framework end-to-end tra cui Business Process Modelling, Requisiti, Cambiamento, Trasporto, Rilasciare, Test, Defect e System Documentation Management. Non sei solo un utente di strumenti; sei il progettista del framework che consente questi processi.

• Govern Ibridi Paesaggi: Definirai i modelli di integrazione necessari per collegare i componenti ALM specifici di SAP con la più ampia gamma di strumenti DevOps, garantendo una strategia "pulita core" mentre gestisci la decommissione degli ambienti legacy SolMan/ChaRM.

Qualifiche

• Mastery of ALM Transition & Toolsets: 8+ anni di esperienza IT totale con la conoscenza a livello di esperti dell'eredità ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) abbinato alla capacità di architetto migrazioni a SAP Cloud ALM.

• Sviluppatore Foundation: Forte sfondo come sviluppatore (ad esempio ABAP, OO-ABAP, Web Dynpro, o ingegneria del software generale). È necessario comprendere logica di codice, registri di trasporto, API e strutture di database per progettare soluzioni personalizzate ALM.

• SDLC & DevOps Proficiency: profonda comprensione dei livelli di gestione dei cambiamenti ERP e dei trasporti, con un approccio moderno al design API-first e l'orchestrazione automatica del rilascio.

• AI-Augmented Engineering: Competenza nell'utilizzo di strumenti di ingegneria potenziati dall'IA (ad esempio, GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, o equivalente) per migliorare la qualità del codice, automatizzare la documentazione e progettare estensioni intelligenti che colmano lacune funzionali nelle offerte standard SaaS è buona da avere.

• Gestione del ciclo di vita: comprovato record di gestione di almeno 2–3 cicli di implementazione full-scale di ERP o di aggiornamento, concentrandosi specificamente sui trade-off architettonici tra "Standard"

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Der ERP Solution Architect entwirft unternehmensorientierte, standardbasierte und zukunftsfähige Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Lösungen in einem spezifischen Lösungskontext. In dieser Rolle entwerfen Sie Lösungen, die den Produktanforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards entsprechen, während Sie nicht funktionale Anforderungen verwalten und die Architektur während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus weiterentwickeln. Durch die Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme, die Definition von Referenzarchitekturen und die Ausrichtung auf die breitere Architekturgemeinschaft für die Governance stellen Sie robuste ERP-Implementierungen sicher, die dem Unternehmen einen Mehrwert bieten.

Der Solution Architect für ERP Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) Prozesse, Framework und Tools ist die primäre technische Instanz, die für den Übergang vom alten SAP Solution Manager zu einem modernen, zukunftssicheren ALM-Ökosystem verantwortlich ist. In dieser Rolle werden Sie die strategische Gestaltung und operative Exzellenz des globalen "Requirements to Deploy" -Prozesses leiten und sicherstellen, dass unsere Lieferpipeline in einer Zeit erheblicher technologischer Veränderungen robust bleibt.

Ihre Kernaufgabe besteht darin, die Komplexität des Cloud-ALM-Angebots von SAP zu bewältigen und gleichzeitig die Flexibilität zu erhalten, proprietäre Lösungen zu entwickeln, wenn Standardtools den notwendigen Einfluss auf Design oder Funktionstiefe haben.

Als Teil Ihres täglichen Auftrags werden Sie:

• Architect the Pivot: Bewerten Sie aktiv die Funktionslücken innerhalb von SAP Cloud ALM und entscheiden Sie, wo das Unternehmen "Build" statt "Buy" bauen muss. Sie sind für das High-Level-Design benutzerdefinierter ALM-Module (möglicherweise auf SAP BTP oder anderen Cloud-nativen Plattformen) verantwortlich, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere spezifischen Geschäftsanforderungen erfüllt werden.

• Design der "Anforderungen an die Bereitstellung" Lifecycle und Lead Technical Decisioning: Sie orchestrieren das End-to-End-Framework einschließlich Business Process Modelling, Anforderungen, Änderung, Transport, Release, Test, Defekt und Systemdokumentation Management. Sie sind nicht nur ein Tool-Benutzer; Sie sind der Designer des Frameworks, das diese Prozesse ermöglicht.

• Governance-Hybrid-Landschaften: Sie definieren die Integrationsmuster, die erforderlich sind, um SAP-spezifische ALM-Komponenten mit der breiteren Enterprise-DevOps-Toolchain zu verknüpfen, um eine "saubere Kernstrategie" zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die Stilllegung von alten SolMan/ChaRM-Umgebungen zu verwalten.

Qualifikationen

• Beherrschung von ALM Transition & Toolsets: 8+ Jahre umfassende IT-Erfahrung mit Expertenwissen über Legacy ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) gepaart mit der Fähigkeit, Migrationen zu SAP Cloud ALM zu erstellen.

• Developer Foundation: Starker Hintergrund als Entwickler (z. B. ABAP, OO-ABAP, Web Dynpro oder allgemeines Software Engineering). Sie müssen Codelogik, Transportprotokolle, APIs und Datenbankstrukturen verstehen, um benutzerdefinierte ALM-Workarounds zu entwerfen.

• SDLC & DevOps Proficiency: Tiefes Verständnis für ERP-Änderungsmanagement und Transportebenen mit einem modernen Ansatz für API-First-Design und automatisierte Release-Orchestrierung.

• AI-Augmented Engineering: Die Kompetenz im Einsatz von AI-Augmented Engineering Tools (z. B. GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule oder gleichwertig) zur Verbesserung der Codequalität, zur Automatisierung der Dokumentation und zum Entwurf intelligenter Erweiterungen, die funktionale Lücken in Standard-SaaS-Angeboten überbrücken, ist gut.

• Lifecycle Management: Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung von mindestens 2-3 umfassenden ERP-Implementierungen oder Upgrade-Lebenszyklen, insbesondere mit Schwerpunkt auf den architektonischen Kompromissen zwischen "Standard"

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

L'ERP Solution Architect conçoit des solutions de planification des ressources axées sur les activités, fondées sur des normes et prêtes à l'avenir dans un contexte de solution spécifique. Dans ce rôle, vous concevrez des solutions qui répondent aux exigences du produit, aux priorités opérationnelles et aux normes d'entreprise tout en gérant les exigences non fonctionnelles et en évoluant l'architecture tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. En résolvant des problèmes techniques complexes, en définissant des architectures de référence et en s'adaptant à l'ensemble de la communauté de l'architecture pour la gouvernance, vous assurerez des implémentations robustes du PGI qui apportent une valeur ajoutée à l'organisation.

L'architecte de solutions pour la gestion du cycle de vie des applications ERP (ALM) Processus, cadre et outils est la principale autorité technique responsable de l'architecture de la transition de l'ancien gestionnaire de solutions SAP à un écosystème moderne et à l'épreuve du futur. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez la conception stratégique et l'excellence opérationnelle du processus mondial « Exigences de déploiement », en veillant à ce que notre pipeline de livraison demeure robuste pendant une période de changement technologique important.

Votre mission principale est de naviguer dans les complexités de l'offre Cloud ALM de SAP tout en maintenant la flexibilité pour construire des solutions propriétaires sur mesure lorsque les outils standard n'ont pas l'influence nécessaire sur la conception ou la profondeur fonctionnelle.

Dans le cadre de votre mission quotidienne, vous:

• Architecte le pivot : Évaluer activement les lacunes fonctionnelles dans SAP Cloud ALM et décider où l'organisation doit « construire » plutôt que « acheter ». Vous serez responsable de la conception de haut niveau de modules ALM personnalisés (potentiellement sur SAP BTP ou d'autres plateformes cloud-native) pour vous assurer que nos exigences professionnelles spécifiques sont satisfaites.

• Concevoir le "Requirements to Deploy" Lifecycle and Lead Technical Decisioning: Vous orchestrerez le cadre de bout en bout, y compris la modélisation des processus d'affaires, les exigences, le changement, le transport, la libération, l'essai, les défauts et la gestion de la documentation du système. Vous n'êtes pas seulement un utilisateur d'outil; vous êtes le concepteur du cadre qui permet ces processus.

• Govern Hybrid Landscapes: Vous définirez les modèles d'intégration nécessaires pour relier les composants ALM spécifiques à SAP à la chaîne d'outils DevOps plus large de l'entreprise, assurant une stratégie de « cœur propre » tout en gérant le déclassement des anciens environnements SolMan/ChARM.

Compétences

• Mastery of ALM Transition & Toolets: 8+ ans d'expérience informatique totale avec une connaissance de niveau expert de l'héritage ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) jumelé à la capacité d'architecter les migrations vers SAP Cloud ALM.

• Fondation des développeurs : Forte expérience en tant que développeur (p. ex. ABAP, OO-ABAP, Web Dynpro ou génie logiciel général). Vous devez comprendre la logique de code, les journaux de transport, les API et les structures de base de données pour concevoir des solutions de rechange ALM personnalisées.

• SDLC & DevOps Compétence: Compréhension approfondie de la gestion du changement ERP et des couches de transport, avec une approche moderne de la conception API-premier et de l'orchestration de sortie automatisée.

• Ingénierie assistée par l'IA : Compétence dans l'utilisation d'outils d'ingénierie perfectionnés par l'IA (p. ex., GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, ou équivalent) pour améliorer la qualité du code, automatiser la documentation et concevoir des extensions intelligentes qui comblent les lacunes fonctionnelles dans les offres SaaS standard.

• Gestion du cycle de vie : Expérience éprouvée de la gestion d'au moins 2 à 3 cycles de mise en œuvre ou de mise à niveau complets des ERP, en se concentrant plus particulièrement sur les compromis architecturaux entre la norme

Die Section Planning & Logistics ist eine wichtige Schnittstelle zu dem aseptischen Herstellbereich und den anderen Sections innerhalb des Clinical Supply Centers. Auch sind in dieser Einheit das MES und Automation Team integriert, welche wichtige Support-Einheiten für das CSC Parenterals darstellen und einen 1st Level User-Support gewährleisten.

Aufgrund der Schnittstellen zu den Supportbereichen, wie dem Engineering, Materials Management, Supplier Quality Management und der Qualitätssicherung, hast du zusätzlich die Möglichkeit, Einblicke in angrenzende Bereiche zu erlangen.

Die Möglichkeit
Bei folgenden Tätigkeiten wirst du uns während deines Praktikums unterstützen:

• Mitwirkung bei allgemeinen Projekten und Support im täglichen Arbeitsablauf.

• Durchführung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen und Unterstützung in den Fachbereichen Planung, Master Data & Material Management, Logistik , Automation und MES Support.

• Definition von KPIs (Key Performance Indicators)

• Visualisierung von Geschäftsprozessen, Erstellen von Dokumenten.

• Unterstützung der Section bei Projekten sowie Übernahme von Teilprojekten und Begleitung von Meetings, inklusive Tracking der Aufgaben.

Wer Du Bist
Das bringst du für diese Rolle mit:

• Du studierst aktuell Logistik Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Wirtschaftsinformatik und möchtest dein Wissen nun in der Praxis einsetzen.

• Offenheit für neue Ideen und Freude an der Arbeit in einem leistungsorientierten Umfeld, das auf gegenseitigem Respekt und Zusammenarbeit basiert.

• Teamfähige, flexible und entscheidungsfreudige Persönlichkeit mit einer motivierten und selbstständigen Arbeitsweise.

• Hohe Affinität für IT-Applikationen sowie ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten zur Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen im E2E-Denken.

• Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse für die tägliche Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit in einem vielfältigen Team.

​Bewerbungsprozess

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your department
The cell culture process development team of Roche in Penzberg is looking for a motivated student to directly contribute to technology development and platform optimization for our future viral vector-manufacturing platform. Hereby, we are entering a new era of gene therapy with the great potential to reshape the treatment of several human diseases.
During your internship you will partake in this development. Our team attaches great importance to making your time at Roche as rewarding as possible. You will be warmly welcomed into the team right from the start and gain exciting insights into a wide variety of areas. The focus is to guarantee you a constant learning effect and to bring in your ideas, to support you but also to challenge you.

Your tasks

• Plan, prepare, and execute laboratory-scale viral vector production experiments to generate starting material for your experiments.

• Investigate, characterize, and optimize current lysis and harvest protocols to improve overall process efficiency.

• Evaluate and compare different filtration setups and clarification technologies to maximize vector recovery while ensuring robust operation.

• Contribute actively to the development and evaluation of innovative harvest and clarification strategies within the department.

• Work both individually and as part of an intercultural team to achieve project milestones within defined timelines.

• Leverage scientific literature and past studies to extract critical information supporting the project.

Your profile

• You are currently enrolled at a university or university of applied sciences in biotechnology, bioprocess engineering, biochemical engineering, biology, biochemistry, or a comparable course, or you are in your gap year between your bachelor’s and master’s studies.

• In the best case, you already hold a Bachelor’s degree in a related scientific or engineering field.

• Initial practical experience or theoretical knowledge in the field of large-scale fermentation and/or filtration techniques is useful and highly advantageous.

• You are distinguished by your independence, commitment, and structured approach to laboratory work, and you enjoy technical challenges.

• You are proficient in English (required) and have a good command of German (favorable) to successfully communicate within our global and intercultural team.

Your benefits

• Flexible working hours with the opportunity for a flexible time management setup.

• 2268 € monthly remuneration for a full-time internship (> 3 months).

• Discounted meal prices (-50%) in our modern staff canteen.

• Fitness center and various health offers directly on the Roche campus.

• Networking events (online and offline) to connect and share experiences with other students and interns.

Your application

Do only upload your CV.

Please remember that this internship is dedicated to enrolled students (m/f/d) or persons in their gap year (only between Bachelor's and Master's studies).

Time frame: Starting October 2026 or upon agreement for a period of 6 months.

We are looking forward to your application!

Please note that referrals for all student activities (e.g. internships, theses, etc.) are excluded.

Your department

The focus is to guarantee you a constant learning effect and to bring in your ideas, to support you but also to challenge you.

Your tasks

• Plan, prepare, and execute laboratory-scale viral vector production experiments to generate starting material for your experiments.

• Investigate, characterize, and optimize current lysis and harvest protocols to improve overall process efficiency.

• Evaluate and compare different filtration setups and clarification technologies to maximize vector recovery while ensuring robust operation.

• Contribute actively to the development and evaluation of innovative harvest and clarification strategies within the department.

• Work both individually and as part of an intercultural team to achieve project milestones within defined timelines.

• Leverage scientific literature and past studies to extract critical information supporting the project.

Your profile

• You are currently enrolled at a university or university of applied sciences in biotechnology, bioprocess engineering, biochemical engineering, biology, biochemistry, or a comparable course, or you are in your gap year between your bachelor’s and master’s studies.

• In the best case, you already hold a Bachelor’s degree in a related scientific or engineering field.

• Initial practical experience or theoretical knowledge in the field of large-scale fermentation and/or filtration techniques is useful and highly advantageous.

• You are distinguished by your independence, commitment, and structured approach to laboratory work, and you enjoy technical challenges.

• You are proficient in English (required) and have a good command of German (favorable) to successfully communicate within our global and intercultural team.

Your benefits

• Flexible working hours with the opportunity for a flexible time management setup.

• 2268 € monthly remuneration for a full-time internship (> 3 months).

• Discounted meal prices (-50%) in our modern staff canteen.

• Fitness center and various health offers directly on the Roche campus.

• Networking events (online and offline) to connect and share experiences with other students and interns.

Do only upload your CV.

Please remember that this internship is dedicated to enrolled students (m/f/d) or persons in their gap year (only between Bachelor's and Master's studies).

Time frame: Starting October 2026 or upon agreement for a period of 6 months.

We are looking forward to your application!

Please note that referrals for all student activities (e.g. internships, theses, etc.) are excluded.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Accountant - French speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and French

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Robotics Technology Deployment Steward (Drug Product)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche's demanding and changing Small Molecules, Bio, and Cell & Gene Therapy product portfolio requires shaping the manufacturing network of the future, driving global investments across different production sites.
As an integral part of Pharma Technical Operations (PT), PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) plays a key role in leading seamless industrialization and thorough technical management by integrating SHE, proactive maintenance, facility fitness, performance optimization, and scalable manufacturing technologies across the network. Product and process robustness, efficiency, and reliability are key performance indicators that PTT owns and drives through continuous improvement.
Within PTT, our Global Manufacturing Science and Technology (gMSAT) departments drive the front-line implementation of advanced capabilities to modernize physical operations across Drug Substance (DS), Drug Product (DP), and Device, Packaging & Distribution (DDP) networks.
The Technology Deployment Groups (TDGs) within the gMSAT departments are the ultimate strategic connectors in our technology standardization framework. They coordinate the collection and assessment of both network-wide operational "pains" and emerging local innovations, bridging the gap between local site realities and globally endorsed network standards.

The Opportunity
As a vital member within the respective TDG the Robotics Technology Deployment Steward serves as the primary execution engine bridging central strategy with site-level manufacturing operations. Working in close partnership with the Robotics Technology Strategy Lead, this role supports technology scouting, translates high-level strategy into value-driven proofs-of-concept (PoCs), and leads the tactical roll-out of standardized robotics and automation solutions to directly address operational pain points across our global production sites.

• Solving Operational Pain Points through Technology Assessment/Implementation: Act as the functional domain network liaison for DP manufacturing sites, identifying operational bottlenecks, evaluating local challenges through a global network lens, and actively supporting the scouting efforts for emerging robotics/automation solutions to drive standardized solutions.

• Strategic Roadmap Co-Creation: Partner closely with the Technology Strategy Lead to drive and shape the global/network robotics roadmap, leading hands-on operational execution, provide technical expertise, and consolidate/represent site feasibility perspectives.

• Proof of Concept (PoC) Execution: Lead cross-functional execution teams (across MSAT, Engineering, Quality, IT/OT, and Operations) to design, execute, and evaluate rapid, ROI-driven PoCs, providing data-backed recommendations to scale, pivot, or stop technologies based on business value.

• Lead Technology deployment lifecycle from ideation to implementation: drive post-CAPEX industrialization plans, oversee cross-functional IT/OT system integration (e.g., SCADA, MES, digital twins), and manage the operational handover by preparing site integration packages (URS, CQV/CSV) to ensure a successful transition to local site operations.

Who you are
You are a pragmatic innovator with deep technical knowhow and hands-on expertise in deploying robotics and automation solutions within complex regulated manufacturing environments, driven to solve critical site operational challenges through creative and scalable technology.

• BSc, MSc or PhD in Robotics Engineering, Mec

The Position
Roche's demanding and changing Small Molecules, Bio, and Cell & Gene Therapy product portfolio requires shaping the manufacturing network of the future, driving global investments across different production sites.
As an integral part of Pharma Technical Operations (PT), PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) plays a key role in leading seamless industrialization and thorough technical management by integrating SHE, proactive maintenance, facility fitness, performance optimization, and scalable manufacturing technologies across the network. Product and process robustness, efficiency, and reliability are key performance indicators that PTT owns and drives through continuous improvement.
Within PTT, our Global Manufacturing Science and Technology (gMSAT) departments drive the front-line implementation of advanced capabilities to modernize physical operations across the Drug Substance (DS), Drug Product (DP), and Device, Packaging & Distribution (DDP) networks.
The Technology Deployment Groups (TDGs) within the gMSAT departments are the ultimate strategic connectors in our technology standardization framework. They coordinate the collection and assessment of both network-wide operational "pains" and emerging local innovations, bridging the gap between local site realities and globally endorsed network standards.

The Opportunity
As a vital member within the Drug Substance Technology Deployment Group, the Robotics Technology Deployment Steward serves as the primary execution engine bridging central strategy with site-level manufacturing operations. Working in close partnership with the Robotics Technology Strategy Lead, this role supports technology scouting, translates high-level strategy into value-driven proofs-of-concept (PoCs), and leads the tactical roll-out of standardized robotics and automation solutions to directly address operational pain points across our global production sites.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】
担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、臨床検査センターなどを対象に、新規開拓を中心としたコンサルティング営業をお任せします。 まだ自社製品を導入していない医療施設へアプローチし、医療現場や検査室が抱える課題をヒアリングから抽出、解消に導くことが最優先のミッションです。自社製品をただ売り込むのではなく、お客様の課題解決に向けた最適なソリューションを提供していただきます。

【業務内容】
1. 新規開拓・コンサルティング提案営業（メインミッション）

• 臨床検査技師などの現場担当者から、医師、事務長そして経営層まで幅広くアプローチし、検査室の課題を抽出します。製品導入によって見込まれる改善点や新しい提案を粘り強く行い、新規導入を目指します。

• 生化学、免疫、遺伝子（PCR）、病理領域の検査機器をはじめ、検査室自動化やITソリューション、デジタルソリューションまで、多岐にわたる製品群の中から、顧客のニーズに合わせて最適な解決策を組み立て、費用対効果（ROI）の提示や契約交渉を行います。

2. 既存顧客への運用サポートおよび社内連携

• すでに導入いただいているお客様に対して運用面の課題解消もサポートしますが、業務の主軸は新規開拓となります。

• 学術やエンジニアリングなど社内の専門部署と緊密に連携し、どうすればお客様にとって最適なサポートができるかを常に考え、関係各所を巻き込んでプロジェクトを推進していただきます。

【応募資格（必須要件）】

• 法人向け（BtoB） 課題解決型の提案営業経験をお持ちの方（業界不問）

「モノ売り」ではなく、顧客の本質課題に対して自社のあらゆるリソース（技術・サービス・ノウハウ等）を最適に掛け合わせたソリューション提案ができる方
　　　　現場担当者だけでなく、経営層・役員クラスといった意思決定者（キーマン）を巻き込み、強固なリレーションを構築できる方
　　　　　※上記いずれかの動き方で、継続的に高いパフォーマンスを出された実績を重視します。

• 普通自動車第一種運転免許 （AT限定可）

【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】

• 医療業界における新規開拓営業の経験。

• 臨床検査領域における専門知識、または同関連製品の営業経験。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方

• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方

• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方

• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　営業職（DMR）
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
就業場所
（雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　 営業手当：月70,000円～
　　＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】
担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、臨床検査センターなどを対象に、新規開拓を中心としたコンサルティング営業をお任せします。 まだ自社製品を導入していない医療施設へアプローチし、医療現場や検査室が抱える課題をヒアリングから抽出、解消に導くことが最優先のミッションです。自社製品をただ売り込むのではなく、お客様の課題解決に向けた最適なソリューションを提供していただきます。

【業務内容】
1. 新規開拓・コンサルティング提案営業（メインミッション）

• 臨床検査技師などの現場担当者から、医師、事務長そして経営層まで幅広くアプローチし、検査室の課題を抽出します。製品導入によって見込まれる改善点や新しい提案を粘り強く行い、新規導入を目指します。

• 生化学、免疫、遺伝子（PCR）、病理領域の検査機器をはじめ、検査室自動化やITソリューション、デジタルソリューションまで、多岐にわたる製品群の中から、顧客のニーズに合わせて最適な解決策を組み立て、費用対効果（ROI）の提示や契約交渉を行います。

2. 既存顧客への運用サポートおよび社内連携

• すでに導入いただいているお客様に対して運用面の課題解消もサポートしますが、業務の主軸は新規開拓となります。

• 学術やエンジニアリングなど社内の専門部署と緊密に連携し、どうすればお客様にとって最適なサポートができるかを常に考え、関係各所を巻き込んでプロジェクトを推進していただきます。

【応募資格（必須要件）】

• 法人向け（BtoB） 課題解決型の提案営業経験をお持ちの方（業界不問）

「モノ売り」ではなく、顧客の本質課題に対して自社のあらゆるリソース（技術・サービス・ノウハウ等）を最適に掛け合わせたソリューション提案ができる方
　　　現場担当者だけでなく、経営層・役員クラスといった意思決定者（キーマン）を巻き込み、強固なリレーションを構築できる方
　　　　　※上記いずれかの動き方で、継続的に高いパフォーマンスを出された実績を重視します。

• 普通自動車第一種運転免許（AT限定可）

【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】

• 医療業界における新規開拓営業の経験。

• 臨床検査領域における専門知識、または同関連製品の営業経験。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方

• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方

• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方

• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。
