jobs.title: ERP Business Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
As a Senior ERP Business Analyst, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams within the SAP Sales and Distribution (SD / Market Plan to Cash) functional area. You will tackle complex business problems with emerging ambiguity, demonstrating a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical business domain, related enterprise technologies, and cross-module interdependencies. In this role, you will apply advanced BA tools and techniques to translate business requirements into strategic implementation plans and solution designs. You will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shape stakeholder perspectives, and drive the design, validation, and delivery of scalable SAP solutions. Additionally, you will mentor junior analysts and actively contribute to the ERP Community of Practice (CoP).

Description of the Area
This role supports the Marketing Plan to Cash (MP2C) value stream and is aligned with the ASPIRE roadmap, a multi-year global initiative aiming to define and develop functional ERP roadmaps that simplify, standardize, and automate core business processes leveraging SAP industry best practices. The team focuses on delivering high-impact Order-to-Cash offerings and integrating SAP SD seamlessly across global enterprise platforms.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams for the SAP SD (Market Plan to Cash) domain without guidance. Adapt and adhere to Roche standard frameworks, mentor junior and intermediate BAs, and drive/lead practices in end-to-end process design and optimization. Work in close partnership with business stakeholders to define, design, build, test, and deploy functional ERP solutions based on SAP ECC and S/4 HANA best practices.

• Accountability / Problem Solving: Perform root cause analysis on complex business issues and lead Key Design Decisions. Accountable for creating comprehensive documentation (functional and technical specifications, test plans) and configuring, building, testing, and deploying SAP SD solutions alongside implementation partners, as well as coordinating production changes and providing L3 support for live operational systems.

• Stakeholder Management: Build strong, trusted partnerships across business and IT teams. Facilitate design workshops, resolve conflicts, manage expectations, and coordinate changes across cross-functional departments in the Agile Release Trains (ARTs) and gain endorsement across global IT and business teams.

• Impact / Strategy: Translate business requirements into strategic implementation plans and global solution roadmaps that maximize business value and minimize solution duplication. Evaluate solution alternatives and ensure continuous product increments aligned with long-term domain goals.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Manage requirements and system interdependencies across complex multi-solution enterprise landscapes. Oversee and ensure integrations between SAP SD and adjacent applications, including SFDC, SAP Hybris, 3PL/4PL integration solutions.

• Business / Technical Ability: Apply deep domain and technical expertise in SAP SD customizing, configuration, and interface monitoring (iDoc, XML, Web Services, RFC, CIF). Ensure strict adherence to Roche IT standards, including security, privacy, IT Quality, GxP compliance, and Computer System Validation (CSV) requirements.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor of Science in Computer Systems, Compute

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro
In qualità di Senior ERP Business Analyst, gestirai in modo indipendente i flussi di lavoro di analisi aziendali end-to-end all'interno dell'area funzionale SAP Sales and Distribution (SD / Market Plan to Cash). Si affronteranno problemi di business complessi con ambiguità emergente, dimostrando una profonda comprensione del settore farmaceutico, le tecnologie aziendali correlate e interdipendenze trasversali. In questo ruolo, si applica strumenti e tecniche BA avanzati per tradurre i requisiti aziendali in piani di implementazione strategica e progetti di soluzioni. Potrai fungere da consulente affidabile per team interfunzionali, modellare le prospettive degli stakeholder e guidare la progettazione, la convalida e la consegna di soluzioni SAP scalabili. Inoltre, tu guiderai gli analisti junior e contribuirai attivamente alla Comunità ERP di Pratica (CoP).

Descrizione dell'Area
Questo ruolo supporta il Marketing Plan to Cash (MP2C) value stream ed è allineato con la roadmap ASPIRE, un'iniziativa globale pluriennale che mira a definire e sviluppare roadmap ERP funzionali che semplificano, standardzzano e automatizzano i processi di core business sfruttando le migliori pratiche del settore SAP. Il team si concentra sulla fornitura di offerte Order-to-Cash ad alto impatto e l'integrazione di SAP SD senza soluzione di continuità su piattaforme aziendali globali.

Responsabilità del lavoro

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Gestione indipendente dei flussi di lavoro di analisi aziendali end-to-end per il dominio SAP SD (Market Plan to Cash) senza guida. Adapt e aderire alle strutture standard Roche, mentore BA junior e intermedie, e le pratiche di drive/lead nella progettazione e ottimizzazione del processo end-to-end. Lavorare in stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder aziendali per definire, progettare, costruire, testare e implementare soluzioni ERP funzionali basate sulle best practice SAP ECC e S/4 HANA.

• Responsabilità / Problem Solving: Eseguire l'analisi della causa radice su questioni aziendali complesse e condurre le decisioni di Key Design. Contabile per la creazione di una documentazione completa (specifiche funzionali e tecniche, piani di test) e la configurazione, la costruzione, il test e la distribuzione di soluzioni SAP SD insieme ai partner di implementazione, oltre a coordinare i cambiamenti di produzione e fornire supporto L3 per i sistemi operativi dal vivo.

• Stakeholder Management: Costruire partnership forti e affidabili tra i team aziendali e IT. Facilitare i workshop di progettazione, risolvere i conflitti, gestire le aspettative e coordinare i cambiamenti tra i dipartimenti interfunzionali nei Treni di rilascio Agile (ART) e ottenere l'approvazione in team IT e business globali.

• Impatto / Strategia: Traduci i requisiti aziendali in piani di implementazione strategica e roadmap di soluzione globale che massimizzano il valore aziendale e minimizzano la duplicazione della soluzione. Valutare alternative di soluzione e garantire incrementi continui di prodotto allineati con obiettivi di dominio a lungo termine.

• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): gestire requisiti e interdipendenze di sistema attraverso complessi paesaggi aziendali multi-soluzione. Superare e garantire integrazioni tra SAP SD e applicazioni adiacenti, tra cui SFDC, SAP Hybris, soluzioni di integrazione 3PL/4PL.

• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: Applicare il dominio profondo e le competenze tecniche in SAP SD personalizzazione, configurazione e monitoraggio dell'interfaccia (iDoc, XML, Web Services, RFC, CIF). Assicurare una stretta adesione agli standard Roche IT, compresi i requisiti di sicurezza, privacy, qualità IT, conformità GxP e convalida del sistema informatico (CSV).

Qualifiche
Istruzione / Esperienza

• Corso di laurea in sistemi informatici, Compute

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Stellenbeschreibung
Als Senior ERP Business Analyst verwalten Sie selbstständig End-to-End Business Analyse Workstreams im Funktionsbereich SAP Sales and Distribution (SD / Market Plan to Cash). Sie werden komplexe Geschäftsprobleme mit aufkommenden Mehrdeutigkeiten angehen und ein tiefes Verständnis des pharmazeutischen Geschäftsbereichs, verwandter Unternehmenstechnologien und modulübergreifender Interdependenzen demonstrieren. In dieser Rolle wenden Sie fortschrittliche BA-Tools und -Techniken an, um Geschäftsanforderungen in strategische Umsetzungspläne und Lösungsdesigns umzusetzen. Sie fungieren als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für funktionsübergreifende Teams, gestalten Stakeholder-Perspektiven und treiben das Design, die Validierung und die Bereitstellung skalierbarer SAP-Lösungen voran. Darüber hinaus betreuen Sie Junior Analysten und tragen aktiv zur ERP Community of Practice (CoP) bei.

Beschreibung des Gebiets
Diese Rolle unterstützt den Marketing Plan to Cash (MP2C) Value Stream und ist auf die ASPIRE Roadmap ausgerichtet, eine mehrjährige globale Initiative, die darauf abzielt, funktionale ERP-Roadmaps zu definieren und zu entwickeln, die Kerngeschäftsprozesse vereinfachen, standardisieren und automatisieren, indem sie die Best Practices der SAP-Branche nutzen. Das Team konzentriert sich auf die Bereitstellung wirkungsvoller Order-to-Cash-Angebote und die nahtlose Integration von SAP SD auf globalen Unternehmensplattformen.

Aufgabenbereich

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Unabhängige Verwaltung von End-to-End-Workstreams für die SAP SD-Domain (Market Plan to Cash) ohne Anleitung. Anpassung und Einhaltung von Roche-Standard-Frameworks, Mentor-Junior- und Intermediate-BAs sowie Drive/Lead-Praktiken bei der End-to-End-Prozessgestaltung und -optimierung. Arbeiten Sie in enger Partnerschaft mit Geschäftsinteressenten, um funktionale ERP-Lösungen basierend auf den Best Practices von SAP ECC und S/4 HANA zu definieren, zu entwerfen, zu erstellen, zu testen und bereitzustellen.

• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Führen Sie eine Ursachenanalyse zu komplexen Geschäftsproblemen durch und leiten Sie wichtige Designentscheidungen. Verantwortlich für die Erstellung einer umfassenden Dokumentation (funktionelle und technische Spezifikationen, Testpläne) und die Konfiguration, Erstellung, Prüfung und Bereitstellung von SAP SD-Lösungen neben Implementierungspartnern sowie für die Koordination von Produktionsänderungen und die Bereitstellung von L3-Support für Live-Betriebssysteme.

• Stakeholder Management: Aufbau starker, vertrauenswürdiger Partnerschaften zwischen Geschäfts- und IT-Teams. Ermöglichen Sie Design-Workshops, lösen Sie Konflikte, verwalten Sie Erwartungen und koordinieren Sie Änderungen in den funktionsübergreifenden Abteilungen in den Agile Release Trains (ARTs) und erhalten Sie Unterstützung in globalen IT- und Geschäftsteams.

• Auswirkung / Strategie: Übersetzen Sie Geschäftsanforderungen in strategische Umsetzungspläne und globale Lösungs-Roadmaps, die den Geschäftswert maximieren und die Lösungsduplizierung minimieren. Bewerten Sie Lösungsalternativen und sorgen Sie für kontinuierliche Produktinkremente, die auf langfristige Domainziele ausgerichtet sind.

• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Verwalten Sie Anforderungen und Systemabhängigkeiten in komplexen Multi-Lösungs-Unternehmenslandschaften. Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Integration zwischen SAP SD und benachbarten Anwendungen, einschließlich SFDC, SAP Hybris und 3PL/4PL-Integrationslösungen.

• Business / Technical Ability: Wenden Sie umfassendes Fachwissen in den Bereichen SAP SD Customizing, Konfiguration und Schnittstellenüberwachung an (iDoc, XML, Web Services, RFC, CIF). Gewährleistung der strikten Einhaltung der Roche IT-Standards, einschließlich Sicherheit, Datenschutz, IT-Qualität, GxP-Compliance und CSV-Anforderungen (Computer System Validation).

Qualifikationen
Bildung / Erfahrung

• Bachelor of Science in Computersystemen, Compute
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Description de l'emploi
En tant qu'analyste principal de l'ERP, vous gérerez de façon indépendante les flux de travail d'analyse opérationnelle de bout en bout dans le domaine fonctionnel des ventes et de la distribution SAP (SD / Market Plan to Cash). Vous vous attaquerez à des problèmes d'affaires complexes avec une ambiguïté émergente, démontrant une compréhension profonde du domaine des affaires pharmaceutiques, des technologies d'entreprise connexes, et des interdépendances entre modules. Dans ce rôle, vous appliquerez des outils et des techniques avancés de BA pour traduire les exigences opérationnelles en plans stratégiques de mise en œuvre et en conception de solutions. Vous agirez en tant que conseiller de confiance pour les équipes interfonctionnelles, façonnerez les perspectives des intervenants et dirigerez la conception, la validation et la livraison de solutions SAP évolutives. De plus, vous encadrerez les analystes subalternes et contribuerez activement à la communauté de pratique ERP (CoP).

Description de la zone
Ce rôle soutient le volet de valeur du Plan de marketing en espèces (MP2C) et est aligné sur la feuille de route ASPIRE, une initiative mondiale pluriannuelle visant à définir et à élaborer des feuilles de route ERP fonctionnelles qui simplifient, standardisent et automatisent les processus opérationnels de base en tirant parti des meilleures pratiques de l'industrie SAP. L'équipe se concentre sur la prestation d'offres d'ordre en espèces à fort impact et l'intégration de SAP SD sans faille dans les plateformes d'entreprise mondiales.

Responsabilités professionnelles

• Portée / ( Leadership en matière de contenu) : Gérer indépendamment les volets de travail d'analyse opérationnelle de bout en bout pour le domaine du DD SAP (Plan de marché en espèces) sans orientation. Adaptez et respectez les cadres standard Roche, mentorez les B.A. juniors et intermédiaires, ainsi que les pratiques de conduite et de leadership dans la conception et l'optimisation des processus de bout en bout. Travailler en partenariat étroit avec les parties prenantes pour définir, concevoir, construire, tester et déployer des solutions ERP fonctionnelles basées sur les meilleures pratiques SAP ECC et S/4 HANA.

• Responsabilité / résolution de problèmes : Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes sur des questions opérationnelles complexes et diriger les décisions clés en matière de conception. Responsable de la création d'une documentation complète (spécifications fonctionnelles et techniques, plans de test) et de la configuration, de la construction, de l'essai et du déploiement de solutions SAP SD aux côtés des partenaires de mise en œuvre, ainsi que de la coordination des changements de production et de la fourniture d'un support L3 pour les systèmes opérationnels en direct.

• Gestion des intervenants : Établir des partenariats solides et fiables entre les équipes d'affaires et de TI. Faciliter les ateliers de conception, résoudre les conflits, gérer les attentes et coordonner les changements à l'échelle des ministères interfonctionnels dans les trains de mainlevée Agile (ART) et obtenir l'approbation des équipes mondiales de TI et d'affaires.

• Impact / Stratégie : Traduire les exigences opérationnelles en plans de mise en oeuvre stratégiques et en feuilles de route des solutions globales qui maximisent la valeur opérationnelle et réduisent le double emploi des solutions. Évaluer les solutions de rechange et veiller à ce que les incréments continus du produit soient alignés sur les objectifs à long terme du domaine.

• Complexité / (Taille du produit): Gérer les exigences et les interdépendances du système sur les paysages d'entreprise multisolution complexes. Surveiller et assurer les intégrations entre SAP SD et les applications adjacentes, y compris SFDC, SAP Hybris, 3PL/4PL solutions d'intégration.

• Capacités d'affaires / techniques : Appliquer une expertise technique et domaine profond dans la personnalisation, la configuration et la surveillance de l'interface (iDoc, XML, Web Services, RFC, CIF). Veiller au strict respect des normes de Roche en matière de TI, y compris les exigences en matière de sécurité, de confidentialité, de qualité des TI, de conformité GxP et de validation des systèmes informatiques (CSV).

Compétences
Éducation / Expérience

• Baccalauréat en sciences en systèmes informatiques, calcul

jobs.title: Cybersecurity & Security Advisory Manager (SAP Expert)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
By combining our unique strengths, we’re redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. Discover what it’s like to work at Roche.

The Opportunity
The Security and Cybersecurity Expert provides expert-level leadership and strategic guidance across the organization's critical security programs and initiatives. This role manages a team of analysts, establishes team objectives and processes, and develops enterprise-wide security best practices that ensure consistency and alignment with organizational standards. The position combines hands-on oversight of high-impact projects with mentorship of less experienced team members, while maintaining quality assurance and strategic alignment across all security initiatives.

Responsibilities
Accountability/Problem Solving

• Leads comprehensive analysis of complex, strategic business problems across organizational boundaries, conducting root cause analysis and eliciting stakeholder needs to influence sound decision-making and drive consensus through persuasive communication

• Demonstrates mastery in requirements and domain knowledge, providing thought leadership on unusually complex problems with innovative solutions; mentors colleagues, leads large-scale process improvement initiatives, and guides strategic change adaptation while ensuring deliverables align with strategic objectives

Stakeholder Management

• Identifies and analyzes complex stakeholder networks across organizational boundaries and global teams, developing comprehensive engagement and communication plans that drive consensus on strategic vision while building and maintaining strong relationships across the organization

• Acts as a master negotiator and trusted advisor to leadership, navigating complex conflicts to achieve alignment, empowering teams in stakeholder management, and serving as a role model in collaboration and organizational trust-building

Impact/Strategy

• Drives significant, consistent impact across major products and domains by ensuring delivery of high-value solutions aligned with business strategy, embedding best practices, and leveraging industry trends to influence organizational strategy and foster continuous improvement

• Leads evaluation and implementation of optimal strategic solutions and transitions across large, complex projects spanning multiple domains; manages highly ambiguous requirements holistically while ensuring traceability and alignment with broader organizational goals

Who you are

• Advanced technical proficiency in Java, JavaScript, AWS (Amazon Web Services), and SAP Customer Data Cloud (SAPCDC), with comprehensive knowledge of cybersecurity technologies and enterprise systems

• In-depth understanding of business domain, organizational strategy, and Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy concepts; ability to apply systems thinking for holistic, enterprise-wide security consulting

• Demonstrated expertise in complex root cause analysis, requirements elicitation, strategic solution evaluation, and traceability principles across organizational boundaries

• Proven leadership and mentoring capabilities with ability to manage technical teams, build consensus among senior stakeholders, and establish trusted advisory relationships that influence strategic decisions

• Track record of driving significant impact through large-scale process improvements, change management initiatives, and thought leadership in emerging security trends and industry best pract

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
PJP Ophtalmology
Preffered Location: Moravia region

The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.

The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions. This role is functionally agnostic.

Responsibilities
● The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
● Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
● Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.
● Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.
● By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem.
● The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs.
● Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services.
Mindset & Behaviors
● The PJP demonstrates personal purpose around improving the patient journey, as well as strong passion to create value and impact on the ecosystem. They think from an Enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, in order to bring best possible outcomes to both the local health environment, and more broadly, across Roche globally.

● Visionary: defining and embedding the strategy around creating improved patient journeys

● Mindset:
○ Strong entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding partnering capabilities (ability to deeply listen, question and understand)
○ Growth mindset, able to learn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche
○ Self managed and self directed - altruistic in supporting the global network
○ Display of integrity in everything (i.e. open, honest, ethical and genuine)

● Enabler mindset leveraging the internal and external networks to create value, sharing back and scaling.
● Boldly acts on key decisions and opportunities and boldly stops any activity that is not adding value. Ability to say “No” to stakeholders when the value is not predictable/foreseen.

Experiences, Knowledge and
• Qualifications
Skills and Experience:
● System thinker and deep listener
● Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with T

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the Role & Team
As a member of our newly established ERP Make & Asset Management team within Roche Digital Technology (RDT), you will be a vital asset in driving our global operations forward. We are looking for a collaborative expert who doesn't just configure systems, but deeply understands end-to-end (E2E) manufacturing process flows and integration dynamics in a complex, multi-partner environment.
Rather than working in a silo, you will work hand-in-hand with Roche internal teams and global vendors to ensure seamless daily operations and drive continuous business improvements. If you thrive on taking true ownership, connecting the dots across system boundaries, and diving into complex supply chain networks to solve tough challenges, this role is built for you.
Key Responsibilities

• E2E Solution Delivery & Integration: Work as a key contributor within the Make team to design, deliver, and support ERP capabilities supporting External Manufacturing and collaboration platforms (GEP Nexxe). Drive strong integration logic across internal SAP modules and partner platforms.

• Process Flow & Operations Support: Ensure smooth daily operations while supporting the business with new features, integrations, and changing operational needs. Apply a strong "process-first" mindset to ensure end-to-end data integrity across system boundaries.

• E2E Ownership & Problem Solving: Take full accountability for complex, cross-system operational and technical challenges. Dig deep into end-to-end process flows to identify root causes and proactively propose sustainable, scalable solutions—even when navigating crowded stakeholder environments.

• Stakeholder & Partner Collaboration: Act as a core bridge between Roche internal business teams, RDT cross functional teams and external system provider. Facilitate clear communication, align expectations, and foster strong team dynamics across a multi-player matrix.

• Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Continuously evaluate current solutions against business requirements to streamline external partner collaboration, reduce friction, and align with global ERP roadmaps.

Qualifications & Experience

• Domain Expertise: Solid hands-on experience in SAP ERP / S/4HANA (MM & QM modules) . Demonstrated expertise in External Manufacturing and collaboration tools (e.g., SAP Ariba, SNC, E2open, Coupa, or O9 Solutions), with proven experience integrating these tools with S/4HANA using middleware such as Mulesoft, SAP CPI, or Tibco.

• End-to-End & Integration Thinking: Strong understanding of E2E manufacturing process flows and key integration points (Procurement, Inventory Management, Quality Control, Supply Chain, and Third-Party System Interfaces via middleware/APIs).

• Curious & Analytical Mindset: High analytical capabilities combined with a relentless curiosity to see "the big picture." You are not satisfied with surface-level fixes; you take pride in understanding why a process works and taking the effort to solve complex topics thoroughly.

• Self-Driven & Accountable: A self-starter who takes personal ownership of outcomes. Comfortable taking the lead, going the extra mile to get alignment, and navigating ambiguous or high-touch situations involving multiple stakeholders.

• Business Process First: Advanced problem-solving skills with a strong process-oriented mindset. You understand business operational impact , not just system configuration.

• Global & Collaborative Mindset: Demonstrated experience working eff

jobs.title: Digital Solutions Business Developer (PEC)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Driving sustainable impact
Our responsibility extends beyond innovation. You'll contribute to solutions that improve healthcare by addressing the most pressing health challenges and diseases with the highest social burden, while reducing our impact on the planet. Together, we create a healthier workplace, society, and future for generations to come.

The Opportunity
Develop the market and business for digital solutions in Peru and/or Ecuador. The purpose is to plan, execute, and monitor digital consulting strategies that positively influence client decision-making, transforming the needs of healthcare institutions into technological innovation projects that generate value, efficiency, and growth for Roche.

Responsibilities
Business Development

• Market Expansion & Demand Generation: Identify and develop new business opportunities for digital solutions while collaborating with sales and marketing to drive adoption and expand the market.

• Technical Advocacy & Support: Serve as the expert technology reference, delivering technical talks and presentations to evangelize and support internal and external teams.

Strategic Relationship Building and Adoption

• Executive & Decision-Maker Engagement: Build long-term relationships with C-Level executives (CEOs, IT Managers, Medical Directors) and key government stakeholders in Peru and Ecuador to position digital solutions.

• Solution Deployment & Adoption: Partner with technical teams to ensure seamless implementation, driving long-term technology adoption and value perception for clients.

Mindset, Skills and Behaviors

• Digital Systems & Strategic Thinking: Connect data architecture directly to improved health outcomes to demonstrate measurable value.

• Lateral Leadership & Alignment: Influence and align cross-functional internal teams to successfully execute complex business opportunities.

• Resilient Communication & Negotiation: Navigate long sales cycles and present high-level, persuasive proposals aligned with client financial objectives.

Who you are: ​

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Business, Marketing, or a related field; an MBA or Master’s in Management is highly valued.

• Advanced English proficiency.

• Strong strategic thinking and agility to translate technology trends into market expansion and drive successful client adoption.

• Ability to serve as a trusted technology advisor, effectively inspiring and influencing IT managers and C-level executives.

• Proven capacity to navigate and resolve technical and operational barriers during the implementation of digital solutions.

Relocation benefits not available for this job posting.
​

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

You'll contribute to solutions that improve healthcare by addressing the most pressing health challenges and diseases with the highest social burden, while reducing our impact on the planet. Together, we create a healthier workplace, society, and future for generations to come.

The Opportunity
Develop the market and business for digital solutions in Peru and/or Ecuador. The purpose is to plan, execute, and monitor digital consulting strategies that positively influence client decision-making, transforming the needs of healthcare institutions into technological innovation projects that generate value, efficiency, and growth for Roche.

Responsibilities
Business Development

• Market Expansion & Demand Generation: Identify and develop new business opportunities for digital solutions while collaborating with sales and marketing to drive adoption and expand the market.

• Technical Advocacy & Support: Serve as the expert technology reference, delivering technical talks and presentations to evangelize and support internal and external teams.

Strategic Relationship Building and Adoption

• Executive & Decision-Maker Engagement: Build long-term relationships with C-Level executives (CEOs, IT Managers, Medical Directors) and key government stakeholders in Peru and Ecuador to position digital solutions.

• Solution Deployment & Adoption: Partner with technical teams to ensure seamless implementation, driving long-term technology adoption and value perception for clients.

Mindset, Skills and Behaviors

• Digital Systems & Strategic Thinking: Connect data architecture directly to improved health outcomes to demonstrate measurable value.

• Lateral Leadership & Alignment: Influence and align cross-functional internal teams to successfully execute complex business opportunities.

• Resilient Communication & Negotiation: Navigate long sales cycles and present high-level, persuasive proposals aligned with client financial objectives.

Who you are: ​

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Business, Marketing, or a related field; an MBA or Master’s in Management is highly valued.

• Advanced English proficiency.

• Strong strategic thinking and agility to translate technology trends into market expansion and drive successful client adoption.

• Ability to serve as a trusted technology advisor, effectively inspiring and influencing IT managers and C-level executives.

• Proven capacity to navigate and resolve technical and operational barriers during the implementation of digital solutions.

Relocation benefits not available for this job posting.
​

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Reagent Manufacturing Supervisor - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Manufacturing Supervisor, you will be supporting a fast-paced operation to deliver diagnostic products and ensure continuous quality, schedule adherence, and efficient production. You will be a member of the Operations Extended Leadership Team, interfacing with other Operations Extended Leadership Team members to deliver on goals and/or collaborate to drive business strategy.

You will operate per internal and external quality and safety requirements and work with area leadership to evaluate production process data and drive continuous improvement cross-functionally to achieve operational KPIs.
The Opportunity
2nd Shift Hours: 2:00 pm-10:30 pm

• Leads and empowers direct reports or teams; provides coaching, training and opportunities to develop skills, and gives ongoing, constructive and timely feedback on performance and progress toward goals and expectations.

• Identifies scheduling conflicts, production issues and equipment maintenance needs and collaborates with support functions for resolution.

• Coordinates with process lead for resource management.

• Responsible for production manufacturing adherence and maintains a thorough understanding of end-to-end production processes.

• Sets goals and aligns deliverables for shifts and processes and reports out misses to daily, weekly and monthly goals and implements corrective actions.

• Creates a lean culture by empowering the workforce to provide and implement ideas to continuously improve and reduce waste while acting as a change agent to drive a culture of continuous improvement by actively demonstrating the use of lean manufacturing tools in everything the team does.

• Collaborates with peers in other shifts/functions and support functions to drive value stream, lean manufacturing improvement and global projects/ initiatives.

Who You Are

• You have a Bachelor's degree. STEM Degree preferred.

• You have 4 years of relevant experience in production, manufacturing, supply chain or related field, of which 2 years include process, people or project leader experience.

Preferred

• Demonstrated ability to develop and lead a high-performing team.

• Ability to influence all levels of staff and management.

• Experience working in a regulated environment.

• Proven skills and experience with process improvement.

• Proficient written, verbal communication and presentation skills.

• Strong team leadership abilities according to VACC principles.

• Demonstrated ability to make data-driven decisions.

• Critical thinking, problem solving and a can-do attitude are required.

Relocation Benefits are not available for this posting

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson, AZ is 75,000.00 - 139,400.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

jobs.title: Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
The Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry is specialized in launching, selling and promoting our breakthrough Mass Spectrometry solution to customers in the territory. Implements sales plans designed to achieve established revenue and financial goals. Accounts are key, highly strategic, and have complex requirements.

Responsible for significant key partner relationship management and development strategy for strategic accounts and ensures the strategy is executed. Sells the company's products or services to new accounts and/or expands existing accounts. Responsible for the development of new business opportunities or emerging areas. Focuses on critical, large, complex, highly visible, strategic or tactically important accounts. Develops and presents comprehensive financial proposals and contracts which enhance profitability and protect margins. Works in coordination with Account Managers to call on prospective and current customers. Conducts demonstration sessions on product characteristics. Involves technical personnel to resolve customer issues and problems as needed. May participate in the establishment of sales targets and design of the territory's sales plan, manages sales expenses.

Has broad expertise or unique knowledge in the lab testing segment and specific LC/MS experience is preferred. Uses skills to contribute to development of company objectives and principles and to achieve goals in creative and effective ways. Viewed as an expert by the company and in the field. Has complete knowledge of all Mass Spectrometry products and services and may be tasked with sales/development of new or strategic products. Works on significant and unique issues where analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of intangibles. Exercises independent judgment in methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Creates formal networks involving coordination among groups.

This is a field based role. The territory is Midwest US.

Job Facts:

• Manages and leads the development and implementation of capital equipment sales strategies to attain assigned sales objectives for highly strategic accounts

• Provides professional leadership in planning, organizing, and controlling balanced sales growth, continued account penetration, and customer satisfaction.

• Utilizes strong product/market knowledge and sales experience to manage complex sales and resolve customer questions and concerns.

• Retains, extends, and acquires customers through effective identification of opportunities and the creation and implementation of solutions.

• Establishes and builds strong client relationships that allow for growth, profitability and predictability. Communicates with other relevant Roche functions to ensure needed sales support and delivery of programs/products.

• Overnight travel as needed, including short notice, to most effectively and efficiently cover territory while maximizing customer facing time.

• Navigates the financial landscape of complex health systems, helping them to maximize their capital budget cycles to achieve growth goals

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

• 7+

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Specialista del Conto Regionale - Spettrometria di Massa

Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

L'opportunità:
Il Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry è specializzato nel lanciare, vendere e promuovere la nostra soluzione Mass Spectrometry innovativa ai clienti del territorio. Attuazione piani di vendita progettati per raggiungere i ricavi consolidati e obiettivi finanziari. I conti sono fondamentali, altamente strategici e hanno requisiti complessi.

Responsabile di una significativa strategia di gestione e sviluppo delle relazioni con i partner chiave per i conti strategici e garantisce l'esecuzione della strategia. Vende i prodotti o servizi dell'azienda a nuovi account e/o amplia i conti esistenti. Responsabile per lo sviluppo di nuove opportunità di business o aree emergenti. Si concentra su conti critici, grandi, complessi, altamente visibili, strategici o tatticamente importanti. Sviluppa e presenta proposte finanziarie e contratti completi che migliorano la redditività e proteggono i margini. Funziona in coordinamento con Account Manager per chiamare i clienti potenziali e attuali. Conduce sessioni dimostrative sulle caratteristiche del prodotto. Invola il personale tecnico per risolvere i problemi e i problemi del cliente come necessario. Può partecipare alla creazione di obiettivi di vendita e progettazione del piano di vendita del territorio, gestisce le spese di vendita.

Ha una vasta esperienza o una conoscenza unica nel segmento di test di laboratorio e l'esperienza specifica LC/MS è preferita. Utilizza le competenze per contribuire allo sviluppo di obiettivi e principi aziendali e per raggiungere gli obiettivi in modi creativi ed efficaci. Visto come esperto della società e del settore. Ha conoscenza completa di tutti i prodotti e servizi Mass Spectrometry e può essere incaricato di vendite / sviluppo di nuovi o prodotti strategici. Funziona su questioni significative e uniche in cui l'analisi di situazioni o dati richiede una valutazione di immateriali. Esercizi giudizio indipendente in metodi, tecniche e criteri di valutazione per ottenere risultati. Crea reti formali che coinvolgono il coordinamento tra i gruppi.

Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo. Il territorio è degli Stati Uniti del Midwest.

Fatti di lavoro:

• Gestisce e guida lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di strategie di vendita di attrezzature di capitale per raggiungere obiettivi di vendita assegnati per conti altamente strategici

• Fornisce leadership professionale nella pianificazione, nell'organizzazione e nel controllo della crescita delle vendite equilibrata, nella penetrazione continua del conto e nella soddisfazione del cliente.

• Utilizza la forte conoscenza del prodotto/mercato e l'esperienza di vendita per gestire le vendite complesse e risolvere le domande e le preoccupazioni del cliente.

• Mantiene, estende e acquisisce i clienti attraverso un'efficace identificazione delle opportunità e la creazione e l'implementazione di soluzioni.

• Stabilisce e costruisce forti relazioni con i clienti che permettono la crescita, la redditività e la prevedibilità. Comunica con altre funzioni Roche rilevanti per garantire il supporto di vendita necessario e la consegna di programmi / prodotti.

• Pernottamento di viaggio secondo necessità, tra cui breve preavviso, per coprire in modo più efficace ed efficiente il territorio, massimizzando il tempo di affrontare il cliente.

• Naviga il paesaggio finanziario di complessi sistemi sanitari, aiutandoli a massimizzare i loro cicli di budget per raggiungere gli obiettivi di crescita

Chi sei:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza equivalente

• 7+

Considéré comme un expert par l'entreprise et dans le domaine. A une connaissance complète de tous les produits et services de spectrométrie de masse et peut être chargé de la vente ou du développement de produits nouveaux ou stratégiques. • Offre un leadership professionnel dans la planification, l'organisation et le contrôle de la croissance équilibrée des ventes, la pénétration continue des comptes et la satisfaction de la clientèle.

• Voyages de nuit au besoin, y compris un court préavis, pour couvrir le territoire le plus efficacement et efficacement tout en maximisant le temps face aux clients.

jobs.title: Central Operations Specialist (PV, Pharmacovigilance)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Are you ready to play a pivotal role in transforming how patient safety data is delivered globally?

As our Central Operations Specialist within Patient Safety Operations , you will be at the heart of our mission to ensure the efficient, high-quality, and compliant delivery of safety data outputs. You will process and report Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs) and device safety reports, via the utilisation of current/future safety systems, and use of vendor services, and co-develop innovative approaches for the transformation and reporting of wider types of safety-relevant data, beyond ICSRs.

In this dynamic role, you will collaborate closely with global vendors, business process owners, and cross-functional teams to maintain our inspection readiness and drive continuous improvements. You will have the unique opportunity to support change initiatives, explore cutting-edge technologies like artificial intelligence in pharmacovigilance, and guide our operations to meet both current and future regulatory requirements.

• Oversee Safety Data Quality: Monitor workload, compliance, and quality across the global ICSR footprint to ensure internal and external performance standards are consistently met.

• Manage Vendor & Process Collaboration: Support the oversight, coordination, and inspection readiness of ICSR and medical device safety activities in collaboration with external vendors and internal alliance managers.

• Drive Continuous Improvement: Develop, maintain, and review metrics and KPIs to identify and execute process enhancements within safety reporting sub-processes.

• Lead AI & Innovation Initiatives: Support the implementation of AI-augmented activities and human-in-the-loop interventions to optimize operational safety report delivery.

• Provide Governance & Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a key point of contact for queries and issue escalations, supporting Case Processing Governance across Patient Safety Operations sites.

• Support Regulatory Reporting Projects: Execute and coordinate regulatory reporting projects for Roche products by preparing documentation and ensuring adherence to established quality standards.

Who You Are

• Industry Experience: A minimum of 2 years of relevant experience within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably with an emphasis on pharmacovigilance.

• PV Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of global Pharmacovigilance regulatory obligations and compliance standards.

• Project & Conflict Management: Proven ability to support or lead projects to a successful conclusion while demonstrating strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.

• Agile Mindset: Comfort working in a matrix environment, actively participating in or leading agile squads and sprints to deliver on business strategies.

• Educational Background: A minimum of a degree-level qualification in a scientific or relevant field.

This position is based in Budapest, Hungary. Relocation Assistance is not available.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make

Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership, you will actively shape long-term roadmaps, drive consensus through persuasive communication, and recommend optimal technology solutions for sustainable business transformation.
Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Oversees initiatives or streams with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale. Defines and leads analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces, navigates complex frameworks, and delegates work while managing the quality of business analysis content.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, defining the problem space and driving comprehensive root cause analysis that may span organizational boundaries. Proactively prevents scope creep, manages the complexity of various scopes of change, and is ultimately accountable for business analysis deliverables ensuring alignment with broader organizational objectives.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders, including management, across organizational boundaries. Shapes strategy as a trusted advisor to leadership, actively navigates conflicts to achieve alignment, and empowers teams in stakeholder management.

• Impact/Strategy: Drives significant impact on projects and programs by ensuring the delivery of high-value solutions that align with business strategy. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, including advanced value analysis and risk assessment, and actively shapes long-term roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Works typically on a product or product line level, effectively managing highly ambiguous and evolving requirements in dynamic environments. Demonstrates a holistic viewpoint to analyze problems, considering potential micro and macro implications across related domains.

• Business / Technical ability: Uses in-depth knowledge of the business or technical domain and relevant technologies to inform business strategies. Leads the application of tools, principles, and techniques across complex and cross-functional initiatives, anticipating challenges and proactively integrating analysis into broader solution design.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Extensive experience overseeing initiatives with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale, and driving alignment across highly ambiguous spaces.

• Demonstrated advanced knowledge of Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy concepts and practices.

• Proven track record of recommending optimal technology solutions for sustainable business transformation and working on unusually complex problems with highly innovative solutions.

Technical Skills

• Ability to apply systems thinking to provide holistic and enterprise-wide consulting advice.

• Strong capability to extend standard approaches by tailoring methods to fit the problem space, often combining methodologies to create tailored approaches.

• Mastery in requirements and domain knowledge, with the ability to conduct comprehensive root cause analysis and advanced value and risk assessments.

jobs.title: Senior Lab Supervisor
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Lab Supervisor to manage the daily operations of R&D laboratories. You, as an ideal candidate, can follow procedures and demonstrate excellent interpersonal skills to ensure smooth, efficient, and compliant lab operations. In this role, you will maintain a safe and organized lab environment supporting the R&D lab users.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will serve as the primary operational liaison for laboratory users while ensuring strict adherence to regulatory standards and safety protocols.

• Coordinate day-to-day R&D laboratory operations, facility projects, and service request tickets while serving as the primary point of contact for stakeholders.

• Oversee vendor management, including relationship building, service technician escorts, and the procurement and inventory of lab supplies, reagents, and equipment.

• Direct the maintenance, calibration, validation, and repair of laboratory equipment, using usage data to anticipate maintenance needs and capital purchases.

• Enforce lab safety protocols and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in partnership with the Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) team to ensure full compliance.

• Maintain complete, audit-ready laboratory documentation, including equipment logs, safety manuals, and digital records, while preparing performance and resource utilization reports.

• Conduct regular lab inspections and audits to proactively identify and resolve potential safety hazards or compliance gaps.

• Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation for controlled temperature storage alarms, providing after-hours onsite support and content relocation when required.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Biological/Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a related field (or an equivalent combination of education and work experience).

• Minimum of 5 years of experience working in an IVD/ISO regulated laboratory environment, with strong knowledge of lab safety procedures and hazard controls.

Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal applicant.

• Proven background with audits and deep familiarity with requirements/controls for IVD product development labs (e.g., ISO 13485, GLP, GDocP).

• Strong organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, laboratory facility projects, and ticketing systems simultaneously.

• Excellent written and interpersonal communication skills for effective cross-functional collaboration with internal teams and external vendors.

• Familiarity with equipment management systems (e.g., SAP, RAM) and digital laboratory management tools is preferred.

This is an on-site position. Relocation benefits are not approved for this posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on California is 81,200.00 - 133 400.00 USD Annually. Actual pay w ill be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed in this link. Benefits

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Stiamo cercando un Senior Lab Supervisor altamente organizzato e dettagliato per gestire le operazioni quotidiane dei laboratori R&D. Lei, come candidato ideale, può seguire le procedure e dimostrare eccellenti capacità interpersonali per garantire operazioni di laboratorio lisce, efficienti e conformi. In questo ruolo, si manterrà un ambiente di laboratorio sicuro e organizzato che supporta gli utenti di laboratorio R&D.

L'opportunità

In questo ruolo, servirai come principale collegamento operativo per gli utenti di laboratorio, garantendo al contempo una rigorosa osservanza degli standard normativi e dei protocolli di sicurezza.

• Coordinate le operazioni di laboratorio R&D quotidiane, i progetti di strutture e i biglietti di richiesta di servizio, mentre servono come punto di contatto principale per le parti interessate.

• Superare la gestione dei fornitori, tra cui la costruzione di relazioni, le escort di tecnici di servizio, e l'approvvigionamento e l'inventario di forniture di laboratorio, reagenti e attrezzature.

• Dirigere la manutenzione, la taratura, la validazione e la riparazione di attrezzature di laboratorio, utilizzando i dati di utilizzo per anticipare le esigenze di manutenzione e gli acquisti di capitale.

• Fornire protocolli di sicurezza di laboratorio e procedure operative standard (SOP) in collaborazione con il team Sicurezza, Salute e Ambiente (SHE) per garantire la piena conformità.

• Mantenere la documentazione completa e pronta per l'audit di laboratorio, compresi i registri delle attrezzature, i manuali di sicurezza e i record digitali, mentre si preparano i report sulle prestazioni e sull'utilizzo delle risorse.

• Condurre ispezioni di laboratorio e audit regolari per identificare e risolvere i potenziali rischi di sicurezza o lacune di conformità.

• Partecipare a una rotazione di 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7 per gli allarmi di archiviazione a temperatura controllata, fornendo assistenza post-ora in loco e trasferimento dei contenuti quando necessario.

Chi sei

• Corso di laurea in Scienze Biologiche / Vita, Chimica, Biochimica, o un campo correlato (o una combinazione equivalente di istruzione e esperienza di lavoro).

• Minimo di 5 anni di esperienza che lavorano in un ambiente di laboratorio regolamentato IVD/ISO, con una forte conoscenza delle procedure di sicurezza del laboratorio e dei controlli sui rischi.

Comportamenti, competenze e qualità del candidato ideale.

• Sfondo collaudato con audit e profonda familiarità con requisiti / controlli per laboratori di sviluppo di prodotti IVD (ad esempio, ISO 13485, GLP, GDocP).

• Forte capacità organizzativa con una capacità dimostrata di gestire più priorità, progetti di impianti di laboratorio e sistemi di ticketing simultaneamente.

• Ottimi capacità di comunicazione scritte e interpersonali per un'efficace collaborazione interfunzionale con team interni e fornitori esterni.

• La familiarità con i sistemi di gestione delle attrezzature (ad esempio, SAP, RAM) e gli strumenti di gestione del laboratorio digitale è preferita.

Questa è una posizione in loco. I benefici di trasferimento non sono approvati per questa pubblicazione.

L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla California è 81,200.00 - 133 400.00 USD Annualmente. La retribuzione effettiva è determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche, alla posizione geografica e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro consentiti dalla legge. Un bonus annuale discrezionale può essere disponibile in base alle prestazioni individuali e aziendali. Questa posizione si qualifica anche per i benefici dettagliati in questo link. Vantaggi

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Noi

• Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten, Laboranlagenprojekte und Ticketsysteme gleichzeitig zu verwalten.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Nous recherchons un superviseur principal de laboratoire hautement organisé et axé sur les détails pour gérer les activités quotidiennes des laboratoires de R-D. Vous, en tant que candidat idéal, pouvez suivre les procédures et démontrer d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles pour assurer des opérations de laboratoire fluides, efficaces et conformes. Dans ce rôle, vous conserverez un environnement de laboratoire sécuritaire et organisé pour aider les utilisateurs de laboratoires de R-D.

L'opportunité

Dans ce rôle, vous serez la principale liaison opérationnelle pour les utilisateurs de laboratoire tout en assurant le strict respect des normes réglementaires et des protocoles de sécurité.

• Coordonner les activités quotidiennes des laboratoires de R-D, les projets d'installations et les demandes de service tout en servant de point de contact principal pour les intervenants.

• Superviser la gestion des fournisseurs, y compris l'établissement de relations, les escortes de techniciens de services, ainsi que l'approvisionnement et l'inventaire des fournitures de laboratoire, des réactifs et du matériel.

• Diriger l'entretien, l'étalonnage, la validation et la réparation du matériel de laboratoire, en utilisant les données d'utilisation pour anticiper les besoins d'entretien et les achats d'immobilisations.

• Appliquer les protocoles de sécurité des laboratoires et les procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON) en partenariat avec l'équipe de la sécurité, de la santé et de l'environnement (SHE) afin d'assurer la pleine conformité.

• Tenir à jour la documentation de laboratoire complète et prête à l'audit, y compris les registres du matériel, les manuels de sécurité et les dossiers numériques, tout en préparant les rapports sur le rendement et l'utilisation des ressources.

• Effectuer régulièrement des inspections et des vérifications en laboratoire afin de cerner et de résoudre de façon proactive les risques potentiels pour la sécurité ou les lacunes en matière de conformité.

• Participer à une rotation sur appel 24/7 pour les alarmes de stockage à température contrôlée, fournir un soutien après les heures sur place et le transfert du contenu au besoin.

Qui vous êtes

• Baccalauréat en sciences biologiques et de la vie, chimie, biochimie ou un domaine connexe (ou une combinaison équivalente d'études et d'expérience de travail).

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un milieu de laboratoire réglementé par la DIV et l'ISO, avec une solide connaissance des procédures de sécurité en laboratoire et des contrôles des dangers.

Comportements, compétences et qualités du candidat idéal.

• Expérience éprouvée des audits et connaissance approfondie des exigences et des contrôles des laboratoires de développement de produits de la DIV (p. ex. ISO 13485, BPL, GDocP).

• De solides compétences organisationnelles avec une capacité démontrée de gérer simultanément plusieurs priorités, des projets d'installations de laboratoire et des systèmes de billetterie.

• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et interpersonnelle pour une collaboration interfonctionnelle efficace avec les équipes internes et les fournisseurs externes.

• Il est préférable de se familiariser avec les systèmes de gestion de l'équipement (p. ex. SAP, RAM) et les outils numériques de gestion de laboratoire.

C'est une position sur place. Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas approuvées pour cette affectation.

L'échelle salariale prévue pour ce poste basé sur la Californie est de 81,200.00 - 133 400,00 USD Chaque année. La rémunération réelle est déterminée en fonction de l'expérience, des qualifications, de l'emplacement géographique et d'autres facteurs liés à l'emploi autorisés par la loi. Une prime annuelle discrétionnaire peut être offerte en fonction des performances individuelles et de l'entreprise. Ce poste est également admissible aux avantages décrits dans ce lien. Avantages

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous

jobs.title: Global Study Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Global Study Lead is responsible for ensuring that all studies are designed, planned, executed, monitored, closed out and documented in an appropriate manner within the planned timeframe and cost; ensuring that the sponsor responsibilities are fulfilled, while assuring compliance to all applicable regulatory requirements. Responsible for the timeline and budget planning and execution of studies. Assigns and ensures delivery of specific tasks to/from other members of the study team. Provides oversight to outside support including CROs, consultants and/or medical advisors

The Opportunity:

• Leads the global study team with full accountability for the study deliverables with respect to quality, budget and timelines, in collaboration with the Study Team and ensures the development of high quality study designs for sponsored studies in collaboration with internal and external experts

• In collaboration with Program Leadership, prepares different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g. study, real-world evidence) in cross-functional collaboration (e.g. with Regulatory Affairs, R&D, CDMA Project Teams) to support global strategies and planning of timeline and costs

• Develops key study documents (i.e., Design Validation Plan, protocol, study training materials, study forms and templates, study report)

• Oversees planning and operational aspects of companion diagnostics studies sponsored by Pharma partners

• Accountable for study-level budget of assigned studies.

• Adherence to regulations, guidelines and standard operating procedures, and ensures audit/inspection readiness.

• Execution of sponsored studies for assigned areas of focus for registrational and/or non-registrational purposes through all study phases (planning, start-up. conduct and close-out). Oversees study activities outsourced to a service provider (i.e., CRO).

• Ensure that study results are published in collaboration with the Publication Team.

• Oversees projects to ensure completion on-time, within scope and budget; and tracks project performance to analyze the completion of short and long term goals.

• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional leaders, key internal and external stakeholders and other alliance partners, including CROs, in meeting business goals and ensuring operational excellence.

Who you are:

• You have a bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or related field

• You have 5+ years of experience managing the full lifecycle of sponsored studies, ensuring projects meet performance goals within scope, quality, budget, and timeline.

• You have extensive experience in ensuring that study results are published in collaboration with the Publication Team.

• You have in-depth knowledge and experience in the role of Clinical Operations in product development and are aware of Roche’s place in the market and our value proposition to patients and customers.

• You have clinical trial management knowledge and experience in the oversight and conduct of clinical trials within the pathology/tissue diagnostics indication areas.

• You have clinical trial management knowledge and experience in the oversight and conduct of clinical trials within the Personalized Healthcare Solu

jobs.title: Health Ecosystem Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Impacto sostenible
Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones.

La Oportunidad
Como Health Ecosystem Partner, conectarás la innovación de Roche con las necesidades reales del ecosistema de salud. Este rol combina un profundo entendimiento de la salud pública con la capacidad de articular alianzas de alto nivel con actores clave como entidades regulatorias, pagadores, responsables políticos y organizaciones de pacientes. Su propósito es transformar el entorno, superar barreras de acceso y posicionar a Roche como un aliado indispensable y sostenible que acelera la llegada de soluciones médicas a quienes más las necesitan.

Responsabilidades

• Relacionamiento y representación institucional: Actuar como punto de contacto clave y socio de confianza ante actores del sistema de salud (reguladores, políticos, cámaras y pacientes) para posicionar la visión de Roche y su estrategia sostenible.

• Mapeo y articulación de la red ( Networking ): Desarrollar, mapear y gestionar una red transversal de partes interesadas para alinear metas comunes que impulsen la transformación del sistema de salud.

• Análisis del entorno y lectura de tendencias: Analizar el sistema de salud local e identificar patrones para moldear el ecosistema y preparar las condiciones para el acceso y adopción de la innovación terapéutica.

• Incidencia regulatoria y de políticas de salud: Promover activamente mejoras en los marcos regulatorios, fiscales y de salud que habiliten la sostenibilidad del ecosistema a corto, mediano y largo plazo.

• Co-creación e innovación: Impulsar proyectos colaborativos y soluciones innovadoras que generen un impacto clínico, social y económico medible en la sociedad.

• Asignación estratégica de recursos e impacto de negocio: Priorizar y asegurar el uso eficiente de los recursos de Roche para respaldar las metas estratégicas y los resultados del ecosistema.

• Gestión de riesgos y reputación corporativa: Anticipar y mitigar impactos regulatorios, políticos y sociales, diseñando estrategias multifuncionales para fortalecer la reputación de Roche ante tomadores de decisión.

Quién Eres

• Título universitario en carreras Científicas, Económicas, Sociales o Derecho (deseable MBA o Maestría en Salud Pública/Políticas Públicas), con un mínimo de 3 años de experiencia en posiciones similares dentro del ecosistema de salud.

• Profundo entendimiento de los sistemas de salud pública, procesos legislativos, diseño de políticas públicas y gestión de riesgos reputacionales, éticos y de cumplimiento.

• Excelentes habilidades de customer engagement y relacionamiento con actores tradicionales y no tradicionales (gobierno, reguladores, organizaciones de pacientes y ONG) para moldear el entorno y catalizar el acceso a la innovación.

• Liderazgo demostrado bajo el modelo VACC (Visionario, Arquitecto, Catalizador, Coach), capacidad para gestionar proyectos complejos y construir/dirigir equipos multifuncionales.

• Dominio estratégico del portafolio/pipeline de Roche y de metodologías ágiles ( Product Ownership , marco OBP e innovación digital) para diseñar soluciones sostenibles en el tiempo.

• Fluidez completa en el idioma local e inglés en nivel intermedio-avanzado (oral y escrito), acompañado de pensamiento sistémico y escucha acti
