jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner (PJP) (contract)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

1 year contract.

Patient Journey Partner, Oncology, Solid Tumor (AB,SK, MB)

Location: Candidates must be based within the Western Provinces

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Driving Success and Excellence in Oncology

At Roche Canada, our work in Oncology is guided by a simple, powerful goal: making life-changing care as accessible and seamless as possible. As a Patient Journey Partner within our Customer Engagement chapter, you will have the opportunity to influence and build meaningful connections with stakeholders across our Oncology ecosystem, fostering a culture of trust and partnership.

Your natural curiosity and passion for networking will fuel your ability to deeply understand our customers' needs and priorities, allowing you to forge strong relationships and unlock new opportunities for collaboration and innovation. If you are a dedicated professional driven by the desire to challenge the status quo and make a tangible impact on patients' lives, join us to help shape the future of medicine.

The Opportunity

• You are acting as the key liaison between stakeholders and Roche, leveraging your influence to foster impactful relationships, trust, and collaboration within the team, thereby driving meaningful connections and use of Roche products.

• You are ensuring appropriate use of Roche's products, sharing benefits and risks with Health Care Practitioners in a truthful and balanced manner

• You are collaborating with cross-functional colleagues to prioritize and plan account/stakeholder activities based on team priorities

• You are partnering across functions to address stakeholder needs, prioritize solutions, and evaluate progress

• You are implementing an omnichannel approach to engage stakeholders with Roche's offerings

• You are participating in a peer-to-peer coaching and mentorship model

• You are embracing self-directed learning and experiential growth as part of the working culture

Who You Are

• You hold a University degree in scientific, economic, or business field and you bring 7+ years' of experience in life sciences or healthcare sector

• You have the ability to build strong relationships with external stakeholders and deliver tailored solutions

• You demonstrate an understanding of fast-paced, competitive market dynamics and the Canadian healthcare system

• You have proven expertise in stakeholder engagement, including collaborating as part of cross-functional teams and leveraging digital tools for improved stakeholder experience

Preferred

• You hold an advanced degree and experience in Oncology

• You have 2+ years experience in pharmaceutical sales or account management experience

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Canada is 136,936.00 and 179,728.50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company.
We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role.

This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the job

At Roche you can show up as yourself, and be embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Opportunity
Imagine working for an organisation that puts people at the heart of everything they do, where your contributions directly impact patient outcomes. At Roche, our number one priority is our patients, and we believe that every person plays a key role in achieving this mission.

As a Medical Affairs Partner you will be a vital part of our Medical Affairs Chapter in the Roche UK affiliate. You will leverage your deep medical and scientific expertise to shape and drive strategic initiatives both locally and globally. This is your opportunity to make a difference and be part of a company dedicated to improving lives.

Who You Are
You are a passionate medical affairs expert with a clear vision for improving patient outcomes. You thrive in a collaborative environment and take pride in sharing your knowledge to help others grow. You are experienced in translating complex scientific data into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions. With a strong track record of building relationships with healthcare experts and influencers, you are ready to contribute to high-impact projects and collaborate across teams.

You also bring:

• A scientific university degree and relevant experience in Medical Affairs, with NHS/clinical experience where applicable

• Broad expertise in medical affairs, including data & insight generation, scientific partnerships, medical education, and strategy

• Proven ability to engage and collaborate with the clinical community to deliver value-adding outcomes

• Experience in leading and mentoring peers, as well as managing stakeholder relationships

• Strong critical appraisal and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information for external audiences

• Experience in Haemophilia, is strongly preferred

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Global Clinical Operations Excellence Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a passionate and enthusiastic Global Clinical Operations Excellence Intern to join the Pharma Product Development (PD) Global Clinical Operations (PDG) team within the Clinical Operations Excellence (COE) department. At Roche/Genentech, our bold Pharma Ambition is to transform drug development and deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden by 2030. Our team aims to lead in clinical operations by emphasizing speed, cost-effectiveness, and an enterprise-wide perspective. We value knowledge-sharing, diverse experiences, and new perspectives to solve problems.

As an intern in this role, your primary focus will be supporting efforts to enhance productivity and facilitate the delivery of clinical trials to patients. You will have the opportunity to enable innovative clinical trial delivery and help address emergent, high-impact needs across Clinical Operations to make trial delivery more efficient for patients, investigators, and clinical site staff.

What you will do:

• Collaborate with study teams, COE colleagues, and Quality and Compliance experts to help optimize processes and support strong compliance and quality assurance.

• Partner within and across different business units, including PDQ, pRED, gRED, and USM.

• Participate in continuous improvement and change management activities, bringing fresh perspectives to help solve complex problems.

• Support the creation, improvement, and implementation of enhanced global and local processes, policies, and training programs.

• Assist in fostering knowledge sharing and support the adoption of new ways of working utilizing data, AI, and innovative technologies.

• Help support a forward-thinking learning management strategy for Clinical Operations, focusing on building future capabilities through innovative learning solutions.

• Maintain a global reach to support local business needs and help foster a culture of collective success and high performance.

Who you are:

• Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program in Biomedical Informatics, Science, Business, Healthcare, or closely related fields.

• You are developing an understanding of the infrastructure needed to conduct clinical trials and drug development.

• You are building awareness of the clinical trial industry and how clinical trials are operationalized.

• You are computer literate and enthusiastic about supporting the timely adoption of cutting-edge technologies and knowledge management tools to optimize operational efficiency.

• You are eager to learn about GCP/GVP compliance, business process ownership, and data integrity.

• Strong communication, good attention to detail, a willingness to learn, and an interest in using data and technology to improve patient outcomes.

• You are a self-starter who can eventually prioritize your own work with minimal guidance.

Preferred:

• Exposure to healthcare or clinical operations.

Additional Information:

Location: Based in Mississauga, Hybrid (minimum of 3 days per week in the office)
Hours: Full-time (35 hours per week) Internship
Length: This position is a 12 months internship, and is expected to begin in January 2027.

This position is not eligible for relocation support.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 57 416,00 and 75 358,50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Main Tasks & Responsibilities

• Investigations & Compliance: Lead and direct production investigations and data summarization, ensuring all nonconformances and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) are completed within appropriate timeframes.

• Issue Management: Proactively identify and respond to technical issues arising during ongoing production; determine root causes and implement sustainable solutions to prevent production interruptions.

• Quality & Change Coordination: Act as the main interface to the Q&R unit for coordinated implementation of product technical changes and represent Global Operations in Product Care and Quality Teams (PCQT).

• Stakeholder Management: Partner and collaborate with APAC Make (MFG, QC), MSAT process SMEs, and global teams (eg. R&D, Q&R, LCT) to resolve issues promptly.

• Network Integration: Operate as one network by partnering with global teams and peers at other networks to share investigation best practices and CAPA learnings.

Qualification & Experience

Education
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific field
Higher education (Master's/PhD) preferred

Qualification & Certification

Requirements of China Medical Device GMP article 8 and IVD section 2.1.1

Experience

6 - 8+ years of experience, preferably in a regulated industry (Medical Device/IVD), manufacturing, Q&R, and investigation units
Significant leadership experience and ability to manage complex regional projects

Professional Competencies

Exceptional analytical and root-cause analysis (RCA) skills.
Ability to cope with high pressure, complexity, and ambiguity.
Proficiency in English and Chinese (Mandarin).
Strong systems thinker with integrated solution-crafting skills.

Leadership Competencies

Leadership competencies at a proficient level, in line with the corporate framework.

Remarks

SHE Responsibility: Please refer to the RDSZ SHE handbook.
GMP Clause: If positions are GMP-related, please specify in the job qualification according to the requirements of China Medical Device GMP Article 8 and IVD Section 2.1.1.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Significant leadership experience and ability to manage complex regional projects

Exceptional analytical and root-cause analysis (RCA) skills.
Ability to cope with high pressure, complexity, and ambiguity.
Proficiency in English and Chinese (Mandarin).
Strong systems thinker with integrated solution-crafting skills.

Leadership competencies at a proficient level, in line with the corporate framework.

jobs.title: System Support Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position: System Support Partner
Team: System Support Team
Report to: System Support Lead

Purpose of the Job
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The opportunity
As a System Support Partner, you are the technical linchpin for our integrated diagnostic systems. You will specialize in the intersection of instrumentation, software, IT, and networking, ensuring seamless connectivity, data integrity, and peak system performance at customer sites. Your role is to resolve the most sophisticated, multi-layered technical challenges, acting as the primary escalation point for system-level issues and a key liaison between field service, customers, and global support teams.

• Customer Support & Troubleshooting: Proactively support customer inquiries and complaints, providing fast and effective solutions to application-related issues to exceed customer expectations.

• Installation & Training: Analyze laboratory workflows to provide expert consultation. Lead the installation and configuration of new systems and provide comprehensive training and retraining to customers to ensure they can operate the instruments confidently and efficiently.

• Product Expertise: Serve as a product expert in your designated area, translating complex technical and application information into clear, understandable terms for customers.

• Project Implementation: Support and implement special customer projects, such as e-lab performance, TIQ con, QC six sigma, and turnaround time evaluations, according to the plan.

• Advanced System Troubleshooting : Provide second-level technical support to field engineers and application specialists for diagnosing complex issues across electro-mechanical equipment, computer systems, and software.

• IT & Connectivity Management : Lead the implementation and support of instrument-LIS/HIS interfaces and middleware solutions. Troubleshoot complex connectivity, data transmission, and network configuration issues to ensure robust system integration within customer environments.

• Software Lifecycle & Performance Monitoring : Manage and implement new updates, upgrades, and all related retrofits for instrument hardware and software across the installed base in Thailand.

• Technical Consultation & Project Support : Act as the subject matter expert on system integration and IT requirements. Support special customer projects, such as those related to workflow and turnaround time evaluations, by providing expert IT consultation.

• Technical Enablement & Knowledge Transfer : Enhance the technical knowledge of service personnel through on-the-job coaching and training on advanced system-level topics. Act as a source for related technical knowledge and tools.

• Compliance: Ensure all activities, especially new installations and complaint handling, are completed according to the relevant Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Who you are

Experience and Competencies:

• Proactive & Agile: Independent, a team player, flexible, and solution-driven with an agile mindset.

• Customer-Focused: Demonstrates a high service-minded attitude with a proven record of excellent application and support performance.

• Problem-Solving: Possesses a positive attitude towards work, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to perform well under

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Supply Chain Partner

titleByLocale.it: Partner strategico della catena di fornitura dei clienti

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Strategic Customer Supply Chain Partner is a client-facing role combining strategic supply chain consultancy with expert project management focused on improving the customer experience, driving profitability, and increasing efficiency through operational excellence, digital execution, and solid project management.

Your Responsibilities

• Act as a consultant to strategic healthcare customers, conducting structured, on-site diagnostics of their internal supply chain setups, material flows, and storage capacities using frameworks like the SCOR Model.

• Co-facilitate collaborative workshops with external hospital, laboratory and authority stakeholders to map current-state logistics workflows and design optimized future-state supply chain models using Value Stream Mapping (VSM).

• Develop customized supply chain strategies that solve customer pain points, delivering measurable value such as optimized inventory levels, reduced manual handling, and minimized operational waste.

• Partner with commercial teams as the supply chain subject matter expert during high-level client discussions, transforming operational findings into compelling commercial service proposals.

• Lead complex supply chain optimization and transformation projects from initial scoping and business-case design through to final execution and closure.

• Build and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams, ensuring clear role definition, optimal resource allocation, and strict adherence to project milestones.

• Establish robust project governance structures to proactively identify risks, manage dependencies, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and report progress to steering committees and leadership.

• Drive stakeholder alignment and change-management strategies to ensure smooth transition and long-term sustainability of newly implemented supply chain processes.

• Rollout of Roche's digital supply chain and inventory management solutions, leveraging CPFR (Collaborative Planning, Forecasting, and Replenishment) strategies to improve customer integration and delivery reliability.

• Monitor and evaluate post-implementation adoption and tool performance to guarantee the customer achieves the intended efficiency gains.

• Manage ongoing customer care by overseeing the resolution of operational incidents and system requests, ensuring long-term solution stability and high customer satisfaction.

• Act as the strategic link between regional customer needs and global development teams, escalating requirements to enhance the long-term digital supply chain product roadmap.

Who You Are

• You hold a BSc degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, Operations Research, Engineering, or related degree. Post graduate degree is preferred

• You built deep functional knowledge of core supply chain principles, advanced inventory management theories, demand forecasting, warehousing optimization, and distribution network design

• You built a minimum of 3 to 5 years of work experience within a management consulting firm or an internal corporate advisory/operational transformation team, steering high-impact initiatives with a specific focus on: logistics, cold chain management, storage topology optimization, deep familiarity with work streams such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C), and/or alignment of customer-facing fulfillment workflows with broader commercial business strategies

• You are experienced in utilizing structured supply chain and project management frameworks

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Lo Strategic Customer Supply Chain Partner è un ruolo di customer-facing che combina la consulenza strategica della supply chain con la gestione di progetti esperti focalizzati sul miglioramento dell'esperienza del cliente, sulla redditività della guida e sull'aumento dell'efficienza attraverso l'eccellenza operativa, l'esecuzione digitale e la gestione di progetti solidi.

Le tue responsabilità

• Agire come consulente per i clienti sanitari strategici, condurre la diagnostica strutturata e in loco delle loro configurazioni della supply chain interna, flussi materiali e capacità di archiviazione utilizzando strutture come il Modello SCOR.

• Co-facilitare workshop collaborativi con gli stakeholder esterni dell'ospedale, del laboratorio e dell'autorità per mappare i flussi di lavoro logistici attuali e i modelli della supply chain del futuro-stato ottimizzati con Value Stream Mapping (VSM).

• Sviluppare strategie di supply chain personalizzate che risolvono i punti di dolore del cliente, offrendo un valore misurabile come i livelli di inventario ottimizzati, la gestione manuale ridotta e minimizzare i rifiuti operativi.

• Collabora con i team commerciali come esperto del settore della supply chain durante le discussioni dei clienti di alto livello, trasformando i risultati operativi in convincenti proposte di servizi commerciali.

• Piombo complessi progetti di ottimizzazione e trasformazione della supply chain, dalla progettazione iniziale di scoping e business-case fino all'esecuzione finale e chiusura.

• Costruire e coordinare team di progetto multidisciplinari, assicurando una chiara definizione del ruolo, un'allocazione ottimale delle risorse e una rigorosa adesione alle pietre miliari del progetto.

• Stabilire robuste strutture di governance del progetto per identificare proattivamente i rischi, gestire le dipendenze, tracciare indicatori chiave di performance (KPI), e segnalare i progressi verso comitati di guida e leadership.

• Guidare le strategie di allineamento e gestione dei cambiamenti degli stakeholder per garantire una transizione regolare e una sostenibilità a lungo termine dei nuovi processi di supply chain implementati.

• Rollout delle soluzioni di gestione digitale della supply chain e dell'inventario di Roche, sfruttando le strategie CPFR (Collaborative Planning, Forecasting e Replenishment) per migliorare l'integrazione dei clienti e l'affidabilità della consegna.

• Monitorare e valutare l'adozione post-implementazione e le prestazioni degli strumenti per garantire al cliente i guadagni di efficienza previsti.

• Gestire l'assistenza clienti continua supervisionando la risoluzione di incidenti operativi e richieste di sistema, garantendo la stabilità della soluzione a lungo termine e l'elevata soddisfazione del cliente.

• Agire come collegamento strategico tra le esigenze dei clienti regionali e i team di sviluppo globale, aumentando i requisiti per migliorare la roadmap dei prodotti della supply chain digitale a lungo termine.

Chi sei

• Hai una laurea in Supply Chain, Logistica, Business Administration, Operazioni di ricerca, Ingegneria, o relativo grado. Laurea post è preferito

• Hai costruito una profonda conoscenza funzionale dei principi della catena di approvvigionamento di base, teorie avanzate di gestione dell'inventario, previsione della domanda, ottimizzazione del warehousing e progettazione della rete di distribuzione

• Hai costruito un minimo di 3-5 anni di esperienza lavorativa all'interno di una società di consulenza gestionale o di un team di consulenza aziendale / di trasformazione operativa interna, orientando iniziative ad alto impatto con un focus specifico su: logistica, gestione della catena fredda, ottimizzazione della topologia dello storage, profonda familiarità con flussi di lavoro come Procure-to-Pay (P2P) e strategie di allineamento del cliente-risolvere il business

• Sei esperto nell'utilizzo di strutture di supply chain e quadri di gestione del progetto

Die Position
Der Strategic Customer Supply Chain Partner ist eine kundenorientierte Rolle, die strategische Supply Chain-Beratung mit kompetentem Projektmanagement kombiniert, das sich auf die Verbesserung des Kundenerlebnisses, die Steigerung der Rentabilität und die Steigerung der Effizienz durch operative Exzellenz, digitale Ausführung und solides Projektmanagement konzentriert.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Handeln Sie als Berater für strategische Gesundheitskunden und führen Sie eine strukturierte Vor-Ort-Diagnose ihrer internen Supply-Chain-Setups, Materialflüsse und Lagerkapazitäten unter Verwendung von Frameworks wie dem SCOR-Modell durch.

• Zusammenarbeit mit externen Krankenhaus-, Labor- und Behördenvertretern, um aktuelle Logistik-Workflows abzubilden und optimierte Supply-Chain-Modelle für den zukünftigen Zustand unter Verwendung von Value Stream Mapping (VSM) zu entwerfen.

• Entwickeln Sie maßgeschneiderte Supply-Chain-Strategien, die Kundenprobleme lösen und messbare Werte wie optimierte Lagerbestände, reduzierte manuelle Handhabung und minimierte Betriebsabfälle liefern.

• Partner mit kaufmännischen Teams als Experten für Supply Chain-Themen in hochrangigen Kundengesprächen und verwandeln operative Ergebnisse in überzeugende kommerzielle Servicevorschläge.

• Führen Sie komplexe Supply-Chain-Optimierungs- und Transformationsprojekte vom ersten Scoping und Business-Case-Design bis hin zur endgültigen Ausführung und Schließung.

• Aufbau und Koordination multidisziplinärer Projektteams, um eine klare Rollendefinition, optimale Ressourcenzuweisung und strikte Einhaltung der Projektmeilensteine zu gewährleisten.

• Etablieren Sie robuste Projekt-Governance-Strukturen, um proaktiv Risiken zu identifizieren, Abhängigkeiten zu verwalten, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) zu verfolgen und Fortschritte an Lenkungsausschüsse und Führungskräfte zu melden.

• Förderung der Ausrichtung der Stakeholder und der Change-Management-Strategien, um einen reibungslosen Übergang und eine langfristige Nachhaltigkeit der neu implementierten Supply-Chain-Prozesse zu gewährleisten.

• Einführung der digitalen Supply-Chain- und Bestandsverwaltungslösungen von Roche unter Nutzung von CPFR-Strategien (Collaborative Planning, Forecasting, and Replenishment), um die Kundenintegration und Lieferzuverlässigkeit zu verbessern.

• Überwachen und bewerten Sie die Einführung und die Werkzeugleistung nach der Implementierung, um sicherzustellen, dass der Kunde die beabsichtigten Effizienzgewinne erzielt.

• Verwalten Sie die laufende Kundenbetreuung, indem Sie die Lösung von betrieblichen Vorfällen und Systemanforderungen überwachen und so langfristige Lösungsstabilität und hohe Kundenzufriedenheit gewährleisten.

• Handeln Sie als strategisches Bindeglied zwischen regionalen Kundenbedürfnissen und globalen Entwicklungsteams und eskalieren die Anforderungen, um die langfristige Roadmap für digitale Lieferkettenprodukte zu verbessern.

Wer du bist

• Sie haben einen BSc-Abschluss in Supply Chain, Logistik, Business Administration, Operations Research, Engineering oder einem verwandten Abschluss. Postgraduiertenabschluss wird bevorzugt

• Sie haben ein umfassendes funktionales Wissen über die wichtigsten Supply-Chain-Prinzipien, fortgeschrittene Bestandsmanagement-Theorien, Bedarfsprognosen, Lageroptimierung und Verteilungsnetzwerkdesign aufgebaut

• Sie haben mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Unternehmensberatungsfirma oder einem internen Unternehmensberatungs-/Betriebstransformationsteam gesammelt und einflussreiche Initiativen mit besonderem Schwerpunkt geleitet: Logistik, Kühlkettenmanagement, Optimierung der Speichertopologie, tiefe Vertrautheit mit Workflows wie Procure-to-Pay (P2P) und Order-to-Cash (O2C) und / oder Ausrichtung von kundenorientierten Fulfillment-Workflows mit breiteren kommerziellen Geschäftsstrategien

• Sie haben Erfahrung im Umgang mit strukturierten Supply Chain und Projektmanagement Frameworks

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Le partenaire stratégique de la chaîne d'approvisionnement client joue un rôle de client en combinant le conseil stratégique de la chaîne d'approvisionnement avec la gestion de projet spécialisée axée sur l'amélioration de l'expérience client, la rentabilité et l'augmentation de l'efficacité grâce à l'excellence opérationnelle, l'exécution numérique et une gestion de projet solide.

Vos responsabilités

• Agir en tant que consultant auprès de clients de soins de santé stratégiques, en effectuant des diagnostics structurés sur place de leurs configurations internes de chaîne d'approvisionnement, des flux de matériaux et des capacités de stockage en utilisant des cadres comme le modèle SCOR.

• Co-faciliter des ateliers de collaboration avec des intervenants externes de l'hôpital, du laboratoire et de l'autorité pour cartographier les flux de travail logistiques actuels et concevoir des modèles optimisés de la chaîne d'approvisionnement à l'avenir à l'aide de Value Stream Mapping (VSM).

• Élaborer des stratégies sur mesure de la chaîne d'approvisionnement qui résolvent les points de douleur des clients, fournissent une valeur mesurable comme des niveaux d'inventaire optimisés, réduisent la manutention manuelle et minimisent les déchets opérationnels.

• S'associer à des équipes commerciales en tant qu'expert en matière de chaîne d'approvisionnement lors de discussions avec des clients de haut niveau, transformant les conclusions opérationnelles en propositions de services commerciaux convaincantes.

• Diriger des projets complexes d'optimisation et de transformation de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de la conception de la portée initiale et de l'analyse de rentabilisation jusqu'à l'exécution finale et à la fermeture.

• Mettre sur pied et coordonner des équipes de projet multidisciplinaires, en veillant à une définition claire du rôle, à une allocation optimale des ressources et au strict respect des jalons du projet.

• Mettre en place des structures solides de gouvernance des projets pour cerner les risques de façon proactive, gérer les dépendances, suivre les indicateurs de rendement clés et rendre compte des progrès aux comités directeurs et aux dirigeants.

• Encourager l'alignement des intervenants et les stratégies de gestion du changement afin d'assurer une transition sans heurts et la viabilité à long terme des nouveaux processus de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.

• Mise en œuvre des solutions numériques de gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et des stocks de Roche, en tirant parti des stratégies CPFR (Planification collaborative, prévision et reconstitution) pour améliorer l'intégration des clients et la fiabilité de la livraison.

• Surveiller et évaluer l'adoption après la mise en œuvre et la performance de l'outil pour garantir que le client réalise les gains d'efficacité escomptés.

• Gérer les soins continus à la clientèle en surveillant la résolution des incidents opérationnels et des demandes de système, en assurant la stabilité à long terme de la solution et une satisfaction élevée de la clientèle.

• Agir en tant que lien stratégique entre les besoins des clients régionaux et les équipes de développement mondial, en accroissant les exigences pour améliorer la feuille de route à long terme de la chaîne d'approvisionnement numérique.

Qui vous êtes

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ès sciences en chaîne d'approvisionnement, logistique, administration des affaires, recherche opérationnelle, ingénierie ou diplôme connexe. Le diplôme supérieur est préféré

• Vous avez acquis une connaissance fonctionnelle approfondie des principes fondamentaux de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des théories avancées de la gestion des stocks, de la prévision de la demande, de l'optimisation de l'entreposage et de la conception du réseau de distribution

• Vous avez construit un minimum de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience de travail au sein d'un cabinet de conseil en gestion ou d'une équipe interne de conseil/transformation opérationnelle de l'entreprise, en dirigeant des initiatives à impact élevé avec un accent particulier sur: la logistique, la gestion de la chaîne du froid, l'optimisation de la topologie de stockage, une connaissance approfondie des flux de travail tels que Procure-to-Pay (P2P) et Order-to-Cash (O2C) et/ou l'alignement des flux de travail d'exécution orientés vers le client avec des stratégies commerciales plus larges

• Vous avez l'expérience d'utiliser des cadres structurés de gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et de projet

jobs.title: Territory Manager - New Delhi
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Territory Manager - New Delhi

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

As a Territory Manager - New Delhi , you are responsible for managing the sale of the organization’s products through distribution and retail channels across the New Delhi geographic area. You serve as a strategic partner to the Area Sales Manager (ASM), providing critical market insights to estimate product demand and drive the organization’s growth. You apply new approaches to merchandising and field activation to increase brand visibility and ensure that our life-changing products reach the customers and patients who need them. You work collaboratively with distributors and dealers to break down barriers to access, ensuring that our sales plans are executed with precision and operational excellence.

Your Opportunity

• Territory Planning & Execution: You drive business results by providing information on the market environment to help estimate yearly product demand. You ensure the monthly achievement of SKU-wise sales plans and targets by generating secondary sales in the market.

• Distribution Management: You monitor distributor performance, reviewing the existing network to propose the appointment of new partners or the termination of non-performing ones. You motivate distributors and dealers through regular communication, sorting out issues regarding accounts, pricing, and schemes.

• Sales Promotion & Merchandising: You prepare and execute sales promotion plans through field activation and merchandising activities designed by the Marketing Team. You maintain rigorous records of these activities, tracking expenses and sales generated to provide feedback on program efficacy.

• Market Intelligence: You monitor competitor information and feedback within your category. You provide regular reports to the ASM on competitor activities and stock availability of promotional materials to ensure Roche remains competitive in the landscape.

• Customer Excellence: You address all complaints and suggestions from distributors and customers by coordinating with customer care. You organize dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies to ensure brand consistency and strong partnerships.

• Financial Oversight: You ensure timely monthly collections through continuous follow-ups and submit inventory requirements at the distributor level as per the sales plan. You maintain disciplined daily reporting of customer visits as per established work norms.

Who You Are

• Qualified Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Science or Pharmacy . A post-graduate qualification is considered an additional advantage.

• Industry Experience: You have a minimum of 2-3 years of experience with a proven track record in OTC, Surgical Equipment or Pharmaceutical Product.

• Regional Expert: You possess a deep understanding of the Goa market environment and have experience managing independent representatives, distributors, or agents.

• Strategic Partner: You have demonstrated the ability to assist leadership in planning and executing complex sales promotion plans with a focus on productivity and efficiency.

• Analytical & Disciplined: You rely on data to track sales performance and inventory, with a high degree of accountability for daily reporting and meeting monthly s

jobs.title: People & Culture Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, 94,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity.

This is a part-time internship role that will take at least 6 months.

JOB DESCRIPTION

• Support for All P&C Operational Processes: Provide active support to the People & Culture (P&C) team in daily operations and routine administrative tasks.

• End-to-End Recruitment & Professional Development: Take part in recruitment processes—including job postings, CV screening, and candidate communication—gaining hands-on practice to develop HR competencies and industry insights.

• Interview Coordination & Observation: Support interview coordination and assessment processes; join select interviews as an observer alongside the Talent Acquisition Partners to gain exposure to interviewing techniques and candidate evaluations.

• Comprehensive Employee Journey Experience: Take active responsibility across every stage of the employee lifecycle—from hiring and onboarding to training and offboarding—to build a holistic HR vision.

• Training Organization & Development: Play an active role in planning, organizing, and executing training programs to learn organizational development processes firsthand.

• Personnel File Management & Onboarding/Offboarding: Manage personnel records by creating files for new hires and processing departing employees.

• P&C Data & Record Management: Assist in preparing and maintaining P&C data and records to gain experience in HR analytics and reporting.

• Internal Communications & Translations: Draft company announcements and complete English-Turkish translations as needed, enhancing corporate communication skills.

• Stakeholder & Agreement Follow-up: Follow up agreements and contract processes with key stakeholders to strengthen task management and business communication skills.

• Participation in Strategic HR Projects: Engage actively in ongoing HR initiatives (e.g., orientation, language support programs) to gain practical project management experience.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 3rd- or 4th-year university students, preferably in Psychology, Business Administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering, or Management Engineering

• Flexible schedule to work 3 days a week for a minimum of 6 months

• Advanced level of English

• Excellent command of MS Office

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Strong analytical skills

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

External Job Ad Text

Exp required- 8+ years
Work Location- Baner, Pune

Job description
The ERP Solution Consultant delivers ERP and EWM solutions independently, proactively addresses challenges, and contributes effectively to team efforts. In this role, you will solve a broad range of difficult problems, prioritize your work, and report status in the area of Inventory and Warehouse Management. You will communicate seamlessly within product teams and occasionally interact with stakeholders on small to medium engagements while ensuring compliance with Roche Service Level Management processes (incident management, change management etc.) . By demonstrating good ERP business analysis knowledge and good understanding of business processes, your work will make a direct impact within your project or workgroup.
Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Works independently to deliver ERP/EWM solutions and proactively identifies and addresses challenges. Seeks senior colleague support for complex product scenarios while ensuring adherence to processes for timely and high-quality results. Contributes to specific chapter-related outcomes, fosters effective teamwork, and actively solicits ideas from others within the project team.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Deals with uncertainty and makes decisions at the product level with guidance from a more senior member. Provides solutions to a broad range of difficult problems.

• Stakeholder Management: Primarily interacts within product teams, squads, and across the Product Line as applicable. Interacts directly with stakeholders on small to medium engagements. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions within product teams and clearly communicates the impact of their own work in the context of business needs.

• Impact/Strategy: Makes an impact that is typically limited to a specific workgroup or project.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Demonstrates the ability to prioritize and report status at the product level.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies understanding of tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis. Demonstrates good knowledge of ERP IT Business Analysis and Consultancy concepts and practices with a focus on inventory and warehouse management.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience independently delivering ERP solutions while fostering effective teamwork and adherence to quality processes.

• Experience making decisions at the product level under guidance and solving a broad range of difficult problems.

• Proven ability to prioritize tasks and accurately report status at the product level.

Technical Skills

• Good knowledge of SAP ERP IT Business Analysis / Consultancy concepts and practices with focus on SAP MM/IM and EWM with 3-5 years of experience in a supply chain environment incl. experience across the SAP modules

• Good understanding and application of tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis.

• Good level of business process domain knowledge.

• Experience in handling 3rd party logistic provider integrations (with LE-IDW) into ERP is a plus.

Additional Qualifications

• Strong collaborative mindset with a track record of actively soliciting ideas from project team members.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Scientist in Pharmaceutical Development, you are part of the Department “Pharmaceutical Development” in Pharma Technical Development (PTD) in Basel, Switzerland. The department Pharmaceutical Development is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products (Synthetic molecules and Biologics) from Phase 1 through market Launch. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for parenteral drug products for all clinical stages and the market launch, the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites, commercial product support and line extension development.

You will balance technical rigor in formulation and process development with an exploratory mindset, driving innovation in parenteral modalities, including Oligonucleotides and complex synthetic molecules.

The Opportunity

• Lead the end-to-end development of parenteral formulations—including liquid and lyophilized dosage forms—and establish robust manufacturing processes from scale-up and characterization to commercial transfer.

• Represent Pharmaceutical Development as a project leader in global CMC and cross-functional teams, providing critical technical expertise and strategic input for regulatory submissions (BLA/MAA/NDA) throughout all clinical stages.

• Actively apply creative, open-minded approaches to overcome unfavorable molecular properties. Serve as a key lab partner to Postdocs and Scientists to test and validate exploratory formulation concepts and new therapeutic modalities.

• Manage and support analytical method scouting, analytical understanding and implementation capabilities in our routine.

Who you are

• You hold a Ph.D. or master degree in chemistry, chemical/process engineering or related fields and bring a minimum of 2 years of professional experience (industry) in formulation and process development DP manufacturing related fields of parenteral dosage forms.

• Eagerness to Learn & Grow: Strong intrinsic motivation to master new therapeutic modalities, specifically building a deep technical footprint in Oligonucleotide formulation and analytical-formulation loops.

• Technical Agility & Curiosity: Comfort in or a strong motivation to acquire knowledge and advance in unfamiliar fields, particularly digital domains. A natural inclination to challenge the status quo and show curiosity.

• Collaboration & Communication: Outstanding team player with highly developed interpersonal skills. Thrives in a matrixed environment where resources, ideas, and lab spaces are shared globally to deliver a high-stakes portfolio.

• Experience in oligonucleotides is a plus

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Backend Python Engineer to build robust, scalable APIs and services that power our digital products in the life sciences sector. Working closely with our Frontend/UX team and Data Scientists, you will design the backend infrastructure required to process, manage, and serve complex bioinformatics and machine learning data.

In this highly collaborative role, you will tackle challenges ranging from optimizing database queries for massive datasets to architecting cloud-native solutions on AWS. We value engineers who are comfortable exploring complex data structures, establishing clean API boundaries, and ensuring high reliability as we scale our platforms to support critical scientific innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and maintain high-performance, asynchronous backend services and robust RESTful APIs.

• Architect, deploy, and manage scalable and secure cloud infrastructure, utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.

• Design efficient database schemas, manage complex data relationships, execute seamless migrations, and ensure performant query optimization for massive datasets.

• Build and maintain data pipelines to ingest, normalize, and process large volumes of structured and unstructured scientific and bioinformatics data.

• Champion engineering excellence by writing clean, testable code, implementing comprehensive automated testing, and maintaining reliable CI/CD pipelines.

• Partner directly with the UX/Frontend team to establish seamless API integrations, and collaborate with Data Scientists to bring machine learning models into production workflows.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, collaborative software engineer who thrives on solving complex backend challenges. You possess a strong analytical mindset, are passionate about clean API boundaries, and excel at transforming data infrastructure to drive meaningful progress.

Qualifications & Skills

The Must-Haves:

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, with Python as your primary language.

• Strong software engineering fundamentals, including robust API design and experience building and scaling RESTful systems.

• Solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, schema migrations, and query optimization.

• Proven experience building, deploying, and managing scalable infrastructure in cloud environments, ideally utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

• A strong focus on code quali

You are a proactive, collaborative software engineer who thrives on solving complex backend challenges. You possess a strong analytical mindset, are passionate about clean API boundaries, and excel at transforming data infrastructure to drive meaningful progress.

• Proven experience building, deploying, and managing scalable infrastructure in cloud environments, ideally utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

jobs.description:

The Position
Job description
The Solution Architect for digital product provisioning and mediation designs business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready E2E solutions . In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements and evolving the architecture throughout the product life cycle. By solving complex technical problems, defining reference architectures, and aligning with the broader architecture community for governance, you will ensure robust implementations that deliver enhanced value to the organization. This is an hands-on solution architecture role
Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Main responsibility: Owns all technical matters related to usage mediation (convergent mediation by DigitalRoute) and the provisioning of digital products (automatic tenant creation) in accordance to defined commercial models. Including all the integration across systems that support the end to end data flow

• Scope: Primary point of contact on all matters concerning mediation and digital product provisioning. Designs solutions that meet requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR). Documents and evolves the architecture and ensures alignment with RDT architecture and governance.

• Accountability: Solves complex problems, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the assigned solution. Assesses and consults on impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape.

• External partners : You will serve as the primary operational guide for external vendors, ensuring all delivery work aligns with our internal standards, project timelines, and quality expectations. You communicate requirements clearly, and offer ongoing technical and procedural direction. While external teams execute the hands-on deliverables, you will monitor progress, unblock challenges

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive technical information and works collaboratively to build consensus among product teams, business stakeholders, and technical peers. Drive all discussions with digital product teams to ensure adoption of commercial backoffice standards and processes

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation for digital product teams. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies.

• Support and operations: You d rive operational excellence by performing root-cause analysis on end-to-end production issues. Serve as a key escalation point to troubleshoot complex operational failures and establish preventative measures that maintain high system reliability and timely output.

• Proven Experience in at least one of the main job capabilities Provisioning or Usage Mediation

• Good experience with System Integration Technologies and common Integration Design Pattern (MuleSoft and SAPCPI / SAP IS preferred).

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro
La Solution Architect per la fornitura di prodotti digitali e la mediazione progetta soluzioni E2E orientate al business, basate su standard e future. In questo ruolo, si progetta soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti di prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali, mentre gestiscono i requisiti non funzionali e l'evoluzione dell'architettura in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Risolvendo complessi problemi tecnici, definendo architetture di riferimento, e allineando con la più ampia comunità di architettura per la governance, ti garantirai implementazioni robuste che offrono un valore aggiunto all'organizzazione. Questo è un ruolo di architettura di soluzioni pratico
Descrizione della zona
Responsabilità del lavoro

• Responsabilità principale: possiede tutte le questioni tecniche relative alla mediazione d'uso (mediazione convergente di DigitalRoute) e alla fornitura di prodotti digitali (creazione automatica dell'inquilino) secondo modelli commerciali definiti. Compresa tutta l'integrazione tra sistemi che supportano il flusso di dati end to end

• Ambito: Punto di contatto primario su tutte le questioni relative alla mediazione e alla fornitura di prodotti digitali. Progetta soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali. Gestisce i requisiti non operativi (NFR). Documenti ed evolve l'architettura e garantisce l'allineamento con l'architettura e la governance RDT.

• Responsabilità: Solves problemi complessi, prendendo una nuova prospettiva sulle soluzioni esistenti e esercitando giudizio basato sull'analisi di più fonti di informazione. Mantiene la visione, la roadmap e il paesaggio attuale per la soluzione assegnata. Assesse e consultazioni su impatti e dipendenze di iniziative su capacità, rischi e il paesaggio delle applicazioni.

• Partner esterni: Lei fungerà da guida operativa primaria per i fornitori esterni, garantendo che tutti i lavori di consegna si allineino ai nostri standard interni, tempi di progetto e aspettative di qualità. Comunica chiaramente i requisiti e offre una direzione tecnica e procedurale in corso. Mentre le squadre esterne eseguono i consegnabili, monitorerete i progressi, sbloccate le sfide

• Stakeholder Management: Spiega informazioni tecniche difficili o sensibili e lavora in collaborazione per costruire il consenso tra team di prodotti, stakeholder aziendali e colleghi tecnici. Guidare tutte le discussioni con i team di prodotti digitali per garantire l'adozione di standard e processi di backoffice commerciali

• Impatto/Strategia: Sviluppa e mantiene la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto. Fornisce la supervisione tecnica, la guida e la consultazione per i team di prodotti digitali. Identifica le opportunità per migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali, migliora le soluzioni esistenti, gestisce il debito tecnico, e le ricerche, valuta, pilota e guida l'adozione di nuove tecnologie.

Qualifiche

• Prova esperienza in almeno una delle principali capacità di lavoro Fornitura o Mediazione di utilizzo

• Buona esperienza con le tecnologie di integrazione di sistema e il modello comune di progettazione di integrazione (MuleSoft e SAPCPI / SAP IS preferito).

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Stellenbeschreibung
Der Solution Architect für die Bereitstellung und Vermittlung digitaler Produkte entwirft geschäftsorientierte, standardbasierte und zukunftsfähige E2E-Lösungen. In dieser Rolle entwerfen Sie Lösungen, die den Produktanforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards entsprechen, während Sie nicht funktionale Anforderungen verwalten und die Architektur während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus weiterentwickeln. Durch die Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme, die Definition von Referenzarchitekturen und die Ausrichtung auf die breitere Architekturgemeinschaft für die Governance stellen Sie robuste Implementierungen sicher, die dem Unternehmen einen Mehrwert bieten. Dies ist eine praktische Lösung Architektur Rolle
Beschreibung des Gebiets
Aufgabenbereich

• Hauptverantwortung: Eigentümer aller technischen Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit der Nutzungsmediation (konvergente Mediation durch DigitalRoute) und der Bereitstellung digitaler Produkte (automatische Mieterstellung) nach definierten kommerziellen Modellen. Einschließlich der gesamten Integration zwischen Systemen, die den End-to-End-Datenfluss unterstützen

• Umfang: Primärer Ansprechpartner in allen Fragen der Mediation und digitalen Produktbereitstellung. Entwirft Lösungen, die Anforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards erfüllen. Verwaltet nichtfunktionale Anforderungen (NFR). Dokumentiert und entwickelt die Architektur und stellt die Ausrichtung auf die RDT-Architektur und -Governance sicher.

• Rechenschaftspflicht: Löst komplexe Probleme, nimmt eine neue Perspektive auf bestehende Lösungen und übt Urteilsvermögen auf der Grundlage der Analyse mehrerer Informationsquellen aus. Behält die Vision, die Roadmap und die aktuelle Landschaft für die zugewiesene Lösung bei. Beurteilt und berät über Auswirkungen und Abhängigkeiten von Initiativen auf Fähigkeiten, Risiken und die Anwendungslandschaft.

• Externe Partner: Sie dienen als primärer operativer Leitfaden für externe Anbieter und stellen sicher, dass alle Lieferarbeiten mit unseren internen Standards, Projektzeitplänen und Qualitätserwartungen übereinstimmen. Sie kommunizieren Anforderungen klar und bieten eine fortlaufende technische und verfahrenstechnische Ausrichtung. Während externe Teams die praktischen Ergebnisse ausführen, überwachen Sie den Fortschritt und entsperren Herausforderungen

• Stakeholder-Management: Erklärt schwierige oder sensible technische Informationen und arbeitet gemeinsam daran, einen Konsens zwischen Produktteams, Geschäftsbeteiligten und technischen Kollegen herzustellen. Führen Sie alle Diskussionen mit digitalen Produktteams, um die Übernahme von kommerziellen Backoffice-Standards und -Prozessen sicherzustellen

• Impact/Strategie: Entwickelt und pflegt die Technologie-Roadmap des Produkts. Bietet technische Aufsicht, Anleitung und Beratung für digitale Produktteams. Identifiziert Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Wert- und Geschäftsprozessen, verbessert bestehende Lösungen, verwaltet technische Schulden und erforscht, bewertet, pilotiert und treibt die Einführung neuer Technologien voran.

• Support und Betrieb: Sie erhalten operative Exzellenz, indem Sie eine Ursachenanalyse zu End-to-End-Produktionsproblemen durchführen. Dienen Sie als wichtiger Eskalationspunkt, um komplexe Betriebsfehler zu beheben und vorbeugende Maßnahmen festzulegen, die eine hohe Systemzuverlässigkeit und zeitnahe Leistung gewährleisten.

Qualifikationen

• Besitzen Sie einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Informationstechnologie oder einem eng verwandten technischen Bereich.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in mindestens einer der wichtigsten Job-Fähigkeiten Bereitstellung oder Nutzung Mediation

• Gute Erfahrungen mit Systemintegrationstechnologien und gemeinsamem Integrationsdesignmuster (MuleSoft und SAPCPI / SAP IS bevorzugt).

• Verständnis grundlegender Integrationsmuster (APIs, ereignisgesteuert, et)

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Description de l'emploi
L'architecte Solution pour la fourniture et la médiation de produits numériques conçoit des solutions E2E axées sur l'entreprise, basées sur des normes et prêtes à l'avenir. Dans ce rôle, vous concevrez des solutions qui répondent aux exigences du produit, aux priorités opérationnelles et aux normes d'entreprise tout en gérant les exigences non fonctionnelles et en évoluant l'architecture tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. En résolvant des problèmes techniques complexes, en définissant des architectures de référence et en s'adaptant à l'ensemble de la communauté de l'architecture pour la gouvernance, vous assurerez des implémentations robustes qui apportent une valeur ajoutée à l'organisation. Maintenir la vision, la feuille de route et le paysage actuel pour la solution assignée. Évaluer et consulter les répercussions et les dépendances des initiatives sur les capacités, les risques et le paysage d'application.

• Partenaires externes : Vous servirez de guide opérationnel principal pour les fournisseurs externes, en s'assurant que tous les travaux de livraison sont conformes à nos normes internes, nos calendriers de projet et nos attentes en matière de qualité. Vous communiquez clairement les exigences et offrez une orientation technique et procédurale continue. Alors que les équipes externes exécutent les résultats concrets, vous surveillerez les progrès, débloquerez les défis

• Gestion des intervenants : Explique l'information technique difficile ou délicate et travaille en collaboration pour établir un consensus entre les équipes de produits, les intervenants commerciaux et les pairs techniques. Conduire toutes les discussions avec les équipes de produits numériques pour assurer l'adoption des normes et des processus commerciaux backoffice

• Impact/Stratégie : Élaborer et maintenir la feuille de route technologique du produit. Fournit une supervision technique, des conseils et des consultations aux équipes de produits numériques. Indique les possibilités d'améliorer la valeur et les processus opérationnels, améliore les solutions existantes, gère la dette technique et recherche, évalue, pilote et stimule l'adoption de nouvelles technologies.

• Soutien et opérations : Vous divulguez l'excellence opérationnelle en effectuant une analyse des causes profondes des problèmes de production de bout en bout. Servir de point d'escalade clé pour résoudre les défaillances opérationnelles complexes et établir des mesures préventives qui maintiennent une fiabilité élevée du système et une production opportune.

Compétences

• Posséder un baccalauréat en informatique, technologie de l'information ou un domaine technique étroitement lié.

• Expérience éprouvée dans au moins une des principales capacités d'emploi Fourniture ou utilisation Médiation

• Bonne expérience avec les technologies d'intégration du système et le modèle de conception d'intégration commun (MuleSoft et SAPCPI / SAP IS préféré).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In your role as Global Technical Transfer Leader, you will be accountable for scoping, planning and executing technical transfers of small and large molecules between clinical & commercial internal and external manufacturing sites. You will become a core member of the Technical Development Team (TDT) and the Product Technical Team (PTT) responsible for managing timelines, resources, risks, and escalation of issues. You will also be accountable for ensuring adherence to established standards and tools to ensure consistent project planning and execution, informed prioritization across the portfolio, and knowledge sharing with peers and stakeholders. Your role has a significant impact on the achievement of company goals and objectives and requires partnering with stakeholders from across the PT organization such as from Product Strategy Teams (PSTs), Technical Development Teams (TDTs), relevant site functions, etc.

• Your key responsibilities will include:
• Lead planning and/or execution as well as provide oversight of assigned transfer projects incl. product launches, line extensions, commercial tech transfers, multi-node transfers, and multi-product programs

• Deliver E2E supply chain implementation by establishing new manufacturing nodes for Drug Substance, Drug Product, Combination Products, and Secondary Packaging

• Implement and apply project management knowledge to the Product Technical Teams (PTTs) and Technical Development Teams (TDTs)

• Escalate and drive resolution of complex risks and issues. Exercise judgment in selecting methods, approaches, and evaluation criteria to provide solutions to the organization

• For external transfers, own the Joint project team (JPT) with team members from the CDMO

• Lead cross functional teams with a Lean and continuous improvement mindset and with a strong focus on outcomes and impact for patients. Drive lessons learned to proactively identify and address network level issues.

• Lead and/or participate in cross-site/product assessments

• Identify all interdependencies to other products, projects to ensure transparency of project risks and alignment with the current network and product strategies

• Support site selections triggering new technical transfers by appropriate project scoping and planning, evaluation of relevant project risks and mitigations, and securing the required project resources/budget with key stakeholders

• Provide transparency of the project status to key customers and stakeholders in a highly visible global setting
