jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

As Team Lead Engineering Event Intelligence & Automation (Senior Engineering Manager) you will ensure and support the delivery as a leader, setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders, and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible. You will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision and will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus on their performance management, and make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics, and a sustainable pace.

Description of the area
The Digital Operations and Reliability function ensures the proactive management and maintenance of the optimal performance, reliability, and availability of all RDT enterprise-wide digital platforms and Infrastructure, minimizing disruption to business processes across the value chain, and guaranteeing compliance.
The Event Intelligence and Automation team provides capabilities and solutions like Event Intelligence or Self-healing, so that systems can automatically detect, diagnose, and remediate known issues without human intervention, ensuring continuous performance optimization and significantly reducing operational toil and reactive incidents.
This team plays a key part within Operational Predictive Intelligence to champion AI Operations and drive operational excellence via tools and automations to anticipate potential service failures or capacity bottlenecks before they impact the business, and enables a shift from reactive troubleshooting to proactive risk identification and planning.

Job responsibilities

• Team Member Capability and Career Development

• Proactively identifies and develops future-focused engineering team capabilities, aligning with long-term strategic goals.

• Mentors team members on long-term career paths, creating new opportunities and roles within the organization to support their growth.

• Addresses and helps resolve complex, systemic roadblocks that impact multiple development teams, and coaches other managers on effective performance management.

• Oversees the technical and soft skill development, ensuring a balanced and high-performing talent portfolio.

• Team Health and Sustainability

• Establishes and monitors metrics for team health and sustainability across several development teams, implementing strategies to ensure long-term balance.

• Designs and implements initiatives to improve collaboration and psychological safety across multiple related development teams or a whole product area.

• Proactively identifies and resolves systemic impediments that affect multiple development teams, improving the overall work environment.

• Manages the talent composition for own and related teams, planning for future needs and ensuring a healthy pipeline of skills.

• Product and Service Delivery Leadership

• Responsible for co-creating the long-term technical vision and strategy for a product portfolio, partnering with Product Managers and Leaders who are overall responsible for the roadmaps.

• Accountable for the overall delivery performance and successful shipment of features across a product, holding teams accountable for their results.

• Manages technical and delivery priorities and dependencies across a portfolio of products or services, ensuring alignment with broader business object

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro

In qualità di Team Lead Engineering Event Intelligence & Automation (Senior Engineering Manager) garantirai e supporterai la consegna come leader, impostando l'attenzione, rimuovendo impedimenti, gestendo le parti interessate e creando efficienze in collaborazione dove possibile. Ti concentrerai sullo sviluppo delle capacità dei membri del tuo team che si allineano alla visione della funzione e incoraggeranno il tuo team a autodefinire il loro percorso di carriera e cercare modi per consentire opportunità di sviluppo nella direzione del viaggio. Li supporterete nella rimozione dei blocchi stradali e mettendo a fuoco la loro gestione delle prestazioni, e assicuratevi di sviluppare il vostro team con le giuste competenze, dinamiche sane e un ritmo sostenibile.

Descrizione della zona
La funzione Digital Operations and Reliability garantisce la gestione e la manutenzione proattiva delle prestazioni ottimali, dell'affidabilità e della disponibilità di tutte le piattaforme digitali e delle Infrastrutture aziendali RDT, riducendo al minimo le interruzioni dei processi aziendali attraverso la catena del valore e garantendo la conformità.
Il team di Event Intelligence e Automation fornisce funzionalità e soluzioni come Event Intelligence o Self-healing, in modo che i sistemi possano rilevare, diagnosticare e risolvere problemi conosciuti senza intervento umano, garantendo un'ottimizzazione continua delle prestazioni e riducendo in modo significativo i problemi operativi e reattivi.
Questo team svolge un ruolo chiave all'interno dell'Intelligenza Predittiva Operativa per sostenere le Operazioni AI e guidare l'eccellenza operativa attraverso strumenti e automazione per anticipare potenziali guasti di servizio o strozzature di capacità prima di impatto sul business, e consente un passaggio dalla risoluzione dei problemi reattivi all'identificazione e alla pianificazione del rischio proattivo.

Responsabilità del lavoro

• Team Member Capability and Career Development

• Identifica e sviluppa in modo proattivo le capacità del team di ingegneria focalizzate sul futuro, allineando con obiettivi strategici a lungo termine.

• I membri del team Mentors sui percorsi di carriera a lungo termine, creando nuove opportunità e ruoli all'interno dell'organizzazione per sostenere la loro crescita.

• Indirizza e aiuta a risolvere blocchi stradali complessi e sistemici che colpiscono più team di sviluppo, e allena altri manager sulla gestione efficace delle prestazioni.

• Supera lo sviluppo tecnico e morbido delle competenze, garantendo un portafoglio di talenti equilibrato e performante.

• Salute e sostenibilità del team

• Stabilisce e monitora le metriche per la salute del team e la sostenibilità in diversi team di sviluppo, implementando strategie per garantire un equilibrio a lungo termine.

• Progetta e implementa iniziative per migliorare la collaborazione e la sicurezza psicologica tra più team di sviluppo correlati o un'intera area del prodotto.

• Proattivamente identifica e risolve gli impedimenti sistemici che influiscono su più team di sviluppo, migliorando l'ambiente di lavoro complessivo.

• Gestisce la composizione del talento per i propri e relativi team, progettando per le esigenze future e garantendo una sana pipeline di competenze.

• Leadership per la consegna di prodotti e servizi

• Responsabile per la co-creazione della visione tecnica a lungo termine e della strategia per un portafoglio di prodotti, collaborando con Product Managers e Leaders che sono in generale responsabili delle roadmap.

• Contabile per le prestazioni generali di consegna e la spedizione di caratteristiche di successo in un prodotto, team che tengono conto dei loro risultati.

• Gestisce le priorità e le dipendenze tecniche e di consegna in un portafoglio di prodotti o servizi, garantendo l'allineamento con l'oggetto aziendale più ampio

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Stellenbeschreibung

Als Team Lead Engineering Event Intelligence & Automation (Senior Engineering Manager) sichern und unterstützen Sie die Lieferung als Führungskraft, setzen den Fokus, beseitigen Hindernisse, verwalten Stakeholder und schaffen Effizienz in der Zusammenarbeit, wo immer möglich. Sie konzentrieren sich auf die Entwicklung der Fähigkeiten Ihrer Teammitglieder, die sich an der Vision der Funktion orientieren, und ermutigen Ihr Team, seine Karrierereise selbst zu definieren und nach Möglichkeiten zu suchen, Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in Richtung der Reise zu ermöglichen. Sie unterstützen sie dabei, Hindernisse zu beseitigen und sich auf ihr Leistungsmanagement zu konzentrieren, und stellen sicher, dass Sie Ihr Team mit den richtigen Fähigkeiten, einer gesunden Dynamik und einem nachhaltigen Tempo entwickeln.

Beschreibung des Gebiets
Die Funktion Digital Operations and Reliability gewährleistet das proaktive Management und die Aufrechterhaltung der optimalen Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Verfügbarkeit aller unternehmensweiten digitalen RDT-Plattformen und Infrastrukturen, minimiert die Unterbrechung von Geschäftsprozessen entlang der Wertschöpfungskette und garantiert die Compliance.
Das Event Intelligence- und Automatisierungsteam bietet Funktionen und Lösungen wie Event Intelligence oder Self-Healing, so dass Systeme bekannte Probleme ohne menschliches Eingreifen automatisch erkennen, diagnostizieren und beheben können, wodurch eine kontinuierliche Leistungsoptimierung und eine signifikante Reduzierung der betrieblichen Arbeit und reaktiver Vorfälle gewährleistet werden.
Dieses Team spielt eine wichtige Rolle bei Operational Predictive Intelligence, um KI-Operationen zu fördern und operative Exzellenz durch Tools und Automatisierungen zu fördern, um potenzielle Serviceausfälle oder Kapazitätsengpässe zu antizipieren, bevor sie sich auf das Geschäft auswirken, und ermöglicht einen Wechsel von der reaktiven Fehlersuche zu einer proaktiven Risikoerkennung und -planung.

Verantwortlichkeiten

• Team Member Capability und Karriereentwicklung

• Proaktiv identifiziert und entwickelt zukunftsorientierte Engineering-Teamfähigkeiten, die sich an langfristigen strategischen Zielen orientieren.

• Mentoren Teammitglieder auf langfristige Karrierewege, neue Möglichkeiten und Rollen innerhalb der Organisation zu schaffen, um ihr Wachstum zu unterstützen.

• Behebt und hilft bei der Lösung komplexer, systemischer Hindernisse, die sich auf mehrere Entwicklungsteams auswirken, und coacht andere Manager beim effektiven Leistungsmanagement.

• Überwacht die technische und Soft-Skill-Entwicklung und gewährleistet ein ausgewogenes und leistungsstarkes Talentportfolio.

• Team Gesundheit und Nachhaltigkeit

• Etabliert und überwacht Metriken für Teamgesundheit und Nachhaltigkeit in mehreren Entwicklungsteams und implementiert Strategien, um ein langfristiges Gleichgewicht zu gewährleisten.

• Entwickelt und implementiert Initiativen zur Verbesserung der Zusammenarbeit und der psychologischen Sicherheit in mehreren verwandten Entwicklungsteams oder einem ganzen Produktbereich.

• Proaktiv identifiziert und löst systemische Hindernisse, die mehrere Entwicklungsteams betreffen, und verbessert so die gesamte Arbeitsumgebung.

• Verwaltet die Talentzusammensetzung für eigene und verwandte Teams, plant zukünftige Bedürfnisse und stellt eine gesunde Pipeline von Fähigkeiten sicher.

• Produkt- und Service Delivery Leadership

• Verantwortlich für die gemeinsame Erstellung der langfristigen technischen Vision und Strategie für ein Produktportfolio und die Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagern und Führungskräften, die insgesamt für die Roadmaps verantwortlich sind.

• Verantwortlich für die gesamte Lieferleistung und den erfolgreichen Versand von Funktionen in einem Produkt, wobei Teams für ihre Ergebnisse verantwortlich sind.

• Verwaltet technische und Lieferprioritäten und Abhängigkeiten über ein Portfolio von Produkten oder Dienstleistungen hinweg und gewährleistet die Ausrichtung auf ein breiteres Geschäftsobjekt
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Description du poste

En tant que chef d'équipe en génie Événement Intelligence et automatisation (gestionnaire principal en génie), vous assurerez et soutenirez la prestation en tant que chef de file, en mettant l'accent sur l'établissement, en éliminant les obstacles, en gérant les intervenants et en créant des gains d'efficacité en collaboration chaque fois que possible. Vous vous concentrerez sur le développement des capacités des membres de votre équipe qui s'alignent sur la vision de la fonction et encouragerez votre équipe à se définir elle-même leur parcours de carrière et à chercher des moyens de permettre des opportunités de développement dans la direction du parcours. Vous les accompagnerez dans la suppression des barrages routiers et en mettant l'accent sur leur gestion de la performance, et assurez-vous de développer votre équipe avec les bonnes compétences, dynamique saine et un rythme durable.

Description de la zone
La fonction d'exploitation et de fiabilité numériques assure la gestion et la maintenance proactives des performances, de la fiabilité et de la disponibilité optimales de toutes les plateformes et infrastructures numériques de RDT à l'échelle de l'entreprise, minimisant ainsi les perturbations des processus opérationnels dans toute la chaîne de valeur et garantissant la conformité.
L'équipe Event Intelligence and Automation fournit des capacités et des solutions comme Event Intelligence ou Self-healing, afin que les systèmes puissent détecter, diagnostiquer et corriger automatiquement les problèmes connus sans intervention humaine, assurant une optimisation continue des performances et réduisant significativement le travail opérationnel et les incidents réactifs.
Cette équipe joue un rôle clé au sein de l'Intelligence Prédictive Opérationnelle pour défendre les Opérations d'IA et stimuler l'excellence opérationnelle au moyen d'outils et d'automatisations pour anticiper les éventuelles défaillances de service ou les goulets d'étranglement de capacité avant qu'elles n'aient une incidence sur l'entreprise, et permet de passer d'un dépannage réactif à une identification et une planification proactives des risques.

Responsabilités professionnelles

• Capacité des membres de l'équipe et perfectionnement professionnel

• Identifier et développer de façon proactive les capacités de l'équipe d'ingénierie axée sur l'avenir, en s'harmonisant avec les objectifs stratégiques à long terme.

• Les membres de l'équipe des mentors sur les parcours de carrière à long terme, créant de nouvelles possibilités et de nouveaux rôles au sein de l'organisation pour soutenir leur croissance.

• Résoudre et aider à résoudre les obstacles complexes et systémiques qui ont une incidence sur plusieurs équipes de perfectionnement, et entraîne d'autres gestionnaires à une gestion efficace du rendement.

• Supervise le développement des compétences techniques et douces, assurant un portefeuille de talents équilibré et performant.

• Équipe Santé et durabilité

• Établir et surveiller des paramètres pour la santé et la durabilité des équipes dans plusieurs équipes de développement, en mettant en œuvre des stratégies visant à assurer un équilibre à long terme.

• Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des initiatives visant à améliorer la collaboration et la sécurité psychologique entre plusieurs équipes de développement connexes ou tout un secteur de produits.

• Leadership dans la prestation des produits et des services

• Responsable de la co-création de la vision et de la stratégie techniques à long terme pour un portefeuille de produits, en partenariat avec les gestionnaires de produits et les dirigeants qui sont globalement responsables des feuilles de route.

• Responsable de la performance globale de la livraison et de l'expédition réussie des caractéristiques d'un produit, les équipes responsables de leurs résultats.

• Gérer les priorités et les dépendances techniques et d'exécution dans un portefeuille de produits ou de services, en assurant l'alignement avec un objectif opérationnel plus large

jobs.title: System Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Die Position:

Als System Scientist (m/w/d) koordinierst Du in der Abteilung Design Evaluation and Prototyping die zentralen Aspekte des Systemkerns in unseren Entwicklungsprojekten. Damit leistest Du einen direkten Beitrag zur Umsetzung unserer Vision: Die Verbesserung der Lebensqualität von Patient:innen weltweit. Du verbindest technische Anforderungsanalysen mit innovativen Herstellverfahren und stellst sicher, dass unsere elektrochemischen Sensorsysteme höchste Leistungs- und Qualitätsstandards erfüllen. Durch Deine Arbeit hilfst Du mit, bahnbrechende Diagnostika zu entwickeln und legst den Grundstein für eine gesündere Zukunft – gemeinsam.

Dein neues Team:

Du wirst Teil unseres engagierten Teams im Bereich Design Evaluation and Prototyping. Wir arbeiten an der Schnittstelle verschiedener Fachbereiche und entwickeln komplexe Diagnostiklösungen. Als System Scientist steuerst Du multidisziplinäre Schnittstellen und arbeitest eng mit Expert:innen aus R&D, Medical und Operations zusammen. Vertrauen, offener Austausch und der Wille, gemeinsam innovative Wege zu gehen, bilden das Fundament unserer Zusammenarbeit.

Deine Aufgabengebiete:

Deine Mission ist es, die Anforderungen an den Systemkern zu überblicken, Optimierungspotenziale zu heben und die Prototypenfertigung termingerecht voranzutreiben. Dabei übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Du stimmst das Design und die Herstellverfahren unterschiedlicher Konfigurationen elektrochemischer Sensorsystemmodule eng mit den Fachbereichen ab, um die Projektziele optimal zu erreichen.

• Du steuerst die Schnittstellen aller beteiligten Fachbereiche, um Einflüsse abzugleichen und eine maximierte Systemleistung sicherzustellen.

• Du koordinierst die fristgerechte Fertigung von Entwicklungs- und Prototypmustern elektrochemischer Sensorsysteme.

• Du verantwortest die GMP-gerechte Dokumentation und veranlasst die Erstellung aller notwendigen entwicklungsbegleitenden Unterlagen im regulierten Umfeld.

• Du bringst Deine Expertise aktiv in die Entwicklung technisch herausfordernder Systeme ein und hältst Dein Wissen in einer dynamischen Prozessumgebung stets auf dem neuesten Stand.

Das bringst Du mit:

Wir suchen eine lösungsorientierte und kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit, die Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit und komplexen Systemprojekten hat. Du bringst folgende Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten mit:

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Masterstudium (M.Sc.) mit Bezug zu Medizinprodukten.

• Fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Medizinprodukten in einem regulierten Umfeld.

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Konstruktion, Elektrotechnik und Programmierung.

• Kenntnisse in Elektrochemie sowie in der Herstellung elektrochemischer Sensoren, ergänzt durch solide Kenntnisse der Biochemie, sind von Vorteil.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Konfigurationsmanagement sowie in der fertigungs- und entwicklungsbegleitenden Dokumentation (speziell für klinische Studien).

• Erfahrung in der Erarbeitung von Optimierungsstrategien sowie in der Zusammenarbeit an Schnittstellen zu R&D, Medical, Operations und externen Partnern.

• Fließende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für den sicheren Austausch in internationalen Projektkontexten.

• Ausgeprägte soziale Kompetenz, Kommunikationsstärke, Verhandlungsgeschick und die Fähigkeit, andere zu motivieren.

Deine Bewerbung:

Bitte lade hierfür einfach nur Deinen Lebenslauf hoch.
Zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt benötigen wir keine weiteren Dokumente, wie Motivationsschreiben, A

jobs.title: Senior SAP Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Senior Cloud Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and evolving reusable SAP BTP /Cloud platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and efficient application development across the enterprise.

The role requires transforming architectural decisions into production-ready capabilities, automation, engineering frameworks, and reusable services. Working closely with Platform Architecture and Platform Operations. The role ensures platform capabilities are engineered with reliability, scalability, security, and developer experience at the forefront. The Platform Engineering Lead drives innovation through technical exploration, proof-of-concepts, engineering standards, automation, and platform modernization while enabling application teams to consume SAP BTP through standardized patterns.

This role provides technical leadership across platform engineering initiatives and is accountable for engineering quality, execution, and continuous improvement of the platform.

Job Responsibilities

Scope:

Platform Engineering, Administration & Capability Development

Lead the administration, development, and continuous evolution of reusable cloud platform capabilities, engineering frameworks, and shared services. Manage platform environments, services, identity and access integration, connectivity, and shared platform capabilities. Own the end-to-end engineering lifecycle from implementation, delivering scalable, secure, and resilient platform capabilities aligned with platform architecture, engineering standards, and regulatory requirements.

Engineering Excellence, Automation & Platform Evolution

Drive engineering excellence by establishing modern engineering practices, including DevSecOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and cloud-native engineering patterns. Lead technology evaluations, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), and adoption of emerging cloud services while continuously improving platform reliability, operational efficiency, developer experience, and self-service capabilities.

Technical Leadership & Engineering Delivery

Provide technical leadership and show accountability across complex platform initiatives by planning engineering capacity, managing technical dependencies and risks, and mentoring engineering teams. Collaborate closely with Architecture, Operations, Security, Vendors, and business stakeholders to translate platform strategy into engineering execution, delivering reusable platform capabilities that simplify adoption and enable enterprise-scale digital solutions.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.

• Demonstrated experience making strategic technical decisions and leading large to enterprise-level project teams.

• Proven track record of designing, and implementing integrated, reliable enterprise platform capabilities across technology space.

• Experience in estimating complex engineering resources, dependencies, and timelines to deliver successful enterprise projects.

• Experience working with SAP BTP or comparable enterprise cloud platforms.

Technical / Business Skills
Strong experience with:

• Advanced technical expertise in multiple areas (e.g., Platform, Compute and Storage, Network Management, ERP Technology Management, High Performance Computing, Datacenter Management, or Database Management).

• SAP BTP administration/Cloud-native engineering

• Infrastructure as Code, Automation framew

jobs.title: Senior ADS Programmer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is in Analytical Data Science, a core function within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across Development at Roche. PDD Analytical Data Science teams are mobilized across the portfolio to generate data-driven insights, identify opportunities for scale, and implement impactful solutions.

PDD Analytical Data Science is recognized as a leading hub for top industry talent, operating as an agile workforce to deliver regulatory commitments across the portfolio. We identify, influence, and adopt industry-leading digital and automation solutions, develop analytical approaches to support exploratory analyses, and align statistical programming practices across both early- and late-stage clinical development.

The Opportunity:

The Analytical Data Science Programmer is a key contributor to the clinical study team, responsible for transforming statistical analysis plans into high-quality, traceable programming deliverables. This includes both static and dynamic outputs, such as tables, listings, figures, and interactive data visualizations or dashboards. The role involves creating and validating datasets in accordance with Study Data Tabulation Model and Analysis Data Model standards, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and Roche standards. In addition to supporting regulatory submissions, the ADS Programmer plays a critical role in generating data insights through platforms such as the Insight Engine, enabling real-time exploration and interpretation of diverse clinical and exploratory data. This role contributes to a modern, insight-driven development environment by facilitating robust, timely, and decision-enabling analytics across clinical programs.

• You independently develop, validate, and maintain datasets and statistical outputs for clinical trials, including Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) datasets, Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets, and tables, listings, and figures (TLFs), ensuring programming accuracy, traceability, and compliance with internal processes and regulatory expectations

• You develop and support programming outputs across a wide range of data types, including exploratory biomarker data and real-world data, to support both regulatory and scientific objectives

• You collaborate on exploratory analyses that span disease areas and therapeutic areas, enabling insight generation to inform drug development strategies

• You support the creation and refinement of interactive tools and analytical applications (e.g., dashboards or visual data platforms) that enable dynamic exploration of integrated datasets by scientific and clinical teams

• You provide programming leadership for assigned studies, coordinating deliverables across internal and external programming partners to meet study timelines and requirements

• You interpret statistical analysis plans and translate them into executable programming specifications to ensure scientific rigor in outputs

• You troubleshoot and resolve technical programming challenges with limited supervision, proactively identifying risks and implementing effective solutions while meeting timelines

• You contribute to the design and maintenance of standard

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

Questo ruolo è in Analytical Data Science, una funzione fondamentale all'interno di Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) che fornisce leadership strategica e rigore scientifico attraverso lo sviluppo a Roche. I team di PDD Analytical Data Science sono mobilitati in tutto il portafoglio per generare informazioni basate sui dati, identificare le opportunità di scala e implementare soluzioni di impatto.

PDD Analytical Data Science è riconosciuto come un hub leader per i migliori talenti del settore, operante come una forza lavoro agile per fornire impegni normativi in tutto il portafoglio. Identifichiamo, influenziamo e adottiamo soluzioni digitali e di automazione leader del settore, sviluppiamo approcci analitici per sostenere le analisi esplorative e allineiamo le pratiche di programmazione statistica sia all'inizio che al tardo stadio dello sviluppo clinico.

L'opportunità:

Il programmatore Analytical Data Science è un contributore chiave al team di studio clinico, responsabile della trasformazione dei piani di analisi statistica in materiali di programmazione tracciabili di alta qualità. Questo include uscite sia statiche che dinamiche, come tabelle, elenchi, figure e visualizzazioni interattive dei dati o dashboard. Il ruolo prevede la creazione e la convalida di set di dati in conformità con gli standard del Modello di Scheda di Studio e del Modello di Dati di Analisi, garantendo il rispetto dei requisiti normativi e degli standard Roche. Oltre a sostenere le presentazioni regolamentari, il programmatore ADS svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella generazione di informazioni sui dati attraverso piattaforme come il Insight Engine, consentendo l'esplorazione in tempo reale e l'interpretazione di diversi dati clinici ed esplorativi. Questo ruolo contribuisce a un ambiente di sviluppo moderno, orientato all'intuizione, facilitando l'analisi robusta, tempestiva e decisionale nei programmi clinici.

• L'utente sviluppa, convalida e mantiene in modo indipendente set di dati e output statistici per gli studi clinici, inclusi i dataset del Modello di Tabulazione dei Dati di Studio (SDTM), i dataset del Modello di analisi (ADaM) e le tabelle, gli elenchi e le cifre (TLF), garantendo precisione di programmazione, tracciabilità e conformità ai processi interni e alle aspettative normative

• Sviluppi e supporti gli output di programmazione in una vasta gamma di tipi di dati, compresi i dati di biomarcatori esplorativi e i dati del mondo reale, per supportare obiettivi sia normativi che scientifici

• Collabori su analisi esplorative che abbracciano aree di malattia e aree terapeutiche, consentendo una generazione di informazioni per informare le strategie di sviluppo della droga

• Supporti la creazione e la raffinatezza di strumenti interattivi e applicazioni analitiche (ad esempio, dashboard o piattaforme di dati visivi) che consentono l'esplorazione dinamica di dataset integrati da parte di team scientifici e clinici

• Fornite la leadership di programmazione per gli studi assegnati, coordinando i deliverable tra i partner di programmazione interni ed esterni per soddisfare le tempistiche e i requisiti di studio

• Lei interpreta i piani di analisi statistica e li traduce in specifiche di programmazione eseguibili per garantire rigore scientifico nelle uscite

• La risoluzione dei problemi e la risoluzione delle sfide di programmazione tecnica con una supervisione limitata, l'identificazione proattiva dei rischi e l'implementazione di soluzioni efficaci durante la riunione dei termini

• Contribuisci alla progettazione e manutenzione di standard

This includes both static and dynamic outputs, such as tables, listings, figures, and interactive data visualizations or dashboards. The role involves creating and validating datasets in accordance with Study Data Tabulation Model and Analysis Data Model standards, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and Roche standards. In addition to supporting regulatory submissions, the ADS Programmer plays a critical role in generating data insights through platforms such as the Insight Engine, enabling real-time exploration and interpretation of diverse clinical and exploratory data. This role contributes to a modern, insight-driven development environment by facilitating robust, timely, and decision-enabling analytics across clinical programs.

• You independently develop, validate, and maintain datasets and statistical outputs for clinical trials, including Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) datasets, Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets, and tables, listings, and figures (TLFs), ensuring programming accuracy, traceability, and compliance with internal processes and regulatory expectations

• You develop and support programming outputs across a wide range of data types, including exploratory biomarker data and real-world data, to support both regulatory and scientific objectives

• You collaborate on exploratory analyses that span disease areas and therapeutic areas, enabling insight generation to inform drug development strategies

• You support the creation and refinement of interactive tools and analytical applications (e.g., dashboards or visual data platforms) that enable dynamic exploration of integrated datasets by scientific and clinical teams

• You provide programming leadership for assigned studies, coordinating deliverables across internal and external programming partners to meet study timelines and requirements

• You interpret statistical analysis plans and translate them into executable programming specifications to ensure scientific rigor in outputs

• You troubleshoot and resolve technical programming challenges with limited supervision, proactively identifying risks and implementing effective solutions while meeting timelines

• You contribute to the design and maintenance of standard
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Diese Rolle ist in Analytical Data Science, einer Kernfunktion innerhalb der Product Development Data Sciences (PDD), die strategische Führung und wissenschaftliche Strenge in der Entwicklung bei Roche bietet. PDD Analytical Data Science-Teams werden im gesamten Portfolio mobilisiert, um datenbasierte Erkenntnisse zu generieren, Skalierungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und wirkungsvolle Lösungen zu implementieren.

PDD Analytical Data Science ist als führendes Zentrum für Top-Industrietalente anerkannt und agiert als agile Belegschaft, um regulatorische Verpflichtungen im gesamten Portfolio zu erfüllen. Wir identifizieren, beeinflussen und übernehmen branchenführende digitale und Automatisierungslösungen, entwickeln analytische Ansätze zur Unterstützung explorativer Analysen und richten statistische Programmierpraktiken sowohl in der frühen als auch in der späten Phase der klinischen Entwicklung aus.

Die Gelegenheit:

Der Analytical Data Science Programmer ist ein wichtiger Beitrag zum klinischen Studienteam, das für die Umwandlung statistischer Analysepläne in qualitativ hochwertige, rückverfolgbare Programmierergebnisse verantwortlich ist. Neben der Unterstützung von Zulassungsanträgen spielt der ADS-Programmierer eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Generierung von Datenerkenntnissen durch Plattformen wie die Insight Engine, die die Echtzeit-Exploration und Interpretation verschiedener klinischer und explorativer Daten ermöglicht. Diese Rolle trägt zu einer modernen, aufschlussreichen Entwicklungsumgebung bei, indem sie robuste, zeitnahe und entscheidungsfähige Analysen in klinischen Programmen ermöglicht.

• Sie entwickeln, validieren und pflegen unabhängig Datensätze und statistische Ausgaben für klinische Studien, einschließlich Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM)-Datensätze, Analysis Data Model (ADaM)-Datensätze sowie Tabellen, Auflistungen und Zahlen (TLFs), um die Programmiergenauigkeit, Rückverfolgbarkeit und Einhaltung interner Prozesse und regulatorischer Erwartungen zu gewährleisten.

• Sie entwickeln und unterstützen Programmierergebnisse für eine Vielzahl von Datentypen, einschließlich explorativer Biomarkerdaten und realer Daten, um sowohl regulatorische als auch wissenschaftliche Ziele zu unterstützen.

• Sie arbeiten an explorativen Analysen zusammen, die Krankheitsbereiche und therapeutische Bereiche umfassen und es ermöglichen, Erkenntnisse zu generieren, um Strategien für die Arzneimittelentwicklung zu informieren

• Sie unterstützen die Erstellung und Verfeinerung von interaktiven Tools und analytischen Anwendungen (z. B. Dashboards oder visuelle Datenplattformen), die eine dynamische Erkundung integrierter Datensätze durch wissenschaftliche und klinische Teams ermöglichen.

• Sie bieten Programmierführung für zugewiesene Studien und koordinieren die Ergebnisse interner und externer Programmierpartner, um die Studienzeitpläne und -anforderungen zu erfüllen

• Sie interpretieren statistische Analysepläne und übersetzen sie in ausführbare Programmierspezifikationen, um die wissenschaftliche Strenge der Ergebnisse sicherzustellen

• Sie beheben und lösen technische Programmierherausforderungen mit begrenzter Aufsicht, erkennen proaktiv Risiken und implementieren effektive Lösungen, während Sie die Zeitvorgaben einhalten

• Sie tragen zur Gestaltung und Wartung von Standards bei

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Ce rôle est dans le domaine de l'analyse des données, une fonction essentielle au sein de l'élaboration de produits Data Sciences (PDD) qui assure le leadership stratégique et la rigueur scientifique dans l'ensemble du développement à Roche. Les équipes de la PDD Analytical Data Science sont mobilisées dans l'ensemble du portefeuille pour générer des informations fondées sur les données, identifier les possibilités d'échelle et mettre en œuvre des solutions efficaces.

La PDD Analytical Data Science est reconnue comme un pôle de premier plan pour les meilleurs talents de l'industrie, fonctionnant comme une main-d'oeuvre agile pour respecter les engagements réglementaires dans l'ensemble du portefeuille. Nous identifions, influons et adoptons des solutions numériques et d'automatisation de pointe, nous développons des approches analytiques pour appuyer les analyses exploratoires et nous aligneons les pratiques de programmation statistique sur le développement clinique en début et en fin de développement.

La possibilité :

Le programmeur de la science des données analytiques est l'un des principaux contributeurs de l'équipe d'étude clinique, qui est chargée de transformer les plans d'analyse statistique en produits de programmation de grande qualité et traçables. Cela comprend les sorties statiques et dynamiques, comme les tableaux, les listes, les figures et les visualisations interactives de données ou les tableaux de bord. Le rôle consiste à créer et à valider des ensembles de données conformément aux normes du modèle de calcul des données d'étude et du modèle de données d'analyse, en assurant le respect des exigences réglementaires et des normes Roche. En plus d'appuyer les présentations réglementaires, le programmeur ADS joue un rôle essentiel dans la production de données par le biais de plates-formes telles que le moteur Insight, permettant l'exploration et l'interprétation en temps réel de diverses données cliniques et exploratoires. Ce rôle contribue à un environnement de développement moderne axé sur les connaissances en facilitant l'analyse robuste, opportune et décisionnelle dans l'ensemble des programmes cliniques.

• Vous élaborez, validez et maintenez de façon indépendante des ensembles de données et des extrants statistiques pour les essais cliniques, y compris des ensembles de données du modèle de tabulation des données d'étude (SDTM), des ensembles de données du modèle de données d'analyse (ADaM) et des tableaux, des listes et des figures (FTL), assurant l'exactitude de la programmation, la traçabilité et la conformité aux processus internes et aux attentes réglementaires.

• Vous développez et supportez des extrants de programmation pour un large éventail de types de données, y compris les données exploratoires de biomarqueurs et les données du monde réel, afin de soutenir des objectifs réglementaires et scientifiques

• Vous collaborez à des analyses exploratoires qui couvrent les domaines de la maladie et des domaines thérapeutiques, permettant de générer des connaissances pour éclairer les stratégies de développement des médicaments

• Vous soutenez la création et le perfectionnement d'outils interactifs et d'applications analytiques (p. ex. tableaux de bord ou plateformes de données visuelles) qui permettent une exploration dynamique des ensembles de données intégrés par les équipes scientifiques et cliniques

• Vous exercez un leadership en matière de programmes pour les études assignées, en coordonnant les produits livrables entre les partenaires de programmes internes et externes afin de respecter les échéances et les exigences de l'étude.

• Vous interprètez les plans d'analyse statistique et les traduisez en spécifications de programmation exécutables pour assurer la rigueur scientifique dans les extrants

• Vous dépannez et résolvez les défis de programmation technique avec une supervision limitée, identifiez proactifment les risques et mettez en œuvre des solutions efficaces tout en respectant les délais

• Vous contribuez à la conception et à la maintenance de la norme

jobs.title: (Senior) Android App Developer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe that every patient deserves the best possible care, supported by innovative science and technology. We are looking for a senior individual contributor to take significant technical ownership of components within our One Diagnostics Platform.

In this role, you won't just build apps; you will design and develop the reusable Android components, frameworks, and libraries that power multiple medical diagnostics ecosystems. Your work will directly impact the reliability, security, and scale of software used globally in life-saving medical environments.

Your responsibilities

• Design, develop and maintain shared Android applications, components, libraries and frameworks using Kotlin and Java.

• Develop clear, stable and well-documented APIs according to the Roche quality processes and regulatory requirements.

• Drive modular Android architecture and establish patterns that support scalability, maintainability and reuse.

• Ensure backward compatibility and manage the lifecycle, versioning and migration of shared components.

• Collaborate with project teams to understand common needs and translate them into reusable platform capabilities.

• Review technical designs and code, identify architectural risks and promote consistent engineering practices.

• Plan and perform software unit verification tests depending on the role as developer or development tester of a specific component from the One diagnostics Platform

• Develop robust automated tests, including unit, integration and UI tests where appropriate.

• Investigate complex technical issues affecting multiple applications and provide sustainable solutions rather than isolated fixes.

• Contribute to secure software design, protection of sensitive data and appropriate handling of application permissions according to regulatory guidelines.

• Create and maintain the technical documentation and development evidence required in a regulated medical environment.

• Work closely with product owners, system architects, quality, regulatory, cybersecurity and verification teams.

• Raise the Bar: Mentor other engineers through constructive code reviews, design discussions, and championing modern engineering practices.

Who You Are
You combine strong hands-on Android expertise with a systems-thinking mindset. You enjoy solving problems once and making the solution useful for many teams. You care about clear interfaces, maintainable code, reliable tests, and thorough documentation within a quality-driven, compliant environment.

Requirements

• High proficiency in Kotlin and strong experience in Java .

• Extensive background in building Android applications, shared software components, system-level architecture, and Gradle build systems.

• Practical experience using AI-assisted tools within software development workflows.

• Proven track record designing modular architectures, managing APIs, and using versioning/dependency tools within highly regulated or safety-critical sectors (e.g., Medical Devices/MedTech, Automotive, Aviation, Defense, Railway).

• Strong grasp of the Android SDK, application lifecycles, memory management, clean architecture, and dependency injection.

• Solid experience with unit and integration test automation and pipeline integration (Azure DevOps/GitHub).

• Professional fluency in English (written and verbal).

• You are capable of traveling 5% to 10% of your time to different locations mainly within Europe.

Beneficial Qualifications:

• Familiarity with healthcare/Med

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
P&C Technology Innovation & Solutions Engineer

The P&C Technology Innovation & Solutions Engineer will be a key member of the People & Culture (P&C) Engineering team within Roche Digital Technology (RDT) . Operating at the intersection of public cloud infrastructure and core HR SaaS platforms, the P&C Engineering team provides the technical enablers and hands-on validation required to realize P&C strategic objectives .

As the P&C Technology Innovation & Solutions Engineer, you will act as a hands-on technical partner to Product Delivery Leads (PDLs) and work alongside Solution Architects . In this role, you will evaluate technology roadmaps, assess feature feasibility, write serverless glue code, and build cloud-native prototypes and integration adapters for our P&C platform ecosystem .

The Opportunity

In this role, you will drive hands-on technical execution, rapid prototyping, and architecture validation across our HR technology landscape. You will:

• Partner daily with Product Delivery Leads and Solution Architects to evaluate feature feasibility, latency, rate limits, and integration impacts across platforms like Workday, ServiceNow, and Cornerstone .

• Engineer lightweight, serverless cloud glue code using services like AWS Lambda and API Gateway to connect core SaaS platforms with internal cloud environments .

• Build rapid Proofs-of-Concept (PoCs) to validate integration feasibility and streamline real-world data flow across cloud ecosystems .

• Lead deep-dive technical discussions with prospective vendors, inspecting API/SDK capabilities, payload schemas, and authentication models beyond high-level product demonstrations .

• Drive technical Security Risk Assessments (SRAs) and detailed data-flow mappings for new tools and integration patterns in close coordination with Cybersecurity teams .

• Analyze existing P&C system capabilities and cloud resources to eliminate redundant middleware, optimize runtime performance, and ensure full utilization of tools .

• Test API payloads, webhooks, and modern authentication protocols in real-world cloud environments to ensure robust execution before squad deployment .

• Translate complex cloud and API performance parameters into clear technical trade-offs to help business stakeholders and product leads make informed decisions .

Who you are

We are looking for an accountable, self-driven engineer who thrives on solving technical roadblocks and inspecting cloud capabilities . To excel in this role, you bring:

• Experience: 4–6 years of hands-on experience in cloud engineering, integration engineering, or senior technical systems analysis within an enterprise setting .

• Education & Certifications: A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, alongside active certification in a major public cloud platform (AWS certified like Solutions Architect Associate/Developer preferred, or Azure/GCP) .

• Cloud Infrastructure Proficiency: Hands-on experience building and managing core serverless cloud services, including AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, IAM, EventBridge, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager .

• APIs & Integration Expertise: Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, JSON/XML payloads, and modern authentication protocols like OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML .

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
P&C Technology Innovation & Solutions Engineer

The P&C Technology Innovation & Solutions Engineer will be a key member of the People & Culture (P&C) Engineering team within Roche Digital Technology (RDT) . Operating at the intersection of public cloud infrastructure and core HR SaaS platforms, the P&C Engineering team provides the technical enablers and hands-on validation required to realize P&C strategic objectives .

As the P&C Technology Innovation & Solutions Engineer, you will act as a hands-on technical partner to Product Delivery Leads (PDLs) and work alongside Solution Architects . In this role, you will evaluate technology roadmaps, assess feature feasibility, write serverless glue code, and build cloud-native prototypes and integration adapters for our P&C platform ecosystem .

The Opportunity

In this role, you will drive hands-on technical execution, rapid prototyping, and architecture validation across our HR technology landscape. You will:

• Partner daily with Product Delivery Leads and Solution Architects to evaluate feature feasibility, latency, rate limits, and integration impacts across platforms like Workday, ServiceNow, and Cornerstone .

• Engineer lightweight, serverless cloud glue code using services like AWS Lambda and API Gateway to connect core SaaS platforms with internal cloud environments .

• Build rapid Proofs-of-Concept (PoCs) to validate integration feasibility and streamline real-world data flow across cloud ecosystems .

• Lead deep-dive technical discussions with prospective vendors, inspecting API/SDK capabilities, payload schemas, and authentication models beyond high-level product demonstrations .

• Drive technical Security Risk Assessments (SRAs) and detailed data-flow mappings for new tools and integration patterns in close coordination with Cybersecurity teams .

• Analyze existing P&C system capabilities and cloud resources to eliminate redundant middleware, optimize runtime performance, and ensure full utilization of tools .

• Test API payloads, webhooks, and modern authentication protocols in real-world cloud environments to ensure robust execution before squad deployment .

• Translate complex cloud and API performance parameters into clear technical trade-offs to help business stakeholders and product leads make informed decisions .

Who you are

We are looking for an accountable, self-driven engineer who thrives on solving technical roadblocks and inspecting cloud capabilities . To excel in this role, you bring:

• Experience: 4–6 years of hands-on experience in cloud engineering, integration engineering, or senior technical systems analysis within an enterprise setting .

• Education & Certifications: A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, alongside active certification in a major public cloud platform (AWS certified like Solutions Architect Associate/Developer preferred, or Azure/GCP) .

• Cloud Infrastructure Proficiency: Hands-on experience building and managing core serverless cloud services, including AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, IAM, EventBridge, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager .

• APIs & Integration Expertise: Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, JSON/XML payloads, and modern authentication protocols like OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML .

• Scripting Skills: Proficiency in modern scripting languages, such as Python or Node.js/TypeScript, for rapid PoC creation and automated data transformations .

• Security & Risk Assessment: Practical experience condu

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Team Lead Engineering Platform Foundations

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

As an Engineering Manager you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area

The Engineering Excellence & Experience (E3) organization builds the robust engineering bedrock that powers the future of medicine. We deliver foundational application lifecycle platforms, core developer platforms and AI tools required to build software seamlessly. By embedding application security and testing solutions directly into the engineering workflow, democratizing software delivery via low-code tools for non-technical creators, and surfacing data-driven insights, E3 accelerates secure, high-quality software delivery enterprise-wide.
As part of the E3 organization, the Developer Platform team champions the provisioning of foundational, AI-enhanced tools and capabilities that empower developers across Roche. The Platform Foundations team, which is part of the Developer platform area, will offer solutions as per Roche enterprise standard in 3 main areas - Source Code Management, Artifact Management, and CI/CD Solutions.
The team will provide a range of continuously evolving platforms fit for emerging technical complexities and accelerated development workflows, evaluation of market trends to efficiently incorporate new capabilities to support developers, full end-to-end lifecycle management of the platforms from new feature requests to delivery and maintenance, with on-going support through and after implementation to rapidly resolve user issues.

Job responsibilities

Team Member Capability and Career Development 

• Focuses on developing engineering team capabilities that align with the immediate project needs and goals and function's overall vision.

• Encourages team members to self-define their career journey and actively enables development opportunities that align with it.

• Removes roadblocks and sets clear, achievable performance goals.

• Ensures the team develops the right skills and healthy internal dynamics to meet current and future challenges.

​
Team Health and Sustainability 

• Maintains a sustainable pace of work for the team, balancing delivery goals with team well-being.

• Cultivates healthy team dynamics and collaboration, ensuring psychological safety and open communication.

• Removes impediments that hinder flow or morale, acting as an escalation point for the team.

• Ensures team members are equipped with the necessary, relevant skills and that roles are clearly defined.

​
Product and Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Weisst Du bereits, was du nach deinem Abschluss machen wirst? Weltverbesserer oder Lebensretterin werden? Nicht nur Du musst Deine Zukunft neu erfinden. Auch wir. Wir bei Roche arbeiten mit einem Ziel - innovative Tests und Medikamente zu entwickeln und Daten auf neue Weise zu nutzen, um Menschen zu einem längeren und besseren Leben zu verhelfen. Lass Dich inspirieren, wer wir sind, was wir tun und wie wir es tun. Absolviere Deine Ausbildung bei Roche und leiste damit einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum Wohle des Patienten!

Lernen. Zukunft. Roche.

Top Argumente für den Job

• Du lernst den Umgang und das Verhalten von kleinen Säugetieren wie Mäusen, Ratten, Meerschweinchen, Kaninchen und Zebrafischen

• Du trägst die Verantwortung für die fach- und artgerechte Pflege, Haltung und Zucht der Tiere. Dazu gehören auch Aufgabenbereiche wie die Kontrolle der klimatischen Bedingungen, Beobachtung der Tiere und Sicherstellung für ihr Wohlergehen (Reinigung von Käfigen und Räumlichkeiten)

• Du arbeitest eng zusammen mit Wissenschaftlern und Wissenschaftlerinnen aus den Laboren welche medizinische und biologische Fragestellungen untersuchen

• Du betreust Zuchten und wirkst bei der Behandlung von Tieren in der Forschung mit

• Du wirkst aktiv mit bei Tierversuchen und führst selbst Massnahmen durch, die du genau dokumentierst

• Du lernst die notwendigen gesetzlichen Vorschriften für Tierversuche kennen

Dein Profil

Du bist gerne mit Menschen und Tieren im Kontakt und bist hilfsbereits und zuverlässig? Prima!
Du bist schonmal gescheitert, wieder aufgestanden und hast weitergemacht? Perfekt!

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Sai cosa farai dopo la laurea? Diventa un potenziatore del mondo o un salvagente? Non solo devi reinventare il tuo futuro. Anche noi. A Roche, lavoriamo con un unico obiettivo – sviluppare test innovativi e farmaci e utilizzare i dati in nuovi modi per aiutare le persone a vivere una vita più lunga e migliore. Vi ispiriamo chi siamo, cosa facciamo e come lo facciamo. Completa la tua formazione a Roche e quindi dare un contributo decisivo a beneficio del paziente!

Imparare. Il futuro. Roche.

Argomenti principali per il lavoro

• Imparerai la manipolazione e il comportamento di piccoli mammiferi come topi, ratti, cavie, conigli e zebrafish

• Lei è responsabile per la cura professionale e specie-appropriata, la zootecnia e l'allevamento degli animali. Questo include anche compiti come il controllo delle condizioni climatiche, il monitoraggio degli animali e la garanzia del loro benessere (gabbie di pulizia e locali).

• Lavorate a stretto contatto con gli scienziati dei laboratori che indagano su questioni mediche e biologiche

• Tu supervisioni gli allevatori e aiuti a trattare gli animali nella ricerca

• Partecipate attivamente agli esperimenti sugli animali e fate delle misure che documentate esattamente

• Imparerai sulle necessarie normative legali per i test sugli animali

Il tuo profilo

Ti piace essere in contatto con persone e animali e sono utili e affidabili? Fantastico!
Hai mai fallito, ti sei alzato di nuovo e hai continuato? Perfetto!
Vuoi espandere la tua conoscenza sulla cura degli animali, la ricerca e il test sugli animali? Allora dovremmo conoscerci!

Cosa dovreste portare:

• Sei amante degli animali e ti piace prenderti cura di animali come topi, ratti e pesci

• Ti dà il piacere di aiutare gli animali e prendersi cura di loro responsabilmente

• Sei attento e paziente nel trattare con gli animali

• Affidabilità e responsabilità sono due competenze essenziali che si dovrebbe portare

• Almeno livello scolastico Sek E (BS/BL/SO), Sek (AG), maturità media (D) o livelli scolastici superiori

• Tedesco: lingua madre o livello B2

I vantaggi

• Lavori in un ambiente internazionale e ottieni informazioni di prima classe sull'azienda e sul lavoro quotidiano

• Frequenti una scuola di laboratorio orientata alla pratica

• Lavori con strutture all'avanguardia, attrezzature e strutture orientate al futuro

• Continueremo a sostenervi dopo la vostra formazione e sarete offerti varie ulteriori opportunità di formazione

• Hai la possibilità di ottenere una stanza nel dormitorio Roche a Basilea

L'applicazione completa contiene i seguenti documenti:

• CVC

• Lettera di motivazione

• Certificati degli ultimi due semestri

• Controlla S2, se sei della zona di istruzione Svizzera nord-occidentale (se disponibile)

Importante: Si prega di prestare attenzione alla completezza della vostra applicazione. In seguito, no
i documenti sono caricati.

Neurodiversità: Tutte le applicazioni vengono valutate secondo gli stessi criteri di eleggibilità equa. Se avete esigenze specifiche per il processo di applicazione o l'insegnamento a causa di neurodiversità (ad esempio ADHD, spettro di autismo) o altre caratteristiche speciali, vi chiediamo di informarci trasparente al più tardi al colloquio. Questa trasparenza ci permette di migliorare la qualità del vostro sostegno durante l'intervista e l'insegnamento.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Do you know what you will do after graduation? Become a world improver or a lifesaver? Not only do you need to reinvent your future. We too. At Roche, we work with one goal – to develop innovative tests and drugs and use data in new ways to help people live longer and better lives. Let us inspire you who we are, what we do and how we do it. Complete your education at Roche and thus make a decisive contribution to the benefit of the patient!

Learning. The future. Roche.

Top Arguments for the Job

• You will learn the handling and behavior of small mammals such as mice, rats, guinea pigs, rabbits and zebrafish

• You are responsible for the professional and species-appropriate care, husbandry and breeding of the animals. This also includes tasks such as controlling climatic conditions, monitoring animals and ensuring their welfare (cleaning cages and premises).

• You work closely together with scientists from the laboratories who investigate medical and biological issues

• You supervise breeders and help treat animals in research

• You actively participate in animal experiments and carry out measures yourself that you document exactly

• You will learn about the necessary legal regulations for animal testing

Your profile

You like to be in contact with people and animals and are helpful and reliable? Great!
Have you ever failed, got up again and continued? Perfect!
Do you want to expand your knowledge about animal care, research and animal testing? Then we should get to know each other!

What you should bring:

• You are animal-loving and like to take care of animals such as mice, rats and fish

• It gives you pleasure to help animals and take care of them responsibly

• You are attentive and patient in dealing with animals

• Reliability and responsibility are two essential skills you should bring

• At least school level Sek E (BS/BL/SO), Sek (AG), Middle maturity (D) or higher school levels

• German: native language or level B2

Your advantages

• You work in an international environment and get first-class insights into the company and everyday work

• You attend a practice-oriented workshop school

• You work with state-of-the-art facilities, equipment and future-oriented facilities

• We will continue to support you after your training and you will be offered various further training opportunities

• You have the opportunity to get a room in the Roche dormitory in Basel

Your full application contains the following documents:

• CVC

• Letter of motivation

• Certificates of the last two semesters

• Check S2, if you are from the education area Northwest Switzerland (if available)

documents are uploaded.

Neurodiversity: All applications are evaluated according to the same, fair eligibility criteria. If you have specific needs for the application process or teaching due to neurodiversity (e.g. ADHD, autism spectrum) or other special features, we ask you to inform us transparently at the latest at the interview. This transparency allows us to improve the quality of your support during the interview and teaching.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Savez-vous ce que vous ferez après votre diplôme ? Devenir un améliorateur du monde ou un sauveteur de vie ? Non seulement vous devez réinventer votre avenir. Nous aussi. Chez Roche, nous travaillons avec un seul objectif : développer des tests et des médicaments innovants et utiliser des données de nouvelles façons pour aider les gens à vivre plus longtemps et mieux. Laissez-nous vous inspirer qui nous sommes, ce que nous faisons et comment nous le faisons. Compléter votre éducation à Roche et ainsi apporter une contribution décisive au bénéfice du patient!

Apprendre. Le futur. Roche.

Haut de la page Arguments pour le travail

• Vous apprendrez la manipulation et le comportement de petits mammifères comme les souris, les rats, les cobayes, les lapins et les poissons zèbres

• Vous êtes responsable des soins professionnels et des espèces appropriées, de l'élevage et de l'élevage des animaux. Cela comprend également des tâches telles que le contrôle des conditions climatiques, la surveillance des animaux et la garantie de leur bien-être (cages et locaux de nettoyage).

• Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec des scientifiques des laboratoires qui étudient des questions médicales et biologiques.

• Vous supervisez les éleveurs et aidez à traiter les animaux dans la recherche

• Vous participez activement à des expériences animales et réalisez vous-même des mesures que vous documentez exactement

• Vous en apprendrez davantage sur les règlements juridiques nécessaires pour l'expérimentation animale

Votre profil

Vous aimez être en contact avec les gens et les animaux et sont utiles et fiables? Génial !
Tu as déjà échoué, tu t'es relevé et tu as continué ? Parfait !
Voulez-vous élargir vos connaissances sur les soins aux animaux, la recherche et l'expérimentation animale? Alors nous devrions apprendre à nous connaître !

Ce que vous devriez apporter:

• Vous aimez les animaux et vous aimez prendre soin d'animaux comme les souris, les rats et les poissons

• Il vous donne le plaisir d'aider les animaux et de prendre soin d'eux de façon responsable

• Vous êtes attentif et patient dans le traitement des animaux

• Fiabilité et responsabilité sont deux compétences essentielles que vous devez apporter

• Au moins au niveau scolaire Sek E (BS/BL/SO), Sek (AG), à maturité moyenne (D) ou au niveau supérieur

• Allemand: langue maternelle ou niveau B2

Vos avantages

• Vous travaillez dans un environnement international et obtenez des informations de première classe sur l'entreprise et le travail quotidien

• Vous assistez à une école d'atelier axée sur la pratique

• Vous travaillez avec des installations, des équipements et des installations de pointe orientées vers l'avenir

• Nous continuerons à vous soutenir après votre formation et vous offrirons diverses possibilités de formation continue

• Vous avez la possibilité d'obtenir une chambre dans le dortoir Roche à Bâle

Votre demande complète contient les documents suivants:

• CVC

• Lettre de motivation

• Certificats des deux derniers semestres

• Vérifiez S2, si vous êtes de la zone d'éducation Nord-Ouest Suisse (si disponible)

Important : Veuillez faire attention à l'exhaustivité de votre demande. Après, non.
les documents sont téléchargés.

Neurodiversité : Toutes les demandes sont évaluées selon les mêmes critères d'admissibilité équitables. Si vous avez des besoins spécifiques pour le processus de demande ou l'enseignement en raison de la neurodiversité (par exemple ADHD, spectre de l'autisme) ou d'autres caractéristiques spéciales, nous vous demandons de nous informer de manière transparente au plus tard à l'entrevue. Cette transparence nous permet d'améliorer la qualité de votre soutien pendant l'entretien et l'enseignement.

jobs.title: Clinical Trial Payment Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Clinical Trial Payment Specialist
Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

The Clinical Trial Payment Specialist will be responsible for facilitating all site payment activities related to Roche clinical studies, while ensuring compliance with country-specific regulations.

This role requires a problem-solver who can achieve accurate and timely results while positively influencing others to meet objectives and milestones. The specialist will manage and triage escalations related to clinical trial payments, ensuring swift resolution and clear communication across stakeholders. They will also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, such as Finance, Procurement, and Clinical Operations, to ensure alignment on payment timelines, reconciliation, and issue resolution.

Proficiency in maintaining the accuracy of site payments through Roche database systems, such as SAP, MyBuy, and Veeva, is essential. The ability to work independently with minimal supervision will also be crucial in fulfilling these responsibilities.

Your Opportunity:

• Ensure the necessary information is recorded in Roche systems, e.g. SAP, MyBuy and Veeva to generate corresponding payment proposals and/or reports

• Generate the necessary reports to consolidate a payment proposal per Research Center, according to Clinical Trial Agreements and appropriate timelines

• Manage payments to the Research Centers through the applicable Roche systems

• Perform payment reconciliation as needed, and assist the Research Centers in case of payment issues

• Provide requested site related payment information (i.e. verification of payments, site communication) to respective countries for financial oversight purposes

• Respond to audit inquiries and requests if applicable

• Make recommendations regarding new and innovative solutions for payment processes, forecasts, and resources that could increase the accuracy, efficiency, and productivity of the process

• Train new resources joining the team on payment processes

• Maintain the data in systems:

• Update and maintain the vendor and contract information in order to process payments

• Update and maintain study status and forecast information in the Roche systems

• Ensure the accuracy of site payments

• Setting up Clinical Trial Purchase Requisition and manage them E2E

• Drive resolution of payment related issues and contribute to problem resolution

• Participate in Stakeholder meetings as a subject matter expert and point of contact

• Calculate and distribute key performance indicators (KPIs) related to payment processes, ensuring transparency and accountability across stakeholders.

Who you are

• You hold a Technical/University Degree in Business Administration and Accounting with minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role in a financial or administrative area, 1 or 2 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry would prefer

• High capacity in analysis, planning, problem-solving, and payment management

• Prioritization skills to focus on results and meet deadlines

• Effective teamwork with commitment and proactivity

• Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present opinions clearly, ask questions, request clarifications, communicate facts objectively, question when required, and follow up on problems until resolution; ability to present clear messages from complex data/information at all levels of the organization.

• Proven interpersonal and collaboration skills, fostering trust, influencing other
