jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Manager Cardiac and Women’s Health – Roche Diagnostics Ltd

Who we are

Roche is one of the world’s leading research-based healthcare companies, providing innovative products to both the Pharmaceutical and Diagnostics industries. We are passionate about transforming patients lives and at Roche, we focus on developing innovative medicines and diagnostic tests that help patients live longer, better lives.

Roche Diagnostics provides a wide range of products and services to the NHS and healthcare organisations to support the diagnosis and treatment of people and patients. An exciting Cardiac and Women’s Health Medical Manager opportunity has arisen within the UK Medical Affairs function based in the UK.

The opportunity

Diagnostics can play a powerful role in changing what happens next for a patient, helping healthcare professionals make better-informed decisions at the moments that matter.

We’re looking for a Medical Manager – Cardiac & Women’s Health to join our UK & IRE medical affairs team and help shape how scientific innovation translates into clinical practice and better patient care.

You’ll lead the UK medical strategy for Cardiac & Women’s Health, build trusted partnerships across the healthcare community, shape evidence generation and provide the medical leadership that helps innovative diagnostics reach the patients and pathways where they can make the biggest difference.

What you’ll do

As the medical and scientific lead for Cardiac & Women’s Health, you’ll:

• Own and deliver the UK medical strategy and plan, setting clear priorities and taking accountability for outcomes and budget.

• Build trusted scientific partnerships with healthcare professionals, clinical experts and other external stakeholders, including leading KOL engagement and advisory boards.

• Shape evidence generation, identifying evidence gaps, leading local programmes and overseeing Investigator Initiated Studies.

• Help innovation reach clinical practice, working across functions to support the appropriate adoption of high-medical-value diagnostic technologies.

• Be a trusted medical voice, providing evidence-based guidance, medical review and input into regulatory and diagnostic policy submissions.

• Look ahead, identifying emerging science, technologies and changes in clinical practice that could create new opportunities for patients and healthcare systems.

• Lead through collaboration, working with colleagues across Medical Affairs, Market Access, Public Affairs, Health Economics, Marketing, Commercial and Business Development, alongside regional and global scientific teams.

Your initial focus will be Cardiac & Women’s Health, with opportunities to broaden your expertise across other priority areas as our medical and business needs evolve.

What you bring
You’ll bring scientific credibility, curiosity and the ability to turn complex evidence into clear, meaningful action.

We’re looking for:

• A GMC-registered physician or relevant science-based PhD

• Medical Affairs experience within the diagnostics or pharmaceutical industry

• Relevant experience within Cardiac and Women’s Health

• Strong clinical evidence interpretation and scientific communication skills

• Experience building credible relationships with KOL’s, healthcare professionals and external experts

• The ability to work effectively across functions and influence in a matrix environment

• Strong project leadership, communication and stakeholder-management skills

Experience in clinical research,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wir bieten ein Praktikum im Utilities Prozessteam an, das für den Betrieb und die Instandhaltung der Versorgungsanlagen verantwortlich ist, die die Biotech-Produktion unterstützen. Du erhältst Einblicke in die pharmazeutische Herstellung und sammelst praktische Erfahrungen in Bereichen wie Lean Production System (LPS), SHE und GMP.

Die Gelegenheit

• Implementierung eines AI basiertes Tool für Predictive Maintenance

• Erfahrung sammeln im Produktionsalltag (Arbeitsorganisation, Projekt Management)

• Bearbeitung von Abweichungen und Process Changes begleiten

• Analyse und Interpretation von Prozessdaten zur Unterstützung von Abweichungskorrekturen, Root Cause Analysis

• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Überarbeitung von betriebsrelevanten Dokumenten (z.B. Standard Operating Procedures)

• Mitarbeit an der Initiierung und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsprojekten im Bereich Verfahrenstechnik und Sustainability

• Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen internen und externen Schnittstellen

Wer Du bist:

• Du hast deinen Master-Abschluss innerhalb von 12 Monaten vor dem Praktikumsbeginn im Bereich Engineering, Energie, Infrastrukturen, Verfahrenstechnik oder Biotech gemacht

• Eigeninitiative, Offenheit und Neugier zeichnen dich aus

• Du arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert und hast ein schnelles Auffassungsvermögen und gehst lösungsorientiert an Aufgaben heran

• Du hast Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Akteuren sowie Spaß an Herausforderungen

• Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

• Du hast gute Kenntnisse im MS Office und Grundkenntnisse im Bereich künstliche Intelligenz (z.B. Datenanalyse, Automatisierung, Machine Learning) sind von Vorteil

Der bevorzugte Start des Praktikums ist im Oktober 2026. Bitte gib Dein präferiertes Startdatum und die gewünschte Praktikumsdauer in Deiner Bewerbung an.

Nicht-EU/EFTA Bürger (m/w/d) müssen der Bewerbung eine Bestätigung der Universität beilagen, dass sie im Rahmen des Studiums ein Pflichtpraktikum absolvieren müssen (Mandatory Letter).

Eine Teilzeitanstellung mit mindestens 80 % ist bei dieser Stelle möglich.

Das Schreiben einer Abschlussarbeit lässt diese Praktikumsstelle nicht zu.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for you to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest .

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for interns, fresh graduates and outstanding professionals.

As an Order Process Intern you will execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level and in compliance with the Standard Operating Procedures of the respective business sub-process, propose process and system improvements and contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of RSS. Your main daily job will be to handle sales orders coming from pharmacies, hospitals and wholesalers.

As an Intern, you:

• Perform complete, stringent, and timely tasks while supporting daily affiliate operations.

• Control, validate, and modify customer orders in SAP, and block orders as required by regional processes.

• Identify and resolve issues, participate in root cause analysis to prevent recurrence, and make decisions within defined criteria.

• Collaborate with the local affiliate's customer service team and ensure precise administration.

• Participate in stakeholder calls, team meetings, and workshops to maintain effective communication.

What can you bring to our team:
​ We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about their job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. In order to provide innovative healthcare solutions to our patients, we need the best talent in our organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you are currently studying in University/College on a day-time schedule . You have intermediate English knowledge .

Furthermore you have the following skills and qualifications:

• You have good communication skills.

• You are available to work 20-30 hours on a weekly basis.

• You are accurate and you like to work in a team.

In exchange we provide you with:
We offer you a strategic opportunity in a truly international work environment with high-profile colleagues and excellent in-house learning and networking opportunities, plus lots of flexibility to make your mark at Roche. We will make sure your daily work will make an impact and you will be able to learn a lot along the way.

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Analyst - Policy Based Access

titleByLocale.it: Senior Cybersecurity Analista - Policy Based Access
titleByLocale.en: Senior Cybersecurity Analyst - Policy Based Access
titleByLocale.de: Senior Cybersecurity Analyst - Policy Based Access
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Cybersecurity Analyste - Policy Based Access

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Cybersecurity Analyst - Policy Based Access

As part of Roche Digital Technology (RDT), our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team protects the organization’s global digital assets by developing and operating sophisticated security platforms. We work at the forefront of identity governance, fine-grained authorization, and hybrid cloud security to support users and business-critical systems in a highly regulated global healthcare ecosystem.

As a Senior Cybersecurity Analyst - Policy Based Access , you will be part of a global team responsible for the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of our Policy Based Access Control (PBAC) infrastructure. You will play a critical role in protecting our information and assets by moving beyond traditional access models toward a dynamic, fine-grained authorization framework that supports our global Zero Trust strategy. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to global application owners, ensuring that our security policies are scalable, resilient, and deployed seamlessly through automated code pipelines.

The Opportunity

• Architect PBAC Infrastructure: Serve as the technical owner of core PBAC components (PDP/PEP) across a hybrid global landscape, ensuring high availability and peak performance.

• Drive Strategic Implementation: Lead the enterprise transition from initial access use cases to global adoption, defining organization-wide standards for policy-based authorization.

• Consult on Integration Pathways: Act as the primary technical consultant for application and data owners, integrating critical systems via RESTful APIs, SQL/JDBC, and LDAP.

• Pioneer Policy as Code (PaC): Drive the shift to PaC by designing automated pipelines for versioning, testing, and deploying authorization logic like modern software.

• Manage Platform Lifecycles: Own the tactical lifecycle of the authorization platforms, including version upgrades, continuous performance tuning, and security patching.

• Lead Incident Analysis: Conduct deep-dive analytical investigations and root cause analysis into moderately complex cybersecurity incidents, threat patterns, and vulnerabilities.

• Streamline Asset Onboarding: Optimize and accelerate onboarding processes for new digital assets while ensuring strict alignment with international data privacy regulations like GDPR.

• Collaborate Across Product Squads: Partner closely with product managers, developers, and global stakeholders to build secure, user-friendly, and friction-free PBAC workflows.

Who you are

• Experienced Security Professional: You bring 4–9 years of professional experience in IT Security, including 3+ years specifically focused on IAM and PBAC/ABAC in large enterprise environments.

• Technical Security Master: You possess advanced, deep-level knowledge of XACML, decentralized policy management, and Zero Trust frameworks (RBAC and ABAC).

• Identity Foundations Expert: You are highly proficient in core identity standards, including SAML, OAuth, OIDC, Single Sign-On (SSO), and Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).

• DevOps & Integration Developer: You are skilled in Java or Python for custom integrations, with practical experience utilizing Git and CI/CD pipelines for secure code deployment.

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

• Analytical Problem Solver: You have advanced logical reason

As part of Roche Digital Technology (RDT), our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team protects the organization’s global digital assets by developing and operating sophisticated security platforms. We work at the forefront of identity governance, fine-grained authorization, and hybrid cloud security to support users and business-critical systems in a highly regulated global healthcare ecosystem.

As a Senior Cybersecurity Analyst - Policy Based Access , you will be part of a global team responsible for the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of our Policy Based Access Control (PBAC) infrastructure. You will play a critical role in protecting our information and assets by moving beyond traditional access models toward a dynamic, fine-grained authorization framework that supports our global Zero Trust strategy. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to global application owners, ensuring that our security policies are scalable, resilient, and deployed seamlessly through automated code pipelines.

The Opportunity

• Architect PBAC Infrastructure: Serve as the technical owner of core PBAC components (PDP/PEP) across a hybrid global landscape, ensuring high availability and peak performance.

• Drive Strategic Implementation: Lead the enterprise transition from initial access use cases to global adoption, defining organization-wide standards for policy-based authorization.

• Consult on Integration Pathways: Act as the primary technical consultant for application and data owners, integrating critical systems via RESTful APIs, SQL/JDBC, and LDAP.

• Pioneer Policy as Code (PaC): Drive the shift to PaC by designing automated pipelines for versioning, testing, and deploying authorization logic like modern software.

• Manage Platform Lifecycles: Own the tactical lifecycle of the authorization platforms, including version upgrades, continuous performance tuning, and security patching.

• Lead Incident Analysis: Conduct deep-dive analytical investigations and root cause analysis into moderately complex cybersecurity incidents, threat patterns, and vulnerabilities.

• Streamline Asset Onboarding: Optimize and accelerate onboarding processes for new digital assets while ensuring strict alignment with international data privacy regulations like GDPR.

• Collaborate Across Product Squads: Partner closely with product managers, developers, and global stakeholders to build secure, user-friendly, and friction-free PBAC workflows.

Who you are

• Experienced Security Professional: You bring 4–9 years of professional experience in IT Security, including 3+ years specifically focused on IAM and PBAC/ABAC in large enterprise environments.

• Technical Security Master: You possess advanced, deep-level knowledge of XACML, decentralized policy management, and Zero Trust frameworks (RBAC and ABAC).

• Identity Foundations Expert: You are highly proficient in core identity standards, including SAML, OAuth, OIDC, Single Sign-On (SSO), and Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).

• DevOps & Integration Developer: You are skilled in Java or Python for custom integrations, with practical experience utilizing Git and CI/CD pipelines for secure code deployment.

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

• Analytical Problem Solver: You have advanced logical reason

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As part of the Enterprise Center of Excellence (eCoE), you will be at the heart of Roche Finance. We are a global network of diverse experts representing our three divisions: Pharmaceutical, Diagnostics, and Group functions. By combining deep financial expertise with a passion for digital innovation, we are shaping the next generation of hybrid finance leaders who are uniquely positioned across the entire value chain - from R&D to Commercial - sensing business needs to bridge local operations with global strategy while driving digital transformation in finance. Through financial stewardship and enterprise insights, we empower our partners to make more informed decisions, ultimately, delivering better outcomes for patients.

The Opportunity
As the Africa SPOC, you closely partner with the Area FMs for Africa and lead FP&A activities within the assigned areas. You are part of the eCOE Pharma Commercial Finance network

The key deliverables of the role include:

• Executive Storytelling: Synthesize complex data into clear, compelling narratives for leadership, focusing on area performance for Africa, commitments, and variances.

• Proactive Analysis: Use deep financial expertise and analytics to identify trends and risks early, providing strategic recommendations to Area Finance Heads

• Cycle Management: Lead process for all end-to-end financial cycles (Business Planning, MTOs, T0, etc.), managing the annual calendar and ensuring a "single source of truth" across Africa

• Continuous improvements & scalability: Challenge the current ways of working. Actively apply Digital and AI solution and Identify standardization and automation opportunities to increase speed and value

• Strategic Partnership: Collaborate across Areas to align on financial stewardship and provide high-impact presentations for key executive events. Bring together the Disease Area and the geographic perspective for the assigned areas

• Enterprise Mindset and connectivity : Providing clarity & transparency on the overall Pharma International context to identify the Areas contribution to broader PI

• Resource allocation: Actively prioritize workpackages and shift focus towards highest impact opportunities. Flex according to needs of the area and constantly re-prioritize

• Contribute, lead and drive eCOE OBC outcomes as well as FINET sponsored workpackages

Who you are

• At least 5 years experience in a multinational environment paired with a master's or equivalent degree in finance or accounting

• Previous experience in a commercial affiliates (Pharma or DIA) is considered a plus

• Strong financial and business acumen, leadership and influencing

• Entrepreneurial spirit and curiosity that is inspirational to others

• passionate about emerging markets and cultural adaptability

• Ability to make an impact in a virtual and global team environment

• Resilience and ability to adjust to a fast-changing environment and to promote and apply the VACC leadership principles

jobs.title: Senior Principal Business Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Principal Business Architect , you will define and maintain the architectural vision and strategy for the Roche organization, ensuring alignment with business goals and supporting the adoption and implementation of Roche’s Reference Architecture. Acting as the authority and guardian of the Reference Architecture, you will create comprehensive solutions, promote best practices, and ensure architecture components and building blocks are reusable, scalable, and align with established standards. Through collaboration across the organization, you will lead efforts to integrate applications and systems effectively, drive innovation, and uphold the architectural integrity of Roche's customer-facing products. Furthermore, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s common platform strategy by contributing to its scalability, reliability, interoperability, and alignment with the needs of digital medical products and engineering teams.

Main Tasks and Duties:

• Act as a guardian of the Architecture roadmap and Reference Architecture for the Roche Ecosystem.

• Collaborate with Engineers, Product Managers, Sales, Medical teams, Customer Area leads, Lifecycle leads, and other stakeholders to recommend scalable, reliable solutions.

• Guide the technical solution process to seamlessly integrate different applications and systems using the standard components and building blocks of Roche’s Reference Architecture.

• Support Development, Solution Architects, and Business teams to effectively deliver strategic outcomes and ensure robust service delivery.

• Foster the delivery of high-quality maintenance, enhancements, and strategic projects in alignment with the Roche Ecosystem strategy.

• Define reusable architectural components and ensure alignment with industry regulations, best practices, and Roche standards.

• Analyze non-functional requirements (e.g., security, scalability, and performance) and implement solutions to address risks and improve systems.

• Develop advanced architecture blueprints and frameworks that foster innovation, reuse, and value creation across Roche's digital products and services.

Key Accountabilities:

• Deliver clear, actionable technology strategies and roadmaps aligned with the Roche Ecosystem Strategy and Reference Architecture.

• Develop and maintain architectural guidelines specific to Roche’s Reference Architecture , supporting engineering and software development excellence.

• Lead the adoption of Roche Reference Architecture across project teams to ensure delivery of high-quality, scalable, and reliable products.

• Identify and address technical gaps in Roche Reference Architecture developing innovative solutions that align with Reference Architecture strategy objectives.

• Facilitate engagement with stakeholders to ensure Roche Reference Architecture meet business and engineering needs across various digital product teams.

• Drive Reference Architecture strategy initiatives to enhance Roche's ability to leverage Reference Architecture for digital transformation, scalability, and innovation.

• Lead architectural decision-making that ensures consistency in technological implementation across customer-facing products.

Key Skills and Experience:

• BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (advanced degree preferred).

• Minimum 10+ years of experience in business architecture or related roles, with a significant focus on reference architecture and shared platform strategies.

• Strong underst

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthcare pioneer and the industry’s global leader in in-vitro diagnostics, the Diagnostics Division pushes boundaries and challenges the status quo to redefine what’s possible. Our commitment to research and development means we can bring to the market integrated solutions in diagnostic testing, laboratory efficiency, healthcare digitalization, and decision support tools and software. Our products deliver increasingly precise information to help save lives, prevent or control the risk of infection, and monitor treatment effectiveness.

At Sensor and Reagent Development BGE , we are at the forefront of innovation in the healthcare industry. Banking on the technical expertise and know-how of our skilled and dedicated team of scientists and engineers, we design and develop sensors and reagents for blood gas and electrolyte (BGE) analyzers. Our products are essential for accurate and reliable patient diagnostics, impacting lives every day.

The Opportunity

In this internship, you will drive an exploratory feasibility project to evaluate novel oxygen scavenging strategies for next-generation blood gas reagent formulations. The project focuses on different innovative pathways such as small organic molecule scavengers, storage-stable enzymatic systems, and functional multilayer packaging foils.
Key responsibilities include:

• Organic Scavenger Screening & Electrochemistry: Identify and evaluate small organic molecules (e.g., food additives, antioxidants) to determine oxygen depletion kinetics while analyzing electrochemical behavior to minimize potential sensor interference.

• Enzymatic Scavenger Systems: Assess and validate enzyme-based systems for their feasibility and performance as effective oxygen scavengers.

• Functional Packaging & Materials Evaluation: Investigate active scavenging polymer laminates and pouch foils, conducting thorough leachables and extractables testing to safeguard sensor and reagent stability.

• Analytical Testing & Characterization: Apply advanced electrochemical, spectroscopic, and chromatographic methods to measure oxygen consumption rates and characterize matrix interactions.

• Data Analysis & Documentation: Synthesize experimental results, assess formulation and material viability, and present clear technical summaries and recommendations to the cross-functional R&D team.

Who You Are

• You are currently enrolled in, or have graduated from, a Master’s degree program (or equivalent advanced studies) in Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science , or a related field within the last 12 months prior to your start date.

• You are eager to gain practical industry experience in a dynamic laboratory setting. Furthermore, You have:

• Strong theoretical and practical foundation in organic chemistry and wet-lab chemical formulation (Required).

• Sound knowledge of enzymes, enzyme kinetics, and biochemical reaction mechanisms (Required).

• High degree of self-organization, analytical problem-solving skills, and a structured approach to experimental design (Required).

• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities in English (Required).

• Interest or experience in electrochemistry (e.g., oxidation potentials, electrode interactions) or analytical techniques (e.g., UV/Vis spectrophotometry, fluorescence assays) (Preferred).

• Basic understanding of or curiosity about packaging materials, active foils, and leachables/extractables testing (Preferred).

jobs.title: Ingenieur/in Heizung, Lüftung, Klimatechnik (Basel, unbefristet)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Ein innovatives und nachhaltiges Industrieareal, eine CO2-neutrale Energieversorgung, alles Themen, die bei uns zum Greifen nah sind. Willst du ein Teil davon sein?

Die Organisation “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, Teil der globalen Group Function “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, stellt die Infrastruktur und Services für den gesamten Standort bereit und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich und auf innovative Art weiter. Wir arbeiten mit allen Anspruchsgruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zusammen, von der frühen Forschung bis zur Versorgung der Patient:innen. Bei uns kannst du dich auf ein modernes Organisationsmodell freuen, in welchem du in Eigenverantwortung deine Talente in sinnhafter Arbeit einbringen kannst. Wir garantieren Gestaltungsspielraum und Entscheidungsfreiheit in unserer Organisation. Klassische Vorgesetzte suchst du bei uns vergebens.

Die Möglichkeit
Als Ingenieur/in Heizung, Lüftung, Klimatechnik (HLK) bist Du im Bereich „Energies & Utilities“ und dort hauptsächlich im Kreis “Site Infrastructure Engineering” am Standort in Basel/Kaiseraugst tätig.
Dein Aufgabengebiet umfasst folgende spannende Tätigkeiten:

• Eigenverantwortliche Abwicklung von HLK-Projekten als Projektleiter, unter Einhaltung der Vorgaben in Bezug auf Kosten, Terminen, Qualität und Sicherheit.

• Fachverantwortung in Investitionsprojekten mit ausgeprägter Komplexität und Entwicklung innovativer sowie wirtschaftlicher Lösungen rund um die Bereiche HLK, auch im GMP-Umfeld.

• Erstellung zielgenauer Leistungsbeschreibungen und Beauftragung und Koordination qualifizierter Fachplaner, Dienstleister und Lieferanten unter Berücksichtigung verschiedener Abwicklungsmodelle (z.B. GP, Einzelvergaben).

• Betreuen von HLK Anlagen in Labor-, Infrastruktur- und Administrationsbauten sowie im Bereich der chemischen und galenischen Forschung, Entwicklung und Produktion.

• Pflege der Projekt- und Werkdokumentation inklusive elektronischer Ablage (Comos System).

• Ausarbeiten von Lüftungskonzepten sowie deren Optimierung.

• Unterstützung bei behördlichen Inspektionen.

Des Weiteren bist Du verantwortlich für die Gestaltung Deiner persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung. Du bringst Dich aktiv ein und kümmerst Dich um die Mitarbeit in selbstorganisierenden Teams im Interesse des OneRoche Gedanken. Auch den Auf- und Ausbau eines Kundennetzwerks gehört zu deinen Verantwortlichkeiten.

Wer Du bist
Du schätzt es, in einer leistungsorientierten und agilen Umgebung zu arbeiten, die von gegenseitigem Respekt, Diskussion und Zusammenarbeit getragen wird? Dann ist Roche für Dich der Ausgangspunkt für ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit vielfältigen Entwicklungschancen. Du bist eine positiv denkende, integere und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit guten kommunikativen Fähigkeiten und Du hast Freude und Geschick im Umgang mit Mitmenschen.

Du bringst ein Studium als Gebäudetechnikingenieur/in im Bereich HLK, oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung, mit. Du verfügst über mehrjährige Arbeitspraxis in relevanter Funktion im Bereich HLK. Du hast bereits im GMP-Umfeld praktische Erfahrungen gesammelt und bist vertraut mit gängigen Regelwerken, wie dem Annex 1 oder dem Guidance for Industry.

Als erfolgreicher Ingenieur/in HLK bringst Du zudem Folgendes mit:

• Eigenverantwortliche team- und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Ausgeprägte Führungseigenschaften im Projektumfeld

• Verständnis & gute Orientierungsfähigkeit innerhalb einer Matrix-Organisation

• Fliessende Deutschken

titleByLocale.en: 治疗领域经理 - 眼科治疗领域（呼和浩特）

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责/责任
客户管理

• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求

• 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案

• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈

• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理

• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

• 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作

• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家

• 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Team Lead Solution Workflow Simulation
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Core Lab Development (CLD), a part of Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), is the global organization responsible for the development of tests in the area of clinical and immunochemistry, coagulation and mass spec and the related analytic systems. In addition, core lab also focuses on the development of lab automation comprising transport systems as well as pre- and post-analytical systems and the integration of the various systems to a comprehensive solution.

As an important component of this mission, the Solution Automation Integration & Test (SAIT) Subchapter is tasked with providing essential services and capabilities to ensure the seamless integration, testing, and simulation of our Automation Systems and End-to-End Solutions. Within the SAIT Subchapter, we are seeking a Solution Workflow Simulation Team Lead.

As the SWS Team Lead, you will be an integral member of the SAIT subchapter, responsible for guiding a team of Simulation and Modeling Engineers spread between 3 sites. This team's core accountability lies in modeling complex laboratory workflows, optimizing system throughput, developing digital twins, and delivering virtual testing and emulation tools to support automation systems integration and operational decision-making.

You will provide decisive leadership to your team, offering expert guidance, comprehensive coaching, and steadfast support throughout all phases of project execution. A key aspect of your role will be fostering a culture defined by high performance, continuous improvement, and clear accountability. We seek candidates who are deeply committed to Roche's Vision, Architect, Coach, Catalyst (VACC) leadership model, adeptly combining these fundamental roles and behaviors with a collaborative approach.

Your main tasks and responsabilities

People Leadership: As a Team Lead, you will be instrumental in cultivating an innovative and positive team culture while driving performance through effective goal-setting, continuous feedback, and tailored professional development plans. You will expertly navigate organizational change, manage a mix of internal FTEs, contractors, managed services, and apprentices, resolve conflicts to maintain a harmonious environment, and ensure full compliance with all training, quality, and employment regulations.

Resource Management: You plan, direct, and monitor team resources and costs, focusing on short-term subchapter goals and tool planning. This includes resolving problems, making decisions, balancing resources between core R&D tool development and incoming simulation service requests, and ensuring adherence to budget and headcount targets through effective workforce and vendor management.

Execution of strategic priorities: In this role, you translate high-level unit goals into actionable team priorities, ensuring their achievement through optimal resource and work allocation. You will drive the continuous evolution and modernization of our simulation software platforms, common model library and oversee the different emulator roadmap. Collaborating closely with the Sub-Chapter Lead and other Team Leads, you will identify and address strategic capability needs, support operational activities, and contribute to defining the simulation/emulation strategy to ensure short-term and long-term virtual testing infrastructure needs are met.

Vision and impact: You will formulate the departmental vision, contributing to the development of team strategies and corporate processes. You will drive d

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub is a growing business line within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our primary goal is to enhance Roche's digital capabilities globally by supporting central initiatives in areas such as Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.

The Content Creation Subchapter Lead (including Medical Content Creation) is a pivotal people leader who inspires and engages subchapter members to collaborate across the network, significantly contributing to Roche’s Ten Year Ambitions. This role is accountable for driving the integration of the new operating model, exemplifying agile collaboration. The content creation chapter team consists of medical writers, content editors, project delivery coordinators, and medical copy quality assurance specialists.

As the Content Creation Subchapter Lead, you will be responsible for supporting the strategic vision and direction of the chapter, continuously seeking opportunities for innovation and value creation. This critical position has a global scope, leading a diverse team across various regions.

Who you are:

• People Leadership: You will lead, mentor, and coach subchapter members while designing tailored personal development plans to support their individual career growth and project execution.

• Operations & Service Excellence: You will manage subchapter resources, optimize team utilization, and establish process governance to consistently deliver high-quality, responsive content solutions that exceed stakeholder expectations.

• Talent Acquisition & Onboarding: You will attract, recruit, and onboard top content creation talent to ensure the team's capabilities continuously evolve alongside business needs.

• Capability Building & Innovation: You will foster a culture of continuous learning and content excellence, encouraging the team to adopt innovative approaches to their daily work.

• Agile & Cross-Functional Collaboration: You will serve as a role model for agile collaboration, working closely with cross-functional chapters and subchapters to align content strategies with Global Digital Hub goals.

• Stakeholder Engagement: You will professionally represent the Content Creation Subchapter across the organization, actively promoting the value and business impact of your team's work.

• Content Tech & AI Integration: You will drive team adoption, training, and best practices for modern content technology, GenAI tools, DAM systems, and regulatory review platforms.

• OneRoche Mindset: You will embed the OneRoche mindset within the subchapter and across the broader hub to cultivate a collaborative and forward-thinking environment.

• You bring over 5 years of overall professional experience, including 2+ years executing commercial marketing campaigns—ideally within pharma/healthcare, agencies, or startups—alongside 2+ years of direct line management or project team leadership.

jobs.title: D2P Solution Consultant - Indirect/Direct Procurement
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
As a Senior D2P Solution Consultant, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis
workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity. You will
demonstrate a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their
interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into
strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to
cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process
interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective
solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes,
methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.
Description of the area
The Demand to Pay (D2P) Value Stream is responsible for driving the end-to-end Procurement, Accounts Payable and Travel & Expense Management Data & AI strategies, by translating Functional strategies into measurable business outcomes.
The role is part of ERP Source to Procure Team within ERP Demand to Pay(D2P) value stream.
As a Senior D2P Solution Consultant and subject matter expert of indirect & Direct procurement focusing on the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle, you will bridge the gap between complex procurement business requirements and technical IT solutions translating business needs into technical solutions.
You will be responsible for optimizing the end-to-end process—from strategic sourcing and contract management to requisitioning, purchasing and receiving, decomposition into Features/User Stories using SAFe, Jira, and ServiceNow. Leveraging your SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement or similar procurement platform expertise, you will ensure global system stability and drive innovative enhancements across the enterprise.
Your goal is to develop sustainable IT solutions to enhance operational efficiency, ensure data integrity, and drive the digital transformation of our procurement landscape.

Job Responsibilities

• Process Optimization: Analyze, document, and redesign "as-is" and "to-be" business processes across the S2P lifecycle (Sourcing, Contracting, Supplier Management, Purchasing, and Invoicing).

• Requirements Engineering: Lead discovery workshops with stakeholders to elicit high-quality business requirements. Translate these into functional specifications, user stories, and technical workflows.

• Solution Design: Act as the functional/technical expert for S2P platforms (e.g., Smart by GEP, ORO, SAP S4HANA, GEP Nexxe and others). Oversee system configurations and enhancement requests.Write and review functional and technical specifications (incl. WRICEFs), perform testing and cut-over/ deployment activities.

• Integration Management: Collaborate with technical teams to manage integrations between S2P tools and ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA), ensuring seamless data flow for master data and financial records.Lead the design of complex WRICEFs, specifically focusing on Interfaces (I) using SAP Integration Suite (BTP/CPI), Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG), or Middleware (e.g MuleSoft).

• Data Mapping & Transformation: Define and document detailed field-level mapping (IDOC, API, cXML, OData) for critical procurement objects such as Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, Invoices, and Supplier Master Data.

• Error Handling & Monitoring: Establish robust monitoring frameworks (using AIF - SAP Application Interface Framework or similar) to proact

jobs.title: Praktikum im Bereich Talent Acquisition (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Deine Abteilung

Im Team der Talent Acquisition Partner in Deutschland bringen wir mit viel Engagement und Leidenschaft das Thema Recruiting voran. Wir arbeiten in einem deutschlandweiten Netzwerk bestehend aus motivierten Talent Acquisition Partner:innen und Praktikant:innen. Wir leben in unserem Team eine “Du”-Kultur. Eine enge Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitige Unterstützung sind für uns selbstverständlich. Wir möchten Dir als Praktikant*in einen Einblick in das daily business eines Talent Acquisition Partner geben und Dir ein klares Bild unserer Version „ We link Roche to Talents & Talents to Roche “ vermitteln. Wir suchen einen Praktikanten oder eine Praktikantin für unseren Standort in Grenzach, Mannheim oder Penzberg.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du verstehst es zu begeistern? Dann begeistere als Praktikant*in unser Team, indem Du bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Auswahlverfahren unterstützt und selbst Verantwortung übernimmst. Als Roche-Botschafter stehst Du dabei in direktem Kontakt mit den Kandidaten und garantierst, dass diese eine tolle Candidate Experience erleben.

• Pre-Screening von Bewerbungen und die Unterstützung bei Interviews gehören zu Deinem Aufgabengebiet.

• Du begleitest den gesamten Recruiting Prozesses von der Stellenausschreibung bis hin zur Einstellung.

• Durch den direkten Kontakt mit Führungskräften und Bewerbern erhältst Du spannende Einblicke und viele Lernmöglichkeiten.

• Dein Engagement ist gefragt: Denn Du arbeitest an aktuellen Themen und hast die Möglichkeit, eigene (standortübergreifende und internationale) Projekte auf die Beine zu stellen.

Dein Profil

• Das Thema Talent Acquisition / Recruiting begeistert Dich und Du möchtest Erfahrungen in diesem Bereich sammeln.

• Aktuell bist Du in einem wirtschafts-, geistes- oder sozialwissenschaftlichen Studium immatrikuliert oder befindest Dich im Gap-Year zwischen Bachelor und Master.

• Du bist kommunikativ, gehst offen auf Menschen zu und bist motiviert, Dich in neue Prozesse einzuarbeiten.

• Du zeichnest Dich durch ein hohes Maß an Flexibilität aus und bewegst Dich sicher im virtuellen Umfeld.

• Außerdem hast du ein positives Mindset und verfügst über eine Can-Do-Mentalität.

• You are proficient in English and not afraid of talking to international clients in person, via phone or Email.

Deine Vorteile

• Deine Entwicklung ist uns wichtig: Daher legen wir viel Wert darauf, dass Du an vielfältigen Aufgabenstellungen arbeiten kannst und immer etwas Neues dazu lernst.

• In unserem Team übernimmst Du schon früh Verantwortung und unterstützt uns aktiv in Recruiting-Prozessen.

• Mobiles Arbeiten ist natürlich auch für Dich als Praktikant möglich und deine Arbeitszeit kannst Du Dir auch flexibel einteilen.

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte lade nur Deinen aktuellen Lebenslauf online hoch.
Zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt benötigen wir keine weiteren Dokumente.
Bitte beachte, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation richtet oder alternativ an Personen im Gap-Year.

Zeitraum : ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von 6 Monaten.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come

jobs.title: Accounting Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
What we do:
The Record to Report Department, often abbreviated as R2R department provides financial services for more than 130 affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Finance and Accounting (General Ledger Accounting, Management Accounting) and Supply Chain Finance. The department is constantly expanding since our main goal is to perform end-to-end accounting activities in the near future.

Your day to day responsibilities are:
As an Accounting Intern you will execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level.
As a qualified expert, you:

• Process General Ledger bookings (and any other local request)

• Clear customer and GL accounts

• Contribute to month-end closing tasks

• Provide help of other team members in need of assistance due to workload

• Assist in investigating account discrepancies involving inventory, variances, and allowances

• Gain practical, real-world exposure to enterprise-level financial systems within a shared services environment

What can you bring to our team:
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Ongoing university studies in the field of Economics - specialized in Accounting

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Available for 25-30 hours per week

• Customer focused mindset

• Proactive mindset

• Proficiency in English

• A solid academic foundation in accounting and finance principles (GAAP or IFRS)

• Proficient with spreadsheet applications and standard office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, G-Suite)

• Bonus Points: Prior exposure to ERP systems (such as SAP modules like FI, CO/PA, MM, PP) or financial close software

In exchange we provide you with:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Young and dynamic environment

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Data Engineer is the technical anchor for our advanced analytics and AI roadmap. You extract critical information from disparate systems and design the underlying data architecture that powers our machine-learning models. By running AI proof-of-concept builds through the software development lifecycle into production, you turn raw data into practical competitive advantage.
Reporting to the Head of Data, Digitalisation and AI, you will establish the technical backbone for AI initiatives across the affiliate. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Data Consultants and cross-functional squads to transition ideas into scalable solutions, in an environment built to sharpen your MLOps and engineering skills.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Enterprise Master Data Management (EMDM) is a Roche cross-functional and cross-divisional network of master data specialists and subject-matter experts developing governance frameworks and maintenance processes to ensure high-quality and trusted master data as the backbone for seamless business operations, data analytics and digitalization.

The Opportunity

In the Enterprise Master Data Management Operations Business Analyst role, you are responsible for the dedication towards undisturbed business activities by committing to Service Level Agreement. In this role, you will ensure that technological architecture meets user requirements, and will support the whole data maintenance related queries - including data quality, lifecycle management and monitoring. Execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level and in compliance with the SOPs of the respective business sub-process. Follow the instructions of the Cluster Lead - Enterprise Master Data Management Operations Business Partner domain regarding the daily work coordination, and propose process and system improvements across multiple divisions. Contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of the Finance, Procurement, Sales and Supply Chain organizations.

• Data Migration & Lifecycle Management: Lead supplier data cleansing, deduplication, load file verification, and migration sign-off, alongside managing ongoing data quality and data lifecycle processes.

• Process Analysis, Optimization & Automation: Analyze current business and system workflows to redesign procedures, evaluate automation opportunities, and develop business cases for system upgrades.

• Incident Management & Technical Collaboration: Deliver 2nd-level user support using ITIL prioritization to resolve incidents for Roche Affiliates and global IT, translating business needs into technical solutions.

• Documentation & Audit Compliance: Maintain SOPs, knowledge bases, and user guides while ensuring internal audit control (ICFR) management.

• Training & Capability Building: Design and deliver training programs—including delta updates—utilizing both Train-the-Trainer and end-user models.

• Project Management & Execution: Lead, coordinate, and participate in local RSS projects while collaborating on global initiatives.

• Stakeholder & Vendor Alignment: Partner closely with internal affiliates, regional and global IT departments, and external vendors to streamline business partner supplier operations.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development.

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential.

• Strong customer centricity and stakeholder management skills

• Experienced in SAP (FI, MM, CO, SD)

• Ability to work independently and in team as well

• Focus on details and innovation

• Skilled in multitasking and prioritization

• Has analytical thinking

• 3-5 years Master Data management experience is desirable

• Project experience (desirable)

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own car

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharma is looking for a Product Owner with strong expertise in digital analytics, web measurement and marketing technology to join our international Web Intelligence team. You will own and prioritize the product backlog for capabilities that enable Roche teams to measure, understand and optimize our external digital experiences across global, regional and local websites .
Our core technology ecosystem includes Adobe Analytics, Adobe Experience Platform Data Collection (Adobe Launch) and Adobe Target , utilizing Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK and Datastreams, alongside consent management, reporting, SEO/GEO and the broader Adobe Experience Platform ecosystem.
You do not need to be the engineer implementing every tag or the analyst building every dashboard. However, you need enough hands-on digital analytics and MarTech expertise to challenge requirements, understand implementation implications, make informed prioritization decisions and work credibly with analytics engineers, analysts, personalization specialists, solution architects and web engineering teams.
You will operate within an international SAFe Agile Release Train , connecting Pharma and Diagnostics stakeholder needs with a shared analytics and optimization backlog.

Your Responsibilities

Analytics Product Ownership & Backlog

• Own and prioritize the digital analytics and personalization backlog , translating business needs and requests into clear epics and KPIs.

• Balance stakeholder value with technical dependencies and compliance in a transparent prioritization process.

• Lead contributions to SAFe Agile ceremonies , including PI Planning, backlog refinement and sprint planning, ensuring adherence to Definition of Done.

Digital Analytics & Measurement
You will provide product leadership across capabilities including:

• Adobe Analytics

• Adobe Experience Platform Data Collection / Adobe Launch / AEP Web SDK

• Web and digital measurement frameworks

• Tagging specifications and data-layer requirements

• Analytics implementation and QA

• Report suites and analytics governance

• KPI and measurement frameworks

• Dashboards and reporting

• Consent-aware measurement and privacy requirements

• Analytics incident management and tracking-quality improvements

You should be comfortable discussing topics such as events, dimensions, conversion metrics, attribution, data layers, tagging architecture, consent dependencies and analytics QA with technical specialists.

Experimentation & Personalization
Partner with targeting and personalization specialists to prioritize and deliver capabilities using Adobe Target. Support use cases involving Experimentation and A/B testing, Audience segmentation, Personalization, Targeting requirements, Experiment measurement and success criteria, Integration between analytics and personalization capabilities. Ensure experimentation starts with a clear hypothesis, measurable outcomes and reliable analytics.

Insights & Decision Enablement
Work closely with the Analytics & Insights Lead and reporting specialists to ensure that measurement ultimately supports decisions rather than simply producing data. Partner with stakeholders to identify which questions matter, what should be measured and which analytics capabilities should be prioritized.

Analytics Governance & Quality
Help establish scalable standards across Roche's international web ecosystem, inclusive

• Consistent tagging & measurement approaches

• Analytics naming conventions

• Reusable measurement

Technical Product Owner - Patient Support

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. As the Technical Product Owner (m/f/d) for the DIA Commercial Patient Support area, you will operate at the intersection of complex systems engineering and strategic commercial outcomes. You will own the technical vision, architectural coherence, and feature backlog for the platforms that enable our commercial customer service ecosystem. Acting as the definitive bridge between Business Product Owners (BPOs), engineering squads, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and enterprise architecture, you will translate high-level business priorities into precise, scalable, secure, and compliant technical implementations.

The opportunity:

jobs.title: People Support Solutions Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The People Support Solutions (PSS) department brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions.

The Opportunity:
As a People Support Team Lead, you will lead a high-performing HR operations team, ensuring efficient, customer-focused service delivery. Your role involves team leadership, workload management, coaching, and performance optimization , while continuously driving process improvements, compliance, and operational excellence.
As a qualified Leader, you are:

• Building, leading and managing a strong and collaborative team

• Building a culture of customer service within the team

• Creating a safe and positive team environment and ensuring that the team demonstrates the right mindset and attitude

• Being a role model, and facilitating people processes

• Building an engaging culture to both attract and retain top talent, coaching team members regarding their individual development and career plan

• Through frequent check-ins, ensuring that ongoing dialog occurs on the topics of Career, Capabilities, Connections and Contributions; and developing the team members’ knowledge, skills, competency, etc. in order to retain and develop talented staff

• Ensuring maintenance, ongoing development and improvements to Tier 2 platforms, ways of working, process flow, driving employee’s self-service efficiency and enabling end user behavior change

• ​ Developing and managing strong partnerships with key internal organizations and stakeholders and partnering across the business to ensure an ongoing evolution of trust, co-creation and fulfillment of their needs

• Driving continuous improvements to increase productivity, quality and service locally and globally.

Who you are:

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about leading with impact, driving innovation, and creating exceptional employee experiences .

• Fluency in English is essential.

• Proven Leadership – 5+ years of experience within a multinational environment, including 2+ years managing a team.

• Broad experience in a shared service center, with a proven track record of leading regional or global service delivery teams, preferably in an HR services environment (2-7 years)

• HR & Tech Savvy – Strong knowledge of Workday HR processes and CRM/Request Management Software is a plus.

• Process & Performance Mindset – Experience in streamlining operations, eliminating inefficiencies, and implementing data-driven decision-making.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each

jobs.title: Finance Insights & Data Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Finance Insights & Data Analyst

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, our Finance Centers of Excellence have led the way in breaking down silos, removing hierarchies, and working in new ways. We’ve learned from our successes and from the things that haven’t gone so well. We’re better equipped to look at interfaces and synergies and to understand the risks of creating new silos. Now is the time to build on those learnings, shifting from a divisional/functional approach to an enterprise approach with an Enterprise Center of Excellence (eCoE).

The Opportunity

The eCoE focuses on three areas delivering a high level of financial expertise, innovative insights, and an entrepreneurial mindset that enables agility and flexibility for stakeholders. The eCoE is a talent engine for Finance through capability building and network building.

There are three focus areas within eCoE:

• Financial Backbone

• Digital Innovation

• Analytics and Insights

Within the eCOE, the R&D Outcome Based Community (OBC) focuses on delivering a high-level of financial expertise, innovative insights, and an entrepreneurial mindset to influence and support R&D investments at Roche. While there are three focus areas and clusters, we are not seeking to create silos. We are looking for individuals who display the Finance Mindset and behaviors and will support a living organism that will leverage the business knowledge and financial expertise of the network to deliver exceptional results for Finance and Roche.

Team members will partner with Roche Services & Solutions, Finance Enterprise Partners, and the Business to deliver many of Finance's core processes and deliverables while also driving process scaling/simplification/harmonization and progressing our digital ambition. Ensuring business continuity is a must.

The key deliverable of the role include and may evolve over time:

• Supports the R&D FP&A community on various deliverables along the monthly and yearly financial cycle (planning, actuals tracking, closing etc.)

• Closely partners with the R&D unit FP&A leads (gRED, pRED and PD) to deliver impactful Analytics & Insights to FEPs and the R&D Finance Leads (recurring and ad-hoc). Positions to be the natural back up of the unit FP&A leads with the business acumen developed

jobs.title: IT Service Specialist - Italian speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Employee Experience Operations is focused on delivering professional IT support for our Roche affiliates in the EMEA region and globally as well in cooperation with our service centers in Costa Rica and Malaysia. Our teams consist of English, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish and French speaking Service Desk Specialists from beginners to highly skilled professionals.

The Opportunity

• Provide first-level support for software and hardware incidents and service requests across Mac, Windows, Microsoft Office, and Google environments.

• Engage with users across multiple channels, including phone, chat, and self-service portal.

• Thrive as a key member of a truly AI-powered IT support operations team.

• Champion the end-users' needs, escalating critical situations as required to ensure swift resolution.

• Keep users updated on their request status, guiding them toward the best solutions for their productivity and satisfaction.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• University education in IT or related discipline is preferred

• 1.5 - 2 years of experience in call center, service desk, or IT desk-side support

• Experience with Apple and Microsoft operating systems, Google suite, Microsoft Office products, SAP, corporate networks, and video conferencing systems

• Strong troubleshooting, task prioritization, and problem-solving skills

• Fluency in Italian and English

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

​ Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidat

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.
