jobs.title: Network Observability Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche, our network is the backbone of our innovation—connecting researchers, labs, and offices across the globe. As a Network Observability Engineer, you won’t just be building dashboards for network engineers; you will be architecting the systems that ensure our global teams can collaborate on life-saving medicine without interruption.

You will join the Network Management Services team, a global group of specialized engineers sitting at the heart of Roche’s infrastructure strategy. Your work directly influences how our global network is designed, monitored, and optimized. At Roche, observability isn't an afterthought; it is a strategic requirement that transforms raw data into the operational intelligence we need to stay ahead.

Main Responsibilities:

• Architecture & Scaling: Design and scale our observability stack (LogicMonitor, ThousandEyes, LiveNX) to provide real-time insights across a massive global footprint.

• Data Acquisition & Integration: Develop and maintain methods for extracting network data using various mechanisms, including SNMP, APIs, and network telemetry/streaming data.

• System Administration & Tooling: Utilize Linux and system administration knowledge to maintain monitoring infrastructure and integrate various open-source and commercial tools.

• Innovate & Prototype: Evaluate new monitoring solutions and open-source visualization tools (e.g., Grafana) to enhance our observability stack and stay ahead of industry trends.

• Proactive Problem Solving: Use monitoring data to identify network performance issues, bottlenecks, and anomalies to reduce Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) and prevent future incidents.

• Unified Analytics & Stakeholder Reporting : Work in the design and implementation of a centralized observability dashboard fed by our corporate Data Lake. You will synthesize disparate data types—including technical network telemetry, financial metrics, and ITSM process data—into meaningful, actionable reports for both internal technical teams and external business stakeholders.

Qualifications :

Education/ Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.

• 3+ years in Network Operations, SRE, or DevOps environments.

Automation Skills:

• Deep proficiency in Linux/Unix and automation (Python, Bash, or Ansible)
Connectivity Foundation: Good understanding of connectivity technologies (CCNA level or equivalent experience).

Tooling Expertise:

• Hands-on experience with modern observability platforms and the ability to turn raw telemetry into actionable insights.

Data-Driven Mindset:

• Experience with API-based data collection and integrating disparate data sources into unified dashboards.

Cross-Domain Data Analytics :

• Experience working with Data Lakes to aggregate and normalize disparate data types (e.g., technical network telemetry, financial metrics, and ITSM process logs) into cohesive, stakeholder-facing reports and business intelligence dashboards.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

A Roche, la nostra rete è la spina dorsale della nostra innovazione, collegando ricercatori, laboratori e uffici in tutto il mondo. In qualità di Network Observability Engineer, non sarà solo costruire cruscotti per gli ingegneri di rete; sarete l'architetto dei sistemi che assicurano che i nostri team globali possono collaborare sulla medicina salvavita senza interruzioni.

Ti unirai al team Network Management Services, un gruppo globale di ingegneri specializzati che siedono nel cuore della strategia infrastrutturale di Roche. Il vostro lavoro influenza direttamente il modo in cui la nostra rete globale è progettata, monitorata e ottimizzata. A Roche, l'osservanza non è un ripensamento; è un requisito strategico che trasforma i dati grezzi nell'intelligenza operativa che dobbiamo rimanere avanti.

Principali responsabilità:

• Architettura e Scala: Progettare e scalare il nostro stack di osservabilità (LogicMonitor, ThousandEyes, LiveNX) per fornire intuizioni in tempo reale su una massiccia impronta globale.

• Acquisizione e integrazione dei dati: Sviluppare e mantenere metodi per estrarre i dati di rete utilizzando vari meccanismi, tra cui SNMP, API e dati di rete di telemetria/streaming.

• Amministrazione di sistema & Tooling: Utilizzare le conoscenze di amministrazione di Linux e di sistema per mantenere l'infrastruttura di monitoraggio e integrare vari strumenti open-source e commerciali.

• Innovate & Prototype: Valutare nuove soluzioni di monitoraggio e strumenti di visualizzazione open-source (ad esempio, Grafana) per migliorare il nostro stack di osservabilità e rimanere al passo con le tendenze del settore.

• Risolvere i problemi proattivi: Utilizzare i dati di monitoraggio per identificare i problemi delle prestazioni della rete, strozzature e anomalie per ridurre il tempo di risoluzione Mean (MTTR) e prevenire gli incidenti futuri.

• Unified Analytics & Stakeholder Reporting: Lavorare nella progettazione e realizzazione di un cruscotto di osservazione centralizzato alimentato dal nostro Corporate Data Lake. Potrai sintetizzare diversi tipi di dati, tra cui la telemetria di rete tecnica, metriche finanziarie e dati di processo ITSM, in report significativi e attuabili sia per i team tecnici interni che per gli stakeholder aziendali esterni.

Qualifiche :

Istruzione / Esperienza:

• Corso di laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, o equivalente esperienza di lavoro.

• 3+ anni negli ambienti Network Operations, SRE o DevOps.

Abilità di automazione:

• Profonda competenza in Linux/Unix e automazione (Python, Bash o Ansible)
Connectivity Foundation: Buona comprensione delle tecnologie di connettività (livello CNA o esperienza equivalente).

Esperienza di utensili:

• Esperienza pratica con moderne piattaforme di osservabilità e la capacità di trasformare la telemetria grezza in insights attuabili.

Data-Driven Mindset:

• Esperienza con la raccolta dati basata su API e integrazione di fonti di dati disparate in dashboard unificati.

Analisi dei dati transfrontalieri:

• Prova a lavorare con Data Lakes per aggregare e normalizzare i tipi di dati disparati (ad esempio, telemetria di rete tecnica, metriche finanziarie e log di processo ITSM) in report coesivi e dashboard di business intelligence.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter offrire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Bei Roche ist unser Netzwerk das Rückgrat unserer Innovation und verbindet Forscher, Labore und Büros auf der ganzen Welt. Als Network Observability Engineer erstellen Sie nicht nur Dashboards für Netzwerkingenieure, sondern auch Systeme, die sicherstellen, dass unsere globalen Teams ohne Unterbrechung an lebensrettenden Medikamenten zusammenarbeiten können.

Sie werden Teil des Network Management Services-Teams, einer globalen Gruppe von spezialisierten Ingenieuren, die im Mittelpunkt der Infrastrukturstrategie von Roche stehen. Ihre Arbeit beeinflusst direkt, wie unser globales Netzwerk gestaltet, überwacht und optimiert wird. Bei Roche ist Beobachtbarkeit kein nachträglicher Einfall; es ist eine strategische Anforderung, die Rohdaten in die operative Intelligenz umwandelt, die wir brauchen, um weiter vorne zu bleiben.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Architektur & Skalierung: Design und Skalierung unseres Observability Stacks (LogicMonitor, ThousandEyes, LiveNX), um Echtzeit-Einblicke über eine massive globale Präsenz zu liefern.

• Datenerfassung & -integration: Entwicklung und Pflege von Methoden zum Extrahieren von Netzwerkdaten unter Verwendung verschiedener Mechanismen, einschließlich SNMP, APIs und Netzwerktelemetrie / Streaming-Daten.

• Systemadministration & Tooling: Nutzen Sie Linux- und Systemadministrationswissen, um die Überwachungsinfrastruktur zu erhalten und verschiedene Open-Source- und kommerzielle Tools zu integrieren.

• Innovate & Prototype: Evaluieren Sie neue Überwachungslösungen und Open-Source-Visualisierungstools (z. B. Grafana), um unseren Beobachtbarkeits-Stack zu verbessern und den Branchentrends einen Schritt voraus zu sein.

• Proaktive Problemlösung: Verwenden Sie Überwachungsdaten, um Netzwerkleistungsprobleme, Engpässe und Anomalien zu identifizieren, um die Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) zu reduzieren und zukünftige Vorfälle zu verhindern.

• Unified Analytics & Stakeholder Reporting: Arbeit an der Gestaltung und Implementierung eines zentralisierten Beobachtungs-Dashboards, das von unserem Corporate Data Lake gespeist wird. Sie synthetisieren unterschiedliche Datentypen - einschließlich technischer Netzwerktelemetrie, Finanzmetriken und ITSM-Prozessdaten - in aussagekräftigen, umsetzbaren Berichten für interne technische Teams und externe Geschäftsbeteiligte.

Qualifikationen :

Ausbildung/Erfahrung:

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung.

• 3+ Jahre in Network Operations, SRE oder DevOps-Umgebungen.

Automatisierungsfähigkeiten:

• Tiefe Kenntnisse in Linux / Unix und Automatisierung (Python, Bash oder Ansible)
Connectivity Foundation: Gutes Verständnis von Konnektivitätstechnologien (CCNA-Ebene oder gleichwertige Erfahrung).

Tooling Expertise:

• Praktische Erfahrung mit modernen Beobachtungsplattformen und der Fähigkeit, rohe Telemetrie in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu verwandeln.

Data-Driven Mindset:

• Erfahrung mit API-basierter Datenerfassung und der Integration unterschiedlicher Datenquellen in einheitliche Dashboards.

Domänenübergreifende Datenanalyse:

• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Data Lakes, um unterschiedliche Datentypen (z. B. technische Netzwerktelemetrie, Finanzmetriken und ITSM-Prozessprotokolle) in zusammenhängenden Berichten mit Stakeholdern und Business Intelligence-Dashboards zu aggregieren und zu normalisieren.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Chez Roche, notre réseau est l'épine dorsale de notre innovation, qui relie les chercheurs, les laboratoires et les bureaux du monde entier. En tant qu'Ingénieur d'observation du réseau, vous n'avez qu'à construire des tableaux de bord pour les ingénieurs du réseau; vous allez innover les systèmes qui assurent la collaboration de nos équipes mondiales sur la médecine vitale sans interruption.

Vous rejoindrez l'équipe de Network Management Services, un groupe mondial d'ingénieurs spécialisés au cœur de la stratégie d'infrastructure de Roches. Votre travail influence directement la conception, le suivi et l'optimisation de notre réseau mondial. À Roche, l'observabilité n'est pas une réflexion; c'est une exigence stratégique qui transforme les données brutes en renseignements opérationnels dont nous avons besoin pour rester en avance.

Principales responsabilités :

• Architecture & Scaling: Concevoir et mettre à l'échelle notre pile d'observation (LogicMonitor, ThousandEyes, LiveNX) pour fournir des informations en temps réel sur une empreinte mondiale massive.

• Acquisition et intégration des données : Élaborer et maintenir des méthodes d'extraction des données du réseau à l'aide de divers mécanismes, notamment la SNMP, les API et les données de télémétrie/diffusion du réseau.

• Administration et outillage du système: Utiliser Linux et les connaissances en administration du système pour maintenir l'infrastructure de surveillance et intégrer divers outils open-source et commerciaux.

• Innover & Prototype : Évaluer les nouvelles solutions de surveillance et les outils de visualisation open-source (p. ex. Grafana) pour améliorer notre pile d'observation et rester en avance sur les tendances de l'industrie.

• Résolution proactive des problèmes : Utiliser des données de surveillance pour identifier les problèmes de performance du réseau, les goulets d'étranglement et les anomalies afin de réduire le délai moyen de résolution (MTTR) et de prévenir les incidents futurs.

• Unified Analytics & Partnership Reporting : Travailler à la conception et à la mise en oeuvre d'un tableau de bord centralisé d'observation alimenté par notre Data Lake. Vous allez synthétiser des types de données disparates – y compris la télémétrie technique du réseau, les mesures financières et les données de processus de l'ITSM – dans des rapports utiles et réalisables pour les équipes techniques internes et les intervenants commerciaux externes.

Qualifications

Éducation/expérience:

• Baccalauréat en informatique, ingénierie ou expérience de travail équivalente.

• 3 ans et plus dans les environnements Network Operations, SRE ou DevOps.

Compétences en automatisation :

• Compétence approfondie en Linux/Unix et automatisation (Python, Bash ou Ansible)
Fondation pour la connectivité : Bonne compréhension des technologies de connectivité (niveau CCNA ou expérience équivalente).

Expertise en outillage :

• Expérience pratique avec les plates-formes modernes d'observation et la capacité de transformer la télémétrie brute en aperçus concrets.

Mindset de données :

• Expérience de la collecte de données basées sur l'API et intégration de sources de données disparates dans des tableaux de bord unifiés.

Analyse de données trans-domaine :

• Expérience de travail avec Data Lakes pour agréger et normaliser des types de données disparates (p. ex. télémétrie de réseau technique, mesures financières et registres de processus de la GTI) en des rapports cohérents avec les intervenants et des tableaux de bord de renseignements commerciaux.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

IT Processes & Operations Improvement and Implementation Specialist

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Delivery Management Professional leads medium-to-large complex process and technology-driven initiatives within the Enterprise Platforms Infrastructure & Engineering Business Operations. Operating at the intersection of strategy and operations, you will define and control initiative scopes and delivery, lead continuous process optimization, embed governance frameworks, and leverage data and AI for process augmentation. While navigating intricate stakeholder environments, you will connect operational efficiency directly with broader enterprise business objectives. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Process SME, Implementation Lead, Improvement Specialist.

Our Core Focus Areas:

• Strategy & Execution : Co-developing roadmaps, driving portfolio commitments, and managing budgets to bridge end-to-end strategy to operations.

• Operational Intelligence & Process Excellence : Delivering evidence-based insights and leveraging sound data management practices to guide senior leadership decision-making. Establishing process adherence, and driving continuous improvements across sub-functions.

• Shared Capabilities : Orchestrating a diverse portfolio of expertise to support and empower RDT sub-functions.

• Cross-Functional Synergy : Partnering across RDT, Finance, P&C, Procurement to drive seamless, high-quality delivery.

The opportunity:

• Scope : Independently defines, manages, and controls the scope of medium-to-large initiatives in heavy infrastructure, platform and engineering environments. Elicits complex requirements and aligns execution directly with broader enterprise strategies and sub-functional dependencies.

• Operational Excellence & Problem Solving : Drives root-cause analysis on delivery and operational issues using Lean Six Sigma methodologies. Formulates actionable improvement plans, identifies feedback loops for system/process improvements, and pragmatically deals with ambiguity.

• Process & Framework Governance : Oversees the health, adoption, and compliance of enterprise IT processes by embedding standards such as ITIL and the Open Group IT4IT. Continuously identifies opportunities for process augmentation with AI to streamline workflows and reduce manual overhead.

• Delivery Discipline & Data Management : Tracks initiative milestones, budget health, and risk parameters. Ensures data integrity within operational and project management tooling, leveraging reliabl

jobs.title: Global Study Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Global Study Lead is responsible for ensuring that all studies are designed, planned, executed, monitored, closed out and documented in an appropriate manner within the planned timeframe and cost; ensuring that the sponsor responsibilities are fulfilled, while assuring compliance to all applicable regulatory requirements. Responsible for the timeline and budget planning and execution of studies. Assigns and ensures delivery of specific tasks to/from other members of the study team. Provides oversight to outside support including CROs, consultants and/or medical advisors

The Opportunity:
The key accountabilities for this position include, but are not limited to:

• Leads the global study team with full accountability for the study deliverables with respect to quality, budget and timelines, in collaboration with the Study Team and ensures the development of high quality study designs for sponsored studies in collaboration with internal and external experts

• In collaboration with Program Leadership, prepares different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g. study, real-world evidence) in cross-functional collaboration (e.g. with Regulatory Affairs, R&D, CDMA Project Teams) to support global strategies and planning of timeline and costs

• Develops key study documents (i.e., Design Validation Plan, protocol, study training materials, study forms and templates, study report)

• Oversees planning and operational aspects of companion diagnostics studies sponsored by Pharma partners

• Accountable for study-level budget of assigned studies.

• Adherence to regulations, guidelines and standard operating procedures, and ensures audit/inspection readiness.

• Execution of sponsored studies for assigned areas of focus for registrational and/or non-registrational purposes through all study phases (planning, start-up. conduct and close-out). Oversees study activities outsourced to a service provider (i.e., CRO).

• Oversees planning and operational aspects of Investigator Initiated Studies and Research Collaboration Studies

• Ensure that study results are published in collaboration with the Publication Team.

• Oversees projects to ensure completion on-time, within scope and budget; and tracks project performance to analyze the completion of short and long term goals.

• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional leaders, key internal and external stakeholders and other alliance partners, including CROs, in meeting business goals and ensuring operational excellence.

Who you are:

• You have a bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or related field

• You have 5+ years of experience managing the full lifecycle of sponsored studies, ensuring projects meet performance goals within scope, quality, budget, and timeline.

• You have extensive experience in ensuring that study results are published in collaboration with the Publication Team.

• You have in-depth knowledge and experience in the role of Clinical Operations in product development and are aware of Roche’s place in the market and our value proposition to patients and customers.

• You have clinical trial management knowledge and experience in the oversight and conduct of clinical trials within the patholo

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
What we do:
The People Support Solutions (PSS) department brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions.

The Opportunity:

As a Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist - German speaking​ you are part of a dynamic, vivid and spiritful team supporting our German affiliates in Mannheim. This team delivers customer service and advisory support to HR and business partners on global HR systems and processes, ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with our customer-focused principles.

As a qualified expert, you are:

• Providing insight, support and explanation on HR system and administrative activities in the area of payroll, time & benefit services

• Providing customer service on payroll, time & benefit related activities (inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting)

• Processing of leaves of absence, processing shifts, cooperation inquiries on the subject of working time, long-term illnesses as well as the associated compensation benefits

• Answering employee requests regarding the pay slip

• Supporting the embedding of the new ways of working, actively participating in the development and implementation of continuous improvement initiatives

• Behaving as role model to team members, showing positive and flexible attitude

• Building relationships with HR colleagues within the PSS organization as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.

Please note that this position is a fixed-term maternity cover.
Who you are: ​
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Strong customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Strong & precise work-ethic, good analytical skills, ability to deal with Excel tables and ability to focus on details and numbers

• Experience in service delivery or customer care environment or HR Operations / HR Services

• Experience in (German) payroll (advantage)

• Fluent in written and spoken English and German.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility : We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a t

jobs.title: Financial Accountant (Fixed term)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Please note that this role offers a fixed-term contract (up until Feb 28, 2029).

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The Opportunity
As a Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process. In this position you will focus on:

• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices, daily bank posting, leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities, taxes, GL journals and accruals and handling rejected and returned payments, posting and reconciling treasury transactions

• Clearing customer accounts, collecting customer direct debit payments, contacting with customers, AR and bank suspense accounts, allocating cash, credit management

• Reconciling and reporting intercompany balance and clearing B/S Accounts

• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling

• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP

• Reporting for consolidation

• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• 1-3 years of experience in a relevant position

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Outstanding customer orientation and service focus

• Strong interpersonal skills and team player attitude

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average. We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recru

jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Senior QA Automation Engineer

At Roche Information Solutions (RIS), we now do what patients need next. We are transforming healthcare through digital innovation, building high-scale, cloud-native platforms that support clinicians and patients globally. We are seeking a high-seniority Senior QA Automation Engineer for our Warsaw-based hub who can be co-located, and brings an AI-first mindset to the software development lifecycle.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity
You will work on a cloud-native digital pathology platform that is transforming how pathology laboratories operate worldwide. The system enables pathologists, histotechnicians, and laboratory coordinators to digitize tissue slide specimens, manage clinical cases end-to-end, review high-resolution slide images remotely, run AI-powered algorithms for diagnostic decision support, and seamlessly exchange data with laboratory information systems (LIS) and PACS archives. The vision is to deliver advanced medical insights and drive personalized healthcare by replacing manual, microscope-bound workflows with a connected, software-defined laboratory experience.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you will own, build, and evolve the automated test frameworks and quality gates that guarantee the reliability of these clinical workflows - from UI and API test layer strategies to algorithm orchestration and third-party integrations - directly contributing to faster, more confident diagnoses for patients globally.

Who you are:

The "AI-First" Mindset
Beyond technical mastery, we value engineers who treat AI agents as a core partner in their workflow:

• SDLC Optimization: Using AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, or LLMs) to accelerate test script generation, test data synthesis, refactoring, and root-cause analysis of test failures.

• Agentic Awareness: Understanding how to leverage AI agents to automate routine tasks such as converting specifications into automated test scenarios, test data generation, documentation, and PR descriptions.

• Efficiency: A proactive approach to using prompt engineering to drive speed, coverage, and quality in production-ready test suites.

Technical Skills:

• Expertise in Java: Deep understanding of Core Java and modern design patterns applied to test automation.

• Playwright & JUnit 5: Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and solid knowledge of JUnit 5 for both UI and API test automation.

• Test Architecture & Layering: Proven experience designing maintainable, scalable test frameworks, structuring multimodule suites in Maven, and executing a sound Test Layering Strategy.

• API Testing: Deep understanding of API test types (contract, functional, integration, smoke) and knowing precisely when to apply each.

• Code Quality Principles: Sound understanding of coding principles (SOLID, DRY, KISS) and their applicability in test codebases to produce stable, reliable, non-flaky tests.

• CI/CD & Reporting: Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (ideally GitHub Actions) and leveraging test reporting tools like Allure or comparable frameworks.

• Tools & Ecosystem: Proficiency with Git, Jira, and Confluence. Experience with Angular,

jobs.title: Principal Bioinformatics Scientist I
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Principal Bioinformatics Scientist I

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Principal Bioinformatics Scientist I within Roche Sequencing Solutions (RSS), you will join a collaborative, cutting-edge team defining a new class of Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) with our proprietary Sequencing by Expansion (SBX) technology.

You will work at the intersection of computational biology and wet-lab innovation to empower global researchers and transform sample prep and systems portfolios. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape state-of-the-art sequencing workflows while driving direct advancements in molecular diagnostic capabilities.

The Opportunity:

• Sequence Data Diagnostics: Perform deep, read-level diagnostics, tracing data from raw basecall signals and FASTQs through alignment and final variant calling to evaluate how upstream chemistry variations impact downstream analytical accuracy.

• Algorithm Deconstruction: Look under the hood of open-source and internal tools to evaluate their core assumptions and failure modes on novel SBX data, prototyping and implementing tailored bioinformatic solutions.

• Workflow Optimization: Uncover the physical and enzymatic mechanisms driving data anomalies, isolating root-cause molecular artifacts across the NGS workflow to directly guide wet-lab reagent formulation and drive independent pipeline/protocol advancements.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with wet-lab scientists, software engineers, and computational teams across all stages, from experimental design and data collection to algorithm design, result interpretation, and clear team-wide communication.

• R&D Leadership & Guidance: Serve as the bioinformatics functional representative on cross-functional project teams, providing data-supported guidance to develop reagent products and offer expert-level technical support across the organization.

Who You Are:

• You hold a Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related quantitative field with 5+ years of experience in the biotechnology industry.

• You bring 3+ years of experience in investigating raw sequence data to solve complex library prep and chemistry challenges (e.g., unexpected adapter behavior, custom UMI/barcode designs, chimeric reads, coverage gaps).

• You have developed a deep, mechanistic intuition for NGS library prep chemistry, target enrichment, and how physical reagent performance directly impacts raw bioinformatic signals and downstream variant detection accuracy.

• You demonstrate in-depth knowledge of NGS, molecular biology, and human genomics, with experience in diverse applications (preferably single-cell, spatial transcriptomics, or proteomics).

• You exhibit proficiency in Python and workflow managers (Nextflow or Snakemake) in Linux environments, with a strong focus on producing reproducible, well-documented code.

• You have an exceptional problem-solving mindset with precision in both routine QC and complex troubleshooting, paired with the ability to translate technical findings for multidisciplinary audiences.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 105,560.00 and 138,547.50 of hiring range

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.

Join our innovative team where you will conduct critical research, development, and manufacturing laboratory experimentation to support Ventana projects . As a Senior Research Scientist, you will exercise technical expertise and discretion to design and execute experiments that directly contribute to our project strategies . You will work in a collaborative environment, driving scientific innovation while maintaining a high level of professional expertise .

The Opportunity

• You design experimental plans to support project objectives and act independently to determine methods and procedures on new assignments .

• You execute bench experiments, analyze data, and prepare technical reports, summaries, protocols, and quantitative analyses .

• You work on extremely complex problems in which the analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of intangible variables .

• You participate in or lead cross-functional technical teams, such as failure investigation or core teams, and establish interfaces across other organizational groups .

• You troubleshoot problems, institute corrective actions, and identify and implement improvements to work processes and the laboratory environment .

• You ensure quality by adhering to company policies for GMP, GLP, and Design Control, while maintaining complete and accurate records .

• You prepare, present, and discuss experimental procedures and results within the department and project teams .

• You act as a productive team member by suggesting creative solutions, providing input to project planning, and training others in your areas of expertise .

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor's Degree in Science plus 6 years of related experience, OR a Master's Degree in Science plus at least 1 year of related experience .

• You are a recognized expert across a wide range of experimental techniques and are highly skilled in their applications .

• You are capable of searching scientific literature to gain general and specific information to maintain your professional expertise .

• You are skilled in the use of word processing, spreadsheets, and graphical and presentation software .

• You work well in a team environment, exercise independent judgment, and may supervise lower-level personnel and laboratory operations .

Preferred

• Prior histological experience, particularly with IHC, is strongly preferred .

• Current HT or HTL certification is a plus .

• A track record of recognizing and documenting activities for publication and/or patent potential, or contributing to scientific journals and conferences .

jobs.title: Pasante de Comunicación Interna
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre Roche:
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Oportunidad:
Estamos en la búsqueda de un talento joven, estudiantes apasionados por la comunicación y la creatividad, para sumarse a nuestro equipo como Pasante/Practicante de Comunicación Interna. En esta posición, tendrás la oportunidad de transformar la comunicación corporativa tradicional en experiencias dinámicas, ágiles y visualmente atractivas, contribuyendo directamente a mantener informados, conectados y motivados a todos los colaboradores de la organización.

Responsabilidades:

• Como pasante, debes de diseñar, proponer y ejecutar nuevos formatos de contenido (desde la conceptualización hasta la edición), asegurando que la información sea clara y atractiva para diversas audiencias internas.

• Redactar contenidos de alto impacto para los diferentes canales internos (boletines, reportes, presentaciones ejecutivas).

• Transformar la información tradicional en mensajes ágiles y digeribles, adecuados para todos los niveles de la organización.

• Brindar soporte activo y coordinación en la realización de eventos internos.

• Apoyar en el monitoreo de los canales de comunicación interna para evaluar su desempeño y proponer mejoras continuas.

Quién eres:

• No puedes ser egresado y debes de graduarte en 2028 para poder realizar 2 años de pasantía.

• Estudiante activo en Comunicación, Marketing, Publicidad, Diseño, Periodismo o carreras afines.

• Profesional en formación con excelente redacción, ortografía y habilidades de comunicación.

• Usuario con dominio de herramientas de diseño y edición como Canva y Adobe Express, con capacidad y gusto por generar contenidos en audio, video y fotografía.

• Persona con nociones básicas para interpretar analíticas de plataformas internas (tasas de apertura, clics, interacción).

• Apasionado por las tendencias actuales de consumo de contenido digital y redes sociales, con visión para aplicarlas en un entorno corporativo.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio (capaz de comprender textos corporativos, buscar referencias y mantener una comunicación básica/intermedia).

• Perfil proactivo, curioso, responsable y con excelente organización para la administración efectiva de sus proyectos y el cumplimiento de los tiempos de trabajo.

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Key Responsibilities & Skills

• Experience / knowledge of transactional Requisition-to-Pay (R2P) processes and systems, Technical proficiency with appropriate Procurement systems and tools.

• Basic analytical skills.

• Process oriented.

• Proficient in use of computer (Microsoft Suite,Google Suite)

• Demonstrated effective time management and organizational skills

• Ability to work in a fast paced environment with competing priorities

• Highly motivated, results focused and act with a high sense of urgency

• Interface professionally and maintain good rapport with requestors, stakeolders, and suppliers alike

• Teamplayer

• Open to flexible alternate working hours (possible East Coast hours)

Who you are
Requirements

• 2-3 Years SAP experience

• 2-3 years Procurement SC-PO related experience

• 2-3 years Invoice Block Resolution experience

• 2-3 years of customer service experience

• English(B2) and Spanish require

​Education

• University Degree (In Progress or Completed) on Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or any related field

Desired Skills

• Biotech/Pharma experience helpful.

• Numeric, with analytical skills and creative problem solving capabilities

• Experience in executing process improvement opportunities

• Flexible and open to change, ability to embrace and support process change

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Histology Process Lead (2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Second Shift: 2:00 PM - 10:30 PM

As the Histology Process Lead you will oversee the operational processes of the 2nd shift histology team to ensure workflow efficiency and support business goals. This role is responsible for delegating tasks to 2nd shift personnel while proactively collaborating with the 1st shift team and the 1st shift Process Lead. You will provide essential line support, ensure quality and training compliance, and assist the Histology Supervisor in meeting overall production schedules and customer service expectations.

The Opportunity

Quality and Safety

• Maintains Right to Operate by ensuring all processes are performed safely; addresses and escalates hazards; timely reports incidents and near misses

• Maintains the quality system and achieves quality objectives

• Ensures audit readiness (OSHA, FAA, FDA, etc.) and represents team during internal audits/inspections

• Ensures accuracy and completeness of procedures for receipt, quarantine, storage, and disbursement of materials per FDA, OSHA, FAA, QSR, ISO, GMP, MEE, and Roche policies

• Coordinates training completion and execution (NCRs, OJT, Operating Procedures, Work Instructions); maintains >95% training compliance

• Ensures inventory accuracy and adherence to inventory control processes (TECO, Cycle counts, etc.)

• Assists with NCR investigations, reworks, corrective actions, and document changes including writing new or updating work instructions and OPs

Production

• Monitors, balances, and delegates work to employees and contractors to achieve production goals and schedule adherence

• Provides 20-40% line support including receive, material handling, product build, formulation, material availability, SAP transactions, packet review, audits, and resource allocation

• Interfaces with complex systems and controls in a regulated manufacturing environment

• Ensures daily end-of-shift reports and pass downs are completed for proper communication between shifts and teams

• Effectively leads multiple production lines

• Coordinates maintenance and calibration of equipment in responsible areas

Continuous Improvement

• Ensures adherence to 6S, cycle times, and standard work; identifies and implements process improvements

• Facilitates and/or participates in Tier Meetings and staff meetings

• Troubleshoots problems, engages support functions, and assists in implementing preventative measures

• Collects, populates, and trends daily metrics (Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery) to identify gaps and support operational excellence

Teamwork and Collaboration

• Proactively collaborates with peers across shifts and functions to achieve daily targets; provides performance feedback to leadership on employee contribution, attendance, and quality

• Ensures successful onboarding of new employees and contractors; participates in the interview process

• Performs other duties as assigned by management

Who You Are

• You have an Associate’s Degree

• You have 3 years Relevant work experience, preferably in GMP environment

• Experience leading teams or projects preferred.

Required Skills and Qualifications

• Demonstrated experience with Lean / Continuous Improvement and previous experience with ERP systems and SAP

• Proficient with Google products (gMail, gSheets, gDoc, etc)

• High degree of initiative with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• Ability to read, write and comprehend English; strong communication skills (written and verbal)

• Strong organizationa

titleByLocale.it: Full-Stack Software Ingegnere (Frontend, Backend & Cloud) – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
titleByLocale.en: Full-Stack Software Engineer (Frontend, Backend & Cloud) – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
titleByLocale.de: Full-Stack Software Ingenieur (Frontend, Backend & Cloud) – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
titleByLocale.fr: Full-Stack Software Ingénieur (Frontend, Backend & Cloud) – Applied & Agentic AI Systems

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
We are looking for a highly skilled, deeply hands-on Full-Stack Software Engineer who will cover frontend UI, backend architecture, cloud deployment, and DevOps engineering all under one hat. Since our team already includes dedicated AI Engineers and Data Engineers, your primary mission is to be the foundational software engineering anchor: building the robust, scalable, and secure user interfaces, infrastructure, integrations, and server-side logic that allows our AI solutions to thrive in a production environment.

Description of the area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high-value AI solutions spanning advanced agentic frameworks, Generative AI applications, and classical Machine Learning. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building these innovative AI applications end-to-end to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~6 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (Agentic SDLC).

Job Responsibilities

• Frontend Architecture & Generative UI: Develop highly scalable, reusable UI components using expert-level TypeScript and modern frameworks (React/Next.js or Angular 16+). Shift from static layouts to flexible, dynamic interfaces that gracefully handle unpredictable data and real-time LLM streams.

• Core Backend Engineering & API Design: Design and build highly scalable, reusable backend services and APIs (using Python) that serve as the backbone for multi-agent workflows and GenAI applications. Build, host, and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and standard APIs to standardize data exchange.

• Cloud Architecture & DevOps Excellence: Design, implement, and manage secure and scalable cloud infrastructure (primarily AWS) tailored for diverse AI workloads. Apply Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices using Terraform. Build, maintain, and optimize fully automated CI/CD pipelines and manage application containerization (Docker).

• Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full-stack development cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code.

Qualifications / Education / Experience

• Experience: 7+ years of strong software engineering experience with a demonstrable focus on backend development, cloud infrastructure, advanced frontend architecture, and DevOps.

• AI Integration Experience: Proven experience building backends for complex solutions and LLM-powered applications, managing streaming responses, and translating non-deterministic AI outputs into safe, functional user interfaces.

• Agentic Workflow: Proven experience leveraging AI coding agents within an agentic SDLC to accelerate feature delivery.

• Hold a B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng., PhD, or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

• Be a passionate builder, staying continuously up-to-date with the latest developments in cloud computing, backend architectures, frontend paradigms, and AI integrations.

• Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, thriving in a fast-paced environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary.

• Have a deep sense of accountability, capable of diagnosing compl

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Description of the Area

• The BI Web Solution Architect serves as the leading technical authority for the web ecosystem, driving architecture strategy across multiple digital products and platforms. The role operates across the full Agile Release Train using SAFe/Scrum methodologies and partners closely with web development, analytics, website rollout, communications, and documentation teams.

• The architect is responsible for defining the technical roadmap, creating architectural enablers, and ensuring scalable, future-ready web solutions across Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and the broader Adobe digital marketing stack.

Key Responsibilities
Architecture Leadership

• Own the end-to-end solution architecture across the web application landscape, covering approximately 10 web applications and 4-5 AEM environments.

• Act as the highest technical authority within the web solution domain.

• Drive the architecture vision, roadmap, and strategic technology direction across the release train.

• Create and manage architectural enablers that support delivery teams and product objectives.

• Lead technical discussions and design reviews with integrated cross-functional teams.

Solution Design & Governance

• Develop and maintain comprehensive architecture documentation including:

o Solution Architecture Documents
o Solution Diagrams
o Process Maps
o Logical Architecture Models
o Data Architecture Models
o Taxonomy and Information Architecture Designs

• Define and govern reference architectures, patterns, integrations, NFRs, and architecture decision records (ADRs).

• Ensure architecture alignment with enterprise standards and digital platform strategies.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Present technology roadmaps, solution designs, and architectural enablers to technical and business stakeholders.

• Collaborate with solution architects responsible for adjacent digital capabilities such as identity management, consent management, CDP, CRM, marketing automation, social media, and email platforms.

• Provide technical leadership and mentoring across development and delivery teams.

Technical Skills & Expertise
Required Skills

• Deep expertise in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) architecture and implementation.

• Hands-on experience with modern AEM deployments, including:

o AEM Managed Services
o AEM as a Cloud Service
o Flexible and Cloud-Native AEM environments

• Strong understanding of enterprise web architecture and content management platforms.

Adobe Ecosystem Experience
Experience with the following Adobe technologies is highly preferred:

• Adobe Analytics

• Adobe Target

• Adobe Dynamic Media

• Adobe Launch

Cloud & Platform Experience

• Experience designing solutions across hybrid hosting models, including:

o Adobe-managed cloud environments
o Self-managed cloud environments

• Knowledge of cloud-native architecture principles and enterprise-scale web platforms.

Architecture Deliverables
Demonstrated experience creating:

• Solution Architecture Documents

• Logical and Physical Architecture Designs

• Process Flow Diagrams

• Data Models

• Integration Architectures

• Content Taxonomies and Information Architecture Frameworks

Nice to Have

• Experience with taxonomy and ontology design.

• Experience in regulated industries such as pharmaceuticals or healthcare.

• Exposure to SSO, Consent Management Platforms, CDPs, CRM solutions, Marketing Automation platforms, Social Media platforms, and Email Marketing technologies.

Qualifications
Education /

The Position
Job description
As an IT Quality Specialist at the SE6 level, you independently manage end-to-end software quality assurance and analysis tasks across various capabilities and contribute to solving moderately complex SDLC and release problems. You will lead the analysis of stakeholder needs, drive root cause analysis, and ensure comprehensive requirements traceability across large-scale initiatives. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will champion accountability, mentor junior team members, and drive process improvements that align delivered solutions with overarching business goals.
Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manages end-to-end software quality tasks across various capabilities and contributes to more complex problems. Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of Quality Specialist best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Independently leads the analysis of moderately complex business problems, clearly defining the problem scope and driving root cause analysis. Elicits, analyzes, and synthesizes complex stakeholder needs, ensuring comprehensive requirements traceability across large-scale initiatives. Assures the delivery of comprehensive and well-structured requirements, contributing significantly to the design and validation of effective solutions. Analyzes technology fit, proposes effective solutions, and proactively identifies discrepancies and improvement opportunities.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of stakeholders across functional areas, analyzing their influence and impact on project outcomes. Interacts within and across multiple product squads within a domain, facilitating workshops and resolving conflicts to ensure alignment. Proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives, anticipates and strategically manages expectations in complex projects, and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor.

• Impact/Strategy: Demonstrates strong and consistent performance across diverse products, with impact typically extending to a specific product, initiative, or cluster. Contributes to the achievement of a product initiative and potentially domain goals by ensuring that delivered solutions meet business needs and provide demonstrable value. Takes a proactive role in shaping team processes, contributes to Communities of Practice (CoPs), and translates requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overall business objectives.

• Complexity/ (Product Size): Manages quality activities on more complex projects or across multiple products within a domain. Handles ambiguous requirements and evaluates solution impacts considering both immediate and longer-term implications within the domain. Ensures alignment with broader goals, manages interdependencies between related processes, and navigates intricate stakeholder environments.

• Business/Technical ability: Demonstrates a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies. Can independently apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis. Effectively handles interdependencies, managing the interconnections between various processes to improve overall efficiency and effectiveness.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Manufacturing Supervisor, you will be supporting a fast-paced operation to deliver diagnostic products and ensure continuous quality, schedule adherence, and efficient production. You will be a member of the Operations Extended Leadership Team, interfacing with other Operations Extended Leadership Team members to deliver on goals and/or collaborate to drive business strategy.

You will operate per internal and external quality and safety requirements and work with area leadership to evaluate production process data and drive continuous improvement cross-functionally to achieve operational KPIs.

The Opportunity
1st Shift Hours: 6:00 AM - 2:30 PM

• Leads and empowers direct reports or teams; provides coaching, training and opportunities to develop skills, and gives ongoing, constructive and timely feedback on performance and progress toward goals and expectations.

• Identifies scheduling conflicts, production issues and equipment maintenance needs and collaborates with support functions for resolution.

• Coordinates with process lead for resource management.

• Responsible for production manufacturing adherence and maintains a thorough understanding of end-to-end production processes.

• Sets goals and aligns deliverables for shifts and processes and reports out misses to daily, weekly and monthly goals and implements corrective actions.

• Creates a lean culture by empowering the workforce to provide and implement ideas to continuously improve and reduce waste while acting as a change agent to drive a culture of continuous improvement by actively demonstrating the use of lean manufacturing tools in everything the team does.

• Collaborates with peers in other shifts/functions and support functions to drive value stream, lean manufacturing improvement and global projects/ initiatives.

Who You Are

• You have a Bachelor's degree, STEM or related field.

• You have 4 years of relevant experience in production, manufacturing, supply chain or related field, of which 2 years include process, people or project leader experience.

Preferred

• Demonstrated ability to develop and lead a high-performing team.

• Ability to influence all levels of staff and management.

• Experience working in a regulated environment.

• Proven skills and experience with process improvement.

• Proficient written, verbal communication and presentation skills.

• Strong team leadership abilities according to VACC principles.

• Demonstrated ability to make data-driven decisions.

• Critical thinking, problem solving and a can-do attitude are required.

Relocation Benefits are not available for this posting

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson, AZ is 75,000.00 - 139,400.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.title: Treasury Accountant (Temporary Fixed Term)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is a temporary, fixed term contract

The Opportunity:

Roche Services Americas is one of the Roche Shared Services Centers worldwide providing Finance and Procurement services to various countries in the Americas region. Based in San José, Costa Rica, the Treasury Accountant reports to the Treasury & Accounts Receivable Manager.

Key responsibilities include:

• Execute day-to-day activities according to agreed service levels and in compliance with sub-process SOPs.

• Coordinate and perform financial tasks, including daily bank posting, interface control, manual corrections, bank suspense B/S reconciliations, clearings, and posting treasury transactions.

• Conduct cash flow analysis, intercompany reconciliations, GL journal postings, FX revaluations, and other reporting activities.

• Handle incoming inquiries via phone and email in a timely manner.

• Proactively seek opportunities for cross-functional/cross-geographic collaboration and foster a open, supportive team environment.

• Support team members during peak workloads, participate in workshops, and propose process and system improvements to drive SSC performance.

Who you are:

• University or College degree with a concentration in Finance, Accounting or a related field.

• 3-5 years of experience in finance and accounting.

• Solid understanding of accounting processes, Finance Shared Services, and related technology systems (e.g., SAP, BlackLine).

• Strong analytical, organizational, and presentation skills with proven ability to prioritize, multitask, and meet tight deadlines under limited guidance.

• Excellent communication and customer service skills with high integrity on the job.

• Business fluency in English and Spanish is required; Portuguese and/or French is preferred.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. jobs.title: Produktionsexpert:in (befristet auf 18 Monate)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Abteilung Solids DP (Solida Produktion) ist Teil der Manufacturing Unit Solids am Produktionszentrum Kaiseraugst. In der Solida Produktion werden verschiedene feste Arzneiformen (Filmtabletten, Kapseln, Granulat in Glasflaschen) sowie kommerzielle als auch Entwicklungsprodukte hergestellt. Hierbei handelt es sich ausschließlich um High-Potent-Produkte mit einer Batch-Size zwischen 15 KG bis 100 KG. Das Produktionsteam besteht aus ca. 45 Mitarbeitern.

Die Möglichkeit
Als Produktionsexpert:in übernimmst du im Produktionsbereich die folgenden Aufgaben:

• Herstellung von Filmtabletten, Kapsel und deren Zwischenstufen

• Abfüllung von Granulaten in Glasflaschen

• Bedienen, Rüsten und Reinigen der zugehörigen Produktionsanlagen und Räumlichkeiten

• GMP-konforme Dokumentation der durchgeführten Arbeiten am Computersystem

• Warenbewegungen von GMP-Materialien

Wer Du Bist
Um in dieser spannenden Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringst du idealerweise Folgendes mit:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung vorzugsweise im Lebensmittelbereich oder Pharmabereich

• Erfahrung in der Herstellung von festen Arzneiformen (Kapsulierung, Tablettierung, Lackierung von großem Vorteil) im GMP-Bereich

• Gute EDV-Kenntnisse

• Erfahrung in der Herstellung von High-Potent-Produkten (von großem Vorteil)

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit inkl. Nacht-, Samstag- und Sonntagsarbeit (5-Schicht)

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Du bringst Zuverlässigkeit, Teamgeist und eine hohe Eigeninitiative mit. Du arbeitest gerne selbstständig.

Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem aktuellen Lebenslauf und releventen Zeugnissen und werde Teil unseres Teams, um gemeinsam die Zukunft zu gestalten!

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Solids DP (Solida Production) fa parte della Solids Manufacturing Unit presso il Kaiseraugst Production Center. Solida produzione produce varie forme farmaceutiche solide (pellicola, capsule, granuli in bottiglie di vetro) e prodotti commerciali e di sviluppo. Questi sono esclusivamente prodotti ad alta potenza con una dimensione del lotto tra 15 KG e 100 KG. Il team di produzione è composto da circa 45 dipendenti. La possibilità Come esperto di produzione, si occupano dei seguenti compiti nell'area di produzione:
• Produzione di compresse, capsule e loro intermedi
• Riempimento di granuli in bottiglie di vetro
• Operazione, installazione e pulizia di impianti e locali di produzione associati
• Documentazione conforme GMP del lavoro svolto sul sistema informatico
• Movimenti di materiali GMP Chi sei Per avere successo in questo ruolo emozionante, è idealmente portare i seguenti:
• Formazione professionale completa preferibilmente nel settore alimentare o farmaceutico
• Esperienza nella produzione di forme di dosaggio solido (capsulamento, tablet, laccatura di grande vantaggio) nel settore GMP
• Buone competenze informatiche
• Esperienza nella produzione di prodotti ad alta potenza (di grande vantaggio)
• Prontezza per il lavoro a turni tra cui lavoro notturno, sabato e domenica (5 turni)
• Buona conoscenza del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura
• Porti affidabilità, spirito di squadra e un alto livello di iniziativa. Ti piace lavorare in modo indipendente. Applicare ora con il tuo CV attuale e le recenti testimonianze e diventare parte del nostro team per modellare il futuro insieme! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
