C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Solids DP (Solida Production) fait partie de l'unité de fabrication des solides du Centre de production Kaiseraugst. La production de Solida produit diverses formes pharmaceutiques solides (comprimés de films, capsules, granulés en bouteilles de verre) ainsi que des produits commerciaux et de développement. Il s'agit exclusivement de produits à haut potentiel ayant une taille de lot comprise entre 15 KG et 100 KG. L'équipe de production compte environ 45 employés. La possibilité En tant qu'expert en production, vous assumez les tâches suivantes dans le domaine de production:
• Production de comprimés, capsules et leurs intermédiaires
• Remplissage de granulés dans des bouteilles en verre
• Exploitation, installation et nettoyage des installations et locaux de production associés
• Documentation conforme aux BPF des travaux effectués sur le système informatique
• Mouvements de matériaux BPF Qui vous êtes Afin de réussir dans ce rôle passionnant, vous apportez idéalement ce qui suit:
• Formation professionnelle complète de préférence dans le secteur alimentaire ou pharmaceutique
• Expérience dans la production de formes posologiques solides (capsulation, tablette, laquage de grand avantage) dans le secteur des BPF
• Bonnes compétences en informatique
• Expérience dans la production de produits de haute puissance (d'un grand avantage)
• Préparation au travail posté, y compris la nuit, le samedi et le dimanche (5 postes)
• Bonne connaissance de l'allemand en mots et en écriture
• Vous apportez fiabilité, esprit d'équipe et un haut niveau d'initiative. Tu aimes travailler indépendamment. Postulez maintenant avec votre CV actuel et des témoignages récents et devenez membre de notre équipe pour façonner l'avenir ensemble! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, garantissant à tous l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur à chances égales.

jobs.title: Sr. Emergency Management Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Why Join Us? At Roche, your expertise in public safety and emergency management directly safeguards the people and the science that are curing cancer. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a culture that values autonomy, leadership, and impactful work.

While physical security is a component of this role, the primary focus is on life-safety systems, emergency management, disaster preparedness, and crisis response. You will act as the driving force behind our site-level incident readiness, ensuring the safety of our personnel, facilities, and sensitive diagnostic materials while managing individual contributors and external managed service providers. You will serve as the Deputy Site Security Officer (to the Senior Security Manager). Interacting frequently with senior executive leadership, this position requires exceptional emotional intelligence, political acumen, and a solutions-based mindset to translate complex safety protocols into actionable business resilience strategies. You must be a self-starter who thrives with limited supervision, capable of effectively diagnosing short- to mid-term security needs and shaping large-scale initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

The Opportunity

• Emergency Management & Preparedness: Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive emergency management, disaster preparedness plans, and safety procedures tailored to a global life sciences environment. Lead unified crisis response efforts utilizing the National Incident Management System (NIMS) and Incident Command System (ICS) frameworks.

• Risk Mitigation & Operations: Conduct risk assessments, tabletop exercises, and emergency drills to ensure cross-departmental readiness. Assess off-campus locations and events for overall security. Identify gaps in security measures, safety systems, training, and policy, and recommend improvements. Life-Safety & Fire Protection Systems Oversight: Direct day-to-day operations, routine testing, preventative maintenance, and compliance inspections for all site life-safety systems, fire protection infrastructure, and emergency suppression equipment in strict accordance with local codes and NFPA standards.

• Team Leadership: Manage the activities and provide leadership to the safety and security team to ensure their actions comply with legal and regulatory requirements.

• Investigations & Partnerships: Manage the most sensitive and complex safety and security investigations involving company products, people, and visitors. Develop cross-functional and external third-party/First Responder relationships to facilitate optimal business partnerships.

• Executive Advising: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership during both steady-state operations and crisis events, navigating complex organizational dynamics to ensure safety directives are supported from the top down.

• Health, Safety & HazMat Operations: Leverage emergency medical/first responder experience to oversee on-site emergency medical and safety capabilities. Apply hazardous materials (HazMat) awareness and handling expertise to ensure the safe containment and mitigation of biological or chemical incidents on campus.

• Analytics & Technology: Leverage technology, data, and digital tools to generate insights, collaborate, and formulate recommendations for security decisions and improvements.

Who You Are

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Emergency Management, Occupational Health and Safety, Homeland Security, Business, Fire Sciences, or a related f

The Position
Un futuro más saludable. Eso es lo que nos motiva a innovar. Promover continuamente la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y para las generaciones venideras. Crear un mundo donde todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Como Especialista de Proyectos y Asesoría Científica (IVD), serás el responsable estratégico de planificar, coordinar y ejecutar la implementación técnica y científica de nuestras plataformas pre y post-analíticas en Chile. En este rol híbrido, combinarás la gestión de proyectos con la asesoría científica de alto nivel (application specialist), liderando la puesta en marcha de equipos, la configuración de sistemas, la capacitación a clientes y la optimización de la eficiencia en laboratorios clínicos.

About the opportunity:

• Planificar y gestionar recursos, tiempos, presupuestos y entregables para la instalación y puesta en marcha de plataformas analíticas y pre-analíticas de mediana complejidad.

• Liderar la implementación técnica desde el área de aplicaciones: configuración de equipos, validación de métodos y garantía de estándares de calidad del fabricante en coordinación con Servicio Técnico e IT.

• Impartir programas de formación, entrenamiento y educación continua a profesionales de laboratorio clínico en el uso de instrumentos, técnicas e interpretación científica.

• Actuar como asesor científico experto para resolver consultas complejas, optimizar procesos de control de calidad y brindar soporte en la eficiencia analítica del laboratorio.

• Dar seguimiento al flujo de repuestos, insumos y reactivos para la ejecución de proyectos, gestionando contingencias y manteniendo la comunicación constante con clientes y stakeholders internos (KAMs, Marketing, Servicio).

• Asegurar el cierre formal de proyectos, el registro riguroso de casos en Rexis y el cumplimiento estricto de las normas corporativas, Compliance, políticas de calidad y bioseguridad.

Qualification:

• Título profesional en áreas de la Salud (Bioquímica, Tecnología Médica, Química y Farmacia) (y/o) Ingeniería (Biomédica, Electrónica, Industrial, Eléctrica) o carreras técnicas afines.

• Al menos 5 años de experiencia laboral en Laboratorios Clínicos y/o empresas de la industria de Diagnóstico In Vitro (IVD) / Salud.

• Dominio intermedio de inglés y manejo intermedio de MS Excel.

• Deseable conocimiento previo de equipamiento, reactivos y sistemas analíticos/software de Roche.

• Deseable experiencia en gestión de proyectos (Project Management) y manejo de herramientas como MS Project, Monday.com, Autodesk Revit o simuladores.

• Perfil con alta capacidad de resolución de problemas analíticos, excelencia en la relación con clientes, rigurosidad metodológica y trabajo en equipo interfuncional.

Ubicación: Santiago, Chile (Modalidad Híbrida / Terreno en laboratorios e instalaciones de clientes).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you an agile engineering professional looking to keep cutting-edge life sciences laboratories operating at peak performance? Join our cross-functional site network across Santa Clara and Pleasanton as a Manufacturing Equipment Engineer. In this high-impact role, you will safeguard our facility's "Right to Operate" by managing critical laboratory infrastructure, ensuring continuous regulatory compliance, and maximizing system uptime. By serving as the core technical leader for our Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) and quality risk management, your expertise will directly ensure data integrity, operational efficiency, and product quality in a regulated environment.

The Opportunity
As a Manufacturing Equipment Engineer, you will serve as the system controller and administrator for the site’s Environmental Monitoring System (EMS), overseeing everything from database administration and alert matrices to software maintenance and sensor allocation. Beyond EMS stewardship, you will drive total equipment lifecycle management across clinical and facility infrastructure—including liquid handling devices, CTUs, and imaging systems—by leading calibrations, preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting. Working closely with quality teams, you will champion Non-Conformance (NC) investigations, execute Root Cause Analysis (RCA) in SAP, and provide front-facing technical support during high-stakes FDA and BSI regulatory audits.

• EMS Administration & Control: Serve as the primary system controller for the Environmental Monitoring System (EMS), overseeing database settings, sensor allocations, CTU mapping, alert matrices, and annual software upkeep to ensure 24/7 data integrity.

• Non-Conformance & RCA Leadership: Drive end-to-end lifecycle resolution of equipment Non-Conformances (NCs), deviations, and Out-of-Specification (OOS) calibration events, executing robust Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and impact assessments in corporate QMS portals (SAP).

• Audit & Compliance Support: Provide direct technical front-room and backroom support during internal quality reviews and external regulatory audits (e.g., FDA, BSI) by assembling critical equipment records and excursion logs.

• Equipment Lifecycle & Maintenance: Plan, validate, calibrate, and perform preventive and corrective maintenance across site equipment and utility systems to minimize operational downtime.

• Infrastructure & Commissioning Support: Oversee the installation, troubleshooting, and C&Q (Commissioning & Qualification) programs for CTUs, process utilities, and facility systems, continuously analyzing system status trends for improvements.

• Vendor & Budget Oversight: Direct external vendor management to control costs, guarantee service deliverability, minimize safety risks, and extend asset life across contractual lifecycles.

• Site Training & Administration: Manage system access credentials, conduct technical software training, and act as a qualified trainer for site C&Q Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Who You Are

• Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Bioengineering, Automation Engineering, Biology, Biochemistry, or equivalent practical experience.

• Biotech Industry Experience: 5+ years of robust background in utility system and equipment engineering within a biotechnology or clinical laboratory environment.

• Hands-on EMS Administration: Proven track record administering and controlling continuous environmental monitoring system networks (e.g., REES, ViewLinc) including al

In questo ruolo di alto impatto, si salvaguarderà la "Right to Operate" della nostra struttura gestendo le infrastrutture di laboratorio critiche, garantendo la conformità normativa continua e massimizzando i tempi di avanzamento del sistema. Servendo come leader tecnico fondamentale per il nostro Sistema di Monitoraggio Ambientale (EMS) e la gestione del rischio di qualità, la vostra competenza assicurerà direttamente l'integrità dei dati, l'efficienza operativa e la qualità del prodotto in un ambiente regolamentato.

• Non-Conformance & RCA Leadership: Guidare la risoluzione end-to-end del ciclo di vita delle apparecchiature Non-Conformances (NC), deviazioni e eventi di calibrazione Out-of-Specification (OOS), eseguendo solide analisi delle cause della radice (RCA) e valutazioni di impatto nei portali QMS aziendali (SAP).

• Supporto Audit & Compliance: Fornire supporto tecnico diretto di fronte-camera e backroom durante le recensioni di qualità interna e controlli normativi esterni (ad esempio, FDA, BSI) assemblando registri di attrezzature critiche e registri delle escursioni.

• Equipaggiamento Lifecycle & Manutenzione: Pianificare, validare, calibrare ed eseguire la manutenzione preventiva e correttiva attraverso le attrezzature del sito e i sistemi di utilità per minimizzare i tempi di fermo operativo.

• Infrastructure & Commissioning Support: supervisionare l'installazione, la risoluzione dei problemi e i programmi C&Q (Commissioning & Qualification) per CTU, utilità di processo e sistemi di struttura, analizzando continuamente le tendenze di stato del sistema per i miglioramenti.

• Vendor & Budget Oversight: Gestione diretta del fornitore esterno per il controllo dei costi, garanzia della consegna dei servizi, minimizzare i rischi di sicurezza e prolungare la vita degli asset nei cicli di vita contrattuali.

• Formazione e amministrazione del sito: Gestisci le credenziali di accesso al sistema, conduci la formazione di software tecnico e funge da addestratore qualificato per le procedure operative standard del sito C&Q (SOP).

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Êtes-vous un professionnel de l'ingénierie agile qui cherche à maintenir des laboratoires de pointe en sciences de la vie fonctionnant à des performances maximales? Rejoignez notre réseau de sites interfonctionnels à Santa Clara et Pleasanton en tant qu'ingénieur en équipement de fabrication. Dans ce rôle à fort impact, vous préserverez le « Droit de fonctionner » de notre établissement en gérant l'infrastructure essentielle de laboratoire, en assurant la conformité continue à la réglementation et en maximisant le temps de disponibilité du système. En servant de chef de file technique principal pour notre système de surveillance environnementale (SGE) et la gestion des risques de qualité, votre expertise assurera directement l'intégrité des données, l'efficacité opérationnelle et la qualité des produits dans un environnement réglementé.

L'opportunité
En tant qu'ingénieur en équipement de fabrication, vous serez le contrôleur et administrateur du système de surveillance de l'environnement (EMS) du site, vous superviserez tout, de l'administration des bases de données et des matrices d'alerte à la maintenance des logiciels et à l'allocation des capteurs. Au-delà de la gérance du SGE, vous dirigerez la gestion totale du cycle de vie de l'équipement dans l'infrastructure clinique et de l'installation, y compris les dispositifs de manutention des liquides, les CTU et les systèmes d'imagerie, en menant des étalonnages, en assurant la maintenance préventive et en dépannant les problèmes. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de qualité, vous serez le champion des enquêtes sur la non-conformité (NC), exécuter l'analyse des causes profondes (RCA) dans SAP, et fournir un soutien technique face à face lors des vérifications réglementaires de la FDA et de l'ISB.

• EMS Administration & Control: Servir de contrôleur principal du système de surveillance de l'environnement (EMS), superviser les paramètres de base de données, l'allocation des capteurs, la cartographie CTU, les matrices d'alerte et l'entretien annuel des logiciels pour assurer l'intégrité des données 24/7.

• Non-conformité et leadership de l'ARC : Conduire la résolution du cycle de vie de bout en bout de l'équipement Non-conformités (NC), déviations et étalonnage hors spécification (OOS), exécuter une analyse de cause racine robuste (RCA) et des évaluations d'impact dans les portails du SGQ de l'entreprise (SAP).

• Soutien à la vérification et à la conformité : Fournir un soutien technique direct à la salle de réception et à l'arrière-salle pendant les examens internes de la qualité et les vérifications réglementaires externes (p. ex., FDA, BSI) en assemblant les dossiers d'équipement essentiel et les registres d'excursions.

• Cycle de vie et entretien de l'équipement : Planifier, valider, étalonner et effectuer des travaux d'entretien préventif et correctif à l'échelle de l'équipement et des systèmes d'utilité publique afin de minimiser les temps d'arrêt opérationnels.

• Soutien à l'infrastructure et à la mise en service : Superviser les programmes d'installation, de dépannage et de C&Q (mise en service et qualification) pour les CTU, les services publics de traitement et les systèmes d'installations, en analysant en permanence les tendances de l'état du système pour les améliorations.

jobs.title: Launch Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description: Launch Partner

Position Overview
Are you looking for an agile, high-intensity opportunity to shape a high-stakes launch at Roche Thailand? We are seeking a dynamic, business-minded talent to step into the role of Launch Partner. This is not a traditional back-office role. It is a unique hybrid archetype combining the data-driven strategic ownership of a Product Manager with the frontline execution capability of a Key Account Partner.

Working alongside our Strategic Launch Lead and an ecosystem of enabling partners (Local ICX, Medical Enablers, and the Alliance Field Force), you will completely own the end-to-end execution engine for an assigned portfolio of priority hospital accounts. Your main objective is to eliminate "last-mile" bottlenecks: accelerating local hospital listings, standardizing field messaging, and driving rapid prescription adoption among top Nephrologists and Rheumatologists.

Key Responsibilities
1. Brand Strategy & Campaign Execution

• Translate high-level brand plans into localized marketing programs utilizing local segmentation data and analytics.

• Design, test, and rapidly adapt promotional tools tailored specifically to the nuances of the Nephrology and Rheumatology therapeutic areas.

• Break out of single-domain silos by managing both the high-level data translation and the practical, frontline application of marketing materials.

2. Sales Team Enablement & Field Excellence

• Run continuous scientific messaging workshops to upskill the contract sales force.

• Provide direct, in-field support to ensure the sales team delivers a standardized, high-impact scientific message to clinicians.

• Monitor field execution performance against frontline KPIs, adjusting coaching and tools responsively.

3. Frontline Account Ownership & Hospital Access Acceleration

• Act as the strategic commercial engine for a dedicated portfolio of target hospital accounts, ensuring zero territory or portfolio overlap.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to core Nephrologists and Rheumatologists to build strong product confidence and bypass hospital formulary barriers.

• Own the "last-mile" listing process by navigating complex institutional hospital frameworks to accelerate local formulary approvals.

4. Cross-Functional Synergy & APAC Network Integration

• Act as the central operational hub connecting local field insights back to our APAC Network tools, local Medical Enablers, and the ICX Partner's digital campaign network.

• Collaborate closely with the Head of Business Enablement and ICX Enablers to leverage commercial excellence analytics and data visualization tools.

Who You Are (Qualifications & Skills)

• The Hybrid Mindset: A strong, proven blend of strategic thinking (data translation, campaign localization, segmentation) and frontline commercial drive (KOL relationship development, presentation mastery, account navigation).

• Agile Collaborator: Proven ability to manage complex interdependencies. You excel at working cross-functionally and acting as a unifying hub between external vendors, strategic leads, and contract sales teams.

• Communication & Influence: Excellent scientific and commercial communication skills, with the credibility required to engage high-level TAEs)

• Resilience & Agility: Thrives in ambiguous launch settings, values quick testing and adaptation of promotional tools, and is deeply motivated by hitting frontline KPIs.

• Language: Be able to communicate in Thai with TAEs and related STHs

Descrizione del lavoro: Partner di lancio

Posizione Panoramica
Stai cercando un'opportunita' agile e ad alta intensita' per modellare un lancio ad alto consumo a Roche Thailand? Stiamo cercando un talento dinamico e orientato al business per entrare nel ruolo di Launch Partner. Questo non è un ruolo tradizionale di back-office. Si tratta di un archetipo ibrido unico che combina la proprietà strategica data-driven di un Product Manager con la capacità di esecuzione frontale di un Key Account Partner.

Lavorando al fianco del nostro Strategic Launch Lead e di un ecosistema di partner abilitanti (Local ICX, Medical Enablers, and the Alliance Field Force), avrete completamente il motore di esecuzione end-to-end per un portafoglio assegnato di conti ospedalieri prioritari. Il vostro obiettivo principale è quello di eliminare "l'ultimo miglia" strozzature: accelerare gli elenchi ospedalieri locali, standardizzare la messaggistica sul campo, e guidare l'adozione rapida prescrizione tra i migliori nefrologi e reumatologi.

Principali responsabilità
1. Strategia di marca & Esecuzione della campagna

• Tradurre piani di marca di alto livello in programmi di marketing localizzati utilizzando dati di segmentazione locale e analisi.

• Progettare, testare e adattare rapidamente gli strumenti promozionali su misura per le sfumature delle aree terapeutiche nefrologiche e reumatologia.

• Ripartire da silos monodominico gestendo sia la traduzione di dati di alto livello sia l'applicazione pratica e front-line dei materiali di marketing.

2. Team di vendita Enables & Field Excellence

• Eseguire laboratori di messaggistica scientifica continua per upskill la forza di vendita del contratto.

• Fornire supporto diretto e in campo per garantire che il team di vendita offre un messaggio scientifico standardizzato e ad alto impatto ai medici.

• Monitorare le prestazioni di esecuzione del campo contro i KPI frontline, regolare coaching e strumenti responsively.

3. Proprietario dell'account anteriore e accelerazione dell'accesso all'ospedale

• Agire come motore commerciale strategico per un portafoglio dedicato di conti ospedalieri di destinazione, assicurando zero territorio o sovrapposizione di portafoglio.

• Servire come consulente affidabile per i nefrologi e i reumatologi core per costruire una forte fiducia del prodotto e superare le barriere formularie ospedaliere.

• Proprio il processo di elenco "ultimo miglia" navigando complessi strutture ospedaliere istituzionali per accelerare le approvazioni formularie locali.

4. Integrazione della rete di Synergy & APAC

• Agite come hub operativo centrale che collega le informazioni sul campo locale ai nostri strumenti di rete APAC, Local Medical Enablers, e la rete di campagna digitale del partner ICX.

• Collabora con il Head of Business Enablement e ICX Enablers per sfruttare gli strumenti di analisi e visualizzazione dei dati di eccellenza commerciale.

Chi sei (qualificazioni e competenze)

• L'Ibrido Mindset: Una forte e collaudata miscela di pensiero strategico (traduzione dei dati, localizzazione delle campagne, segmentazione) e azionamento commerciale front-line (KOL relazione sviluppo, mastery di presentazione, navigazione account).

• Collaboratore Agile: comprovata capacità di gestire interdipendenze complesse. Si eccelle nel lavorare cross-funzionalmente e agire come hub unificante tra fornitori esterni, lead strategici e team di vendita contract.

• Comunicazione e influenza: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scientifica e commerciale, con la credibilità necessaria per coinvolgere TAE di alto livello)

• Resilience & Agility: Thrives in ambientazioni di lancio ambigue, valori di test rapidi e adattamento di strumenti promozionali, ed è profondamente motivato dal colpire KPI di prima linea.

• Lingua: essere in grado di comunicare in tailandese con TAE e relativi STH
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description: Launch Partner

Position Overview
Are you looking for an agile, high-intensity opportunity to shape a high-stakes launch at Roche Thailand? We are seeking a dynamic, business-minded talent to step into the role of Launch Partner. This is not a traditional back-office role. It is a unique hybrid archetype combining the data-driven strategic ownership of a Product Manager with the frontline execution capability of a Key Account Partner.

Working alongside our Strategic Launch Lead and an ecosystem of enabling partners (Local ICX, Medical Enablers, and the Alliance Field Force), you will completely own the end-to-end execution engine for an assigned portfolio of priority hospital accounts. Your main objective is to eliminate "last-mile" bottlenecks: accelerating local hospital listings, standardizing field messaging, and driving rapid prescription adoption among top Nephrologists and Rheumatologists.

Key Responsibilities
1. Brand Strategy & Campaign Execution

• Translate high-level brand plans into localized marketing programs utilizing local segmentation data and analytics.

• Design, test, and rapidly adapt promotional tools tailored specifically to the nuances of the Nephrology and Rheumatology therapeutic areas.

• Break out of single-domain silos by managing both the high-level data translation and the practical, frontline application of marketing materials.

2. Sales Team Enablement & Field Excellence

• Run continuous scientific messaging workshops to upskill the contract sales force.

• Provide direct, in-field support to ensure the sales team delivers a standardized, high-impact scientific message to clinicians.

• Monitor field execution performance against frontline KPIs, adjusting coaching and tools responsively.

3. Frontline Account Ownership & Hospital Access Acceleration

• Act as the strategic commercial engine for a dedicated portfolio of target hospital accounts, ensuring zero territory or portfolio overlap.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to core Nephrologists and Rheumatologists to build strong product confidence and bypass hospital formulary barriers.

• Own the "last-mile" listing process by navigating complex institutional hospital frameworks to accelerate local formulary approvals.

4. Cross-Functional Synergy & APAC Network Integration

• Act as the central operational hub connecting local field insights back to our APAC Network tools, local Medical Enablers, and the ICX Partner's digital campaign network.

• Collaborate closely with the Head of Business Enablement and ICX Enablers to leverage commercial excellence analytics and data visualization tools.

Who You Are (Qualifications & Skills)

• The Hybrid Mindset: A strong, proven blend of strategic thinking (data translation, campaign localization, segmentation) and frontline commercial drive (KOL relationship development, presentation mastery, account navigation).

• Agile Collaborator: Proven ability to manage complex interdependencies. You excel at working cross-functionally and acting as a unifying hub between external vendors, strategic leads, and contract sales teams.

• Communication & Influence: Excellent scientific and commercial communication skills, with the credibility required to engage high-level TAEs)

• Resilience & Agility: Thrives in ambiguous launch settings, values quick testing and adaptation of promotional tools, and is deeply motivated by hitting frontline KPIs.

• Language: Be able to communicate in Thai with TAEs and related STHs

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Stellenbeschreibung: Launch Partner

Lageübersicht
Suchen Sie nach einer agilen, hochintensiven Gelegenheit, einen High-Stakes-Launch bei Roche Thailand zu gestalten? Wir suchen ein dynamisches, geschäftsorientiertes Talent, um die Rolle des Launch Partners zu übernehmen. Dies ist keine traditionelle Back-Office-Rolle. Es ist ein einzigartiger hybrider Archetyp, der die datengesteuerte strategische Eigentümerschaft eines Produktmanagers mit der Frontline-Ausführungsfähigkeit eines Key Account Partners kombiniert.

In Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Strategic Launch Lead und einem Ökosystem von Partnern (Local ICX, Medical Enablers und Alliance Field Force) besitzen Sie die End-to-End-Ausführungsmaschine für ein zugewiesenes Portfolio von vorrangigen Krankenhauskonten. Ihr Hauptziel ist es, "letzte Meile" -Engpässe zu beseitigen: Beschleunigung lokaler Krankenhausauflistungen, Standardisierung von Feldnachrichten und schnelle Einführung von Rezepten unter Top-Nephrologen und Rheumatologen.

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
1. Brand Strategy & Campaign Execution

• Übersetzen Sie hochrangige Markenpläne in lokalisierte Marketingprogramme mit lokalen Segmentierungsdaten und Analysen.

• Entwerfen, testen und schnell anpassen Promotion-Tools speziell auf die Nuancen der Nephrologie und Rheumatologie therapeutischen Bereichen zugeschnitten.

• Brechen Sie aus Single-Domain-Silos aus, indem Sie sowohl die hochkarätige Datenübersetzung als auch die praktische Anwendung von Marketingmaterialien an vorderster Front verwalten.

2. Sales Team Enablement & Field Excellence

• Führen Sie kontinuierliche wissenschaftliche Messaging-Workshops durch, um den Vertragsvertrieb zu verbessern.

• Direkte Unterstützung vor Ort, um sicherzustellen, dass das Verkaufsteam eine standardisierte, wirkungsvolle wissenschaftliche Botschaft an die Kliniker liefert.

• Überwachen Sie die Feldausführungsleistung anhand von KPIs an vorderster Front, passen Sie Coaching und Tools reaktionsschnell an.

3. Frontline Account Ownership & Krankenhauszugangsbeschleunigung

• Handeln Sie als strategischer kommerzieller Motor für ein dediziertes Portfolio von Zielkrankenhauskonten und stellen Sie sicher, dass sich das Nullgebiet oder das Portfolio überschneiden.

• Dienen Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Kernnephrologen und Rheumatologen, um ein starkes Produktvertrauen aufzubauen und Krankenhausformelbarrieren zu umgehen.

• Besitzen Sie den "last-mile" -Listing-Prozess, indem Sie komplexe institutionelle Krankenhaus-Frameworks navigieren, um lokale Formelbuchgenehmigungen zu beschleunigen.

4. Funktionsübergreifende Synergie & APAC Netzwerkintegration

• Handeln Sie als zentrales operatives Zentrum, das lokale Einblicke in unsere APAC Network-Tools, lokale Medical Enabler und das digitale Kampagnennetzwerk des ICX-Partners verbindet.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Head of Business Enablement und ICX Enablers zusammen, um kommerzielle Exzellenzanalysen und Datenvisualisierungstools zu nutzen.

Wer du bist (Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten)

• Das Hybrid Mindset: Eine starke, bewährte Mischung aus strategischem Denken (Datenübersetzung, Kampagnenlokalisierung, Segmentierung) und kommerziellem Frontline-Antrieb (KOL-Beziehungsentwicklung, Präsentationsbeherrschung, Kontonavigation).

• Agile Collaborator: Bewährte Fähigkeit, komplexe Interdependenzen zu verwalten. Sie zeichnen sich dadurch aus, dass Sie funktionsübergreifend arbeiten und als verbindender Knotenpunkt zwischen externen Anbietern, strategischen Leads und Vertragsverkaufsteams fungieren.

• Kommunikation & Einfluss: Ausgezeichnete wissenschaftliche und kommerzielle Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Glaubwürdigkeit, die erforderlich ist, um hochrangige TAEs zu engagieren

• Resilienz & Agilität: Gedeiht in mehrdeutigen Launch-Einstellungen, schätzt schnelles Testen und Anpassen von Promotion-Tools und ist zutiefst motiviert, indem es KPIs an vorderster Front trifft.

• Sprache: In der Lage sein, auf Thai mit TAEs und verwandten STHs zu kommunizieren

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Description de l'emploi: Partenaire de lancement

Aperçu de la position
Cherchez-vous une occasion agile et de haute intensité de façonner un lancement à haut débit à Roche Thailand ? Nous recherchons un talent dynamique et axé sur les affaires pour entrer dans le rôle de partenaire de lancement. Ce n'est pas un rôle traditionnel de back-office. Il s'agit d'un archétype hybride unique combinant la propriété stratégique d'un gestionnaire de produits axée sur les données avec la capacité d'exécution de première ligne d'un partenaire de compte clé.

En collaboration avec notre responsable de lancement stratégique et un écosystème de partenaires habilitants (ICX local, Activateurs médicaux et la Force de campagne de l'Alliance), vous posséderez entièrement le moteur d'exécution de bout en bout pour un portefeuille de comptes hospitaliers prioritaires. Votre objectif principal est d'éliminer les goulets d'étranglement du « dernier kilomètre » : accélérer les listes d'hôpitaux locaux, normaliser les messages sur le terrain, et conduire l'adoption rapide des ordonnances parmi les meilleurs néphrologues et les rhumatologues.

Principales responsabilités
1. Stratégie de marque et exécution de la campagne

• Traduire les plans de marque de haut niveau en programmes de marketing localisés en utilisant les données de segmentation locale et l'analyse.

• Concevoir, tester et adapter rapidement des outils promotionnels adaptés aux nuances des domaines thérapeutiques de Néphrologie et de Rheumatologie.

• Débarrassez-vous des silos monodomaine en gérant à la fois la traduction de données de haut niveau et l'application pratique et de première ligne des matériaux de marketing.

2. Capacité de l'équipe de vente et excellence sur le terrain

• Exécuter des ateliers de messagerie scientifique continus pour accroître la force de vente contractuelle.

• Fournir un soutien direct sur le terrain pour s'assurer que l'équipe des ventes transmet un message scientifique normalisé et à fort impact aux cliniciens.

• Surveiller les performances d'exécution sur le terrain par rapport aux KPI de première ligne, ajuster l'encadrement et les outils de manière réactive.

3. Propriété du compte de première ligne et accélération de l'accès aux hôpitaux

• Agir en tant que moteur commercial stratégique pour un portefeuille spécifique de comptes hospitaliers cibles, en assurant un chevauchement nul territoire ou portefeuille.

• Servir de conseiller de confiance auprès des néphrologues et des rheumatologues de base pour renforcer la confiance des produits et contourner les barrières de formulations hospitalières.

• Posséder le processus de listage du « dernier kilomètre » en naviguant sur des cadres complexes d'hôpitaux institutionnels pour accélérer l'approbation des formules locales.

4. Synergy interfonctionnelle et intégration réseau APAC

• Agissez en tant que centre opérationnel central reliant les informations locales sur le terrain à nos outils du réseau APAC, aux facilitateurs médicaux locaux et au réseau de campagne numérique du partenaire ICX.

• Collaborer étroitement avec le responsable de l'activation des activités et les facilitateurs ICX pour tirer parti des outils d'analyse et de visualisation des données d'excellence commerciale.

Qui vous êtes (Qualifications et compétences)

• L'Hybrid Mindset : Un mélange solide et éprouvé de pensée stratégique (traduction de données, localisation de campagnes, segmentation) et d'entraînement commercial en première ligne (développement de relations KOL, maîtrise de la présentation, navigation des comptes).

• Collaborateur Agile : Capacité éprouvée de gérer des interdépendances complexes. Vous excellez dans le travail interfonctionnel et agissant comme un centre d'unification entre les fournisseurs externes, les responsables stratégiques et les équipes de vente contractuelle.

• Communication et influence: Excellentes compétences en communication scientifique et commerciale, avec la crédibilité nécessaire pour engager des TAE de haut niveau)

• Résilience & Agilité : Des tendances dans des paramètres de lancement ambigus, des valeurs de test rapide et d'adaptation d'outils promotionnels, et est profondément motivé par des KPI en première ligne.

• Langue: être en mesure de communiquer en thaï avec les TAE et les STH connexes

jobs.title: Biostatistiker (m/w/d) innerhalb R&D Diagnostic
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als Biostatistiker (m/w/d) wirst du in einem hochqualifizierten Team innerhalb der Forschung und Entwicklung von Roche Diagnostics arbeiten. Unsere Abteilung unterstützt die Entwicklung von neuen Systemen, Assays und digitalen Lösungen. Komplexes Datenmanagement, Design of Experiments, die Entwicklung von Algorithmen, sowie mathematische und statistische Modellierung sind unsere Kernthemen. Das Ziel ist die Analyse und Optimierung der technischen und klinischen Leistungsfähigkeit unserer diagnostischen Produkte.

Wir sind ein interdisziplinäres Team, das eine wichtige Rolle in der Forschung und Entwicklung der diagnostischen Produkte von Roche spielt. Wir arbeiten eng mit den Teams in den Abteilungen Assay-Entwicklung und Systemintegration zusammen.

Das erwartet Dich in der Rolle

• Unterstützung in der Planung und Auswertung von Schlüsselexperimenten der Assay- und Systementwicklung, wendest dabei die entsprechenden Methoden der Versuchsplanung und der Statistik an.

• Du analysierst vorhandene Prozesse, bildest sie in mathematischen Modellen ab und verbesserst sie unter anderem durch Simulation und Optimierung.

• Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit und Optimierung der Auslastung sowie der Konfiguration unserer R-Server.

• Du setzt komplexe Anfragen unserer internen Kunden in maßgeschneiderte Lösungen um und arbeitest eng mit den zuständigen Projektleitern zusammen.

• Du bildest Dich kontinuierlich fachlich, produkt- und prozessbezogen weiter und teilst Dein Wissen im Team.

• Betreuung der Praktikanten und Diplomanden; außerdem wirkst bei der Auswahl von Themen und der Erstellung von Arbeitsplänen mit.

Wer du bist

• Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Master) in Mathematik, Statistik, Informatik oder einer Naturwissenschaft (zB Biologie, Physik, Chemie), idealerweise mit Promotion.

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse der Biostatistik und angewandten Mathematik, mit praktischer Erfahrung in biometrischen Verfahren in der Industrie sowie sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse (besonders in R und Webtechnologien).

• Erfahrung in Methoden und Werkzeugen zur Datenauswertung und zum Datenmanagement komplexer Experimente.

• Basiskenntnisse in Biochemie und medizinischer Terminologie.

• Du hast eine lösungsorientierte, entscheidungsfreudige und teamfähige Arbeitsweise sowie eine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit.

• Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.

Diese Position ist auf zwei Jahre befristet .

Deine Bewerbung

Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf und relevante Zeugnisse

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als Biostatistiker (m/w/d) wirst du in einem hochqualifizierten Team innerhalb der Forschung und Entwicklung von Roche Diagnostics arbeiten. Unsere Abteilung unterstützt die Entwicklung von neuen Systemen, Assays und digitalen Lösungen. Komplexes Datenmanagement, Design of Experiments, die Entwicklung von Algorithmen, sowie mathematische und statistische Modellierung sind unsere Kernthemen. Das Ziel ist die Analyse und Optimierung der technischen und klinischen Leistungsfähigkeit unserer diagnostischen Produkte.

Wir sind ein interdisziplinäres Team, das eine wichtige Rolle in der Forschung und Entwicklung der diagnostischen Produkte von Roche spielt. Wir arbeiten eng mit den Teams in den Abteilungen Assay-Entwicklung und Systemintegration zusammen.

Das erwartet Dich in der Rolle

• Unterstützung in der Planung und Auswertung von Schlüsselexperimenten der Assay- und Systementwicklung, wendest dabei die entsprechenden Methoden der Versuchsplanung und der Statistik an.

• Du analysierst vorhandene Prozesse, bildest sie in mathematischen Modellen ab und verbesserst sie unter anderem durch Simulation und Optimierung.

• Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit und Optimierung der Auslastung sowie der Konfiguration unserer R-Server.

• Du setzt komplexe Anfragen unserer internen Kunden in maßgeschneiderte Lösungen um und arbeitest eng mit den zuständigen Projektleitern zusammen.

• Du bildest Dich kontinuierlich fachlich, produkt- und prozessbezogen weiter und teilst Dein Wissen im Team.

• Betreuung der Praktikanten und Diplomanden; außerdem wirkst bei der Auswahl von Themen und der Erstellung von Arbeitsplänen mit.

Wer du bist

• Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Master) in Mathematik, Statistik, Informatik oder einer Naturwissenschaft (zB Biologie, Physik, Chemie), idealerweise mit Promotion.

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse der Biostatistik und angewandten Mathematik, mit praktischer Erfahrung in biometrischen Verfahren in der Industrie sowie sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse (besonders in R und Webtechnologien).

• Erfahrung in Methoden und Werkzeugen zur Datenauswertung und zum Datenmanagement komplexer Experimente.

• Basiskenntnisse in Biochemie und medizinischer Terminologie.

• Du hast eine lösungsorientierte, entscheidungsfreudige und teamfähige Arbeitsweise sowie eine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit.

• Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.

Diese Position ist auf zwei Jahre befristet .

Deine Bewerbung

Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf und relevante Zeugnisse

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Vulnerability & Exposure Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Security Monitoring & Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche is dedicated to protecting our networks, systems, applications, and users from constantly evolving cyber threats. As a Security Engineer within the Vulnerability & Exposure Management team, you will play a critical role in identifying, assessing, prioritizing, and reducing cybersecurity risks across Roche’s global environment.

This role goes beyond reviewing scanner outputs. You will help investigate critical vulnerabilities, assess exploitability, improve security tooling and automation capabilities, and partner with stakeholders globally to strengthen Roche’s security posture.

You will join a collaborative and highly technical cybersecurity team that values innovation, curiosity, continuous learning, and proactive risk reduction.

Your Opportunity
In this role, you will:

• Triage, investigate, and respond to critical vulnerabilities impacting Roche systems and applications

• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities identified through security tools and external programs, including bug bounty initiatives

• Research emerging threats and assess exploitability against Roche’s attack surface

• Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, application, and security teams to drive remediation activities

• Assess company systems and web applications using automated and manual testing approaches

• Engineer and enhance vulnerability scanning, detection, automation, and monitoring capabilities

• Contribute to security monitoring and incident response activities within a global environment

• Develop scripts, detection logic, templates, and automation workflows to improve operational efficiency

• Support continuous improvement initiatives across vulnerability and exposure management processes

Who you are
You bring a strong cybersecurity foundation combined with analytical thinking, technical curiosity, and a proactive approach to solving complex security challenges.

You also bring:

• Associate Degree in a relevant field or 5+ years of professional experience in information security, with demonstrated experience triaging, analyzing, and escalating security vulnerabilities

• Strong understanding of web application, network, endpoint, and cloud security concepts, including vulnerability management or attack surface management within complex enterprise environments

• Hands-on scripting or programming experience using languages such as Python, JavaScript, or Node.js, with familiarity in security tooling, detection logic, automation, or custom scripting

• Experience validating vulnerabilities, assessing exploitability, and supporting security monitoring or incident response activities

• Ability to communicate technical risks effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, while balancing operational priorities and research initiatives

• Passion for cybersecurity, continuous learning, and emerging security trends, with exposure to open-source security projects or modern AI-assisted engineering workflows considered advantageous

• Professional fluency in English, with industry certifications related to offensive or application security (e.g., OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE) and enterprise cloud security experience viewed as strong assets

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 mill

自我管理和团队协作

岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 多产品资源整合能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 1年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责/责任
客户管理

• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求

• 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

a)传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
b)传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
c)传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升
学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

• 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作

• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家

• 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 多产品资源整合能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 1年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a Team Lead Engineering Manager to lead our Enterprise Identity Management Reliability Team, supporting a mission-critical SailPoint IIQ platform and transforming how identity services operate at scale in a global, highly regulated environment. This platform sits at the core of our Identity Governance strategy, ensuring secure, seamless access for thousands of users across the organization. In this role, you won’t just keep the lights on—you’ll help us redefine how reliability is built and sustained. You will lead the shift from reactive support to a proactive, automation-driven SRE model, improving performance, scalability, and overall user experience. At its core, this role is about building empowered teams, creating reliable systems, and driving meaningful change in how identity services are delivered at scale.

The Opportunity

• Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement

• Support team members in shaping their career paths while removing roadblocks and maintaining a healthy, sustainable pace

• Drive improvements in platform reliability, stability, and performance in a complex, high-volume environment

• Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and implement automation to improve efficiency and scalability

• Partner closely with Product, Security, Infrastructure, and business teams to deliver reliable and secure identity services

• Oversee Managed Service Provider (MSP) performance, ensuring accountability, SLA adherence, and service quality

• Bring structure and clarity to operations through better monitoring, incident management, and continuous optimization

​
Who you are

• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field.

• 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering or technical teams

• Experience working in pharma, biotech, or other regulated industries

• Strong experience in Identity & Access Management (SailPoint IIQ is a strong plus)

• Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver) and Access Governance in regulated and large-scale environments.

• Solid understanding of running production systems (monitoring, alerting, incident response, performance tuning)

• Experience with tools like Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, or similar observability platforms

• Experience managing SailPoint IIQ upgrades, patches, and regression testing

• Ability to navigate complexity, manage stakeholders, and drive outcomes in a global environment

• Experience working with managed service providers or system integrators

• Professional Information Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM) are a plus.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Scientist Intern to join our team for a 6 month full-time period. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in data insights within the In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) market and exposure to AI-driven data analysis. The intern will be responsible for supporting key data initiatives, including data mapping, classification, and cleansing.

Your Opportunity

• Data Mapping: Map data from the Ministry of Health (MOH) list and the tender dashboard/internal sales dashboard to establish clear connections and insights.

• Data Classification Support: Provide support in the market data set from in-market volume and value by all players related to the IVD market. Validate the output from internal models to improve accuracy of result. Improving classification models by new patterns, fixing false identification.

• Data Cleansing: Perform data cleansing for distributors' insight data to ensure accuracy and consistency for analysis.

Who you are

• English and Vietnamese

• Keen to gain exposure on data analysis tools (tableau)

• Working knowledge on Microsoft Excel and Google sheets

The intern will gain valuable experience and exposure to:

• Data management and Interpretation that translate to business strategy

• The In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) market.

• AI-driven data analysis techniques.

titleByLocale.it: ERP Solution Architetto Process & Access Control
titleByLocale.en: ERP Solution Architect Process & Access Control
titleByLocale.de: ERP Solution Architect Process & Access Control
titleByLocale.fr: ERP Solution Architecte Process & Access Control

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect focuses on maximizing product and system value by designing, governing, and delivering business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready architectures within a complex, multiple solution context. In this role, you will ensure that architectural designs align with business priorities and enterprise standards while balancing functional requirements with non-functional requirements (NFRs). You will maintain the architectural vision and roadmap, collaborate closely with engineering and product teams, and continuously improve the ecosystem through technical innovation, risk mitigation, and robust governance.

The Opportunity
Architecture and Governance for ERP Process, Access, and Security Controls. Lead the architectural lifecycle management of SAP GRC Platform. The mission is to design a robust, scalable control environment that secures sensitive data, minimizes technical debt, and streamlines audit readiness. This role ensures that architectural patterns and security controls are consistently applied across the SAP ERP landscape to meet strict compliance requirements for GxP, Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR), and Data Privacy & Protection.

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Defines and owns the architectural blueprint and reference patterns to ensure delivery of solutions that meet business priorities and enterprise standards. Ensures Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)—such as scalability, performance, and security—are baked into the core design. Collaborates with product management and engineering teams to align technical evolution with enterprise governance.

• Accountability / Problem Solving: Leads architecture-related problem solving for complex security and compliance challenges using data, threat modeling, and stakeholder input. Maintains the technical vision, architectural roadmap, and guardrails. Assesses the architectural impacts, dependencies, and risks of new initiatives across the broader application landscape.

• Stakeholder Management: Engages and aligns stakeholders across business, security, and IT. Communicates complex technical concepts, trade-offs, and architectural decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Impact / Strategy: Defines and maintains the technical and integration roadmap aligned with the overarching business strategy. Reviews and guides feature implementation to maximize value delivery while ensuring long-term system sustainability. Continuously improves the architectural landscape and supports the secure adoption of new capabilities.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex, Multi-Instance, or Multiple Solution and Product Context.

• Business / Technical Ability: Applies expert-level functional and technical understanding of SAP security architectures to drive design decisions and collaborates deeply with engineering and development teams to guide implementation.

Who you are

• Deep understanding of SAP GRC Process & Access Control architecture and how they integrate seamlessly with complex ERP systems.

• Strong background in IT Service Management / ITIL to manage service delivery and system integrity.

• Very good understanding of ERP specific compliance requirements, incl. Computerized System Validation (CSV), ICFR, Data Protection/Privacy

Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience leading technical teams in designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready architectures within a complex or multiple solution/product context.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for you to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest.

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. This is the reason why we are continuously expanding, looking for new talents join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office days/week on average).

What your key responsibilities will be:

• Vendor creation/maintenance in SAP

• Bank maintenance in SAP

• Vendor Request validation and approval

• Participation in data cleansing activities

What you should bring to our company:

• Ongoing Hungarian University studies

• Able to work at least 30 hours per week

• Fluent English, Hungarian is a plus

• Knowledge of MS Office

Why you should join us:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Free language courses

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Young, diverse and dynamic environment

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Global Sustainability Manager (Corporate Sustainability Reporting)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As part of Pharma Technical Operations (PT), the PT MSAT, Engineering & Sustainability (PTT) division plays a key role in leading seamless industrialization and thorough technical product management. PTT integrates safety, health, and environment (SHE), proactive maintenance, facility fitness, performance optimization, and scalable manufacturing processes to support the manufacturing network. Product and process robustness, efficiency, and reliability are key performance indicators that PTT owns and continuously improves. Within this division, the PT Sustainability team fosters a robust sustainable culture across the organization, our partners, and stakeholders. We ensure that sustainability is deeply embedded in all PT operations, delivering measurable value and impact on the environment, society, and the economy.
As a Global Sustainability Manager, you act as a key strategic architect and primary Subject Matter Expert for sustainability initiatives. You lead global high-impact projects, drive cross-functional squads, and manage complex stakeholder landscapes to ensure compliance with reporting requirements such as the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD). Sustainability is core to our business strategy, and leveraging your deep technical expertise, you will inspire the PT community to pioneer data-driven programs. You will champion the race to zero greenhouse gas emissions, advance circular economy principles, and govern resource accounting to sustain our global license to operate.

The Opportunity

• CSRD Leadership: Lead global projects and manage reporting deliverables under the CSRD framework for sustainable product metrics.

• Resource Tracking: Calculate and track key material weights, including critical raw materials, product durability, and designed recyclability rates for products and packaging, reporting on year-over-year drivers.

• Waste & Safety Metrics: Oversee and track hazardous and non-hazardous waste streams and Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC) quantities across procurement, production, and environmental releases.

• Methodology Governance: Standardize and govern global reporting methodologies for key materials, packaging recyclability, waste streams, and SVHC metrics in collaboration with the chemical legislation team.

• Global Initiatives: Lead cross-functional global sustainability initiatives, including chemical recycling technologies and digitalization for sustainability.

• Sustainable Strategy Rollout: Support the global sustainable construction program, drive the rollout of the Sustainable Sites (SuSi) Framework across network facilities, and support the implementation lead in deploying decarbonization and sustainable products roadmaps to Pharma divisional functions.

• Business Case & Alignment: Develop robust business cases for new sustainability technologies globally to ensure optimal ROI and minimal business impact, while partnering with Group SHE for strategic alignment and environmental goal setting.

Who You Are

• Education & Experience: You hold a BS/MS in Engineering or Science (preferred) with 12+ years of professional experience in Manufacturing, Engineering, or Sustainability, demonstrating a proven track record of senior-level strategic delivery in the biotech or pharmaceutical industries.

• ESG Expertise: You possess strong familiarity with ESG reporting frameworks (specifically CSRD/ESRS requirements), life-cycle metrics, material accounting, waste tracking, and chemical safety standards suc

jobs.title: Medical Copywriter
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.

The Medical Copy and Content Team within the Global Digital Hub operates under the Content Creation Chapter. This specialized team focuses on generating commercial content intended for various digital formats (emails, videos, banners, infographics, websites etc.). Their work plays a crucial role in supporting the communication strategies developed by Roche's global and local business teams.

The Opportunity
As a Medical Copywriter (Junior Medical Writer), you will support the growing Medical Writing Team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners. You will be part of formulating and identifying current and future content needs and support different content creation initiatives.
In addition, you will work with Senior Medical Writers to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that writing activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs.
As a Medical Copywriter you will commit to continuous professional development and you will uphold the highest standards of scientific accuracy, quality, and compliance with all applicable industry guidelines, both local and international.

As an emerging expert, you will:

• Engage in continuous learning and development. Participate actively in mentorship and training programs to gain comprehensive knowledge of Roche’s therapeutic areas and enhance medical writing skills. This includes attending workshops, seminars, and one-on-one mentoring sessions to ensure the production of high-quality scientific documents.

• Assist in writing and editing medical content for different formats/digital channels and platforms, including information for patients, educational materials for HCPs (slides, posters, speaker briefs and presentations for conferences), newsletters, medical reports/study summaries, and materials for use in public relations teams.

• Exhibit excellent writing skills and be open to working on briefs across various outputs and disease areas with internal support.

• Understand and analyze briefs by identifying key components and formulating relevant questions for clients. Proactively identify and raise potential issues with briefs that may affect delivery.

• Demonstrate high-level self-editing to understand common proofing errors and ensure client-ready quality.

• Accurately reference and create marked-up packs, ensuring the authenticity and authority of source files with clear, accurate mark-up and appropriate filing.

• Adhere to regulatory frameworks and research specific guidelines for accurate writing.

• Manage multiple concurrent projects across a range of therapeutic areas, delivering on agreed timelines.

• Monitor deadlines and ensure projects are delivered on time.

• Prepare content for LMR approval in VVPM (incl. referencing).

• Partner with the Creative teams to develop content.

• Proactively contribute creative ideas, concepts or suggestions to provide added value

• Exercise excellent interpersonal/communication skills for effective and professional liaison with the internal team, clients, healthcare professiona

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Procurement Enablement - Procurement Capability Lead -
Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:

This role sits within the Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution.
This position is part of the Materials, Manufacturing and Capex (MMC) Procurement Delivery leadership team reporting into the Chapter Lead of Materials, Manufacturing and Capex Procurement Delivery. However, the scope of the role is to be applied to all of Global Procurement with a focus on both Delivery Chapters (Indirects and MMC).

As a Capability Lead - Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), you will work in a dynamic global environment where you will bring analytical thinking, planning, relationship shaping, execution, and focus to how Global Procurement segments and manages its most impactful supplier relationship and drives value, compliance, risk and innovation from them.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end management and strategic direction of Supplier Relationship Management within Global Procurement, drive alignment with the overarching Procurement strategy, digital initiatives, and customer satisfaction, and ensure consistent application of procurement methodologies. You will utilise your leadership expertise and your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise to contribute and implement a best-in-class procurement delivery capability in your area. You will apply a data driven approach to measure progress against this plan and ensure champion adoption.

You will collaborate with internal procurement (such as both Delivery Chapters, Business Partnering, Business and Digital Solutions, Analytics, Contracting, Learning and Development, etc.) functional management and business stakeholders to build and implement the capability ensuring balanced team resource utilisation, consistent application of procurement methodologies and contribution to continuous improvement projects.

As a Capability Lead - SRM, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a subject matter expert in global SRM, evaluating requests and business needs to develop and execute global SRM process and best practices in alignment with the Procurement strategy, digital initiatives and stakeholder / business needs

• You will own the end-to-end process for the SRM Capability area, from strategic conception to end-user adoption, ensuring seamless integration and a consistent approach to Category Management and Strategic Sourcing within Global Procurement

• You will lead a set of ‘’SRM Champions and Leads’’ from othe
