Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Procurement Enablement - Procurement Capability Lead - Category Management

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:

This role sits within the Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution.
This position is part of the Materials, Manufacturing and Capex (MMC) Procurement Delivery leadership team reporting into the Chapter Lead of Materials, Manufacturing and Capex Procurement Delivery. However, the scope of the role is to be applied to all of Global Procurement with a focus on both Delivery Chapters (Indirects and MMC).

As a Capability Lead - Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), you will work in a dynamic global environment where you will bring analytical thinking, planning, relationship shaping, execution, and focus to how Global Procurement segments and manages its most impactful supplier relationship and drives value, compliance, risk and innovation from them.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end management and strategic direction of Supplier Relationship Management within Global Procurement, drive alignment with the overarching Procurement strategy, digital initiatives, and customer satisfaction, and ensure consistent application of procurement methodologies. You will utilise your leadership expertise and your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise to contribute and implement a best-in-class procurement delivery capability in your area. You will apply a data driven approach to measure progress against this plan and ensure champion adoption.

You will collaborate with internal procurement (such as both Delivery Chapters, Business Partnering, Business and Digital Solutions, Analytics, Contracting, Learning and Development, etc.) functional management and business stakeholders to build and implement the capability ensuring balanced team resource utilisation, consistent application of procurement methodologies and contribution to continuous improvement projects.

As a Capability Lead - SRM, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a subject matter expert in global SRM, evaluating requests and business needs to develop and execute global SRM process and best practices in alignment with the Procurement strategy, digital initiatives and stakeholder / business needs

• You will own the end-to-end process for the SRM Capability area, from strategic conception to end-user adoption, ensuring seamless integration and a consistent approach to Category Management and Strategic Sourcing within Global Procurement

jobs.title: Praktikum bei MSAT Analytics (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

Unser 14-köpfiges Team, bestehend aus Analytikern, Projektleitern und Gruppenleiter im Bereich der molekularbiologischen Analytik, freut sich auf tatkräftige Unterstützung von einem hilfsbereiten und flexiblen neuen Teammitglied. Du solltest Spaß an neuen Herausforderungen haben und Dich in unsere positive Arbeitsatmosphäre einfügen.

Wir möchten Dir als Praktikant (m/w/d) einen Einblick in das „ daily business “ im Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) Umfeld geben. Dabei wirst Du auch die Möglichkeit haben, Dich selbstständig mit Projektarbeiten zu befassen, um bestehende Prozesse zu optimieren.

Deine Aufgaben

• Unterstützung unserer Projektarbeiten im Bereich Design Transfer & Product Care

• Analytik von molekularbiologischen und biochemischen und Einsatzstoffen im diagnostischen Umfeld

Dein Profil

• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium (Bachelor oder Master in Biochemie / Molekularbiologie / Lebensmittelchemie / Life Science) immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in Deinem Gap-Year zwischen diesen beiden

• Kenntnisse in der molekularbiologische / biochemische Analytik (insbesondere qPCR & Nukleinsäureaufreinigung, wie auch Zellkultur )

• Du bist motiviert, neugierig und möchtest Dich und Deine Ideen einbringen

• solide Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate

• Vernetzungsmöglichkeiten für Deine weitere Karriereplanung

• Vergünstigte Preise in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Zugang zu unserem Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boarding House während des Praktikums

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte beachte, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation richtet oder alternativ an Personen im Gap-Year zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium.

Für Deine Bewerbung benötigen wir ausschließlich Deinen vollständigen Lebenslauf.

Zeitraum: Flexibel im Zeitraum August bis Oktober für die Gesamtdauer des Praktikums von 6 Monaten

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il tuo dipartimento Il nostro team di 14 membri, composto da analisti, project manager e leader di gruppo nel campo dell'analisi della biologia molecolare, è impaziente di sostenere attivamente un nuovo membro del team disponibile e flessibile. Si dovrebbe godere di nuove sfide e adattarsi alla nostra atmosfera di lavoro positiva. In qualità di tirocinante, vorremmo darvi una panoramica dell’ambiente di Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT). Avrete anche la possibilità di affrontare in modo indipendente il lavoro di progetto per ottimizzare i processi esistenti. I tuoi compiti
• Supporto del nostro lavoro di progetto nell'area di Design Transfer & Product Care
• Analisi dei materiali molecolari biologici e biochimici e di input nell'ambiente diagnostico Il tuo profilo
• Sei attualmente iscritto a una laurea in scienze (Bachelor o Master in Biochimica / Biologia molecolare / Chimica alimentare / Scienza della vita) o sei Nel vostro periodo di tempo tra questi due
• Conoscenza dell'analisi molecolare biologica / biochimica (in particolare la purificazione dell'acido qPCR & nucleico, così come la cultura cellulare)
• Sei motivato, curioso e vuoi contribuire te stesso e le tue idee
• solida conoscenza del tedesco è richiesto I vantaggi
• Divisione tempo flessibile
• 2268 € compensazione al mese per uno stage a tempo pieno > 3 mesi
• Opportunità di rete per la tua ulteriore pianificazione della carriera
• Prezzi ridotti nella nostra mensa dei dipendenti
• Accesso al nostro centro fitness nel campus Roche
• Possibilità di alloggio presso la Roche Boarding House durante lo stage La tua domanda Si prega di notare che questo tirocinio è rivolto agli studenti (m/f/d) con registrazione continua o in alternativa alle persone nell'anno tra Bachelor e Master. Per la vostra applicazione, abbiamo solo bisogno del vostro CV completo. Periodo: Flessibile tra agosto e ottobre per la durata totale dello stage di 6 mesi Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione! Si prega di notare che le raccomandazioni per tutte le attività degli studenti (ad esempio stage, tesi finali, ecc.) sono escluse. Il tuo contatto con noi! Con la gente. Per le persone. Hai bisogno di ulteriore supporto? Date un'occhiata alle nostre FAQ, le troverete via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

• Analysis of molecular biological and biochemical and input materials in the diagnostic environment Your profile

• Knowledge of molecular biological / biochemical analysis (especially qPCR & nucleic acid purification, as well as cell culture)
• You are motivated, curious and want to contribute yourself and your ideas
• solid knowledge of German is required Your advantages
• Flexible time division
• 2268 € compensation per month for a full-time internship > 3 months
• Networking opportunities for your further career planning
• Reduced prices in our employee canteen

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Votre département Notre équipe de 14 membres, composée d'analystes, de gestionnaires de projet et de chefs de groupe dans le domaine de l'analyse de la biologie moléculaire, est impatiente d'obtenir le soutien actif d'un nouveau membre d'équipe utile et flexible. Vous devriez profiter de nouveaux défis et s'intégrer à notre atmosphère de travail positive. En tant que stagiaire, nous aimerions vous donner un aperçu de l'entreprise quotidienne dans l'environnement de la science et de la technologie manufacturière (MSAT). Vous aurez également la possibilité de traiter de manière indépendante le travail du projet afin d'optimiser les processus existants. Vos tâches
• Soutien de notre projet dans le domaine du transfert de conception et du soin des produits
• Analyse des matériaux moléculaires biologiques, biochimiques et d'entrée dans l'environnement diagnostique Votre profil
• Vous êtes actuellement inscrit à un diplôme en sciences (Bachelor ou Master en biochimie / Biologie moléculaire / Chimie alimentaire / Sciences de la vie) ou vous êtes Dans votre écart-année entre ces deux
• Connaissance de l'analyse moléculaire biologique / biochimique (en particulier la purification qPCR & acide nucléique, ainsi que la culture cellulaire)
• Vous êtes motivé, curieux et vous voulez contribuer vous-même et vos idées
• une connaissance solide de l'allemand est nécessaire Vos avantages
• Division du temps flexible
• 2268 € compensation par mois pour un stage à plein temps > 3 mois
• Possibilités de réseautage pour votre planification de carrière
• Prix réduits dans notre cantine pour employés
• Accès à notre centre de fitness sur le campus de Roche
• Possibilité d'hébergement à la pension Roche pendant le stage Votre demande Veuillez noter que ce stage est destiné aux étudiants (m/f/d) avec inscription continue ou alternativement aux personnes dans l'écart-année entre les études de baccalauréat et de maîtrise. Pour votre candidature, nous n'avons besoin que de votre CV complet. Période : Flexible entre août et octobre pour la durée totale du stage de 6 mois Nous nous réjouissons de votre candidature! Veuillez noter que les recommandations pour toutes les activités des étudiants (par exemple les stages, les thèses finales, etc.) sont exclues. Votre contact avec nous ! Avec des gens. Pour les gens. Avez-vous besoin d'un soutien supplémentaire? Consultez nos FAQ, vous les trouverez via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, garantissant à tous l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur à chances égales.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The People Support Solutions (PSS) department brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions.

The opportunity:
As a German-speaking Template Manager (P&C Document Management Solution),​ you are part of a dynamic, vivid and spiritful organization and you are responsible for supporting the document generation process within Global P&C Document Management Solution, especially for creating document templates in Workday using Kainos Extend.

Your main tasks will include (but not limited to):

• Creating and maintaining document templates in Global P&C Document Management Solution according to guidelines and guidance from Template Requesters

• Supporting the implementation of template automations in other P&C systems (e. g. ServiceNow, Workday)

• Consulting with Template Requesters regarding possible options for template creation

• Supporting the testing activities for document generation.

• Ensuring document delivery from the personal files upon request

• Providing professional customer service, developing key stakeholder relationships and advising partners on the adoption of new ways of working.

• Demonstrating process knowledge to ensure compliance by updating documentation (SWIs, SOPs, GWIs) and strictly adhering to legal and data protection regulations.

Who you are:
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Strong customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Strong & precise work-ethic, good analytical skills, ability to deal with Excel tables and ability to focus on details and numbers

• A tech savvy vein, analytical thinking, strong knowledge of MS Office and G Suite applications

• Experience with Java or Visual Basic, basic knowledge of HTML (would be a plus)

• Experience in service delivery or customer care environment

• Fluent in written and spoken English and German.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office days/week)

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Help shape the future of sustainable healthcare.
Global chemical and environmental regulations play a vital role in every stage of a product’s lifecycle — from development and manufacturing to usage and disposal. At Roche Pharma Technical Operations, we are uniting our expertise and expanding our capabilities to ensure strong compliance with these important regulations.

The Opportunity
Join a dynamic, international team at the forefront of product environmental compliance. You will be working in the Roche Pharma Environmental & Chemical Regulations team. Our goal is to ensure our products comply with environmental regulations, and improve their sustainability performance. Joining our team will provide you with the experience of working in a cross-functional and international team, and will give you the opportunity to learn about pharmaceutical manufacturing and how this connects to sustainability and environmental compliance.
The scope of your work will include supporting our Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) Lead in conducting LCA analyses of our pharmaceutical products, providing the product teams with valuable product sustainability insights, while contributing to increasing transparency for our customers. You will be responsible for LCA data projects aiming at increasing the quality and representativity of LCA analyses. In addition, you will be supporting the team with various tasks related to the optimization and streamlining of LCA analyses and their communication.

Who You are:

• Education : You are currently enrolled in or have completed a Master’s degree program at a university, preferably in Environmental Science or another Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) field that includes Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) in its curriculum.

• Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) Expertise: You possess both theoretical and applied knowledge of the methodology, with hands-on experience in conducting at least one study (covering data collection, modeling, and impact assessment). You are familiar with dedicated assessment software, preferably SimaPro, and the ecoinvent database. Experience with modeling chemical retrosynthesis, energy systems, or biochemical processes is a plus.

• Mindset & Sustainability Passion : You are genuinely interested in the environmental sustainability of pharmaceutical products and motivated to perform LCA analyses, collect and model project data, and support product teams with sustainability insights.

• Data Management & Analytical Skills: You are comfortable collecting, standardizing, organizing, and communicating complex data from multiple sources in a clear, precise, and structured manner. You enjoy optimizing and streamlining analysis workflows.

• Soft Skills & Collaboration: You are a proactive, passionate, and critical thinker with excellent communication skills. You thrive as a team player in cross-functional, international environments and possess excellent written and spoken English skills.

Application process
Please upload a current CV and a Motivation Letter, where you indicate your preferred start date of the internship.

Additional Information:

• Please note, due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university for the whole duration of this internship.

• Start: January 2027.

• Duration: 12 months.

• Location: Basel.

If you are eager to contribute

jobs.title: Healthcare Systems Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Healthcare System Partner (HSP) serves as an empowered leader and the local representative of Roche, collaborating with healthcare stakeholders like policymakers, regulators, and payers. The HSP identifies common goals, co-creates, and implements solutions within ecosystems, thereby influencing outcomes for many patients. Through this role, the HSP is accountable for challenging and shaping the healthcare system to achieve improved health outcomes for more patients in a sustainable manner."

Your Responsibilities

• The HSP collaborates with healthcare system stakeholders to foster innovation and create value for both the ecosystem and society.

• This role involves identifying, mapping, engaging, and managing various ecosystem stakeholders.

• The HSP serves as a trusted primary contact for both stakeholders and Roche, sharing the stakeholder community's vision and securing necessary resources to drive solutions.

• Embracing the Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst (VACC) model, the HSP acts as a catalyst and coach both internally and externally.

• The position is empowered to leverage local and network resources, collaborating with other Healthcare System Partners and Patient Journey Partners as needed.

• The HSP analyzes individual ecosystems to identify broader trends and patterns within healthcare systems.

• The HSP brings external insights into Roche to shape strategy while disseminating Roche's expertise, science, and knowledge back into the ecosystem.

Who You Are

• University degree in Pharmacy, an advanced degree in Life
science and/or MBA is a plus.

• At least two years of experience in Market Access is a must for this role.

• Possesses a deep understanding of the healthcare system, including processes, governance, access, pricing, and policy strategies.

• Demonstrates excellent customer engagement and management skills, along with the ability to handle complex projects effectively.

• Has experience leading cross-functional teams, with desirable expertise in formulating strategies and orchestrating collaboration.

• Functions as a system thinker and deep listener, showcasing sensitivity as a leader who reflects and responds to team needs.

• Holds strong business acumen with expertise in commercialization and customer experience, adept at leveraging innovative methods and digital tools for stakeholder benefit.

• Fluent in English and Arabic Languages.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
The Healthcare System Partner (HSP) serves as an empowered leader and the local representative of Roche, collaborating with healthcare stakeholders like policymakers, regulators, and payers. The HSP identifies common goals, co-creates, and implements solutions within ecosystems, thereby influencing outcomes for many patients. Through this role, the HSP is accountable for challenging and shaping the healthcare system to achieve improved health outcomes for more patients in a sustainable manner."

Your Responsibilities

• The HSP collaborates with healthcare system stakeholders to foster innovation and create value for both the ecosystem and society.

• This role involves identifying, mapping, engaging, and managing various ecosystem stakeholders.

• The HSP serves as a trusted primary contact for both stakeholders and Roche, sharing the stakeholder community's vision and securing necessary resources to drive solutions.

• Embracing the Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst (VACC) model, the HSP acts as a catalyst and coach both internally and externally.

• The position is empowered to leverage local and network resources, collaborating with other Healthcare System Partners and Patient Journey Partners as needed.

• The HSP analyzes individual ecosystems to identify broader trends and patterns within healthcare systems.

• The HSP brings external insights into Roche to shape strategy while disseminating Roche's expertise, science, and knowledge back into the ecosystem.

Who You Are

• University degree in Pharmacy, an advanced degree in Life
science and/or MBA is a plus.

• At least two years of experience in Market Access is a must for this role.

• Has experience leading cross-functional teams, with desirable expertise in formulating strategies and orchestrating collaboration.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Expert Digital Product & Service Designer - RDT Workforce Enablement

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The UX Professional is a leader who owns the UX/CX for an entire product or service. In this role, you will lead complex initiatives, resolve ambiguous challenges, and cultivate strong stakeholder relationships within your scope.

By seamlessly integrating UX into development cycles and utilizing human-centered design methodologies, you will actively shape the product user experience, drive robust, evidence-based recommendations, and mentor junior designers to elevate the overall user and customer experience.

The opportunity:

Scope

• Leads the UX/CX for complex initiatives, projects, or products from concept through to successful implementation

• This includes managing intricate features, overarching designs, and critical value metrics across all their constituent digital solutions and services, and serving as a key contributor to defining and evolving UX best practices and standards within a specific domain or product line

Accountability/Problem Solving

• Demonstrates a consistent ability to navigate and effectively resolve highly complex and ambiguous UX challenges with pragmatic solutions

• Possesses and applies an advanced understanding of specialized UX capabilities, actively fostering a culture of curiosity within the immediate team, and guides and empowers others in collaborative efforts to tackle complex design and user experience challenges within their assigned scope

Stakeholder Management

• Communicates with clarity and impact, articulating complex information and ideas to diverse project or product-related stakeholders with different viewpoints (e.g., Product Management, IT Leads, relevant Business Process Owners)

• Leads and encourages proactive conversations to share ideas, build consensus on actions, and align strategic direction for their assigned initiatives

• Proactively manages stakeholder expectations and cultivates robust, trusting relationships throughout the entire project or product lifecycle, influencing design and business decisions

Impact/Strategy

• Recognized as a leader who confidently leads UX initiatives and projects within their area of responsibility

• Plays a pivotal role in shaping the overall user and customer experience for their assigned scope, directly leading to significant improvements in user satisfaction, engagement, and business value

• Actively mentors and develops other designers, fostering their professional growth, and contributes to the development of the broader UX c

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Network Technical Lead - Digital Health Solutions (IVD & MD)

Roche Diagnostics is a division of Roche. As a science-driven company, we are constantly looking for talent to drive the next wave of healthcare breakthroughs. A key reason why many prospective employees join Roche and choose to stay with us is the calibre of the people who work here. From award-winning scientists with pioneering inventions to top experts and professionals in various fields of study, we attract and retain some of the world’s most talented people. In our daily work, we’re committed to finding better ways to prevent, diagnose, and monitor disease.

As a Network Technical Lead within the Digital Solutions Chapter of Post Market Quality (PMQ) , you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the quality, safety, and performance of Roche's digital health solutions once they are in the hands of customers and patients.

Our chapter supports a broad portfolio of cloud platforms, mobile applications, connected medical devices, and digital ecosystems. Every day, we investigate complex product quality issues, customer complaints, and patient allegations, working closely with Development, Regulatory, Medical, and global affiliates to understand what happened, determine the technical root cause, and drive the right actions to continuously improve our products.

As the Network Technical Lead, you will provide technical leadership across this ecosystem. This is a matrix leadership position , where your success comes from influencing technical direction, facilitating cross-functional collaboration, and enabling engineering teams to resolve the most challenging product quality investigations while continuously strengthening our technical capabilities and ways of working.

The Opportunity

As a Network Technical Lead within the Digital Solutions Chapter of Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will lead the technical community responsible for a portfolio of Roche's Digital Solutions, ensuring we continue to deliver the highest standards of quality, reliability, and patient safety after our products reach the market.

• You provide technical leadership for the investigation and resolution of the most complex customer complaints, product quality issues, and patient allegations across Roche's Digital Solutions portfolio.

• You coordinate cross-functional investigations involving software engineers, product teams, quality experts, and global affiliates to ensure timely, evidence-based root cause analysis.

• You enable teams to make sound technical decisions while ensuring compliance with quality and regulatory requirements.

• You identify trends emerging from field experience and customer feedback, driving proactive improvements that enhance product quality, reliability, and patient safety.

• You partner closely with Engineers and Sub Chapter leads to continuously improve engineering practices, investigation approaches, and way of working across the Digital Solutions Chapter.

Who You Are:

• A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

• Solid background in the healthcare industry (pharma, diagnostics, digital solutions for medical devices, In vitro devices) or another highly regulated domain.

• Extensive experience in software engineering, software architecture, or technical leadership within complex cloud-based and distributed software environments.

• Demonstrated success leading through influence in matrix organizations, bringing together diverse stake

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Network Technical Lead – Soluzioni digitali

Roche Diagnostics è una divisione di Roche. Come azienda scientifica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di talento per guidare la prossima ondata di scoperte sanitarie. Un motivo chiave per cui molti potenziali dipendenti si uniscono a Roche e scelgono di stare con noi è il calibro delle persone che lavorano qui. Da scienziati pluripremiati con invenzioni pionieristiche ai migliori esperti e professionisti in vari campi di studio, attiriamo e conserviamo alcune delle persone più talentuose del mondo. Nel nostro lavoro quotidiano, ci impegniamo a trovare modi migliori per prevenire, diagnosticare e monitorare la malattia.

Come Network Technical Lead all'interno del Digital Solutions Chapter of Post Market Quality (PMQ) , si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire la qualità, la sicurezza e le prestazioni delle soluzioni per la salute digitale di Roche una volta che sono nelle mani di clienti e pazienti.

Il nostro capitolo supporta un ampio portafoglio di piattaforme cloud, applicazioni mobili, dispositivi medici collegati e ecosistemi digitali. Ogni giorno, indaghiamo su problemi di qualità dei prodotti complessi, reclami dei clienti e accuse dei pazienti, lavorando a stretto contatto con lo sviluppo, la regolamentazione, le affiliate mediche e globali per capire cosa è successo, determinare la causa principale tecnica, e guidare le azioni giuste per migliorare continuamente i nostri prodotti.

Come Network Technical Lead, fornirete la leadership tecnica in questo ecosistema. Si tratta di una posizione di leadership matrice, in cui il vostro successo deriva dall'influenza della direzione tecnica, facilitando la collaborazione interfunzionale, e consentendo ai team di ingegneria di risolvere le più difficili indagini sulla qualità del prodotto, rafforzando continuamente le nostre capacità tecniche e i modi di lavorare.

L'opportunità

Come Network Technical Lead all'interno del Digital Solutions Chapter of Post Market Quality (PMQ), guiderai la comunità tecnica responsabile di un portafoglio di soluzioni digitali di Roche, assicurandoci di continuare a fornire i più elevati standard di qualità, affidabilità e sicurezza dei pazienti dopo che i nostri prodotti raggiungono il mercato.

• Fornite la leadership tecnica per l'indagine e la risoluzione dei reclami più complessi dei clienti, dei problemi di qualità dei prodotti e delle accuse dei pazienti attraverso il portafoglio di Roche Digital Solutions.

• Coordinate le indagini interfunzionali che coinvolgono ingegneri del software, team di prodotti, esperti di qualità e affiliati globali per garantire analisi puntuali e basate sulle prove.

• Permette ai team di prendere decisioni tecniche sonore, garantendo il rispetto dei requisiti di qualità e di regolamentazione.

• Identifichi le tendenze emergenti dall'esperienza sul campo e dal feedback dei clienti, guidando miglioramenti proattivi che migliorano la qualità del prodotto, l'affidabilità e la sicurezza dei pazienti.

• L'utente collabora strettamente con gli ingegneri e il Sub Capitolo porta a migliorare continuamente le pratiche ingegneristiche, gli approcci di indagine e il modo di lavorare attraverso il Capitolo Soluzioni Digitali.

Chi sei?

• Una laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria del Software, Tecnologia dell'Informazione, o una disciplina relativa.

• Ampia esperienza nell'ingegneria del software, nell'architettura del software o nella leadership tecnica all'interno di ambienti software complessi basati su cloud e distribuiti.

• Dimostrato successo che conduce attraverso l'influenza nelle organizzazioni di matrice, unendo diversi stakeholder per raggiungere obiettivi tecnici comuni.

• Forte background tecnico nello sviluppo moderno del software, tecnologie cloud, sistemi distribuiti, pratiche DevOps o guarire digitale

• You provide technical leadership for the investigation and resolution of the most complex customer complaints, product quality issues, and patient allegations across Roche's Digital Solutions portfolio.

• You coordinate cross-functional investigations involving software engineers, product teams, quality experts, and global affiliates to ensure timely, evidence-based root cause analysis.

• You enable teams to make sound technical decisions while ensuring compliance with quality and regulatory requirements.

• You identify trends emerging from field experience and customer feedback, driving proactive improvements that enhance product quality, reliability, and patient safety.

• You partner closely with Engineers and Sub Chapter leads to continuously improve engineering practices, investigation approaches, and way of working across the Digital Solutions Chapter.

Who You Are:

• A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

• Solid background in the healthcare industry (pharma, diagnostics, digital solutions for medical devices, In vitro devices) or another highly regulated domain.

• Extensive experience in software engineering, software architecture, or technical leadership within complex cloud-based and distributed software environments.

• Demonstrated success leading through influence in matrix organizations, bringing together diverse stake
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Network Technical Lead – Digitale Lösungen

Roche Diagnostics ist eine Division von Roche. Als wissenschaftsgetriebenes Unternehmen sind wir ständig auf der Suche nach Talenten, um die nächste Welle von Durchbrüchen im Gesundheitswesen voranzutreiben. Ein wichtiger Grund, warum viele potenzielle Mitarbeiter zu Roche kommen und sich dafür entscheiden, bei uns zu bleiben, ist das Kaliber der Menschen, die hier arbeiten. Von preisgekrönten Wissenschaftlern mit bahnbrechenden Erfindungen bis hin zu Top-Experten und Fachleuten in verschiedenen Studienbereichen ziehen und halten wir einige der talentiertesten Menschen der Welt. In unserer täglichen Arbeit sind wir bestrebt, bessere Wege zu finden, um Krankheiten zu verhindern, zu diagnostizieren und zu überwachen.

Als Network Technical Lead innerhalb des Digital Solutions Chapter of Post Market Quality (PMQ) spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gewährleistung der Qualität, Sicherheit und Leistung der digitalen Gesundheitslösungen von Roche, sobald sie in den Händen von Kunden und Patienten sind.

Unser Kapitel unterstützt ein breites Portfolio von Cloud-Plattformen, mobilen Anwendungen, vernetzten medizinischen Geräten und digitalen Ökosystemen. Jeden Tag untersuchen wir komplexe Produktqualitätsprobleme, Kundenbeschwerden und Patientenvorwürfe und arbeiten eng mit Entwicklungs-, Regulierungs-, Medizin- und globalen Tochtergesellschaften zusammen, um zu verstehen, was passiert ist, die technische Ursache zu ermitteln und die richtigen Maßnahmen zu ergreifen, um unsere Produkte kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Als Network Technical Lead bieten Sie technische Führung in diesem Ökosystem. Dies ist eine Matrix-Führungsposition, bei der Ihr Erfolg darauf zurückzuführen ist, die technische Richtung zu beeinflussen, die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zu erleichtern und Ingenieurteams in die Lage zu versetzen, die anspruchsvollsten Produktqualitätsuntersuchungen zu lösen und gleichzeitig unsere technischen Fähigkeiten und Arbeitsweisen kontinuierlich zu stärken.

Die Chance

Als Network Technical Lead innerhalb des Digital Solutions Chapter of Post Market Quality (PMQ) leiten Sie die technische Gemeinschaft, die für ein Portfolio von Roches Digital Solutions verantwortlich ist, um sicherzustellen, dass wir auch nach der Markteinführung unserer Produkte die höchsten Standards in Bezug auf Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und Patientensicherheit liefern.

• Sie übernehmen die technische Leitung für die Untersuchung und Lösung der komplexesten Kundenbeschwerden, Produktqualitätsprobleme und Patientenvorwürfe im gesamten Portfolio von Roche Digital Solutions.

• Sie koordinieren funktionsübergreifende Untersuchungen mit Software-Ingenieuren, Produktteams, Qualitätsexperten und globalen Tochtergesellschaften, um eine zeitnahe, evidenzbasierte Ursachenanalyse zu gewährleisten.

• Sie ermöglichen es Teams, fundierte technische Entscheidungen zu treffen und gleichzeitig die Einhaltung der Qualitäts- und Regulierungsanforderungen sicherzustellen.

• Sie identifizieren Trends, die sich aus Erfahrung vor Ort und Kundenfeedback ergeben und proaktive Verbesserungen vorantreiben, die die Produktqualität, Zuverlässigkeit und Patientensicherheit verbessern.

• Ihre enge Partnerschaft mit Ingenieuren und Sub Chapter führt zu einer kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Engineering-Praktiken, Untersuchungsansätze und Arbeitsweise im gesamten Digital Solutions Chapter.

Wer Du bist:

• Ein Abschluss in Informatik, Software Engineering, Informationstechnologie oder einer verwandten Disziplin.

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in Software Engineering, Softwarearchitektur oder technischer Führung in komplexen Cloud-basierten und verteilten Softwareumgebungen.

• Demonstrierter Erfolg, der durch Einfluss in Matrixorganisationen führt und verschiedene Interessengruppen zusammenbringt, um gemeinsame technische Ziele zu erreichen.

• Starker technischer Hintergrund in moderner Softwareentwicklung, Cloud-Technologien, verteilten Systemen, DevOps-Praktiken oder digitaler Heilung

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Responsable technique du réseau – Solutions numériques

Roche Diagnostics est une division de Roche. En tant qu'entreprise scientifique, nous sommes constamment à la recherche de talents pour conduire la prochaine vague de percées en soins de santé. Une des principales raisons pour lesquelles de nombreux employés potentiels rejoignent Roche et choisissent de rester avec nous est le calibre des personnes qui travaillent ici. Des scientifiques primés avec des inventions pionnières aux experts et professionnels de haut niveau dans divers domaines d'études, nous attirons et conservons certains des gens les plus talentueux du monde. Dans notre travail quotidien, nous sommes déterminés à trouver de meilleurs moyens de prévenir, diagnostiquer et surveiller les maladies.

En tant que responsable technique du réseau au sein du chapitre Solutions numériques de la qualité post-commercialisation (PMQ), vous jouerez un rôle central pour assurer la qualité, la sécurité et la performance des solutions numériques de santé de Roche une fois qu'elles seront entre les mains de clients et de patients.

Notre chapitre prend en charge un large éventail de plateformes cloud, d'applications mobiles, de dispositifs médicaux connectés et d'écosystèmes numériques. Chaque jour, nous enquêtons sur des questions complexes de qualité des produits, des plaintes de clients et des allégations de patients, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des sociétés affiliées de Développement, de Réglementation, de Médical et de Global pour comprendre ce qui s'est passé, déterminer la cause fondamentale technique et conduire les bonnes actions pour améliorer continuellement nos produits.

En tant que responsable technique du réseau, vous exercerez un leadership technique dans l'ensemble de cet écosystème. Il s'agit d'une position de leadership matricielle , où votre succès vient d'influencer la direction technique, de faciliter la collaboration interfonctionnelle et de permettre aux équipes d'ingénierie de résoudre les enquêtes les plus difficiles sur la qualité des produits tout en renforçant continuellement nos capacités techniques et nos méthodes de travail.

L'opportunité

En tant que responsable technique réseau au sein du chapitre Solutions numériques de la qualité post-commercialisation (PMQ), vous dirigerez la communauté technique responsable d'un portefeuille de Solutions numériques Roche, assurant ainsi que nous continuons à fournir les plus hautes normes de qualité, de fiabilité et de sécurité des patients après que nos produits soient arrivés sur le marché.

• Vous fournissez un leadership technique pour l'enquête et le règlement des plaintes les plus complexes des clients, des problèmes de qualité des produits et des allégations de patients dans le portefeuille de Solutions numériques de Roche.

• Vous coordonnez les enquêtes interfonctionnelles impliquant des ingénieurs en logiciels, des équipes de produits, des experts de qualité et des affiliés mondiaux afin d'assurer une analyse des causes profondes en temps opportun et fondée sur des données probantes.

• Vous permettez aux équipes de prendre des décisions techniques saines tout en assurant le respect des exigences de qualité et de réglementation.

• Vous identifiez les tendances qui émergent de l'expérience sur le terrain et de la rétroaction des clients, ce qui entraîne des améliorations proactives qui améliorent la qualité du produit, la fiabilité et la sécurité des patients.

• Vous collaborez étroitement avec Ingénieurs et Sous-Chapitre mène à l'amélioration continue des pratiques d'ingénierie, des approches d'investigation et de la façon de travailler à travers le Chapitre Solutions numériques.

Qui vous êtes :

• Diplôme en informatique, génie logiciel, technologie de l'information ou discipline connexe.

• Expérience approfondie en ingénierie logicielle, architecture logicielle ou leadership technique dans des environnements logiciels complexes basés sur le cloud et distribués.

• La réussite démontrée se traduit par une influence au sein des organisations matricielles, qui réunit divers intervenants pour atteindre des objectifs techniques communs.

• Forte expérience technique dans le développement de logiciels modernes, les technologies cloud, les systèmes distribués, les pratiques DevOps, ou la guérison numérique

jobs.title: Head of S&C Planning & Material Management

titleByLocale.en: Head of S&C Planning & Material Management

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a leader in Global Operations, you inspire all of our people to boldly innovate, collaborate, and deliver answers to patients. You lead collectively, demonstrating an enterprise mindset and taking accountability for the whole beyond your own area of responsibility, fostering a high-performance culture that empowers teams to thrive and unlock their full potential. In this role, you navigate complexity and ambiguity with resilience, breaking down silos to standardize processes and create alignment across manufacturing and enabling functions to drive continuous growth.

As the Head of Sensor & Cartridge (S&C) Planning and Material Management, you drive excellence across the global S&C manufacturing and supply network with agile and strategic leadership. You enable and lead a network of leaders within a complex, above-country operating organization, taking direct responsibility for critical supply chain functions including buying, production planning, master data management, launch management, and logistics/warehousing.

The Opportunity

• Develop and communicate a compelling vision aligned with S&C strategic priorities, collaborating cross-functionally with Procurement, Global Supply Chain, and R&D to define the organization's role in operations and align the end-to-end supply chain from sales planning to customer delivery to enhance efficiency, sustainability, and innovation.

• Take full responsibility for cross-functional operations planning, operational purchasing, production planning, and operational logistics, including managing in- and outbound processes, order management, import/export, inventory optimization, and supply chain monitoring across international networks.

• Develop operational procurement, strengthen supplier integration to establish strategic partnerships, lead long-term capacity planning within the S&C network, and initiate resulting supply chain design changes.

• Ensure efficient material handling for goods receipt, physical inventory management, outbound shipments to hubs, oversee and improve master data management processes, and provide first-level SAP IT support for S&C.

• Foster early involvement in launch and transfer projects to optimize the total cost of ownership while supporting development projects with logistical expertise, production concepts, and efficient implementation.

• Actively influence supply chain design and network optimization to enhance flexibility, scalability, and resilience, driving innovation, adopting new technologies, and setting clear performance metrics and KPIs using data and analytics to identify risks and implement corrective actions.

• Initiate projects for sustainable improvement, drive operational excellence, anticipate and mitigate supply chain risks related to production, logistics, and market conditions, ensure compliance with global trade regulations, customs requirements, internal policies, and GMP standards, and effectively communicate strategic goals and performance results to senior leaders and stakeholders.

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor's degree (Master's preferred) in Supply Chain Management or Business Administration, ideally with professional certifications like CSCP or CPSM.

• You possess a minimum of 10 years of experience in supply chain management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.

• You have a proven track record of managing and developing above-country teams in complex, global environments, including functions like buying, network planning, and internat

This role requires strong expertise in SAP architecture, modules, and integration points, with a deep understanding of how SAP systems operate within complex enterprise environments.
You will be responsible for cross-application reliability, system performance management, proactive SAP system health monitoring, and performance tuning . Collaborating closely with SAP developers, functional consultants, and business stakeholders, you will help reduce technical debt and ensure seamless, highly reliable ERP platform and business operations.
Applying SRE principles to SAP systems , you will drive improvements in availability, performance, and scalability, ensuring the Digital Core runs smoothly under dynamic business demands. Your work will directly influence system stability, user experience, and platform scalability for mission-critical SAP business processes .

As a key member of the Roche ERP within Enterprise Platforms, Infrastructure & Engineering (EPIE) organization, you will lead within the ERP Systems Management sub-function. Ensure availability and continuity management at the application level across all integrated SAP landscapes. Drive problem management through root cause identification and preventive action, minimizing system downtime.

jobs.title: Learning Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Learning Partner at Roche, you will utilize your adult learning expertise to partner with senior business leaders to drive the development, execution, and evaluation of innovative learning strategies and solutions. You will develop and maintain strategic relationships with either regional or functional partners across the organization to act as their primary point of contact.

By applying your deep business acumen, you will support learning programs and portfolios from end-to-end. You will drive the development and execution of innovative learning methodologies to create meaningful learning outcomes that truly stand out and make a global impact.
Key responsibilities:

• Cultivate Partnerships: Create and cultivate strong strategic partnerships with key senior global business stakeholders.

• Drive Strategy: Develop and support the execution of short- and long-term learning strategies aligned with business goals.

• Provide Strategic Leadership: Offer subject matter expertise in adult learning and guide the end-to-end leadership of complex learning projects and programs.

• Manage Stakeholders: Act as the primary point of contact within Global Learning Services (GLS) to ensure seamless support for LMS administration, instructional design, and event management.

• Continuous Improvement: Lead change management strategies and drive continuous improvements to increase productivity and quality across the PSS network.

• Coach Leaders: Guide Roche leaders on the application of non-training performance solutions, such as job aids, knowledge management, coaching, and lean process improvement.

• Measure Impact: Deploy data collection solutions to measure and improve the effectiveness and business value of learning programs.

Who you are

• Educational Background: University degree (Master's or Bachelor's) in Human Resources, Organization Development, Project Management, or an equivalent field. An advanced degree or certification in Adult Learning is preferred.

• Professional Experience: 5–10+ years of combined project management and adult learning consultant experience in a global environment (prior consulting or professional services experience is preferred).

• Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to collaborate, influence, and manage senior stakeholders across a highly matrixed, global organisation without direct authority.

• Methodologies & Tools: Strong knowledge of Design Thinking, Agile development methodologies, rapid prototyping, and experience with cloud-based learning management solutions (such as Cornerstone) is preferred.

• Analytical Mindset: Excellent problem-solving abilities with a proven track record of managing multiple competing priorities balancing speed and quality.

• Communication Skills : Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with fluency in English (additional languages such as German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, or Mandarin are a plus).

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

jobs.title: Asset Excellence Manager (befristet, 18 Monate)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In der Manufacturing Unit Solids kümmern wir uns am Produktionsstandort in Kaiseraugst um die Herstellung und Verpackung verschiedener fester Arzneiformen. Hierzu zählen Filmtabletten, Kapseln und Granulate zur Herstellung von Oralsuspensionen.
Für unsere Asset Excellence Unit suchen wir einen Asset Excellence Manager für den Bereich Drug Product Herstellung:
Als Asset Excellence Manager in der Manufacturing Unit Solids stellst du zusammen mit deinen Kolleg*innen sicher, dass die Umsetzung der relevanten GMP Anforderungen gewährleistet ist. Du bist Ansprechpartner bezüglich Initiierung, Koordination und Implementierung aller notwendigen Maßnahmen zur Erreichung und Erhaltung der GMP-Compliance.
Hierzu hat der Asset Excellence Manager eine fachliche Beratungsfunktion in GMP-Belangen gegenüber dem gesamten Personal der Manufacturing Unit

Die Möglichkeit

• ​Abweichungs- & Änderungsmanagement: Bearbeitung von Events, Abweichungen, Reklamationen und CAPAs (Korrektur- und Vorbeugemaßnahmen) als Verantwortlicher oder Fachexperte. Dazu gehören Ursachenanalysen (Root Cause Analyse, RCA), Trendanalysen und das Management von Änderungen (Changes)

• Batch Record Review: Durchführung der Kontrolle auf Vollständigkeit und Richtigkeit der Eintragungen in der Chargendokumentation und Freigabe von Betriebsseite

• Quality Risk Management (QRM): Verantwortung für den QRM-Prozess, Planung, Erstellung und Moderation von Risikoanalysen sowie Unterstützung als Fachexperte.

• Training & Schulungen: Organisation und Durchführung von Schulungen.

• Erstellung und Pflege GxP-konformer Dokumente, sowie Erstellung und Aktualisierung von Arbeitsvorschriften (SOPs) zur Sicherung von GMP-gerechten Betriebs- und Produktionsabläufen

• Inspektionsmanagement: Vertretung des Bereichs als Fachexperte bei internen und externen Inspektionen/Audits, deren Vorbereitung, Koordination und Begleitung sowie die Nachverfolgung von Maßnahmen.

• Projektmanagement: Leitung, Koordination, Unterstützung und Mitarbeit bei lokalen und globalen Projekten

• Prozessaktivitäten & Produktionsabläufe: Optimierung von Anlagen und Prozessen; Mitarbeit bei Launches und Transferprojekten; Unterstützung von kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen

• Bereitschaft zu Pikettarbeit

Wer bist Du:

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes pharmazeutischen, naturwissenschaftliches oder technisches Studium oder eine Berufsausbildung in Kombination mit langjähriger Berufserfahrung.

• Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion, Entwicklung, Qualitätssicherung und -kontrolle oder einer nahen Industrie sind von Vorteil.

• Routinierter Umgang mit IT-Systemen (zb. Google-Anwendungen)

• Erste Kenntnisse im GMP regulierten Umfeld wünschenswert

• Projektmanagement Kenntnisse, sowie Kenntnisse und überzeugter Einsatz bezüglich Prozessverbesserungen (z.B. Lean Production System) sowie Agile Management sind von Vorteil

• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift in Deutsch und Englisch

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explor

jobs.title: R&D Process Support Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Process Specialist within the R&D DCE Subchapter, you will play a key role in designing and optimizing various processes that support our development activities and product innovation. You will be responsible for driving, optimizing, and harmonizing development activities through future-oriented and efficient process management.
You will also support or independently author regulatory documents provided to various authorities (including TÜV and the FDA).

The Opportunity:

• Design, continuous development, and execution of core R&D processes (e.g., in line with Design & Development) during product development and product care activities, such as Requirements Management, Risk Management, and Configuration Management.

• Design, continuous development, and execution of core R&D processes (e.g., in line with Quality & Verification) during product development and product care activities, such as Verification and Validation Management.

• Guidance, execution, and documentation of process activities during product development as well as on-market support for established products.

• Providing excellent process support to our internal and external partners.

• Stakeholder management , coordinating alignments, and applying best practices and a unified approach across units and projects.

• Ensuring full compliance and complete documentation according to internal guidelines.

• Database mapping of respective processes and their contents (e.g., risk records).

• Proactive and independent execution of duties.

• Ensuring defined project targets are met within established budgets, timelines, and quality requirements.

• Execution of various work packages within your area of responsibility, including effective time management.

• Creation of high-quality documentation .

• Leading national sub-projects and contributing to ongoing process improvements.

• Fostering future-oriented Ways of Working .

• Acting as a role model and living our Roche Commitments regarding culture, behavior, and mindset.

• Coaching colleagues to help expand and strengthen our team capabilities.

Who You Are:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Natural Sciences or Engineering, OR an equivalent combination of degree and experience

• You bring at least 3 years of experience in a diagnostics development environment.

• You have deep conceptual and practical experience in designing or executing development processes (e.g., Risk, Requirements, Configuration, or Verification Management).

• You have knowledge of software development, software validation, and associated processes.

• You have experience working with databases and an eye for detail.

• You have a solid understanding of the principles and methods of project and quality management is essential.

• You have strong communication skills, including fluency in English, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to non-technical stakeholders

• You have the ability to influence, drive decisions and change, resolve conflicts to reach project goals, and take ownership of outcomes.

• ​You have s trong customer orientation, an open-minded team spirit, and the agility to navigate ambiguity and frequent change effectively.

• You are a natural leader with strong interpersonal skills, high emotional intelligence, and strategic thinking.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the location of Pleasanton, California is $89,400 to $166,000. Actual pay

jobs.title: Digital Workplace Senior Technical Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Digital Workplace Senior Technical Engineer in the Digital Workplace Core Engineering Team, part of the Digital Workplace organization in Roche Digital Technology IT global organization, you will join a team of experts in technology working to provide tools and technologies that are connecting more than 150.000 users, enabling them to work and collaborate efficiently.
In collaboration with local and global Business Partners and Stakeholders, you will be providing technical consultancy to clients and affiliates across all divisions and locations at Roche, providing solutions to our Digital Workplace with state of the art technology in a modern and collaborative environment.
We believe in fostering a workplace that promotes growth, collaboration, and innovation. As a leader in the industry, we are committed to creating a digital environment that empowers our employees and enhances productivity. Join us and be a part of a team that values creativity, excellence, and a forward-thinking mindset.
The ideal candidate possesses a strong technical background, a passion for enhancing the employee digital experience, and a certification as a M365 Administrator. This role will be pivotal in designing, implementing, and managing digital solutions that support our dynamic workforce.

Job Responsibilities:

• Lead the design, implementation, and support of our Digital Workplace solutions using M365 and other modern digital technologies

• Act as a subject matter expert for digital workplace technologies, providing guidance, technical consultancy and support to users and stakeholders

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions

• Ensure seamless integration of digital tools and platforms to enhance productivity and collaboration in partnership with other IT areas

• Manage and optimize M365 environments, ensuring security, scalability, and reliability

• Proactively identify and address potential issues, implementing preventative measures to maintain system integrity.

• Leverage Artificial Intelligence to enhance digital workplace solutions and improve user experience

• Utilize AI technologies to analyze data and provide actionable insights for optimizing workplace performance

• Explore and integrate AI capabilities in collaboration tools to enhance communication and productivity

• 3rd level Business Critical incidents and requests. Escalation management

• Document solutions and processes: Create clear and concise documentation to guide future use and maintenance

• Mentor and provide guidance to junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement

Qualifications:

Education / Experience

• Certified M365 with hands-on experience managing M365 environments

• More than 8 years of experience in system administration on email and cloud services

• Fluent English spoken

Technical / Business Skills

• Understanding of the standard email protocols, authentication methods and networking basics (SMTP, IMAP, SPF, DKIM, DMARC,TCP/IP, DNS, etc)

• Strong hands-on technical skills, and working experience with infrastructure technologies and business applications

• Strong understanding of modern workplace technologies

Additional Qualifications

• Experience in Email Transport through Secure Email Gateways ( Fortimail, ProofPoint, Fast path or any other MTA)

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Responsibilities:

• Provides administrative support to the Managing Director

• Requires thorough knowledge of company operations, policies and procedures. Handles details of a highly confidential and critical nature.

• Collects and prepares information for use in discussions/meetings of executive staff and outside individuals. Minutes meetings, circulates notes and owns site documents repository

• Prepare presentation materials for leadership meetings. Ensures all meetings are scheduled. Thorough understanding of MS office and Google docs, slides and sheets

• Makes high-level contacts of a sensitive nature inside and outside the company. Owns calendar, travel bookings, events, visitor appointments and synchronizes schedules of the legal entity head for seamless and productive activities

• Works autonomously within established procedures and practices.

• Manages within the the admin budget

• Anticipates patterns and links; looks beyond the immediate problem to the wider implications.

• Requires a professional certification or equivalent experience in working with senior-level executives within and outside the company, customers, vendors, visitors and other dignitaries.

• In depth knowledge of company operations and excellent communications skills are required.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Confident, amiable person who maintains relationships with internal and external stakeholders

• Performs varied and complex administrative support functions, relieving the manager of administrative details and requiring knowledge of department policies, practices, and procedures. Completes assignments that may require attendance at and documentation of meetings. Prepares memos, reports, spreadsheets, and presentations. Coordinates domestic and international conference calls. Reviews and prioritizes incoming mail, and replies directly to general routine inquiries. Sets up and maintains files, documents, and logs. Screens incoming calls and takes messages. Assists in coordinating the preparation of department budget, and monitors expenses. Gather information from various sources, and compile data to prepare reports.

• Schedule meetings and appointments.

• Coordinates national and international travel arrangements; compiles expense reports for submission for the Head and the team.

• Purchases office supplies. Enters data into SAP / MyBuy and uses the system to track purchase orders and/ or budget.

• Serves as an information resource on department, division, and organization policies and procedures. Keeps abreast of changes, and assists the manager in implementing new/revised procedures.

• May provide occasional leadership or guidance to other administrative support positions and onboarding of new admins and provide mentorship to them.

• Continuous training and development on PC applications, SAP-Tools and internal technologies

• Driving the regular LT agenda and meeting coordination, key action items and decisions for recurrent bi-weekly LT Calls and F2F Meetings

• Providing complex coordination meetings and events including external engagements, check status if needed and coordinate with India affiliates

Additional tasks:

• Responsible for handling and documentation training process in SAP/R3

• Cornerstone Learning Expert / Cornerstone Super Admin for site level reports

For all employees:

• Optimizes processes in order to increase quality and efficiency standards.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more
