A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Principali compiti:

• Fornisce supporto amministrativo a capo dell'ente legale 6221

• Richiede una conoscenza approfondita delle operazioni, politiche e procedure aziendali. Cura i dettagli di una natura altamente riservata e critica.

• Raccoglie e prepara le informazioni per l'uso in discussioni / incontri di personale esecutivo e persone esterne. Riunioni verbali, circola note e possiede il repository dei documenti del sito

• Preparare materiali di presentazione per riunioni di leadership. Assicura che tutti gli incontri siano programmati. comprensione approfondita dell'ufficio di MS e di Google documenti, diapositive e fogli

• Rende contatti di alto livello di natura sensibile all'interno e all'esterno dell'azienda. Calendario, prenotazioni di viaggio, eventi, appuntamenti dei visitatori e sincronizza gli orari della testa dell'entità legale per attività senza soluzione di continuità e produttive

• Funziona autonomamente all'interno di procedure e pratiche stabilite.

• Gestione all'interno del bilancio amministratore

• Anticipa modelli e link; guarda oltre il problema immediato alle implicazioni più ampie.

• Richiede una certificazione professionale o un'esperienza equivalente nel lavorare con dirigenti di alto livello all'interno e all'esterno della società, clienti, fornitori, visitatori e altri dignitari.

• Sono richieste conoscenze approfondite delle operazioni aziendali e ottime capacità di comunicazione.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta. Confidente, persona amabile che mantiene relazioni con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni

• Esegui funzioni di supporto amministrativo varie e complesse, affidando il gestore di dettagli amministrativi e richiedendo la conoscenza di politiche, pratiche e procedure di reparto. Completa gli incarichi che possono richiedere la partecipazione e la documentazione delle riunioni. Prepara memos, report, fogli di calcolo e presentazioni. Coordina le conferenze nazionali e internazionali. Recensioni e priorità posta in arrivo, e risponde direttamente alle richieste di routine generali. Imposta e mantiene file, documenti e registri. Schermi in arrivo chiamate e prende messaggi. Assiste nel coordinamento della preparazione del bilancio del dipartimento e controlla le spese. Raccogli informazioni da varie fonti e compila i dati per preparare i report.

• Organizza riunioni e appuntamenti.

• Coordina le modalità di viaggio nazionali e internazionali; compila i rapporti di spesa per la presentazione per il Capo e la squadra.

• Acquisti forniture di ufficio. Immette i dati in SAP / MyBuy e utilizza il sistema per monitorare gli ordini di acquisto e/o budget.

• Serve come risorsa informativa sulle politiche e le procedure di reparto, divisione e organizzazione. Mantiene il rispetto dei cambiamenti, e assiste il gestore nell'attuazione di nuove / revisionate procedure.

• Può fornire occasionali leadership o guida ad altre posizioni di supporto amministrativo e di bordo di nuovi amministratori e fornire loro mentorship.

• Formazione e sviluppo continuo su applicazioni PC, SAP-Tools e tecnologie interne

• Guidare l'agenda regolare LT e coordinare le riunioni, le questioni chiave di azione e le decisioni per le chiamate LT bi-settimanali ricorrenti e le riunioni F2F

• Fornire complessi incontri di coordinamento ed eventi tra cui impegni esterni, verificare lo stato se necessario e coordinare con le affiliate dell'India

Ulteriori compiti:

• Responsabile del processo di gestione e documentazione in SAP/R3

• Cornerstone Learning Expert / Cornerstone Super Admin per i rapporti di livello del sito

Per tutti i dipendenti:

• Ottimizza i processi al fine di aumentare gli standard di qualità ed efficienza.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più t

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Hauptaufgaben:

• Bietet administrative Unterstützung für Leiter der juristischen Person 6221

• Erfordert gründliche Kenntnisse der Geschäftstätigkeit, Richtlinien und Verfahren des Unternehmens. Behandelt Details von höchst vertraulicher und kritischer Natur.

• Sammelt und bereitet Informationen für die Verwendung in Diskussionen / Sitzungen von Führungskräften und externen Personen. Protokollsitzungen, verteilt Notizen und besitzt das Repository für Website-Dokumente

• Bereiten Sie Präsentationsmaterialien für Führungstreffen vor. Stellt sicher, dass alle Meetings geplant sind. Gründliches Verständnis von MS Office und Google Docs, Dias und Blättern

• Führt hochrangige Kontakte sensibler Natur innerhalb und außerhalb des Unternehmens. Eigener Kalender, Reisebuchungen, Veranstaltungen, Besuchertermine und synchronisiert Zeitpläne der juristischen Person für nahtlose und produktive Aktivitäten

• Funktioniert autonom innerhalb etablierter Verfahren und Praktiken.

• Verwaltet innerhalb des Admin-Budgets

• Antizipiert muster und verbindungen; schaut über das unmittelbare problem hinaus auf die breiteren implikationen.

• Erfordert eine professionelle Zertifizierung oder gleichwertige Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Führungskräften innerhalb und außerhalb des Unternehmens, Kunden, Lieferanten, Besuchern und anderen Würdenträgern.

• Tiefe Kenntnisse des Unternehmensbetriebs und ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sind erforderlich.

• Hervorragende verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Selbstbewusste, liebenswürdige Person, die Beziehungen zu internen und externen Stakeholdern unterhält

• Führt vielfältige und komplexe administrative Unterstützungsfunktionen durch, entlastet den Manager von administrativen Details und erfordert Kenntnisse der Abteilungsrichtlinien, -praktiken und -verfahren. Erledigt Aufgaben, die möglicherweise die Teilnahme an und Dokumentation von Sitzungen erfordern. Bereitet Memos, Berichte, Tabellenkalkulationen und Präsentationen vor. Koordiniert nationale und internationale Telefonkonferenzen. Überprüfen und priorisieren Sie eingehende E-Mails und antworten Sie direkt auf allgemeine Routineanfragen. Einrichtet und verwaltet Dateien, Dokumente und Protokolle. Bildschirme eingehende Anrufe und nimmt Nachrichten. Hilft bei der Koordination der Vorbereitung des Abteilungsbudgets und überwacht die Ausgaben. Sammeln Sie Informationen aus verschiedenen Quellen und kompilieren Sie Daten, um Berichte vorzubereiten.

• Termine und Termine.

• Koordiniert nationale und internationale Reisearrangements; erstellt Spesenberichte für die Einreichung für den Leiter und das Team.

jobs.title: Sales Specialist - South West
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.

Purpose
Every year across the globe, more than 14 million people develop cancer, a number that is expected to grow to more than 21 million by the year 2030. Strengthening diagnosis improves chances of survival for the millions of people living with cancer, which means precise, personalised diagnostics are critical as we continue the fight against this deadly disease.
As an innovator of tissue-based diagnostic solutions for patients worldwide, we provide the anatomic pathology lab with a powerful combination of instrumentation, medical value assays and digitally integrated workflow.

We work directly with our healthcare partners in hospital and private pathology departments. Our strong product portfolio, excellent team and a deep understanding of our customer’s needs has meant we have been very successful. We have a strong product portfolio and an excellent pipeline of future products and the determination to continue to be successful. Reporting to the Regional Sales Manager, you will be coming into the sales team at an opportune time to play your part in reshaping the healthcare landscape.

The Opportunity
Locations – South West NHS Networks
We have an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated individual to join our Tissue Diagnostics sales team in the South West UK region, covering the Devon, Somerset, Bristol, Dorset, Hampshire, and Wiltshire - NHS Networks (S1, S2, S3 & S6) . You will be promoting the value proposition of our products with key clinical, procurement and finance stakeholders.
As part of your remit, you will mainly focus on:

• Taking a lead in the account sales strategy and execution for the product portfolio on your territory, you will work closely with Customer Account Managers, Product Specialists, Managed Laboratory Service Team and Workflow IT Specialists

• Managing and coordinating the Tissue Diagnostics response within complex pan pathology procurements, utilising self-discipline and a creative approach to ensure sales methodology is delivered on time and in full. This will involve engagement with all levels of the key decision making team, including senior management

• Identifying market development and changes in NHS landscape on your territory (payment, procurement, tendering, and NHS processes) to maximise opportunities/minimise threats

• Developing innovative strategies to retain existing Roche sites and acquire new sites
Qualifications and Experience

• Educated to BSc (Hons) /BA Degree or equivalent in a life science or with related experiences such as a biomedical scientist background

• Experience of field sales and/or knowledge of laboratories and the Roche Tissue Diagnostics product portfolio

• Skilled in defining customer needs and building strong and effective relationships. Ideally, have knowledge of best practices in Cellular pathology (especially IHC) and cancer pathways.

• Resilient, tenacious and both adaptable and flexible to work within a changing environment. You have the blend of discipline to follow best practice and creativity to re-define best practice. You will understand barriers to acceptance of new solutions and be able to drive positive sales outcomes.

• Self-motivated, focused and methodical, with the ability to work alone, y

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo.
Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

Oggetto
Ogni anno in tutto il mondo, oltre 14 milioni di persone sviluppano il cancro, un numero che dovrebbe crescere a più di 21 milioni entro l'anno 2030. Rafforzare la diagnosi migliora le probabilità di sopravvivenza per milioni di persone che vivono con il cancro, il che significa che la diagnosi precisa e personalizzata è fondamentale mentre continuiamo la lotta contro questa malattia mortale.
Come innovatore di soluzioni diagnostiche basate sui tessuti per i pazienti in tutto il mondo, forniamo il laboratorio di patologia anatomica con una potente combinazione di strumentazione, saggi di valore medico e flusso di lavoro integrato digitalmente.

Lavoriamo direttamente con i nostri partner sanitari nei dipartimenti di patologia ospedaliera e privata. Il nostro forte portafoglio di prodotti, team eccellente e una profonda comprensione delle esigenze del nostro cliente ha fatto sì che abbiamo avuto molto successo. Abbiamo un portafoglio di prodotti forte e un'ottima pipeline di prodotti futuri e la determinazione a continuare ad avere successo. Segnalando al Responsabile Vendite Regionale, entrerete nel team di vendita in un momento opportuno per giocare la vostra parte nel rimodellare il paesaggio sanitario.

L'opportunità
Località - South West NHS Networks
Abbiamo un'emozionante opportunità per un individuo altamente motivato per unire il nostro team di vendita di Tissue Diagnostics nella regione del sud-ovest del Regno Unito, coprendo il Devon, Somerset, Bristol, Dorset, Hampshire e Wiltshire - NHS Networks (S1, S2, S3 & S6) . Promuoverete la proposizione del valore dei nostri prodotti con i principali stakeholder clinici, di approvvigionamento e di finanza.
Come parte del vostro remit, vi concentrerete principalmente su:

• Prendendo un vantaggio nella strategia di vendita dell'account e l'esecuzione per il portafoglio di prodotti sul tuo territorio, lavorerai a stretto contatto con Customer Account Managers, Product Specialists, Managed Laboratory Service Team e Workflow IT Specialists

• Gestire e coordinare la risposta di Tissue Diagnostics all'interno di complessi appalti di patologia pan, utilizzando l'autodisciplina e un approccio creativo per garantire la metodologia di vendita viene consegnato in tempo e in pieno. Questo coinvolgerà l'impegno con tutti i livelli del team di decisione chiave, tra cui la gestione senior

• Identificare lo sviluppo del mercato e i cambiamenti nel paesaggio NHS sul tuo territorio (pagamento, approvvigionamento, tendering e processi NHS) per massimizzare le opportunità / minare le minacce

• Sviluppare strategie innovative per mantenere i siti Roche esistenti e acquisire nuovi siti
Qualifiche ed Esperienza

• Educato a BSc (Hons) /BA Degree o equivalente in una scienza della vita o con esperienze correlate come un background di scienziato biomedico

• Esperienza delle vendite sul campo e/o conoscenza dei laboratori e del portafoglio prodotti Roche Tissue Diagnostics

• Abilitato nella definizione delle esigenze del cliente e nella costruzione di relazioni forti ed efficaci. Idealmente, avere conoscenza delle migliori pratiche in patologia cellulare (soprattutto IHC) e percorsi tumorali.

• Resiliente, tenace e adattabile e flessibile per lavorare in un ambiente in evoluzione. Hai la miscela di disciplina per seguire la migliore pratica e creatività per ridefinire la migliore pratica. Capirete le barriere all'accettazione di nuove soluzioni e sarete in grado di guidare i risultati di vendita positivi.

• Automotivato, concentrato e metodico, con la capacità di lavorare da solo, y

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben.
Das macht uns zu Roche.

Zweck
Jedes Jahr erkranken weltweit mehr als 14 Millionen Menschen an Krebs, eine Zahl, die bis zum Jahr 2030 auf über 21 Millionen anwachsen soll. Die Stärkung der Diagnose verbessert die Überlebenschancen für Millionen von Menschen, die mit Krebs leben, was bedeutet, dass eine präzise, personalisierte Diagnose entscheidend ist, wenn wir den Kampf gegen diese tödliche Krankheit fortsetzen.
Als Innovator von gewebebasierten Diagnoselösungen für Patienten weltweit bieten wir dem anatomischen Pathologielabor eine leistungsstarke Kombination aus Instrumentierung, medizinischen Wertanalysen und digital integriertem Workflow.

Wir arbeiten direkt mit unseren Gesundheitspartnern in Krankenhaus- und privaten Pathologieabteilungen zusammen. Unser starkes Produktportfolio, unser exzellentes Team und ein tiefes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden haben uns sehr erfolgreich gemacht. Wir haben ein starkes Produktportfolio und eine ausgezeichnete Pipeline zukünftiger Produkte und die Entschlossenheit, weiterhin erfolgreich zu sein. Wenn Sie dem Regional Sales Manager berichten, werden Sie zum richtigen Zeitpunkt in das Verkaufsteam kommen, um Ihren Beitrag zur Neugestaltung der Gesundheitslandschaft zu leisten.

Die Chance
Standorte - South West NHS Networks
Wir haben eine aufregende Gelegenheit für eine hoch motivierte Person, unserem Tissue Diagnostics-Vertriebsteam in der Region South West UK beizutreten, das Devon, Somerset, Bristol, Dorset, Hampshire und Wiltshire abdeckt - NHS Networks (S1, S2, S3 & S6). Sie fördern das Wertversprechen unserer Produkte mit wichtigen klinischen, Beschaffungs- und Finanzakteuren.
Im Rahmen Ihres Auftrags konzentrieren Sie sich hauptsächlich auf:

• Durch die Führung in der Verkaufsstrategie und -ausführung für das Produktportfolio in Ihrem Gebiet arbeiten Sie eng mit Kundenbetreuern, Produktspezialisten, Managed Laboratory Service Team und Workflow IT-Spezialisten zusammen

• Verwaltung und Koordination der Reaktion auf die Gewebediagnose innerhalb komplexer pan-Pathologie-Beschaffungen, unter Verwendung von Selbstdisziplin und einem kreativen Ansatz, um sicherzustellen, dass die Verkaufsmethodik pünktlich und vollständig geliefert wird. Dies beinhaltet die Einbeziehung aller Ebenen des wichtigsten Entscheidungsteams, einschließlich der Geschäftsleitung.

• Identifizierung der Marktentwicklung und Veränderungen in der NHS-Landschaft in Ihrem Gebiet (Zahlung, Beschaffung, Ausschreibung und NHS-Prozesse), um Chancen zu maximieren / Bedrohungen zu minimieren

• Entwicklung innovativer Strategien, um bestehende Roche-Standorte zu erhalten und neue Standorte zu erwerben
Qualifikationen und Erfahrung

• Erzogen nach BSc (Hons) / BA Degree oder gleichwertig in einer Biowissenschaft oder mit verwandten Erfahrungen wie einem biomedizinischen Wissenschaftler Hintergrund

• Erfahrung im Außendienst und/oder Wissen über Laboratorien und das Roche Tissue Diagnostic Produktportfolio

• Geschickt darin, Kundenbedürfnisse zu definieren und starke und effektive Beziehungen aufzubauen. Idealerweise haben Kenntnisse der besten Praktiken in der zellulären Pathologie (insbesondere IHC) und Krebswege.

• Widerstandsfähig, hartnäckig und sowohl anpassungsfähig als auch flexibel, um in einer sich verändernden Umgebung zu arbeiten. Sie haben die Mischung aus Disziplin, um Best Practice und Kreativität zu folgen, um Best Practice neu zu definieren. Sie werden Hindernisse für die Akzeptanz neuer Lösungen verstehen und in der Lage sein, positive Verkaufsergebnisse zu erzielen.

• Selbstmotiviert, fokussiert und methodisch, mit der Fähigkeit, alleine zu arbeiten, y

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

We are seeking a visionary Data/Information Architect within the RDT Data Platforms function to lead the strategic design and implementation of our AI-driven Master Data Management (MDM) solutions. In this role, you will be the core architect enabling artificial intelligence across our MDM ecosystem, transforming legacy relational master records into intelligent, context-aware, and AI-ready data assets.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Data/Information Architect - Datenplattformen

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation ihren Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu unterstützen und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der Digital eine Kernstärke von Roche ist, intelligentere Arbeitsweisen ermöglicht, menschliches Potenzial erschließt und Durchbrüche ermöglicht, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt von Bedeutung sind.

Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Im Moment verlangen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen.

Wir suchen einen visionären Data/Information Architect innerhalb der RDT Data Platforms-Funktion, um die strategische Gestaltung und Implementierung unserer KI-gesteuerten Master Data Management (MDM)-Lösungen zu leiten. In dieser Rolle werden Sie der Kernarchitekt sein, der künstliche Intelligenz in unserem MDM-Ökosystem ermöglicht und relationale Stammdatensätze in intelligente, kontextbewusste und KI-fähige Datenbestände umwandelt.

Die erste wichtige Priorität dieser architektonischen Roadmap wird sich auf die Modernisierung der Masterdatenprogramme Healthcare Professional (HCP) und Healthcare Organisation (HCO) konzentrieren, mit einer breiteren Skalierungsstrategie für alternative Stammdatendomänen in zukünftigen Wellen. Ein entscheidender Schwerpunkt Ihres Architekturdesigns wird darin bestehen, die Lücke zwischen traditionellen MDM-Plattformen und fortschrittlichen semantischen Unternehmensschichten zu schließen und Master-Datensätze nahtlos in einheitliche Wissensgraphen umzuwandeln, die innovative Generative AI-Anwendungen unterstützen.

Der Bereich Datenmanagement und Datenqualitätsplattformen dient als grundlegende Intelligenzmaschine unseres globalen digitalen Unternehmens. Unsere Mission ist es, ein harmonisiertes, FAIR-konformes Master-Daten-Framework zu skalieren, das sich stark in eine automatisierte, KI-fähige Semantic Layer integriert. Indem wir kontextbezogene Bedeutungen, Ontologiestandards und Beziehungsgraphen in Rohstammdaten einfügen, bieten wir dem Unternehmen eine einzige, vertrauensvolle und auffindbare Ansicht unseres Netzwerks. Die Gelegenheit:

• AI-fähige MDM-Architektur: Architekt, Entwurf und Leitung der technischen Ausführung der Modernisierung von Enterprise Master Data Management-Systemen durch die Integration von AI / ML-Fähigkeiten für Datenabgleich, Entitätsauflösung und Datenanreicherung.

• HCP & HCO Program Leadership: Handeln Sie als primärer technischer Architekt für die grundlegenden Initiativen Healthcare Professional (HCP), Healthcare Organisation (HCO) und Business Partner / Vendor Master Data, um eine hochpräzise Modellierung und Skalierbarkeit für nachfolgende Domänen zu gewährleisten.

• Semantische Layer-Integration: Definieren Sie die Blaupausen und Abbildungsregeln, die erforderlich sind, um transaktionale Stammdaten mit einheitlichen semantischen Schichten, Ontologien und Unternehmenswissensgraphen zu verbinden.

• AI-Ready Data Engineering: Stellen Sie sicher, dass Stammdatenmodelle vollständig maschinenlesbar und explizit strukturiert sind
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Architecte de données/d'information - Plateformes de données

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde.

Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration.

Nous recherchons un architecte visionnaire de données et d'information dans le cadre de la fonction des plates-formes de données de RDT pour diriger la conception stratégique et la mise en œuvre de nos solutions de gestion de données Master (MDM) pilotées par l'IA. Dans ce rôle, vous serez l'architecte de base permettant l'intelligence artificielle dans notre écosystème MDM, transformant les documents-maîtres relationnels existants en actifs de données intelligents, conscients du contexte et prêts à l'intelligence artificielle.

La première priorité clé de cette feuille de route architecturale sera la modernisation des programmes de données maîtres des professionnels de la santé (HCP) et de l'Organisation des soins de santé (HCO), avec une stratégie d'échelle plus large dans les domaines de données maîtres alternatifs dans les prochaines vagues. Un des objectifs de votre conception architecturale sera de combler l'écart entre les plates-formes MDM traditionnelles et les couches sémantiques d'entreprise avancées, en transformant de façon transparente les ensembles de données maîtres en graphiques de connaissances unifiés qui alimentent les applications d'IA génériques de pointe.

La zone Data Management and Data Quality Platforms est le moteur de l'intelligence fondamentale de notre entreprise numérique mondiale. Notre mission est de mettre à l'échelle un cadre de données principal harmonisé et conforme à FAIR qui s'intègre fortement à un calque sémantique automatisé et compatible avec l'IA. En injectant la signification contextuelle, les normes d'ontologie et les graphiques de relation dans les données de référence brutes, nous fournissons à l'entreprise une vue unique, forte de confiance et découvrable de notre réseau. Rejoindre ce domaine signifie jouer un rôle de premier plan en veillant à ce que les modèles de données spécifiques aux soins de santé restent précis, hautement sécurisés, conformes aux normes réglementaires mondiales et totalement optimisés pour le déploiement de machines d'apprentissage de pointe.

L'occasion :

• Architecture MDM compatible avec l'IA: Architecte, conception et direction de l'exécution technique de la modernisation des systèmes de gestion de données Master d'entreprise en intégrant les capacités AI/ML pour l'appariement des données, la résolution des entités et l'enrichissement des données.

• Leadership du programme HCP & HCO : agir en tant que principal architecte technique pour le professionnel de santé fondamental (HCP), l'organisation de soins de santé (HCO) et les initiatives de gestion des données des partenaires d'affaires/vedor, assurant une modélisation et une évolutivité de haute fidélité pour les domaines suivants.

• Intégration des couches sémantiques : Définir les plans et les règles de cartographie nécessaires pour connecter les données principales transactionnelles aux couches sémantiques unifiées, aux ontologies et aux graphiques de connaissances d'entreprise.

• AI-Ready Data Engineering: S'assurer que les modèles de données maîtres sont entièrement lisibles par machine et explicitement struct

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
À propos du rôle
Chez Roche Digital Technology, nous progressons dans les limites de l'IA appliquée. L'équipe d'ingénierie et d'exploitation des cas d'utilisation de l'IA appliquée est chargée de construire des applications d'IA innovantes, des agents de l'IAG et des fondations d'agents.
Dans le paysage technologique de 2026, les frontières entre disciplines traditionnelles se sont brouillées. Nous opérons dans de petites équipes agiles (p. ex. ~6 membres) alimentées par des agents de codage avancés (comme Claude Code) pour développer et expédier des solutions plus rapidement que jamais. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur / Data Scientist hautement qualifié, pratique, avec un sens profond de la propriété. Plutôt que d'être un spécialiste des données, ingénieur ML ou ingénieur MLOps, vous combinerez ces ensembles de compétences. Vous créerez des systèmes d'IA génératifs et des systèmes ML classiques de bout en bout, en prenant la responsabilité du concept et de l'analyse des données exploratoires jusqu'aux rejets de production et au suivi.

Pioche et portée de la technologie de base
Ce rôle consiste à travailler en profondeur avec les modèles de fondation multimodales, les flux de travail d'agents avancés (y compris les communications Agent-à-Agent/A2A), Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), les autres technologies d'IA émergentes et les sous-systèmes MLOps. Vous utiliserez les services cloud (AWS et multicloud) aux côtés des bases de données vectorielles, graphiques et traditionnelles pour développer des solutions d'IA évolutives et robustes.

Principales responsabilités
Agentic & GenAI Développement d'applications :

• Concevoir et construire des systèmes d'agents d'IA avancés, des machines d'état, des systèmes de conversation basés sur la recherche qui résolvent des problèmes commerciaux complexes.

• Développer des flux de travail en tirant parti de grands modèles multimodaux fondamentaux pour traiter et raisonner selon les modalités textuelles, audio et vidéo.

• Mettre en oeuvre les serveurs/clients du protocole de contexte modèle (MCP) pour normaliser l'échange de contextes entre les agents, les sources de données et les outils externes.

• Collaborer avec AI Architects, Product Owners et d'autres développeurs afin d'intégrer les capacités d'IA dans des applications utilisateur final évolutives, équitables et éthiques axées sur la pertinence et la performance en temps réel.
Ingénierie complète et agent SDLC :

• Bénéficiez quotidiennement d'agents de codage de l'IA (p. ex., Claude Code) pour accélérer les cycles de développement de piles complètes, en maintenant une productivité élevée à travers les tâches de frontend, backend et infrastructure.

• Prenez la responsabilité de bout en bout pour les fonctionnalités : écrivez un code Python (et parfois TypeScript) de haute qualité et prêt à la production avec des tests complets et de la documentation.

• Gérer le cycle de vie de DevOps/MLOps : containerize applications using Docker, configurer les pipelines CI/CD, et les solutions cloud-native à haut débit et fiables d'architecte sur AWS/multicloud.
Science des données, ADE et stratégie :

• Effectuer une analyse approfondie des données exploratoires (EDA) pour comprendre les caractéristiques des ensembles de données, découvrir les modèles, détecter les biais et identifier les problèmes de qualité des données.

• Utilisez des techniques de statistique et de visualisation pour éclairer l'ingénierie des caractéristiques, la sélection des modèles et l'optimisation des applications basées sur les modèles de fondation.

• Concevoir des pipelines de données robustes afin d'organiser, de préprocéder et de structurer divers ensembles de données qui maximisent l'efficacité des LLM et réduisent les biais.
Développement et optimisation de l'algorithme :

• Concevoir, personnaliser, optimiser et affiner les algorithmes d'IA basés sur LLM et traditionnels pour des cas d'utilisation spécifiques (p. ex. génération de texte, synthèse, agents d'IA, modélisation de séquence).

• Diriger des stratégies d'ingénierie rapides avancées, en utilisant zéro-shot, peu-shot et d'autres paradigmes pour optimiser les sorties de modèles sans réglage détaillé.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As Digital Solution Lead - Trial Simulation & Protocol Design (Technology Consultant), you will serve as a strategic thought leader and go-to expert for RDT. You will lead cross-functional teams on high-impact, complex products, anticipating changing business conditions and recommending strategic directions with enterprise-wide implications. By engaging with senior executives and scaling Agile frameworks, you will align priorities across product squads and resolve unprecedented problems. You will shape product roadmaps, influence domain strategy using extensive industry knowledge, and masterfully mentor colleagues to foster a highly collaborative, safe, and innovative team environment.

The Opportunity:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Leads cross-functional teams in a matrix organization, including peers from outside of your own function, to deliver high-impact and/or complex products. Shapes and influences strategy for complex products and cross-functional agile teams.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Decides on important topics with a significant impact on the goals and objectives of the organization. Helps solve unique or unprecedented problems that impact major products. Fosters healthy disagreements and discussions to ensure convergence and agreement, and scales Agile frameworks in order to align priorities across squads or product teams. Collaborated with program leads to elaborate the strategic program roadmaps, develop business case and funding request for board deliberation and decision.

• Stakeholder Management: Engages and leads partnerships with senior stakeholders and executives, managing expectations and sponsorship. Communicates strategic information, issues, and solution options across the enterprise or multiple large business portfolios. Able to captivate audiences and exchange ideas by mastering the messaging used and selecting the most appropriate communication channels.

• Impact/Strategy: Acts as a go-to person for Leadership in RDT, determining the best course of action in new/innovative capabilities. Provides consistent leadership and significant impact on complex and/or high-impact programs. Influences strategy at the domain level by using extensive industry knowledge to shape product roadmaps and workforce strategies toward strategic trends. Masters coaching and mentoring to develop others' expertise and creates a safe environment that empowers participants and enables great teamwork.

• Complexity/ (Product Size): Leads extremely complex projects with enterprise-wide implications. Anticipates changing conditions and business needs, and recommends strategic directions to management to mitigate them.

• AI Innovation / AI-Native Transformation: Identifies and drives creative opportunities to embed AI, intelligent agents, and automation into existing business and engineering workflows. Challenges traditional ways of working and partners with business, product, and engineering teams to reimagine processes, improve decision-making, accelerate delivery, and create more intuitive user experiences.

• Business/Technical ability: Receives positive feedback, maintains a strong reputation, and is recognized by organizational leaders internally and externally due to impact, expertise, and collaboration capability. Possesses a proficient level of business process domain knowledge in multiple domains and stays abreast of technology innovation. Considered a thought leader in an area of Consultancy with deep expertise in multiple Consultancy capa

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Clinical and Real World Evidence Digital Solution Lead (Technology Consultant), you possess a strong understanding of complex business and scientific workflows, data science workflows, AI/ML/GenAI technologies, and modern data platform capabilities including AI-ready data product requirements. You will support the identification, evaluation, development, and scaling of innovative data and AI capabilities across the real-world and clinical data ecosystem.

This role bridges business needs, data science expertise, evidence generation workflows, and platform engineering to ensure that new capabilities progress from idea and proof of concept into scalable, governed, and sustainable digital solutions.

Acting as a trusted technical and data science partner, you will contribute to PoCs, product evaluations, data product roadmaps, productisation of innovative solutions. You will help ensure that emerging capabilities are evaluated for business value, scientific relevance, technical feasibility, scalability, governance, cost-effectiveness, and fit with the broader RW&C data ecosystem.

The Real World & Clinical Data Innovation area focuses on accelerating the use of real-world data and clinical trial data, to support evidence generation, clinical development, study simulation, and AI-enabled decision-making. The area works at the intersection of data science, platform engineering, data products, GenAI, governance, and business strategy. Its mission is to identify and scale capabilities that improve access to high-quality data, enable reusable data products, support advanced analytics, and accelerate the generation of reliable evidence. Key focus areas include clinical insight layer development, reusable data product delivery, evaluation of external RWD analysis platforms, novel data licensing models, GenAI-enabled workflows, study simulation enablement, and AI-ready data foundations.

The Opportunity:

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Frames complex business problems, drives root-cause analysis, manages scope, and ensures engineering deliverables align with organizational objectives, including AI-ready data and ethical AI requirements.

• Stakeholder Management: Engages stakeholders across organizational boundaries, acts as a trusted advisor to leadership, and drives alignment across teams.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers high-value solutions aligned with business strategy, evaluates strategic options and risks, and helps shape long-term roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates at product or product-line level, navigating evolving requirements and translating complex problems into scalable, production-ready solutions.

• Technical ability and hands-on expertise: Applies strong technical, data science, and AI/ML/GenAI expertise to define AI-ready data products, evaluate solutions, and build PoC prototypes, with particular focus on GenAI and agentic AI, including their application in sensitive and regulated data environments.

• Data innovation and capability development: Identifies and shapes data and AI capabilities for RWD, clinical data reuse, study simulation, and evidence generation. Translates scientific and business needs into scalable, reusable, and governed platform capabilities from PoC through productisation.

Who You Are:

• University degree or equivalent experience in Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Life Sciences, or another relevant scientific or technical field.

• Strong hands-on experie

jobs.title: Field Support Representative
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Field Support Representative
Location: Candidates must be based in Ontario – London Area.

This position will support hardware for Core Lab (Chemistry and Immunochemistry)

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all.

We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

As part of a collaborative team, you play a meaningful role in front line support for our customers. By performing installations, maintaining and repairing our customers’ instrumentation on site, the work you perform has a direct impact on patient care and has the ability to change and save lives.

You will be a master problem solver, out-of-the box thinker who acts as a calming source under stressful situations. Your passion for continuous improvement and customer-centric approach will help us to become the partner of choice in our industry. The pairing of your strong technical ability, steadfast problem solving and outstanding relationship building and communication will help provide a stellar customer experience.

The Opportunity

• Provide excellent customer service and support to a designated group of customers, ensuring their needs are met and issues are resolved promptly.

• Collaborate closely with team members, including Roche Care Centre Technical Support Specialists, Lab Integration Specialists, Field Application Specialists, and Account Managers to guarantee customers receive complete and efficient support.

• Participate actively in service, sales, and customer meetings, chipping in your technical expertise and insights to improve customer relationships and drive business growth.

• Provide crucial back-up support to other Support Representatives, ensuring detailed service continuity and maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.

• Enhance equipment uptime and reliability by performing preventative maintenance in accordance with established Roche Diagnostics Canada guidelines and schedules.

• Ensure peak equipment performance and regulatory compliance by adhering to guidelines and timelines when completing technical service bulletins.

• Conduct detailed site inspections and meticulously complete all required documentation, ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards and maintaining accurate service records.

• Offer expert recommendations for preparing suitable environments for Roche instrument installations

• Skillfully install Roche instrumentation and integrated solutions, ensuring that they are correctly configured, calibrated, and tested to meet customer needs and specifications.

Who you are

• You hold a diploma of collegial studies in electronic technology or community college Specialty in Biomedical Engineering and have 5+ years of experience troubleshooting diagnostic instrumentation

• You have a proven ability to interact and build relationships with individuals at all levels, possess excellent written and verbal communication skills and you are highly customer-focused

• You demonstrate knowledge of Windows and common Office programs (word,

jobs.title: IT Project Manager - ERP
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The ERP Delivery Manager & Community Co-lead is a senior, pivotal individual contributor role within the ERP Delivery team. This position is dedicated to serving as the critical bridge from the ERP Delivery organization to the Technical operations team that manage products within Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain.

As we launch our new site, this pivotal role will be the linchpin that connects these two vital organizations. You will foster a culture of cross-functional synergy, ensuring that ERP delivery initiatives seamlessly align with the strategic needs of our manufacturing and supply chain products. In addition to community building and stakeholder alignment, you will wear a Delivery Manager hat, taking ownership of the crucial project initiation phase for new integration and technology initiatives.

Job Responsibilities

• Bridge the Gap: Act as the primary liaison representing the ERP Delivery home organization to the Technical Operations Product Management team at the new site.

• Culture & Communication: Build a collaborative community environment. Break down organizational silos by translating technical ERP complexities into clear business impacts for the Technical Operations teams, and vice versa.

• Conflict Resolution: Proactively identify friction points between delivery constraints and product roadmaps, negotiating mutually beneficial solutions.

• Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate regular syncs, workshops, and forums to ensure continuous alignment between ERP capabilities and manufacturing, quality, and supply chain business needs.

• Drive Product Strategy: Accountable for setting the product direction, ensuring all features and roadmaps align with defined financial objectives and organizational goals.

• Foster Trusted Partnerships: Build deep alliances with Business and IT executives through transparent communication, facilitate regular syncs, workshops, and forums to ensure continuous alignment between ERP capabilities and manufacturing, quality, and supply chain business needs.

• Champion Customer-Centricity: Act as the primary owner of the customer's problem, prioritizing internal user needs to deliver solutions that provide tangible value.

• Innovate with AI: Proactively integrate relevant Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities into the product roadmap to maintain a competitive and future-ready portfolio.

Who are you:

• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 5+ years of experience in product management or business analysis with a proven track record of launching technology products.

• Industry Specialist: You possess 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry.

• Technically Proficient: You have a strong understanding of software architecture (APIs, cloud) and the product development lifecycle, including GxP and GDPR.

• Strategic Communicator: You excel at translating high-level scientific goals into concrete roadmaps and influencing diverse groups toward a common vision.

• Agile Expert: You are skilled in SAFe facilitation and capable of removing systemic impediments to maintain operational excellence and flow.

• Academic Foundation: You are highly educated in a relevant scientific, technical, or business field, supporting your ability to navigate the healthcare landscape.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
¿Te apasiona transformar la vida de los pacientes con enfermedades autoinmunes complejas y liderar el acceso a terapias biológicas de vanguardia en el sector público de salud?

En Roche, nos mueve un futuro más saludable. Desarrollamos soluciones médicas transformadoras para asegurar que las personas tengan más tiempo con quienes aman. Únete a nuestro equipo de Inmunología y sé parte fundamental en la transformación del tratamiento del Lupus en México, conectando la ciencia de Roche con el ecosistema de salud para generar un impacto real y sostenible en la vida de los pacientes.

La Oportunidad

• Liderar la estrategia de adopción e impacto de nuestro portafolio de Inmunología para transformar el abordaje de enfermedades autoinmunes reumatológicas y de riñón en México.

• Generar valor en el ecosistema de salud, acelerando el acceso temprano a terapias biológicas para evitar daño orgánico irreversible en los pacientes.

• Trabajar bajo una cultura de alta autonomía y colaboración cross-funcional ( Act as one team ), con poder de decisión para asignar recursos de forma eficiente.

• Formar parte de un entorno enfocado en la innovación continua, el aprendizaje acelerado ( Accelerate learning ) y el desarrollo profesional dentro de Roche.

• Colaborar directamente con los principales tomadores de decisión y especialistas de la salud para rediseñar la experiencia del paciente.

Responsabilidades

• Posicionar la propuesta de valor científica de nuestro tratamiento de Inmunología ante Reumatólogos, Nefrólogos y autoridades del sector público.

• Gestionar y ejecutar la estrategia comercial y de acceso en el sector institucional, asegurando la disponibilidad del tratamiento.

• Identificar barreras en la ruta del paciente ( patient journey ) y co-crear soluciones efectivas con actores clave del ecosistema de salud.

• Administrar con visión estratégica los recursos asignados al territorio para maximizar el impacto en los pacientes y el negocio.

• Colaborar estrechamente con las áreas de Asuntos Médicos, Acceso y Comercial para garantizar un uso ético, equilibrado y veraz de nuestras soluciones.

Quién Eres

• Profesional con título universitario en Ciencias de la Salud, Químico-Biológicas o áreas Económico-Administrativas.

• Experiencia sólida y comprobable en alta especialidad con dominio indispensable del sector institucional / gobierno .

• Residencia actual e indispensable en CDMX (cobertura CDMX Norte, EdoMex, Puebla, Veracruz) o León, Guanajuato (cobertura Región Bajío).

• Enfoque estratégico en la construcción de relaciones de largo plazo, con una mentalidad orientada al valor y no únicamente a ventas transaccionales.

• Fuerte capacidad de colaboración, toma de decisiones con impacto ( Make impact now ) y adaptabilidad ante entornos complejos.

Deseable

• Experiencia previa en el área terapéutica de Inmunología (Reumatología, Nefrología, Gastroenterología o Dermatología).

• Estudios de posgrado, maestría (MBA) o especialización en el sector salud.

• Dominio del idioma inglés (nivel intermedio a avanzado).

• Habilidad para apalancar herramientas digitales en la gestión diaria.

Los beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta vacante .

The Position
Application Specialist L1

About Roche
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
We are looking for an experienced Senior Application Specialist to provide cross-border technical support to our customer laboratories in the region. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in the Serum Work Area to deliver the highest level of support and foster a collaborative team environment. Join us to mentor peers and guide them through immediate technical escalations.

The Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Senior Application Specialist to provide cross-border technical support to our customer laboratories in the region. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in the Serum Work Area to deliver the highest level of support and foster a collaborative team environment. Join us to mentor peers and guide them through immediate technical escalations.

Responsabilities
1.Handling of customer and staff inquiries/complaints by phone and in written form:

• Provides first-level technical support to customers of the affiliates (Inquiries, Complaints) and resolve concerns raised by customers.

• Provide SLS support to affiliates' FSRs

• Report customer service in the CRM system according to the guidelines

• Escalation of PRI cases and support in cases escalated as PRI and non-PRI to the PMQ

2. Identification and trouble-shooting of failures; extended complaint management

• Use of remote access to systems for troubleshooting, gathering problem investigation data, and supporting inquiries.

• Documents customer information and recurring technical issues to support product quality programs and product development

• Identification of complex, intermittent, or unusual cases in systems for consultation with L2 and troubleshoots problems with malfunctioning electro/mechanical equipment or software applications and recommends corrective action

3. Conducting of customer and staff training:

• Provide staff training and workshops to customers

4. Information and knowledge transfer; support for product updates and launches; quality monitoring:

• Ensure compliance with all mandatory and role related training.

• Active participation in continuous improvement and quality processes

• Participate in special projects to support the objectives of the area

5. Service activities on site, support of Field Service Reps and Sales Reps:

• Participate in supporting SoS activities (PMs, Correctives, installations) in conjunction and in agreement with L2 or TPM

• Building upon the standard L1 front-line duties, the L1 Senior acts as the advanced first-line responder and mentor. The L1 SR is responsible for coaching new team members, guiding peers through immediate escalations, and filtering complex or intermittent daily cases using advanced standard methodologies and AI tools.

Who you are

• Applications Degree in biology or microbiology or health sciences

• Knowledge in laboratory analysis, information Technology & Networking

• Excellent analytical, problem analysis and decision-making skills, as well as effective planning, organizational and time management.

• Customer service orientation, mastering written/verbal communication, organization and prioritization skills.

jobs.title: Commercial Business Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
La persona en esta posición lidera el crecimiento sostenible de Roche Diagnóstica y maximizar el valor que ofrecemos a nuestros clientes estratégicos, tanto actuales como futuros.
Desarrolla y ejecuta estrategias comerciales innovadoras, centradas en la expansión de nuestras cuentas clave y la identificación de nuevas oportunidades de negocio y modelos comerciales disruptivos. El objetivo es consolidar la fidelización de clientes, asegurar el crecimiento del "share of wallet" y expandir la presencia de Roche en el mercado diagnóstico, reforzando nuestra posición de liderazgo. Esto implica un profundo entendimiento del ecosistema diagnóstico, las necesidades no cubiertas de los clientes y el panorama competitivo, para desarrollar propuestas de valor diferenciadoras que generen un impacto significativo en el negocio y la salud.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas asignados en cuentas estratégicas, contribuyendo de manera directa a las metas comerciales de la organización.

• Participar en el estudio y análisis de la estrategia y planes de marketing regional de nuestros portafolios.

• Definir y/o customizar estrategias para la generación de nuevos negocios con nuestros clientes estratégicos; así como para posibles negocios con clientes no Roche en coordinación con los squads de desarrollo de negocio.

• Liderar la ejecución de la estrategia para el desarrollo y la generación de nuevos negocios y modelos de negocio innovadores mediante la elaboración de la propuesta de valor que integre todas nuestras soluciones (consultoría, soluciones digitales, disease management, etc.).

• Ejecutar la estrategia de desarrollo de negocio, generar y conseguir nuevas oportunidades de negocio incremental, crecer el market share, el alcance e impacto de nuestras soluciones/portafolios.

• Colaborar en la implementación de nuevas soluciones de valor y de nuevos modelos de negocio, atendiendo las necesidades del cliente.

• Visita en campo y cobertura nacional para la prospección de nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

• Actuar como conector interno entre equipos y asegurar la colaboración entre diferentes chapters a través del liderazgo de los diferentes SQUADs de la organización (Strategy, Medical, Acceso, Servicio, etc), asegurando que la organización en su conjunto capitalice las oportunidades con los clientes estratégicos.

• Garantizar la diferenciación de Roche en el mercado mediante una propuesta de valor robusta que refuerce nuestro posicionamiento como líder en diagnóstico innovador y socio estratégico confiable y sostenible.

• Monitorear la satisfacción de clientes estratégicos, promoviendo relaciones de largo plazo basadas en confianza y resultados medibles, asegurando que se consideran los insights estratégicos del mercado y de performance de negocio.

Tu perfil:

• Título universitario en ciencias de la salud, ventas, negocios, marketing o similares.

• Experiencia en funciones comerciales similares para la industria de diagnóstico, dispositivos médicos o similares.

• Conocimiento de la dinámica y los participantes del mercado de salud, su sistema y las políticas de salud, también sobre la problemática y soluciones para el laboratorio.

• Amplio conocimiento de la tecnología y marcas de los competidores.

• Conocimiento intermedio del idioma Inglés.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As Key Account Manager (NGS) you will be responsible to drive the commercial expansion of our NGS portfolio within your territory by identifying new business opportunities and maximizing solution adoption in existing accounts . You will position Roche as the partner of choice in clinical and research genomics through a blend of technical expertise, strategic account management, and consultative selling. By orchestrating seamless cross-functional collaboration across Marketing, Sales, and Service, you will deliver an exceptional customer experience while achieving ambitious commercial targets and strengthening Roche’s footprint in the evolving NGS landscape.

About the opportunity:

• Achieve quarterly and annual sales targets for the NGS portfolio—including instruments, consumables, and services—by executing strategic account plans and maintaining a disciplined opportunity pipeline in Salesforce.

• Maximize market share by identifying and converting new business opportunities across clinical, research, and government institutions, while collaborating with Key Account Managers on territory business plans.

• Lead the full purchase cycle—from concept to closing—utilizing consultative selling, effective negotiation, and strategic contract proposals to optimize overall business profitability.

• Establish scientific credibility by delivering high-level technical presentations, demos, and workflow recommendations (library prep, automation, bioinformatics) tailored to specific customer operational needs.

• Partner with Field Applications Scientists (FAS) to drive technical evaluations, proof-of-concept projects, and seamless customer onboarding, ensuring successful implementation of solutions.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales Leadership, and Technical Support/Service teams to execute commercial campaigns, product launches, and workshops while ensuring superior customer satisfaction.

• Provide accurate revenue and demand forecasts, aligning local stock requirements with planners and analyzing territory performance data to proactively identify gaps and implement corrective actions.

• Manage external relationships and distributors effectively, ensuring frequent communication, alignment on pricing and commercial strategies, and timely resolution of operational issues.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences (Biology, Biotechnology, Genetics, or related field).

• 5+ years of successful sales experience in genomics, molecular biology, or life science instrumentation, with a proven track record of achieving sales quotas and selling sequencing technologies or molecular diagnostic platforms.

• Strong technical understanding of NGS workflows and applications, including library preparation and instrumentation.

• In-depth experience within Oncology, Rare Disease, Microbiology, and/or Agrogenomics markets, with established relationships in hospital labs, reference labs, academic institutions, and biotech companies.

• Advanced negotiation and presentation skills, with a proven ability to manage the full sales cycle, influence decision-makers, and communicate complex scientific value propositions.

jobs.title: Technical CIAM Business Analyst - RDT Identity & Access Management (Warsaw or Madrid)

titleByLocale.it: Technical CIAM Business Analista - RDT Identity & Access Management (Warsaw or Madrid)
titleByLocale.en: Technical CIAM Business Analyst - RDT Identity & Access Management (Warsaw or Madrid)
titleByLocale.de: Technical CIAM Business Analyst - RDT Identity & Access Management (Warsaw or Madrid)
titleByLocale.fr: Technical CIAM Business Analyste - RDT Identity & Access Management (Warsaw or Madrid)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Technical Business Analyst with experience in Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) to support the delivery and continuous improvement of customer identity services.
The successful candidate will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into clear requirements and ensuring scalable, secure, and user-centric CIAM solutions. This role combines business analysis, technical understanding, stakeholder engagement, and delivery support in a complex enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities
Business Analysis and Requirements Management

• Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to customer identity, registration, authentication, consent, profile management, and access journeys.

• Translate business needs into functional and technical requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.

• Challenge and refine requirements to ensure clarity, feasibility, and business value.

• Support prioritization of demand, backlog items, and roadmap initiatives.

Solution Design and Delivery Support

• Work closely with architects, engineers, and product teams to shape fit-for-purpose CIAM solutions.

• Support design discussions by bringing process, customer journey, and business context.

• Ensure requirements are traceable through delivery, testing, and implementation.

• Participate in release planning, change activities, and deployment readiness.

Stakeholder Management and Collaboration

• Engage with business, security, legal, compliance, digital, and IT stakeholders across multiple functions.

• Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, and decision meetings.

• Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and options clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

Governance, Risk, and Compliance

• Support alignment with privacy and regulatory requirements such as GDPR and related frameworks.

• Ensure customer identity processes reflect governance, auditability, and security expectations.

• Contribute to control documentation and evidence gathering where required.

Continuous Improvement

• Identify pain points, inefficiencies, and opportunities to simplify CIAM processes and customer journeys.

• Support KPI tracking, service improvement initiatives, and process optimization.

• Stay informed on CIAM trends, identity standards, and digital customer expectations.

Qualifications
Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.

Experience

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role.

• Experience in Identity & Access Management, Customer Identity, digital platforms, or customer-facing systems.

• Experience working in enterprise delivery environments with multiple stakeholders.

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of CIAM concepts such as registration, authentication, SSO, MFA, consent, profile lifecycle, and access control.

• Familiarity with identity standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML.

• Ability to interpret APIs, system integrations, data flows, and technical dependencies.

• Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Visio, Miro, or equivalent collaboration platforms.

• Familiarity with SAP Customer Data Cloud (SAP CDC) or similar CIAM platforms is an advantage.

Soft Skills

•

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Technical Business Analyst with experience in Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) to support the delivery and continuous improvement of customer identity services.
The successful candidate will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into clear requirements and ensuring scalable, secure, and user-centric CIAM solutions. This role combines business analysis, technical understanding, stakeholder engagement, and delivery support in a complex enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities
Business Analysis and Requirements Management

• Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to customer identity, registration, authentication, consent, profile management, and access journeys.

• Translate business needs into functional and technical requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.

• Challenge and refine requirements to ensure clarity, feasibility, and business value.

• Support prioritization of demand, backlog items, and roadmap initiatives.

Solution Design and Delivery Support

• Work closely with architects, engineers, and product teams to shape fit-for-purpose CIAM solutions.

• Support design discussions by bringing process, customer journey, and business context.

• Ensure requirements are traceable through delivery, testing, and implementation.

• Participate in release planning, change activities, and deployment readiness.

Stakeholder Management and Collaboration

• Engage with business, security, legal, compliance, digital, and IT stakeholders across multiple functions.

• Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, and decision meetings.

• Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and options clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

Governance, Risk, and Compliance

• Support alignment with privacy and regulatory requirements such as GDPR and related frameworks.

• Ensure customer identity processes reflect governance, auditability, and security expectations.

• Contribute to control documentation and evidence gathering where required.

Continuous Improvement

• Identify pain points, inefficiencies, and opportunities to simplify CIAM processes and customer journeys.

• Support KPI tracking, service improvement initiatives, and process optimization.

• Stay informed on CIAM trends, identity standards, and digital customer expectations.

Qualifications
Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.

Experience

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role.

• Experience in Identity & Access Management, Customer Identity, digital platforms, or customer-facing systems.

• Experience working in enterprise delivery environments with multiple stakeholders.

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of CIAM concepts such as registration, authentication, SSO, MFA, consent, profile lifecycle, and access control.

• Familiarity with identity standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML.

• Ability to interpret APIs, system integrations, data flows, and technical dependencies.

• Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Visio, Miro, or equivalent collaboration platforms.

• Familiarity with SAP Customer Data Cloud (SAP CDC) or similar CIAM platforms is an advantage.

Soft Skills

•

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre Roche:

Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Oportunidad:

Estamos en la búsqueda de talento joven, estudiantes apasionados por la logística, los procesos operativos y la excelencia en el servicio al cliente, para sumarse a nuestro equipo como Pasante/Practicante de Order Management. En esta posición, tendrás la oportunidad de aprender y optimizar el ciclo completo de procesamiento de pedidos, asegurando un flujo eficiente, ágil y preciso que contribuya directamente a que nuestros productos lleguen a tiempo a quienes más los necesitan.

Responsabilidades:

• Apoyar en el ingreso, seguimiento y validación de órdenes de compra en el sistema (ERP/SAP).

• Coordinar con las áreas de Logística, Almacén y Comercial para asegurar el cumplimiento de las fechas de entrega.

• Dar seguimiento al estatus de facturación y resolución de incidencias en los pedidos.

• Analizar y actualizar indicadores clave del proceso de gestión de pedidos (KPIs).

• Proponer, desarrollar y monitorear proyectos enfocados en la simplificación, automatización y optimización de las tareas operativas del área.

Quien eres:

• Estudiante activo en Ingeniería Industrial, Logística o carreras afines (no puedes ser egresado; debes graduarte en 2028 para poder completar 2 años de pasantía).

• Profesional en formación con alta orientación al detalle, capacidad analítica y excelentes habilidades de comunicación.

• Usuario con manejo intermedio de Excel (tablas dinámicas, fórmulas) y apertura para aprender sistemas de gestión de pedidos (ERP / SAP).

• Persona con nociones básicas para interpretar datos de la operación (cumplimiento de tiempos de entrega, volumen de pedidos e incidencias).

• Apasionado por la optimización de procesos, el seguimiento logístico y la satisfacción del cliente interno y externo.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio (capaz de comprender correos/manuales corporativos y mantener una comunicación básica/intermedia escrita y oral).

• Perfil proactivo, comprometido, organizado, orientado a la solución de problemas, con alta capacidad para gestionar tiempos en entornos dinámicos y enfocado a la atención tanto al cliente interno como externo.

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
