jobs.title: Global Study Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Global Study Lead is responsible for ensuring that all studies are designed, planned, executed, monitored, closed out and documented in an appropriate manner within the planned timeframe and cost; ensuring that the sponsor responsibilities are fulfilled, while assuring compliance to all applicable regulatory requirements. Responsible for the timeline and budget planning and execution of studies. Assigns and ensures delivery of specific tasks to/from other members of the study team. Provides oversight to outside support including CROs, consultants and/or medical advisors

The Opportunity:
The key accountabilities for this position include, but are not limited to:

• Leads the global study team with full accountability for the study deliverables with respect to quality, budget and timelines, in collaboration with the Study Team and ensures the development of high quality study designs for sponsored studies in collaboration with internal and external experts

• In collaboration with Program Leadership, prepares different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g. study, real-world evidence) in cross-functional collaboration (e.g. with Regulatory Affairs, R&D, CDMA Project Teams) to support global strategies and planning of timeline and costs

• Develops key study documents (i.e., Design Validation Plan, protocol, study training materials, study forms and templates, study report)

• Oversees planning and operational aspects of companion diagnostics studies sponsored by Pharma partners

• Accountable for study-level budget of assigned studies.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity
The Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Applications Specialist you will:

• Acting as the primary liaison/customer representative throughout the implementation process and future histology application support, Includes planning and coordination for the implementation and customer training, as well as problem-solving issues that arise for customers throughout the life cycle of the solution.

• Provide highly visible, self-supervised and self-directed, extensive on-site advisory customer support through the implementation of Roche Tissue instrumentation and tailored customer training on our Roche solutions to meet customer needs based on an individualized assessment of the customer’s personnel, organizational structure, workflow, and maximization of equipment capabilities, which may include: equipment, applications, systems, and IT solutions.

• Act as an advisor on customer issues and drive efficiencies & optimization for the customer and Roche through independent analysis and problem-solving. Additionally, will be responsible for increased sales revenue by identifying opportunities for new system consumables for clients (i.e. reagents, primary antibodies, bio-markers, software). Performs these job duties remotely and independently.

• Advanced and specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system, or equipment with regard to technologically advanced instruments and scientific applications. Requires specific training and certification.

• Utilizes independent judgment and discretion in the analysis of customer particularized needs and issues that arise both during and after the implementation process. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment, and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Independently analyzes and resolves most customer questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

• Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of this highly responsible position.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.
The ideal candidate for this role will reside in New Hampshire.
This is a field-based role on a national team - the primary territory is New England and out of state travel is expected for this position.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Information Technology, Computer Science, Chemistry, Biology or Clinical Laboratory or equivalent work experience.

• 3 + years of experience implementing and evaluating complex laboratory, IT products, medical diagnostic equipment, reagents and/or

jobs.title: (Sr) Regional Technical Solution Specialist - IT
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary职位概述:
作为罗氏诊断 Customer Care 团队在区域内的IT 技术专家，本岗位致力于为罗氏总部的数字化解决方案以及本地的数字化产品系列的实施、运维、优化等服务。通过与一线服务团队(RCS)、总部二线技术专家(TSE&TSA)及客户的紧密协作，确保数字化系统在客户端的高效、稳定运行，提升客户满意度，赋能罗氏数字化转型战略。

Main Tasks & Responsibilities主要工作职责 :

• 负责区域内罗氏数字化产品的复杂 IT 技术问题的接收、分析、诊断与解决。

• 对一线工程师和应用无法解决的疑难 IT 故障进行远程或现场技术支持，确保符合服务级别协议（SLA）的要求。

• 负责与 CC TSE IT二线团队对接，准确升级并追踪尚未解决的系统 Bug 或复杂技术案例。

• 深度参与区域内数字化项目的关键交付环节，包括复杂的网络架构设计、服务器部署、LIS/HIS 系统集成（HL7/ASTM 协议）及信息安全合规评估。

• 协助客户 IT 部门进行系统联调、压力测试及上线前的技术验证，确保产品顺利转入售后维护阶段。

• 担任罗氏与客户医院/实验室 IT 主任及工程师之间的技术桥梁，建立专业互信，有效管理客户在数字化产品运行中的技术期望。

• 负责区域内数字化产品的软硬件升级、补丁管理及信息安全漏洞修复的规划与实施。

• 总结区域内数字化产品的常见故障与案例，定期编写技术维护文档、知识库条目。

• 负责对区域内的一线服务工程师和应用及第三方合作伙伴进行 IT 技术和数字化产品的赋能培训。

• 经理指派的其他任务。

• 遵守罗氏所有合规要求，包括但不限于罗氏信息安全，罗氏商业中的行为，罗氏竞争法互动对话，罗氏安全健康环境等，合法合理开展业务活动。

Basic Requirements of the Job基本任职资格:

• 计算机科学、软件工程、医学信息学、自动化、电子信息或相关专业，本科及以上学历。

• 英语说写能力俱佳

• 熟练应用微软办公软件

• 拥有5 以上医疗行业 IT 支持（如 LIS, HIS, PACS, EMR）、IVD实验室数字化产品支持，或大型企业级软件技术支持经验。

• 具备实验室信息化系统或类似产品支持经验者优先；熟悉 Navify Lab Operation (nLO) 或相关实验室中间件/数据管理软件者优先。

• 熟练掌握TCP/IP 协议、路由/交换、网络安全（防火墙/VPN/网络隔离），具备 Windows Server/Linux 操作系统管理及虚拟化技术（VMware/Hyper-V/Docker）的实际部署与排错经验。

• 熟练编写 SQL 语句，具备主流数据库（Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL）的维护与诊断能力；深入理解 HL7、ASTM 等医疗行业标准集成协议。

• 具备优秀的跨团队沟通技巧，能将复杂的 IT 技术术语转化为业务或客户可理解的语言，善于处理客户冲突。

• 良好的英语读写能力，能够无障碍阅读全球英文技术文档、撰写技术报告，并和跨部门同事进行邮件或会议沟通。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• 具备优秀的跨团队沟通技巧，能将复杂的 IT 技术术语转化为业务或客户可理解的语言，善于处理客户冲突。

• 良好的英语读写能力，能够无障碍阅读全球英文技术文档、撰写技术报告，并和跨部门同事进行邮件或会议沟通。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary职位概述:
作为罗氏诊断 Customer Care 团队在区域内的IT 技术专家，本岗位致力于为 罗氏总部的数字化解决方案以及本地的数字化产品系列的实施、运维、优化等服务 。通过与一线服务团队(RCS)、总部二线技术专家(TSE&TSA)及客户的紧密协作，确保数字化系统在客户端的高效、稳定运行，提升客户满意度，赋能罗氏数字化转型战略。

Main Tasks & Responsibilities主要工作职责 :

• 负责区域内罗氏数字化产品的复杂 IT 技术问题的接收、分析、诊断与解决。

• 对一线工程师和应用无法解决的疑难 IT 故障进行远程或现场技术支持，确保符合服务级别协议（SLA）的要求。

• 负责与 CC TSE IT二线团队对接，准确升级并追踪尚未解决的系统 Bug 或复杂技术案例。

• 深度参与区域内数字化项目的关键交付环节，包括复杂的网络架构设计、服务器部署、LIS/HIS 系统集成（HL7/ASTM 协议）及信息安全合规评估。

• 协助客户 IT 部门进行系统联调、压力测试及上线前的技术验证，确保产品顺利转入售后维护阶段。

• 担任罗氏与客户医院/实验室 IT 主任及工程师之间的技术桥梁，建立专业互信，有效管理客户在数字化产品运行中的技术期望。

• 负责区域内数字化产品的软硬件升级、补丁管理及信息安全漏洞修复的规划与实施。

• 总结区域内数字化产品的常见故障与案例，定期编写技术维护文档、知识库条目。

• 负责对区域内的一线服务工程师和应用及第三方合作伙伴进行 IT 技术和数字化产品的赋能培训。

• 经理指派的其他任务。

• 遵守罗氏所有合规要求，包括但不限于罗氏信息安全，罗氏商业中的行为，罗氏竞争法互动对话，罗氏安全健康环境等，合法合理开展业务活动。

Basic Requirements of the Job基本任职资格:

• 计算机科学、软件工程、医学信息学、自动化、电子信息或相关专业，本科及以上学历。

• 英语说写能力俱佳

• 熟练应用微软办公软件

• 拥有5 以上医疗行业 IT 支持（如 LIS, HIS, PACS, EMR）、IVD实验室数字化产品支持，或大型企业级软件技术支持经验。

• 具备实验室信息化系统或类似产品支持经验者优先；熟悉 Navify Lab Operation (nLO) 或相关实验室中间件/数据管理软件者优先。

• 熟练掌握TCP/IP 协议、路由/交换、网络安全（防火墙/VPN/网络隔离），具备 Windows Server/Linux 操作系统管理及虚拟化技术（VMware/Hyper-V/Docker）的实际部署与排错经验。

• 熟练编写 SQL 语句，具备主流数据库（Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL）的维护与诊断能力；深入理解 HL7、ASTM 等医疗行业标准集成协议。

• 良好的英语读写能力，能够无障碍阅读全球英文技术文档、撰写技术报告，并和跨部门同事进行邮件或会议沟通。

• 负责与 CC TSE IT二线团队对接，准确升级并追踪尚未解决的系统 Bug 或复杂技术案例。

• 深度参与区域内数字化项目的关键交付环节，包括复杂的网络架构设计、服务器部署、LIS/HIS 系统集成（HL7/ASTM 协议）及信息安全合规评估。

• 协助客户 IT 部门进行系统联调、压力测试及上线前的技术验证，确保产品顺利转入售后维护阶段。

• 担任罗氏与客户医院/实验室 IT 主任及工程师之间的技术桥梁，建立专业互信，有效管理客户在数字化产品运行中的技术期望。

• 负责区域内数字化产品的软硬件升级、补丁管理及信息安全漏洞修复的规划与实施。

• 总结区域内数字化产品的常见故障与案例，定期编写技术维护文档、知识库条目。

• 负责对区域内的一线服务工程师和应用及第三方合作伙伴进行 IT 技术和数字化产品的赋能培训。

• 经理指派的其他任务。

• 遵守罗氏所有合规要求，包括但不限于罗氏信息安全，罗氏商业中的行为，罗氏竞争法互动对话，罗氏安全健康环境等，合法合理开展业务活动。

Basic Requirements of the Job基本任职资格:

• 计算机科学、软件工程、医学信息学、自动化、电子信息或相关专业，本科及以上学历。

• 英语说写能力俱佳

• 熟练应用微软办公软件

• 拥有5 以上医疗行业 IT 支持（如 LIS, HIS, PACS, EMR）、IVD实验室数字化产品支持，或大型企业级软件技术支持经验。

• 具备实验室信息化系统或类似产品支持经验者优先；熟悉 Navify Lab Operation (nLO) 或相关实验室中间件/数据管理软件者优先。

• 熟练掌握TCP/IP 协议、路由/交换、网络安全（防火墙/VPN/网络隔离），具备 Windows Server/Linux 操作系统管理及虚拟化技术（VMware/Hyper-V/Docker）的实际部署与排错经验。

• 熟练编写 SQL 语句，具备主流数据库（Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL）的维护与诊断能力；深入理解 HL7、ASTM 等医疗行业标准集成协议。

• 具备优秀的跨团队沟通技巧，能将复杂的 IT 技术术语转化为业务或客户可理解的语言，善于处理客户冲突。

• 良好的英语读写能力，能够无障碍阅读全球英文技术文档、撰写技术报告，并和跨部门同事进行邮件或会议沟通。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Project/Delivery Manager - Pharma R&D
Introduction
The Delivery Management Professional leads moderately complex deliveries, proactively identifies improvements, manages diverse stakeholders, and contributes to strategic implementation. In this role, you will independently define and control the scope of medium to large initiatives, utilizing effective facilitation and analytical skills to drive value delivery. While navigating intricate stakeholder environments, you will connect team development with broader business objectives. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Project Manager, Service (Delivery) Manager, ITSM Process SME, Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach.
The Opportunity
In this role, you will have the chance to lead impactful initiatives within our Pharma R&D informatics landscape. You will be responsible for:

• Leading Delivery Excellence: Independently define, manage, and control the scope of medium to large initiatives or significant workstreams with moderate complexity.

• Strategic Alignment: Facilitate the scope definition process to ensure every project aligns perfectly with Roche’s strategic objectives and stakeholder expectations.

• Proactive Risk Management: Identify, analyze, and mitigate scope-related risks while championing the adoption of best-in-class management practices.

• Complex Problem Solving: Drive root cause analysis for delivery challenges and elicit complex stakeholder needs to ensure robust solution design

• Stakeholder Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor by developing comprehensive communication plans and navigating intricate environments to ensure alignment.

• Driving Value: Ensure consistent value delivery across specific products or clusters, actively shaping team processes to achieve domain goals.

• Methodology Mastery: Select and tailor delivery methodologies—from Agile to Waterfall—to optimize results and manage dependencies effectively.

• Business Transformation: Utilize your business acumen to translate complex needs into effective delivery strategies and advanced planning.

• AI Awareness & Practical Application: A solid baseline understanding of how Generative AI and modern digital tools apply to daily delivery operations, with a mindset for exploring AI-driven efficiencies in task management, documentation, and communication (hands-on AI software engineering or implementation experience is NOT required).

Who you are
You are a proactive leader who thrives in ambiguous environments and is passionate about connecting team development with business impact. You bring:

• Proven Experience: A solid track record operating as a Project Manager, Scrum Master, or RTE managing medium to large-scale initiatives.

• Educational Background: A University degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field is required.

• Expert Delivery: Demonstrated experience managing the delivery of complex features, such as service transitions or ART increments, across functional areas.

• Strategic Planning: Proven ability to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans and contribute to business forecasting.

• Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills used to drive root cause analysis and propose comprehensive, data-driven improvement plans.

• Collaboration & Communication: Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the ability to facilitate workshops and resolve conflicts professionally.

• Mentorship & Coa

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Project/Delivery Manager - Pharma R&D
Introduction
The Delivery Management Professional leads moderately complex deliveries, proactively identifies improvements, manages diverse stakeholders, and contributes to strategic implementation. In this role, you will independently define and control the scope of medium to large initiatives, utilizing effective facilitation and analytical skills to drive value delivery. While navigating intricate stakeholder environments, you will connect team development with broader business objectives. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Project Manager, Service (Delivery) Manager, ITSM Process SME, Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach.
The Opportunity
In this role, you will have the chance to lead impactful initiatives within our Pharma R&D informatics landscape. You will be responsible for:

• Leading Delivery Excellence: Independently define, manage, and control the scope of medium to large initiatives or significant workstreams with moderate complexity.

• Strategic Alignment: Facilitate the scope definition process to ensure every project aligns perfectly with Roche’s strategic objectives and stakeholder expectations.

• Proactive Risk Management: Identify, analyze, and mitigate scope-related risks while championing the adoption of best-in-class management practices.

• Complex Problem Solving: Drive root cause analysis for delivery challenges and elicit complex stakeholder needs to ensure robust solution design

• Stakeholder Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor by developing comprehensive communication plans and navigating intricate environments to ensure alignment.

• Driving Value: Ensure consistent value delivery across specific products or clusters, actively shaping team processes to achieve domain goals.

• Methodology Mastery: Select and tailor delivery methodologies—from Agile to Waterfall—to optimize results and manage dependencies effectively.

• Business Transformation: Utilize your business acumen to translate complex needs into effective delivery strategies and advanced planning.

• AI Awareness & Practical Application: A solid baseline understanding of how Generative AI and modern digital tools apply to daily delivery operations, with a mindset for exploring AI-driven efficiencies in task management, documentation, and communication (hands-on AI software engineering or implementation experience is NOT required).

Who you are
You are a proactive leader who thrives in ambiguous environments and is passionate about connecting team development with business impact. You bring:

• Proven Experience: A solid track record operating as a Project Manager, Scrum Master, or RTE managing medium to large-scale initiatives.

• Educational Background: A University degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field is required.

• Expert Delivery: Demonstrated experience managing the delivery of complex features, such as service transitions or ART increments, across functional areas.

• Strategic Planning: Proven ability to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans and contribute to business forecasting.

• Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills used to drive root cause analysis and propose comprehensive, data-driven improvement plans.

• Collaboration & Communication: Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the ability to facilitate workshops and resolve conflicts professionally.

jobs.title: Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Summary: As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful delivery of digital campaign content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a crucial role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaign content creation, coordination, and completion. The Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist may collaborate closely with affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party vendors, and campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines.

The Opportunity:

• Manage the affiliate or global digital campaigns' content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.

• Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns' content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Instructs stakeholders on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area

• Supports Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators in client communications in the area of service offering, change management or communication

• Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility

Who you are:
You are a person with high interest and ability in project coordination with a keen understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your excellent organizational and communication skills enable you to manage multiple projects efficiently, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery. You excel at collaborating with diverse stakeholders and adapting to their feedback to meet their needs and expectations.

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, with at least 1+ years of proven project management experience, preferably in digital marketing or content creation.

• Strong understanding of digital marketing principles and campaign management and openness to learn and use project management tools and software.

• Excellent organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities, with a demonstrated track record of prioritizing and managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.

• Experience coordinating and collaborating with cross-functional teams, including designers, copywriters, marketers, and clients/stakeholders.

Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country.
#LI-DC1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a health

jobs.title: Sr Service Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
负责指定区域内技术服务

主要工作职责 :
• 1. 日常仪器及配套解决方案的维护和维修工作
• 2. 根据技术手册的要求，独立完成安装，保养和常见故障排除的工作
• 3. 不断提高责任客户满意度和忠诚度
• 4. 收集并反馈客户需求及最新市场动态信息，协助相关团队持续优化升级解决方案
• 5. 充分理解公司的相关服务工作流程，并能严格遵照执行
• 6. 熟练地运用工具，例如Rexis和Grips等，不断学习和提高维修技能
• 7. 根据公司服务流程要求，及时和准确地更新维修数据
• 8. 协同应用技术，客户服务及其他人员解决问题，加快维修进度
• 9.通过现场调查，工程变化和整体产品知识制作服务手册和报告
• 10. 作为公司和客户沟通的桥梁，确保为客户提供有效的服务，处理客户投诉
• 11. 对员工，客户及经销商进行安全操作仪器的培训和技巧的展示
• 12. 协助技术服务部的年度预算
• 13. 协助经销商的管理。零配件的管理
• 14. 确保维修服务活动符合SHE的要求
• 15.主管指派的其他任务
• 16. 遵循罗氏所有合规要求，包括但不限于罗氏信息安全，罗氏商业中的行为，罗氏竞争法互动对话，罗氏安全
• 健康环境等，合法合理开展业务活动

基本任职资格:

电子，计算机、机械专业大专及以上学历
• 英语说写能力俱佳
• 熟练应用微软办公软件
• 3-5年相关工作经验
• 服务专业知识
• 计划和组织
• 以客户为中心及客户关系管理
• 内部合作协调
• 产品和运用的专业知识

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: (Sr) Regional Technical Solution Specialist - IT
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary职位概述:
作为罗氏诊断 Customer Care 团队在区域内的IT 技术专家，本岗位致力于为罗氏总部的数字化解决方案以及本地的数字化产品系列的实施、运维、优化等服务。通过与一线服务团队(RCS)、总部二线技术专家(TSE&TSA)及客户的紧密协作，确保数字化系统在客户端的高效、稳定运行，提升客户满意度，赋能罗氏数字化转型战略。

Main Tasks & Responsibilities主要工作职责 :

• 负责区域内罗氏数字化产品的复杂 IT 技术问题的接收、分析、诊断与解决。

• 对一线工程师和应用无法解决的疑难 IT 故障进行远程或现场技术支持，确保符合服务级别协议（SLA）的要求。

• 负责与 CC TSE IT二线团队对接，准确升级并追踪尚未解决的系统 Bug 或复杂技术案例。

• 深度参与区域内数字化项目的关键交付环节，包括复杂的网络架构设计、服务器部署、LIS/HIS 系统集成（HL7/ASTM 协议）及信息安全合规评估。

• 协助客户 IT 部门进行系统联调、压力测试及上线前的技术验证，确保产品顺利转入售后维护阶段。

• 担任罗氏与客户医院/实验室 IT 主任及工程师之间的技术桥梁，建立专业互信，有效管理客户在数字化产品运行中的技术期望。

• 负责区域内数字化产品的软硬件升级、补丁管理及信息安全漏洞修复的规划与实施。

• 总结区域内数字化产品的常见故障与案例，定期编写技术维护文档、知识库条目。

• 负责对区域内的一线服务工程师和应用及第三方合作伙伴进行 IT 技术和数字化产品的赋能培训。

• 经理指派的其他任务。

• 遵守罗氏所有合规要求，包括但不限于罗氏信息安全，罗氏商业中的行为，罗氏竞争法互动对话，罗氏安全健康环境等，合法合理开展业务活动。

Basic Requirements of the Job基本任职资格:

• 计算机科学、软件工程、医学信息学、自动化、电子信息或相关专业，本科及以上学历。

• 英语说写能力俱佳

• 熟练应用微软办公软件

• 拥有5 以上医疗行业 IT 支持（如 LIS, HIS, PACS, EMR）、IVD实验室数字化产品支持，或大型企业级软件技术支持经验。

• 具备实验室信息化系统或类似产品支持经验者优先；熟悉 Navify Lab Operation (nLO) 或相关实验室中间件/数据管理软件者优先。

• 熟练掌握TCP/IP 协议、路由/交换、网络安全（防火墙/VPN/网络隔离），具备 Windows Server/Linux 操作系统管理及虚拟化技术（VMware/Hyper-V/Docker）的实际部署与排错经验。

• 熟练编写 SQL 语句，具备主流数据库（Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL）的维护与诊断能力；深入理解 HL7、ASTM 等医疗行业标准集成协议。

• 具备优秀的跨团队沟通技巧，能将复杂的 IT 技术术语转化为业务或客户可理解的语言，善于处理客户冲突。

• 良好的英语读写能力，能够无障碍阅读全球英文技术文档、撰写技术报告，并和跨部门同事进行邮件或会议沟通。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities主要职责/责任
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility realization, including but not limited to FAT, SAT, IOPQ etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Participate in the implementation of warehouse operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, etc. according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified in the daily operation in the warehouse.
Routine Operation:
Technical & Operational
● Material Handling: Receive raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods. Verify
quantity and inspect for damage or discrepancies against purchase orders and shipping
documents. Also including dangerous and chemical goods
● Storage and Inventory: Safely store materials in designated warehouse locations. Perform accurate and timely stocktaking, including cycle counts and physical inventories, to ensure stock accuracy.
● Documentation: Maintain precise and complete records for all warehouse activities, including receiving records, material transfer forms, and inventory records. Ensure all documentation is accurate and legible.
● Picking and Packing: Accurately pick materials for production orders or shipments. Stage materials in designated areas, ensuring they are ready for use or transport. Prepare finished goods for shipment, including packing, labeling, and documentation.
● System Operations: Operate the Warehouse Management System (WMS) or other inventory management software to record all material movements and transactions.
● Equipment Operation: Safely operate warehouse equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment. Perform pre-operational checks and report any maintenance issues.
● Other tasks assigned by AM.
Compliance & Safety
● Adhere to all GMP and SOPs to ensure the quality and integrity of all materials and products.
● Follow all SHE rules and regulations, including wearing appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and maintaining a clean and orderly work area.
● Report any deviations, quality issues, or safety hazards immediately to the supervisor/manager.
● Participate in team meetings, safety training, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/
• Qualifications
● A college degree or above in logistics management, warehouse management, or related fields (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred)
● Qualification of dangerous and chemical goods handling
Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力
● 3 years of experience in a warehouse or logistics environment.
● Experience operating a forklift and other material handling equipment.
● Familiarity with WMS (e.g. SAP, MES) and Microsoft Excel (data entry and basic reports)
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry
● Good communication with team members and cross function colleagues.

Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Senior Network Engineer is a highly skilled expert responsible for solving complex business problems using advanced technologies within their specialized infrastructure area. In this role, you will technically lead challenging projects, make critical technical decisions, and architect resilient solutions across multiple domains. This position requires excellent problem-solving capabilities, strategic stakeholder management, and the ability to influence technical strategy, vendor relationships, and inter-organizational initiatives.

Job Responsibilities:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Highly skilled in a specific infrastructure solution area, adept at solving a variety of complex business problems through the practical and ingenious application of technologies. Contributes to and technically leads challenging projects requiring deep technical knowledge. Architect (acting as a solution architect), design, build, test, and implement integrated, resilient, and reliable first-time deployments in multiple solution areas. Accountable for decision-making in technical design, build, and testing.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Exercises sound judgment, balanced with effective consultative engagement of key stakeholders, to resolve complex problems. Works on complex issues where analysis requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors, including inter-organizational impact. Leads the end-to-end design of infrastructure solutions and maintains component standards. Evaluates promising solutions via Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and feasibility studies across multiple areas, and provides internal escalation support for major incidents.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates and presents complex information and potential solutions to cross-functional teams and the business in non-technical terms. Represents the organization as a prime contact on initiatives and interacts with senior internal and external personnel. Uses depth of knowledge to influence IT Infrastructure vendor product evaluations and collaborates with multiple IT partners (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Solution Owners) to integrate feedback.

• Impact/Strategy: Leads small-to-medium sized technical teams to achieve objectives in medium-sized initiatives (projects, lifecycle work, PoCs). Ensures solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and that designs adhere to the organization’s Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) policies and directions. Assists in planning technology projects, estimating engineering resources, dependencies, risks, and timelines for successful delivery.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Manages complex issues and variable factors spanning across different organizational boundaries. Coordinates multiple moving parts, dependencies, and inter-organizational impacts to deliver reliable infrastructure on medium-to-large initiatives.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies extensive technical expertise, providing depth and breadth across many areas while acting as a recognized expert in one specific area. Maintains in-depth knowledge in at least two technology areas (e.g., Platform, Compute and Storage, Network Management, ERP Technology Management, High Performance Computing, Datacenter Management, or Database Management). Demonstrates a detailed understanding of how IT infrastructure impacts respective Roche business processes.

Qualifications:

Education / Experience

• Proven experience designing and operating modern data center network architectures, including spine-leaf

The Position
Was Dich erwartet:

Als Team Business Finance sind wir flexibel und halten das Business handlungs- und sprachfähig - global wie lokal - intern wie extern. Der Fokus unserer Arbeit liegt darauf, als Sparringspartner Squads, Teams und Abteilungen der Roche Pharma AG in allen finanziellen und unternehmerischen Entscheidungen unter Einbeziehung vorhandener Informationen als auch zukünftiger, antizipierter Entwicklungen zu beraten und Impulse zu setzen. • Unterstützung von Monatsabschluss Aktivitäten

jobs.title: Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role: Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist
Location: Hyderabad
Job Type: Full Time
Years of Experience: 4–6 years
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.

Mission

Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The PD Regulatory Innovation and Sustainment Chapter is accountable for creating and maintaining a framework for building, maturing, and sustaining PDR business capabilities. This includes fostering innovation, ensuring operational readiness, and implementing continuous improvement across our regulatory processes, systems, and tools. Chapter members lead by designing and deploying innovative, compliant solutions that optimize regulatory workflows while maintaining the highest standards of integrity and data quality. We operate with enterprise thinking in a highly transformative regulated environment—assessing end-to-end processes, anticipating regulatory landscape changes, and unlocking company-wide benefits through strategic partnerships across PD, affiliates, Pharma, and the Roche group. Success in this chapter requires strategic thinking, systems thinking, data and content management expertise, an enterprise mindset, and the ability to drive continuous improvement and change leadership in a matrix environment.

Your Opportunity
As a Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist within PD Regulatory Innovation and Sustainment Chapter at RSS Hyderabad, you will drive the hands-on digital execution of regulatory operations. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy AI-driven tools, document intelligence engines, and automated workflows that accelerate regulatory document processing, submission dossier management, and compliance tracking across global health authorities
Key Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with regulatory stakeholders to evaluate incoming AI/automation requests, assess technical feasibility, and help prioritize high-value use cases for regulatory document workflows.

• Build and deploy scalable AI, machine learning, and automation solutions—integrating RPA, Low-Code/No-Code platforms, Python, NLP, and cloud-native services like AWS—specifically tailored to optimize global regulatory workflows and document management.

• Perform operational process mining and opportunity mapping by partnering directly with SMEs from PDR Innovation & Sustainment chapter and global regulatory SMEs to identify high-impact AI and automation opportunities.

• Support IT team by providing business directions for ongoing technical & preventive maintenance, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting for all deployed automation scripts, machine learning models, and AI assets operating in production.

• Maintain comprehensive technical artifacts (including solution archit

jobs.title: Production Process Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 生产运行与倒班管理 / Production Operation & Shift Management
• 负责高活口服固体制剂车间 (SHiP II) 的日常生产协调与组织。合理调配人力与设备资源以高效执行生产计划，确保所有现场操作严格遵守 cGMP 和标准操作规程（ SOP ）。全面参与并管理班次生产线，执行现场操作巡检、车间查核、考勤管理及生产辅助用品的管控。制定并落实员工守则，维护安全、有序的现场生产环境。
Coordinate and organize daily production activities in the highly potent Oral Solid Dosage (OSD) workshop (SHiP II). Appropriately allocate labor and equipment resources to efficiently execute the production plan, ensuring all on-site operations strictly comply with cGMP and SOPs. Fully participate in and manage the shift production line, executing on-site operations inspection, shop floor audits, attendance management, and auxiliary supplies control. Formulate and implement staff rules to maintain a safe and orderly on-site production environment.

2. 生产问题的解决 / Troubleshooting of Production Issues
深刻理解制药技术及端到端（ E2E ）系统影响，与各支持部门密切合作，为设备及产品生产过程中出现的突发异常提供快速排故与解决方案。具备前瞻性，及时发现潜在问题并采取预防措施；在解决生产问题的同时，能够准确评估所采取行动对其他人员或系统的影响，并为管理层决策提供专业的信息支持。
Understand pharmaceutical technology and end-to-end (E2E) process impacts deeply, working closely with support groups to rapidly troubleshoot and provide solutions for unexpected equipment and production process issues. Anticipate potential problems and take preventative actions. While resolving production issues, accurately assess how own actions impact others or other systems, using this information to provide professional support for management decision-making.

3. 质量控制与合规 / Quality Control & Compliance
严格贯彻罗氏集团质量标准，确保生产全环节符合国家 cGMP 法规及公司政策要求。主导并参与车间生产变更与偏差的管理，制定切实有效的 CAPA （纠正与预防措施）并及时追踪闭环。负责主导或参与内部及外部官方质量审计的准备工作，并在现场提供专业的应对与支持。
Strictly implement Roche quality standards and ensure all production stages comply with national cGMP regulations and corporate policies. Lead and participate in workshop change and deviation management, formulate effective CAPAs (Corrective and Preventive Actions), and track their timely closure. Take charge of or participate in preparations for internal and external regulatory quality audits, providing professional on-site response and support.

4. 文件、数据与信息化管理 / Documentation, Data & IT System Management
负责车间内 SOP 等各项生产操作规程及工艺文件的起草、修订、定期回顾与全生命周期的更换管理。熟练操作 SAP 、 MES 、 Veeva 及 Cornerstone 等信息化系统。填写、复核生产批记录及运行日志，审核文件及相关数据计算，确保所有纸质及电子数据严格符合数据完整性（ DI ）要求。
Responsible for drafting, revising, periodically reviewing, and managing the full lifecycle replacement of SOPs and technical documents within the workshop. Proficiently operate SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone, and other IT systems. Complete and review production batch records and logbooks, check documentation and related calculations, ensuring all paper and electronic data strictly meet Data Integrity (DI) requirements.

5. 工艺管理 / Process Technology Management
参与新产品试制与新工艺的导入转化。与 MSAT （制造科学与技术）团队紧密合作，以高度的独立性与专业胜任力，执行相关工艺验证、清洁验证以及设备的确认的生产支持性工作，确保持续的工艺稳健性和符合性。
Participate in new product trials and technology transfers. Work closely with MSAT (Manufacturing Science and Technology) and validation teams with high independency and competence to support and execute process validation, cleaning validation, and equipment qualification. Ensure continuous process robustness and manufacturing process compliance.

6. 设备运行与维护 / Equipment Operation & Maintenance
负责口服固体制剂及包装生产线设备的日常操作、深层清洁、预防性维护支持与模具更换。整合及准备生产设备以确保其随时可用于生产。配合工程团队完成机器设备的安装、调试与成套，使设备始终处于高效的运行与管理状态之中。
Manag

• 负责高活口服固体制剂车间 (SHiP II) 的日常生产协调与组织。合理调配人力与设备资源以高效执行生产计划，确保所有现场操作严格遵守 cGMP 和标准操作规程（ SOP ）。全面参与并管理班次生产线，执行现场操作巡检、车间查核、考勤管理及生产辅助用品的管控。制定并落实员工守则，维护安全、有序的现场生产环境。
Coordinate and organize daily production activities in the highly potent Oral Solid Dosage (OSD) workshop (SHiP II). Appropriately allocate labor and equipment resources to efficiently execute the production plan, ensuring all on-site operations strictly comply with cGMP and SOPs. Fully participate in and manage the shift production line, executing on-site operations inspection, shop floor audits, attendance management, and auxiliary supplies control. Formulate and implement staff rules to maintain a safe and orderly on-site production environment.

2. 生产问题的解决 / Troubleshooting of Production Issues
深刻理解制药技术及端到端（ E2E ）系统影响，与各支持部门密切合作，为设备及产品生产过程中出现的突发异常提供快速排故与解决方案。具备前瞻性，及时发现潜在问题并采取预防措施；在解决生产问题的同时，能够准确评估所采取行动对其他人员或系统的影响，并为管理层决策提供专业的信息支持。
Understand pharmaceutical technology and end-to-end (E2E) process impacts deeply, working closely with support groups to rapidly troubleshoot and provide solutions for unexpected equipment and production process issues. Anticipate potential problems and take preventative actions. While resolving production issues, accurately assess how own actions impact others or other systems, using this information to provide professional support for management decision-making.

3. 质量控制与合规 / Quality Control & Compliance
严格贯彻罗氏集团质量标准，确保生产全环节符合国家 cGMP 法规及公司政策要求。主导并参与车间生产变更与偏差的管理，制定切实有效的 CAPA （纠正与预防措施）并及时追踪闭环。负责主导或参与内部及外部官方质量审计的准备工作，并在现场提供专业的应对与支持。
Strictly implement Roche quality standards and ensure all production stages comply with national cGMP regulations and corporate policies. Lead and participate in workshop change and deviation management, formulate effective CAPAs (Corrective and Preventive Actions), and track their timely closure. Take charge of or participate in preparations for internal and external regulatory quality audits, providing professional on-site response and support.

4. 文件、数据与信息化管理 / Documentation, Data & IT System Management
负责车间内 SOP 等各项生产操作规程及工艺文件的起草、修订、定期回顾与全生命周期的更换管理。熟练操作 SAP 、 MES 、 Veeva 及 Cornerstone 等信息化系统。填写、复核生产批记录及运行日志，审核文件及相关数据计算，确保所有纸质及电子数据严格符合数据完整性（ DI ）要求。
Responsible for drafting, revising, periodically reviewing, and managing the full lifecycle replacement of SOPs and technical documents within the workshop. Proficiently operate SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone, and other IT systems. Complete and review production batch records and logbooks, check documentation and related calculations, ensuring all paper and electronic data strictly meet Data Integrity (DI) requirements.

5. 工艺管理 / Process Technology Management
参与新产品试制与新工艺的导入转化。与 MSAT （制造科学与技术）团队紧密合作，以高度的独立性与专业胜任力，执行相关工艺验证、清洁验证以及设备的确认的生产支持性工作，确保持续的工艺稳健性和符合性。
Participate in new product trials and technology transfers. Work closely with MSAT (Manufacturing Science and Technology) and validation teams with high independency and competence to support and execute process validation, cleaning validation, and equipment qualification. Ensure continuous process robustness and manufacturing process compliance.

6. 设备运行与维护 / Equipment Operation & Maintenance
负责口服固体制剂及包装生产线设备的日常操作、深层清洁、预防性维护支持与模具更换。整合及准备生产设备以确保其随时可用于生产。配合工程团队完成机器设备的安装、调试与成套，使设备始终处于高效的运行与管理状态之中。

jobs.title: Global Head of Legal Operations
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The location for this position can be Basel, Switzerland or South San Francisco, US. Depending on the selected candidate, we are open to considering other Roche locations across Europe and Americas (North & Central) . Please note that fully remote working is not an option for this role.

Are you ready to shape the future of legal operations for a global healthcare leader? As our Global Head of Legal Operations , you will join our Legal & Compliance strategy & operations team to lead, transform, and scale our global operations function supporting over 700 legal professionals worldwide. You will play a pivotal role in architecting a tech-augmented delivery model, advancing our digital capabilities, and driving our long-term strategy to empower our teams and deliver exceptional business value.

The Opportunity

• Define and execute the multi-year global legal operations strategy to drive efficiency, mitigate risk, and support the achievement of our 2030 Data & Digital Ambitions.

• Establish and steer a global service delivery model, strategically integrating internal teams, legal service hubs, alternative legal service providers (ALSPs), and panel firms.

• Architect our global legal systems and data framework, enforcing single sources of truth across systems of record and engagement.

• Oversee a global legal knowledge strategy that transforms advice and playbooks into structured data assets accessible to teams and automated AI solutions.

• Deploy AI-powered, agentic self-service tools within core business systems to embed automated legal guardrails for routine tasks.

• Establish operational KPIs and real-time analytics to monitor emerging risks, streamline contract cycle times, and turn legal data into strategic business intelligence.

• Champion change leadership and a culture of innovation, empowering legal professionals through modern ways of working and collaborative decision-making.

Who You Are

• You bring 10+ years of progressive leadership in legal operations within a large, matrixed multinational organization, with a proven track record of driving operating model transformations.

• You possess expertise in enterprise legal data architecture, generative AI/LLM frameworks, and driving large-scale digital adoption.

• You are an influential, visionary change leader who excels at upskilling multidisciplinary teams and shifting culture toward agility and tech fluency.

• You demonstrate deep executive presence, with the ability to communicate strategic narratives and operational insights effectively to executive committees and C-suite stakeholders.

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, Information Technology, or a related field (advanced degrees or certifications in Legal Operations or Change Management are a plus).

We look forward to your application!

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. The Position
The Opportunity
This P&C Business Partner (Advisory) will be supporting the leaders across the globe, offering on-demand, ad-hoc support on Business Partnering topics that need more immediate or short-term guidance and value creation. With a good understanding of the business needs and the business context and an excellent ability to apply key P&C concepts, policies and processes, this position provides coaching, guidance and support to leaders to help them diagnose and translate their business needs into immediate P&C approaches and ensures effective implementation of solutions in partnership with other chapters. This position partners closely with other P&C colleagues, participates in flexible squads and leverages technology to provide customer insights. This position is a trusted member of the Business Partner Chapter and closely integrated into the PSS organization.

As the P&C Business Partner (Advisory), you are responsible for:

Business Acumen

• Provide immediate short-term strategic guidance to leaders on strategic P&C needs such as succession and talent management, performance management, goal setting, development planning, reward & compensation management and organizational set-up. Leverage the P&C community, specifically P&C Business Partners, Operational Advisors and subject-matter experts of other Chapters, to develop high quality solutions in a timely manner.

• Use knowledge of business and P&C insights, metrics, expertise, and decision principles to effectively deliver support on topics with a wide range of complexity.

• Participate in global / regional squads for deployment of key P&C initiatives or new system launches

• Leverage a strong understanding of global P&C processes to consult, advice and train both business leaders as well as P&C leaders on system and process related topics. • Ensure alignment and execution of established policies, procedures and global P&C initiatives. Ensure compliance of all P&C practices within legislative requirements and established standards and guidelines by building a broad knowledge base on regional approaches and connecting with global P&C colleagues.

Leadership

• Be a trusted partner to leaders in all aspects of P&C generalist areas. Grasp a broad range of generalist P&C topics and be able to thoughtfully diagnose, evaluate and propose fit-for-purpose approaches including weighing risks and benefits of options.

• Be a trusted partner and lead others through complex generalist P&C topics by understanding the philosophies, approaches and systems-relevant configurations of topics such as succession and talent management (people discussions), access to relevant data, performance and compensation (performance management, benefits and other compensation elements), transformations (change management and redundancies), employee wellbeing (may include reintegration processes and time management), career paths, resolution of conflicts, employee representation topics and relocation, depending on the scope of the request.

A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
L'opportunità
Questo P&C Business Partner (Advisory) supporterà i leader di tutto il mondo, offrendo supporto on-demand, ad-hoc su temi di Business Partnering che hanno bisogno di una guida più immediata o a breve termine e creazione di valore. Con una buona comprensione delle esigenze aziendali e del contesto aziendale e un'eccellente capacità di applicare concetti, politiche e processi chiave P&C, questa posizione fornisce coaching, guida e supporto ai leader per aiutarli a diagnosticare e tradurre le loro esigenze aziendali in approcci P&C immediati e garantisce un'efficace attuazione delle soluzioni in collaborazione con altri capitoli. Questa posizione collabora strettamente con altri colleghi P&C, partecipa a squadre flessibili e sfrutta la tecnologia per fornire informazioni ai clienti. Questa posizione è un membro affidabile del Business Partner Chapter e strettamente integrato nell'organizzazione PSS.

In qualità di P&C Business Partner (Advisory), sei responsabile di:

Business Acumen

• Fornire una guida strategica a breve termine immediata ai leader sulle esigenze strategiche di P&C, come la gestione di successione e talento, la gestione delle prestazioni, l'impostazione degli obiettivi, la pianificazione dello sviluppo, la gestione della ricompensa e la gestione della compensazione e l'organizzazione. Leverage la comunità P&C, in particolare P&C Business Partners, Operational Advisors e soggetti-matter esperti di altri capitoli, per sviluppare soluzioni di alta qualità in modo tempestivo.

• Utilizzare la conoscenza di business e P&C approfondimenti, metriche, competenze e principi decisionali per fornire efficacemente supporto su argomenti con una vasta gamma di complessità.

• Partecipare a squadre globali/regionali per l'implementazione di iniziative chiave P&C o nuovi sistemi

Fornire supporto di prima classe, consulenza e coaching ai leader specificamente quando nuovi processi o progetti (ad esempio grading globale) sono arrotolati.

• Assicurare l'allineamento e l'esecuzione di politiche, procedure e iniziative P&C globali. Assicurare la conformità di tutte le pratiche P&C all'interno di requisiti legislativi e standard e linee guida stabilite, costruendo un'ampia base di conoscenze sugli approcci regionali e collegandosi con i colleghi P&C globali.

With a good understanding of the business needs and the business context and an excellent ability to apply key P&C concepts, policies and processes, this position provides coaching, guidance and support to leaders to help them diagnose and translate their business needs into immediate P&C approaches and ensures effective implementation of solutions in partnership with other chapters. This position partners closely with other P&C colleagues, participates in flexible squads and leverages technology to provide customer insights. This position is a trusted member of the Business Partner Chapter and closely integrated into the PSS organization.

As the P&C Business Partner (Advisory), you are responsible for:

Business Acumen

• Provide immediate short-term strategic guidance to leaders on strategic P&C needs such as succession and talent management, performance management, goal setting, development planning, reward & compensation management and organizational set-up. Leverage the P&C community, specifically P&C Business Partners, Operational Advisors and subject-matter experts of other Chapters, to develop high quality solutions in a timely manner.

• Use knowledge of business and P&C insights, metrics, expertise, and decision principles to effectively deliver support on topics with a wide range of complexity.

• Participate in global / regional squads for deployment of key P&C initiatives or new system launches

• Leverage a strong understanding of global P&C processes to consult, advice and train both business leaders as well as P&C leaders on system and process related topics. • Ensure alignment and execution of established policies, procedures and global P&C initiatives. Ensure compliance of all P&C practices within legislative requirements and established standards and guidelines by building a broad knowledge base on regional approaches and connecting with global P&C colleagues.

Leadership

• Be a trusted partner to leaders in all aspects of P&C generalist areas. Grasp a broad range of generalist P&C topics and be able to thoughtfully diagnose, evaluate and propose fit-for-purpose approaches including weighing risks and benefits of options.

• Be a trusted partner and lead others through complex generalist P&C topics by understanding the philosophies, approaches and systems-relevant configurations of topics such as succession and talent management (people discussions), access to relevant data, performance and compensation (performance management, benefits and other compensation elements), transformations (change management and redundancies), employee wellbeing (may include reintegration processes and time management), career paths, resolution of conflicts, employee representation topics and relocation, depending on the scope of the request.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

ServiceNow Architect / Technical Product Owner for RDT 4 P&C

The ServiceNow Architect/Technical Product Owner will be a key member of the People & Culture Engineering team, part of Roche Digital Technology (RDT). Our primary business stakeholders are People & Culture (P&C) at Roche. The P&C Engineering team operates as a foundational force across various P&C products, providing the essential enablers and technical capabilities required to meet strategic objectives.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

In this role, you will provide subject matter expertise, act as a technical product advocate, and evaluate new features to produce comprehensive analysis and recommendations for the ServiceNow platform. As both a Solution Architect and Technical PO, you will perform and participate in product road map planning, translating business needs into use cases and functional requirements for the technical team.

Key Responsibilities

• Product Ownership : Collaborate closely with the different Business Product Owners to act as a technical product advocate. Translate requirements into functional and technical requirements, and develop technical design documents. Translate technical complexities to project stakeholders.

• Implementation & Customization : Contribute to the strategic development of new platform customizations based on customer needs, participating in the configuration of new applications or suites during the planning, development, and roll out phases. Lead ServiceNow upgrade planning and execution, and support the scheduling of releases and new technology deployments. Implement technology-specific best practices and standards.

• Quality Assurance & Testing : Review and refine designs for usability, review testing scenarios, and work with users to review test results to ensure applications meet expected quality. Ensure strict adherence to corporate standards by managing ICFR audits, SRA, Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and maintaining accurate Solution Design Documents (SDD).

• Leadership & Documentation : Lead assignments, build the team, and mentor others. Lead geographically separated customers and onshore/offshore teams members, interacting cross-functionally to ensure coordination across the organization. Produce and maintain detailed system documentation, including design specs, maintenance, disaster recovery, and tech notes. Maintain continuous research and assessment of new resources and technology available for the platform.

• Architecture & Design : Create and maintain the current state of the ServiceNow platform architecture documentation and provide architectural control. Design and develop extensions to the ServiceNow data model in support of requirements for custom modules, HRSD, and other areas. Research alternative solutions and propose data models, design changes, and cost-effective solutions. Participate in Architecture Review Board (ARB) discussions and drive solution proposals for the products

Who you are:

Minimum 7 years of ServiceNow experience with a must have ServiceNow HRSD Product experience, strong knowledge of ITIL methodologies and processes. Practical experience with agile methodologies and tools.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

ServiceNow Architetto / Titolare del prodotto tecnico per RDT 4 P&C

Il ServiceNow Architect/Technical Product Owner sarà un membro chiave del team People & Culture Engineering, parte della Roche Digital Technology (RDT). I nostri principali stakeholder aziendali sono People & Culture (P&C) a Roche. Il team di P&C Engineering opera come forza di base in diversi prodotti P&C, fornendo i principali abilitatori e capacità tecniche necessarie per raggiungere obiettivi strategici.

A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi.

L'opportunità:

In questo ruolo, fornirete competenze di materia tematica, agire come avvocato di prodotto tecnico, e valutare nuove funzionalità per produrre analisi e raccomandazioni complete per la piattaforma ServiceNow. In qualità di Solution Architect e Technical PO, eseguirai e parteciperai alla pianificazione della mappa stradale del prodotto, traducendo le esigenze aziendali in casi di utilizzo e requisiti funzionali per il team tecnico.

Principali responsabilità

• Proprietario del prodotto: Collaborare a stretto contatto con i diversi proprietari di prodotti aziendali per agire come un sostenitore di prodotto tecnico. Traduci i requisiti in requisiti funzionali e tecnici, e sviluppi documenti di progettazione tecnica. Traduci complessi tecnici alle parti interessate del progetto.

• Attuazione e personalizzazione: Contribuisci allo sviluppo strategico di nuove personalizzazione della piattaforma in base alle esigenze del cliente, partecipando alla configurazione di nuove applicazioni o suite durante la pianificazione, lo sviluppo e l'implementazione delle fasi. Lead ServiceNow aggiorna la pianificazione e l'esecuzione, e supporta la pianificazione di release e nuove implementazioni tecnologiche. Implementare le migliori pratiche e standard tecnologici-specifici.

• Garanzia di qualità & Testing: revisione e perfezionare i progetti per l'usabilità, revisione scenari di test e lavorare con gli utenti per rivedere i risultati dei test per garantire le applicazioni soddisfare la qualità prevista. Assicurare una stretta adesione agli standard aziendali gestendo audit ICFR, SRA, Business Continuity Planning (BCP), e mantenendo i documenti di progettazione della soluzione accurate (SDD).

• Leadership & Documentazione: Incarichi di piombo, costruire il team e mentore altri. Guida clienti geograficamente separati e membri delle squadre onshore/offshore, interagendo trasversalmente per garantire il coordinamento in tutta l'organizzazione. Produrre e mantenere la documentazione dettagliata del sistema, tra cui specifiche di progettazione, manutenzione, recupero disastri e note tecnologiche. Mantenere la ricerca continua e la valutazione di nuove risorse e tecnologie disponibili per la piattaforma.

• Architettura & Design: Creare e mantenere lo stato attuale della documentazione di architettura della piattaforma ServiceNow e fornire il controllo architettonico. Progettare e sviluppare estensioni al modello di dati ServiceNow a supporto dei requisiti per moduli personalizzati, HRSD e altre aree. Ricerca di soluzioni alternative e proporre modelli di dati, cambiamenti di progettazione e soluzioni convenienti. Partecipare a Architettura Review Board (ARB) discussioni e proposte di soluzioni di azionamento per i prodotti

Chi sei:

Minimo 7 anni di esperienza ServiceNow con un must avere ServiceNow HRSD Esperienza di prodotto, forte conoscenza delle metodologie e processi ITIL. Esperienza pratica con metodologie e strumenti agili.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

ServiceNow Architecte / Propriétaire de produit technique pour RDT 4 P&C

Le ServiceNow Architect/Technical Product Owner sera un membre clé de l'équipe du génie des personnes et de la culture, faisant partie de la technologie numérique Roche (RDT). Nos principaux intervenants commerciaux sont People & Culture (P&C) à Roche. L'équipe d'ingénierie des P&C fonctionne comme une force fondamentale pour divers produits de P&C, fournissant les outils essentiels et les capacités techniques nécessaires pour atteindre les objectifs stratégiques.

Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration.

La possibilité :

Dans ce rôle, vous fournirez une expertise thématique, agirez comme un défenseur technique des produits, et évaluerez de nouvelles fonctionnalités pour produire une analyse complète et des recommandations pour la plateforme ServiceNow. En tant qu'architecte de solutions et OP technique, vous effectuerez et participerez à la planification de la feuille de route des produits, traduisant les besoins opérationnels en cas d'utilisation et exigences fonctionnelles pour l'équipe technique.

Principales responsabilités

• Propriété du produit : Collaborez étroitement avec les différents propriétaires de produits d'affaires pour agir comme un défenseur technique du produit. Traduire les exigences en exigences fonctionnelles et techniques, et élaborer des documents de conception technique. Traduire les complexités techniques aux intervenants du projet.

• Mise en œuvre et personnalisation : Contribuer au développement stratégique de nouvelles personnalisations de plateforme basées sur les besoins des clients, participer à la configuration de nouvelles applications ou suites pendant les phases de planification, de développement et de déploiement. Diriger ServiceMaintenant, mettre à niveau la planification et l'exécution, et appuyer le calendrier des rejets et des déploiements de nouvelles technologies. Mettre en oeuvre des pratiques et des normes exemplaires propres à la technologie.

• Assurance de la qualité et essais : Examiner et affiner les conceptions en vue de leur utilisation, revoir les scénarios d'essais et collaborer avec les utilisateurs pour examiner les résultats des essais afin de s'assurer que les applications répondent à la qualité attendue. Assurer le strict respect des normes ministérielles en gérant les audits du CIRF, l'EAR, la planification de la continuité des activités (PCA) et en maintenant des documents de conception de solutions (SDD) précis.

• Leadership & Documentation : Diriger les missions, construire l'équipe et encadrer les autres. Diriger les clients géographiquement séparés et les membres des équipes terrestres et terrestres, interagir de façon interfonctionnelle pour assurer la coordination dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Produire et tenir à jour la documentation détaillée du système, y compris les spécifications de conception, la maintenance, la reprise après sinistre et les notes techniques. Maintenir la recherche et l'évaluation continues des nouvelles ressources et technologies disponibles pour la plateforme.

• Architecture & Design : Créer et maintenir l'état actuel de la documentation d'architecture de la plateforme ServiceNow et fournir un contrôle architectural. Concevoir et développer des extensions au modèle de données ServiceNow à l'appui des exigences des modules personnalisés, RHSD et d'autres domaines. Rechercher des solutions alternatives et proposer des modèles de données, des changements de conception et des solutions rentables. Participer aux discussions du Conseil d'examen de l'architecture (CEA) et proposer des solutions pour les produits

Qui vous êtes :

Au moins 7 ans d'expérience de ServiceMaintenant avec un doit avoir ServiceNow RHSD Expérience produit, une connaissance solide des méthodologies et des processus ITIL. Expérience pratique avec des méthodologies et des outils agiles.

Technica

jobs.title: Praktikum im Bereich Projects & Digitalization (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

Wir sind das Team Projects & Digitalization in Pharma, Penzberg und leisten mit viel Engagement und Leidenschaft einen großen Beitrag zur Ausrichtung des Bereichs und zur Durchführung der vielfältigen Projekte am Standort. Unser Verantwortungsbereich erstreckt sich hierbei von der Steuerung des Projekt-Portfolios und dem konkreten Programm- und Projektmanagement bis zur strategischen Ausrichtung der Digitalisierung am Standort sowie der praktischen Umsetzung von Maßnahmen (z.B. Trainings) und natürlich Projekten zur Digitalisierung.

Wir denken die Themen neu und möchten Dir als Praktikant (m/w/d) die Chance geben, gemeinsam mit uns etwas zu bewegen.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du übernimmst selbständig und verantwortlich Aufgaben oder Teilprojekte aus unserem vielfältigen Themenspektrum

• Du unterstützt bei der Projektarbeit und das Thema Digitalisierung z.B. durch Aufbereitung von Ergebnissen und Vorbereitung von Workshops oder Veranstaltungen

• Du analysierst Daten, erstellst Reports und bereitest die Ergebnisse managementgerecht auf

• Du organisierst Trainingsveranstaltungen zum Projektmanagement

• Du kümmerst Dich um die Aufbereitung und Dokumentation von abteilungsinternen und ggf. übergreifenden Geschäftsprozessen.

Dein Profil

• Studiengang des Ingenieurwesens, Naturwissenschaften, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie Freude am Umgang mit neuen Technologien

• Sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Sicherer Umgang mit Google Suite sowie Collaboration Tools, Kenntnisse von Business Intelligence Tools wünschenswert

• Erste Erfahrungen in Projektmanagement und Datenanalysen wünschenswert

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• Anteiliges mobiles Arbeiten möglich (ca. 20%)

• 2.268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum; 6 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

• Shuttlebus aus München zu Roche Penzberg nutzbar

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte lade nur Deinen Lebenslauf online hoch.

Denke daran, dass sich dieses Praktikum ausschließlich an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden.

Zeitraum: ab 01.10.2026 nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von 6 Monaten

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Do you need further support?

Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare so
