jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Methodology Coaching . Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Business Value & Success Factors: Understanding the business goals and value of the project to deliver defined organizational benefits, while ensuring critical success factors (reliability, compliance, efficiency, sustainability, time-to-value) are managed throughout the entire lifecycle.

• Methodology & Execution: Using the appropriate methodology (Waterfall, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) to manage dependencies and set clear priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Global Team Leadership: Leading or participating in global project teams by ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and precise resource assignment to project plan deliverables.

• Stakeholder & Change Management: Effectively managing stakeholders and understanding their organizations to establish key relationships, while applying organizational change management practices and ensuring effective project communication.

• Facilitation & Coaching: Designing and leading workshops, acting as a proactive facilitator, and serving as a comfortable coach for project squads.

• Planning & Risk Management: Generating, maintaining, and tracking an accurate and realistic project plan alongside a project risk and issue log, ensuring the project status remains timely and transparent.

• Governance & Reporting: Preparing and presenting to relevant governance meetings as required by the chosen project methodology and good project management practice.

• Financial Control: Tracking project financials and seeking governance approvals whenever needed.

• Business Development: Contributing to business development opportunities where appropriate

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Methodology Coaching . Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Business Value & Success Factors: Understanding the business goals and value of the project to deliver defined organizational benefits, while ensuring critical success factors (reliability, compliance, efficiency, sustainability, time-to-value) are managed throughout the entire lifecycle.

• Methodology & Execution: Using the appropriate methodology (Waterfall, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) to manage dependencies and set clear priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Global Team Leadership: Leading or participating in global project teams by ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and precise resource assignment to project plan deliverables.

• Stakeholder & Change Management: Effectively managing stakeholders and understanding their organizations to establish key relationships, while applying organizational change management practices and ensuring effective project communication.

• Facilitation & Coaching: Designing and leading workshops, acting as a proactive facilitator, and serving as a comfortable coach for project squads.

• Planning & Risk Management: Generating, maintaining, and tracking an accurate and realistic project plan alongside a project risk and issue log, ensuring the project status remains timely and transparent.

• Governance & Reporting: Preparing and presenting to relevant governance meetings as required by the chosen project methodology and good project management practice.

• Financial Control: Tracking project financials and seeking governance approvals whenever needed.

• Business Development: Contributing to business development opportunities where appropriate

jobs.title: GTM Lead (Digital Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

The Opportunity
Are you ready to shape the future of digital healthcare? As the GTM Lead for Platforms and Digital Infrastructure , you will drive market growth and commercial success for Roche Information Solutions (RIS).
Operating across our Product Lifecycle Framework and in close alignment with the Value Stream, you will serve as the primary commercial interface within the Product Core Team. Your mission? Translate technical infrastructure value into market success, ensure full commercial readiness, enable regional pilots, and turn technical capabilities into scalable digital solutions for global affiliates.

Your Key Responsibilities:

• Portfolio Launch & Readiness: Embed end-to-end GTM strategies (via our GTM Blueprint) connecting clinical value propositions, deployment models, and affiliate capability building.

• Market Growth & Digital Adoption: Accelerate digital adoption across priority geographies by empowering affiliates and fostering data-driven, collaborative commercial decision-making.

• Value Stream Alignment: Achieve strategic integration of GTM objectives within the specific Disease Management Value Stream, ensuring shared accountability for commercial outcomes.

• Cross-Functional Synergy: Foster seamless collaboration between GTM, Product, and Value Stream teams to ensure sharp product positioning and consistent global execution.

• Strategic Insights & Roadmap Influence: Identify mid- to long-term growth levers in disease management and influence roadmap decisions through the systematic integration of clinician and patient feedback.

• Commercial Intelligence: Provide actionable market intelligence, serving as the key interface between health-tech business strategy, clinical product development, and commercialization.

• Ecosystem & Partnerships: Collaborate with the GTM Market Adoption team to identify foundational drivers to access digital healthcare markets, leveraging regional networks and third-party health partnerships.

• Customer & Patient Advocacy: Act as the expert on users, patients, and healthcare providers to ensure real-world needs remain central to product development .

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker who thrives in matrixed, fast-paced environments. You combine business acumen with a passion for health-tech and possess the following qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Business, Science, Healthcare, or a relevant discipline; a Master’s degree or MBA is highly preferred.

• Professional Experience: A minimum of 5 years of directly related experience driving commercial strategy, product marketing, or sales within the healthcare software industry .

• Specialist Knowledge: Proven track record of launching cloud-based healthcare software solutions , digital health platforms, or remote patient monitoring tools.

• Ecosystem Acumen: Deep understanding of the digital health landscape, including

jobs.title: Insights & Performance Subchapter Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub is a growing business line within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our primary goal is to enhance Roche's digital capabilities globally by supporting central initiatives in areas such as Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.

The Opportunity
As a Insights & Performance Subchapter Lead in the Global Digital Hub within Roche Services & Solutions, you ensure delivery of the Hub’s long-term outcomes, strategy, and priorities; inspire subchapter members to collaborate across the network and contribute to Roche’s Ten-Year Ambitions; drive embedding of the new operating model and role model agile collaboration; and help shape the Hub’s future by developing cutting-edge digital capabilities and supporting colleague development across Social Media Management, Channels & Publishing, Creative Design, Digital Campaign Management, Marketing Automation, and Digital Operations.

Your work will include but will not be limited to:

• Owning a complete business service end-to-end, including managing both the digital work and the people who deliver it, acting as the primary point of contact and leader to global partners and stakeholders.

• Leading, mentoring, and coaching team members by setting goals, managing performance, onboarding, and growing careers to maintain high effectiveness across the subchapter.

• Leveraging domain depth in digital operations to set technical and quality standards for the service, establish process governance principles, and coach team members in their craft.

• Attracting, developing, and retaining top talent aligned with evolving business needs, advocating for diversity and fostering an inclusive team culture reflecting the world around us.

• Building collaborative partner relationships across Subchapters, Chapters, and RSS organizations to align strategic priorities, accelerate decision-making, and embed the One Roche mindset.

• Driving continuous service improvement by monitoring resource utilization and customer satisfaction, making recommendations to enhance responsiveness, and ensuring compliance with local or global labor regulations and policies.

Who You Are

• You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 7+ years of experience working in digital operations for large organizations, agencies, or startups, alongside 3+ years of experience in people leadership, coaching, and talent development.

• You possess strong domain credibility and business leadership skills, capable of setting quality bars, driving strategic planning, and owning end-to-end partner relationships.

• You are skilled in people leadership, adept at handling conflict constructively, giving and seeking open feedback, and modeling a growth mindset.

• You have proven experience operating and influencing effectively in matrixed, cross-functional global environments using agile ways of working.

• You have strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) with the ability to engage confidently with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

• You are a proactive, innovative problem solver with strong project and change management skills, end-to-end accountability, and a focus on sustainable, scalable solutions.

​ In Exchange we provide you with

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub is a growing business line within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our primary goal is to enhance Roche's digital capabilities globally by supporting central initiatives in areas such as Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.

The Opportunity
As a Insights & Performance Subchapter Lead in the Global Digital Hub within Roche Services & Solutions, you ensure delivery of the Hub’s long-term outcomes, strategy, and priorities; inspire subchapter members to collaborate across the network and contribute to Roche’s Ten-Year Ambitions; drive embedding of the new operating model and role model agile collaboration; and help shape the Hub’s future by developing cutting-edge digital capabilities and supporting colleague development across Social Media Management, Channels & Publishing, Creative Design, Digital Campaign Management, Marketing Automation, and Digital Operations.

Your work will include but will not be limited to:

• Owning a complete business service end-to-end, including managing both the digital work and the people who deliver it, acting as the primary point of contact and leader to global partners and stakeholders.

• Leading, mentoring, and coaching team members by setting goals, managing performance, onboarding, and growing careers to maintain high effectiveness across the subchapter.

• Leveraging domain depth in digital operations to set technical and quality standards for the service, establish process governance principles, and coach team members in their craft.

• Attracting, developing, and retaining top talent aligned with evolving business needs, advocating for diversity and fostering an inclusive team culture reflecting the world around us.

• Building collaborative partner relationships across Subchapters, Chapters, and RSS organizations to align strategic priorities, accelerate decision-making, and embed the One Roche mindset.

• Driving continuous service improvement by monitoring resource utilization and customer satisfaction, making recommendations to enhance responsiveness, and ensuring compliance with local or global labor regulations and policies.

Who You Are

• You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 7+ years of experience working in digital operations for large organizations, agencies, or startups, alongside 3+ years of experience in people leadership, coaching, and talent development.

• You possess strong domain credibility and business leadership skills, capable of setting quality bars, driving strategic planning, and owning end-to-end partner relationships.

• You are skilled in people leadership, adept at handling conflict constructively, giving and seeking open feedback, and modeling a growth mindset.

• You have proven experience operating and influencing effectively in matrixed, cross-functional global environments using agile ways of working.

• You have strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) with the ability to engage confidently with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

• You are a proactive, innovative problem solver with strong project and change management skills, end-to-end accountability, and a focus on sustainable, scalable solutions.

​ In Exchange we provide you with

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Our AI for Drug Discovery organization, as part of Roche’s Computational Sciences Center of Excellence, advances drug discovery through cutting-edge machine learning. Our Foundation Models team builds large language models (LLMs) and agent platforms that enable next-generation scientific and biomedical applications across the drug-discovery pipeline. We are seeking exceptional scientists to join our efforts on one of the largest scientific agent and automation platforms in the industry. Our team focuses on developing and operating the foundational platform that transforms scientific knowledge and actions from thousands of world-class scientists into sharable, reusable tools, workflows, and agents, reshaping how drug discovery operates with large-scale in-house scientific use cases.

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to develop the backend components and tooling for our scientific agents. In this role, you will build the software layer that connects our models to internal scientific capabilities. You will focus on writing clean, performant code that wraps scientific logic into accessible APIs and maintaining the infrastructure that supports our agent workflows.

The Opportunity

• Develop scientific tools by creating Python wrappers and API definitions that allow models to execute specific tasks (e.g., molecular property calculation, database queries).

• Build backend services using modern web frameworks (FastAPI/Flask) to serve agent capabilities to internal platforms.

• Implement data pipelines for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), ensuring models have access to up-to-date proprietary scientific data.

• Maintain infrastructure by writing Dockerfiles, setting up CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring automated testing for agent components.

• Integrate models into the execution environment, handling inference requests and validating structured outputs.

• Write high-quality code that is modular, well-tested, and adheres to the team’s software engineering standards.

• Collaborate closely with computational scientists and subject matter experts on designing and evaluating targeted agents for drug discovery.

• Contribute to frontier research related to agentic use in scientific scenarios.

Who You Are

• Education: BS/MS with 1–4+ years of experience, or PhD graduates with strong software engineering skills.

• Software Foundation: Strong proficiency in Python and standard software engineering practices (Git, testing, CI/CD).

• LLM Application Development: Experience building applications that utilize LLMs, with an understanding of embeddings, prompt engineering, and function calling.

• Modern Stack: Familiarity with containerization and backend development frameworks.

• Execution Focused: Ability to work independently on defined engineering tasks and deliver robust solutions.

• Collaborative: Eager to learn from senior engineers and scientists and contribute to a fast-paced technical environment.

• Mission Driven: A strong interest in applying software engineering to drug discovery and a commitment to patient impact.

• Experience with molecular modalities (e.g., protein sequences, chemical graphs) or scientific data is a plus, but not required.

• General interest in the natural sciences (chemistry, biology, or physics).

As a global leader in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, we commit ourselves to scientific excellence, cutting-edge innovation, and sustainable growth. We believe that good business means a better world, and we achieve this by fostering an inclusive, collaborative environment where our people are empowered to push the boundaries of medical science and technology. Joining Roche means bringing your purpose to a team that values integrity, courage, and passion, ensuring that the right treatment reaches the right patient at the right time.

The Opportunity

• Drive System Strategy: Serve as the global Technology PT Product Owner for Learning Management technologies (specifically Cornerstone on Demand), effectively translating complex business requirements into standardized technical solutions.

• Manage Lifecycle & Governance: Direct the entire system lifecycle—including upgrades, system replacements, and retirements—while strictly adhering to established change management processes.

• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Mobilize and lead high-performing, cross-functional teams spanning global Learning departments, business stakeholders, IT partners, and validation functions.

• Optimize Processes & Systems: Drive continuous improvement initiatives, manage deviations and CAPAs, and oversee master data validation within validated quality systems.

• Govern the Learning Ecosystem: Manage the integration and structural nuances of the learning ecosystem, ensuring seamless data flow, reporting, and interface connectivity across global manufacturing and commercial sites.

• You possess deep technical expertise: You bring 7+ years of experience in Learning Management technology and platform management—specifically Cornerstone on Demand—ideally with Roche Super Admin-level competency.

• You are an expert in regulated environments: You possess a strong understanding of database management, data analytics, and software validation within validated or controlled pharmaceutical/healthcare environments (GMP, FDA, GxP).

• You are strategically and academically qualified: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field (or an equivalent qualification like a Federal Diploma of Higher Education) combined with a proven track record in formulating long-term computer system strategies.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
A Roche, siamo appassionati di trasformare la salute e cambiare la vita dei pazienti per il meglio. Come leader globale nel settore farmaceutico e diagnostico, ci impegniamo a eccellenza scientifica, innovazione all'avanguardia e crescita sostenibile. Crediamo che il buon business significhi un mondo migliore, e lo raggiungeremo promuovendo un ambiente inclusivo e collaborativo in cui le nostre persone sono abilitate a spingere i confini della scienza e della tecnologia medica. Raggiungere Roche significa portare il vostro scopo a un team che valorizza l'integrità, il coraggio e la passione, assicurando che il trattamento giusto raggiunga il paziente giusto al momento giusto.

L'opportunità

• Drive System Strategy: Serve come proprietario globale di prodotti Technology PT per le tecnologie di gestione dell'apprendimento (specificamente Cornerstone on Demand), traducendo efficacemente i complessi requisiti aziendali in soluzioni tecniche standardizzate.

• Gestisci Lifecycle & Governance: Dirigere l'intero ciclo di vita del sistema, compresi gli aggiornamenti, i sostituti del sistema e i pensionati, mentre aderiscono rigorosamente ai processi di gestione dei cambiamenti stabiliti.

• Shape Product Roadmaps: Partner a stretto contatto con il team Global Learning Solutions (GLS) per definire la visione del prodotto, allineare le roadmap, gestire i backlog delle funzionalità e dare priorità ai miglioramenti del sistema.

• Assicurare Compliance & Data Stewardship: agire come il Business Data Steward dedicato, assicurando la conformità GxP in continuo, la governance dei dati rigorosa e l'adesione alle politiche di qualità globali.

• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Mobilitare e condurre team altamente performanti e interfunzionali che spaziano dai dipartimenti di apprendimento globali, dagli stakeholder aziendali, dai partner IT e dalle funzioni di validazione.

• Ottimizzare Processi e Sistemi: Guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo, gestire deviazioni e CAPAs, e supervisionare la convalida dei dati master all'interno di sistemi di qualità convalidati.

• Governare l'Ecosistema di apprendimento: Gestire l'integrazione e le sfumature strutturali dell'ecosistema di apprendimento, assicurando flussi di dati senza soluzione di continuità, reporting e connettività di interfaccia tra i siti produttivi e commerciali globali.

Chi sei

• Possiedi una profonda competenza tecnica: porti 7+ anni di esperienza nella tecnologia Learning Management e nella gestione delle piattaforme, in particolare Cornerstone on Demand, con la competenza a livello di Roche Super Admin.

• Sei un esperto in ambienti regolamentati: Possiedi una forte comprensione della gestione del database, dell'analisi dei dati e della convalida del software all'interno di ambienti farmaceutici / sanitari convalidati o controllati (GMP, FDA, GxP).

• Sei strategicamente e accademicamente qualificato: hai una laurea o master in Scienze della vita, Scienza informatica, o un campo correlato (o una qualifica equivalente come un diploma federale di istruzione superiore) combinato con un record di traccia provata nella formulazione di strategie di sistema informatico a lungo termine.

• Lei è un collaboratore e comunicatore Agile: Lei è altamente esperto nell'utilizzo di metodologie Agile e possiede eccezionali capacità di comunicazione per trasmettere i risultati tecnici e raccomandazioni al pubblico tecnico e non tecnico.

• Sei un amministratore avanzato di Cornerstone: hai masterizzato la creazione di gruppi dinamici, la modifica dei componenti di formazione, la costruzione di complessi dashboard Reporting 2.0 e la risoluzione degli errori di configurazione del sistema in modo efficiente.

• Sei un risolutore di problemi proattivo: Possiedi una fondazione tecnica accoppiata con acume aziendale acuto, permettendoti di risolvere problemi di sistema intricati, navigare percorsi di escalation attraverso ServiceNOW, e

jobs.title: Access Evidence Lead - 12 months contract
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are brave in both decision and action and believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this tod ay to build a better tomorr ow. The Global Access (GA) organization is a key part of this mission. We are seeking a dedicated Access Evidence Lead to join our RWE and Post-Launch pod, a specialized team focused on ensuring our medicines remain accessible to patients throughout their entire lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape and sustain the value of our in-market medicines through evidence as an individual contributor in a dual-responsibility role.

The Opportunity

• RWE Strategy & Execution: Identify critical launch and post-launch evidence gaps, design robust RWE studies to fill them, and collaborate closely with global and affiliate colleagues on study design, execution, and dissemination of results.

• HTA Deliverable Management: Take ownership of and update core global HTA deliverables—including cost-effectiveness models (CEMs), budget impact models (BIMs), systematic literature reviews (SLRs), indirect treatment comparisons (ITCs), and Global Value Dossiers (GVDs)—for established medicines (2-3 years after launch).

• Affiliate Partnership: Act as the primary technical partner for affiliates in later-launching countries or those facing access re-negotiations, providing hands-on support to update HTA deliverables to meet specific needs and assisting with answering technical questions from HTA bodies and payers.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work seamlessly with colleagues across Global Access, Medical Affairs, Commercial, Product Development Data, Real-World Data, and affiliates to deliver integrated evidence solutions in a highly collaborative, global matrix environment.

• Technical Expertise: Serve as a strategic expert and subject-matter expert on the application of RWE for market access and on updating HTA deliverables for lifecycle management to ensure continued patient access.

Who You Are

• Education: You hold a Master's or doctoral-level degree (MSc, PhD, PharmD) in a quantitative discipline such as Health Economics, Epidemiology, Statistics, or Public Health.

• Experience: You have at least 5 years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry, a health technology assessment agency, or a HEOR consultancy.

• Hands-on Expertise: You have demonstrated experience in designing and implementing RWE studies for market access, developing/adapting health economic models (CEMs, BIMs), conducting SLRs/ITCs, and supporting HTA submissions while responding to questions from HTA bodies.

• Technical & Soft Skills: You possess strong analytical skills, proficiency with relevant software (e.g., R for statistical analysis; MS Excel including VBA for economic modeling), and are an excellent communicator and collaborator.

• Mindset: You are a proactive, solution-oriented professional driven by scientific innovation and passionate about demonstrating product value through evidence to make a meaningful impact for patients through teamwork.

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are brave in both decision and action and believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this tod ay to build a better tomorr ow. The Global Access (GA) organization is a key part of this mission. We are seeking a dedicated Access Evidence Lead to join our RWE and Post-Launch pod, a specialized team focused on ensuring our medicines remain accessible to patients throughout their entire lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape and sustain the value of our in-market medicines through evidence as an individual contributor in a dual-responsibility role.

The Opportunity

• RWE Strategy & Execution: Identify critical launch and post-launch evidence gaps, design robust RWE studies to fill them, and collaborate closely with global and affiliate colleagues on study design, execution, and dissemination of results.

• HTA Deliverable Management: Take ownership of and update core global HTA deliverables—including cost-effectiveness models (CEMs), budget impact models (BIMs), systematic literature reviews (SLRs), indirect treatment comparisons (ITCs), and Global Value Dossiers (GVDs)—for established medicines (2-3 years after launch).

• Affiliate Partnership: Act as the primary technical partner for affiliates in later-launching countries or those facing access re-negotiations, providing hands-on support to update HTA deliverables to meet specific needs and assisting with answering technical questions from HTA bodies and payers.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work seamlessly with colleagues across Global Access, Medical Affairs, Commercial, Product Development Data, Real-World Data, and affiliates to deliver integrated evidence solutions in a highly collaborative, global matrix environment.

• Technical Expertise: Serve as a strategic expert and subject-matter expert on the application of RWE for market access and on updating HTA deliverables for lifecycle management to ensure continued patient access.

Who You Are

• Education: You hold a Master's or doctoral-level degree (MSc, PhD, PharmD) in a quantitative discipline such as Health Economics, Epidemiology, Statistics, or Public Health.

• Experience: You have at least 5 years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry, a health technology assessment agency, or a HEOR consultancy.

• Hands-on Expertise: You have demonstrated experience in designing and implementing RWE studies for market access, developing/adapting health economic models (CEMs, BIMs), conducting SLRs/ITCs, and supporting HTA submissions while responding to questions from HTA bodies.

• Technical & Soft Skills: You possess strong analytical skills, proficiency with relevant software (e.g., R for statistical analysis; MS Excel including VBA for economic modeling), and are an excellent communicator and collaborator.

• Mindset: You are a proactive, solution-oriented professional driven by scientific innovation and passionate about demonstrating product value through evidence to make a meaningful impact for patients through teamwork.

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!

That’s what makes us Roche.

Enterprise Master Data Management (EMDM) is a Roche cross-functional and cross-divisional network of master data specialists and subject-matter experts developing governance frameworks and maintenance processes to ensure high-quality and trusted master data as the backbone for seamless business operations, data analytics and digitalization.

In the Enterprise Master Data Management Operations Business Analyst role, you are responsible for the dedication towards undisturbed business activities by committing to Service Level Agreement. In this role, you will ensure that technological architecture meets user requirements, and will support the whole data maintenance related queries - including data quality, lifecycle management and monitoring. Execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level and in compliance with the SOPs of the respective business sub-process. Follow the instructions of the Cluster Lead - Enterprise Master Data Management Operations Business Partner domain regarding the daily work coordination, and propose process and system improvements across multiple divisions. Contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of the Finance, Procurement, Sales and Supply Chain organizations.

You will be:

• Handling incoming incidents, supporting both Roche Affiliates and multiple regional and global IT departments. 2nd level evaluation of user requests based on ITIL methodology and prioritization towards IT accordingly. Collaborate with IT teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions

• Performs and participates in the analysis, (re)design and implementation of business and systems processes and procedures following appropriate standards

• Management of continuous data cleansing and Data lifecycle management. Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for automation and optimization. Develop business cases and proposals for process improvements and system upgrades

• Maintenance of SOPs, Knowledge Base and User Guidance. Audit control management (ICFR). Training material preparation and delivery (including delta training) – using Train the Trainer and end user concepts

• Project management (lead, coordinate, facilitate, participate within RSS projects and participate in global projects)

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development.

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential. Strong customer centricity and stakeholder management skills

• Experienced in SAP (FI, MM, CO, SD)

• Ability to work independently and in team as well. Focus on details and innovation. Skilled in multitasking and prioritization

• Has analytical thinking; 3-5 years Master Data management experience is desirable. Project experience (desirable)

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Business Intelligence (BI) Lead
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad or Chennai

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) at Chennai to drive analytics & technology-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

The Opportunity

As a Business Intelligence (BI) Lead, you will drive the end to end delivery of Business Intelligence solutions while serving as the go-to person in conversations with our partners. This is a true leadership role. The ideal candidate brings the right blend of technical depth and business understanding to navigate conversations around feasibility, data challenges, tool selection, and delivery timelines with confidence, keeping discussions productive and moving forward. Beyond responding to what is asked, you will be a thought partner to our stakeholders, proactively suggesting better approaches to visualizing data, identifying more meaningful KPIs, and recommending data sources or methods that stakeholders may not have considered.

All Roche employees are expected to effectively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and coordination and comply with all laws, regulations, policies & procedures that govern our business.

As a Business Intelligence (BI) Lead, you will:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for business leaders to gather requirements, manage expectations, and provide transparent project timelines across multiple workstreams

• Assess and recommend the right BI approach for a given problem, considering data availability, platform capabilities, and business context, and communicate trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences

• Drive the design and delivery of enterprise-grade BI applications (Tableau), ensuring scalability, performance, security and data governance

• Lead data discovery sessions to identify new data sources and ensure the underlying data warehouse architecture supports long-term BI reporting needs

• Guide the translation of business requirements into analytics prototypes that provide meaningful business and data insights

• Oversee data and BI analysis efforts, including review of source systems, KPI definitions and aggregations, ensuring quality and consistency

• Review and guide the development of Tableau applications, ensuring reporting components from multiple data sources are integrated effectively

• Create and understand Figma-based prototypes to understand the "user journey" of data. Translate these designs into functional KPIs for BI developers

• Provide oversight of the end to end BI ecosystem (Desktop, Server, and Cloud), ensuring best practices in dashboard performance, security and scalability

• Mentor and guide team members, fostering a collaborative environment and contributing to overall team growth

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Engineering or other technical disciplines) and 7+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, with a progressive shift from hands-on development to leading delivery and stakeholder engagement

• Strong foundation in Tableau development, dashboarding, data modeling and reporting techniques, with the ability to guide a

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Medical Writer
Roche India – Roche Services & solutions
Hyderabad

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Roche Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2-office days/week).

The Global Digital Hub growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.

Position Summary

As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy as well as excellent delivery of content creation priorities. As a Senior Medical writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners across various therapeutic areas and play a crucial role in business development and stakeholder engagement

As a Senior Medical Writer, you will be at the forefront of creating high-quality content for medical communications tailored solutions. The Senior Medical Writer is an experienced subject matter expert, advisor and leader within the chapter. Focussing on specific therapeutic areas in dedicated service teams, Senior Medical Writers are responsible for training and mentoring medical writers, copywriters and content editors within their assigned team - also driving cross-team upskilling and knowledge transfer to grow the capabilities of the chapter overall. This critical position has a global scope and a key component of the role involves acting as a trusted advisor and knowledgeable consultant to our business teams on the topic of medical writing and communications.

The Opportunity

• Apply your broad knowledge of medical writing for the pharmaceutical industry, you will work closely with cross-functional teams, including medical, scientific, and commercial partners, to understand client needs and develop tailored and effective scientific content for digital implementation

• Manage multiple concurrent projects across a range of therapeutic areas, delivering on agreed timelines

• Ensuring that the content, format and structure comply with regulatory and other guidelines, as well as with Roche best practices

• Monitor assigned tasks and manage own workload, taking ownership and anticipating capacity issues and potential solutions

• As a trained and experienced senior medical writer you will provide mentorship and technical coaching to other medical writers in the team, as well as new writers joining the team

• As a senior medical writer you will be a subject matter expert in pharmaceutical and medical communications as well as lead the team in assigned, specific therapeutic areas.

Key responsibilities:

• Your role will require taking responsibility and ownership for upholding the highest standards of scientific accuracy, quality and compliance with all applicable industry guidelines, local and international

jobs.title: Senior Electronics Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your New Team
Do you want to play a key role in developing next-generation medical diagnostic devices that improve the lives of millions of patients? We combine innovative circuit design with the highest quality standards. Together, we shape the future of healthcare—precisely, reliably, and with a forward-looking approach. In our Hardware Development department, you will join a highly motivated, interdisciplinary team of engineers, software specialists, and system architects. We foster an open feedback culture, interact as equals, and support one another through complex technical challenges. From the initial concept to series production, we work hand in hand.

The Opportunity
In the role of Senior Electronics Engineer (m/f/d) , you will take charge of the conceptualization and circuit design of analogue and digital assemblies for diagnostic devices in medical applications. Building prototypes and demonstrators, conducting systematic troubleshooting at the assembly and component levels, and performing EMC pre-compliance testing will be part of your daily routine. You will also actively contribute to risk analyses and Design FMEAs, implementing technical safety measures directly into the electronics design.
Additionally, you can look forward to the following exciting tasks:

• Specifications & System Requirements: Define electronics specifications and interface documentation, actively contributing to global system requirements.

• Standards-Compliant Design (IEC 60601): Design circuits in compliance with DIN EN 60601-1 (electrical safety, isolation concepts, MOPP/MOOP, clearance and creepage distances) and DIN EN 60601-1-2 (EMC).

• Approval & CE Compliance: Prepare, execute, and document standards-relevant tests to support external CE certifications in accredited testing laboratories.

• Process & Interface Collaboration: Create technical documentation, oversee the transition of designs into volume production (DFM/DFT), and coordinate closely with adjacent technical disciplines.

• Mentoring: Conduct design reviews and support junior team members with your technical expertise.

Who You Are
For this challenging role, you hold a successfully completed degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Medical Engineering, Mechatronics, Communications Engineering, or a comparable qualification. You bring at least 5–10 years of solid experience in independent hardware development, ideally gained within the regulated medical technology sector. Routine experience with common design tools (e.g., Altium Designer, KiCAD, EAGLE, or OrCAD) and circuit simulation (e.g., SPICE) is second nature to you.
The following attributes complete your profile:

• Circuit Design: Sound knowledge of analogue and digital circuit design—especially low-power design for battery-operated devices. Specific expertise in analogue technology, RF design, or electrical/functional safety is an advantage.

• Measurement & Lab Equipment: Strong practical experience using oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers, logic analysers, and electrical safety testing equipment.

• Standards & Regulatory Knowledge: Proficiency with the IEC 60601-1 / 60601-1-2 family of standards, understanding of ISO 14971 (risk management), and familiarity with CE approval processes for medical devices.

• Manufacturing Expertise: Deep insight into EMC-compliant design, Design for Manufacturability/Testability (DFM/DFT), and obsolescence management.

• Language Skills: Business-fluent German and excellent written and spoken English skill

• Process & Interface Collaboration: Create technical documentation, oversee the transition of designs into volume production (DFM/DFT), and coordinate closely with adjacent technical disciplines.

• Mentoring: Conduct design reviews and support junior team members with your technical expertise.

Who You Are
For this challenging role, you hold a successfully completed degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Medical Engineering, Mechatronics, Communications Engineering, or a comparable qualification. You bring at least 5–10 years of solid experience in independent hardware development, ideally gained within the regulated medical technology sector. Routine experience with common design tools (e.g., Altium Designer, KiCAD, EAGLE, or OrCAD) and circuit simulation (e.g., SPICE) is second nature to you.
The following attributes complete your profile:

• Circuit Design: Sound knowledge of analogue and digital circuit design—especially low-power design for battery-operated devices. Specific expertise in analogue technology, RF design, or electrical/functional safety is an advantage.

• Measurement & Lab Equipment: Strong practical experience using oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers, logic analysers, and electrical safety testing equipment.

• Standards & Regulatory Knowledge: Proficiency with the IEC 60601-1 / 60601-1-2 family of standards, understanding of ISO 14971 (risk management), and familiarity with CE approval processes for medical devices.

• Manufacturing Expertise: Deep insight into EMC-compliant design, Design for Manufacturability/Testability (DFM/DFT), and obsolescence management.

• Language Skills: Business-fluent German and excellent written and spoken English skill

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Especialista em Comércio Exterior com foco em Trade Compliance no Chapter de Supply Chain, você terá a responsabilidade pela manutenção da excelência operacional e da integridade corporativa. Você será o principal responsável por assegurar a total conformidade de todas as operações de comércio exterior da RDB, o que abrange a importação de insumos críticos garantindo o rigoroso cumprimento das complexas regulamentações aduaneiras, fiscais e internacionais vigentes no país. Atuando como um especialista de riscos, sua função é essencial para mitigar vulnerabilidades legais e operacionais na cadeia de suprimentos, implementando políticas e procedimentos robustos. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Der Produktionsstandort Kaiseraugst ist ein Eckpfeiler im weltweiten Produktions- und
Logistiknetzwerk von Roche. Ca. 2000 Personen sind hier beschäftigt und der Standort beherbergt den weltweit grössten und innovativsten Verpackungsbetrieb von Roche.

Die Möglichkeit

Als PraktikantIn Innerhalb der Training Academy für die Manufacturing Unit Sterile Filling bist Du am Puls des Geschehens:

• Du unterstützt uns dabei, neue Mitarbeitende optimal auf ihre Aufgaben vorzubereiten, Trainings weiterzuentwickeln und die hohen Qualitätsstandards zu sichern.

• Du bist die treibende Kraft bei der Organisation, Koordination und Weiterentwicklung unseres produktionsspezifischen Onboarding-Programms.

• Du sorgst dafür, dass neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen einen reibungslosen und motivierenden Start hinlegen.

• Du begleitest die Teilnehmenden durch ihre ersten Tage, bist Ansprechperson für Fragen und baust die Brücke zwischen der Academy und der Produktion.

• Du unterstützt uns aktiv bei der Konzeption und dem Design von modernen Trainings-Modulen und erstellst zielgruppengerechte, anschauliche Trainingsmaterialien.

• Du übernimmst das eigenständige Handling von administrativen Prozessen (z. B. smarte Kalenderverwaltung, Ressourcenplanung und Materialbeschaffung für Schulungszwecke) und stimmst Dich dazu eng mit den verschiedenen Produktionslinien ab.

• Du unterstützt bei der Durchführung von Virtual Reality Trainings.

• Du übernimmst selbstständig Teil-/Projekte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen.

Wer Du bist

• Du bist an einer Universität oder Fachhochschule immatrikuliert oder hast Dein Studium, vorzugsweise im Bereich Erwachsenenbildung, Pharmazie, Medien-/Kommunikationswissenschaften , Mediamatik, Psychologie oder Wirtschaft - innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate vor dem Startdatum abgeschlossen.

• Du hast Interesse daran, Deine Kenntnisse im Rahmen eines 12-monatigen Praktikums mit einem Arbeitspensum von mindestens 80 % in einer modernen Arbeitsumgebung einzusetzen und die pharmazeutische Industrie kennenzulernen.

• Du verfügst über eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, ein hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative sowie eine selbstständige, genaue und nachvollziehbare Arbeitsweise.

• Du zeigst Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

• Du bringst Kreativität, Ideenreichtum und Innovationsgeist mit.

• Du zeichnest Dich durch hohe Teamfähigkeit, Lösungsorientierung sowie eine kollaborative Arbeitsweise aus.

• Du hast eine teamorientierte Denkweise mit dem Blick auf die stetige Verbesserung von Prozessen.

• Von Vorteil: Du hast Interesse daran, selbstständig Trainings durchzuführen.

• Du besitzt fliessende Deutschkenntnisse und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse für den Arbeitsalltag in Wort und Schrift.

Bewerbungsprozess
Deine Bewerbung muss einen Lebenslauf und ein Motivationsschreiben enthalten.

Zusätzliche Information

• ​Bitte beachte, aufgrund von Vorschriften müssen Nicht-EU/EFTA-Bürger als Teil der Bewerbungsunterlagen eine Bescheinigung der Universität vorlegen, aus der hervorgeht, dass ein Praktikum verpflichtend ist, sowie die Dauer des Pflichtpraktikums

• Standort: Kaiseraugst, Schweiz

• Start: November 2026

• Dauer: 12 Monate

• Pensum: 80-100%

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Specialist Process Operations (m/w/d) / auf 2 Jahre befristet

Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Das Team
Für unser Team in der biotechnologischen Pharmaproduktion suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Specialist Process Operations für das Steuern und Nachbereiten von geplanten und ungeplanten Prozessereignissen. Als Team aus Fachexpertinnen und Fachexperten betreuen wir den Herstell- und Freigabeprozess in der Fermentation von Anzucht bis zur Ernte.

Das erwartet Dich

• Change-Management: Du steuerst die Bewertung, Planung und termingerechte Umsetzung von geplanten Prozessänderungen (Changes) in der biotechnologischen Produktion.

• Abweichungsmanagement (Deviations): Du leitest die strukturierte Bearbeitung, Ursachenanalyse (Root Cause Analysis) und Nachbereitung ungeplanter Ereignisse und stellen die regulatorische Compliance sicher.

• Technical Writing: Du verfasst und überarbeitest präzise GMP-Dokumente, Untersuchungsberichte sowie Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) auf Deutsch und Englisch.

• Schnittstellen- & Projektarbeit: Du steuerst fachübergreifende Optimierungsprojekte mit agilen Methoden und arbeitest eng mit der Qualitätssicherung (QA), Produktion und Technik zusammen. Die Produktion befindet sich in einem regulierten Bereich mit gesonderten Hygienevorgaben.

Das bringst du mit

• Qualifikation: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes naturwissenschaftliches Studium (z. B. Biotechnologie, Biochemie, Bioprozesstechnik) oder eine naturwissenschaftlich-technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum/zur staatlich geprüften Techniker/in.

• Berufserfahrung: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der biotechnologischen Produktion mit fundierten Kenntnissen im Bereich der Zellfermentation sowie im Qualitätsmanagement (GMP).

• Arbeitsweise: Exzellente Kenntnisse im agilen Arbeiten und im klassischen Projektmanagement.

• Persönlichkeit: Stark in der lösungsorientierten Kommunikation, durchsetzungsstark bei Qualitätsentscheidungen, belastbar unter Termindruck und konfliktfähig im Schnittstellenmanagement.

• Kommunikation: Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in der schriftlichen Dokumentation und präzisem Technical Writing.

• Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch C1, Englisch B2 .

Deine Arbeit findet teilweise in einer Reinraumumgebung statt – das bedeutet: Arbeitssicherheit, Hygiene und GMP haben bei uns höchste Priorität. Um unsere strengen Qualitätsstandards einzuhalten, trägst du spezielle Schutzkleidung wie Overall, Kopfhaube, Bartbinde (falls erforderlich) und Schutzbrille. Körperschmuck (z.B. Ringe, Ohrringe, Piercings, Nagellack und Nagel-Applikationen) oder Make-up darf im Reinraum nicht getragen werden – so stellen wir sicher, dass unsere Produkte jederzeit den höchsten Anforderungen entsprechen.

Die Position ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung
Ganz pragmatisch: Bitte lade online nur Deinen Lebenslauf hoch.
Zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt benötigen wir kein Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse oder Ähnliches.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinz

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Director, Commercial Training
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
As a key member of the Training and Development Leadership Team, you'll shape the vision and strategy for sales, marketing, and commercial talent development at Roche Diagnostics. You'll lead all Commercial training initiatives—partnering with senior stakeholders to understand their needs and deliver solutions that directly impact revenue goals and competitive positioning. Your global perspective ensures consistent, effective partnership development across the organization.
In this role, you will:

• provide strategic oversight and management supporting the Roche Diagnostics Commercial's sales and marketing training needs and T&D initiatives that equip teams with future ready capabilities

• foster a culture of growth by actively seeking and offering feedback, providing meaningful coaching and guidance, and creating clear development pathways for your team

• align all training initiatives with Roche's mission and vision, anticipate future commercial needs, and proactively adapt strategies to evolving business priorities and organizational changes

• serve as a trusted thought leader and advisor across Training and Development and throughout the entire Commercial organization

• partner with global colleagues to standardize training content and ensure consistent development across the organization

This Indianapolis-based position requires 25% travel to support business meetings, customer engagement, and stakeholder collaboration.

Who You Are:

• BS/BA in business, organizational development, related technical, scientific, marketing, sales or related fields

• 10 years of professional experience in related technical, training, sales or marketing

• 5 years of leadership experience or equivalent

• 5 years of previous training experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Strong knowledge of product development, regulatory and clinical affairs

• Strong grasp/understanding of customers, products and the dynamics of the diagnostics market

• Previous field management experience in the pharmaceutical, medical diagnostics or related industry

• Creates and manages sales training budget and headcount utilization

• People leadership experience managing and developing a team of direct reports

• Previous experience leading large-scale business planning processes, including development and implementation of strategies, plans, goals and metrics

• Experience with global commercial teams

Relocation benefits are available for this job posting

jobs.title: Clinical Scientist - Late Stage Development (Ophthalmology)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Clinical Scientist - Late Stage Development in Ophthalmology , you will support our cross-functional molecule and study teams in executing clinical strategies and Phase 2-3 clinical trials to deliver medically differentiated therapies for patients. Working closely with experienced Clinical Scientists and Medical Directors, you will contribute directly to study documentation, medical data reviews, and regulatory submissions.

• Contribute to the preparation and writing of Clinical Development Plans (CDPs), protocols, informed consent forms (ICFs), and Case Report Forms (CRFs).

• Conduct ongoing medical and safety data reviews to ensure accurate data interpretation and support study reporting.

• Support clinical trial application (CTA) submissions, briefing packs, and written responses to Health Authority inquiries.

• Collaborate with study site personnel to optimize trial conduct and resolve clinical queries effectively.

• Present study updates and clinical science insights at internal cross-functional meetings, investigator meetings, and scientific events.

• Assist in drafting abstracts, posters, and presentation materials for external scientific conferences.

Who You Are

You are a detail-oriented, curious life science professional eager to grow your career within clinical drug development. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are passionate about translating scientific insights into meaningful health solutions.

• Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences required; an advanced degree (e.g., PhD, PharmD, Master’s in Life Sciences or Public Health) is strongly preferred.

• Basic understanding of global clinical trial execution, including GCP (Good Clinical Practice) and regulatory frameworks (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA).

• Broad foundational knowledge of multidisciplinary functions involved in drug development.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize complex clinical information clearly.

• Collaborative mindset with demonstrated ability to contribute effectively within dynamic team settings.

How to Apply

Ready to join our team? Please submit the following documents: Updated CV, Cover Letter, Copy of your Higher Education Diploma

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als (Senior) Engineer für DC Device Systems (m/w/d) startest Du an unserem Standort Mannheim im Team „System Integration & Verification“ innerhalb der Forschung & Entwicklung. Mit Deinem Know-how und Deinem Talent bringst Du Test-Expertise direkt in die Produktentwicklung ein. In einem agilen Umfeld gestaltest Du aktiv die Zuverlässigkeit und Sicherheit unserer Medizinprodukte mit, um das Leben von Patienten:innen weltweit zu verbessern. In dieser Rolle bist Du die treibende Kraft für System Verifizierung und stellst sicher, dass unsere Innovationen den höchsten Qualitätsstandards entsprechen.

Unser Team verbindet tiefes Systemverständnis mit echter Begeisterung für technische Exzellenz und hochwertige Medizinprodukte. Durch unsere interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit schaffen wir Lösungen, die komplexe Anforderungen zuverlässig in praxistaugliche Ergebnisse übersetzen. Dabei treiben uns Neugier, Qualitätsbewusstsein und der Anspruch an, jedes Detail so zu gestalten, dass es im späteren Einsatz einen spürbaren Unterschied macht.

Das erwartet Dich in der Rolle

• Du leitest die Erstellung von Teststrategien und Verifizierungsplänen für komplexe Medizinprodukte (MD/IVD) nach regulatorischen Vorgaben und kannst eine Matrix Rolle in Projekten übernehmen.

• Übersetzung von Produktanforderungen und Produktdesign in Testanforderungen unter Berücksichtigung relevanter Normen sowie Bewertung der Designaktivitäten hinsichtlich ihrer Konformität.

• Du führst funktionale Systemtests durch, bewertest und präsentierst die Ergebnisse zur Sicherstellung der Robustheit unserer Gesamtsysteme und agierst als Subject Matter Expert in Audits.

• Du arbeitest eng und operativ mit Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Operations, Product Management, Complaint Handling Team und externen Partnern wie akkreditierten Laboren zusammen.

• Weiterentwicklung der Testinfrastruktur, Qualifizierung der Prüfmittel und Einführung moderner Testmethoden nach dem Stand der Technik.

• Du führst funktionale Systemtests durch und bewertest und präsentierst die Ergebnisse, um die Robustheit unserer Gesamtsysteme sicherzustellen.

Wer du bist

• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Master-Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwissenschaften (z. B. Medizintechnik, Elektrotechnik, Nachrichtentechnik) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von regulierten Produkten, idealerweise im Bereich Medizintechnik oder In-Vitro-Diagnostika (MD/IVD).

• Du bist sicher in der Anwendung technischer Normen und hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Prüflabore.

• Freude an der Arbeit in einer Matrixorganisation und du bist erfahren in agilen Methoden (z. B. SAFe).

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, um in unserem internationalen Umfeld erfolgreich zu agieren.

Deine Bewerbung

Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf und relevante Zeugnisse.

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Data Advisory and Insights Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Senior Data Advisory & Insights Specialist is responsible for leading, translating business challenges into analytical problems, and delivering data-driven insights and actionable recommendations to stakeholders. This role involves independently conducting comprehensive data analysis, developing compelling visualizations, preparing detailed reports, and presenting findings to various business units to inform strategic and operational decisions. In this role, you will act as a key liaison between data teams and business functions, ensuring that insights are clearly understood and leveraged for maximum impact.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Leads data analysis projects and delivers high-value insights. Works independently on specific projects from inception to completion.

• Accountability/Problem Solving : Solves complex business problems using data. Validates insights and ensures their accuracy with no supervision required.

• Stakeholder Management : Manages direct communication with key business stakeholders regarding analytical findings. Engages proactively with broader business units to thoroughly understand their data needs.

• Impact/Strategy: Drives medium- to large-sized projects that directly influence business decisions. Ensures that analysis projects are closely aligned with broader business strategy and goals.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Handles more complex datasets and multifaceted analysis tasks. Develops comprehensive reports and interactive dashboards to support business needs.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate complex insights effectively. Demonstrates proficiency in data visualization tools and advanced data analysis techniques.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience independently conducting comprehensive data analysis and managing medium- to large-sized projects that influence business decisions.

• Proven track record of translating business challenges into analytical problems and delivering actionable, data-driven recommendations.

• Experience acting as a key liaison between data teams and business functions, ensuring insights inform strategic and operational decisions.

Technical Skills

• Proficient in utilizing data visualization tools to develop compelling visualizations and comprehensive dashboards.

• Strong expertise in advanced data analysis techniques and handling more complex datasets.

• Ability to independently validate insights and ensure high data accuracy.

Additional Qualifications

• Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to manage direct communication with key business stakeholders and present findings to various business units.

• Strong analytical mindset with a focus on ensuring complex insights are understood by non-technical audiences and leveraged for maximum impact.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
