jobs.title: Senior Analyst (Data Strategy & Acquisition)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Analyst (Data Strategy & Acquisition)
Roche India - Roche Services and Solutions
Hyderabad / Chennai

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

The Opportunity:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise in the external healthcare data ecosystem and contribute to decisions that shape how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.

You will be exposed to a broad range of U.S. healthcare and pharmaceutical data sources, including payer, market access, sales, claims, alerts, field, competitive intelligence, and market intelligence datasets. You will learn how these datasets are created, how they differ from one another, where they are strong, where they have limitations, and how they can be applied to real business questions.

You will work closely with U.S. stakeholders, external data vendors, and cross-functional Roche teams. The role provides a strong platform to develop skills in data strategy, vendor evaluation, stakeholder consultation, business problem-solving, and structured communication.

This opportunity is well suited for candidates with a life sciences, pharma, healthcare analytics, consulting, market research, business research, or commercial analytics background who are interested in moving into a broader data strategy and acquisition role. The role will allow you to develop the ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, assess business fit, and support informed data-related decisions.

Key Responsibilities

• Support the evaluation, acquisition, and ongoing management of external healthcare and commercial data sources used by Roche U.S. business teams.

• Work with U.S. stakeholders to understand business needs, clarify use cases, and translate business questions into data requirements or evaluation criteria.

• Evaluate new and existing datasets and vendors based on business relevance, data coverage, methodology, usability, quality, limitations, and fit-for-purpose application.

• Support the assessment and maintenance of payer intelligence datasets, including sources such as MMIT and DRG Fingertip, to address commercial and market access business needs.

• Support the evaluation of sales, claims, alert-based, field, competitive intelligence, and market intelligence datasets from vendors such as IQVIA, Komodo Health, Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group, NCCN, and similar healthcare data sources.

• Partner with external data vendors to understand source methodologies, resolve data-related questions, clarify deliverables, and support timely access to high-quality datasets.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to onboard datasets, document business requirements, track evaluation findings, and support decision-making around data investments.

• Apply structured thinking to assess whether a dataset can answer the intended business question, identify potential gaps or risks, and recommend practical next steps.

• Challenge assumptions and provide constructive pushback when data sources, methodologies, or stakeholder re

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Our DP manufacturing network (PTM) plays a critical role in bringing innovative medicines to patients. We own day-to-day DP operations, maintain end-to-end visibility of product flows and quality, and ensure a clear line of sight to patient impact. Our network spans 5 sites, encompassing both DP and finished goods (FG) operations.

The Opportunity
As the Data & Digital and Strategic Programs Leader, you will step into a pivotal strategic role within the PTM Business Operations and Manufacturing Excellence function. In this role, you will define and execute the global digital and operational excellence strategy for the Drug Product (DP) network, ensuring manufacturing priorities align closely with enterprise goals. Acting as a catalyst for value delivery, you will drive digital transformation, project management excellence, and performance accountability across our internal and external global facilities.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive Digital Strategy & Advanced Analytics: Lead the Digital Roadmap for the DP network, establishing robust data governance and steering the AI translation and transition roadmap to accelerate digital adoption.

• Orchestrate the Strategic PMO: Oversee the PMO function for the Operational Excellence Roadmap, implementing rigorous governance, tracking mechanisms, and network-wide change management strategies.

• Foster an Improvement Culture: Cultivate a high-performing, agile culture with a relentless focus on continuous improvement, mentoring global leaders to embed operational discipline.

• Advance Capability Building: Collaborate closely with the Learning Academy to integrate critical digital skills and Lean/Six Sigma methodologies into the organizational framework.

• Deploy Global S&OP Processes: Lead the global deployment of the PTM Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process to optimize supply-demand alignment, capacity utilization, and operational resilience.

• Lead Business & Stakeholder Integration: Deeply align with key internal technical, quality, and commercial functions, while coordinating manufacturing inputs for Business Development and Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) alliances.

• Connect with External Networks: Establish and maintain active connections with external industry experts and peers to integrate specialized knowledge and best practices across the network.

Who You Are
You are a strategic and analytical leader who excels at translating complex opportunities into concrete, structured execution plans. You possess strong personal judgment, tackle ambiguous problems with data-driven insights, and comfortably orchestrate multiple complex activities simultaneously within a global matrix environment.

Qualifications & Experience:

• Extensive Tech Ops Leadership: 15 or more years of progressive leadership experience within a global pharmaceutical manufacturing environment, spanning full-stack Technical Operations (Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering, and Quality).

• Digital & Strategic Acumen: A proven track record of defining and executing digital transformation roadmaps, including advanced data analytics and AI implementation.

• Business & Financial Expertise: Deep understanding of the end-to-end value chain and profit and loss (P&L) management, with significant experience governing large operational and capital budgets.

jobs.title: Solutions Owner, Customer Engagement & CRM
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solutions Owner for Customer Engagement & CRM is responsible for the end-to-end integrity and strategic effectiveness of the UK's CRM ecosystem. You are the vital bridge between global platform design and local tactical execution, and the UK's expert voice on CRM. You are both a technical expert and a change agent.

While a central global team manages the core infrastructure, you serve as the UK's subject-matter expert, influencing global builds, driving adoption and acting as the hands-on escalation point for diagnosing and resolving issues. You will be the pivotal lead for the launch of our new CRM in 2027, guiding the affiliate to evolve its mindset and operational approach, not just its technology. A separate Data team handles management of the underlying data lake.

The Opportunity:

Your focus is to keep the CRM optimised, reliable and genuinely valued by the teams who depend on it.

• You serve as the primary advocate and face of the CRM within the UK affiliate.

• You maintain deep knowledge of system architecture to diagnose and troubleshoot issues independently.

• You partner with global and central support teams to orchestrate resolutions and ensure continuous availability.

• You act as the UK lead subject-matter expert influencing the global product roadmap.

• You leverage and promote AI integrations within the CRM to improve user experience and performance.

• You partner Marketers, Medical Affairs and Field teams to define requirements and maximise their use of the system.

• You lead upskilling and mentorship, and oversee governance for data integrity and industry codes.

Who you are:

• You bring deep, hands-on experience in the backend of life-sciences CRM platforms, including data schemas, logic flows and configuration.

• You have proven experience managing complex territory alignments and field-force structures within a CRM.

• You can move from a strategic conversation to a technical session on system logic without losing commercial context.

• You navigate global organisations to advocate for local technical needs.

• You are happy to be strategic and ready to be tactical, comfortable doing admin work when the business needs it.

Preferred:

• Experience with Veeva CRM.

• Deep understanding of the IQVIA OneKey dataset and its use in CRM ecosystems.

• Experience of global-to-local software release management.

• Experience with Salesforce.

Apply now and power the customer connections that bring our medicines to more patients. Help us lead the next era of engagement.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Journey Orchestrator
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Journey Orchestrator engineers and deploys world-class customer experiences. You are the architect of the logic that connects our brands with healthcare professionals and patients, translating the vision from Marketers, Medical Affairs and Field teams into functional, automated and personalised journeys. You build in our CRM and marketing automation platforms.

This role sits at the intersection of data, technology and customer experience. You will build complex journey flows, use data for precise segmentation, and rigorously test every interaction across multiple therapy areas, while coaching colleagues to handle simple builds themselves so you can focus on high-complexity engineering.

The Opportunity:

Your focus is to make every automated journey technically perfect before it ever reaches a customer.

• You build and manage complex conditional logic for automated email flows, webinar invitations and field-triggered interactions.

• You lead end-to-end testing, verifying links, data triggers and branching logic before deployment.

• You ensure a customer's experience across web, email and field interactions is technically linked and consistent.

• You transform Medical and Marketing campaign briefs into sophisticated customer segments.

• You act as the primary link to global operational teams, directing tactical builds while owning quality of the UK output.

• You train Marketing and Medical Affairs colleagues to build their own simple journeys.

• You create and maintain a library of self-service journey templates that meet technical and compliance standards.

Who you are:

• You bring deep, hands-on experience in the backend of CRM and marketing automation tools.

• You are comfortable with data logic, customer segmentation and multi-step journey building.

• You take a disciplined approach to quality assurance and take pride in finding errors before customers do.

• You understand customer data structures well enough to create actionable segments from business briefs.

• You communicate clearly and can train non-technical colleagues in complex system processes.

Preferred:

• Direct experience with Adobe Campaign or Journey Optimiser, and Veeva CRM.

• Experience working across multiple therapy areas simultaneously.

• Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

• Working knowledge of HTML and CSS.

Join us and design the journeys that bring our science closer to patients. Apply now to build experiences that matter.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. The Position
The Solutions Owner for Commercial Analytics is responsible for the design and integrity of the UK's commercial analytics products. Your focus is the last mile of data: the dashboards, performance suites and visualisation tools built on top of the data lake. You ensure Marketers, Medical Affairs and Field teams have high-performance products to answer their commercial questions.

jobs.title: Commercial Solutions Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Commercial Solutions Lead is a specialised leadership role responsible for the operational integrity of the UK's customer-engagement infrastructure. You lead a high-performing team of Solution Owners and Journey Orchestrators to deliver robust digital platforms, seamless data flows and innovative GenAI tools. Your mandate is to lead a multi-year transition toward using data, analytics, AI and digital most effectively to deliver business outcomes.

You own the technical roadmap and operational health of the entire UK commercial toolkit that enables world-class customer engagement. You will position the UK as a global centre for commercial innovation, partnering with the Data Team to keep platforms powered by clean, real-time, compliant data, and serving as the primary UK technical stakeholder for global product teams.

The Opportunity:

Your focus is to build the integrated technology ecosystem that lets marketing, medical affairs, sales and field teams win.

• You direct a team of five, including three Solution Owners and two Journey Orchestrators, fostering technical excellence and agile delivery.

• You oversee the lifecycle of our MarTech stack, ensuring CRM, marketing automation and analytics tools are fit for purpose.

• You define what good looks like for our technical products, owning backlogs and delivery cycles.

• You lead the technical deployment of GenAI and automated marketing models.

• You are accountable for the technical guardrails that ensure automated compliance across digital and field interactions.

• You identify and decommission redundant local tools to streamline the UK commercial engine.

• You drive organisation-wide mindset shifts so new commercial solutions are genuinely adopted.

Who you are:

• You have led specialised technical teams and navigated complex, matrixed global environments.

• You bring expert-level knowledge of the CRM and marketing-automation ecosystem, such as Veeva and Adobe.

• You understand deeply how integrated technology stacks drive sales outcomes and patient access.

• You manage complex software lifecycles and technical roadmaps with exceptional agility.

• You have driven digital transformation and organisational change that delivered high technology adoption.

Preferred:

• Proven success leading omnichannel infrastructure design in a complex matrix.

• Experience influencing global product owners to secure local priorities.

• Familiarity with PowerBI or Tableau, enterprise data lakes and GenAI commercial models.

Relocation:

Relocation support is available for internal Roche candidates moving to the UK from another Roche affiliate.

Join us and build the technology that helps more patients benefit from our medicines. Apply now to shape our digital future.

jobs.title: Events Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Events Lead is the strategic and operational lead for the UK's physical and hybrid event engagement footprint. Reporting to the Head of Marketing & Commercial Solutions, you lead a team of specialised Partners to deliver world-class experiences at national and international congresses and events, and internal events. You ensure every event is a data-driven, customer-centred touchpoint.

You will build on the high-performing foundations of the current function, driving continuous modernisation and using data and technology to deepen customer engagement. This is a high-visibility role at the heart of our scientific and commercial presence, where events are treated as part of a continuous loop of learning, execution and engagement rather than endpoints in a customer journey.

The Opportunity:

Your focus is to architect the UK's presence at scientific meetings while growing your team into strategic partners.

• You line-manage and coach the Events & Congress Partners, owning their growth, performance and wellbeing.

• You oversee the strategic calendar of UK events, ensuring high-quality execution and consistent brand standards across therapy areas.

• You close capability gaps in digital integration, data analytics and advanced project management.

• You champion the Patient Voice in congress environments, ensuring booths and meetings focus on real-world impact.

• You lead our commitment to green events, reducing waste through modular design and digital-first content.

• You are accountable for adherence to ABPI, local procedures, data-protection and global compliance standards.

• You cultivate high-value strategic agency partnerships spanning creative, audio-visual, travel and housing services.

Who you are:

• You bring a proven track record of line-managing and developing a specialised team of events professionals.

• You have significant experience leading large-scale pharmaceutical events or congresses, nationally and internationally.

• You combine deep understanding of the ABPI Code with the ability to connect event activity to business results.

• You influence senior stakeholders across Marketing and Medical Affairs and manage complex external vendor networks.

• You maintain agile resourcing models that flex to peak congress cycles and evolving portfolio needs.

Preferred:

• Experience partnering technical teams on event platforms and data capture.

• Experience leading sustainability initiatives.

• Experience with global event management platforms such as Cvent and hybrid engagement tools.

Apply now and create the experiences that connect science with the patients who need it. Join a team that sets the standard.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Methodology Coaching . Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Business Value & Success Factors: Understanding the business goals and value of the project to deliver defined organizational benefits, while ensuring critical success factors (reliability, compliance, efficiency, sustainability, time-to-value) are managed throughout the entire lifecycle.

• Methodology & Execution: Using the appropriate methodology (Waterfall, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) to manage dependencies and set clear priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Global Team Leadership: Leading or participating in global project teams by ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and precise resource assignment to project plan deliverables.

• Stakeholder & Change Management: Effectively managing stakeholders and understanding their organizations to establish key relationships, while applying organizational change management practices and ensuring effective project communication.

• Facilitation & Coaching: Designing and leading workshops, acting as a proactive facilitator, and serving as a comfortable coach for project squads.

• Planning & Risk Management: Generating, maintaining, and tracking an accurate and realistic project plan alongside a project risk and issue log, ensuring the project status remains timely and transparent.

• Governance & Reporting: Preparing and presenting to relevant governance meetings as required by the chosen project methodology and good project management practice.

• Financial Control: Tracking project financials and seeking governance approvals whenever needed.

• Business Development: Contributing to business development opportunities where appropriate

Capability Building
Be an active member of the Methodology Coaching Chapter by

• Continuously improve the project management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics

• Supporting the development of training content and toolkits for our team

• Actively managing your project management upskilling

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your chapter colleagues

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

• Appropriate university degree and 5+ years of project management related work experience

• Deep understanding of project management fundamentals (Waterfall) and agile ways of working (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe), alon

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Impacto Sostenible
Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones.

La Oportunidad
Líder en la generación e implementación de estrategias que permitan conocer, mejorar, optimizar y gestionar el “Patient Journey” para las Áreas Terapéuticas asignadas, orquestando los recursos necesarios para generar valor e impacto en el ecosistema.

Responsabilidades

• Actúa como socio de confianza y punto de contacto principal (no exclusivo) entre las partes interesadas y Roche de las áreas terapéuticas a su cargo.

• Actúa con pensamiento sistémico para asociarse y trabajar estrechamente con los stakeholders clave (HCPs, tomadores de decisión, pagadores, etc.) del patient journey.

• Rol de alto nivel que apoya la toma de decisiones en conjunto con los squads para solicitar recursos de Roche al equipo de finanzas y/o ET con el fin de impactar el outcome.

• Adopta el rol de Product Owner para liderar la gestión de outcomes de corto plazo.

Quién eres

• Profesional de la salud en Medicina o Farmacia.

• Experiencia en roles con responsabilidades que incluyan planes y proyecciones estratégicas de ventas, manejo de clientes. Conocimiento de la experiencia de los pacientes y de los tratamientos.

• Profundo conocimiento general sobre el proceso local de contratación administrativa.

• Pensamiento sistémico, estratégico y escucha activa.

• Comprensión práctica de las metodologías de innovación digital y/o Customer Centricity.

• Conocimiento para interpretar estudios clínicos en inglés.

Deseable

• Experiencia institucional.

• Experiencia en las siguientes áreas terapéuticas: Hematología Maligna & Hemofilia.

• Facilidad de adopción tecnológica.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: ERP Business Analyst - Management Accounting
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
As a Technical Consultant , you will bridge the gap between business and IT, translating complex needs into SAP functional specifications and technical roadmaps. Working within a defined business strategy, you will specialize in the interpretation and consistent application of global cost controlling/ management accounting requirements within the S/4HANA environment. Leveraging your SAP FICO expertise, you will execute critical initiatives focused on how accounting data is captured, stored, and securely transferred to local authorities or external systems. You will ensure global system stability and compliance by delivering high-quality Features and User Stories within the SAFe methodology , using tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, and Solman

Description of the area
This role focuses on the governance and optimization of global cost controlling/management accounting within the SAP ecosystem. A central pillar of this area is the management of the Finance and Controlling, Cost Allocation and Period End Closing and ensuring data integrity across the S/4HANA landscape. Our mission is to provide a robust framework for capturing and storing accounting data, facilitating its secure and consistent transfer to external systems and regulatory bodies, while proactively seeking innovative solutions for long-term scalability
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership)
Consults teams and squads on diverse offerings. This involves shaping strategy for complex products, influencing approaches, and managing prioritization and status reporting across the enterprise. Maintain deep knowledge of the SAP FI CO (Cost Center Accounting; Profit Center Accounting; Project System; Profitability Analysis; CATS and Service Management) inclusive driving the integration and interfaces with other landscapes.

• Accountability/Problem Solving
Drives innovative solutions for complex challenges, influencing strategy and contributing to organizational growth. Makes impactful decisions, resolves unprecedented problems, and fosters convergence while utilizing frameworks to align priorities across consulting teams and squads. Aligned with industry best practices and organizational requirements, for new features, enhancements, and deployments for the effective and efficient in Cost Controlling & Management Accounting. Drive Global template implementations, localization of processes and compliance as per Financial needs to ensure the ICFR and any compliances are met.

• Stakeholder Management
Manages high-level relationships with and engages senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment and managing expectations. Communicates complex and strategic information, issues, and solutions across the enterprise or multiple large business portfolios, tailoring messaging and mastering communication channels. Analyze business needs and translate them into detailed requirements for the implementations and roll outs to the affiliates.

• Impact/Strategy
This role drives strategy application, shapes product roadmaps, and influences domain-level strategy. This individual provides consistent leadership and significant impact on complex products, mastering coaching to develop others, and enabling great participation within consulting teams and squads.

• Complexity/ (Product Size)
Works on high-impact, multi-faceted projects and provides highly innovative solutions for unusually complex problems. Leads extremely complex projects with enterprise-wide implications, anticipating changing business needs,

In qualità di professionista degli affari regolamentari internazionali a Roche, sarete responsabili di:

• Conoscenza approfondita dei requisiti normativi globali, delle linee guida e delle procedure in particolare per gli strumenti IVD e il software

• Forte capacità organizzative e di comunicazione

• Capacità di multitask e gestire efficacemente più progetti contemporaneamente

• Automotivata e capace di lavorare in modo indipendente in un ambiente di autogestione

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di strumenti e/o software IVD idealmente nello spazio di automazione del laboratorio.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
- pour la version allemande voir ci-dessous -

Votre nouvelle équipe

Roche cherche une personne dynamique et très motivée pour rejoindre notre équipe en tant que professionnel des affaires réglementaires internationales. Nous sommes à la recherche de candidats qui apportent un esprit novateur et créatif à la table, ainsi qu'une expérience éprouvée dans le domaine des affaires réglementaires. Si vous êtes passionné par un impact positif sur les soins de santé mondiaux grâce à l'excellence réglementaire, nous vous invitons à faire partie de notre équipe dédiée.

Principales responsabilités
En tant que professionnel de la réglementation internationale chez Roche, vous serez responsable :

• Diriger et soutenir des stratégies réglementaires pour les instruments et les logiciels de DIV/MD mondiaux, en particulier dans l'environnement d'automatisation de laboratoire interclients

• Assurer le respect des exigences et normes réglementaires internationales

• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, y compris la R-D, la qualité et la clinique, pour mener des initiatives réglementaires

• Fournir des conseils réglementaires pour appuyer le développement de produits et la gestion du cycle de vie

• Se tenir au courant de l'évolution des tendances et des mises à jour de la réglementation et mettre en oeuvre les pratiques exemplaires

Exigences

• Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie, affaires réglementaires ou domaine connexe

• 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en affaires réglementaires (réglementation, R-D, qualité et/ou clinique), avec une certaine expérience en affaires réglementaires en soins de santé

• Connaissance approfondie des exigences réglementaires, des lignes directrices et des procédures mondiales, en particulier pour les instruments et logiciels de DIV

• Compétences solides en matière d ' organisation et de communication

• Capacité à multitâcher et gérer efficacement plusieurs projets simultanément

• Automotivé et capable de travailler indépendamment dans un environnement d'autogestion

• Expérience dans le développement d'instruments et/ou de logiciels IVD idéalement dans l'espace Automatisation de laboratoire.

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature!

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Oportunidad:

Desarrollo de Proyectos de Optimización

• Liderar iniciativas para la optimización de procesos, automatización y búsqueda constante de eficiencias.

Soporte a Procesos Administrativos y Logísticos:

• Brindar soporte integral en áreas administrativas, logísticas y operativas.

• Ejemplos: compras, selección y evaluación de proveedores,
cierres de eventos, comunicaciones internas y gestión de contratos.

Gestión de Plataformas SAP y Similares:

• Uso de plataforma SAP y similares para los módulos de Procurement, Master Data, Compras y Contratación.

• Uso de plataformas del ambiente google

Análisis de Datos y Medición de KPIs:

• Realizar análisis de datos, elaborar reportes detallados y medir indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPIs) para informar decisiones estratégicas.

• Análisis e identificación de oportunidades de mejora para los procesos operativos de la compañía

Quien eres

• Estudiante de las carreras de Ingeniería Industrial o Administración de Empresas

• Inglés intermedio

• Disponibilidad de laborar jornada continua.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Validation Lead - RDT Artificial Intelligence

AI validation is one of the most complex and consequential emerging disciplines in enterprise technology - and there is no established playbook. As Validation Lead within RDT Artificial Intelligence, you will help write it.

This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge AI systems and the rigorous compliance standards of one of the world’s leading healthcare companies. You will design and implement the validation frameworks, risk strategies, and governance programs that ensure our AI platforms - from LLM-powered applications to autonomous agentic systems - are safe, auditable, and compliant at enterprise scale.

Validating AI is fundamentally different from validating traditional software. Models evolve, agents make decisions, and outputs are probabilistic. The stakes in healthcare are high. This role offers a genuinely rare opportunity to build expertise and set standards in a space that regulators, industry peers, and technology leaders are still figuring out - with the resources of a global enterprise behind you.

The Opportunity

1. AI Validation Strategy &Compliance

• Validation Framework Design: Develop and implement comprehensive validation strategies for AI and ML systems, including LLMs, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows -applying risk-based approaches appropriate to the novelty and complexity of each system.

• Regulatory Alignment: Translate evolving regulatory guidance (FDA, EMA, GxP frameworks) into practical validation standards for AI systems used in research, diagnostics, and enterprise operations. Ensure our platforms remain audit-ready as the regulatory landscape matures.

• Policy & Documentation: Improve and maintain validation policies, procedures, and qualification documentation - ensuring they reflect both current best practice and the unique characteristics of AI-driven systems.

2. Risk Management & Incident Response

• AI Risk Assessment: Lead complex risk assessments for AI platform deployments, identifying failure modes specific to probabilistic systems - including model drift, hallucination risks, and agentic decision failures - and designing mitigation strategies accordingly.

• Critical Incident Leadership: Lead responses to compliance and continuity events affecting AI systems, conducting post-incident reviews to strengthen validation controls and prevent recurrence.

• Business Continuity: Develop and test continuity and recovery plans for AI-dependent processes, ensuring resilience across the enterprise AI ecosystem.

3. Stakeholder Engagement & Governance

• Expert Advisory: Act as the internal authority on AI validation and compliance - advising product teams, architects, and senior leadership on what it takes to deploy AI responsibly in a regulated environment.

• Audit & Oversight: Facilitate internal and external audits relating to AI systems, managing relationships with high-level stakeholders and regulators with confidence and technical credibility.

• Capability Building: Train teams on advanced validation techniques, risk management practices, and Business Continuity Management (BCM) in the context of AI - building organisational capability as the function scales.

4. Enterprise Tooling & Scalability

• Tool Selection & Integration: Evaluate and select enterprise validation and compliance tooling suited to AI systems, ensuring solutions scale with the pace of AI adoption across Roche.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Piombo di convalida - RDT intelligenza artificiale

Come Conducente di Convalida progettare e implementare la resilienza IT completa, la gestione del rischio e le strategie di conformità allineate agli obiettivi aziendali. Potrai condurre valutazioni di rischio complesse, sviluppare programmi di audit e continuità raffinati, e stabilire le migliori pratiche per gestire le interruzioni critiche e la conformità normativa. Facendo da consulente esperto per gli stakeholder di alto livello, condurrai le risposte agli incidenti critici e garantirai la scalabilità e la protezione futura delle soluzioni di rischio e continuità a livello aziendale.

L'opportunità

• Scope / (Content Leadership): sviluppa strategie di gestione del rischio, conformità e continuità e piani di recupero. Migliora le politiche esistenti per migliorare l'efficacia e i quadri di conformità. Conduce la formazione avanzata sulle best practice di rischio, audit e Business Continuity Management (BCM) e recensioni e documentazione di aggiornamento per l'accuratezza.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: porta le risposte ai rischi IT critici, agli audit e agli eventi di continuità. Stabilisce le migliori pratiche per la gestione delle interruzioni e dei problemi di conformità. Conduce recensioni post-incident/post-mortem per identificare le aree per il miglioramento e formare i membri del team sulle tecniche avanzate di problem solving.

• Stakeholder Management: gestisce i rapporti con gli stakeholder di alto livello e facilita le riunioni per discutere di conformità, questioni di audit e continuità. Atti sul feedback per migliorare le strategie e assicura l'allineamento delle politiche di rischio e di continuità con le esigenze degli stakeholder.

• Impatto/Strategia: Sviluppa strategie di rischio, audit, conformità e continuità dettagliate allineate agli obiettivi aziendali, adattando le politiche per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali in evoluzione. Collabora con la leadership per allineare gli obiettivi e fornisce informazioni strategiche basate sulle migliori pratiche del settore.

• Complessità/ (dimensione del prodotto): supervisiona le strategie per iniziative di rischio, conformità e continuità a livello aziendale. Garantisce la scalabilità delle soluzioni, integra le politiche con i sistemi esistenti e valuta e seleziona gli strumenti per la gestione aziendale.

• Capacità commerciale/tecnica: Serve come esperto nella gestione del rischio, nell'audit, nella conformità e nelle tecnologie di continuità e nelle loro applicazioni aziendali. Si basa sulle strategie per supportare le funzioni aziendali, fornisce informazioni sulle migliori pratiche ai leader aziendali e garantisce la scalabilità e la protezione futura delle tecnologie rilevanti.

Chi sei

Istruzione e esperienza

• Ampia esperienza nella progettazione e nell'implementazione di strategie di resilienza IT, leader di valutazioni di rischio complesse e nello sviluppo di programmi di audit.

• Provato il record di gestione delle relazioni con gli stakeholder di alto livello e collaborando con la leadership per allineare i rischi e gli obiettivi di continuità.

Competenze tecniche

• Competenza nelle tecnologie di gestione del rischio, audit, conformità e continuità aziendale e nelle loro applicazioni in un contesto aziendale.

• Forte capacità di valutare e selezionare gli strumenti aziendali e garantire la scalabilità e la protezione futura delle soluzioni di resilienza.

Ulteriori qualifiche

• Forte capacità di problem solving analitico con la capacità di condurre risposte a eventi di continuità critica e formare team su tecniche avanzate.

Cosa otterrai

• Gamma di salario competitivo 19,075 - 35,425 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro.

• Pagamento bonus annuale basato sulle tue prestazioni ( target 20% ).

• Modello di lavoro ibrido: 2 giorni alla settimana in ufficio (Poznań o Varsavia)

• Prestazioni complementari: Assistenza sanitaria privata (LuxMed), gruppo lif

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Validation Lead - RDT Künstliche Intelligenz

Als Validation Lead entwerfen und implementieren Sie umfassende IT-Resilienz-, Risikomanagement- und Compliance-Strategien, die auf die Geschäftsziele ausgerichtet sind. Sie leiten komplexe Risikobewertungen, entwickeln verfeinerte Audit- und Kontinuitätsprogramme und etablieren Best Practices für den Umgang mit kritischen Störungen und die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften. Als kompetenter Berater für hochrangige Interessengruppen leiten Sie Reaktionen auf kritische Vorfälle und gewährleisten die Skalierbarkeit und Zukunftssicherheit unternehmensweiter Risiko- und Kontinuitätslösungen.

Die Chance

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Entwickelt verfeinerte Strategien für Risikomanagement, Compliance und Kontinuität sowie Wiederherstellungspläne. Verbessert bestehende Richtlinien, um Effektivität und Compliance-Rahmenbedingungen zu verbessern. Führt Fortbildungen zu Best Practices für Risiko-, Audit- und Business Continuity Management (BCM) durch und überprüft und aktualisiert die Dokumentation auf Genauigkeit.

• Verantwortlichkeit/Problemlösung: Leitet Reaktionen auf kritische IT-Risiken, Audits und Kontinuitätsereignisse. Etabliert Best Practices für den Umgang mit Störungen und Compliance-Problemen. Führt Post-Incident / Post-Mortem-Reviews durch, um Bereiche für Verbesserungen zu identifizieren, und schult Teammitglieder zu fortschrittlichen Problemlösungstechniken.

• Stakeholder Management: Verwaltet die Beziehungen zu hochrangigen Stakeholdern und erleichtert Meetings, um Compliance, Auditangelegenheiten und Kontinuität zu diskutieren. Handeln Sie auf Feedback, um Strategien zu verbessern und sicherzustellen, dass Risiko- und Kontinuitätspolitiken an den Bedürfnissen der Stakeholder ausgerichtet sind.

• Auswirkung/Strategie: Entwickelt detaillierte Risiko-, Audit-, Compliance- und Kontinuitätsstrategien, die auf die Geschäftsziele ausgerichtet sind, und passt Richtlinien an sich ändernde Geschäftsanforderungen an. Arbeitet mit der Führung zusammen, um Ziele auszurichten und bietet strategische Einblicke auf der Grundlage von Best Practices der Branche.

• Komplexität/ (Produktgröße): Überwacht Strategien für unternehmensweite Risiko-, Compliance- und Kontinuitätsinitiativen. Sicherstellt die Skalierbarkeit von Lösungen, integriert Richtlinien in bestehende Systeme und bewertet und wählt Tools für das Unternehmensmanagement aus.

• Business/Technische Fähigkeiten: Dient als Experte für Risikomanagement, Audit, Compliance und Kontinuitätstechnologien und deren Geschäftsanwendungen. Wendet Strategien zur Unterstützung von Geschäftsfunktionen an, bietet Unternehmensleitern Einblicke in Best Practices und stellt die Skalierbarkeit und Zukunftssicherheit relevanter Technologien sicher.

Wer du bist

Bildung und Erfahrung

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Umsetzung von IT-Resilienzstrategien, der Leitung komplexer Risikobewertungen und der Entwicklung von Auditprogrammen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung von Beziehungen zu hochrangigen Stakeholdern und der Zusammenarbeit mit der Führung, um Risiko- und Kontinuitätsziele auszurichten.

Technische Fähigkeiten

• Expertise in Risikomanagement, Audit, Compliance und Business Continuity Technologien und deren Anwendungen im Geschäftskontext.

• Starke Fähigkeit zur Bewertung und Auswahl von Unternehmenstools und zur Gewährleistung der Skalierbarkeit und Zukunftssicherheit von Resilienzlösungen.

Zusätzliche Qualifikationen

• Starke analytische Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Reaktionen auf kritische Kontinuitätsereignisse zu führen und Teams in fortgeschrittenen Techniken zu schulen.

Was du bekommen wirst

• Wettbewerbsfähige Gehaltsspanne 19,075 - 35,425 PLN brutto basierend auf dem Arbeitsvertrag.

• Jährliche Bonuszahlung basierend auf Ihrer Leistung (Ziel 20% ).

• Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: 2 Tage pro Woche im Amt (Poznań oder Warschau)

• Umfassende Vorteile : Private Gesundheitsversorgung (LuxMed), Gruppe lif
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Plomb de validation - RDT Intelligence artificielle

En tant que responsable de validation, vous concevrez et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies globales de résilience, de gestion des risques et de conformité aux objectifs opérationnels. Vous dirigerez des évaluations des risques complexes, élaborerez des programmes de vérification et de continuité améliorés et établirez des pratiques exemplaires pour gérer les perturbations critiques et la conformité réglementaire. En tant que conseiller expert auprès des intervenants de haut niveau, vous dirigerez les interventions en cas d'incidents critiques et vous assurerez l'évolutivité et la protection future des solutions de risque et de continuité à l'échelle de l'entreprise.

L'opportunité

• Portée / ( Leadership du contenu) : Élaborer des stratégies de gestion du risque, de conformité et de continuité et des plans de rétablissement. Améliorer les politiques existantes pour améliorer l'efficacité et les cadres de conformité. Mener une formation avancée sur les pratiques exemplaires en matière de gestion des risques, de vérification et de continuité des activités (GCM), et examiner et mettre à jour la documentation pour en vérifier l'exactitude.

• Responsabilisation/Résoudre les problèmes : Diriger les interventions face aux risques critiques en TI, à la vérification et à la continuité. Établir des pratiques exemplaires pour gérer les perturbations et les problèmes de conformité. Effectuer des examens post-incident/post mortem afin de déterminer les domaines à améliorer et former les membres de l'équipe sur les techniques avancées de résolution de problèmes.

• Gestion des intervenants : Gérer les relations avec les intervenants de haut niveau et faciliter les réunions pour discuter de la conformité, des questions de vérification et de la continuité. Agir sur la rétroaction pour améliorer les stratégies et assurer l'alignement des politiques de risque et de continuité sur les besoins des intervenants.

• Impact/stratégie : Élaborer des stratégies détaillées de risque, de vérification, de conformité et de continuité conformes aux objectifs opérationnels, en adaptant les politiques pour répondre aux besoins opérationnels en évolution. Collabore avec le leadership pour harmoniser les objectifs et fournir des renseignements stratégiques fondés sur les pratiques exemplaires de l'industrie.

• Complexité/ (taille du produit): Supervise les stratégies pour les initiatives de risque, de conformité et de continuité à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Assurer l'évolutivité des solutions, intégrer les politiques avec les systèmes existants, et évaluer et sélectionner des outils pour la gestion d'entreprise.

• Capacité opérationnelle/technique : est un expert en gestion des risques, vérification, conformité et continuité des technologies et de leurs applications commerciales. Applique des stratégies pour appuyer les fonctions opérationnelles, fournit des renseignements sur les pratiques exemplaires aux chefs d'entreprise et assure l'évolutivité et la protection future des technologies pertinentes.

Qui vous êtes

Éducation et expérience

• Expérience approfondie dans la conception et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de résilience des TI, la conduite d'évaluations des risques complexes et l'élaboration de programmes de vérification.

• Expérience éprouvée de la gestion des relations avec les intervenants de haut niveau et de la collaboration avec le leadership pour harmoniser les objectifs de risque et de continuité.

Compétences techniques

• Expertise en gestion des risques, en vérification, en conformité et en continuité des opérations et leurs applications dans un contexte opérationnel.

• Forte capacité d'évaluer et de sélectionner les outils d'entreprise et d'assurer l'évolutivité et la protection future des solutions de résilience.

Qualités supplémentaires

• De solides compétences analytiques en résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de diriger les réponses aux événements critiques de continuité et de former des équipes sur des techniques avancées.

Ce que vous aurez

• Plage salariale concurrentielle 19 075 - 35 425 PLN brut selon le contrat de travail.

• Paiement de bonus annuel en fonction de votre performance ( objectif 20% ).

• Modèle de travail hybride : 2 jours par semaine au bureau (Poznań ou Varsovie)

• Prestations globales : Soins de santé privés (LuxMed), groupe lif

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
En Roche, nos impulsa la innovación para asegurar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones venideras. Al unirte a nuestra división de Diagnóstica , formarás parte de un equipo que optimiza la eficiencia de los laboratorios para crear un mundo donde todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Como Practicante de Consultoría Business Innovation , tendrás la oportunidad única de aprender y cocrear soluciones de alto impacto en un entorno ágil y colaborativo.

Oportunidad

• Apoyas activamente el desarrollo de análisis transversales para identificar oportunidades de mejora y negocio dentro de las instituciones de salud.

• Generas reportes de escenarios que incluyen beneficios cuantitativos para posicionar la propuesta de valor diferenciada de Roche.

• Integras soluciones de información con metodologías de análisis y plataformas Roche para facilitar la toma de decisiones basadas en evidencia financiera.

• Cocreas modelos de negocio y brindas acompañamiento a diversos stakeholders, incluyendo perfiles clínicos y financieros.

• Colaboras con equipos regionales y globales para habilitar localmente nuevos servicios que amplíen nuestro portafolio de soluciones.

• Documentas y mantienes actualizadas las actividades de gestión en las herramientas de CRM definidas por la organización.

• Adoptas y propones nuevas formas de trabajo ágiles para asegurar el éxito en entornos cambiantes.

• Aseguras la satisfacción del cliente apoyando la gestión de oportunidades, solicitudes y quejas asociadas al portafolio.

Quien eres

• Eres estudiante de últimos semestres en Ciencias de la Salud, Administración de Empresas o Ingeniería.

• Cuentas con un nivel de inglés básico o intermedio.

• Posees habilidades en el manejo de herramientas digitales y de Inteligencia Artificial.

• Te destacas por tu capacidad de comunicación, gestión del cambio y orientación a la consecución de resultados.

• Eres una persona con integridad, coraje y pasión, que disfruta del trabajo en equipo y la colaboración.

Preferred:

• Conocimientos o interés en Metodologías Ágiles, LEAN, técnicas de facilitación o estándares PMI.

Beneficios de reubicacion no estan disponibles para esta vacante.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: AI Architect - RDT Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

AI Architect - RDT Artificial Intelligence

This is a rare opportunity to shape the architectural foundation of enterprise AI at one of the world’s leading healthcare and diagnostics companies. As AI Architect within RDT Artificial Intelligence, you will hold strategic and engineering ownership of Roche’s enterprise AI technology stack - defining how AI is built, governed, and scaled across the organization.

This role serves as the central technical visionary connecting advanced agentic workflows, traditional AI and ML platforms, and core infrastructure. You will architect a secure, robust, and highly scalable enterprise platform ecosystem that enables diverse teams across Roche to deploy cutting-edge AI capabilities safely, compliantly, and cost-effectively - at global scale.

More than a platform role, this is a mission to prevent technological fragmentation and agentic chaos: to establish the digital guardrails and architectural principles that allow AI to proliferate responsibly across one of the world’s most complex regulated enterprises. You will translate strategic vision into concrete blueprints, and blueprints into production reality.

The Opportunity

1. Enterprise AI Architecture & Taxonomy

• Capability-Based Reference Architecture: Architect and evolve the enterprise AI reference architecture based on logical capabilities and flows, maintaining vendor neutrality and enabling multi-platform configurations rather than forcing monolithic alignment.

• Platform & Application Taxonomy: Govern the enterprise AI landscape, clearly demarcating developer-facing platforms (e.g., managed ML environments, API gateways, enterprise retrieval services) from ready-to-use business applications - ensuring every team can navigate the landscape without duplication or confusion.

• Advanced Technology Integration: Lead the technical design, proof of concepts, and production implementation of core developer enablement modules, including the AI Gateway, PI/PII detection pipelines, and advanced content safety layers.

2. Infrastructure Engineering & Compute Operationalisation

• High-Compute Software Framework: Take technical ownership of designing, validating, and establishing the production-ready software layer - orchestration, monitoring, job scheduling, and cost tracking - required to operationalise high-compute environments such as dedicated GPU infrastructure (e.g., NVIDIA AI Factory).

• Hyperscaler Strategy: Architect cloud-native multi-region endpoints across AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring optimal workload placement for model serving and training.

• Vector & Data Layer Strategy: Define structural standards for data and context layer integration, utilising specialised databases (e.g., Qdrant Cloud for long-term memory, PostgreSQL pgvector, MongoDB Atlas) linked natively into agent frameworks.

• Agentic Strategy: Translate the vision of an AI-augmented workforce into a structured agentic architecture - balancing speed of delivery with the stability, compliance, and safety controls required in a regulated enterprise.

3. Governance, Traceability & Security

• End-to-End Traceability Framework: Enforce enterprise invocation standards using structured Correlation IDs (business journey mapping), Trace IDs (independent agent execution), and Span IDs (sub-flows and tool calls) across the AI Gateway - making every AI interaction auditable and debuggable.

• Agent Governance Architecture: Author and execute technical pre-deployment sign-offs, agent identity propagation

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

AI Architect - RDT intelligenza artificiale

Stiamo cercando un AI Architect altamente esperto per prendere piena responsabilità ingegneristica e la proprietà strategica del nostro stack di tecnologia AI aziendale in evoluzione. Uscendo dall'iniziativa di base della piattaforma AI in una capacità embedded enterprise RDT, questo ruolo serve come il centro tecnico visionario che collega flussi di lavoro agentici avanzati con le piattaforme AI e ML tradizionali e con l'infrastruttura core. Potrai progettare un ecosistema di piattaforme enterprise sicuro, robusto e altamente scalabile che consente a team diversi in tutta l'azienda di implementare funzionalità AI all'avanguardia in modo sicuro e conveniente.
Come AI Architect istituirai gli standard tecnici per la nostra piattaforma AI tassonomia, gestirai complessi paesaggi multi-cloud e fornitori di hardware, e aziona l'allineamento strutturale attraverso framework di agenti, MLOps e architetture di dati aziendali. La vostra missione principale sarà di influenzare la nostra visione strategica e di tradurla in progetti che lo porteranno in realtà.

L'opportunità

1. Enterprise Tech Stack Architecture & Taxonomy

• Core Design: Architetto e evolve l'architettura di riferimento aziendale basata su capacità e flussi logici, mantenendo la neutralità dei fornitori e consentendo configurazioni multipiattaforma piuttosto che forzare l'allineamento monolitico.

• Piattaforma & App Positioning: Governare la tassonomia AI aziendale, demarcare chiaramente piattaforme di sviluppatori (ad esempio, Galileo, ADP, ML Studio, RAG-as-a-Service) da applicazioni aziendali pronte all'uso (ad esempio, ChatGPT Enterprise, LangSmith).

• Integrazione tecnologica avanzata: Guidare la progettazione tecnica, la prova dei concetti e l'implementazione della produzione per i moduli di attivazione dello sviluppatore core, tra cui le pipeline di rilevamento AI Gateway, PI/PII e gli strati avanzati di sicurezza dei contenuti.

2. Infrastructure Engineering & Hardware Operationalization

• AI Factory Software Layer: Assumere la proprietà tecnica di progettazione, validazione e creazione del framework software POC-ready (orchestrazione, monitoraggio, pianificazione del lavoro e monitoraggio dei costi) necessario per operare ambienti hardware ad alta conformità come il prossimo NVIDIA AI Factory.

• Strategia Hyperscaler: Architect cloud-native multi-region endpoints in AWS, Azure e GCP, garantendo un posizionamento ottimale del carico di lavoro per il servizio e la formazione del modello.

• Multi-Engine Vector Strategy: Definire gli standard strutturali per l'integrazione dei dati e dei livelli di contesto, utilizzando database specializzati ottimali (ad esempio, Qdrant Cloud per la memoria a lungo termine, PostgreSQL PGVector, MongoDB Atlas) collegati in modo nativo in quadri di agente.

• Strategia Agentica: Portare la strategia di una forza lavoro potenziata attraverso gli agenti AI in realtà con il giusto equilibrio tra velocità e stabilità per garantire la consegna garantendo al contempo la conformità delle nostre piattaforme e soluzioni.

3. Tracciabilità, governance e sicurezza

• E2E Traceability Framework: Applicare gli standard di invocazione dell'impresa utilizzando i rigorosi ID di correlazione (business travel mapping), Trace IDs (esecuzione dell'agente indipendente), e Span IDs (sotto flussi o chiamate degli strumenti) attraverso il gateway AI.

• Agent Governance Architecture: Autorizzazione ed esecuzione dei segnali di pre-deployment tecnici, propagazione dell'identità dell'agente e meccanismi di controllo del ciclo di vita per gli agenti autonomi, semi-autonomi, e i fornitori-embedded.

• Risk & Compliance Liaison: Partner a stretto contatto con il team AI Risks & Ethics per implementare processi di assunzione verificabili (tramite ServiceNow e AI Registry) e garantire il rispetto della struttura di sicurezza e privacy

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

AI Architekt - RDT Künstliche Intelligenz

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen KI-Architekten, der die volle technische Verantwortung und strategische Verantwortung für unseren sich entwickelnden KI-Technologie-Stack übernimmt. Diese Rolle, die sich aus der grundlegenden KI-Plattform-Initiative in eine eingebettete Enterprise-RTT-Fähigkeit entwickelt, dient als zentraler technischer Visionär, der fortschrittliche agentische Workflows mit traditionellen KI- und ML-Plattformen und mit der Kerninfrastruktur verbindet. Sie erstellen ein sicheres, robustes und hochskalierbares Enterprise-Plattform-Ökosystem, das es verschiedenen Teams im Unternehmen ermöglicht, hochmoderne KI-Fähigkeiten sicher und kostengünstig einzusetzen.
Als AI Architect legen Sie die technischen Standards für unsere AI-Plattform-Taxonomie fest, verwalten komplexe Multi-Cloud- und Hardware-Anbieterlandschaften und fördern die strukturelle Ausrichtung über Agent-Frameworks, MLOps und Unternehmensdatenarchitekturen hinweg. Ihre Hauptaufgabe wird es sein, unsere strategische Vision zu beeinflussen und sie in Blaupausen zu übersetzen, die sie in die Realität umsetzen.

Die Chance

1. Enterprise Tech Stack Architektur und Taxonomie

• Capability-Based Core Design: Architektur und Weiterentwicklung der Enterprise-Referenzarchitektur basierend auf logischen Fähigkeiten und Abläufen, Aufrechterhaltung der Anbieterneutralität und Ermöglichung von Multi-Plattform-Setups, anstatt monolithische Ausrichtung zu erzwingen.

• Plattform- und App-Positionierung: Regulieren Sie die KI-Taxonomie von Unternehmen, indem Sie Entwicklerplattformen (z. B. Galileo, ADP, ML Studio, RAG-as-a-Service) klar von gebrauchsfertigen Geschäftsanwendungen (z. B. ChatGPT Enterprise, LangSmith) abgrenzen.

• Advanced Technology Integration: Führen Sie das technische Design, den Proof of Concepts und die Implementierung der Produktion für Core Developer Enablement Module, einschließlich des AI Gateway, PI/PII Detection Pipelines und Advanced Content Safety Layers.

2. Infrastructure Engineering & Hardware Operationalisierung

• AI Factory Software Layer: Übernehmen Sie die technische Verantwortung für die Gestaltung, Validierung und Einrichtung des POC-fähigen Software-Frameworks (Orchestrierung, Überwachung, Auftragsplanung und Kostenverfolgung), das für die Operationalisierung von High-Compute-Hardwareumgebungen wie der kommenden NVIDIA AI Factory erforderlich ist.

• Hyperscaler-Strategie: Erstellen Sie Cloud-native Multi-Region-Endpunkte für AWS, Azure und GCP, um eine optimale Workload-Platzierung für die Modellierung und Schulung zu gewährleisten.

• Multi-Engine-Vektor-Strategie: Definieren Sie die strukturellen Standards für die Integration von Daten und Kontextschichten unter Verwendung optimaler spezialisierter Datenbanken (z. B. Qdrant Cloud für das Langzeitgedächtnis, PostgreSQL PGVector, MongoDB Atlas), die nativ in Agent-Frameworks verknüpft sind.

• Agentische Strategie: Bringen Sie die Strategie einer Belegschaft, die durch KI-Agenten verbessert wurde, mit der richtigen Balance zwischen Geschwindigkeit und Stabilität in die Realität, um die Lieferung zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die Compliance unserer Plattformen und Lösungen zu gewährleisten.

3. Rückverfolgbarkeit, Governance & Sicherheit

• E2E Traceability Framework: Erzwingen Sie Enterprise Invocation Standards mit strengen Correlation IDs (Business Journey Mapping), Trace IDs (Independent Agent Execution) und Span IDs (Subflows oder Tool Calls) über das AI Gateway.

• Agent-Governance-Architektur: Erstellen und Ausführen der technischen Sign-Offs vor dem Deployment, der Agent-Identitäts-Propagation und der Lifecycle-Kontrollmechanismen für autonome, semi-autonome und herstellereingebettete Agenten.

• Risk & Compliance Liaison: Enge Partnerschaft mit dem AI Risks & Ethics-Team, um auditierbare Aufnahmeprozesse (über ServiceNow und AI Registry) zu implementieren und die Einhaltung des Sicherheits- und Datenschutzrahmens zu gewährleisten
