C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Description de l'emploi
L'expert en données TI principal est responsable de l'architecture, de la direction et de la prestation de solutions avancées en matière d'IA et de science des données qui répondent aux défis complexes des activités et des sciences au sein de la R-D Pharma. Ce rôle sert de chef de file technique, guidant la conception, le développement, le déploiement et la gouvernance des systèmes d'IA/ML à l'échelle de l'entreprise, tout en guidant les jeunes spécialistes des données et en stimulant l'innovation dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
Opérant dans un environnement GxP hautement réglementé, vous dirigerez le développement de plates-formes de prochaine génération alimentées par l'IA et d'agents autonomes spécialisés soutenant les chercheurs en données analytiques tout au long du cycle de vie des données cliniques. Le rôle exige une expertise approfondie en AI Generative, les cadres d'IA Agentic, l'orchestration multi-agents, la génération Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) basée sur les graphiques, les opérations de modèles de grande langue (LLMOps) et l'ingénierie des plates-formes d'IA. Vous définirez la stratégie technique, établirez les meilleures pratiques et collaborerez avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour assurer des solutions d'IA évolutives, conformes et adaptées aux besoins des entreprises.

Description de la zone
La fonction Production et réutilisation de données et de contenu de présentations cliniques vise à transformer la création, la gestion et la réutilisation de données cliniques et de contenu de présentations réglementaires grâce à des capacités numériques avancées et à l'automatisation axée sur l'IA. L'organisation met au point des plateformes structurées de gestion du contenu, des données et des éléments de contenu réutilisables et des écosystèmes d'agents intelligents qui appuient les présentations cliniques, la conformité réglementaire et la communication scientifique.
L'équipe est à l'avant-garde pour tirer parti de l'IA, des flux de travail des agents, des graphiques de connaissances et des analyses avancées afin d'améliorer la qualité, d'accélérer les délais de présentation et de permettre la prise de décisions axées sur les données dans l'ensemble du paysage clinique et réglementaire.

Responsabilités professionnelles
1. Portée / contenu Leadership

• Diriger l'architecture, le développement et le déploiement de solutions d'IA/ML et de systèmes d'agents de qualité entreprise.

• Diriger simultanément de multiples initiatives stratégiques en matière de science des données, en assurant l'harmonisation avec les priorités opérationnelles.

• Définir des normes techniques, des cadres réutilisables et des pratiques exemplaires pour le développement de l'IA et de l'apprentissage automatique.

• Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des cadres de données scientifiques à l'échelle de l'entreprise, des modèles de gouvernance et des pratiques exemplaires pour assurer la cohérence, l'évolutivité et l'excellence opérationnelle des initiatives d'IA.

• Mentor et guide les data savants, favorisant l'excellence technique et l'innovation dans toute l'équipe.

• Diriger les projets complexes de science des données de bout en bout, depuis la définition des problèmes et la conception des solutions jusqu'au déploiement, l'adoption et l'impact opérationnel mesurable.
2. Responsabilité / résolution des problèmes

• Résoudre les problèmes d'affaires très complexes et ambigus en utilisant des techniques avancées de modélisation statistique, d'apprentissage automatique et d'IA générative.

• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des workflows multi-agents sophistiqués en utilisant des cadres tels que LangGraph et AWS AgentCore.

• Diriger le développement de solutions d'automatisation intelligentes comprenant des examinateurs de code autonomes, des copilotes cliniques, des assistants de débogage pilotés par l'IA et des agents de production de contenu de soumission.

• Conduire la validation des modèles, la surveillance, l'explicabilité et les pratiques de gouvernance de l'IA dans les environnements réglementés.
3. Gestion des parties prenantes

• Établir des partenariats avec des chefs d'entreprise, des experts cliniques, des statisticiens et des équipes technologiques pour déterminer les possibilités stratégiques d'adoption de l'IA.

• Traduire des concepts analytiques complexes en idées d'affaires exploitables pour l'examen exécutif et non technique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the Role
We are hiring a GenAI Agent Developer to join the AIDCG initiative, a transformative program focused on automating complex, multi-step document generation workflows through state-of-the-art AI agents.
This role blends advanced GenAI engineering, open-source innovation, and AWS cloud expertise to deliver production-grade AI agents that are accurate, scalable, and highly secure. You will design orchestration frameworks that transform raw, unstructured data into highly structured, compliant outputs.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Agentic Architecture: Design, deploy, and scale multi-agent orchestration systems and autonomous workflows using cutting-edge frameworks.

• Advanced RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize advanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over massive, heterogeneous datasets (structured and unstructured).

• State & Memory Management: Implement robust state management, short/long-term memory systems, and self-correction/reflection loops within agent networks.

• Evaluation & Guardrails: Create and implement robust evaluation metrics, observability pipelines, and guardrails for content quality, hallucination reduction, bias mitigation, and safety standards.

• Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize AI inference cost, latency, throughput, token usage, and overall system reliability.

• Security & Access Control: Implement robust access controls, data encryption, user authentication, and prompt injection mitigation across all LLM workflows.

• Collaboration & Best Practices: Document and share reusable agent patterns, prompt libraries, and engineering components across cross-functional technical teams.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience taking ownership of ambiguous tasks, successfully driving small to medium initiatives, and acting as a technical mentor.

• Proven track record of engaging in knowledge-sharing initiatives, speaking at internal technical events, and navigating group dynamics in diversified settings.

Technical Skills

• GenAI Development: Advanced prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG/GraphRAG, schema-constrained outputs, function/tool-calling, and semantic caching.

• Agentic Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI , AutoGen , and DSPy .

• Vector Databases: FAISS, Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, and Pgvector .

• LLM Serving & Infra: vLLM, Hugging Face TGI, and Ollama (for local development).

• Guardrails & Validation: NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, Pydantic, and Instructor .

• LLM Ops & Observability: Ragas, DeepEval, Langfuse, LangSmith , and Phoenix.

• Data Parsing: Unstructured, Apache Tika, LlamaParse , and PDFPlumber.

• Programming & DevOps: Python (FastAPI, asyncio), REST/GraphQL APIs, Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenTelemetry.

• Emerging Protocols: Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent communication standards.

AWS Ecosystem (Baseline Experience)

• Amazon Bedrock: Foundation model access, custom configurations, and managed agent workflows.

• Amazon SageMaker: Fine-tuning, hosting, evaluating, and deploying open-source LLMs.

• Amazon OpenSearch Service: Vector search, hybrid search, and enterprise retrieval infrastructure.

• AWS Step Functions: Multi-step orchestration and state machine management for hybrid AI/traditional pipelines.

Additional Qualifications

• Problem-Solving: An analytical mindset capable of breaking down highly abstract, ambiguous logic loops into predictable agent behavior

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Informazioni sul ruolo
Stiamo assumendo un agente sviluppatore GenAI per aderire all'iniziativa AIDCG, un programma di trasformazione focalizzato sull'automazione di flussi di lavoro di generazione di documenti complessi e multi-step attraverso agenti AI all'avanguardia.
Questo ruolo fonde l'ingegneria GenAI avanzata, l'innovazione open source e l'esperienza cloud AWS per fornire agenti AI di livello di produzione che sono precisi, scalabili e altamente sicuri. Progetterai quadri di orchestrazione che trasformano dati grezzi e non strutturati in output altamente strutturati e conformi.

Descrizione della zona
Responsabilità del lavoro

• Architettura Agentica: Progettazione, distribuzione e scala sistemi di orchestrazione multi-agent e flussi di lavoro autonomi utilizzando strutture all'avanguardia.

• Advanced RAG Pipelines: Costruire e ottimizzare le tubazioni di generazione aumentata dal recupero avanzato (RAG) su set di dati eterogenei (strutturati e non strutturati).

• Gestione dello stato e della memoria: implementare una gestione dello stato robusta, sistemi di memoria a breve/lungo termine e loop di autocorrezione/riflessione all'interno delle reti di agente.

• Valutazione & Guardrails: Creare e implementare metriche di valutazione robuste, condotte di osservabilità, e guardrails per la qualità dei contenuti, riduzione dell'allucinazione, mitigazione dei pregiudizi e standard di sicurezza.

• Ottimizzazione delle prestazioni: Monitorare e ottimizzare i costi di inferenza dell'AI, la latenza, il throughput, l'utilizzo dei token e l'affidabilità generale del sistema.

• Controllo di sicurezza e accesso: implementare controlli di accesso robusti, crittografia dei dati, autenticazione degli utenti e mitigazione dell'iniezione rapida su tutti i flussi di lavoro LLM.

• Collaborazione & Migliori Pratiche: Documento e condividere modelli di agente riutilizzabili, librerie rapide e componenti ingegneristici attraverso team tecnici interfunzionali.

Qualifiche
Istruzione / Esperienza

• Esperienza dimostrata prendendo possesso di compiti ambigui, guidando con successo piccole e medie iniziative, e agendo come mentore tecnico.

• Provato record di coinvolgimento in iniziative di condivisione della conoscenza, parlando in eventi tecnici interni, e la navigazione di dinamiche di gruppo in ambienti diversificati.

Competenze tecniche

• Sviluppo del GenAI: Ingegneria avanzata del prompt, fine-tuning, RAG/GraphRAG, uscite a schema, funzione/tool-calling e caching semantico.

• Quadri Agenti: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI , AutoGen , e DSPy .

• Database vettoriali: FAISS, Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate e Pgvector .

• LLM Serving & Infra: vLLM, Hugging Face TGI e Ollama (per lo sviluppo locale).

• Guardrails & Validazione: NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, Pydantic e Istructor .

• LLM Ops & Observability: Ragas, DeepEval, Langfuse, LangSmith e Phoenix.

• Data Parsing: Non strutturato, Apache Tika, LlamaParse , e PDFPlumber.

• Programmazione & DevOps: Python (FastAPI, asyncio), REST/GraphQL API, Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes e OpenTelemetry.

• Protocolli emergenti: Protocollo di contesto modello (MCP) e norme di comunicazione Agent2Agent.

AWS Ecosystem (Baseline Experience)

• Amazon Bedrock: accesso ai modelli della Fondazione, configurazioni personalizzate e flussi di lavoro degli agenti gestiti.

• Amazon SageMaker: Fine-tuning, hosting, valutazione e distribuzione di LLM open-source.

• Amazon OpenSearch Service: Ricerca vettoriale, ricerca ibrida e infrastruttura di recupero aziendale.

• Funzioni passo AWS: orchestrazione multi-step e gestione della macchina statale per le tubazioni ibride AI/tradizionali.

Ulteriori qualifiche

• Problem-Solving: Una mentalità analitica capace di abbattere loop logici altamente astratti e ambigui in comportamento di agente prevedibile
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the Role
We are hiring a GenAI Agent Developer to join the AIDCG initiative, a transformative program focused on automating complex, multi-step document generation workflows through state-of-the-art AI agents.
This role blends advanced GenAI engineering, open-source innovation, and AWS cloud expertise to deliver production-grade AI agents that are accurate, scalable, and highly secure. You will design orchestration frameworks that transform raw, unstructured data into highly structured, compliant outputs.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Agentic Architecture: Design, deploy, and scale multi-agent orchestration systems and autonomous workflows using cutting-edge frameworks.

• Advanced RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize advanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over massive, heterogeneous datasets (structured and unstructured).

• State & Memory Management: Implement robust state management, short/long-term memory systems, and self-correction/reflection loops within agent networks.

• Evaluation & Guardrails: Create and implement robust evaluation metrics, observability pipelines, and guardrails for content quality, hallucination reduction, bias mitigation, and safety standards.

• Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize AI inference cost, latency, throughput, token usage, and overall system reliability.

• Security & Access Control: Implement robust access controls, data encryption, user authentication, and prompt injection mitigation across all LLM workflows.

• Collaboration & Best Practices: Document and share reusable agent patterns, prompt libraries, and engineering components across cross-functional technical teams.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience taking ownership of ambiguous tasks, successfully driving small to medium initiatives, and acting as a technical mentor.

• Proven track record of engaging in knowledge-sharing initiatives, speaking at internal technical events, and navigating group dynamics in diversified settings.

Technical Skills

• GenAI Development: Advanced prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG/GraphRAG, schema-constrained outputs, function/tool-calling, and semantic caching.

• Agentic Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI , AutoGen , and DSPy .

• Vector Databases: FAISS, Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, and Pgvector .

• LLM Serving & Infra: vLLM, Hugging Face TGI, and Ollama (for local development).

• Guardrails & Validation: NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, Pydantic, and Instructor .

• LLM Ops & Observability: Ragas, DeepEval, Langfuse, LangSmith , and Phoenix.

• Data Parsing: Unstructured, Apache Tika, LlamaParse , and PDFPlumber.

• Programming & DevOps: Python (FastAPI, asyncio), REST/GraphQL APIs, Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenTelemetry.

• Emerging Protocols: Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent communication standards.

AWS Ecosystem (Baseline Experience)

• Amazon Bedrock: Foundation model access, custom configurations, and managed agent workflows.

• Amazon SageMaker: Fine-tuning, hosting, evaluating, and deploying open-source LLMs.

• Amazon OpenSearch Service: Vector search, hybrid search, and enterprise retrieval infrastructure.

• AWS Step Functions: Multi-step orchestration and state machine management for hybrid AI/traditional pipelines.

Additional Qualifications

• Problem-Solving: An analytical mindset capable of breaking down highly abstract, ambiguous logic loops into predictable agent behavior
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Über die Rolle
Wir stellen einen GenAI Agent Developer ein, um der AIDCG-Initiative beizutreten, einem transformativen Programm, das sich auf die Automatisierung komplexer, mehrstufiger Dokumentengenerierungs-Workflows durch hochmoderne KI-Agenten konzentriert.
Diese Rolle vereint fortschrittliches GenAI-Engineering, Open-Source-Innovation und AWS-Cloud-Expertise, um KI-Agenten in Produktionsqualität bereitzustellen, die genau, skalierbar und hochsicher sind. Sie entwerfen Orchestrierungs-Frameworks, die rohe, unstrukturierte Daten in hochstrukturierte, konforme Ausgaben umwandeln.

Beschreibung des Gebiets
Aufgabenbereich

• Agentische Architektur: Design, Deployment und Skalierung von Multiagenten-Orchestrierungssystemen und autonomen Workflows unter Verwendung modernster Frameworks.

• Advanced RAG Pipelines: Erstellen und Optimieren von Advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Pipelines über massive, heterogene Datensätze (strukturiert und unstrukturiert).

• Zustands- und Speichermanagement: Implementieren Sie robustes Zustandsmanagement, Kurz- / Langzeitspeichersysteme und Selbstkorrektur- / Reflexionsschleifen in Agentennetzwerken.

• Evaluation & Guardrails: Erstellen und implementieren Sie robuste Evaluierungsmetriken, Observability-Pipelines und Leitplanken für Inhaltsqualität, Halluzinationsreduktion, Bias-Minderung und Sicherheitsstandards.

• Performance-Optimierung: Überwachen und optimieren Sie die KI-Inferenzkosten, Latenz, Durchsatz, Token-Nutzung und die Zuverlässigkeit des Gesamtsystems.

• Security & Access Control: Implementieren Sie robuste Zugriffskontrollen, Datenverschlüsselung, Benutzerauthentifizierung und sofortige Injektionsminderung in allen LLM-Workflows.

• Collaboration & Best Practices: Dokumentieren und teilen Sie wiederverwendbare Agentenmuster, Eingabeaufforderungsbibliotheken und Engineering-Komponenten in funktionsübergreifenden technischen Teams.

Qualifikationen
Bildung / Erfahrung

• Demonstrierte Erfahrung in der Übernahme mehrdeutiger Aufgaben, der erfolgreichen Förderung kleiner bis mittlerer Initiativen und der Tätigkeit als technischer Mentor.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Teilnahme an Initiativen zum Wissensaustausch, bei internen technischen Veranstaltungen und beim Navigieren in Gruppendynamiken in diversifizierten Umgebungen.

Technische Fähigkeiten

• GenAI Development: Advanced prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG/GraphRAG, schema-constrained outputs, function/tool-calling, and semantic caching.

• Agentische Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen und DSPy.

• Vektordatenbanken: FAISS, Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate und Pgvector.

• LLM Serving & Infra: vLLM, Hugging Face TGI und Ollama (für lokale Entwicklung).

• Guardrails & Validation: NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, Pydantic und Instructor.

• LLM Ops & Observability: Ragas, DeepEval, Langfuse, LangSmith und Phoenix.

• Daten Parsing: Unstrukturiert, Apache Tika, LlamaParse und PDFPlumber.

• Programmierung & DevOps: Python (FastAPI, asyncio), REST/GraphQL APIs, Git, CI/CD Pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes und OpenTelemetry.

• Emerging Protocols: Model Context Protocol (MCP) und Agent2Agent Kommunikationsstandards.

AWS Ecosystem (Baseline Experience)

• Amazon Bedrock: Foundation-Modellzugriff, benutzerdefinierte Konfigurationen und Workflows für Managed Agents.

• Amazon SageMaker: Feintuning, Hosting, Evaluierung und Bereitstellung von Open-Source-LMs.

• Amazon OpenSearch Service: Vektorsuche, Hybridsuche und Enterprise Retrieval-Infrastruktur.

• AWS Step Functions: Multi-step orchestration and state machine management for hybrid AI/traditional pipelines.

Zusätzliche Qualifikationen

• Problemlösung: Eine analytische Denkweise, die in der Lage ist, hochgradig abstrakte, mehrdeutige Logikschleifen in vorhersehbares Agentenverhalten aufzubrechen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
À propos du rôle
Nous embauchons un développeur d'agents GenAI pour rejoindre l'initiative AIDCG, un programme de transformation axé sur l'automatisation de flux de travail complexes et multi-étapes de production de documents par l'intermédiaire d'agents d'IA de pointe.
Ce rôle combine l'ingénierie avancée GenAI, l'innovation open-source et l'expertise en nuage AWS pour fournir des agents AI de qualité de production qui sont précis, évolutives et hautement sécurisés. Vous concevrez des cadres d'orchestration qui transforment les données brutes non structurées en sorties hautement structurées et conformes.

Description de la zone
Responsabilités professionnelles

• Architecture Agentique : Conception, déploiement et mise à l'échelle de systèmes d'orchestration multi-agents et de workflows autonomes utilisant des cadres de pointe.

• Pipelines avancées RAG : Construisez et optimisez des pipelines avancés de génération augmentée (RAG) sur des ensembles de données massives et hétérogènes (structurées et non structurées).

• Gestion de l'état et de la mémoire : Implémenter une gestion robuste de l'état, des systèmes de mémoire à court/long terme et des boucles d'auto-correction/réflexion au sein des réseaux d'agents.

• Évaluation et garde-corps : Créer et mettre en oeuvre des mesures d'évaluation robustes, des pipelines d'observation et des garde-corps pour la qualité du contenu, la réduction des hallucinations, l'atténuation des biais et les normes de sécurité.

• Optimisation des performances : Surveiller et optimiser le coût de l'inférence de l'IA, latence, débit, utilisation du jeton et fiabilité globale du système.

• Sécurité et contrôle d'accès : Implémenter des contrôles d'accès robustes, le cryptage des données, l'authentification des utilisateurs et l'atténuation rapide des injections sur tous les flux de travail LLM.

• Collaboration et pratiques exemplaires : documenter et partager les profils d'agents réutilisables, les bibliothèques rapides et les composants d'ingénierie entre les équipes techniques interfonctionnelles.

Compétences
Éducation / Expérience

• Expérience démontrée en prenant en main des tâches ambiguës, en menant avec succès des initiatives de petite à moyenne envergure et en agissant comme mentor technique.

• Expérience éprouvée de participation à des initiatives de partage des connaissances, de discours lors d'événements techniques internes et de navigation dynamique de groupe dans des contextes diversifiés.

Compétences techniques

• Développement de GenAI: ingénierie rapide avancée, réglage fin, RAG/GraphRAG, sorties de schéma-contraintes, fonction/appel d'outils, et cache sémantique.

• Cadres mandataires : LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen et DSPy.

• Bases de données vectorielles : FAISS, Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate et Pgvector .

• LLM Serving & Infra: vLLM, Hugging Face TGI et Ollama (pour le développement local).

• Garde-corps et validation: NeMo Garde-corps, Garde-corps AI, Pydantique et Instructeur .

• LLM Ops & Observability: Ragas, DeepEval, Langfuse, LangSmith et Phoenix.

• Analyse des données : non structuré, Apache Tika, LlamaParse et PDFPlumber.

• Programmation & DevOps: Python (FastAPI, asyncio), API REST/GraphQL, Git, pipelines CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes et OpenTelemetry.

• Protocoles émergents : Modèle de protocole contextuel (MCP) et normes de communication Agent2

Écosystèmes du SSFE (expérience de base)

• Amazon Bedrock : accès au modèle de fondation, configurations personnalisées et flux de travail des agents gérés.

• Amazon SageMaker: Finissage, hébergement, évaluation et déploiement de LLMs open-source.

• Amazon OpenSearch Service: Recherche vectorielle, recherche hybride et infrastructure de recherche d'entreprise.

• Fonctions d'étape AWS : orchestration multi-étapes et gestion de machines d'état pour pipelines hybrides IA/traditionnels.

Qualités supplémentaires

• Résolution des problèmes : un état d'esprit analytique capable de décomposer des boucles logiques très abstraites et ambiguës en un comportement d'agent prévisible

jobs.title: APAC DAN Marketing Enabler
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose
At Roche, we believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about improving the lives of patients’ and are fearless in both decision and action. We believe that partnering with health systems around the world can create value for patients, society and for Roche. We are uniquely positioned to realize truly integrated
health solutions across pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, digital health and big data solutions; positioning us as a key partner for personalized, sustainable healthcare everywhere. That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
In the APAC Disease Area Network, Roche is committed to a bold new operating model that leverages our collective capabilities across the enterprise to deliver real impact for patients quickly around the globe. We are expected to pursue meaningful work across the system where our experience, perspectives and skills can have the biggest impact. By collaborating and coordinating
our efforts as a network, we can deliver more for patients collectively.

As the Marketing Enabler, you aim to:

• Optimize the overall care experience for patients with cancer

• Work with a complex set of internal and external stakeholders

• Understand, develop, drive and monitor the customer value proposition for potential integrated health solutions

• Work cross functionally to coordinate and steward the integrated marketing plan in the Disease Area (DA)

• Work to catalyze rapid solutions to significant gaps in the patient journey (diagnostics, digital health solutions, treatments(s), distribution / supply) by connecting with enterprise knowledge and resources.

• Work in cross border collaborations in Asia Pacific and will be a member of the Network capabilities despite being hired into a country affiliate.

• Realize and scale country outcomes by contributing to virtual, cross border, cross functional work package teams

• Jointly cultivate an environment that enables a self-managed team, with strong innovative, agile and enterprise mindset, customer centricity and a culture of discovery, experimentation and learning. Despite being hired into a country affiliate, this role will be a member of the APAC network model, working in cross border collaborations, to realize and scale country outcomes by contributing to virtual, cross border, cross functional work package team

Responsibility and Accountability
As part of the Marketing capabilities Chapter, you will be hired into a country affiliate and will be responsible for the following:

• Translating stakeholder, system and patient needs into a clear vision and valuable partnerships

• Providing DA knowledge, system awareness, treatment landscape and product(s) expertise to help inform portfolio resourcing, prioritization and other commercial management tasks

• Shaping, stewarding and contributing to core business processes (affiliate and beyond borders) to ensure the investment and resourcing needs in DA are well served

• Building and contributing the capabilities to cross functional, cross cultural, self-managed, work package teams that apply agile methodologies to quickly deliver high value work

• Assuming shared accountability for organizational launch preparedness within and across countries.

• Serving as a cross-channel digital engagement expert, leading strategie

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Head of RDT Applied AI Engineering, India Center is accountable for defining and executing the engineering strategy, agentic toolkit development, and organizational scaling for the Applied AI department. You will oversee multiple engineering squads, led by Technical Team Leads, focused on building robust, scalable agentic engineering solutions and toolkits. You work closely with your peer in Applied AI, the Head of Applied AI Solutions, to ensure your team's delivery fits the business problem, demonstrates value (proof-of-value) and enables the realization of high-value business outcomes through AI innovation.
You will serve as a Strategic Business Partner for Applied AI Engineering to the Pharma Medicines, Pharma R&D, Diagnostics and EPIE Leadership Teams.
Your primary objective is to co-create, define, and drive the new Hyderabad location and teams to deliver the unified global Data & AI strategy. You will build a world-class engineering organization that delivers sustainable, secure, and compliant agentic engineering at scale, accelerating the transformation of our business through advanced automation.
Description of the area
The Applied AI Engineering function is the foundational accelerator for agentic engineering across our Software Development and AI initiatives. We focus on industrializing AI through the development of an agentic engineering practices, and the integration of AI-driven tools into the software development lifecycle. We accelerate closing the gap between proof-of-concept and production-grade services.
This leadership role focuses on the structural and strategic health of the engineering discipline, fostering a culture of excellence, high-performance, and continuous technical evolution within our multidisciplinary squads.
Job Responsibilities

• Engineering Strategy & Governance
Define the long-term technical roadmap for Applied AI engineering. Establish global engineering standards, governance frameworks, and architectural principles to ensure applicability and scalability across all AI services.
Partner with the AI and Data Platform Leads to influence and ensure that AI and Data Platform capabilities are evolving with the frontier engineering demands.

• Organizational Design & Scaling
Design and build high-performing engineering squads. Lead the recruitment and professional development of Technical Team Leads and engineers. Implement organizational structures that optimize for speed, quality, and cross-functional alignment with business consulting teams.

• Platform Development & AI SDLC
Champion the implementation of Agentic SDLC and modern AI/ML engineering practices. Oversee the development of internal AI platforms that provide reusable components, automated testing, and seamless deployment paths for AI models and applications.

• Strategic Leadership & Financial Oversight
Manage the department's engineering budget, including infrastructure costs and vendor relationships. Collaborate with senior leadership to align engineering capacity with the highest-priority business opportunities. Act as a primary technical advisor to executive stakeholders.

• Cross-Functional Partnership
Work in close partnership with the Head of Applied AI Use Case Consulting and Head of Applied AI Solutions to ensure agentic capabilities are integrated into the overall functions demand management process. Ensure that proof of value and delivered solutions meet the business value requirements defined by your peers.
As part of the forward deployed engineerin

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics

Main Tasks:

• Promote and sell Roche Diagnostics Products and Solutions to customers

• Achieve preset sales targets

• Prepare quotation, proposal and exchange business correspondence with customers

• Prepare sales forecast

• Maintain good after-sales services to existing customers

• Help implement marketing plans and new product launch plans

• Collect and report market information and intelligence

Requirements:

• Bachelor degree in Biochemistry, Chemistry, Biomedical Science, or Biology or equivalent

• ≥3 years selling experience in diagnostic field

• General knowledge of clinical laboratory workflow

• General computer software knowledge including WORD, EXCEL, POWERPOINT etc

• Excellent communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills

• Accountable, self-motivated and a good team player

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Diagnostica Roche

Compiti principali:

• Promuovere e vendere prodotti e soluzioni Roche Diagnostics ai clienti

• Ottenere obiettivi di vendita preimpostati

• Preparare quotazione, proposta e scambio di corrispondenza commerciale con i clienti

• Preparare le previsioni di vendita

• Mantenere buoni servizi post-vendita ai clienti esistenti

• Aiuto implementare piani di marketing e nuovi piani di lancio del prodotto

• Raccogliere e segnalare informazioni sul mercato e l'intelligenza

Requisiti:

• Laurea in Biochimica, Chimica, Scienze Biomedicali, Biologia o equivalente

• ≥3 anni di esperienza di vendita nel campo diagnostico

• Conoscenza generale del flusso di lavoro di laboratorio clinico

• Conoscenza generale del software del computer tra cui WORD, EXCEL, POWERPOINT ecc

• Ottima comunicazione, competenze interpersonali e di negoziazione

• Contabile, automotivato e un buon giocatore di squadra

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Roche Diagnostik

Hauptaufgaben:

• Förderung und Verkauf von Roche Diagnostic Produkten und Lösungen an Kunden

• Voreingestellte Verkaufsziele erreichen

• Angebot, Vorschlag und Austausch von Geschäftskorrespondenz mit Kunden erstellen

• Pflegen Sie gute After-Sales-Services für bestehende Kunden

• Erhebung und Meldung von Marktinformationen und Erkenntnissen

• ≥3 Jahre Verkaufserfahrung im diagnostischen Bereich

• Allgemeine Kenntnisse des klinischen Laborworkflows

• Allgemeines Wissen über Computersoftware einschließlich WORD, EXCEL, POWERPOINT usw.

• Hervorragende Kommunikation, zwischenmenschliche und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten

• Verantwortlich, selbstmotiviert und ein guter Teamplayer

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
The ERP team at Roche manages the enterprise’s unified digital backbone, supporting over 100,000 users across more than 100 countries . Our mission is to operate, protect, scale, and innovate the ERP/SAP systems that ensure the reliable delivery of medicines and diagnostics globally . This includes driving the ASPIRE program—one of the healthcare industry’s largest digital transformations, migrating our global footprint to SAP S/4HANA .
The ERP Business Operations team runs the operational engine behind this massive unit . We turn complex workforce, financial, and delivery data into the high-impact insights and strategic decisions that keep our global ecosystem moving forward .

The Role: What You Will Do
We are looking for an independent, tech-savvy, and genuinely curious Business Analyst to own key operational domains end-to-end . You won't just compile spreadsheets; you will instinctively leverage data tooling, automation, and AI to make operations faster, cleaner, and more reliable .
Your core responsibilities will include:

• Workforce & Resource Analytics: Own and maintain the unit's comprehensive global workforce data baseline (internal FTEs, external partners, location strategies, and capacity scaling models) while ensuring absolute data consistency .

• Financial Planning & Budget Tracking: Support budget planning, forecasting, and planned-vs-actual cost tracking . You will reconcile data across sustainment and program lines, investigate variances, and prepare reports that withstand executive scrutiny .

• Leadership Reporting: Prepare and quality-assure recurring status reports, KPI dashboards, and critical decision-support materials for the ERP Leadership Team and governance bodies .

• Process Optimization & AI Automation: Identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone processes and pragmatically redesign them using advanced spreadsheets, BI dashboards, and emerging AI productivity tools .

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as a dependable contact point across Value Streams (Digital Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing), chasing inputs, managing deadlines, and navigating stakeholder pushback constructively .

• Initiative & Content Leadership: Independently structure and drive complex analysis topics sponsored by the Head of ERP, defining problem spaces, performing root-cause analyses, and bringing clear recommendations to a decision .

Who You Are
Experience & Background

• 5+ years of experience in business analysis, business operations, PMO, or financial analysis within a digital technology or large-scale transformation environment .

• A proven track record of independently owning ambiguous analysis topics from a vague question down to a structured, leadership-ready presentation .

• Experience working within global matrix organizations, massive ERP/SAP environments, or regulated fields (Pharma/Biotech) is a major plus .

Technical Skills & Craft

• Data Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel (complex modeling, large datasets, data hygiene) and hands-on experience with BI tools like Looker Studio, Power BI, or Tableau .

• Tech-Savvy & AI-Curious: A distinct passion for experimenting with and adopting new technologies, automation, or scripting (SQL, Python, Apps Script) to optimize workflows .

• Financial Acumen: Comfort working with complex cost structures, resource models, and forecasts, with a sharp eye for tracing financial inconsistencies to their root cause .

• Structured Problem Solving: Ability to apply sys

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

The Delivery Management Professional (SE6) leads moderately complex deliveries, proactively identifies improvements, manages diverse stakeholders, and contributes to strategic implementation. In this role, you will independently define and control the scope of medium to large initiatives, utilizing effective facilitation and analytical skills to drive value delivery. While navigating intricate stakeholder environments, you will connect team development with broader business objectives. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Project Manager, Service (Delivery) Manager, ITSM Process SME, Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / ( Content Leadership): Independently defines, manages, and controls the scope of medium to large initiatives or significant workstreams with moderate complexity. Leads and facilitates the scope definition process, aligning with strategic objectives , stakeholder expectations, and team dependencies. Proactively identifies , analyzes, and mitigates scope-related risks, manages scope changes, and champions the adoption of scope management best practices within the Chapter.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Independently leads the analysis of moderate to complex delivery problems, driving root cause analysis and eliciting complex stakeholder needs. Accountable for comprehensive improvement plans and contributes to solution design and validation. Champions accountability, deals pragmatically with ambiguity, and uses effective facilitation techniques to guide teams while mentoring colleagues and building team spirit.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of stakeholders across functional areas and develops comprehensive stakeholder communication plans. Effectively manages relationships to act as a trusted advisor, proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives, and navigates intricate stakeholder environments by resolving conflicts to ensure alignment.

• Impact/Strategy: Demonstrates consistent performance with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster. Contributes to achieving product or domain goals by ensuring value delivery, takes a proactive role in shaping team processes, and contributes to the implementation of strategic objectives for Informatics, the Chapter, and/or Domains.

• Complexity / ( Product Size): Manages moderately complex initiatives or workstreams extending across a product or service. Manages the delivery of complex features, services, or projects (e.g., a service transition, a product release, or an Agile Release Train (ART) increment). Selects and tailors delivery methodologies while managing dependencies between activities.

• Business/Technical ability: Demonstrates strong business acumen by analyzing business needs and translating them into effective delivery strategies. Selects and adapts delivery methodologies to optimize results, manages complex delivery processes, and utilizes advanced delivery tools and techniques to address business challenges and contribute to planning.

Qualifications

Education / Experience

• Proven track record operating in a Delivery Management archetype (e.g., Project Manager, Service Manager, Scrum Master, RTE, Agile Coach) managing medium to large initiatives or significant workstreams.

• Experience managing the delivery of complex features or projects (such as service transitions or ART increments) across functional are

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Principal Business Analyst possesses in-depth knowledge of the business domain, relevant technologies, and organizational strategy to provide holistic, enterprise-wide consulting advice. In this role, you will apply systems thinking to navigate the complexity of interconnected systems, overseeing initiatives with full autonomy and leading analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces. Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership, you will actively shape long-term roadmaps, drive consensus through persuasive communication, and recommend optimal technology solutions for sustainable business transformation.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Oversees initiatives or streams with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale. Defines and leads analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces, navigates complex frameworks, and delegates work while managing the quality of business analysis content.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, defining the problem space and driving comprehensive root cause analysis that may span organizational boundaries. Proactively prevents scope creep, manages the complexity of various scopes of change, and is ultimately accountable for business analysis deliverables ensuring alignment with broader organizational objectives.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders, including management, across organizational boundaries. Shapes strategy as a trusted advisor to leadership, actively navigates conflicts to achieve alignment, and empowers teams in stakeholder management.

• Impact/Strategy: Drives significant impact on projects and programs by ensuring the delivery of high-value solutions that align with business strategy. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, including advanced value analysis and risk assessment, and actively shapes long-term roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Works typically on a product or product line level, effectively managing highly ambiguous and evolving requirements in dynamic environments. Demonstrates a holistic viewpoint to analyze problems, considering potential micro and macro implications across related domains.

• Business / Technical ability: Uses in-depth knowledge of the business or technical domain and relevant technologies to inform business strategies. Leads the application of tools, principles, and techniques across complex and cross-functional initiatives, anticipating challenges and proactively integrating analysis into broader solution design.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Extensive experience overseeing initiatives with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale, and driving alignment across highly ambiguous spaces.

• Demonstrated advanced knowledge of Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy concepts and practices.

• Proven track record of recommending optimal technology solutions for sustainable business transformation and working on unusually complex problems with highly innovative solutions.

• Ability to apply systems thinking to provide holistic and enterprise-wide consulting advice.

• Strong capability to extend standard approaches by tailoring methods to fit the problem space, often combining methodologies to create tailored approaches.

• Mastery in requirements and domain knowledge, with the ability to conduct comprehensive root cause analysis and advanced value and risk assessments.

Additional Qualifications

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro
Il Principal Business Analyst possiede una conoscenza approfondita del dominio aziendale, delle tecnologie rilevanti e della strategia organizzativa per fornire consulenza olistica e aziendale. In questo ruolo, si applicheranno sistemi che pensano di navigare nella complessità dei sistemi interconnessi, supervisionando iniziative con piena autonomia e principali sforzi di analisi in spazi altamente ambigui. Facendo da consulente di fiducia per la leadership, si forma attivamente roadmap a lungo termine, spingere il consenso attraverso la comunicazione persuasiva, e consigliare soluzioni tecnologiche ottimali per la trasformazione aziendale sostenibile.

Descrizione della zona
Responsabilità del lavoro

• Scope / (Content Leadership): supervisiona iniziative o flussi con autonomia, coordinando complessità e scala. Definisce e conduce gli sforzi di analisi in spazi altamente ambigui, naviga i framework complessi e i delegati lavorano mentre gestiscono la qualità dei contenuti di analisi aziendale.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: conduce l'analisi dei problemi aziendali, definendo lo spazio di problema e guidando l'analisi completa delle cause radice che possono abbracciare i confini organizzativi. Proattivamente previene lo scopo strisciante, gestisce la complessità di vari ambiti di cambiamento, ed è in definitiva responsabile per i risultati di analisi aziendale garantendo l'allineamento con obiettivi organizzativi più ampi.

• Stakeholder Management: Identificare e coinvolgere i principali stakeholder, tra cui la gestione, attraverso i confini organizzativi. Forma la strategia come consulente di fiducia per la leadership, naviga attivamente i conflitti per raggiungere l'allineamento e potenzia i team nella gestione degli stakeholder.

• Impatto/Strategia: Un impatto significativo sui progetti e programmi assicurando la fornitura di soluzioni ad alto valore che si allineano alla strategia aziendale. Conduce la valutazione delle opzioni di soluzione strategica, tra cui analisi del valore avanzato e valutazione del rischio, e forma attivamente roadmap a lungo termine.

• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): Funziona tipicamente a livello di prodotto o di linea di prodotto, gestendo efficacemente requisiti altamente ambigui ed evolutivi in ambienti dinamici. Dimostra un punto di vista olistico per analizzare i problemi, considerando potenziali implicazioni micro e macro su domini correlati.

• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: Utilizza la conoscenza approfondita del dominio commerciale o tecnico e le tecnologie rilevanti per informare le strategie aziendali. Conduce l'applicazione di strumenti, principi e tecniche attraverso iniziative complesse e interfunzionali, anticipando le sfide e integrando in modo proattivo l'analisi nella progettazione di soluzioni più ampie.

Qualifiche
Istruzione / Esperienza

• Esperienza ampia che supervisiona iniziative con autonomia, coordinamento della complessità e della scala e allineamento di guida in spazi altamente ambigui.

• Conoscenza avanzata dimostrata dei concetti e delle pratiche di Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy.

• Risultato record di consigliare soluzioni tecnologiche ottimali per la trasformazione aziendale sostenibile e lavorare su problemi insolitamente complessi con soluzioni altamente innovative.

Competenze tecniche

• Capacità di applicare sistemi che pensano di fornire consulenza olistica e aziendale.

• Forte capacità di estendere approcci standard con metodi di sartoria per adattarsi allo spazio dei problemi, spesso combinando metodologie per creare approcci su misura.

• Padroneggiare nei requisiti e nella conoscenza del dominio, con la capacità di condurre un'analisi completa della causa radice e valutazioni avanzate del valore e del rischio.

Ulteriori qualifiche

• Exc

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Stellenbeschreibung
Der Principal Business Analyst verfügt über fundierte Kenntnisse des Geschäftsbereichs, der relevanten Technologien und der Organisationsstrategie, um eine ganzheitliche, unternehmensweite Beratung zu bieten. In dieser Rolle werden Sie das Systemdenken anwenden, um die Komplexität miteinander verbundener Systeme zu steuern, Initiativen mit voller Autonomie zu überwachen und Analysebemühungen in sehr mehrdeutigen Räumen zu leiten. Als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Führungskräfte gestalten Sie aktiv langfristige Roadmaps, fördern den Konsens durch überzeugende Kommunikation und empfehlen optimale Technologielösungen für eine nachhaltige Geschäftstransformation.

Beschreibung des Gebiets
Aufgabenbereich

• Umfang / (Content Leadership): Überwacht Initiativen oder Streams mit Autonomie, koordiniert Komplexität und Skalierung. Definiert und leitet die Analysebemühungen in sehr mehrdeutigen Bereichen, navigiert komplexe Frameworks und die Delegierten arbeiten, während sie die Qualität der Geschäftsanalyseinhalte verwalten.

• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Leitet die Analyse von Geschäftsproblemen, definiert den Problembereich und führt eine umfassende Ursachenanalyse durch, die organisatorische Grenzen überspannen kann. Proaktiv verhindert Scope Creep, verwaltet die Komplexität verschiedener Änderungsbereiche und ist letztlich für die Ergebnisse der Geschäftsanalyse verantwortlich, die die Ausrichtung auf breitere organisatorische Ziele gewährleisten.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifiziert und bindet wichtige Stakeholder, einschließlich des Managements, über organisatorische Grenzen hinweg ein. Gestaltet die Strategie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater der Führung, steuert aktiv Konflikte, um eine Ausrichtung zu erreichen, und stärkt Teams im Stakeholder-Management.

• Auswirkung/Strategie: Führt zu erheblichen Auswirkungen auf Projekte und Programme, indem es die Bereitstellung hochwertiger Lösungen sicherstellt, die mit der Geschäftsstrategie übereinstimmen. Leitet die Bewertung strategischer Lösungsoptionen, einschließlich fortschrittlicher Wertanalyse und Risikobewertung, und gestaltet aktiv langfristige Roadmaps.

• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Funktioniert typischerweise auf einer Produkt- oder Produktlinienebene und verwaltet effektiv sehr mehrdeutige und sich entwickelnde Anforderungen in dynamischen Umgebungen. Zeigt einen ganzheitlichen Standpunkt zur Analyse von Problemen unter Berücksichtigung möglicher Mikro- und Makroimplikationen in verwandten Bereichen.

• Business / Technische Fähigkeiten: Verwendet fundierte Kenntnisse des Geschäfts- oder technischen Bereichs und relevanter Technologien, um Geschäftsstrategien zu informieren. Leitet die Anwendung von Tools, Prinzipien und Techniken in komplexen und funktionsübergreifenden Initiativen, antizipiert Herausforderungen und integriert proaktiv Analysen in ein breiteres Lösungsdesign.

Qualifikationen
Bildung / Erfahrung

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Überwachung von Initiativen mit Autonomie, der Koordination von Komplexität und Skalierung und der Ausrichtung in sehr mehrdeutigen Räumen.

• Demonstrierte fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse der Business Analysis Advisory / Beratung Konzepte und Praktiken.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Empfehlung optimaler Technologielösungen für eine nachhaltige Geschäftstransformation und der Bearbeitung ungewöhnlich komplexer Probleme mit hochinnovativen Lösungen.

Technische Fähigkeiten

• Fähigkeit, Systemdenken anzuwenden, um ganzheitliche und unternehmensweite Beratungsberatung zu bieten.

• Starke Fähigkeit, Standardansätze zu erweitern, indem Methoden an den Problemraum angepasst werden, wobei häufig Methoden kombiniert werden, um maßgeschneiderte Ansätze zu erstellen.

• Beherrschung von Anforderungen und Domänenkenntnissen mit der Fähigkeit, umfassende Ursachenanalysen und fortgeschrittene Wert- und Risikobewertungen durchzuführen.

Zusätzliche Qualifikationen

• Exc

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Description de l'emploi
L'analyste principal des affaires possède une connaissance approfondie du domaine des affaires, des technologies pertinentes et de la stratégie organisationnelle afin de fournir des conseils-conseils globaux à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Dans ce rôle, vous appliquerez la pensée des systèmes pour naviguer dans la complexité des systèmes interconnectés, superviser les initiatives en toute autonomie et diriger les efforts d'analyse dans des espaces très ambigus. En tant que conseiller de confiance auprès du leadership, vous élaborerez activement des feuilles de route à long terme, susciterez un consensus grâce à une communication persuasive et recommanderez des solutions technologiques optimales pour la transformation durable des entreprises.

Description de la zone
Responsabilités professionnelles

• Portée / ( Leadership du contenu) : Supervise les initiatives ou les volets avec autonomie, coordination de la complexité et de l'échelle. Définit et dirige les efforts d'analyse dans des espaces très ambigus, navigue dans des cadres complexes et délègue le travail tout en gérant la qualité du contenu d'analyse d'affaires.

• Responsabilité/solution des problèmes : Dirige l'analyse des problèmes d'affaires, définit l'espace des problèmes et dirige l'analyse globale des causes profondes qui peut s'étendre aux limites organisationnelles. Prévient de façon proactive l'évolution de la portée, gère la complexité des divers secteurs de changement et, en bout de ligne, rend compte des résultats de l'analyse des activités afin d'assurer l'harmonisation avec les objectifs organisationnels plus généraux.

• Gestion des intervenants : Identifier et mobiliser les intervenants clés, y compris la gestion, au-delà des frontières organisationnelles. Forme la stratégie en tant que conseiller de confiance en matière de leadership, navigue activement dans les conflits pour parvenir à l'alignement et habilite les équipes à gérer les intervenants.

• Impact/Stratégie : Conduit un impact important sur les projets et les programmes en assurant la prestation de solutions de grande valeur qui s'harmonisent avec la stratégie opérationnelle. Dirige l'évaluation des options de solutions stratégiques, y compris l'analyse de valeur avancée et l'évaluation des risques, et élabore activement des feuilles de route à long terme.

• Complexité / (taille du produit): Fonctionne généralement au niveau de la gamme de produits, gérant efficacement des exigences très ambiguës et évolutives dans des environnements dynamiques. Démontre un point de vue holistique pour analyser les problèmes, en tenant compte des implications micro et macro potentielles dans les domaines connexes.

• Capacités d'affaires / techniques: Utilise une connaissance approfondie du domaine d'affaires ou technique et des technologies pertinentes pour éclairer les stratégies d'affaires. Diriger l'application d'outils, de principes et de techniques dans le cadre d'initiatives complexes et interfonctionnelles, anticiper les défis et intégrer proactivement l'analyse à la conception de solutions plus larges.

Compétences
Éducation / Expérience

• Expérience approfondie en matière de supervision des initiatives avec autonomie, de coordination de la complexité et de l'échelle, et d'alignement dans des espaces très ambigus.

• Connaissance avancée démontrée des concepts et des pratiques d'analyse des activités et de consultation.

• Expérience éprouvée de recommander des solutions technologiques optimales pour la transformation durable des entreprises et de travailler sur des problèmes inhabituellement complexes avec des solutions hautement innovantes.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité d'appliquer la pensée des systèmes pour fournir des conseils holistiques et à l'échelle de l'entreprise.

• Forte capacité d'étendre les approches standard en adaptant des méthodes à l'espace de problèmes, combinant souvent des méthodologies pour créer des approches adaptées.

• Maîtrise des exigences et des connaissances du domaine, avec la capacité d'effectuer une analyse complète des causes profondes et des évaluations avancées de la valeur et des risques.

Qualités supplémentaires

• Autres

jobs.title: System Support Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position: System Support Partner
Team: System Support Team
Report to: System Support Lead

Purpose of the Job
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The opportunity
As a System Support Partner, you are the technical linchpin for our integrated diagnostic systems. You will specialize in the intersection of instrumentation, software, IT, and networking, ensuring seamless connectivity, data integrity, and peak system performance at customer sites. Your role is to resolve the most sophisticated, multi-layered technical challenges, acting as the primary escalation point for system-level issues and a key liaison between field service, customers, and global support teams.

• Customer Support & Troubleshooting: Proactively support customer inquiries and complaints, providing fast and effective solutions to application-related issues to exceed customer expectations.

• Installation & Training: Analyze laboratory workflows to provide expert consultation. Lead the installation and configuration of new systems and provide comprehensive training and retraining to customers to ensure they can operate the instruments confidently and efficiently.

• Product Expertise: Serve as a product expert in your designated area, translating complex technical and application information into clear, understandable terms for customers.

• Project Implementation: Support and implement special customer projects, such as e-lab performance, TIQ con, QC six sigma, and turnaround time evaluations, according to the plan.

• Advanced System Troubleshooting : Provide second-level technical support to field engineers and application specialists for diagnosing complex issues across electro-mechanical equipment, computer systems, and software.

• IT & Connectivity Management : Lead the implementation and support of instrument-LIS/HIS interfaces and middleware solutions. Troubleshoot complex connectivity, data transmission, and network configuration issues to ensure robust system integration within customer environments.

• Software Lifecycle & Performance Monitoring : Manage and implement new updates, upgrades, and all related retrofits for instrument hardware and software across the installed base in Thailand.

• Technical Consultation & Project Support : Act as the subject matter expert on system integration and IT requirements. Support special customer projects, such as those related to workflow and turnaround time evaluations, by providing expert IT consultation.

• Technical Enablement & Knowledge Transfer : Enhance the technical knowledge of service personnel through on-the-job coaching and training on advanced system-level topics. Act as a source for related technical knowledge and tools.

• Compliance: Ensure all activities, especially new installations and complaint handling, are completed according to the relevant Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Who you are

Experience and Competencies:

• Proactive & Agile: Independent, a team player, flexible, and solution-driven with an agile mindset.

• Customer-Focused: Demonstrates a high service-minded attitude with a proven record of excellent application and support performance.

• Problem-Solving: Possesses a positive attitude towards work, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to perform well under

The Position
Position: System Support Partner
Team: System Support Team
Report to: System Support Lead

Purpose of the Job
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The opportunity
As a System Support Partner, you are the technical linchpin for our integrated diagnostic systems. You will specialize in the intersection of instrumentation, software, IT, and networking, ensuring seamless connectivity, data integrity, and peak system performance at customer sites. Your role is to resolve the most sophisticated, multi-layered technical challenges, acting as the primary escalation point for system-level issues and a key liaison between field service, customers, and global support teams.

• Customer Support & Troubleshooting: Proactively support customer inquiries and complaints, providing fast and effective solutions to application-related issues to exceed customer expectations.

• Installation & Training: Analyze laboratory workflows to provide expert consultation. Lead the installation and configuration of new systems and provide comprehensive training and retraining to customers to ensure they can operate the instruments confidently and efficiently.

• Product Expertise: Serve as a product expert in your designated area, translating complex technical and application information into clear, understandable terms for customers.

• Project Implementation: Support and implement special customer projects, such as e-lab performance, TIQ con, QC six sigma, and turnaround time evaluations, according to the plan.

• Advanced System Troubleshooting : Provide second-level technical support to field engineers and application specialists for diagnosing complex issues across electro-mechanical equipment, computer systems, and software.

• IT & Connectivity Management : Lead the implementation and support of instrument-LIS/HIS interfaces and middleware solutions. Troubleshoot complex connectivity, data transmission, and network configuration issues to ensure robust system integration within customer environments.

• Software Lifecycle & Performance Monitoring : Manage and implement new updates, upgrades, and all related retrofits for instrument hardware and software across the installed base in Thailand.

• Technical Consultation & Project Support : Act as the subject matter expert on system integration and IT requirements. Support special customer projects, such as those related to workflow and turnaround time evaluations, by providing expert IT consultation.

• Technical Enablement & Knowledge Transfer : Enhance the technical knowledge of service personnel through on-the-job coaching and training on advanced system-level topics. Act as a source for related technical knowledge and tools.

• Compliance: Ensure all activities, especially new installations and complaint handling, are completed according to the relevant Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Who you are

Experience and Competencies:

• Proactive & Agile: Independent, a team player, flexible, and solution-driven with an agile mindset.

• Customer-Focused: Demonstrates a high service-minded attitude with a proven record of excellent application and support performance.

• Problem-Solving: Possesses a positive attitude towards work, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to perform well under

The Global Learning Services teams focus on executing system data maintenance and administrative activities in Cornerstone and all relevant Learning management systems as well as providing all necessary non-systems related Learning process support. As a Learning Systems & Solutions Analyst you work closely with internal Global Learning Services, People Support Solutions, Learning IT staff, business leaders and Learning system vendors to effectively meet the Learning technology needs of the organization. • Partner with local and global teams on the implementation of new systems and initiatives across People Support Solutions

• Support the development of training content and delivery as needed and ensure consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced and i mplement processes and initiatives to ensure continuous improvement as well as service enhancement.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Si prega di notare che questo è un ruolo di copertura premaman a tempo determinato.

I team di Global Learning Services si concentrano sull'esecuzione delle attività di manutenzione e di gestione dei dati del sistema in Cornerstone e in tutti i sistemi di gestione dell'apprendimento pertinenti, oltre a fornire tutti i necessari non sistemi relativi supporto del processo di apprendimento. Global Learning Services fornisce assistenza clienti e supporto consultivo alla comunità di apprendimento e ai partner commerciali sui sistemi e processi di apprendimento globali e garantisce il completamento del processo end-to-end in linea con i principi focalizzati sul cliente per garantire il lavoro Roche People Practices per il business.

L'opportunità:
In qualità di Learning Systems & Solutions Analyst si lavora a stretto contatto con i servizi interni di apprendimento globale, soluzioni di supporto per le persone, personale IT di apprendimento, leader aziendali e fornitori di sistemi di apprendimento per soddisfare efficacemente le esigenze della tecnologia di apprendimento dell'organizzazione. Partner con le controparti globali e locali per rappresentare le esigenze aziendali all'interno della più grande organizzazione globale People Support Solutions per conto di Global Learning Services e della più ampia comunità di apprendimento. Le tue responsabilità includono il supporto e il mantenimento del sistema Cornerstone On Demand, oltre ad altri sistemi interfacciati utilizzati all'interno dell'organizzazione People Support Solutions e della comunità Learning.

• Servire come punto di contatto tecnico/funzionale per i team di Global Learning Services e i relativi gruppi aziendali. Lavora con altri Analisti Tecnologici, Learning Service Advisors, i team di Learning Center of Excellence e Global Learning Services sullo sviluppo di nuove richieste di funzionalità avanzate, che includono la revisione di miglioramenti e funzionalità fornite da Cornerstone e altri sistemi HR Technology/HRIS. Può richiedere lo sviluppo di materiali di formazione/contenuto, compreso il coordinamento e l'esecuzione.

• Eseguire attività varie e complesse associate al supporto del sistema Cornerstone di Roche, oltre a supportare e fornire l'amministrazione di sistema su altri sistemi di apprendimento correlati, cioè sistema di gestione dei casi.

• Servire come esperto di materia e fornire supporto al Learning Center of Excellence e Global Learning Services con un focus sui processi aziendali e le attività di supporto alle applicazioni, tra cui gestione del rilascio, ottimizzazione delle applicazioni, assegnazioni di ruolo di sistema / accesso, risoluzione di problemi, requisiti di raccolta e specifiche da parte degli utenti, la creazione di documenti di specificazione, lavorare con HR, la comunità di apprendimento e team IT per configurare miglioramenti nel sistema, e serve come collegamento a IT per miglioramenti tecnici e indagini.

• Fornire supporto per la risoluzione dei problemi e la risoluzione per le soluzioni di supporto per le persone appropriate per i problemi relativi al sistema (ad esempio Cornerstone, ServiceNow)

• Partner con team locali e globali per l'implementazione di nuovi sistemi e iniziative in ambito People Support Solutions

• Sostenere lo sviluppo del contenuto e della consegna di formazione secondo le necessità e garantire la fornitura di servizi coerente e affidabile per i clienti serviti e i processi di implementazione e le iniziative per garantire il miglioramento continuo e la valorizzazione del servizio.

• Assicurare la cessazione della proprietà della risoluzione, delle operazioni secondo KPI e SLA definiti e garantire la conformità normativa in linea con i paesi, i clienti e le normative.

• Collaborare con i coetanei all'interno della regione e a livello globale per garantire che la rete People Support Solutions fornisca servizi coerenti ed efficaci ai nostri clienti e raggiunga la nostra visione People Support Solutions di Dr.
