At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Maintenance Specialist provides advanced technical support to ensure the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of manufacturing equipment. This role performs troubleshooting, corrective repairs, and preventive/predictive maintenance on electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems to minimize downtime and sustain equipment performance. The Maintenance Specialist works independently or within a team to resolve simple to complex issues, maintains accurate GxP-compliant documentation, and supports engineering activities. This position requires strong mechanical aptitude, practical troubleshooting experience, and the ability to interpret technical instructions, schematics, and automation-related information. The role also collaborates closely with Engineering, Production, and cross-functional teams to support equipment reliability, continuous improvement initiatives, and overall operational readiness.

The Opportunity:

​ ● Perform troubleshooting and corrective maintenance on electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems, resolving simple to medium-complexity failures and identifying true root causes.
● Execute preventive and predictive maintenance tasks to improve equipment reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.
● Work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks, escalating complex issues as needed.
● Maintain accurate and compliant maintenance records, following GxP and strong documentation practices using CMMS and software systems (Google Suite, Microsoft Office, SAP, etc.).
● Provide support to Senior Maintenance Specialists and peers during repairs, including part retrieval, teardown/rebuild assistance, and basic troubleshooting support.
● Demonstrate full competence in the use of hand tools, power tools, test instruments, and precision measurement devices required for maintaining manufacturing equipment.
● Collaborate with engineering, production, and cross-functional teams on equipment-related activities and continuous improvement initiatives.

Who you are:

● High school diploma or equivalency required (Associate degree or equivalent military training preferred).
● Minimum 5 years of troubleshooting and repair experience with electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems in a manufacturing or industrial operations environment. Or, an Associates degree in a technical field or equivalent military training with 2 years of relevant maintenance experience.
● Experience with Precision Maintenance practices.
● Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Suite.
● Strong mechanical aptitude, analytical thinking, and ability to follow technical instructions and schematics.
● Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot, repair, and maintain a wide range of equipment.
● Strong communication skills and ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
● Ability to learn new equipment and technologies through on-the-job training and formal instruction.

Preferred
• Qualifications:

● 7+ years of total experience in mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic maintenance.
● Experience with RSLogix/Studio 5000, servo drives, and basic automation systems.
● Knowledge of GxP requirements.
● Working knowledge of Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) concepts.
● Experience with Lean methodologies (5S, Kaizen, TPM, Six Sigma).

This is an on-site position.
Relocation benefits are not approved for this posting.

Questa posizione richiede una forte attitudine meccanica, un'esperienza di risoluzione dei problemi pratici e la capacità di interpretare le istruzioni tecniche, gli schemi e le informazioni relative all'automazione. Il ruolo collabora anche a stretto contatto con team ingegneristici, produttivi e interfunzionali per supportare l'affidabilità delle attrezzature, le iniziative di miglioramento continuo e la disponibilità operativa complessiva.

L'opportunità:

● Eseguire la risoluzione dei problemi e la manutenzione correttiva su sistemi elettrici, meccanici e pneumatici, risolvendo i guasti semplici a media complessità e identificando le vere cause della radice.
● Eseguire attività di manutenzione preventiva e predittiva per migliorare l'affidabilità delle attrezzature e ridurre i tempi di fermo non pianificati.
● Lavorare in modo indipendente o come parte di un team per completare le attività assegnate, aumentando problemi complessi come necessario.
● Mantenere registri di manutenzione accurati e conformi, seguendo GxP e forti pratiche di documentazione utilizzando sistemi CMMS e software (Google Suite, Microsoft Office, SAP, ecc).
● Fornire supporto a specialisti e coetanei di manutenzione senior durante le riparazioni, tra cui il recupero di parte, la rimozione / ricostruire l'assistenza, e il supporto di risoluzione dei problemi di base.
● Dimostrare piena competenza nell'uso di strumenti manuali, strumenti di potenza, strumenti di prova e dispositivi di misura di precisione necessari per il mantenimento di apparecchiature di produzione.
● Collaborare con team di ingegneria, produzione e cross-funzionali su attività legate alle attrezzature e iniziative di miglioramento continuo.

Chi sei:

● diploma di scuola superiore o equivalenza richiesto (Associate grado o equivalente formazione militare preferito).
● Minimo 5 anni di esperienza di risoluzione dei problemi e riparazione con sistemi elettrici, meccanici e pneumatici in un ambiente di produzione o di operazioni industriali. O, un grado di Associates in un campo tecnico o equivalente formazione militare con 2 anni di esperienza di manutenzione rilevante.
● Esperienza con le pratiche di manutenzione di precisione.
● Proficienza in Microsoft Office e Google Suite.
● Forte attitudine meccanica, pensiero analitico, e la capacità di seguire le istruzioni tecniche e gli schemi.
● Capacità dimostrata di risolvere i problemi, riparare e mantenere una vasta gamma di attrezzature.
● Forte capacità di comunicazione e capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo.
● Capacità di imparare nuove attrezzature e tecnologie attraverso formazione on-the-job e istruzione formale.

Preferito
• Qualifiche:

● 7+ anni di esperienza totale nella manutenzione meccanica, elettrica e pneumatica.
● Esperienza con RSLogix/Studio 5000, servo drive e sistemi di automazione di base.
● Conoscenza dei requisiti GxP.
● Conoscenza di lavoro dei concetti di Manutenzione Centro di Affidabilità (RCM).
● Esperienza con metodologie Lean (5S, Kaizen, TPM, Six Sigma).

Questa è una posizione in loco.
I benefici di trasferimento non sono approvati per questa pubblicazione.

L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla posizione principale di Indianapolis è $51,500.00 - $95,700.00 USD Annuale. Retribuzione effettiva
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Maintenance Specialist provides advanced technical support to ensure the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of manufacturing equipment. This role performs troubleshooting, corrective repairs, and preventive/predictive maintenance on electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems to minimize downtime and sustain equipment performance. The Maintenance Specialist works independently or within a team to resolve simple to complex issues, maintains accurate GxP-compliant documentation, and supports engineering activities. This position requires strong mechanical aptitude, practical troubleshooting experience, and the ability to interpret technical instructions, schematics, and automation-related information. The role also collaborates closely with Engineering, Production, and cross-functional teams to support equipment reliability, continuous improvement initiatives, and overall operational readiness.

The Opportunity:

​ ● Perform troubleshooting and corrective maintenance on electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems, resolving simple to medium-complexity failures and identifying true root causes.
● Execute preventive and predictive maintenance tasks to improve equipment reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.
● Work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks, escalating complex issues as needed.
● Maintain accurate and compliant maintenance records, following GxP and strong documentation practices using CMMS and software systems (Google Suite, Microsoft Office, SAP, etc.).
● Provide support to Senior Maintenance Specialists and peers during repairs, including part retrieval, teardown/rebuild assistance, and basic troubleshooting support.
● Demonstrate full competence in the use of hand tools, power tools, test instruments, and precision measurement devices required for maintaining manufacturing equipment.
● Collaborate with engineering, production, and cross-functional teams on equipment-related activities and continuous improvement initiatives.

Who you are:

● High school diploma or equivalency required (Associate degree or equivalent military training preferred).
● Minimum 5 years of troubleshooting and repair experience with electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems in a manufacturing or industrial operations environment. Or, an Associates degree in a technical field or equivalent military training with 2 years of relevant maintenance experience.
● Experience with Precision Maintenance practices.
● Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Suite.
● Strong mechanical aptitude, analytical thinking, and ability to follow technical instructions and schematics.
● Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot, repair, and maintain a wide range of equipment.
● Strong communication skills and ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
● Ability to learn new equipment and technologies through on-the-job training and formal instruction.

Preferred
• Qualifications:

● 7+ years of total experience in mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic maintenance.
● Experience with RSLogix/Studio 5000, servo drives, and basic automation systems.
● Knowledge of GxP requirements.
● Working knowledge of Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) concepts.
● Experience with Lean methodologies (5S, Kaizen, TPM, Six Sigma).

This is an on-site position.
Relocation benefits are not approved for this posting.

Die Position
Der Wartungsspezialist bietet fortschrittliche technische Unterstützung, um den sicheren, zuverlässigen und effizienten Betrieb von Fertigungsanlagen zu gewährleisten. Diese Rolle führt Fehlersuche, korrigierende Reparaturen und vorbeugende / vorausschauende Wartung an elektrischen, mechanischen und pneumatischen Systemen durch, um Ausfallzeiten zu minimieren und die Leistung der Ausrüstung aufrechtzuerhalten. Der Wartungsspezialist arbeitet unabhängig oder innerhalb eines Teams, um einfache bis komplexe Probleme zu lösen, pflegt eine genaue GxP-konforme Dokumentation und unterstützt Engineering-Aktivitäten. Diese Position erfordert eine starke mechanische Eignung, praktische Erfahrung bei der Fehlerbehebung und die Fähigkeit, technische Anweisungen, Schaltpläne und automatisierungsbezogene Informationen zu interpretieren. Die Rolle arbeitet auch eng mit Engineering, Produktion und funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um die Zuverlässigkeit der Ausrüstung, kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen und die allgemeine Betriebsbereitschaft zu unterstützen.

● Nachweis der Fähigkeit zur Fehlersuche, Reparatur und Wartung einer breiten Palette von Geräten.
Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, sowohl unabhängig als auch kooperativ zu arbeiten.
● Fähigkeit, neue Geräte und Technologien durch On-the-Job-Training und formale Unterweisung zu erlernen.

● 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der mechanischen, elektrischen und pneumatischen Wartung.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Le spécialiste de l'entretien fournit un soutien technique avancé pour assurer le fonctionnement sûr, fiable et efficace de l'équipement de fabrication. Ce rôle consiste à dépanner les systèmes électriques, mécaniques et pneumatiques, à les réparer et à les entretenir de façon préventive ou préventive afin de réduire au minimum les temps d'arrêt et de maintenir les performances de l'équipement. Le spécialiste de la maintenance travaille de façon indépendante ou au sein d'une équipe pour résoudre des problèmes simples à complexes, conserver une documentation précise conforme au GxP et appuyer les activités d'ingénierie. Cette position nécessite une forte aptitude mécanique, une expérience pratique de dépannage et la capacité d'interpréter les instructions techniques, les schémas et l'information liée à l'automatisation. Ce rôle collabore également étroitement avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de production et d'interfonctionnement pour appuyer la fiabilité de l'équipement, les initiatives d'amélioration continue et la préparation opérationnelle globale.

La possibilité :

● Effectuer le dépannage et l'entretien correctif des systèmes électriques, mécaniques et pneumatiques, en résolvant les défaillances simples à moyennes et en identifiant les causes profondes.
● Exécuter des tâches de maintenance préventive et prédictive pour améliorer la fiabilité de l'équipement et réduire les temps d'arrêt imprévus.
● Travaillez de façon indépendante ou en équipe pour accomplir les tâches qui leur sont assignées, ce qui augmente les problèmes complexes au besoin.
● Tenir des dossiers de maintenance précis et conformes, en suivant GxP et de solides pratiques de documentation utilisant les systèmes CMMS et logiciels (Google Suite, Microsoft Office, SAP, etc.).
● Fournir un soutien aux spécialistes principaux de l'entretien et aux pairs pendant les réparations, y compris la récupération des pièces, l'aide à la démolition/reconstruction et l'aide de base au dépannage.
● Démontrer toute compétence dans l'utilisation des outils à main, des outils électriques, des instruments d'essai et des dispositifs de mesure de précision nécessaires à l'entretien des équipements de fabrication.
● Collaborer avec des équipes d'ingénierie, de production et d'interfonctionnement à des activités liées à l'équipement et à des initiatives d'amélioration continue.

Qui vous êtes :

● Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalence requis (diplôme associé ou formation militaire équivalente préférée).
● Au moins 5 ans d'expérience de dépannage et de réparation avec des systèmes électriques, mécaniques et pneumatiques dans un environnement de fabrication ou d'exploitation industrielle. Ou, un diplôme d'associé dans un domaine technique ou une formation militaire équivalente avec 2 années d'expérience de maintenance pertinente.
● Expérience des pratiques d'entretien de précision.
● Compétence en Microsoft Office et en Google Suite.
● Forte aptitude mécanique, réflexion analytique et capacité à suivre les instructions techniques et les schémas.
● Capacité démontrée de dépanner, réparer et entretenir un large éventail d'équipements.
● Fortes capacités de communication et de travail indépendant et collaboratif.
● Capacité d'apprendre de nouveaux équipements et technologies par la formation en cours d'emploi et l'enseignement formel.

Préféré
• Qualifications

● 7+ ans d'expérience totale dans l'entretien mécanique, électrique et pneumatique.
● Expérience avec RSLogix/Studio 5000, lecteurs de servomoteurs et systèmes d'automatisation de base.
● Connaissance des exigences du GxP.
● Connaissance pratique des concepts de maintenance centrée sur la fiabilité.
● Expérience des méthodologies Lean (5S, Kaizen, TPM, Six Sigma).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Senior Program Manager- RDT Hyderabad

Work Location - Hyderabad

As the Senior Program Manager, you are the operational architect of Roche Digital Technology’s (RDT) most critical strategic evolution: the transformation of our global external ecosystem and the establishment of the RDT Tech Hub in Hyderabad. You will bridge the gap between high-level executive vision and on-the-ground execution, orchestrating a large-scale, time-bound initiative that fundamentally redefines how Roche harnesses digital talent.
Operating with significant autonomy, you will manage the roadmap, rigorous financial tracking, and value-realization targets of a unified workforce strategy. This is a "legacy-building" role designed for a transformative leader capable of driving cultural change and operational excellence across a global multinational matrix.

Key Accountabilities

• Strategic Hub Orchestration: Lead the end-to-end delivery of the "RDT Hyderabad Tech Hub." Define the multi-year roadmap, establish KPIs, and ensure the seamless integration of this new capability into the global RDT ecosystem.

• Ecosystem & Value Optimization: Execute a program strategy that leverages deep market insights to drive cost efficiencies and value creation. You will move the organization toward a more effective digital delivery model by optimizing external partner engagements.

• Governance & Workforce Policy: Implement a consistent governance framework and "Total Workforce Management" policies. Ensure RDT functions are aligned with how we attract, manage, and retain talent in a hybrid global model.

• Executive Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary liaison for the RDT Leadership Team. Prepare executive-level briefings, influence senior decision-makers to remove roadblocks, and ensure cross-functional alignment with Finance, P&C (HR), Legal, and Procurement.

• Change Leadership: Drive the cultural shift required for a successful transformation. You will guide global teams through the adoption of new operational processes and foster a "partnership-first" mindset with strategic vendors.

• Financial & Data Integrity: In partnership with Financial Enterprise Partners, oversee the program budget. You will be responsible for the "Planned vs. Actual" tracking of costs and the synthesis of complex data into actionable insights for the CDTO and leadership.

Key Leadership Competencies and Skills

• Market Intelligence: Knowledge of the Indian Global Capability Center (GCC) landscape, including talent trends, vendor ecosystems, and operational best practices.

• Strategic Program Leadership: Proven track record of managing $10M+ digital transformation portfolios. You are adept at using Agile and Waterfall methodologies to manage complex, cross-functional workstreams.

• Executive Presence & Influence: Exceptional ability to navigate a complex matrix organization. You can persuade C-suite-level stakeholders and build consensus across disparate global regions.

• Business & Financial Acumen: Ability to translate operational data into clear P&L impacts. You possess a "business-owner" mindset regarding budget management and resource allocation.

• Analytical Problem Solving: A pragmatic approach to troubleshooting large-scale organizational hurdles, with the ability to simplify complex information into clear strategic choices.

• Strategic Hub Orchestration: Guida la consegna end-to-end del "RDT Hyderabad Tech Hub". Definire la roadmap pluriennale, stabilire i KPI e garantire l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità di questa nuova funzionalità nell'ecosistema RDT globale.

• Ecosystem & Value Optimization: Eseguire una strategia di programma che sfrutta intuizioni di mercato profonde per guidare le efficienze dei costi e la creazione di valore. Trasferirai l'organizzazione verso un modello di consegna digitale più efficace ottimizzando gli impegni dei partner esterni.

• Governance & Workforce Policy: implementare un quadro di governance coerente e le politiche di "Total Workforce Management". Assicurare funzioni RDT sono allineati con come attrarre, gestire e mantenere il talento in un modello globale ibrido.

• Executive Stakeholder Management: agire come collegamento primario per il team di leadership RDT. Preparare briefing executive-level, influenzare i decisori senior per rimuovere i blocchi stradali, e garantire l'allineamento interfunzionale con Finance, P&C (HR), Legale e Procurement.

• Cambia leadership: guidare il cambiamento culturale necessario per una trasformazione di successo. Potrai guidare i team globali attraverso l'adozione di nuovi processi operativi e promuovere una mentalità "partnership-first" con fornitori strategici.

• Financial & Data Integrity: In collaborazione con Financial Enterprise Partners, supervisionare il budget del programma. Sarete responsabili del monitoraggio "Planned vs. Actual" dei costi e della sintesi di dati complessi in insight attuabili per il CDTO e la leadership.

Competenze e competenze chiave di Leadership

• Intelligenza di mercato: Conoscenza del paesaggio del Global Capability Center indiano (GCC), comprese le tendenze del talento, gli ecosistemi dei fornitori e le migliori pratiche operative.

• Leadership del programma strategico: comprovato record di gestione dei portafogli di trasformazione digitale di $10M+. Sei abile nell'utilizzo di metodologie Agile e Waterfall per gestire flussi di lavoro complessi e interfunzionali.

• Presenza e influenza esecutiva: Eccezionale capacità di navigare in una complessa matrice organizzazione. È possibile convincere le parti interessate a livello C-suite e costruire il consenso in diverse regioni globali.

• Business & Financial Acumen: Capacità di tradurre i dati operativi in chiari impatti P&L. Possiedi una mentalità "business-owner" per quanto riguarda la gestione del bilancio e l'allocazione delle risorse.

• Risolvere i problemi analitici: un approccio pragmatico alla risoluzione dei problemi di grandi ostacoli organizzativi, con la capacità di semplificare le informazioni complesse in scelte strategiche chiare.

Als Senior Program Manager sind Sie der operative Architekt der wichtigsten strategischen Entwicklung von Roche Digital Technology (RDT): die Transformation unseres globalen externen Ökosystems und die Gründung des RDT Tech Hub in Hyderabad. Sie schließen die Lücke zwischen einer hochrangigen Führungsvision und der Ausführung vor Ort und orchestrieren eine groß angelegte, zeitgebundene Initiative, die grundlegend neu definiert, wie Roche digitale Talente nutzt.
Mit erheblicher Autonomie verwalten Sie die Roadmap, die strenge Finanzverfolgung und die Wertrealisierungsziele einer einheitlichen Personalstrategie. Dies ist eine "Legacy-Building" -Rolle für einen transformativen Führer, der in der Lage ist, kulturellen Wandel und operative Exzellenz in einer globalen multinationalen Matrix voranzutreiben.

Hauptbuchhaltung

• Strategic Hub Orchestration: Führen Sie die End-to-End-Lieferung des "RDT Hyderabad Tech Hub". Definieren Sie den mehrjährigen Fahrplan, legen Sie KPIs fest und gewährleisten Sie die nahtlose Integration dieser neuen Fähigkeit in das globale RDT-Ökosystem.

• Ecosystem & Value Optimization: Führen Sie eine Programmstrategie aus, die tiefe Markterkenntnisse nutzt, um Kosteneffizienz und Wertschöpfung zu steigern. Sie bewegen das Unternehmen zu einem effektiveren digitalen Bereitstellungsmodell, indem Sie externe Partnereinsätze optimieren.

• Governance & Workforce Policy: Implementieren Sie einen konsistenten Governance-Rahmen und "Total Workforce Management" -Richtlinien. Stellen Sie sicher, dass RDT-Funktionen darauf ausgerichtet sind, wie wir Talente in einem globalen Hybridmodell gewinnen, verwalten und halten.

• Executive Stakeholder Management: Handeln Sie als primäre Verbindungsstelle für das RDT Leadership Team. Bereiten Sie Briefings auf Führungsebene vor, beeinflussen Sie leitende Entscheidungsträger, um Hindernisse zu beseitigen, und sorgen Sie für eine funktionsübergreifende Abstimmung mit Finanzen, P & C (HR), Recht und Beschaffung.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
At Roche, we are shaping the future of healthcare through data and digital innovation. We are looking for a Platform Architect / Senior Solution Architect to lead the design and evolution of our Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) and Data Streaming platforms.
In this role, you will define and drive the architectural vision for scalable, secure, and high-performance data integration platforms, enabling real-time data flow across the enterprise. You will play a critical role in transforming how Roche leverages streaming data to accelerate insights and improve patient outcomes.

Your Mission
You will act as a technical and architectural leader, responsible for designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions across complex, multi-product ecosystems.
You will:

• Establish and evolve event-driven and streaming architecture patterns

• Drive platform strategy and roadmap for Kafka, Solace, and related technologies

• Ensure solutions meet non-functional requirements (NFRs) including scalability, resiliency, security, and observability

• Enable enterprise-wide adoption of streaming and event-driven integration

Key Responsibilities
Architecture Leadership & Strategy

• Define and communicate a shared architectural vision for Data Streaming and Event-Driven platforms

• Develop and maintain the technology roadmap, aligning with Roche’s enterprise architecture strategy

• Drive reference architectures, patterns, and integration standards for EDA and streaming

• Lead architecture governance, including Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and design reviews

Solution Design & Delivery

• Design end-to-end event-driven solutions across business domains

• Create conceptual and logical data models, taxonomies, and integration patterns

• Ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, balancing emergent design with long-term sustainability

• Embed observability, resilience, and performance engineering into platform designs

Platform Ownership (Kafka / Solace / Streaming Ecosystem)

• Lead architecture for data streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Solace, Kinesis)

• Define topic design, event schemas, and data contracts

• Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and multi-region architectures

• Drive platform scalability, security, and governance

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

• Evaluate and pilot emerging technologies and trends in EDA and streaming

• Conduct proofs of concept (PoCs) and feasibility studies

• Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve platform efficiency

• Promote reuse of integration patterns across the enterprise

Stakeholder Collaboration

• Partner with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders

• Facilitate workshops to define business processes and integration needs

• Align with enterprise architects and contribute to architecture communities

• Communicate complex concepts clearly and influence decision-making

Your Profile
Experience

• 5+ years as a Solution Architect / Platform Architect

• Proven experience designing event-driven and streaming architectures in enterprise environments

• Hands-on experience with platforms such as:

• Apache Kafka / Confluent Kafka

• Solace Event Broker

• AWS streaming services (Kinesis, MSK)

• Experience in highly regulated industries (pharma, healthcare, finance) is a plus

Technical Expertise

• Deep knowledge of:

• Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) and Streaming patterns

• Data lifecycle management (ingestion, integration, governance,

• Embed osservanza, resilienza e ingegneria delle prestazioni in progetti di piattaforma

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Supply Chain division operates as a vital strategic vehicle for business transformation, driving cross-functional alignment and global regulatory compliance across R&D, Manufacturing, and Quality functions. The department focuses on embedding innovative design methodologies, standardizing end-to-end supply chain integration, and planning multi-year distribution footprints to achieve carbon neutrality. Every team member in this global network is dedicated to permanently optimizing processes in order to increase quality and efficiency standards, ensuring that organizational future readiness is balanced with high-precision launch execution.

We are seeking a Global Product Launch and Supply Chain Lead ( New Product Launch Expert (Instruments) - Supply Chain ) to manage organization-wide integration initiatives and new product commercialization on an international scale. This role functions with an operational-to-strategic split that balances 60% operational execution, coordinating timelines, managing volume ramps, and resolving immediate cold chain bottlenecks, with 40% strategic direction focused on footprint optimization and high-level systems thinking. Operating as a transformational project leader, you will navigate highly ambiguous, cross-functional challenges to bring complex instruments and hardware systems successfully to market.
The Opportunity

• Securing global launch readiness and achieving successful pilot-to-commercial scaling across diverse countries drives organization-wide performance and long-term commercial impact.

• Dedicating 60% of your time to day-to-day timeline coordination, volume ramps, and immediate cold chain or regulatory compliance bottleneck resolution ensures products hit the market smoothly.

• Executing multi-year planning in the early stages of the Product Life Cycle positions the network for future readiness regarding hardware solutions that may not launch for two to five years.

• Challenging the status quo involves introducing new technologies and design methodologies to break down structural silos and foster a transformational leadership environment.

• Overseeing critical, large-scale integration projects encompasses managing E2E supply chain workflows, divisional launches, and technical problem-solving across internal manufacturing and external sites.

• Influencing internal leaders across the DIA Supply Chain Leadership Team, Finance, and R&D happens on a daily or weekly basis alongside negotiating global design standards with external Logistics Service Providers.

• Managing high-stakes conflicts is central to this governance role, specifically when balancing R&D’s desire for speed against supply chain compliance or aligning financial cost goals with operational resilience needs.

Who You Are

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering, or Supply Chain Management is required, with an MBA or advanced technical degree preferred.

• Possessing 8+ years of leadership experience within Diagnostics, Medical Devices, or Aerospace/Capital Equipment is essential, backed by a deep understanding of manufacturing and distributing complex hardware systems.

• Proven experience managing global launches for capital equipment and instruments in highly regulated environments, such as ISO 13485 or FDA frameworks, is necessary.

• Deep comprehension of the hardware Product Life Cycle is required, including manufacturing scale-up, global trade compliance for electronics, and field

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
La divisione Global Supply Chain opera come veicolo strategico vitale per la trasformazione aziendale, la guida dell'allineamento interfunzionale e la conformità normativa globale nelle funzioni R&D, Manufacturing e Quality. Il dipartimento si concentra sull'integrazione di metodologie di progettazione innovative, sulla standardizzazione dell'integrazione della supply chain end-to-end e sulla pianificazione di impronte di distribuzione pluriennali per raggiungere la neutralità del carbonio. Ogni membro del team di questa rete globale è dedicato all'ottimizzazione permanente dei processi al fine di aumentare gli standard di qualità ed efficienza, garantendo che la disponibilità futura organizzativa sia bilanciata con l'esecuzione di lancio ad alta precisione.

Stiamo cercando un Global Product Launch and Supply Chain Lead (New Product Launch Expert (Instruments) - Supply Chain ) per gestire le iniziative di integrazione a livello organizzativo e la nuova commercializzazione dei prodotti su scala internazionale. Questo ruolo funziona con una divisione operativa-to-strategica che bilancia l'esecuzione operativa del 60%, coordinando le linee temporali, gestendo le rampe di volume e risolvendo i colli di bottiglia a catena fredda immediata, con il 40% di direzione strategica focalizzata sull'ottimizzazione delle impronte e il pensiero di sistemi di alto livello. Operando come leader di progetto trasformazionale, navigherai sfide altamente ambigue e interfunzionali per portare al mercato strumenti complessi e sistemi hardware.
L'opportunità

• L'acquisizione della disponibilità di lancio globale e il raggiungimento di un successo di scaling pilota-commerciale in diversi paesi guida le prestazioni a livello organizzativo e l'impatto commerciale a lungo termine.

• Dedicando il 60% del vostro tempo al coordinamento timeline di giorno per giorno, rampe di volume, e immediata catena a freddo o conformità normativa soluzione bottleneck assicura che i prodotti colpiscono il mercato senza intoppi.

• L'esecuzione della pianificazione pluriennale nelle prime fasi del ciclo di vita del prodotto pone la rete per la disponibilità futura per le soluzioni hardware che potrebbero non lanciare per due o cinque anni.

• Sfidare lo status quo comporta l'introduzione di nuove tecnologie e metodologie di progettazione per abbattere i silos strutturali e promuovere un ambiente di leadership trasformazionale.

• La supervisione di progetti critici di integrazione su larga scala comprende la gestione dei flussi di lavoro della supply chain di E2E, i lanci divisionali e la risoluzione dei problemi tecnici attraverso la produzione interna e siti esterni.

• L'influenza dei leader interni in tutto il team di Leadership DIA Supply Chain, finanza e R&D avviene ogni giorno o settimana, oltre a negoziare standard di progettazione globali con i fornitori di servizi logistici esterni.

• Gestire conflitti di alto livello è fondamentale per questo ruolo di governance, in particolare quando si bilancia il desiderio di R&D di velocità contro la conformità della supply chain o allineare gli obiettivi dei costi finanziari con le esigenze di resilienza operativa.

Chi sei

• Una laurea o Master in ingegneria meccanica, elettrica o industriale, o Supply Chain Management è richiesto, con un MBA o un grado tecnico avanzato preferito.

• Possedere 8+ anni di esperienza di leadership all'interno di sistemi diagnostici, dispositivi medici, o attrezzature aerospaziale / ospedaliera è essenziale, sostenuta da una profonda comprensione della produzione e della distribuzione di sistemi hardware complessi.

• È necessaria una comprovata esperienza nella gestione dei lanci globali per attrezzature e strumenti di capitale in ambienti altamente regolamentati, come i quadri ISO 13485 o FDA.

• È necessaria una profonda comprensione dell'hardware del ciclo di vita del prodotto, compresa la scala di produzione, la conformità commerciale globale per l'elettronica e il campo

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Die Division Global Supply Chain agiert als wichtiges strategisches Vehikel für die Geschäftstransformation, die funktionsübergreifende Ausrichtung und globale regulatorische Compliance in den Bereichen Forschung und Entwicklung, Fertigung und Qualität. Die Abteilung konzentriert sich auf die Einbettung innovativer Designmethoden, die Standardisierung der End-to-End-Lieferkettenintegration und die Planung mehrjähriger Vertriebsbilanzen, um CO2-Neutralität zu erreichen. Jedes Teammitglied in diesem globalen Netzwerk widmet sich der permanenten Optimierung von Prozessen, um die Qualitäts- und Effizienzstandards zu erhöhen und sicherzustellen, dass die organisatorische Zukunftsbereitschaft mit einer hochpräzisen Startausführung in Einklang gebracht wird.

Wir suchen einen Global Product Launch and Supply Chain Lead (New Product Launch Expert (Instruments) - Supply Chain), um organisationsweite Integrationsinitiativen und die Kommerzialisierung neuer Produkte auf internationaler Ebene zu verwalten. Diese Rolle funktioniert mit einer operativen-zu-strategischen Aufteilung, die die operative Ausführung von 60% ausgleicht, Zeitlinien koordiniert, Volumenrampen verwaltet und unmittelbare Kühlkettenengpässe löst, wobei sich die strategische Ausrichtung von 40% auf die Optimierung des Fußabdrucks und das Denken auf hoher Ebene konzentriert. Als transformativer Projektleiter navigieren Sie durch sehr mehrdeutige, funktionsübergreifende Herausforderungen, um komplexe Instrumente und Hardwaresysteme erfolgreich auf den Markt zu bringen.
Die Chance

• Die Sicherung der globalen Startbereitschaft und das Erreichen einer erfolgreichen Pilot-to-Commercial-Skalierung in verschiedenen Ländern tragen zur unternehmensweiten Leistung und langfristigen kommerziellen Auswirkungen bei.

• Wenn Sie 60% Ihrer Zeit der täglichen Timeline-Koordination, Volumenrampen und der sofortigen Lösung von Kühlketten- oder Compliance-Engpässen widmen, werden Produkte reibungslos auf den Markt gebracht.

• Die Durchführung einer mehrjährigen Planung in den frühen Phasen des Product Life Cycle positioniert das Netzwerk für die zukünftige Bereitschaft in Bezug auf Hardwarelösungen, die möglicherweise erst in zwei bis fünf Jahren eingeführt werden.

• Um den Status quo herauszufordern, müssen neue Technologien und Designmethoden eingeführt werden, um strukturelle Silos abzubauen und ein transformatives Führungsumfeld zu fördern.

• Die Überwachung kritischer, groß angelegter Integrationsprojekte umfasst die Verwaltung von E2E-Lieferketten-Workflows, die Einführung von Abteilungen und die technische Problemlösung an internen Fertigungs- und externen Standorten.

• Die Beeinflussung interner Führungskräfte in den Bereichen Supply Chain Leadership Team, Finanzen und F&E erfolgt täglich oder wöchentlich neben der Verhandlung globaler Designstandards mit externen Logistikdienstleistern.

• Die Bewältigung von Konflikten mit hohen Einsätzen ist von zentraler Bedeutung für diese Governance-Rolle, insbesondere wenn der Wunsch von F & E nach Geschwindigkeit mit der Einhaltung der Lieferkette in Einklang gebracht oder die finanziellen Kostenziele an die Anforderungen der operativen Widerstandsfähigkeit angepasst werden.

Wer du bist

• Ein Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder Industrietechnik oder Supply Chain Management ist erforderlich, wobei ein MBA oder ein fortgeschrittener technischer Abschluss bevorzugt wird.

• Über 8 Jahre Führungserfahrung in den Bereichen Diagnostik, Medizinprodukte oder Aerospace/Capital Equipment sind unerlässlich, unterstützt durch ein tiefes Verständnis der Herstellung und Verteilung komplexer Hardwaresysteme.

• Bewährte Erfahrung im Umgang mit globalen Einführungen für Investitionsgüter und -instrumente in stark regulierten Umgebungen wie ISO 13485 oder FDA-Frameworks ist notwendig.

• Ein tiefes Verständnis des Hardware-Produktlebenszyklus ist erforderlich, einschließlich Scale-up, Global Trade Compliance für Elektronik und Feld
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
La division de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale fonctionne comme un véhicule stratégique vital pour la transformation des activités, la conduite de l'alignement interfonctionnel et la conformité de la réglementation mondiale aux fonctions de R-D, de Fabrication et de Qualité. Le Ministère se concentre sur l'intégration de méthodes de conception novatrices, la normalisation de l'intégration de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de bout en bout et la planification d'empreintes de distribution pluriannuelles pour atteindre la neutralité carbone. Chaque membre de l'équipe de ce réseau mondial se consacre à l'optimisation permanente des processus afin d'améliorer les normes de qualité et d'efficacité, en veillant à ce que l'état de préparation de l'organisation soit équilibré avec l'exécution de lancement de haute précision.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader mondial du lancement de produits et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement (Nouvel Expert de lancement de produits (Instruments) - Chaîne d'approvisionnement) pour gérer les initiatives d'intégration à l'échelle de l'organisation et la commercialisation de nouveaux produits à l'échelle internationale. Ce rôle fonctionne avec une répartition opérationnelle-stratégique qui équilibre l'exécution opérationnelle de 60 %, la coordination des délais, la gestion des rampes de volume et la résolution des goulets d'étranglement immédiats de la chaîne du froid, avec une orientation stratégique de 40 % axée sur l'optimisation de l'empreinte et la réflexion des systèmes de haut niveau. Fonctionnant en tant que chef de projet transformationnel, vous allez naviguer des défis hautement ambigus, interfonctionnels pour apporter des instruments complexes et des systèmes matériels avec succès sur le marché.
L'opportunité

• Le fait d'être prêt au lancement à l'échelle mondiale et d'atteindre une échelle pilote à commerciale réussie dans divers pays est à l'origine de la performance de l'organisation et de son impact commercial à long terme.

• Dédiez 60 % de votre temps à la coordination quotidienne des délais, des rampes de volume et de la chaîne du froid immédiate ou de la conformité réglementaire.

• L'exécution de la planification pluriannuelle aux premières étapes du cycle de vie du produit permet au réseau de se préparer à des solutions matérielles qui ne seront peut-être pas lancées pendant deux à cinq ans.

• Pour faire face au statu quo, il faut introduire de nouvelles technologies et des méthodes de conception pour briser les cloisonnements structurels et favoriser un environnement de leadership transformationnel.

• Surveillant des projets d'intégration critiques à grande échelle, il s'agit de gérer les flux de travail de la chaîne d'approvisionnement E2E, les lancements de divisions et la résolution de problèmes techniques dans tous les sites de fabrication interne et externes.

• Influencer les dirigeants internes de l'équipe de leadership de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des finances et de la R-D de la DIA se produit tous les jours ou toutes les semaines, parallèlement à la négociation de normes de conception mondiales avec des fournisseurs externes de services logistiques.

• La gestion des conflits à fort débit est au cœur de ce rôle de gouvernance, en particulier lorsqu'il s'agit d'équilibrer le désir de R-D en fonction de la conformité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou d'aligner les objectifs de coûts financiers sur les besoins de résilience opérationnelle.

Qui vous êtes

• Un baccalauréat en génie mécanique, électrique ou industriel ou en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement est requis, avec un MBA ou un diplôme technique avancé préféré.

• Il est essentiel de posséder plus de 8 ans d'expérience en leadership au sein des systèmes diagnostiques, des dispositifs médicaux ou des équipements aérospatiaux/capitaux, grâce à une compréhension approfondie de la fabrication et de la distribution de systèmes matériels complexes.

• Une expérience éprouvée de la gestion des lancements mondiaux d'équipement et d'instruments dans des environnements hautement réglementés, comme les cadres ISO 13485 ou FDA, est nécessaire.

• Une compréhension approfondie du cycle de vie du matériel est nécessaire, y compris l'échelle de fabrication, la conformité commerciale mondiale pour l'électronique et le terrain

• Istruzione: Corso di laurea in Informatica, Clinical Laboratory Science, o Biomedical Science

• Collaborazione: Un vero giocatore di squadra che è orientato al cliente, orientato alla soluzione e pronto ad imparare insieme ai pari

Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
APAC Senior Lab IT Specialist, Roche Diagnostics Asia Pacific

The Opportunity:
As the APAC Senior Lab IT Specialist, you will drive technical excellence, lead regional initiatives and empower affiliates across the Roche Diagnostics Asia Pacific landscape. You will bridge the gap between complex digital products and regional business needs, ensuring seamless project delivery and robust system integration.

As APAC Senior Lab IT Specialist, you will be responsible for:

• Regional Strategy & Alignment: Collaborate with APAC affiliates, product marketing and Global Customer Support (GCS) teams to successfully align and adopt digital strategies across Roche Information Solution (RIS) and Roche Diagnostics Solution (RDS)

• Technical Support & Escalations: Provide high-level technical support for APAC affiliates across Roche digital products, ensuring critical, escalated issues are efficiently resolved

• Project Leadership: Lead the rollout and implementation of new features and products, coordinating seamlessly between internal stakeholders and regional affiliates

• Community & Knowledge Transfer: Advocate for industry best practices, mentor team members and conduct regional workshops to drive continuous internal knowledge transfer

• Process Optimization: Propose and execute continuous system and process improvements to enhance Lab IT service delivery across the APAC region

• Future Proofing: Support the formulation of a sustainable, long-term APAC Lab IT support model aligned with the broader RIS strategy

• Based in Singapore and reports to APAC Lab IT Team Manager, Service & Support, Lab & C-Suite Value Stream

Who You Are

Required Technical Skills & Background

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Clinical Laboratory Science, or Biomedical Science

• Experience: 5 years of hands-on experience in the clinical diagnostics field (e.g., as a Medical Technologist or LIS Administrator)

• System Integration: Expert-level proficiency in Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) and diagnostics product integration

• Technical Stack: Strong command of network topology, LINUX, SQL queries, data flow configurations, and interface engines utilizing ASTM/HL7 standards

Preferred Qualifications (Highly Desirable)

• Cybersecurity & Data Protection:

• Solid understanding of cybersecurity principles relevant to healthcare environments, including medical device security, data privacy regulations, and threat vulnerability management

• Familiarity with secure data transmission protocols and network segmentation within a hospital or laboratory infrastructure

Core Competencies & Soft Skills

• Leadership Mindset: Accountable, self-driven and eager to take on challenging projects outside of routine responsibilities

• Interpersonal Excellence: Strong communication, facilitation and negotiation skills, with full professional fluency in written and verbal English

• Collaboration: A true team player who is customer-centric, solution-oriented and keen to learn alongside peers

• Mobility: Willingness and flexibility to travel internationally up to 40% of the time

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibi

strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to
cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process

solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes,
methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

The Demand to Pay (D2P) Value Stream is responsible for driving the end-to-end Procurement, Accounts Payable and Travel & Expense Management Data & AI strategies, by translating Functional strategies into measurable business outcomes.
The role is part of ERP Source to Procure Team within ERP Demand to Pay(D2P) value stream.
As a Senior D2P Solution Consultant and subject matter expert of indirect & Direct procurement focusing on the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle, you will bridge the gap between complex procurement business requirements and technical IT solutions translating business needs into technical solutions.
You will be responsible for optimizing the end-to-end process—from strategic sourcing and contract management to requisitioning, purchasing and receiving, decomposition into Features/User Stories using SAFe, Jira, and ServiceNow. Leveraging your SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement or similar procurement platform expertise, you will ensure global system stability and drive innovative enhancements across the enterprise.
Your goal is to develop sustainable IT solutions to enhance operational efficiency, ensure data integrity, and drive the digital transformation of our procurement landscape.

Job Responsibilities

• Process Optimization: Analyze, document, and redesign "as-is" and "to-be" business processes across the S2P lifecycle (Sourcing, Contracting, Supplier Management, Purchasing, and Invoicing).

• Requirements Engineering: Lead discovery workshops with stakeholders to elicit high-quality business requirements. Translate these into functional specifications, user stories, and technical workflows.

Oversee system configurations and enhancement requests.Write and review functional and technical specifications (incl. WRICEFs), perform testing and cut-over/ deployment activities.

A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro
Come consulente senior della soluzione D2P, gestirete in modo indipendente l'analisi end-to-end
workstreams, affrontare problemi di business complessi con ambiguità emergente. Lo farai.
dimostrare una forte comprensione del dominio aziendale, delle tecnologie correlate e della loro
interdipendenze, applicazione di strumenti e tecniche avanzate per tradurre i requisiti in
piani di attuazione strategici. In questo ruolo, si agirà come consulente di fiducia a
team interfunzionali, modellare le prospettive degli stakeholder, gestire il processo
interdipendenze, e contribuire significativamente alla progettazione e validazione di efficace
soluzioni. Potrai anche mentore analisti junior e modellare attivamente i processi del team,
metodologie e migliori pratiche all'interno della più ampia Comunità di pratica.
Descrizione della zona
La richiesta di pagamento (D2P) Value Stream è responsabile per la guida delle strategie di gestione dei dati e dell'intelligenza artificiale, traducendo strategie funzionali in risultati aziendali misurabili.
Il ruolo fa parte del flusso di valore ERP Source to Procure Team all'interno di ERP Demand to Pay(D2P).
In qualità di consulente senior della soluzione D2P e esperto in materia di approvvigionamento indiretto e diretto che si concentra sul ciclo di vita Procure-to-Pay (P2P), collaborerai il divario tra i complessi requisiti aziendali di approvvigionamento e le soluzioni IT tecniche che traducono le esigenze aziendali in soluzioni tecniche.
Sarete responsabili dell'ottimizzazione del processo end-to-end, dal supporto strategico e dalla gestione dei contratti alla requisizione, all'acquisto e alla ricezione, alla decomposizione in Caratteristiche/User Stories utilizzando SAFe, Jira e ServiceNow. Grazie all'esperienza di SAP S/4HANA Sourcing e Procurement o simili piattaforme di approvvigionamento, garantirai stabilità del sistema globale e guiderai miglioramenti innovativi in tutta l'azienda.
Il vostro obiettivo è quello di sviluppare soluzioni IT sostenibili per migliorare l'efficienza operativa, garantire l'integrità dei dati e guidare la trasformazione digitale del nostro paesaggio di approvvigionamento.

Responsabilità del lavoro

• Ottimizzazione dei processi: Analizzare, documentare e ridisegnare processi aziendali "as-is" e "to-be" attraverso il ciclo di vita S2P (Sourcing, Contracting, Gestione dei fornitori, Acquisizione e Fatturazione).

• Ingegneria dei requisiti: laboratori di scoperta di piombo con le parti interessate per suscitare requisiti aziendali di alta qualità. Traduci questi in specifiche funzionali, storie utente e flussi di lavoro tecnici.

• Solution Design: agire come esperto funzionale/tecnico per piattaforme S2P (ad esempio, Smart by GEP, ORO, SAP S4HANA, GEP Nexxe e altri). Controllare le configurazioni di sistema e le richieste di miglioramento. Scrivere e rivedere le specifiche funzionali e tecniche (incl. WRICEFs), eseguire attività di test e cut-over/implementazione.

• Gestione dell'integrazione: collaborare con i team tecnici per gestire le integrazioni tra gli strumenti S2P e i sistemi ERP (ad esempio, SAP S/4HANA), garantendo un flusso di dati senza soluzione di continuità per i dati master e i record finanziari. Guidare la progettazione di WRICEF complessi, in particolare focalizzandosi su Interfaces (I) utilizzando SAP Integration Suite (BTP/CPI), Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG), o Middleware (ad esempio MuleSoft).

• Data Mapping & Transformation: Definire e documentare la mappatura a livello di campo dettagliata (IDOC, API, cXML, OData) per oggetti di approvvigionamento critico come ordini di acquisto, ricevute di merci, fatture e dati master del fornitore.

• Gestione degli errori & Monitoraggio: Stabilire dei framework di monitoraggio robusti (utilizzando AIF - SAP Application Interface Framework o simili) per evidenziare

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
As a Senior Business Analyst, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity. You will demonstrate a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.
Description of the area
Within RDT Pharma Technical Operations and specifically in the context of Manufacturing Technologies, the MES CORE SPOC bridges site-specific knowledge with MES CORE objectives, ensuring efficient recipe authoring, verification, and compliance with global standards.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manages end-to-end business analysis workstreams without guidance, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks, mentors junior and intermediate BAs, and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, performs thorough domain research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to solution selection, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers impact that extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster, contributing to domain goals by ensuring solutions provide demonstrable business value. Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans, influences tactical decisions, and contributes to long-term solution roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Works at a solution or product level involving multiple solutions, handling ambiguous requirements and systematically interacting with stakeholders across a broader product environment. Evaluates solution impacts considering both immediate and long-term business implications.

• Business / Technical ability: Demonstrates a deep understanding of business and technical domains, technologies, and their interdependencies. Independently applies tools, principles, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis to manage interconnections and improve overall efficiency.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field with 5+ years of Business Analysis/Consultancy experience in life sciences, medical, or pharmaceutical sectors in regulated environments.

• Proven experience independently managing end-to-end BA workstreams, navigating ambiguous requirements, and evaluating strategic solution options.

• Demonstrated experience in translating requirements into strategic implementation

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro
Come Senior Business Analyst, gestirai in modo indipendente flussi di lavoro di analisi aziendali end-to-end, affrontando problemi aziendali complessi con l'ambiguità emergente. Dimostrerai una forte comprensione del dominio aziendale, delle tecnologie correlate e delle loro interdipendenze, applicando strumenti e tecniche avanzate per tradurre i requisiti in piani di implementazione strategici. In questo ruolo, si agirà come consulente di fiducia per i team interfunzionali, modellare le prospettive degli stakeholder, gestire le interdipendenze di processo e contribuire in modo significativo alla progettazione e validazione di soluzioni efficaci. Potrai anche tutor junior analisti e modellare attivamente i processi di squadra, le metodologie e le migliori pratiche all'interno della più ampia Comunità di Pratica.
Descrizione della zona
Nell'ambito delle operazioni tecniche di RDT Pharma e in particolare nel contesto di Manufacturing Technologies, la MES CORE SPOC collega la conoscenza site-specific con gli obiettivi di MES CORE, garantendo un'efficace ricetta di autore, verifica e conformità con gli standard globali.

Responsabilità del lavoro

• Scope / (Content Leadership): gestisce autonomamente flussi di lavoro di analisi aziendali end-to-end senza guida, affrontando problemi con l'ambiguità emergente. Proficientemente adatta una gamma di quadri standard, mentori BA junior e intermedi, e forma proattivamente i modi di lavoro e le migliori pratiche di squadra.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: conduce l'analisi dei problemi aziendali, esegue una ricerca approfondita del dominio e guida l'analisi delle cause root. Contabile per fornire requisiti completi, contribuendo in modo significativo alla selezione della soluzione, e identificare proattivamente discrepanze di risoluzione delle esigenze per proporre miglioramenti creativi.

• Stakeholder Management: Identificare una gamma diversificata di stakeholder interfunzionali e costruisce affidamento attraverso una profonda comprensione aziendale per agire come consulente di fiducia. Facilita i workshop, risolve i conflitti e forma proattivamente le prospettive degli stakeholder per gestire strategicamente le aspettative e allinearli con gli obiettivi del progetto.

• Impatto/Strategia: Fornisce impatto che si estende a un prodotto specifico, iniziativa o cluster, contribuendo agli obiettivi di dominio garantendo soluzioni che forniscono un valore aziendale dimostrabile. Traduci i requisiti in piani di implementazione strategica, influenza le decisioni tattiche, e contribuisce a soluzioni a lungo termine roadmap.

• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): Funziona a una soluzione o a livello di prodotto che coinvolge più soluzioni, gestire requisiti ambigui e interagire sistematicamente con gli stakeholder in un ambiente di prodotto più ampio. Valuta gli impatti della soluzione considerando le implicazioni aziendali immediate e a lungo termine.

• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: dimostra una profonda comprensione dei domini aziendali e tecnici, delle tecnologie e delle loro interdipendenze. Applicare in modo indipendente strumenti, principi e tecniche relative a requisiti, dati, usabilità e analisi di processo per gestire le interconnessioni e migliorare l'efficienza complessiva.

Qualifiche
Istruzione / Esperienza

• Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria, Informatica, o un campo tecnico correlato con 5+ anni di Business Analysis/ Esperienza di Consulenza nelle scienze della vita, nei settori medico o farmaceutico in ambienti regolamentati.

• Esperienza comprovata indipendentemente la gestione dei flussi di lavoro BA end-to-end, la navigazione di requisiti ambigui e la valutazione delle opzioni di soluzione strategica.

• Esperienza dimostrata nel tradurre i requisiti nell'attuazione strategica

descriptionByLocale.de:

Die Position
Stellenbeschreibung
Als Senior Business Analyst verwalten Sie selbstständig End-to-End-Workstreams für Geschäftsanalysen und lösen komplexe Geschäftsprobleme mit aufkommenden Mehrdeutigkeiten. Sie werden ein starkes Verständnis für die Geschäftsdomäne, verwandte Technologien und ihre Interdependenzen demonstrieren und fortschrittliche Werkzeuge und Techniken anwenden, um Anforderungen in strategische Umsetzungspläne zu übersetzen. In dieser Rolle fungieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für funktionsübergreifende Teams, gestalten Stakeholder-Perspektiven, behandeln Prozess-Interdependenzen und tragen wesentlich zur Gestaltung und Validierung effektiver Lösungen bei. Sie werden auch Junior-Analysten betreuen und Teamprozesse, Methoden und Best Practices innerhalb der breiteren Community of Practice aktiv gestalten.
Beschreibung des Gebiets
Innerhalb von RDT Pharma Technical Operations und speziell im Kontext von Fertigungstechnologien verbindet das MES CORE SPOC standortspezifisches Wissen mit den MES CORE-Zielen und gewährleistet eine effiziente Erstellung, Verifizierung und Einhaltung globaler Standards.

Aufgabenbereich

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Verwaltet selbstständig End-to-End-Workstreams für Geschäftsanalysen ohne Anleitung und geht Probleme mit aufkommenden Mehrdeutigkeiten an. Passt eine Reihe von Standard-Frameworks professionell an, betreut Junior- und Intermediate-BAs und gestaltet proaktiv Arbeitsweisen und Best Practices im Team.

• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Leitet die Analyse von Geschäftsproblemen, führt gründliche Domänenforschung durch und treibt die Ursachenanalyse voran. Verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung umfassender Anforderungen, einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Lösungsauswahl und die proaktive Identifizierung von Bedarfs-Lösungs-Unstimmigkeiten, um kreative Verbesserungen vorzuschlagen.

• Stakeholder-Management: Identifiziert eine Vielzahl von funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern und baut Vertrauen durch ein tiefes Geschäftsverständnis auf, um als vertrauenswürdiger Berater zu agieren. Ermöglicht Workshops, löst Konflikte und gestaltet proaktiv Stakeholder-Perspektiven, um Erwartungen strategisch zu managen und an den Projektzielen auszurichten.

• Wirkung/Strategie: Liefert Wirkung, die sich auf ein bestimmtes Produkt, eine bestimmte Initiative oder ein bestimmtes Cluster erstreckt und zu den Domänenzielen beiträgt, indem sichergestellt wird, dass Lösungen einen nachweisbaren Geschäftswert bieten. Übersetzt Anforderungen in strategische Umsetzungspläne, beeinflusst taktische Entscheidungen und trägt zu langfristigen Lösungs-Roadmaps bei.

• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Funktioniert auf Lösungs- oder Produktebene mit mehreren Lösungen, behandelt mehrdeutige Anforderungen und interagiert systematisch mit Stakeholdern in einer breiteren Produktumgebung. Bewertet die Auswirkungen von Lösungen unter Berücksichtigung sowohl unmittelbarer als auch langfristiger Geschäftsauswirkungen.

• Business / Technische Fähigkeiten: Demonstriert ein tiefes Verständnis von Business und technischen Domänen, Technologien und deren Interdependenzen. Wendet Werkzeuge, Prinzipien und Techniken in Bezug auf Anforderungen, Daten, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und Prozessanalyse unabhängig an, um Verbindungen zu verwalten und die Gesamteffizienz zu verbessern.

Qualifikationen
Bildung / Erfahrung

• Master-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Informatik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich mit mehr als 5 Jahren Business Analysis / Beratungserfahrung in den Bereichen Life Sciences, Medizin oder Pharma in regulierten Umgebungen.

• Bewährte Erfahrung in der unabhängigen Verwaltung von End-to-End-BA-Workstreams, der Navigation mehrdeutiger Anforderungen und der Bewertung strategischer Lösungsoptionen.

• Demonstrierte Erfahrung bei der Umsetzung von Anforderungen in die strategische Umsetzung

La position
Description de l'emploi
En tant qu'analyste principal des affaires, vous gérerez de façon indépendante les processus d'analyse commerciale de bout en bout, en s'attaquant à des problèmes d'affaires complexes avec une ambiguïté émergente. Vous démontrerez une bonne compréhension du domaine d'activité, des technologies connexes et de leurs interdépendances, en appliquant des outils et des techniques avancés pour traduire les exigences en plans stratégiques de mise en oeuvre. Dans ce rôle, vous agirez comme conseiller de confiance auprès des équipes interfonctionnelles, façonnerez les points de vue des intervenants, gérerez les interdépendances des processus et contribuerez grandement à la conception et à la validation de solutions efficaces. Vous encadrerez également les analystes subalternes et façonnerez activement les processus, les méthodologies et les pratiques exemplaires des équipes au sein de la communauté de pratique.
Description de la zone
Dans le cadre des opérations techniques de RDT Pharma et plus particulièrement dans le contexte des technologies de fabrication, le MES CORE SPOC établit des ponts entre les connaissances spécifiques au site et les objectifs du MES CORE, en assurant l'efficacité de l'élaboration, de la vérification et du respect des normes mondiales.

Responsabilités professionnelles

• Portée / ( Leadership en matière de contenu) : Gérer de façon indépendante les secteurs de travail d'analyse opérationnelle de bout en bout sans orientation, en s'attaquant aux problèmes avec l'ambiguïté émergente. Adapte de façon compétente une gamme de cadres standard, mentore des B.A. juniors et intermédiaires et façonne de façon proactive les méthodes de travail et les pratiques exemplaires des équipes.

• Responsabilité et résolution des problèmes : Dirige l'analyse des problèmes d'affaires, effectue des recherches approfondies sur le domaine et stimule l'analyse des causes profondes. Accomplissement des besoins complets, contribution importante au choix des solutions et identification proactive des écarts entre les besoins et les solutions pour proposer des améliorations créatives.

• Gestion des intervenants : Indique un éventail diversifié d'intervenants interfonctionnels et renforce la confiance grâce à une profonde compréhension des activités pour agir comme conseiller de confiance. Faciliter les ateliers, résoudre les conflits et orienter de façon proactive les perspectives des intervenants afin de gérer stratégiquement les attentes et de les aligner sur les objectifs du projet.

• Impact/Stratégie : produit un impact qui s'étend à un produit, une initiative ou une grappe spécifique, contribuant aux objectifs du domaine en garantissant que les solutions offrent une valeur opérationnelle démontrable. Traduit les exigences en plans de mise en oeuvre stratégiques, influence les décisions tactiques et contribue aux feuilles de route des solutions à long terme.

• Complexité / (taille du produit): Fonctionne à un niveau de solution ou de produit impliquant plusieurs solutions, manipulant des exigences ambiguës et interagissant systématiquement avec les intervenants dans un environnement de produit plus large. Évaluer les répercussions de la solution en tenant compte des répercussions immédiates et à long terme sur les activités.

• Capacités d'affaires / techniques: Démontre une compréhension approfondie des domaines d'affaires et techniques, des technologies et de leurs interdépendances. Appliquer indépendamment les outils, les principes et les techniques liés aux exigences, aux données, à la facilité d'utilisation et à l'analyse des processus pour gérer les interconnexions et améliorer l'efficacité globale.

Compétences
Éducation / Expérience

• Maîtrise en ingénierie, informatique ou un domaine technique connexe avec 5 ans et plus d'expérience en analyse d'affaires/consultance en sciences de la vie, en médecine ou en pharmaceutique dans des environnements réglementés.

• Expérience éprouvée dans la gestion indépendante des flux de travail de bout en bout de BA, la navigation des exigences ambiguës et l'évaluation des options de solutions stratégiques.

• Expérience démontrée de la traduction des exigences en une mise en œuvre stratégique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about leading the transformation of healthcare through technology, driving artificial intelligence solutions and diagnostic digitalization that directly impact millions of lives? At Roche Diagnostics Mexico, we are uniting science and technology to revolutionize personalized medicine and optimize patient care. As our Digital Solutions Strategy & Business Development Lead , you will play a critical role in shaping, stabilizing, and expanding our digital health footprint across the country.

The Opportunity

• Design the commercial strategy and business development roadmap for Digital Solutions within the Strategy & Business Development Chapter.

• Evolve our digital health portfolio across two core pillars:
a) Lab Insights Solutions (laboratory operational efficiency)
b) Healthcare Insights solutions (AI-driven clinical decision support).

• Thrive in a high-performing, collaborative culture centered on trust, innovation, and long-term impact ( Innovation & Technology ).

• Co-create the 3-year Business Plan, bridging local market opportunities with regional and global strategic priorities.

• Access continuous growth opportunities while delivering meaningful value for a healthier future ( Vision & Ambition ).

Responsibilities

• Ensure commercial stability and customer satisfaction across our existing installed base, resolving operational bottlenecks and contract tracking.

• Drive market expansion and new business development, targeting both private and public healthcare ecosystems.

• Lead, coach, and empower a cross-functional team of product and business partners, fostering autonomy and agile leadership.

• Partner cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Market Access, and Business Intelligence to build integrated value propositions.

• Manage P&L, budget execution, and financial performance metrics to maximize the long-term profitability of our digital solutions.

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, Business, Marketing, or a Healthcare-related field.

• You bring proven experience in business development, commercial strategy, or product management within HealthTech, Medical Devices/Diagnostics, or Enterprise IT (B2B software).

• You have a strong track record in team leadership, talent development, and operating within Agile frameworks ( Agile Mindset ).

• You demonstrate strategic thinking, a big-picture business perspective, and the ability to effectively influence C-Suite decision-makers.

• You are fluent in English (C1 advanced level) for seamless collaboration with global and regional teams.

Preferred

• Master’s degree or MBA.

• Prior experience in Digital Health commercialization within the Mexican public sector, including regulatory certifications and public tenders.

• Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, enterprise software, and data management tools (e.g., Salesforce, Veeva).

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
