At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The UX Professional is a leader who owns the UX/CX for an entire product or service
In this role, you will lead complex initiatives, resolve ambiguous challenges, and cultivate strong stakeholder relationships within your scope
By seamlessly integrating UI design into development cycles and utilizing human-centered design methodologies, you will actively shape the product user experience, drive robust, evidence-based recommendations, and mentor junior designers to elevate the overall user and customer experience

Description of the area
The Clinical Submission Data and Content Generation & Reuse function focuses on modernizing the creation and management of clinical data and regulatory submission assets (data and content). It develops and deploys platforms for structured content management, enabling the reuse of approved components across documents. This group also pioneers the use of agentic AI to assist in generating, reviewing, and assembling complex submission assets (data and content), aiming to improve quality and reduce authoring timelines.

Job Responsibilities
Scope

• Leads the UX/CX for complex initiatives, projects, or products from concept through to successful implementation

• This includes managing intricate features, overarching designs, and critical value metrics across all their constituent digital solutions and services, and serving as a key contributor to defining and evolving UX best practices and standards within a specific domain or product line

Accountability/Problem Solving

• Demonstrates a consistent ability to navigate and effectively resolve highly complex and ambiguous UX/UI challenges with pragmatic solutions

• Possesses and applies an advanced understanding of specialized UI capabilities, actively fostering a culture of curiosity within the immediate team, and guides and empowers others in collaborative efforts to tackle complex design and user experience challenges within their assigned scope

Stakeholder Management

• Communicates with clarity and impact, articulating complex information and ideas to diverse project or product-related stakeholders with different viewpoints (e.g., Product Management, IT Leads, relevant Business Process Owners)

• Leads and encourages proactive conversations to share ideas, build consensus on actions, and align strategic direction for their assigned initiatives

• Proactively manages stakeholder expectations and cultivates robust, trusting relationships throughout the entire project or product lifecycle, influencing design and business decisions

Impact/Strategy

• Recognized as a leader who confidently leads UI initiatives and projects within their area of responsibility

• Plays a pivotal role in shaping the overall user and customer experience for their assigned scope, directly leading to significant improvements in user satisfaction, engagement, and business value

• Actively mentors and develops other designers, fostering their professional growth, and contributes to the development of the broader UI/UX community through consistent mentorship and knowledge sharing

Complexity

• Human-Centered Design: Independently apply advanced research and design methodologies (e.g., usability testing) to drive evidence-based decisions and define UX success metrics.

• Strategic Problem Solving: Navigate complex/ambiguous challenges by considering technical and business constraints, exploring multiple solutions, and articulating trade-offs.

• Frontend Architecture: Architect, implement

In this role, you will lead complex initiatives, resolve ambiguous challenges, and cultivate strong stakeholder relationships within your scope
By seamlessly integrating UI design into development cycles and utilizing human-centered design methodologies, you will actively shape the product user experience, drive robust, evidence-based recommendations, and mentor junior designers to elevate the overall user and customer experience

Description of the area
The Clinical Submission Data and Content Generation & Reuse function focuses on modernizing the creation and management of clinical data and regulatory submission assets (data and content). It develops and deploys platforms for structured content management, enabling the reuse of approved components across documents. This group also pioneers the use of agentic AI to assist in generating, reviewing, and assembling complex submission assets (data and content), aiming to improve quality and reduce authoring timelines.

Job Responsibilities
Scope

• Leads the UX/CX for complex initiatives, projects, or products from concept through to successful implementation

• This includes managing intricate features, overarching designs, and critical value metrics across all their constituent digital solutions and services, and serving as a key contributor to defining and evolving UX best practices and standards within a specific domain or product line

Accountability/Problem Solving

• Demonstrates a consistent ability to navigate and effectively resolve highly complex and ambiguous UX/UI challenges with pragmatic solutions

• Possesses and applies an advanced understanding of specialized UI capabilities, actively fostering a culture of curiosity within the immediate team, and guides and empowers others in collaborative efforts to tackle complex design and user experience challenges within their assigned scope

Stakeholder Management

• Communicates with clarity and impact, articulating complex information and ideas to diverse project or product-related stakeholders with different viewpoints (e.g., Product Management, IT Leads, relevant Business Process Owners)

• Leads and encourages proactive conversations to share ideas, build consensus on actions, and align strategic direction for their assigned initiatives

• Proactively manages stakeholder expectations and cultivates robust, trusting relationships throughout the entire project or product lifecycle, influencing design and business decisions

Impact/Strategy

• Recognized as a leader who confidently leads UI initiatives and projects within their area of responsibility

• Plays a pivotal role in shaping the overall user and customer experience for their assigned scope, directly leading to significant improvements in user satisfaction, engagement, and business value

• Actively mentors and develops other designers, fostering their professional growth, and contributes to the development of the broader UI/UX community through consistent mentorship and knowledge sharing

Complexity

• Human-Centered Design: Independently apply advanced research and design methodologies (e.g., usability testing) to drive evidence-based decisions and define UX success metrics.

• Strategic Problem Solving: Navigate complex/ambiguous challenges by considering technical and business constraints, exploring multiple solutions, and articulating trade-offs.

• Frontend Architecture: Architect, implement

Descrizione del lavoro
Il Senior IT Data Scientist è responsabile di soluzioni leader, sviluppo e attuazione basate sui dati per problemi aziendali complessi. Questo ruolo comporta l'individuazione indipendente di opportunità analitiche, la realizzazione di approfondimenti di esplorazione e analisi dei dati, la costruzione, il test e la distribuzione di modelli predittivi utilizzando varie tecniche di machine learning. Contribuirai a progetti dall'inizio alla distribuzione, sfruttando una forte programmazione, modellazione statistica e capacità di visualizzazione dei dati, mentre comunicherai chiaramente i risultati a stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici.

Questo gruppo pionieristico anche l'uso di agentic AI per assistere a generare, rivedere e assemblare beni complessi di sottomissione (dati e contenuti), mirando a migliorare la qualità e ridurre i tempi di autore.

• Scope / (Content Leadership): porta lo sviluppo e la distribuzione dei modelli. Funziona indipendentemente su specifici progetti di data science dall'inizio alla fine.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Stellenbeschreibung
Der Senior IT Data Scientist ist verantwortlich für die Leitung, Entwicklung und Implementierung datengesteuerter Lösungen für komplexe Geschäftsprobleme. Diese Rolle beinhaltet die unabhängige Identifizierung analytischer Möglichkeiten, die Durchführung einer eingehenden Datenerkundung und -analyse sowie das Erstellen, Testen und Bereitstellen prädiktiver Modelle unter Verwendung verschiedener maschineller Lerntechniken. Sie werden von der Gründung bis zur Bereitstellung zu Projekten beitragen, indem Sie starke Programmier-, statistische Modellierungs- und Datenvisualisierungsfähigkeiten nutzen und gleichzeitig die Ergebnisse sowohl technischen als auch nicht-technischen Interessengruppen klar kommunizieren.
In einer stark regulierten GxP-Umgebung bauen Sie spezialisierte KI-Agenten, die Analytical Data Scientists über den gesamten klinischen Datenlebenszyklus hinweg unterstützen. Dies erfordert umfassendes Fachwissen in fortgeschrittener generativer KI, Multi-Agenten-Architekturen (z. B. LangGraph), Graph-basierter Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) und LLMOps. Sie werden praktische technische Arbeit mit Führungsverantwortung in Einklang bringen und häufig zur technischen Roadmap des Teams beitragen.
Beschreibung des Gebiets
Die Funktion Clinical Submission Data and Content Generation & Reuse konzentriert sich auf die Modernisierung der Erstellung und Verwaltung von klinischen Daten und regulatorischen Submission Assets (Daten und Inhalte). Es entwickelt und setzt Plattformen für strukturiertes Content Management ein, die die Wiederverwendung von genehmigten Komponenten in allen Dokumenten ermöglichen. Diese Gruppe ist auch Vorreiter bei der Verwendung von Agentic AI, um bei der Generierung, Überprüfung und Zusammenstellung komplexer Einreichungsressourcen (Daten und Inhalte) zu helfen, mit dem Ziel, die Qualität zu verbessern und die Autorenzeit zu verkürzen.
Aufgabenbereich

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Leitet die Entwicklung und den Einsatz von Modellen. Arbeitet unabhängig an spezifischen Data Science Projekten von Anfang bis Ende.

• Verantwortlichkeit/Problemlösung: Identifiziert und löst Zwischen- und komplexe Datenprobleme. Validiert Modelle und gewährleistet deren Genauigkeit mit minimaler Überwachung. Bewältigt komplexe Herausforderungen der klinischen Programmierung durch die Entwicklung maßgeschneiderter Multi-Agenten-Workflows. Beispiele sind das Erstellen proaktiver Codierungs-Debugger, die ausführliche Protokolle analysieren, Fehler klassifizieren und automatisch Code/Konfiguration fixe vorschlagen.

• Stakeholder Management: Engagiert sich mit breiteren Geschäftseinheiten, um ihre Datenbedürfnisse klar zu verstehen und zu erfüllen. Präsentiert analytische Ergebnisse und Erkenntnisse für verschiedene Interessengruppen, einschließlich nicht-technisches Publikum.

• Impact/Strategie: Fördert mittelgroße Projekte, die direkt Geschäftsentscheidungen beeinflussen. Stellt sicher, dass Projekte eng mit breiteren Geschäftszielen und -strategien ausgerichtet sind.

• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Behandelt größere, komplexere Datensätze. Entwickelt neue prädiktive Modelle von Grund auf neu und optimiert bestehende, um die Leistung zu verbessern.

• Business / Technical Fähigkeit: Anwendbar Kenntnisse in mehreren Programmiersprachen und fortschrittliche Datenmanipulationstechniken. Nutzt ein fundiertes Wissen über fortschrittliche statistische Methoden und maschinelle Lernalgorithmen, um Geschäftsfragen zu beantworten.

Qualifikationen
Bildung / Erfahrung

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung bei der unabhängigen Identifizierung analytischer Möglichkeiten, der Durchführung einer eingehenden Datenerkundung und dem Besitz von Projekten von der Gründung bis zur Bereitstellung.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Förderung mittelgroßer Projekte, die Geschäftsentscheidungen beeinflussen und sich an strategischen Zielen orientieren.

Technische Fähigkeiten

• Kenntnisse in mehreren Programmiersprachen und fortschrittlicher Datenmanipulation; Know-how in Python (für AI / ML Backend / Agent Logik) und R (schwerer Fokus auf c)

La position
Description du poste
L'expert principal en données informatiques est chargé de diriger, d'élaborer et de mettre en œuvre des solutions fondées sur les données pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels complexes. Ce rôle consiste à identifier de manière indépendante les possibilités d'analyse, à effectuer des travaux approfondis d'exploration et d'analyse de données, à construire, à tester et à déployer des modèles prédictifs à l'aide de diverses techniques d'apprentissage automatique. Vous contribuerez à des projets depuis le début jusqu'au déploiement, en tirant parti de solides compétences en programmation, en modélisation statistique et en visualisation des données, tout en communiquant clairement les résultats aux intervenants techniques et non techniques.
En travaillant dans un environnement hautement réglementé GxP, vous allez construire des agents d'IA spécialisés qui aident les chercheurs en données analytiques tout au long du cycle de vie des données cliniques. Cela nécessite une expertise approfondie en IA générative avancée, en architectures multi-agents (p. ex. LangGraph), en génération retrieval-augmentée (GraphRAG) et en LLMOps. Vous équilibrerez le travail technique pratique avec les responsabilités de leadership, contribuant souvent à la feuille de route technique de l'équipe.
Description de la zone
La fonction Production et réutilisation des données et du contenu des présentations cliniques met l'accent sur la modernisation de la création et de la gestion des données cliniques et des éléments de présentation réglementaires (données et contenu). Il développe et déploie des plateformes pour la gestion structurée du contenu, permettant la réutilisation des composants approuvés dans tous les documents. Responsabilités professionnelles

• Portée / ( Leadership du contenu) : Dirige l'élaboration et le déploiement de modèles. Travaille de façon indépendante sur des projets spécifiques de data science du début à la fin.

• Responsabilité/Résoudre les problèmes : Identifier et résoudre des problèmes de données intermédiaires à complexes. Valide les modèles et assure leur précision avec une supervision minimale. S'attaquer aux défis complexes de la programmation clinique en développant des workflows multi-agents sur mesure. Les exemples comprennent la construction de débogueurs de codage proactifs qui analysent les journaux de verbes, classifient les erreurs et proposent automatiquement le code/fixe de configuration s.

• Gestion des intervenants : S'engage à mettre en place des unités opérationnelles plus vastes pour comprendre clairement leurs besoins en matière de données et y répondre. Présente les constatations et les points de vue analytiques à divers intervenants, y compris des auditoires non techniques.

• Impact/Stratégie : Il favorise des projets de taille moyenne qui influencent directement les décisions des entreprises. Veiller à ce que les projets soient étroitement alignés sur les objectifs et les stratégies opérationnels plus larges.

• Complexité / (taille du produit): Poignée des ensembles de données plus grands et plus complexes. Développer de nouveaux modèles prédictifs à partir de zéro et optimiser les modèles existants pour améliorer la performance.

• Capacité d'affaires / technique: Applique la compétence dans plusieurs langages de programmation et techniques avancées de manipulation de données. Exploiter une solide connaissance des méthodes statistiques avancées et des algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique pour répondre aux questions des entreprises.

Compétences
Éducation / Expérience

• Expérience démontrée en ce qui a trait à l'identification indépendante des possibilités d'analyse, à l'exploration approfondie des données et à la possession de projets depuis le début jusqu'au déploiement.

• Expérience éprouvée de la conduite de projets de taille moyenne qui influent sur les décisions des entreprises et s'harmonisent avec les objectifs stratégiques.

Compétences techniques

• Compétence en plusieurs langages de programmation et manipulation avancée des données; expertise en Python (pour la logique AI/ML backend/agent) et R (accent lourd sur c

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

Strategy, Portfolio & Operations (SPO) is a unified function that serves as the strategic and operational backbone enabling pRED's strategy from lab to clinic. Operating under a dynamic Chapter Model, SPO centralizes specialized skills across critical areas including Sites & Lab Services, Program & Project Management, Strategy, Clinical Operations, External Operations, Capability Development, Core Lab Technology Platforms (360Labs) and Asset Team Leadership. SPO’s mission is to drive enterprise value creation by delivering operational excellence, and accelerating portfolio productivity. As a trusted partner, SPO fosters a culture of collaboration and accountability to ensure pRED transitions assets smoothly from early research to late stage development.

The Opportunity

The Strategy & Portfolio (S&P) chapter acts as pRED’s strategic "engine room". The Chapter provides strategic consulting across internal and cross-Roche initiatives, using systems thinking to connect different areas of the business. Additionally, we design and manage critical governance boards while maintaining the organization's "single source of truth" data systems. This data is used to generate portfolio analytics and reports, root cause analyses, and pipeline projections for leadership. Ultimately, our core mission is to shape the future of the business and enable data-driven, high-quality decisions that optimize efficiency and drive overall portfolio productivity.

We are offering an outstanding opportunity to support and augment the ongoing strategy activities within the Strategy and Portfolio Chapter (S&P) of SPO. This is a unique opportunity to join a high-impact group, working with multidisciplinary teams and acting as an independent and objective thought-partner to senior stakeholders on a range of business and strategic questions related to the overall direction and long-term strategy of pRED.

In this position, your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting the ongoing dialogue of the pRED strategy.

• Translate strategy into guidance for decision making at the pRED Leadership Team (pLT), and within the Disease Translational Areas or Global Functions (GFx)..

• Support senior pRED leadership (pLT and/or DTA / GFx LTs) and enhance decision making, specifically focusing on clarifying the right problem statement.

• Evolve the strategic priorities and initiatives to meet the holistic needs across pRED and establish a pRED-wide perspective on the portfolio strategy and priorities.

• Facilitate and lead communication efforts to ensure pRED wide understanding of strategy and portfolio context and be an ambassador and challenger for the portfolio voice across pRED.

• Facilitate an integrative and continuous dialogue across the pRED value chain to evaluate our strategy and implementation for the 3-5 year horizon and support leadership to navigate the portfolio to impact the Pharma vision.

• Consistently seek to evolve the strategic pRED wide perspective, external landscape evaluation for assets & technolo

Operating under a dynamic Chapter Model, SPO centralizes specialized skills across critical areas including Sites & Lab Services, Program & Project Management, Strategy, Clinical Operations, External Operations, Capability Development, Core Lab Technology Platforms (360Labs) and Asset Team Leadership. SPO’s mission is to drive enterprise value creation by delivering operational excellence, and accelerating portfolio productivity. As a trusted partner, SPO fosters a culture of collaboration and accountability to ensure pRED transitions assets smoothly from early research to late stage development.

The Opportunity

The Strategy & Portfolio (S&P) chapter acts as pRED’s strategic "engine room". The Chapter provides strategic consulting across internal and cross-Roche initiatives, using systems thinking to connect different areas of the business. Additionally, we design and manage critical governance boards while maintaining the organization's "single source of truth" data systems. This data is used to generate portfolio analytics and reports, root cause analyses, and pipeline projections for leadership. Ultimately, our core mission is to shape the future of the business and enable data-driven, high-quality decisions that optimize efficiency and drive overall portfolio productivity.

We are offering an outstanding opportunity to support and augment the ongoing strategy activities within the Strategy and Portfolio Chapter (S&P) of SPO. This is a unique opportunity to join a high-impact group, working with multidisciplinary teams and acting as an independent and objective thought-partner to senior stakeholders on a range of business and strategic questions related to the overall direction and long-term strategy of pRED.

In this position, your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting the ongoing dialogue of the pRED strategy.

• Translate strategy into guidance for decision making at the pRED Leadership Team (pLT), and within the Disease Translational Areas or Global Functions (GFx)..

• Support senior pRED leadership (pLT and/or DTA / GFx LTs) and enhance decision making, specifically focusing on clarifying the right problem statement.

• Evolve the strategic priorities and initiatives to meet the holistic needs across pRED and establish a pRED-wide perspective on the portfolio strategy and priorities.

• Facilitate and lead communication efforts to ensure pRED wide understanding of strategy and portfolio context and be an ambassador and challenger for the portfolio voice across pRED.

• Facilitate an integrative and continuous dialogue across the pRED value chain to evaluate our strategy and implementation for the 3-5 year horizon and support leadership to navigate the portfolio to impact the Pharma vision.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro

Il Business Systems Analyst prende la proprietà di compiti ambigui, sfida lo status quo e agisce come mentore tecnico mentre promuove una forte collaborazione tra le squadre. In questo ruolo, si porterà piccole a medie iniziative, priorità efficacemente con gli stakeholder, e mantenere una visione "grande immagine" di come i vari componenti si allineano con la strategia generale. Analizzerai problemi di business complessi per consigliare soluzioni automatizzate, identificare e implementare miglioramenti di processo, e ottimizzare le configurazioni di sistema per la massima efficienza. Sviluppando strategie di test complete, leader team interfunzionali, e la progettazione di integrazioni di sistema, si leverà una profonda comprensione del paesaggio tecnico più ampio per guidare risultati di alta qualità.

Descrizione della zona

Responsabilità del lavoro

• Scope / (Content Leadership) & Accountability/Problem Solving: prende possesso di compiti e argomenti ambigui nella "grande zona" (dove non c'è un proprietario definito) e guida con successo iniziative da piccole a medie (S/M) a livello di progetto, squadra o prodotto. Sfida lo status quo, naviga abilmente le dinamiche di gruppo in ambienti diversificati, e favorisce una buona collaborazione, coaching e mentoring. Analizza complessi problemi aziendali per consigliare soluzioni di sistema automatizzate, identifica i miglioramenti dei processi, ottimizza le configurazioni di sistema, progetta e implementa le integrazioni di sistema.

• Stakeholder Management: Priorizza e comunica con gli stakeholder in modo efficace. Mantiene una visione d'immagine più grande per capire a fondo come i vari componenti tecnici si adattano alla strategia generale del prodotto e obiettivi.

• Impact/Strategy: agisce come mentore tecnico e allinea i piani di sviluppo con la strategia globale. Attivamente dà discorsi e condivide la conoscenza in eventi interni (ad esempio, DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live). Impegna nell'organizzazione di eventi di condivisione della conoscenza e viene coinvolto in iniziative o compiti che raggiungono al di fuori dell'ambito di progetto regolare.

• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): Funziona a livello del prodotto o del sito, avendo un impatto diretto sulle decisioni tecniche all'interno del prodotto e sui modi di lavorare di altri membri del capitolo. Conduce team collegati trasversalmente per affrontare problemi di business o sistemi.

• Business / Capacità tecnica: Possede una profonda comprensione del paesaggio tecnico più ampio oltre la componente specifica su cui si lavora. Formula e implementa strategie tecniche allineate agli obiettivi organizzativi, e investe il tempo e l'energia in iniziative che incrementano la creatività e l'innovazione mantenendo la massima qualità ingegneristica.

Qualifiche

Istruzione / Esperienza

• Esperienza dimostrata che prende possesso di compiti ambigui, agendo come mentore tecnico, e guida con successo piccole e medie iniziative a livello di progetto o di prodotto.

• Esperienza leader team interfunzionali collegati per risolvere problemi complessi di business o sistemi.

• Provato record di coinvolgimento in iniziative di condivisione della conoscenza, parlando in eventi tecnici interni, e la navigazione di dinamiche di gruppo in ambienti diversificati.

Competenze tecniche

• Forte capacità nell'analisi di problemi di business complessi e consigliare, progettare e implementare soluzioni e integrazioni di sistema automatizzate.

• Competenza nell'ottimizzazione delle configurazioni e delle impostazioni di sistema per efficienza e prestazioni.

• La competenza nello sviluppo di strategie e piani di test completi.

• La profonda comprensione del paesaggio tecnico più ampio

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Stellenbeschreibung

Der Business Systems Analyst übernimmt die Verantwortung für mehrdeutige Aufgaben, fordert den Status Quo heraus und fungiert als technischer Mentor, während er eine starke Zusammenarbeit zwischen den Teams fördert. In dieser Rolle leiten Sie kleine bis mittlere Initiativen, priorisieren effektiv mit den Stakeholdern und behalten ein "größeres Bild" darüber, wie verschiedene Komponenten mit der Gesamtstrategie übereinstimmen. Sie analysieren komplexe Geschäftsprobleme, um automatisierte Lösungen zu empfehlen, Prozessverbesserungen zu identifizieren und zu implementieren und Systemkonfigurationen für maximale Effizienz zu optimieren. Durch die Entwicklung umfassender Teststrategien, die Leitung funktionsübergreifender Teams und die Gestaltung von Systemintegrationen nutzen Sie ein tiefes Verständnis der breiteren technischen Landschaft, um qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Beschreibung des Gebiets

Aufgabenbereich

• Scope / (Content Leadership) & Accountability / Problem Solving: Übernimmt die Verantwortung für mehrdeutige Aufgaben und Themen in der "Grauzone" (wo es keinen definierten Eigentümer gibt) und führt erfolgreich kleine bis mittlere (S / M) Initiativen auf Projekt-, Squad- oder Produktebene durch. Fordert den Status quo heraus, steuert geschickt die Gruppendynamik in diversifizierten Umgebungen und fördert gute Zusammenarbeit, Coaching und Mentoring. Analysiert komplexe Geschäftsprobleme, um automatisierte Systemlösungen zu empfehlen, identifiziert Prozessverbesserungen, optimiert Systemkonfigurationen und entwirft und implementiert Systemintegrationen.

• Stakeholder Management: Priorisiert und kommuniziert effektiv mit Stakeholdern. Behält eine größere Bildansicht bei, um gründlich zu verstehen, wie verschiedene technische Komponenten in die gesamte Produktstrategie und -ziele passen.

• Impact/Strategie: Agiert als technischer Mentor und richtet Entwicklungspläne an der globalen Strategie aus. Gibt aktiv Vorträge und teilt Wissen in internen Veranstaltungen (z.B. DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live). Beteiligt sich an der Organisation von Veranstaltungen zum Wissensaustausch und beteiligt sich an Initiativen oder Aufgaben, die außerhalb des regulären Projektumfangs liegen.

• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Funktioniert auf Produkt- oder Site-Ebene und hat direkten Einfluss auf die technischen Entscheidungen innerhalb des Produkts und die Arbeitsweise anderer Kapitelmitglieder. Leitet funktionsübergreifende verknüpfte Teams, um Geschäfts- oder Systemprobleme zu lösen.

• Business / Technische Fähigkeiten: Verfügt über ein tiefes Verständnis der breiteren technischen Landschaft über die spezifische Komponente hinaus, an der gearbeitet wird. Formuliert und implementiert technische Strategien, die auf organisatorische Ziele ausgerichtet sind, und investiert Zeit und Energie in Initiativen, die Kreativität und Innovation fördern und gleichzeitig höchste technische Qualität gewährleisten.

Qualifikationen

Bildung / Erfahrung

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Übernahme mehrdeutiger Aufgaben, als technischer Mentor und erfolgreicher Umsetzung kleiner bis mittlerer Initiativen auf Projekt- oder Produktebene.

• Führen Sie funktionsübergreifende verbundene Teams, um komplexe Geschäfts- oder Systemprobleme zu lösen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Teilnahme an Wissensaustauschinitiativen, Vorträgen bei internen technischen Veranstaltungen und der Navigation in Gruppendynamiken in diversifizierten Umgebungen.

Technische Fähigkeiten

• Starke Fähigkeit, komplexe Geschäftsprobleme zu analysieren und automatisierte Systemlösungen und Integrationen zu empfehlen, zu entwerfen und zu implementieren.

• Expertise in der Optimierung von Systemkonfigurationen und Einstellungen für Effizienz und Leistung.

• Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung umfassender Teststrategien und -pläne.

• Tiefes Verständnis der breiteren technischen Landschaft werden

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Description du poste

L'analyste des systèmes d'affaires s'approprie des tâches ambiguës, conteste le statu quo et agit comme mentor technique tout en favorisant une collaboration solide entre les équipes. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des initiatives de petite à moyenne taille, vous prioriserez efficacement les intervenants et vous garderez une vue d'ensemble de la façon dont les divers éléments s'harmonisent avec la stratégie globale. Vous analyserez des problèmes d'affaires complexes pour recommander des solutions automatisées, identifier et mettre en œuvre des améliorations de processus, et optimiser les configurations du système pour une efficacité maximale. En élaborant des stratégies d'essai exhaustives, en dirigeant des équipes interfonctionnelles et en concevant des intégrations de systèmes, vous tirerez profit d'une compréhension approfondie du paysage technique plus large pour obtenir des résultats de haute qualité.

Description de la zone

Responsabilités professionnelles

• Portée / ( Leadership du contenu) & Responsabilité/Résoudre les problèmes : S'approprier des tâches et des sujets ambigus dans la « zone grise » (où il n'y a pas de propriétaire défini) et conduire avec succès des initiatives de petite à moyenne (S/M) au niveau du projet, de l'équipe ou du produit. Défis le statu quo, navigue habilement la dynamique de groupe dans des contextes diversifiés et favorise la bonne collaboration, l'encadrement et le mentorat. Analyse les problèmes d'affaires complexes pour recommander des solutions automatisées, identifier les améliorations de processus, optimiser les configurations du système, concevoir et mettre en œuvre des intégrations de système.

• Gestion des intervenants : Établir des priorités et communiquer efficacement avec les intervenants. Maintient une vue d'ensemble afin de bien comprendre comment divers composants techniques s'inscrivent dans la stratégie et les objectifs globaux du produit.

• Impact/Stratégie : agit comme mentor technique et harmonise les plans de développement avec la stratégie mondiale. Donner activement des discours et partager des connaissances dans les événements internes (p. ex., DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live). S'engage dans l'organisation d'événements de partage des connaissances et participe à des initiatives ou à des tâches qui dépassent la portée du projet.

• Complexité / (Taille du produit): Fonctionne au niveau du produit ou du site, ce qui a un impact direct sur les décisions techniques au sein du produit et les méthodes de travail des autres membres du chapitre. Dirige les équipes interfonctionnelles liées pour régler les problèmes d'affaires ou de systèmes.

• Capacités d'affaires / techniques: Possède une compréhension profonde du paysage technique plus large au-delà de la composante spécifique sur laquelle on travaille. Formule et met en œuvre des stratégies techniques alignées sur les objectifs organisationnels, et investit du temps et de l'énergie dans des initiatives qui stimulent la créativité et l'innovation tout en maintenant la plus haute qualité d'ingénierie.

Compétences

Éducation / Expérience

• Expérience démontrée s'approprier des tâches ambiguës, agir comme mentor technique et mener avec succès des initiatives de petite à moyenne envergure au niveau du projet ou du produit.

• Expérience de diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles liées pour résoudre des problèmes complexes d'affaires ou de systèmes.

• Expérience éprouvée de participation à des initiatives de partage des connaissances, de discours lors d'événements techniques internes et de navigation de la dynamique des groupes dans des contextes diversifiés.

Compétences techniques

• Forte capacité d'analyser les problèmes d'affaires complexes et de recommander, de concevoir et de mettre en oeuvre des solutions et des intégrations automatisées.

• Expertise dans l'optimisation des configurations et des réglages du système pour l'efficacité et les performances.

• Compétence dans l'élaboration de stratégies et de plans d'essai complets.

• Compréhension approfondie du paysage technique plus large

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Team Lead Engineer SRE Clusters - Digital Operations and Reliability

As Team Lead (Senior Engineering Manager) for SRE in Digital Operations and Reliability (DOR)you will ensure and support the delivery as an entrepreneurial leader, setting focus, removingimpediments, managing stakeholders, and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

You are an experienced and entrepreneurial SRE Technical Lead who drives the strategic development and delivery of our global Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) platform and operating model. This is a critical leadership role for a technical driver, who is passionate about creating immense value, pushing technical boundaries, and building resilient, scalable systems from the ground up - and mentor the talent needed to get us there.

You will develop the capabilities of your team members to align with the function’s vision and will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus on their performance management, and make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics, and a sustainable pace.

Description of the Area

• The Digital Operations and Reliability function ensures the proactive management and maintenance of the optimal performance, reliability, and availability of all RDT enterprise-wide digital platforms and Infrastructure, minimizing disruption to business processes across the value chain, and guaranteeing compliance.

• As the SRE Technical Lead, you will be instrumental in defining, building, and scaling our SRE capabilities and platform globally. You are responsible for the holistic maturation of the SRE platform and tooling infrastructure, while simultaneously establishing a technical strategy that aligns with broader organizational product goals.

• This role mandates the rigorous enforcement of operational standards—such as error budgets and standardized service models—coupled with the strategic deployment of AI-driven operations and automation to maximize system reliability and scalability. Furthermore, you will function as a central subject matter expert, bridging cross-functional silos through partnership with key business stakeholders while actively accelerating organizational growth by identifying, hiring, and mentoring high-potential talent to ensure a sustainable, high-performing engineering culture.

• This team plays a key part within DOR as an enabler to champion AI Operations and drive the adoption of self service operational excellence which enables a shift from reactive troubleshooting to proactive risk identification and planning via the building of a shared SRE Center of Excellence .

Job Responsibilities
Team Member Capability and Career Development

• Proactively identifies and develops future-focused engineering team capabilities, aligning with long-term strategic goals.

• Mentors team members on long-term career paths, creating new opportunities and roles within the organization to support their growth.

• Addresses and helps resolve complex, systemic roadblocks that impact multiple development teams, and coaches other managers on effective performance management.

• Oversees the technical and soft skill development, ensuring a balanced and high-performing talent portfolio.

Team Health and Sustainability

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
Are you an experienced sales professional with a talent for solving complex challenges? In this role, you'll use your expertise to navigate diverse issues and make strategic decisions that drive success. You'll manage medium to large accounts, exceeding sales targets while building lasting relationships with key decision-makers.

Your goal will be to expand your network, identify new opportunities, and present compelling value propositions. With a deep understanding of our product line, you'll serve as a trusted advisor, continuously improving our quality system through your daily actions.

As an Account Executive - GenMark, you will:

• be responsible for promoting GenMark’s products and services.

• contact new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• generate demand and maximize product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• work with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• Conduct and organize necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• communicates competitive market information internally.

• networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

This is a field-based role - the territory includes New Jersey, Philadelphia, and Baltimore.

Travel expectation: Up to 25% Overnight travel expected

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience

Preferred Requirements:

• Good oral and written communication skills, including making impactful presentations

• Proven leadership abilities

• Negotiation, contracting, and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting

The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Pennsylvania is $86,700.00 - $169,00.00. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This position is eligible to earn incentive compensation that is calculated and paid in accordance with the applicable Incentive Compensation Plan for the role. This position also qualifies for

titleByLocale.en: Site Head, Kentucky Distribution Center (Sr. Director)
titleByLocale.it: Site Head, Kentucky Distribution Center (Sr. Direttore)
titleByLocale.de: Site Head, Kentucky Distribution Center (Sr. Direktor)
titleByLocale.fr: Site Head, Kentucky Distribution Center (Sr. Directeur)

jobs.description:
The Position
The Kentucky Distribution Center (KDC) Site Head is a vital part of our Supply Chain and Logistics network, which is committed to ensuring the safe, compliant, and uninterrupted delivery of life-changing medicines to patients across the US market. This position is responsible for leading all operational teams in Louisville and serving as the face of Genentech within the local community. You will collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Customer Operations, US Commercial, Quality, Safety, Health & Environment (SHE), and global network leadership to drive operational excellence and business continuity.

The Opportunity
As the KDC Site Head (Sr. Director) , you are directly accountable for the safe, cost-effective, and cGMP-compliant operation of our primary US distribution center, driving strategic vision and network alignment while inspiring a high-performing organization through servant leadership, personal transformation, and clear vision to optimize the contributions of all employees. Key responsibilities include:

• Set the strategic vision and define long-range business strategies for commercial finished goods and site assets, aligning site capabilities with the broader global network.

• Direct all site operations including staffing, facilities, logistics, warehousing, inventory management, technology, and Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) compliance.

• Serve as the face of Genentech in the Louisville, Kentucky region, driving local community initiatives, government affairs, and media representation.

• Ensure full compliance with cGMP, SOPs, and Roche Quality standards while meeting operational, financial, and OTIF (On-Time, In-Full) delivery targets.

• Establish and continuously exercise robust Business Continuity and risk mitigation plans to ensure resilient delivery of medicines representing significant revenue.

• Act as an active change agent, fostering a culture of trust, agility, continuous improvement, and professional development across direct and non-direct reports.

• Partner with Customer Operations, Hillsboro distribution leadership, and Commercial stakeholders to streamline delivery processes and maximize customer satisfaction.

Who You Are

• Education: Bachelor of Science (BS) or Bachelor of Arts (BA) in Business, Engineering, Materials Management, Packaging, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• Leadership & Industry Experience: Proven track record as a site head in distribution, warehouse, or manufacturing operations within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare distribution space (15+ years of total supply chain/distribution experience preferred, with 10–12+ years of relevant leadership experience, including cold-chain management).

• Technical Expertise: Expert knowledge of cGMP standards, pharmaceutical distribution regulations, warehousing, facilities management, and ERP or integrated inventory management systems.

• Strategic & Risk Management Acumen: Demonstrated enterprise mindset with experience developing long-range operational strategies, driving business continuity planning, and executing risk mitigation in complex environments.

• Operational Excellence & Change Leadership: Strong background in driving continuous improvement (Lean/Six Sigma preferred) and acting as a visible change agent who adapts strategies to evolving network needs.

• Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to influence cross-functional executives, build high-performing diverse teams, and communicate effectively with front-line execution staff.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Kentucky is $153,000 - $284,200. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed in this link .

jobs.title: US Distribution Executive Director
jobs.description:
The Position
This role is a valuable part of our US Supply Chain organization, which is committed to achieving our mission of delivering life-saving therapies to patients across the nation. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to collaborate closely with key stakeholders across Commercial Operations, Quality, IT, Business Process, and Logistics. This opportunity offers a unique and exciting challenge for a senior executive to build and share an inspiring vision, lead teams to do their best work, and be a catalyst for change and world-class performance.

The Opportunity
As the US Distribution Executive Director , you are accountable for day-to-day operations and strategic oversight to ensure a safe, compliant, cost-effective, and resilient US Distribution Network that supports market demands and meets evolving customer expectations. Key responsibilities include:

• Set and drive distribution strategy across a multi-node network, establishing US distribution as a competitive advantage to support commercial product strategies.

• Provide people leadership and foster an engaged culture of trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement using the Vision, Architect, Coach, Catalyst leadership model.

• Oversee network performance to ensure full cGMP, safety, and regulatory compliance while consistently meeting operational and financial metrics (OTIF, budget, inventory accuracy).

• Manage end-to-end supply chain resilience by orchestrating robust risk mitigation, DSCSA serialization compliance, and business continuity planning.

• Optimize systems and interfaces (e.g., SAP TMS and EWM) in close partnership with IT, customer service, inventory planning, and logistics teams to improve ways of working.

• Continuously evaluate, prioritize, and advise Senior Management on network-level risks and continuous improvement initiatives.

Who You Are

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s/MBA preferred).

• Leadership Experience: Proven track record as a senior leader of senior leaders with enterprise-level impact, including experience as a Site Head of warehouse and distribution operations.

• Industry Expertise: 15+ years of total supply chain/distribution experience, with deep expertise in regulated pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device distribution (FMCG experience a plus).

• Technical Skills: Extensive experience managing multi-node networks, cold chain/temperature-sensitive products, 3PL management (RFPs, contracts, SLAs), and SAP enterprise systems (TMS/EWM).

• Quality & Compliance: Strong working knowledge of cGMP, DSCSA serialization, track-and-trace requirements, and operational excellence frameworks (Lean, Six Sigma certifications preferred).

• Soft Skills & Mindset: Authentic, inclusive leader with an enterprise mindset, exceptional cross-functional communication skills, and a data-driven approach to solving complex operational challenges.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $232,900 - $432,500. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed in this link .

Relocation benefits are approved for this posting.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

The Data Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex, multiple solution, or product context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. Applies frameworks in a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for the product. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded and published for multiple solutions or the product. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including vendor assessments.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates difficult concepts clearly and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view. Drives information sharing across the complete product.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes.

• Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others.

Technical Skills

• In-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas

• Strong understanding of modern data engineering architectures and patterns, including cloud-based data platforms, batch and streaming data pipelines, and analytics layers

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomie

jobs.title: Digital Pathology Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Digital Pathology Sales Specialist

The Opportunity:

• The Digital Pathology Sales Specialist is responsible for driving the sales of digital pathology solutions, including hardware, software, AI, and services, to hospitals, reference labs, research institutions, pharmaceutical companies, and diagnostic labs.

• This role involves identifying potential customers, understanding their needs, presenting tailored solutions, and closing deals that meet revenue targets

• The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of digital pathology products, healthcare IT, strong sales acumen, and the ability to build relationships within the healthcare and research sectors.

• Leverages current business relationships to maintain and grow current customer base. Works in coordination with Account Managers and Strategic Account Managers, Discovery Business Managers, to call on perspective and current customers.

• Present and demonstrate digital pathology solutions to potential clients, highlighting the value of transitioning to digital workflows.

• Achieve and exceed sales quotas by building a robust pipeline of prospects and closing new business.:

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, understanding their pathology workflows and providing tailored solutions to meet their specific needs.

• Collaborate with technical teams to provide product demonstrations, training, and post-sales support.

• Address customer inquiries, resolve concerns, and ensure customer satisfaction throughout the sales process.

• Stay informed about industry trends, competitive products, and emerging technologies in the digital pathology space.

• Achieve high levels of customer satisfaction through delivery of sales and support assistance

• Coordinate product demos, installs, and customer training when required

• Develop and execute strategic sales plans to grow the company’s market share in digital pathology.

• Partner with customer service, technical support, and Roche Healthcare Consulting to ensure smooth post-sales implementation and support

• Maintain accurate records of sales activities, customer interactions, and sales opportunities in the SFDC system.

• Provide regular sales forecasts and reports to the regional sales manager and participate in sales meetings.

This is a field based role: the territory includes Chicago area, IN, MI, parts of Kentucky, Toledo, OH & WI. Candidate must reside within 50 miles of territory border and near a major airport. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor's Degree in a related field (life sciences, biomedical engineering, biotechnology or similar) or equivalent experience

• You hold 5+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience required with the highest level of sales proficiency

Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s)

• Achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.

• Increase market share for digital pathology products in assigned region

• Establish and maintain a pipeline of prospects.

• Customer satisfaction scores and retention rates.

Preferred:

• Sales experience in digital pathology, medical devices, laboratory, healthcare IT software, or life sciences

• Background in IT or technology sales

• Leadership presence and business acumen with an understanding of digital pathology systems and their software applications in clinical and research settings.

• Proven success in previous sales capacity, using consultative selling skills, along with demonstrated leadership an

Specialista di vendita di patologia digitale

L'opportunità:

• Il Digital Pathology Sales Specialist è responsabile per la guida delle vendite di soluzioni di patologia digitale, tra cui hardware, software, AI e servizi, agli ospedali, laboratori di riferimento, istituti di ricerca, aziende farmaceutiche e laboratori diagnostici.

• Questo ruolo coinvolge l'identificazione di potenziali clienti, la comprensione delle loro esigenze, la presentazione di soluzioni su misura, e le offerte di chiusura che soddisfano gli obiettivi di fatturato

• Il candidato ideale avrà una profonda comprensione dei prodotti di patologia digitale, l'IT sanitario, un forte acume di vendita, e la capacità di costruire relazioni all'interno del settore sanitario e della ricerca.

• Leva le relazioni commerciali attuali per mantenere e crescere la base clienti attuale. Funziona in coordinamento con Account Manager e Strategic Account Managers, Discovery Business Managers, per chiamare in prospettiva e clienti attuali.

• Presentare e dimostrare soluzioni di patologia digitale ai potenziali clienti, evidenziando il valore del passaggio ai flussi di lavoro digitali.

• Raggiungere e superare le quote di vendita mediante la costruzione di una robusta pipeline di prospettive e la chiusura di nuove imprese:

• Agire come consulente affidabile per i clienti, comprendere i flussi di lavoro di patologia e fornire soluzioni su misura per soddisfare le loro esigenze specifiche.

• Collabora con i team tecnici per fornire dimostrazioni, formazione e supporto post-vendita.

• Rivolgersi alle richieste del cliente, risolvere le preoccupazioni e garantire la soddisfazione del cliente durante il processo di vendita.

• Restate informati sulle tendenze del settore, sui prodotti competitivi e sulle tecnologie emergenti nello spazio di patologia digitale.

• Ottenere alti livelli di soddisfazione del cliente attraverso la consegna di vendite e assistenza di supporto

• Coordinare demo, installazioni e formazione dei clienti quando necessario

• Sviluppare ed eseguire piani strategici di vendita per aumentare la quota di mercato dell'azienda nella patologia digitale.

• Partner con servizio clienti, supporto tecnico e Roche Healthcare Consulting per garantire l'implementazione e il supporto post-vendita

• Mantenere registri accurati di attività di vendita, interazioni dei clienti e opportunità di vendita nel sistema SFDC.

• Fornire previsioni di vendita e rapporti regolari al responsabile vendite regionale e partecipare a riunioni di vendita.

Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo: il territorio comprende Chicago area, IN, MI, parti di Kentucky, Toledo, OH & WI. Il candidato deve risiedere entro 50 miglia di confine del territorio e vicino a un aeroporto maggiore. Le prestazioni di trasferimento non sono previste per questo ruolo.

Chi sei:

• Hai una laurea in un campo correlato (scienze di vita, ingegneria biomedica, biotecnologia o simili) o esperienza equivalente

• Hai 5+ anni di vendite rilevanti o esperienza equivalente richiesto con il più alto livello di competenza di vendita

Indicatori di prestazione chiave (KPI)

• Raggiungere e superare gli obiettivi mensili, trimestrali e annuali di vendita.

• Aumentare la quota di mercato per i prodotti di patologia digitale nella regione assegnata

• Stabilire e mantenere una pipeline di prospettive.

• Punteggi di soddisfazione del cliente e tassi di ritenzione.

Preferito:

• Esperienza di vendita nella patologia digitale, dispositivi medici, laboratorio, software IT sanitario, o scienze della vita

• Background in IT o vendita di tecnologia

• Presenza di leadership e business acumen con una comprensione dei sistemi di patologia digitale e le loro applicazioni software in ambienti clinici e di ricerca.

• Risultato successo nella precedente capacità di vendita, utilizzando competenze di vendita consultive, insieme a una leadership dimostrata

Spécialiste des ventes en pathologie numérique

• Le candidat idéal aura une compréhension profonde des produits de pathologie numérique, des TI de soins de santé, un fort niveau de ventes et la capacité à établir des relations au sein des secteurs de la santé et de la recherche.

Travaille en coordination avec les gestionnaires de comptes et les gestionnaires de comptes stratégiques, les gestionnaires d'affaires Discovery, pour faire appel à la perspective et aux clients actuels.

• Atteindre et dépasser les quotas de vente en construisant un pipeline solide de perspectives et en fermant de nouvelles entreprises.

jobs.title: AI Solution Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a key driver of technological innovation, you will leverage cutting-edge AI technologies and advanced architectures to deliver strategic business value for Roche China. You will lead the end-to-end design, development, iterative enhancement, and ecosystem integration of the AI infrastructure, platform, and application adoption layers, ensuring all systems strictly adhere to enterprise security and compliance standards.
We are seeking a visionary architect who combines enterprise-level system design, platform engineering methodologies, and agile delivery with profound AI expertise. Your ultimate mission is to translate state-of-the-art AI capabilities into transformative, real-world healthcare solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for:

AI Platform Layer Design, Development, and Management

• Kubernetes Cluster Management: Lead the deployment, administration, and full lifecycle management of Kubernetes clusters, including node scaling, upgrades/rollbacks, certificate rotation, RBAC administration, and cluster teardowns. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Edge Network Security), you will play a pivotal role in the end-to-end lifecycle of our perimeter and cloud security products. Your primary focus will be the global engineering, adoption, and optimization of our Edge security stack, including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), DDoS mitigation, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA). You are a technical implementer responsible for designing robust, high-availability architectures that protect our global network from external threats while enabling secure, seamless access to multi-cloud environments.

Responsibilities:

• Perimeter Defense: Lead the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of Next-Generation Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet) ensuring high availability and optimal inspection across global entry points.

• Zero Trust Transition: Architect and implement ZTNA solutions moving beyond legacy VPNs, focusing on granular, application-level access and identity-aware security policies.

• Multi-Cloud Security & DDoS Mitigation: Engineer cloud-native security controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP; design DDoS protection strategies (Cloudflare, Akamai) and threat prevention policies (SSL decryption, IPS/IDS).

• Product Evolution: Oversee Edge solutions from initial design through global rollout, identifying emerging trends in SASE and Edge computing.

• Troubleshooting & Observability: Serve as lead engineer for complex network escalations using deep-packet analysis; develop telemetry and monitoring dashboards for edge traffic.

• On-Call Support: Participate in a rotating on-call schedule to ensure continuous availability of global edge security services.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, or a related technical field or equivalent work experience.

• You possess 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and managing enterprise-grade Firewall environments (specifically Palo Alto and/or Fortinet , including TLS inspection, WildFire, Threat Prevention, and GlobalProtect).

• You bring proven experience with DDoS Mitigation services (e.g., Cloudflare, Akamai, or F5) and modern Zero Trust / ZTNA frameworks.

• You have a deep understanding of core networking protocols (BGP, OSPF, DNS, TLS/SSL) .

• You have a strong understanding of multi-cloud network security (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

• You have experience operating in complex, global enterprise environments (including regulated industries like Pharma/Healthcare).

Preferred:

• Certifications: Palo Alto Networks PCNSE/PCNSA, Fortinet NSE, Cisco CCNP Security, or CISSP.

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, GitHub) or scripting (Python, Go) to build custom automation and API integrations.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Perimeter Defense: Lead the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of Next-Generation Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet) ensuring high availability and optimal inspection across global entry points.

• Zero Trust Transition: Architect and implement ZTNA solutions moving beyond legacy VPNs, focusing on granular, application-level access and identity-aware security policies.

• Multi-Cloud Security & DDoS Mitigation: Engineer cloud-native security controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP; design DDoS protection strategies (Cloudflare, Akamai) and threat prevention policies (SSL decryption, IPS/IDS).

• Product Evolution: Oversee Edge solutions from initial design through global rollout, identifying emerging trends in SASE and Edge computing.

• Troubleshooting & Observability: Serve as lead engineer for complex network escalations using deep-packet analysis; develop telemetry and monitoring dashboards for edge traffic.

• On-Call Support: Participate in a rotating on-call schedule to ensure continuous availability of global edge security services.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, or a related technical field or equivalent work experience.

• You possess 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and managing enterprise-grade Firewall environments (specifically Palo Alto and/or Fortinet , including TLS inspection, WildFire, Threat Prevention, and GlobalProtect).

• You bring proven experience with DDoS Mitigation services (e.g., Cloudflare, Akamai, or F5) and modern Zero Trust / ZTNA frameworks.

• You have a deep understanding of core networking protocols (BGP, OSPF, DNS, TLS/SSL) .

• You have a strong understanding of multi-cloud network security (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

• You have experience operating in complex, global enterprise environments (including regulated industries like Pharma/Healthcare).

Preferred:

• Certifications: Palo Alto Networks PCNSE/PCNSA, Fortinet NSE, Cisco CCNP Security, or CISSP.

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, GitHub) or scripting (Python, Go) to build custom automation and API integrations.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
What we do:
Global Labeling (PDRL) ensures the consistent and safe use of our medicines through high-quality labels to create and maintain scientifically-sound, evidence-based, and balanced labels.
The Labeling function leads the development and update of core datasheet (CDS), EU Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC) and US Product Information (USPI) in partnership with Regulatory Program Management and cross-functional experts throughout the lifecycle. In addition, a Labeling compliance unit tracks CDS implementation into local product Information and ensures end-to-end labeling oversight and adherence to regulatory standards.

The opportunity:

• Support and assist PDRL colleagues to accomplish tasks in meeting deadlines to achieve the project, team and departmental goals

• Under supervised coaching and tutoring, gradually assume responsibility for agreed tasks

• Prepare regulatory labeling packages in collaboration with the other teams

• Participate in and support the development and implementation of the regulatory labeling strategies

• Support, as requested, Labeling colleagues and Regulatory lead in the implementation of CDS changes into local products labels and the management of local label deviations

• Support the PDRL system and compliance activities as requested

• Acquire and maintain an overview of relevant regulatory labeling requirements, develop the potential to demonstrate the core competencies required for a senior regulatory labeling associate

Please note that this position is a fixed-term maternity cover.

Who you are:

• You possess a knowledge of scientific- and regulatory labeling environment and procedures

• You have a university degree, preferably in a scientific / technical discipline

• You have a basic working knowledge of drug discovery, development, manufacturing and marketing

• You are fluent in written and spoken English

• You are able to provide input, set milestones, and monitor progress towards results within sub-teams to achieve team goals

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average).

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.
